   * If you specify this property then its value will be used for all data requests for this symbol. ticker will be treated the same as {@link LibrarySymbolInfo.name} if not specified explicitly.
   */
  ticker?: string;
  /**
   * The description of the symbol.
   * Will be displayed in the chart legend for this symbol.
   */
  description: string;
  /**
   * Symbol Long description
   *
   * Optional long(er) description for the symbol.
   */
  long_description?: string;
  /**
   * Type of the instrument.
   * Possible values: {@link SymbolType}
   */
  type: string;
  /**
   * Trading hours for this symbol. See the [Trading Sessions article](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/connecting_data/Trading-Sessions) to learn more details.
   * @example "1700-0200"
   */
  session: string;
  /**
   * The session value to display in the UI. If not specified, then `session` is used.
   */
  session_display?: string;
  /**
   * List of holidays for this symbol. These dates are not displayed on the chart.
   * It's a string in the following format: `YYYYMMDD[,YYYYMMDD]`.
   * @example "20181105,20181107,20181112"
   */
  session_holidays?: string;
  /**
   * List of corrections for this symbol. Corrections are days with specific trading sessions. They can be applied to holidays as well.
   *
   * It's a string in the following format: `SESSION:YYYYMMDD[,YYYYMMDD][;SESSION:YYYYMMDD[,YYYYMMDD]]`
   * Where SESSION has the same format as [Trading Sessions](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/connecting_data/Trading-Sessions).
   *
   * @example "1900F4-2350F4,1000-1845:20181113;1000-1400:20181114"
   */
  corrections?: string;
  /**
   * Traded exchange (current (proxy) exchange).
   * The name will be displayed in the chart legend for this symbol.
   *
   * @example "NYSE"
   */
  exchange: string;
  /**
   * short name of the exchange where this symbol is traded (real listed exchange).
   * The name will be displayed in the chart legend for this symbol.
   *
   * @example "NYSE"
   */
  listed_exchange: string;
  /**
   * Timezone of the exchange for this symbol. We expect to get the name of the time zone in `olsondb` format.
   * See [Timezones](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/connecting_data/Symbology#timezone) for a full list of supported timezones
   */
  timezone: Timezone;
  /**
   * Format of displaying labels on the price scale:
   *
   * `price` - formats decimal or fractional numbers based on `minmov`, `pricescale`, `minmove2`, `fractional` and `variableMinTick` values. See [Price Formatting](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/connecting_data/Symbology#price-format) for more details
   * `volume` - formats decimal numbers in thousands, millions, billions or trillions
   */
  format: SeriesFormat;
  /**
   * Code (Tick)
   * @example 8/16/.../256 (1/8/100 1/16/100 ... 1/256/100) or 1/10/.../10000000 (1 0.1 ... 0.0000001)
   */
  pricescale: number;
  /**
   * The number of units that make up one tick.
   * @example For example, U.S. equities are quotes in decimals, and tick in decimals, and can go up +/- .01. So the tick increment is 1. But the e-mini S&P futures contract, though quoted in decimals, goes up in .25 increments, so the tick increment is 25. (see also Tick Size)
   */
  minmov: number;
  /**
   * For common prices this can be skipped.
   *
   * Fractional prices are displayed 2 different forms: 1) `xx'yy` (for example, `133'21`) 2) `xx'yy'zz` (for example, `133'21'5`).
   *
   * - `xx` is an integer part.
   * - `minmov/pricescale` is a Fraction.
   * - `minmove2` is used in form 2.
   * - `fractional` is `true`.
   * - `variableMinTick` is skipped.
   *
   * Example:
   *
   * If `minmov = 1`, `pricescale = 128` and `minmove2 = 4`:
   *
   * - `119'16'0` represents `119 + 16/32`
   * - `119'16'2` represents `119 + 16.25/32`
   * - `119'16'5` represents `119 + 16.5/32`
   * - `119'16'7` represents `119 + 16.75/32`
   *
   * More examples:
   *
   * - `ZBM2014 (T-Bond)` with `1/32`: `minmov = 1`, `pricescale = 32`, `minmove2 = 0`
   * - `ZCM2014 (Corn)` with `2/8`: `minmov = 2`, `pricescale = 8`, `minmove2 = 0`
   * - `ZFM2014 (5 year t-note)` with `1/4 of 1/32`: `minmov = 1`, `pricescale = 128`, `minmove2 = 4`
   */
  fractional?: boolean;
  /**
   * For common prices this can be skipped.
   * @example Quarters of 1/32: pricescale=128, minmovement=1, minmovement2=4
   */
  minmove2?: number;
  /**
   * Dynamic minimum price movement. It is used if the instrument's minimum price movement changes depending on the price range.
   *
   * For example, '0.01 10 0.02 25 0.05', where the tick size is 0.01 for a price less than 10, the tick size is 0.02 for a price less than 25, the tick size is 0.05 for a price greater than or equal to 25.
   */
  variable_tick_size?: string;
  /**
   * Boolean value showing whether the symbol includes intraday (minutes) historical data.
   *
   * If it's `false` then all buttons for intraday resolutions will be disabled for this particular symbol.
   * If it is set to `true`, all intradays resolutions that are supplied directly by the datafeed must be provided in `intraday_multipliers` array.
   *
   * **WARNING** Any daily, weekly or monthly resolutions cannot be inferred from intraday resolutions!
   *
   * `false` if DWM only
   * @default false
   */
  has_intraday?: boolean;
  /**
   * An array of resolutions which should be enabled in resolutions picker for this symbol.
   *
   * Each item of an array is expected to be a string. Format is described in another article.
   *
   * If one changes the symbol and new symbol does not support the selected resolution then resolution will be switched to the first available one in the list.
   *
   * **Resolution availability logic (pseudocode):**
   * ```
   * resolutionAvailable  =
   *     resolution.isIntraday
   *         ? symbol.has_intraday && symbol.supported_resolutions(resolution)
   *         : symbol.supported_resolutions(resolution);
   * ```
   *
   * In case of absence of `supported_resolutions` in a symbol info all DWM resolutions will be available. Intraday resolutions will be available if `has_intraday` is `true`.
   * Supported resolutions affect available timeframes too. The timeframe will not be available if it requires the resolution that is not supported.
   */
  supported_resolutions: ResolutionString[];
  /**
   * Array of resolutions (in minutes) supported directly by the data feed. Each such resolution may be passed to, and should be implemented by, `getBars`. The default of [] means that the data feed supports aggregating by any number of minutes.
   *
   * If the data feed only supports certain minute resolutions but not the requested resolution, `getBars` will be called (repeatedly if needed) with a higher resolution as a parameter, in order to build the requested resolution.
   *
   * For example, if the data feed only supports minute resolution, set `intraday_multipliers` to `['1']`.
   *
   * When the user wants to see 5-minute data, `getBars` will be called with the resolution set to 1 until the library builds all the 5-minute resolution by itself.
   * @example (for ex.: "1,5,60") - only these resolutions will be requested, all others will be built using them if possible
   * @default []
   */
  intraday_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * Boolean value showing whether the symbol includes seconds in the historical data.
   *
   * If it's `false` then all buttons for resolutions that include seconds will be disabled for this particular symbol.
   *
   * If it is set to `true`, all resolutions that are supplied directly by the data feed must be provided in `seconds_multipliers` array.
   * @default false
   */
  has_seconds?: boolean;
  /**
   * Boolean value showing whether the symbol includes ticks in the historical data.
   *
   * If it's `false` then all buttons for resolutions that include ticks will be disabled for this particular symbol.
   * @default false
   */
  has_ticks?: boolean;
  /**
   * It is an array containing resolutions that include seconds (excluding postfix) that the data feed provides.
   * E.g., if the data feed supports resolutions such as `["1S", "5S", "15S"]`, but has 1-second bars for some symbols then you should set `seconds_multipliers` of this symbol to `[1]`.
   * This will make the library build 5S and 15S resolutions by itself.
   */
  seconds_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * The boolean value showing whether data feed has its own daily resolution bars or not.
   *
   * If `has_daily` = `false` then the library will build the respective resolutions using 1-minute bars by itself.
   * If not, then it will request those bars from the data feed only if specified resolution belongs to `daily_multipliers`, otherwise an error will be thrown.
   * @default true
   */
  has_daily?: boolean;
  /**
   * Array (of strings) containing the [resolutions](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/core_concepts/Resolution#days) (in days - without the suffix) supported by the data feed. {@link ResolutionString}
   *
   * For example it could be something like
   *
   * ```javascript
   * daily_multipliers = ['1', '3', '4', '6', '7'];
   * ```
   * @default ['1']
   */
  daily_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * The boolean value showing whether data feed has its own weekly and monthly resolution bars or not.
   *
   * If `has_weekly_and_monthly` = `false` then the library will build the respective resolutions using daily bars by itself.
   * If not, then it will request those bars from the data feed using either the `weekly_multipliers` or `monthly_multipliers` if specified.
   * If resolution is not within either list an error will be raised.
   * @default false
   */
  has_weekly_and_monthly?: boolean;
  /**
   * Array (of strings) containing the [resolutions](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/core_concepts/Resolution#weeks) (in weeks - without the suffix) supported by the data feed. {@link ResolutionString}
   *
   * For example it could be something like
   *
   * ```javascript
   * weekly_multipliers = ['1', '5', '10'];
   * ```
   * @default ['1']
   */
  weekly_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * Array (of strings) containing the [resolutions](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/core_concepts/Resolution#months) (in months - without the suffix) supported by the data feed. {@link ResolutionString}
   *
   * For example it could be something like
   *
   * ```javascript
   * monthly_multipliers = ['1', '3', '4', '12'];
   * ```
   * @default ['1']
   */
  monthly_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * The boolean value showing whether the library should generate empty bars in the session when there is no data from the data feed for this particular time.
   *
   * I.e., if your session is `0900-1600` and your data has gaps between `11:00` and `12:00` and your `has_empty_bars` is `true`, then the Library will fill the gaps with bars for this time.
   *
   * Flag `has_empty_bars` = `true` cannot be used if featureset `disable_resolution_rebuild` is enabled.
   * @default false
   */
  has_empty_bars?: boolean;
  /**
   * Represents what values are supported by the symbol. Possible values:
   *
   * - `ohlcv` - the symbol supports open, high, low, close and has volume
   * - `ohlc` - the symbol supports open, high, low, close, but doesn't have volume
   * - `c` - the symbol supports only close, it's displayed on the chart using line-based styles only
   * @default 'ohlcv'
   */
  visible_plots_set?: VisiblePlotsSet;
  /**
   * Integer showing typical volume value decimal places for a particular symbol.
   * 0 means volume is always an integer.
   * 1 means that there might be 1 numeric character after the comma.
   * @default '0'
   */
  volume_precision?: number;
  /**
   * The status code of a series with this symbol.
   * This could be represented as an icon in the legend, next to the market status icon for `delayed_streaming` & `endofday` type of data.
   * When declaring `delayed_streaming` you also have to specify its {@link LibrarySymbolInfo.delay} in seconds.
   */
  data_status?: 'streaming' | 'endofday' | 'pulsed' | 'delayed_streaming';
  /**
   * Type of delay that is associated to the data or real delay for real time data.
   * - `0` for realtime
   * - `-1` for endofday
   * - `-2` for pulsed
   * - or delay in seconds (for delayed realtime)
   */
  delay?: number;
  /**
   * Boolean showing whether this symbol is expired futures contract or not.
   * @default false
   */
  expired?: boolean;
  /**
   * Unix timestamp of the expiration date. One must set this value when `expired` = `true`.
   * The library will request data for this symbol starting from that time point.
   */
  expiration_date?: number;
  /** Sector for stocks to be displayed in the Symbol Info. */
  sector?: string;
  /** Industry for stocks to be displayed in the Symbol Info. */
  industry?: string;
  /**
   * The currency in which the instrument is traded or some other currency if currency conversion is enabled.
   * It is displayed in the Symbol Info dialog and on the price axes.
   */
  currency_code?: string;
  /** The currency in which the instrument is traded. */
  original_currency_code?: string;
  /**
   * A unique identifier of a unit in which the instrument is traded or some other identifier if unit conversion is enabled.
   * It is displayed on the price axes.
   */
  unit_id?: string;
  /**
   * A unique identifier of a unit in which the instrument is traded.
   */
  original_unit_id?: string;
  /**
   * Allowed unit conversion group names.
   */
  unit_conversion_types?: string[];
  /**
   * Subsession ID. Must match the `id` property of one of the subsessions.
   */
  subsession_id?: string;
  /**
   * Subsessions definitions.
   */
  subsessions?: LibrarySubsessionInfo[];
  /**
   * Optional ID of a price source for this symbol. Should match one of the price sources from the {@link price_sources} array.
   */
  price_source_id?: string;
  /**
   * Supported price sources for the symbol. The source of the values that this symbol's bars represent.
   *
   * For example 'Spot Price', 'Ask', 'Bid', etc.
   *
   * Mostly useful when viewing non-OHLC series types. The price source will be shown in the series legend.
   *
   * @example [{ id: '1', name: 'Spot Price' }, { id: '321', name: 'Bid' }]
   */
  price_sources?: SymbolInfoPriceSource[];
  /**
   * URL of image/s to be displayed as the logo/s for the symbol. The `show_symbol_logos` featureset needs to be enabled for this to be visible in the UI.
   *
   * - If a single url is returned then that url will solely be used to display the symbol logo.
   * - If two urls are provided then the images will be displayed as two partially overlapping
   * circles with the first url appearing on top. This is typically used for FOREX where you would
   * like to display two country flags are the symbol logo.
   *
   * The image/s should ideally be square in dimension. You can use any image type which
   * the browser supports natively.
   *
   * Examples:
   * - `https://yourserver.com/apple.svg`
   * - `/images/myImage.png`
   * - `data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3...`
   * - `data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASABIAAD/4...`
   */
  logo_urls?: [string] | [string, string];
  /**
   * URL of image to be displayed as the logo for the exchange. The `show_exchange_logos` featureset needs to be enabled for this to be visible in the UI.
   *
   * The image should ideally be square in dimension. You can use any image type which
   * the browser supports natively. Simple SVG images are recommended.
   *
   * Examples:
   * - `https://yourserver.com/exchangeLogo.svg`
   * - `/images/myImage.png`
   * - `data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3...`
   * - `data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASABIAAD/4...`
   */
  exchange_logo?: string;
}

  readonly defaults: Readonly<Partial<StudyDefaults>>;
  /** Bands */

  /** Filled area is a special object, which allows coloring an area between two plots or hlines. Please note, that it is impossible to fill the area between a band and a hline. */

  /** array with inputs info depending on type. See dedicated article: [Custom Studies Inputs](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/custom_studies/metainfo/Custom-Studies-Inputs) */
  readonly inputs?: StudyInputInfoList;
  /** Symbol source */

   * definitions of palettes that are used in plots and defaults. Palettes allows you use different styles (not only colors) for each line point.
   *
   * This object contains palette names as keys, and palette info as values: `[palette.name]: { colors, valToIndex, addDefaultColor }`, where
   * - `colors`* - an object `{ [color_id]: { name: 'name' }}`, where name is a string that will appear on Style tab of study properties dialog.
   * - `valToIndex` - an object, the mapping between the values that are returned by the script and palette colors.
   * - `addDefaultColor` - boolean, if true the defaults are used for colorer type plot, when its value is null or undefined.
   */
  readonly palettes?: MappedObject<Readonly<StudyPalettesInfo>>;
  /** array with study plots info. See dedicated article: [Custom Studies Plots](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/custom_studies/Custom-Studies-Plots) */
  readonly plots?: readonly Readonly<StudyPlotInfo>[];
  /** an object with plot id as keys and style info as values. */

  /** array with study plots info. See dedicated article: [Custom Studies OHLC Plots](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/custom_studies/Custom-Studies-OHLC-Plots) */

}

/**
 * [Symbol Search](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/ui_elements/Symbol-Search) result item.
 * Pass the resulting array of symbols as a parameter to {@link SearchSymbolsCallback} of the [`searchSymbols`](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/connecting_data/Datafeed-API#searchsymbols) method.
 *
 * @example
 * ```
 * {
 * 	description: 'Apple Inc.',
 * 	exchange: 'NasdaqNM',
 * 	full_name: 'NasdaqNM:AAPL',
 * 	symbol: 'AAPL',
 * 	ticker: 'AAPL',
 * 	type: 'stock',
 * }
 * ```
 */
export interface SearchSymbolResultItem {
  /** Short symbol name */
  symbol: string;
  /** Full symbol name  */
  full_name: string;
  /** Description */
  description: string;
  /** Exchange name */
  exchange: string;
  /** Symbol ticker name. Should be an unique id */
  ticker?: string;
  /**
   * Type of symbol
   *
   * 'stock' | 'futures' | 'forex' | 'index'
   */
  type: string;
  /**
   * URL of image/s to be displayed as the logo/s for the symbol. The `show_symbol_logos` featureset needs to be enabled for this to be visible in the UI.
   *
   * - If a single url is returned then that url will solely be used to display the symbol logo.
   * - If two urls are provided then the images will be displayed as two partially overlapping
   * circles with the first url appearing on top. This is typically used for FOREX where you would
   * like to display two country flags as the symbol logo.
   *
   * The image/s should ideally be square in dimension. You can use any image type which
   * the browser supports natively. Simple SVG images are recommended.
   *
   * Examples:
   * - `https://yourserver.com/symbolName.svg`
   * - `/images/myImage.png`
   * - `data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3...`
   * - `data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASABIAAD/4...`
   */
  logo_urls?: [string] | [string, string];
  /**
   * URL of image to be displayed as the logo for the exchange. The `show_exchange_logos` featureset needs to be enabled for this to be visible in the UI.
   *
   * The image should ideally be square in dimension. You can use any image type which
   * the browser supports natively. Simple SVG images are recommended.
   *
   * Examples:
   * - `https://yourserver.com/exchangeLogo.svg`
   * - `/images/myImage.png`
   * - `data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3...`
   * - `data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASABIAAD/4...`
   */
  exchange_logo?: string;
}

   */

  /**
   * Reset scales button has been clicked
   */

   * A compare dialog has been shown
   */

  /**
   * A compare instrument has been added
   */

  /**
   * A study template has been loaded
   */

  /**
   * Last bar has been updated
   * @param  {Bar} tick - data for last bar
   */

  /**
   * User has changed the chart. `Chart change` means any user action that can be undone.
   * The callback function will not be called more than once every 5 seconds. See also `auto_save_delay` within the Widget constructor options ({@link ChartingLibraryWidgetOptions.auto_save_delay}).
   */

  /**
   * A screenshot URL has been returned by the server
   * @param  {string} url - url of the screenshot
   */

  /**
   * User has clicked on a 'mark on a bar'.
   * @param  {Mark['id']} markId - ID of the clicked mark
   */

  /**
   * User clicked the "plus" button on the price scale.

   */

  /**

  /** Selected drawing tool has changed */

  /**

  /**

   */

  /**
   * Active chart has changed

   * @param  {number} chartIndex - index of the active chart
   */

  /**
   * An event related to the series has occurred.
   * @param  {SeriesEventType} seriesEventType - series event type
   */

  /**
   * An event related to the study has occurred.
   * @param  {EntityId} entityId - study ID

   */

  /**

  /**

  /**

  /**
   * Panes' size has changed.
   */

  /**

   */

}

   *
   * Example:

   * ```
   */

  /**

   */
  favorites?: Favorites<TradingTerminalChartTypeFavorites>;
  /** configuration flags for the Trading Platform. */
  brokerConfig?: SingleBrokerMetaInfo;
  /** configuration flags for the Trading Platform. */
  broker_config?: SingleBrokerMetaInfo;
  /** Connection configuration settings for Rest Broker API */
  restConfig?: RestBrokerConnectionInfo;
  /**
   * Settings for the widget panel on the right side of the chart.
   * Watchlist, news, details and data window widgets on the right side of the chart can be enabled using the `widgetbar` field in Widget constructor
   */
  widgetbar?: WidgetBarParams;
  /**
   * Use this property to change the RSS feed for news. You can set a different RSS for each symbol type or use a single RSS for all symbols. The object should have the `default` property, other properties are optional. The names of the properties match the symbol types. Each property is an object (or an array of objects) with the following properties:
   *
   * 1. `url` - is a URL to be requested. It can contain tags in curly brackets that will be replaced by the terminal: `{SYMBOL}`, `{TYPE}`, `{EXCHANGE}`.
   * 1. `name` - is a name of the feed to be displayed underneath the news.
   *
   * @example
   * ```javascript
   * rss_news_feed: {
   *     default: [ {
   *         url: "https://articlefeeds.nasdaq.com/nasdaq/symbols?symbol={SYMBOL}",
   *         name: "NASDAQ"
   *       }, {
   *         url: "http://feeds.finance.yahoo.com/rss/2.0/headline?s={SYMBOL}&region=US&lang=en-US",
   *         name: "Yahoo Finance"
   *       } ]
   * },
   * ```
   *
   * @example
   * ```javascript
   * rss_news_feed: {
   *     "default": {
   *         url: "https://articlefeeds.nasdaq.com/nasdaq/symbols?symbol={SYMBOL}",
   *         name: "NASDAQ"
   *     }
   * }
   * ```
   *
   * @example
   * ```javascript
   * rss_news_feed: {
   *     "default": {
   *         url: "https://articlefeeds.nasdaq.com/nasdaq/symbols?symbol={SYMBOL}",
   *         name: "NASDAQ"
   *      },
   *     "stock": {
   *         url: "http://feeds.finance.yahoo.com/rss/2.0/headline?s={SYMBOL}&region=US&lang=en-US",
   *         name: "Yahoo Finance"
   *     }
   * }
   * ```
   */
  rss_news_feed?: RssNewsFeedParams;
  /**
   * Use this property to set your own news getter function. Both the `symbol` and `callback` will be passed to the function.
   *
   * The callback function should be called with an object. The object should have two properties: `title` which is a optional string, and `newsItems` which is an array of news objects that have the following structure:
   *
   * * `title` (required) - the title of news item.
   * * `published` (required) - the time of news item in ms (UTC).
   * * `source` (optional) - source of the news item title.
   * * `shortDescription` (optional) - Short description of a news item that will be displayed under the title.
   * * `link` (optional) - URL to the news story.
   * * `fullDescription` (optional) - full description (body) of a news item.
   *
   * **NOTE:** Only `title` and `published` are the main properties used to compare what has already been published and what's new.
   *
   * **NOTE 2:** When a user clicks on a news item a new tab with the `link` URL will be opened. If `link` is not specified then a pop-up dialog with `fullDescription` will be shown.
   *
   * **NOTE 3:** If both `news_provider` and `rss_news_feed` are available then the `rss_news_feed` will be ignored.
   *
   * See [News API examples](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/trading_terminal/news/News-Api-Examples) for usage examples.
   */
  news_provider?: GetNewsFunction;
  /** Override customizations for trading */
  trading_customization?: TradingCustomization;
  /**
   * @deprecated
   * Alias for {@link broker_factory}
   */
  brokerFactory?(host: IBrokerConnectionAdapterHost): IBrokerWithoutRealtime | IBrokerTerminal;
  /**
   * Use this field to pass the function that returns a new object which implements Broker API. This is a function that accepts the Trading Host ({@link IBrokerConnectionAdapterHost}).
   *
   * @example
   * ```javascript
   * broker_factory: function(host) { ... }
   * ```
   * @param host - Trading Host
   */
  broker_factory?(host: IBrokerConnectionAdapterHost): IBrokerWithoutRealtime | IBrokerTerminal;
}

 * - The `move` event is emitted when a drawing is moved as a whole, whilst the `points_changed`

/**
 * GMT timezone ID.
 *
 * In order to conform with the POSIX style, those zone names
 * beginning with "Etc/GMT" have their sign reversed from the
 * standard ISO 8601 convention. In the "Etc" area, zones west
 * of GMT have a positive sign and those east have a negative
 * sign in their name (e.g "Etc/GMT-14" is 14 hours ahead of GMT).
 */

/**
 * Resolution or time interval is a time period of one bar. Advanced Charts supports tick, intraday (seconds, minutes, hours), and DWM (daily, weekly, monthly) resolutions. The table below describes how to specify different types of resolutions:
 *
 * Resolution | Format | Example
 * ---------|----------|---------
 * Ticks | `xT` | `1T` — one tick
 * Seconds | `xS` | `1S` — one second
 * Minutes | `x` | `1` — one minute
 * Hours | `x` minutes | `60` — one hour
 * Days | `xD` | `1D` — one day
 * Weeks | `xW` | `1W` — one week
 * Months | `xM` | `1M` — one month
 * Years | `xM` months | `12M` — one year
 *
 * Refer to [Resolution](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/core_concepts/Resolution) for more information.
 */

   *
   * Each item of an array is expected to be a string. Format is described in another article.
   *
   * If one changes the symbol and new symbol does not support the selected resolution then resolution will be switched to the first available one in the list.
   *
   * **Resolution availability logic (pseudocode):**
   * ```
   * resolutionAvailable  =
   *     resolution.isIntraday
   *         ? symbol.has_intraday && symbol.supported_resolutions(resolution)
   *         : symbol.supported_resolutions(resolution);
   * ```
   *
   * In case of absence of `supported_resolutions` in a symbol info all DWM resolutions will be available. Intraday resolutions will be available if `has_intraday` is `true`.
   * Supported resolutions affect available timeframes too. The timeframe will not be available if it requires the resolution that is not supported.
   */
  supported_resolutions: ResolutionString[];
  /**
   * Array of resolutions (in minutes) supported directly by the data feed. Each such resolution may be passed to, and should be implemented by, `getBars`. The default of [] means that the data feed supports aggregating by any number of minutes.
   *
   * If the data feed only supports certain minute resolutions but not the requested resolution, `getBars` will be called (repeatedly if needed) with a higher resolution as a parameter, in order to build the requested resolution.
   *
   * For example, if the data feed only supports minute resolution, set `intraday_multipliers` to `['1']`.
   *
   * When the user wants to see 5-minute data, `getBars` will be called with the resolution set to 1 until the library builds all the 5-minute resolution by itself.
   * @example (for ex.: "1,5,60") - only these resolutions will be requested, all others will be built using them if possible
   * @default []
   */
  intraday_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * Boolean value showing whether the symbol includes seconds in the historical data.
   *
   * If it's `false` then all buttons for resolutions that include seconds will be disabled for this particular symbol.
   *
   * If it is set to `true`, all resolutions that are supplied directly by the data feed must be provided in `seconds_multipliers` array.
   * @default false
   */
  has_seconds?: boolean;
  /**
   * Boolean value showing whether the symbol includes ticks in the historical data.
   *
   * If it's `false` then all buttons for resolutions that include ticks will be disabled for this particular symbol.
   * @default false
   */
  has_ticks?: boolean;
  /**
   * It is an array containing resolutions that include seconds (excluding postfix) that the data feed provides.
   * E.g., if the data feed supports resolutions such as `["1S", "5S", "15S"]`, but has 1-second bars for some symbols then you should set `seconds_multipliers` of this symbol to `[1]`.
   * This will make the library build 5S and 15S resolutions by itself.
   */
  seconds_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * The boolean value showing whether data feed has its own daily resolution bars or not.
   *
   * If `has_daily` = `false` then the library will build the respective resolutions using 1-minute bars by itself.
   * If not, then it will request those bars from the data feed only if specified resolution belongs to `daily_multipliers`, otherwise an error will be thrown.
   * @default true
   */
  has_daily?: boolean;
  /**
   * Array (of strings) containing the [resolutions](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/core_concepts/Resolution#days) (in days - without the suffix) supported by the data feed. {@link ResolutionString}
   *
   * For example it could be something like
   *
   * ```javascript
   * daily_multipliers = ['1', '3', '4', '6', '7'];
   * ```
   * @default ['1']
   */
  daily_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * The boolean value showing whether data feed has its own weekly and monthly resolution bars or not.
   *
   * If `has_weekly_and_monthly` = `false` then the library will build the respective resolutions using daily bars by itself.
   * If not, then it will request those bars from the data feed using either the `weekly_multipliers` or `monthly_multipliers` if specified.
   * If resolution is not within either list an error will be raised.
   * @default false
   */
  has_weekly_and_monthly?: boolean;
  /**
   * Array (of strings) containing the [resolutions](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/core_concepts/Resolution#weeks) (in weeks - without the suffix) supported by the data feed. {@link ResolutionString}
   *
   * For example it could be something like
   *
   * ```javascript
   * weekly_multipliers = ['1', '5', '10'];
   * ```
   * @default ['1']
   */
  weekly_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * Array (of strings) containing the [resolutions](https://www.tradingview.com/charting-library-docs/latest/core_concepts/Resolution#months) (in months - without the suffix) supported by the data feed. {@link ResolutionString}
   *
   * For example it could be something like
   *
   * ```javascript
   * monthly_multipliers = ['1', '3', '4', '12'];
   * ```
   * @default ['1']
   */
  monthly_multipliers?: string[];
  /**
   * The boolean value showing whether the library should generate empty bars in the session when there is no data from the data feed for this particular time.
   *
   * I.e., if your session is `0900-1600` and your data has gaps between `11:00` and `12:00` and your `has_empty_bars` is `true`, then the Library will fill the gaps with bars for this time.
   *
   * Flag `has_empty_bars` = `true` cannot be used if featureset `disable_resolution_rebuild` is enabled.
   * @default false
   */
  has_empty_bars?: boolean;
  /**

   * - `ohlcv` - the symbol supports open, high, low, close and has volume

  /**

import React from 'react';

import Cell from 'components/Cell';
import { CellProps } from 'components/Cell/types';

import { ReactComponent as SmallArrowRightSvg } from 'images/icons/small-arrow-right.svg';

import styles from './ActionCell.module.pcss';

const ActionCell: React.FC<CellProps> = ({
  disabled = false,
  addonAfter,
  onClick,
  ...otherProps
}) => {
  const customAddonAfter = (
    <div className={styles.addonAfterContainer}>
      {addonAfter}
      <div className={styles.arrowContainer}>{onClick && !disabled && <SmallArrowRightSvg />}</div>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <Cell addonAfter={customAddonAfter} onClick={onClick} {...otherProps} disabled={disabled} />
  );
};

export default ActionCell;

import { ReactElement } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Popover } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  button: ReactElement;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onDismiss: () => void;
  className?: string;
  classNameContent?: string;
  isStretched?: boolean;
};

const AdaptivePopover: React.FC<Props> = ({
  button,
  isOpen,
  onDismiss,
  children,
  className,
  classNameContent,
  isStretched,
}) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <>
        {button}
        <BottomSheet open={isOpen} onDismiss={onDismiss} initialFocusRef={false}>
          {children}
        </BottomSheet>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Popover
      onClose={onDismiss}
      content={children}
      showContent={isOpen}
      controlled={true}
      className={cn(className, { [styles.popover]: isStretched })}
      classNameContent={classNameContent}
    >
      {button}
    </Popover>
  );
};

export default AdaptivePopover;

import { BottomSheet, BottomSheetProps, Popup } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

type Props = {
  open: boolean;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  className?: string;
  classNameContent?: string;
  bottomSheetProps?: Partial<BottomSheetProps>;
};

const AdaptivePopup: React.FC<Props> = ({
  open,
  onDismiss,
  children,
  className,
  classNameContent,
  bottomSheetProps = {},
}) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss} initialFocusRef={false} {...bottomSheetProps}>
        {children}
      </BottomSheet>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {open && (
        <Popup
          onClickCloseCross={onDismiss}
          onClickOutside={onDismiss}
          className={className}
          classNameContent={classNameContent}
        >
          {children}
        </Popup>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default AdaptivePopup;

import { PropsWithChildren, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

const AddonBottom: React.FC<any> = ({ children }) => {
  const [container, setContainer] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => setContainer(document.querySelector('#addon-layout-bottom') as HTMLElement), []);

  if (!container) {
    return null;

  return createPortal(children, container);
};

import { createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

import { State } from './types';

export const initialState: State = {
  alerts: [],
};

export const alertSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'alertNotifications',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    createAlert: (state, action) => {
      state.alerts.push(action.payload.alert);
    },
    removeAlert: (state, action) => {
      state.alerts.splice(
        state.alerts.findIndex((el) => el.id === action.payload),
        1,
      );
    },
  },
});

export const { createAlert, removeAlert } = alertSlice.actions;

export default alertSlice.reducer;

import { FC, Fragment } from 'react';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';

import Alert from '@vision/alert';
import { RootState, store } from 'store';

import { removeAlert } from '../../alertSlice';

const AlertNotifications: FC = () => {
  const data = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.alertNotifications.alerts);
  return (
    <div style={{ position: 'relative', zIndex: 100_000 }}>
      {data.map((el) => {
        const deleteAlertFromStore = () => {
          store.dispatch(removeAlert(el.id));
        };
        return (
          <Fragment key={el.id}>
            <Alert data={el} id={el.id} removeAlertFromStore={deleteAlertFromStore} />
          </Fragment>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};
export default AlertNotifications;

import { store } from 'store';

import { createAlert, removeAlert } from './alertSlice';
import { AlertNotificationItem, IncomeAlertNotificationProps } from './types';

export const createAlertNotification = ({
  text,
  status = 'info',
  isClose = false,
  isCheckMark = false,
  attachToId,
  ms = 5000,
  onClose,
  className,
}: IncomeAlertNotificationProps) => {
  const {
    alertNotifications: { alerts },
  } = store.getState();
  const lastAlert = alerts[alerts.length - 1];
  const alertId = alerts.length && lastAlert ? lastAlert.id + 1 : 1;
  const alertItem: AlertNotificationItem = {
    text,
    id: alertId,
    status,
    isClose,
    isCheckMark,
    attachToId,
    className,
    onClose,
    ms,
  };
  alerts.length && lastAlert && store.dispatch(removeAlert(lastAlert.id));
  store.dispatch(createAlert({ alert: alertItem }));
};

import React, { FC, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import Input from '@aurora/input';

import { useClickOutside } from 'hooks/useClickOutside';

import { ReactComponent as Arrow } from 'images/icons/arrow-right.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { AutocompleteProps } from './types';

const Autocomplete: FC<AutocompleteProps> = ({
  label,
  className,
  classNameInput,
  placeholder,
  value,
  list,
  mask = '',
  emptyMessage = 'По вашему запросу ничего не найдено',
  minChar = 3,
  status,
  name,
  description,
  onBlur,
  onChange,
  onSelect,
  onFocus,
  onKeyDown,
}) => {
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState(false);
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);

  const handleInputFocus = useCallback(
    (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      setFocus(true);
      onFocus && onFocus(e);
    },
    [onFocus],
  );

  const handleItemClick = useCallback(
    (id: number) => {
      const el = list.find((item) => item.id === id);
      el && onSelect(el);
      setFocus(false);
    },
    [onSelect, list],
  );
  const onCloseRef = useRef<typeof setFocus | null>(null);
  onCloseRef.current = setFocus;

  const closeDropdown = useCallback(() => {
    setOpened(false);
    onCloseRef.current?.(false);
  }, []);
  const dropDownRef = useClickOutside<HTMLDivElement>(closeDropdown);

  useEffect(() => {
    focus && !!value && value.length >= minChar ? setOpened(true) : setOpened(false);
  }, [focus, value.length, minChar, value]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.root} ref={dropDownRef}>
      <Input
        classNameInput={classNameInput}
        className={className}
        label={label}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        value={value}
        mask={mask}
        status={status}
        name={name}
        description={description}
        onChange={onChange}
        onFocus={handleInputFocus}
        onBlur={onBlur}
        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
      />
      {opened && (
        <div className={styles.menu}>
          {list.length !== 0 &&
            list.map((bank) => (
              <div key={bank.id} className={styles.item}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleItemClick(bank.id)}
                  className={styles.itemButton}
                ></button>
                {bank.value}
                <Arrow color="#C1CCD3" />
              </div>
            ))}
          {!list.length && emptyMessage && (
            <div className={styles.emptyMessage}>{emptyMessage}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Autocomplete;

import React from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import { Balance } from '.';
import { BalanceProps } from './Balance';
import style from './FormattedBalance.module.pcss';

const plusSymbol = '+';
const minusSymbol = '–';
const arrowUpSymbol = '↑';
const arrowDownSymbol = '↓';

export type FormattedBalanceProps = Omit<BalanceProps, 'children'> & {
  value?: number | null;
  precision?: number | null; //если -1 или null, то округление не применяется
  minPrecision?: number | null;
  diff?: number | null;
  currency?: PriceCurrencyType;
  colored?: boolean;
  symbolType?: 'math' | 'arrow';
  showDiff?: boolean;
};

const FormattedBalance: React.FC<FormattedBalanceProps> = ({
  value,
  precision = 2,
  minPrecision,
  diff,
  currency = 'RUB',
  className,
  colored = true,
  variant,
  symbolType = 'math',
  showDiff = true,
  ...props
}) => {
  const classNames = cx(style.inlineBlock, className);

  const isValueValidNumber = Number.isFinite(value);
  const isDiffValidNumber = Number.isFinite(diff);

  if (!isValueValidNumber && !isDiffValidNumber) {
    return (
      <Balance className={classNames} {...props}>
        –
      </Balance>
    );
  }

  const mainValue = (isValueValidNumber ? value : diff) as number;
  let type: BalanceProps['variant'];
  let symbol:
    | typeof plusSymbol
    | typeof minusSymbol
    | typeof arrowUpSymbol
    | typeof arrowDownSymbol
    | null = mainValue < 0 ? (symbolType === 'math' ? minusSymbol : arrowDownSymbol) : null;

  if (variant) {
    type = variant;
  } else if (isDiffValidNumber && colored) {
    if (diff === 0) {
      type = 'neutral';
    } else if (mainValue > 0) {
      type = 'plus';
      symbol = symbolType === 'math' ? plusSymbol : arrowUpSymbol;
    } else if (mainValue < 0) {
      type = 'minus';
    }
  }

  return (
    <Balance className={classNames} variant={type} {...props}>
      {symbol}
      {isValueValidNumber ? (
        <span className={style.nowrap}>
          {sumFormatter(Math.abs(value as number), precision, minPrecision)}

          {currency !== 'PRC' && ' '}
          <span>{currencySign(currency)}</span>

          {showDiff && isDiffValidNumber && (
            <span> ({sumFormatter(Math.abs(diff as number))}%)</span>
          )}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span>{sumFormatter(Math.abs(diff as number), precision, minPrecision)}%</span>
      )}
    </Balance>
  );
};

export default FormattedBalance;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import VisionBanner, { IBannerProps } from '@vision/banner';

import { Hint } from 'types/hints';

import { BannerSlug } from './types';

type Props = IBannerProps & { slugData?: BannerSlug; hints: Hint[] };

const Banner: FC<Props> = ({ hints, slugData, text, className, variant = 'warning' }) => {
  const { slug } = slugData || {};

  const currentSlug = hints.find((item) => item.slug === slug);

  const textFromSlug = currentSlug?.text.replace(
    /{{(.*?)}}/g,
    (_, p1) => (slugData?.vars && slugData?.vars[p1]) || p1,
  );

  return <VisionBanner text={textFromSlug ?? text} variant={variant} className={className} />;
};

export default memo(Banner);

import React, { memo } from 'react';

import { Carousel } from '@aurora/components';

import { useBanners } from 'core/banners';

import Banner from 'components/Banners/components/Banner/Banner';
import Skeleton from 'components/Banners/components/Skeleton/Skeleton';
import { BannersProps } from 'components/Banners/types';

const Banners = (props: BannersProps) => {
  const { carousels, handleClose, isLoading } = useBanners(props);

  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />;
  if (isLoading || !carousels || carousels.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {carousels?.map((carousel) => {
        return (
          <Carousel key={carousel.id} variant="cardFilled" navigation={false} slidesToShow={1}>
            {carousel &&
              carousel?.banners?.map((el) => (
                <Banner
                  key={el.id}
                  {...el}
                  locationImage={carousel.locationImage}
                  count={carousel.banners.length}
                  size={carousel.size}
                  onClose={handleClose(el.id)}
                />
              ))}
          </Carousel>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(Banners);

import React, { useRef } from 'react';

import { BannerLk, BannerTimer, Button } from '@aurora/components';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import CustomField from 'components/Banners/components/CustomField/CustomField';
import { BannerProps } from 'components/Banners/types';

import styles from './Banner.module.pcss';

const Banner = ({
  id,
  size,
  point,
  name,
  count,
  title,
  description,
  colorBackground,
  colorText,
  signClosed,
  imageBackground,
  locationImage,
  allBannerClickable,
  href,
  timerBanner,
  buttons,
  customFields,
  onClose,
}: BannerProps) => {
  const haveButtons = buttons && buttons.length !== 0;
  const haveAddonBottom = haveButtons || (customFields && customFields.length !== 0);

  const mousePositionRef = useRef<{ clientX: number; clientY: number } | undefined>();

  const handleBannerClick = () => {
    reachGoal('banners', 'banner_tap', {
      id: String(id),
      from: String(point),
      dashboardLkTest: '',
    });
  };

  const handlePointerDown = (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!allBannerClickable || !href) return;
    mousePositionRef.current = { clientX: event.clientX, clientY: event.clientY };
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!allBannerClickable || !href) return;
    if (
      event.clientX !== mousePositionRef?.current?.clientX &&
      event.clientY !== mousePositionRef?.current?.clientY
    )
      return;
    const newWindow = window.open(href, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    if (newWindow) {
      newWindow.opener = null;
    }
    handleBannerClick();
  };

  const mode = 'mobile';

  const addonBottom = (
    <div className={styles.addonBottomContainer}>
      {haveButtons &&
        buttons &&
        buttons.map((el, index) => {
          return (
            <Button
              key={`b-${index}`}
              variant={el.type === 'PRIMARY' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
              shape="inline"
              link={el.link}
              external
              as={'a'}
              className={styles.button}
              onPointerUp={(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) =>
                event.stopPropagation()
              }
              onClick={handleBannerClick}
            >
              {el.title}
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      {!haveButtons &&
        customFields &&
        customFields.map((el, index) => <CustomField key={`cf-${index}`} {...el} />)}
    </div>
  );

  if (timerBanner) {
    return (
      <BannerTimer
        size={size === 'L' ? 'large' : 'medium'}
        deadline={timerBanner}
        indent={false}
        title={title && sanitizeHtml(title)}
        description={description && sanitizeHtml(description)}
        dangerouslyMode
        addonBottom={haveAddonBottom && addonBottom}
        colorBackground={colorBackground}
        colorText={colorText}
        colorTextTimer={colorText}
        className={styles.banner}
        classNameBannerTimer={styles.banner}
        classNameContent={styles.banner}
        onClickClose={signClosed ? onClose : undefined}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <BannerLk
      size={size === 'L' ? 'large' : size === 'M' ? 'medium' : 'small'}
      mode={mode}
      indent={false}
      title={title && sanitizeHtml(title)}
      description={description && sanitizeHtml(description)}
      addonBottom={haveAddonBottom && addonBottom}
      imgPosition={locationImage}
      source={imageBackground}
      colorBackground={colorBackground}
      colorText={colorText}
      dangerouslyMode
      className={styles.banner}
      classNameBanner={styles.banner}
      onClickClose={signClosed ? onClose : undefined}
      onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
      onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
    />
  );
};

export default Banner;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Button } from '@aurora/components';
import BottomSheet from '@vision/bottom-sheet';
import Text from '@vision/text';

import { serviceWorkerSelector } from 'core/serviceWorker/serviceWorkerSelectors';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { createAlertNotification } from '../Alert/createAlertNotification';
import styles from './BottomSheetUpdateServiceWorker.module.pcss';
import { IS_UPDATE_SERVICE_WORKER } from './constants';

const BottomSheetUpdateServiceWorker: React.FC = () => {
  const { serviceWorkerUpdated, serviceWorkerRegistration, serviceWorkerUpdateForce } =
    useAppSelector(serviceWorkerSelector);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    sessionStorage[IS_UPDATE_SERVICE_WORKER] &&
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Успешно обновлено' });
    sessionStorage.removeItem(IS_UPDATE_SERVICE_WORKER);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let handleSetOpen: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    if (serviceWorkerUpdated) {
      if (serviceWorkerUpdateForce) {
        setOpen(serviceWorkerUpdated);
        return;
      }
      handleSetOpen = setTimeout(() => setOpen(serviceWorkerUpdated), 10_000);
    }
    return () => handleSetOpen && clearTimeout(handleSetOpen);
  }, [serviceWorkerUpdateForce, serviceWorkerUpdated]);

  const updateServiceWorker = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    const registrationWaiting = serviceWorkerRegistration?.waiting;
    if (registrationWaiting) {
      registrationWaiting.addEventListener('statechange', (event) => {
        const sw = event?.target as ServiceWorker;
        if (sw?.state === 'activated') {
          window.location.reload();
        }
      });
      registrationWaiting.postMessage({ type: 'SKIP_WAITING' });
      sessionStorage.setItem(IS_UPDATE_SERVICE_WORKER, 'success');
    }
  };

  const onDismiss = () => setOpen(false);

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.root}>
        <Text>Доступна новая версия этой страницы</Text>
        <div className={styles.buttonsWrapper}>
          <Button onClick={onDismiss} variant="specialSecondary">
            Позднее
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={updateServiceWorker}>Обновить</Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default BottomSheetUpdateServiceWorker;

  onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  className?: string;
  autoFocus?: boolean;
}

const Captcha: React.FC<CaptchaProps> = ({ value, onChange, className, autoFocus = true }) => {
  const [hash, setHash] = useState(Date.now().toString());
  const handleUpdate = () => {
    setHash(Date.now().toString());
  };
  return (
    <div className={cn(className, styles.container)}>
      <div className={styles.captcha}>
        <img src={`/rs/v1/captcha?${hash}`} alt={'captcha'} />
        <div className={styles.update} onClick={handleUpdate}>
          <UpdateSvg />
          <Text tag={'span'} type={'labelRegular'}>
            Обновить картинку
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <Input
          classNameInput={styles.input}
          value={value}
          onChange={onChange}
          placeholder="Введите код с картинки"
          autoFocus={autoFocus}
          mask={'9999'}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Captcha;

import React from 'react';

import Card from '@vision/card';
import Text, { KeyText as TypeText } from '@vision/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { ReactComponent as ChevronRightSvg } from 'images/icons/chevron-right.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ChevronSvg } from 'images/icons/chevron.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

interface CardButtonProps {
  title: string;
  subTitle?: string | React.ReactNode;
  size?: 'small' | 'medium';
  name?: string;
  nameType?: TypeText;
  className?: string;
  classNameTitle?: string;
  classNameHeader?: string;
  classNameTextWrapper?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactElement;
  colorIcon?: string;
  bgColorIcon?: string;
  bgColor?: 'white' | 'gray';
  chevronRight?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  onClick?: () => void;
}

const CardButton: React.FC<CardButtonProps> = ({
  title,
  subTitle,
  size,
  className,
  classNameTitle,
  classNameHeader,
  classNameTextWrapper,
  name,
  nameType = 'bodySemiBold',
  icon = null,
  bgColor = 'gray',
  chevronRight = false,
  disabled = false,
  placeholder,
  onClick,
}) => {
  return (
    <>
      {name && (
        <Text type={nameType} className={cn(styles.name, classNameHeader)}>
          {name}
        </Text>
      )}
      <Card
        className={cn(styles.wrapper, className, { [styles.disabled]: disabled })}
        backgroundColor={bgColor}
        {...(!disabled && { onClick })}
        size={size}
      >
        {icon && <div className={styles.iconStyle}>{icon}</div>}
        <div className={cn(styles.textWrapper, classNameTextWrapper)}>
          <Text
            type={'lineMedium'}
            className={cn(styles.title, classNameTitle, { [styles.placeholder]: !title })}
          >
            {title ? title : placeholder}
          </Text>
          {subTitle && (
            <Text type={'labelRegular'} className={styles.subTitle}>
              {subTitle}
            </Text>
          )}
        </div>
        {!disabled && (chevronRight ? <ChevronRightSvg /> : <ChevronSvg />)}
      </Card>
    </>
  );
};

export default CardButton;

import React, { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
import {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  ReferenceLine,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from 'recharts';

import styles from './Chart.module.pcss';
import { ReferenceLineLabel, TooltipContent } from './components';
import config from './config';
import { calcExtent, formatValue } from './helpers';
import { useSvgDefs } from './hooks';
import { Series, SeriesData, TooltipChangeEvent } from './types';

export type DotsColors = {
  [id: string]: string;
};

type TooltipPosition = {
  x: number | undefined;
  y: number | undefined;
};

export type ChartProps = {
  series: Series[];
  seriesData: SeriesData[];
  lastPrice?: number;
  percentageOffset?: number;
  isPercent?: boolean;
  yTickCount?: number;
  onTooltipStateChange?: (props: TooltipChangeEvent) => void;
};

const Chart: React.FC<ChartProps> = ({
  series,
  seriesData,
  percentageOffset = 0,
  yTickCount = 5,
  lastPrice,
  isPercent,
  onTooltipStateChange,
}) => {
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  const chartRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const tooltipRef = useRef<Tooltip<number, number>>(null);
  const [tooltipPosition, setTooltipPosition] = useState<TooltipPosition>({
    x: undefined,
    y: undefined,
  });

  const dotsColors = useMemo(() => {
    const colors: DotsColors = {};
    series.forEach((item) => {
      colors[item.id] = item.colorSet ? item.colorSet[0] : '#018AD5';
    });
    return colors;
  }, [series]);

  const interval = Math.floor(seriesData.length / (config.xAxisTicksCount + 1));

  const xAxisTicks = useMemo(() => {
    return seriesData.map((item) => item.date).slice(interval || 1);
  }, [seriesData, interval]);

  const formatDateMode: 'years' | 'months' | 'days' = useMemo(() => {
    if (xAxisTicks.length) {
      const firstDate = DateTime.fromMillis(xAxisTicks[0]);
      const lastDate = DateTime.fromMillis(xAxisTicks[xAxisTicks.length - 1]);

      if (lastDate.diff(firstDate, 'years').years >= config.xAxisTicksCount) {
        return 'years';
      } else if (lastDate.diff(firstDate, 'months').months >= config.xAxisTicksCount) {
        return 'months';
      }
    }
    return 'days';
  }, [xAxisTicks]);

  const formatDate = useCallback(
    (value: number | 'auto') => {
      const date = typeof value === 'number' ? DateTime.fromMillis(value) : undefined;
      if (!date || !date.isValid) return '';

      let formattedDate;
      if (formatDateMode === 'years') {
        formattedDate = date.toFormat('yyyy');
      } else if (formatDateMode === 'months') {
        formattedDate = date.toFormat('MMM yy');
      } else {
        formattedDate = date.toFormat('dd MMM yy');
      }

      return formattedDate.replace('.', '');
    },
    [formatDateMode],
  );

  const valueMaxAmount = useMemo(() => {
    let maxValue = 0;
    seriesData.forEach((item) => {
      for (const key in item) {
        if (key !== 'date' && key !== 'dateTo') {
          const value = item[key];
          const numberValue = typeof value === 'number' ? Math.abs(value) : 0;
          if (numberValue > maxValue) {
            maxValue = numberValue;
          }
        }
      }
    });
    return Math.floor(maxValue).toString().length;
  }, [seriesData]);

  const isOneLine = series.length === 1;

  const handleMouseMove = useCallback(
    (data: {
      isTooltipActive?: boolean;
      chartX?: number;
      chartY?: number;
      activePayload: Array<{ value: number | string }> | null;
    }) => {
      if (!data.isTooltipActive) return;

      const tooltipWidth = tooltipRef.current
        ? tooltipRef.current.state.boxWidth
        : config.tooltipConfig.minWidth;
      const tooltipHeight = tooltipRef.current
        ? tooltipRef.current.state.boxHeight
        : config.tooltipConfig.minHeight;

      const tooltipWidthWithOffset = tooltipWidth + config.tooltipConfig.offsetX;
      const y =
        !chartRef.current || !data.activePayload || !isOneLine
          ? 0
          : chartRef.current.state.yAxisMap[0].scale(data.activePayload[0].value) -
            tooltipHeight / 2;

      setTooltipPosition({
        x:
          data.chartX && data.chartX > tooltipWidthWithOffset
            ? data.chartX - tooltipWidthWithOffset
            : (data.chartX || 0) + config.tooltipConfig.offsetX,
        y,
      });
    },
    [isOneLine],
  );

  const handleMouseUp = () => {
    chartRef.current.setState({ isTooltipActive: false });
  };

  const seriesMinMax = useMemo(() => calcExtent(seriesData), [seriesData]);

  const dontShowReferenceLine = useMemo(() => {
    const numbers: number[] = [];
    for (const key in seriesMinMax) {
      numbers.push(...seriesMinMax[key]);
    }

    return Math.min(...numbers) >= 0 || Math.max(...numbers) <= 0;
  }, [seriesMinMax]);

  const {
    content: svgDefsContent,
    areaGradientUrl,
    shadowFilterUrl,
    bottomLineGradientUrl,
  } = useSvgDefs(series, seriesMinMax);

  const activeDots = useMemo(() => {
    const dotsParams: {
      [id: string]: Area['props']['activeDot'];
    } = {};
    Object.keys(dotsColors).forEach((key) => {
      dotsParams[key] = {
        stroke: '#ffffff',
        strokeWidth: 3,
        r: 6.5,
        fill: dotsColors[key],
        filter: shadowFilterUrl,
      };
    });
    return dotsParams;
  }, [dotsColors, shadowFilterUrl]);

  return (
    <ResponsiveContainer
      width="100%"
      height={config.chartConfig.height}
      className={styles.container}
    >
      <AreaChart
        ref={chartRef}
        width={config.chartConfig.width}
        height={config.chartConfig.height}
        data={seriesData}
        // @ts-ignore
        onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
        onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
        throttleDelay={50}
        margin={config.chartMargin}
      >
        {svgDefsContent}

        <CartesianGrid
          vertical={false}
          stroke="#F0F4F7"
          strokeWidth={1}
          shapeRendering="crispEdges"
        />

        <XAxis
          dataKey="date"
          tickMargin={5}
          tickSize={20}
          tickLine={config.lineSvgProps}
          axisLine={config.lineSvgProps}
          tick={config.xTickSvgProps}
          fontSize={10}
          fontWeight={500}
          tickFormatter={formatDate}
          ticks={xAxisTicks}
          interval={interval}
        />

        <YAxis
          domain={config.yAxisDomain}
          orientation="right"
          tickLine={false}
          axisLine={false}
          tickMargin={4}
          fontSize={10}
          fontWeight={500}
          tick={config.yTickSvgProps}
          tickFormatter={(value) => formatValue(value, valueMaxAmount, percentageOffset, isPercent)}
          tickCount={yTickCount}
        />

        <Tooltip
          ref={tooltipRef}
          offset={0}
          position={tooltipPosition}
          cursor={config.lineSvgProps}
          isAnimationActive={false}
          wrapperStyle={config.tooltipWrapperStyle}
          wrapperClassName={styles.tooltipWrapper}
          content={
            <TooltipContent
              dotsColors={dotsColors}
              config={config.tooltipConfig}
              percentageOffset={percentageOffset}
              isPercent={isPercent}
              onChange={onTooltipStateChange}
            />
          }
        />

        {dontShowReferenceLine ? null : <ReferenceLine y={0} stroke="white" strokeWidth={2} />}

        {dontShowReferenceLine ? null : (
          <ReferenceLine
            y={0}
            stroke="#E0E9EC"
            strokeWidth={2}
            strokeDasharray="1 4"
            strokeLinecap="round"
          />
        )}

        {/* top area */}
        {series.map((item) => (
          <Area
            key={item.id}
            isAnimationActive={false}
            type="monotoneX"
            dataKey={item.id}
            stroke={`url(#${item.id})`}
            dot={false}
            strokeWidth={3}
            clipPath={`url(#${item.id}-top-clip)`}
            fill={isOneLine ? areaGradientUrl : undefined}
            fillOpacity={isOneLine ? 0.3 : 0}
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            name={item.name}
            activeDot={false}
          />
        ))}

        {/* bottom area */}
        {series.map((item) => (
          <Area
            key={`${item.id}-bottom`}
            isAnimationActive={false}
            type="monotoneX"
            dataKey={item.id}
            stroke={isOneLine ? bottomLineGradientUrl : `url(#${item.id}-opacity)`}
            strokeOpacity={isOneLine ? 1 : 0.9}
            clipPath={`url(#${item.id}-bottom-clip)`}
            dot={false}
            strokeWidth={3}
            fillOpacity={0}
            strokeLinejoin="round"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            tooltipType="none"
            activeDot={activeDots[item.id]}
          />
        ))}

        {lastPrice && (
          <ReferenceLine
            y={lastPrice}
            strokeWidth={1}
            stroke={'#C1CCD3'}
            strokeDasharray="6 3"
            label={({ viewBox }) => (
              <ReferenceLineLabel
                lineViewbox={viewBox}
                value={lastPrice}
                isPercent={isPercent}
                percentageOffset={percentageOffset}
                valueMaxAmount={valueMaxAmount}
              />
            )}
          />
        )}
      </AreaChart>
    </ResponsiveContainer>
  );
};

export default Chart;

import React from 'react';
import { useShallowCompareEffect } from 'react-use';

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
import { TooltipProps } from 'recharts';

import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import styles from 'components/Chart/components/TooltipContent/TooltipContent.module.pcss';
import { DotsColors } from 'components/Chart/index';
import { TooltipChangeEvent } from 'components/Chart/types';
import { FormattedBalance } from 'components/index';

export type TooltipConfig = {
  minWidth: number;
  minHeight: number;
  offsetX: number;
};

const formatDate = (date: number, dateTo?: number) => {
  try {
    if (dateTo) {
      return `Период: ${DateTime.fromMillis(date).toFormat('dd MMM yyyy')} - ${DateTime.fromMillis(
        dateTo,
      ).toFormat('dd MMM yyyy')}`;
    }
    return DateTime.fromMillis(date).toFormat('dd MMM yyyy').replace('.', '');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Date formatting error:', error);
  }
};

export type TooltipContentProps = {
  config: TooltipConfig;
  dotsColors: DotsColors;
  isAreaChart?: boolean;
  isPercent?: boolean;
  percentageOffset?: number;
  onChange?: (props: TooltipChangeEvent) => void;
};

const TooltipContent = ({
  dotsColors,
  active,
  payload,
  label,
  config,
  isAreaChart = true,
  isPercent,
  percentageOffset,
  onChange,
}: TooltipContentProps & TooltipProps<number, number>) => {
  useShallowCompareEffect(() => {
    onChange && onChange({ active, payload });
  }, [active, payload]);

  if (!active || !label || !payload || !payload.length) {
    return null;
  }

  const filteredPayload = payload.filter((item) => item.type !== 'none');
  const payloadItem = filteredPayload[0];
  const dateTo = payloadItem?.payload?.dateTo ? payloadItem.payload.dateTo : undefined;
  const formattedDate = formatDate(label, dateTo);

  return (
    <div
      style={
        {
          '--minWidth': `${config.minWidth}px`,
          '--minHeight': `${config.minHeight}px`,
        } as React.CSSProperties
      }
      className={styles.tooltip}
    >
      {formattedDate && <div className={styles.date}>{formattedDate}</div>}
      {filteredPayload.length === 1 && isAreaChart ? (
        <div className={styles.row}>
          {isPercent ? (
            <FormattedBalance className={styles.balance} diff={payloadItem.value} />
          ) : (
            <>
              {sumFormatter(payload[0].value || 0)} {payload[0].unit}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {filteredPayload.map((item) => {
            return (
              <div key={item.dataKey} className={styles.grid}>
                <div className={styles.dotContainer}>
                  <div
                    style={
                      {
                        '--color': item.dataKey ? dotsColors[item.dataKey] : '#018AD5',
                      } as React.CSSProperties
                    }
                    className={styles.dot}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.label}>{item.name}</div>
                <div className={styles.balanceContainer}>
                  {isPercent ? (
                    <FormattedBalance className={styles.balance} diff={item.value} />
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {sumFormatter(item.value || 0)} {isPercent ? item.unit : ` ${item.unit}`}
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TooltipContent;

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { SeriesData, SeriesMinMax } from './types';

export const calcOffset = (min: number, max: number): number => {
  if (max <= 0) return 0;
  if (min >= 0) return 1;

  return max / (max - min);
};

export const calcExtent = (data: SeriesData[]): SeriesMinMax => {
  const numbers: { [id: string]: number[] } = {};

  data.forEach((el) => {
    Object.entries(el).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      if (key !== 'date' && key !== 'dateTo' && typeof value === 'number') {
        if (!numbers[key]) {
          numbers[key] = [value];
        } else {
          numbers[key].push(value);
        }
      }
    });
  });

  const result: SeriesMinMax = {};
  for (const key in numbers) {
    result[key] = numbers[key] ? [Math.min(...numbers[key]), Math.max(...numbers[key])] : [0, 0];
  }

  return result;
};

export const formatValue = (
  value: number,
  valueMaxAmount: number,
  percentageOffset: number,
  isPercent?: boolean,
) => {
  if (isPercent) {
    const displayedValue = value + percentageOffset;
    const formattedValue = sumFormatter(Math.abs(displayedValue), 0);
    return `${displayedValue >= 0 ? ` ${formattedValue}` : `–${formattedValue}`}${currencySign(
      'PRC',
    )}`;
  }

  let label;

  if (valueMaxAmount >= 13) {
    value = value / 1_000_000_000_000;
    label = 'трлн';
  } else if (valueMaxAmount >= 10) {
    value = value / 1_000_000_000;
    label = 'млрд';
  } else if (valueMaxAmount >= 7) {
    value = value / 1_000_000;
    label = 'млн';
  } else if (valueMaxAmount >= 5) {
    value = value / 1000;
    label = 'тыс';
  }

  if (label) return `${sumFormatter(value, 2)} ${label}`;
  return sumFormatter(value, 2);
};

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

import { calcOffset } from './helpers';
import { Series, SeriesMinMax } from './types';

const useGuid = () => {
  return useMemo(() => uuidv4(), []);
};

export const useSvgDefs = (series: Series[], seriesMinMax: SeriesMinMax) => {
  const areaGradientId = useGuid();
  const shadowFilterId = useGuid();
  const bottomLineGradientId = useGuid();

  const isOneLine = series.length === 1;

  const content = useMemo(() => {
    const seriesOffs: Array<{ id: string; off: number }> = [];

    for (const id in seriesMinMax) {
      seriesOffs.push({ id, off: calcOffset(seriesMinMax[id][0], seriesMinMax[id][1]) });
    }

    return (
      <defs>
        {series.map((item) => (
          <linearGradient key={item.id} id={item.id} x1="1" y1="0" x2="0" y2="0">
            {item.colorSet ? (
              <>
                <stop offset="0" stopColor={item.colorSet[1]} />
                <stop offset="0.12" stopColor={item.colorSet[2]} />
                <stop offset="0.73" stopColor={item.colorSet[3]} />
                <stop offset="1" stopColor={item.colorSet[4]} />
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <stop offset="0" stopColor="#007ABF" />
                <stop offset="0.12" stopColor="#3AB6EC" />
                <stop offset="0.73" stopColor="#45B9EC" />
                <stop offset="1" stopColor="#CEE2EB" />
              </>
            )}
          </linearGradient>
        ))}

        {series.map((item) => (
          <linearGradient
            key={`${item.id}-opacity`}
            id={`${item.id}-opacity`}
            x1="1"
            y1="0"
            x2="0"
            y2="0"
          >
            {item.colorSet ? (
              <>
                <stop offset="0" stopColor={item.colorSet[1]} stopOpacity={0.1} />
                <stop offset="0.12" stopColor={item.colorSet[2]} stopOpacity={0.1} />
                <stop offset="0.73" stopColor={item.colorSet[3]} stopOpacity={0.1} />
                <stop offset="1" stopColor={item.colorSet[4]} stopOpacity={0.1} />
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <stop offset="0" stopColor="#007ABF" stopOpacity={0.1} />
                <stop offset="0.12" stopColor="#3AB6EC" stopOpacity={0.1} />
                <stop offset="0.73" stopColor="#45B9EC" stopOpacity={0.1} />
                <stop offset="1" stopColor="#CEE2EB" stopOpacity={0.1} />
              </>
            )}
          </linearGradient>
        ))}

        {seriesOffs.map((item) => (
          <clipPath key={item.id} id={`${item.id}-top-clip`} clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox">
            <rect x={0} y={-1.2} width={1} height={1.2 + item.off} />
          </clipPath>
        ))}

        {seriesOffs.map((item) => (
          <clipPath key={item.id} id={`${item.id}-bottom-clip`} clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox">
            <rect x={0} y={item.off} width={1} height={1.2} />
          </clipPath>
        ))}

        {isOneLine && (
          <linearGradient id={areaGradientId} x1={0} y1={0} x2={0} y2={1}>
            <stop offset={0} stopColor="#1a9ad1" />
            <stop offset={0.15} stopColor="#3ab6ec" />
            <stop offset={1} stopColor="#f0fcf9" />
          </linearGradient>
        )}

        {isOneLine && (
          <linearGradient id={bottomLineGradientId} x1={1} x2={0} y1={0} y2={0}>
            <stop offset={0} stopColor="#758e9b" />
            <stop offset={0.12} stopColor="#9db3bc" />
            <stop offset={0.73} stopColor="#e0e9ec" />
            <stop offset={1} stopColor="#f0f4f7" />
          </linearGradient>
        )}

        <filter
          id={shadowFilterId}
          x="-100%"
          y="-100%"
          width="300%"
          height="300%"
          filterUnits="objectBoundingBox"
          primitiveUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
        >
          <feOffset dx="0" dy="2.5565" in="SourceAlpha" result="offset" />
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5.113 5.113" in="offset" result="blur" />
          <feFlood floodColor="#28282d" floodOpacity="0.1" result="flood" />
          <feComposite in="flood" in2="blur" operator="in" result="composite" />
          <feMerge result="merge">
            <feMergeNode in="composite" result="mergeNode" />
            <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" result="mergeNode1" />
          </feMerge>
        </filter>
      </defs>
    );
  }, [areaGradientId, bottomLineGradientId, isOneLine, series, seriesMinMax, shadowFilterId]);

  return {
    content,
    areaGradientUrl: `url(#${areaGradientId})`,
    shadowFilterUrl: `url(#${shadowFilterId})`,
    bottomLineGradientUrl: `url(#${bottomLineGradientId})`,
  };
};

import React from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';

import Text from '@vision/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import { valueFormatter } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const DEFAULT_FRACTION_DIGITS = 2;

type Props = {
  className?: string;
  data: {
    name: string;
    percents: number;
    currencyCode?: PriceCurrencyType;
    link?: string;
    parts?: { name: string; percents: number; currencyCode?: string }[];
  }[];
  colors?: string[];
  textColors?: string[];
  selected?: number;
  onSelectedChange?: (index: number) => void;
  minValue?: number;
  percentFractionDigits?: number;
  enabledProgressBar?: boolean;
};

const ChartLegend = ({
  className,
  data,
  colors,
  textColors,
  selected,
  onSelectedChange,
  minValue,
  percentFractionDigits = DEFAULT_FRACTION_DIGITS,
  enabledProgressBar,
}: Props) => {
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      {data.map((item, index) => {
        const style: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
        if (Array.isArray(colors) && colors.length > 0) {
          style['--item-color'] =
            typeof selected !== 'number' || selected < 0 || selected === index
              ? colors[index % colors.length]
              : undefined;
        }

        if (Array.isArray(textColors) && textColors.length > 0) {
          style['--value-color'] =
            typeof selected !== 'number' || selected < 0 || selected === index
              ? textColors[index % textColors.length]
              : 'inherit';
        }

        const formattedPercents = valueFormatter(item.percents, {
          fractionDigits: percentFractionDigits,
          minValue,
          symbol: '%',
        });

        if (enabledProgressBar) {
          style['--percents'] = item.percents + '%';
        }

        const containerProps = {
          className: cn(styles.item, enabledProgressBar && styles.progressBar),
          style: style,
          onMouseEnter: () => {
            if (typeof onSelectedChange !== 'function') return;
            onSelectedChange(index);
          },
          onMouseLeave: () => {
            if (typeof onSelectedChange !== 'function') return;
            onSelectedChange(-1);
          },
        };

        const content = (
          <>
            <div className={styles.itemRow}>
              <span className={styles.itemIndicator} />
              <Text type={'lineMedium'} className={styles.itemName}>
                {item.name}
              </Text>
              <div className={styles.itemPercents}>
                <Text type={'lineMedium'}>{formattedPercents}</Text>
              </div>
            </div>
            {Array.isArray(item.parts) &&
              item.parts.map(({ name, percents }, i) => (
                <div key={i} className={styles.itemRow}>
                  <div className={styles.itemName}>{name}</div>
                  <div className={styles.itemPercentsParts}>
                    {valueFormatter(percents, {
                      fractionDigits: percentFractionDigits,
                      minValue: minValue,
                      symbol: '%',
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
          </>
        );

        if (item.link) {
          return (
            <Link {...containerProps} key={index} to={item.link}>
              {content}
            </Link>
          );
        }

        return (
          <div {...containerProps} key={index}>
            {content}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ChartLegend;
