import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

export const stringNumberFormatter = (value: number | string | BigNumber): string => {
  const valueString = String(value);
  const regexp = new RegExp(
    '\\B(?=(\\d{3})+(?!\\d)' + (/[,.]/.test(valueString) ? ',' : '') + ')',
    'g',
  );

  return valueString.replace('.', ',').replace(regexp, ' ');
};

export const valueFormatter = (
  value?: number,
  options: { minValue?: number; fractionDigits?: number; symbol?: string; placeholder?: '-' } = {},
): string => {
  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return '-';
  }

  const { minValue, symbol = '' } = options;
  const fractionDigits =
    options.fractionDigits == null || options.fractionDigits < 0 ? null : options.fractionDigits;

  if (minValue == null) {
    return (
      (fractionDigits == null
        ? stringNumberFormatter(String(value))
        : stringNumberFormatter(new BigNumber(value).toFixed(2))) + symbol
    );
  }

  if (fractionDigits == null) {
    const lessThanMin = value < minValue;

    return (
      (lessThanMin ? '<' : '') + stringNumberFormatter(lessThanMin ? minValue : value) + symbol
    );
  }

  const roundedValue = new BigNumber(value).decimalPlaces(fractionDigits);
  const roundedMinValue = new BigNumber(minValue).decimalPlaces(fractionDigits);
  const lessThanMin = roundedValue.isLessThan(roundedMinValue);

  return (
    (lessThanMin ? '<' : '') +
    stringNumberFormatter((lessThanMin ? roundedMinValue : roundedValue).toFixed(fractionDigits)) +
    symbol
  );
};

export const symbolFormatter = (
  currency?: PriceCurrencyType,
  defaultCurrency?: PriceCurrencyType,
) => {
  if (currency) return ' ' + currencySign(currency);
  if (defaultCurrency) return ' ' + currencySign(defaultCurrency);
};

import React from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';

import Percent from 'components/CircleProgressBar/components/Percent';
import Plus from 'components/CircleProgressBar/components/Plus';

import styles from './CircleProgressBar.module.pcss';

type CircleProgressBarProps = {
  percentage: number;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  sqSize?: number;
  maxPercent?: number;
  isViewMaxPercent?: boolean;
  color?: 'blue' | 'green';
  variant?: 'plus' | 'percent';
};

const CircleProgressBar: React.FC<CircleProgressBarProps> = ({
  percentage,
  strokeWidth = 5,
  sqSize = 50,
  maxPercent = 40,
  isViewMaxPercent = false,
  color = 'blue',
  variant = 'plus',
}) => {
  const radius = (sqSize - strokeWidth) / 2;
  const viewBox = `0 0 ${sqSize} ${sqSize}`;
  const dashArray = radius * Math.PI * 2;
  const dashOffset = dashArray - (dashArray * percentage) / 100;
  const maxPercentStrokeDashOffset = dashArray - (dashArray * 2) / 100;
  const maxPercentRotate = (360 * maxPercent) / 100;

  return (
    <svg width={sqSize} height={sqSize} viewBox={viewBox}>
      <circle
        className={styles.circleBackground}
        cx={sqSize / 2}
        cy={sqSize / 2}
        r={radius}
        strokeWidth={`${strokeWidth}px`}
      />
      <circle
        className={cx(styles.circleProgress, styles[color])}
        cx={sqSize / 2}
        cy={sqSize / 2}
        r={radius}
        strokeWidth={`${strokeWidth}px`}
        transform={`rotate(-90 ${sqSize / 2} ${sqSize / 2})`}
        style={{
          strokeDasharray: dashArray,
          strokeDashoffset: dashOffset,
        }}
      />
      {isViewMaxPercent && (
        <circle
          className={cx(styles.circleProgress, styles[color])}
          cx={sqSize / 2 - 2}
          cy={sqSize / 2}
          r={radius}
          strokeWidth={`${strokeWidth + 4}px`}
          transform={`rotate(${-90 + maxPercentRotate} ${sqSize / 2} ${sqSize / 2})`}
          style={{
            strokeDasharray: dashArray,
            strokeDashoffset: maxPercentStrokeDashOffset,
          }}
        />
      )}
      <foreignObject x="0" y="0" height={sqSize} width={sqSize}>
        <div className={styles.node}>
          {variant === 'plus' ? <Plus color={color} /> : <Percent color={color} />}
        </div>
      </foreignObject>
    </svg>
  );
};

export default CircleProgressBar;

import React from 'react';
import styles from './collapse.module.pcss';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { UnmountClosed } from 'react-collapse';

type CollapseProps = {
  isOpened: boolean;
  theme?: { collapse: string; content: string };
  onRest?: () => void;
  onWork?: () => void;
  initialStyle?: { height?: number; overflow?: string };
  checkTimeout?: number;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  speed?: number;
};

const Collapse: React.FC<CollapseProps> = ({
  theme,
  isOpened,
  children,
  initialStyle,
  checkTimeout,
  onRest,
  onWork,
  speed,
}) => {
  return (
    <div
      style={
        {
          '--speed': `height ${speed}ms ease-in-out`,
        } as React.CSSProperties
      }
    >
      <UnmountClosed
        initialStyle={initialStyle}
        isOpened={isOpened}
        checkTimeout={checkTimeout}
        onRest={onRest}
        onWork={onWork}
        theme={{
          collapse: cx(styles.collapseDef, theme?.collapse),
          content: cx(styles.contentDef, theme?.content),
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </UnmountClosed>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Collapse;

import { useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import styles from './CollapseText.module.pcss';
import { CollapseProps } from './types';
import { getCollapsedText } from './utils';

const CollapseText = ({ text, length, className, showMoreText, showLessText }: CollapseProps) => {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleShowMoreButtonClick = () => {
    setExpanded(!expanded);
  };

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <Text type={'bodyRegular'}>
        {text.length > length && !expanded ? getCollapsedText(text, length) : text}
      </Text>
      {text.length > length && (
        <button className={styles.moreButton} onClick={handleShowMoreButtonClick}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
            {expanded ? showLessText ?? 'Скрыть' : showMoreText ?? 'Показать больше'}
          </Text>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CollapseText;

export const getCollapsedText = (string: string, len: number) => {
  const collapsedText = string.slice(0, len);
  const lastIndexOfSpace = collapsedText.lastIndexOf(' ');
  if (lastIndexOfSpace === -1) {
    return collapsedText + '...';
  }

  return collapsedText.slice(0, Math.max(0, lastIndexOfSpace)) + '...';
};

import { FC } from 'react';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { ReactComponent as CopyIcon } from 'images/icons/small-copy.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  text: string;
};

const CopyButton: FC<Props> = ({ text }) => {
  const handleCopyIconClick = () => {
    navigator.clipboard
      .writeText(text)
      .then(() => {
        createAlertNotification({ text: 'Скопировано в буфер', ms: 3000 });
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        // eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax
        console.log('Something went wrong', err);
      });
  };

  return (
    <span className={styles.container}>
      <CopyIcon onClick={handleCopyIconClick} />
    </span>
  );
};

export default CopyButton;

import React, { useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { DayClickEventHandler, DayModifiers, DayPicker } from 'react-day-picker';
import 'react-day-picker/dist/style.css';
import { animated, useTransition } from 'react-spring';
import { useDrag } from 'react-use-gesture';

import ru from 'date-fns/locale/ru';

import DateRangeButtons from 'components/DateRangePicker/components/DateRangeButtons/DateRangeButtons';
import Day from 'components/DateRangePicker/components/Day/Day';
import {
  minusMonth,
  plusMonth,
  processingDefaultDateRangeChanges,
  processingDetermineSideDateRangeChanges,
} from 'components/DateRangePicker/helpers';
import { DateRangePickerProps, DateRangeSide } from 'components/DateRangePicker/types';

import styles from './DateRangePicker.module.pcss';

const DateRangePicker = ({
  stopPropagation,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  showDateRangeButtons = true,
  ...dayPickerProps
}: DateRangePickerProps) => {
  const today = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);

  const [dir, setDir] = useState<'right' | 'left'>('right');

  const divRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [month, setMonth] = useState<Date>(today);

  const [rangeSide, setRangeSide] = useState<DateRangeSide>(null);

  const transitions = useTransition(month, (keys) => keys.toString(), {
    initial: null,
    from: { transform: `translate(${dir === 'right' ? '-100%' : '100%'}, 0)` },
    enter: { transform: 'translate(0%, 0)' },
    leave: { transform: `translate(${dir === 'right' ? '100%' : '-100%'}, 0)` },
  });

  const bind = useDrag(({ event, down, direction: [xDir], distance, cancel, canceled }) => {
    stopPropagation && event.stopPropagation();

    if (down && !canceled && divRef.current && distance > divRef.current.clientWidth / 4) {
      cancel();
      if (xDir > 0) {
        setDir('right');
        setMonth(minusMonth(month));
      }
      if (xDir < 0) {
        const nextMonth = plusMonth(month);
        if (nextMonth <= today) {
          setDir('left');
          setMonth(nextMonth);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  const modifiers: DayModifiers = {
    firstDate: (date: Date) => date.getDate() === 1,
    lastDate: (date: Date) => {
      const oneDayInMs = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24;
      return new Date(date.getTime() + oneDayInMs).getDate() === 1;
    },
    monday: (date: Date) => date.getDay() === 1,
    sunday: (date: Date) => date.getDay() === 0,
  };

  const classNames = {
    caption_label: styles.captionLabel,
    month: styles.month,
    head: styles.head,
    head_cell: styles.headCell,
    table: styles.table,
    cell: styles.cellContainer,
    day: styles.day,
    day_selected: '',
    day_range_start: styles.dayRange,
    day_range_middle: styles.dayRangeMiddle,
    day_range_end: styles.dayRange,
    day_today: styles.dayToday,
    button: styles.button,
  };

  const handleMonthChange = (date: Date) => {
    if (date < month) {
      setDir('right');
    } else {
      setDir('left');
    }
    setMonth(date);
  };

  const handleRangeSideClick = (side: DateRangeSide) => {
    if (rangeSide && rangeSide === side) {
      setRangeSide(null);
    } else {
      setRangeSide(side);
    }
  };

  const handleDayClick: DayClickEventHandler = (day, activeModifiers, e) => {
    let range;
    if (rangeSide) {
      range = processingDetermineSideDateRangeChanges(rangeSide, day, selected);
      setRangeSide(null);
    } else {
      range = processingDefaultDateRangeChanges(day, selected);
    }
    onSelect && onSelect(range, day, activeModifiers, e);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div {...bind()} ref={divRef} className={styles.container}>
        {transitions.map(({ key, props, item }) => (
          <animated.div className={styles.item} style={props} key={key}>
            <DayPicker
              mode="range"
              month={item}
              selected={selected}
              onSelect={onSelect}
              onDayClick={handleDayClick}
              onMonthChange={handleMonthChange}
              components={{ Day }}
              modifiers={modifiers}
              classNames={classNames}
              locale={ru}
              toDate={today}
              {...dayPickerProps}
            />
          </animated.div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {showDateRangeButtons && (
        <DateRangeButtons
          from={selected?.from}
          to={selected?.to}
          rangeSide={rangeSide}
          onClick={handleRangeSideClick}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
export default DateRangePicker;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { DateRange } from 'react-day-picker';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Filter, FilterBar, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import DateRangePicker from 'components/DateRangePicker/components/DateRangePicker/DateRangePicker';
import { DEFAULT_FILTERS } from 'components/DateRangePicker/consts';
import {
  DateRangePickerBottomSheetProps,
  DefaultFiltersNameType,
} from 'components/DateRangePicker/types';

import styles from './DateRangePickerBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const DateRangePickerBottomSheet = ({
  range,
  onDateRangeChange,
  enabledFilters = [],
  activeFilter,
  onActiveFilterChange,
  open,
  onClose,
}: DateRangePickerBottomSheetProps) => {
  const [tempRange, setTempRange] = useState<DateRange | undefined>();
  const [tempActiveFilter, setTempActiveFilter] = useState<DefaultFiltersNameType | null>(null);

  const handleRangeChange = (filterName: DefaultFiltersNameType | null) => (range?: DateRange) => {
    setTempActiveFilter(filterName);
    setTempRange(range);
  };

  const handleDateRangeApplying = () => {
    tempRange && onDateRangeChange(tempRange);
    activeFilter !== undefined && onActiveFilterChange && onActiveFilterChange(activeFilter);
    onClose();
  };

  const onDismiss = () => {
    onClose();
    setTempRange(range);
    activeFilter !== undefined && setTempActiveFilter(activeFilter);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setTempRange(range);
  }, [range]);

  useEffect(() => {
    activeFilter !== undefined && setTempActiveFilter(activeFilter);
  }, [activeFilter]);

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.head}>
        <Text type="subtitleBold">Период</Text>
      </div>
      {enabledFilters?.length !== 0 && (
        <FilterBar>
          {enabledFilters.map((type) => {
            const { name, range } = DEFAULT_FILTERS[type];
            return (
              <Filter
                key={type}
                onClick={() => handleRangeChange(type)(range)}
                text={name}
                active={type === tempActiveFilter}
              />
            );
          })}
          <Filter
            onClick={() => handleRangeChange(null)()}
            text={'Свой период'}
            active={tempActiveFilter === null}
          />
        </FilterBar>
      )}
      <DateRangePicker
        stopPropagation={true}
        selected={tempRange}
        onSelect={handleRangeChange(null)}
      />
      <Button
        onClick={handleDateRangeApplying}
        disabled={!tempRange?.from || !tempRange?.to}
        className={styles.button}
      >
        Применить
      </Button>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default DateRangePickerBottomSheet;

import React, { useRef } from 'react';
import { Button, DayProps, useDayRender } from 'react-day-picker';

import cn from 'classnames';

import styles from './Day.module.pcss';

const Day = (props: DayProps) => {
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const dayRender = useDayRender(props.date, props.displayMonth, buttonRef);

  if (dayRender.isHidden) {
    return <></>;
  }
  if (!dayRender.isButton) {
    return <div {...dayRender.divProps} />;
  }
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        styles.cell,
        dayRender.activeModifiers.selected && styles.cellSelected,
        (dayRender.activeModifiers.range_start ||
          dayRender.activeModifiers.firstDate ||
          dayRender.activeModifiers.monday) &&
          styles.cellStart,
        (dayRender.activeModifiers.range_end ||
          dayRender.activeModifiers.lastDate ||
          dayRender.activeModifiers.sunday) &&
          styles.cellEnd,
        ((dayRender.activeModifiers.firstDate && dayRender.activeModifiers.sunday) ||
          (dayRender.activeModifiers.lastDate && dayRender.activeModifiers.monday) ||
          (dayRender.activeModifiers.firstDate && dayRender.activeModifiers.range_end) ||
          (dayRender.activeModifiers.lastDate && dayRender.activeModifiers.range_start) ||
          (dayRender.activeModifiers.range_start && dayRender.activeModifiers.range_end)) &&
          styles.cellSingle,
      )}
    >
      <Button ref={buttonRef} {...dayRender.buttonProps} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Day;

import { DateRange } from 'react-day-picker';

import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { DateRangeSide } from 'components/DateRangePicker/types';

export const plusMonth = (month: Date) => {
  const copy = new Date(month.getTime());
  copy.setMonth(month.getMonth() + 1);
  return copy;
};

export const minusMonth = (month: Date) => {
  const copy = new Date(month.getTime());
  copy.setMonth(month.getMonth() - 1);
  return copy;
};

export const processingDefaultDateRangeChanges = (
  day: Date,
  range: DateRange | undefined,
): DateRange | undefined => {
  const { from, to } = range || {};
  if (!from || (from && to)) {
    return { from: day };
  } else if (!to && day < from) {
    return { from: day, to: from };
  } else if (!to && day >= from) {
    return { from, to: day };
  }
};

export const processingDetermineSideDateRangeChanges = (
  side: DateRangeSide,
  day: Date,
  range: DateRange | undefined,
): DateRange | undefined => {
  const { from, to } = range || {};
  if (side === 'from') {
    return to && day <= to ? { from: day, to } : { from: to, to: day };
  }
  if (side === 'to') {
    return from && day >= from ? { from, to: day } : { from: day, to: from };
  }
};

export const formattingDate = (date: Date, format = DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT) => {
  return DateTime.fromJSDate(date).toFormat(format);
};

import React from 'react';

export type FilterType = {
  name: string;
  range: DateRange;
};

export type DefaultFiltersNameType =
  | 'lastYear'
  | 'lastThreeMonths'
  | 'lastMonth'
  | 'lastTwoWeek'
  | 'lastWeek'
  | 'today';

export type DateRangeSide = 'from' | 'to' | null;

export type DateRangePickerProps = {
  selectedRangeSide?: DateRangeSide;
  showDateRangeButtons?: boolean;
  stopPropagation?: boolean;
} & Omit<DayPickerRangeProps, 'month' | 'mode' | 'locale' | 'toDate' | 'onMonthChange' | 'dir'>;

export type DateRangePickerBottomSheetProps = {
  range?: DateRange;
  onDateRangeChange: (range: DateRange) => void;
  enabledFilters?: DefaultFiltersNameType[];
  activeFilter?: DefaultFiltersNameType | null;
  onActiveFilterChange?: (filter: DefaultFiltersNameType | null) => void;
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export type DateRangeButtonsProps = {
  from?: Date;
  to?: Date;
  rangeSide: DateRangeSide;
  format?: string;
  onClick?: (side: DateRangeSide) => void;
};

  date: Date;
  format?: string;
  selected?: boolean;
} & Omit<
  React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, HTMLButtonElement>,

>;

  id: string;
  action?: () => void;

const DesktopMenu = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const activeTab = sessionStorage.getItem('activeTab');
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const [logout] = useLogoutMutation();

  const [openLogout, setOpenLogout] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleLogOutButtonClick = () => setOpenLogout(true);

  const handleCloseConfirm = () => setOpenLogout(false);

  const handleLogOutConfirmButtonClick = async () => {
    try {
      await logout().unwrap();
      navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN);
      resetStore();
      sessionStorage.clear();
    } catch (error) {
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Что-то пошло не так', status: 'error' });
      handleCloseConfirm();
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const transfersRoutes = [
      ROUTE_TRANSFERS,
      ROUTE_REQUISITES_VIEW,
      ROUTE_WITHDRAWAL,
      ROUTE_SECURITIES_REQUISITES,
      ROUTE_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF,
    ];

    if (transfersRoutes.some((route) => pathname === route || pathname.startsWith(`${route}/`))) {
      if (activeTab !== 'transfers') {
        sessionStorage.setItem('activeTab', 'transfers');
      }
      return;
    }

    for (const section of menuItems) {
      const tab = section.find(({ link }) => link === pathname);
      if (tab && activeTab !== tab.id) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('activeTab', tab.id);
        break;

    ],
  ];

  const handleMenuItemClick = ({ id, action, link }: MenuItemHandlerParams) => {
    if (action) action();
    else if (link) {
      sessionStorage.setItem('activeTab', id);
      navigate(link);
    }
  };

  const { data: { products = [] } = {} } = useGetProductsQuery({

                        {icon}
                        <IndicatorSvg className={styles.profileIconAttentionDot} aria-hidden />
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      icon
                    );

                  return (
                    <MenuItem
                      key={id}
                      withCellWrapper
                      active={isActive}
                      arrowRight={false}
                      as="button"
                      direction="vertical"
                      iconLeft={iconLeft}
                      label={name}
                      onClick={() => handleMenuItemClick({ id, action, link })}
                      shape="tab"
                    />
                  );
                })}
              </SidebarMenu>
            );
          })}
        </>
        <CollectionCurrency products={products} countInProcess={countInProcess} />
      </Sidebar>
      {ROUTES_WITH_DESKTOP_MENU_SPACE.includes(location.pathname) && (
        <div className={styles.emptySpace}></div>
      )}

      <Confirm
        open={openLogout}
        onConfirm={handleLogOutConfirmButtonClick}
        onCancel={handleCloseConfirm}
        title={LOGOUT_CONFIRM_TITLE}
        confirmBtnText={'Выйти'}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default DesktopMenu;

import Text from '@aurora/text';

import { DocumentCellProps } from 'components/DocumentCell/types';

import { ReactComponent as PdfSvg } from 'images/icons/pdf.svg';

import styles from './DocumentCell.module.pcss';

const DocumentCell = ({ url, name, id, onClick, fullClickable = false }: DocumentCellProps) => {
  const openDocument = () => {
    if (onClick) {
      onClick();
      return;
    }

    if (url) {
      window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    }
  };

  const handleWrapClick = () => {
    if (fullClickable) {
      openDocument();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={`${styles.wrap} ${fullClickable ? styles.fullClickable : ''}`}
      onClick={handleWrapClick}
      role={fullClickable ? 'button' : undefined}
      tabIndex={fullClickable ? 0 : undefined}
      onKeyDown={
        fullClickable
          ? (event) => {
              if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
                event.preventDefault();
                openDocument();
              }
            }
          : undefined
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.content}>
        <Text>{name}</Text>
        <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          {id}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <a
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (fullClickable) {
            e.stopPropagation();
          }
          if (onClick) {
            e.preventDefault();
            onClick();
          }
        }}
        href={url}
        target={'_blank'}
        rel={'noreferrer'}
        className={styles.document}
      >
        <PdfSvg />
      </a>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DocumentCell;

import React, { memo, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';

import { Badge, Card, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { getNoun } from 'utils/string';

import style from 'components/EducationCard/EducationCard.module.pcss';

import { ReactComponent as MiniLessonSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/education/mini-lesson.svg';
import { ReactComponent as VideoSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/education/video.svg';

import {
  COMPILATION_ELEMENT_TYPES,
  COMPILATION_TAGS,
  EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES,
  MINUTES_PLURALIZATION,
} from './consts';
import { EducationCardPropsType } from './types';

const EducationCard: React.FC<EducationCardPropsType> = ({
  tag,
  image,
  title,
  duration,
  type = EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.COURSE,
  elementType,
  description,
  name,
  onClick,
}) => {
  const isArticle = useMemo(
    () =>
      type === EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.MINI_COURSE &&
      elementType === COMPILATION_ELEMENT_TYPES.ARTICLE,
    [elementType, type],
  );

  const onImageError = useCallback(
    (e) => ((e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = 'none'),
    [],
  );

  return (
    <Card className={cn(style.card, style.cardMobile)} onClick={onClick} hoverUpLift withShadow>
      <div className={style.cardHeader}>
        <div className={style.image}>
          <img src={image} alt="Обучение" onError={onImageError} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={style.cardContent}>
        <div>
          {type !== EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.MINI_COURSE && tag && (
            <Badge
              label={COMPILATION_TAGS[tag].label}
              color={COMPILATION_TAGS[tag].color}
              size="xs20"
              variant="secondary"
              className={cn(style.badge, style.mobileBadge)}
            />
          )}

          <Text
            type="subtitleMedium"
            className={cn(style.cardTitle, {
              [style.oneLineCardTitle]: type === EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.COMPILATION,
            })}
          >
            {title || name}
          </Text>

          {type === EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.COMPILATION && description && (
            <div
              className={style.compilationDesc}
              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sanitizeHtml(description) }}
            />
          )}
        </div>

        {type !== EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.COMPILATION && (
          <div className={cn(style.cardInfo, style.cardInfoMobile)}>
            <div className={style.cardDuration}>
              {isArticle ? <MiniLessonSvg /> : <VideoSvg />}

              <Text type="bodyMedium">{`${duration} ${getNoun(
                duration,
                ...MINUTES_PLURALIZATION,
              )}`}</Text>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default memo(EducationCard);

import React, { memo } from 'react';

import { Button, Carousel, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import {
  useGetEducationCompilationQuery,
  useGetEducationCompilationsQuery,
} from 'core/api/education';

import { useMoveToLKAuthToken } from 'hooks/useMoveToLKAuthToken';

import { EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES, EducationCardType } from 'components/EducationCard';
import CompilationCard from 'components/EducationCard/EducationCard';
import styles from 'components/EducationCompilation/EducationCompilation.module.pcss';
import Skeleton from 'components/EducationCompilation/components/Skeleton/Skeleton';
import { ROUTE_EDUCATION_MINI_COURSES } from 'components/EducationCompilation/consts';
import { getPathname } from 'components/EducationCompilation/helpers';

const EducationCompilation = () => {
  const { data: compilations, isLoading: isCompilationsLoading } = useGetEducationCompilationsQuery(
    { type: 1 },
  );

  const { data, isLoading: isCompilationLoading } = useGetEducationCompilationQuery(
    compilations?.[0].id,
    {
      skip: !compilations?.[0].id,
    },
  );
  const { handleNavigateToLK } = useMoveToLKAuthToken();

  const onCardClick = (type: EducationCardType, id: number, slug: string, link: string) => {
    return handleNavigateToLK(getPathname(type, id, slug, link));
  };

  if (isCompilationLoading || isCompilationsLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  if (!data || !data?.elements?.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Headline
        title={<Text type="bodySemiBold">Бесплатное обучение от наших экспертов</Text>}
        addonRightNode={
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            shape="text"
            typeText="lineRegular"
            onClick={handleNavigateToLK(ROUTE_EDUCATION_MINI_COURSES)}
          >
            Все
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <Carousel variant="cardFilled" paginationType="expanding" navigation={false} slidesToShow={1}>
        {data?.elements?.map((el, index) => (
          <CompilationCard
            key={index}
            image={el.image}
            duration={el.duration}
            title={el.title}
            type={EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.MINI_COURSE}
            elementType={el.type}
            onClick={onCardClick(EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.MINI_COURSE, el.id, el.slug, el.link)}
          />
        ))}
      </Carousel>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(EducationCompilation);

import { EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES, EducationCardType } from 'components/EducationCard';
import {
  ROUTE_DEFAULT_PATHNAME,
  ROUTE_EDUCATION_MINI_COURSES,
} from 'components/EducationCompilation/consts';
import { GetPathnameByCardType } from 'components/EducationCompilation/types';

export const getCoursePathname: GetPathnameByCardType = ({ slug, link }) => {
  return slug ? `/education/courses/${slug || '404'}` : `/education${link || '/courses/404'}`;
};

export const getMiniCoursePathname: GetPathnameByCardType = ({ link }) => {
  return `${ROUTE_EDUCATION_MINI_COURSES}${link?.split('.ru')?.[1] || '/404'}`;
};

export const getCompilationPathname: GetPathnameByCardType = ({ id }) => {
  return `/education/compilations/${id || 'not-found'}`;
};

export const getPathnameByCardType = {
  [EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.COURSE]: getCoursePathname,
  [EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.MINI_COURSE]: getMiniCoursePathname,
  [EDUCATION_CARD_TYPES.COMPILATION]: getCompilationPathname,
};

export const getPathname = (type: EducationCardType, id: number, slug: string, link: string) => {
  const fn = getPathnameByCardType[type];
  if (fn) return fn({ id, slug, link });
  return ROUTE_DEFAULT_PATHNAME;
};

import { FC, createContext, useContext, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';
import { throttle } from 'lodash';

import styles from './style.module.pcss';

type Direction = 'up' | 'down';

type Context = {
  direction: Direction;
  setHeightHeader?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<number>>;
  ref: HTMLDivElement | null;
};

type Props = {
  className?: string;
  onScroll?: (ref: HTMLDivElement) => void;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
};

const ContextDirectionScroll = createContext<Context>({ direction: 'up', ref: null });

export const useFiltersContext = () => {
  const direction = useContext(ContextDirectionScroll);
  if (direction == null) {
    throw new Error(
      'You must to wrap your scrollable component with FilterScrollProvider to using useScrollContext hook',
    );
  }
  return direction;
};

let prevScrollY = 0;
const FilterScrollProvider: FC<Props> = ({ children, className, onScroll, style }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [heightHeader, setHeightHeader] = useState(0);
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<Direction>('up');

  const handleScroll = throttle(() => {
    const currentScrollY = (ref.current && ref.current.scrollTop) || 0;
    currentScrollY > heightHeader && prevScrollY < currentScrollY
      ? setDirection('down')
      : setDirection('up');
    prevScrollY = (ref.current && ref.current.scrollTop) || 0;
    onScroll && ref.current && onScroll(ref.current);
  }, 300);

  return (
    <ContextDirectionScroll.Provider value={{ direction, setHeightHeader, ref: ref.current }}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cx(styles.filterWrapper, className && className)}
        style={style}
        onScroll={handleScroll}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </ContextDirectionScroll.Provider>
  );
};

export default FilterScrollProvider;

import { FC, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

import { APP_TITLE } from 'const/app';
import { DOCUMENT_TITLES } from 'const/documentTitles';

import BigHeaderContent from './BigHeaderContent';
import SmallHeaderContent from './SmallHeaderContent';
import { HeaderPageProps } from './types';

const HeaderPage: FC<HeaderPageProps> = ({
  addonLeft,
  addonRight,
  children,
  className,
  documentTitle,
  hide,
  indent,
  leftIconVariant,
  onContentClick,
  onLeftIconClick,
  showDivider,
  size,
  subtitle,
  title,
  withoutMargin,
  isDesktop,
}) => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const [, update] = useState<unknown>();
  const elemRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const localTitle =
      documentTitle ||
      title ||
      Object.entries(DOCUMENT_TITLES).find(([key]) => location.pathname.startsWith(key))?.[1];
    if (localTitle) {
      document.title = `${localTitle} — ${APP_TITLE}`;
      return;
    }
    document.title = APP_TITLE;
  }, [documentTitle, title, location.pathname]);

  useEffect(() => {
    elemRef.current = document.querySelector('#page-header-portal');
    update({});
  }, []);

  const content = children ? (
    children
  ) : size === 'big' ? (
    <BigHeaderContent
      addonRight={addonRight}
      className={className}
      showDivider={showDivider}
      title={title}
      isDesktop={isDesktop}
    />
  ) : (
    <SmallHeaderContent
      addonLeft={addonLeft}
      addonRight={addonRight}
      showDivider={showDivider}
      indent={indent}
      withoutMargin={withoutMargin}
      className={className}
      hide={hide}
      leftIconVariant={leftIconVariant}
      onContentClick={onContentClick}
      onLeftIconClick={onLeftIconClick}
      subtitle={subtitle}
      title={title}
    />
  );

  if (elemRef.current) {
    return createPortal(children ? children : content, elemRef.current);
  }

  return null;
};

HeaderPage.displayName = 'header';

export default HeaderPage;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import IconButton from '@vision/icon-button';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';
import { ReactComponent as CloseSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/close.svg';

import styles from './HeaderPage.module.pcss';
import { ISmallHeaderContentProps } from './types';

const SmallHeaderContent: FC<ISmallHeaderContentProps> = ({
  addonLeft,
  addonRight,
  className,
  hide,
  indent,
  leftIconVariant,
  onContentClick,
  onLeftIconClick,
  showDivider,
  subtitle,
  title,
  withoutMargin,
}) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const haveAddons = addonRight || addonLeft || leftIconVariant;
  const iconAddon =
    leftIconVariant === 'back' ? <BackSvg /> : leftIconVariant === 'close' ? <CloseSvg /> : null;
  const titleHeader = leftIconVariant === 'back' ? 'Назад' : '';

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? (
        <div
          className={cx(styles.headerContainer, className, {
            [styles.headerContainerDivider]: showDivider,
            [styles.headerContainerWithoutAddonRight]: !addonRight,
            [styles.headerHide]: hide,
          })}
        >
          {haveAddons ? (
            addonLeft ? (
              <div className={cx(styles.headerLeft, styles.headerSmall)}>{addonLeft}</div>
            ) : (
              <div className={cx(styles.headerLeft, styles.headerSmall)}>
                <IconButton onClick={onLeftIconClick}>
                  {leftIconVariant === 'back' ? (
                    <BackSvg />
                  ) : leftIconVariant === 'close' ? (
                    <CloseSvg />
                  ) : null}
                </IconButton>
              </div>
            )
          ) : null}
          <div
            className={cx(styles.headerCenter, {
              [styles.headerCenterMaxStretch]: !addonRight,
              [styles.clickable]: onContentClick,
            })}
            onClick={onContentClick}
          >
            <Text className={styles.title} type={'lineSemiBold'}>
              {title}
            </Text>

            {subtitle && (
              <Text className={styles.headerLabel} color="colorForeground2" type="labelSemiBold">
                {subtitle}
              </Text>
            )}
          </div>

          {addonRight && (
            <div className={cx(styles.headerRight, styles.headerSmall)}>{addonRight}</div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.headerButtonWrap}>

import React, { Fragment } from 'react';

import Text, { TextType } from '@aurora/text';

import styles from './HideBalance.module.pcss';

type HideBalanceProps = {
  starsCount: number;
  initialValue?: number;
  textType?: TextType;
};

const HideBalance: React.FC<HideBalanceProps> = ({ starsCount, initialValue, textType }) => {
  const stars = Array.from({ length: starsCount }).map((_, index) => (
    <Fragment key={index}>*</Fragment>
  ));

  if (!initialValue) return <></>;

  const getClassNameColor = () => {
    if (initialValue > 0) {
      return 'plus';
    } else if (initialValue < 0) {
      return 'minus';
    } else if (initialValue === 0) {
      return 'neutral';
    }
    return 'neutral';
  };

  return (
    <span className={styles[getClassNameColor()]}>
      <Text type={textType} tag={'span'}>
        {stars}
      </Text>
    </span>
  );
};

export default HideBalance;

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import styles from 'components/Hint/DynamicHintBottomSheet/DynamicHintBottomSheet.module.pcss';

export type DescriptionFormatterFn = (text: string) => string;

export type BottomSheetHintProps = {
  slug?: string | null;
  title?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  descriptionFormatter?: DescriptionFormatterFn;
};

const DynamicHintBottomSheet = ({
  slug,
  title,
  onClose,
  descriptionFormatter,
}: BottomSheetHintProps) => {
  const { data: hints, isLoading } = useGetHintsQuery(undefined, { skip: !slug });
  const hint = useMemo(() => {
    const text = hints?.hints.find((f) => f?.slug === slug)?.text;
    if (!text) return;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(text)[0];
    } catch {
      return { Description: text };
    }
  }, [hints, slug]);
  return (
    <BottomSheet open={Boolean(slug)} onDismiss={onClose}>
      {isLoading && (
        <div className={styles.loadingContainer}>
          <CircleLoader brandColor />
        </div>
      )}
      {!isLoading && (
        <>
          {(hint?.Title || title) && (
            <Text className={styles.title} type={'subtitleBold'}>
              {hint?.Title ? hint?.Title : title}
            </Text>
          )}
          <div
            className={styles.description}
            dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
              __html: sanitizeHtml(
                descriptionFormatter ? descriptionFormatter(hint?.Description) : hint?.Description,
              ),
            }}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default DynamicHintBottomSheet;

import React, { ReactNode, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { useLazyGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

type Tag = 'div' | 'p' | 'span';

export type DynamicPartialProps = {
  className?: string;
  slug: string | undefined;
  tag?: Tag;
  fallback?: ReactNode;
};

const DynamicPartial = ({ className, slug, fallback, tag = 'div' }: DynamicPartialProps) => {
  const [trigger, result] = useLazyGetHintsQuery();
  const [loadedContent, setLoadedContent] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (slug) {
      trigger();
    }
  }, [slug, trigger]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (slug) {
      const slugText = result.data?.hints.find((item) => item.slug === slug)?.text;
      if (slugText) {
        setLoadedContent(sanitizeHtml(slugText));
      }
    }
  }, [result, slug]);

  return (
    <>
      {loadedContent
        ? React.createElement(tag, {
            className,
            dangerouslySetInnerHTML: { __html: loadedContent },
          })
        : fallback}
    </>
  );
};

export default DynamicPartial;

--- FILE: src\components\InputNewPassword\helpers.ts ---

export const calcPasswordStrength = (password: string) => {
  const numEx = /\d/;
  const lcEx = /[a-z]/;
  const ucEx = /[A-Z]/;
  const syEx = /\W/;
  let character_set_size = 0;

  // loop over each char of the password and check it per regexes above.
  // weight numbers, upper case and lowercase at .75, 1 and .25 respectively.
  if (numEx.test(password)) {
    character_set_size += 10;
  }
  if (ucEx.test(password)) {
    character_set_size += 26;
  }
  if (lcEx.test(password)) {
    character_set_size += 26;
  }
  if (syEx.test(password)) {
    character_set_size += 32;
  }

  // assume that 100% is a meterMult of maxMulti
  const strength = Math.pow(character_set_size, password.length);

  // init crackers at hashes/second
  // all numbers from slowest computer here http://hashcat.net/oclhashcat-plus/
  const rateSHA1 = 433_000_000;

  // calculate a human readable time based on seconds and nodes
  const secSHA1 = Math.floor(strength / rateSHA1 / 86_400);

  return secSHA1 <= 3 ? 1 : secSHA1 <= 7 ? 2 : 3;
};

export const validatePassword = (password: string, pattern: string) => {
  if (new RegExp(pattern).test(password)) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
};

import React, { ChangeEvent, useState } from 'react';

import { IInputProps, InputStatus } from '@vision/input/types';

import { Progress } from 'components';
import InputPassword from 'components/InputPassword';

import { PasswordPolicy } from 'types/auth';

import { calcPasswordStrength, validatePassword } from './helpers';
import { PasswordStrengthDescription } from './types';

const passwordStrengthDescriptionList: Record<number, PasswordStrengthDescription> = {
  1: {
    description: 'Неверный формат',
    percent: 19.51,
    progressStatus: 'danger',
  },
  2: { description: 'Средняя надёжность пароля', percent: 47.52, progressStatus: 'warning' },
  3: { description: 'Высокая надёжность пароля', percent: 87.17, progressStatus: 'success' },
};

type InputNewPasswordProps = Omit<IInputProps, 'onChange' | 'value'> & {
  value: string;
  onChange: (ev: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>, minReqMet: boolean) => void;
  passwordPolicy?: PasswordPolicy | null;
};

const InputNewPassword: React.FC<InputNewPasswordProps> = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  passwordPolicy,
  ...props
}) => {
  const [passDescription, setPassDescription] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [passwordStrength, setPasswordStrength] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<InputStatus>();

  const { pattern, errorMessage } = passwordPolicy || {};

  const handleChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    let minReqMet = false;
    const { value } = event.target;
    if (value) {
      if (pattern && validatePassword(value, pattern)) {
        const passStrength = calcPasswordStrength(value);
        setPasswordStrength(passStrength);
        setPassDescription(passwordStrengthDescriptionList[passStrength].description || null);
        minReqMet = true;
        setStatus('success');
      } else {
        setPassDescription(errorMessage || 'Пароль не удовлетворяет политике безопасности');
        setPasswordStrength(1);
        setStatus('error');
      }
    } else {
      setPasswordStrength(1);
      setPassDescription('Пароль не может быть пустым');
      setStatus('error');
    }
    onChange && onChange(event, minReqMet);
  };

  return (
    <InputPassword
      {...props}
      value={value}
      status={status}
      addonUnder={
        passwordStrength ? (
          <Progress
            status={passwordStrengthDescriptionList[passwordStrength].progressStatus}
            percentage={passwordStrengthDescriptionList[passwordStrength].percent / 100}
          />
        ) : undefined
      }
      description={passDescription}
      onChange={handleChange}
      disabled={!pattern || props.disabled}
    />
  );
};

export default InputNewPassword;

import { calcPasswordStrength, validatePassword } from '../helpers';

const value = 'password';
const value2 = 'password89';
const value3 = 'Password89';
const value4 = 'paSSw99ord';

const pattern =
  '^(?=\\S*?[A-Z])(?=\\S*?[a-z])(?=\\S*?\\d)[A-Za-z0-9!@#$%^&*_\\-\\+=\\,\\.\\<\\>\\?\\ \\"\\\'\\(\\)\\[\\]\\{\\}\\`\\|\\;\\:\\\\\\/\\~]{8,}$';

describe('calcPasswordStrength', () => {
  test('calcPasswordStrength args1', () => {
    expect(calcPasswordStrength(value)).toBe(1);
  });
  test('calcPasswordStrength args2', () => {
    expect(calcPasswordStrength(value2)).toBe(3);
  });
});

describe('validatePassword', () => {
  test('calcPasswordStrength args1', () => {
    expect(validatePassword(value, pattern)).toBe(false);
  });
  test('calcPasswordStrength args2', () => {
    expect(validatePassword(value2, pattern)).toBe(false);
  });
  test('calcPasswordStrength args2', () => {
    expect(validatePassword(value3, pattern)).toBe(true);
  });
  test('calcPasswordStrength args2', () => {
    expect(validatePassword(value4, pattern)).toBe(true);
  });
});

import React, { useEffect, useReducer } from 'react';
import { shallowEqual } from 'react-redux';

import { useUpdateFavoritePutMutation } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { BaseErrorType } from 'core/types';

import { palette } from 'vars';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { ReactComponent as StarFillSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/search/star-fill.svg';
import { ReactComponent as StarSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/search/star.svg';

type Props = {
  className?: string;
  isFavorite?: boolean;
  instrumentId: number;
  tradePlaceId: number;
  onUpdate?: () => void;
};

type State = {
  isFavorite: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
};

const reducer = (
  state: State,
  update: Partial<State> | ((state: State) => Partial<State>),
): State => {
  const newState =
    typeof update === 'function' ? { ...state, ...update(state) } : { ...state, ...update };

  return shallowEqual(state, newState) ? state : newState;
};

const FavoriteButton = ({
  className,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  onUpdate,
  isFavorite: isFavoriteProp = false,
}: Props) => {
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(reducer, null, () => ({
    isFavorite: isFavoriteProp,
    isLoading: false,
  }));
  const [updateFavorite] = useUpdateFavoritePutMutation<BaseErrorType>();

  useEffect(() => {
    setState({
      isFavorite: isFavoriteProp,
      isLoading: false,
    });
  }, [isFavoriteProp, instrumentId, tradePlaceId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state.isLoading) {
      return;
    }

    updateFavorite({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      favorite: !state.isFavorite,
    })
      .unwrap()
      .then(() => {
        setState((prev) => ({ isLoading: false, isFavorite: !prev.isFavorite }));

        !state.isFavorite
          ? createAlertNotification({
              text: 'Добавлено в список отслеживаемых',
              status: 'info',
            })
          : createAlertNotification({
              text: 'Удалено из списка отслеживаемых',
              status: 'info',
            });

        onUpdate && onUpdate();
      })
      .catch(() => {
        createAlertNotification({
          text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
          status: 'error',
        });
        setState({ isLoading: false });
      });
  }, [instrumentId, onUpdate, state.isFavorite, state.isLoading, tradePlaceId, updateFavorite]);

  if (instrumentId == null || tradePlaceId == null) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <button
      className={className}
      type="button"
      onClick={() => setState(() => ({ isLoading: true }))}
      disabled={state.isLoading}
    >
      {state.isFavorite ? (
        <StarFillSvg color={palette.colorAccent} />
      ) : (
        <StarSvg color={palette.colorForeground2} />
      )}
    </button>
  );
};

export default FavoriteButton;

import { CATALOG_GROUP_CODES } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import { Balance, FormattedBalance } from 'components/Balance';
import { InstrumentIcon, SubIcon } from 'components/Instrument';
import { getLinkToInstruments } from 'components/Instrument/helpers/getLinkToInstruments';
import Link from 'components/Link';
import SimpleLine from 'components/SimpleLine';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { IInstrumentCardProps } from './types';

const InstrumentCard: FC<IInstrumentCardProps> = ({
  additionalBlockText,
  categoryName = '',
  className,
  classNameWrapper,
  currencyCode = 'RUB',
  customPriceDiff,
  dataLine,
  disabled,
  expirationDate,
  favorite: isFavorite,
  groupName = '',
  groupType = '',
  hasInvestIdea,
  hasPeriodPriceDiff = true,
  hasPrice = true,
  hasPriceThreshold,
  hasStopOrder,
  instrumentCategoryCode = '',
  instrumentCode,
  instrumentId,
  instrumentImageName,
  instrumentImageTime,
  instrumentName,
  maturityDescription,
  minPrecision = 2,
  notificationTime,
  periodPriceDiff,
  periodPriceDiffPcnt,
  precision = -1,
  price,
  selected,
  status,
  style,
  to,
  tradePlaceId,
  tradePlaceShortName,
  type = CATALOG_GROUP_CODES.shares,
  wrapperStyle,
  yieldSum,
}) => {
  // для корректного отображения сетки
  const isThreeElements = !dataLine || dataLine.length < 2;

  const isBond = type === CATALOG_GROUP_CODES.bonds;
  const isFutures = type === CATALOG_GROUP_CODES.futures;

  const handleClick = useCallback(() => {
    const params = {
      from: 'full_list',
      instrument_code: instrumentCode,
      instrument_id: `${instrumentId}`,
      trade_place_id: `${tradePlaceId}`,
      ...(groupName && { comp_name: groupName }),
      ...(groupType && { comp_type: groupType === 'MANUAL' ? groupType : 'AUTO' }),
      ...(categoryName && { compcategory_name: categoryName }),
      ...(instrumentCategoryCode && { instrument_category: instrumentCategoryCode }),
    };

    reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.compilationRowTap, params);
  }, [
    categoryName,
    groupName,
    groupType,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    instrumentCode,
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
  ]);

  const getCode = () => {
    const code = (
      <div className={styles.code}>
        {instrumentCode} {tradePlaceShortName && <>&bull; {tradePlaceShortName}</>}
      </div>
    );

    if (!status) {
      return code;
    }

    return (
      <div className={styles.codeWrapper}>
        <div className={status === 'A' ? styles.greenCircle : styles.purpleCircle} />
        {code}
      </div>
    );
  };

  //**TODO: временное ограничение для прода */
  const isTestMode = !process.env.TIER || process.env.TIER === 'tt';

  return (
    <Link
      className={cx(
        className,
        styles.instrumentWrapper,
        selected && styles.instrumentWrapperSelected,
        isFutures && styles.instrumentWrapperAdditional,
      )}
      classNameWrapper={classNameWrapper}
      disabled={disabled}
      hasOpacity={false}
      onClick={isTestMode ? handleClick : undefined}
      style={style}
      to={isTestMode ? to || getLinkToInstruments(instrumentId, tradePlaceId) : ''}
      wrapperStyle={wrapperStyle}
    >
      <div className={styles.icon}>
        <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />

        <SubIcon
          className={styles.subIcon}
          isFavorite={isFavorite}
          hasInvestIdea={hasInvestIdea}
          hasPriceThreshold={hasPriceThreshold}
          hasStopOrder={hasStopOrder}
        />
      </div>

      <div className={cx(styles.root, isThreeElements && styles.rootLess)}>
        <div className={cx(styles.info, styles.gap)}>
          <div className={styles.name}>{instrumentName}</div>
          {getCode()}
        </div>

        {dataLine && dataLine.length > 1 ? (
          <SimpleLine
            type={dataLine[0] - dataLine[dataLine.length - 1] > 0 ? 'negative' : 'positive'}
            data={dataLine}
            showPoint={false}
            gradient={false}
            fullSize
            lineType="monotone"
          />
        ) : null}

        <div className={cx(styles.price, styles.gap)}>
          {hasPrice && (
            <FormattedBalance
              type="lineRegular"
              value={price}
              precision={precision}
              minPrecision={minPrecision}
              currency={currencyCode}
            />
          )}

          {customPriceDiff ? (
            customPriceDiff
          ) : !hasPeriodPriceDiff ? null : periodPriceDiff ? (
            <FormattedBalance
              type="labelRegular"
              precision={precision}
              minPrecision={minPrecision}
              value={periodPriceDiff}
              diff={periodPriceDiffPcnt}
              currency={currencyCode}
            />
          ) : maturityDescription ? (
            <div className={styles.priceDescription}>
              <div>
                {yieldSum !== undefined ? (
                  <FormattedBalance
                    className={cx(yieldSum > 0 && styles.green, yieldSum < 0 && styles.red)}
                    type="lineRegular"
                    value={yieldSum}
                    currency={currencyCode}
                  />
                ) : isBond ? (
                  <Balance>–</Balance>
                ) : null}
              </div>
              <div className={styles.priceDescriptionText}>
                <>
                  <>&nbsp;</>
                  {yieldSum !== undefined && <>&bull;</>} {maturityDescription}
                </>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : notificationTime ? (
            <div className={styles.notificationTime}>
              {DateTime.fromISO(notificationTime).toFormat('hh:mm')}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Balance>-</Balance>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div />

      <div className={styles.additionalBlock}>
        {additionalBlockText && (
          <>
            <div>{additionalBlockText}</div>
            <div className={styles.additionalBlockPrice}>
              {expirationDate ? (
                DateTime.fromISO(expirationDate)
                  .toLocaleString(DateTime.DATE_FULL)
                  .replace(' г.', '')
              ) : (
                <Balance>-</Balance>
              )}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </Link>
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentCard);

import { ReactNode } from 'react';

import placeHolder from 'images/icons/fi_placeholder.png';

export const getSrc = (basePath?: ReactNode, fileName = '') => {
  if (fileName === '') return placeHolder;
  if (typeof basePath === 'string') {
    const _basePath = basePath.replace(/(\/*)$/, '');
    const _fileName = fileName.replace(/^(\/*)/, '');

    return `${_basePath}/${_fileName}`;
  }
  return placeHolder;
};

import React, { FC, ReactNode, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENT } from 'const/routes';
import { RootState } from 'store';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { getSrc } from 'components/Instrument/components/InstrumentIcon/helpers';

import placeHolder from 'images/icons/fi_placeholder.png';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

interface ParametersProps {
  name: string;
  value: ReactNode;
}

interface InstrumentIconProps {
  instrumentImageName?: string;
  parameters?: ParametersProps[];
  subtracted?: boolean;
  topLeftIndicator?: ReactNode;
  bottomRightIndicator?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  instrumentId?: string;
  isOtherUnderlyingAsset?: boolean;
}

const clipPathId = 'RoundedImage_clipPath';
const subtractedClipPathId = 'RoundedImage_clipPath_subtracted';
const clipPathHTML = `
  <svg style="position:absolute;width:0;height:0;">
    <clipPath id=${clipPathId}>
      <path d="M23 0C5.11111 0 0 5.11111 0 23C0 40.8889 5.12389 46 23 46C40.8761 46 46 40.8889 46 23C46 5.11111 40.8761 0 23 0Z" />
    </clipPath>
    <clipPath id=${subtractedClipPathId}>
      <path d="M34.9959 1.29407C29.5503 4.89462 27.6533 11.5805 27.6533 23C27.6533 34.4182 29.5546 41.1039 35 44.7047C31.8613 45.62 27.9278 46 23.0444 46C5.13378 46 0 40.8889 0 23C0 5.11111 5.12097 0 23.0444 0C27.9256 0 31.8579 0.379627 34.9959 1.29407Z" />
    </clipPath>
  </svg>
`;

const InstrumentIcon: FC<InstrumentIconProps> = (props) => {
  const {
    instrumentImageName,
    subtracted,
    topLeftIndicator,
    bottomRightIndicator,
    className = '',
    instrumentId,
    isOtherUnderlyingAsset = false,
  } = props;

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const { data: systemParameters } = useAppSelector((state: RootState) => state.systemParameters);

  const basePathName = isOtherUnderlyingAsset ? 'S3.Logo.OtherAsset.Path' : 'S3.Logo.Base.Path';

  const basePath = (systemParameters?.find((param) => param.name === basePathName) || {}).value;

  useEffect(() => {
    const clipPath = document.querySelector(`#${clipPathId}`);
    if (clipPath == null) {
      document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', clipPathHTML);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setError(false);
  }, [instrumentImageName]);

  const href = useMemo(
    () => (error ? placeHolder : getSrc(basePath, instrumentImageName)),
    [basePath, error, instrumentImageName],
  );

  const handleImgClick = () => {
    if (!instrumentId) return;

    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENT, { instrument: instrumentId }));
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={cx(
        [styles.instrumentIcon, subtracted && styles.instrumentIconSubtracted],
        className,
      )}
      onClick={handleImgClick}
    >
      <svg viewBox="0 0 46 46">
        <image
          clipPath={`url(#${subtracted ? subtractedClipPathId : clipPathId})`}
          href={href}
          height="46"
          width="46"
          onError={() => setError(true)}
        />
      </svg>
      <span className={styles.topLeftIndicator}>{topLeftIndicator}</span>
      <span className={styles.bottomRightIndicator}>{bottomRightIndicator}</span>
    </div>
  );
};

export default InstrumentIcon;

import { CSSProperties, FC, memo, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Confirm } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useUpdateFavoriteDeleteMutation } from 'core/api/catalog';

import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';
import { useSwipeable } from 'hooks/useSwipeable';

import FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { ReactComponent as BinSvg } from 'images/icons/bin.svg';
import { ReactComponent as StarSvg } from 'images/icons/star.svg';
import { ReactComponent as StarFillSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/search/star-fill.svg';

import InstrumentCard from '../InstrumentCard';
import styles from './SwipeableInstrumentCard.module.pcss';
import { ISwipeableInstrumentCardProps } from './types';

const SwipeableInstrumentCard: FC<ISwipeableInstrumentCardProps> = (props) => {
  const {
    customFavoriteButton = null,
    favorite,
    groupIdToDelete = null,
    hasDeleteButton = false,
    instrumentId,
    isDragging = false,
    onRefetch,
    tradePlaceId,
  } = props;

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

  const [updateFavoriteDelete] = useUpdateFavoriteDeleteMutation();

  const [isConfirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

  const {
    containerRef,
    buttonsWrapperRef,
    handleTouchEnd,
    handleTouchStart,
    isContainerDimensionsCalculated,
    containerStyle,
    componentStyle: instrumentCardStyle,
  } = useSwipeable(isDragging);

  const openConfirm = () => setConfirmOpen(true);
  const closeConfirm = () => setConfirmOpen(false);

  const onConfirm = async () => {
    await updateFavoriteDelete({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      ...(groupIdToDelete ? { groupList: `${groupIdToDelete}` } : { favorite: true }),
    });

    createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text: 'Бумага удалена' });

    closeConfirm();
    onRefetch?.();
  };

  const customButton = useMemo(
    () =>
      customFavoriteButton || (
        <div className={cx(styles.iconWrapper, styles.iconBlue)}>
          {favorite ? <StarFillSvg /> : <StarSvg />}
        </div>
      ),
    [customFavoriteButton, favorite],
  );

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={cx(styles.container, { [styles.containerDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
      style={isContainerDimensionsCalculated ? (containerStyle as React.CSSProperties) : undefined}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
      onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
    >
      <InstrumentCard
        {...props}
        {...(isContainerDimensionsCalculated && {
          wrapperStyle: isDesktopView ? undefined : (instrumentCardStyle as CSSProperties),
        })}
      />

      {isContainerDimensionsCalculated && (
        <div ref={buttonsWrapperRef} className={styles.buttonsWrapper}>
          <FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet
            customButton={customButton}
            instrumentId={instrumentId}
            isTouchStart
            onRefetch={onRefetch}
            tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
          />

          {hasDeleteButton && (
            <div
              className={cx(styles.iconWrapper, styles.iconRed)}
              // onClick иногда не работает из-за react-beautiful-dnd
              onTouchStart={openConfirm}
            >
              <BinSvg />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <Confirm
        confirmBtnText="Удалить"
        onCancel={closeConfirm}
        onConfirm={onConfirm}
        open={isConfirmOpen}
        title="Вы действительно хотите удалить бумагу?"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(SwipeableInstrumentCard);

import React from 'react';
import { NavLink, LinkProps as RouterLinkProps } from 'react-router-dom';

import cx from 'classnames';

import style from './Link.module.pcss';

export type LinkProps = RouterLinkProps & {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  size?: 's' | 'm';
  negative?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  external?: boolean;
  iconLeft?: React.ReactNode;
  iconRight?: React.ReactNode;
  to: string;
  classNameWrapper?: string;
  wrapperStyle?: React.CSSProperties;
  hasOpacity?: boolean;
};

const Link: React.FC<LinkProps> = ({
  children,
  className,
  classNameWrapper,
  size = 'm',
  disabled,
  external = false,
  negative = false,
  iconLeft = null,
  iconRight = null,
  to,
  wrapperStyle,
  hasOpacity = true,
  ...props
}) => {
  const isDisabled = disabled || (external && typeof to !== 'string');
  const classNames = cx(
    style.link,
    hasOpacity && style.opacity,
    style[size],
    isDisabled && style.disabled,
    className,
    !!props.onClick && !isDisabled && style.clickable,
    negative && style.negative,
  );

  const childrenContent = (
    <>
      {iconLeft && <div className={style.iconLeft}>{iconLeft}</div>}
      {children}
      {iconRight && <div className={style.iconRight}>{iconRight}</div>}
    </>
  );

  const linkComponent = external ? (
    <a {...props} className={classNames} href={to}>
      {childrenContent}
    </a>
  ) : (
    <NavLink
      {...props}
      className={({ isActive }) => (isActive ? cx(classNames, style.active) : classNames)}
      to={to}
    >
      {childrenContent}
    </NavLink>
  );

  return (
    <div className={cx(style.wrapper, classNameWrapper)} style={wrapperStyle}>
      {isDisabled ? <span className={classNames}>{childrenContent}</span> : linkComponent}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Link;

  ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS,

  ROUTE_PROFILE,

  ROUTE_TRANSFERS,
} from 'const/routes';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const isTransfersPath = (pathname: string) =>
  pathname === ROUTE_TRANSFERS ||
  pathname.startsWith(`${ROUTE_TRANSFERS}/`) ||
  pathname === ROUTE_REQUISITES_VIEW;

const menuItems = [
  { id: 'view', name: 'Портфель', url: ROUTE_360, icon: HomeSvg },
  // { id: 'catalog', name: 'Каталог', url: ROUTE_CATALOG, icon: CatalogSvg },
  { id: 'transfers', name: 'Переводы', url: ROUTE_TRANSFERS, icon: TransferSvg },
  // { id: 'feed', name: 'Лента', url: ROUTE_FEED, icon: FeedSvg },
  // { id: 'chat', name: 'Чат', url: ROUTE_CHAT, icon: MessageSvg },
  { id: 'more', name: 'Ещё', url: ROUTE_PROFILE, icon: MoreSvg },
];

const MobileMenu: FC = () => {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { session } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state);

  const handleClick = (url: string) => {
    if (url === ROUTE_CATALOG) {
      reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.catalogView);
    }
  };

  const filteredMenuItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (!session.data?.chatEnabled) {
      return menuItems.filter(({ id }) => id !== 'chat');
    }

    return menuItems;
  }, [session.data?.chatEnabled]);

  const isFavorites = pathname === ROUTE_FAVORITES_360 || pathname === ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS;

  return (
    <div className={cn(styles.menu, { [styles.menuFixed]: isFavorites })}>
      {!session.data ? (
        <SkeletonMobileMenu />
      ) : (
        <>
          {filteredMenuItems.map(({ id, url, name, icon: Icon }, index) => (
            <Fragment key={`${index}-${id}`}>
              {url && (
                <NavLink
                  className={({ isActive }) =>
                    cn(styles.menuItem, {
                      [styles.menuItemActive]:
                        isActive || (id === 'transfers' && isTransfersPath(pathname)),
                    })
                  }
                  onClick={() => handleClick(url)}
                  to={url}
                >
                  <Icon />

                  {name}
                </NavLink>
              )}
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(MobileMenu);

import React from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Popup } from '@aurora/components';

import { ModalCommonSelectTypes } from 'components/ModalCommonSelect/types';

import styles from './ModalCommonSelect.module.pcss';

const ModalCommonSelect: React.FC<ModalCommonSelectTypes> = ({
  isDesktopView,
  children,
  open,
  onDismiss,
  className,
  shape = 'bsh_popup',
  ...props
}) => {
  if (shape === 'sms') {
    return !isDesktopView ? (
      <>{children}</>
    ) : (
      <Popup
        {...props}
        onClickCloseCross={onDismiss}
        onClickOutside={onDismiss}
        className={styles.animation}
      >
        {children}
      </Popup>
    );
  }

  return !isDesktopView ? (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss} className={className} {...props}>
      {children}
    </BottomSheet>
  ) : (
    <>
      {open && (
        <Popup
          {...props}
          onClickCloseCross={onDismiss}
          onClickOutside={onDismiss}
          className={styles.animation}
        >
          {children}
        </Popup>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default ModalCommonSelect;

import React, { FC, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Confirm, Text, TextArea, useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { useCreateNoteMutation, useDeleteNoteMutation, useEditNoteMutation } from 'core/api/notes';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import { KEYBOARD_BLUR_DELAY_MS, NOTE_CHANGED, NOTE_COUNT } from 'components/Notes/constants';
import { CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetProps } from 'components/Notes/types';
import { addSpaces, fortmatDate } from 'components/Notes/utils';

import { ReactComponent as BinSvg } from 'images/icons/bin.svg';

import styles from './CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet: FC<CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  noteId,
  changeTime,
  text,
  futureInstrumentInfo,
  onCreate,
  onDismiss,
}) => {
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();

  const isNewNote = noteId === undefined || changeTime === undefined || text === undefined;

  const [deleteNote] = useDeleteNoteMutation();
  const [createNote] = useCreateNoteMutation();
  const [editNote] = useEditNoteMutation();

  const isTextAreaBlured = useRef(false);
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isConfirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

  const formattedDate = useMemo(() => {
    return fortmatDate(isNewNote || changeTime === undefined ? DateTime.utc().toISO() : changeTime);
  }, [isNewNote, changeTime]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: TouchEvent) => e.preventDefault();

    document.body.addEventListener('touchmove', handler);
    return () => document.body.removeEventListener('touchmove', handler);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setValue('');
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setValue(text === undefined ? '' : text);
  }, [text]);

  const setTextAreaRef = useCallback((node: HTMLTextAreaElement) => {
    if (node && !isTextAreaBlured.current) {
      isTextAreaBlured.current = true;

      setTimeout(() => {
        node.blur();
      }, KEYBOARD_BLUR_DELAY_MS);
    }
  }, []);

  const currentCount = value !== null ? NOTE_COUNT - value.length : null;

  const handleOpenConfirm = () => setConfirmOpen(true);
  const handleCloseConfirm = () => setConfirmOpen(false);

  const handleCreateOrEditNote = async () => {
    if (isNewNote && instrumentId !== undefined && tradePlaceId !== undefined && value) {
      onDismiss();
      setValue(null);

      await createNote({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, text: value.trim() });

      if (futureInstrumentInfo && onCreate) {
        const { instrumentName, instrumentCode, tradePlaceCode, instrumentImageName } =
          futureInstrumentInfo;

        onCreate({
          instrumentId,
          tradePlaceId,
          instrumentName,
          instrumentCode,
          tradePlaceCode,
          instrumentImageName,
        });
      }

      createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text: 'Заметка сохранена' });
      Notifications.emit(NOTE_CHANGED);

      return;
    }

    if (!isNewNote && value) {
      onDismiss();
      setValue(null);

      await editNote({ noteId, text: value.trim() });
      createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text: 'Заметка сохранена' });
      Notifications.emit(NOTE_CHANGED);

      return;
    }

    if (!isNewNote && !value) {
      handleOpenConfirm();

      return;
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteNote = async () => {
    handleCloseConfirm();
    onDismiss();
    setValue(null);

    if (!isNewNote) {
      await deleteNote(noteId);
      createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text: 'Заметка удалена' });
      Notifications.emit(NOTE_CHANGED);
    }
  };

  const showSnackbar = () => {
    snackbarTopAlert?.closeAll();
    snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      label: 'Вы достигли лимита по количеству символов в одной заметке',
    });
  };

  const handleValueChange = ({ value: newValue }: { value: string }) => {
    setValue((prevValue) => {
      if (prevValue === null) {
        return null;
      }

      if (prevValue.length < NOTE_COUNT && newValue.length > NOTE_COUNT) {
        showSnackbar();
        return newValue.slice(0, NOTE_COUNT);
      }

      if (prevValue.length === NOTE_COUNT && newValue.length > NOTE_COUNT) {
        showSnackbar();
        return prevValue;
      }

      if (prevValue.length === NOTE_COUNT && newValue.length < NOTE_COUNT) {
        return newValue;
      }

      if (newValue.length === NOTE_COUNT) {
        showSnackbar();
      }

      return newValue;
    });
  };

  const header = (
    <React.Fragment>
      {isNewNote ? (
        <Text type="subtitleSemiBold">Новая заметка</Text>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.binIconWrapper} onClick={handleOpenConfirm}>
          <BinSvg />
        </div>
      )}

      {value !== null && (
        <div onClick={handleCreateOrEditNote}>
          <Text
            type="lineRegular"
            color={isNewNote && !value.length ? 'colorForeground2' : 'colorAccent'}
          >
            Готово
          </Text>
        </div>
      )}
    </React.Fragment>
  );

  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <BottomSheet
        open={isOpen}
        expandOnContentDrag={false}
        header={header}
        className={styles.bottomSheet}
        onDismiss={() => {
          onDismiss();
          setValue(null);
        }}
      >
        <div className={cx(styles.infoWrapper, { [styles.infoWrapperRight]: isNewNote })}>
          {!isNewNote && (
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              {formattedDate}
            </Text>
          )}

          {currentCount !== null && (
            <Text
              type="labelRegular"
              color={currentCount <= 10 ? 'colorDestructive' : 'colorForeground2'}
            >
              {addSpaces(`${currentCount}`)}
            </Text>
          )}
        </div>

        {value !== null && (
          <TextArea
            ref={setTextAreaRef}
            placeholder="Оставьте заметку по бумаге"
            value={{ value }}
            className={cx(
              styles.textArea,
              isNewNote ? styles.textAreaSmallMarginTop : styles.textAreaLargeMarginTop,
            )}
            onChange={handleValueChange}
          />
        )}
      </BottomSheet>

      <Confirm
        open={isConfirmOpen}
        title="Вы действительно хотите удалить заметку?"
        confirmBtnText="Удалить"
        onCancel={handleCloseConfirm}
        onConfirm={handleDeleteNote}
      />
    </React.Fragment>
  );
};

export default memo(CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet);

      <LargeBlock className={hasInstrument ? styles.marginTopLarge : styles.marginTopMedium} />

import { CSSProperties, FC, TouchEvent, memo, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import Confirm from '@aurora/confirm';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { useDeleteNoteMutation } from 'core/api/notes';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { useSwipeable } from 'hooks/useSwipeable';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import { Note } from 'components/Notes';
import { NOTE_CHANGED } from 'components/Notes/constants';
import { NoteProps } from 'components/Notes/types';

import { ReactComponent as BinSvg } from 'images/icons/bin.svg';

import styles from './SwipeableNote.module.pcss';

const SwipeableNote: FC<NoteProps & { containerClassName?: string }> = (props) => {
  const { noteId, text, containerClassName } = props;

  const [deleteNote] = useDeleteNoteMutation();

  const mounted = useRef(false);
  const [isConfirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

  const {
    containerRef,
    buttonsWrapperRef,
    handleTouchEnd,
    handleTouchStart,
    isContainerDimensionsCalculated,
    containerStyle,
    componentStyle: noteStyle,
    recalculateContainerHeight,
  } = useSwipeable(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mounted.current) {
      recalculateContainerHeight();
    } else {
      mounted.current = true;
    }
  }, [text, recalculateContainerHeight]);

  const handleCloseConfirm = () => setConfirmOpen(false);

  const handleDeleteNote = async () => {
    handleCloseConfirm();
    await deleteNote(noteId);
    createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text: 'Заметка удалена' });
    Notifications.emit(NOTE_CHANGED);
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={cx(styles.container, containerClassName)}
      style={isContainerDimensionsCalculated ? (containerStyle as CSSProperties) : undefined}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
      onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
    >
      <Note
        {...props}
        className={styles.note}
        style={isContainerDimensionsCalculated ? (noteStyle as CSSProperties) : undefined}
      />

      {isContainerDimensionsCalculated && (
        <div
          ref={buttonsWrapperRef}
          className={styles.binIconWrapper}
          // onClick иногда не работает из-за react-beautiful-dnd
          onTouchStart={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}
        >
          <BinSvg />
        </div>
      )}

      <Confirm
        open={isConfirmOpen}
        title="Вы действительно хотите удалить заметку?"
        confirmBtnText="Удалить"
        onCancel={handleCloseConfirm}
        onConfirm={handleDeleteNote}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(SwipeableNote);
