import React, { FC, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import BottomSheet from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENT } from 'const/routes';

import { useLazyGetPersonsCurrentNotesInstrumentQuery } from 'core/api/notes';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { InstrumentCardWithButton } from 'components/Instrument';
import { CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet } from 'components/Notes';
import ErrorOrEmpty from 'components/Notes/components/InstrumentNotesBottomSheet/components/ErrorOrEmpty';
import Skeleton from 'components/Notes/components/InstrumentNotesBottomSheet/components/Skeleton';
import SwipeableNote from 'components/Notes/components/InstrumentNotesBottomSheet/components/SwipeableNote';
import { NOTE_CHANGED, ROWS_COUNT, ROWS_OFFSET } from 'components/Notes/constants';
import {
  InstrumentNotesBottomSheetProps,
  OpenedCreateOrEditNoteDataType,
} from 'components/Notes/types';

import styles from './InstrumentNotesBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const InstrumentNotesBottomSheet: FC<InstrumentNotesBottomSheetProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  instrumentName,
  instrumentCode,
  instrumentImageName,
  tradePlaceCode,
  onDismiss,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const hasInstrument = !!(
    instrumentName &&
    instrumentCode &&
    instrumentImageName &&
    tradePlaceCode
  );

  const [getPersonsCurrentNotesInstrument, { isError, data }] =
    useLazyGetPersonsCurrentNotesInstrumentQuery();

  const [openedCreateOrEditNoteData, setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData] =
    useState<OpenedCreateOrEditNoteDataType | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = () => {
      if (isOpen && instrumentId && tradePlaceId) {
        getPersonsCurrentNotesInstrument({
          instrumentId,
          tradePlaceId,
          rowsOffset: ROWS_OFFSET,
          rowsCount: ROWS_COUNT,
        });
      }
    };

    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe(NOTE_CHANGED, listener);

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [isOpen, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, getPersonsCurrentNotesInstrument]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && instrumentId && tradePlaceId) {
      getPersonsCurrentNotesInstrument({
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
        rowsOffset: ROWS_OFFSET,
        rowsCount: ROWS_COUNT,
      });
    }
  }, [isOpen, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, getPersonsCurrentNotesInstrument]);

  const handleNavigateToInstrumentPage = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENT, { instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}` }));
  };

  const handleNoteClick = useCallback(
    ({ noteId, text, changeTime }: { noteId: number; text: string; changeTime: string }) => {
      if (instrumentId && tradePlaceId) {
        setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, noteId, text, changeTime });
      }
    },
    [instrumentId, tradePlaceId],
  );

  const handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss = useCallback(
    () => setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData(null),
    [],
  );

  const handleCreateNewNoteClick = useCallback(() => {
    if (instrumentId !== undefined && tradePlaceId !== undefined) {
      setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });
    }
  }, [instrumentId, tradePlaceId]);

  const getContent = () => {
    if (!instrumentId || !tradePlaceId) {
      return null;
    }

    const instrumentCard = hasInstrument && (
      <InstrumentCardWithButton
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
        instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
        tradePlaceCode={tradePlaceCode}
        className={styles.instrumentCard}
        onClick={handleNavigateToInstrumentPage}
      />
    );

    if (isError) {
      return (
        <React.Fragment>
          {instrumentCard}

          <ErrorOrEmpty isError />
        </React.Fragment>
      );
    }

    if (!data) {
      return <Skeleton hasInstrument={hasInstrument} />;
    }

    const { notes } = data;

    if (!notes.length) {
      return (
        <React.Fragment>
          {instrumentCard}

          <ErrorOrEmpty isError={false} />
        </React.Fragment>
      );
    }

    return (
      <React.Fragment>
        {instrumentCard}

        {notes.map(({ noteId, text, changeTime }, index) => (
          <SwipeableNote
            key={noteId}
            noteId={noteId}
            text={text}
            changeTime={changeTime}
            instrumentId={instrumentId}
            tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
            containerClassName={
              index ? styles.swipeableNoteContainer : styles.firstSwipeableNoteContainer
            }
            onClick={handleNoteClick}
          />
        ))}
      </React.Fragment>
    );
  };

  const header = (
    <React.Fragment>
      <Text type="subtitleSemiBold">Заметки</Text>

      <Button className={styles.button} variant="link" onClick={handleCreateNewNoteClick}>
        <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorAccent">
          Создать
        </Text>
      </Button>
    </React.Fragment>
  );

  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <BottomSheet
        open={isOpen}
        expandOnContentDrag={false}
        header={header}
        className={styles.bottomSheet}
        onDismiss={onDismiss}
      >
        {getContent()}
      </BottomSheet>

      <CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedCreateOrEditNoteData}
        instrumentId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.tradePlaceId}
        noteId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.noteId}
        text={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.text}
        changeTime={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.changeTime}
        onDismiss={handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss}
      />
    </React.Fragment>
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentNotesBottomSheet);

import { FC, memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cx from 'classnames';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { NoteProps } from 'components/Notes/types';
import { fortmatDate } from 'components/Notes/utils';

import styles from './Note.module.pcss';

const Note: FC<NoteProps> = ({
  isInCarousel = false,
  noteId,
  text,
  changeTime,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  className,
  style,
  onClick,
}) => {
  const formattedDate = useMemo(() => fortmatDate(changeTime), [changeTime]);
  const formattedText = useMemo(() => text.replace(/\r\n|\r|\n/g, '<br />'), [text]);

  return (
    <div
      className={cx(styles.container, className)}
      style={style}
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClick({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, noteId, text, changeTime });
      }}
    >
      <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
        {formattedDate}
      </Text>

      <p
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sanitizeHtml(formattedText) }}
        className={cx(styles.text, isInCarousel ? styles.twoLines : styles.fourLines)}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(Note);

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { isToday } from 'modules/Notification/helpers';

export const isYesterday = (date: string) => {
  const formattedDate = DateTime.fromISO(date).plus({ days: 1 });
  return isToday(formattedDate.toISODate());
};

export const fortmatDate = (changeTime: string) => {
  const luxonDate = DateTime.fromISO(changeTime);

  if (isToday(changeTime)) {
    return `Сегодня, ${luxonDate.toFormat('HH:mm')}`;
  }

  if (isYesterday(changeTime)) {
    return `Вчера, ${luxonDate.toFormat('HH:mm')}`;
  }

  return luxonDate.toFormat('d.LL.y, HH:mm');
};

export const addSpaces = (str: string) => {
  const remainder = str.length % 3;
  return (str.slice(0, remainder) + str.slice(remainder).replace(/(\d{3})/g, ' $1')).trim();
};

import React, { useRef } from 'react';

import Checkbox from '@aurora/checkbox';
import Text from '@vision/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import CheckedIcon from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/CheckedIcon';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const formatIconText = (text: string) => {
  return text.length <= 2 ? (
    text
  ) : (
    <>
      <div className={styles.iconFirstColumn}>
        <div>{text.slice(0, 1)}</div>
        <div className={styles.gridFirstColumn}>{text.slice(1, 2)}</div>
      </div>

      <div>{text.slice(2)}</div>
    </>
  );
};

export type Option<Id extends string | number> = {
  id: Id;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactElement | string;
  disabled?: boolean;
};

interface OptionsListProps<Id extends string | number> {
  inputPosition?: 'left' | 'right';
  options: Option<Id>[];
  selectedOption?: Option<Id>;
  selectedOptions?: Option<Id>[];
  type?: 'check' | 'circle' | 'multi';
  className?: string;
  onChange: (option: Option<Id>) => void;
  onClick?: () => void;
}
const OptionsList = <Id extends string | number>({
  inputPosition = 'right',
  options,
  selectedOption,
  selectedOptions,
  type = 'check',
  className,
  onChange,
  onClick,
}: OptionsListProps<Id>) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLLabelElement[]>([]);

  const handleClick = (index: number) => (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (type !== 'multi' && ref.current.length > 0) {
      ref.current[index].click();
      onClick && onClick();
    }
  };

  const handleChange = (option: Option<Id>) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    onChange(option);
  };

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      {options.map((option, index) => {
        const { id, title, description, icon, disabled } = option;

        const label = type !== 'multi' && (
          <label
            ref={(el) => (ref.current[index] = el as HTMLLabelElement)}
            htmlFor={id as string}
            className={cn(styles.labelText, { [styles.cardWithIcon]: icon })}
          >
            <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.title}>
              {title}
            </Text>
            {description && (
              <Text
                type="labelRegular"
                className={cn(styles.descr, { [styles.descCheck]: type === 'check' })}
              >
                {description}
              </Text>
            )}
          </label>
        );

        const inputTable = {
          circle: (
            <input
              id={id as string}
              name={title}
              type="radio"
              className={cn(
                styles.radioButtonIcon,
                inputPosition === 'right'
                  ? styles.radioButtonIconRight
                  : styles.radioButtonIconLeft,
                { [styles.cardWithIcon]: icon },
              )}
              checked={selectedOption?.id === id}
              onChange={handleChange(option)}
              disabled={disabled}
            />
          ),
          check: (
            <React.Fragment>
              <input
                id={id as string}
                name={title}
                type="radio"
                className={styles.hiddenRadio}
                checked={selectedOption?.id === id}
                onChange={handleChange(option)}
                disabled={disabled}
              />
              <div className={cn(styles.check, { [styles.cardWithIcon]: icon })}>
                {selectedOption?.id === id && <CheckedIcon />}
              </div>
            </React.Fragment>
          ),
          multi: (
            <Checkbox
              checked={selectedOptions?.some(({ id: selectedOptionId }) => selectedOptionId === id)}
              label={title}
              className={styles.checkbox}
              onChange={handleChange(option)}
            />
          ),
        };

        const input = inputTable[type];

        return (
          <div className={styles.listItem} onClick={handleClick(index)} key={id}>
            <div className={styles.radioButton}>
              {!icon ? null : typeof icon === 'string' ? (
                <div
                  className={cn(styles.icon, styles.createdIcon, {
                    [styles.disabled]: disabled,
                    [styles.flexCreatedIcon]: icon.length === 3,
                  })}
                >
                  {formatIconText(icon)}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className={styles.icon}>{icon}</div>
              )}
              {inputPosition === 'right' ? (
                <React.Fragment>
                  {label}
                  {input}
                </React.Fragment>
              ) : (
                <React.Fragment>
                  {input}
                  {label}
                </React.Fragment>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default OptionsList;

import React from 'react';
import { Sector } from 'recharts';

const DEFAULT_OUTER_RADIUS_RATIO = 1.03;

type Props = {
  className?: string;
  cx?: number;
  cy?: number;
  innerRadius?: number;
  outerRadius?: number;
  outerRadiusRatio?: number;
  startAngle?: number;
  endAngle?: number;
  fill?: string;
};

const ActiveShape = ({
  className,
  cx,
  cy,
  innerRadius,
  outerRadius,
  startAngle,
  endAngle,
  fill,
  outerRadiusRatio = DEFAULT_OUTER_RADIUS_RATIO,
}: Props) => {
  const outer = typeof outerRadius === 'number' ? outerRadius * outerRadiusRatio : outerRadius;

  return (
    <Sector
      className={className}
      cx={cx}
      cy={cy}
      innerRadius={innerRadius}
      outerRadius={outer}
      startAngle={startAngle}
      endAngle={endAngle}
      fill={fill}
    />
  );
};

export default ActiveShape;

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

import { Cell, Pie, PieChart as PieChartContainer } from 'recharts';

import ActiveShape from './components/ActiveShape';
import { DEFAULT_INACTIVE_COLOR } from './constants';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  className?: string;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
  data: Record<string, unknown>[];
  dataKey?: string;
  selected?: number;
  onSelectedChange?: (index: number) => void;
  inactiveColor?: string;
  isAnimationActive?: boolean;
  colors: string[];
};

const PieChart = ({
  className,
  colors,
  selected,
  title,
  onSelectedChange,
  data,
  dataKey = 'value',
  isAnimationActive = false,
  inactiveColor = DEFAULT_INACTIVE_COLOR,
}: Props) => {
  const { onMouseEnter, onMouseLeave } = useMemo(
    () => ({
      onMouseEnter(_: unknown, index: number) {
        if (typeof onSelectedChange !== 'function') return;
        onSelectedChange(index);
      },
      onMouseLeave() {
        if (typeof onSelectedChange !== 'function') return;
        onSelectedChange(-1);
      },
    }),
    [onSelectedChange],
  );

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div className={styles.innerContainer}>
        <PieChartContainer width={268} height={268}>
          <Pie
            dataKey={dataKey}
            data={data}
            innerRadius={'75%'}
            outerRadius={'94%'}
            startAngle={90}
            endAngle={-270}
            label={false}
            activeIndex={selected}
            onMouseMove={onMouseEnter}
            onMouseLeave={onMouseLeave}
            activeShape={<ActiveShape />}
            isAnimationActive={isAnimationActive}
          >
            {data.map((_, index) => {
              const fill =
                Array.isArray(colors) && (selected == null || selected < 0 || selected === index)
                  ? colors[index % colors.length]
                  : inactiveColor;

              return <Cell className={styles.sector} key={index} stroke="none" fill={fill} />;
            })}
          </Pie>
        </PieChartContainer>

        <div className={styles.overlay}>
          <div className={styles.overlayInner}>{title != null && title}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PieChart;

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { ReactComponent as ArrowDownSvg } from 'images/icons/arrow-down.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ArrowUpSvg } from 'images/icons/arrow-up.svg';

import ChartLegend from '../ChartLegend';
import PieChart, { PieChartLabel } from '../PieChart';
import {
  DEFAULT_DATA_MAX_LENGTH,
  OTHER_CATEGORY_COLOR,
  OTHER_CATEGORY_TEXT_COLOR,
  PIE_COLORS,
} from './constants';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { PieChartDataItem } from './types';

type Props = {
  className?: string;
  legendClassName?: string;
  data: PieChartDataItem[];
  /** Скрывать другие категории, если их больше этого числа */
  maxLength?: number;
  /** Блок внутри диаграммы */
  chartLabel?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Состояние загрузки */
  isLoading?: boolean;
  /** Элемент лоадера */
  loader?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Заголовок внутри карточки */
  header?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Футер внутри карточки */
  footer?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Цвета графика */
  colors?: string[];
  /** Цвета значений в легенде */
  textColors?: string[];
  /** Цвет для группы Прочее */
  otherColor?: string;
  /** Цвет значения в легенде для категории Прочее */
  otherTextColor?: string;
  /** Минимальное значение */
  minValue?: number;
  valueFractionDigits?: number;
  percentFractionDigits?: number;
};

const PieChartWithLegend = ({
  className,
  legendClassName,
  data,
  chartLabel,
  maxLength = DEFAULT_DATA_MAX_LENGTH,
  colors = PIE_COLORS,
  textColors = PIE_COLORS,
  otherColor = OTHER_CATEGORY_COLOR,
  otherTextColor = OTHER_CATEGORY_TEXT_COLOR,
  minValue,
  percentFractionDigits,
}: Props) => {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(-1);
  const onSelectedChange = useCallback((index: number) => {
    setSelected(index);
  }, []);

  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(true);
  const [filteredData, computedColors, computedTextColors] = useMemo(() => {
    if (data.length > maxLength) {
      const max = maxLength - 1;
      const lastItem = data.slice(max).reduce(
        (acc, item) => {
          acc.percents += item.percents;

          return acc;
        },
        { name: 'Другое', percents: 0 },
      );

      const filteredData = [...data.slice(0, max), lastItem];

      const computedColors = filteredData.map((_, index) =>
        index < max ? colors[index % colors.length] : otherColor,
      );

      const computedTextColors = filteredData.map((_, index) =>
        index < max ? textColors[index % textColors.length] : otherTextColor,
      );

      return [filteredData, computedColors, computedTextColors];
    }

    return [data, colors, textColors];
  }, [data, maxLength, colors, textColors, otherColor, otherTextColor]);

  const currentData = collapsed ? filteredData : data;
  const currentColors = collapsed ? computedColors : colors;
  const currentTextColors = collapsed ? computedTextColors : textColors;

  const [title, setTitle] = useState<React.ReactNode>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selected < 0) {
      setTitle(null);
    } else {
      const { name, percents } = currentData[selected];

      setTitle(<PieChartLabel title={name} value={percents} currencyCode={'PRC'} />);
    }
  }, [currentData, selected]);

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <PieChart
        className={styles.chart}
        data={currentData}
        dataKey={'percents'}
        selected={selected}
        colors={currentColors}
        title={title || chartLabel}
        onSelectedChange={onSelectedChange}
      />
      <div className={legendClassName}>
        <ChartLegend
          data={currentData}
          selected={selected}
          colors={currentColors}
          textColors={currentTextColors}
          onSelectedChange={onSelectedChange}
          minValue={minValue}
          percentFractionDigits={percentFractionDigits}
        />
        {data.length > maxLength && (
          <button
            className={styles.toggleButton}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setCollapsed((prev) => !prev)}
          >
            <span>Показать {collapsed ? 'больше' : 'меньше'}</span>
            <span className={styles.toggleButtonIcon}>
              {collapsed && <ArrowDownSvg />}
              {!collapsed && <ArrowUpSvg />}
            </span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PieChartWithLegend;

import { ChangeEvent, FC, useState } from 'react';

import cn from 'classnames';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  count: number;
  onTradePasswordFulfilled: (password: string) => void;
};

const PinCodeInput: FC<Props> = ({ count, onTradePasswordFulfilled }) => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState('');

  const onChange = async ({ target: { value } }: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (value.length > count) return false;

    setValue(value);

    if (value.length === count) {
      await onTradePasswordFulfilled(value);
      setValue('');
    }
  };
  // eslint-disable-next-line unicorn/new-for-builtins
  const DOTS: number[] = Array.from(Array(count), () => 0);

  return (
    <div>
      <input
        autoFocus
        id="pinInput"
        type="tel"
        pattern={'[0-9]*'}
        inputMode={'numeric'}
        name="pin"
        className={styles.visuallyHidden}
        value={value}
        onChange={onChange}
        maxLength={count}
        autoComplete="off"
      />
      {DOTS.map((_, index) => (
        <span
          key={index}
          className={cn(styles.indicator, index < value.length && styles.active)}
        ></span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PinCodeInput;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useDispatch, useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { Navigate, Outlet } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_LOGIN } from 'const/routes';
import { RootState } from 'store';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { setupUserId } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { resetStore } from 'core/helpers/resetStore';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';
import { fetchPermissions } from 'core/permissions/permissionsSlice';
import { hasClientSession } from 'core/session/clientSession';
import { fetchSession } from 'core/session/sessionSlice';
import { fetchSystemParams } from 'core/systemParameters/systemParametersSlice';
import { fetchTradeSessionStatus, updateTradeSession } from 'core/tradeSession/tradeSessionSlice';

import { useUpdateSessionInfoBackground } from 'hooks/useUpdateSessionInfoBackground';

import { initCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/helpers';

import DesktopMenu from 'components/DesktopMenu';
import Header from 'components/Header';
import MobileMenu from 'components/MobileMenu';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type PrivatePageProps = {
  showMenu: boolean;
};

const LOADED_STATUSES = ['error', 'success'];

const PrivatePage: React.FC<PrivatePageProps> = ({ showMenu }) => {
  const [started, setStarted] = useState(false);
  const [showLoader, setShowLoader] = useState(true);
  const {
    session: { data: sessionData, status: sessionStatus },
    systemParameters: { status: systemParametersStatus },
    tradeSession: { status: tradeSessionStatus },
    permissions: { status: permissionsStatus },
  } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state);
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { SnackbarsInfoContainer } = useSnackbars();

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

  useEffect(() => {
    initCatalogFilters();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sessionData || sessionData.personId == null) return;
    setupUserId(sessionData.personId);
  }, [sessionData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!started) {
      setStarted(true);
      dispatch(fetchSession());
      dispatch(fetchSystemParams());
      dispatch(fetchTradeSessionStatus());
      dispatch(fetchPermissions());
    }
  }, [dispatch, started]);

  useEffect(() => {
    Notifications.reopenNotifications();

    Notifications.subscribe('TradeSessionChanged', (response) => {
      Promise.resolve(response)
        .then(({ response: { TradeSessionList: session } }) => {
          updateTradeSession({ session });
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          //
        });
    });
    Notifications.subscribe('SessionClosed', () => {
      resetStore();
      window.location.href = '/login';
    });
  }, []);

  useUpdateSessionInfoBackground();

  const allLoaded =
    started &&
    LOADED_STATUSES.includes(sessionStatus) &&
    LOADED_STATUSES.includes(systemParametersStatus) &&
    LOADED_STATUSES.includes(tradeSessionStatus) &&
    LOADED_STATUSES.includes(permissionsStatus);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (allLoaded) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setShowLoader(false);
      }, 500);

      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    } else {
      setShowLoader(true);
    }
  }, [allLoaded]);

  if (showLoader) {
    return <CircleLoader brandColor type="page" />;
  }

  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.layout, { [styles.desktopWrapper]: isDesktopView })}>
      {isDesktopView && <DesktopMenu />}
      <div className={cx(styles.content, { [styles.desktop]: isDesktopView })}>
        {isDesktopView && <Header />}
        <Outlet />
        <SnackbarsInfoContainer className={styles.cusomSnackBarContainer} />
        {isDesktopView && <div id="addon-layout-bottom" />}
      </div>
      {isMobile && <div id="addon-layout-bottom" />}
      {isMobile && showMenu && <MobileMenu />}
    </div>
  );
};

/** Не монтируем PrivatePage без клиентской сессии — иначе bootstrap GET уходят до /login. */
const PrivatePageGuard: React.FC<PrivatePageProps> = (props) => {
  if (!hasClientSession()) {
    return <Navigate to={ROUTE_LOGIN} replace />;
  }
  return <PrivatePage {...props} />;
};

export default PrivatePageGuard;

--- FILE: src\components\ScrollProvider\ScrollProvider.tsx ---

import { FC, createContext, memo, useContext, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';
import { throttle } from 'lodash';

import styles from './style.module.pcss';
import { IContext, IScrollProvider, TDirection } from './types';

const ContextDirectionScroll = createContext<IContext>({
  direction: 'up',
  ref: null,
});

export const useScrollContext = () => {
  const direction = useContext(ContextDirectionScroll);

  if (direction === null) {
    throw new Error(
      'You must to wrap your scrollable component with FilterScrollProvider to using useScrollContext hook',
    );
  }

  return direction;
};

const ScrollProvider: FC<IScrollProvider> = ({ children, className, onScroll, style }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [prevScrollY, setPrevScrollY] = useState(0);
  const [heightHeader, setHeightHeader] = useState(0);
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState<TDirection>('up');

  const handleScroll = throttle(() => {
    const currentScrollY = ref?.current?.scrollTop || 0;

    currentScrollY > heightHeader && prevScrollY < currentScrollY
      ? setDirection('down')
      : setDirection('up');

    setPrevScrollY(currentScrollY);

    ref?.current && onScroll?.(ref.current);
  }, 300);

  return (
    <ContextDirectionScroll.Provider value={{ direction, setHeightHeader, ref: ref.current }}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cx(styles.scrollWrapper, className)}
        style={style}
        onScroll={handleScroll}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </ContextDirectionScroll.Provider>
  );
};

export default memo(ScrollProvider);

import { CSSProperties, Dispatch, ReactNode, SetStateAction } from 'react';

export type TDirection = 'up' | 'down';

export interface IContext {
  direction: TDirection;
  setHeightHeader?: Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>;
  ref: HTMLDivElement | null;
}

export interface IScrollProvider {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  height?: number;
  onScroll?: (ref: HTMLDivElement) => void;
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

import { FC, createElement } from 'react';

import cn from 'classnames';

import styles from './Section.module.pcss';
import { ISectionProps } from './types';

/**
 * Обёртка для блока с вертикальными отступами
 */

const Section: FC<ISectionProps> = ({
  children,
  className = '',
  id,
  padding,
  sectionRef,
  tag = 'section',
  theme = 'Light',
  ...rest
}) => {
  const props = {
    className: cn(
      styles.section,
      styles[`sectionTheme${theme}`],
      styles[`sectionPadding${padding}`],
      {
        [className]: className,
      },
    ),
    id,
    ref: sectionRef,
    ...rest,
  };

  return createElement(tag, props, children);
};

Section.displayName = 'Section';

export default Section;

import { ReactNode } from 'react';

export type TSectionPadding = 'none' | 'xxs' | 'xs' | 's' | 'sm' | 'm' | 'l' | 'xl' | 'xxl';
export type TSectionTags = 'div' | 'section' | 'article';
export type TSectionThemes = 'Blue' | 'Blue-10' | 'Dark' | 'Light' | 'White' | 'Transparent';

export interface ISectionProps {
  /** контент секции */
  children: ReactNode;
  /** кастомные стили для секции */
  className?: string;
  /** id элемента */
  id?: string;
  /** задает отступы одновременно для верха и низа секции */
  padding?: TSectionPadding;
  /** задает отступы одновременно только для низа секции, имеет преимущество над padding */
  paddingBottom?: TSectionPadding;
  /** задает отступы одновременно только для верха секции, имеет преимущество над padding */
  paddingTop?: TSectionPadding;
  /** ref для секции */
  sectionRef?: React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>;
  /** задать другой тэг для элемента */
  tag?: TSectionTags;
  /** фон секции */
  theme?: TSectionThemes;
  onTouchStart?(event?: any): void;
  onMouseDown?(event?: any): void;
}

import React from 'react';

import Checkbox from '@aurora/checkbox';

import { colorAccent } from 'vars/palette';

import Cell from 'components/Cell';
import { SelectableCellProps } from 'components/SelectableCell/types';

import { ReactComponent as IndicatorCheckedSvg } from 'images/icons/indicator-checked.svg';

export type IndicatorProps = {
  checked: boolean;
};

const Indicator = ({ checked }: IndicatorProps) => {
  if (checked) {
    return (
      <div style={{ color: colorAccent }}>
        <IndicatorCheckedSvg />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return null;
};

const SelectableCell: React.FC<SelectableCellProps> = ({
  variant,
  checked,
  customAddonAfter,
  onCheckBoxChange,
  ...otherProps
}) => {
  const getAddonAfter = () => {
    switch (variant) {
      case 'checkbox':
        return <Checkbox checked={checked} onChange={onCheckBoxChange} />;
      case 'indicator':
        return <Indicator checked={checked} />;
      case 'custom':
        return customAddonAfter;
    }
  };

  return <Cell addonAfter={getAddonAfter()} {...otherProps} />;
};

export default SelectableCell;

import { FC, memo, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_CATALOG } from 'const/routes';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { GROUP_FORMAT } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { ShowcaseGroup } from '../../types';
import InstrumentCardTable from '../CardTable/componets/InstrumentCardTable';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

interface CardTableProps extends ShowcaseGroup {
  slidesCount: number;
  categoryName?: string;
}

const CardTable: FC<CardTableProps> = ({
  categoryName,
  groupCode,
  groupFormat,
  groupId,
  groupName,
  groupType,
  instruments,
  slidesCount,
  smallGroupName,
  withShadow,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const instrumentList = useMemo(() => instruments?.slice(0, 4), [instruments]);

  const handleClick = useCallback(() => {
    const params = {
      comp_name: groupName,
      ...(categoryName && { compcategory_name: categoryName }),
      compilation_id: `${groupId}`,
      ...(groupFormat && { type: GROUP_FORMAT[groupFormat] }),
    };

    reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.compilationShowmoreTap, params);

    navigate(`${ROUTE_CATALOG}/selections/${groupCode}?categoryName=${categoryName}`);
  }, [categoryName, groupCode, groupFormat, groupId, groupName, navigate]);

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        `${styles.wrapper} ${slidesCount === 1 ? styles.wrapperFull : ''}`,
        withShadow && styles.withShadow,
      )}
    >
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <div>
          <div className={styles.groupType}>
            <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground2">
              {smallGroupName}
            </Text>
          </div>

          <div className={styles.groupName}>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold" tag="span">
              {groupName}
            </Text>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <>
        {instrumentList.map((instrument, index) => (
          <InstrumentCardTable
            key={index}
            categoryName={categoryName}
            className={styles.instrumentCard}
            favorite={instrument.isFavorite}
            groupType={groupType}
            periodPriceDiff={instrument.dailyPriceDiff}
            periodPriceDiffPcnt={instrument.dailyPriceDiffPcnt}
            price={instrument.lastPrice}
            {...instrument}
          />
        ))}
      </>

      <Button className={styles.button} variant="secondary" onClick={handleClick}>
        Смотреть все
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(CardTable);

import { FC, memo, useCallback } from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { FormattedBalance, InstrumentIcon, Link } from 'components';
import { SubIcon } from 'components/Instrument';
import { getLinkToInstruments } from 'components/Instrument/helpers/getLinkToInstruments';
import { isBonds } from 'components/ShowcaseSelection/helpers';

import styles from './InstrumentCardTable.module.pcss';
import { IInstrumentCardTableProps } from './types';

const InstrumentCardTable: FC<IInstrumentCardTableProps> = ({
  categoryName,
  currencyCode,
  favorite: isFavorite,
  groupName,
  groupType,
  hasInvestIdea,
  hasPriceThreshold,
  hasStopOrder,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  instrumentCode,
  instrumentId,
  instrumentImageName,
  instrumentName,
  isDividends,
  paymentProfitability,
  periodPriceDiff,
  periodPriceDiffPcnt,
  price,
  tradePlaceId,
  tradePlaceShortName,
  yieldBonds,
}) => {
  const isBond = isBonds(instrumentCategoryCode);

  const handleClick = useCallback(() => {
    const params = {
      from: 'preview',
      instrument_code: instrumentCode,
      instrument_id: `${instrumentId}`,
      trade_place_id: `${tradePlaceId}`,
      ...(groupName && { comp_name: groupName }),
      ...(groupType && { comp_type: groupType === 'MANUAL' ? groupType : 'AUTO' }),
      ...(categoryName && { compcategory_name: categoryName }),
      ...(instrumentCategoryCode && { instrument_category: instrumentCategoryCode }),
    };

    reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.compilationRowTap, params);
  }, [
    categoryName,
    groupName,
    groupType,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    instrumentCode,
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
  ]);

  return (
    <Link
      className={styles.instrumentWrapper}
      onClick={handleClick}
      to={getLinkToInstruments(instrumentId, tradePlaceId)}
    >
      <div className={styles.icon}>
        <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />

        <SubIcon
          className={styles.subIcon}
          isFavorite={isFavorite}
          hasInvestIdea={hasInvestIdea}
          hasPriceThreshold={hasPriceThreshold}
          hasStopOrder={hasStopOrder}
        />
      </div>

      <div className={styles.root}>
        <div>
          <div className={styles.name}>{instrumentName}</div>

          <div className={styles.code}>
            {instrumentCode} {tradePlaceShortName && <>&bull; {tradePlaceShortName}</>}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.price}>
          <FormattedBalance
            type="lineRegular"
            value={price}
            currency={currencyCode}
            precision={price >= 1 ? 2 : 4}
          />

          {isBond && yieldBonds ? (
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">{`доход ${yieldBonds}%`}</Text>
          ) : isDividends ? (
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              доход <FormattedBalance value={paymentProfitability} currency={'PRC'} />
            </Text>
          ) : (
            <FormattedBalance
              className={cx(
                periodPriceDiff && periodPriceDiff > 0 && styles.green,
                periodPriceDiff && periodPriceDiff < 0 && styles.red,
                periodPriceDiff && periodPriceDiff === 0 && styles.black,
              )}
              symbolType={undefined}
              type="labelRegular"
              value={periodPriceDiff}
              diff={periodPriceDiffPcnt}
              currency={currencyCode}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Link>
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentCardTable);

      <Swiper
        className={cx(styles.swiper, { [styles.cardTableSwiperWrapper]: type === 'T' })}
        slidesPerView="auto"
        spaceBetween={8}
        touchMoveStopPropagation
        touchStartPreventDefault
        preventClicksPropagation
      >
        {groups?.map((itemGroup, idx) => (
          <SwiperSlide key={idx} className={cx(isManySlidesCount && styles.slider)}>
            {type === 'C' && (
              <div className={cx({ [styles.fullSlide]: !isManySlidesCount })}>
                <CardImg categoryName={title} {...itemGroup} withShadow={withShadow} />
              </div>
            )}

            {type === 'L' && (
              <div className={cx({ [styles.fullSlide]: !isManySlidesCount })}>
                <CardList categoryName={title} {...itemGroup} withShadow={withShadow} />
              </div>
            )}

            {type === 'T' && (
              <div className={cx(styles.wrapper, { [styles.fullSlide]: !isManySlidesCount })}>
                <CardTable
                  categoryName={title}
                  {...itemGroup}
                  slidesCount={groups.length}
                  withShadow={withShadow}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </SwiperSlide>
        ))}
      </Swiper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(SliderShowcase);

import { ShowFormat, ShowcaseInstrument, ShowcasesGroupResponse } from 'types/catalog';

import { ShowcaseCategoryList, ShowcaseGroupList } from './types';

export const getMinLInstruments = (format: ShowFormat) => {
  return format === 'T' ? 4 : 2;
};

export const getSlidesToShow = (category: ShowFormat, groups: number): number => {
  switch (category) {
    case 'T':
      return groups > 1 ? 2 : 1;
    case 'C':
    case 'L':
      return groups > 3 ? 3 : groups;
    default:
      return 2;
  }
};
export const adaptShowcaseGroup = (data: ShowcasesGroupResponse): ShowcaseCategoryList => {
  const instrumentByGroup = data.showcaseInstrument.reduce((acc, item) => {
    if (!acc[item.groupCode]) {
      acc[item.groupCode] = [];
    }
    acc[item.groupCode].push(item);
    return acc;
  }, {} as { [p: string]: ShowcaseInstrument[] });

  const groupByCategory = data.showcaseInstrumentGroup.reduce((acc, item) => {
    if (!acc[item.categoryCode]) {
      acc[item.categoryCode] = [];
    }

    if (instrumentByGroup[item.groupCode]?.length >= getMinLInstruments(item.format)) {
      acc[item.categoryCode].push({ ...item, instruments: instrumentByGroup[item.groupCode] });
    }
    return acc;
  }, {} as { [p: string]: ShowcaseGroupList });

  const showcaseCategoryList = data.showcaseInstrumentCategory.map((item) => {
    const groups = groupByCategory[item.categoryCode];
    const slidesToShow = getSlidesToShow(item.categoryFormat, groups?.length);
    return { ...item, groups, slidesToShow };
  });
  return showcaseCategoryList.filter(
    (item) => item.groups?.length >= 1 && ['C', 'T', 'L'].includes(item.categoryFormat),
  );
};
export const isBonds = (s: string) =>
  ['RBN', 'EBN', 'FBN', 'RGB', 'FGB', 'FCB', 'RCB', 'INB', 'STB'].includes(s);

import React, { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useGetShowcasesGroupQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';

import SliderShowcase from './components/SliderShowcase';
import { adaptShowcaseGroup } from './helpers';
import { ShowcaseCategoryList, ShowcaseSelectionProps } from './types';

import 'swiper/css';

const ShowcaseSelection: FC<ShowcaseSelectionProps> = ({ withShadow, ...others }) => {
  const { data } = useGetShowcasesGroupQuery(others);
  const [list, setList] = useState<ShowcaseCategoryList>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    data && setList(adaptShowcaseGroup(data));
  }, [data]);

  return (
    <>
      {list.map(({ categoryCode, categoryFormat, categoryName, groups }) => {
        return (
          <div key={categoryCode}>
            <SliderShowcase
              type={categoryFormat !== 'B' ? categoryFormat : 'T'}
              title={categoryName}
              groups={groups}
              withShadow={withShadow}
            />
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(ShowcaseSelection);

import React, { memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import { uniqueId } from 'lodash';
import {
  CurveProps,
  Line,
  LineChart,
  ReferenceDot,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from 'recharts';
import { palette } from 'vars';

import style from './SimpleLine.module.pcss';

export type SimpleLineData = number[];

export interface SimpleLineProps {
  data: SimpleLineData;
  type?: 'negative' | 'positive' | 'realist';
  className?: string;
  showPoint?: boolean;
  gradient?: boolean;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  fullSize?: boolean;
  lineType?: CurveProps['type'];
}
const SimpleLine: React.FC<SimpleLineProps> = ({
  data,
  type,
  showPoint = true,
  gradient = true,
  strokeWidth = 2,
  width = 20,
  height = 20,
  fullSize,
  lineType = 'basis',
}) => {
  const dataForGraph = useMemo(() => {
    return data.map((value, i) => ({ name: i, value }));
  }, [data]);

  const lastPointName = data.length - 1;
  const lastPointValue = data[lastPointName];

  const colorId = useMemo(() => {
    return uniqueId();
  }, []);

  const color = (() => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'negative':
        return palette.colorDestructive;
      case 'positive':
        return palette.colorConstructive;
      default:
        return palette.colorForeground2;
    }
  })();

  if (data.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div
      style={{ '--width': `${width}px`, '--height': `${height}px` } as React.CSSProperties}
      className={style.wrapper}
    >
      <ResponsiveContainer>
        <LineChart
          data={dataForGraph}
          margin={fullSize ? { left: 0, right: 0, top: 4, bottom: 4 } : undefined}
        >
          <defs>
            {gradient && (
              <linearGradient
                id={colorId + '-gradient'}
                x1="38.5"
                y1="49"
                x2="-9"
                y2="49"
                gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
              >
                <stop stopColor={color} />
                <stop offset="1" stopColor={color} stopOpacity="0" />
              </linearGradient>
            )}
            <filter
              id={colorId + '-filter'}
              x="-50%"
              y="-20%"
              width="200%"
              height="200%"
              filterUnits="objectBoundingBox"
              primitiveUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
              colorInterpolationFilters="linearRGB"
            >
              <feOffset dx="0" dy="2" in="SourceAlpha" result="offset" />
              <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" in="offset" result="blur" />
              <feFlood floodColor="#28282d" floodOpacity="0.1" result="flood" />
              <feComposite in="flood" in2="blur" operator="in" result="composite" />
              <feMerge result="merge">
                <feMergeNode in="composite" result="mergeNode" />
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" result="mergeNode1" />
              </feMerge>
            </filter>
          </defs>
          <Line
            dot={false}
            type={lineType}
            shape-rendering="crispEdges"
            stroke-linecap="butt"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            dataKey="value"
            strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
            isAnimationActive={false}
            stroke={gradient ? `url(#${colorId}-gradient)` : color}
          />
          {fullSize ? (
            <YAxis hide domain={['dataMin', 'dataMax']} />
          ) : (
            <YAxis hide padding={{ top: 5, bottom: 5 }} />
          )}

          {fullSize ? (
            <XAxis hide domain={['dataMin', 'dataMax']} />
          ) : (
            <XAxis hide padding={{ right: 5 }} />
          )}

          {showPoint && (
            <ReferenceDot
              x={lastPointName}
              y={lastPointValue}
              r={4}
              strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
              stroke="#fff"
              filter={`url(#${colorId}-filter)`}
              fill={color}
            />
          )}
        </LineChart>
      </ResponsiveContainer>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(SimpleLine);

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useOtpConfirmMutation, useOtpRenewMutation } from 'core/api/oneTimePassword';

import { isOTPConfirmErrorType } from 'utils/oneTimePassword';

import { useTimer } from 'hooks/useTimer';

import SomethingWentWrong from 'modules/SomethingWentWrong/SomethingWentWrong';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import SmsInput from 'components/SmsInput';

import styles from './SmsConfirmation.module.pcss';
import { SmsConfirmationFooter } from './SmsConfirmationFooter';
import { buttonText, text, title } from './const';
import { SmsConfirmationProps } from './types';

const SmsConfirmation = ({
  initialOTPChallenge,
  smsInputCount,
  loaderChildren,
  withHeader,
  withTitle = true,
  subTitle,
  headerleftIconVariant,
  headerTitle,
  onSuccess,
  onError,
  onOTPError,
  onBackClick,
}: SmsConfirmationProps) => {
  const [
    otpConfirm,
    {
      data: confirmData,
      isLoading: isOTPConfirmLoading,
      error: otpConfirmError,
      isError: isOTPConfirmError,
      isSuccess: isOTPConfirmSuccess,
      reset: resetOTPConfirm,
    },
  ] = useOtpConfirmMutation();
  const [
    otpRenew,
    {
      data: otpRenewData,
      isLoading: isOTPRenewLoading,
      error: otpRenewError,
      isError: isOTPRenewError,
      isSuccess: isOTPRenewSuccess,
      isUninitialized: isOTPRenewUninitialized,
    },
  ] = useOtpRenewMutation();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const currentOTPChallenge =
    !isOTPRenewUninitialized && isOTPRenewSuccess && otpRenewData?.otpChallenge
      ? otpRenewData.otpChallenge
      : initialOTPChallenge;

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { currentCount, formattedTimeout, startTimer, resetTimer } = useTimer(
    currentOTPChallenge?.timeout,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentOTPChallenge?.timeout) {
      startTimer();
    }
  }, [startTimer, currentOTPChallenge]);

  const handleSmsInputChange = async (value: string) => {
    if (value.length === smsInputCount && currentOTPChallenge?.operationId) {
      try {
        await otpConfirm({
          OTP: value,
          OperationId: currentOTPChallenge.operationId,
        }).unwrap();
      } catch (error) {
        onError(error);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSmsRetryButtonClick = async () => {
    if (currentOTPChallenge?.operationId) {
      try {
        await otpRenew({ OperationId: currentOTPChallenge.operationId }).unwrap();
        resetOTPConfirm();
        resetTimer();
      } catch (error) {
        onError(error);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    if (onBackClick) {
      onBackClick();
    } else {
      navigate(-1);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOTPConfirmSuccess) {
      onSuccess(confirmData || null);
    }
  }, [confirmData, isOTPConfirmSuccess, onSuccess]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOTPConfirmError && isOTPConfirmErrorType(otpConfirmError)) {
      createAlertNotification({
        text: otpConfirmError.data.error[0].errorMessageText,
        status: 'error',
      });
      onOTPError?.(otpConfirmError);
    }
  }, [isOTPConfirmError, onOTPError, otpConfirmError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOTPRenewError && isOTPConfirmErrorType(otpRenewError)) {
      createAlertNotification({
        text: otpRenewError.data.error[0].errorMessageText,
        status: 'error',
      });
    }
  }, [isOTPRenewError, otpRenewError]);

  //@ts-ignore
  if (otpConfirmError?.status === 'FETCH_ERROR') {
    return (
      <SomethingWentWrong
        title={title}
        error={title}
        text={text}
        buttonText={buttonText}
        onAction={handleSmsRetryButtonClick}
        loading={isOTPRenewLoading}
      />
    );
  }

  if (isOTPConfirmLoading || isOTPRenewLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.loaderContainer : styles.loaderContainerDesktop}>
        {withHeader && (
          <HeaderPage
            title={headerTitle}
            leftIconVariant={headerleftIconVariant}
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          />
        )}
        <CircleLoader brandColor size={'large'} />
        {isOTPRenewLoading ? <Text>Запрос нового СМС-кода...</Text> : loaderChildren}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrap}>
      {isMobile && (
        <HeaderPage
          title={'СМС-подтверждение'}
          leftIconVariant={'back'}
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        />
      )}
      {withTitle && (
        <div className={styles.text}>
          <Text type={'bodyMedium'}>{`Введите код, отправленный на номер:`}</Text>
          <Text type={'bodyMedium'}>{currentOTPChallenge?.maskedPhone}</Text>
        </div>
      )}

      {subTitle && <div className={styles.text}>{subTitle}</div>}
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.smsInputContainer}>
          <SmsInput count={smsInputCount} onChange={handleSmsInputChange} />
        </div>
        <SmsConfirmationFooter
          onSmsRetryButtonClick={handleSmsRetryButtonClick}
          timeout={currentCount}
          formattedTimeout={formattedTimeout}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SmsConfirmation;

import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';

import SmsInputElement from './SmsInputElement';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type SmsInputProps = {
  count: number;
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
};

const SmsInput = ({ count, onChange, disabled }: SmsInputProps) => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string>('');
  const hiddenInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const handleClick = () => {
    hiddenInputRef?.current?.focus();
    setTimeout(() => containerRef?.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }), 500);
  };

  const handleInputChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (event.target.value.length > count) return;
    setValue(event.target.value);
    onChange && onChange(event.target.value);
  };

  const elements = Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, index) => (
    <SmsInputElement
      key={index}
      value={value[index] ?? ''}
      active={index === value.length}
      onClick={handleClick}
    />
  ));

  return (
    <div className={styles.container} ref={containerRef}>
      {elements}
      <input
        ref={hiddenInputRef}
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        name={'search-otp-confirm'}
        className={styles.hiddenInput}
        pattern={'[0-9]*'}
        inputMode={'numeric'}
        autoComplete={'off'}
        disabled={disabled}
        autoFocus
        type="tel"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default SmsInput;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import styles from './SmsTimer.module.pcss';

interface TimerProps {
  timeout: number;
  updateSmsCode: () => void;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isSmsCodeSuccess: boolean;
}

const SmsTimer: React.FC<TimerProps> = ({
  timeout,
  updateSmsCode,
  isLoading,
  isSmsCodeSuccess,
}) => {
  const [timer, setTimer] = useState(timeout);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (timer <= 0) return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setTimer((prev) => prev - 1);
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [timer]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSmsCodeSuccess) {
      setTimer(timeout);
    }
  }, [isSmsCodeSuccess, timeout]);
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      {isLoading ? (
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.smsWrap}>
          {timer > 0 ? (
            <div>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                Вы можете запросить новый код через {timer} секунды
              </Text>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div onClick={updateSmsCode}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                Выслать код еще раз
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default SmsTimer;

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

import Text from '@vision/text';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { rootQuery } from 'const/app';

import styles from 'components/SnackbarInfo/styles.module.pcss';
import { SnackbarInfoProps } from 'components/SnackbarInfo/types';
import { useScrollContext } from 'components/index';

import { ReactComponent as SvgClose } from 'images/raw-icons/snackbar/close.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SvgInfo } from 'images/raw-icons/snackbar/info.svg';

//Если нужно показать несколько снекбаров внизу экрана, используй SnackbarInfoWrapper

const SnackbarInfo = ({
  text,
  description,
  buttonText,
  onButtonClick,
  subIcon,
  icon = <SvgInfo />,
  isClose,
  position = 'bottom',
  className,
  isPortal = true,
}: SnackbarInfoProps) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isShow, setIsShow] = useState(true);
  const onCloseSnackbar = () => {
    setIsShow(false);
    ref.current && ref.current.remove();
  };
  const { direction } = useScrollContext();

  if (!rootQuery || !isShow) return null;

  const content = (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={cx(
        'snackbarInfo',
        styles.snackbar,
        position === 'top' ? styles.snackbarTop : styles.snackbarBottom,
        direction === 'down' && styles.snackbarHidden,
        className && className,
      )}
    >
      <div className={styles.card}>
        <div className={styles.iconsWrapper}>
          {icon}
          {subIcon && <div className={styles.subIcon}>{subIcon}</div>}
        </div>
        <div>
          <Text type="lineMedium">{text}</Text>
          {description && <Text type="labelRegular">{description}</Text>}
          {buttonText && (
            <button className={styles.button} onClick={onButtonClick}>
              <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorAccent">
                {buttonText}
              </Text>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {isClose && (
          <button className={styles.close} onClick={onCloseSnackbar}>
            <SvgClose />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return isPortal ? createPortal(content, rootQuery) : content;
};
export default SnackbarInfo;

import { FC, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { SwipeableTabsWrapper } from 'components/Tabs';

import { ISwipeableRouterTabsWrapperProps } from './types';

const SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper: FC<ISwipeableRouterTabsWrapperProps> = ({
  activeTab,
  additionalTop,
  children,
  classNameContent,
  classNameTab,
  classNameTabs,
  classNameWrapper,
  disableSwipe = false,
  fullWidth = false,
  icons,
  onScroll,
  replace = false,
  tabWidthEvenly,
  tabs,
  onChange,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleChange = useCallback(
    (_event, _newValue, label) => {
      tabs?.forEach(({ name, link, analyticsParams }) => {
        if (label === name) {
          navigate(link, { replace });
          onChange && onChange(_event, _newValue, label);
          reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.mainTap, { patterns: analyticsParams });
        }
      });
    },
    [navigate, replace, tabs, onChange],
  );

  if (!tabs) return <>{children}</>;

  return (
    <SwipeableTabsWrapper
      activeTab={activeTab}
      additionalTop={additionalTop}
      classNameContent={classNameContent}
      classNameTab={classNameTab}
      classNameTabs={classNameTabs}
      classNameWrapper={classNameWrapper}
      disableSwipe={disableSwipe}
      fullWidth={fullWidth}
      handleChange={handleChange}
      icons={icons}
      onScroll={onScroll}
      tabWidthEvenly={tabWidthEvenly}
      tabs={tabs}
    >
      {children}
    </SwipeableTabsWrapper>
  );
};

export default SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper;

import React, { RefObject, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const getTouchEventData = (
  e: TouchEvent | MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent<HTMLElement> | React.MouseEvent<HTMLElement>,
) => {
  return 'changedTouches' in e ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
};

export function useStateRef<T>(defaultValue: T): [T, (value: T) => void, RefObject<T>] {
  const ref = useRef<T>(defaultValue);
  const [state, _setState] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const setState = (value: T) => {
    _setState(value);
    ref.current = value;
  };

  return [state, setState, ref];
}

import { FC, Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Tab, Tabs } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { ScrollProvider } from 'components/ScrollProvider';
import Section from 'components/Section';

import { getTouchEventData, useStateRef } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { ISwipeableTabsWrapperProps } from './types';

const SwipeableTabsWrapper: FC<ISwipeableTabsWrapperProps> = ({
  activeTab = 0,
  additionalTop,
  children,
  classNameContent,
  classNameTabs,
  classNameWrapper,
  disableSwipe = false,
  handleChange,
  icons,
  onScroll,
  tabWidthEvenly,
  tabs,
}) => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(activeTab);
  const { pathname, search } = useLocation();

  const startXRef = useRef(0);
  const [offsetX, setOffsetX, offsetXRef] = useStateRef(0);

  const currentOffsetXRef = useRef(0);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // для изменения таба по роутеру при обновлении страницы
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tabs?.length) {
      setValue(activeTab);

      const path = search.length ? `${pathname}${search}` : pathname.replace(/\/$/, '');

      tabs.forEach(({ link }, index) => {
        if (link === path) setValue(index);
      });
    }
  }, [tabs, search, pathname, activeTab]);

  const onChange = useCallback(
    (event, newValue, label) => {
      setValue(newValue);
      handleChange?.(event, newValue, label);
    },
    [handleChange],
  );

  const onTouchMove = useCallback(
    (event) => {
      if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
      const currentX = getTouchEventData(event).clientX;
      let diff = currentOffsetXRef.current - (startXRef.current - currentX);

      if (tabs && containerRef.current && containerRef.current.offsetWidth * 0.4 < Math.abs(diff)) {
        if (diff > 0 && value !== 0) {
          onChange(event, value - 1, tabs[value - 1].name);
        }

        if (diff < 0 && tabs.length - 1 > value) {
          onChange(event, value + 1, tabs[value + 1].name);
        }
      }

      diff = 0;
      setOffsetX(diff);
    },
    [containerRef, currentOffsetXRef, onChange],
  );

  const onTouchEnd = useCallback(() => {
    window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onTouchMove);
    window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onTouchEnd);
    window.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
    window.removeEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
  }, [onTouchMove]);

  const onTouchStart = useCallback(
    (e) => {
      currentOffsetXRef.current = offsetXRef.current ? offsetXRef.current : 0;
      startXRef.current = getTouchEventData(e).clientX;

      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onTouchMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onTouchEnd);
      window.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
      window.addEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
    },
    [onTouchMove, onTouchEnd],
  );

  const onTouch = useMemo(
    () => (disableSwipe ? undefined : onTouchStart),
    [disableSwipe, onTouchStart],
  );

  const swiperableTabs = useMemo(
    () => (
      <>
        {tabs && (
          <Tabs
            classNameTabs={cx(classNameTabs, styles.tabs)}
            onChange={onChange}
            tabWidthEvenly={tabWidthEvenly}
            value={value}
          >
            {tabs.map(({ name }, index) => (
              <Tab
                key={`${name}-${index}`}
                label={name}
                value={index}
                {...(icons && {
                  iconRight: icons[name],
                })}
              />
            ))}
          </Tabs>
        )}

        <div
          className={classNameContent}
          style={{
            userSelect: 'none',
            touchAction: 'pan-y',
          }}
          ref={containerRef}
          onTouchStart={onTouch}
          onMouseDown={onTouch}
        >
          <Suspense
            fallback={
              <div className={styles.loader}>
                <CircleLoader brandColor />
              </div>
            }
          >
            {children}
          </Suspense>
        </div>
      </>
    ),
    [
      children,
      classNameContent,
      classNameTabs,
      icons,
      onChange,
      onTouch,
      tabWidthEvenly,
      tabs,
      value,
    ],
  );

  const swiperableTabsScroll = useMemo(
    () => (
      <ScrollProvider onScroll={onScroll}>
        {additionalTop}
        {swiperableTabs}
      </ScrollProvider>
    ),
    [additionalTop, onScroll, swiperableTabs],
  );

  if (!tabs) return <>{children}</>;

  return (
    <Section
      onTouchStart={onTouch}
      onMouseDown={onTouch}
      className={classNameWrapper}
      {...(!additionalTop && { theme: 'White' })}
    >
      {additionalTop ? swiperableTabsScroll : swiperableTabs}
    </Section>
  );
};

export default SwipeableTabsWrapper;

import { ReactNode, SyntheticEvent } from 'react';

export interface ISwipeableTabsWrapperProps {

  classNameContent?: string;
  classNameTab?: string;
  classNameTabs?: string;

  disableSwipe?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  handleChange: THandleChange<Event>;
  icons?: Record<string, JSX.Element>;
  onScroll?(value?: any): void;
  tabWidthEvenly?: boolean;

}

import React from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Card from '@aurora/card';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import { ROUTE_FUND_DETAILS, ROUTE_STRATEGY_DETAILS } from 'const/routes';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { FormattedBalance, InstrumentIcon } from 'components';
import styles from 'components/TrustManagementCard/TrustManagementCard.module.pcss';
import { TrustManagementCardProps } from 'components/TrustManagementCard/types';

const TrustManagementCard = ({
  type,
  instrumentId,
  shortTitleOI,
  instrumentImageName,
  diff,
  riskType,
  withShadow,
  onClick,
}: TrustManagementCardProps) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleClick = () => {
    navigate(
      generatePath(type === 'pif' ? ROUTE_FUND_DETAILS : ROUTE_STRATEGY_DETAILS, {
        instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      }),
    );
    onClick && onClick(instrumentId, type);
  };

  return (
    <Card onClick={handleClick} withShadow={withShadow}>
      <div className={styles.titleContainer}>
        <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />
        <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
          {shortTitleOI}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.infoContainer}>
        <div className={styles.diffContainer}>
          {(typeof diff === 'number' || diff == null) && (
            <FormattedBalance type={'lineSemiBold'} diff={diff} />
          )}
          {typeof diff === 'string' && (
            <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} color={'colorConstructive'}>
              +{diff}
            </Text>
          )}
          {type === 'iic' && <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>годовых</Text>}
        </div>
        <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>{riskType}</Text>
        <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          {type === 'pif' ? 'За прошлый год' : 'Можно заработать'}
        </Text>
        <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          Риск
        </Text>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default TrustManagementCard;

import React from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { colorContent } from 'vars/palette';

import styles from 'components/VerticalStepper/VerticalStepper.module.pcss';
import { StepProps } from 'components/VerticalStepper/types';

import { ReactComponent as CheckSvg } from 'images/icons/check.svg';

const Step: React.FC<StepProps> = ({
  children,
  title,
  index = 0,
  completed,
  active,
  disabled,
  last,
}) => {
  return (
    <div key={index} className={styles.step}>
      <div className={styles.stepNumberContainer}>
        <div
          className={cn(
            styles.stepNumber,
            disabled && styles.disabled,
            completed && styles.completed,
          )}
        >
          {!completed && (
            <Text type="lineMedium" color={disabled ? 'colorForeground3' : 'colorContent'}>
              {index + 1}
            </Text>
          )}
          {completed && <CheckSvg color={colorContent} />}
        </div>
        {!last && (
          <div className={styles.stepLineContainer}>
            <div className={styles.stepLine} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div>
        <Text type="bodySemiBold" color={disabled ? 'colorForeground3' : undefined}>
          {title}
        </Text>
        {children && active && (
          <div className={cn(styles.addonBottomContainer, last && styles.addonBottomContainerLast)}>
            {children}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Step;

import React from 'react';

import { VerticalStepperProps } from 'components/VerticalStepper/types';

import styles from './VerticalStepper.module.pcss';

const VerticalStepper: React.FC<VerticalStepperProps> = ({ children, activeIndex }) => {
  const childrenArray = React.Children.toArray(children).filter(Boolean);
  const steps = childrenArray.map((step, index) => {
    if (React.isValidElement(step)) {
      const active = index === activeIndex;
      const disabled = index > activeIndex;
      const completed = index < activeIndex;
      const last = index === childrenArray.length - 1;
      return React.cloneElement(step, {
        index,
        active,
        disabled,
        completed,
        last,
        ...step?.props,
      });
    }
    return step;
  });
  return <div className={styles.container}>{steps}</div>;
};

export default VerticalStepper;

--- FILE: src\const\files.ts ---

export const FILE_EXT_ACCEPT = '.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .pdf';
export const FILE_EXT_ACCEPT_ARRAY = ['.pdf', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'];
export const MAX_FILE_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES = 8_000_000;
export const MAX_UPLOAD_FILES_COUNT = 3;
export const FILE_SIZE_ERROR_MSG = 'Максимальный размер одного файла — 8 Мб';
export const FILE_COUNT_ERROR_MSG = 'Можно загрузить не более 3 файлов';
export const FILE_UPLOAD_INFO_TEXT =
  'Данные передаются в зашифрованном виде.\nМаксимальный размер одного файла — 8 Мб.\nМожно загрузить не более 3 файлов.\nМожно загружать jpg, jpeg, png, pdf.';
export const FILE_FORMAT_ERROR_MSG = 'Неверный формат файла';
export const FILE_UPLOAD_FAILED_MSG = 'Не удалось отправить файл. Попробуйте ещё раз.';

export const getFileExtension = (fileName: string) =>
  `.${fileName.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? ''}`;

export const filterValidUploadFiles = (
  files: File[],
  existingFiles: File[] = [],
): {
  validFiles: File[];
  hasSizeError: boolean;
  hasFormatError: boolean;
  hasCountError: boolean;
} => {
  let filesCount = existingFiles.length;
  let hasSizeError = false;
  let hasFormatError = false;
  let hasCountError = false;
  const validFiles: File[] = [];

  files.forEach((file) => {
    const fileExtension = getFileExtension(file.name);

    if (!FILE_EXT_ACCEPT_ARRAY.includes(fileExtension)) {
      hasFormatError = true;
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES) {
      hasSizeError = true;
      return;
    }

    if (filesCount >= MAX_UPLOAD_FILES_COUNT) {
      hasCountError = true;
      return;
    }

    filesCount += 1;
    validFiles.push(file);
  });

  return { validFiles, hasSizeError, hasFormatError, hasCountError };
};

import {
  AccountsRequest,
  AccountsResponse,
  CalcComissionRequest,
  CalcComissionResponse,
} from 'types/accounts';

import { API_REQUEST_URL } from './apiConstants';
import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from './apiUnionEntryPoint';

export const accountsApi = apiUnionEntryPoint.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getAccounts: builder.query<AccountsResponse, AccountsRequest>({
      query: ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, datasets }) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/persons/current/trading/accounts`,
        params: {
          datasets,
          instrument_Id: instrumentId,
          tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId,
        },
      }),
    }),
    calcComission: builder.query<CalcComissionResponse, CalcComissionRequest>({
      query: ({ subAccountId, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, direction, price, lots }) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/persons/current/trading/pretrade`,
        params: {
          subAccount_Id: subAccountId,
          instrument_Id: instrumentId,
          tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId,
          direction,
          price,
          lots,
        },
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

export const { useGetAccountsQuery, useLazyGetAccountsQuery, useLazyCalcComissionQuery } =
  accountsApi;

import createInfiniteScrollQuery from 'core/helpers/createInfiniteScrollQuery';

import {
  AnalyticRequest,
  AnalyticResponse,
  AnalyticsRequest,
  AnalyticsResponse,
  NewsRequest,
  ParsedAnalyticsResponse,
} from 'types/analytics';

import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from './apiUnionEntryPoint';

export const analyticsInfiniteScrollApi = createInfiniteScrollQuery<
  ParsedAnalyticsResponse[],
  AnalyticsRequest
>({
  reducerPath: 'analyticsInfiniteScrollReducer',
  query: ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, instrumentCategoryId, analystId, ...other }) => ({
    url: '/rs/v5/analytics',
    params: {
      instrument_Id: instrumentId,
      tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId,
      instrumentCategory_Id: instrumentCategoryId,
      analyst_Id: analystId,
      ...other,
    },
  }),
  transformResponse: (response: AnalyticsResponse) => {
    const analytics = response.analytics;
    const analyticsInstrumentImage = response.analyticsInstrumentImage;
    const parsedAnalyticsResponse: ParsedAnalyticsResponse[] = [];

    for (const item of analytics) {
      parsedAnalyticsResponse.push({
        ...item,
        instrumentImages: analyticsInstrumentImage.filter((f) => f.analyticId === item.analyticId),
      });
    }

    return parsedAnalyticsResponse;
  },
  hasNextPage: (data) => {
    return data.length !== 0;
  },
  addNextPage: (state, newPage) => {
    if (state) {
      state.push(...newPage);
    }
  },
});

export const analyticsApi = apiUnionEntryPoint.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getAnalytic: builder.query<AnalyticResponse, AnalyticRequest>({
      query: ({ id, datasets }) => ({ url: `/rs/v3/analytics/${id}`, params: { datasets } }),
    }),

    getNews: builder.query<ParsedAnalyticsResponse[], NewsRequest>({
      query: ({ issuerId, ...params }) => ({
        url: '/rs/v5/analytics',
        params: { issuer_Id: issuerId, ...params },
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: AnalyticsResponse) => {
        const analytics = response.analytics;
        const analyticsInstrumentImage = response.analyticsInstrumentImage;
        const parsedAnalyticsResponse: ParsedAnalyticsResponse[] = [];

        for (const item of analytics) {
          parsedAnalyticsResponse.push({
            ...item,
            instrumentImages: analyticsInstrumentImage.filter(
              (f) => f.analyticId === item.analyticId,
            ),
          });
        }

        return parsedAnalyticsResponse;
      },
    }),
  }),
});

export const { useGetAnalyticQuery, useGetNewsQuery } = analyticsApi;
export const { useInfiniteScrollQuery: useAnalyticsInfiniteScrollQuery } =
  analyticsInfiniteScrollApi;

import {
  CaptchaConfigResponse,
  LoginRequest,
  LoginResponse,
  PasswordPolicyResponse,
  RecoverLoginRequest,
  RegisterUserRequest,
  RegisterUserResponse,
  ResetPswRequest,
  SaltResponse,
  SelectRoleResponse,
  SetCredentialsUserResponse,
  SuccessResponse,
  TempTokenResponse,
  selectRoleRequest,
  setAdditionalDataRequest,
  setCredentialsUserRequest,
  setNewPasswordRequest,
} from 'types/auth';

import { API_REQUEST_URL, API_REQUEST_URL_V2 } from './apiConstants';
import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from './apiUnionEntryPoint';

const apiUrlCommonV2 = `${API_REQUEST_URL_V2}/users/`;

export const authApi = apiUnionEntryPoint.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getPasswordPolicies: builder.query<PasswordPolicyResponse, void>({
      query: () => `${API_REQUEST_URL}/password_policies`,
    }),
    getCaptchaConfig: builder.query<CaptchaConfigResponse, void>({
      query: () => `${API_REQUEST_URL}/captcha/config`,
    }),
    getSalt: builder.query<SaltResponse, void>({
      query: () => `${API_REQUEST_URL}/users/login/salt`,
    }),
    login: builder.mutation<LoginResponse, LoginRequest>({
      query: ({ login, passwordHash, language, Captcha }) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/users/login`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { login, passwordHash, language, Captcha },
      }),
    }),
    logout: builder.mutation<void, void>({
      query: () => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/sessions`,
        method: 'DELETE',
      }),
    }),
    getTempToken: builder.query<TempTokenResponse, string>({
      query: (targetAccessType) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/users/login/temp_token`,
        params: {
          targetAccessType,
        },
      }),
    }),
    setUTCOffset: builder.mutation({
      query: (utcOffset) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/persons/all/messages/utc_offset`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { utcOffset },
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

export const authApi2 = apiUnionEntryPoint.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    resetPassword: builder.mutation<LoginResponse, ResetPswRequest>({
      query: ({ Login, Captcha }) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}reset_password`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { Login, Captcha },
      }),
    }),
    recoverLogin: builder.mutation<LoginResponse, RecoverLoginRequest>({
      query: ({ BirthDate, Email, FirstName, LastName, MiddleName, Captcha }) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}recover_login`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { BirthDate, Email, FirstName, LastName, MiddleName, Captcha },
      }),
    }),
    checkIdResetPassword: builder.mutation({
      query: (hash) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}reset_password/check_id`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { ResetId: hash },
      }),
    }),
    checkIdResetLogin: builder.mutation({
      query: (hash) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}reset_login/check_id`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { ResetId: hash },
      }),
    }),
    setNewPassword: builder.mutation<SuccessResponse, setNewPasswordRequest>({
      query: (passwordHash) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}reset_password/password`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: passwordHash,
      }),
    }),
    registerUser: builder.mutation<RegisterUserResponse, RegisterUserRequest>({
      query: ({ FirstName, LastName, MiddleName, Phone, Captcha }) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}register`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { FirstName, LastName, MiddleName, Phone, Captcha },
      }),
    }),
    saveRegAdditionalData: builder.mutation<void, setAdditionalDataRequest>({
      query: ({ PassportSeries, PassportNumber }) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}register/additional_data`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { PassportSeries, PassportNumber },
      }),
    }),
    saveRegCredentials: builder.mutation<SetCredentialsUserResponse, setCredentialsUserRequest>({
      query: ({ Login, passwordHash }) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}register/credentials`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { Login, Password: passwordHash },
      }),
    }),
    selectRole: builder.mutation<SelectRoleResponse, selectRoleRequest>({
      query: ({ DetailsId, Role }) => ({
        url: `${apiUrlCommonV2}register/roles`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { DetailsId, Role },
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

export const {
  useGetPasswordPoliciesQuery,
  useLogoutMutation,
  useGetCaptchaConfigQuery,
  useLazyGetTempTokenQuery,
  useSetUTCOffsetMutation,
} = authApi;
