import { createApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

import {
  BrokerBankAccountsGuidResponse,
  BrokerBankAccountsParams,
  BrokerBankAccountsResponse,
  BrokerBankAccountsStatusResponse,
  PDFGuid,
  PDFParams,
  PDFStatus,
  PDFStatusData,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import {
  API_REQUEST_V2_PERSONS_ALL_BROKER_BANK_ACCOUNTS_PDF,
  API_REQUEST_V2_PERSONS_ALL_BROKER_BANK_ACCOUNTS_STATUS,
  API_REQUEST_V2_PERSONS_CURRENT_BROKER_BANK_ACCOUNTS,
  API_REQUEST_V3_PERSONS_ALL_BROKER_BANK_ACCOUNTS,
  getApiRequestPersonsAllBrokerBankAccountsPDFStatus,
} from './apiConstants';
import { fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize } from './common';

// Define a service using a base URL and expected endpoints
export const brokerBankAccountsApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'brokerBankAccountsApi',
  tagTypes: ['BrokerBankAccounts'],
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize({ baseUrl: '' }),
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getBrokerBankAccounts: builder.query<string, void>({
      query: () => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_V2_PERSONS_CURRENT_BROKER_BANK_ACCOUNTS,
        method: 'POST',
        providesTags: [{ type: 'BrokerBankAccounts', id: 'List' }],
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: BrokerBankAccountsGuidResponse) =>
        response.dataRequest[0].dataGuid,
    }),

    getBrokerBankAccountsStatus: builder.query<string, BrokerBankAccountsParams['data_Guid']>({
      query: (data_Guid) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_V2_PERSONS_ALL_BROKER_BANK_ACCOUNTS_STATUS,
        params: {
          data_Guid,
        },
        providesTags: [{ type: 'BrokerBankAccounts', id: 'Status' }],
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: BrokerBankAccountsStatusResponse) =>
        response.dataRequestStatus[0].status,
    }),

    getBrokerBankAccountsParams: builder.query<
      BrokerBankAccountsResponse,
      BrokerBankAccountsParams['data_Guid']
    >({
      query: (data_Guid) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_V3_PERSONS_ALL_BROKER_BANK_ACCOUNTS,
        params: {
          data_Guid,
        },
        providesTags: [{ type: 'BrokerBankAccounts', id: 'Params' }],
      }),
    }),

    brokerBankPDF: builder.mutation<string, PDFParams>({
      query: ({ brokerBankAccountGuid, bankDetailsId, portfolioId }) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_V2_PERSONS_ALL_BROKER_BANK_ACCOUNTS_PDF,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          dataRequest_Guid: brokerBankAccountGuid,
          bankDetails_Id: bankDetailsId,
          portfolio_Id: portfolioId,
        },
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: PDFGuid) => response.reportRequest[0].reportRequestGuid,
    }),

    brokerBankPDFStatus: builder.mutation<PDFStatus['status'], string>({
      query: (statusGuid) => ({
        url: getApiRequestPersonsAllBrokerBankAccountsPDFStatus(statusGuid),
        method: 'GET',
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: PDFStatusData) => {
        if (
          typeof response?.reportRequestStatus[0]?.status === 'string' &&
          response.reportRequestStatus[0].status !== 'completed'
        ) {
          throw new Error(`ReportRequestStatus:${response.reportRequestStatus[0].status}`);
        }
        return response.reportRequestStatus[0].status;
      },
    }),
  }),
});

// Export hooks for usage in functional components, which are
// auto-generated based on the defined endpoints
export const {
  useGetBrokerBankAccountsStatusQuery,
  useGetBrokerBankAccountsQuery,
  useGetBrokerBankAccountsParamsQuery,
  useBrokerBankPDFMutation,
  useBrokerBankPDFStatusMutation,
} = brokerBankAccountsApi;

import { API_REQUEST_URL } from './apiConstants';
import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from './apiUnionEntryPoint';

export const brokerDocumentsApi = apiUnionEntryPoint.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getBrokerDocuments: builder.query<BrokerDocumentsResponse, BrokerDocumentsRequest>({
      query: ({ codes }) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/broker/documents`,

});

export const catalogApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'catalogApi',
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize({ baseUrl: '' }),
  endpoints: ({ query, mutation }) => ({
    getInstruments: query<InstrumentSearchResponse, QuerySearchInstrumentsRequest>({
      query: (params) => {
        if (params.search_text.length < 3) return;
        return { url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_LIST, params };
      },
    }),
    getInstrumentsStatistics: query<IInstrumentStatisticsResponse, IInstrumentStatisticsRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({ url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENTS_STATISTICS, params }),
    }),
    getInstrumentsStatisticsCount: query<
      IInstrumentStatisticsResponse,
      IInstrumentStatisticsRequest
    >({
      query: (params) => ({ url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENTS_STATISTICS_COUNT, params }),
    }),
    updateFavoritePut: mutation({
      query: ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, favorite }) => {
        const body = {
          instrument_id: String(instrumentId),
          trade_place_id: String(tradePlaceId),
          favorite,
        };
        return {
          url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_FAVORITE,
          method: 'PUT',
          body,
        };
      },
    }),
    updateFavoritePost: mutation({
      query: ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, favorite, groupList }) => {
        return {
          url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_FAVORITE,
          method: 'POST',
          body: {
            instrument_Id: String(instrumentId),
            tradePlace_Id: String(tradePlaceId),
            favorite,
            groupList,
          },
        };
      },
    }),
    updateFavoriteDelete: mutation({
      query: ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, favorite, groupList }) => {
        return {
          url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_FAVORITE,
          method: 'DELETE',
          body: {
            instrument_Id: String(instrumentId),
            tradePlace_Id: String(tradePlaceId),
            favorite,
            groupList,
          },
        };
      },
    }),
    getDictionaries: query<DictionariesResponse, EmptyRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({ url: API_REQUEST_DICTIONARIES_INDUSTRIES, params }),
    }),

    getEquities: query<ShowcaseEquitiesResponse, ShowcaseEquitiesRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({ url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_STOCKS, params }),
    }),

    getBonds: query<ShowcaseBondsResponse, ShowcaseBondsRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_BONDS,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    getCurrencies: query<ShowcaseCurrenciesResponse, ShowcaseCurrenciesRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_CURRENCIES,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    getETF: query<ShowcaseETFResponse, ShowcaseETFRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_ETF,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    getFutures: query<ShowcaseFuturesResponse, ShowcaseFuturesRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_FUTURES,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    getMetals: query<ShowcaseMetalsResponse, ShowcaseMetalsRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_METALS,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    getFavorite: query<ParsedFavoriteInstrument[], FavoriteRequest>({
      keepUnusedDataFor: 0,
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_FAVORITE,
        params,
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: FavoriteResponse) =>
        parseInstruments(response.instrument, response.quoteHistory),
      async onCacheEntryAdded(
        { sessionType },
        { updateCachedData, cacheDataLoaded, cacheEntryRemoved },
      ) {
        try {
          await cacheDataLoaded;
          let subscribeUrl = API_REQUEST_CATALOG_REALTIME_FAVORITE;
          if (sessionType) {
            subscribeUrl += `?sessionType=${sessionType}`;
          }
          await fetchWithCamelize(subscribeUrl);
          const listener = (data: {
            lastModified: number;
            response: { InstrumentQuoteList: QuoteChanges[] };
          }) => {
            updateCachedData((draft) => {
              if (draft) {
                applyRealTimeChanges(draft, data.response.InstrumentQuoteList);
              }
            });
          };

          const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('QuotesChanged', listener);

          await cacheEntryRemoved;
          unsubscribe();
          await fetchWithCamelize(API_REQUEST_CATALOG_REALTIME_FAVORITE_UNSUBSCRIBE, {
            method: 'POST',
          });
        } catch {
          console.warn('Favorite Real Time Error');
        }
      },
    }),

    getAllCurrencies: query<AllCurrenciesResponse, void>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_GET_CURRENCIES,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    getBanks: query<BankResponse, BanksRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_GET_BANK_BY_BIC,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    getSwiftBanks: query<SwiftBankResponse, BanksRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_BANK_GET_BY_SWIFT,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    // API: showcases group
    getShowcasesGroup: query<ShowcasesGroupResponse, ShowcasesGroupRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_GROUP_CATEGORY,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    // API: showcase favorites
    getShowcaseFavorites: query<ShowcaseGroupResponse, ShowcaseGroupRequest>({
      query: ({ groupCode, ...params }) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_CATALOG_GROUP}/${groupCode}`,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    updateMyFavoriteList: mutation<void, UpdateFavoriteList>({
      query: ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, newIndexNumber }) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_LIST_FAVORITE,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { instrument_Id: instrumentId, tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId, newIndexNumber },
      }),
    }),

    getFunds: query<ShowcaseFundResponse, IShowcaseFundRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_FUNDS,
        params,
      }),
    }),

    getStrategies: query<ShowcaseStrategyResponse, IShowcaseStrategyRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_CATALOG_STRATEGIES,
        params,
      }),
    }),
    getFavoriteGroup: query<FavoriteGroupResponse, FavoriteGroupRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENTS_FAVORITE_GROUP,
        params,
      }),
    }),
    updateFavoriteGroup: mutation({
      query: (body) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENTS_FAVORITE_GROUP,
        method: 'POST',
        body,
      }),
    }),
    deleteFavoriteGroup: mutation({
      query: (body) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENTS_FAVORITE_GROUP,
        method: 'DELETE',
        body,
      }),
    }),
    addInstrumentsToFavoriteGroup: mutation<void, AddInstrumentsToFavoriteGroupRequest>({
      query: (body) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENTS_FAVORITE_GROUP_INSTRUMENTS,
        method: 'POST',
        body,
      }),
    }),
    getInstrumentsFavoriteGroupById: query<
      InstrumentInfoResponse,
      InstrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdRequest
    >({
      query: ({ groupId, showQuoteHistory, quoteHistoryDays, datePart, dateStep }) => ({
        url: getApiRequestInstrumentsFavoriteGroup(groupId),
        params: { showQuoteHistory, quoteHistoryDays, datePart, dateStep },
      }),
      onCacheEntryAdded: async (_, { cacheDataLoaded, cacheEntryRemoved, updateCachedData }) => {
        try {
          await cacheDataLoaded;
          await fetchWithCamelize(API_REQUEST_CATALOG_REALTIME_FAVORITE);

          const listener = (data: { response: { InstrumentQuoteList: QuoteChanges[] } }) => {
            updateCachedData((draft) => {
              if (draft) {
                applyRealTimeChanges(
                  draft.instrument as unknown as ParsedFavoriteInstrument[],
                  data.response.InstrumentQuoteList,
                );
              }
            });
          };

          const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('QuotesChanged', listener);

          await cacheEntryRemoved;
          unsubscribe();
          await fetchWithCamelize(API_REQUEST_CATALOG_REALTIME_FAVORITE_UNSUBSCRIBE, {
            method: 'POST',
          });
        } catch {
          console.warn('Group detail real time error');
        }
      },
    }),
    reorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroup: mutation<void, InstrumentsFavoriteGroupReorderRequest>({
      query: ({ groupId, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, newIndexNumber }) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENTS_FAVORITE_GROUP_REORDER,

        body: {
          group_Id: groupId,

    reorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroupGroup: mutation<

import httpCommunicator, { AxiosError, AxiosRequestConfig } from '@aurora/http-communicator';
import { BaseQueryFn } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query';
import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';
import camelcaseKeys from 'camelcase-keys';
import { ACCESS_TYPE_GUID, ACCESS_TYPE_GUID_ANDROID } from 'const/app';

const apiVersionRegEx = /^\/rs\/v\d/;
const re = /"(StopOrderNum|OrderNum|LinkedOrderNum|TradeNum)"\s*:\s*(\d+(\.?\d*([Ee][+-]?\d*)?)?)/g;

const urlWithDefaultParams = [
  '/minAppVersion',
  '/system/parameters',
  '/dictionaries/disclaimer',
  '/users/login',
  '/users/login/installToken',
  '/users/register',
  '/users/recover_login',
  '/users/reset_password',
];

function nativeApiAvailable() {
  // @ts-ignore
  return typeof window.NativeAPI !== 'undefined';
}

const defaultParams: Record<string, any> = {
  accessType: nativeApiAvailable() ? ACCESS_TYPE_GUID_ANDROID : ACCESS_TYPE_GUID,
};

const isHaveDefaultParams = (url: string) => {
  return urlWithDefaultParams.includes(url.replace(apiVersionRegEx, ''));
};

const parseErrorResponseData = (data: unknown): unknown => {
  if (typeof data !== 'string') return data;

  const trimmed = data.trim();
  if (!trimmed.startsWith('{') && !trimmed.startsWith('[')) {
    return data;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(trimmed);
  } catch {
    return data;
  }
};

const normalizeErrorData = (data: unknown): unknown => {
  const parsed = parseErrorResponseData(data);

  if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
    return camelcaseKeys(parsed as Record<string, unknown>, { deep: true });
  }

  return parsed;
};

export const fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize =
  ({ baseUrl }: { baseUrl: string }): BaseQueryFn =>
  async (args) => {
    const url = typeof args !== 'string' ? args.url : args;

    if (typeof args === 'string') {
      args = { url };
    }

    if (isHaveDefaultParams(url)) {
      if (args.method && args.method !== 'GET') {
        args.body = { ...defaultParams, ...args.body };
      } else {
        args.params = { ...defaultParams, ...args.params };
      }
    }

    try {
      const result = await httpCommunicator({
        data: args.body,
        ...args,
        baseURL: baseUrl,
        headers: { ...getDefaultHeaders(baseUrl || url), ...args.headers },
        transformResponse: jsonParse,
      });
      return { data: camelcaseKeys(result.data, { deep: true }) };
    } catch (axiosError) {
      const err = axiosError as AxiosError;
      return {
        error: {
          status: err.response?.status,
          data: normalizeErrorData(err.response?.data || err.message),
        },
      };
    }
  };

export const getDefaultHeaders = (baseUrl = ''): Record<string, string> => {
  if (!baseUrl.startsWith('/rs/')) return {};
  return {
    'X-User-Agent': JSON.stringify({
      Type: 'web',
      DeviceType: 'mobile',
    }),
    // версия ЛК
    'X-AppVersion': '1.17.0',
  };
};

const bigNumReplacer = (_: string, p1: string, p2: string) => {
  const num = new BigNumber(p2);
  return `"${p1}":"${num}"`;
};

export const jsonParse = (text: string) =>
  text ? JSON.parse(text.replace(re, bigNumReplacer)) : '';

export const fetchWithCamelize = async (info: string, init: AxiosRequestConfig = {}) => {
  const url = new URL(info, window.location.origin);

  if (isHaveDefaultParams(url.pathname)) {
    if (init?.method && init?.method !== 'GET') {
      init.data = { ...defaultParams, ...init?.data };
    } else {
      init.params = { ...defaultParams, ...init?.params };
    }
  }

  init.headers = { ...getDefaultHeaders(info), ...init?.headers };

  const result = await httpCommunicator({
    url: url.toString(),
    transformResponse: jsonParse,
    ...init,
  });

  return camelcaseKeys(result.data, { deep: true });
};

export const createUrlWithParams = <T>(url: string, params?: T) => {
  if (params) {
    return (
      url +
      '?' +
      Object.entries(params)
        .map(([key, value]) => {
          if (!value) return null;
          if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            return `${key}=${value.join(',')}`;
          }
          return `${key}=${value}`;
        })
        .filter((f) => !!f)
        .join('&')
    );
  }
  return url;
};

import { createApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

import { CurrenciesResponse } from 'types/dictionaries';

import { API_REQUEST_GET_CURRENCIES } from './apiConstants';
import { fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize } from './common';

// Define a service using a base URL and expected endpoints
export const dictionariesApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'dictionariesApi',
  tagTypes: ['Dictionaries'],
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize({ baseUrl: '' }),
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getCurrencyDictionary: builder.query<
      Record<string, { id: number; code: string; name: string } | undefined>,
      void
    >({
      query: () => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_GET_CURRENCIES,
        providesTags: [{ type: 'Dictionaries', id: 'Currencies' }],
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: CurrenciesResponse) =>
        response.currency.reduce<
          Record<string, { id: number; code: string; name: string } | undefined>
        >((acc, item) => {
          acc[item.code] = {
            id: item.id,
            code: item.code,
            name: item.name,
          };
          return acc;
        }, {}),
    }),
  }),
});

// Export hooks for usage in functional components, which are
// auto-generated based on the defined endpoints
export const { useGetCurrencyDictionaryQuery } = dictionariesApi;

import {

  DocumentManagementFileRequest,
  DocumentManagementItemResponse,

  DocumentManagementStatusResponse,
  DocumentManagementVerifyResponse,
  DocumentsHistoryFilters,
  ReferenceDocumentsRequest,
} from 'types/documents';

import { API_REQUEST_URL } from './apiConstants';
import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from './apiUnionEntryPoint';

export const documentsApi = apiUnionEntryPoint.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getDocumentsHistory: builder.query<DocumentManagementResponse, DocumentsHistoryFilters>({
      query: (filters) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/documentManagement`,
        params: { ...filters },
      }),
    }),
    getDocument: builder.query<DocumentManagementItemResponse, string | undefined>({
      query: (documentGuid) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/documentManagement/${documentGuid}?type=SIGN`,
      }),
    }),
    getDocumentFile: builder.query<File, DocumentManagementFileRequest>({
      query: ({ documentGuid, title, download }) => ({

import { createApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

import {
  API_FEEDBACK_GET_THEMES,
  API_FEEDBACK_SEND_MSG,
} from 'core/api/apiConstants';

import { ResponseMessageTypes } from 'modules/Feedback/types';

import { FeedbackResponse, FeedbackRequest } from 'types/feedback';

import { fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize } from './common';

const camelToSnakeCase = (str: string) =>
  str.replace(/[A-z]/g, (letter: string) =>
    letter === letter.toUpperCase() ? `_${letter.toLowerCase()}` : letter,
  );

// Define a service using a base URL and expected endpoints
export const feedbackApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'feedbackApi',
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize({ baseUrl: '' }),

  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getFeedbackThemes: builder.query<ResponseMessageTypes, void>({
      query: () => ({ url: API_FEEDBACK_GET_THEMES }),
    }),
    sendFeedbackMsg: builder.mutation<FeedbackResponse, FeedbackRequest>({
      query: (data) => {
        const formData = new FormData();

        formData.append('title', data.title);
        data.type && formData.append('type', camelToSnakeCase(data.type));
        formData.append('text', data.text);
        if (Object.values(data.files).length) {
          Object.values(data.files).forEach((file) => formData.append('file', file));
        }
        return { url: API_FEEDBACK_SEND_MSG, method: 'POST', body: formData };
      },
    }),
  }),
});

// Export hooks for usage in functional components, which are
// auto-generated based on the defined endpoints
export const { useGetFeedbackThemesQuery, useSendFeedbackMsgMutation } =
feedbackApi;

import { createApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';
import camelcaseKeys from 'camelcase-keys';

import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { QuoteChanges } from 'types/catalog';
import {
  InstrumentInfoRequest,
  InstrumentInfoResponse,
  OrderBookRequestType,
  OrderBookResponseType,
} from 'types/instruments';

import {
  API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_INFO,
  API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_ORDER_BOOK,
  API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_REALTIME_QUOTES,
} from './apiConstants';
import { fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize, fetchWithCamelize } from './common';

// Define a service using a base URL and expected endpoints
export const instrumentsApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'instrumentsApi',
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize({ baseUrl: '' }),
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getInstrumentInfo: builder.query<InstrumentInfoResponse, InstrumentInfoRequest>({
      query: ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, sessionType, source }) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_INFO,
        params: { instrument_id: instrumentId, trade_place_id: tradePlaceId, sessionType, source },
      }),
      keepUnusedDataFor: 0,
      async onCacheEntryAdded(
        { sessionType, subscribe, tradePlaceId, instrumentId },
        { updateCachedData, cacheDataLoaded, cacheEntryRemoved },
      ) {
        if (!subscribe) return;

        try {
          await cacheDataLoaded;
          await fetchWithCamelize(API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_REALTIME_QUOTES, {
            method: 'PUT',
            data: {
              instrument_id: instrumentId,
              trade_place_id: tradePlaceId,
              realtime_quote: true,
              sessionType: 'CURRENT',
            },
          });
          const listener = (data: {
            lastModified: number;
            response: { InstrumentQuoteList: QuoteChanges[] };
          }) => {
            updateCachedData((draft) => {
              if (draft) {
                const quoteChanges = data.response.InstrumentQuoteList;

                draft.instrument.forEach((instrument) => {
                  const quoteChange = quoteChanges.filter(
                    (f) =>
                      f.TradePlace_Id === instrument.tradePlaceId &&
                      f.Instrument_Id === instrument.instrumentId,
                  );

                  if (quoteChange.length !== 0) {
                    instrument.lastPrice = quoteChange[0].LastPrice;
                    instrument.priceCurrency = quoteChange[0].CurrencyCode;
                    instrument.priceDiffCurr = quoteChange[0].PriceDiffCurr;
                    instrument.priceDiffPcnt = quoteChange[0].PriceDiffPcnt;
                  }

                  draft.trading?.forEach((item) => {
                    const quoteChange = quoteChanges.filter(
                      (f) =>
                        f.TradePlace_Id === instrument.tradePlaceId &&
                        f.Instrument_Id === instrument.instrumentId,
                    );
                    if (quoteChange.length !== 0) {
                      item.bid = quoteChange[0].Bid;
                      item.ask = quoteChange[0].Ask;
                      item.bidSize = quoteChange[0].BidSize;
                      item.askSize = quoteChange[0].AskSize;
                    }
                  });
                });
              }
            });
          };

          const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('QuotesChanged', listener);

          await cacheEntryRemoved;
          unsubscribe();
          await fetchWithCamelize(API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_REALTIME_QUOTES, {
            method: 'PUT',
            data: {
              instrument_id: instrumentId,
              trade_place_id: tradePlaceId,
              realtime_quote: false,
              sessionType: 'CURRENT',
            },
          });
        } catch {
          console.warn('Instruments Quotes Real Time Error');
        }
      },
    }),
    setOrderBook: builder.query<Record<string, OrderBookResponseType>, OrderBookRequestType>({
      query: ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, ...rest }) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_ORDER_BOOK,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { instrument_Id: instrumentId, tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId, ...rest },
      }),
      keepUnusedDataFor: 0,
      async onCacheEntryAdded(
        { instrumentId, tradePlaceId, type },
        { updateCachedData, cacheDataLoaded, cacheEntryRemoved },
      ) {
        try {
          const listenerName = type === 'S' ? 'OrderBookShortChanged' : 'OrderBookChanged';
          await cacheDataLoaded;
          const listener = (data: {
            lastModified: number;
            response: { [key: string]: OrderBookResponseType[] };
          }) => {
            updateCachedData((draft) => {
              const res =
                type === 'S' ? data.response.OrderBookShortList[0] : data.response.OrderBookList[0];

              const formattedRes = camelcaseKeys(res, { deep: true });
              const key = `${formattedRes.instrumentId}_${formattedRes.tradePlaceId}`;

              if (draft) {
                draft[key] = formattedRes;

                return;
              }

              return { [key]: formattedRes };
            });
          };

          const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe(listenerName, listener);

          await cacheEntryRemoved;
          unsubscribe();

          await fetchWithCamelize(API_REQUEST_INSTRUMENT_ORDER_BOOK, {
            method: 'POST',
            data: {
              type,
              active: false,
              instrument_Id: instrumentId,
              tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId,
            },
          });
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn('Instruments Quotes Real Time Error');
        }
      },
    }),
  }),
});

// Export hooks for usage in functional components, which are
// auto-generated based on the defined endpoints
export const { useLazyGetInstrumentInfoQuery, useGetInstrumentInfoQuery, useSetOrderBookQuery } =
  instrumentsApi;

import {
  API_REQUEST_NOTIFICATION_FROM_DISCOVERY,
  API_REQUEST_NOTIFICATION_PRICE,
  API_REQUEST_READ_NOTIFICATION,
} from 'core/api/apiConstants';

import {
  FullMessageResponse,
  INotificationFilters,
  NotificationAboutPrice,
  NotificationAboutPriceResponse,
  NotificationFromDiscoveryResponse,
} from 'types/notification';

import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from './apiUnionEntryPoint';

const apiWithTag = apiUnionEntryPoint.enhanceEndpoints({ addTagTypes: ['Notifications'] });

export const notificationApi = apiWithTag.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getNotificationsPrice: builder.query<NotificationAboutPriceResponse, INotificationFilters>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_NOTIFICATION_PRICE,
        params: {
          rowsOffset: params.offset,
          rowsCount: params.count,
        },
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: NotificationAboutPriceResponse) => {
        const modifedDataFromServer = response.subscriptionPriceThreshold.reduce(
          (acc: NotificationAboutPrice[], item) => {
            acc.push({
              ...item,
              price: item.threshold,
              notificationTime: item.sendTime,
            });
            return acc;
          },
          [],
        );
        return { subscriptionPriceThreshold: modifedDataFromServer };
      },
    }),
    getNotificationsFromDiscovery: builder.query<
      NotificationFromDiscoveryResponse,
      INotificationFilters
    >({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_NOTIFICATION_FROM_DISCOVERY,
        params,
      }),
      providesTags: () => ['Notifications'],
    }),
    getFullMessage: builder.query<FullMessageResponse, string>({
      query: (messageId) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_NOTIFICATION_FROM_DISCOVERY}/${messageId}`,
      }),
    }),
    readMessage: builder.mutation<null, string>({
      query: (messageId) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_READ_NOTIFICATION}/${messageId}/read_notification`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {},
      }),
      invalidatesTags: ['Notifications'],
    }),
  }),
});

export const {
  useGetNotificationsPriceQuery,
  useGetNotificationsFromDiscoveryQuery,
  useLazyGetFullMessageQuery,
  useReadMessageMutation,
} = notificationApi;

import {
  API_REQUEST_TRADING_ORDERS,
  API_REQUEST_TRADING_ORDERS_UNSUBSCRIBE,
  API_REQUEST_URL,
} from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import createInfiniteScrollQuery from 'core/helpers/createInfiniteScrollQuery';

import { INonTradeOrderHistory, IOnlyGuid } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';
import { ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/consts';
import { parseOrdersHistory } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';

import { EventHistoryFiltersType, EventHistoryResponse } from 'types/eventHistory';
import {
  AdministrativeParametersResponse,
  AdministrativeResponse,
  IOrderHistoryDetails,
  IOrdersHistoryStructureDetail,
  NonTradeParametersResponse,
  NonTradeResponse,
  OrderDetailsResponse,
  OrderStatusesResponse,
  OrdersHistoryStructureDetailResponse,
  ParsedTradeOrdersHistoryResponse,
  ProductsRequest,
  ProductsResponse,
} from 'types/orderHistory';
import { TradeOrdersHistoryRequest, TradeOrdersHistoryResponse } from 'types/orders';

import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from './apiUnionEntryPoint';

const DEFAULT_PATH = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/persons/current/orders/history/`;

export const orderHistoryApi = apiUnionEntryPoint.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getNonTrade: builder.query<NonTradeResponse, INonTradeOrderHistory | IOnlyGuid>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: `${DEFAULT_PATH}nontrade`,
        params: params,
      }),
    }),
    getAdministrative: builder.query<AdministrativeResponse, INonTradeOrderHistory>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: `${DEFAULT_PATH}administrative`,
        params: params,
      }),
    }),
    getNonTradeParameters: builder.query<NonTradeParametersResponse, void>({
      query: () => `${DEFAULT_PATH}nontrade/parameters`,
    }),
    getAdministrativeParameters: builder.query<AdministrativeParametersResponse, void>({
      query: () => `${DEFAULT_PATH}administrative/parameters`,
    }),
    getOrderDetail: builder.query<IOrderHistoryDetails, string>({
      query: (guid) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/orders/history/nontrade/detail?order_guid=${guid}`,
      }),
      providesTags: (_result, _error, orderGuid) => [{ type: 'OrderHistoryDetail', id: orderGuid }],
      transformResponse: (response: OrderDetailsResponse) => {
        const orderHistoryDetails = {};
        response.orderBankDetail &&
          Object.assign(orderHistoryDetails, { bankDetails: response.orderBankDetail[0] });
        response.ordersHistoryNonTradeDetail &&
          Object.assign(orderHistoryDetails, {
            nonTradeDetails: response.ordersHistoryNonTradeDetail[0],
          });
        response.ordersHistoryNonTradeMoneyDetail &&
          Object.assign(orderHistoryDetails, {
            moneyDetails: response.ordersHistoryNonTradeMoneyDetail[0],
          });
        (response.nonTradeSecurityDetail || response.ordersHistoryNonTradeSecurityDetail) &&
          Object.assign(orderHistoryDetails, {
            securityDetails: (response.nonTradeSecurityDetail ||
              response.ordersHistoryNonTradeSecurityDetail)?.[0],
          });
        response.operationReasonDetail &&
          Object.assign(orderHistoryDetails, { reasonDetails: response.operationReasonDetail[0] });
        response.innerContractorDetail &&
          Object.assign(orderHistoryDetails, {
            innerContractor: response.innerContractorDetail[0],
          });
        response.outerContractorDetail &&
          Object.assign(orderHistoryDetails, {
            outerContractor: response.outerContractorDetail[0],
          });
        return orderHistoryDetails;
      },
    }),
    getOrderStatuses: builder.query<OrderStatusesResponse, void>({
      query: () => `${API_REQUEST_URL}/persons/all/trading/order_statuses`,
    }),
    getProducts: builder.query<ProductsResponse, ProductsRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/persons/current/products`,
        params: params,
      }),
    }),
    unsubscribeFromOrders: builder.mutation<void, string>({
      query: (subscriptionGUID) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_TRADING_ORDERS_UNSUBSCRIBE,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { SubscriptionGUID: subscriptionGUID },
      }),
    }),
    getDetailStructure: builder.query<IOrdersHistoryStructureDetail, string>({
      query: (orderGuid) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/orders/history/structure/detail?order_guid=${orderGuid}`,
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: OrdersHistoryStructureDetailResponse) =>
        response.ordersHistoryStructureDetail[0],
    }),
    getEventsHistory: builder.query<EventHistoryResponse, EventHistoryFiltersType>({
      query: ({ productId, ...params }) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/persons/current/timeline`,
        params: { product_Id: productId, ...params },
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

export const tradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollApi = createInfiniteScrollQuery<
  ParsedTradeOrdersHistoryResponse,
  TradeOrdersHistoryRequest
>({
  reducerPath: 'tradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollApi',
  query: ({ subAccountId, productId, portfolioId, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, ...others }) => ({
    url: API_REQUEST_TRADING_ORDERS,
    params: {
      subAccount_Id: subAccountId,
      product_Id: productId,
      portfolio_Id: portfolioId,
      instrument_Id: instrumentId,
      tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId,
      ...others,
    },
  }),
  transformResponse: (response: TradeOrdersHistoryResponse) => {
    return {
      orderList: parseOrdersHistory(response.orderList),
      subscription: response.subscription,
    };
  },
  addNextPage: (state, newPage) => {
    if (state?.orderList) {
      for (const orderId of newPage.orderList.ids) {
        if (state.orderList.ids.includes(orderId)) {
          state.orderList.entities[orderId].push(...newPage.orderList.entities[orderId]);
        } else {
          state.orderList.ids.push(orderId);
          state.orderList.entities[orderId] = newPage.orderList.entities[orderId];
        }
      }
    }
  },
  hasNextPage: (response) => {
    const itemsCount = Object.entries(response.orderList.entities).reduce(
      (acc, curr) => acc + curr[1].length,
      0,
    );
    return response.orderList.ids.length !== 0 && itemsCount === ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT;
  },
});

export const {
  useGetAdministrativeQuery,
  useGetAdministrativeParametersQuery,
  useGetNonTradeQuery,
  useGetNonTradeParametersQuery,
  useGetOrderDetailQuery,
  useGetOrderStatusesQuery,
  useGetProductsQuery,
  useUnsubscribeFromOrdersMutation,
  useGetDetailStructureQuery,
  useGetEventsHistoryQuery,
} = orderHistoryApi;

export const {
  useInfiniteScrollQuery: useTradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollQuery,
  useMutateState: useMutateTradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollState,
} = tradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollApi;

import { createApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

import {
  API_REQUEST_STOP_ORDER_BY_ORDER_NUM,
  API_REQUEST_TRADING_ORDERS,
} from 'core/api/apiConstants';

import {
  OrderRequest,
  OrderResponse,
  TradeOneOrderHistoryRequest,
  TradeOrdersHistoryRequest,
  TradeOrdersHistoryResponse,
} from 'types/orders';
import { DeleteOrderRequest } from 'types/orders/requests';
import { StopOrder } from 'types/stopOrders';

import { fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize } from './common';

// Define a service using a base URL and expected endpoints
export const ordersApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'ordersApi',
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize({ baseUrl: '' }),

  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getOrders: builder.query<TradeOrdersHistoryResponse, TradeOrdersHistoryRequest>({
      query: ({ subAccountId, productId, portfolioId, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, ...others }) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_TRADING_ORDERS,
        params: {
          subAccount_Id: subAccountId,
          product_Id: productId,
          portfolio_Id: portfolioId,
          instrument_Id: instrumentId,
          tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId,
          ...others,
        },
      }),
    }),

    getStopOrder: builder.query<StopOrder, number>({
      query: (orderNum) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_STOP_ORDER_BY_ORDER_NUM}/${orderNum}`,
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: { stopOrderDetails: StopOrder[] }) =>
        response.stopOrderDetails[0],
    }),

    createOrder: builder.mutation<OrderResponse, OrderRequest>({
      query: ({
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
        subAccountId,
        ideaHistoryId,
        ipoId,
        personalRecommendationId,
        amount,
        ...other
      }) => ({
        url: `/rs/${ipoId && !amount ? 'v2' : 'v3'}/trading/orders`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          subAccount_Id: subAccountId,
          instrument_Id: instrumentId,
          tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId,
          ideaHistory_Id: ideaHistoryId,
          personalRecommendation_Id: personalRecommendationId,
          ipo_Id: ipoId,
          amount,
          ...other,
        },
      }),
    }),

    deleteOrder: builder.mutation<OrderResponse, DeleteOrderRequest>({
      query: ({ orderNum, subAccountId, tradePlaceId, ...other }) => ({
        url: `/rs/v2/trading/orders/${orderNum}`,
        method: 'DELETE',
        body: {
          subAccount_Id: subAccountId,
          tradePlace_Id: tradePlaceId,
          ...other,
        },
      }),
    }),
    getOneOrder: builder.query<TradeOrdersHistoryResponse, TradeOneOrderHistoryRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_TRADING_ORDERS,
        params: params,
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

// Export hooks for usage in functional components, which are
// auto-generated based on the defined endpoints
export const {
  useCreateOrderMutation,
  useDeleteOrderMutation,
  useGetOrdersQuery,
  useGetStopOrderQuery,
  useLazyGetStopOrderQuery,
  useLazyGetOrdersQuery,
  useGetOneOrderQuery,
} = ordersApi;

    }),

    saveFormAddress: builder.mutation<void, any>({
      query: ({ requestGuid, ...params }) => ({
        url: API_SAVE_ADDRESS_CHANGES_FORM_DRAFT,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
          ...params,
        },
      }),
    }),
    saveFormAddressPostal: builder.mutation<void, any>({
      query: ({ requestGuid, ...params }) => ({
        url: API_SAVE_ADDRESS_POSTAL_CHANGES_FORM_DRAFT,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
          ...params,
        },
      }),
    }),

    saveFormPersonData: builder.mutation<void, PersonalDataRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid }) => ({
        url: API_SAVE_PERSON_DATA_CHANGES_FORM_DRAFT,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
          businessRelationsConfirm: true,
          independentConfirm: true,
        },
      }),
    }),

    saveFormBusinessRelations: builder.mutation<void, RequestBusinessDataType>({
      query: ({ ...props }) => ({
        url: API_SAVE_BUSINESS_RELATIONS_CHANGES_FORM_DRAFT,
        method: 'POST',
        body: props,
      }),
    }),

    saveResidencesStatusData: builder.mutation<void, ResidencesStatus>({
      query: ({ ...props }) => ({
        url: API_SET_RESIDENCES_STATUS,
        method: 'POST',
        body: props,
      }),
    }),

    getPersonalDraftStatus: builder.query<PersonalDraftStatusType, void>({
      query: () => ({
        url: API_GET_PROFILE_DRAFT_STATUS,
        method: 'GET',
        params: {
          datasets: 'AnketDataStatus',
        },
      }),
    }),

    saveSrcData: builder.mutation<void, RequestSrcDataType>({
      query: ({ ...props }) => ({
        url: API_SAVE_SRC_CHANGES_FORM_DRAFT,
        method: 'POST',
        body: props,
      }),
    }),

    checkForm: builder.query<RequestErrorList[], PersonalDataRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid }) => ({
        url: API_CREATE_FORM_DRAFT_CHECK,
        params: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
        },
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: PersonalDataFormCheckResponse) => response.requestErrorList,
    }),

    checkListForm: builder.query<CheckListFormDataResponse, PersonalDataRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid }) => ({
        url: API_CREATE_FORM_DRAFT_CHECK_LIST,
        params: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
        },
      }),
    }),
    checkListFormFile: builder.query({
      query: ({ requestGuid }) => ({
        url: API_CREATE_FORM_DRAFT_CHECK_LIST_FILE,
        params: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
          type: 'Анкета',
        },
      }),
    }),

    getDraftForSign: builder.query<string, PersonalDataRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid }) => ({
        url: API_GETTING_DRAFT,
        params: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
        },
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: GetDraftRequestStatusType) => response.requestStatus[0].status,
    }),

    setFormDraftVerify: builder.mutation<OTPChallengeResponse, PersonalDataRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid }) => ({
        url: API_CREATE_FORM_DRAFT_VERIFY,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
        },
      }),
    }),

    getFormDraftData: builder.query<DraftProfileResponse, PersonalDataRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid }) => ({
        url: API_CREATE_FORM_DRAFT,
        params: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
        },
      }),
    }),

    getHdoDictionaries: builder.query<PersonalDataHdoRequest, void>({
      query: () => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_GET_HDO_DICTIONARIES,
      }),
    }),

    getResidenceCountries: builder.query<CountryListItem[], void>({
      query: () => ({
        url: API_GET_COUNTRIES_BY_KLADR,
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: CountriesDictionaryType) =>
        response.countries.map((item, index) => {
          return {
            id: index,
            value: item.name,
            code: item.code,
          };
        }),
    }),

    getCrsIssues: builder.query<InncrsAbsenceReasonType[], void>({
      query: () => ({
        url: API_GET_CRS_ISSUES,
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: CrsIssuesType) => response.inncrsAbsenceReason,
    }),

    getKladrValue: builder.query({
      query: ({ query, typeFilter }) => ({
        url: API_CHECK_KLADR,
        params: {
          query,
          maxCount: 5,
          typeFilter,
        },
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: any) => {
        return response.suggestionList.map((item: any, index: number) => {
          return {
            value: item.value,
            id: index,
            postalCode: item.postalCode,
            region: item.region,
            regionType: item.regionType,
          };
        });
      },
    }),

    uploadFiles: builder.mutation<any, UploadDraftFilesRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid, type, file }) => ({
        url: API_UPLOAD_FILES,
        method: 'POST',
        body: createFormData({ guid: requestGuid, type, file }),
      }),
    }),

    uploadFilesCommit: builder.mutation<any, UploadDraftFilesCommitRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid, type }) => ({
        url: API_UPLOAD_FILES_COMMIT,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
          type,
        },
      }),
    }),

    cancelFormDraft: builder.mutation<void, PersonalDataRequest>({
      query: ({ requestGuid }) => ({
        url: API_CANCEL_FORM_DRAFT,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
        },
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

function createFormData({ guid, type, file }: any) {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('request_Guid', guid);
  formData.append('type', type);
  if (file.length) {
    file.forEach((item: any) => formData.append('file', item));
  }
  return formData;
}

export const {
  useGetPersonalDraftStatusQuery,
  useSaveFormAddressPostalMutation,
  useUploadFilesCommitMutation,
  useUploadFilesMutation,
  useSaveResidencesStatusDataMutation,
  useSaveSrcDataMutation,
  useGetCrsIssuesQuery,
  useGetResidenceCountriesQuery,
  useLazyGetFormDraftDataQuery,
  useSaveFormBusinessRelationsMutation,
  useSaveFormPersonDataMutation,
  useGetHdoDictionariesQuery,
  useSaveFormPassportMutation,
  useSaveFormFIOMutation,
  useSaveFormAddressMutation,
  useLazyGetKladrValueQuery,
  useGetKladrValueQuery,
  useSaveFormEmailMutation,
  useSaveFormPhoneMutation,
  useCancelFormDraftMutation,
  useGetDraftForSignQuery,
  useLazyGetDraftForSignQuery,
  useSaveFormDraftMutation,
  useLazyGetFormDraftQuery,
  useCreateFormDraftMutation,
  useSaveFormSnilsMutation,
  useSaveFormINNMutation,
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useDeleteFormDraftMutation,
  useLazyCheckListFormQuery,
  useCheckListFormFileQuery,
  useSetFormDraftVerifyMutation,
} = personalDataApi;

import { createApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

import { dateFormatterForSave } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/components/Passport/helper';

import { ErrorData } from 'types/auth';
import {
  CreateReportRequest,
  CreateReportResponse,
  ReportHistoryFilters,
  ReportHistoryResponse,
  ReportItem,
  ReportParameterData,
  ReportParametersResponse,
  ReportStatus,
  ReportStatusResponse,
  ReportsParametersResponse,
} from 'types/reports';

import { fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize } from './common';

export const reportsApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'reportsApi',
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize({ baseUrl: '/rs/v2' }),

  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getReportsParameters: builder.query<ReportsParametersResponse, void>({
      query: () => ({ url: '/reports/parameters' }),
    }),
    getReportStatus: builder.query<ReportStatus, string>({
      query: (reportRequestGuid) => ({ url: `/reports/${reportRequestGuid}/status` }),
      transformResponse: (resp: ReportStatusResponse) => resp?.reportRequestStatus?.[0]?.status,
    }),
    getReportParameters: builder.query<ReportParameterData, string>({
      query: (reportRequestGuid) => ({ url: `/reports/${reportRequestGuid}/parameters` }),
      transformResponse: (resp: ReportParametersResponse) => resp?.reportParameters?.[0],
    }),
    getReportsHistory: builder.query<ReportItem[], ReportHistoryFilters>({
      query: (filters) => ({
        url: '/reports',
        params: {
          fromDate: filters.fromDate,
          toDate: filters.toDate,
          codes: filters.reportTypeCode === 'all' ? undefined : filters.reportTypeCode,
        },
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: ReportHistoryResponse) => response.reportRequests || [],
    }),
    getReportFile: builder.query<File | ErrorData, number | undefined>({
      query: (fileId?: number) => ({ url: '/reports/file', params: { file_Id: fileId } }),
    }),
    createReport: builder.mutation<CreateReportResponse, CreateReportRequest>({
      query: (data) => ({
        url: 'reports',
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          reportType_Id: data.reportTypeId,
          portfolio_Id: data.portfolioId,
          product_Id: data.productId,
          depoAccount_Id: data.depoAccountId,
          instrument_Id: data.instrumentId,
          agreement_Id: data.agreementId,
          fromDate: data.fromDate ? dateFormatterForSave(data.fromDate) : undefined,
          toDate: data.toDate ? dateFormatterForSave(data.toDate) : undefined,
          sendViaEmail: Boolean(data.sendViaEmail),
        },
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

export const {
  useGetReportsParametersQuery,
  useLazyGetReportFileQuery,
  useGetReportParametersQuery,
  useLazyGetReportParametersQuery,
  useLazyGetReportStatusQuery,
  useLazyGetReportsHistoryQuery,
  useCreateReportMutation,
} = reportsApi;

      { productId: string | number; onlyPortfolio?: boolean }
    >({
      query: ({ productId, onlyPortfolio }) => ({
        url: getApiRequestPortfoliosFromProduct(productId),
        params: { onlyPortfolio: onlyPortfolio },
      }),
    }),

    getPortfoliosCollateral: builder.query<CollateralResponse, { portfolioId: string | number }>({
      query: ({ portfolioId }) => ({
        url: getApiRequestPortfoliosCollateral(portfolioId),
      }),
    }),

    postReport: builder.mutation<ReportParamsResponseType, ReportParamsType>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_STATISTIC_REPORT_CREATE_REQUEST,
        method: 'POST',
        body: params,
      }),
    }),
    getPositionParams: builder.query<
      PositionParamsResponse,
      { productId: string | number | undefined }
    >({
      query: ({ productId }) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_PERSONS_CURRENT_POSITION_PARAMS,
        params: { product_Id: productId },
      }),
    }),
    getCorporateEventsData: builder.query<
      CorporateEventsDataNormalized,
      {
        beginDate: string;
        endDate: string;
        datePart: DividendsPeriodsType;
        dateStep: number;
        currencyId: number;
        productId?: string;
      }
    >({
      query: ({ beginDate, endDate, datePart, dateStep, currencyId, productId }) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_PERSONS_CURRENT_CORPORATE_EVENTS_ALL,
        params: {
          begin_date: beginDate,
          end_date: endDate,
          date_part: datePart,
          date_step: dateStep,
          currency_Id: currencyId,
          product_Id: productId,
        },
      }),
      transformResponse: (data: CorporateEventsDataResponse): CorporateEventsDataNormalized => {
        const updatedData = {
          corporateEvent: corporateEventPaperNormalization(data.corporateEvent),
          corporateEventGroupedNormalized: getIsFactCorporativeEventsHelper(
            corporateEventNormalization(data.corporateEventGrouped),
          ),
          corporateEventTotal: corporateEventTotalFormatter(
            corporateEventNormalization(data.corporateEventTotal),
          ),
        };
        return updatedData;
      },
    }),
  }),
});

const corporateEventNormalization = (
  group: CorporateEventGroupedType[],
): CorporateEventGroupedType[] => {
  return group.map((item) => (item?.amount ? item : { ...item, amount: 0 }));
};

const corporateEventPaperNormalization = (group: CorporateEventType[]): CorporateEventType[] => {
  return group.map((item) => {
    const updatedItem = { ...item, date: DateTime.fromISO(item.date.toString()).toMillis() };
    return updatedItem;
  });
};

export const {
  useGetPositionParamsQuery,
  useLazyGetPositionParamsQuery,
  useGetCorporateEventsDataQuery,
  useGetProductPortfoliosQuery,
  useLazyGetProductPortfoliosQuery,
  useLazyGetCorporateEventsDataQuery,
  usePostReportMutation,
  useGetPortfoliosCollateralQuery,
  useLazyGetPortfoliosCollateralQuery,
} = statsApi;

export const getIsFactCorporativeEventsHelper = (data: CorporateEventGroupedType[]) => {
  const cpnIsFact = [] as CorporateEventGroupedType[];
  const cpnIsNotFact = [] as CorporateEventGroupedType[];
  const dvdIsFact = [] as CorporateEventGroupedType[];
  const dvdIsNotFact = [] as CorporateEventGroupedType[];

  const chartFormatter = (
    element: CorporateEventGroupedType,
    type: 'CPN' | 'DVD',
    isFact: boolean,
  ) => {
    const typeOfChart = type === 'CPN' ? (isFact ? 'pv' : 'uv') : isFact ? 'amt' : 'rv';
    return {
      ...element,
      normalizedData: Date.parse(element.startDate),
      normalizedStartDate: Date.parse(element.startDate),
      normalizedEndDate: Date.parse(element.endDate),
      [typeOfChart]: element.amount,
    };
  };

  data.forEach((item) => {
    if (item.typeCode === 'CPN') {
      if (item.isFact) {
        cpnIsFact.push(chartFormatter(item, 'CPN', true));
      } else {
        cpnIsNotFact.push(chartFormatter(item, 'CPN', false));
      }
    } else {
      if (item.isFact) {
        dvdIsFact.push(chartFormatter(item, 'DVD', true));
      } else {
        dvdIsNotFact.push(chartFormatter(item, 'DVD', false));
      }
    }
  });
  return {
    cpnIsFact: cpnIsFact,
    cpnIsNotFact: cpnIsNotFact,
    dvdIsFact: dvdIsFact,
    dvdIsNotFact: dvdIsNotFact,
  };
};

export const getMaxEventValue = (data: CorporateEventGroupedType[]) => {
  return [...data].sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount)[0].amount;
};

export const corporateEventTotalFormatter = (data: CorporateEventGroupedType[]) => {
  const cpnFact = data.find((item) => item.isFact && item.typeCode === 'CPN');
  const cpnIsNotFact = data.find((item) => !item.isFact && item.typeCode === 'CPN');
  const dvdFact = data.find((item) => item.isFact && item.typeCode === 'DVD');
  const dvdIsNotFact = data.find((item) => !item.isFact && item.typeCode === 'DVD');

  return {
    amountCurrency:
      cpnFact?.amountCurrency ||
      cpnIsNotFact?.amountCurrency ||
      dvdFact?.amountCurrency ||
      dvdIsNotFact?.amountCurrency ||
      null,
    cpnValue: cpnFact?.amount || 0,
    dvdValue: dvdFact?.amount || 0,
    cpnIsNotFact: cpnIsNotFact?.amount || 0,
    dvdIsNotFact: dvdIsNotFact?.amount || 0,
  };
};

    >({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_SECURITIES_CONTRACTORS,
        params: params?.sbp === true ? { sbp: true } : undefined,
      }),
      transformResponse: (
        data: SecuritiesContractorsResponse | SecuritiesContractor[] | Record<string, unknown>,
      ) => {
        console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] GET /v1/nontrade/securities/contractors raw', data);

        if (Array.isArray(data)) {
          return data;
        }

        const record = data as Record<string, unknown>;
        const list =
          (record.contractors as SecuritiesContractor[] | undefined) ??
          (record.contractor as SecuritiesContractor[] | undefined) ??
          (record.counterparties as SecuritiesContractor[] | undefined) ??
          (record.counterparty as SecuritiesContractor[] | undefined);

        return Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
      },
    }),

    >({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF,

        return Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];

import { createApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';

import { UserSettingRequest, UserSettingResponse, UserSettingTransform } from 'types/userSetting';

import { fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize } from './common';

// Define a service using a base URL and expected endpoints
export const userSettingApi = createApi({
  reducerPath: 'userSettingApi',
  baseQuery: fetchBaseQueryWithCamelize({ baseUrl: '/rs/v1' }),
  tagTypes: ['setting'],
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    getUserSetting: builder.query<UserSettingResponse, { name: string } | void>({
      query: (params) => ({ url: `/users/current/setting`, params }),
      providesTags: ['setting'],
    }),
    updateUserSetting: builder.mutation<void, UserSettingRequest>({
      query: ({ noRefetch, ...body }) => ({ url: `/users/current/setting`, method: 'POST', body }),
      invalidatesTags: (result, error, { noRefetch }) => (noRefetch ? [] : ['setting']),
    }),
    getUserSettingTransform: builder.query<UserSettingTransform, { name: string } | void>({
      query: (params) => ({ url: `/users/current/setting`, params }),
      providesTags: ['setting'],
      transformResponse: (response: UserSettingResponse) => {
        return response.userSetting.reduce((acc, item) => {
          acc = { ...acc, [item.name]: item };
          return acc;
        }, {});
      },
    }),
  }),
});

// Export hooks for usage in functional components, which are
// auto-generated based on the defined endpoints
export const {
  useGetUserSettingQuery,
  useUpdateUserSettingMutation,
  useGetUserSettingTransformQuery,
  useLazyGetUserSettingTransformQuery,
} = userSettingApi;

import {
  API_REQUEST_CATALOG_GROUP,
  API_REQUEST_INVEST_IDEAS_LIST,
  API_REQUEST_URL,
  API_REQUEST_URL_V3,
} from 'core/api/apiConstants';

import {
  FXSpotGroupType,
  GetInvestIdeasRequest,
  GetInvestIdeasResponse,
  GetTopCurrenciesRequest,
  GetTopCurrenciesResponse,
  ITransformCurrencyValuation,
  ProductsSortingListType,
  SetCurrencyRequest,
  StoriesListType,
  UserProductTypeRequest,
  UserProductsType,
  UserProductsTypeResponse,
} from 'types/view360';

import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from './apiUnionEntryPoint';

export const view360Api = apiUnionEntryPoint.injectEndpoints({
  endpoints: (builder) => ({
    productsListDictionary: builder.query<ProductsSortingListType, string>({
      query: (sortType) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/dictionaries/instruments/groups`,
        params: {
          sortType,
        },
      }),
    }),
    fxSpotList: builder.query<FXSpotGroupType, string>({
      query: (base_currency_code) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/instruments/fxspot`,
        params: {
          base_currency_code,
          quote_currency_code: 'RUB',
          defaultOnly: false,
        },
      }),
    }),
    storiesList: builder.query<StoriesListType, void>({
      query: (it) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/stories`,
      }),
    }),
    updateStoryReadStatus: builder.mutation({
      query: (story_id) => ({ url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/stories/${story_id}/read`, method: 'POST' }),
    }),
    updateStoryClickStatus: builder.mutation({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/stories/${params.storyId}/action_receipt`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          pageUrl: params.url,
        },
      }),
    }),
    getProductsData: builder.query<UserProductsType, UserProductTypeRequest>({
      query: ({ params }) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL_V3}/persons/current/position`,
        params: params,
      }),
      transformResponse: (response: UserProductsTypeResponse) => {
        const uniqueIds: number[] = [];
        let transformCurrencyValuation: ITransformCurrencyValuation = {};
        if (response.currencyValuationByPortfolio) {
          response.currencyValuationByPortfolio?.forEach((item) => {
            if (uniqueIds.includes(item.portfolioId)) {
              transformCurrencyValuation[item.portfolioId].push(item);
            } else {
              transformCurrencyValuation = {
                ...transformCurrencyValuation,
                [item.portfolioId]: [item],
              };
              uniqueIds.push(item.portfolioId);
            }
          });
        }
        return { ...response, currencyValuationByPortfolio: transformCurrencyValuation || {} };
      },
    }),
    setCurrency: builder.mutation<void, SetCurrencyRequest>({
      query: ({ productId, currencyCode }) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_URL}/products/${productId}/currency`,
        method: 'POST',
        body: { currencyCode },
      }),
    }),
    getInvestIdeas: builder.query<GetInvestIdeasResponse, GetInvestIdeasRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: API_REQUEST_INVEST_IDEAS_LIST,
        params: {
          product_id: params.productId,
          instrument_id: params.instrumentId,
          is_active: params.isActive,
          category_id: params.categoryId,
          status_code: params.statusCode,
          buy_hold_marker: params.buyHoldMarker,
          order_by: params.orderBy,
          rows_offset: params.rowsOffset,
          rows_count: params.rowsCount,
          is_personal: params.isPersonal,
          ...params,
        },
      }),
    }),
    getTopCurrencies: builder.query<GetTopCurrenciesResponse, GetTopCurrenciesRequest>({
      query: (params) => ({
        url: `${API_REQUEST_CATALOG_GROUP}/top_currencies`,
        params: params,
      }),
    }),
  }),
});

export const {
  useProductsListDictionaryQuery,
  useStoriesListQuery,
  useUpdateStoryReadStatusMutation,
  useUpdateStoryClickStatusMutation,
  useLazyFxSpotListQuery,
  useGetProductsDataQuery,
  useSetCurrencyMutation,
  useLazyGetProductsDataQuery,
  useGetInvestIdeasQuery,
  useGetTopCurrenciesQuery,
} = view360Api;

import { BannerTypeCheckerFnType } from 'core/banners/types';

import { BannerType, CarouselType } from 'types/banners';

const isShowBanner = (id: number, isClosed?: Record<string, boolean>) => {
  if (!isClosed) return true;
  return !isClosed?.[id];
};

const bannersContainCertainType = (banners: BannerType[], checker: BannerTypeCheckerFnType) => {
  if (!banners) return false;
  for (const banner of banners) {
    if (checker(banner)) return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const carouselsContainCertainBannerType = (
  carousels: CarouselType[] | undefined,
  checker: BannerTypeCheckerFnType,
) => {
  if (!carousels) return false;
  for (const carousel of carousels) {
    if (bannersContainCertainType(carousel.banners, checker)) return true;
  }
  return false;
};

export const prepareBanners = (
  banners: BannerType[],
  isClosed: Record<string, boolean> | undefined,
) => {
  const preparedBanners = banners
    .map((banner) => {
      if (!isShowBanner(banner.id, isClosed)) return null;
      return banner;
    })
    .filter(Boolean) as BannerType[];
  return preparedBanners.sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
};

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useLocalStorage } from 'react-use';

import { useGetBannersQuery } from 'core/api/banners';
import { DEFAULT_PLATFORM } from 'core/banners/consts';
import { prepareBanners } from 'core/banners/helpers';
import { BannersState, UseBanners } from 'core/banners/types';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

const useBanners = ({ locationPoint, platform = DEFAULT_PLATFORM, ...props }: UseBanners) => {
  const { clientCode } = getSession() || {};
  const { data: carouselsResponse, isLoading: isCarouselsLoading } = useGetBannersQuery({
    platform,
    clientCode,
    ...props,
  });

  const [isClosed, setIsClosed] = useLocalStorage<BannersState | undefined>('banners');

  const isLoading = isCarouselsLoading;

  const carousels = useMemo(() => {
    const openDBClientId = getSession()?.openDbClientId;

    if (!openDBClientId) return;

    return carouselsResponse?.data
      ?.filter((f) => f.locationPoint === locationPoint)
      ?.sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority)
      ?.map((el) => ({
        ...el,
        banners: prepareBanners(el.banners, isClosed?.[openDBClientId]),
      }))
      ?.filter((f) => f.banners.length !== 0);
  }, [carouselsResponse, locationPoint, isClosed]);

  const handleClose = (id: number) => () => {
    const openDBClientId = getSession()?.openDbClientId;

    if (!openDBClientId) return;
    setIsClosed({
      ...isClosed,
      [openDBClientId]: {
        ...isClosed?.[openDBClientId],
        [id]: true,
      },
    });
  };
  return { carousels, handleClose, isLoading };
};

export default useBanners;

import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';

import { useLazyGetCategoriesQuery } from 'core/api/categorization';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

const PERSON_CATEGORIZATION = 'PERSON_CATEGORIZATION';

const useCategorization = () => {
  const session = getSession();

  const [getCategories, { isError: isCategoriesError, data: categoriesData }] =
    useLazyGetCategoriesQuery();

  const hasTestingAccess = useMemo(() => {
    if (!session) {
      return null;
    }

    if (session.isQual) {
      return false;
    }

    return Permissions.granted(PERSON_CATEGORIZATION);
  }, [session]);

  const { categories, ...testingProgress } = useMemo(() => {
    if (isCategoriesError || !categoriesData) {
      return { passed: 0, all: 0, categories: [] };
    }

    const { categories } = categoriesData;

    const passedCount = categories.reduce((acc, category) => (category.passed ? acc + 1 : acc), 0);

    return { categories, passed: passedCount, all: categories.length };
  }, [isCategoriesError, categoriesData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasTestingAccess && session) {
      getCategories(session.personId);
    }
  }, [hasTestingAccess, session, getCategories]);

  const isSomeDataNotFetched = !categoriesData;
  const isRequestsHaveNoErrors = hasTestingAccess !== false && !isCategoriesError;

  return {
    isLoading: isSomeDataNotFetched && isRequestsHaveNoErrors,
    hasTestingAccess,
    isActualQualOrder: session?.isActualQualOrder,
    personFirstName: session?.personFirstName,
    personLastName: session?.personLastName,
    testingProgress,
    categories,
  };
};

export { useCategorization };

import { UAParser } from 'ua-parser-js';

export const isMobileDevice = (): boolean => {
  if (matchMedia('(hover: none)').matches && matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches) {
    return true;
  } else {
    // Only as a last resort, fall back to user agent sniffing
    const { type } = new UAParser().getDevice();
    if (type === 'mobile' || type === 'tablet') {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
};

const YM_KEY = 'ym';
const MY_TRACKER_KEY = '_tmr';
const EVENT_TYPE = 'reachGoal';

const MAIL_ID = process.env.MAIL_COUNTER_ID;
const YANDEX_METRIKA_ID = process.env.YANDEX_METRIKA_ID;

type TTrackerParams = Record<string, string>;

export const loginEvent = (personId: number) => {
  const tmr = window?.[MY_TRACKER_KEY];

  MAIL_ID &&
    tmr?.push({
      id: MAIL_ID,
      type: 'reachGoal',
      goal: 'mt_login',
      userid: String(personId),
    });
};

export const setupUserId = (personId: number) => {
  const ymw = window?.[YM_KEY];
  const tmr = window?.[MY_TRACKER_KEY];

  YANDEX_METRIKA_ID &&
    ymw?.(Number(YANDEX_METRIKA_ID), 'userParams', {
      UserID: Number(personId),
    });
  MAIL_ID && tmr?.push({ type: 'setUserID', userid: String(personId) });
};

export const reachGoal = (target: string, id: string, params?: TTrackerParams) => {
  const ymw = window?.[YM_KEY];
  const tmr = window?.[MY_TRACKER_KEY];

  YANDEX_METRIKA_ID && ymw?.(+YANDEX_METRIKA_ID, EVENT_TYPE, target, { [id]: params ?? true });

  MAIL_ID &&
    tmr?.push({
      goal: id,
      id: MAIL_ID,
      type: EVENT_TYPE,
      ...(params && { params }),
    });
};

--- FILE: src\core\helpers\createInfiniteScrollQuery.ts ---

import { useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux';
import { useShallowCompareEffect } from 'react-use';

import { Draft, PayloadAction, createAsyncThunk, createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { RootState } from 'store';

import { createUrlWithParams, fetchWithCamelize } from 'core/api/common';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import { Status } from 'types/common';

type ResponseType<T> = T | undefined;
type QueryParams<T> = {
  url: string;
  params: T | undefined;
};

type CreateInfiniteScrollQueryType<Response = any, Request = any> = {
  reducerPath: string;
  query: (args: Request) => QueryParams<Request>;
  transformResponse?: (response: any) => Response;
  addNextPage: (state: Draft<ResponseType<Response>>, newPage: Response) => void;
  hasNextPage: (data: Response) => boolean;
};

type StateType<T> = {
  data: ResponseType<T>;
  error: unknown;
  page: number;
  hasNextPage: boolean;
  status: Status;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  isFetching: boolean;
  isNextPageFetching: boolean;
  isNextPageError: boolean;
};

type UseInfiniteScrollQueryHookType = {
  skip?: boolean;
};

type MutateStateActionPayloadType<T> = {
  callback: (state: T) => void;
};

const createInfiniteScrollQuery = <Response = any, Request = any>({
  reducerPath,
  query,
  transformResponse,
  addNextPage,
  hasNextPage,
}: CreateInfiniteScrollQueryType<Response, Request>) => {
  const initialState: StateType<Response> = {
    data: undefined,
    error: undefined,
    page: 0,
    hasNextPage: true,
    status: 'idle',
    isLoading: false,
    isError: false,
    isFetching: false,
    isNextPageFetching: false,
    isNextPageError: false,
  };

  const asyncThunkFirstPageQuery = createAsyncThunk(
    reducerPath + 'FirstPageQuery',
    async (params: Request) => {
      const { url, params: _params } = query(params);

      return await fetchWithCamelize(createUrlWithParams(url, _params));
    },
  );

  const asyncThunkNextPageQuery = createAsyncThunk(
    reducerPath + 'NextPageQuery',
    async (params: Request) => {
      const { url, params: _params } = query(params);

      return await fetchWithCamelize(createUrlWithParams(url, _params));
    },
  );

  const slice = createSlice({
    name: reducerPath,
    initialState,
    reducers: {
      mutateState: (
        state,
        action: PayloadAction<MutateStateActionPayloadType<Draft<ResponseType<Response>>>>,
      ) => {
        action.payload.callback(state.data);
      },
      resetStore: () => initialState,
    },
    extraReducers: (builder) => {
      builder
        .addCase(asyncThunkFirstPageQuery.pending, (state) => {
          if (state.status === 'idle') {
            state.isLoading = true;
          }
          state.isFetching = true;
          state.status = 'pending';
        })
        .addCase(asyncThunkFirstPageQuery.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
          state.data = transformResponse ? transformResponse(action.payload) : action.payload;
          state.page = 1;
          state.hasNextPage = transformResponse
            ? hasNextPage(transformResponse(action.payload))
            : hasNextPage(action.payload);
          state.isLoading = false;
          state.isFetching = false;
          state.status = 'success';
        })
        .addCase(asyncThunkFirstPageQuery.rejected, (state, action) => {
          if (state.status === 'pending') {
            state.status = 'error';
            state.isLoading = false;
            state.isFetching = false;
            state.isError = true;
            state.hasNextPage = false;
            state.error = action.payload;
          }
        })
        .addCase(asyncThunkNextPageQuery.pending, (state) => {
          if (state.status === 'idle') {
            state.isLoading = true;
          }
          state.isNextPageFetching = true;
          state.status = 'pending';
        })
        .addCase(asyncThunkNextPageQuery.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
          const transformedResponse = transformResponse
            ? transformResponse(action.payload)
            : action.payload;
          addNextPage(state.data, transformedResponse);
          state.page += 1;
          state.hasNextPage = transformResponse
            ? hasNextPage(transformResponse(action.payload))
            : hasNextPage(action.payload);
          state.isLoading = false;
          state.isNextPageFetching = false;
          state.status = 'success';
        })
        .addCase(asyncThunkNextPageQuery.rejected, (state, action) => {
          if (state.status === 'pending') {
            state.status = 'error';
            state.isLoading = false;
            state.isNextPageFetching = false;
            state.hasNextPage = false;
            state.isNextPageError = true;
            state.error = action.payload;
          }
        });
    },
  });

  const useInfiniteScrollQuery = (params: Request, settings?: UseInfiniteScrollQueryHookType) => {
    const { skip } = settings || {};

    const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

    const nextPage = (params: Request) => {
      dispatch(asyncThunkNextPageQuery(params));
    };

    const refresh = (params: Request) => {
      dispatch(asyncThunkFirstPageQuery(params));
    };

    useShallowCompareEffect(() => {
      if (!skip) {
        dispatch(asyncThunkFirstPageQuery(params));
      }
    }, [dispatch, params, skip]);

    useEffect(() => {
      return () => {
        dispatch(slice.actions.resetStore());
      };
    }, [dispatch]);

    return [
      useCallback(nextPage, [dispatch]),
      useSelector(
        (
          store: RootState & { [key: typeof reducerPath]: StateType<Response> },
        ): StateType<Response> => {
          return store[reducerPath];
        },
      ),
      useCallback(refresh, [dispatch]),
    ] as const;
  };

  const useMutateState = () => {
    const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

    const mutateStore = ({
      callback,
    }: MutateStateActionPayloadType<Draft<ResponseType<Response>>>) => {
      dispatch(slice.actions.mutateState({ callback }));
    };
    return useCallback(mutateStore, [dispatch]);
  };

  return {
    reducerPath: slice.name,
    reducer: slice.reducer,
    useInfiniteScrollQuery,
    useMutateState,
  };
};

export default createInfiniteScrollQuery;

import { ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/consts';
import { getDate } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';

import { FormattedIpoOrders, IpoOrderResponse } from 'types/ipoOrder';

export const getFormattedIpoOrders = (rawIpoOrders: IpoOrderResponse): FormattedIpoOrders => {
  const formattedIpoOrders: FormattedIpoOrders = {};

  for (const item of rawIpoOrders.ipoOrderList) {
    const date = getDate(item.time);

    if (date in formattedIpoOrders) {
      formattedIpoOrders[date].push(item);
    } else {
      formattedIpoOrders[date] = [item];
    }
  }

  return formattedIpoOrders;
};

export const addIpoOrdersNextPage = (
  state: FormattedIpoOrders | undefined,
  newPage: FormattedIpoOrders,
) => {
  if (state) {
    Object.keys(newPage).forEach((item) => {
      if (Object.keys(state).includes(item)) {
        state[item].push(...newPage[item]);
      } else {
        state[item] = newPage[item];
      }
    });
  }
};

export const hasIpoOrdersNextPage = (ipoOrders: FormattedIpoOrders): boolean => {
  const itemsCount = Object.entries(ipoOrders).reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr[1].length, 0);

  return Object.keys(ipoOrders).length !== 0 && itemsCount === ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT;
};

import { BaseQueryErrorType } from 'core/types';

export const isError = (error: unknown): error is BaseQueryErrorType => {
  const data = (error as { data?: unknown })?.data;
  const first =
    data &&
    typeof data === 'object' &&
    'error' in data &&
    Array.isArray((data as { error: unknown }).error)
      ? (data as { error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).error[0]
      : undefined;

  return (
    typeof error === 'object' &&
    error != null &&
    'data' in error &&
    typeof data === 'object' &&
    data != null &&
    'error' in data &&
    Array.isArray((data as { error: unknown }).error) &&
    typeof first === 'object' &&
    first != null &&
    (('error' in first && typeof first.error === 'string') ||
      ('errorCode' in first && typeof first.errorCode === 'string') ||
      ('errorMessageText' in first && typeof first.errorMessageText === 'string'))
  );
};

import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';

const re = /"(StopOrderNum|OrderNum|LinkedOrderNum|TradeNum)"\s*:\s*(\d+(\.?\d*([Ee][+-]?\d*)?)?)/g;
const replacer = (_: string, p1: string, p2: string) => {
  const num = new BigNumber(p2);
  return `"${p1}":"${num}"`;
};

export const tradeOrderJsonParse = (text: string) => JSON.parse(text.replace(re, replacer));

export type currenciesType = 'RUB' | 'GBP' | 'EUR' | 'USD' | 'JPY' | 'CNY';

/**
 * Методы для форматирования чисел:
 * sumFormatter: 1234234.12 -> 1 234 234,12
 * @param  {Number} d Число
 * @param  {Number} [precision=2] Точность округления, если -1 – то сохранить
 *                                изначальную точность
 * @param  {Number, null} [minPrecision=null] Минимальная точность округления,
 *                                      работает только, когда precision = -1
 *                                      и текущая точность меньше minPrecision
 * @return {string} Отформатированная строка
 */
export const sumFormatter = function (d: number, precision = 2, minPrecision = null) {
  if (d && !Number.isNaN(Number.parseFloat(d.toString())) && Number.isFinite(d)) {
    // nothing
  } else {
    d = 0;
  }
  const _d = new BigNumber(d);
  let v;

  if (precision === -1) {
    v = minPrecision !== null ? _d.toString(10) : _d.toString(10);
  } else {
    v = _d.toFixed(precision);
  }

  const r = new RegExp('\\B(?=(\\d{3})+(?!\\d)' + (/\.|,/.test(v) ? ',' : '') + ')', 'g');

  return v.replace('.', ',').replace(r, ' ');
};

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */

/* функция хелпер для lazy импорта компонент, которые экспортируются без default'а */
import { lazy } from 'react';

export const lazyToDefault = <T extends Record<string, unknown>, U extends keyof T>(
  loader: (x?: string) => Promise<T>,
) =>
  new Proxy({} as unknown as T, {
    get: (_, componentName: string) => {
      return lazy(() =>
        loader(componentName).then((x) => ({
          default: x[componentName as U] as any as React.ComponentType<any>,
        })),
      );
    },
  });

import { NO_REDIRECT_TO_LK } from 'const/sessionConst';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

const LK_HOSTS = {
  prod: 'https://vykupicb.investpalata.ru',
  tt: 'https://vykupicb-tt.investpalata.ru',
} as const;

type LKHost = keyof typeof LK_HOSTS;

export const getLkHost = () => LK_HOSTS[(process.env.TIER as LKHost) || 'prod'];

export const getLkUrl = (uri?: string) => {
  const url = new URL(uri || '', getLkHost());
  url.searchParams.set('from', 'pwa');
  return url.toString();
};

const getRedirectFlag = () => sessionStorage.getItem(NO_REDIRECT_TO_LK);

export const checkRedirectToLK = (): boolean => {
  const noNeedRedirect = getRedirectFlag() === 'yes';
  return !noNeedRedirect && !isMobileDevice();
};

export const redirectToLK = () => window.location.replace(getLkHost());

const handleRedirectOrigin = (): void => {
  const { search } = window?.location ?? {};
  if (search?.toLowerCase().includes(NO_REDIRECT_TO_LK)) {
    sessionStorage.setItem(NO_REDIRECT_TO_LK, 'yes');
  }
};

export const checkDeviceAndRedirectToLK = (): void => {
  handleRedirectOrigin();
  if (checkRedirectToLK()) {
    redirectToLK();
  }
};

export const getLkUrlWithoutParams = (uri?: string) => {
  const url = new URL(uri || '', getLkHost());
  return url.toString().replace(/\/$/, '');
};

import React from 'react';

export const removeBr = (children: React.ReactNode): React.ReactNode => {
  if (Array.isArray(children)) {
    return children.map((item) => {
      if (typeof item === 'object' && item && 'type' in item && item.type === 'br') {
        return ' ';
      }
      return item;
    });
  } else if (
    children &&
    typeof children === 'object' &&
    'props' in children &&
    'children' in children.props
  ) {
    return removeBr(children.props.children);
  }
  return children;
};

export const tabWithEnter = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
  const allInput = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("input"))
  if (event.keyCode === 13) {
    const index = allInput.indexOf(event.currentTarget)
    allInput[index+1]?.focus()
    event.preventDefault()
  }
}
