export const setViewport = (type: string, angle: number) => {
  const viewport = document.querySelector('meta[name=viewport]');
  if (viewport) {
    const isLandscape = type ? type.includes('landscape') : angle !== 0;
    if (isLandscape) {
      viewport.setAttribute(
        'content',
        'user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover, initial-scale=0.7, maximum-scale=0.7, minimum-scale=0.7',
      );
    } else {
      viewport.setAttribute('content', 'width=375, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover');
    }
  }
};

import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';

import {
  useLazyGetActiveOrderListQuery,
  useLazyGetProfileInfoQuery,
  useLazyGetProfileQuery,
} from 'core/api/investmentProfile';
import { useGetPersonalDraftStatusQuery } from 'core/api/personalData';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { isAnketExpired } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

const PERSON_INVESTMENTPROFILE = 'PERSON_INVESTMENTPROFILE';
const INVESTMENT_PROFILE_TYPE = 'investment_profile';
const INVESTMENT_PROFILE_STATUS_CODE = 'InvestmentProfile';
const WAITING_ANSWERS = 'waiting_answers';
const INVESTMENT_PROFILE_NOT_DEFINED = 'Не определен';

const STATUS_DETAIL_INITIAL_DATA = {
  statusDetailCode: null,
  statusDetailName: null,
  statusDetailValue: null,
  statusDetailValueDate: null,
  anketDataStatusCode: null,
};

const useInvestmentProfile = () => {
  const session = getSession();
  const isPermissionGranted = Permissions.granted(PERSON_INVESTMENTPROFILE);

  const [getProfileInfo, { isError: isProfileInfoError, data: profileInfoData }] =
    useLazyGetProfileInfoQuery();
  const [getActiveOrderList, { isError: isActiveOrderListError, data: activeOrderListData }] =
    useLazyGetActiveOrderListQuery();
  const [getProfile, { isError: isProfileError, data: profileData }] = useLazyGetProfileQuery();
  const { data } = useGetPersonalDraftStatusQuery();
  const isAnketDataExpired = isAnketExpired(data?.anketDataStatus[0]?.endDate || '');

  const hasInvestmentProfileAccess = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isProfileInfoError && !profileInfoData) {
      return null;
    }

    return !isProfileInfoError && isPermissionGranted;
  }, [isProfileInfoError, profileInfoData, isPermissionGranted]);

  const investmentProfile = useMemo(() => {
    if (!profileInfoData) {
      return null;
    }

    const investmentProfile = profileInfoData.info[0].investmentProfile;

    if (!investmentProfile) {
      return INVESTMENT_PROFILE_NOT_DEFINED;
    }

    return investmentProfile;
  }, [profileInfoData]);

  const { hasNotFinishedQuiz, requestGuid } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeOrderListData) {
      return {
        hasNotFinishedQuiz: null,
        requestGuid: null,
      };
    }

    const foundOrderInfo = activeOrderListData.ordersInfo.find((orderInfo) => {
      return orderInfo.type === INVESTMENT_PROFILE_TYPE && orderInfo.status === WAITING_ANSWERS;
    });

    return {
      hasNotFinishedQuiz: !!foundOrderInfo,
      requestGuid: foundOrderInfo ? foundOrderInfo.requestGuid : null,
    };
  }, [activeOrderListData]);

  const {
    statusDetailCode,
    statusDetailName,
    statusDetailValue,
    statusDetailValueDate,
    anketDataStatusCode,
  } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!profileData) {
      return STATUS_DETAIL_INITIAL_DATA;
    }

    const foundPersonStatusDetail = profileData.personStatusDetail.find(
      (detail) => detail.statusCode === INVESTMENT_PROFILE_STATUS_CODE,
    );

    const anketDataStatusCode = profileData.anketDataStatus[0]?.anketDataStatusCode;
    if (!foundPersonStatusDetail) {
      return { ...STATUS_DETAIL_INITIAL_DATA, anketDataStatusCode };
    }

    return {
      statusDetailCode: foundPersonStatusDetail.statusDetailCode,
      statusDetailName: foundPersonStatusDetail.statusDetailName,
      statusDetailValue: foundPersonStatusDetail.statusDetailValue,
      statusDetailValueDate: foundPersonStatusDetail.statusDetailValueDate,
      anketDataStatusCode,
    };
  }, [profileData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPermissionGranted && session) {
      getProfileInfo(session.personId);
      getActiveOrderList(session.personId);
      getProfile(session.personId);
    }
  }, [isPermissionGranted, session, getProfileInfo, getActiveOrderList, getProfile]);

  const isSomeDataNotFetched = !profileInfoData || !activeOrderListData || !profileData;
  const isRequestsHaveNoErrors =
    hasInvestmentProfileAccess !== false &&
    !isProfileInfoError &&
    !isActiveOrderListError &&
    !isProfileError;

  const updatedStatusCode = isAnketDataExpired ? 'DraftIsExpired' : anketDataStatusCode;

  return {
    isLoading: isSomeDataNotFetched && isRequestsHaveNoErrors,
    isError: isProfileInfoError || isActiveOrderListError || isProfileError,
    hasInvestmentProfileAccess,
    hasNotFinishedQuiz,
    requestGuid,
    isInvestmentProfileNotDefined: investmentProfile === INVESTMENT_PROFILE_NOT_DEFINED,
    investmentProfile,
    statusDetailCode,
    statusDetailName,
    statusDetailValue,
    statusDetailValueDate,
    formDataStatusCode: updatedStatusCode,
  };
};

export { useInvestmentProfile };

/**
 * Сервис для работы с нотифкациями от MW
 * @author Роман Чаругин <cr@redmadrobot.com>
 */
// eslint-disable-next-line
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

import Notificator from './notificator';
import { Notify } from './types';

class Notifications extends EventEmitter {
  private _notificator: Notificator;

  constructor() {
    super();

    this._notificator = new Notificator().onReceive((notification: Notify) =>
      this._onNotificationReceive(notification),
    );

    this._notificator.start();
  }

  /**
   * Обработчик уведомления
   * @param {object} notification Объект уведомления
   */
  _onNotificationReceive(notification: Notify) {
    this.emit(notification.type, notification.data);
  }

  /**
   * Подписаться на уведомление
   * @param {string} type Тип события
   * @param {function} callback Обработчик события
   * @return {function} Функция для отписки от уведомлений
   */
  // TODO: Временное решение с типом any
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  subscribe(type: string | symbol, callback: (data?: any) => void) {
    this.on(type, callback);
    this._notificator.start();
    return () => this.removeListener(type, callback);
  }
  // restart notifications by opening\closing socket
  reopenNotifications() {
    const prevSocket = this._notificator._getActiveSocket();
    if (prevSocket !== null) {
      prevSocket.close();
    }
    this._notificator.start();
  }

  closeNotification = (reason: string) => {
    this._notificator.closeConnection(reason);
  };

  /**
   * Sort by date ASC, oldest first
   *
   * @param messages
   * @param asc
   */
  sortMessages(messages: Notify[], asc = true) {
    return messages.sort((a, b) => {
      // follow dates is ISO string, and moment very slow for large list :(
      if (b.receiveTime > a.receiveTime) {
        //if (Moment(b.receiveTime).isAfter(a.receiveTime, 'second')) {
        return asc ? -1 : 1;
      } else {
        return asc ? 1 : -1;
      }
    });
  }
}

export default new Notifications();


--- FILE: src\core\notification\notificator.ts ---

import { API_SOCKET_NOTIFICATIONS } from 'const/apiSocketConstants';

import { tradeOrderJsonParse } from 'core/helpers/json';

import { Notify } from './types';

const pingMsg = 'PING';
const pongMsg = 'PONG';
let pingInterval: number | null = null;
let missedPongs = 0;

const RECONNECT_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 100;
let reconnectCounter = 0;
const tradeOrderType = /"Type"\s*:\s*"TradeOrderChanged"/;

/**
 * Класс проверки/получения уведомлений от сервера MW.
 * Нотификатор однажды стартовав работате до тех пор, пока
 * не завершится пользовательская сессия. После этого нотификатор
 * переходит в режим ожидания. Для продолжения работы после
 * штатного завершения необходимо вызвать метод start.
 */
export default class Notificator {
  private _socketPointer: WebSocket | null = null;
  private _isActive = false;
  private _onReceive: unknown;

  start() {
    if (!this._isActive && this._isWebSocketAvailalbe()) {
      this._asyncStart();
      this._isActive = true;
    }
  }

  _getActiveSocket() {
    return this._socketPointer ?? null;
  }

  _isWebSocketAvailalbe() {
    return !!window.WebSocket;
  }

  _asyncStart() {
    const sockStart = () => {
      try {
        const sock = new WebSocket(API_SOCKET_NOTIFICATIONS);
        this._socketPointer = sock;

        sock.addEventListener('error', (e) => console.error(e));

        sock.addEventListener('open', () => {
          if (pingInterval === null) {
            missedPongs = 0;
            pingInterval = window.setInterval(function () {
              try {
                missedPongs++;
                if (missedPongs >= 3) {
                  throw new Error('Too many missed pongs.');
                }

                if (sock.readyState <= 1) {
                  sock.send(pingMsg);
                }
              } catch (e) {
                window.clearInterval(pingInterval ?? 0);
                pingInterval = null;
                if (e instanceof Error) {
                  console.warn('Closing connection. Reason: ' + e.message);
                }
                sock.close();
              }
            }, 5000);
          }

          // reset
          reconnectCounter = 0;
        });

        // eslint-disable-next-line unicorn/prefer-add-event-listener
        sock.onmessage = (event: Event | MessageEvent) => {
          if (event instanceof MessageEvent) {
            if (event.data === pongMsg) {
              missedPongs = 0;
              return;
            }
            const isSockOpened = event.data !== 'OPEN';

            let parsedRes;
            if (!isSockOpened) {
              parsedRes = { Announcement: [] };
            } else if (tradeOrderType.test(event.data)) {
              parsedRes = tradeOrderJsonParse(event.data);
            } else {
              parsedRes = JSON.parse(event.data);
            }

            const notify = isSockOpened ? parsedRes.Announcement?.[0] : '';

            // OrderHistoryChanged:
            // {
            //   Announcement: [{ LastModified, Type }],
            //   ResponseData: [{ OrderHistoryList: [{ Order_Guid, Status, StatusCode, ... }] }]
            // }
            // ResponseData на верхнем уровне (рядом с Announcement), не внутри Announcement[0].
            let responseData = null;
            if (isSockOpened && notify) {
              const rawResponseData = parsedRes.ResponseData ?? notify.ResponseData;

              if (Array.isArray(rawResponseData)) {
                const first = rawResponseData[0];
                const isDirectOrderItem =
                  first &&
                  (first.Order_Guid != null ||
                    first.OrderGuid != null ||
                    first.StatusCode != null ||
                    first.Status != null);

                // массив заявок → весь массив; иначе обёртка [{ OrderHistoryList|tradeOrderList|... }]
                responseData = isDirectOrderItem ? rawResponseData : first ?? null;
              } else if (rawResponseData != null) {
                responseData = rawResponseData;
              }
            }

            if (typeof this._onReceive === 'function' && isSockOpened && notify) {
              this._onReceive({
                type: notify.Type,
                data: {
                  lastModified: notify.LastModified,
                  response: responseData,
                },
              });
            }
          }
        };

        // this socket will be reopened on close
        sock.addEventListener('close', (event: CloseEvent) => {
          if (
            event.code !==
            1000 /*event.code !== 1001 && event.code !== 1003 && event.code !== 1006*/
          ) {
            if (reconnectCounter <= RECONNECT_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
              sockStart();
              reconnectCounter++;
            } else {
              console.error(
                `Maximum number of reconnection attempts exceeded (${RECONNECT_MAX_ATTEMPTS})`,
              );
            }
          } else {
            this._isActive = false;

            if (pingInterval) {
              clearInterval(pingInterval);
              pingInterval = null;
            }
          }
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      }
    };

    sockStart();
  }

  closeConnection = (reason?: string) => {
    if (!this._socketPointer || !this._isActive) return;

    this._socketPointer.close(1000, reason);
  };

  onReceive(callback: (notification: Notify) => void) {
    this._onReceive = callback;
    return this;
  }
}


--- FILE: src\core\notification\types.ts ---

export type NotifyType = 'TOP' | 'MODAL' | string;

export type Notify = {
  action: unknown[];
  active: boolean;
  data?: unknown;
  event: string;

import { PayloadAction, createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

import {
  DEFAULT_OFFICES,
  DEFAULT_POSITION,
  DEFAULT_TITLE_CITY,
  DEFAULT_YOUR_POSITION,
  HEAD_OFFICE,
} from 'modules/Offices/consts';

import {
  BottomSheetStateType,
  HomeOfficeProps,
  OfficesListProps,
  OfficesProps,
  OfficesStateType,
  PositionProps,
} from 'types/offices';

const initialState: OfficesStateType = {
  bottomSheetState: null,
  name: '',
  officeId: 1,
  titleCity: DEFAULT_TITLE_CITY,
  position: DEFAULT_POSITION,
  yourPosition: DEFAULT_YOUR_POSITION,
  chosenCity: [],
  offices: DEFAULT_OFFICES,
  isNeededUpdatePosition: true,
  filteredOffices: [],
  homeOffice: HEAD_OFFICE,
  isNeededUpdateOffice: true,
};

export const officesSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'offices',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setBottomSheetState: (state, action: PayloadAction<BottomSheetStateType>) => {
      state.bottomSheetState = action.payload;
    },
    setName: (state, action: PayloadAction<string>) => {
      state.name = action.payload;
    },
    setOfficeId: (state, action: PayloadAction<number>) => {
      state.officeId = action.payload;
    },
    setTitleCity: (state, action: PayloadAction<string>) => {
      state.titleCity = action.payload;
    },
    setPosition: (state, action: PayloadAction<PositionProps>) => {
      state.position = action.payload;
    },
    setYourPosition: (state, action: PayloadAction<PositionProps>) => {
      state.yourPosition = action.payload;
    },
    setChosenCity: (state, action: PayloadAction<OfficesProps[]>) => {
      state.chosenCity = action.payload;
    },
    setOffices: (state, action: PayloadAction<OfficesListProps>) => {
      state.offices = action.payload;
    },
    setHomeOffices: (state, action: PayloadAction<HomeOfficeProps>) => {
      state.homeOffice = action.payload;
    },
    setIsNeededUpdatePosition: (state, action: PayloadAction<boolean>) => {
      state.isNeededUpdatePosition = action.payload;
    },
    setIsNeededUpdateOffice: (state, action: PayloadAction<boolean>) => {
      state.isNeededUpdateOffice = action.payload;
    },
    setIsFilteredOffices: (state, action: PayloadAction<OfficesProps[]>) => {
      state.filteredOffices = action.payload;
    },
  },
});

export const {
  setBottomSheetState,
  setName,
  setOfficeId,
  setTitleCity,
  setPosition,
  setYourPosition,
  setChosenCity,
  setOffices,
  setIsNeededUpdatePosition,
  setIsFilteredOffices,
  setHomeOffices,
  setIsNeededUpdateOffice,
} = officesSlice.actions;

export default officesSlice.reducer;

import { PermissionsValues, PermisssionList } from './types';

export const permissionsPriority = {
  GRANTED: 1,
  DENIED: 2,
  BLOCKED: 3,
  NONACTIVE: null,
};

/**
 * Простое правило
 */
const only = (permission: string) => {
  return (
    permissions: PermisssionList,
    objectId: string | number = 'default',
  ): PermissionsValues | null =>
    !!permissions[permission] && permissions[permission][objectId]
      ? permissions[permission][objectId]
      : null;
};

/**
 * Логическое «И» для проверки прав доступа
 */
const and = function (...permissionsList: string[]) {
  return (
    permissions: PermisssionList,
    objectId: string | number = 'default',
  ): PermissionsValues => {
    return permissionsList.reduce((res: 'GRANTED' | 'DENIED' | 'BLOCKED', p) => {
      const permission = only(p)(permissions, objectId) || 'DENIED';

      if (permission !== 'NONACTIVE') {
        return permissionsPriority[res] < permissionsPriority[permission] ? permission : res;
      } else {
        return res;
      }
    }, 'GRANTED');
  };
};

/**
 * Маппинг прав доступа на UI
 * @param  {object} permissions Объект с правами доступа
 * @return {object} Объект с правами
 */

import cloneDeep from 'lodash/cloneDeep';
import { store } from 'store';

import PermissionsMapConstants, { PermissionsMapConstantsKeys } from './constants';
import { setPermissions } from './permissionsSlice';
import { PermissionsValues } from './types';

export const Permissions = {
  get OBJECT_ALL() {
    return 'all';
  },

  get GRANTED(): 'GRANTED' {
    return 'GRANTED';
  },

  get NONACTIVE(): 'NONACTIVE' {
    return 'NONACTIVE';
  },

  get BLOCKED(): 'BLOCKED' {
    return 'BLOCKED';
  },

  get DENIED(): 'DENIED' {
    return 'DENIED';
  },

  get(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId: string | number = 'default') {
    const { list: permissions } = store.getState().permissions;
    const rule = PermissionsMapConstants[permission];

    let result = null;
    if (typeof rule === 'function') {
      result = rule(permissions, objectId);
    }

    //Debug.log('perm:: ' + permission + ' (' + objectId + ') = ' + result);

    return result;
  },

  getObject(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId?: string | number) {
    const { list: permissions } = store.getState().permissions;

    return objectId ? permissions[permission][objectId] : permissions[permission];
  },

  set(
    permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys,
    newValue: PermissionsValues,
    objectId: string | number = 'default',
  ) {
    const { list } = store.getState().permissions;
    const permissions = cloneDeep(list);
    const rule = PermissionsMapConstants[permission];

    let result = null;
    if (typeof rule === 'function') {
      result = rule(permissions, objectId);
    }

    // Debug.log('Set perm:: ' + permission + ' (' + objectId + ') = ' + result);

    permissions[permission][objectId] = newValue;
    store.dispatch(setPermissions(permissions));

    return permissions;
  },

  someGranted(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId = null) {
    return (
      this.someOf(permission, objectId, Permissions.GRANTED) ||
      this.someOf(permission, objectId, Permissions.NONACTIVE)
    );
  },

  someBlocked(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId = null) {
    return this.someOf(permission, objectId, Permissions.BLOCKED);
  },

  someOf(
    permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys,
    objectId: number | string | null = null,
    permissionLevel: PermissionsValues,
  ) {
    if (objectId) return this.get(permission, objectId) === permissionLevel;

    const { list: permissions } = store.getState().permissions;
    const p = permissions[permission];

    for (const key in p) {
      if (p[key] === permissionLevel) return true;
    }

    return false;
  },

  granted(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId: string | number = 'default') {
    return (
      this.get(permission, objectId) === Permissions.GRANTED ||
      this.get(permission, objectId) === Permissions.NONACTIVE
    );
  },

  onlyGranted(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId: string | number = 'default') {
    return this.get(permission, objectId) === Permissions.GRANTED;
  },

  blocked(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId: string | number = 'default') {
    return this.get(permission, objectId) === Permissions.BLOCKED;
  },

  denied(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId: string | number = 'default') {
    return this.get(permission, objectId) === Permissions.DENIED;
  },

  blockedOrDenied(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys, objectId: string | number = 'default') {
    return (
      this.get(permission, objectId) === Permissions.BLOCKED ||
      this.get(permission, objectId) === Permissions.DENIED
    );
  },

  personGranted(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys) {
    return (
      this.get(permission, Permissions.getPersonId()) === Permissions.GRANTED ||
      this.get(permission, Permissions.getPersonId()) === Permissions.NONACTIVE
    );
  },

  personBlocked(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys) {
    return this.get(permission, Permissions.getPersonId()) === Permissions.BLOCKED;
  },

  personDenied(permission: PermissionsMapConstantsKeys) {
    return this.get(permission, Permissions.getPersonId()) === Permissions.DENIED;
  },

  getPersonId() {
    const { currentPersonId } = store.getState().permissions;
    return currentPersonId;
  },
  getStatus() {
    const { status } = store.getState().permissions;
    return status;
  },
};

import { PayloadAction, createAsyncThunk, createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

import { API_REQUEST_URL } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import { fetchWithCamelize } from 'core/api/common';

import { PermissionState, PermissionsResponse } from 'types/auth';

import { PermissionGroupList, PermissionStore, PermisssionList } from './types';

const url = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/permissions`;

export const fetchPermissions = createAsyncThunk<PermissionsResponse>(
  url,
  async (params, { rejectWithValue }) => {
    try {
      return await fetchWithCamelize(url);
    } catch (error) {
      return rejectWithValue(error);
    }
  },
);

const initialState: PermissionStore = {
  status: 'idle',
  list: {},
  currentPersonId: '',
  error: null,
};

const permissionsSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'permissions',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setPermissions: (state, action: PayloadAction<PermisssionList>) => {
      state.list = action.payload;
    },
  },
  extraReducers: (builder) => {
    builder
      .addCase(fetchPermissions.pending, (state, action) => {
        state.status = 'pending';
      })
      .addCase(fetchPermissions.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
        if (state.status === 'pending') {
          state.status = 'success';
          const { payload } = action;
          // eslint-disable-next-line unicorn/prefer-object-from-entries
          const groupList = payload.permissionTypes.reduce((ac: PermissionGroupList, el) => {
            if (!ac[el.code]) {
              ac[el.code] = {
                [el.accessObjectId]: el.permissionState,
              };
            } else {
              ac[el.code][el.accessObjectId] = el.permissionState;
            }

            return ac;
          }, {});

          // eslint-disable-next-line unicorn/prefer-object-from-entries
          const list = Object.keys(groupList).reduce((ac: PermisssionList, key) => {
            const arr = Object.values(groupList[key]);
            ac[key] = { ...groupList[key] };
            if (arr.length === 1) {
              ac[key].default = arr[0];
            }
            ac[key].all = arr.reduce(
              (ac: PermissionState | null, el) => (ac === el ? el : null),
              arr[0],
            );

            return ac;
          }, {});

          state.list = list;
          state.currentPersonId =
            payload.permissionTypes
              .find((permission) => permission.code === 'PERSON')
              ?.accessObjectId.toString() || '';
        }
      })
      .addCase(fetchPermissions.rejected, (state, action) => {
        state.error = action.payload || action.error;
        if (state.status === 'pending') {
          state.status = 'error';
        }
      });
  },
});

export const { setPermissions } = permissionsSlice.actions;
export default permissionsSlice.reducer;

import {
  ReportParameterType,
  ReportTypesWithParams,
  ReportsParametersResponse,
} from 'types/reports';

const controlsSortOrder: { [K in ReportParameterType]: number } = {
  Product: 0,
  Portfolio: 1,
  DepoAccount: 2,
  Instrument: 3,
  Agreement: 4,
  Date: 4,
  Period: 4,
};

export const getReportsParametersWithData = (response: ReportsParametersResponse) => {
  const types = response.reportTypes;
  const parameters = [...response.reportParameters].sort(
    (param1, param2) => controlsSortOrder[param1.parameter] - controlsSortOrder[param2.parameter],
  );

  const reportParamsObject: ReportTypesWithParams = types.reduce(
    (prev, curr) => ({
      ...prev,
      [curr.code]: parameters.filter((p) => p.reportTypeId === curr.reportTypeId),
    }),
    {},
  );

  return reportParamsObject;
};

/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */
import React, { useRef, useLayoutEffect, useReducer, createContext, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Router, Location } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Action, Update } from 'history';

import { history } from './RouteService';

type ListenerCb = (loc: Location) => void;
type BeforeListenerContext = {
  current: ListenerCb[];
};

const BeforeListenersContext = createContext<BeforeListenerContext>({ current: [] });
const BrowserRouter = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer((_: Update, action: Update): Update => action, {
    action: history.action,
    location: history.location,
  });

  const beforeListeners = useRef([]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const listener = (update: { action: Action; location: Location }) => {
      beforeListeners.current.forEach((fn: (loc: Location) => void) => {
        if (typeof fn === 'function') {
          fn(update.location);
        }
      });

      dispatch(update);
    };

    return history.listen(listener);
  }, []);

  return (
    <BeforeListenersContext.Provider value={beforeListeners}>
      <Router location={state.location} navigator={history}>
        {children}
      </Router>
    </BeforeListenersContext.Provider>
  );
};

export default BrowserRouter;

import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS, ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK } from 'const/routes';

import {

  INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY_UK_UKS,
} from 'modules/Instrument/constants';

export function getRouteInstrument(
  instrumentId: number,
  tradePlaceId: number,
  categoryCode: string,
  from?: string,
) {
  switch (categoryCode) {
    case INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY_UK_UKF:
    case INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY_UK_UKS:
      return `${ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK}/${instrumentId}${from ? `?from=${from}` : ''}`;
    default:
      return `${ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS}/${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`;
  }
}

import Cookies from 'js-cookie';

const KEY = 'isClient';
const VALUE = '1';

const cookieAttrs = (): Cookies.CookieAttributes => {
  const attrs: Cookies.CookieAttributes = { expires: 7 };
  if (/\.investpalata\.ru$/i.test(window.location.hostname)) {
    attrs.domain = '.investpalata.ru';
  }
  return attrs;
};

export const hasClientSession = () => Cookies.get(KEY) === VALUE;

export const setClientSession = () => {
  Cookies.set(KEY, VALUE, cookieAttrs());
};

export const clearClientSession = () => {
  Cookies.remove(KEY, { domain: '.investpalata.ru' });
  Cookies.remove(KEY);
};

import { PayloadAction, createAsyncThunk, createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { AppDispatch } from 'store';

import { API_REQUEST_URL } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import { fetchWithCamelize } from 'core/api/common';

import { Session, SessionResponse, SessionState } from './types';

const url = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/sessions/info`;

export const fetchSession = createAsyncThunk<SessionResponse>(url, () => fetchWithCamelize(url));

export const updateFetchSessionBackground = () => async (dispatch: AppDispatch) => {
  try {
    const response = await fetchWithCamelize(url);
    dispatch(sessionSlice.actions.updateSession(response));
  } catch (e) {
    dispatch(sessionSlice.actions.errorUpdateSession());
  }
};

const initialState: SessionState = {
  status: 'idle',
  data: null,
  error: null,
};

const sessionSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'session',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    updateSession: (state, action: PayloadAction<Session>) => {
      state.data = action.payload;
    },
    errorUpdateSession: (state) => {
      state.status = 'error';
    },
  },
  extraReducers: (builder) => {
    builder
      .addCase(fetchSession.pending, (state) => {
        state.status = 'pending';
      })
      .addCase(fetchSession.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
        if (state.status === 'pending') {
          state.status = 'success';
          state.data = action.payload;
        }
      })
      .addCase(fetchSession.rejected, (state, action) => {
        state.error = action.payload || action.error;
        if (state.status === 'pending') {
          state.status = 'error';
        }
      });
  },
});

export default sessionSlice.reducer;

import { store } from 'store';

import { SessionRegistry } from './types';

export function getCurrentMoexStockSession() {
  return store.getState().tradeSession.currentMoexStockSession;
}

export function getEarliestAvailalbleMoexStockSession() {
  return store.getState().tradeSession.earliestAvailalbleMoexStockSession;
}

export function getStockMoexTradePlaceId() {
  return store.getState().tradeSession.stockMoexTradePlaceId;
}

export function getFortsTradePlaceId() {
  const session = getFortsSession();
  return session?.tradePlaceId;
}

function getFortsSession(): SessionRegistry | null {
  const { sessionRegistry } = store.getState().tradeSession;
  const fortsTradePlaceId = Object.keys(sessionRegistry).find(
    (tradePlaceId) => sessionRegistry[tradePlaceId].tradePlaceCode === 'СР FORTS',
  );
  return fortsTradePlaceId ? sessionRegistry[fortsTradePlaceId] : null;
}

export function getTradeSessionByTradePlaceId(tradePlaceId: number): SessionRegistry | null {
  const { sessionRegistry } = store.getState().tradeSession;
  return sessionRegistry[tradePlaceId] ? sessionRegistry[tradePlaceId] : null;
}

import { PayloadAction, createAction, createAsyncThunk, createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
import { store } from 'store';

import { API_REQUEST_URL } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import { fetchWithCamelize } from 'core/api/common';

import { TradeSession, TradeSessionResponse, TradeSessionTiming } from 'types/tradeSession';

import { STOCK_MOEX_TRADEPLACE_CODE } from './constants';
import { TradeSessionStore } from './types';
import { getIdByCode } from './utils';

const url = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/trade_sessions/status`;

export const fetchTradeSessionStatus = createAsyncThunk<TradeSessionResponse>(url, async () => {
  return await fetchWithCamelize(url);
});

const initialState: TradeSessionStore = {
  status: 'idle',
  sessionRegistry: {},
  timingList: [],
  stockMoexTradePlaceId: undefined,
  currentMoexStockSession: undefined,
  earliestAvailalbleMoexStockSession: undefined,
  error: null,
};

const tradeSessionSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'tradeSession',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    updateTradeSession: (
      state,
      action: PayloadAction<{ session: TradeSession[]; sessionTiming?: TradeSessionTiming[] }>,
    ) => {
      const { session, sessionTiming } = action.payload;

      state.stockMoexTradePlaceId = getIdByCode(session, STOCK_MOEX_TRADEPLACE_CODE);

      session.forEach((item) => {
        state.sessionRegistry[item.tradePlaceId] = {
          tradePlaceId: item.tradePlaceId,
          sessionState: item.sessionState,
          sessionType: item.sessionType,
          tradePlaceCode: item.tradePlaceCode,
          sessionOTCState: item.sessionOtcState,
        };
      });

      // on WS timingList doesn't exist
      if (sessionTiming !== undefined && sessionTiming.length) {
        const stockMoexTimingList = sessionTiming.filter(
          (item) => item.tradePlaceId === state.stockMoexTradePlaceId,
        );
        const sortedAscTimingList = stockMoexTimingList.sort(
          (timing, timing2) =>
            DateTime.fromISO(timing.startTime).toMillis() -
            DateTime.fromISO(timing2.startTime).toMillis(),
        );

        state.currentMoexStockSession = stockMoexTimingList.find((timing) => timing.current);
        state.earliestAvailalbleMoexStockSession = sortedAscTimingList[0];
        state.timingList = sessionTiming.map((item) => ({
          tradePlaceId: item.tradePlaceId,
          sessionState: item.sessionState,
          startTime: item.startTime,
          endTime: item.endTime,
          current: item.current,
        }));
      }
    },
  },
  extraReducers: (builder) => {
    builder
      .addCase(fetchTradeSessionStatus.pending, (state) => {
        state.status = 'pending';
      })
      .addCase(fetchTradeSessionStatus.fulfilled, (state, action) => {
        if (state.status === 'pending') {
          tradeSessionSlice.caseReducers.updateTradeSession(state, action);
          state.status = 'success';
        }
      })
      .addCase(fetchTradeSessionStatus.rejected, (state, action) => {
        state.error = action.payload || action.error;
        if (state.status === 'pending') {
          state.status = 'error';
        }
      });
  },
});

export const { updateTradeSession } = tradeSessionSlice.actions;

export default tradeSessionSlice.reducer;

import { PayloadAction, createSlice } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

import { DEFAULT_POSITION_HIDE } from 'core/view360/constants';

import { IProductId, SetCountRenameType, UserProductsType } from 'types/view360';

export type ISelectedPortfolio = {
  productId: IProductId;
  name: string;
  portfolioId?: number;
};

export type view360State = {
  allData: UserProductsType;
  allDataSeted: boolean;
  currentPortfolio: {
    open: boolean;
    selectedPortfolio?: { [key: string]: ISelectedPortfolio };
  };
  hideAccountAssets: { isHideAccountAssets: number; isFetching: boolean };
  productIdFromView360: number | null;
  countInProcess: boolean;
};

const initialState: view360State = {
  allData: {} as UserProductsType,
  allDataSeted: false,
  currentPortfolio: {
    open: false,
  },
  hideAccountAssets: { isHideAccountAssets: DEFAULT_POSITION_HIDE, isFetching: true },
  productIdFromView360: null,
  countInProcess: false,
};

export const view360Slice = createSlice({
  name: 'view360',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    switchCurrentPortfolioSelect: (state, action: PayloadAction<boolean>) => {
      state.currentPortfolio.open = action.payload;
    },
    setCurrentPortfolio: (state, action: PayloadAction<ISelectedPortfolio>) => {
      state.currentPortfolio.selectedPortfolio = {
        ...state.currentPortfolio.selectedPortfolio,
        [action.payload.productId]: action.payload,
      };
    },
    loadCurrencyPortfolio: (
      state,
      action: PayloadAction<{ [key: string]: ISelectedPortfolio }>,
    ) => {
      state.currentPortfolio.selectedPortfolio = action.payload;
    },
    setHideAccountAssets: (state, action: PayloadAction<number>) => {
      state.hideAccountAssets.isHideAccountAssets = action.payload;
      state.hideAccountAssets.isFetching = false;
    },
    setAllData: (state, action: PayloadAction<UserProductsType>) => {
      state.allData = action.payload;
    },
    setAllDataSeted: (state, action: PayloadAction<boolean>) => {
      state.allDataSeted = action.payload;
    },
    setProductIdFromView360: (state, action: PayloadAction<number | null>) => {
      state.productIdFromView360 = action.payload;
    },
    setCountInProcess: (state, action: PayloadAction<boolean>) => {
      state.countInProcess = action.payload;
    },
    setCountRename: (state, action: PayloadAction<SetCountRenameType>) => {
      state.allData.positionValuationByProduct.forEach((item) => {
        item.productId === action.payload.productId &&
          (item.productName = action.payload.productRename);
      });
    },
  },
});

export const {
  switchCurrentPortfolioSelect,
  setCurrentPortfolio,
  loadCurrencyPortfolio,
  setHideAccountAssets,
  setAllData,
  setAllDataSeted,
  setProductIdFromView360,
  setCountInProcess,
  setCountRename,
} = view360Slice.actions;

export default view360Slice.reducer;

import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { setDesktopView } from 'core/common/commonSlice';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

export const useAdaptive = () => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  useEffect(() => {
    const meta = document.createElement('meta');
    if (!isMobile) {
      meta.name = 'viewport';
      meta.content = 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0';
      document.head.append(meta);
      document.body.classList.add('body-adaptive');
      dispatch(setDesktopView(true));
    }
    return () => {
      if (isMobile) {
        meta.content = 'width=375, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover';
        document.head.append(meta);
        document.body.classList.remove('body-adaptive');
        dispatch(setDesktopView(false));
      }
    };
  }, [dispatch, isMobile]);
};

import { RefObject, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export const useClickOutside = <T>(handler?: () => void): RefObject<T> => {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const handlerRef = useRef<typeof handler>();
  handlerRef.current = handler;

  useEffect(() => {
    const cb = (event: Event) => {
      const handler = handlerRef.current;
      const parent = ref.current;
      if (
        typeof handler === 'function' &&
        event.target instanceof Node &&
        parent instanceof Node &&
        !parent.contains(event.target)
      ) {
        handler();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('click', cb);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('click', cb);
    };
  }, []);

  return ref;
};

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import httpCommunicator from '@aurora/http-communicator';

import { getDefaultHeaders } from 'core/api/common';

type UseDownloadFileProps = {
  url?: string;
  enabled?: boolean;
};

type FileType = {
  url: string;
  size: number;
};

const useDownloadFile = ({ url, enabled = true }: UseDownloadFileProps) => {
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isError, setIsError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [file, setFile] = useState<FileType | undefined>();

  const handleDownloadFile = async (url: string) => {
    await setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await httpCommunicator(url, {
        method: 'get',
        responseType: 'blob',
        headers: getDefaultHeaders(url),
      });
      if (response.data?.Error) {
        setIsError(true);
      } else {
        const blob = new Blob([response.data], { type: 'application/pdf' });
        const objectURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        setFile({ url: objectURL, size: blob.size });
      }
      setIsLoading(false);
    } catch {
      setIsError(true);
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(url && enabled)) return;
    handleDownloadFile(url);
  }, [url, enabled]);

  useEffect(() => () => file && URL.revokeObjectURL(file.url), [file]);
  return { file, isLoading, isError };
};

export default useDownloadFile;

import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';

import { getErrorMessageText } from 'utils/errorResponse';

export const useErrorNotification = (error: unknown, message?: string) => {
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();

  const errorMessage = getErrorMessageText(error);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (error) {
      snackbarTopAlert?.show({
        autoClose: 3500,
        label: message || errorMessage,
        variant: 'primary',
        onClick: () => snackbarTopAlert.close,
      });
    }
  }, [error]);
};

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { ACCESS_TYPE_GUID_LKK } from 'const/app';
import { LK_ROUTE_LOGIN, LK_ROUTE_LOGIN_FROM } from 'const/lkRoutes';

import { useLazyGetTempTokenQuery } from 'core/api/auth';
import { getLkUrl, getLkUrlWithoutParams } from 'core/helpers/lk';

export const useMoveToLKAuthToken = () => {
  const [getTempToken] = useLazyGetTempTokenQuery();
  const [tempToken, setTempToken] = useState<string>('');
  const [isLoadingToken, setIsLoadingToken] = useState(false);
  const [externalUrl, setExternalUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleNavigateToLK = (url: string) => async (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    const windowReference = window.open(); //safari по умолчанию блокирует window.open из async fn
    try {
      setIsLoadingToken(true);
      const response = await getTempToken(ACCESS_TYPE_GUID_LKK).unwrap();
      setTempToken(response.result[0].temporaryToken);
      if (windowReference) {
        url && setExternalUrl(url);
        windowReference.location = getLkUrl(LK_ROUTE_LOGIN_FROM);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setIsLoadingToken(false);
      const urlIfError = getLkUrl(LK_ROUTE_LOGIN);
      window.open(urlIfError, '_blank') || window.location.replace(urlIfError);
    }
  };

  const eventFn = useCallback(
    (event: MessageEvent) => {
      if (event.origin !== getLkUrlWithoutParams()) {
        return;
      }
      event.source?.postMessage(
        { tempToken, url: externalUrl },
        { targetOrigin: getLkUrlWithoutParams() },
      );
      setIsLoadingToken(false);
    },
    [externalUrl, tempToken],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    window.addEventListener('message', eventFn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', eventFn);
  }, [eventFn]);

  return { isLoadingToken, handleNavigateToLK };
};

import React, { useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { PasswordInputStateProps } from 'components/InputNewPassword/types';

const defaultPasswordInputState: PasswordInputStateProps = {
  value: '',
  progressStatus: 'none',
  percent: 0.2,
};

const useNewPasswordInput = () => {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState<PasswordInputStateProps>(defaultPasswordInputState);
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] =
    useState<PasswordInputStateProps>(defaultPasswordInputState);
  const [minReq, setMinReq] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const newPasswordOnChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>, minReqMet: boolean) => {
      const { value } = e.target;
      setMinReq(minReqMet);
      if (value) {
        if (confirmPassword.value && value !== confirmPassword.value) {
          setConfirmPassword({
            ...confirmPassword,
            status: 'error',
            description: 'Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что пароли совпадают',
            progressStatus: 'danger',
          });
        } else if (confirmPassword.value && value === confirmPassword.value) {
          setConfirmPassword({
            ...confirmPassword,
            status: 'success',
            description: 'Пароль совпадает',
            progressStatus: 'success',
            percent: 0.87,
          });
        }
        setPassword((oldValue) => ({ ...oldValue, value: value }));
      } else {
        setPassword((oldValue) => ({ ...oldValue, value: value }));
        setConfirmPassword({
          ...confirmPassword,
          status: 'error',
          description: 'Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что пароли совпадают',
          progressStatus: 'danger',
        });
      }
    },
    [confirmPassword],
  );

  const confirmPasswordOnChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const { value } = e.target;
      if (value) {
        setConfirmPassword({ ...confirmPassword, value: value });
        if (value !== password.value) {
          setConfirmPassword({
            ...confirmPassword,
            value: value,
            status: 'error',
            description: 'Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что пароли совпадают',
            progressStatus: 'danger',
            percent: 0.87,
          });
        } else {
          setConfirmPassword({
            ...confirmPassword,
            value: value,
            status: 'success',
            description: 'Пароль совпадает',
            progressStatus: 'success',
            percent: 0.87,
          });
        }
      } else {
        setConfirmPassword({
          ...confirmPassword,
          value: value,
          status: 'error',
          description: 'Пароль не может быть пустым',
          progressStatus: 'danger',
          percent: 0.2,
        });
      }
    },
    [confirmPassword, password.value],
  );

  return {
    minReq,
    password,
    confirmPassword,
    newPasswordOnChange,
    confirmPasswordOnChange,
  };
};

export default useNewPasswordInput;

import { useReducer } from 'react';

type Reducer<S extends Record<string, unknown>> = (state: S, partialState: Partial<S>) => S;

const reducer = <S extends Record<string, unknown>>(state: S, partialState: Partial<S>) => ({
  ...state,
  ...partialState,
});

const useReducerAsState = <S extends Record<string, unknown>>(initialState: (() => S) | S) => {
  const [state, setState] = useReducer<Reducer<S>>(
    reducer,
    typeof initialState === 'function' ? initialState() : initialState,
  );

  return { state, setState };
};

export default useReducerAsState;

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import {
  FILE_COUNT_ERROR_MSG,
  FILE_FORMAT_ERROR_MSG,
  FILE_SIZE_ERROR_MSG,
  FILE_UPLOAD_FAILED_MSG,
  MAX_UPLOAD_FILES_COUNT,
  filterValidUploadFiles,
} from 'const/files';

import {
  getPersonalDataErrorMessage,
  throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

export type FileUploadItemStatus = 'pending' | 'success' | 'failed';

const getUploadErrorMessage = (error: unknown) =>
  getPersonalDataErrorMessage(error) || FILE_UPLOAD_FAILED_MSG;

const notifyUploadError = (error: unknown) => {
  const text = getUploadErrorMessage(error);
  createAlertNotification({ text, ms: 3000, status: 'error' });
};

const notifyValidationErrors = ({
  hasSizeError,
  hasFormatError,
  hasCountError,
}: {
  hasSizeError: boolean;
  hasFormatError: boolean;
  hasCountError: boolean;
}) => {
  if (hasSizeError) {
    createAlertNotification({ text: FILE_SIZE_ERROR_MSG, ms: 3000, status: 'error' });
  }

  if (hasCountError) {
    createAlertNotification({ text: FILE_COUNT_ERROR_MSG, ms: 3000, status: 'error' });
  }

  if (hasFormatError) {
    createAlertNotification({ text: FILE_FORMAT_ERROR_MSG, ms: 3000, status: 'error' });
  }
};

type UseSequentialFileUploadOptions = {
  uploadFile: (file: File) => Promise<unknown>;
  onComplete: () => void | Promise<unknown>;
};

const mergeSelectedFiles = (prev: File[], nextFiles: File[]) => {
  const isRemoveOperation =
    nextFiles.length < prev.length && nextFiles.every((file) => prev.includes(file));

  if (isRemoveOperation) {
    return nextFiles;
  }

  return [...prev, ...nextFiles.filter((file) => !prev.includes(file))].slice(
    0,
    MAX_UPLOAD_FILES_COUNT,
  );
};

export const useSequentialFileUpload = ({
  uploadFile,
  onComplete,
}: UseSequentialFileUploadOptions) => {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [fileStatuses, setFileStatuses] = useState<FileUploadItemStatus[]>([]);
  const [isLocked, setIsLocked] = useState(false);
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [hasCompleteError, setHasCompleteError] = useState(false);
  const [hasUploadAttempt, setHasUploadAttempt] = useState(false);
  const validationRejectedRef = useRef(false);

  const onValidateFiles = useCallback(
    async (incomingFiles: File[]) => {
      const { validFiles, hasSizeError, hasFormatError, hasCountError } = filterValidUploadFiles(
        incomingFiles,
        files,
      );

      if (incomingFiles.length > 0 && validFiles.length === 0) {
        validationRejectedRef.current = true;
      }

      notifyValidationErrors({ hasSizeError, hasFormatError, hasCountError });

      return validFiles;
    },
    [files],
  );

  const handleFilesChange = useCallback(
    (nextFiles: File[]) => {
      if (isLocked) {
        return;
      }

      if (validationRejectedRef.current && nextFiles.length === 0) {
        validationRejectedRef.current = false;
        return;
      }

      setFiles((prev) => {
        const merged = mergeSelectedFiles(prev, nextFiles);
        setFileStatuses(merged.map(() => 'pending'));
        return merged;
      });
    },
    [isLocked],
  );

  const uploadPendingFiles = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!files.length || isUploading) {
      return;
    }

    setIsLocked(true);
    setIsUploading(true);
    setHasUploadAttempt(true);
    setHasCompleteError(false);

    const nextStatuses = [...fileStatuses];
    while (nextStatuses.length < files.length) {
      nextStatuses.push('pending');
    }

    let index = 0;
    while (index < files.length) {
      if (nextStatuses[index] === 'success') {
        index += 1;
        continue;
      }

      nextStatuses[index] = 'pending';
      setFileStatuses([...nextStatuses]);

      try {
        const response = await uploadFile(files[index]);
        throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(response);
        nextStatuses[index] = 'success';
        setFileStatuses([...nextStatuses]);
      } catch (error) {
        nextStatuses[index] = 'failed';
        setFileStatuses([...nextStatuses]);
        notifyUploadError(error);
        setIsUploading(false);
        return;
      }

      index += 1;
    }

    setIsUploading(false);

    try {
      const completeResponse = await onComplete();
      throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(completeResponse);
    } catch (error) {
      setHasCompleteError(true);
      notifyUploadError(error);
    }
  }, [fileStatuses, files, isUploading, onComplete, uploadFile]);

  const hasFailedFiles = fileStatuses.includes('failed');
  const submitLabel =
    hasUploadAttempt && (hasFailedFiles || hasCompleteError) ? 'Повторить' : 'Отправить';

  return {
    files,
    fileStatuses,
    isLocked,
    isUploading,
    submitLabel,
    onValidateFiles,
    handleFilesChange,
    uploadPendingFiles,
  };
};

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { shareOrDownloadFile } from 'utils/shareOrDownloadFile';

export const useShareFile = () => {
  const [generatingImage, setGeneratingImage] = useState(false);
  const file = useRef<File>();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const shareHandler = () => {
    if (!generatingImage) {
      if (file.current) {
        shareOrDownloadFile(file.current);
      } else {
        setGeneratingImage(true);
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (generatingImage && ref.current) {
      const qrCodeURL = document.querySelector('#qrCode') as HTMLCanvasElement;
      qrCodeURL.toBlob((blob) => {
        if (blob) {
          file.current = new File([blob], 'qr.png', {
            type: blob.type,
            lastModified: Date.now(),
          });
          shareOrDownloadFile(file.current);
        }
        setGeneratingImage(false);
      });
    }
  }, [generatingImage]);
  return { shareHandler, generatingImage, file, ref };
};

/* eslint-disable jsx-a11y/alt-text */
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

// import snackbar from '@aurora/snackbar';
import { useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';

import { useCloseSnackBarMutation, useSnackBarStatusQuery } from 'core/api/snackBar';
import { getSessionPersonGuidSelector } from 'core/session/session';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import defaultIcon from 'images/icons/defaultSnackBar.png';

const snackBarMap = {
  '/view360': 'OVERVIEW',
  '/withdrawal': 'WITHDRAWAL',
  '/transfers/internal': 'TRANSFERS',
  '/transfers/refill': 'TOPUP',
  '/refill': 'TOPUP',
  '/more': 'MORE',
  '/my-information': 'MORE',
  '/profile/info': 'MORE',
  '/chat': 'CHAT',
  '/view360/instruments': 'FI_CARD',
  '/catalog': 'SHOWCASE',
};

const directUrl = ['/catalog'];

const onceShowList = ['FI_CARD'];
type SnackBarMapType = keyof typeof snackBarMap;
const getMapKey = (str: string) => {
  const keys = Object.keys(snackBarMap);
  const keys2 = keys.map((key) => str.match(key)).filter((it) => it != null);
  const updatedKeys = keys2 as RegExpMatchArray[];
  const values = updatedKeys.map((it) => {
    return it[0];
  });
  const closest = values.sort(
    (a, b) => Math.abs(str.length - a.length) - Math.abs(str.length - b.length),
  )[0] as SnackBarMapType;
  if (directUrl.includes(closest)) return;
  return snackBarMap[closest];
};

const getSnackBarKey = (): string => {
  type SnackBarMapType = keyof typeof snackBarMap;
  const location = window.location.pathname as SnackBarMapType;
  const key = snackBarMap[location] || (getMapKey(location) as string);
  return key;
};
const SNACKBAR_KEYS = 'SNACKBAR_KEYS';

export const useSnackBar = (enabled = true) => {
  const [closeSnackBar, error] = useCloseSnackBarMutation();
  const [locationState, setLocationState] = useState('');
  const [iconError, setIconError] = useState(false);
  const location = window.location.pathname;
  const actionGuid = useAppSelector(getSessionPersonGuidSelector) || '';
  const key = getSnackBarKey();
  const { data } = useSnackBarStatusQuery({ key: key, actionGuid }, { skip: !enabled });
  const { snackbarInfo } = useSnackbars();
  const SNACKBAR_KEYS_LIST = window.sessionStorage.getItem(SNACKBAR_KEYS) || '';

  const snackBar = (SNACKBAR_KEYS_LIST && JSON.parse(SNACKBAR_KEYS_LIST)) || '';

  const dialogue = data?.dialogue;

  const cancelHandler = () => {
    closeSnackBar({ actionGuid, messageGuid: dialogue?.messageGuid });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocationState(location);
    if (!locationState || !dialogue || !dialogue.message || snackBar[key]) return;
    if (key === 'MORE' && dialogue.message === 'Какой-то текст для MORE') return;

    const id = snackbarInfo?.show({
      autoClose: false,
      caption: <span style={{ width: '250px' }}>{dialogue.message}</span>,
      icon: iconError ? (
        <img style={{ width: '40px' }} src={defaultIcon} />
      ) : (
        <img
          style={{ width: '40px' }}
          src={dialogue?.icon || ''}
          onError={() => {
            setIconError(true);
          }}
        />
      ),
      showCloseButton: dialogue.close,
      variant: 'primary',
      onCloseBtnClick: cancelHandler,
    });

    if (onceShowList.includes(key) || error.isError) {
      const setItemToSessionStorage = (key: string) => JSON.stringify({ ...snackBar, [key]: true });
      const element = setItemToSessionStorage(key);
      window.sessionStorage.setItem(SNACKBAR_KEYS, element);
    }

    return () => {
      setLocationState('');
      id && snackbarInfo?.close(id);
    };
  }, [locationState, key, dialogue, SNACKBAR_KEYS_LIST, error.isError, iconError]);

  return null;
};

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

const SWIPE_DIFF_X = 50;

const useSwipeable = (isDragging: boolean) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const buttonsWrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [attemptsToCalculateContainerHeight, setAttemptsToCalculateContainerHeight] = useState(1);
  const [containerHeight, setContainerHeight] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [containerWidth, setContainerWidth] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [buttonsWrapperWidth, setButtonsWrapperWidth] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const isSwipeOpenRef = useRef(false);
  const [_, setForceUpdate] = useState(false);

  const startTouchXRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const isTransitionStartedRef = useRef(false);

  const isContainerDimensionsCalculated = containerHeight !== null && containerWidth !== null;
  const isButtonsWrapperDimensionsCalculated = buttonsWrapperWidth !== null;

  const doSwipe = (diff: number, isSwipeToLeft: boolean) => {
    if (Math.abs(diff) < SWIPE_DIFF_X) {
      return;
    }

    if (isSwipeToLeft && !isSwipeOpenRef.current) {
      isSwipeOpenRef.current = true;
      setForceUpdate((prev) => !prev);
      return;
    }

    if (!isSwipeToLeft && isSwipeOpenRef.current) {
      isSwipeOpenRef.current = false;
      setForceUpdate((prev) => !prev);
      return;
    }
  };

  const handleTouchMove = useCallback(
    (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (
        isDragging ||
        !isContainerDimensionsCalculated ||
        !isButtonsWrapperDimensionsCalculated ||
        startTouchXRef.current == null
      ) {
        return;
      }
      const currentTouchX = e.targetTouches[0].clientX;

      const diff = currentTouchX - startTouchXRef.current;
      const isSwipeToLeft = Math.sign(diff) < 0;

      if (
        !isTransitionStartedRef.current &&
        ((isSwipeToLeft && !isSwipeOpenRef.current) || (!isSwipeToLeft && isSwipeOpenRef.current))
      ) {
        isTransitionStartedRef.current = true;
      }
      if (isTransitionStartedRef.current) {
        e.preventDefault();
      }

      doSwipe(diff, isSwipeToLeft);
    },
    [isDragging, isContainerDimensionsCalculated, isButtonsWrapperDimensionsCalculated],
  );

  const handleTouchStart: React.TouchEventHandler = (e) => {
    if (isDragging || !isContainerDimensionsCalculated || !isButtonsWrapperDimensionsCalculated) {
      return;
    }
    startTouchXRef.current = e.targetTouches[0].clientX;
  };

  const handleTouchEnd: React.TouchEventHandler = (e) => {
    if (isDragging || !isContainerDimensionsCalculated || !isButtonsWrapperDimensionsCalculated) {
      return;
    }
    isTransitionStartedRef.current = false;
    startTouchXRef.current = null;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (containerRef.current) {
      setContainerHeight(containerRef.current.offsetHeight);
      setContainerWidth(containerRef.current.offsetWidth);
      containerRef.current.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
      return () => containerRef.current?.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
    }
  }, [attemptsToCalculateContainerHeight, handleTouchMove]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isContainerDimensionsCalculated && buttonsWrapperRef.current) {
      setButtonsWrapperWidth(buttonsWrapperRef.current.offsetWidth);
    }
  }, [isContainerDimensionsCalculated]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDragging) {
      startTouchXRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [isDragging]);

  const recalculateContainerHeight = useCallback(() => {
    setAttemptsToCalculateContainerHeight((prev) => prev + 1);
    setContainerHeight(null);
    setContainerWidth(null);
    setButtonsWrapperWidth(null);
  }, []);

  const containerStyle = { position: 'relative', minHeight: containerHeight };

  const formattedButtonsWrapperWidth = buttonsWrapperWidth ? buttonsWrapperWidth + 32 : 0;
  const componentStyle = {
    position: 'absolute',
    right: isSwipeOpenRef.current ? formattedButtonsWrapperWidth : 0,
    width: containerWidth,
    transition: 'right .3s linear',
  };

  return {
    containerRef,
    buttonsWrapperRef,
    handleTouchEnd,
    handleTouchStart,
    isContainerDimensionsCalculated,
    isButtonsWrapperDimensionsCalculated,
    containerStyle,
    componentStyle,
    recalculateContainerHeight,
  };
};

export { useSwipeable };

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

const formattedTimeout = (seconds: number) => DateTime.fromSeconds(seconds).toFormat('mm:ss');

export const useTimer = (count?: number, delay = 1000) => {
  const [currentCount, setCurrentCount] = useState<number | undefined>(count);
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const decreaseCount = () => {
    if (currentCount && currentCount > 0) {
      setCurrentCount(currentCount - 1);
    } else {
      setIsRunning(false);
    }
  };

  const memoizedDecreaseCount = useCallback(decreaseCount, [currentCount]);

  const startTimer = () => {
    setIsRunning(true);
  };

  const stopTimer = () => {
    setIsRunning(false);
  };

  const resetTimer = () => {
    setIsRunning(false);
    setCurrentCount(count);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isRunning) {
      const interval = setInterval(() => {
        memoizedDecreaseCount();
      }, delay);

      return () => {
        clearInterval(interval);
      };
    }
  }, [currentCount, isRunning, memoizedDecreaseCount, delay]);

  return {
    currentCount,
    formattedTimeout: typeof currentCount === 'number' ? formattedTimeout(currentCount) : undefined,
    startTimer: useCallback(startTimer, []),
    stopTimer,
    resetTimer,
  };
};

import { RefObject, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

interface IntersectionOptions extends IntersectionObserverInit {}

export default function useViewOnScreen(
  ref: RefObject<HTMLElement> | null,
  options: IntersectionOptions,
): boolean {
  const observerRef = useRef<IntersectionObserver>();
  const [isOnScreen, setIsOnScreen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    let forwardRef = ref;
    observerRef.current = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      setIsOnScreen(entry.isIntersecting);
    }, options);
    forwardRef?.current && observerRef.current.observe(forwardRef.current);
    return () => {
      forwardRef?.current && observerRef.current?.unobserve(forwardRef.current);
      forwardRef = null;
    };
  }, [ref, options]);
  return isOnScreen;
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

export default function () {
  const [windowSize, setWindowSize] = useState({
    height: window.innerHeight,
    scaleX: 1,
    scaleY: 1,
    transform: 'matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)',
    width: window.innerWidth,
  });

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  useEffect(() => {
    const designWidth = 375;
    const designHeight = 667;

    function handleResize() {
      const width = window.innerWidth;
      const height = window.innerHeight;

      let scaleX = width / designWidth;
      let scaleY = height / designHeight;

      if (width / height < designWidth / designHeight) {
        scaleY = scaleX;
      } else {
        scaleX = scaleY;
      }
      const transformMatrix = `matrix(${scaleX}, 0, 0, ${scaleY}, 0, 0)`;

      if (!isMobile) {
        setWindowSize({
          height: designHeight,
          scaleX,
          scaleY,
          transform: transformMatrix,
          width: designWidth,
        });
      }
    }

    // Добавляем слушатель изменения размера окна
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    // Инициализируем состояние
    handleResize();

    // Удаляем слушатель при размонтировании компонента
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);

  return windowSize;
}

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ActionCell, Card, Headline } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_HELP } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetBrokerDocumentsQuery } from 'core/api/brokerDocuments';

import HeaderPage from 'components/HeaderPage';

import { ReactComponent as Logo } from 'images/logo.svg';

import styles from './AboutApp.module.pcss';

const LK_AGREEMENT_CODE = 'lk_agreement';

const OPTIONS = [
  {
    title: 'Пользовательское соглашение',
    info: 'Об использовании программного обеспечения',
    documentCode: LK_AGREEMENT_CODE,
  },
];

const AboutApp = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const { data: brokerDocumentsData } = useGetBrokerDocumentsQuery({
    codes: LK_AGREEMENT_CODE,
  });

  const agreementLink = brokerDocumentsData?.reglaments?.find(
    ({ code }) => code === LK_AGREEMENT_CODE,
  )?.link;

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_HELP);
  };

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.container : styles.containerDesktop}>
      <HeaderPage
        title="О приложении"
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        className={styles.header}
      />
      {!isMobile && <Headline title={'О приложении'} indent={false} />}
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.contentWrapper : styles.contentWrapperDesktop}>
        {!isMobile && <Logo className={styles.logo} />}
        <Card withShadow className={styles.card}>
          {OPTIONS.map(({ title, info, documentCode }) => (
            <ActionCell
              key={documentCode}
              title={title}
              description={info}
              link={agreementLink}
              external
              as="a"
              separator={false}
              addonRight
              hover={false}
              disabled={!agreementLink}
            />
          ))}
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AboutApp;

import { FC, TouchEvent, memo } from 'react';

import cn from 'classnames';
import { Pagination } from 'swiper';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { TradingAccount, TradingProduct } from 'types/accounts';
import { InstrumentCategoryType, PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { SubAccount } from 'types/subAccount';

import AccountCard from './components/AccountCard';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/pagination';

type Props = {
  instrumentId: string;
  tradePlaceId: string;
  instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel: string;
  freeCollateralLabel: string;
  instrumentType: InstrumentCategoryType;
  initialMargin?: number;
  initialMarginCurrencyCode?: PriceCurrencyType;
  tradingAccounts: TradingAccount[];
  tradingProducts: TradingProduct[];
  onSubAccountChange: (subAccount: SubAccount) => void;
  onTraidingProductChange: (portfolioName: string) => void;
};

const AccountCards: FC<Props> = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel,
  freeCollateralLabel,
  instrumentType,
  initialMargin,
  initialMarginCurrencyCode,
  tradingAccounts,
  tradingProducts,
  onSubAccountChange,
  onTraidingProductChange,
}) => {
  const { productId } = useAppSelector((state) => state?.tradeOrder);

  const pagination = {
    renderBullet: function (_: number, className: string) {
      return '<span class="' + className + '"></span>';
    },
  };

  const getTradingAccountsByProduct = (id: string | number) =>
    tradingAccounts.filter(({ productId }) => productId === id);

  const handleTouch = (event: TouchEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
  };

  return (
    <div onTouchMove={handleTouch}>
      <Swiper
        slidesPerView="auto"
        spaceBetween={8}
        pagination={pagination}
        modules={[Pagination]}
        className={styles.mySwiper}
        initialSlide={tradingProducts.findIndex((item) => item.productId === productId)}
        preventClicksPropagation
        touchMoveStopPropagation
        touchStartPreventDefault
      >
        {tradingProducts.map((item) => {
          const accounts = getTradingAccountsByProduct(item.productId);

          return accounts.length ? (
            <SwiperSlide
              key={item.productId}
              className={cn(tradingAccounts.length === 1 ? styles.aloneSlider : styles.slider)}
            >
              {({ isActive }) => {
                return (
                  <AccountCard
                    {...item}
                    tradingAccounts={accounts}
                    isActive={isActive}
                    instrumentId={instrumentId}
                    tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
                    instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel={instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel}
                    freeCollateralLabel={freeCollateralLabel}
                    onSubAccountChange={onSubAccountChange}
                    instrumentType={instrumentType}
                    initialMargin={initialMargin}
                    initialMarginCurrencyCode={initialMarginCurrencyCode}
                    onTraidingProductChange={onTraidingProductChange}
                  />
                );
              }}
            </SwiperSlide>
          ) : null;
        })}
      </Swiper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(AccountCards);

import { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Card, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useLazyGetSubAccountQuery } from 'core/api/subAccount';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { getHint } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import { STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/StopOrders/StopOrdersHistory/consts';

import { ReactComponent as SmallArrowDown } from 'images/icons/small-arrow-down.svg';
import { ReactComponent as CheckSVG } from 'images/raw-icons/indicator-checked.svg';

import { TradingAccount, TradingProduct } from 'types/accounts';
import { InstrumentCategoryType, PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { SubAccount } from 'types/subAccount';

import Skeleton from '../Skeleton';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = TradingProduct & {
  isActive: boolean;
  tradingAccounts?: TradingAccount[];
  instrumentId: string;
  tradePlaceId: string;
  instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel: string;
  freeCollateralLabel: string;
  instrumentType: InstrumentCategoryType;
  initialMargin?: number;
  initialMarginCurrencyCode?: PriceCurrencyType;
  onSubAccountChange: (subAccount: SubAccount) => void;
  onTraidingProductChange: (portfolioName: string) => void;
};

const AccountCard: FC<Props> = ({
  tradingAccounts = [],
  productName,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  isActive,
  instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel,
  freeCollateralLabel,
  instrumentType,
  initialMargin,
  initialMarginCurrencyCode,
  onSubAccountChange,
  onTraidingProductChange,
}) => {
  const { subAccountId } = useAppSelector((state) => state?.tradeOrder);

  const [isBottomSheetOpened, setIsBottomSheetOpened] = useState(false);
  const [activeTradingAccount, setActiveTradingAccount] = useState(
    () =>
      tradingAccounts.find((item) => item.subAccountId === subAccountId) ||
      tradingAccounts.find((item) => item.tradePermissionState === 'GRANTED') ||
      tradingAccounts[0],
  );

  const [trigger, { data, isLoading }] = useLazyGetSubAccountQuery();
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    trigger({
      subAccountId: activeTradingAccount?.subAccountId,
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
    });
  }, [activeTradingAccount?.subAccountId, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, trigger]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isActive && data?.balance[0] && onSubAccountChange(data?.balance[0]);
  }, [data?.balance, isActive, onSubAccountChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isActive && onTraidingProductChange(activeTradingAccount.portfolioName);
  }, [activeTradingAccount.portfolioName, isActive, onTraidingProductChange, productName]);

  if (!data) return null;

  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  const {
    instrumentCurrency,
    instrumentCurrencyBalance: i,
    freeCollateral: f,
    collateralCurrency,
  } = data?.balance[0] || {};
  const instrumentCurrencyBalance =
    instrumentType === 'isFutures'
      ? `${sumFormatter(f)} ${currencySign(collateralCurrency)}`
      : `${sumFormatter(i, null, 2)} ${currencySign(instrumentCurrency)}`;
  const freeCollateral =
    instrumentType === 'isFutures'
      ? initialMargin && initialMarginCurrencyCode
        ? `${sumFormatter(initialMargin)} ${currencySign(initialMarginCurrencyCode)}`
        : '–'
      : `${sumFormatter(f, null, 2)} ${currencySign(collateralCurrency)}`;

  const handleAccountCardClick = () => {
    tradingAccounts.length > 1 && setIsBottomSheetOpened(true);
  };

  const handleTradingAccountChange = (tradingAccount: TradingAccount) => {
    if (tradingAccount.tradePermissionState === 'DENIED') return;

    setActiveTradingAccount(tradingAccount);
  };

  return (
    <Card
      size="small"
      withShadow={isActive}
      className={cn(styles.card, isActive && styles.activeCard)}
    >
      <div className={styles.info} onClick={handleAccountCardClick}>
        <Text type="lineSemiBold">{productName}</Text>
        <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
          {activeTradingAccount?.portfolioName}
          {tradingAccounts.length > 1 && <SmallArrowDown />}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.list}>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel}
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelSemiBold">{instrumentCurrencyBalance}</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {freeCollateralLabel}
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelSemiBold">{freeCollateral}</Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <BottomSheet open={isBottomSheetOpened} onDismiss={() => setIsBottomSheetOpened(false)}>
        <ul className={styles.tradingAccountList}>
          {tradingAccounts.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.subAccountId} onClick={() => handleTradingAccountChange(item)}>
              <div className={styles.denied}>
                <Text
                  type="lineRegular"
                  color={
                    item.tradePermissionState === 'GRANTED' ? 'colorForeground' : 'colorForeground2'
                  }
                >
                  {item.portfolioName}
                </Text>
                {item.deniedReason && (
                  <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                    {getHint(hints?.hints, STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[item.deniedReason])}
                  </Text>
                )}
              </div>
              {item.subAccountId === activeTradingAccount?.subAccountId && <CheckSVG />}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </BottomSheet>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default memo(AccountCard);
