import { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useSessionStorage } from 'react-use';

import { FilterBar } from '@aurora/components';
import FilterCard from '@vision/filter-card';

import { useAnalyticsInfiniteScrollQuery } from 'core/api/analytics';

import AnalyticsBottomSheet from 'modules/Analytics/components/AnalyticsBottomSheet/AnalyticsBottomSheet';
import AnalyticsCard from 'modules/Analytics/components/AnalyticsCard/AnalyticsCard';
import AnalyticsCardSkeleton from 'modules/Analytics/components/AnalyticsCardSkeleton/AnalyticsCardSkeleton';
import AnalyticsSkeleton from 'modules/Analytics/components/AnalyticsSkeleton/AnalyticsSkeleton';
import EmptyPlug from 'modules/Analytics/components/EmptyPlug/EmptyPlug';
import ErrorPlug from 'modules/Analytics/components/ErrorPlug/ErrorPlug';
import FilterBottomSheet from 'modules/Analytics/components/FilterBottomSheet/FilterBottomSheet';
import FilterSkeleton from 'modules/Analytics/components/FilterSkeleton/FilterSkeleton';
import FlashAnalyticsCard from 'modules/Analytics/components/FlashAnalyticsCard/FlashAnalyticsCard';

import { FilterScrollProvider } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import styles from './Analytics.module.pcss';
import { INSTRUMENT_FILTER, ROWS_COUNT, SOURCE_FILTER, SOURCE_LIST } from './const';
import {
  AnalyticsProps,
  CombineItemsType,
  FilterItemsType,
  InstrumentFilterValueType,
  SourceFilterValueType,
} from './types';

const Analytics: FC<AnalyticsProps> = ({ type, filters, issuerId }) => {
  const [instrumentFilter, setInstrumentFilter] = useSessionStorage<
    FilterItemsType<InstrumentFilterValueType>
  >('newsInstrumentFilter', INSTRUMENT_FILTER[0]);
  const [sourceFilter, setSourceFilter] = useSessionStorage<FilterItemsType<SourceFilterValueType>>(
    'newsSourceFilter',
    SOURCE_FILTER[0],
  );
  const [importantOnly, setImportantOnly] = useSessionStorage<boolean>('newsImportantOnly', false);
  const [filterBottomSheetState, setFilterBottomSheetState] = useState<
    'instrument' | 'source' | null
  >(null);
  const [analyticId, setAnalyticId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const isSomeFilterActive =
    instrumentFilter.value !== 'ALL_INSTRUMENT' ||
    sourceFilter.value !== 'ALL_SOURCE' ||
    importantOnly;
  const commonQueryParams =
    type === 'news'
      ? {
          urgency: importantOnly ? 4 : undefined,
          hasFavorite: instrumentFilter.value === 'favorite' ? true : undefined,
          hasPosition: instrumentFilter.value === 'position' ? true : undefined,
          sourceList: filters ? SOURCE_LIST[sourceFilter.value] : SOURCE_LIST['NO_FILTERS'],
          sections: filters ? 'top_list_traders' : undefined,
          issuerId,
        }
      : {
          sections: type === 'daily' ? 'daily' : 'strategy',
          sourceList: 'WebAdmin',
        };

  const [
    nextPage,
    {
      data,
      page,
      hasNextPage,
      isLoading,
      isFetching,
      isNextPageFetching,
      isError,
      isNextPageError,
    },
  ] = useAnalyticsInfiniteScrollQuery({
    ...commonQueryParams,
    rowsCount: ROWS_COUNT,
    rowsOffset: 0,
  });

  const handleFilterBottomSheetClose = () => {
    setFilterBottomSheetState(null);
  };

  const handleAnalyticsCardClick = (analyticId: number) => {
    setAnalyticId(analyticId);
  };

  const onScroll = (ref: HTMLDivElement) => {
    if (
      !isFetching &&
      !isNextPageFetching &&
      !isNextPageError &&
      ref &&
      (ref.scrollHeight - ref.scrollTop) * 0.9 <= ref.clientHeight &&
      hasNextPage
    ) {
      nextPage({ ...commonQueryParams, rowsOffset: ROWS_COUNT * page });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isNextPageError) {
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Не удалось загрузить данные', status: 'error' });
    }
  }, [isNextPageError]);

  if (isError) {
    return <ErrorPlug text={'Не удалось загрузить данные'} />;
  }

  return (
    <FilterScrollProvider onScroll={onScroll} className={styles.filterProvider}>
      {filters && isLoading && <FilterSkeleton />}

      {filters && !isLoading && (
        <FilterBar className={styles.filterWrapper}>
          <FilterCard
            text={instrumentFilter.name}
            type={instrumentFilter.value === 'ALL_INSTRUMENT' ? 'select' : 'toggle'}
            handleClick={() => !isFetching && setFilterBottomSheetState('instrument')}
            showCloseIcon={instrumentFilter.value !== 'ALL_INSTRUMENT'}
            onClose={() => !isFetching && setInstrumentFilter(INSTRUMENT_FILTER[0])}
            state={instrumentFilter.value !== 'ALL_INSTRUMENT' ? 'active' : undefined}
          />
          <FilterCard
            text={sourceFilter.name}
            type={sourceFilter.value === 'ALL_SOURCE' ? 'select' : 'toggle'}
            handleClick={() => !isFetching && setFilterBottomSheetState('source')}
            showCloseIcon={sourceFilter.value !== 'ALL_SOURCE'}
            onClose={() => !isFetching && setSourceFilter(SOURCE_FILTER[0])}
            state={sourceFilter.value !== 'ALL_SOURCE' ? 'active' : undefined}
          />
          <FilterCard
            text={'Только важное'}
            type={'toggle'}
            state={importantOnly ? 'active' : undefined}
            handleClick={() => !isFetching && setImportantOnly(!importantOnly)}
          />
        </FilterBar>
      )}

      {isFetching && <AnalyticsSkeleton />}

      {isSomeFilterActive && data?.length === 0 && (
        <EmptyPlug title={'Ничего не найдено'} text={'Попробуйте изменить фильтр'} />
      )}

      {!isSomeFilterActive && data?.length === 0 && (
        <EmptyPlug title={'Здесь пока пусто'} text={'Попробуйте обновить экран позже'} />
      )}

      {!isFetching && data?.length !== 0 && (
        <div className={styles.container}>
          {data?.map((el, index) => {
            if (el.hasDetails) {
              return (
                <AnalyticsCard
                  key={`${el.analyticId}-${index}`}
                  analyticId={el.analyticId}
                  title={el.title}
                  created={el.created}
                  sourceName={el.sourceName}
                  isUrgently={el.urgency > 3}
                  instrumentImages={el.instrumentImages}
                  onClick={handleAnalyticsCardClick}
                />
              );
            }

            return (
              <FlashAnalyticsCard
                key={`${el.analyticId}-${index}`}
                title={el.title}
                created={el.created}
                sourceName={el.sourceName}
                isUrgently={el.urgency > 3}
                instrumentImages={el.instrumentImages}
              />
            );
          })}

          {hasNextPage && (
            <>
              <AnalyticsCardSkeleton />
              <AnalyticsCardSkeleton />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {analyticId && (
        <AnalyticsBottomSheet analyticId={analyticId} onClose={() => setAnalyticId(null)} />
      )}

      {filters && (
        <FilterBottomSheet
          open={Boolean(filterBottomSheetState)}
          onFilterChange={
            filterBottomSheetState === 'instrument'
              ? (item: CombineItemsType) => {
                  if (
                    item.value === 'favorite' ||
                    item.value === 'position' ||
                    item.value === 'ALL_INSTRUMENT'
                  )
                    setInstrumentFilter(item);
                }
              : filterBottomSheetState === 'source'
              ? (item: CombineItemsType) => {
                  if (
                    item.value === 'ALL_SOURCE' ||
                    item.value === 'interfax' ||
                    item.value === 'investpalata'
                  )
                    setSourceFilter(item);
                }
              : undefined
          }
          title={
            filterBottomSheetState === 'instrument'
              ? 'Инструменты'
              : filterBottomSheetState === 'source'
              ? 'Источники'
              : undefined
          }
          items={
            filterBottomSheetState === 'instrument'
              ? INSTRUMENT_FILTER
              : filterBottomSheetState === 'source'
              ? SOURCE_FILTER
              : undefined
          }
          active={
            filterBottomSheetState === 'instrument'
              ? instrumentFilter
              : filterBottomSheetState === 'source'
              ? sourceFilter
              : undefined
          }
          onClose={handleFilterBottomSheetClose}
        />
      )}
    </FilterScrollProvider>
  );
};

export default memo(Analytics);

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { useGetAnalyticQuery } from 'core/api/analytics';

import { AnalyticsBottomSheetProps } from 'modules/Analytics';
import AnalyticsBottomSheetFooter from 'modules/Analytics/components/AnalyticsBottomSheetFooter/AnalyticsBottomSheetFooter';
import AnalyticsCardHeader from 'modules/Analytics/components/AnalyticsCardHeader/AnalyticsCardHeader';
import InstrumentGroup from 'modules/Analytics/components/InstrumentGroup/InstrumentGroup';

import { ReactComponent as PdfSvg } from 'images/icons/pdf.svg';

import styles from './AnalyticsBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const NewsBottomSheet: FC<AnalyticsBottomSheetProps> = ({ analyticId, onClose }) => {
  const { data, isFetching } = useGetAnalyticQuery({ id: analyticId });

  if (!data || isFetching) return null;

  const { title, sourceName, created, urgency } = data.analytics[0];

  const content = sanitizeHtml(data.analyticsDetails[0].text);

  const analyticsInstrument = data.analyticsInstrument;

  const disclaimer = data.disclaimer[0].text;

  const file = data.analyticsFileUrl[0];

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={Boolean(analyticId)} onDismiss={onClose} initialFocusRef={false}>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.headerContainer}>
          <AnalyticsCardHeader sourceName={sourceName} created={created} isUrgently={urgency > 3} />

          {file && (
            <a rel="noreferrer" target="_blank" href={file.url} className={styles.pdf}>
              <PdfSvg />
            </a>
          )}
        </div>

        <Text type={'title'} className={styles.title}>
          {title}
        </Text>

        <Text dangerouslyMode className={styles.content}>
          {content}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <InstrumentGroup analyticsInstrument={analyticsInstrument} />
      <AnalyticsBottomSheetFooter disclaimer={disclaimer} />
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(NewsBottomSheet);

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { CombineItemsType, FilterBottomSheetProps } from 'modules/Analytics';

import { SelectableCell } from 'components';

import styles from './FilterBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const FilterBottomSheet: FC<FilterBottomSheetProps> = ({
  title,
  open,
  items,
  active,
  onFilterChange,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const handleCellClick = (filterItem: CombineItemsType) => () => {
    onFilterChange && onFilterChange(filterItem);
    onClose();
  };
  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onClose}>
      <Text type={'subtitleBold'} className={styles.title}>
        {title}
      </Text>
      <div>
        {items?.map((item, index) => (
          <SelectableCell
            key={index}
            checked={active?.value === item.value}
            variant={'indicator'}
            onClick={handleCellClick(item)}
            separator={false}
          >
            {item.name}
          </SelectableCell>
        ))}
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(FilterBottomSheet);

import { FC, memo, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';
import { CDN_BASE_URL } from 'const/app';

import { InstrumentIconProps } from 'modules/Analytics';

import { getSrc } from 'components/Instrument/components/InstrumentIcon/helpers';

import placeHolder from 'images/icons/fi_placeholder.png';

import styles from './InstrumentIcon.module.pcss';

const InstrumentIcon: FC<InstrumentIconProps> = ({
  instrumentImageName,
  subtracted,
  className,
}) => {
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setError(false);
  }, [instrumentImageName]);

  const href = useMemo(
    () => (error ? placeHolder : getSrc(CDN_BASE_URL, instrumentImageName)),
    [error, instrumentImageName],
  );
  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.instrumentIcon, { [styles.subtracted]: subtracted }, className)}>
      <svg
        viewBox="0 0 40 40"
        role="none"
        className={subtracted ? styles.subtractedMask : styles.mask}
        height="100%"
        width="100%"
      >
        <g>
          <image
            x="0"
            y="0"
            height="100%"
            width="100%"
            preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"
            href={href}
          />
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentIcon);

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

const isDateNow = (dateTime: DateTime) => {
  const now = DateTime.now();
  return now.startOf('day').equals(dateTime.startOf('day'));
};

const isDateYesterday = (dateTime: DateTime) => {
  const nowDay = DateTime.now().startOf('day');
  const dateTimeDay = dateTime.startOf('day');
  return nowDay.diff(dateTimeDay, 'days').days === 1;
};

export const formattedDateTime = (dateTime: string) => {
  const parsedDateTime = DateTime.fromISO(dateTime);
  const isNowDay = isDateNow(parsedDateTime);
  if (isNowDay) {
    return 'Сегодня, ' + parsedDateTime.toFormat('HH:mm');
  }
  if (isDateYesterday(parsedDateTime)) {
    return 'Вчера, ' + parsedDateTime.toFormat('HH:mm');
  }
  return parsedDateTime.toFormat('dd.MM.yy, HH:mm');
};

import { FC, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNetworkState, useOrientation } from 'react-use';

//import { HeaderBar } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import setupLuxon from 'core/helpers/setLuxon';
import { setViewport } from 'core/helpers/viewport';

import { useAdaptive } from 'hooks/useAdaptive';

import { AlertNotifications, Header, createAlertNotification } from 'components';
import BottomSheetUpdateServiceWorker from 'components/BottomSheetUpdateServiceWorker';

//import { ReactComponent as Logo } from 'images/logo.svg';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const App: FC = ({ children }) => {
  const { type, angle } = useOrientation();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { online } = useNetworkState();

  // const headerAdaptive = isMobile ? (
  //   <Header />
  // ) : (
  //   <HeaderBar logo={<Logo height={44} width={44} />} className={styles.headerBar} />
  // );

  useEffect(() => {
    setViewport(type, angle);
  }, [type, angle]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!online) {
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Нет подключения к сети', status: 'error' });
    }
  }, [online]);

  setupLuxon();
  useAdaptive();

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile && <Header />}
      <div className={cx(styles.container, { [styles.desktop]: !isMobile })}>{children}</div>
      <AlertNotifications />
      <BottomSheetUpdateServiceWorker />

  );
};

  const [setLogin, { isLoading: isLoginLoading, error: errorLogin, data: loginResponseData }] =
    authApi.useLoginMutation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const error = (errorSalt || errorLogin) as ErrorResponse;
  useErrorNotification(error);
  const isDisableButton = !(
    login.value &&
    password.value &&
    !(errorLogin && captcha.value.length !== SMS_LENGTHS)
  );
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const isLoading = isSaltLoading || isLoginLoading;

  const preLoginPhrase = useInput('');
  const preLoginConfirmed =
    !IS_PRE_LOGIN_GATE_ENABLED ||
    preLoginPhrase.value === TEMP_PRE_LOGIN_PHRASE ||
    localStorage.getItem(TEMP_PRE_LOGIN_CONFIRMED_KEY) === 'confirmed';

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      if (!hasNativeApi) return;
      // PWA запущено через APK
      const hasPin = (await nativeApi?.hasSavedPin('login')) || false;
      if (hasPin) {
        setIsOpenEnrtyPin(true);
        setIsEnrtyByPin(true);
      }
    })();

    if (process.env.TIER && localStorage.getItem('service') === 'obmen') {
      const loginUrl =
        process.env.TIER === 'tt' ? 'https://x-tt.investpalata.ru' : 'https://x.investpalata.ru';
      window.open(loginUrl, '_self');
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!IS_PRE_LOGIN_GATE_ENABLED) return;
    if (preLoginPhrase.value === TEMP_PRE_LOGIN_PHRASE) {
      localStorage.setItem(TEMP_PRE_LOGIN_CONFIRMED_KEY, 'confirmed');
    }
  }, [preLoginPhrase?.value]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    !isMobile && setIsOpen(true);
    try {
      const loginValue = tempEntryData?.login || login.value;
      const passwordValue = tempEntryData?.password || password.value;

      const responseSalt = await trigger();
      const salt = responseSalt?.data?.salt;
      const passwordHash = salt && getPasswordHash(salt, passwordValue);

      if (passwordHash) {
        await setLogin({
          login: loginValue,
          passwordHash,
          language: 'RU',
          Captcha: captcha.value,
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const smsConfirmationOnSuccess = (data: any) => {
    if (hasNativeApi && !isEnrtyByPin) {
      setIsOpen(false);
      setIsOpenPin(true);
    } else {
      handleConfirm();
    }
  };

  const [setUTCOffset] = useSetUTCOffsetMutation();

  const handleConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setUTCOffset(getTimeZoneOffset());
    setClientSession();
    const startScreen = localStorage.getItem('startScreen');
    dispatch(fetchSession())
      .unwrap()
      .then((response) => loginEvent(response?.personId))
      .catch((error) => console.warn(error));
    navigate(START_SCREEN_ROUTES[startScreen as StartScreenType] || ROUTE_360, {
      askPin: true,
    } as any);
  }, [dispatch, navigate, setUTCOffset]);

  const handleRegClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_REGISTRATION);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (loginResponseData && 'session' in loginResponseData) {
      handleConfirm();
    }
  }, [loginResponseData, handleConfirm]);

  if (isLoading && isMobile)
    return (
      <div className={styles.load}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <div className={styles.rootContainer}>
      {(!loginResponseData?.otpChallenge && isMobile) || !isMobile ? (
        <>
          <HeaderPage title={'Авторизация'} />

          <div className={isMobile ? styles.container : styles.containerDesktop}>
            <div className={styles.wrapper}>
              {!isMobile && (
                <div className={styles.headerButtonWrapper}>
                  <Text direction="center" type="headline">
                    Авторизация
                  </Text>
                </div>
              )}

              {preLoginConfirmed || process.env.TIER === 'tt' || !process.env.TIER ? ( // IS_PRE_LOGIN_GATE_ENABLED — см. const/app.ts
                <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
                  <div className={styles.formInputs}>
                    <Input
                      classNameInputElement={styles.input}
                      classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
                      label={'Логин'}
                      {...login}
                      onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
                      className={styles.inputDesktop}
                    />
                    <InputPassword
                      classNameInputElement={styles.input}
                      classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
                      label={'Пароль'}
                      type={'password'}
                      {...password}
                      onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
                    />
                    {(needCaptcha?.authCaptchaImmediate || error) && (
                      <Captcha className={styles.captcha} {...captcha} />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <Card className={isMobile ? styles.card : styles.cardDesktop}>
                    <ActionCell
                      description="Создайте логин и пароль для входа в личный кабинет"
                      title="У меня нет логина"
                      iconLeft={<LkPasswordSvg />}
                      separator={false}
                      onClick={handleRegClick}
                    />
                  </Card>

                  <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
                    <Button disabled={isDisableButton} onClick={handleSubmit}>
                      Войти
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="specialSecondary" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_RECOVERY)}>
                      Восстановить доступ
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              ) : (
                <div className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
                  <InputPassword
                    classNameInputElement={styles.input}
                    classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
                    label={'Пароль'}
                    type={'password'}
                    {...preLoginPhrase}
                    onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
                  />
                  <Text
                    direction="center"
                    type={'lineRegular'}
                    color="colorForeground2"
                    tag={'div'}
                  >
                    Ресурс находится в разработке и тестировании.
                    <br />
                    Рекомендуем пользоваться мобильным приложением{' '}
                    <a rel="noreferrer" href="https://vision-invest.ru/app/">
                      Vision Invest.
                    </a>
                  </Text>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          {!isMobile && !error && (
            <AdaptivePopup
              open={isOpen}
              onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
              classNameContent={styles.contentDesktop}
            >
              {!loginResponseData?.otpChallenge ? (
                <CircleLoader brandColor />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Text type="bodyMedium">SMS-подтверждение</Text>
                  <SmsConfirmation
                    initialOTPChallenge={loginResponseData.otpChallenge}
                    smsInputCount={SMS_LENGTHS}
                    onSuccess={smsConfirmationOnSuccess}
                    onError={console.error}
                  />
                </>
              )}
            </AdaptivePopup>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          {isMobile && (
            <div className={styles.smsWrap}>
              <SmsConfirmation
                initialOTPChallenge={loginResponseData?.otpChallenge}
                smsInputCount={SMS_LENGTHS}
                onSuccess={smsConfirmationOnSuccess}
                onError={console.error}
                loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется вход...</Text>}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      <AdaptivePopup
        open={isOpenPin}
        onDismiss={() => setIsOpenPin(false)}
        classNameContent={styles.contentDesktop}
      >
        {
          <PinCreation
            onComplete={async (pin: string | null) => {
              if (nativeApi && nativeApi.saveSecureData) {
                await nativeApi.saveSecureData('login', `${login.value}|${password.value}`, pin);
              }
              setIsOpenPin(false);
              handleConfirm();
            }}
          />
        }
      </AdaptivePopup>

      {isOpenEntryPin ? (
        <PinEntry
          onComplete={(data: any) => {
            if (data.isSuccess && typeof data.enrtyData === 'string') {
              const parts = data.enrtyData.split('|');
              if (parts && parts.length === 2) {
                const [lg, pwd] = parts;
                setTempEntryData({
                  login: lg,
                  password: pwd,
                });
              }

              // setIsOpenEnrtyPin(false);
              handleSubmit();
              return;
            }

            setIsEnrtyByPin(false);
            setIsOpenEnrtyPin(false);
            setTempEntryData(null);
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AuthorizationPage;

import CryptoJsCore from "crypto-js/core";
import md5 from "crypto-js/md5";
import pbkdf2 from "crypto-js/pbkdf2";

export const getPasswordHash = (salt: string, password: string) => {
  const _salt = CryptoJsCore.enc.Hex.parse(salt)
  const _md5 = md5(password).toString().toUpperCase();
  return pbkdf2(_md5, _salt, {
    keySize: 5,
    iterations: 1000,
  }).toString().toUpperCase();
}

import { FC, useRef } from 'react';
import { matchPath, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

import cn from 'classnames';
import {
  ROUTE_BONDS,
  ROUTE_CATALOG,
  ROUTE_CURRENCY,
  ROUTE_ETF, //ROUTE_FAVORITES,
  //ROUTE_FAVORITES_360,
  //ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS,
  ROUTE_FUTURES,
  ROUTE_METAL,
  ROUTE_SELECTIONS,
  ROUTE_STOCKS,
  ROUTE_TURNKEY_SOLUTIONS,
} from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { useSnackBar } from 'hooks/useSnackBar';

import Search from 'modules/Catalog/components/Search';
import { CATALOG_LINKS, NAV_NAMES } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import HeaderPage from 'components/HeaderPage';
import { SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components/Tabs';

import styles from './CatalogWrapper.module.pcss';
import { useCatalog } from './hooks';
import SearchHeader from './partials/SearchHeader';
import { TITLE } from './store';
import { ICatalogWrapper } from './types';

const CatalogWrapper: FC<ICatalogWrapper> = ({ children }) => {
  useSnackBar();

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktop = !isMobile;

  const { pathname } = useLocation();

  const searchRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const isInSelections = matchPath(ROUTE_SELECTIONS, pathname);
  const isMainPageCatalog = CATALOG_LINKS.reduce(
    (acc, curr) => acc || pathname === curr.link,
    false,
  );

  const showHeader = !isInSelections || isDesktop;

  const title = TITLE[pathname] || NAV_NAMES.catalog;

  const { handleNavigate, handleSearch, isActiveSearch, isFavorites, tabs } = useCatalog(pathname);

  const disableSwipe =
    pathname === ROUTE_TURNKEY_SOLUTIONS ||
    pathname === `${ROUTE_CATALOG}/${ROUTE_STOCKS}` ||
    pathname === `${ROUTE_CATALOG}/${ROUTE_BONDS}` ||
    pathname === `${ROUTE_CATALOG}/${ROUTE_ETF}` ||
    pathname === `${ROUTE_CATALOG}/${ROUTE_CURRENCY}` ||
    pathname === `${ROUTE_CATALOG}/${ROUTE_METAL}` ||
    pathname === `${ROUTE_CATALOG}/${ROUTE_FUTURES}` ||
    pathname === ROUTE_CATALOG;

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>
      {showHeader && (
        <HeaderPage
          isDesktop={isDesktop}
          addonRight={
            <Search
              handleClick={handleSearch}
              isActiveSearch={isActiveSearch}
              showIcon={!isMainPageCatalog}
            />
          }
          className={cn(styles.headerPage, {
            [styles.headerFixed]: isFavorites,
            [styles.headerCatalog]: isMainPageCatalog,
            [styles.headerDesktop]: isDesktop,
          })}
          onLeftIconClick={handleNavigate}
          size={isMainPageCatalog || isDesktop ? 'big' : 'small'}
          title={title}
          {...(!isMainPageCatalog && { leftIconVariant: 'back' })}
        />
      )}

      <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
        additionalTop={
          isMainPageCatalog && (
            <SearchHeader
              sectionRef={searchRef}
              classNameInput={styles.inputWrapper}
              classNameInputElement={styles.inputElement}
              onFocus={handleSearch}
            />
          )
        }
        classNameTabs={cn({
          [styles.tabs]: isFavorites,
          [styles.tabsSticky]: isMainPageCatalog,
        })}
        classNameContent={styles.tabsContent}
        classNameWrapper={cn(styles.tabsWrapper, {
          [styles.tabsWrapperPage]: !isMainPageCatalog,
          [styles.extraMarginTop]: isFavorites,
          [styles.tabsWrapperDesktop]: !isMobile,
        })}
        disableSwipe={disableSwipe}
        tabs={tabs}
      >
        {children}
      </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CatalogWrapper;

import { memo } from 'react';

import { SUB_NAVIGATOR_NAMES, SubNavigatorType } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import { ReactComponent as SvgBonds } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/bonds.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SvgCurrencies } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/currenies.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SvgFonds } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/fonds.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SvgFutures } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/futures.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SvgPreciousMetals } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/precious-metals.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SvgStocks } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/stocks.svg';

const IconTab = ({ text }: { text: SubNavigatorType['label'] }) => {
  switch (text) {
    case SUB_NAVIGATOR_NAMES.stock:
      return <SvgStocks />;

    case SUB_NAVIGATOR_NAMES.fonds:
      return <SvgFonds />;

    case SUB_NAVIGATOR_NAMES.bonds:
      return <SvgBonds />;

    case SUB_NAVIGATOR_NAMES.currencies:
      return <SvgCurrencies />;

    case SUB_NAVIGATOR_NAMES.preciousMetals:
      return <SvgPreciousMetals />;

    default:
      return <SvgFutures />;
  }
};

export default memo(IconTab);

import { FC, memo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { CATALOG_BONDS } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { getCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/helpers';
import { ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import Link from 'components/Link';

import IconTab from '../IconTab';
import { ISubTabProps } from './types';

const SubTab: FC<ISubTabProps> = ({ label, url, analyticsParams }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleClick = useCallback(
    (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();

      const category = getCatalogFilters().bonds.category;

      const state = (url === CATALOG_BONDS && { stateParams: category }) || {};

      reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.tabsTap, {
        ...(analyticsParams && { tabs_type: analyticsParams }),
      });

      navigate(url, { state });
    },
    [analyticsParams, navigate, url],
  );

  return (
    <Link to={url} onClick={handleClick}>
      <IconTab text={label} />
    </Link>
  );
};

export default memo(SubTab);

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Input, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useUpdateFavoriteGroupMutation } from 'core/api/catalog';

import { allowedEmojis } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { ReactComponent as SquircleWithPenSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/squircle-with-pen.svg';

import { FavoriteGroup } from 'types/catalog';

import styles from './CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  groupId?: number;
  groupTitle?: string;
  groupName?: string;
  onCreateOrEditGroup: (createdOrEditedGroup: FavoriteGroup) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
};

const CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet = ({
  isOpen,
  groupId,
  groupTitle,
  groupName,
  onCreateOrEditGroup,
  onClose,
}: Props) => {
  const isEdit = groupId !== undefined && groupTitle !== undefined && groupName !== undefined;

  const [updateFavoriteGroup] = useUpdateFavoriteGroupMutation();

  const [value, setValue] = useState(isEdit ? groupName : '');

  const [isChooseEmojiBottomSheetOpen, setChooseEmojiBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [emojiIconGroup, setEmojiIconGroup] = useState(() =>
    isEdit ? groupTitle : allowedEmojis[Math.floor(Math.random() * allowedEmojis.length)],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (value.length > 64) {
      setValue(value.slice(0, value.length - 1));
    }
  }, [value]);

  const handleCreateOrEditGroup = () => {
    updateFavoriteGroup({
      name: value,
      title: emojiIconGroup,
      group_Id: groupId === undefined ? undefined : groupId,
    })
      .unwrap()
      .then((data) => {
        if (!isEdit) {
          setValue('');
          setEmojiIconGroup(allowedEmojis[Math.floor(Math.random() * allowedEmojis.length)]);
        }

        onCreateOrEditGroup(data.favoriteGroup[0]);
        onClose();
      })
      .catch(() => createAlertNotification({ text: 'Что-то пошло не так', status: 'error' }));
  };

  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <BottomSheet
        open={isOpen}
        className={styles.createOrEditGroupBottomSheet}
        onDismiss={onClose}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className={styles.createOrEditGroupContainer}>
          <Text className={styles.title} type="subtitleBold">
            {isEdit ? 'Редактировать группу' : 'Создание группы'}
          </Text>

          <div className={styles.iconWrapper} onClick={() => setChooseEmojiBottomSheetOpen(true)}>
            <SquircleWithPenSvg className={styles.iconMask} />
            <div className={styles.icon}>{emojiIconGroup}</div>
          </div>

          <Input
            placeholder="Мой список"
            value={value}
            label={<Text type="lineRegular">Название группы</Text>}
            onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
          />

          <Button
            className={styles.createOrEditGroupConfirm}
            disabled={value.length < 1 || value.length > 64}
            onClick={handleCreateOrEditGroup}
          >
            Готово
          </Button>
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>

      <BottomSheet
        snapPoints={({ maxHeight }) => [maxHeight * 0.9, maxHeight]}
        open={isChooseEmojiBottomSheetOpen}
        className={styles.chooseEmojiBottomSheet}
        onDismiss={() => setChooseEmojiBottomSheetOpen(false)}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <ul className={styles.emojiList}>
          {allowedEmojis.map((emoji) => (
            <li key={emoji}>
              <div
                className={styles.emoji}
                onClick={() => {
                  setEmojiIconGroup(emoji);
                  setChooseEmojiBottomSheetOpen(false);
                }}
              >
                {emoji}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </BottomSheet>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
};

export { CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet };

import { FC, memo, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_IPO_DETAILS } from 'const/routes';

import { ColorStylesType } from 'utils/colors';

import IpoIcon from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/components/IpoIcon/IpoIcon';
import { getApplicationReceiptDate } from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/utils';

import { IpoItem } from 'types/ipo';

import styles from './IpoCard.module.pcss';

const IpoCard: FC<IpoItem> = ({
  beginDate,
  endDate,
  id,
  instrumentImageName,
  instrumentName,
  name,
  placingCanceled,
  subName,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [colorStyles, setColorStyles] = useState<ColorStylesType | null>(null);

  const applicationReceiptDateState = useMemo(
    () => getApplicationReceiptDate(beginDate, endDate, placingCanceled),
    [beginDate, endDate, placingCanceled],
  );

  const handleStylesChange = (styles: ColorStylesType) => setColorStyles(styles);

  const handleCardClick = () => navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_IPO_DETAILS, { id: String(id) }));

  return (
    <div
      className={styles.card}
      style={colorStyles ? colorStyles : undefined}
      onClick={handleCardClick}
    >
      <div className={styles.head}>
        <div className={styles.img}>
          <IpoIcon
            instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
            onColorStylesChange={handleStylesChange}
          />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.contentItem}>
          <Text type="lineSemiBold" color="colorContent">
            {applicationReceiptDateState.value}
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorContent">
            {applicationReceiptDateState.name}
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <Text type="subtitleBold" color="colorBackground2" className={styles.instrumentName}>
          {name || instrumentName}
        </Text>
        {subName && (
          <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorBackground2">
            {subName}
          </Text>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { FC, memo } from 'react';
import { Link, generatePath } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_IPO } from 'const/routes';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';

import { useGetIpoListQuery } from 'core/api/ipo';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import IpoCard from 'modules/Catalog/components/EquityIpoCards/components/IpoCard/IpoCard';
import IpoCardsSkeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/components/IpoCardsSkeleton/IpoCardsSkeleton';

import styles from './IpoCards.module.pcss';

const EquityIpoCards: FC = () => {
  const personIpoTradPermission = Permissions.get('PERSON_IPOTRADE');
  const isDenied = personIpoTradPermission === 'BLOCKED' || personIpoTradPermission === 'DENIED';

  const { data, isLoading } = useGetIpoListQuery({ isEquity: true }, { skip: isDenied });

  if (isLoading) return <IpoCardsSkeleton />;

  if (!data || data.ipOs.length === 0 || isDenied) return null;

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.titleSection}>
        <div className={styles.title}>
          <Text type="bodySemiBold">Размещение акций</Text>
        </div>
        {data.ipOs.length > 6 && (
          <Link to={generatePath(ROUTE_IPO, { type: 'equities' })} className={styles.allButton}>
            <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              Все
            </Text>
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>
      <Swiper
        autoHeight
        className={styles.swiper}
        preventClicksPropagation
        slidesPerView="auto"
        spaceBetween={8}
        touchMoveStopPropagation
        touchStartPreventDefault
      >
        {data.ipOs.slice(0, 6).map((ipo, index) => (
          <SwiperSlide key={index} className={styles.slide}>
            <IpoCard {...ipo} />
          </SwiperSlide>
        ))}
      </Swiper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(EquityIpoCards);

import { FC, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import {
  useLazyGetFavoriteGroupQuery,
  useUpdateFavoriteDeleteMutation,
  useUpdateFavoritePostMutation,
} from 'core/api/catalog';
import { useLazyGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { ReactComponent as PlusCircleSvg } from 'images/icons/plus-circle.svg';

import { FavoriteGroup } from 'types/catalog';

import ErrorOrEmpty from './ErrorOrEmpty';
import styles from './FavoriteBottomSheet.module.pcss';
import Option from './Option';
import { getAlertNotificationText, getGroupList } from './helpers';
import { IFavoriteBottomSheetProps } from './types';

const FavoriteBottomSheet: FC<IFavoriteBottomSheetProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  createdGroup,
  onCreateGroup,
  onRefetch,
  onDismiss,
}) => {
  const [getInstrumentInfo, { isError: isInstrumentInfoError, data: instrumentInfoData }] =
    useLazyGetInstrumentInfoQuery();

  const [
    getFavoriteGroup,
    { isError: isFavoriteGroupError, isLoading: isFavoriteGroupLoading, data: favoriteGroupData },
  ] = useLazyGetFavoriteGroupQuery();

  const [updateFavoritePost] = useUpdateFavoritePostMutation();
  const [updateFavoriteDelete] = useUpdateFavoriteDeleteMutation();

  const [favoriteGroups, setFavoriteGroups] = useState<FavoriteGroup[] | null>(null);

  const [initialIsFavoriteChecked, setInitialIsFavoriteChecked] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [isFavoriteChecked, setFavoriteChecked] = useState<boolean | null>(null);

  const [initialCheckedGroups, setInitialCheckedGroups] = useState<number[] | null>(null);
  const [checkedGroups, setCheckedGroups] = useState<number[] | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      getInstrumentInfo({
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
        subscribe: false,
      });
    }
  }, [isOpen, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, getInstrumentInfo]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      getFavoriteGroup({});
    }
  }, [isOpen, getFavoriteGroup]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (instrumentInfoData) {
      const { favoriteGroup: favoriteGroups } = instrumentInfoData;

      const isFavoriteChecked = favoriteGroups.some(({ groupId }) => groupId === undefined);
      setInitialIsFavoriteChecked(isFavoriteChecked);
      setFavoriteChecked(isFavoriteChecked);

      const checkedGroups = favoriteGroups
        .map(({ groupId }) => groupId)
        .filter((groupId) => groupId !== undefined);
      setInitialCheckedGroups(checkedGroups);
      setCheckedGroups(checkedGroups);
    }
  }, [instrumentInfoData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (favoriteGroupData) {
      setFavoriteGroups(favoriteGroupData.favoriteGroup);
    }
  }, [favoriteGroupData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (createdGroup) {
      setFavoriteGroups((prev) => (prev ? [createdGroup, ...prev] : prev));
    }
  }, [createdGroup]);

  const handleGroupCheckClick = useCallback(
    (groupId?: number) => {
      const isChecked = groupId && checkedGroups?.includes(groupId);
      if (isChecked) {
        setCheckedGroups((prev) =>
          prev ? prev.filter((prevGroupId) => prevGroupId !== groupId) : prev,
        );
      } else {
        setCheckedGroups((prev) => (prev && groupId ? [...prev, groupId] : prev));
      }
    },
    [checkedGroups],
  );

  if (isInstrumentInfoError || isFavoriteGroupError) {
    return null;
  }

  const handleApply = async () => {
    if (
      initialIsFavoriteChecked === null ||
      isFavoriteChecked === null ||
      !initialCheckedGroups ||
      !checkedGroups
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const addedGroups = checkedGroups.filter((groupId) => !initialCheckedGroups.includes(groupId));
    const deletedGroups = initialCheckedGroups.filter(
      (groupId) => !checkedGroups.includes(groupId),
    );

    const isFavoritePost = initialIsFavoriteChecked !== isFavoriteChecked && isFavoriteChecked;
    const isFavoriteDelete = initialIsFavoriteChecked !== isFavoriteChecked && !isFavoriteChecked;

    const needToPost = isFavoritePost || addedGroups.length > 0;
    const needToDelete = isFavoriteDelete || deletedGroups.length > 0;

    await Promise.all([
      needToPost &&
        updateFavoritePost({
          instrumentId,
          tradePlaceId,
          ...(isFavoritePost ? { favorite: isFavoritePost } : {}),
          ...(addedGroups.length ? { groupList: getGroupList(addedGroups) } : {}),
        }),
      needToDelete &&
        updateFavoriteDelete({
          instrumentId,
          tradePlaceId,
          ...(isFavoriteDelete ? { favorite: isFavoriteDelete } : {}),
          ...(deletedGroups.length ? { groupList: getGroupList(deletedGroups) } : {}),
        }),
    ]);

    onDismiss();

    if (needToPost || needToDelete) {
      createAlertNotification({
        status: 'info',
        text: getAlertNotificationText({
          numberOfAddedGroups: isFavoritePost ? addedGroups.length + 1 : addedGroups.length,
          numberOfDeletedGroups: isFavoriteDelete ? deletedGroups.length + 1 : deletedGroups.length,
        }),
      });

      Notifications.emit('FavoriteInstrumentsChanged');

      onRefetch?.();
    }
  };

  const getHeader = () => {
    return (
      <>
        <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.moveToGroup}>
          Переместить в группу
        </Text>

        <Option
          isChecked={!!isFavoriteChecked}
          title="Избранное"
          onCheckClick={() => setFavoriteChecked((prev) => !prev)}
        />

        <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.chooseGroup}>
          Выберите группу
        </Text>
      </>
    );
  };

  const getFooter = () => {
    return (
      <>
        <div className={styles.separator} />

        <div className={styles.createNewGroupWrapper} onClick={onCreateGroup}>
          <div className={styles.plusCircleIconWrapper}>
            <PlusCircleSvg />
          </div>
          <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.createNewGroup}>
            Создать новую группу
          </Text>
        </div>

        <Button className={styles.button} onClick={handleApply}>
          Применить
        </Button>
      </>
    );
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={isOpen}
      expandOnContentDrag={false}
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
      header={getHeader()}
      footer={getFooter()}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
    >
      {isFavoriteGroupLoading && <CircleLoader />}
      <div className={styles.contentWrapper}>
        {!favoriteGroups?.length && <ErrorOrEmpty isError={false} />}

        {favoriteGroups?.map(({ groupId, title, name }) => {
          return (
            <Option
              key={groupId}
              groupId={groupId}
              isChecked={!!checkedGroups?.includes(groupId)}
              emoji={title}
              title={name}
              onCheckClick={handleGroupCheckClick}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(FavoriteBottomSheet);

import { FC, cloneElement, memo, useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet } from 'modules/Catalog/components/CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet';

import { ReactComponent as StarFillSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/search/star-fill.svg';
import { ReactComponent as StarSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/search/star.svg';

import { FavoriteGroup } from 'types/catalog';

import FavoriteBottomSheet from './FavoriteBottomSheet';
import { IFavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet } from './types';

const FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet: FC<IFavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet> = ({
  customButton,
  instrumentId,
  isFavorite,
  isTouchStart,
  onRefetch,
  tradePlaceId,
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCreateFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen, setCreateFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen] =
    useState(false);
  const [createdGroup, setCreatedGroup] = useState<FavoriteGroup | null>(null);

  const handleFavoriteBottomSheetOpen = useCallback(() => setIsOpen(true), []);
  const handleFavoriteBottomSheetClose = useCallback(() => setIsOpen(false), []);

  const onClose = useCallback(() => setCreateFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen(false), []);
  const onCreateGroup = useCallback(() => setCreateFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen(true), []);
  const onCreateOrEditGroup = useCallback((event) => setCreatedGroup(event), []);

  const buttonProps = useMemo(
    () =>
      isTouchStart
        ? { onTouchStart: handleFavoriteBottomSheetOpen }
        : { onClick: handleFavoriteBottomSheetOpen },
    [handleFavoriteBottomSheetOpen, isTouchStart],
  );

  const defaultButton = (
    <button type="button" {...buttonProps}>
      {isFavorite ? <StarFillSvg /> : <StarSvg />}
    </button>
  );

  return (
    <>
      {cloneElement(customButton ? customButton : defaultButton, buttonProps)}

      <FavoriteBottomSheet
        isOpen={isOpen}
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        createdGroup={createdGroup}
        onCreateGroup={onCreateGroup}
        onRefetch={onRefetch}
        onDismiss={handleFavoriteBottomSheetClose}
      />

      <CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet
        isOpen={isCreateFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen}
        onCreateOrEditGroup={onCreateOrEditGroup}
        onClose={onClose}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet);

export const getGroupList = (addedGroups: number[]) =>
  addedGroups.reduce((acc, groupId, index) => {
    if (index === 0) {
      return `${groupId}`;
    }

    return `${acc},${groupId}`;
  }, '');

export const getAlertNotificationText = ({
  numberOfAddedGroups,
  numberOfDeletedGroups,
}: {
  numberOfAddedGroups: number;
  numberOfDeletedGroups: number;
}) => {
  if (numberOfAddedGroups && numberOfDeletedGroups) {
    return 'Изменения внесены';
  }

  if (numberOfDeletedGroups) {
    return 'Бумага удалена';
  }

  if (numberOfAddedGroups === 1) {
    return 'Бумага добавлена в группу';
  }

  return 'Бумага добавлена в группы';
};

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Checkbox, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';

import {
  useAddInstrumentsToFavoriteGroupMutation,
  useLazyGetFavoriteQuery,
  useLazyGetInstrumentsQuery,
} from 'core/api/catalog';

import { palette } from 'vars';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import { InstrumentCardWithButton, InstrumentIcon, InstrumentType } from 'components/Instrument';

import { ReactComponent as CloseSvg } from 'images/icons/search/close.svg';
import { ReactComponent as EmptyHistoryNontradeSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/servise-17.svg';

import { ParsedFavoriteInstrument } from 'types/catalog';

import styles from './AddInstrumentsBottomSheet.module.pcss';
import Header from './components/Header';
import { Search } from './components/Search';
import { INSTRUMENTS_SEARCH_MAX_COUNT } from './const';
import { AddInstrumentsBottomSheetProps, SearchGroup, SelectedInstrument } from './types';
import { useDebounceSearchValue } from './useDebounceSearchValue';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/pagination';

const AddInstrumentsBottomSheet = ({
  isOpen,
  createdGroupId,
  groupInstruments = null,
  onFinish,
  onDismiss,
}: AddInstrumentsBottomSheetProps) => {
  const [getFavorite, { isError: isFavoriteError, data: favoriteData }] = useLazyGetFavoriteQuery();

  const [
    getInstruments,
    { isError: isInstrumentsError, status: instrumentsStatus, data: instrumentsData },
  ] = useLazyGetInstrumentsQuery();

  const [addInstrumentsToFavoriteGroup] = useAddInstrumentsToFavoriteGroupMutation();

  const [searchValue, setSearchValue] = useState('');
  const {
    isLoadingOnType,
    debouncedValue: debouncedSearchValue,
    resetLoadingOnType,
  } = useDebounceSearchValue(searchValue);
  const [selectedInstruments, setSelectedInstruments] = useState<SelectedInstrument[]>([]);

  const isBottomSheetReady = isOpen && createdGroupId !== null;
  const isSearchMode = debouncedSearchValue.length > 2;

  const searchGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isBottomSheetReady) {
      return null;
    }

    if (!isSearchMode || !favoriteData || !instrumentsData) {
      return null;
    }

    const favoriteSearchInstruments = favoriteData.filter(({ instrumentName }) => {
      return instrumentName.toLowerCase().includes(debouncedSearchValue.toLowerCase());
    });
    const favoriteSearchGroup =
      favoriteSearchInstruments.length > 0
        ? { title: 'Из избранного', instruments: favoriteSearchInstruments }
        : null;

    return instrumentsData.instrument.reduce<SearchGroup[]>(
      (acc, instrument) => {
        const { instrumentGroupName } = instrument;

        const foundIndex = acc.findIndex(
          (searchGroup) => searchGroup.title === instrumentGroupName,
        );

        if (foundIndex === -1) {
          return [...acc, { title: instrumentGroupName, instruments: [instrument] }];
        }

        const updatedSearchGroup = {
          ...acc[foundIndex],
          instruments: [...acc[foundIndex].instruments, instrument],
        };

        const copiedAcc = [...acc];
        copiedAcc.splice(foundIndex, 1, updatedSearchGroup);

        return copiedAcc;
      },
      favoriteSearchGroup ? [favoriteSearchGroup] : [],
    );
  }, [isBottomSheetReady, isSearchMode, favoriteData, instrumentsData, debouncedSearchValue]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isBottomSheetReady) {
      getFavorite({});
    }
  }, [isBottomSheetReady, getFavorite]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isBottomSheetReady && isSearchMode) {
      getInstruments({
        search_text: debouncedSearchValue,
        max_count: INSTRUMENTS_SEARCH_MAX_COUNT,
      });
    }
  }, [isBottomSheetReady, isSearchMode, debouncedSearchValue, getInstruments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isBottomSheetReady && instrumentsStatus === 'fulfilled') {
      resetLoadingOnType();
    }
  }, [isBottomSheetReady, instrumentsStatus, resetLoadingOnType]);

  if (isFavoriteError || isInstrumentsError) {
    return <div>Error</div>;
  }

  const handleFinish = async () => {
    if (!isBottomSheetReady) {
      return;
    }

    const { length: numberOfSelectedInstruments } = selectedInstruments;

    if (!numberOfSelectedInstruments) {
      onFinish();
      return;
    }

    const instrumentArray = selectedInstruments.reduce(
      (acc, { instrumentId, tradePlaceId }, index) => {
        if (index === 0) {
          return `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`;
        }

        return `${acc};${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`;
      },
      '',
    );

    await addInstrumentsToFavoriteGroup({ group_Id: createdGroupId, instrumentArray });

    createAlertNotification({
      status: 'info',
      text: numberOfSelectedInstruments === 1 ? 'Бумага добавлена' : 'Бумаги добавлены',
    });

    setSearchValue('');
    setSelectedInstruments([]);

    onFinish();
  };

  const getContent = () => {
    const renderInstrumentsList = (instruments: (InstrumentType | ParsedFavoriteInstrument)[]) => {
      return instruments.map(
        ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, instrumentImageName, ...otherInstrument }) => {
          const foundGroupInstrument = groupInstruments?.find((groupInstrument) => {
            return (
              groupInstrument.instrumentId === instrumentId &&
              groupInstrument.tradePlaceId === tradePlaceId
            );
          });
          const isInGroup = !!foundGroupInstrument;

          const foundSelectedInstrument =
            isInGroup ||
            selectedInstruments.find((selectedInstrument) => {
              return (
                selectedInstrument.instrumentId === instrumentId &&
                selectedInstrument.tradePlaceId === tradePlaceId
              );
            });
          const isChecked = !!foundSelectedInstrument;

          const handleClick = () => {
            if (isChecked) {
              setSelectedInstruments((prev) => {
                return prev.filter((prevSelectedInstrument) => {
                  return (
                    prevSelectedInstrument.instrumentId !== instrumentId ||
                    prevSelectedInstrument.tradePlaceId !== tradePlaceId
                  );
                });
              });
            } else {
              setSelectedInstruments((prev) => {
                return [...prev, { instrumentId, tradePlaceId, instrumentImageName }];
              });
            }
          };

          return (
            <InstrumentCardWithButton
              {...otherInstrument}
              key={`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`}
              noSubIcon
              instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
              className={styles.instrument}
              button={<Checkbox disabled={isInGroup} checked={isChecked} onChange={handleClick} />}
            />
          );
        },
      );
    };

    if (isSearchMode) {
      if (isLoadingOnType || instrumentsStatus === 'pending') {
        return (
          <div className={styles.searchLoading}>
            <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />
          </div>
        );
      }

      if (instrumentsStatus === 'fulfilled' && (!searchGroups || !searchGroups.length)) {
        return (
          <Text type="bodyRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.notFound}>
            Ничего не найдено
          </Text>
        );
      }

      if (!searchGroups) {
        return null;
      }

      return searchGroups.map(({ title, instruments }) => {
        return (
          <React.Fragment key={title}>
            <Text type="subtitleSemiBold" className={styles.title}>
              {title}
            </Text>

            {renderInstrumentsList(instruments)}
          </React.Fragment>
        );
      });
    }

    if (!favoriteData) {
      return null;
    }

    if (!favoriteData.length) {
      return (
        <React.Fragment>
          <EmptyHistoryNontradeSvg className={styles.emptyHistoryNontradeIcon} />
          <Text type="subtitleSemiBold" className={styles.emptyTitle}>
            Список инструментов пуст
          </Text>
          <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.emptyDescription}>
            Воспользуйтесь поиском, чтобы добавить инструмент
          </Text>
        </React.Fragment>
      );
    }

    return (
      <React.Fragment>
        <Text type="subtitleSemiBold" className={styles.title}>
          Из избранного
        </Text>

        {renderInstrumentsList(favoriteData)}
      </React.Fragment>
    );
  };

  const haveSelectedInstruments = selectedInstruments.length > 0;

  const header = (
    <React.Fragment>
      <Header haveSelectedInstruments={haveSelectedInstruments} onFinish={handleFinish} />
      <Search value={searchValue} setValue={setSearchValue} />

      {haveSelectedInstruments && (
        <Swiper
          touchMoveStopPropagation
          touchStartPreventDefault
          preventClicksPropagation
          slidesPerView="auto"
          spaceBetween={8}
          className={styles.swiper}
        >
          {selectedInstruments.map(({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, instrumentImageName }) => {
            const handleClick = () => {
              setSelectedInstruments((prev) => {
                return prev.filter((prevSelectedInstrument) => {
                  return (
                    prevSelectedInstrument.instrumentId !== instrumentId ||
                    prevSelectedInstrument.tradePlaceId !== tradePlaceId
                  );
                });
              });
            };

            return (
              <SwiperSlide key={`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`} className={styles.slide}>
                <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />

                <div className={styles.closeIconWrapper} onClick={handleClick}>
                  <CloseSvg color={palette.colorForeground2} />
                </div>
              </SwiperSlide>
            );
          })}
        </Swiper>
      )}
    </React.Fragment>
  );

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={isOpen}
      expandOnContentDrag={false}
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
      header={header}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
    >
      <div className={styles.content}>{getContent()}</div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export { AddInstrumentsBottomSheet };

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { DEBOUNCE_SEARCH_VALUE_DELAY } from './const';

const useDebounceSearchValue = (value: string) => {
  const [isLoadingOnType, setLoadingOnType] = useState(false);
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value);

  const resetLoadingOnType = useCallback(() => setLoadingOnType(false), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
      setLoadingOnType(true);
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, DEBOUNCE_SEARCH_VALUE_DELAY);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    };
  }, [value]);

  return { isLoadingOnType, debouncedValue, resetLoadingOnType };
};

export { useDebounceSearchValue };

import { FC, memo, useState } from 'react';

import { Confirm } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useDeleteFavoriteGroupMutation } from 'core/api/catalog';

import { useSwipeable } from 'hooks/useSwipeable';

import { CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet } from 'modules/Catalog/components/CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet';

import { ReactComponent as BinSvg } from 'images/icons/bin.svg';
import { ReactComponent as EditSvg } from 'images/icons/edit.svg';

import FavoriteGroup from './FavoriteGroup';
import styles from './SwipeableFavoriteGroup.module.pcss';
import { ISwipeableFavoriteGroupProps } from './types';

const SwipeableFavoriteGroup: FC<ISwipeableFavoriteGroupProps> = ({
  groupId,
  title,
  name,
  instrumentCount,
  isDragging = false,
  onRefetch,
}) => {
  const [deleteFavoriteGroup] = useDeleteFavoriteGroupMutation();

  const [isCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen, setCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen] =
    useState(false);
  const [isConfirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktop = !isMobile;

  const {
    containerRef,
    buttonsWrapperRef,
    handleTouchEnd,
    handleTouchStart,
    isContainerDimensionsCalculated,
    containerStyle,
    componentStyle: favoriteGroupStyle,
  } = useSwipeable(isDragging);

  const closeCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet = () => {
    setCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen(false);
  };
  const closeConfirm = () => setConfirmOpen(false);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={cx(styles.container, { [styles.containerDesktop]: isDesktop })}
      style={isContainerDimensionsCalculated ? (containerStyle as React.CSSProperties) : undefined}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
      onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
    >
      <FavoriteGroup
        groupId={groupId}
        name={name}
        title={title}
        instrumentCount={instrumentCount}
        style={
          isContainerDimensionsCalculated && isMobile
            ? (favoriteGroupStyle as React.CSSProperties)
            : undefined
        }
      />

      {isContainerDimensionsCalculated && (
        <div ref={buttonsWrapperRef} className={styles.buttonsWrapper}>
          <div
            className={cx(styles.iconWrapper, styles.iconBlue)}
            // onClick иногда не работает из-за react-beautiful-dnd
            onTouchStart={() => setCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen(true)}
          >
            <EditSvg />
          </div>

          <div
            className={cx(styles.iconWrapper, styles.iconRed)}
            // onClick иногда не работает из-за react-beautiful-dnd
            onTouchStart={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}
          >
            <BinSvg />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet
        isOpen={isCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen}
        groupId={groupId}
        groupTitle={title}
        groupName={name}
        onCreateOrEditGroup={() => {
          closeCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet();
          onRefetch();
        }}
        onClose={closeCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet}
      />

      <Confirm
        open={isConfirmOpen}
        title="Вы действительно хотите удалить группу?"
        confirmBtnText="Удалить"
        onCancel={closeConfirm}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          await deleteFavoriteGroup({ group_Id: groupId });
          onRefetch();
          closeConfirm();
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(SwipeableFavoriteGroup);

import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { DragDropContext, DropResult, Droppable } from 'react-beautiful-dnd';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useGetFavoriteGroupQuery,
  useReorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroupGroupMutation,
} from 'core/api/catalog';

import { CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet } from 'modules/Catalog/components/CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet';
import { AddInstrumentsBottomSheet } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/AddInstrumentsBottomSheet';
import { SwipeableFavoriteGroupDragDrop } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/FavoritesGroups/components/SwipeableFavoriteGroupDragDrop';

import { FilterScrollProvider } from 'components/Filters';

import { ReactComponent as CreateGroupSvg } from 'images/icons/create-group.svg';

import { FavoriteGroup as FavoriteGroupType } from 'types/catalog/models';

import styles from './FavoritesGroups.module.pcss';
import ErrorPlug from './pages/ErrorPlug';
import Skeleton from './pages/Skeleton';

const FavoritesGroups = () => {
  const { isError, data, refetch } = useGetFavoriteGroupQuery({});
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [reorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroupGroup] = useReorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroupGroupMutation();

  const [containerStyle, setContainerStyle] = useState<React.CSSProperties | null>(null);
  const [localFavoriteGroups, setLocalFavoriteGroups] = useState<FavoriteGroupType[] | null>(null);
  const [isCreateGroupOpen, setIsCreateGroupOpen] = useState(false);
  const [createdGroupId, setCreatedGroupId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    refetch();
  }, [refetch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data) {
      setLocalFavoriteGroups(data.favoriteGroup);
    }
  }, [data]);

  const setContainerRef = useCallback(
    (node: HTMLDivElement) => {
      if (node && isMobile) {
        setContainerStyle({ position: 'fixed', width: '100%', height: node.clientHeight });
      }
    },
    [isMobile],
  );

  if (isError) {
    return <ErrorPlug />;
  }

  if (!localFavoriteGroups) {
    return <Skeleton />;
  }

  const isAddInstrumentsMode = createdGroupId !== null;

  const handleDragEnd = (dropResult: DropResult) => {
    if (!dropResult.destination) {
      return;
    }

    const {
      destination: { index: endIndex },
      source: { index: startIndex },
    } = dropResult;

    const draggableGroup = localFavoriteGroups.find((_, index) => index === startIndex);

    if (draggableGroup) {
      const newLocalFavoriteGroups = [...localFavoriteGroups];
      const [deletedFavoriteGroup] = newLocalFavoriteGroups.splice(startIndex, 1);
      newLocalFavoriteGroups.splice(endIndex, 0, deletedFavoriteGroup);

      setLocalFavoriteGroups(newLocalFavoriteGroups);

      reorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroupGroup({
        groupId: draggableGroup.groupId,
        newIndexNumber: endIndex + 1,
      });
    }
  };

  const button = (
    <Button
      className={cx(styles.createGroupBtnWrapper, {
        [styles.createGroupBtnWrapperDesktop]: !isMobile,
      })}
      classNameContent={styles.createGroupBtn}
      variant="secondary"
      onClick={() => setIsCreateGroupOpen(!isCreateGroupOpen)}
    >
      <CreateGroupSvg style={{ marginRight: '18px' }} />
      Создать группу
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <>
      {localFavoriteGroups.length ? (
        <div ref={setContainerRef} className={styles.container}>
          <FilterScrollProvider style={containerStyle || undefined}>
            <DragDropContext onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}>
              <Droppable droppableId="favoriteCard">
                {(provided) => {
                  return (
                    <div
                      {...provided.droppableProps}
                      ref={provided.innerRef}
                      className={styles.listContainer}
                    >
                      {localFavoriteGroups.map(
                        ({ indexNumber, groupId, name, title, instrumentCount }, index) => (
                          <SwipeableFavoriteGroupDragDrop
                            key={groupId}
                            index={index}
                            indexNumber={indexNumber}
                            groupId={groupId}
                            name={name}
                            title={title}
                            instrumentCount={instrumentCount}
                            onRefetch={refetch}
                          />
                        ),
                      )}

                      {provided.placeholder}
                      {button}
                    </div>
                  );
                }}
              </Droppable>
            </DragDropContext>

            <div className={styles.margin} />
          </FilterScrollProvider>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.noGroups}>
          <Text type="subtitleBold">Групп пока нет</Text>
          <Text type="bodyRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            У вас пока не создано ни одной группы инструментов
          </Text>

          {button}
        </div>
      )}

      <CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet
        isOpen={isCreateGroupOpen}
        onCreateOrEditGroup={({ groupId }) => {
          setCreatedGroupId(groupId);
          refetch();
        }}
        onClose={() => setIsCreateGroupOpen(false)}
      />

      <AddInstrumentsBottomSheet
        isOpen={isAddInstrumentsMode}
        createdGroupId={createdGroupId}
        onFinish={() => {
          setCreatedGroupId(null);
          refetch();
        }}
        onDismiss={() => setCreatedGroupId(null)}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(FavoritesGroups);
