import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { DragDropContext, DropResult, Droppable } from 'react-beautiful-dnd';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Confirm, Filter, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useDeleteFavoriteGroupMutation,
  useGetFavoriteGroupQuery,
  useLazyGetInstrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdQuery,
  useReorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroupMutation,
} from 'core/api/catalog';

import { getNoun } from 'utils/string';

import { palette } from 'vars';

import { CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet } from 'modules/Catalog/components/CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet';
import { AddInstrumentsBottomSheet } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/AddInstrumentsBottomSheet';
import { InstrumentCardDragDrop } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/InstrumentCardDragDrop/InstrumentCardDragDrop';
import SortBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/SortBottomSheet';
import {
  SORT_BY_DOWN,
  SORT_BY_LIST,
  SORT_BY_NAME,
  SORT_BY_UP,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/consts';
import { SortType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/types';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import { SwipeableInstrumentCard } from 'components/Instrument';

import { ReactComponent as PlusCircleSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/plus-circle.svg';
import { ReactComponent as MoreSvg } from 'images/icons/more.svg';
import { ReactComponent as DownSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/favorites/down.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ListSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/favorites/list.svg';
import { ReactComponent as UpSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/favorites/up.svg';
import { ReactComponent as WordSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/favorites/word.svg';

import styles from './GroupDetail.module.pcss';
import MenuBottomSheet from './MenuBottomSheet';
import { LocalInstrumentType } from './types';

const GroupDetail = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { groupId } = useParams();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const {
    isError: isFavoriteGroupError,
    data: favoriteGroupData,
    refetch: refetchFavoriteGroup,
  } = useGetFavoriteGroupQuery({});

  const [
    getInstrumentsFavoriteGroupById,
    { isError: isInstrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdError, data: instrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdData },
  ] = useLazyGetInstrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdQuery();

  const [reorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroup] = useReorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroupMutation();
  const [deleteFavoriteGroup] = useDeleteFavoriteGroupMutation();

  const [containerStyle, setContainerStyle] = useState<React.CSSProperties | null>(null);

  const [isMenuBottomSheetOpen, setMenuBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);

  const [isSortBottomSheetOpen, setSortBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSortType, setSelectedSortType] = useState<SortType>(SORT_BY_LIST);
  const [localInstruments, setLocalInstruments] = useState<LocalInstrumentType[] | null>(null);

  const [isCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen, setCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen] =
    useState(false);

  const [isAddInstrumentsBottomSheetOpen, setAddInstrumentsBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);

  const [isConfirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

  const { title, name, instrumentCountSubtitle } = useMemo(() => {
    const INITIAL_DATA = { title: null, name: null, instrumentCountSubtitle: null };

    if (!groupId || !favoriteGroupData) {
      return INITIAL_DATA;
    }

    const foundFavoriteGroup = favoriteGroupData.favoriteGroup.find(
      ({ groupId: favoriteGroupGroupId }) => favoriteGroupGroupId === Number.parseInt(groupId),
    );

    if (!foundFavoriteGroup) {
      return INITIAL_DATA;
    }

    const { title, name, instrumentCount } = foundFavoriteGroup;

    return {
      title,
      name,
      instrumentCountSubtitle: `${instrumentCount} ${getNoun(
        instrumentCount,
        'бумага',
        'бумаги',
        'бумаг',
      )}`,
    };
  }, [groupId, favoriteGroupData]);

  const { filterText, filterSortDirection } = useMemo<{
    filterText: string;
    filterSortDirection: 'list' | 'up' | 'down' | 'word';
  }>(() => {
    switch (selectedSortType) {
      case SORT_BY_LIST:
        return { filterText: 'Мой список', filterSortDirection: 'list' };
      case SORT_BY_UP:
        return { filterText: 'Изменение за сегодня', filterSortDirection: 'up' };
      case SORT_BY_DOWN:
        return { filterText: 'Изменение за сегодня', filterSortDirection: 'down' };
      case SORT_BY_NAME:
        return { filterText: 'По названию', filterSortDirection: 'word' };
    }
  }, [selectedSortType]);

  const titleIcon =
    (filterText === 'Мой список' && <ListSvg />) ||
    (filterText === 'Изменение за сегодня' && filterSortDirection === 'up' && <UpSvg />) ||
    (filterText === 'Изменение за сегодня' && filterSortDirection === 'down' && <DownSvg />) ||
    (filterText === 'По названию' && <WordSvg />);

  const sortedLocalInstruments = useMemo(() => {
    if (!localInstruments) {
      return null;
    }

    if (selectedSortType === SORT_BY_LIST) {
      return localInstruments;
    }

    if (selectedSortType === SORT_BY_UP || selectedSortType === SORT_BY_DOWN) {
      return [...localInstruments].sort((left, right) => {
        if (left.priceDiffPcnt > right.priceDiffPcnt) {
          return selectedSortType === SORT_BY_UP ? -1 : 1;
        }

        if (left.priceDiffPcnt < right.priceDiffPcnt) {
          return selectedSortType === SORT_BY_UP ? 1 : -1;
        }

        return 0;
      });
    }

    if (selectedSortType === SORT_BY_NAME) {
      return [...localInstruments].sort((left, right) => {
        return left.instrumentName.localeCompare(right.instrumentName, 'en');
      });
    }

    return localInstruments;
  }, [localInstruments, selectedSortType]);

  const formattedSortedLocalInstruments = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sortedLocalInstruments) {
      return null;
    }

    return sortedLocalInstruments.map(({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId }) => {
      return {
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
      };
    });
  }, [sortedLocalInstruments]);

  const refetchInstruments = useCallback(() => {
    if (!groupId) {
      return;
    }

    getInstrumentsFavoriteGroupById({
      groupId: Number.parseInt(groupId),
      showQuoteHistory: true,
      quoteHistoryDays: 180,
      datePart: 'week',
      dateStep: 3,
    });
  }, [groupId, getInstrumentsFavoriteGroupById]);

  useEffect(() => {
    refetchFavoriteGroup();
  }, [refetchFavoriteGroup]);

  useEffect(() => {
    refetchInstruments();
  }, [refetchInstruments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const doParseData = () => {
      if (!instrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdData) {
        return;
      }

      const { instrument: instruments, quoteHistory } = instrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdData;

      if (!localInstruments || instruments.length !== localInstruments.length) {
        const formattedInstruments = instruments.map((instrument) => {
          const { instrumentId } = instrument;

          return {
            ...instrument,
            quoteHistory: quoteHistory
              .filter(({ instrumentId: quoteInstrumentId }) => quoteInstrumentId === instrumentId)
              .map(({ quote }) => quote),
          };
        });

        setLocalInstruments(formattedInstruments);
        return;
      }

      const formattedInstruments: LocalInstrumentType[] = [];

      localInstruments.forEach((localInstrument) => {
        const foundInstrument = instruments.find((instrument) => {
          return (
            instrument.instrumentId === localInstrument.instrumentId &&
            instrument.tradePlaceId === localInstrument.tradePlaceId
          );
        });

        if (!foundInstrument) {
          return;
        }

        formattedInstruments.push({
          ...foundInstrument,
          quoteHistory: quoteHistory
            .filter(({ instrumentId: quoteInstrumentId }) => {
              return quoteInstrumentId === foundInstrument.instrumentId;
            })
            .map(({ quote }) => quote),
        });
      });

      setLocalInstruments(formattedInstruments);
    };

    doParseData();

    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [instrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdData]);

  const setContainerRef = useCallback((node: HTMLDivElement) => {
    if (node) {
      setContainerStyle({
        position: isMobile ? 'fixed' : 'relative',
        width: '100%',
        height: node.clientHeight - 44,
      });
    }
  }, []);

  if (!groupId || isFavoriteGroupError || isInstrumentsFavoriteGroupByIdError) {
    return null;
  }

  const isLoading =
    title === null ||
    name === null ||
    instrumentCountSubtitle === null ||
    !localInstruments ||
    !sortedLocalInstruments ||
    !formattedSortedLocalInstruments;

  if (isLoading) {
    return null;
  }

  const handleDragEnd = (dropResult: DropResult) => {
    if (!groupId || !dropResult.destination) {
      return;
    }

    const {
      destination: { index: endIndex },
      source: { index: startIndex },
    } = dropResult;

    const draggableInstrument = sortedLocalInstruments.find((_, index) => index === startIndex);

    if (draggableInstrument) {
      const { instrumentId, tradePlaceId } = draggableInstrument;

      const newSortedLocalInstruments = [...sortedLocalInstruments];
      const [deletedInstrument] = newSortedLocalInstruments.splice(startIndex, 1);
      newSortedLocalInstruments.splice(endIndex, 0, deletedInstrument);

      setLocalInstruments(newSortedLocalInstruments);

      reorderInstrumentsFavoriteGroup({
        groupId: Number.parseInt(groupId),
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
        newIndexNumber: endIndex + 1,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleRefetch = () => {
    refetchFavoriteGroup();
    refetchInstruments();
  };

  const getContent = () => {
    if (!sortedLocalInstruments.length) {
      return (
        <Text type="bodyRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.noInstruments}>
          В группе нет бумаг
        </Text>
      );
    }

    return (
      <>
        <div className={styles.filterCardWrapper}>
          <Filter
            text={
              <div className={styles.filter}>
                {titleIcon}
                {filterText}
              </div>
            }
            onClick={() => {
              setSortBottomSheetOpen(true);
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {selectedSortType === SORT_BY_LIST ? (
          <DragDropContext onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}>
            <Droppable droppableId="favoriteCard">
              {(provided) => {
                return (
                  <div {...provided.droppableProps} ref={provided.innerRef}>
                    {sortedLocalInstruments.map((instrument, index) => (
                      <InstrumentCardDragDrop
                        key={`${instrument.instrumentId}-${instrument.tradePlaceId}`}
                        index={index}
                        indexNumber={(instrument as any).indexNumber}
                        instrumentId={instrument.instrumentId}
                        tradePlaceId={instrument.tradePlaceId}
                        instrumentImageName={instrument.instrumentImageName}
                        instrumentName={instrument.instrumentName}
                        instrumentCode={instrument.instrumentCode}
                        tradePlaceShortName={instrument.tradePlaceShortName}
                        dataLine={instrument.quoteHistory}
                        price={instrument.lastPrice}
                        currencyCode={instrument.priceCurrency}
                        periodPriceDiff={instrument.priceDiffCurr}
                        periodPriceDiffPcnt={instrument.priceDiffPcnt}
                        hasDeleteButton
                        groupIdToDelete={Number.parseInt(groupId)}
                        onRefetch={handleRefetch}
                      />
                    ))}

                    {provided.placeholder}
                  </div>
                );
              }}
            </Droppable>
          </DragDropContext>
        ) : (
          sortedLocalInstruments.map((instrument) => (
            <SwipeableInstrumentCard
              key={`${instrument.instrumentId}-${instrument.tradePlaceId}`}
              instrumentId={instrument.instrumentId}
              tradePlaceId={instrument.tradePlaceId}
              instrumentImageName={instrument.instrumentImageName}
              instrumentName={instrument.instrumentName}
              instrumentCode={instrument.instrumentCode}
              tradePlaceShortName={instrument.tradePlaceShortName}
              dataLine={instrument.quoteHistory}
              price={instrument.lastPrice}
              currencyCode={instrument.priceCurrency}
              periodPriceDiff={instrument.priceDiffCurr}
              periodPriceDiffPcnt={instrument.priceDiffPcnt}
              hasDeleteButton
              groupIdToDelete={Number.parseInt(groupId)}
              onRefetch={handleRefetch}
            />
          ))
        )}
      </>
    );
  };

  const navigateToFavotiteGroups = () => navigate(ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS);

  const openAddInstrumentsBottomSheet = () => setAddInstrumentsBottomSheetOpen(true);

  const closeMenuBottomSheet = () => setMenuBottomSheetOpen(false);
  const closeSortBottomSheet = () => setSortBottomSheetOpen(false);
  const closeCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet = () =>
    setCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen(false);
  const closeAddInstrumentsBottomSheet = () => setAddInstrumentsBottomSheetOpen(false);

  return (
    <div
      ref={setContainerRef}
      className={cx(
        styles.container,
        sortedLocalInstruments.length ? styles.containerWithInstruments : styles.containerEmpty,
      )}
    >
      <HeaderPage
        size="small"
        leftIconVariant="back"
        title={name}
        subtitle={instrumentCountSubtitle}
        addonRight={<MoreSvg onClick={() => setMenuBottomSheetOpen(true)} />}
        className={styles.header}
        onLeftIconClick={navigateToFavotiteGroups}
      />

      <div style={selectedSortType === SORT_BY_LIST && containerStyle ? containerStyle : undefined}>
        {getContent()}

        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          iconLeft={<PlusCircleSvg color={palette.colorForeground} />}
          className={cx(styles.button, { [styles.buttonDesktop]: !isMobile })}
          onClick={openAddInstrumentsBottomSheet}
        >
          Добавить бумагу
        </Button>
      </div>

      <BottomSheet open={isMenuBottomSheetOpen} onDismiss={closeMenuBottomSheet}>
        <MenuBottomSheet
          onAddInstrument={() => {
            closeMenuBottomSheet();
            openAddInstrumentsBottomSheet();
          }}
          onEditGroup={() => {
            closeMenuBottomSheet();
            setCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen(true);
          }}
          onDeleteGroup={() => {
            closeMenuBottomSheet();
            setConfirmOpen(true);
          }}
        />
      </BottomSheet>

      <BottomSheet open={isSortBottomSheetOpen} onDismiss={closeSortBottomSheet}>
        <SortBottomSheet
          selectedSortType={selectedSortType}
          setSelectedSortType={setSelectedSortType}
          onClose={closeSortBottomSheet}
        />
      </BottomSheet>

      <CreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet
        isOpen={isCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheetOpen}
        groupId={Number.parseInt(groupId)}
        groupTitle={title}
        groupName={name}
        onCreateOrEditGroup={() => {
          closeCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet();
          refetchFavoriteGroup();
        }}
        onClose={closeCreateOrEditFavoriteGroupBottomSheet}
      />

      <AddInstrumentsBottomSheet
        isOpen={isAddInstrumentsBottomSheetOpen}
        createdGroupId={Number.parseInt(groupId)}
        groupInstruments={formattedSortedLocalInstruments}
        onFinish={() => {
          closeAddInstrumentsBottomSheet();
          handleRefetch();
        }}
        onDismiss={closeAddInstrumentsBottomSheet}
      />

      <Confirm
        open={isConfirmOpen}
        title="Вы действительно хотите удалить бумагу?"
        confirmBtnText="Удалить"
        onCancel={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={async () => {
          await deleteFavoriteGroup({ group_Id: groupId });
          createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text: 'Группа удалена' });
          navigateToFavotiteGroups();
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(GroupDetail);

import { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import {
  INSTRUMENT_CARD_ANIMATION_DURATION,
  MIN_PRICE_RECORDED_CHANGES,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/consts';

import { InstrumentCard as InstrumentCardComponent } from 'components/Instrument';
import { IInstrumentCardProps } from 'components/Instrument/components/InstrumentCard';

import styles from './InstrumentCard.module.pcss';

const InstrumentCard: FC<IInstrumentCardProps> = (props) => {
  const { price } = props;

  const [className, setClassName] = useState('');
  const [prevPrice, setPrevPrice] = useState(price);

  useEffect(() => {
    const priceDiff = price - prevPrice;
    const isChanged = Math.abs(priceDiff) >= MIN_PRICE_RECORDED_CHANGES;
    const newClassName = isChanged ? (priceDiff > 0 ? styles.priceUp : styles.priceDown) : '';

    if (isChanged) {
      setClassName(newClassName);
      setPrevPrice(price);
      setTimeout(() => setClassName(''), INSTRUMENT_CARD_ANIMATION_DURATION);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [price]);

  return <InstrumentCardComponent {...props} className={className} />;
};

export default memo(InstrumentCard);

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Draggable } from 'react-beautiful-dnd';

import cx from 'classnames';

import {
  INSTRUMENT_CARD_ANIMATION_DURATION,
  MIN_PRICE_RECORDED_CHANGES,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/consts';

import { SwipeableInstrumentCard } from 'components/Instrument';
import { IInstrumentCardProps } from 'components/Instrument/components/InstrumentCard';

import { ReactComponent as GroupSvg } from 'images/icons/group.svg';

import styles from './InstrumentCardDragDrop.module.pcss';

type InstrumentCardDragDropProps = IInstrumentCardProps & {
  index: number;
  indexNumber: number;
  hasDeleteButton?: boolean;
  groupIdToDelete?: number;
  onRefetch: () => void;
};

export const InstrumentCardDragDrop = (props: InstrumentCardDragDropProps) => {
  const { price, indexNumber, index, tradePlaceId, instrumentId } = props;

  const [className, setClassName] = useState<string>();
  const [prevPrice, setPrevPrice] = useState<number>(price);

  useEffect(() => {
    const priceDiff = price - prevPrice;
    const isChanged = Math.abs(priceDiff) >= MIN_PRICE_RECORDED_CHANGES;
    const newClassName = isChanged ? (priceDiff > 0 ? styles.priceUp : styles.priceDown) : '';
    if (isChanged) {
      setClassName(newClassName);
      setPrevPrice(price);
      setTimeout(() => setClassName(''), INSTRUMENT_CARD_ANIMATION_DURATION);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [price]);

  return (
    <Draggable
      key={`${indexNumber}-${tradePlaceId}-${instrumentId}`}
      draggableId={`${indexNumber}`}
      index={index}
    >
      {(provided, snapshot) => {
        return (
          <div
            ref={provided.innerRef}
            {...provided.draggableProps}
            {...provided.dragHandleProps}
            className={styles.card}
          >
            <SwipeableInstrumentCard
              {...props}
              isDragging={snapshot.isDragging}
              customFavoriteButton={
                <div className={styles.groupIconWrapper}>
                  <GroupSvg />
                </div>
              }
              className={cx(
                styles.price,
                snapshot.isDragging && styles.priceDrag,
                className?.length && className,
              )}
            />
          </div>
        );
      }}
    </Draggable>
  );
};

import { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import {
  SORT_BY_DOWN,
  SORT_BY_LIST,
  SORT_BY_NAME,
  SORT_BY_UP,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/consts';
import { SortType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/types';

import { SelectableCell } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as MyListSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/sorting/myList.svg';
import { ReactComponent as PricesSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/sorting/prices.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SquircleArrowDownSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/sorting/squircle-arrow-down.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SquircleArrowUpSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/sorting/squircle-arrow-up.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SquircleSortNameSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/catalog/sorting/squircle-sort-name.svg';

import styles from './SortBottomSheet.module.pcss';
import { INITIAL_SORT_LIST } from './store';
import { FormatSortListType, ISortBottomSheet } from './types';

const formatSortList = ({ setSortList, oldSortType, newSortType }: FormatSortListType) => {
  setSortList((prev) =>
    prev.map(({ sortType, ...other }) => {
      if (sortType === oldSortType) {
        return { ...other, sortType: newSortType };
      }

      return { ...other, sortType };
    }),
  );
};

const getAddonBefore = (sortType: SortType) => {
  switch (sortType) {
    case SORT_BY_LIST:
      return <MyListSvg />;
    case SORT_BY_UP:
    case SORT_BY_DOWN:
      return <PricesSvg />;
    case SORT_BY_NAME:
      return <SquircleSortNameSvg />;
  }
};

const SortBottomSheet: FC<ISortBottomSheet> = ({
  selectedSortType,
  setSelectedSortType,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [localSelectedSortType, setLocalSelectedSortType] = useState(selectedSortType);
  const [sortList, setSortList] = useState(INITIAL_SORT_LIST);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedSortType === SORT_BY_DOWN) {
      formatSortList({ setSortList, oldSortType: SORT_BY_UP, newSortType: SORT_BY_DOWN });
    }
  }, [selectedSortType]);

  const content = sortList.map(({ sortType, title }) => {
    const isSortByListOrName = sortType === SORT_BY_LIST || sortType === SORT_BY_NAME;

    const getSubtitle = () => {
      if (isSortByListOrName) {
        return;
      }

      if (sortType === SORT_BY_DOWN) {
        return 'По убыванию';
      }

      return 'По возрастанию';
    };

    const getCustomAddonAfter = () => {
      if (isSortByListOrName) {
        return;
      }

      if (localSelectedSortType === SORT_BY_UP) {
        return <SquircleArrowUpSvg />;
      }

      if (localSelectedSortType === SORT_BY_DOWN) {
        return <SquircleArrowDownSvg />;
      }
    };

    const handleClick = () => {
      if (
        isSortByListOrName ||
        (localSelectedSortType !== SORT_BY_UP && localSelectedSortType !== SORT_BY_DOWN)
      ) {
        setLocalSelectedSortType(sortType);
      } else if (localSelectedSortType === SORT_BY_UP) {
        setLocalSelectedSortType(SORT_BY_DOWN);
        formatSortList({ setSortList, oldSortType: SORT_BY_UP, newSortType: SORT_BY_DOWN });
      } else {
        setLocalSelectedSortType(SORT_BY_UP);
        formatSortList({ setSortList, oldSortType: SORT_BY_DOWN, newSortType: SORT_BY_UP });
      }
    };

    return (
      <SelectableCell
        key={sortType}
        variant={isSortByListOrName ? 'indicator' : 'custom'}
        separator={false}
        checked={isSortByListOrName ? sortType === localSelectedSortType : false}
        subtitle={getSubtitle()}
        addonBefore={getAddonBefore(sortType)}
        customAddonAfter={getCustomAddonAfter()}
        className={styles.sortCell}
        onClick={handleClick}
      >
        {title}
      </SelectableCell>
    );
  });

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.sort}>
        Сортировка
      </Text>

      {content}

      <Button
        className={styles.button}
        onClick={() => {
          setSelectedSortType(localSelectedSortType);
          onClose();
        }}
      >
        Применить
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(SortBottomSheet);

import { SortContentType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/types';

export const INSTRUMENT_CARD_ANIMATION_DURATION = 250; //ms

import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { DragDropContext, DropResult, Droppable } from 'react-beautiful-dnd';

import { BottomSheet, Filter, FilterBar } from '@aurora/components';
import update from 'immutability-helper';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';

import { useGetFavoriteQuery, useUpdateMyFavoriteListMutation } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { getTradeSessionByTradePlaceId } from 'core/tradeSession';

import Error from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/Error/Error';
import FavoriteEmptyPlug from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/FavoriteEmptyPlug/FavoriteEmptyPlug';
import { InstrumentCardDragDrop } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/InstrumentCardDragDrop/InstrumentCardDragDrop';
import Skeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/Skeleton/Skeleton';
import SortBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/components/SortBottomSheet';
import { ItemDragTypes, sortContent } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/consts';
import { GroupType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/types';
import {
  getGroupFilters,
  instrumentFilter,
  instrumentsSort,
  somethingWentWrong,
  subscribeFavoriteInstrumentsChanged,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/utils';
import { DEFAULT_FAVORITES_FILTERS } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { useCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/hooks';
import { CatalogFiltersType } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { SwipeableInstrumentCard } from 'components/Instrument';

import { ReactComponent as GroupSvg } from 'images/icons/group.svg';
import { ReactComponent as DownSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/favorites/down.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ListSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/favorites/list.svg';
import { ReactComponent as UpSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/favorites/up.svg';
import { ReactComponent as WordSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/favorites/word.svg';

import { ParsedFavoriteInstrument } from 'types/catalog';

import styles from './Favorite.module.pcss';
import { SORT_BY_DOWN, SORT_BY_LIST, SORT_BY_UP } from './consts';
import { SortType } from './types';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/pagination';

const Favorites = () => {
  const { data, isLoading, isError, refetch } = useGetFavoriteQuery({
    sessionType: getTradeSessionByTradePlaceId(3)?.sessionType,
    showQuoteHistory: true,
    datePart: 'week',
    quoteHistoryDays: 180,
  });

  const [updatePositionInstrument] = useUpdateMyFavoriteListMutation();
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState<GroupType[] | null>(null);

  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useCatalogFilters();
  const favoritesFilters = allFilters.favorites;

  const [isBottomSheetOpen, setIsBottomSheetOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  //стейт списка инструментов
  const [preparedData, setPreparedData] = useState<ParsedFavoriteInstrument[] | null>(null);

  //доп стейт списка инструментов для сохранения списка при фильтрации, в первую очередь для сортировки по моему списку
  const [dataFilters, setDataFilters] = useState<ParsedFavoriteInstrument[] | null>(null);

  const [wrapperSize, setWrapperSize] = useState<React.CSSProperties>();

  const setupWrapperSize = useCallback((node: HTMLDivElement) => {
    if (node) {
      setWrapperSize({
        height: node.clientHeight,
        width: node.clientWidth,
      });
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data) {
      return;
    }

    setPreparedData((prevInstruments) => {
      const prevNumIndexes = prevInstruments?.map((el) => el.indexNumber);

      const res = instrumentFilter(
        instrumentsSort(data, favoritesFilters.sort.orderBy),
        favoritesFilters.filter.groupCode,
      );

      setDataFilters(data);

      if (prevInstruments && prevNumIndexes) {
        return [...res].sort(
          (a, b) => prevNumIndexes.indexOf(a.indexNumber) - prevNumIndexes.indexOf(b.indexNumber),
        );
      }
      return res;
    });
  }, [data, favoritesFilters.filter.groupCode, favoritesFilters.sort.orderBy]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data) {
      return;
    }

    dataFilters &&
      favoritesFilters &&
      setPreparedData(
        instrumentFilter(
          instrumentsSort(dataFilters, favoritesFilters.sort.orderBy),
          favoritesFilters.filter.groupCode,
        ),
      );
  }, [data, dataFilters, favoritesFilters]);

  const moveCard = (result: DropResult) => {
    if (!preparedData || !result.destination) return;

    const {
      destination: { index: dragIndex },
      source: { index: hoverIndex },
    } = result;

    const draggableInstrument = preparedData.find((el, i) => i === hoverIndex);

    setPreparedData((prevInstruments) => {
      if (!prevInstruments) return null;

      return update(prevInstruments, {
        $splice: [
          [hoverIndex, 1],
          [dragIndex, 0, prevInstruments[hoverIndex]],
        ],
      });
    });

    setDataFilters((prevInstruments) => {
      if (!prevInstruments) return null;

      return update(prevInstruments, {
        $splice: [
          [hoverIndex, 1],
          [dragIndex, 0, prevInstruments[hoverIndex]],
        ],
      });
    });

    if (draggableInstrument) {
      const { instrumentId, tradePlaceId } = draggableInstrument;

      updatePositionInstrument({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, newIndexNumber: dragIndex })
        .unwrap()
        .catch(() => somethingWentWrong());
    } else {
      somethingWentWrong();
    }
  };

  const titleIcon =
    (favoritesFilters.sort.name === 'Мой список' && <ListSvg />) ||
    (favoritesFilters.sort.name === 'Изменение за сегодня' &&
      favoritesFilters.sort.orderBy === 'SORT_BY_UP' && <UpSvg />) ||
    (favoritesFilters.sort.name === 'Изменение за сегодня' &&
      favoritesFilters.sort.orderBy === 'SORT_BY_DOWN' && <DownSvg />) ||
    (favoritesFilters.sort.name === 'По названию' && <WordSvg />);

  const updateFilters = (updatedFilters: CatalogFiltersType) => {
    setAllFilters(updatedFilters);
  };

  const handleFilterCardClick = (filter: GroupType) => () => {
    updateFilters({ ...allFilters, favorites: { sort: favoritesFilters.sort, filter } });
  };

  const handleBottomSheetOpen = () => {
    setIsBottomSheetOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOrderByChange = (orderBy: SortType) => {
    const sortItem = sortContent.find((f) => f.orderBy === orderBy);

    if (sortItem) {
      updateFilters({
        ...allFilters,
        favorites: { filter: favoritesFilters.filter, sort: sortItem },
      });
    }

    setIsBottomSheetOpen(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && data) {
      setGroups(getGroupFilters(data));
    }
  }, [data, isLoading]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!favoritesFilters) {
      updateFilters({ ...allFilters, favorites: DEFAULT_FAVORITES_FILTERS });
    }

    const unsubscribe = subscribeFavoriteInstrumentsChanged(() => refetch());

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!preparedData?.length && !!data?.length) {
      updateFilters({ ...allFilters, favorites: DEFAULT_FAVORITES_FILTERS });
    }
  }, [allFilters, data?.length, preparedData?.length]);

  if (isError) {
    return <Error />;
  }

  if (isLoading || !groups) {
    return <Skeleton />;
  }

  if (!data?.length) {
    return <FavoriteEmptyPlug />;
  }

  const closeBottomSheet = () => setIsBottomSheetOpen(false);

  return (
    <div ref={setupWrapperSize} className={styles.wrapper}>
      <div {...(favoritesFilters.sort.orderBy === 'SORT_BY_LIST' && { style: wrapperSize })}>
        <FilterBar className={styles.filterWrapper}>
          <Swiper
            slidesPerView="auto"
            spaceBetween={8}
            className={styles.swiper}
            touchMoveStopPropagation
            touchStartPreventDefault
            preventClicksPropagation
          >
            <SwiperSlide className={styles.slide}>
              <Filter
                text={
                  <div className={styles.filter}>
                    {titleIcon}
                    {favoritesFilters.sort.name}
                  </div>
                }
                onClick={handleBottomSheetOpen}
              />
            </SwiperSlide>

            {groups.map((group) => (
              <SwiperSlide key={group.groupCode} className={styles.slide}>
                <Filter
                  shape={'toggle'}
                  text={group.groupName}
                  onClick={handleFilterCardClick(group)}
                  active={group.groupCode === favoritesFilters.filter.groupCode}
                />
              </SwiperSlide>
            ))}
          </Swiper>
        </FilterBar>
        {favoritesFilters.sort.orderBy === 'SORT_BY_LIST' ? (
          <DragDropContext onDragEnd={moveCard}>
            <Droppable droppableId={ItemDragTypes.FAVORITE_CARD}>
              {(provided) => (
                <div {...provided.droppableProps} ref={provided.innerRef}>
                  {preparedData?.map((el, index) => (
                    <InstrumentCardDragDrop
                      key={index}
                      currencyCode={el.priceCurrency}
                      dataLine={el.quoteHistory}
                      hasDeleteButton
                      hasInvestIdea={el.hasInvestIdea}
                      hasPriceThreshold={el.hasPriceThreshold}
                      hasStopOrder={el.hasStopOrder}
                      index={index}
                      indexNumber={el.indexNumber}
                      instrumentCode={el.instrumentCode}
                      instrumentId={el.instrumentId}
                      instrumentImageName={el.instrumentImageName}
                      instrumentImageTime={el.instrumentImageTime}
                      instrumentName={el.instrumentName}
                      onRefetch={refetch}
                      periodPriceDiff={el.priceDiffCurr}
                      periodPriceDiffPcnt={el.priceDiffPcnt}
                      price={el.lastPrice}
                      tradePlaceId={el.tradePlaceId}
                      tradePlaceShortName=""
                      type={el.instrumentGroupCode}
                    />
                  ))}

                  {provided.placeholder}
                </div>
              )}
            </Droppable>
          </DragDropContext>
        ) : (
          <div className={styles.container}>
            {preparedData?.map((el, index) => (
              <SwipeableInstrumentCard
                key={index}
                currencyCode={el.priceCurrency}
                dataLine={el.quoteHistory}
                hasDeleteButton
                hasInvestIdea={el.hasInvestIdea}
                hasPriceThreshold={el.hasPriceThreshold}
                hasStopOrder={el.hasStopOrder}
                instrumentCode={el.instrumentCode}
                instrumentId={el.instrumentId}
                instrumentImageName={el.instrumentImageName}
                instrumentImageTime={el.instrumentImageTime}
                instrumentName={el.instrumentName}
                periodPriceDiff={el.priceDiffCurr}
                periodPriceDiffPcnt={el.priceDiffPcnt}
                price={el.lastPrice}
                tradePlaceId={el.tradePlaceId}
                tradePlaceShortName=""
                type={el.instrumentGroupCode}
                customFavoriteButton={
                  <div className={styles.groupIconWrapper}>
                    <GroupSvg />
                  </div>
                }
                onRefetch={refetch}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className={styles.margin} />
      </div>

      <BottomSheet open={isBottomSheetOpen} onDismiss={closeBottomSheet}>
        <SortBottomSheet
          selectedSortType={favoritesFilters.sort.orderBy}
          setSelectedSortType={handleOrderByChange}
          onClose={closeBottomSheet}
        />
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(Favorites);

import { GroupCode } from 'types/catalog';

import { SORT_BY_DOWN, SORT_BY_LIST, SORT_BY_NAME, SORT_BY_UP } from './consts';

export type GroupType = {
  groupCode: GroupCode | 'all';
  groupName: string;
};

export type SortType =
  | typeof SORT_BY_LIST
  | typeof SORT_BY_UP
  | typeof SORT_BY_DOWN
  | typeof SORT_BY_NAME;

export type SortContentType = {
  name: string;
  orderBy: SortType;
};


--- FILE: src\modules\Catalog\components\Favorites\utils.ts ---

import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { GroupType, SortType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/types';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

import { GroupCode, ParsedFavoriteInstrument } from 'types/catalog';

export const instrumentsSort = (instruments: ParsedFavoriteInstrument[], orderBy: SortType) => {
  const copy = [...instruments];
  switch (orderBy) {
    case 'SORT_BY_NAME':
      return copy.sort((a, b) => a.instrumentName.localeCompare(b.instrumentName));
    case 'SORT_BY_DOWN':
      return copy.sort((a, b) => {
        if (!b.priceDiffPcnt && !a.priceDiffPcnt) {
          return 0;
        }
        if (!b.priceDiffPcnt) {
          return -1;
        }
        if (!a.priceDiffPcnt) {
          return 1;
        }
        return b.priceDiffPcnt - a.priceDiffPcnt;
      });
    case 'SORT_BY_UP':
      return copy.sort((a, b) => {
        if (!b.priceDiffPcnt && !a.priceDiffPcnt) {
          return 0;
        }
        if (!b.priceDiffPcnt) {
          return -1;
        }
        if (!a.priceDiffPcnt) {
          return 1;
        }
        return a.priceDiffPcnt - b.priceDiffPcnt;
      });
    default:
      return instruments;
  }
};

export const instrumentFilter = (
  instruments: ParsedFavoriteInstrument[],
  groupCode: GroupCode | 'all',
) => {
  if (groupCode === 'all') {
    return instruments;
  }
  return instruments.filter((f) => f.instrumentGroupCode === groupCode);
};

export const getGroupFilters = (instruments: ParsedFavoriteInstrument[]): GroupType[] => {
  const groups: GroupType[] = [
    { groupCode: 'SHARES', groupName: 'Акции' },
    { groupCode: 'BONDS', groupName: 'Облигации' },
    { groupCode: 'CURRENCIES', groupName: 'Валюты' },
    { groupCode: 'FUTURES', groupName: 'Фьючерсы' },
    { groupCode: 'OPTIONS', groupName: 'Опционы' },
    // { groupCode: 'METALS', groupName: 'Драгметаллы' },
    { groupCode: 'OTHER', groupName: 'Фонды и прочее' },
    { groupCode: 'STRUCTURE', groupName: 'Структурные продукты' },
    { groupCode: 'UKF', groupName: 'Паевые фонды' },
    { groupCode: 'UKS', groupName: 'Стратегии' },
  ];

  const allowedGroups: GroupCode[] = [
    'SHARES',
    'BONDS',
    'CURRENCIES',
    'FUTURES',
    'OPTIONS',
    // 'METALS',
    'OTHER',
  ];

  const availableGroups = new Set();
  const result: GroupType[] = [{ groupCode: 'all', groupName: 'Все' }];
  for (const instrument of instruments) {
    if (allowedGroups.includes(instrument.instrumentGroupCode)) {
      availableGroups.add(instrument.instrumentGroupCode);
    }
  }
  result.push(...groups.filter((f) => availableGroups.has(f.groupCode)));
  return result;
};

export const subscribeFavoriteInstrumentsChanged = (onFavoriteInstrumentsChanged: () => void) => {
  const listener = () => {
    onFavoriteInstrumentsChanged();
  };
  return Notifications.subscribe('FavoriteInstrumentsChanged', listener);
};

export const somethingWentWrong = () =>
  createAlertNotification({
    text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
    status: 'error',
  });

} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Favorites/__tests__/fixture';

  instrumentFilter,

import { FC, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { ReactComponent as SvgChecked } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import styles from './IndustriesBottomSheet.module.pcss';
import { BUTTON_VALUE, BUTTON_VALUE_RESET, FIRST_ITEM, TITLE_DEFAULT } from './store';
import { IIndustriesBottomSheetProps, TDictionariesList } from './types';

const IndustriesBottomSheet: FC<IIndustriesBottomSheetProps> = ({
  currentIndustry,
  dictionariesList,
  dynamicHeight,
  firstItemListName = FIRST_ITEM,
  isDefaultItem,
  isResetButton,
  onConfirm,
  open,
  setOpen,
  title = TITLE_DEFAULT,
}) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLLabelElement[]>([]);
  const [selectedIndustry, setSelectedIndustry] = useState<string | null>(currentIndustry);

  const isNotEmptyList = !!dictionariesList.length;
  const isBond = isNotEmptyList && typeof dictionariesList[0].code === 'object';

  const preparedList: TDictionariesList = useMemo(() => {
    if (isDefaultItem) {
      return [
        {
          id: 0,
          code: isBond ? { daysBeforeMaturityMin: 0 } : '',
          name: firstItemListName,
        },
      ].concat(dictionariesList);
    }

    return dictionariesList;
  }, [dictionariesList, firstItemListName, isBond, isDefaultItem]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedIndustry(currentIndustry);
  }, [currentIndustry]);

  const snapPoints = useCallback(
    ({ minHeight, maxHeight }) => {
      if (!isNotEmptyList || dynamicHeight) {
        return [minHeight, maxHeight];
      }

      const newMinHeight = maxHeight * 0.8;

      return [newMinHeight, maxHeight];
    },
    [dynamicHeight, isNotEmptyList],
  );

  const onDismiss = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);

    setSelectedIndustry(currentIndustry);
  }, [currentIndustry, setOpen]);

  const handleChange = useCallback((event) => {
    setSelectedIndustry(event.currentTarget.value);
  }, []);

  const onTouchMove = useCallback((event) => event.stopPropagation(), []);

  const onClickButton = useCallback(
    () => onConfirm(selectedIndustry),
    [onConfirm, selectedIndustry],
  );

  const onClickReset = useCallback(() => setSelectedIndustry(null), []);

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      className={styles.wrapper}
      expandOnContentDrag={false}
      initialFocusRef={false}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onTouchMove={onTouchMove}
      open={open}
      snapPoints={snapPoints}
    >
      <div className={styles.list}>
        <div className={styles.listHeader}>
          <Text type="subtitleBold">{title}</Text>

          {isResetButton && (
            <Button
              className={styles.button}
              onClick={onClickReset}
              proportion="mobileSE"
              shape="text"
              size="s"
              variant="negative"
            >
              {BUTTON_VALUE_RESET}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.listBody}>
          {preparedList.map(({ id, name, code }, index) => {
            const value =
              typeof code === 'object'
                ? `${code.daysBeforeMaturityMin}${
                    code.daysBeforeMaturityMax ? `_${code.daysBeforeMaturityMax}` : ''
                  }`
                : code;

            return (
              <div key={index} className={styles.listItem}>
                <input
                  checked={selectedIndustry === value}
                  className={styles.hide}
                  id={`${id}`}
                  name={name}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  type="radio"
                  value={value}
                />

                <label ref={(el) => el && (ref.current[id] = el)} htmlFor={`${id}`}>
                  <Text type="lineRegular">{name}</Text>
                </label>

                <div className={styles.listChecked}>
                  {selectedIndustry === value && <SvgChecked />}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.listFooter}>
          <Button className={styles.button} onClick={onClickButton}>
            {BUTTON_VALUE}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(IndustriesBottomSheet);

import { FC, memo, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_IPO_DETAILS } from 'const/routes';

import { ColorStylesType } from 'utils/colors';

import IpoIcon from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/components/IpoIcon/IpoIcon';
import { IpoCardProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/types';
import {
  getApplicationReceiptDate,
  getCouponRate,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/utils';

import styles from './IpoCard.module.pcss';

const IpoCard: FC<IpoCardProps> = ({
  beginDate,
  conditionalCouponRate,
  couponRate,
  couponValue,
  endDate,
  id,
  indicativeCouponText,
  indicativeYieldText,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  instrumentGroupName,
  instrumentImageName,
  instrumentName,
  name,
  placingCanceled,
  isMarket,
  bondTypeCode,
  participationRate,
  participationRateName,
  conditionalCouponRateName,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [colorStyles, setColorStyles] = useState<ColorStylesType | null>(null);

  const couponRateState = useMemo(
    () =>
      getCouponRate({
        conditionalCouponRate,
        couponRate,
        couponValue,
        indicativeCouponText,
        indicativeYieldText,
        instrumentCategoryCode,
        isMarket,
        bondTypeCode,
        participationRate,
        participationRateName,
        conditionalCouponRateName,
      }),
    [
      conditionalCouponRate,
      couponRate,
      couponValue,
      indicativeCouponText,
      indicativeYieldText,
      instrumentCategoryCode,
      isMarket,
      bondTypeCode,
      participationRate,
      participationRateName,
      conditionalCouponRateName,
    ],
  );

  const applicationReceiptDateState = useMemo(
    () => getApplicationReceiptDate(beginDate, endDate, placingCanceled),
    [beginDate, endDate, placingCanceled],
  );

  const handleStylesChange = (styles: ColorStylesType) => setColorStyles(styles);

  const handleCardClick = () => navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_IPO_DETAILS, { id: String(id) }));

  return (
    <div className={styles.card} onClick={handleCardClick}>
      <div className={styles.head} style={colorStyles ? colorStyles : undefined}>
        <div className={styles.icon}>
          <IpoIcon
            instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
            onColorStylesChange={handleStylesChange}
          />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.info}>
          <Text type="lineSemiBold" color="colorBackground2" className={styles.instrumentName}>
            {name || instrumentName}
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorBackground2">
            {instrumentGroupName}
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.content}>
        {couponRateState && (
          <div className={styles.contentItem}>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.oneLineText}>
              {couponRateState.value}
            </Text>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.oneLineText}>
              {couponRateState.name}
            </Text>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className={styles.contentItem}>
          <Text type="bodySemiBold">{applicationReceiptDateState.value}</Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {applicationReceiptDateState.name}
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(IpoCard);

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useSessionStorage } from 'react-use';

import { getColorStyles } from 'utils/colors';

import styles from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/components/IpoIcon/IpoIcon.module.pcss';
import { BASE_ICON_URL, CACHE_PREFIX } from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/consts';
import {
  ExtractedMainImgColorsCache,
  IpoIconProps,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/types';

import placeHolder from 'images/icons/fi_placeholder.png';

const IpoIcon = ({ instrumentImageName, onColorStylesChange }: IpoIconProps) => {
  const [error, setError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [colorsCache, setColorsCache] = useSessionStorage<ExtractedMainImgColorsCache>(
    CACHE_PREFIX,
    {},
  );

  const onLoad = (event: React.SyntheticEvent<HTMLImageElement, Event>) => {
    if (error) return;
    if (colorsCache[instrumentImageName]) {
      onColorStylesChange && onColorStylesChange(colorsCache[instrumentImageName]);
    } else {
      const colorStyles = getColorStyles(event.currentTarget);
      colorStyles && setColorsCache({ ...colorsCache, [instrumentImageName]: colorStyles });
      colorStyles && onColorStylesChange && onColorStylesChange(colorStyles);
    }
  };

  return (
    <img
      alt="Финансовый инструмент"
      crossOrigin="anonymous"
      src={
        error ? placeHolder : `https://s3n.investpalata.ru${BASE_ICON_URL + instrumentImageName}`
      }
      className={styles.img}
      onLoad={onLoad}
      onError={() => setError(true)}
    />
  );
};

export default IpoIcon;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';
import { Link, generatePath } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_IPO } from 'const/routes';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';

import { useGetIpoListQuery } from 'core/api/ipo';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import IpoCard from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/components/IpoCard/IpoCard';
import IpoCardsSkeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/components/IpoCardsSkeleton/IpoCardsSkeleton';

import styles from './IpoCards.module.pcss';

const IpoCards: FC = () => {
  const personIpoTradPermission = Permissions.get('PERSON_IPOTRADE');
  const { data, isLoading } = useGetIpoListQuery(
    { isBond: true },
    { skip: personIpoTradPermission === 'BLOCKED' || personIpoTradPermission === 'DENIED' },
  );

  if (isLoading) return <IpoCardsSkeleton />;

  if (
    !data ||
    data.ipOs.length === 0 ||
    personIpoTradPermission === 'BLOCKED' ||
    personIpoTradPermission === 'DENIED'
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const { ipOs } = data;

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.titleSection}>
        <div className={styles.title}>
          <Text type="bodySemiBold">Размещение облигаций</Text>
        </div>

        {ipOs.length > 6 && (
          <Link to={generatePath(ROUTE_IPO, { type: 'bonds' })} className={styles.allButton}>
            <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              Все
            </Text>
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>

      <Swiper
        autoHeight
        className={styles.swiper}
        preventClicksPropagation
        slidesPerView="auto"
        spaceBetween={8}
        touchMoveStopPropagation
        touchStartPreventDefault
      >
        {ipOs.slice(0, 6).map((ipo, index) => (
          <SwiperSlide key={index} className={styles.slide}>
            <IpoCard {...ipo} />
          </SwiperSlide>
        ))}
      </Swiper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(IpoCards);

import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { getNoun } from 'utils/string';
import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getBondPlacementType } from '../Pages/IPODetails/helpers';
import { IpoCardProps } from './types';

export const getCouponRate = ({
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  conditionalCouponRate,
  couponRate,
  couponValue,
  indicativeCouponText,
  indicativeYieldText,
  isMarket,
  bondTypeCode,
  participationRate,
  participationRateName,
  conditionalCouponRateName,
}: Pick<
  IpoCardProps,
  | 'conditionalCouponRate'
  | 'couponRate'
  | 'couponValue'
  | 'indicativeCouponText'
  | 'indicativeYieldText'
  | 'instrumentCategoryCode'
  | 'isMarket'
  | 'bondTypeCode'
  | 'participationRate'
  | 'participationRateName'
  | 'conditionalCouponRateName'
>) => {
  const placement = getBondPlacementType(instrumentCategoryCode);

  if (placement === 'bird') {
    if (isMarket && bondTypeCode === 'WITHPART') {
      return {
        name: participationRateName,
        value: participationRate ? sumFormatter(participationRate) + '%' : '-',
      };
    }

    return {
      name: conditionalCouponRateName,
      value: conditionalCouponRate ? sumFormatter(conditionalCouponRate) + '%' : '-',
    };
  }

  if (placement === 'otc' && !indicativeCouponText && !indicativeYieldText) {
    const sumValue = isMarket ? couponRate : couponValue;

    return {
      name: 'Ставка купона',
      value: sumValue ? sumFormatter(sumValue, null, 2) + '%' : '-',
    };
  }

  if (placement === 'otc' && indicativeCouponText) {
    return { name: 'Ориентир купона', value: indicativeCouponText };
  }

  if (placement === 'otc' && indicativeYieldText) {
    return { name: 'Ориентир доходности', value: indicativeYieldText };
  }

  return null;
};

export const getApplicationReceiptDate = (
  beginDate: string,
  endDate: string,
  placingCanceled: boolean,
) => {
  if (placingCanceled)
    return {
      name: 'Дата окончания приёма заявок',
      value: 'Отменено',
    };

  const now = DateTime.now();
  const parsedBeginDate = DateTime.fromISO(beginDate);
  const parsedEndDate = DateTime.fromISO(endDate);

  const formattedDate = (date: DateTime) => {
    const diff = date.diff(now, ['days', 'hours', 'minutes']);
    if (diff.days > 7) {
      return date.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
    }
    if (diff.days <= 7 && diff.days > 1) {
      return `Осталось ${diff.days} ${getNoun(diff.days, 'день', 'дня', 'дней')}`;
    }

    if (diff.days === 1) {
      return `Остался 1 день`;
    }

    if (diff.days < 1 && diff.hours >= 1) {
      return `Осталось ${diff.hours} ${getNoun(diff.hours, 'час', 'часа', 'часов')}`;
    }
    return `Осталось ${Math.floor(diff.minutes)} ${getNoun(
      Math.floor(diff.minutes),
      'минута',
      'минуты',
      'минут',
    )}`;
  };

  if (parsedBeginDate.startOf('day') > now.startOf('day')) {
    return {
      name: 'Дата начала приёма заявок',
      value: formattedDate(parsedBeginDate),
    };
  }
  if (
    parsedBeginDate.startOf('day') <= now.startOf('day') &&
    parsedEndDate.toMillis() > now.toMillis()
  ) {
    return {
      name: 'Дата окончания приёма заявок',
      value: formattedDate(parsedEndDate),
    };
  }
  return {
    name: 'Дата окончания приёма заявок',
    value: 'Завершено',
  };
};

    onSort,
    onSortIndustries,
    bottomSheetState,
    handleCloseBottomSheet,
    handleReadyListsChange,
    updatePagination,
    title,
  } = useEvents({
    allFilters,
    pageType,
    selectedFilterText,
    setPageType,
    updateFilters,
  });

  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  const bondsFiltersSorting = allFilters.bonds.sorting;
  const isActual = allFilters.actual.bonds;

  const instrumentsCard = instrumentsList.map((instrument, index) => (
    <SwipeableInstrumentCard
      key={index}
      {...instrument}
      price={'price' in instrument ? instrument?.price : instrument?.lastPrice}
      currencyCode={instrument.priceCurrency}
      favorite={instrument.isFavorite}
      onRefetch={handleRefetch}
      type="BONDS"
      yieldSum={instrument.yield}
      periodPriceDiff={undefined}
      periodPriceDiffPcnt={undefined}
      {...(index === 0 && { style: { paddingTop: 0 } })}
    />
  ));

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderFilter filters={filters} />

      <EmptyContentCheck error={isError} content={instrumentsList}>
        {!isActual && (
          <ListWithPagination
            type="BONDS"
            requestResultLength={instrumentShowcaseBonds.length}
            isFetching={isFetching}
            updatePagination={updatePagination}
          >
            {instrumentsCard}
          </ListWithPagination>
        )}
        {isActual && <>{instrumentsCard}</>}
      </EmptyContentCheck>

      <SortBottomSheet
        currentSortPrice={bondsFiltersSorting}
        list={BONDS_SORT_LIST}
        onConfirm={onSort}
        open={bottomSheetState === 'sort'}
        setOpen={handleCloseBottomSheet}
      />

      <IndustriesBottomSheet
        currentIndustry={currentIndustry}
        dictionariesList={dictionariesList}
        dynamicHeight
        isResetButton={isReset}
        onConfirm={onSortIndustries}
        open={bottomSheetState === 'industries'}
        setOpen={handleCloseBottomSheet}
        title={title}
      />

      <ReadyListsBottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetState === 'readyLists'}
        options={READY_LISTS_OPTIONS}
        selected={isActual ? 'actual' : 'all'}
        onClose={handleCloseBottomSheet}
        onCommit={handleReadyListsChange}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(Bonds);

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

import { useLazyGetBondsQuery, useLazyGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import {
  BONDS_LIST_DATES_FILTER,
  VALUE_FILTER_MATURITY,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Bonds/store';
import { TStateType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Bonds/types';
import {
  CATALOG_FILTERS,
  DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_FAVORITES_ACTUAL_BONDS_FILTERS,
} from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { useCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/hooks';
import { CatalogFiltersType } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { ShowcaseBonds, ShowcaseInstrument } from 'types/catalog';

const useBonds = () => {
  const location = useLocation();

  const { stateParams = CATALOG_FILTERS.bonds.category } = (location?.state || {}) as TStateType;

  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useCatalogFilters();
  const [instrumentsList, setInstrumentsList] = useState<(ShowcaseBonds | ShowcaseInstrument)[]>(
    [],
  );
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [pageType, setPageType] = useState(stateParams);

  const bondsFilters = allFilters.bonds;

  const [
    fetchBonds,
    {
      data: { instrumentShowcaseBonds = [] } = {},
      isFetching: isBondsFetching,
      isError: isBondsError,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetBondsQuery();

  const [
    fetchShowcaseFavorites,
    { isFetching: isShowcaseInstrumentFetching, isError: isShowcaseInstrumentError },
  ] = useLazyGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery();

  const selectedFilterText =
    BONDS_LIST_DATES_FILTER.find(
      ({ code }) => code.daysBeforeMaturityMin === Number(bondsFilters.daysBeforeMaturityMin),
    )?.name || VALUE_FILTER_MATURITY;

  const updateFilters = useCallback(
    ({
      updatedFilters,
      saveState,
      noLoading,
    }: {
      updatedFilters: CatalogFiltersType;
      saveState?: boolean;
      noLoading?: boolean;
    }) => {
      const {
        bonds,
        actual: { bonds: isActual },
      } = updatedFilters;
      setAllFilters(updatedFilters);

      if (!saveState && !noLoading) setIsLoading(true);

      if (isActual) {
        fetchShowcaseFavorites(DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_FAVORITES_ACTUAL_BONDS_FILTERS)
          .then((res) => {
            if (!res.data) setInstrumentsList([]);
            else if (saveState)
              setInstrumentsList(instrumentsList.concat(res.data.showcaseInstrument));
            else setInstrumentsList(res.data.showcaseInstrument);
            setIsLoading(false);
          })
          .catch((err) => console.error(err));
      } else {
        fetchBonds(bonds)
          .then(({ data }) => {
            setInstrumentsList(
              !data
                ? []
                : saveState
                ? instrumentsList.concat(data.instrumentShowcaseBonds)
                : data.instrumentShowcaseBonds,
            );

            setIsLoading(false);
          })
          .catch((err) => console.error(err));
      }
    },
    [fetchBonds, instrumentsList],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const { actualBond } = getSession() || {};

    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        bonds: {
          ...bondsFilters,
          rowsOffset: 0,
          category: pageType,
        },
        actual: {
          ...allFilters.actual,
          ...(actualBond ? { bonds: allFilters.actual.bonds } : { bonds: false }),
        },
      },
    });
  }, [pageType]);

  return {
    allFilters,
    instrumentShowcaseBonds,
    instrumentsList,
    isError: isBondsError || isShowcaseInstrumentError,
    isFetching: isBondsFetching || isShowcaseInstrumentFetching,
    isLoading,
    pageType,
    selectedFilterText,
    setPageType,
    updateFilters,
  };
};

export default useBonds;

import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { FilterShape, IFilterProps } from '@aurora/components';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { TDictionariesList } from 'modules/Catalog/components/IndustriesBottomSheet/types';
import { getReadyListFilterTitle } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Bonds/helpers';
import { BottomSheetStateType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Bonds/types';
import { ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { TBondsSortingType, TCategoryType } from 'types/catalog';

import {
  BONDS_LIST_CATEGORIES_FILTER,
  BONDS_LIST_DATES_FILTER,
  SORT_CATEGORY,
  SORT_CONTENT,
  VALUE_FILTER_MATURITY,
} from '../store';

const useEvents = ({
  allFilters,
  selectedFilterText,
  setPageType,
  updateFilters,
  pageType,
}: any) => {
  const [currentIndustry, setCurrentIndustry] = useState('');
  const [dictionariesList, setDictionariesList] =
    useState<TDictionariesList>(BONDS_LIST_DATES_FILTER);
  const [isReset, setIsReset] = useState(false);
  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<BottomSheetStateType | null>(null);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');

  const bondsFilters = allFilters.bonds;
  const bondsFiltersSorting = bondsFilters.sorting;

  const isActual = allFilters.actual.bonds;

  const bondSortFilter = bondsFiltersSorting.slice(0, -1);
  const sortText = bondsFiltersSorting.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию';
  const filterText =
    bondSortFilter === 'PRICE' ? 'Цены' : bondSortFilter === 'MATURITY' ? 'Срока' : 'Доходности';

  const handleCloseBottomSheet = useCallback(() => {
    setBottomSheetState(null);
  }, []);

  const onCloseDateFilter = useCallback(() => {
    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        bonds: {
          ...bondsFilters,
          daysBeforeMaturityMin: 0,
          daysBeforeMaturityMax: undefined,
        },
      },
    });
  }, [allFilters, bondsFilters, updateFilters]);

  const onSort = useCallback(
    (order) => {
      const isOrderGrowth = order.includes('+');
      const newSortingItem = `${isOrderGrowth ? order : `${order}-`}` as TBondsSortingType;

      if (newSortingItem !== bondsFiltersSorting) {
        updateFilters({
          updatedFilters: {
            ...allFilters,
            bonds: { ...bondsFilters, sorting: newSortingItem, rowsOffset: 0 },
          },
        });

        reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.sortingTap, {
          category_type: 'bonds',
          sorts: `${sortText} / ${filterText}`,
        });
      }

      handleCloseBottomSheet();
    },
    [allFilters, bondsFilters, bondsFiltersSorting, filterText, sortText, updateFilters],
  );

  const onSortIndustries = useCallback(
    (codes: string | null) => {
      const isDates =
        codes &&
        (/_/.test(codes) || (!Number.isNaN(Number.parseFloat(codes)) && Number.isFinite(+codes)));

      const arrayOfCodes = (isDates && codes?.split('_')) || null;

      const updatedFilters = {
        ...allFilters,
        bonds: {
          ...bondsFilters,
          rowsOffset: 0,
          ...(isDates && {
            daysBeforeMaturityMin: arrayOfCodes?.[0],
            daysBeforeMaturityMax: arrayOfCodes?.[1],
          }),
          ...(!isDates &&
            codes && {
              category: codes as TCategoryType,
            }),
          ...(!codes && {
            daysBeforeMaturityMin: 0,
            daysBeforeMaturityMax: undefined,
          }),
        },
      };

      reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.filtersTap, {
        category_type: 'bonds',
        filters: selectedFilterText,
      });

      updateFilters({ updatedFilters });

      handleCloseBottomSheet();

      !isDates && codes && setPageType(codes as TCategoryType);
    },
    [allFilters, bondsFilters, selectedFilterText, setPageType, updateFilters],
  );

  const updatePagination = useCallback(() => {
    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        bonds: {
          ...bondsFilters,
          rowsOffset: bondsFilters.rowsOffset + pageType === 'EBN' ? 20 : 50,
        },
      },
      saveState: true,
    });
  }, [allFilters, bondsFilters, pageType, updateFilters]);

  const handleSort = useCallback(
    () => setBottomSheetState('sort'),
    [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState],
  );

  const handleSelect = useCallback(() => {
    setDictionariesList(BONDS_LIST_DATES_FILTER);
    setIsReset(true);
    setBottomSheetState('industries');
    setCurrentIndustry(
      `${bondsFilters.daysBeforeMaturityMin}${
        bondsFilters.daysBeforeMaturityMax ? `_${bondsFilters.daysBeforeMaturityMax}` : ''
      }`,
    );
    setTitle(VALUE_FILTER_MATURITY);
  }, [bondsFilters.daysBeforeMaturityMax, bondsFilters.daysBeforeMaturityMin]);

  const handleRefetch = useCallback(
    () => updateFilters({ updatedFilters: allFilters, noLoading: true }),
    [allFilters, updateFilters],
  );

  const handleSelectCategory = useCallback(() => {
    setDictionariesList(BONDS_LIST_CATEGORIES_FILTER);
    setIsReset(false);
    setBottomSheetState('industries');
    setCurrentIndustry(pageType);
    setTitle('Тип');
  }, [pageType]);

  const handleClearAllFilters = useCallback(() => {
    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        bonds: {
          ...bondsFilters,
          daysBeforeMaturityMin: 0,
          daysBeforeMaturityMax: undefined,
        },
        actual: { ...allFilters.actual, bonds: false },
      },
    });
  }, [allFilters, bondsFilters, updateFilters]);

  const handleReadyLists = useCallback(() => setBottomSheetState('readyLists'), []);

  const handleReadyListsChange = useCallback(
    (value: string) => {
      updateFilters({
        updatedFilters: {
          ...allFilters,
          actual: {
            ...allFilters.actual,
            bonds: value === 'actual',
          },
        },
      });
    },
    [updateFilters],
  );
  const onCloseReadyListFilters = useCallback(() => {
    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        actual: {
          ...allFilters.actual,
          bonds: false,
        },
      },
    });
  }, [updateFilters]);

  const filters = useMemo(() => {
    const active = selectedFilterText !== VALUE_FILTER_MATURITY || isActual;
    const { actualBond } = getSession() || {};
    return [
      active && {
        onClick: handleClearAllFilters,
        shape: 'reset' as FilterShape,
      },
      actualBond && {
        active: isActual,
        onClick: handleReadyLists,
        onClose: onCloseReadyListFilters,
        shape: 'select' as FilterShape,
        text: getReadyListFilterTitle(isActual),
      },
      {
        onClick: !isActual ? handleSort : undefined,
        shape: 'sort',
        sortDirection: bondsFiltersSorting.includes('-') || isActual ? 'down' : 'up',
        text: isActual ? 'Сортировка' : SORT_CONTENT[bondsFiltersSorting.replace(/[+-]$/g, '')],
        disabled: isActual,
      },
      {
        onClick: !isActual ? handleSelectCategory : undefined,
        shape: 'select',
        text: SORT_CATEGORY[pageType],
        disabled: isActual,
      },
      {
        active: !isActual ? selectedFilterText !== VALUE_FILTER_MATURITY : false,
        onClick: !isActual ? handleSelect : undefined,
        onClose: !isActual ? onCloseDateFilter : undefined,
        shape: 'select',
        text: isActual ? VALUE_FILTER_MATURITY : selectedFilterText,
        disabled: isActual,
      },
    ].filter(Boolean) as IFilterProps[];
  }, [
    bondsFiltersSorting,
    handleSelect,
    handleSelectCategory,
    handleSort,
    onCloseDateFilter,
    pageType,
    selectedFilterText,
  ]);

  return {
    currentIndustry,
    dictionariesList,
    filters,
    handleRefetch,
    isReset,
    onSort,
    onSortIndustries,
    bottomSheetState,
    handleCloseBottomSheet,
    handleReadyListsChange,
    updatePagination,
    title,
  };
};

export default useEvents;

import { FC, memo, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { BottomSheet, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_CATEGORY_INFO } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { getCategorizationIcon } from 'core/categorization';

import { palette } from 'vars';

import { ReactComponent as QuestionOutlineSvg } from 'images/icons/question-outline.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SaveIconSvg } from 'images/icons/save-icon.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SmallArrowRightSvg } from 'images/icons/small-arrow-right.svg';

import { CATEGORIZATION_HINT_TEXT, CATEGORIZATION_TIME_TO_CHECK_DEFAULT_TEXT } from './consts';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { CategorizationBottomSheetProps } from './types';

const CategorizationBottomSheet: FC<CategorizationBottomSheetProps> = ({
  data,
  isIpo = false,
  setHasBottomSheetShown,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const categorizationHintText = useMemo(
    () => hints?.hints.find((item) => item.slug === 'CATEGORIZATION')?.text,
    [hints?.hints],
  );
  const timeToCheckHintText = useMemo(
    () =>
      hints?.hints.find((item) => item.slug === 'CATEGORIZATION_TIME_TO_CHECK')?.text ??
      CATEGORIZATION_TIME_TO_CHECK_DEFAULT_TEXT,
    [hints?.hints],
  );

  const handleCategoryClick = (code: string, passed: boolean) => {
    if (passed) return;

    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_CATEGORY_INFO, { category: code }));
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheet open onDismiss={() => setHasBottomSheetShown(true)}>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.header}>
          <Text type="subtitleSemiBold">Пройдите тестирование</Text>
          {categorizationHintText && <QuestionOutlineSvg onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)} />}
        </div>
        <Text type="bodyRegular">
          {isIpo
            ? 'Для участия в данном размещении необходимо пройти тест'
            : 'Чтобы иметь возможность торговать данным инструментом, необходимо пройти тест'}
        </Text>
        <ul className={styles.list}>
          {data.map(({ name, code, passed }) => {
            const Icon = getCategorizationIcon(code);

            return (
              <li
                key={code}
                className={styles.item}
                onClick={() => handleCategoryClick(code, passed)}
              >
                <div className={styles.wrapper}>
                  <div
                    className={cn(styles.iconWrapper, passed ? styles.blueIcon : styles.orangeIcon)}
                  >
                    <Icon />
                  </div>
                  <div className={styles.content}>
                    <Text type="bodyRegular">{name}</Text>
                    <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                      {passed ? 'Пройдено' : 'Не пройдено'}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {!passed && <SmallArrowRightSvg color={palette.colorForeground4} />}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
        {timeToCheckHintText && (
          <div className={styles.timeBlock}>
            <SaveIconSvg />
            <Text type="lineRegular">{timeToCheckHintText}</Text>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <BottomSheet open={isOpen} onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text>{CATEGORIZATION_HINT_TEXT}</Text>
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(CategorizationBottomSheet);

import { memo, useCallback } from 'react';

import HeaderFilter from 'modules/Catalog/components/HeaderFilter';
import EmptyContentCheck from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/EmptyContentCheck';
import ListWithPagination from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/ListWithPagination';
import Skeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Skeleton';
import SortBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet';
import { CURRENCY_SORT_LIST } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import { SwipeableInstrumentCard } from 'components/Instrument';

import { useEventsCurrency, useQueryCurrency } from './hooks';

const Currency = () => {
  const {
    allFilters,
    currencyFilters,
    currencyFiltersSorting,
    fetchCurrency,
    instrumentList,
    instrumentsList,
    isError,
    isFetching,
    isLoading,
    openBottomSheet,
    setOpenBottomSheet,
    updateFilters,
  } = useQueryCurrency();

  const { filters, onSort, updatePagination } = useEventsCurrency({
    allFilters,
    currencyFilters,
    currencyFiltersSorting,
    setOpenBottomSheet,
    updateFilters,
  });

  const isPeriodDay = currencyFiltersSorting?.startsWith('PRICE_1_DAY');

  const onRefetch = useCallback(
    () => fetchCurrency(allFilters.currency),
    [allFilters.currency, fetchCurrency],
  );

  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderFilter filters={filters} />

      <EmptyContentCheck error={isError} content={instrumentsList}>
        <ListWithPagination
          isFetching={isFetching}
          requestResultLength={instrumentList.length}
          type="CURRENCIES"
          updatePagination={updatePagination}
        >
          {instrumentList?.map((instrument, index) => (
            <SwipeableInstrumentCard
              key={index}
              {...instrument}
              favorite={instrument.isFavorite}
              onRefetch={onRefetch}
              price={instrument.lastPrice}
              {...(isPeriodDay || !currencyFiltersSorting
                ? {
                    periodPriceDiff: instrument.dailyPriceDiff,
                    periodPriceDiffPcnt: instrument.dailyPriceDiffPcnt,
                  }
                : {})}
            />
          ))}
        </ListWithPagination>
      </EmptyContentCheck>

      <SortBottomSheet
        currentSortPrice={currencyFiltersSorting}
        isResetButton
        list={CURRENCY_SORT_LIST}
        onConfirm={onSort}
        open={openBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setOpenBottomSheet}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(Currency);

import { SORTING_GROUP_MD } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import { SortingType } from 'types/catalog';

const textPeriod = (sortParam: SortingType): string =>
  SORTING_GROUP_MD.reduce(
    (acc, value) => ({ ...acc, [value]: /DAY/.test(value) ? 'За сегодня' : 'За полгода' }),
    [],
  )[sortParam as never];

export const sortContent = (sortParam?: SortingType): string => {
  if (!sortParam) return 'Сортировка';

  return `${sortParam.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию'} • ${textPeriod(sortParam)}`;
};

import { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react';

import { CatalogFiltersType } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { SortingType } from 'types/catalog';

export type FiltersType = (
  updatedFilters: CatalogFiltersType,
  saveState?: boolean,
  eventGoal?: boolean,
) => void;

export interface IUseEventsCurrency {
  allFilters: CatalogFiltersType;
  currencyFilters: CatalogFiltersType['currency'];
  currencyFiltersSorting?: SortingType;
  setOpenBottomSheet: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  updateFilters: FiltersType;
}


--- FILE: src\modules\Catalog\components\Pages\Currency\hooks\useEventsCurrency.tsx ---

import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';

import { FilterShape, IFilterProps } from '@aurora/components';

import { SortingType } from 'types/catalog';

import { sortContent } from '../helpers';
import { IUseEventsCurrency } from './types';

const useEventsCurrency = ({
  allFilters,
  currencyFilters,
  currencyFiltersSorting,
  setOpenBottomSheet,
  updateFilters,
}: IUseEventsCurrency) => {
  const onSort = useCallback(
    (order, name) => {
      const sorting =
        (order && (`${name}${order === 'PRICE' ? '-' : '+'}` as SortingType)) || undefined;

      if (sorting !== currencyFiltersSorting) {
        updateFilters(
          {
            ...allFilters,
            currency: {
              ...currencyFilters,
              sorting,
              rowsOffset: 0,
            },
          },
          false,
          true,
        );
      }

      setOpenBottomSheet(false);
    },
    [allFilters, currencyFilters, currencyFiltersSorting, setOpenBottomSheet, updateFilters],
  );

  const handleSort = useCallback(() => setOpenBottomSheet((prev) => !prev), [setOpenBottomSheet]);

  const updatePagination = useCallback(
    () =>
      updateFilters(
        {
          ...allFilters,
          currency: {
            ...currencyFilters,
            rowsOffset: currencyFilters.rowsOffset + 20,
          },
        },
        true,
      ),
    [allFilters, currencyFilters, updateFilters],
  );

  const handleClearAllFilters = useCallback(
    () =>
      updateFilters(
        {
          ...allFilters,
          currency: {
            ...currencyFilters,
            sorting: undefined,
            rowsOffset: 0,
          },
        },
        false,
        true,
      ),
    [allFilters, currencyFilters, updateFilters],
  );

  const filters = useMemo(
    () =>
      [
        currencyFiltersSorting && {
          onClick: handleClearAllFilters,
          shape: 'reset' as FilterShape,
        },
        {
          onClick: handleSort,
          shape: 'sort',
          sortDirection: currencyFiltersSorting?.includes('+') ? 'up' : 'down',
          text: sortContent(currencyFiltersSorting),
        },
      ].filter(Boolean) as IFilterProps[],
    [currencyFiltersSorting, handleSort],
  );

  return {
    onSort,
    updatePagination,
    filters,
  };
};

export default useEventsCurrency;
