import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useLazyGetCurrenciesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { useCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/hooks';
import { ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { ShowcaseCurrencies } from 'types/catalog';

import { FiltersType } from './types';

const useQueryCurrency = () => {
  const [openBottomSheet, setOpenBottomSheet] = useState(false);

  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useCatalogFilters();

  const currencyFilters = allFilters.currency;
  const currencyFiltersSorting = currencyFilters.sorting;

  const [instrumentsList, setInstrumentsList] = useState<ShowcaseCurrencies[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const [
    fetchCurrency,
    { data: { currencyPairList: instrumentList = [] } = {}, isFetching, isError },
  ] = useLazyGetCurrenciesQuery();

  const updateFilters = useCallback<FiltersType>(
    (updatedFilters, saveState, eventGoal) => {
      const { currency } = updatedFilters;
      const sorting = currency?.sorting;

      eventGoal &&
        reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.sortingTap, {
          category_type: 'currency',
          ...(sorting && {
            sorts: `${sorting.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию'} / ${
              sorting.slice(0, -1) === 'PRICE_6_MONTHS' ? 'За полгода' : 'За сегодня'
            }`,
          }),
        });

      setAllFilters(updatedFilters);

      if (!saveState) setIsLoading(true);

      fetchCurrency(currency)
        .then(({ data }) => {
          setInstrumentsList(
            !data
              ? []
              : saveState
              ? instrumentsList.concat(data.currencyPairList)
              : data.currencyPairList,
          );

          setIsLoading(false);
        })
        .catch((err) => console.error(err));
    },
    [fetchCurrency, instrumentsList],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    updateFilters(allFilters);
  }, []);

  return {
    allFilters,
    currencyFilters,
    currencyFiltersSorting,
    instrumentList,
    fetchCurrency,
    instrumentsList,
    isError,
    isFetching,
    isLoading,
    setOpenBottomSheet,
    openBottomSheet,
    updateFilters,
  };
};

export default useQueryCurrency;

type Props = {
  content: unknown[];
  error: boolean;
};

const EmptyContentCheck: React.FC<Props> = ({ children, content, error }) => {
  return error || content.length < 1 ? (
    <div className={styles.content}>
      {error ? 'Не удалось загрузить данные' : 'Ничего не найдено. Попробуйте изменить фильтры'}
    </div>
  ) : (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>{children}</div>
  );
};

export default EmptyContentCheck;

import HeaderFilter from 'modules/Catalog/components/HeaderFilter/HeaderFilter';
import { READY_LISTS_OPTIONS } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/ETF/consts';
import useETF from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/ETF/hooks/useETF';
import EmptyContentCheck from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/EmptyContentCheck';
import ListWithPagination from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/ListWithPagination';
import Skeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Skeleton';
import { ReadyListsBottomSheet } from 'modules/Catalog/components/ReadyListsBottomSheet';
import SortBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet';
import { ETF_SORT_LIST } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import { FilterScrollProvider } from 'components';
import { SwipeableInstrumentCard } from 'components/Instrument';

const ETF = () => {
  const {
    bottomSheetState,
    etfFiltersSorting,
    filters,
    handleCloseBottomSheet,
    handleReadyListsChange,
    instrumentsList,
    isActual,
    isLoading,
    isFetching,
    isError,
    onSort,
    onRefetch,
    updatePagination,
  } = useETF();

  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  return (
    <FilterScrollProvider>
      <HeaderFilter filters={filters} />
      <EmptyContentCheck error={isError} content={instrumentsList}>
        <ListWithPagination
          type="FONDS"
          requestResultLength={instrumentsList.length}
          updatePagination={updatePagination}
          isFetching={isFetching}
        >
          {instrumentsList.map((el) => {
            return (
              <SwipeableInstrumentCard
                {...el}
                key={`${el.instrumentId}-${el.tradePlaceId}`}
                price={el.lastPrice}
                favorite={el.isFavorite}
                onRefetch={onRefetch}
                {...(isActual || !etfFiltersSorting
                  ? {
                      periodPriceDiff: el.dailyPriceDiff,
                      periodPriceDiffPcnt: el.dailyPriceDiffPcnt,
                    }
                  : {})}
              />
            );
          })}
        </ListWithPagination>
      </EmptyContentCheck>
      <SortBottomSheet
        currentSortPrice={etfFiltersSorting}
        isResetButton
        list={ETF_SORT_LIST}
        onConfirm={onSort}
        open={bottomSheetState === 'sort'}
        setOpen={handleCloseBottomSheet}
      />
      <ReadyListsBottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetState === 'readyLists'}
        options={READY_LISTS_OPTIONS}
        selected={isActual ? 'actual' : 'all'}
        onClose={handleCloseBottomSheet}
        onCommit={handleReadyListsChange}
      />
    </FilterScrollProvider>
  );
};

export default ETF;

import { FutureSortingType } from 'types/catalog';

export const getFilterCardText = (type?: FutureSortingType | null) => {
  if (!type) return 'Сортировка';
  const filterName = type.slice(0, -1);

  const direction = type.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию';
  const period =
    filterName === 'PRICE_6_MONTHS'
      ? 'За полгода'
      : filterName === 'EXPIRATION'
      ? 'По дате экспирации'
      : 'За сегодня';
  return `${direction} • ${period}`;
};

export const getReadyListFilterTitle = (isActual: boolean) => {
  return isActual ? 'Актуальное' : 'Все фонды';
};

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { FilterShape, IFilterProps } from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyGetETFQuery, useLazyGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import {
  getFilterCardText,
  getReadyListFilterTitle,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/ETF/helpers';
import { DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_FAVORITES_ACTUAL_ETF_FILTERS } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { useCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/hooks';
import { CatalogFiltersType, ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { ShowcaseETF, ShowcaseInstrument, SortingType } from 'types/catalog';

type BottomSheetState = 'sort' | 'readyLists';

const useETF = () => {
  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<BottomSheetState | null>(null);
  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useCatalogFilters();
  const [instrumentsList, setInstrumentsList] = useState<(ShowcaseETF | ShowcaseInstrument)[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const [fetchEtf, { isError: isEtfError, isFetching: isEtfFetching }] = useLazyGetETFQuery();

  const [
    fetchShowcaseFavorites,
    { isFetching: isShowcaseInstrumentFetching, isError: isShowcaseInstrumentError },
  ] = useLazyGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery();

  const etfFilters = allFilters.etf;
  const etfFiltersSorting = etfFilters.sorting;

  const isActual = allFilters.actual.etf;

  const handleCloseBottomSheet = () => setBottomSheetState(null);

  const handleReadyLists = () => setBottomSheetState('readyLists');

  const handleCloseReadyListFilters = () => {
    updateFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      etf: {
        ...allFilters.etf,
        sorting: null,
      },
      actual: { ...allFilters.actual, etf: false },
    });
  };

  const handleClearAllFilters = () => {
    updateFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      etf: {
        ...allFilters.etf,
        sorting: null,
        rowsOffset: 0,
      },
      actual: {
        ...allFilters.actual,
        etf: false,
      },
    });
  };

  const filters = useMemo(() => {
    const { actualEtf } = getSession() || {};
    const active = isActual || Boolean(etfFiltersSorting);
    return [
      active && {
        onClick: handleClearAllFilters,
        shape: 'reset' as FilterShape,
      },
      actualEtf && {
        active: isActual,
        onClick: handleReadyLists,
        onClose: handleCloseReadyListFilters,
        shape: 'select' as FilterShape,
        text: getReadyListFilterTitle(isActual),
      },
      {
        shape: 'sort',
        disabled: isActual,
        text: getFilterCardText(etfFiltersSorting),
        sortDirection: etfFiltersSorting?.includes('+') ? 'up' : 'down',
        onClick: () => !isActual && setBottomSheetState('sort'),
      },
    ].filter(Boolean) as IFilterProps[];
  }, [isActual, etfFiltersSorting]);

  const updateFilters = (
    updatedFilters: CatalogFiltersType,
    saveState?: boolean,
    eventGoal?: boolean,
  ) => {
    const {
      etf,
      actual: { etf: isActual },
    } = updatedFilters;
    const sorting = etf.sorting;

    eventGoal &&
      reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.sortingTap, {
        category_type: 'etf',
        sorts: `${sorting?.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию'} / ${
          sorting?.slice(0, -1) === 'PRICE_6_MONTHS' ? 'За полгода' : 'За сегодня'
        }`,
      });

    setAllFilters(updatedFilters);
    if (!saveState) setIsLoading(true);

    if (isActual) {
      fetchShowcaseFavorites(DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_FAVORITES_ACTUAL_ETF_FILTERS)
        .then((res) => {
          if (!res.data) setInstrumentsList([]);
          else if (saveState)
            setInstrumentsList(instrumentsList.concat(res.data.showcaseInstrument));
          else setInstrumentsList(res.data.showcaseInstrument);
          setIsLoading(false);
        })
        .catch((err) => console.error(err));
    } else {
      fetchEtf(etf)
        .then((res) => {
          if (!res.data) setInstrumentsList([]);
          else if (saveState)
            setInstrumentsList(instrumentsList.concat(res.data.instrumentShowcaseEtf));
          else setInstrumentsList(res.data.instrumentShowcaseEtf);
          setIsLoading(false);
        })
        .catch((err) => console.error(err));
    }
  };

  const updatePagination = () => {
    updateFilters(
      {
        ...allFilters,
        etf: { ...etfFilters, rowsOffset: etfFilters.rowsOffset + 20 },
      },
      true,
    );
  };

  const handleReadyListsChange = (value: string) => {
    updateFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      actual: {
        ...allFilters.actual,
        etf: value === 'actual',
      },
    });
  };

  const onSort = (order?: string, name?: string) => {
    const newSortingItem =
      (order && (`${name}${order === 'PRICE' ? '-' : '+'}` as SortingType)) || null;

    if (newSortingItem !== etfFiltersSorting) {
      updateFilters(
        {
          ...allFilters,
          etf: { ...etfFilters, sorting: newSortingItem, rowsOffset: 0 },
        },
        false,
        true,
      );
    }
    handleCloseBottomSheet();
  };

  const onRefetch = () => fetchEtf(etfFilters);

  useEffect(() => {
    const { actualEtf } = getSession() || {};
    updateFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      actual: {
        ...allFilters.actual,
        ...(!actualEtf ? { etf: false } : { etf: allFilters.actual.etf }),
      },
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  return {
    etfFiltersSorting,
    isActual,
    filters,
    instrumentsList,
    isLoading,
    isError: isEtfError || isShowcaseInstrumentError,
    isFetching: isEtfFetching || isShowcaseInstrumentFetching,
    onSort,
    onRefetch,
    handleCloseBottomSheet,
    handleReadyListsChange,
    bottomSheetState,
    updatePagination,
  };
};

export default useETF;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Filter, FilterBar } from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyGetFuturesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import EmptyContentCheck from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/EmptyContentCheck';
import ListWithPagination from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/ListWithPagination';
import Skeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Skeleton';
import SortBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet';
import { FUTURES_SORT_LIST } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { TextFilterWithSorting } from 'modules/Catalog/helpers';
import { useCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/hooks';
import { CatalogFiltersType, ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { SwipeableInstrumentCard } from 'components/Instrument';

import { ShowcaseFutures, SortingType } from 'types/catalog';

const Futures = () => {
  const [sortBottomSheet, setSortBottomSheet] = useState(false);

  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useCatalogFilters();
  const futuresFilters = allFilters.futures;
  const futuresFiltersSorting = futuresFilters.sorting;

  const [instrumentsList, setInstrumentsList] = useState<ShowcaseFutures[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const [fetchFutures, { data: { instrumentShowcaseFutures = [] } = {}, isError, isFetching }] =
    useLazyGetFuturesQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    updateFilters(allFilters);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const updateFilters = (
    updatedFilters: CatalogFiltersType,
    saveState?: boolean,
    eventGoal?: boolean,
  ) => {
    const { futures } = updatedFilters;
    const sorting = futures.sorting;

    eventGoal &&
      reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.sortingTap, {
        category_type: 'futures',
        sorts: `${sorting?.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию'} / ${
          sorting?.slice(0, -1) === 'PRICE_6_MONTHS'
            ? 'Изменения цены за полгода'
            : sorting?.slice(0, -1) === 'EXPIRATION'
            ? 'По дате экспирации'
            : 'Изменения цены за сегодня'
        }`,
      });

    setAllFilters(updatedFilters);
    if (!saveState) setIsLoading(true);
    fetchFutures(futures)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!res.data) setInstrumentsList([]);
        else if (saveState)
          setInstrumentsList(instrumentsList.concat(res.data.instrumentShowcaseFutures));
        else setInstrumentsList(res.data.instrumentShowcaseFutures);
        setIsLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((err) => console.error(err));
  };

  const onSort = (order: string) => {
    const isOrderGrowth = order.includes('+');
    const newSortingItem = `${isOrderGrowth ? order : `${order}-`}` as SortingType;

    if (newSortingItem !== futuresFiltersSorting) {
      updateFilters(
        {
          ...allFilters,
          futures: { ...futuresFilters, sorting: newSortingItem, rowsOffset: 0 },
        },
        false,
        true,
      );
    }
    setSortBottomSheet(false);
  };

  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  return (
    <>
      <FilterBar>
        <Filter
          shape="sort"
          //@ts-ignore
          //временная мера, пока не выгрузят обновленный кит
          text={<TextFilterWithSorting text={futuresFiltersSorting} additionalText />}
          sortDirection={futuresFiltersSorting?.includes('-') ? 'down' : 'up'}
          onClick={() => setSortBottomSheet(!sortBottomSheet)}
        />
      </FilterBar>
      <EmptyContentCheck error={isError} content={instrumentsList}>
        <ListWithPagination
          type="FUTURES"
          requestResultLength={instrumentShowcaseFutures.length}
          updatePagination={() =>
            updateFilters(
              {
                ...allFilters,
                futures: { ...futuresFilters, rowsOffset: futuresFilters.rowsOffset + 50 },
              },
              true,
            )
          }
          isFetching={isFetching}
        >
          {instrumentShowcaseFutures.map((el) => {
            return (
              <SwipeableInstrumentCard
                {...el}
                key={`${el.instrumentId}-${el.tradePlaceId}`}
                favorite={el.isFavorite}
                currencyCode={el.priceCurrency}
                type="FUTURES"
                price={el.lastPrice}
                periodPriceDiff={el.priceDiff}
                periodPriceDiffPcnt={el.priceDiffPcnt}
                additionalBlockText="Дата экспирации"
                onRefetch={() => fetchFutures(allFilters.futures)}
              />
            );
          })}
        </ListWithPagination>
      </EmptyContentCheck>
      <SortBottomSheet
        list={FUTURES_SORT_LIST}
        currentSortPrice={futuresFiltersSorting}
        onConfirm={onSort}
        open={sortBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setSortBottomSheet}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default Futures;

import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { useGetIpoListQuery } from 'core/api/ipo';

import IpoEquityCard from 'modules/Catalog/components/EquityIpoCards/components/IpoCard';
import IpoBondCard from 'modules/Catalog/components/IpoCards/components/IpoCard/IpoCard';
import ErrorPlug from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPO/components/ErrorPlug/ErrorPlug';
import IpoSkeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPO/components/IpoSkeleton/IpoSkeleton';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import styles from './IPO.module.pcss';

const IPO = () => {
  const { type } = useParams();

  const isBond = type === 'bonds';
  const title = `Размещение ${isBond ? 'облигаций' : 'акций'}`;

  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useGetIpoListQuery(
    isBond ? { isBond: true } : { isEquity: true },
  );

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleBackButtonClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  if (isLoading)
    return (
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <HeaderPage
          title={title}
          leftIconVariant={'back'}
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackButtonClick}
        />
        <IpoSkeleton />
      </div>
    );

  if (isError)
    return (
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <HeaderPage
          title={title}
          leftIconVariant={'back'}
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackButtonClick}
        />
        <ErrorPlug />
      </div>
    );

  if (!data || data.ipOs.length === 0) return null;
  const { ipOs } = data;

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <HeaderPage title={title} leftIconVariant={'back'} onLeftIconClick={handleBackButtonClick} />
      {ipOs.map((ipo, index) => (
        <div key={index} className={styles.card}>
          {isBond ? <IpoBondCard {...ipo} /> : <IpoEquityCard {...ipo} />}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default IPO;

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { RangeField, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { getNoun } from 'utils/string';
import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import Row from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/components/Row/Row';
import Section from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/components/Section/Section';
import {
  getCirculationPeriod,
  getCouponPeriod,
  range,
  validateCalcParams,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/helpers';
import { CalculatorProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/types';

import { DynamicHint } from 'components';

import styles from './Calculator.module.pcss';

const Calculator = ({
  placement,
  minimumAmount,
  nominal,
  conditionalCouponRate,
  couponPeriod,
  maturityDate,
  placingDate,
}: CalculatorProps) => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<number>(minimumAmount ?? 0);

  const circulationPeriod = getCirculationPeriod(maturityDate, placingDate);
  const circulationPeriodRounded = Math.round(circulationPeriod * 10) / 10;
  // S∙CR∙T  / 100
  const CP = couponPeriod / 365;
  const fullPayment = Math.floor((value * conditionalCouponRate * circulationPeriod) / 100);
  // fullPayment / (T / CP)
  const oneTimePayment = Math.floor((fullPayment * CP) / circulationPeriodRounded);

  const isValid = useMemo(
    () =>
      validateCalcParams({
        minimumAmount,
        nominal,
        conditionalCouponRate,
        couponPeriod,
        maturityDate,
        placingDate,
      }),
    [minimumAmount, nominal, conditionalCouponRate, couponPeriod, maturityDate, placingDate],
  );
  if (placement !== 'bird' || !isValid) return null;

  const MIN = minimumAmount ?? 0;
  const MAX = 50_000_000;
  const STEP = 500_000;

  return (
    <Section title={'Калькулятор потенциальной доходности'}>
      <div className={styles.sliderContainer}>
        <div className={styles.params}>
          <RangeField
            showLabels
            labelType="text"
            fieldLeftTitle={
              <Text color="colorForeground2" type="lineRegular" tag={'span'}>
                Сумма инвестирования
              </Text>
            }
            fieldRightTitle={
              <Text type="bodySemiBold" tag={'span'}>
                {sumFormatter(value, 0)} {currencySign('RUB')}
              </Text>
            }
            farLeftLabel={
              <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                {`от ${minimumAmount} ${currencySign('RUB')}`}
              </Text>
            }
            farRightLabel={
              <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>{`до 50 000 000 ${currencySign(
                'RUB',
              )}`}</Text>
            }
            rangeOptions={{
              min: MIN,
              max: MAX,
              steps: [...range(MIN, MAX, STEP)],
              onChange: (_: number[], [value]: number[]) => setValue(value),
              values: [value],
            }}
            wrapperClassName={styles.rangeField}
          />
          <Row
            name={'Купонный период'}
            value={getCouponPeriod(couponPeriod)}
            slug={'STB_COUPON_PERIOD'}
          />
          <Row
            name={'Период обращения'}
            value={`${String(circulationPeriodRounded).replace('.', ',')} ${getNoun(
              circulationPeriodRounded,
              'год',
              'года',
              'лет',
            )}`}
            slug={'STB_COUPON_PERIOD'}
          />
        </div>

        <div className={styles.result}>
          <div className={styles.resultSection}>
            <div className={styles.resultRow}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'} className={styles.resultName}>
                Купонный доход за весь период
              </Text>
              <DynamicHint hideOnScroll slug={'STB_TOTAL_COUPON_AMOUNT'} />
            </div>
            <Text type={'headline'}>{`${sumFormatter(fullPayment, null, 0)} ${currencySign(
              'RUB',
            )}`}</Text>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.resultSection}>
            <div className={styles.resultRow}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'} className={styles.resultName}>
                Разовая купонная выплата
              </Text>
              <DynamicHint hideOnScroll slug={'STB_ONE_COUPON_AMOUNT'} />
            </div>
            <Text type={'title'}>{`${sumFormatter(oneTimePayment, null, 0)} ${currencySign(
              'RUB',
            )}`}</Text>
          </div>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
            Потенциальная доходность при достижении ценами всех базовых активов барьера выплаты
            купона
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Section>
  );
};

export default Calculator;

import React from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { getApplicationReceiptDate } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/helpers';
import { DateSectionProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/types';

import styles from './DateSection.module.pcss';

const DateSection = ({
  beginDate,
  endDate,
  placingPostponed,
  placingCanceled,
}: DateSectionProps) => {
  const { dateTime, diff } = getApplicationReceiptDate(beginDate, endDate, placingCanceled);
  return (
    <div className={cn(styles.container, !diff && styles.canceled)}>
      {placingPostponed && <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Размещение перенесено</Text>}
      <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{dateTime}</Text>
      {diff && (
        <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          {diff}
        </Text>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DateSection;

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { useIntersection } from 'react-use';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { getSystemParameterValueByName } from 'core/systemParameters/systemParameters';

import Badge from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/components/Badge/Badge';
import ParticipateButton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/components/ParticipateButton/ParticipateButton';
import { HeadProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/types';

import styles from './Head.module.pcss';

const Head = ({
  name,
  instrumentName,
  bondTypeCode,
  instrumentCategoryName,
  headerImagePath,
  beginDate,
  endDate,
  placingCanceled,
  mainBtnDisabled,
  onButtonIntersectionChange,
  onButtonClick,
}: HeadProps) => {
  const basePath = getSystemParameterValueByName('S3.IPO.HeaderImagePath');

  const threshold = useMemo(() => [1, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0], []);

  const firstParticipateButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const firstParticipateButtonIntersection = useIntersection(firstParticipateButtonRef, {
    root: null,
    rootMargin: '0px',
    threshold,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    onButtonIntersectionChange(firstParticipateButtonIntersection);
  }, [firstParticipateButtonIntersection, onButtonIntersectionChange]);
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.head}
      style={
        {
          '--background-img-url':
            basePath && headerImagePath ? `url(${basePath + headerImagePath})` : undefined,
        } as React.CSSProperties
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.badgeSection}>
        <Badge color={'attention'} variant={'filled'} className={styles.badge}>
          Первичное размещение
        </Badge>
        {bondTypeCode && (
          <Badge color={'other'} variant={'filled'} className={styles.badge}>
            {bondTypeCode === 'COUPON' ? 'Купонная' : 'С участием'}
          </Badge>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.titleSection}>
        <Text type={'headline'} color={'colorForegroundSecondary'} className={styles.title}>
          {name || instrumentName}
        </Text>
        <Text type={'lineMedium'} color={'colorForegroundSecondary'} className={styles.title}>
          {instrumentCategoryName}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <ParticipateButton
        disabled={mainBtnDisabled}
        ref={firstParticipateButtonRef}
        beginDate={beginDate}
        endDate={endDate}
        placingCanceled={placingCanceled}
        onClick={onButtonClick}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Head;

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import { Accordion, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import { HowItWordProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/types';
import { getHintText } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';

import styles from './HowItWork.module.pcss';

const HowItWork = ({
  placement,
  barrierRate,
  barrierRateName,
  exerciseBarrierRate,
  exerciseBarrierRateName,
  recallBarrierRate,
  recallBarrierRateName,
  isMarket,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
}: HowItWordProps) => {
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const recallBarrierRateHint = useMemo(
    () => hints?.hints.find((f) => f.slug === 'STB_RECALL_BARIER')?.text,
    [hints],
  );
  const exerciseBarrierRateHint = useMemo(
    () => hints?.hints.find((f) => f.slug === 'STB_PROTECT_BARIER')?.text,
    [hints],
  );
  const barrierRateHint = useMemo(
    () => hints?.hints.find((f) => f.slug === 'STB_CUPON_BARIER')?.text,
    [hints],
  );

  const hintText =
    hints?.hints &&
    getHintText(
      hints?.hints,
      instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB' ? 'STB_PRODUCT_WORK' : 'INB_PRODUCT_WORK',
    );

  if (
    !hints ||
    !(placement === 'bird' && (barrierRate || exerciseBarrierRate || recallBarrierRate))
  )
    return null;

  return (
    <Accordion title={'Как это работает'}>
      {(instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB') &&
        isMarket &&
        hintText && (
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {hintText}
          </Text>
        )}
      {recallBarrierRate && (
        <div className={styles.section}>
          <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
            {recallBarrierRateName ?? 'Барьер отзыва'}
          </Text>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{recallBarrierRateHint}</Text>
        </div>
      )}
      {exerciseBarrierRate && (
        <div className={styles.section}>
          <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
            {exerciseBarrierRateName ?? 'Защитный барьер'}
          </Text>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{exerciseBarrierRateHint}</Text>
        </div>
      )}
      {barrierRate && (
        <div className={styles.section}>
          <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
            {barrierRateName ?? 'Барьер выплаты купона'}
          </Text>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{barrierRateHint}</Text>
        </div>
      )}
    </Accordion>
  );
};

export default HowItWork;

import { FC, memo, useEffect } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyCurrenciesQuery } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getMinimumAmount, getPercentValue, getPlacingDate } from '../../helpers';
import { MainSectionProps } from '../../types';
import MainSectionRow from '../MainSectionRow/MainSectionRow';
import styles from './MainSection.module.pcss';

const MainSection: FC<MainSectionProps> = ({
  commissionFree,
  conditionalCouponRate,
  conditionalCouponRateName,
  couponRate,
  couponValue,
  indicativeCouponText,
  indicativeYieldText,
  minimumAmount,
  nominalCurrencyCode,
  placement,
  placingDate,
  participationRateName,
  participationRate,
  bondTypeCode,
  isMarket,
  dealCurrency,
  priceRangeTo,
  priceCurrency,
}) => {
  const [getCurrency, { data }] = useLazyCurrenciesQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    priceCurrency !== dealCurrency && getCurrency();
  }, [dealCurrency, getCurrency, priceCurrency]);

  const currencyName =
    priceCurrency !== dealCurrency && data?.find((item) => item.code === dealCurrency)?.name;

  return (
    <div>
      {placement === 'bird' ? (
        isMarket && bondTypeCode === 'WITHPART' ? (
          <MainSectionRow
            name={participationRateName}
            value={
              participationRate ? `${sumFormatter(participationRate)} ${currencySign('PRC')}` : '–'
            }
            slug="STB_PARTICIPATION_RATE"
            divider
          />
        ) : (
          <MainSectionRow
            name={
              conditionalCouponRate
                ? conditionalCouponRateName
                  ? conditionalCouponRateName
                  : 'Ставка условного купона'
                : 'Ставка купона'
            }
            value={
              conditionalCouponRate
                ? `${sumFormatter(conditionalCouponRate)} ${currencySign('PRC')}`
                : `${sumFormatter(couponRate)} ${currencySign('PRC')}`
            }
            slug="STB_COUPON_RATE"
            divider
          />
        )
      ) : null}

      {placement === 'otc' && !(indicativeCouponText || indicativeYieldText) && (
        <MainSectionRow
          name="Ставка купона"
          value={getPercentValue(isMarket ? couponRate : couponValue)}
          slug="STB_COUPON_RATE"
          divider
        />
      )}

      {placement === 'otc' && indicativeCouponText && (
        <MainSectionRow
          name="Ориентир купона"
          value={indicativeCouponText}
          slug="STB_INDICATIVE_COUPON_TEXT"
          divider
        />
      )}

      {placement === 'otc' && indicativeYieldText && (
        <MainSectionRow
          name="Ориентир доходности"
          value={indicativeYieldText}
          slug="STB_INDICATIVE_YIELD_TEXT"
          divider
        />
      )}

      {placement === 'other' && priceRangeTo && priceCurrency && (
        <MainSectionRow
          name="Ориентир цены"
          value={`${priceRangeTo} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`}
          slug="IPO_RRICE_RANGE"
          divider
        />
      )}

      {placement === 'other' && currencyName && (
        <MainSectionRow
          name="Валюта участия"
          value={currencyName}
          slug="IPO_DEAL_CURRENCY"
          divider
        />
      )}

      {minimumAmount != null && (
        <MainSectionRow
          name="Сумма инвестирования"
          value={`от ${getMinimumAmount(minimumAmount, nominalCurrencyCode ?? dealCurrency)}`}
          divider
        />
      )}

      <MainSectionRow
        name="Дата размещения"
        value={getPlacingDate(placingDate)}
        slug="STB_INDICATIVE_YIELD_TEXT"
      />

      {commissionFree && (
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <div className={styles.info}>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground">
              Комиссия за размещение не взымается, только за сделку согласно тарифу.
            </Text>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(MainSection);

        </Text>
      </div>
      <div>
        <Text type={'title'}>{value}</Text>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MainSectionRow;

import { forwardRef } from 'react';

import { Button } from '@aurora/components';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { ParticipateButtonProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/types';

const ParticipateButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ParticipateButtonProps>(
  ({ beginDate, endDate, placingCanceled, onClick, disabled }, ref) => {
    const personIpoTradCreatePermission = Permissions.get('PERSON_IPOTRADE_CREATE');

    const now = DateTime.now();

    const parsedBeginDate = DateTime.fromISO(beginDate);
    const parsedEndDate = DateTime.fromISO(endDate);

    const hidden = placingCanceled || (parsedBeginDate < now && parsedEndDate < now) || !endDate;

    const isDisabled =
      parsedBeginDate > now ||
      personIpoTradCreatePermission === 'BLOCKED' ||
      personIpoTradCreatePermission === 'DENIED' ||
      disabled;

    if (hidden) return null;

    return (
      <Button ref={ref} disabled={isDisabled} onClick={onClick}>
        Участвовать
      </Button>
    );
  },
);

ParticipateButton.displayName = 'ParticipateButton';

export default ParticipateButton;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { formatProfit, numberToLocaleFormat } from '@um/helpers';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import {
  getBarrierValue,
  getCouponPeriod,
  getCouponType,
  getMaturityDate,
  getMaturityRate,
  getNominal,
  getPercentValue,
  getPlacingRate,
  getPriceDirectionUp,
} from '../../helpers';
import { IProductParametersSectionProps } from '../../types';
import Row from '../Row/Row';
import Section from '../Section/Section';

const ProductParametersSection: FC<IProductParametersSectionProps> = ({
  agentName,
  barrierRate,
  barrierRateName,
  bondTypeCode,
  capitalProtectionFactor,
  capitalProtectionFactorName,
  couponPeriod,
  couponType,
  exerciseBarrierRate,
  exerciseBarrierRateName,
  gearedput,
  growLimit,
  growLimitName,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  isin,
  issuerName,
  maturityDate,
  maturityRate,
  maturityRateName,
  nominal,
  nominalCurrencyCode,
  observationPeriod,
  participationRate,
  participationRateName,
  placement,
  placingRate,
  priceDirectionUp,
  recallBarrierRate,
  recallBarrierRateName,
  regNum,
  stepdown,
  extraParams,
  isMarket,
  priceRangeFrom,
  priceRangeTo,
  priceCurrency,
}) => (
  <Section title="Параметры продукта">
    {placement !== 'other' && placingRate && (
      <Row name="Цена размещения" value={getPlacingRate(placingRate)} />
    )}

    {placement === 'other' && priceRangeFrom && (
      <Row
        name="Диапозон цены"
        value={`${priceRangeFrom}–${priceRangeTo} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`}
        slug="IPO_RRICE_RANGE"
      />
    )}

    {!!nominal && nominalCurrencyCode && (
      <Row name="Номинал" value={getNominal(nominal, nominalCurrencyCode)} />
    )}

    {!(placement === 'bird' && isMarket) && maturityDate && (
      <Row name="Дата погашения" value={getMaturityDate(maturityDate)} />
    )}

    {couponType && <Row name="Тип купона облигации" value={getCouponType(couponType)} />}

    {Boolean(couponPeriod) &&
      couponPeriod &&
      !((instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB') && isMarket) && (
        <Row
          name="Купонный период"
          value={getCouponPeriod(couponPeriod)}
          slug="STB_COUPON_PERIOD"
        />
      )}

    {(instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB') && (
      <>
        {observationPeriod && <Row name="Период наблюдения" value={observationPeriod} />}

        {stepdown && <Row name="Stepdown" value={stepdown} slug="LOWERING_RECALL_BARRIER" />}

        {gearedput && (
          <Row
            name="Gearedput"
            value={`${numberToLocaleFormat(formatProfit(gearedput, 4), 4)}`}
            slug="CONDITIONAL_PROTECTION_BARRIER"
          />
        )}
      </>
    )}

    {placement === 'bird' && barrierRate && (
      <Row
        name={barrierRateName ?? 'Барьер выплаты купона'}
        value={getBarrierValue(barrierRate)}
        slug="STB_CUPON_BARIER"
      />
    )}

    {placement === 'bird' && recallBarrierRate && (
      <Row
        name={recallBarrierRateName ?? 'Барьер отзыва'}
        value={getBarrierValue(recallBarrierRate)}
        slug="STB_RECALL_BARIER"
      />
    )}

    {placement === 'bird' && exerciseBarrierRate && (
      <Row
        name={exerciseBarrierRateName ?? 'Защитный барьер'}
        value={getBarrierValue(exerciseBarrierRate)}
        slug="STB_PROTECT_BARIER"
      />
    )}

    {placement === 'bird' && capitalProtectionFactor && (
      <Row
        name={capitalProtectionFactorName ?? 'Защита капитала'}
        value={getPercentValue(capitalProtectionFactor)}
        slug="STB_CAPITAL_PROTECTION"
      />
    )}

    {bondTypeCode === 'WITHPART' && participationRate && (
      <Row
        name={participationRateName ?? 'Коэффициент участия'}
        value={getPercentValue(participationRate)}
        slug="STB_PARTICIPATION_RATE"
      />
    )}

    {bondTypeCode === 'WITHPART' && growLimit && (
      <Row
        name={growLimitName ?? 'Ограничение роста актива'}
        value={getPercentValue(growLimit)}
        slug="STB_THRESHOLD_PRICE_LIMIT"
      />
    )}

    {bondTypeCode === 'WITHPART' && priceDirectionUp != null && (
      <Row
        name="Направление движения цены"
        value={getPriceDirectionUp(priceDirectionUp)}
        slug="STB_DIRECTION_PRICE_MOVEMENT"
      />
    )}

    {placement === 'bird' && maturityRate && (
      <Row name={maturityRateName ?? 'Цена погашения'} value={getMaturityRate(maturityRate)} />
    )}

    {Boolean(extraParams?.length) &&
      placement === 'bird' &&
      isMarket &&
      extraParams.map(({ name, value, prompt }) => (
        <Row key={name} name={name} value={value} slug={prompt} />
      ))}

    {isin && <Row name="ISIN" value={isin} />}

    {issuerName && <Row name="Эмитент" value={issuerName} />}

    {regNum && <Row name="Регистрационный номер" value={regNum} />}

    {agentName && <Row name="Агент по размещению" value={agentName} />}
  </Section>
);

export default memo(ProductParametersSection);

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Accordion, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import ResultDependOnCaseCard from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/components/ResultDependOnCaseCard/ResultDependOnCaseCard';
import { getResultDependOnCases } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/helpers';
import { ResultDependOnProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/types';
import { getHintText } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';

import styles from './ResultDependOn.module.pcss';

const ResultDependOn = ({
  placement,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  barrierRate,
  exerciseBarrierRate,
  isMarket,
}: ResultDependOnProps) => {
  const [selectedCase, setSelectedCase] = useState<number>(0);

  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const resultDependOnCases = useMemo(
    () =>
      getResultDependOnCases({
        instrumentCategoryCode,
        barrierRate,
        exerciseBarrierRate,
      }),
    [instrumentCategoryCode, barrierRate, exerciseBarrierRate],
  );

  const handleCaseCardClick = (index: number) => () => setSelectedCase(index);

  const hintText =
    hints?.hints &&
    getHintText(
      hints?.hints,
      instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB' ? 'STB_RESULT_REASONS' : 'INB_RESULT_REASONS',
    );

  const isHidden =
    !resultDependOnCases ||
    placement !== 'bird' ||
    (instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB' &&
      !(barrierRate === 0 || exerciseBarrierRate === 0 || barrierRate >= exerciseBarrierRate)) ||
    (instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB' && !(barrierRate > 0));

  if (isHidden) return null;

  const { title, text, Img } = resultDependOnCases[selectedCase];
  return (
    <Accordion title={'От чего зависит результат'}>
      {(instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB') &&
        isMarket &&
        hintText && (
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {hintText}
          </Text>
        )}
      {resultDependOnCases.length > 1 && (
        <div className={styles.caseCardsWrapper}>
          <div className={styles.caseCards}>
            {resultDependOnCases.map((el, index) => (
              <ResultDependOnCaseCard
                key={index}
                onClick={handleCaseCardClick(index)}
                active={index === selectedCase}
              >{`Сценарий ${index + 1}`}</ResultDependOnCaseCard>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
        {title}
      </Text>
      <Text type={'lineRegular'} className={styles.text}>
        {text}
      </Text>
      <Img className={styles.figure} />
    </Accordion>
  );
};

export default ResultDependOn;

import React from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENT } from 'const/routes';

import { UnderlyingAssetCardProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/IPODetails/types';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components';

import styles from './UnderlyingAssetCard.module.pcss';

const UnderlyingAssetCard = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  instrumentImageName,
  instrumentName,
  instrumentLink,
}: UnderlyingAssetCardProps) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleClick = () => {
    if (instrumentId)
      navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENT, { instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}` }));

    if (instrumentLink) {
      window.open(instrumentLink);
      return;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.card} onClick={handleClick}>
      <InstrumentIcon
        instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
        className={styles.instrumentIcon}
        isOtherUnderlyingAsset={!instrumentId}
      />
      <Text type={'labelSemiBold'}>{instrumentName}</Text>
    </div>
  );
};

export default UnderlyingAssetCard;

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { CouponType } from 'types/ipo';

export type BondPlacementType = 'bird' | 'otc' | 'other';

export const getBondPlacementType = (instrumentCategoryCode: string): BondPlacementType => {
  const isInbOrStb = instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB';

  if (isInbOrStb) return 'bird';

  if (
    instrumentCategoryCode === 'RCB' ||
    instrumentCategoryCode === 'RGB' ||
    instrumentCategoryCode === 'EBN' ||
    instrumentCategoryCode === 'FGB' ||
    instrumentCategoryCode === 'FCB'
  )
    return 'otc';

  return 'other';
};

export const getPercentValue = (value: number) => (value ? `${value}%` : '–');
export const getPlacingRate = (value: number) => `${getPercentValue(value)} от номинала`;
export const getPlacingDate = (placingDate: string) =>
  DateTime.fromISO(placingDate).toFormat('dd MMMM yyyy');
export const getNominal = (nominal: number, nominalCurrencyCode: PriceCurrencyType) => {
  return `${sumFormatter(nominal, null, 0)} ${currencySign(nominalCurrencyCode)}`;
};
export const getCouponType = (couponType: CouponType) => {
  const couponTypesDescription: Record<CouponType, string> = {
    CONST: 'Постоянный',
    VAR: 'Переменный',
    FLOAT: 'Плавающий',
  };
  return couponTypesDescription[couponType];
};
export const getCouponPeriod = (couponPeriod: number) => {
  return `${couponPeriod} ${getNoun(couponPeriod, 'день', 'дня', 'дней')}`;
};
export const getBarrierValue = (barrierRate: number) =>
  `${getPercentValue(barrierRate)} от начальной цены актива`;
export const getPriceDirectionUp = (priceDirectionUp: boolean) => {
  if (priceDirectionUp) return 'На рост цены';
  return 'На падение цены';
};
export const getMaturityRate = (maturityRate: number) =>
  `${getPercentValue(maturityRate)} от номинала`;

export const getCirculationPeriod = (maturityDate: string, placingDate: string) => {
  const parsedPlacingDate = DateTime.fromISO(placingDate);
  const parsedMaturityDate = DateTime.fromISO(maturityDate);

  return parsedMaturityDate.diff(parsedPlacingDate, 'days').days / 365;
};
export const getMaturityDate = (date: string) =>
  DateTime.fromISO(date).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);

export const validateCalcParams = ({
  minimumAmount,
  nominal,
  conditionalCouponRate,
  couponPeriod,
  maturityDate,
  placingDate,
}: CalcParams): boolean => {
  return (
    typeof conditionalCouponRate === 'number' &&
    typeof minimumAmount === 'number' &&
    typeof nominal === 'number' &&
    nominal !== 0 &&
    typeof couponPeriod === 'number' &&
    couponPeriod !== 0 &&
    typeof maturityDate === 'string' &&
    typeof placingDate === 'string' &&
    couponPeriod <= DateTime.fromISO(maturityDate).diff(DateTime.fromISO(placingDate), 'days').days
  );
};

export const formattedDate = (endDate: DateTime, pretext: [string, string, string]) => {
  const startDate = DateTime.now();

  const {
    months,
    days,
    hours,
    minutes: m,
  } = endDate.diff(startDate, ['months', 'days', 'hours', 'minutes']);

  const minutes = Math.floor(m);

  if (days >= 30 || months >= 1) {
    return `${getNoun(months, ...pretext)} ${months} ${getNoun(
      months,
      'месяц',
      'месяца',
      'месяцев',
    )}`;
  }

  if (days < 30 && days >= 1) {
    return `${getNoun(days, ...pretext)} ${days} ${getNoun(days, 'день', 'дня', 'дней')}`;
  }

  if (days < 1 && hours >= 1) {
    return `${getNoun(hours, ...pretext)} ${hours} ${getNoun(hours, 'час', 'часа', 'часов')}`;
  }

  return `${getNoun(minutes, ...pretext)} ${minutes} ${getNoun(
    minutes,
    'минута',
    'минуты',
    'минут',
  )}`;
};

export const getApplicationReceiptDate = (
  beginDate: string,
  endDate: string,
  placingCanceled: boolean,
) => {
  const DATE_TIME_FORMAT = 'dd MMMM HH:mm';

  const now = DateTime.now();
  const parsedBeginDate = DateTime.fromISO(beginDate);
  const parsedEndDate = DateTime.fromISO(endDate);

  if (placingCanceled) {
    return {
      dateTime: 'Размещение отменено',
    };
  }

  if (parsedBeginDate.startOf('day') > now.startOf('day')) {
    return {
      dateTime: `Приём заявок начнётся ${parsedBeginDate.toFormat(DATE_TIME_FORMAT)}`,
      diff: formattedDate(parsedBeginDate, ['через', 'через', 'через']),
    };
  }

  if (
    parsedBeginDate.startOf('day') <= now.startOf('day') &&
    parsedEndDate.toMillis() > now.toMillis()
  ) {
    return {
      dateTime: `Приём заявок до ${parsedEndDate.toFormat(DATE_TIME_FORMAT)}`,
      diff: formattedDate(parsedEndDate, ['остался', 'осталось', 'осталось']),
    };
  }

  return {
    dateTime: 'Приём заявок завершён',
  };
};

export const getMinimumAmount = (
  minimumAmount: number,
  minimumAmountCurrencyCode: PriceCurrencyType,
) => {
  return `${sumFormatter(minimumAmount, null, 0)} ${currencySign(minimumAmountCurrencyCode)}`;
};

export const range = (min: number, max: number, step: number) => {
  const result = [];
  for (let i = min; i <= max; i += step) {
    result.push(i);
  }
  return result;
};

import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useScroll } from 'react-use';

import { Disclaimer, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER_IPO } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetIpoQuery, useLazyGetPersonsCurrentTradingAccountsQuery } from 'core/api/ipo';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import CategorizationBottomSheet from '../CategorizationBottomSheet';
import styles from './IPODetails.module.pcss';
import Calculator from './components/Calculator/Calculator';
import DateSection from './components/DateSection/DateSection';
import DescriptionSection from './components/DescriptionSection/DescriptionSection';
import ErrorPlug from './components/ErrorPlug/ErrorPlug';
import Head from './components/Head/Head';
import HowItWork from './components/HowItWork/HowItWork';
import IssueDocuments from './components/IssueDocuments/IssueDocuments';
import MainSection from './components/MainSection/MainSection';
import ParticipateButtonSection from './components/ParticipateButtonSection/ParticipateButtonSection';
import ProductParametersSection from './components/ProductParametersSection/ProductParametersSection';
import QualInvestorsAvailableOnlyBottomSheet from './components/QualInvestorsAvailableOnlyBottomSheet/QualInvestorsAvailableOnlyBottomSheet';
import ResultDependOn from './components/ResultDependOn/ResultDependOn';
import Skeleton from './components/Skeleton/Skeleton';
import UnderlyingAssetsSection from './components/UnderlyingAssetsSection/UnderlyingAssetsSection';
import { DISCLAIMER_FULL_TEXT } from './consts';
import { getBondPlacementType } from './helpers';
import { QualInvestorsAvailableOnlyBottomSheetVariantType } from './types';

const IPODetails = () => {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [scrollRef, setScrollRef] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const { y: scrollY } = useScroll({ current: scrollRef });

  const { data, isError } = useGetIpoQuery(Number(id), { skip: !id });
  const [
    getPersonsCurrentTradingAccounts,
    { isError: isPersonsCurrentTradingAccountsError, data: personsCurrentTradingAccountsData },
  ] = useLazyGetPersonsCurrentTradingAccountsQuery();

  const session = getSession();
  const fullText = DISCLAIMER_FULL_TEXT;

  const [secondParticipateButtonOpacity, setSecondParticipateButtonOpacity] = useState(0);
  const [hasBottomSheetShown, setHasBottomSheetShown] = useState(false);
  const [openedBottomSheet, setOpenedBottomSheet] =
    useState<QualInvestorsAvailableOnlyBottomSheetVariantType | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data) {
      const { ipo } = data;

      const { instrumentId, tradePlaceId } = ipo[0] || {};

      if (instrumentId !== undefined && tradePlaceId !== undefined) {
        getPersonsCurrentTradingAccounts({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });
      }
    }
  }, [data, getPersonsCurrentTradingAccounts]);

  const handleBackButtonClick = useCallback(() => navigate(-1), [navigate]);

  const handleFirstParticipateButtonIntersectionChange = useCallback(
    (intersection: IntersectionObserverEntry | null) => {
      if (intersection?.intersectionRatio) {
        setSecondParticipateButtonOpacity(
          1 - Math.floor(intersection?.intersectionRatio * 100) / 100,
        );
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  const handleBottomSheetClose = useCallback(() => setOpenedBottomSheet(null), []);

  const {
    ipo = [],
    marketInvestBondBasket = [],
    document = [],
    ipoPersonCategory = [],
  } = data || {};

  const categories = useMemo(
    () =>
      ipoPersonCategory.map(
        ({
          personCategoryTypeFullName,
          personCategoryTypeCode,
          personCategoryTypeName,
          personCategory,
        }) => ({
          code: personCategoryTypeCode,
          fullName: personCategoryTypeFullName,
          name: personCategoryTypeName,
          passed: personCategory === 'TESTPASSED',
        }),
      ),
    [ipoPersonCategory],
  );

  const hasNotPassedTest = useMemo(
    () => ipoPersonCategory.find((item) => item.personCategory === 'TESTNOTPASSED'),
    [ipoPersonCategory],
  );

  if (isError || isPersonsCurrentTradingAccountsError) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage onLeftIconClick={handleBackButtonClick} leftIconVariant="back" title="" />
        <ErrorPlug />
      </>
    );
  }

  if (!data || !personsCurrentTradingAccountsData) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage onLeftIconClick={handleBackButtonClick} leftIconVariant="back" title="" />
        <Skeleton />
      </>
    );
  }

  const ipoData = ipo?.[0] || {};

  const {
    barrierRate,
    barrierRateName,
    beginDate,
    bondTypeCode,
    commissionFree,
    conditionalCouponRate,
    conditionalCouponRateName,
    couponPeriod,
    couponRate,
    couponValue,
    description,
    documentsComment,
    endDate,
    exerciseBarrierRate,
    exerciseBarrierRateName,
    filePath,
    headerImagePath,
    indicativeCouponText,
    indicativeYieldText,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    instrumentCategoryName,
    instrumentName,
    isMarket,
    isQual,
    maturityDate,
    minimumAmount,
    name,
    nominal,
    nominalCurrencyCode,
    placingCanceled,
    placingDate,
    placingPostponed,
    recallBarrierRate,
    recallBarrierRateName,
    participationRateName,
    participationRate,
    fieldNameReviewLink,
    extraParams,
    dealCurrency,
    priceRangeTo,
    priceRangeFrom,
    priceCurrency,
  } = ipoData;

  const placement = getBondPlacementType(instrumentCategoryCode);

  const getMainBtnDisabled = () => {
    if (hasNotPassedTest) {
      return true;
    }

    const { tradingAvailability } = personsCurrentTradingAccountsData;

    if (!tradingAvailability.length) {
      return true;
    }

    const { tradePermissionState, otcPermissionState } = tradingAvailability[0];

    if (isMarket) {
      return tradePermissionState === 'BLOCKED' || tradePermissionState === 'DENIED';
    }

    return otcPermissionState === 'BLOCKED' || otcPermissionState === 'DENIED';
  };

  const mainBtnDisabled = getMainBtnDisabled();

  const handleParticipateButtonClick = () => {
    if (session && !session.isQual && !session.isActualQualOrder && isQual) {
      setOpenedBottomSheet('becomeQualInvestor');
      return;
    }

    if (session && !session.isQual && session.isActualQualOrder && isQual) {
      setOpenedBottomSheet('qualInvetorActiveOrder');
      return;
    }

    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER_IPO, { ipoId: id }));
  };

  if (hasNotPassedTest && !hasBottomSheetShown)
    return (
      <CategorizationBottomSheet
        data={categories}
        setHasBottomSheetShown={setHasBottomSheetShown}
        isIpo
      />
    );

  return (
    <div className={styles.container} ref={setScrollRef}>
      <HeaderPage
        className={cx(styles.headerWrapper, { [styles.headerWrapperBg]: scrollY > 0 })}
        title={instrumentName}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackButtonClick}
        leftIconVariant="back"
      />
      <Head
        name={name}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        instrumentCategoryName={instrumentCategoryName}
        bondTypeCode={bondTypeCode}
        headerImagePath={headerImagePath}
        beginDate={beginDate}
        endDate={endDate}
        placingCanceled={placingCanceled}
        mainBtnDisabled={mainBtnDisabled}
        onButtonClick={handleParticipateButtonClick}
        onButtonIntersectionChange={handleFirstParticipateButtonIntersectionChange}
      />
      <DateSection
        beginDate={beginDate}
        endDate={endDate}
        placingPostponed={placingPostponed}
        placingCanceled={placingCanceled}
      />
      <MainSection
        placement={placement}
        indicativeCouponText={indicativeCouponText}
        indicativeYieldText={indicativeYieldText}
        conditionalCouponRate={conditionalCouponRate}
        couponRate={couponRate}
        conditionalCouponRateName={conditionalCouponRateName}
        couponValue={couponValue}
        minimumAmount={minimumAmount}
        nominalCurrencyCode={nominalCurrencyCode}
        placingDate={placingDate}
        commissionFree={commissionFree}
        participationRateName={participationRateName}
        participationRate={participationRate}
        bondTypeCode={bondTypeCode}
        isMarket={isMarket}
        dealCurrency={dealCurrency}
        priceRangeTo={priceRangeTo}
        priceCurrency={priceCurrency}
      />
      <DescriptionSection
        description={description}
        filePath={filePath}
        fileName={
          placement === 'bird' && isMarket
            ? fieldNameReviewLink ?? 'Информация о размещении'
            : 'Презентация по размещению'
        }
      />
      <UnderlyingAssetsSection
        placement={placement}
        marketInvestBondBasket={marketInvestBondBasket}
      />
      <ProductParametersSection placement={placement} {...ipoData} extraParams={extraParams} />
      <IssueDocuments documents={document} documentsComment={documentsComment} />
      {!((instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB') && isMarket) && (
        <Calculator
          placement={placement}
          nominal={nominal}
          maturityDate={maturityDate}
          minimumAmount={minimumAmount}
          placingDate={placingDate}
          couponPeriod={couponPeriod}
          conditionalCouponRate={conditionalCouponRate}
          conditionalCouponRateName={conditionalCouponRateName}
        />
      )}
      <ResultDependOn
        placement={placement}
        instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
        barrierRate={barrierRate}
        exerciseBarrierRate={exerciseBarrierRate}
        isMarket={isMarket}
      />
      <HowItWork
        placement={placement}
        barrierRate={barrierRate}
        barrierRateName={barrierRateName}
        exerciseBarrierRate={exerciseBarrierRate}
        exerciseBarrierRateName={exerciseBarrierRateName}
        recallBarrierRate={recallBarrierRate}
        recallBarrierRateName={recallBarrierRateName}
        isMarket={isMarket}
        instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
      />
      <Disclaimer text={'Не является индивидуальной инвестиционной рекомендацией'}>
        <div className={styles.disclaimer}>
          {fullText.split('\n').map((row, index) => (
            <Text type={'bodyRegular'} key={index}>
              {row}
            </Text>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Disclaimer>
      <ParticipateButtonSection
        opacity={secondParticipateButtonOpacity}
        beginDate={beginDate}
        endDate={endDate}
        placingCanceled={placingCanceled}
        mainBtnDisabled={mainBtnDisabled}
        onButtonClick={handleParticipateButtonClick}
      />
      <QualInvestorsAvailableOnlyBottomSheet
        variant={openedBottomSheet}
        open={
          openedBottomSheet === 'qualInvetorActiveOrder' ||
          openedBottomSheet === 'becomeQualInvestor'
        }
        onClose={handleBottomSheetClose}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(IPODetails);

import { FC, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { CardSkeleton } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Skeleton/Skeleton';

type ListContentProps = {
  type?: 'SHARES' | 'BONDS' | 'CURRENCIES' | 'FUTURES' | 'OPTIONS' | 'METALS' | 'FONDS';
  requestResultLength: number;
  updatePagination: () => void;
  isFetching: boolean;
};

let prevScrollY = 0;
let prevRatio = 0;
/* обертка над списком инструментов добавляющая пагинацию и скелетон для нее */
const ListWithPagination: FC<ListContentProps> = ({
  type,
  children,
  requestResultLength,
  updatePagination,
  isFetching,
}) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const observer = useRef<IntersectionObserver>();
  const [obsState, setObsState] = useState('hidden');
  const minLength =
    type === 'METALS'
      ? 30
      : type === 'FONDS' || type === 'BONDS' || type === 'CURRENCIES'
      ? 20
      : 50;
  useEffect(() => {
    observer.current = new IntersectionObserver((entry) => {
      entry.forEach((entry) => {
        const currentY = entry.boundingClientRect.y;
        const currentRatio = entry.intersectionRatio;
        const isIntersecting = entry.isIntersecting;
        if (currentY < prevScrollY) {
          if (currentRatio > prevRatio && isIntersecting) {
            setObsState('visible');
          }
        } else if (currentY > prevScrollY && isIntersecting) {
          setObsState('visible');
        }
        if (!isIntersecting) setObsState('hidden');
        prevScrollY = currentY;
        prevRatio = currentRatio;
      });
    });
    ref.current &&
      ref.current.lastElementChild &&
      observer.current.observe(ref.current.lastElementChild);
  }, [obsState, isFetching]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (obsState !== 'hidden' && requestResultLength >= minLength) {
      updatePagination();
      ref.current &&
        ref.current.lastElementChild &&
        observer.current?.unobserve(ref.current.lastElementChild);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [obsState]);

  return (
    <div ref={ref}>
      <>
        {children}
        {requestResultLength >= minLength && (
          <>
            <CardSkeleton />
            <CardSkeleton />
            <CardSkeleton />
          </>
        )}
      </>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ListWithPagination;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Filter, FilterBar } from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyGetMetalsQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import EmptyContentCheck from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/EmptyContentCheck';
import ListWithPagination from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/ListWithPagination';
import Skeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Skeleton';
import SortBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet';
import { CURRENCY_SORT_LIST } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { TextFilterWithSorting } from 'modules/Catalog/helpers';
import { useCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/hooks';
import { CatalogFiltersType, ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { SwipeableInstrumentCard } from 'components/Instrument';

import { ShowcaseCurrencies, SortingType } from 'types/catalog';

const Metals = () => {
  const [sortBottomSheet, setSortBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useCatalogFilters();
  const metalsFilters = allFilters.metals;
  const metalsFiltersSorting = metalsFilters.sorting;

  const [instrumentsList, setInstrumentsList] = useState<ShowcaseCurrencies[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const [fetchMetals, { data: { currencyPairList = [] } = {}, isFetching, isError }] =
    useLazyGetMetalsQuery();

  const isPeriodDay = metalsFiltersSorting?.startsWith('PRICE_1_DAY');

  useEffect(() => {
    updateFilters(allFilters);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const updateFilters = (
    updatedFilters: CatalogFiltersType,
    saveState?: boolean,
    eventGoal?: boolean,
  ) => {
    const { metals } = updatedFilters;
    const sorting = metals.sorting;

    eventGoal &&
      reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.sortingTap, {
        category_type: 'metals',
        sorts: `${sorting?.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию'} / ${
          sorting?.slice(0, -1) === 'PRICE_6_MONTHS' ? 'За полгода' : 'За сегодня'
        }`,
      });

    setAllFilters(updatedFilters);
    if (!saveState) setIsLoading(true);
    fetchMetals(metals)
      .then((res) => {
        if (!res.data) setInstrumentsList([]);
        else if (saveState) setInstrumentsList(instrumentsList.concat(res.data.currencyPairList));
        else setInstrumentsList(res.data.currencyPairList);
        setIsLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((err) => console.error(err));
  };

  const onSort = (order: string, name: string) => {
    const sorting =
      (order && (`${name}${order === 'PRICE' ? '-' : '+'}` as SortingType)) || undefined;
    if (sorting !== metalsFiltersSorting) {
      updateFilters(
        {
          ...allFilters,
          metals: { ...metalsFilters, sorting, rowsOffset: 0 },
        },
        false,
        true,
      );
    }
    setSortBottomSheet(false);
  };

  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  return (
    <>
      <FilterBar>
        <Filter
          shape="sort"
          //@ts-ignore
          //временная мера, пока не выгрузят обновленный кит
          text={<TextFilterWithSorting text={metalsFiltersSorting} />}
          sortDirection={metalsFiltersSorting?.includes('-') ? 'down' : 'up'}
          onClick={() => setSortBottomSheet(!sortBottomSheet)}
        />
      </FilterBar>
      <EmptyContentCheck error={isError} content={instrumentsList}>
        <ListWithPagination
          type="METALS"
          requestResultLength={currencyPairList.length}
          updatePagination={() =>
            updateFilters(
              {
                ...allFilters,
                metals: { ...metalsFilters, rowsOffset: metalsFilters.rowsOffset + 30 },
              },
              true,
            )
          }
          isFetching={isFetching}
        >
          {currencyPairList.map((el) => {
            return (
              <SwipeableInstrumentCard
                {...el}
                key={`${el.instrumentId}-${el.tradePlaceId}`}
                price={el.lastPrice}
                favorite={el.isFavorite}
                onRefetch={() => fetchMetals(allFilters.metals)}
                {...(isPeriodDay
                  ? {
                      periodPriceDiff: el.dailyPriceDiff,
                      periodPriceDiffPcnt: el.dailyPriceDiffPcnt,
                    }
                  : {})}
              />
            );
          })}
        </ListWithPagination>
      </EmptyContentCheck>
      <SortBottomSheet
        currentSortPrice={metalsFiltersSorting}
        list={CURRENCY_SORT_LIST}
        onConfirm={onSort}
        open={sortBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setSortBottomSheet}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default Metals;

import { SORTING_GROUP_MD } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import { SortingType } from 'types/catalog';

const textPeriod = (sortParam: SortingType) =>
  SORTING_GROUP_MD.reduce(
    (acc, value) => ({ ...acc, [value]: /DAY/.test(value) ? 'За сегодня' : 'За полгода' }),
    [],
  )[sortParam as any];

export const sortContent = (sortParam: SortingType): string =>
  `${sortParam?.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию'} • ${textPeriod(sortParam)}`;

export const getReadyListFilterTitle = (isActual: boolean, isDividendStability: boolean) => {
  if (isActual) {
    return 'Актуальные';
  }

  if (isDividendStability) {
    return 'Стабильные дивиденды';
  }

  return 'Все акции';
};
