import { FC, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { FilterShape } from '@aurora/components';

import {
  useGetDictionariesQuery,
  useLazyGetEquitiesQuery,
  useLazyGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery,
} from 'core/api/catalog';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import IndustriesBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/IndustriesBottomSheet';
import EmptyContentCheck from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/EmptyContentCheck';
import ListWithPagination from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/ListWithPagination';
import Skeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Skeleton';
import { TFilter } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Stocks/partials/StocksFilter';
import { BottomSheetType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Stocks/types';
import {
  ReadyListsBottomSheet,
  ReadyListsBottomSheetOptionsType,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/ReadyListsBottomSheet';
import SortBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet';
import {
  DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_FAVORITES_FILTERS,
  DEFAULT_SORT_LIST,
  STOCK_TYPE_VALUE_FOR,
  STOCK_TYPE_VALUE_RUS,
} from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { graphPrepare } from 'modules/Catalog/helpers';
import { useCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/hooks';
import { CatalogFiltersType, ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { SwipeableInstrumentCard } from 'components/Instrument';

import { ShowcaseEquities, ShowcaseInstrument, SortingType } from 'types/catalog';

import { getReadyListFilterTitle, sortContent } from './helpers';
import StocksFilter from './partials/StocksFilter';
import { DEFAULT_INDUSTRY_FILTER_TEXT, DEFAULT_SORT_TEXT } from './store';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const Stocks: FC = () => {
  const [bottomSheet, setBottomSheet] = useState<BottomSheetType | null>(null);

  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const pageType = searchParams.get('type');

  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useCatalogFilters();

  const stocksFilters = allFilters.equities;
  const stocksFiltersSorting = stocksFilters.sorting;

  const actual = allFilters.actual;
  const isEquitiesActual = allFilters.actual.equities;

  const [instrumentsList, setInstrumentsList] = useState<(ShowcaseEquities | ShowcaseInstrument)[]>(
    [],
  );
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const [
    fetchStocks,
    {
      data: { instrumentShowcaseEquities = [], quoteHistory: stocksQuoteHistory = [] } = {},
      isError: errorEquities,
      isFetching,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetEquitiesQuery();

  const [
    fetchShowcaseFavorites,
    {
      data: { showcaseInstrument = [], quoteHistory: showcaseFavoritesQuoteHistory = [] } = {},
      isError: showcaseError,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery();

  const instruments = isEquitiesActual ? showcaseInstrument : instrumentShowcaseEquities;
  const quoteHistory = isEquitiesActual ? showcaseFavoritesQuoteHistory : stocksQuoteHistory;

  const updateFilters = useCallback(
    ({
      updatedFilters,
      saveState,
      noLoading,
    }: {
      updatedFilters: CatalogFiltersType;
      saveState?: boolean;
      noLoading?: boolean;
    }) => {
      const {
        equities,
        actual: { equities: isActual },
      } = updatedFilters;

      setAllFilters(updatedFilters);

      if (!saveState && !noLoading) setIsLoading(true);

      if (isActual) {
        fetchShowcaseFavorites(DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_FAVORITES_FILTERS)
          .then((res) => {
            if (!res.data) setInstrumentsList([]);
            else if (saveState)
              setInstrumentsList(instrumentsList.concat(res.data.showcaseInstrument));
            else setInstrumentsList(res.data.showcaseInstrument);
            setIsLoading(false);
          })
          .catch((err) => console.error(err));
      } else {
        fetchStocks(equities)
          .then((res) => {
            if (!res.data) setInstrumentsList([]);
            else if (saveState)
              setInstrumentsList(instrumentsList.concat(res.data?.instrumentShowcaseEquities));
            else setInstrumentsList(res.data?.instrumentShowcaseEquities);
            setIsLoading(false);
          })
          .catch((err) => console.error(err));
      }
    },
    [fetchStocks, instrumentsList],
  );

  const openBottomSheet = (type: BottomSheetType) => setBottomSheet(type);
  const closeBottomSheet = () => setBottomSheet(null);

  const {
    data: { industryClassifierType: dictionaries = [] } = {},
    isLoading: isDictionariesLoading,
    isError: errorDictionaries,
  } = useGetDictionariesQuery({});

  const industryText = useMemo(
    () =>
      dictionaries.find(({ code }) => code === String(stocksFilters.industryCode))?.name ||
      DEFAULT_INDUSTRY_FILTER_TEXT,
    [dictionaries, stocksFilters.industryCode],
  );

  // errorDictionaries меняем фильтр отраслей на все, если список этого фильтра не пришел от бека
  useEffect(() => {
    const { actualEquities } = getSession() || {};
    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        equities: {
          ...stocksFilters,
          rowsOffset: 0,
          ...(errorDictionaries
            ? { industryCode: '' }
            : {
                category:
                  pageType && pageType === 'for' ? STOCK_TYPE_VALUE_FOR : STOCK_TYPE_VALUE_RUS,
              }),
        },
        actual: { ...actual, ...(!actualEquities ? { equities: false } : {}) },
      },
    });
  }, []);

  const graphData = graphPrepare<ShowcaseEquities | ShowcaseInstrument>(
    instrumentsList,
    quoteHistory,
  );

  const onSort = useCallback(
    (order, name) => {
      const newSortingItem = `${name}${order === 'PRICE' ? '-' : '+'}` as SortingType;

      if (newSortingItem !== stocksFiltersSorting) {
        updateFilters({
          updatedFilters: {
            ...allFilters,
            equities: { ...stocksFilters, sorting: newSortingItem, rowsOffset: 0 },
          },
        });

        reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.sortingTap, {
          category_type: 'shares',
          sorts: `${newSortingItem?.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию'} / ${
            newSortingItem?.slice(0, -1) === 'PRICE_6_MONTHS' ? 'За полгода' : 'За сегодня'
          }`,
        });
      }

      closeBottomSheet();
    },
    [allFilters, stocksFilters, stocksFiltersSorting, updateFilters],
  );

  const onSortIndustries = useCallback(
    (industryCode: string) => {
      updateFilters({
        updatedFilters: {
          ...allFilters,
          equities: { ...stocksFilters, industryCode, rowsOffset: 0 },
        },
      });

      reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.filtersTap, {
        category_type: 'shares',
        filters: industryText,
      });

      closeBottomSheet();
    },
    [allFilters, industryText, stocksFilters, updateFilters],
  );

  const onReadyListChange = useCallback(
    (value: string) => {
      updateFilters({
        updatedFilters: {
          ...allFilters,
          equities: {
            ...stocksFilters,
            dividendStability: value === 'dividendStability',
            rowsOffset: 0,
          },
          actual: { ...actual, equities: value === 'actual' },
        },
      });
    },
    [updateFilters, stocksFilters, actual],
  );

  const onCloseIndustryFilters = useCallback(() => {
    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        equities: { ...stocksFilters, industryCode: '', rowsOffset: 0 },
      },
    });
  }, [allFilters, stocksFilters, updateFilters]);

  const onCloseReadyListFilters = useCallback(() => {
    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        equities: { ...stocksFilters, dividendStability: false, rowsOffset: 0 },
        actual: { ...actual, equities: false },
      },
    });
  }, [allFilters, stocksFilters, updateFilters]);

  const onClearAllFilters = useCallback(() => {
    updateFilters({
      updatedFilters: {
        ...allFilters,
        equities: {
          ...stocksFilters,
          industryCode: '',
          dividendStability: false,
          rowsOffset: 0,
        },
        actual: { ...actual, equities: false },
      },
    });
  }, [allFilters, stocksFilters, updateFilters]);

  const updatePagination = useCallback(() => {
    !isEquitiesActual &&
      updateFilters({
        updatedFilters: {
          ...allFilters,
          equities: { ...stocksFilters, rowsOffset: stocksFilters.rowsOffset + 50 },
        },
        saveState: true,
      });
  }, [allFilters, stocksFilters, isEquitiesActual, updateFilters]);

  const handleSort = useCallback(() => openBottomSheet('sort'), []);
  const handleSelect = useCallback(() => openBottomSheet('industries'), []);
  const handleReadyLists = useCallback(() => openBottomSheet('readyLists'), []);

  const handleRefetch = useCallback(
    () => updateFilters({ updatedFilters: allFilters, noLoading: true }),
    [allFilters, updateFilters],
  );

  const filters = useMemo(() => {
    const active =
      !!stocksFilters?.industryCode || stocksFilters?.dividendStability || isEquitiesActual;
    return [
      active && {
        onClick: onClearAllFilters,
        shape: 'reset' as FilterShape,
      },
      {
        active: isEquitiesActual || stocksFilters.dividendStability,
        onClick: handleReadyLists,
        onClose: onCloseReadyListFilters,
        shape: 'select' as FilterShape,
        text: getReadyListFilterTitle(isEquitiesActual, stocksFilters.dividendStability),
      },
      {
        onClick: !isEquitiesActual ? handleSort : undefined,
        shape: 'sort' as FilterShape,
        sortDirection: stocksFiltersSorting?.includes('-') || isEquitiesActual ? 'down' : 'up',
        text: isEquitiesActual ? DEFAULT_SORT_TEXT : sortContent(stocksFiltersSorting),
        disabled: isEquitiesActual,
      },
      {
        active: !isEquitiesActual ? !!stocksFilters?.industryCode : false,
        onClick: !isEquitiesActual ? handleSelect : undefined,
        onClose: onCloseIndustryFilters,
        shape: 'select' as FilterShape,
        text: isEquitiesActual ? DEFAULT_INDUSTRY_FILTER_TEXT : industryText,
        disabled: isEquitiesActual,
      },
    ].filter(Boolean) as TFilter[];
  }, [
    handleSelect,
    handleSort,
    industryText,
    isEquitiesActual,
    onClearAllFilters,
    onCloseIndustryFilters,
    stocksFilters?.dividendStability,
    stocksFilters?.industryCode,
    stocksFiltersSorting,
  ]);

  const readyListsBottomSheetOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const { actualEquities } = getSession() || {};

    return [
      {
        title: 'Все акции',
        value: 'all',
      },
      actualEquities && {
        title: 'Актуальное',
        value: 'actual',
      },
      {
        title: 'Стабильные дивиденды',
        value: 'dividendStability',
      },
    ].filter(Boolean) as ReadyListsBottomSheetOptionsType;
  }, []);

  const instrumentsCards = graphData?.map((el, index) => (
    <SwipeableInstrumentCard
      key={`${el.instrumentId}-${el.tradePlaceId}`}
      {...el}
      dataLine={el.history}
      favorite={el.isFavorite}
      onRefetch={handleRefetch}
      price={el.lastPrice}
      type="SHARES"
      {...(isEquitiesActual
        ? { periodPriceDiff: el.dailyPriceDiff, periodPriceDiffPcnt: el.dailyPriceDiffPcnt }
        : {})}
      {...(index === 0 && { style: { paddingTop: 0 } })}
    />
  ));

  if (isLoading || isDictionariesLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  return (
    <div className={styles.stocksWrapper}>
      <StocksFilter filters={filters} />

      <EmptyContentCheck
        content={instrumentsList}
        error={errorEquities || errorDictionaries || showcaseError}
      >
        {!isEquitiesActual && (
          <ListWithPagination
            isFetching={isFetching}
            requestResultLength={instruments.length}
            type="SHARES"
            updatePagination={updatePagination}
          >
            {instrumentsCards}
          </ListWithPagination>
        )}
        {isEquitiesActual && <>{instrumentsCards}</>}
      </EmptyContentCheck>

      <SortBottomSheet
        list={DEFAULT_SORT_LIST}
        currentSortPrice={stocksFiltersSorting}
        onConfirm={onSort}
        open={bottomSheet === 'sort'}
        setOpen={closeBottomSheet}
      />

      <IndustriesBottomSheet
        currentIndustry={stocksFilters.industryCode}
        dictionariesList={dictionaries}
        onConfirm={onSortIndustries}
        open={bottomSheet === 'industries'}
        setOpen={closeBottomSheet}
      />

      <ReadyListsBottomSheet
        options={readyListsBottomSheetOptions}
        selected={
          isEquitiesActual
            ? 'actual'
            : stocksFilters.dividendStability
            ? 'dividendStability'
            : 'all'
        }
        open={bottomSheet === 'readyLists'}
        onClose={closeBottomSheet}
        onCommit={onReadyListChange}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(Stocks);

import React, { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, ButtonBar, HeadlineBottomSheet } from '@aurora/components';

import { CheckedSelectableCell } from './components/CheckedSelectableCell/CheckedSelectableCell';
import { ReadyListsBottomSheetProps } from './types';

const ReadyListsBottomSheet: FC<ReadyListsBottomSheetProps> = ({
  options,
  selected,
  onClose,
  onCommit,
  open,
}) => {
  const [tempSelected, setTempSelected] = useState<string>(selected);

  const handleChange = (value: string) => () => {
    setTempSelected(value);
  };

  const handleCommit = () => {
    onCommit(tempSelected);
    onClose();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setTempSelected(selected);
  }, [selected]);

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onClose}>
      <HeadlineBottomSheet title="Готовые списки" />
      {options.map(({ value, ...el }) => (
        <CheckedSelectableCell
          key={value}
          separator={false}
          active={value === tempSelected}
          onClick={handleChange(value)}
          {...el}
        />
      ))}
      <ButtonBar>
        <Button onClick={handleCommit}>Применить</Button>
      </ButtonBar>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(ReadyListsBottomSheet);

import { getInitialState } from './reducer';
import { Action, State } from './types';

export const setTextValue = (value: string): Action => ({ value });

export const reset = (): Action => getInitialState();

export const searchDataLoading = (): Action => ({ status: 'loading' });

export const resetData = (): Action => ({
  status: 'initial',
  data: [],
});

export const searchDataSuccess = (data: State['data']): Action => ({
  status: 'success',
  data,
});

export const updateFavorite =
  (instrumentId: number, tradePlaceId: number, favorite: boolean): Action =>
  (prev: State) => {
    const index = prev.data.findIndex(
      (item) => item.instrumentId === instrumentId && item.tradePlaceId === tradePlaceId,
    );

    return index < 0
      ? prev
      : {
          data: prev.data
            .slice(0, index)
            .concat({ ...prev.data[index], favorite }, prev.data.slice(index + 1)),
        };
  };

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import { Button } from '@aurora/components';

import { ReactComponent as CloseSvg } from 'images/icons/search/close.svg';

import styles from '../Search.module.pcss';
import { BUTTON_VALUE } from '../store';
import { IUseButtons } from './types';

const useButtons = ({ value, onClear, onCancelClick }: IUseButtons) => {
  const addonAfter = useMemo(
    () =>
      (!!value?.length && (
        <button onClick={onClear}>
          <CloseSvg />
        </button>
      )) ||
      null,
    [onClear, value?.length],
  );

  const addonRight = useMemo(
    () => (
      <Button
        className={styles.button}
        classNameContent={styles.buttonContent}
        onClick={onCancelClick}
        proportion="mobileSE"
        size="s"
        variant="transparent"
      >
        {BUTTON_VALUE}
      </Button>
    ),
    [onCancelClick],
  );

  return {
    addonAfter,
    addonRight,
  };
};

export default useButtons;

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

import { reset, setTextValue } from '../actionCreators';
import { LIST_SELECT } from '../partials/SectionStatistics/store';
import { DEFAULT_SORT_NAME, getParamsQueryStatisticsCount } from '../store';
import { IUseEvents } from './types';

const useEvents = ({ dispatch, handleClick, inputRef, setParamsCount }: IUseEvents) => {
  const [, setFetchCount] = useState(0);
  const [sortBottomSheet, setSortBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(DEFAULT_SORT_NAME);

  const onClear = useCallback(() => dispatch(reset()), [dispatch]);

  const onShowSearch = useCallback(() => {
    handleClick?.();

    setTimeout(() => {
      inputRef?.current?.focus();
    }, 201);

    reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.mainTap, { patterns: 'search' });
  }, [handleClick, inputRef]);

  const onCancelClick = useCallback(() => {
    dispatch(reset());

    handleClick?.();
  }, [dispatch, handleClick]);

  const changeInput = useCallback(
    (event) => dispatch(setTextValue(event.target.value)),
    [dispatch],
  );

  const onRefetch = useCallback(() => setFetchCount((prev) => prev + 1), []);

  const onSort = useCallback(
    (order) => {
      const currentName = LIST_SELECT.find(({ code }) => code === order)?.name || DEFAULT_SORT_NAME;

      setSortBottomSheet(!sortBottomSheet);

      setCurrent(currentName);

      if (order === 'empty') return setParamsCount(getParamsQueryStatisticsCount());

      if (/_/.test(order)) {
        const [endDate, beginDate] = order.split('_');

        return setParamsCount(getParamsQueryStatisticsCount(endDate, beginDate));
      }

      setParamsCount(getParamsQueryStatisticsCount(order));
    },
    [setParamsCount, sortBottomSheet],
  );

  return {
    changeInput,
    current,
    onCancelClick,
    onClear,
    onRefetch,
    onShowSearch,
    onSort,
    setSortBottomSheet,
    sortBottomSheet,
  };
};

export default useEvents;

import { useEffect, useReducer, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

import {
  useGetInstrumentsStatisticsCountQuery,
  useGetInstrumentsStatisticsQuery,
  useLazyGetInstrumentsQuery,
} from 'core/api/catalog';

import { reset, resetData, searchDataLoading, searchDataSuccess } from '../actionCreators';
import { getInitialState, reducer } from '../reducer';
import { IUseSearch } from './types';

const useSearch = ({ isActiveSearch, paramsQueryCount, paramsQueryStatistics }: IUseSearch) => {
  const [isFetch, setIsFetch] = useState(false);
  const [passMount, setPassMount] = useState(false);
  const [paramsCount, setParamsCount] = useState(paramsQueryCount);

  const { pathname } = useLocation();

  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, null, getInitialState);

  const { value, data: instrumentsList, status } = state;

  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const isMount = useRef(false);

  const {
    data: dataStatistics,
    isError: isErrorStatistics,
    isLoading: isLoadingStatistics,
  } = useGetInstrumentsStatisticsQuery(paramsQueryStatistics);

  const {
    data: dataStatisticsCount,
    isError: isErrorCount,
    isLoading: isLoadingCount,
  } = useGetInstrumentsStatisticsCountQuery(paramsCount);

  const [getInstruments] = useLazyGetInstrumentsQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFetch) {
      dispatch(resetData());
      dispatch(searchDataLoading());

      const promise = getInstruments({
        search_text: value,
      });

      promise
        .then(({ data }) => {
          data && dispatch(searchDataSuccess(data.instrument));
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          console.error(error);
        });

      return () => {
        promise.abort();
      };
    }
  }, [getInstruments, isFetch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsFetch(false);

    let timerToFetch: NodeJS.Timeout;

    if (value.length > 2) {
      dispatch(searchDataLoading());

      timerToFetch = setTimeout(() => {
        setIsFetch(true);
      }, 300);
    }

    return () => clearTimeout(timerToFetch);
  }, [value.length]);

  // для отключения анимации поиска при первичном маунте
  useEffect(() => {
    isMount?.current && setPassMount(true);

    isMount.current = true;

    isActiveSearch && inputRef?.current?.focus();

    return () => {
      dispatch(reset());
    };
  }, [isActiveSearch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (value.length < 3 && status !== 'initial') {
      dispatch(resetData());
    }
  }, [status, value.length]);

  return {
    dataStatistics,
    dataStatisticsCount,
    dispatch,
    inputRef,
    instrumentsList,
    isError: isErrorStatistics && isErrorCount,
    isLoading: isLoadingStatistics && isLoadingCount,
    passMount,
    pathname,
    setParamsCount,
    status,
    value,
  };
};

export default useSearch;

import { FC, memo, useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Button, Headline } from '@aurora/components';

import styles from '../../Search.module.pcss';
import InstrumentItem from '../InstrumentItem';
import { DEFAULT_VISIBLE, SHOW_LESS, SHOW_MORE } from './store';
import { IInstrumentGroup } from './types';

const InstrumentGroup: FC<IInstrumentGroup> = ({ groups, onRefetch }) => {
  const { instrumentGroupName = '' } = groups?.[0] || null;
  const [isMore, setIsMore] = useState(false);
  const instruments = isMore ? groups : groups.slice(0, DEFAULT_VISIBLE);

  const handleClick = useCallback(() => {
    setIsMore((more) => !more);
  }, []);

  const addonRightNode = useMemo(
    () => (
      <Button
        className={styles.button}
        classNameContent={styles.buttonContent}
        onClick={handleClick}
        proportion="mobileSE"
        size="s"
        variant="transparent"
      >
        {isMore ? SHOW_LESS : SHOW_MORE}
      </Button>
    ),
    [handleClick, isMore],
  );

  return (
    <>
      <Headline
        title={instrumentGroupName}
        size="xs"
        {...(groups.length > 3 && { addonRightNode })}
      />

      {instruments?.map((instrument, index) => (
        <InstrumentItem key={index} instrument={instrument} onRefetch={onRefetch} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentGroup);

import { FC, memo, useReducer } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { getRouteInstrument } from 'core/router/helpers';

import FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet';

import { InstrumentCardWithButton } from 'components/Instrument';

import { reset } from '../../actionCreators';
import { getInitialState, reducer } from '../../reducer';
import { IInstrumentItem } from './types';

const InstrumentItem: FC<IInstrumentItem> = ({ instrument, onRefetch }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, null, getInitialState);

  const { instrumentId, tradePlaceId, instrumentCategoryCode, favorite } = instrument;

  const location = getRouteInstrument(instrumentId, tradePlaceId, instrumentCategoryCode);

  const onClick = () => {
    navigate(location, { state: { from: 'search' } });
    dispatch(reset());
  };

  //**TODO: временное ограничение для прода */
  const isTestMode = !process.env.TIER || process.env.TIER === 'tt';

  return (
    <InstrumentCardWithButton
      {...instrument}
      onClick={isTestMode ? onClick : undefined}
      button={
        <FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet
          instrumentId={instrumentId}
          isFavorite={favorite}
          onRefetch={onRefetch}
          tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        />
      }
    />
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentItem);

import { FC, memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';

import InstrumentGroup from '../InstrumentGroup';
import styles from './ListResult.module.pcss';
import { groupInstruments } from './helpers';
import { INSTRUMENT_KEY_GROUP, NOT_FORUND } from './store';
import { IListResult } from './types';

const ListResult: FC<IListResult> = ({ instrumentsList, isLoading, onRefetch }) => {
  const instrumentsGroup = useMemo(
    () => instrumentsList?.length && groupInstruments(instrumentsList, INSTRUMENT_KEY_GROUP),
    [instrumentsList],
  );

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loading}>
        <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!instrumentsList?.length) {
    return <div className={styles.emptyContent}>{NOT_FORUND}</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.content}>
      {Object.values(instrumentsGroup).map((instruments, index) => (
        <InstrumentGroup key={index} groups={instruments} onRefetch={onRefetch} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(ListResult);

import { FC, memo, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';

import { Filter, Headline } from '@aurora/components';

import Section from 'components/Section';
import Wrapper from 'components/Wrapper';

import InstrumentStatistics from '../InstrumentStatistics';
import InstrumentTop from '../InstrumentTop';
import SortModal from '../SortModal';
import styles from './SectionStatistics.module.pcss';
import { EMPTY_CONTENT, LIST_SELECT, TITLE, TITLE_TOP } from './store';
import { ISectionStatistics } from './types';

const SectionStatistics: FC<ISectionStatistics> = ({
  current,
  isError,
  isLoading,
  list,
  listTop,
  onSort,
  setSortBottomSheet,
  sortBottomSheet,
}) => {
  const onClick = useCallback(() => setSortBottomSheet((prev) => !prev), [setSortBottomSheet]);

  const addonFilter = useMemo(
    () => (
      <Filter className={styles.filterContainer} onClick={onClick} shape="select" text={current} />
    ),
    [current, onClick],
  );

  if (isLoading || isError || (!list?.length && !listTop?.length)) {
    return <div className={styles.emptyContent}>{EMPTY_CONTENT}</div>;
  }

  return (
    <Section className={styles.section} theme="White">
      {!!list?.length && (
        <Section theme="White">
          <Headline className={styles.title} title={TITLE} size="xxs" />

          <Wrapper>
            {list.map(
              (
                {
                  instrumentCategoryCode,
                  instrumentId,
                  instrumentImageName,
                  instrumentName,
                  tradePlaceId,
                },
                index,
              ) => (
                <InstrumentStatistics
                  key={index}
                  id={instrumentId}
                  placeId={tradePlaceId}
                  code={instrumentCategoryCode}
                  name={instrumentName}
                  image={instrumentImageName}
                />
              ),
            )}
          </Wrapper>
        </Section>
      )}

      {!!listTop?.length && (
        <Section theme="White">
          <Headline
            addonRightNode={addonFilter}
            className={styles.title}
            size="xxs"
            title={TITLE_TOP}
          />

          <Wrapper className={styles.listWrapper}>
            <div className={styles.listContainer}>
              {listTop.map(
                (
                  {
                    instrumentCategoryCode,
                    instrumentId,
                    instrumentImageName,
                    instrumentName,
                    tradePlaceId,
                  },
                  index,
                ) => (
                  <InstrumentTop
                    key={index}
                    id={instrumentId}
                    placeId={tradePlaceId}
                    code={instrumentCategoryCode}
                    name={instrumentName}
                    image={instrumentImageName}
                  />
                ),
              )}
            </div>
          </Wrapper>
        </Section>
      )}

      <SortModal
        current={LIST_SELECT[0].code}
        onConfirm={onSort}
        open={sortBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setSortBottomSheet}
        list={LIST_SELECT}
      />
    </Section>
  );
};

export default memo(SectionStatistics);

import { FC, memo, useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { ReactComponent as SvgChecked } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import styles from './SortModal.module.pcss';
import { ISortModal } from './types';

const SortModal: FC<ISortModal> = ({ current, list, onConfirm, open, setOpen }) => {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(current);

  const ref = useRef<HTMLLabelElement[]>([]);

  const onDismiss = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);

    setSelected(current);
  }, [current, setOpen]);

  const handleChange = useCallback((event) => {
    setSelected(event.currentTarget.value);
  }, []);

  const onTouchMove = useCallback((event) => event.stopPropagation(), []);

  const onClickButton = useCallback(() => onConfirm(selected), [onConfirm, selected]);

  return (
    <BottomSheet onDismiss={onDismiss} onTouchMove={onTouchMove} open={open}>
      <div className={styles.list}>
        <div className={styles.listHeader}>
          <Text type="subtitleBold">Топ просмотров</Text>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.listBody}>
          {list.map(({ id, name, code }, index) => (
            <div key={index} className={styles.listItem}>
              <input
                checked={selected === code}
                className={styles.hide}
                id={`${id}`}
                name={name}
                onChange={handleChange}
                type="radio"
                value={code}
              />

              <label ref={(el) => el && (ref.current[id] = el)} htmlFor={`${id}`}>
                <Text type="lineRegular">{name}</Text>
              </label>

              <div className={styles.listChecked}>{selected === code && <SvgChecked />}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.listFooter}>
          <Button className={styles.button} onClick={onClickButton}>
            Применить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(SortModal);

import { shallowEqual } from 'react-redux';

import { Action, State } from './types';

export const getInitialState = (state?: null | Partial<State>): State => {
  return {
    status: 'initial',
    value: '',
    data: [],
  };
};

export const reducer = (state: State, update: Action): State => {
  const newState =
    typeof update === 'function' ? { ...state, ...update(state) } : { ...state, ...update };

  return shallowEqual(newState, state) ? state : newState;
};

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_FAVORITES_360, ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS } from 'const/routes';

import { ReactComponent as SearchSvg } from 'images/icons/search/search.svg';

import SearchHeader from '../../partials/SearchHeader';
import styles from './Search.module.pcss';
import { useButtons, useEvents, useSearch } from './hooks';
import ListResult from './partials/ListResult';
import SectionStatistics from './partials/SectionStatistics';
import { PARAMS_QUERY_STATISTICS, TODAY, getParamsQueryStatisticsCount } from './store';
import { ISearchProps, InputRefType } from './types';

const Search: FC<ISearchProps> = ({ handleClick, isActiveSearch, showIcon }) => {
  const {
    dataStatistics,
    dataStatisticsCount,
    dispatch,
    inputRef,
    instrumentsList,
    isError,
    isLoading,
    passMount,
    pathname,
    setParamsCount,
    status,
    value,
  } = useSearch({
    isActiveSearch,
    paramsQueryCount: getParamsQueryStatisticsCount(TODAY),
    paramsQueryStatistics: PARAMS_QUERY_STATISTICS,
  });

  const {
    current,
    changeInput,
    onCancelClick,
    onClear,
    onRefetch,
    onShowSearch,
    onSort,
    setSortBottomSheet,
    sortBottomSheet,
  } = useEvents({
    dispatch,
    handleClick,
    inputRef,
    setParamsCount,
  });

  const { addonAfter, addonRight } = useButtons({ value, onClear, onCancelClick });

  const isFavorites = pathname === ROUTE_FAVORITES_360 || pathname === ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS;

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className={cx(styles.wrapper, {
          [styles.wrapperFixed]: isFavorites,
          [styles.wrapperAbsolute]: !isFavorites,
          [styles.wrapperVisible]: isActiveSearch,
          [styles.wrapperHidden]: !isActiveSearch && passMount,
        })}
      >
        <SearchHeader
          addonAfter={addonAfter}
          addonRight={addonRight}
          classNameAddonAfter={styles.searchClear}
          inputRef={inputRef as InputRefType}
          onChange={changeInput}
          theme="light"
          themeSection="White"
          value={value}
        />

        {value?.length > 2 ? (
          <ListResult
            instrumentsList={instrumentsList}
            isLoading={status === 'loading'}
            onRefetch={onRefetch}
          />
        ) : (
          <SectionStatistics
            isError={isError}
            current={current}
            isLoading={isLoading}
            list={dataStatistics?.instrument}
            listTop={dataStatisticsCount?.instrument}
            onSort={onSort}
            setSortBottomSheet={setSortBottomSheet}
            sortBottomSheet={sortBottomSheet}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {showIcon && <SearchSvg onClick={onShowSearch} />}
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(Search);

import { InstrumentGroupParamsBlockType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Selections/types';

import { ShowcaseInstrument } from 'types/catalog';

export const prepareGroups = (
  blocks: InstrumentGroupParamsBlockType[],
  instruments: ShowcaseInstrument[],
) =>
  blocks.map((block) => ({
    ...block,
    instruments: instruments.filter((instrument) => {
      const instrumentBlockCode = instrument?.parameters
        ? JSON.parse(instrument?.parameters)?.instrumentBlockCode
        : undefined;
      return block.instrumentBlockID === instrumentBlockCode;
    }),
  }));

import { FC, Fragment, memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import {
  groupInstrumentsSelections,
  groupInstrumentsSelectionsDividends,
} from 'modules/Catalog/helpers';

import { FormattedBalance, InstrumentCard } from 'components';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { ISelectionsListProps } from './types';

const SelectionsList: FC<ISelectionsListProps> = ({
  instruments,
  groupType,
  groupName,
  categoryName = '',
}) => {
  const isDividends = groupType === 'DIVIDENDS';

  const instrumentsGroup = useMemo(() => {
    const notSortedInstrumentsGroup = isDividends
      ? Array.from(groupInstrumentsSelectionsDividends(instruments))
      : Array.from(groupInstrumentsSelections(instruments));

    return [...notSortedInstrumentsGroup].sort((left, right) => {
      return (
        DateTime.fromISO(right[1][0].lastDayCanBuy || '').toSeconds() -
        DateTime.fromISO(left[1][0].lastDayCanBuy || '').toSeconds()
      );
    });
  }, [isDividends, instruments]);

  return (
    <div className={cx(instrumentsGroup.length < 3 && styles.wrapper)}>
      {instrumentsGroup.map(([type, inst]) => (
        <Fragment key={type}>
          {instrumentsGroup.length > 1 && (
            <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.type}>
              {type}
            </Text>
          )}
          {inst.map((el) => (
            <InstrumentCard
              key={`${el.instrumentId}-${el.tradePlaceId}`}
              price={el.lastPrice}
              customPriceDiff={
                isDividends && (
                  <div className={styles.dividendsPrice}>
                    {el.paymentProfitability && (
                      <>
                        доход &nbsp;
                        <FormattedBalance value={el.paymentProfitability} currency={'PRC'} />
                      </>
                    )}
                    {el.paymentPerUnit && (
                      <>
                        &nbsp;(
                        <FormattedBalance value={el.paymentPerUnit} currency={el.priceCurrency} />)
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )
              }
              favorite={el.isFavorite}
              groupType={groupType}
              categoryName={categoryName}
              {...el}
              groupName={groupName}
            />
          ))}
        </Fragment>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(SelectionsList);

import { HeaderPage, NotInvestRecommendation } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as PdfSvg } from 'images/icons/pdf.svg';

import Footer from './components/Footer';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const Selections: FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { groupCode = '' } = useParams();

  const categoryName = searchParams.get('categoryName') || '';

  const { data, isError, isLoading } = useGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery({
    groupCode,
    daysPeriodPriceDiff: 1,
  });

  const {
    data: dictionaries,
    isLoading: isDictionariesLoading,
    isError: isDictionariesError,
  } = useGetDictionariesQuery({ url: '/disclaimer' });

  const instrumentGroup = data?.showcaseInstrumentGroup[0];
  const params = useMemo(
    () =>
      instrumentGroup?.params
        ? (JSON.parse(instrumentGroup?.params) as InstrumentGroupParamsType)
        : undefined,
    [instrumentGroup?.params],
  );
  return (
    <>
      {isLoading || isDictionariesLoading || isError || isDictionariesError || !data ? (
        <>
          <HeaderPage
            leftIconVariant="back"
            onLeftIconClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_CATALOG)}
            documentTitle={instrumentGroup?.smallGroupName || 'Подборки'}
          />
          {isLoading || isDictionariesLoading ? <SkeletonSelections /> : <Error />}
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <div className={styles.content}>
            <SelectionsHeader
              groupName={instrumentGroup?.groupName}
              smallGroupName={instrumentGroup?.smallGroupName}
              groupImageName={instrumentGroup?.groupImageName}
              onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_CATALOG)}
              className={styles.indent}
            />
            {instrumentGroup?.comment && (
              <Description className={styles.description}>{instrumentGroup?.comment}</Description>
            )}
            {params?.groupDescriptionFileName && params?.groupDescriptionFileComment && (
              <SmartLink
                className={styles.descriptionPdfContainer}
                href={params?.groupDescriptionFileName}
                rel="noreferrer"
                target="_blank"
              >
                <InformationCell
                  addonRight={<PdfSvg />}
                  className={styles.descriptionPdf}
                  separator={false}
                  title={params?.groupDescriptionFileComment}
                />
              </SmartLink>
            )}
            {data && params?.groupViewInstrumentsDisplaying !== 'B' && (
              <SelectionsList
                categoryName={categoryName}
                groupName={instrumentGroup?.groupName}
                groupType={instrumentGroup?.groupType}
                instruments={data.showcaseInstrument}
              />
            )}
            {data && params?.groupViewInstrumentsDisplaying === 'B' && params?.blocks && (
              <SelectionBlocks blocks={params?.blocks} instruments={data.showcaseInstrument} />
            )}
            {dictionaries && (
              <NotInvestRecommendation
                text={dictionaries?.disclaimer[0].disclaimerShort}
                description={dictionaries?.disclaimer[0].disclaimer}
              />
            )}
          </div>
          {instrumentGroup?.groupType === 'DIVIDENDS' && <Footer />}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(Selections);

import React, { FC, useRef } from 'react';

import { Filter as FilterComponent } from '@aurora/components';

import { IFilterProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/components/Filter/types';
import HiddenInput from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/components/HiddenInput';

const Filter: FC<IFilterProps> = ({ id, value, selected, onChange, text, ...props }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleClick = () => ref?.current?.click();

  return (
    <>
      <HiddenInput
        ref={ref}
        id={`filter-${id}`}
        name={text}
        type="radio"
        value={value}
        checked={selected === value}
        onChange={onChange}
      />
      <FilterComponent
        shape="toggle"
        text={text}
        active={selected === value}
        indent={false}
        onClick={handleClick}
        {...props}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default Filter;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import HiddenInput from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/components/HiddenInput';

import { ReactComponent as SvgArrow } from 'images/raw-icons/arrow-down.svg';

import styles from './GroupItem.module.pcss';
import { useEvents } from './hooks';
import { ASC_ORDER, DESC_ORDER } from './store';
import { IGroupItem } from './types';

const GroupItem: FC<IGroupItem> = ({ icon: Icon, id, label, onChange, selected, value }) => {
  const { handleClick, isSelected, ref, selectedValue } = useEvents({ selected, value });

  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.listItem, styles.listItemGroup)}>
      {<Icon onClick={handleClick} />}

      <HiddenInput
        checked={selected === value}
        id={`groupItem-${id}`}
        onChange={onChange}
        type="checkbox"
        value={value}
      />

      <label ref={ref} htmlFor={`groupItem-${id}`}>
        <Text type="lineRegular">{label}</Text>

        {isSelected && (
          <Text color="colorForeground2" type="labelRegular" tag="span">
            {selectedValue === value ? DESC_ORDER : ASC_ORDER}
          </Text>
        )}
      </label>

      {isSelected && (
        <div
          className={cx(styles.listChecked, {
            [styles.listCheckedUp]: selectedValue !== value,
          })}
          onClick={handleClick}
        >
          <SvgArrow />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(GroupItem);

import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

import { TUseEvents } from './types';

const useEvents = ({ selected, value }: TUseEvents) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLLabelElement>(null);

  const handleClick = useCallback(() => ref?.current?.click(), [ref]);

  const isSelected = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selected) return false;

    const regExpValue = new RegExp(value);

    return regExpValue.test(selected);
  }, [selected, value]);

  const selectedValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selected) return value;

    return `${selected.slice(0, value.length)}${/\+/.test(selected) ? '+' : ''}`;
  }, [selected, value]);

  return {
    handleClick,
    isSelected,
    ref,
    selectedValue,
  };
};

export default useEvents;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import FilterBar from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/partials/FilterBar';
import GroupItem from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/partials/GroupItem/GroupItem';
import ListItem from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/partials/ListItem/ListItem';

import { IItemProps } from './types';

const Item: FC<IItemProps> = ({
  item,
  handleChangeSort,
  handleChangeDate,
  selectedDate,
  selectedSort,
}) => {
  if (item.type === 'group') {
    return <GroupItem onChange={handleChangeSort} selected={selectedSort || ''} {...item} />;
  }
  if (item.type === 'list') {
    return <ListItem onChange={handleChangeDate} selected={selectedDate || ''} {...item} />;
  }
  if (item.type === 'filter-bar') {
    return <FilterBar onChange={handleChangeDate} selected={selectedDate || ''} {...item} />;
  }
  return null;
};

export default memo(Item);

import { FC, MouseEvent, memo, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import HiddenInput from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/components/HiddenInput';

import { ReactComponent as SvgChecked } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import styles from '../../SortBottomSheet.module.pcss';
import { IRenderListItem } from './types';

const ListItem: FC<IRenderListItem> = ({ icon: Icon, id, label, onChange, selected, value }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLLabelElement[]>([]);

  const handleClick = useCallback(
    (index: number) => (e: MouseEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (ref.current[index]) {
        ref.current[index].click();
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  return (
    <div className={styles.listItem} onClick={handleClick(id)}>
      <Icon />

      <HiddenInput
        id={String(id)}
        name={label}
        type="radio"
        value={value}
        checked={selected === value}
        onChange={onChange}
      />

      <label ref={(el) => (ref.current[id] = el as HTMLLabelElement)} htmlFor={String(id)}>
        <Text type="lineRegular">{label}</Text>
      </label>

      {selected === value && (
        <div>
          <SvgChecked />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(ListItem);

import { ChangeEvent, FC, memo, useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, HeadlineBottomSheet } from '@aurora/components';

import Item from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/partials/Item';

import styles from './SortBottomSheet.module.pcss';
import { BUTTON_VALUE, BUTTON_VALUE_RESET, TITLE_MODAL } from './store';
import { ISortBottomSheetProps, ListType } from './types';

const SortBottomSheet: FC<ISortBottomSheetProps> = ({
  currentSortPrice,
  isResetButton,
  list,
  onConfirm,
  open,
  setOpen,
}) => {
  const currentSortList = currentSortPrice?.replace(/[+-]$/g, '');
  const [selectedSort, setSelectedSort] = useState<string | null | undefined>(
    currentSortPrice?.replace(/-$/g, ''),
  );
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(currentSortList);

  const getDefaultValue = (list?: ListType[]) => {
    if (!list) return;
    for (const el of list) {
      if ('items' in el) {
        const defaultItem = el.items.find((item) => item?.default);

        if (defaultItem) {
          return defaultItem.value;
        }
      } else if (el?.default) {
        return el.value;
      }
    }
  };

  const handleChangeSort = useCallback(
    (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const { checked, value } = event.target;

      if (!selectedDate) {
        const date = getDefaultValue(list);
        setSelectedDate(date);
      }

      setSelectedSort(checked ? value : `${value}+`);
    },
    [list, selectedDate],
  );

  const handleChangeDate = useCallback(
    (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (!selectedSort) {
        const sort = getDefaultValue(list);
        setSelectedSort(sort);
      }

      setSelectedDate(event.currentTarget.value);
    },
    [list, selectedSort],
  );

  const onDismiss = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);
    setSelectedSort(currentSortPrice);
    setSelectedDate(currentSortList);
  }, [currentSortList, currentSortPrice, setOpen]);

  const onTouchMove = useCallback((event) => event.stopPropagation(), []);

  const onClickButton = useCallback(
    () => onConfirm(selectedSort, selectedDate),
    [onConfirm, selectedDate, selectedSort],
  );

  const onClickReset = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectedSort('');
    setSelectedDate('');
  }, []);

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      expandOnContentDrag={false}
      initialFocusRef={false}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onTouchMove={onTouchMove}
      open={open}
    >
      <div className={styles.list}>
        <HeadlineBottomSheet
          title={TITLE_MODAL}
          addonRight={
            isResetButton && (
              <Button
                disabled={!selectedSort && !selectedDate}
                onClick={onClickReset}
                proportion="mobileSE"
                shape="text"
                size="s"
                variant="negative"
              >
                {BUTTON_VALUE_RESET}
              </Button>
            )
          }
        />
        <div className={styles.listBody}>
          {list?.map((item, index) => (
            <Item
              key={index}
              item={item}
              handleChangeSort={handleChangeSort}
              handleChangeDate={handleChangeDate}
              selectedSort={selectedSort}
              selectedDate={selectedDate}
            />
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.listFooter}>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={onClickButton}>
            {BUTTON_VALUE}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(SortBottomSheet);

import { IFilterProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/components/Filter';
import { IFilterBarProps } from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/partials/FilterBar';
import { IGroupItem } from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/partials/GroupItem';
import { IRenderListItem } from 'modules/Catalog/components/SortBottomSheet/partials/ListItem';

export type BaseListType = {
  default?: boolean;
};

export type ListType = BaseListType &
  (
    | ({
        type: 'group';
      } & Pick<IGroupItem, 'id' | 'icon' | 'label' | 'value'>)
    | ({ type: 'list' } & Pick<IRenderListItem, 'id' | 'icon' | 'label' | 'value'>)
    | ({ type: 'filter-bar' } & { items: (IFilterProps & BaseListType)[] })
  );

export interface ISortBottomSheetProps {
  currentSortPrice?: string | null;
  list?: ListType[];
  onConfirm(sortOnPrice?: string | null, sortOnDate?: string | null): void;
  open: boolean;
  setOpen(isOpen: boolean): void;
  isResetButton?: boolean;
}

import React, { ChangeEvent, FC, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { SortDates, SortPrices } from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Stocks/types';
import { DEFAULT_SORT_LIST_OLD } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import { ReactComponent as SvgChecked } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type SortBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  onConfirm: (sortOnPrice: SortPrices, sortOnDate: SortDates) => void;
  setOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  currentSortPrice: SortPrices;
  currentSortDate: SortDates;
  list?: typeof DEFAULT_SORT_LIST_OLD;
};

type RenderListItem = {
  id: number;
  label: string;
  icon: React.FunctionComponent<React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> & { title?: string | undefined }>;
  value: string;
  selected: SortPrices | SortDates;
  onChange: (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
};

const SortBottomSheet: FC<SortBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  onConfirm,
  setOpen,
  currentSortDate,
  currentSortPrice,
  list = DEFAULT_SORT_LIST_OLD,
}) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLLabelElement[]>([]);
  const [selectedSort, setSelectedSort] = useState<SortPrices>(currentSortPrice);
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState<SortDates>(currentSortDate);
  const handleChangeSort = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setSelectedSort(event.currentTarget.value as SortPrices);
  };
  const handleChangeDate = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setSelectedDate(event.currentTarget.value as SortDates);
  };

  const onDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    setSelectedSort(currentSortPrice);
    setSelectedDate(currentSortDate);
  };

  const handleClick = (index: number) => (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (ref.current[index]) ref.current[index].click();
  };

  const renderListItem = ({ value, id, icon: Icon, label, selected, onChange }: RenderListItem) => (
    <div key={id} className={styles.sortItem} onClick={handleClick(id)}>
      <Icon />
      <input
        id={String(id)}
        className={styles.hide}
        name={label}
        type="radio"
        value={value}
        checked={selected === value}
        onChange={onChange}
      />
      <label ref={(el) => (ref.current[id] = el as HTMLLabelElement)} htmlFor={String(id)}>
        <Text type="lineRegular">{label}</Text>
      </label>
      <div className={styles.checked}>{selected === value && <SvgChecked />}</div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      initialFocusRef={false}
      expandOnContentDrag={false}
    >
      <div className={styles.content}>
        <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.title}>
          Сортировка
        </Text>
        {list?.[0]?.map((el) =>
          renderListItem({ onChange: handleChangeSort, selected: selectedSort, ...el }),
        )}
        <div className={styles.border} />
        {list?.[1]?.map((el) =>
          renderListItem({ onChange: handleChangeDate, selected: selectedDate, ...el }),
        )}
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          className={styles.button}
          onClick={() => onConfirm(selectedSort, selectedDate)}
        >
          Применить
        </Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default SortBottomSheet;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet } from '@aurora/components';

import { FAQ_BOTTOM_SHEET_VARIANTS } from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/consts';
import { FAQBottomSheetPropsType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/types';

import styles from './FAQBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const FAQBottomSheet: FC<FAQBottomSheetPropsType> = ({ variant, onClose }) => {
  const Header = variant && FAQ_BOTTOM_SHEET_VARIANTS[variant].header;
  const Footer = variant && FAQ_BOTTOM_SHEET_VARIANTS[variant].footer;
  const Content = variant && FAQ_BOTTOM_SHEET_VARIANTS[variant].content;
  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={Boolean(variant)}
      onDismiss={onClose}
      header={Header && <Header />}
      footer={Footer && <Footer onClose={onClose} />}
      initialFocusRef={false}
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
    >
      {Content && <Content />}
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(FAQBottomSheet);

import { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, HeadlineBottomSheet } from '@aurora/components';

import {
  RiskFilterType,
  RiskSortBottomSheetPropsType,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/types';

import { SelectableCell } from 'components';

import styles from './RiskFilterBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const RiskFilterBottomSheet: FC<RiskSortBottomSheetPropsType> = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onSortChange,
  currentRisk,
}) => {
  const [tempRisk, setTempRisk] = useState<RiskFilterType>(currentRisk);

  const handleTempRiskChange = (newSort: RiskFilterType) => () => setTempRisk(newSort);

  const handleApplyFilterChange = () => {
    onSortChange(tempRisk);
    onClose();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentRisk === tempRisk) return;
    setTempRisk(currentRisk);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onClose}>
      <HeadlineBottomSheet title={'Риск'} />
      <SelectableCell
        variant={'indicator'}
        checked={tempRisk === 'all'}
        onClick={handleTempRiskChange('all')}
        separator={false}
      >
        Все
      </SelectableCell>
      <SelectableCell
        variant={'indicator'}
        checked={tempRisk === 'low'}
        onClick={handleTempRiskChange('low')}
        separator={false}
      >
        Низкий
      </SelectableCell>
      <SelectableCell
        variant={'indicator'}
        checked={tempRisk === 'medium'}
        onClick={handleTempRiskChange('medium')}
        separator={false}
      >
        Средний
      </SelectableCell>
      <SelectableCell
        variant={'indicator'}
        checked={tempRisk === 'high'}
        onClick={handleTempRiskChange('high')}
        separator={false}
      >
        Высокий
      </SelectableCell>
      <div className={styles.buttonContainer}>
        <Button onClick={handleApplyFilterChange}>Применить</Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(RiskFilterBottomSheet);

import { FC, memo } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_FUND_DETAILS, ROUTE_STRATEGY_DETAILS } from 'const/routes';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { TrustManagementCellPropsType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/types';

import { FormattedBalance, InstrumentIcon } from 'components';

import styles from './TrustManagementCell.module.pcss';

const TrustManagementCell: FC<TrustManagementCellPropsType> = ({
  from,
  type,
  instrumentId,
  instrumentImageName,
  shortTitleOi,
  diff,
  riskType,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleClick = () => {
    navigate(
      generatePath(type === 'pif' ? ROUTE_FUND_DETAILS : ROUTE_STRATEGY_DETAILS, {
        instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      }),
    );
    reachGoal('uk', 'catalog_uk_card_product_view', {
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      from,
      type,
    });
  };
  return (
    <div className={styles.container} onClick={handleClick}>
      <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />
      <div className={styles.content}>
        <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>{shortTitleOi}</Text>
        <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          {riskType ? riskType : '—'} риск
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.diffContainer}>
        <div className={styles.diff}>
          {(typeof diff === 'number' || diff == null) && (
            <FormattedBalance type={'lineRegular'} diff={diff} />
          )}
          {typeof diff === 'string' && (
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorConstructive'}>
              +{diff.replace('.', ',')}
            </Text>
          )}
          {type === 'iic' && <Text type={'lineRegular'}>годовых</Text>}
        </div>
        <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          {type === 'pif' ? 'за прошлый год' : 'можно заработать'}
        </Text>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(TrustManagementCell);

--- FILE: src\modules\Catalog\components\TurnkeySolutions\helpers.ts ---

import { RISK_FILTERS_MAP } from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/consts';
import { RiskFilterType, YieldSortType } from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/types';

import { InstrumentShowcaseFund, InstrumentShowcaseStrategy } from 'types/catalog';

export const filterInstruments = <T extends { riskType: string }>(
  instruments: T[],
  filter: RiskFilterType,
) => {
  return filter === 'all'
    ? instruments
    : instruments.filter((f) => {
        return f.riskType === RISK_FILTERS_MAP[filter];
      });
};

export const sortFunds = (instruments: InstrumentShowcaseFund[], sortBy: YieldSortType) => {
  return [...instruments].sort((a, b) => {
    if (!b.oneYear) return -1;
    if (!a.oneYear) return 1;
    if (sortBy === 'descending') {
      return b.oneYear - a.oneYear;
    }
    return a.oneYear - b.oneYear;
  });
};

export const parseYield = (yieldStr: string) =>
  Number(yieldStr.match(/[+-]?\d*[,.]?\d+/)?.[0]?.replace(',', '.'));

export const sortStrategies = (
  instruments: InstrumentShowcaseStrategy[],
  sortBy: YieldSortType,
) => {
  return [...instruments].sort((a, b) => {
    const parsedYieldA = parseYield(a.yield);
    const parsedYieldB = parseYield(b.yield);
    if (Number.isNaN(parsedYieldA) || Number.isNaN(parsedYieldB)) return 0;
    if (Number.isNaN(parsedYieldB)) return -1;
    if (Number.isNaN(parsedYieldA)) return 1;
    if (sortBy === 'descending') {
      return parsedYieldB - parsedYieldA;
    }
    return parsedYieldA - parsedYieldB;
  });
};

export const getFilteredAndSortedFunds = (
  instruments: InstrumentShowcaseFund[] | undefined,
  filter: RiskFilterType,
  sortBy: YieldSortType,
) => {
  if (!instruments) return;
  const filteredInstruments = filterInstruments<InstrumentShowcaseFund>(instruments, filter);
  return sortFunds(filteredInstruments, sortBy);
};

export const getFilteredAndSortedStrategies = (
  instruments: InstrumentShowcaseStrategy[] | undefined,
  filter: RiskFilterType,
  sortBy: YieldSortType,
) => {
  if (!instruments) return;
  const filteredInstruments = filterInstruments<InstrumentShowcaseStrategy>(instruments, filter);
  return sortStrategies(filteredInstruments, sortBy);
};

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Filter, FilterBar } from '@aurora/components';
import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { useGetFundsQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';

import FAQ from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/components/FAQ/FAQ';
import RiskFilterBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/components/RiskFilterBottomSheet/RiskFilterBottomSheet';
import TrustManagementCell from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/components/TrustManagementCell/TrustManagementCell';
import YieldSortBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/components/YieldSortBottomSheet/YieldSortBottomSheet';
import {
  PIF_QUESTIONS,
  RISK_FILTERS_NAMES,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/consts';
import { getFilteredAndSortedFunds } from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/helpers';
import {
  BottomSheetType,
  RiskFilterType,
  YieldSortType,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/types';

import { DisclaimerUK, HeaderPage } from 'components';

const Funds = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [open, setOpen] = useState<BottomSheetType | null>(null);

  const [sortByYield, setSortByYield] = useState<YieldSortType>('descending');
  const [riskFilter, setRiskFilter] = useState<RiskFilterType>('all');

  const now = useMemo(() => DateTime.now().toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT), []);

  const { data, isLoading } = useGetFundsQuery({
    structureSiteShow: 1,
    sortOrder: 'OneYear',
    dateLKOIEnd: now,
  });
  const { instrumentShowcaseFund } = data || {};

  const sortedAndFilteredInstruments = useMemo(() => {
    return getFilteredAndSortedFunds(instrumentShowcaseFund, riskFilter, sortByYield);
  }, [instrumentShowcaseFund, sortByYield, riskFilter]);

  const handleBack = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const handleYieldSortChange = (sortBy: YieldSortType) => setSortByYield(sortBy);
  const handleRiskFilterChange = (sortBy: RiskFilterType) => setRiskFilter(sortBy);

  const handleBottomSheetOpen = (bottomSheet: BottomSheetType) => () => setOpen(bottomSheet);

  const handleBottomSheetClose = () => setOpen(null);

  if (isLoading) return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title={'Паевые фонды'} leftIconVariant={'back'} onLeftIconClick={handleBack} />
      <FilterBar>
        <Filter
          shape={'sort'}
          text={'По доходности'}
          sortDirection={sortByYield === 'descending' ? 'down' : 'up'}
          onClick={handleBottomSheetOpen('yield')}
        />
        <Filter
          shape={'select'}
          text={RISK_FILTERS_NAMES[riskFilter]}
          onClick={handleBottomSheetOpen('risk')}
        />
      </FilterBar>
      {sortedAndFilteredInstruments?.map((el) => (
        <TrustManagementCell
          key={`${el.instrumentId}_${el.tradePlaceId}`}
          from="show_all"
          type={'pif'}
          instrumentId={el.instrumentId}
          shortTitleOi={el.shortTitleOi}
          instrumentImageName={el.instrumentImageName}
          diff={el.oneYear}
          riskType={el.riskType}
        />
      ))}
      <FAQ questions={PIF_QUESTIONS} />
      <DisclaimerUK field={'disclaimerUk'} />
      <YieldSortBottomSheet
        open={open === 'yield'}
        onClose={handleBottomSheetClose}
        currentSortBy={sortByYield}
        onSortChange={handleYieldSortChange}
      />
      <RiskFilterBottomSheet
        open={open === 'risk'}
        onClose={handleBottomSheetClose}
        currentRisk={riskFilter}
        onSortChange={handleRiskFilterChange}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default Funds;

import { memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';
import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { ROUTE_FUNDS } from 'const/routes';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { useGetFundsQuery, useGetStrategiesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

//import Categories from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/components/Categories/Categories';
import FAQ from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/components/FAQ/FAQ';
import Showcase from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/components/Showcase/Showcase';
import { TURNKEY_SOLUTIONS_QUESTIONS } from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/consts';

import { DisclaimerUK } from 'components';
import { TrustManagementCardProps } from 'components/TrustManagementCard/types';

const TurnkeySolutions = () => {
  const now = useMemo(() => DateTime.now().toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT), []);
  const { data: fundsResponse, isLoading: isFundsLoading } = useGetFundsQuery({
    structureSiteShow: 1,
    dateLKOIEnd: now,
  });
  const { data: strategiesResponse, isLoading: isStrategiesLoading } = useGetStrategiesQuery({
    structureSiteShow: 1,
    dateLKOIEnd: now,
  });

  const isLoading = isFundsLoading || isStrategiesLoading;

  if (isLoading) return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;

  const { instrumentShowcaseFund } = fundsResponse || {};
  // const { instrumentShowcaseStrategy } = strategiesResponse || {};

  const handleCardClick = (instrumentId: number, type: string) => {
    reachGoal('uk', 'catalog_uk_card_product_view', {
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      type,
      from: 'ready_solutions',
    });
  };

  const fundShowcase: TrustManagementCardProps[] | undefined = instrumentShowcaseFund?.map(
    (el) => ({
      type: 'pif',
      instrumentId: el.instrumentId,
      shortTitleOI: el.shortTitleOi,
      instrumentImageName: el.instrumentImageName,
      diff: el.oneYear,
      riskType: el.riskType,
      onClick: handleCardClick,
    }),
  );
  // const strategyShowcase: TrustManagementCardProps[] | undefined = instrumentShowcaseStrategy?.map(
  //   (el) => ({
  //     type: 'iic',
  //     instrumentId: el.instrumentId,
  //     shortTitleOI: el.shortTitleOi,
  //     instrumentImageName: el.instrumentImageName,
  //     diff: el.yield,
  //     riskType: el.riskType,
  //     onClick: handleCardClick,
  //   }),
  // );
  return (
    <>
      {/* <Categories /> */}
      <Showcase type="pif" name="Паевые фонды" items={fundShowcase} to={ROUTE_FUNDS} />
      {/*<Showcase type="iic" name="Стратегии ИИС" items={strategyShowcase} to={ROUTE_STRATEGIES} />*/}
      <FAQ questions={TURNKEY_SOLUTIONS_QUESTIONS} />
      <DisclaimerUK field="disclaimerUk" />
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(TurnkeySolutions);

import {
  FILTER_INSTRUMENTS_CASES,
  FUND_1,
  FUND_2,
  FUND_3,
  FUND_4,
  GET_FILTERED_AND_SORTED_FUNDS_CASES,

  SORT_STRATEGIES_CASES,
  STRATEGY_1,
  STRATEGY_2,
  STRATEGY_3,
  STRATEGY_4,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/__tests__/fixture';
import {
  filterInstruments,
  getFilteredAndSortedFunds,
  getFilteredAndSortedStrategies,
  parseYield,
  sortFunds,
  sortStrategies,
} from 'modules/Catalog/components/TurnkeySolutions/helpers';

import { InstrumentShowcaseStrategy } from 'types/catalog';

describe('filterInstruments', () => {
  it('should return all instruments when filter is "all"', () => {
    expect(filterInstruments(FILTER_INSTRUMENTS_CASES, 'all')).toEqual(FILTER_INSTRUMENTS_CASES);
  });
  it('should filter instruments by risk type', () => {
    expect(filterInstruments(FILTER_INSTRUMENTS_CASES, 'low')).toEqual([FUND_3]);
    expect(filterInstruments(FILTER_INSTRUMENTS_CASES, 'medium')).toEqual([FUND_2]);
    expect(filterInstruments(FILTER_INSTRUMENTS_CASES, 'high')).toEqual([FUND_4]);
  });
});

describe('sortFunds', () => {
  it('should sort funds in ascending order by default', () => {
    const sortedFunds = sortFunds(SORT_FUNDS_CASES, 'ascending');
    expect(sortedFunds).toEqual([FUND_1, FUND_2, FUND_3]);
  });

  it('should sort funds in descending order if specified', () => {
    const sortedFunds = sortFunds(SORT_FUNDS_CASES, 'descending');
    expect(sortedFunds).toEqual([FUND_3, FUND_2, FUND_1]);
  });
});

describe('parseYield', () => {
  it('should parse a positive integer yield string', () => {
    expect(parseYield('5')).toEqual(5);
  });

  it('should parse a negative integer yield string', () => {
    expect(parseYield('-5')).toEqual(-5);
  });

  it('should parse a yield string with a decimal point', () => {
    expect(parseYield('3.14')).toEqual(3.14);
  });

  it('should parse a yield string with a comma separator', () => {
    expect(parseYield('2,5')).toEqual(2.5);
  });

  it('should parse a yield string with a leading plus sign', () => {
    expect(parseYield('+2.5')).toEqual(2.5);
  });

  it('should parse a yield string with a leading minus sign', () => {
    expect(parseYield('-2.5')).toEqual(-2.5);
  });

  it('should return NaN for a non-numeric yield string', () => {
    expect(parseYield('not a number')).toBeNaN();
  });

  it('should return NaN for an empty yield string', () => {
    expect(parseYield('')).toBeNaN();
  });

  it('should return NaN for a yield string with no digits', () => {
    expect(parseYield('+-')).toBeNaN();
  });
});

describe('sortStrategies', () => {
  test('should sort instruments by ascending yield', () => {
    const sorted = sortStrategies(SORT_STRATEGIES_CASES, 'ascending');
    expect(sorted).toEqual([STRATEGY_1, STRATEGY_2, STRATEGY_3, STRATEGY_4]);
  });

  test('should sort instruments by descending yield', () => {
    const sorted = sortStrategies(SORT_STRATEGIES_CASES, 'descending');
    expect(sorted).toEqual([STRATEGY_4, STRATEGY_3, STRATEGY_2, STRATEGY_1]);
  });

  test('should return the same array when given an empty array', () => {
    const sorted = sortStrategies([], 'ascending');
    expect(sorted).toEqual([]);
  });

  test('should handle invalid yield values', () => {
    const invalidYieldInstrument = { yield: 'abc%', title: 'Invalid Yield Instrument' };
    const instrumentsWithInvalidYield = [
      ...SORT_STRATEGIES_CASES,
      invalidYieldInstrument,
    ] as InstrumentShowcaseStrategy[];
    const sorted = sortStrategies(instrumentsWithInvalidYield, 'ascending');
    expect(sorted).toEqual([
      STRATEGY_1,
      STRATEGY_2,
      STRATEGY_3,
      STRATEGY_4,
      invalidYieldInstrument,
    ]);
  });
});

describe('getFilteredAndSortedFunds', () => {
  test('should return undefined when given undefined instruments', () => {
    const filteredAndSorted = getFilteredAndSortedFunds(undefined, 'high', 'ascending');
    expect(filteredAndSorted).toBeUndefined();

  test('should filter by risk and sort by ascending yield', () => {

import { cloneDeep, isObject, mergeWith, pick } from 'lodash';

import { CATALOG_FILTERS, CATALOG_FILTERS_KEY } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { CatalogFiltersType } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

const customizer = (objValue: unknown, srcValue: unknown): unknown => {
  if (isObject(objValue) && isObject(srcValue)) {
    return mergeWith(objValue, pick(srcValue, Object.keys(objValue)), customizer);
  }
};

const deepMergeExcluding = (source: unknown, target: unknown): unknown => {
  return mergeWith(source, target, customizer);
};

// первично сетим в PrivatePage
export const initCatalogFilters = () => {
  const catalogFilters = window.localStorage.getItem(CATALOG_FILTERS_KEY);
  if (!catalogFilters) {
    window.localStorage.setItem(CATALOG_FILTERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(CATALOG_FILTERS));
    return;
  }
  const parsedCatalogFilters = JSON.parse(catalogFilters);
  const mergedFilters = deepMergeExcluding(cloneDeep(CATALOG_FILTERS), parsedCatalogFilters);
  window.localStorage.setItem(CATALOG_FILTERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(mergedFilters));
};

export const getCatalogFilters = (): CatalogFiltersType =>
  JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(CATALOG_FILTERS_KEY) as string);

export const setCatalogFilters = (filters: CatalogFiltersType) => {
  return window.localStorage.setItem(CATALOG_FILTERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(filters));
};

export const resetCatalogFilters = () => {
  window.localStorage.setItem(CATALOG_FILTERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(CATALOG_FILTERS));
};

import {
  ROUTE_CATALOG,
  ROUTE_FAVORITES,
  ROUTE_FAVORITES_360,
  ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS,
  ROUTE_TURNKEY_SOLUTIONS,
} from 'const/routes';

import { CATALOG_LINKS, FAVORITES_LINKS } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

export const getCatalogTabs = (pathname: string) => {
  switch (pathname) {
    case ROUTE_FAVORITES_360:
    case ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS:
      return FAVORITES_LINKS;
    case ROUTE_CATALOG:
    case ROUTE_FAVORITES:
    case ROUTE_TURNKEY_SOLUTIONS:
      return CATALOG_LINKS;
    default:
      return null;
  }
};


--- FILE: src\modules\Catalog\helpers\graphPrepare.ts ---

import { GraphHistoryType } from 'types/catalog';

export const graphPrepare = <T extends { instrumentId: number }>(
  data: T[],
  history: GraphHistoryType[],
) => {
  return data.map((i) => {
    const quote: number[] = [];

    history.forEach((j) => {
      if (i.instrumentId === j.instrumentId) {
        quote.push(j.quote);
      }
    });

    return { ...i, history: quote };
  });
};

import { ShowcaseInstrument } from 'types/catalog';

export const groupInstrumentsSelections = (instruments: ShowcaseInstrument[]) => {
  const result = new Map<string, ShowcaseInstrument[]>();
  instruments.forEach((inst) => {
    if (!result.has(inst.instrumentGroupName)) {
      result.set(inst.instrumentGroupName, [inst]);
    } else {
      result.get(inst.instrumentGroupName)!.push(inst);
    }
  });
  return result;
};


--- FILE: src\modules\Catalog\helpers\groupInstrumentsSelectionsDividends.ts ---

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { ShowcaseInstrument } from 'types/catalog';

export const groupInstrumentsSelectionsDividends = (instruments: ShowcaseInstrument[]) => {
  const result = new Map<string, ShowcaseInstrument[]>();
  const today = DateTime.now().toFormat('dd MMMM');

  [...instruments]
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        DateTime.fromISO(b.lastDayCanBuy || '').toSeconds() -
        DateTime.fromISO(a.lastDayCanBuy || '').toSeconds(),
    )
    .forEach((inst) => {
      if (inst.lastDayCanBuy) {
        const lastDayCanBuyDate = DateTime.fromISO(inst.lastDayCanBuy).toFormat('dd MMMM');
        const isEqualToToday = lastDayCanBuyDate === today;
        if (!result.has(lastDayCanBuyDate) || (isEqualToToday && !result.has('Сегодня'))) {
          result.set(isEqualToToday ? 'Сегодня' : lastDayCanBuyDate, [inst]);
        } else {
          result.get(isEqualToToday ? 'Сегодня' : lastDayCanBuyDate)!.push(inst);
        }
      }
    });
  return result;
};

import { FutureSortingType } from 'types/catalog';

export const TextFilterWithSorting = ({
  text,
  additionalText = false,
}: {
  text: FutureSortingType;
  additionalText?: boolean;
}) => {
  const filterName = text?.slice(0, -1);
  return (
    <>
      {text?.includes('-') ? 'По убыванию' : 'По возрастанию'} &bull;{' '}
      {filterName === 'PRICE_6_MONTHS'
        ? additionalText
          ? 'Изменения цены за полгода'
          : 'За полгода'
        : filterName === 'EXPIRATION'
        ? 'По дате экспирации'
        : additionalText
        ? 'Изменения цены за сегодня'
        : 'За сегодня'}
    </>
  );
};

import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_360, ROUTE_CATALOG, ROUTE_FAVORITES_360, ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS } from 'const/routes';

import { getCatalogTabs } from 'modules/Catalog/helpers';

const useCatalog = (pathname: string) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [isActiveSearch, setIsActiveSearch] = useState(false);

  const isFavorites = pathname === ROUTE_FAVORITES_360 || pathname === ROUTE_FAVORITE_GROUPS;

  const tabs = useMemo(() => getCatalogTabs(pathname), [pathname]);

  const handleNavigate = useCallback(() => {
    navigate(isFavorites ? ROUTE_360 : ROUTE_CATALOG);
  }, [isFavorites, navigate]);

  const handleSearch = useCallback(() => setIsActiveSearch(!isActiveSearch), [isActiveSearch]);

  return {
    handleNavigate,
    handleSearch,
    isActiveSearch,
    isFavorites,
    tabs,
  };
};

export default useCatalog;

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { getCatalogFilters, setCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/helpers';
import { CatalogFiltersType } from 'modules/Catalog/types';

const useCatalogFilters = () => {
  const [filters, setLocalyFilters] = useState(getCatalogFilters);

  const setFilters = useCallback((newFilters: CatalogFiltersType) => {
    setLocalyFilters(newFilters);
    setCatalogFilters(newFilters);
  }, []);
  return [filters, setFilters] as const;
};

export default useCatalogFilters;
