import { FC, memo, useEffect } from 'react';

import { Input } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { useScrollContext } from 'components/ScrollProvider';
import Section from 'components/Section';
import Wrapper from 'components/Wrapper';

import { ReactComponent as InputSearchSvg } from 'images/icons/search/input-search.svg';

import styles from './SearchHeader.module.pcss';
import { DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER } from './store';
import { ISearchHeader } from './types';

const SearchHeader: FC<ISearchHeader> = ({
  addonAfter,
  addonRight,
  classNameAddonAfter,
  classNameInput,
  classNameInputElement,
  description,
  inputRef,
  onBlur,
  onChange,
  onFocus,
  placeholder = DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER,
  sectionRef,
  sizeInput = 'xs',
  theme,
  themeSection,
  value,
}) => {
  const { direction, ref: scrollRef } = useScrollContext();
  const scrollTop = scrollRef?.scrollTop || 0;
  const heightSearch = sectionRef?.current?.clientHeight || 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollRef &&
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--rdp-top-sticky', `${heightSearch}px`);
  }, [heightSearch, scrollRef, scrollTop]);

  return (
    <Section
      className={cn(styles.section, {
        [styles.sectionHidden]: direction !== 'up',
      })}
      sectionRef={sectionRef}
      padding="xxs"
      theme={themeSection}
    >
      <Wrapper className={styles.wrapper}>
        <Input
          addonAfter={addonAfter}
          addonBefore={<InputSearchSvg />}
          className={styles.wrapperItem}
          classNameAddonAfter={classNameAddonAfter}
          classNameInput={cn(styles.wrapperInput, classNameInput)}
          classNameInputElement={cn(
            styles.wrapperInputElement,
            classNameInputElement,
            styles[`input-${sizeInput}`],
          )}
          description={description}
          onBlur={onBlur}
          onChange={onChange}
          onFocus={onFocus}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          ref={inputRef}
          scale="small"
          theme={theme}
          type="search"
          value={value}
        />

        {addonRight && (
          <div className={cn(styles.wrapperItem, styles.wrapperItemRight)}>{addonRight}</div>
        )}
      </Wrapper>
    </Section>
  );
};

export default memo(SearchHeader);

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_CATEGORY_INFO, ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useGetUserSettingTransformQuery,
  useUpdateUserSettingMutation,
} from 'core/api/userSettings';
import { getCategorizationIcon, useCategorization } from 'core/categorization';

import AccessDenied from 'modules/AccessDenied';
import OnboardingPage from 'modules/OnboardingPage';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as CloseSvg } from 'images/icons/alert/close.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ArrowRightSvg } from 'images/icons/arrow-right.svg';
import { ReactComponent as PersonLoyaltySvg } from 'images/icons/person-loyalty.svg';
import { ReactComponent as OnboardingSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/onboarding/categories-list.svg';

import styles from './CategoriesList.module.pcss';

const USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_CATEGORIZATION = 'onboarding_categorization';

const CategoriesList = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { isLoading, hasTestingAccess, isActualQualOrder, testingProgress, categories } =
    useCategorization();

  const [hasQualNotification, setQualNotification] = useState<boolean | undefined>();
  const [showOnboarding, setShowOnboarding] = useState(false);
  const {
    data: userSetting,
    isSuccess: isSuccessUserSetting,
    isLoading: isLoadingUserSetting,
  } = useGetUserSettingTransformQuery({
    name: USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_CATEGORIZATION,
  });

  const [updateUserSetting] = useUpdateUserSettingMutation();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasQualNotification === undefined && isActualQualOrder !== undefined) {
      setQualNotification(isActualQualOrder);
    }
  }, [hasQualNotification, isActualQualOrder]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setShowOnboarding(
      isSuccessUserSetting &&
        (!userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_CATEGORIZATION]?.value ||
          userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_CATEGORIZATION]?.value === '0'),
    );
  }, [isSuccessUserSetting, userSetting]);

  const handleOnboardingClick = () => {
    setShowOnboarding(false);
    updateUserSetting({
      name: USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_CATEGORIZATION,
      value: '1',
    });
  };

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
  };

  if (isLoading || isLoadingUserSetting) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loader}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!hasTestingAccess) {
    return <AccessDenied />;
  }

  if (showOnboarding) {
    return (
      <OnboardingPage
        title="Торгуйте сложными инструментами"
        text="Пройдите тестирование, подтверждающее ваши знания, чтобы совершать операции с более сложными и рисковыми финансовыми инструментами"
        svg={<OnboardingSvg />}
        hintTitle="Подробнее о тестировании"
        hintSubTitle="Почему необходимо проходить тестирование?"
        hintText={[
          'В соответствии с изменениями в Федеральный закон от 22.04.1996 № 39-ФЗ «О рынке ценных бумаг», чтобы получить доступ к заключению ряда сделок, неквалифицированный инвестор должен пройти тестирование, подтверждающее его знания о соответствующем виде сделок.',
        ]}
        onClick={handleOnboardingClick}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.container : styles.containerDesktop}>
      <HeaderPage
        size="small"
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        title={'Доступ к инструментам и операциям'}
      />

      <Text type="title" className={styles.access}>
        Доступ к инструментам и операциям
      </Text>
      <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.testingProgress} color={'colorForeground2'}>
        {testingProgress.passed} из {testingProgress.all} пройдено
      </Text>
      <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.federalLaw}>
        Пройдите тестирование, подтверждающее ваши знания, чтобы совершать операции с более сложными
        и рисковыми финансовыми инструментами
      </Text>

      {hasQualNotification && (
        <div className={styles.qualNotificationWrapper}>
          <div
            className={styles.closeIconWrapper}
            onClick={() => {
              setQualNotification(false);
            }}
          >
            <CloseSvg />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.personLoyaltyIconWrapper}>
            <PersonLoyaltySvg />
          </div>
          <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.qualText}>
            Ваша заявка на присвоение статуса «Квалифицированный инвестор» в обработке. При
            положительном результате по заявке тестирование проходить не нужно. Дождитесь
            уведомление о результатах рассмотрения по электронной почте
          </Text>
        </div>
      )}

      {categories.map(({ code, name, passed }, index) => {
        const Icon = getCategorizationIcon(code);

        return (
          <React.Fragment key={code}>
            <div
              className={cx(
                styles.optionContainer,
                index === 0 && styles.optionContainerFirst,
                !passed && styles.optionContainerNotPassed,
              )}
              onClick={() => {
                if (!passed) {
                  navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_CATEGORY_INFO, { category: code }));
                }
              }}
            >
              <div className={styles.optionWrapper}>
                <div
                  className={cx(
                    styles.optionIconWrapper,
                    passed ? styles.blueIcon : styles.orangeIcon,
                  )}
                >
                  <Icon />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.optionInfoWrapper}>
                  <Text type="bodyRegular">{name}</Text>
                  <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.optionInfo}>
                    {passed ? 'Пройдено' : 'Не пройдено'}
                  </Text>
                </div>
              </div>
              {!passed && (
                <div className={styles.arrowRightIconWrapper}>
                  <ArrowRightSvg className={styles.arrowRightIcon} />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {index !== categories.length - 1 && <div className={styles.separator} />}
          </React.Fragment>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CategoriesList;

import styles from './CategoryInfo.module.pcss';

const CategoryInfo = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { category: categoryCode } = useParams();

  const { isLoading, hasTestingAccess, categories } = useCategorization();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loader}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!hasTestingAccess) {
    return <AccessDenied />;
  }

  const foundCategory = categories.find((category) => category.code === categoryCode);

  if (!foundCategory || foundCategory.passed) {
    return <Navigate to={ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG} />;
  }

  const { code, name, fullName } = foundCategory;
  const Icon = getCategorizationIcon(code);

  const handleButtonClick = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_QUIZ, { category: categoryCode }));
  };

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
  };

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.container : styles.containerDesktop}>
      <HeaderPage
        size="small"
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        title={''}
        documentTitle={name}
      />

      <div className={styles.contentWrapper}>
        <div className={styles.iconWrapper}>
          <Icon className={styles.icon} />
        </div>
        <Text type="title" className={styles.title}>
          {name}
        </Text>
        <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.testing}>
          Тестирование займет до 15 минут
        </Text>
        <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.info}>
          {fullName}
        </Text>
      </div>

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.buttonsWrapper : styles.buttonsWrapperDesktop}>
        <Button onClick={handleButtonClick}>Пройти тестирование</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CategoryInfo;

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import Chat from '@um/chat';
import { APP_TITLE } from 'const/app';
import { ROUTE_360 } from 'const/routes';

import { getSession, getSessionStatus } from 'core/session/session';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import styles from './ChatPWA.module.pcss';

const ChatPWA = () => {
  const data = useAppSelector(getSession);
  const isLoading = useAppSelector(getSessionStatus);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && !data?.chatEnabled) {
      navigate(ROUTE_360);
    }
  }, [data?.chatEnabled, navigate, isLoading]);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `Чат — ${APP_TITLE}`;
  }, []);

  const chatMode = !process.env.TIER || process.env.TIER === 'tt' ? 'dev' : 'prod';

  return (
    <div className={styles.chatContainer}>
      {isLoading || !data ? (
        <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
          <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Chat mode={chatMode} source="mobile_lk" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ChatPWA;

import { useState } from 'react';

import BottomSheet from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import cn from 'classnames';

import Footer from 'modules/Checks/components/Footer/Footer';
import Header from 'modules/Checks/components/Header/Header';
import Table from 'modules/Checks/components/Table/Table';
import { ChecksProps } from 'modules/Checks/types';
import CancelBottomSheet from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/CancelBottomSheet/CancelBottomSheet';

import styles from './Checks.module.pcss';
import { getHeaderData, getInstrumentIconIndicator } from './helpers';

const Checks = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onTradeOrderGoBackBtn,
  onTradeOrderCancelButtonClick,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  instrumentName,
  instrumentCode,
  instrumentImageName,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  baseCurrencyCode,
  ordStatus,
  transactTime,
  side,
  portfolioName,
  price,
  priceSecondary,
  priceSecondaryCurrencyCode,
  totalPrice,
  totalPriceSecondary,
  totalPriceCurrency,
  quantityText,
  currency,
  cumQty,
  orderQty,
  errorMessage,
  orderType,
  priceUnit,
  showDividers = false,
  isIpo,
  isBond,
}: ChecksProps) => {
  const [isConfirmOpen, setIsConfirmOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const { type, headerText } = getHeaderData(ordStatus, orderType, errorMessage, isIpo);

  const indicator = getInstrumentIconIndicator(type);
  const deviationLabel = `Отступ от ${side === 'BUY' ? 'min' : 'max'}`;

  const handleRetryButtonClick = () => onClose();

  const handleCancelButtonClick = async () => {
    setIsConfirmOpen(true);
  };

  const handleConfirmClose = () => {
    setIsConfirmOpen(false);
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    setIsConfirmOpen(false);
    onTradeOrderCancelButtonClick();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <BottomSheet
        open={open}
        onDismiss={onClose}
        className={cn(styles.check, !showDividers && styles.notShowDividers)}
        header={
          <Header
            type={type}
            instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
            side={side}
            instrumentName={instrumentName}
            headerText={headerText}
            indicator={indicator}
            orderType={orderType}
            instrumentId={`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`}
            isIpo={isIpo}
            subTitle={instrumentCode}
          />
        }
        footer={
          <Footer
            type={type}
            instrumentId={instrumentId}
            tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
            orderType={orderType}
            isIpo={isIpo}
            onCancelButtonClick={handleCancelButtonClick}
            onReadyButtonClick={onTradeOrderGoBackBtn}
            onRetryButtonClick={handleRetryButtonClick}
          />
        }
      >
        <div className={styles.content}>
          <Table
            transactTime={transactTime}
            price={price}
            priceSecondary={priceSecondary}
            priceSecondaryCurrencyCode={priceSecondaryCurrencyCode}
            baseCurrencyCode={baseCurrencyCode}
            currency={currency}
            instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
            totalPrice={totalPrice}
            totalPriceSecondary={totalPriceSecondary}
            totalPriceCurrency={totalPriceCurrency}
            portfolioName={portfolioName}
            cumQty={cumQty}
            orderQty={orderQty}
            quantityText={quantityText}
            orderType={orderType}
            deviationLabel={deviationLabel}
            priceUnit={priceUnit}
            isIpo={isIpo}
            isBond={isBond}
          />
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
      <CancelBottomSheet
        onCancel={handleConfirmClose}
        onConfirm={handleConfirm}
        open={isConfirmOpen}
        side={side}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        transactTime={transactTime}
        orderQty={orderQty}
        cumQty={cumQty}
        baseCurrencyCode={baseCurrencyCode}
        instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
        instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default Checks;

import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import {
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE,
  ROUTE_APPLICATIONS,
  ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY,
} from 'const/routes';

import { FooterProps } from 'modules/Checks/types';

import styles from './Footer.module.pcss';

const Footer = ({
  type,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  orderType,
  isIpo,
  onCancelButtonClick,
  onReadyButtonClick,
  onRetryButtonClick,
}: FooterProps) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  if (type === 'performed' && orderType === 'limit') {
    return (
      <div className={styles.buttonContainer}>
        <Button onClick={onReadyButtonClick}>Готово</Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (type === 'registered' || (type === 'performed' && orderType === 'stopOrder')) {
    const handleApplicationsBtnClick = () => {
      if (isIpo) {
        window.sessionStorage.setItem('activeOrderType', 'Размещения');

        navigate(
          `${ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY}/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB}/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE}`,
        );

        return;
      }

      window.sessionStorage.setItem(
        'activeOrderType',
        orderType === 'limit' ? 'Лимитные' : 'Условные',
      );

      window.localStorage.setItem(
        'orderHistoryFilterState',
        JSON.stringify({ isHistoryFilterActive: false }),
      );

      navigate(
        generatePath(ROUTE_APPLICATIONS, { instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}` }),
        { replace: true },
      );
    };

    return (
      <div>
        <Button variant="link" className={styles.button} onClick={handleApplicationsBtnClick}>
          Перейти в заявки
        </Button>
        <div className={styles.buttonContainer}>
          {orderType === 'limit' ||
            (type === 'registered' && (
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onCancelButtonClick} className={styles.button}>
                <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} color={'colorDestructive'}>
                  Отменить
                </Text>
              </Button>
            ))}
          <Button className={styles.button} onClick={onReadyButtonClick}>
            Готово
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (type === 'error') {
    return (
      <div className={styles.buttonContainer}>
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onRetryButtonClick} className={styles.button}>
          Повторить
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={onReadyButtonClick} className={styles.button}>
          Готово
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return null;
};

export default Footer;

import { useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { formattedTitle } from 'modules/Checks/helpers';
import { HeaderProps } from 'modules/Checks/types';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as TooltipSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/small-question-outline.svg';

import styles from './Header.module.pcss';

const Header = ({
  type,
  headerText,
  indicator,
  instrumentImageName,
  side,
  instrumentName,
  orderType,
  instrumentId,
  isIpo,
  titleClassName,
  subTitle,
  slugText,
}: HeaderProps) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const headerTextLastWord = headerText ? headerText.split(' ').pop() : null;
  const cutHeaderText =
    headerTextLastWord && headerText?.slice(0, headerText.indexOf(headerTextLastWord));

  const handleTooltipIconClick = () => {
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <div className={cx(styles.topSideContainer, styles[type])}>
        <div className={styles.status}>
          <Text color={'colorFixedWhite'}>
            {cutHeaderText}
            <Text tag="span" color="colorFixedWhite" className={styles.noWrap}>
              {headerTextLastWord}
              {slugText && <TooltipSvg className={styles.icon} onClick={handleTooltipIconClick} />}
            </Text>
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.imgContainer}>
          <div className={styles.imgBg}>
            <InstrumentIcon
              className={styles.img}
              bottomRightIndicator={indicator}
              instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
              instrumentId={instrumentId}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={cx(styles.title, titleClassName)}>
        <Text type={'subtitleBold'}>{formattedTitle(side, instrumentName, orderType, isIpo)}</Text>
        {subTitle && (
          <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {subTitle}
          </Text>
        )}
      </div>
      <BottomSheet open={isOpen} onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}>
        <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.container}>
          {slugText}
        </Text>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default Header;

import { FC } from 'react';

import { CompactTable as Table, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { formattedDateTime } from 'modules/Checks/helpers';

import { IPOTableProps } from './types';

const IPOTable: FC<IPOTableProps> = ({
  transactTime,
  portfolioName,
  price,
  quantity,
  volume,
  isBond,
}) => {
  const tableDataBond = [
    { title: 'На счёт', addonRight: <Text type="lineSemiBold">{portfolioName ?? '–'}</Text> },
    { title: 'Цена', addonRight: <Text type="lineSemiBold">{price ?? '–'}</Text> },
    { title: 'Количество', addonRight: <Text type="lineSemiBold">{quantity ?? '–'}</Text> },
    { title: 'Объём участия', addonRight: <Text type="lineSemiBold">{volume}</Text> },
  ];

  const tableDataEquity = [
    { title: 'На счёт', addonRight: <Text type="lineSemiBold">{portfolioName ?? '–'}</Text> },
    { title: 'Объём участия', addonRight: <Text type="lineSemiBold">{volume}</Text> },
  ];

  const tableData = isBond ? tableDataBond : tableDataEquity;

  transactTime &&
    tableData.unshift({
      title: 'Выставлено',
      addonRight: <Text type="lineSemiBold">{formattedDateTime(transactTime)}</Text>,
    });

  return <Table data={tableData} />;
};

export default IPOTable;

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { useLazyCalcComissionQuery } from 'core/api/accounts';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import {
  formattedCount,
  formattedDateTime,
  formattedPrice,
  formattedVolume,
} from 'modules/Checks/helpers';
import { TableProps } from 'modules/Checks/types';

import styles from './Table.module.pcss';
import IPOTable from './components/IPOTable';

const Table = ({
  transactTime,
  portfolioName,
  currency,
  price,
  priceSecondary,
  priceSecondaryCurrencyCode,
  cumQty,
  orderQty,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  baseCurrencyCode,
  totalPrice,
  totalPriceSecondary,
  totalPriceCurrency,
  orderType,
  deviationLabel,
  priceUnit,
  isIpo,
  isBond,
}: TableProps) => {
  const { takeProfit, stopLimit, stopLimitPrice, deviation, protectiveSpread } = useAppSelector(
    (state) => {
      return {
        takeProfit: state.tradeOrder.takeProfit,
        stopLimit: state.tradeOrder.stopLimit,
        stopLimitPrice: state.tradeOrder.stopLimitPrice,
        deviation: state.tradeOrder.deviation,
        protectiveSpread: state.tradeOrder.protectiveSpread,
      };
    },
  );

  const [isCalculatingCommision, setIsCalculatingCommision] = React.useState(false);

  if (isIpo)
    return (
      <IPOTable
        transactTime={transactTime}
        portfolioName={portfolioName}
        price={formattedPrice(price, currency, priceSecondary, priceSecondaryCurrencyCode)}
        quantity={Number.isFinite(orderQty) ? `${cumQty} шт.` : '–'}
        volume={
          totalPrice && totalPriceCurrency && Number.isFinite(totalPrice)
            ? `${sumFormatter(totalPrice)} ${totalPriceCurrency}`
            : '–'
        }
        isBond={isBond}
      />
    );

  return (
    <div className={styles.table}>
      <div className={cn(styles.tableRow, orderType === 'stopOrder' && styles.withDivider)}>
        <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Выставлено</Text>
        <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
          {transactTime ? formattedDateTime(transactTime) : '–'}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.tableRow}>
        <Text type={'lineRegular'}>На счет</Text>
        <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
          {portfolioName}
        </Text>
      </div>
      {orderType === 'limit' ? (
        <div className={styles.tableRow}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Цена {priceUnit}</Text>
          <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
            {formattedPrice(price, currency, priceSecondary, priceSecondaryCurrencyCode)}
          </Text>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {takeProfit && (
            <div className={styles.tableRow}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Тэйк-профит {priceUnit}</Text>
              <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
                {formattedPrice(takeProfit, currency, priceSecondary, priceSecondaryCurrencyCode)}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
          {deviation != undefined && currency && (
            <div className={styles.tableRow}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{deviationLabel}</Text>
              <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
                {`${sumFormatter(deviation, -1)} ${currencySign(currency)}`}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
          {protectiveSpread && (
            <div className={styles.tableRow}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Защитный спред</Text>
              <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
                {formattedPrice(
                  protectiveSpread,
                  currency,
                  priceSecondary,
                  priceSecondaryCurrencyCode,
                )}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
          {stopLimit && (
            <div className={styles.tableRow}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Стоп-лимит {priceUnit}</Text>
              <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
                {formattedPrice(stopLimit, currency, priceSecondary, priceSecondaryCurrencyCode)}{' '}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
          {stopLimitPrice && (
            <div className={styles.tableRow}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Цена выставления лимитной заявки {priceUnit}</Text>
              <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
                {formattedPrice(
                  stopLimitPrice,
                  currency,
                  priceSecondary,
                  priceSecondaryCurrencyCode,
                )}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      <div className={styles.tableRow}>
        <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Количество</Text>
        <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
          {Number.isFinite(cumQty) && Number.isFinite(orderQty)
            ? formattedCount(cumQty, orderQty, instrumentCategoryCode, baseCurrencyCode, orderType)
            : '–'}
        </Text>
      </div>
      {orderType === 'limit' ? (
        <div className={styles.tableRow}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Объем</Text>
          <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
            {totalPrice && totalPriceCurrency && Number.isFinite(totalPrice)
              ? formattedVolume(totalPrice, totalPriceCurrency, totalPriceSecondary, currency)
              : '–'}
          </Text>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.tableRow}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Срок действия</Text>
          <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} className={styles.leftText}>
            До отмены
          </Text>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Table;

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { OrderType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import { ReactComponent as BadgeIconCheckSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/check/badge-icon-check.svg';
import { ReactComponent as BadgeIconClockSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/check/badge-icon-clock.svg';
import { ReactComponent as BadgeIconCrossSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/check/badge-icon-cross.svg';

import { InstrumentCategoryCode, PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import { HEADER_TEXT_STOP_ORDER, HEADER_TEXT_STOP_ORDER_DEFAULT } from './consts';
import { CheckType } from './types';

export const formattedTitle = (
  side: string,
  instrumentName?: string,
  orderType: OrderType = 'limit',
  isIpo = false,
) => {
  if (isIpo) {
    return `Участие в размещении ${instrumentName}`;
  }

  return `${orderType === 'limit' ? 'Лимитная' : 'Условная'} заявка на ${
    side === 'BUY' ? 'покупку' : 'продажу'
  } ${instrumentName}`;
};

export const formattedDateTime = (dateTime: string) =>
  DateTime.fromISO(dateTime).toFormat('dd.MM.yy в HH:mm:ss');

export const formattedCount = (
  cumQty?: number,
  orderQty?: number,
  instrumentCategoryCode?: InstrumentCategoryCode,
  baseCurrencyCode?: PriceCurrencyType,
  orderType: OrderType = 'limit',
) => {
  const isCurrency = instrumentCategoryCode === 'CUP' && baseCurrencyCode;
  const isMetal = instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP';

  const postfix = isCurrency ? currencySign(baseCurrencyCode) : isMetal ? 'гр.' : 'шт.';

  return orderType === 'limit' ? `${cumQty} из ${orderQty} ${postfix}` : `${orderQty} ${postfix}`;
};

export const formattedVolume = (
  value: number,
  currency: string,
  valueSecondary?: number,
  currencySecondary?: PriceCurrencyType,
) => {
  if (valueSecondary && currencySecondary) {
    return `${sumFormatter(valueSecondary)} ${currencySign(currencySecondary)} (${sumFormatter(
      value,
    )} ${currency})`;
  }
  return `${sumFormatter(value)} ${currency}`;
};

export const formattedPrice = (
  price?: number | null,
  priceCurrency?: PriceCurrencyType,
  priceSecondary?: number,
  priceSecondaryCurrency?: PriceCurrencyType,
) => {
  if (!price || !priceCurrency) return '–';
  if (priceSecondary && priceSecondaryCurrency) {
    return `${sumFormatter(price, null, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)} (${sumFormatter(
      priceSecondary,
    )} ${currencySign(priceSecondaryCurrency)})`;
  }
  return `${sumFormatter(price, null, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency ?? 'RUB')}`;
};

export const getInstrumentIconIndicator = (type: string) =>
  type === 'performed' ? (
    <BadgeIconCheckSvg />
  ) : type === 'registered' ? (
    <BadgeIconClockSvg />
  ) : (
    <BadgeIconCrossSvg />
  );

export const getHeaderData = (
  ordStatus: string | undefined,
  orderType: OrderType,
  errorMessage: string | undefined,
  isIpo = false,
) => {
  let type: CheckType | undefined;

  if (orderType === 'stopOrder') {
    type =
      ordStatus === 'FILLED'
        ? 'performed'
        : ordStatus === 'NEW' ||
          ordStatus === 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' ||
          ordStatus === 'PENDING_REPLACE' ||
          ordStatus === 'REPLACED'
        ? 'registered'
        : 'error';
  } else {
    type =
      ordStatus === 'FILLED'
        ? 'performed'
        : ordStatus === 'NEW' || ordStatus === 'PartiallyFilled'
        ? 'registered'
        : 'error';
  }

  const headerText = getHeaderText(type, isIpo, orderType, errorMessage);

  return { headerText, type };
};

export const getHeaderText = (
  type: CheckType,
  isIpo: boolean,
  orderType: OrderType,
  errorMessage: string | undefined,
) => {
  if (isIpo) {
    return type === 'performed'
      ? 'Поручение на участие зарегистрировано'
      : type === 'registered'
      ? 'Поручение на участие зарегистрировано'
      : errorMessage
      ? errorMessage
      : 'Что-то пошло не так';
  }

  if (orderType === 'stopOrder') {
    return type === 'performed' || type === 'registered'
      ? HEADER_TEXT_STOP_ORDER
      : errorMessage
      ? errorMessage
      : HEADER_TEXT_STOP_ORDER_DEFAULT;
  }

  return type === 'performed'
    ? 'Исполнено'
    : type === 'registered'
    ? 'Зарегистрировано'
    : errorMessage
    ? errorMessage
    : 'Что-то пошло не так';

import {
  formattedCount,
  formattedDateTime,
  formattedPrice,
  formattedTitle,
  formattedVolume
} from '../helpers'

const side = 'BUY';
const side2 = 'SELL';
const instrumentName = '';
const instrumentName2 = 'test';

const dateTime = '12';

const cumQty = 14;
const orderQty = 25;

const value = 15;
const currency = 'test';
const valueSecondary = 25;

const price = 15;
const priceCurrency = 'RUB';
const priceSecondary = 30;
const priceSecondaryCurrency = 'KZT'

describe('formatted', () => {
  test('formattedTitle buy util', () => {
    expect(formattedTitle(side, instrumentName)).toBe('Покупка ');
  });
  test('formattedTitle util sell wrong', () => {
    expect(formattedTitle(side2, instrumentName)).toBe('Продажа ');
  });
  test('formattedTitle util buy with value wrong', () => {
    expect(formattedTitle(side2, instrumentName2)).toBe('Продажа test');
  });
  test('formattedTitle util wrong', () => {
    expect(formattedTitle(side, instrumentName2)).not.toBe('Покупка');
  });

  test('formattedDateTime util not undefined', () => {
    expect(formattedDateTime(dateTime)).not.toBeUndefined();
  });
  test('formattedDateTime util correct type', () => {
    expect(formattedDateTime(dateTime)).toHaveLength(19);
  });

  test('formattedCount to be defined', () => {
    expect(formattedCount()).toBeDefined();
  });
  test('formattedCount with 2 args', () => {
    expect(formattedCount(cumQty, orderQty)).toBe(`${cumQty} из ${orderQty} шт.`);
  });

  test('formattedVolume result', () => {
    expect(formattedVolume(value, currency, valueSecondary)).toBe(`${value},00 ${currency}`);
  });
  test('formattedVolume length', () => {
    const length = Number(`${value}`.length + 4 + `${currency}`.length)
    expect(formattedVolume(value, currency)).toHaveLength(length);
  });

  test('formattedPrice without priceCurrency', () => {
    expect(formattedPrice(price)).toBe('–');
  });
  test('formattedPrice with 2 args', () => {
    expect(formattedPrice(price, priceCurrency)).toBe(`${price},00 ₽`);
  });
  test('formattedPrice without args', () => {
    expect(formattedPrice()).toBeDefined();
  });
  test('formattedPrice without args', () => {
    expect(formattedPrice()).toBeDefined();
  });
  test('formattedPrice with 3 args', () => {
    expect(formattedPrice(price, priceCurrency, priceSecondary)).toBe(`${price},00 ₽`);
  });
  test('formattedPrice with 4 args', () => {
    expect(formattedPrice(
      price,
      priceCurrency,
      priceSecondary,
      priceSecondaryCurrency
    )).toBe(`${price},00 ₽ (${priceSecondary},00 ₸)`);
  });
});

import React, { FC, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ActionCell, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_CODE_WORD } from 'const/routes';

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import styles from 'modules/CodewordPage/components/CodewordBottomSheet/styles.module.pcss';
import { PERSON_CODEWORD_CHANGE } from 'modules/CodewordPage/const';
import { CodewordDeleteModal } from 'modules/CodewordPage/index';
import { CodewordBottomSheetProps } from 'modules/CodewordPage/types';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as GlyphCrossSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/glyph-cross-squircle.svg';
import { ReactComponent as GlyphPlusSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/glyph-plus-squircle.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SmallEditSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/small-edit-squircle.svg';

const CodewordBottomSheet: FC<CodewordBottomSheetProps> = ({ open, onDismiss, isExist }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [deleteModalOpen, setDeleteModalOpen] = useState(false);

  const codewordChangePermission = Permissions.get(PERSON_CODEWORD_CHANGE);

  const isCodewordChangedBlocked = codewordChangePermission === 'BLOCKED';

  const createCodewordClick = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_CODE_WORD, { operationType: 'create' }));
  };

  const changeCodewordClick = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_CODE_WORD, { operationType: 'change' }));
  };

  const deleteCodewordClick = () => {
    setDeleteModalOpen(true);
    onDismiss();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <AdaptivePopup open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
        <div className={styles.wrap}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Кодовое слово</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.text}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>
            Используется для вашей идентификации при обращении в «Открытие Инвестиции» по телефону
            для решения вопросов
          </Text>
        </div>
        {!isExist ? (
          <ActionCell
            title={'Установить кодовое слово'}
            className={styles.cell}
            onClick={createCodewordClick}
            disabled={isCodewordChangedBlocked}
            separator={false}
            iconLeft={<GlyphPlusSvg />}
            addonRight
            hover={false}
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            <ActionCell
              title={'Изменить кодовое слово'}
              className={styles.cell}
              onClick={changeCodewordClick}
              disabled={isCodewordChangedBlocked}
              separator={false}
              iconLeft={<SmallEditSvg />}
              addonRight
              hover={false}
            />
            <ActionCell
              title={'Удалить кодовое слово'}
              className={styles.cell}
              onClick={deleteCodewordClick}
              disabled={isCodewordChangedBlocked}
              separator={false}
              iconLeft={<GlyphCrossSvg />}
              addonRight
              hover={false}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </AdaptivePopup>

      {deleteModalOpen && (
        <CodewordDeleteModal open={deleteModalOpen} onClose={() => setDeleteModalOpen(false)} />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default CodewordBottomSheet;

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_CODE_WORD_SUCCESS, ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useCodewordConfirmMutation, useDeleteCodewordMutation } from 'core/api/codeword';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const CodewordDelete = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleSuccess = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_CODE_WORD_SUCCESS, { operationType: 'delete' }));
  };

  const [deleteCodeword] = useDeleteCodewordMutation();
  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading }] = useCodewordConfirmMutation();

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleDeleteCodewordConfirm = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await deleteCodeword().unwrap();
        getSms({ requestGuid: res.codewordRequest[0].requestGuid });
      } catch (e) {
        navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
      }
    };
    handleDeleteCodewordConfirm();
  }, [deleteCodeword, navigate, getSms]);

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile && !smsData && (
        <HeaderPage
          title={isSmsLoading ? 'СМС-подтверждение' : 'Удаление кодового слова'}
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          documentTitle={'Кодовое слово'}
        />
      )}

      {!smsData ? (
        <div className={styles.loaderContainer}>
          <CircleLoader brandColor />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {!isMobile && (
            <div className={styles.textWrap}>
              <Text type={'bodyMedium'}>SMS-подтверждение</Text>
            </div>
          )}
          <SmsConfirmation
            initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
            smsInputCount={4}
            onSuccess={handleSuccess}
            onError={() => console.log('Error')}
            loaderChildren={<Text>Удаление кодового слова...</Text>}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default CodewordDelete;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Checkbox, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_CODE_WORD_SUCCESS, ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useCodewordConfirmMutation, useSetCodewordMutation } from 'core/api/codeword';

import { AdaptivePopup, HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';

import { OperationTypes } from '../../types';
import InputCodeword from './InputCodeword';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const CodewordForm = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { operationType } = useParams();
  const [codeword, setCodeword] = useState('');
  const [checkAgreement, setCheckAgreement] = useState(false);
  const [disableButton, setDisableButton] = useState(false);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true);

  const codewordPageTitles: Partial<Record<OperationTypes | string, string>> = {
    create: 'Создание кодового слова',
    change: 'Изменение кодового слова',
  };

  const title = operationType && codewordPageTitles[operationType];

  const [codewordSet, { isLoading: isCodewordSetLoading }] = useSetCodewordMutation();
  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading }] = useCodewordConfirmMutation();

  const handleCodewordChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setCodeword(event.target.value);
  };

  const handleConfirmButton = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await codewordSet({ Codeword: codeword }).unwrap();
      getSms({ requestGuid: res.codewordRequest[0].requestGuid });
      setIsOpen(true);
    } catch (e) {
      navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
    }
  };

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const handleSuccess = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_CODE_WORD_SUCCESS, { operationType }));
  };

  return (
    <>
      {(isMobile && !smsData) || !isMobile ? (
        <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrap : styles.wrapDesktop}>
          <HeaderPage
            leftIconVariant={'back'}
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
            documentTitle={'Кодовое слово'}
          />
          <div className={isMobile ? styles.main : styles.mainDesktop}>
            <Text type={'title'}>{title}</Text>
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
              Рекомендуем не использовать в качестве кодового слова паспортные данные, имя, фамилию,
              дату рождения.
            </Text>
            <div className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
              <InputCodeword
                value={codeword}
                onChange={handleCodewordChange}
                placeholder={'Введите кодовое слово'}
                setDisableButton={setDisableButton}
              />
              <div className={styles.checkbox}>
                <Checkbox
                  checked={checkAgreement}
                  onChange={() => setCheckAgreement(!checkAgreement)}
                />
                <div>
                  <span>
                    Ознакомлен с
                    <a
                      className={styles.link}
                      href={
                        'https://s3.investpalata.ru/site/files/public/wgKOtGQxgg5E6Y2OQYxeZcEQ/phone_request_procedure.pdf'
                      }
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                    >
                      &nbsp; порядком подачи торговых поручений по телефону
                    </a>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className={isMobile ? styles.footer : styles.footerDesktop}>
            <span className={styles.overlineText}>
              Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
            </span>
            <Button
              onClick={handleConfirmButton}
              disabled={!(checkAgreement && disableButton)}
              loading={isSmsLoading || isCodewordSetLoading}
              className={cx({ [styles.btn]: !isMobile })}
            >
              Подтвердить
            </Button>
          </div>

          {smsData && !isMobile && (
            <AdaptivePopup open={isOpen} onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}>
              {!isMobile && (
                <div className={styles.textWrap}>
                  <Text type="subtitleBold">SMS-подтверждение</Text>
                </div>
              )}
              <SmsConfirmation
                initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
                smsInputCount={4}
                onSuccess={handleSuccess}
                onError={() => console.log('Error')}
                loaderChildren={<Text>Установка кодового слова...</Text>}
              />
            </AdaptivePopup>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <SmsConfirmation
          initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
          smsInputCount={4}
          onSuccess={handleSuccess}
          onError={() => console.log('Error')}
          loaderChildren={<Text>Установка кодового слова...</Text>}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default CodewordForm;

import React, { FC, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Input, InputStatus } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetCodewordPoliciesQuery } from 'core/api/codeword';

import { InputCodewordProps } from 'modules/CodewordPage/types';

import { ReactComponent as CrossedEyeSvg } from 'images/icons/crossed-eye.svg';
import { ReactComponent as EyeSvg } from 'images/icons/eye.svg';

import { validateCodeword } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const InputCodeword: FC<InputCodewordProps> = ({ value, onChange, setDisableButton, ...props }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [showCodeword, setShowCodeword] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<InputStatus>(null);
  const [codewordDescription, setCodewordDescription] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { data, isError: isPoliciesError } = useGetCodewordPoliciesQuery();
  const { pattern } = data?.codewordPolicy[0] || {};

  const toggleShowCodeword = (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    setShowCodeword((prev) => !prev);
  };

  const handleChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const { value } = event.target;
    if (value) {
      if (pattern && validateCodeword(value, pattern)) {
        setStatus('success');
        setDisableButton(true);
      } else {
        setStatus('warning');
        setCodewordDescription('Кириллица и цифры, без пробелов, 5-15 символов');
        setDisableButton(false);
      }
    }
    onChange && onChange(event);
  };

  if (isPoliciesError) {
    navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
  }

  return (
    <Input
      {...props}
      value={value}
      status={status}
      type={showCodeword ? 'text' : 'password'}
      label={props.label || 'Кодовое слово'}
      addonAfter={
        <div style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={toggleShowCodeword}>
          {showCodeword ? <CrossedEyeSvg /> : <EyeSvg />}
        </div>
      }
      description={codewordDescription}
      onChange={handleChange}
      disabled={props.disabled}
      className={styles.input}
    />
  );
};

export default InputCodeword;

import { validateCodeword } from '../helpers';

const value = 'Somestring';
const value2 = 'строка';
const value3 = '12345';
const value4 = '123';
const value5 = '12345!!';

const pattern = '^[а-яА-ЯёЁ0-9]{5,15}$';

describe('validateCodeword', () => {
  test('validateCodeword args1', () => {
    expect(validateCodeword(value, pattern)).toBe(false);
  });
  test('validateCodeword args2', () => {
    expect(validateCodeword(value2, pattern)).toBe(true);
  });
  test('validateCodeword args3', () => {
    expect(validateCodeword(value3, pattern)).toBe(true);
  });
  test('validateCodeword args4', () => {
    expect(validateCodeword(value4, pattern)).toBe(false);
  });
  test('validateCodeword args5', () => {
    expect(validateCodeword(value5, pattern)).toBe(false);
  });
});

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_SETTINGS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import {
  CODEWORD_CHANGE_TEXT,
  CODEWORD_CHANGE_TITLE,
  CODEWORD_CREATE_TEXT,
  CODEWORD_CREATE_TITLE,
  CODEWORD_DELETE_TEXT,
  CODEWORD_DELETE_TITLE,
} from 'modules/CodewordPage/const';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { OperationSuccessStatus, OperationTypes } from '../../types';
import styles from './Success.module.pcss';

const operationSuccessStatuses: Record<OperationTypes | string, OperationSuccessStatus> = {
  create: {
    title: CODEWORD_CREATE_TITLE,
    text: CODEWORD_CREATE_TEXT,
  },
  change: {
    title: CODEWORD_CHANGE_TITLE,
    text: CODEWORD_CHANGE_TEXT,
  },
  delete: {
    title: CODEWORD_DELETE_TITLE,
    text: CODEWORD_DELETE_TEXT,
  },
};

const Success = () => {
  const { operationType } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const status = operationType
    ? operationSuccessStatuses[operationType]
    : operationSuccessStatuses.create;

  const handleActionButtonClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_SETTINGS, { replace: true });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'close'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleActionButtonClick}
        indent
        documentTitle={'Кодовое слово'}
      />
      <Placeholder
        variant={'success'}
        badgeText={'Заявка принята'}
        text={status.text}
        title={status.title}
        actionButtonText={'Хорошо'}

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ActionCell, Card, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_HELP, ROUTE_OFFICES_MAP } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetEmployeesListQuery } from 'core/api/contacts';
import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { contactsData } from 'modules/Contacts/ContactsData';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as Geotag } from 'images/raw-icons/contacts/geotag.svg';
import { ReactComponent as Person } from 'images/raw-icons/contacts/person.svg';
import { ReactComponent as PhoneMini } from 'images/raw-icons/contacts/phonemini.svg';

import styles from './Contacts.module.pcss';

interface IWorkTimeHint {
  Title: string;
  Description: string;
}

const Contacts = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const isGrantedPersBrokerInfo = Permissions.someGranted('PRODUCT_BROKER_INFO');
  const isGrantedPersBrokerFullProfile = Permissions.someGranted('PRODUCT_BROKER_FULLPROFILE');
  const isGrantedInvAdviserInfo = Permissions.granted('PERSON_BROKERCONTACTS_EMPLOYEES');
  const isGrantedPersonContacts = Permissions.granted('PERSON_BROKERCONTACTS');
  const isGrantedOffices = Permissions.granted('PERSON_BROKERCONTACTS_OFFICES');

  const { data } = useGetEmployeesListQuery();
  const persBroker = data?.employees.filter((item) => item.typeCode === 'PersBroker');
  const invAdviser = data?.employees.filter((item) => item.typeCode === 'InvAdviser');
  const visibleContactCard = !!(invAdviser?.length || persBroker?.length);

  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();
  const workingHours = JSON.parse(
    hints?.hints?.filter((item) => item.slug === 'LK_WORK_TIME')[0]?.text || '[]',
  ) as Array<IWorkTimeHint>;

  const replaceNumber = (number: string) => number.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(1);

  const handleBackClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_HELP);

  const handleClickOfficeButton = () => navigate(ROUTE_OFFICES_MAP);

  return (
    <div>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        title={'Контакты'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        documentTitle={'Контакты'}
        withoutMargin
      />

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrap : styles.wrapAdaptive}>
        {!isMobile && <Headline title={'Контакты'} indent={false} />}
        {visibleContactCard && (
          <Card withShadow indent={false} className={styles.cardWrap}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
              Консультанты
            </Text>

            {isGrantedPersBrokerInfo &&
              isGrantedPersBrokerFullProfile &&
              persBroker?.map(({ employeeId, firstName, lastName, type, phone }) => (
                <ActionCell
                  key={employeeId}
                  iconLeft={<Person />}
                  title={firstName + ' ' + lastName}
                  description={type}
                  addonRight={phone && <PhoneMini />}
                  as="a"
                  link={phone ? `tel:+7${replaceNumber(phone)}` : '#'}
                  arrowRight={false}
                  separator
                  disabled={!phone}
                />
              ))}

            {isGrantedInvAdviserInfo &&
              invAdviser?.map(({ employeeId, firstName, lastName, type, phone }, index, array) => (
                <ActionCell
                  key={employeeId}
                  iconLeft={<Person />}
                  title={firstName + ' ' + lastName}
                  description={type}
                  addonRight={phone && <PhoneMini />}
                  as="a"
                  link={phone ? `tel:+7${replaceNumber(phone)}` : '#'}
                  arrowRight={false}
                  separator={!(index === array.length - 1)}
                  disabled={!phone}
                />
              ))}
          </Card>
        )}

        {isGrantedPersonContacts && (
          <Card withShadow indent={false} className={styles.cardWrap}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
              Свяжитесь с нами
            </Text>
            {workingHours.map((item) => (
              <div key={item.Title}>
                <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} color={'colorForeground2'} className={styles.hint}>
                  {item.Title + ':'}
                </Text>
                <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'} className={styles.hint}>
                  {item.Description}
                </Text>
              </div>
            ))}

            {contactsData.map(({ id, icon, title, description, separator, link }) => (
              <ActionCell
                key={id}
                iconLeft={icon}
                title={title}
                as="a"
                link={link}
                description={description}
                separator={separator}
              />
            ))}
          </Card>
        )}

        {isGrantedOffices && (
          <Card withShadow indent={false} className={styles.cardWrap}>
            <ActionCell
              title={'Офисы обслуживания'}
              description={'Найти офис рядом'}
              iconLeft={<Geotag />}
              addonRight
              separator={false}
              onClick={handleClickOfficeButton}
            />
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Contacts;

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import './FileUploaderLK.pcss';

export interface FileData {
  file: File;
  previewUrl?: string;
}

export interface FileCardProps {
  fileData: FileData;
  onRemove?: (fileData: FileData) => void;
  formatFileSize?: (size: number) => string;
}

export const FileCard: React.FC<FileCardProps> = ({ fileData, onRemove, formatFileSize }) => {
  return (
    <div className="file-uploader__file">
      <div className="file-uploader__file-preview">
        {fileData.previewUrl ? (
          <img
            src={fileData.previewUrl}
            alt={fileData.file.name}
            className="file-uploader__file-image"
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="file-uploader__file-icon">
            <svg
              width="24"
              height="24"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
            >
              <path
                d="M14 2H6C4.9 2 4 2.9 4 4V20C4 21.1 4.9 22 6 22H18C19.1 22 20 21.1 20 20V8L14 2Z"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />
              <path
                d="M14 2V8H20"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />
            </svg>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="file-uploader__file-info">
        <div className="file-uploader__file-name">{fileData.file.name}</div>
        {formatFileSize && (
          <div className="file-uploader__file-size">{formatFileSize(fileData.file.size)}</div>
        )}
      </div>
      {onRemove && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="file-uploader__file-remove"
          onClick={() => onRemove(fileData)}
        >
          <svg
            width="20"
            height="20"
            viewBox="0 0 20 20"
            fill="none"
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          >
            <path
              d="M15 5L5 15"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
            <path
              d="M5 5L15 15"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />
          </svg>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export interface FileUploaderProps {
  /** Список допустимых расширений файлов (например, ['.pdf', '.jpg']) */
  allowedExtensions?: string[];
  /** Максимальный размер файла в байтах */
  maxFileSize?: number;
  /** Множественный выбор файлов */
  multiple?: boolean;
  /** Начальные файлы */
  initialFiles?: File[];
  /** Функция обратного вызова при добавлении файла */
  onFileAdd?: (file: File) => void;
  /** Функция обратного вызова при удалении файла */
  onFileRemove?: (fileData: FileData) => void;
  /** Основной текст области загрузки */
  uploadText?: string;
  /** Вспомогательный текст */
  helperText?: string;
  /** Текст ошибки, если он предоставлен */
  errorText?: string;
  /** Показывать загруженные файлы */
  showUploadedFiles?: boolean;
}

export const FileUploader: React.FC<FileUploaderProps> = ({
  allowedExtensions = [],
  maxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024, // По умолчанию 10MB
  multiple = false,
  initialFiles = [],
  onFileAdd,
  onFileRemove,
  uploadText = 'Нажмите или перетащите файлы сюда для загрузки',
  helperText,
  errorText,
  showUploadedFiles = true,
}) => {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<FileData[]>([]);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(errorText || null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Обработка начальных файлов
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialFiles && initialFiles.length > 0) {
      const initialFileData = initialFiles.map((file) => ({
        file,
        previewUrl: getFilePreview(file),
      }));
      setFiles(initialFileData);
    }
  }, []);

  const getFilePreview = (file: File): string | undefined => {
    if (file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      return URL.createObjectURL(file);
    }
    return undefined;
  };

  const validateFile = (file: File): string | null => {
    if (allowedExtensions.length > 0) {
      const fileExtension = `.${file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase()}`;
      if (!allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {
        return `Неверный формат файла`;
      }
    }

    if (file.size > maxFileSize) {
      return `Превышен максимальный размер файла`;
    }

    return null;
  };

  const formatFileSize = (size: number): string => {
    if (size < 1024) {
      return `${size} байт`;
    } else if (size < 1024 * 1024) {
      return `${(size / 1024).toFixed(1)} КБ`;
    } else {
      return `${(size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} МБ`;
    }
  };

  const handleFileSelect = useCallback(
    (selectedFiles: FileList | null) => {
      if (!selectedFiles || selectedFiles.length === 0) return;

      setError(null);

      const filesToProcess = Array.from(selectedFiles);

      filesToProcess.forEach((file) => {
        const validationError = validateFile(file);
        if (validationError) {
          setError(validationError);
          return;
        }

        const newFile = {
          file,
          previewUrl: getFilePreview(file),
        };

        setFiles((prevFiles) => {
          if (!multiple) {
            // Если режим одиночного выбора, заменяем старый файл
            return [newFile];
          }
          return [...prevFiles, newFile];
        });

        if (onFileAdd) {
          onFileAdd(file);
        }
      });

      // Сбрасываем значение input, чтобы можно было загружать тот же файл повторно
      if (fileInputRef.current) {
        fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      }
    },
    [multiple, onFileAdd, validateFile],
  );

  const handleRemoveFile = useCallback(
    (fileToRemove: FileData) => {
      setFiles((prevFiles) => prevFiles.filter((fileData) => fileData.file !== fileToRemove.file));

      if (onFileRemove) {
        onFileRemove(fileToRemove);
      }
    },
    [onFileRemove],
  );

  const handleClick = () => {
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.click();
    }
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragging(false);
    handleFileSelect(e.dataTransfer.files);
  };

  return (
    <div className="file-uploader">
      <div
        className={`file-uploader__dropzone ${
          isDragging ? 'file-uploader__dropzone--dragging' : ''
        } ${error ? 'file-uploader__dropzone--error' : ''}`}
        onClick={handleClick}
        onDragOver={handleDragOver}
        onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
        onDrop={handleDrop}
      >
        <input
          type="file"
          ref={fileInputRef}
          className="file-uploader__input"
          onChange={(e) => handleFileSelect(e.target.files)}
          multiple={multiple}
          accept={allowedExtensions.join(',')}
        />
        <div className="file-uploader__content">
          <div className="file-uploader__icon">
            <svg
              width="24"
              height="24"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
            >
              <path
                d="M14 2H6C4.9 2 4 2.9 4 4V20C4 21.1 4.9 22 6 22H18C19.1 22 20 21.1 20 20V8L14 2Z"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />
              <path
                d="M14 2V8H20"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />
              <path
                d="M12 18V12"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />
              <path
                d="M9 15L12 12L15 15"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div className="file-uploader__text">{uploadText}</div>
          {helperText && <div className="file-uploader__helper-text">{helperText}</div>}
          {error && <div className="file-uploader__error-text">{error}</div>}
        </div>
      </div>

      {showUploadedFiles && files.length > 0 && (
        <div className="file-uploader__files">
          {files.map((fileData, index) => (
            <FileCard
              key={`${fileData.file.name}-${index}`}
              fileData={fileData}
              onRemove={handleRemoveFile}
              formatFileSize={formatFileSize}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FileUploader;

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { Button, Headline, Text, TextArea } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import styles from './StepDecline.module.pcss';

interface StepDeclineProps {
  onConfirmDecline(comment: string): void;
  goBack(): void;
}

const StepDecline = ({ onConfirmDecline, goBack }: StepDeclineProps) => {
  const [declineReason, setDeclineReason] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const onChangeComment = useCallback(({ value: newValue }: { value: string }) => {
    setDeclineReason(newValue);
  }, []);

  const onClick = useCallback(() => {
    if (declineReason) {
      onConfirmDecline(declineReason);
    }
  }, [declineReason, onConfirmDecline]);

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage title={'Отказ от подписания'} leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      ) : (
        <Headline className={styles.headlineDesktop} title="Отказ от подписания" />
      )}

      <div className={cx(styles.contentWrapper)}>
        <Text type="subtitle">Вы отказываетесь подписывать данный документ</Text>
        <TextArea
          className={styles.comment}
          maxLength={1000}
          title="Комментарий"
          shape="default"
          indent={false}
          placeholder="Укажите причину отказа"
          value={{ value: declineReason || '' }}
          onChange={onChangeComment}
        />
      </div>
      <div className={styles.stickyBottomContainer}>
        <Button disabled={!declineReason?.trim()?.length} onClick={onClick}>
          Подтвердить
        </Button>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default StepDecline;

// Функция для определения типа файла по его имени
export const getFileType = (fileName: string): string => {
  const extension = fileName.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();

  switch (extension) {
    case 'pdf':
      return 'application/pdf';
    case 'doc':
      return 'application/msword';
    case 'docx':
      return 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document';
    case 'jpg':
    case 'jpeg':
      return 'image/jpeg';
    case 'png':
      return 'image/png';
    default:
      return 'application/octet-stream';
  }
};

import { ReactNode, useCallback } from 'react';

import { Button, FileUploader, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { FILE_EXT_ACCEPT, FILE_UPLOAD_INFO_TEXT } from 'const/files';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useAddFileMutation } from 'core/api/documents';

import { useSequentialFileUpload } from 'hooks/useSequentialFileUpload';

import { DocumentPageStep } from 'modules/DocumentPage/types';
import { throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { DocumentManagementStatusResponse } from 'types/documents';

import styles from './StepExtraDocs.module.pcss';

interface StepExtraDocsProps {
  setStep?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<DocumentPageStep>>;
  description?: ReactNode | null;
  requestGuid?: string | null;
  onChangeStatus: (data: DocumentManagementStatusResponse) => void;
}

const UPLOAD_TITLE = 'Для подписания, пожалуйста, загрузите дополнительные документы';

const StepExtraDocs = ({
  setStep,
  description,
  requestGuid,
  onChangeStatus,
}: StepExtraDocsProps) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [addFile] = useAddFileMutation();

  const uploadSingleFile = useCallback(
    async (file: File) => {
      if (!requestGuid) {
        throw new Error('requestGuid is missing');
      }

      const response = await addFile({ requestGuid, file }).unwrap();
      throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(response);
      onChangeStatus(response);
      return response;
    },
    [addFile, onChangeStatus, requestGuid],
  );

  const onComplete = useCallback(async () => {
    setStep?.('sign');
  }, [setStep]);

  const {
    files,
    isLocked,
    isUploading,
    submitLabel,
    onValidateFiles,
    handleFilesChange,
    uploadPendingFiles,
  } = useSequentialFileUpload({
    uploadFile: uploadSingleFile,
    onComplete,
  });

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={() => setStep?.('view')} />
      ) : (
        <Headline className={styles.headlineDesktop} title={UPLOAD_TITLE} />
      )}

      <div className={styles.content}>
        <div className={cx(styles.contentWrapper)}>
          <div className={styles.documentFileUploader}>
            {isMobile && <Text type="title">{UPLOAD_TITLE}</Text>}

            {description && (
              <Text className={styles.description} type={isMobile ? 'lineRegular' : 'bodyRegular'}>
                {description}
              </Text>
            )}

            <Text
              className={styles.acceptInfo}
              color="colorForeground2"
              type={isMobile ? 'labelRegular' : 'bodyRegular'}
            >
              {FILE_UPLOAD_INFO_TEXT.split('\n').map((line, index, lines) => (
                <span key={line}>
                  {line}
                  {index < lines.length - 1 && <br />}
                </span>
              ))}
            </Text>

            <div className={isLocked ? styles.uploaderLocked : undefined}>
              <FileUploader
                listShape="box"
                mode="attach"
                variant="button"
                accept={FILE_EXT_ACCEPT}
                onChange={handleFilesChange}
                className={styles.uploader}
                caption=""
                validateFiles={onValidateFiles}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.stickyBottomContainer}>
          <Button
            disabled={files.length === 0 || isUploading || !requestGuid}
            variant="primary"
            onClick={uploadPendingFiles}
          >
            {isUploading ? 'Отправка...' : submitLabel}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default StepExtraDocs;

import React from 'react';

import { Button, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import Separator from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/Separator';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell';

import { DocumentManagementHashFile, DocumentManagementStatusResponse } from 'types/documents';

import styles from './StepSign.module.pcss';

interface StepSignProps {
  files: DocumentManagementHashFile[];
  statusData: DocumentManagementStatusResponse;
  onConfirmSign(): void;
  handleViewFile(param?: boolean): void;
  goBack(): void;
}

const StepSign = ({ files, statusData, onConfirmSign, goBack, handleViewFile }: StepSignProps) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage title="Документы" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      ) : (
        <Headline className={styles.headlineDesktop} title="Документы" />
      )}

      <div className={styles.content}>
        <div className={styles.contentWrapper}>
          <div>
            <Text type="subtitle">Вы подписываете следующие документы:</Text>

            {statusData && !!statusData?.referenceDocuments?.length && (
              <div className={styles.files}>
                {statusData?.referenceDocuments.map((fileItem) => (
                  <React.Fragment key={fileItem.crc}>
                    <DocumentCell
                      id={`ID: ${fileItem.crc.toLocaleLowerCase()}`}
                      name={fileItem.displayName}
                      fullClickable={true}
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (handleViewFile) {
                          handleViewFile(true);
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                    <Separator />
                  </React.Fragment>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <Text
            type={'lineRegular'}
            color={'colorForeground2'}
            className={isMobile ? styles.text : styles.textDesktop}
          >
            Для продолжения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.stickyBottomContainer}>
          <Button onClick={onConfirmSign}>Подтвердить</Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default StepSign;

import { Headline, Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as SuccessSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-success.svg';
import { ReactComponent as WrongSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-wrong.svg';

import styles from './StepSuccess.module.pcss';

interface StepSuccessProps {
  isDocumentSign: boolean;
  goBack?(): void;
  onClick?(): void;
}

const StepSuccess = ({ onClick, goBack, isDocumentSign }: StepSuccessProps) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage title={'Документы'} leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      ) : (
        <Headline className={styles.headlineDesktop} title="Документы" />
      )}

      <Placeholder
        variant={'success'}
        badgeText={'Успешно'}
        title={isDocumentSign ? 'Документ подписан' : 'Документ отклонен'}
        text={
          isDocumentSign
            ? 'Статус документа будет обновлен после проверки менеджером.'
            : 'При необходимости вы можете подать новую заявку.'
        }
        actionButtonText="Хорошо"
        onActionButtonClick={onClick}
        img={
          isDocumentSign ? (
            <SuccessSvg width={250} height={150} />
          ) : (
            <WrongSvg width={250} height={150} />
          )
        }
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default StepSuccess;
