import React, { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { ROUTE_DOCUMENTS } from 'const/routes';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import { description } from 'modules/DocumentPage/constants';
import { statusTextColor } from 'modules/DocumentsPage/constants';
import Separator from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/Separator';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell';

import {
  DocumentManagementHashFile,
  DocumentManagementInfo,
  DocumentManagementStatus,
  DocumentManagementStatusResponse,
} from 'types/documents';

import DocumentFileSkeleton from '../DocumentFileSkeleton';
import styles from './StepViewInfo.module.pcss';

interface StepViewInfoProps {
  docInfo: DocumentManagementInfo;
  statusData: DocumentManagementStatusResponse | null;
  isStatusLoading: boolean;
  docFiles?: DocumentManagementHashFile[];
  handleViewFile?(param?: boolean): void;
  handleSign?(): void;
  handleDecline?(): void;
}

const StepViewInfo = ({
  docInfo,
  statusData,
  isStatusLoading,
  docFiles,
  handleDecline,
  handleSign,
  handleViewFile,
}: StepViewInfoProps) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [isDisabledButtons, changeIsDisabledButtons] = useState(true);

  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const descriptionHintText = useMemo(() => {
    if (docInfo.status === 'STARTED') {
      return hints?.hints.find((item) => item.slug === 'DOC_STARTED')?.text || description.STARTED;
    }

    return description[docInfo.status];
  }, [docInfo.status, hints?.hints]);

  const goToDocHistory = () => navigate(ROUTE_DOCUMENTS);

  const getStatusName = useCallback(() => {
    if (
      docInfo?.status === DocumentManagementStatus.STARTED &&
      docInfo.type === 'SIGN' &&
      docInfo?.endDate
    ) {
      const fromIsoEndDate = DateTime.fromISO(docInfo?.endDate);
      return `Подписать до ${fromIsoEndDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)}`;
    }

    if (
      docInfo?.status === DocumentManagementStatus.NEW &&
      docInfo?.type === 'VIEW' &&
      docInfo?.endDate
    ) {
      const fromIsoEndDate = DateTime.fromISO(docInfo?.endDate);

      return `Доступен до ${fromIsoEndDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)}`;
    }

    return docInfo?.statusName;
  }, [docInfo?.endDate, docInfo?.status, docInfo?.statusName, docInfo?.type]);

  const renderFiles = useCallback(() => {
    const uniqueFiles = new Map();

    statusData?.referenceDocuments?.forEach((fileItem) => {
      uniqueFiles.set(fileItem.displayName, {
        id: fileItem.crc.toLocaleLowerCase(),
        name: fileItem.displayName,
        key: fileItem.crc,
      });
    });

    docFiles?.forEach((fileItem) => {
      uniqueFiles.set(fileItem.title, {
        id: fileItem.hash.toLocaleLowerCase(),
        name: fileItem.title,
        key: fileItem.hash,
      });
    });

    return Array.from(uniqueFiles.values()).map((file) => (
      <React.Fragment key={file.key}>
        <DocumentCell
          id={`ID: ${file.id}`}
          name={file.name}
          fullClickable={true}
          onClick={() => {
            if (handleViewFile) {
              handleViewFile(true);
              changeIsDisabledButtons(false);
            }
          }}
        />
        <Separator />
      </React.Fragment>
    ));
  }, [statusData?.referenceDocuments, docFiles, handleViewFile]);

  const getStartDate = useCallback(() => {
    if (docInfo?.createDate) {
      const fromIsoStartDate = DateTime.fromISO(docInfo?.createDate);
      return `Дата создания: ${fromIsoStartDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)}`;
    }

    return '';
  }, [docInfo?.createDate]);

  const allowSign =
    docInfo?.type === 'SIGN' &&
    (docInfo?.status === DocumentManagementStatus.VIEWED ||
      docInfo?.status === DocumentManagementStatus.NEW ||
      docInfo?.status === DocumentManagementStatus.STARTED);

  const allowView =
    docInfo?.type === 'VIEW' &&
    docInfo?.status === DocumentManagementStatus.NEW &&
    statusData?.referenceDocuments?.length;

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage title={'Документы'} leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goToDocHistory} />
      ) : (
        <Headline className={styles.headlineDesktop} title="Документы" />
      )}

      <div className={styles.content}>
        <div className={cx(styles.contentWrapper)}>
          <Text type="subtitleMedium">{docInfo?.title}</Text>
          {/* <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.createDate}>
            {getStartDate()}
          </Text> */}
          <Text
            type="lineRegular"
            color={statusTextColor[docInfo.status]}
            className={styles.status}
          >
            {getStatusName()}
          </Text>

          <Text type="lineRegular">{descriptionHintText}</Text>

          <div className={styles.files}>
            {isStatusLoading ? <DocumentFileSkeleton /> : renderFiles()}
          </div>

          {docInfo?.comment && (
            <div className={styles.commentBlock}>
              <div className={styles.commentLabel}>Комментарий</div>
              <div className={styles.commentDescription}>{docInfo?.comment}</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.stickyBottomContainer}>
          {allowSign && (
            <>
              <Button disabled={isDisabledButtons} onClick={handleSign}>
                Подписать
              </Button>
              <Button disabled={isDisabledButtons} variant="secondary" onClick={handleDecline}>
                Отклонить
              </Button>
            </>
          )}

          {allowView && <Button onClick={() => handleViewFile?.(true)}>Посмотреть документ</Button>}

          {!(allowSign || allowView) && <Button onClick={goToDocHistory}>Хорошо</Button>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default StepViewInfo;

import { FC, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_DOCUMENTS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { API_REQUEST_URL } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import {
  useDeclineDocumentMutation,
  useGetDocumentQuery,
  useLazyGetDocumentStatusQuery,
  useStartSigningDocumentMutation,
  useVerifyDocumentManagementMutation,
} from 'core/api/documents';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { isErrorResponseType } from 'utils/errorResponse';
import { isOTPConfirmErrorType, isRetriableOTPConfirmError } from 'utils/oneTimePassword';

import SomethingWentWrong from 'modules/SomethingWentWrong/SomethingWentWrong';

import { SmsConfirmation, createAlertNotification } from 'components';

import {
  DocumentManagementDeclineResponse,
  DocumentManagementStatusResponse,
} from 'types/documents/responses';
import { OTPChallenge } from 'types/oneTimePassword';

import styles from './DocumentPage.module.pcss';
import StepDecline from './components/StepDecline/StepDecline';
import StepExtraDocs from './components/StepExtraDocs/StepExtraDocs';
import StepSign from './components/StepSign/StepSign';
import StepSuccess from './components/StepSuccess/StepSuccess';
import StepViewInfo from './components/StepViewInfo/StepViewInfo';
import { getDocumentFileByUrl } from './helpers';
import { DocumentPageStep } from './types';

const DocumentPage: FC = () => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<DocumentPageStep>('view');
  const [requestGuid, setRequestGuid] = useState<string | null | undefined>(null);
  const [isLoadingStatus, setLoadingStatus] = useState(false);
  const [isDocumentSign, setIsDocumentSign] = useState(false);
  const [statusData, changeStatusData] = useState<DocumentManagementStatusResponse | null>(null);
  const [otpChallengeData, setOtpChallengeData] = useState<OTPChallenge | null>(null);
  const [otpChallengeDataDecline, setOtpChallengeDataDecline] = useState<OTPChallenge | null>(null);
  const params = useParams();
  const id = useMemo(() => params?.documentId, [params]);

  const { data, isError: isDocumentError, isLoading } = useGetDocumentQuery(id);
  const [getStatus, { isError: isStatusError }] = useLazyGetDocumentStatusQuery();
  const [startSign, { error: errorDocumentStartSign }] = useStartSigningDocumentMutation();
  const [declineDocument, { isError: isDeclineError }] = useDeclineDocumentMutation();
  const [verifyDocument, { isError: isVerifyError }] = useVerifyDocumentManagementMutation();
  const docInfo = useMemo(() => data?.document?.[0], [data]);

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const goBackToDocuments = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_DOCUMENTS);
  };

  const isPersonDocumentManagementSignGranted =
    Permissions.granted('PERSON_DOCUMENTMANAGEMENT') &&
    Permissions.granted('PERSON_DOCUMENTMANAGEMENT_SIGN');

  const checkTitle = useCallback((title?: string) => {
    if (!title) return title;

    return title.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf') ? title : `${title}.pdf`;
  }, []);

  const handleStart = useCallback(() => {
    if (id) {
      startSign(id)
        .unwrap()
        .then((data) => {
          setLoadingStatus(true);

          const guid = data?.request?.[0]?.requestGuid;
          let isRequestPending = false;
          const interval = setInterval(async () => {
            if (isRequestPending) return;

            try {
              isRequestPending = true;
              const statusData = await getStatus(guid).unwrap();
              isRequestPending = false;

              if (statusData?.requestStatus && statusData?.requestStatus[0]?.status === 'editing') {
                clearInterval(interval);
                changeStatusData(statusData);
              }
            } catch (error) {
              isRequestPending = false; // Сбрасываем флаг при ошибке
              clearInterval(interval); // Очищаем интервал при ошибке
            }
            setLoadingStatus(false);
          }, 500);
          setRequestGuid(guid);
        })
        .catch(console.error);
    }
  }, [getStatus, id, startSign]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data && !isLoading && !isDocumentError) handleStart();
  }, [data, isLoading, isDocumentError, handleStart]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (errorDocumentStartSign && isErrorResponseType(errorDocumentStartSign)) {
      const errorCode = errorDocumentStartSign?.data?.error?.[0]?.errorCode;
      if (errorCode === 'DocumentNotFound') {
        createAlertNotification({
          text: errorDocumentStartSign.data.error?.[0].errorMessageText,
          status: 'error',
        });
      }
    }
  }, [errorDocumentStartSign]);

  const handlViewReferenceFile = useCallback(async () => {
    const type = statusData?.referenceDocuments?.[0]?.type;
    const displayName = statusData?.referenceDocuments?.[0]?.displayName;
    if (!type) return;

    const referenceUrl = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/documentManagement/${requestGuid}/referenceDocument?type=${type}`;
    const fileName = `${checkTitle(displayName) || 'ReferenceFile.pdf'}`;
    await getDocumentFileByUrl(referenceUrl, fileName, isMobile);
  }, [checkTitle, isMobile, requestGuid, statusData?.referenceDocuments]);

  const handleViewFile = useCallback(
    async (isReferenceFile?: boolean) => {
      if (isReferenceFile) {
        handlViewReferenceFile();
        return;
      }
      const docFile = data?.file?.[0];
      if (id && docFile?.title) {
        const urlPdf = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/documentManagement/${id}/file?title=${docFile.title}&download=false`;
        const fileName = `${checkTitle(docFile.title) || 'document.pdf'}`;
        await getDocumentFileByUrl(urlPdf, fileName, isMobile);
      }
    },
    [checkTitle, data?.file, handlViewReferenceFile, id, isMobile],
  );

  const handleSign = useCallback(() => {
    if (docInfo) {
      setStep(docInfo.uploadFlag ? 'extraDocs' : 'sign');
    }
  }, [docInfo]);

  const handleDecline = useCallback(() => setStep('decline'), []);

  const viewState = useCallback(() => {
    setStep('view');
    setRequestGuid(null);
    changeStatusData(null);
    setOtpChallengeData(null);
    setOtpChallengeDataDecline(null);
    handleStart();
  }, [handleStart]);

  const onConfirmSign = useCallback(() => {
    if (requestGuid) {
      verifyDocument(requestGuid)
        .unwrap()
        .then((verifyData) => {
          setOtpChallengeData(verifyData?.otpChallenge);
          setStep('smsVerify');
          return;
        })
        .catch(console.error);
    }
  }, [requestGuid, verifyDocument]);

  const onConfirmDecline = useCallback(
    (comment: string) => {
      if (requestGuid) {
        declineDocument({ requestGuid, comment })
          .unwrap()
          .then((declineData: DocumentManagementDeclineResponse) => {
            if (declineData?.otpChallenge) {
              setOtpChallengeDataDecline(declineData.otpChallenge);
              setStep('smsDecline');
              setIsDocumentSign(false);
            }
          })
          .catch(console.error);
      }
    },
    [declineDocument, requestGuid],
  );

  const setSuccessStep = useCallback(() => {
    setIsDocumentSign(true);
    setStep('success');
  }, []);

  const setDeclinedStep = useCallback(() => {
    setIsDocumentSign(false);
    setStep('success');
  }, []);

  const handleError = (error: unknown) => {
    if (isOTPConfirmErrorType(error) && !isRetriableOTPConfirmError(error)) {
      createAlertNotification({
        text: error.data.error[0].errorMessageText,
        status: 'error',
      });
    }
  };

  const onChangeStatus = useCallback(
    (data: DocumentManagementStatusResponse) => changeStatusData(data),
    [],
  );

  if (
    isDocumentError ||
    isStatusError ||
    isVerifyError ||
    isDeclineError ||
    (!isPersonDocumentManagementSignGranted && docInfo?.type === 'SIGN')
  ) {
    return (
      <SomethingWentWrong
        title="Документы"
        buttonText="Закрыть"
        onAction={() => navigate(ROUTE_DOCUMENTS)}
      />
    );
  }

  if (isLoading || !docInfo) return <CircleLoader />;

  return (
    <>
      {step === 'view' && docInfo && (
        <StepViewInfo
          docInfo={docInfo}
          statusData={statusData}
          isStatusLoading={isLoadingStatus}
          docFiles={data?.file}
          handleDecline={handleDecline}
          handleSign={handleSign}
          handleViewFile={handleViewFile}
        />
      )}

      {step === 'decline' && (
        <StepDecline onConfirmDecline={onConfirmDecline} goBack={() => setStep('view')} />
      )}

      {step === 'sign' && statusData && (
        <StepSign
          onConfirmSign={onConfirmSign}
          files={data?.file || []}
          statusData={statusData}
          handleViewFile={handleViewFile}
          goBack={() => viewState()}
        />
      )}

      {otpChallengeDataDecline && step === 'smsDecline' && (
        <div className={styles.wrapperSmsForm}>
          <SmsConfirmation
            initialOTPChallenge={otpChallengeDataDecline}
            smsInputCount={4}
            onError={handleError}
            onSuccess={setDeclinedStep}
            onBackClick={viewState}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {otpChallengeData && step === 'smsVerify' && (
        <div className={styles.wrapperSmsForm}>
          <SmsConfirmation
            initialOTPChallenge={otpChallengeData}
            smsInputCount={4}
            onError={handleError}
            onSuccess={setSuccessStep}
            onBackClick={viewState}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {step === 'extraDocs' && docInfo && (
        <StepExtraDocs
          setStep={setStep}
          description={docInfo?.description}
          onChangeStatus={onChangeStatus}
          requestGuid={requestGuid}
        />
      )}

      {step === 'success' && (
        <StepSuccess
          goBack={goBackToDocuments}
          isDocumentSign={isDocumentSign}
          onClick={() => {
            window.location.reload();
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default DocumentPage;

import httpCommunicator from '@aurora/http-communicator';

import { getDefaultHeaders } from 'core/api/common';

import downloadFile from 'utils/downloadFile';

export const getDocumentFileByUrl = async (url: string, filename: string, isMobile: boolean) => {
  const response = await httpCommunicator(url, {
    method: 'get',
    responseType: 'blob',
    headers: getDefaultHeaders(url),
  });

  if (isMobile) {
    downloadFile(response.data, filename);
  } else {
    const blob = new Blob([response.data], { type: 'application/pdf' });

    // Создаем URL для blob
    const fileURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

    // Открываем URL в новой вкладке
    window.open(fileURL, '_blank');
  }
};

import { FC, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Filter, Multiselect, Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_DOCUMENTS_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import { useLazyGetDocumentsHistoryQuery } from 'core/api/documents';

import OrderSkeleton from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/OrderSkeleton';

import { ReactComponent as EmptySvg } from 'images/raw-icons/empty.svg';

import { DocumentsHistoryFilters } from 'types/documents';

import DocumentCell from '../DocumentCell';
import styles from './DocumentsHistory.module.pcss';
import { PAGE_SIZE, defaultFilters, defaultFiltersNew, getFilterData } from './constants';
import { FilterItem } from './types';

// Добавляем тип для документа
interface Document {
  guid: string;
  // Добавляем остальные поля документа, которые нужны
  [key: string]: any;
}

interface DocumentsHistoryProps {
  newOnly?: boolean;
}

const DocumentsHistory: FC<DocumentsHistoryProps> = ({ newOnly }) => {
  const [documentSize, setDocumentSize] = useState<number>(0);
  const [hasMoreDocuments, setHasMoreDocuments] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [selectedItems, setSelectedItems] = useState<FilterItem[]>([]);
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState<Document[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingMore, setIsLoadingMore] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<DocumentsHistoryFilters>(defaultFilters);

  const [getDocumentsHistory, { isFetching, isError: isDocumentsHistoryError }] =
    useLazyGetDocumentsHistoryQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    setFilters(newOnly ? defaultFiltersNew : defaultFilters);
  }, [newOnly]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchDocuments = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await getDocumentsHistory(filters);
        const fetchedDocuments: Document[] = result.data?.document || [];

        // Проверяем, есть ли еще документы
        setHasMoreDocuments(fetchedDocuments.length > PAGE_SIZE);

        if (filters.rowsOffset === 0) {
          // Для первоначальной загрузки или при изменении фильтров
          setDocuments(fetchedDocuments.slice(0, PAGE_SIZE));
        } else {
          // Для загрузки дополнительных документов (loadMore)
          setDocuments((prevDocs) => [...prevDocs, ...fetchedDocuments.slice(0, PAGE_SIZE)]);
        }

        setIsLoadingMore(false);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Ошибка при получении истории документов:', error);
        setIsLoadingMore(false);
      }
    };

    fetchDocuments();
  }, [filters, getDocumentsHistory]);

  const handleFilterChange = useCallback(
    (items: FilterItem[]): void => {
      const statusList =
        newOnly && !items?.length
          ? 'STARTED,NEW'
          : items.map((item: FilterItem) => item.id).join(',');

      setSelectedItems(items);
      setDocumentSize(0);
      setFilters({
        ...filters,
        statusList,
        rowsOffset: 0,
      });
    },
    [filters, newOnly],
  );

  const handleSortChange = (): void => {
    const newOrderBy = filters.orderBy === 'createDate-' ? 'createDate+' : 'createDate-';

    setFilters({
      ...filters,
      orderBy: newOrderBy,
      rowsOffset: 0,
    });
    setDocumentSize(0);
  };

  const loadMore = (): void => {
    const newDocumentSize = documentSize + PAGE_SIZE;
    setIsLoadingMore(true);
    setDocumentSize(newDocumentSize);
    setFilters({
      ...filters,
      rowsOffset: newDocumentSize,
    });
  };

  if (isDocumentsHistoryError) {
    return <Navigate to={ROUTE_DOCUMENTS_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>
      <div className={styles.content} onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {isFetching && !isLoadingMore ? (
          <OrderSkeleton count={4} />
        ) : (
          <div>
            <div className={styles.topBarAction}>
              <div className={styles.topBarActionFilter}>
                {selectedItems.length === 0 && (
                  <div className={styles.filterPlaceholder}>Выберите статус</div>
                )}
                <Multiselect
                  data={getFilterData(newOnly)}
                  onChange={(filterData: any) => {
                    handleFilterChange(filterData);
                  }}
                  shape="dropdown"
                  value={selectedItems}
                />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.topBarActionSortFilter}>
                <Filter
                  mode="whitebg"
                  shape="sort"
                  sortDirection={filters.orderBy === 'createDate-' ? 'up' : 'down'}
                  onClick={handleSortChange}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            {documents?.length
              ? documents.map((doc: any) => <DocumentCell key={doc.guid} data={doc} />)
              : !isFetching && (
                  <Placeholder
                    shape="emptyState"
                    title="Здесь пока пусто"
                    text="Документы отсутствуют"
                    img={<EmptySvg />}
                  />
                )}
            {hasMoreDocuments && (
              <div className={styles.loadMoreButton}>
                <Button variant={'secondary'} size="s" onClick={loadMore} disabled={isLoadingMore}>
                  {isLoadingMore ? 'Загрузка...' : 'Показать еще'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DocumentsHistory;

import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { useLazyGetDocumentsHistoryQuery } from 'core/api/documents';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

import { DocumentsHistoryFilters } from 'types/documents';

import { DEFAULT_QUERY_ERROR_MESSAGE } from '../constants';

export const useDocumentsHistory = (filters: DocumentsHistoryFilters) => {
  const [getDocumentsHistory, { data, isLoading, isError }] = useLazyGetDocumentsHistoryQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    getDocumentsHistory(filters);
  }, [getDocumentsHistory, filters]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isError &&
      createAlertNotification({
        text: DEFAULT_QUERY_ERROR_MESSAGE,
        status: 'error',
      });
  }, [isError]);

  return {
    data,
    isLoading,
  };
};

import { Dispatch, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Text, TextArea } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useSendFeedbackMsgMutation } from 'core/api/feedback';
import { useLazyGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import ErrorPage from 'modules/Feedback/components/ErrorPage';

import { AdaptivePopover, CardButton, Option, OptionsList } from 'components';

import { getFormFunctions, getTextMessage } from '../../helpers';
import { FeedbackState, MessageType, ResponseMessageTypes } from '../../types';
import FeedbackFormFooter from '../FeedbackFormFooter';
import FileSwiper from '../FileSwiper';
import SuccessPage from '../SuccessPage';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  state: FeedbackState;
  dataFeedbackTypes?: ResponseMessageTypes;
  dispatch: Dispatch<
    Partial<FeedbackState> | ((state: FeedbackState) => Partial<FeedbackState> | null)
  >;
};

const FeedbackForm = ({ state, dataFeedbackTypes, dispatch }: Props) => {
  const { type } = useParams();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const { email, topicMessage, typeMessage, message, files, step } = state;
  const isValidCommentForm = !!topicMessage.trim() && !!message.trim() && !!typeMessage?.trim();
  const isValidComplainForm = !!message.trim();
  const isValidForm = type === 'claim' ? isValidComplainForm : isValidCommentForm;
  const [trigger, hints] = useLazyGetHintsQuery();

  const [
    sendFeedbackMessage,
    {
      isSuccess: isSuccessStatusSendFeedbackMessage,
      isLoading: isLoadingStatusSendFeedbackMessage,
      isError: isErrorStatusSendFeedbackMessage,
      data: dataSendFeedbackMessage,
    },
  ] = useSendFeedbackMsgMutation();

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const handleBottomSheetOpen = () => {
    setIsOpen(!isOpen);
  };

  const { setTopicMessage, setMessage, onFileChange, deleteFile } = useMemo(
    () => getFormFunctions(dispatch, files),
    [dispatch, files],
  );

  const feedbackTopicList = useMemo((): Option<MessageType>[] => {
    if (!dataFeedbackTypes) return [];

    return Object.entries(dataFeedbackTypes.result)
      .filter(([key]) => !['question', 'complaint'].includes(key))
      .map(([key, label]) => {
        const value = key as MessageType;

        return {
          title: label,
          id: value,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.title.length - a.title.length);
  }, [dataFeedbackTypes]);

  const selectedOption = useMemo(() => {
    return feedbackTopicList.find((el) => el.title === topicMessage);
  }, [topicMessage, feedbackTopicList]);

  const onTopicSelect = (option: Option<string>) => {
    const selectedTopic = feedbackTopicList.find((el) => el.id === option.id);
    if (!selectedTopic) return;
    setTopicMessage(selectedTopic);
  };

  const handleSendMessage = () => {
    if (!isValidForm) return;
    if (type === 'claim') {
      sendFeedbackMessage({
        title: 'Официальная претензия',
        text: getTextMessage(message, email),
        files,
      });
    } else {
      sendFeedbackMessage({
        title: 'Оценка работы сервиса',
        text: getTextMessage(message),
        type: typeMessage || '',
        files,
      });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!feedbackTopicList.length) return;

    dispatch(({ typeMessage }) => {
      if (!typeMessage) {
        return { typeMessage: feedbackTopicList[0].title };
      }

      return null;
    });
  }, [dispatch, feedbackTopicList]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSuccessStatusSendFeedbackMessage && !!dataSendFeedbackMessage) {
      dispatch({ step: 'SUCCESS' });
    }
  }, [dataSendFeedbackMessage, isSuccessStatusSendFeedbackMessage, dispatch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (type === 'claim' && !hints.data) {
      trigger();
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [trigger, type]);

  const isLoading = isLoadingStatusSendFeedbackMessage || (type === 'claim' && !hints.data);

  const slugText = useMemo(
    () => hints.data?.hints.find((item) => item.slug === 'CLAIM')?.text,
    [hints.data?.hints],
  );

  if (isErrorStatusSendFeedbackMessage) {
    return <ErrorPage />;
  }

  return isLoading ? (
    <CircleLoader type="page" brandColor />
  ) : step === 'FILL' ? (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrapper : styles.wrapperDesktop}>
      <div>
        {type === 'claim' ? (
          <>
            <Text type="title">Оформление претензии</Text>
            <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.subTitle}>
              Обратиться с официальным запросом по процессам обслуживания брокерского счёта
            </Text>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Text type="title">Оценка работы сервиса</Text>
            <Text type="lineRegular" className={isMobile ? styles.subTitle : styles.subTitleWrap}>
              Поделитесь предложениями по развитию
            </Text>
            <AdaptivePopover
              isOpen={isOpen}
              onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
              button={
                <CardButton
                  title={topicMessage}
                  placeholder={'Выберите тему'}
                  onClick={handleBottomSheetOpen}
                  className={!isMobile ? styles.cardWrapper : styles.topicInput}
                  classNameTitle={cx({ [styles.topicInputText]: isMobile })}
                />
              }
              classNameContent={styles.cardTitle}
              className={styles.popup}
            >
              <div className={cx({ [styles.bottomSheetContent]: isMobile })}>
                {isMobile && (
                  <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.topicListTitle}>
                    Выберите тему
                  </Text>
                )}
                <OptionsList
                  options={feedbackTopicList}
                  selectedOption={selectedOption}
                  onChange={onTopicSelect}
                  onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
                />
              </div>
            </AdaptivePopover>
          </>
        )}

        {!!Object.keys(files).length && <FileSwiper files={files} deleteFile={deleteFile} />}
        <div
          className={cx({
            [styles.textareaWrapper]: message?.length,
            [styles.withFileAttachment]: !!Object.keys(files).length,
          })}
        >
          <TextArea
            placeholder="Ваше сообщение"
            maxLength={1000}
            value={{ value: message }}
            onChange={setMessage}
            className={styles.textarea}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <FeedbackFormFooter
        files={files}
        isButtonDisabled={!isValidForm}
        onFileChange={onFileChange}
        handleSendMessage={handleSendMessage}
      />
    </div>
  ) : (
    <SuccessPage state={state} slugText={slugText} />
  );
};

export default FeedbackForm;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import FileItem, { IFileItemProps } from '@um/file-item';
import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  file: File;
  id: string;
  deleteFile: (key: string) => void;
};

const imgExtensions = ['gif', 'jpg', 'png'];

const FilePreview = ({ file, id, deleteFile }: Props) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [base64, setBase64] = useState('');

  const [fileName, fileExtension] = file.name.split('.');
  const isImg = imgExtensions.includes(fileExtension);
  const fileSize = new BigNumber(file.size).toFixed(2);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isImg || !file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = function () {
      if (typeof reader.result === 'string') {
        setBase64(reader.result);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }, [file, isImg]);

  return (
    <FileItem
      name={fileName}
      size={+fileSize}
      status={'default'}
      mime={file.type as IFileItemProps['mime']}
      previewSrc={base64}
      view="box"
      withBorder={true}
      classNameHoverBox={cx({ [styles.fileWrapper]: isMobile })}
      onRemoveClick={() => deleteFile(id)}
    />
  );
};

export default FilePreview;

import { Pagination } from 'swiper';

    <Swiper

          <FilePreview id={key} file={files[key]} deleteFile={deleteFile} />
        </SwiperSlide>
      ))}
    </Swiper>
  );
};

import { ChangeEvent, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { ReactInputMask } from 'react-input-mask';

import Input from '@aurora/input';
import Text from '@vision/text';

import { ReactComponent as ClipSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/feedback/clip.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  files: Record<string, File>;
  onFileChange: (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
};

type InputType = ReactInputMask & {
  setInputValue: (str: string | null) => void;
};

const accept = '.docx, .doc, .rtf, .xlsx, .xls, .gif, .pdf, .jpg, .png';

const InputFile = ({ files, onFileChange }: Props) => {
  const inputRef = useRef<InputType>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!inputRef?.current?.setInputValue) return;
    inputRef.current.setInputValue(null);
  }, [files]);

  return (
    <label>
      <Input
        ref={inputRef}
        className={styles.input}
        type="file"
        multiple
        accept={accept}
        onChange={onFileChange}
      />
      <div className={styles.btnWrapper}>
        <ClipSvg />
        <Text type="lineMedium">Прикрeпить</Text>
      </div>
    </label>
  );
};

export default InputFile;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import Badge from '@vision/badge';
import { ROUTE_HELP } from 'const/routes';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { DynamicText, HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as SuccessSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import { FeedbackState } from '../../types';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  state: FeedbackState;
  slugText?: string;
};

const SuccessPage = ({ state, slugText }: Props) => {
  const { type } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const goToHelpPage = () => navigate(ROUTE_HELP);
  const { email } = state;
  const [loadedContent, setLoadedContent] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (slugText) {
      setLoadedContent(sanitizeHtml(slugText));
    }
  }, [slugText]);

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        size="small"
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={goToHelpPage}
        documentTitle="Отзывы и претензии"

      />

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.contentWrapper : styles.contentWrapperDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.imgContainer}>
          <SuccessSvg />
        </div>
        <div>
          <Badge variant="success">Успешно</Badge>
          {type === 'claim' ? (
            <>
              <Text type="title" className={styles.title}>
                Претензия отправлена
              </Text>
              <Text type="lineRegular">{loadedContent.replace('почту', email)}</Text>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Text type="title" className={styles.title}>
                Сообщение отправлено
              </Text>
              <DynamicText type="lineRegular" slug="SEND_FEEDBACK" />
            </>
          )}
          <div className={isMobile ? styles.buttonWrapper : styles.buttonWrapperDesktop}>
            <Button onClick={goToHelpPage}>Хорошо</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default SuccessPage;

export const SIZE_FILE_MB = Math.pow(2, 20) * 5;

export const MAX_COMMON_SIZE_FILES_MB = Math.pow(2, 20) * 15;

export const ACCEPTED_TYPES = [
  '.docx$',
  '.doc$',
  '.rtf$',
  '.xlsx$',
  '.xls$',
  '.gif$',
  '.pdf$',
  '.jpg$',
  '.jpeg$',
  '.png$',
];

export const ACCEPTED_TYPES_REGEX = new RegExp(
  ACCEPTED_TYPES.map(function (s) {
    return s.replace(/[()*+./?[\\\]^{|}-]/g, '\\$&');
  }).join('|'),
);

import { useEffect, useReducer } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { useGetFeedbackThemesQuery } from 'core/api/feedback';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { HeaderPage, UnavailableContent } from 'components';

import FeedbackForm from './components/FeedbackForm';
import Skeleton from './components/Skeleton';
import { feedbackInitialState, feedbackReducer } from './reducer';

const Feedback = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { type } = useParams();
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(feedbackReducer, feedbackInitialState);
  const {
    data: dataFeedbackTypes,
    isSuccess: isSuccessFeedbackTypes,
    isError: isErrorFeedbackTypes,
    isLoading: isLoadingFeedbackTypes,
  } = useGetFeedbackThemesQuery();

  const userInfo = getSession();

  const brokerChatSendDenied = Permissions.denied('PERSONAL_BROKERCHAT_SEND');
  const brokerChatSendBlocked = Permissions.blocked('PERSONAL_BROKERCHAT_SEND');

  const isError =
    (isErrorFeedbackTypes && type === 'comment') || brokerChatSendDenied || brokerChatSendBlocked;
  const isLoading =
    isLoadingFeedbackTypes && type === 'comment' && !brokerChatSendDenied && !brokerChatSendBlocked;
  const showContent =
    (isSuccessFeedbackTypes || type === 'claim') && !brokerChatSendDenied && !brokerChatSendBlocked;

  const onLeftIconClick = () => navigate(-1);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userInfo?.userEMail) {
      dispatch({
        email: userInfo.userEMail,
      });
    }
  }, [userInfo]);

  return (
    <>
      {state.step !== 'SUCCESS' && (
        <HeaderPage
          size="small"
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={onLeftIconClick}
          title="Отзывы и претензии"
          documentTitle="Отзывы и претензии"
        />
      )}
      {isLoading && <Skeleton />}
      {isError && <UnavailableContent />}
      {showContent && (
        <FeedbackForm state={state} dataFeedbackTypes={dataFeedbackTypes} dispatch={dispatch} />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Feedback;

import { ChangeEvent, Dispatch } from 'react';

import { TextAreaValue } from '@aurora/components';
import { UAParser } from 'ua-parser-js';

import {
  ACCEPTED_TYPES_REGEX,
  MAX_COMMON_SIZE_FILES_MB,
  SIZE_FILE_MB,
} from 'modules/Feedback/consts';

import { Option } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { FeedbackState } from './types';

export const getFormFunctions = (
  dispatch: Dispatch<
    Partial<FeedbackState> | ((state: FeedbackState) => Partial<FeedbackState> | null)
  >,
  files: Record<string, File>,
) => ({
  setTopicMessage: (option: Option<string>) =>
    dispatch({ topicMessage: option.title, typeMessage: option.id }),
  setMessage: (data: TextAreaValue) => dispatch({ message: data.value }),
  onFileChange: (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const uploadedFiles = e.target.files;
    if (
      uploadedFiles &&
      Array.from(uploadedFiles).some(({ name }) => !ACCEPTED_TYPES_REGEX.test(name.toLowerCase()))
    ) {
      createAlertNotification({
        status: 'error',
        text: 'Допустимые форматы: docx, doc, rtf, xlsx, xls, gif, pdf, jpg, png',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (uploadedFiles && Array.from(uploadedFiles).some(({ size }) => size > SIZE_FILE_MB)) {
      createAlertNotification({
        status: 'error',
        text: 'Максимальный размер загружаемого файла: 5 Мб',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (
      uploadedFiles &&
      Array.from(uploadedFiles)
        .concat(Object.values(files))
        .reduce((acc, { size }) => acc + size, 0) > MAX_COMMON_SIZE_FILES_MB
    ) {
      createAlertNotification({
        status: 'error',
        text: 'Суммарный размер загружаемых файлов должен быть не больше 15 Мб',
      });
      return;
    }

    dispatch(({ files: stateFiles }) => {
      if (!uploadedFiles || !uploadedFiles.length) return null;

      const maxId = Object.keys(stateFiles).reduce((maxId, key) => {
        if (Number(key) && Number(key) > maxId) {
          maxId = Number(key);
        }

        return maxId;
      }, 0);

      const newFiles = {
        ...stateFiles,
      };
      Array.from(uploadedFiles).forEach((el, i) => {
        newFiles[i + maxId + 1] = el;
      });

      return { files: newFiles };
    });
  },
  deleteFile: (deleteFileKey: string) => {
    dispatch(() => {
      const newFiles: Record<string, File> = {};
      Object.entries(files).forEach(([key, file]) => {
        if (key !== deleteFileKey) {
          newFiles[key] = file;
        }
      });

      return { files: newFiles };
    });
  },
});

export const getTextMessage = (text: string, email?: string) => {
  const { model } = new UAParser().getDevice();
  const browser = new UAParser().getBrowser();
  const info = email
    ? `



  ------

  Email: ${email}

  Канал: PWA

  Устройство: ${model}

  Версия приложения: ${browser.name} ${browser.version}

  `
    : `



  ------

  Канал: PWA

  Устройство: ${model}

  Версия приложения: ${browser.name} ${browser.version}

  `;
  return text + info;
};

import { FeedbackState } from './types';

export const feedbackInitialState: FeedbackState = {
  email: '',
  message: '',
  topicMessage: '',
  typeMessage: null,
  files: {},
  isValidForm: false,
  step: 'FILL',
};

export const feedbackReducer = (
  state = feedbackInitialState,
  update: Partial<FeedbackState> | ((state: FeedbackState) => Partial<FeedbackState> | null),
): FeedbackState => {
  const updates = typeof update === 'function' ? update(state) : update;

  if (!updates) return state;

  const newState = {
    ...state,
    ...updates,
  };

  const isValidForm = !!newState.message && !!newState.topicMessage && !!newState.typeMessage;
  newState.isValidForm = isValidForm;

  return newState;
};

};

describe('getTextMessage function', () => {
  describe.each(GET_TEXT_MESSAGE_CASES)(
    "when given text '%s' and email '%s'",
    (text, email, expected) => {
      it('should return the expected result', () => {
        const result = getTextMessage(text, email);
        expect(result).toEqual(expected);
      });
    },
  );
});

describe('getFormFunctions', () => {
  const dispatch = jest.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    dispatch.mockClear();
  });

  describe('setTopicMessage', () => {
    it('should dispatch the correct action', () => {
      const { setTopicMessage } = getFormFunctions(dispatch, {});
      const option = { id: '1', title: 'Test topic' };
      setTopicMessage(option);
      expect(dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        topicMessage: option.title,
        typeMessage: option.id,
      });
    });
  });

  describe('setMessage', () => {
    it('should dispatch the message', () => {
      const { setMessage } = getFormFunctions(dispatch, {});
      const textAreaValue = { value: 'Hello, world!' };
      setMessage(textAreaValue);
      expect(dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ message: textAreaValue.value });
    });
  });

  describe('onFileChange', () => {
    const { onFileChange } = getFormFunctions(dispatch, {});

    const createAlertNotificationMocked = jest.mocked(createAlertNotification, true);

    const getEvent = (files: File[]) => {
      return { target: { files } } as unknown as ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>;
    };

    beforeEach(() => {
      createAlertNotificationMocked.mockClear();
    });

    it('should dispatch nothing if all uploaded files are of an accepted type and size', () => {
      const filesArray = ACCEPTED_TYPES.map((type, index) => {
        return new File([''], `file${index}${type.replace('$', '')}`, {
          type: '',
          lastModified: 0,
        });
      });

      const event = getEvent(filesArray);
      onFileChange(event as unknown as ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>);
      expect(dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.any(Function));
      expect(createAlertNotificationMocked).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should create an error alert notification and dispatch nothing if any uploaded files are not of an accepted type', () => {
      const file1 = new File([''], 'file1.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg', lastModified: 0 });
      const file2 = new File([''], 'file2.unknown', {
        type: 'application/octet-stream',
        lastModified: 0,
      });
      const event = getEvent([file1, file2]);
      onFileChange(event);
      expect(dispatch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(createAlertNotificationMocked).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        status: 'error',
        text: 'Допустимые форматы: docx, doc, rtf, xlsx, xls, gif, pdf, jpg, png',
      });
    });

    it('should create an error alert notification and dispatch nothing if any uploaded files are too large', () => {
      const file1 = new File([''], 'file1.jpg', {
        type: 'image/jpeg',
        lastModified: 0,
      });
      Object.defineProperty(file1, 'size', { value: SIZE_FILE_MB + 1 });
      const event = getEvent([file1]);
      onFileChange(event as unknown as ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>);
      expect(dispatch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(createAlertNotificationMocked).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        status: 'error',
        text: 'Максимальный размер загружаемого файла: 5 Мб',
      });
    });
    it('should create an error alert notification and dispatch nothing if the uploaded files exceed the maximum common size', () => {
      const file1 = new File(['file1'], 'file1.pdf', { type: 'application/pdf' });
      const file2 = new File(['file2'], 'file2.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });
      const file3 = new File(['file3'], 'file3.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' });

      Object.defineProperty(file1, 'size', { value: Math.floor(MAX_COMMON_SIZE_FILES_MB / 3) });
      Object.defineProperty(file2, 'size', { value: Math.floor(MAX_COMMON_SIZE_FILES_MB / 3) });
      Object.defineProperty(file3, 'size', {
        value: Math.floor(MAX_COMMON_SIZE_FILES_MB / 3) + 10,
      });

      const filesArray = [file1, file2, file3];

      const event = getEvent(filesArray);
      onFileChange(event);

      expect(createAlertNotification).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        status: 'error',
        text: 'Суммарный размер загружаемых файлов должен быть не больше 15 Мб',
      });
      expect(dispatch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('should add a single file to state', () => {
      dispatch.mockImplementationOnce((fn) => {
        return fn({ files: {} });
      });
      const filesArray = [new File(['test'], 'test.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' })];

      const event = getEvent(filesArray);
      onFileChange(event);

      const dispatchedFiles = Array.from(filesArray).reduce((acc, curr, index) => {
        acc[index + 1] = curr;
        return acc;
      }, {} as Record<number, File>);

      expect(dispatch).toReturnWith({ files: dispatchedFiles });
    });

    it('should add multiple files to state', () => {
      dispatch.mockImplementationOnce((fn) => {
        return fn({ files: {} });
      });
      const filesArray = [
        new File(['test'], 'test1.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' }),
        new File(['test'], 'test2.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' }),
        new File(['test'], 'test3.jpg', { type: 'image/jpeg' }),
      ];

      const event = getEvent(filesArray);
      onFileChange(event);

      const dispatchedFiles = Array.from(filesArray).reduce((acc, curr, index) => {
        acc[index + 1] = curr;
        return acc;
      }, {} as Record<number, File>);
      expect(dispatch).toReturnWith({ files: dispatchedFiles });
    });
  });
  describe('deleteFile', () => {
    it('should delete a file from the files state and dispatch an update', () => {
      dispatch.mockImplementationOnce((fn) => {
        return fn({ files: {} });
      });
      const files = {
        '1': new File([], 'file1.jpg'),
        '2': new File([], 'file2.png'),
      };
      const { deleteFile } = getFormFunctions(dispatch, files);

      deleteFile('2');

      expect(dispatch).toReturnWith({
        files: { '1': files['1'] },
      });
    });

    it('should not dispatch an update if the deleteFileKey does not exist in the files state', () => {
      dispatch.mockImplementationOnce((fn) => {
        return fn({ files: {} });
      });
      const files = {
        '1': new File([], 'file1.jpg'),
        '2': new File([], 'file2.png'),
      };
      const { deleteFile } = getFormFunctions(dispatch, files);

      deleteFile('3');

      expect(dispatch).toReturnWith({
        files: { '1': files['1'], '2': files['2'] },
      });
    });
  });
});

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet';
import { HeaderProps } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/types';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';
import { ReactComponent as NotesSvg } from 'images/icons/notes.svg';

import styles from './Header.module.pcss';

const Header = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  instrumentName,
  instrumentCode,
  tradePlaceShortName,
  favorite,
  onNotesClick,
  onRefetch,
}: HeaderProps) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  return isMobile ? (
    <HeaderPage
      title={instrumentName}
      subtitle={instrumentCode ? `${instrumentCode} · ${tradePlaceShortName}` : tradePlaceShortName}
      leftIconVariant="back"
      onLeftIconClick={() => navigate(-1)}
      addonRight={
        <div className={styles.iconsWrapper}>
          <div className={styles.notesIconWrapper} onClick={() => onNotesClick?.()}>
            <NotesSvg />
          </div>

          <FavoriteButtonWithBottomSheet
            instrumentId={Number(instrumentId)}
            tradePlaceId={Number(tradePlaceId)}
            isFavorite={favorite}
            onRefetch={onRefetch}
          />
        </div>
      }
    />
  ) : (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title={instrumentName}>
        <div
          className={cx(
            styles.alternativeHeaderContainer,
            styles.alternativeHeaderWithoutAddonRight,
          )}
        >
          <div className={cx(styles.alternativeHeaderLeft, styles.alternativeHeaderSmall)}>
            <Button
              iconLeft={<BackSvg />}
              onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
              shape="inline"
              variant="white"
            >
              <Text type="labelMedium">Назад</Text>
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div
            className={cx(styles.alternativeHeaderCenter, styles.alternativeHeaderCenterMaxStretch)}
          >
            <Text className={styles.alternativeHeaderTitle} type={'lineSemiBold'}>
              {instrumentName}
            </Text>
            <Text
              className={styles.alternativeHeaderLabel}
              color="colorForeground2"
              type="labelSemiBold"
            >
              {instrumentCode ? `${instrumentCode} · ${tradePlaceShortName}` : tradePlaceShortName}
            </Text>
          </div>
        </div>
      </HeaderPage>
    </>
  );
};

export default Header;

import { FC } from 'react';

import Card from '@vision/card';
import Text from '@vision/text';

import { StopOrderStatus } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/types';

import { ReactComponent as PlusIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/badge-glyph-plus.svg';
import { ReactComponent as StopOrderIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/badge-icon-stop-order.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  status: StopOrderStatus;
  hasStopOrder: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
};

const StopOrderButton: FC<Props> = ({ status, hasStopOrder, onClick }) => {
  const isActive = status === 'ACTIVE';

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>
      <Card backgroundColor="gray" onClick={onClick} className={styles.card}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text type="lineRegular" color={isActive ? 'colorForeground' : 'colorDisabledButtonText'}>
            Условная заявка
          </Text>
          {hasStopOrder && <StopOrderIcon />}
        </div>
        <PlusIcon className={isActive ? undefined : styles.disabled} />
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StopOrderButton;

import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

type TypedState = { from: string };

export const useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam = () => {
  const location = useLocation();

  const { state } = location;
  const typedState = state as TypedState;

  if (!typedState) {
    return 'view';
  }

  if (typedState.from === 'portfolio') return;

  if (typedState.from === 'search') {
    return 'search';
  }

  return 'view';
};

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { useGetPersonsCurrentNotesInstrumentQuery } from 'core/api/notes';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { NOTE_CHANGED } from 'components/Notes/constants';

import { UseInstrumentNotesProps } from '../types';

export const useInstrumentNotes = ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId }: UseInstrumentNotesProps) => {
  const [openedInstrumentNotesData, setOpenedInstrumentNotesData] = useState<{
    instrumentId: number;
    tradePlaceId: number;
  } | null>(null);

  const {
    isError: isPersonsCurrentNotesInstrumentError,
    data: personsCurrentNotesInstrumentData,
    refetch: refetchPersonsCurrentNotesInstrument,
  } = useGetPersonsCurrentNotesInstrumentQuery({
    instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
    tradePlaceId: Number(tradePlaceId),
  });

  const [openedCreateOrEditNoteData, setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData] = useState<{
    instrumentId: number;
    tradePlaceId: number;
    noteId: number;
    text: string;
    changeTime: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const formattedNotes = useMemo(() => {
    if (!personsCurrentNotesInstrumentData) {
      return null;
    }

    return personsCurrentNotesInstrumentData.notes.map(({ noteId, text, changeTime }) => {
      const typedInstrumentId = Number(instrumentId);
      const typedTradePlaceId = Number(tradePlaceId);

      return {
        instrumentId: typedInstrumentId,
        tradePlaceId: typedTradePlaceId,
        noteId,
        text,
        changeTime,
        onClick: () => {
          setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData({
            instrumentId: typedInstrumentId,
            tradePlaceId: typedTradePlaceId,
            noteId,
            text,
            changeTime,
          });
        },
      };
    });
  }, [instrumentId, tradePlaceId, personsCurrentNotesInstrumentData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe(NOTE_CHANGED, refetchPersonsCurrentNotesInstrument);

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [refetchPersonsCurrentNotesInstrument]);

  const handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss = useCallback(
    () => setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData(null),
    [],
  );

  const handleNotesClick = useCallback(() => {
    setOpenedInstrumentNotesData({
      instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
      tradePlaceId: Number(tradePlaceId),
    });
  }, [instrumentId, tradePlaceId]);

  const handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss = useCallback(
    () => setOpenedInstrumentNotesData(null),
    [],
  );

  return {
    formattedNotes,
    openedInstrumentNotesData,
    openedCreateOrEditNoteData,
    isPersonsCurrentNotesInstrumentError,
    handleNotesClick,
    handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss,
    handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss,
  };
};

import { isBond, isFund, isStock } from 'utils/instrument';

import { TabType } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/types';

import { ReactComponent as StopOrderIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/badge-icon-stop-order.svg';

import { TradingAccount, TradingProduct } from 'types/accounts';
import { Hint } from 'types/hints';
import { InstrumentInfoFlag } from 'types/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { InstrumentInfoResponse } from 'types/instruments';

import { getInstrumentType } from './pages/Details/helpers';
import { StopOrderStatus, StopOrderStatusParams, StopOrderStatusTextParams } from './types';

export const getInstrumentIds = (instrument?: string) => {
  if (instrument) {
    const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = instrument.split('_');
    return [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] as const;
  }
  return ['', ''] as const;
};

export const getTradingSessionBtn = (
  tradeSessionStatus: string,
  tradingAvailibility = '',
  deniedReason = '',
  hints: Hint[] = [],
  tradingProducts: TradingProduct[] | undefined,
  tradingAccounts: TradingAccount[] | undefined,
): { isBtnShow: boolean; notificationText?: string } => {
  if (tradeSessionStatus === 'CLEARING') {
    const slug = getHintText(hints, 'FI_CLEARING');
    return {
      isBtnShow: false,
      notificationText: slug ? slug : 'Проводится клиринг. Совершение операций невозможно.',
    };
  }

  if (tradingAvailibility === 'DENIED') {
    if (deniedReason === 'InstrumentTypeOrTradePlaceRestriction') {
      const slug = getHintText(hints, 'FI_INSTRUMENT_TYPE_OR_TRADE_PLACE_RESTRICTION');
      return {
        isBtnShow: false,
        notificationText: slug ? slug : '',
      };
    }

    if (deniedReason === 'NoActiveTradeSession') {
      const slug = getHintText(hints, 'FI_NO_ACTIVE_TRADE_SESSION');
      return {
        isBtnShow: false,
        notificationText: slug
          ? slug
          : 'Торговая сессия закрыта. Совершение торговой операции невозможно',
      };
    }

    if (deniedReason === 'W8TradeRestriction') {
      const slug = getHintText(hints, 'FI_W_EIGHT_TRADE_RESTRICTION');
      return {
        isBtnShow: false,
        notificationText: slug ? slug : 'Для совершения операции необходимо подписать форму W8-BEN',
      };
    }

    if (!tradingProducts || !tradingProducts?.length) {
      const slug = getHintText(hints, 'FI_TRADING_PRODUCTS_IS_EMPTY');
      return {
        isBtnShow: false,
        notificationText: slug ? slug : 'Нет счетов для торговли данным инструментом.',
      };
    }

    if (deniedReason === 'TechnicalProblem') {
      const slug = getHintText(hints, 'FI_TECHNICAL_PROBLEM');
      return {
        isBtnShow: false,
        notificationText: slug
          ? slug
          : 'Совершение торговых операций временно невозможно. Подать поручение по тел.: 8 800 775-1945',
      };
    }

    if (deniedReason === 'NoActiveTradingAccount') {
      if (!tradingProducts)
        return {
          isBtnShow: false,
          notificationText: 'Совершение торговой операции невозможно',
        };

      const areAllAccountBlocked = tradingAccounts?.every(
        (item) => item.tradePermissionState === 'DENIED',
      );

      if (areAllAccountBlocked) {
        if (
          tradingAccounts?.every((item) => item.deniedReason === 'AccountBlocked') ||
          tradingAccounts?.every((item) => item.deniedReason === 'AbsenceOfTradingAccountCode')
        )
          return {
            isBtnShow: false,
            notificationText: 'На ваших счетах введены ограничения на подачу поручений',
          };

        if (tradingAccounts?.every((item) => item.deniedReason === 'MT5TerminalConnected'))
          return {
            isBtnShow: false,
            notificationText: 'Совершение торговой операции невозможно',
          };
      }

      return {
        isBtnShow: false,
        notificationText: 'Совершение торговой операции невозможно',
      };
    }

    return { isBtnShow: true };
  }

  return {
    isBtnShow: true,
  };
};

export const getHintText = (hints: Hint[], slug: string) => {
  return hints.find((item) => item.slug === slug)?.text;
};

export const getStopOrderStatus = ({
  tradeAvailability,
  stopOrderPermissionState,
  stopOrderDeniedReason,
}: StopOrderStatusParams): StopOrderStatus => {
  if (
    !tradeAvailability ||
    (stopOrderPermissionState !== 'GRANTED' &&
      stopOrderDeniedReason === 'InstrumentTypeOrTradePlaceRestriction')
  )
    return 'OFF';

  if (stopOrderPermissionState !== 'GRANTED') return 'NONACTIVE';

  return 'ACTIVE';
};

export const getStopOrderStatusText = ({
  stopOrderDeniedReason,
  hints,
  tradingProducts,
  tradingAccounts,
}: StopOrderStatusTextParams): string => {
  if (stopOrderDeniedReason === 'StopOrderNotAvailable') {
    const slug = getHintText(hints, 'STOP_ORDER_NOT_AVAILABLE');

    return slug || 'Выставление условной заявки недоступно. Повторите попытку позднее';
  }

  if (!tradingProducts.length && stopOrderDeniedReason === 'NoActiveTradingAccount') {
    const slug = getHintText(hints, 'FI_TRADING_PRODUCTS_IS_EMPTY');

    return slug || 'Нет счетов для торговли данным инструментом.';
  }

  if (stopOrderDeniedReason === 'TechnicalProblem') {
    const slug = getHintText(hints, 'TECHNICAL_PROBLEM');

    return (
      slug ||
      'Совершение торговых операций временно недоступно. Подайте поручение по тел.: 8 800 775-1945'
    );
  }

  if (stopOrderDeniedReason === 'W8TradeRestriction') {
    const slug = getHintText(hints, 'FI_W_EIGHT_TRADE_RESTRICTION');

    return slug || 'Для совершения операции необходимо подписать форму W8-BEN';
  }

  if (stopOrderDeniedReason === 'NoActiveTradingAccount') {
    const areAllAccountBlocked = tradingAccounts?.every(
      (item) => item.tradePermissionState === 'DENIED' && item.deniedReason === 'AccountBlocked',
    );

    if (areAllAccountBlocked) {
      const slug = getHintText(hints, 'ORDER_LIST_NO_ACTIVE_TRADING_ACCOUNT');

      return slug || 'На ваших счетах введены ограничения на подачу поручений';
    }

    const areAllAccountHaveAnotherReason = tradingAccounts?.every(
      (item) =>
        item.tradePermissionState === 'DENIED' &&
        (item.deniedReason === 'MT5TerminalConnected' ||
          item.deniedReason === 'AbsenceOfTradingAccountCode'),
    );

    if (areAllAccountHaveAnotherReason) {
      const slug = getHintText(hints, 'ORDER_LIST_MT_FIVE_TERMINAL_CONNECTED');

      return slug || 'Совершение торговой операции невозможно.';
    }
  }

  const slug = getHintText(hints, 'ОRDER_LIST_DEFAULT');

  return slug || 'Совершение торговой операции невозможно.';
};

export const getInstrumentActiveTabs = (
  tabs: TabType[],
  instrumentCategoryCode?: string,
  infoFlags?: InstrumentInfoFlag,
  issuerId?: number,
) => {
  const activeTabsId = ['review', 'applications', 'details'];
  if (instrumentCategoryCode && isBond(instrumentCategoryCode)) {
    activeTabsId.push('coupons');
  }
  if (
    instrumentCategoryCode &&
    (isStock(instrumentCategoryCode) || isFund(instrumentCategoryCode))
  ) {
    activeTabsId.push('dividends');
  }
  if (infoFlags?.issuerNews && issuerId) {
    activeTabsId.push('news');
  }
  if (infoFlags?.orderBook) {
    activeTabsId.push('orderBook');
  }
  return tabs
    .filter((f) => activeTabsId.includes(f.id))
    .map((el) => ({ link: el.link, name: el.name }));
};

export const getDirectionForStopOrder = (
  positions: boolean,
  hasPositionValuationByProduct: boolean,
): 'buy' | 'sell' => {
  if (positions && hasPositionValuationByProduct) {
    return 'sell';
  }

  return 'buy';
};

// TODO: Допилить, сделать универсальной
export const getTabIcon = (flags: {
  hasStopOrder: boolean;
}): Record<string, JSX.Element> | null => {
  return flags.hasStopOrder ? { Заявки: <StopOrderIcon /> } : null;
};

export const getIssuerIdByInstrumentCategory = (instrument: InstrumentInfoResponse) => {
  const instrumentType = getInstrumentType(instrument.instrument[0].instrumentCategoryCode);

  if (instrumentType === 'bond') return instrument.bond[0].issuerId;

  if (instrumentType === 'share') return instrument.share[0].issuerId;

  if (instrumentType === 'futures') return instrument.futures[0].underlyingIssuerId;

  if (instrumentType === 'option') return instrument.option[0].underlyingIssuerId;

  return instrument.other[0]?.issuerId;
};

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Navigate, generatePath, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import { ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import CategorizationBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/CategorizationBottomSheet';
import { INSTRUMENT_TABS } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/consts';
import {
  getInstrumentActiveTabs,
  getInstrumentIds,
  getIssuerIdByInstrumentCategory,
  getTabIcon,
} from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import styles from 'modules/InstrumentPage/styles.module.pcss';
import NonTradableInstrument, { isNonTradableInstrument } from 'modules/NonTradableInstrument';

import { SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components';

import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from './helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';

const InstrumentPageWrapper: React.FC = ({ children }) => {
  const source = useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam();
  const { instrument } = useParams();
  const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = getInstrumentIds(instrument);
  const session = getSession();

  const [hasBottomSheetShown, setHasBottomSheetShown] = useState(false);

  const {
    data: instrumentInfo,
    isLoading: isInstrumentInfoLoading,
    isSuccess: isInstrumentInfoSuccess,
    isError: isInstrumentInfoError,
  } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: true,
    source,
  });

  const {
    data: instrumentInfoFlags,
    isLoading: isInstrumentInfoFlagsLoading,
    isSuccess: isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees,
    isError: isInstrumentInfoFlagsError,
  } = useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    sourceList: 'Interfax',
  });

  const hasStopOrder =
    isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees && instrumentInfoFlags.instrumentInfoFlag[0].stopOrder;

  const personCategory =
    isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees && instrumentInfoFlags.instrumentInfoFlag[0].personCategory;

  const hasTestingAccess =
    !session?.isQual && (personCategory === 'TESTNOTPASSED' || personCategory === 'TESTPASSED');

  const icons = useMemo(() => getTabIcon({ hasStopOrder }), [hasStopOrder]);

  const issuerId = instrumentInfo && getIssuerIdByInstrumentCategory(instrumentInfo);

  const tabs = useMemo(() => {
    const activeTabs = getInstrumentActiveTabs(
      INSTRUMENT_TABS,
      instrumentInfo?.instrument[0].instrumentCategoryCode,
      instrumentInfoFlags?.instrumentInfoFlag[0],
      issuerId,
    );
    return activeTabs.map((tab) => ({
      ...tab,
      link: generatePath(tab.link, { instrument }),
    }));
  }, [instrument, instrumentInfo?.instrument, instrumentInfoFlags?.instrumentInfoFlag, issuerId]);

  if (isInstrumentInfoSuccess && isNonTradableInstrument(instrumentInfo.instrument[0])) {
    return <NonTradableInstrument instrumentId={instrumentId} tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId} />;
  }

  if (!instrumentId || !tradePlaceId || isInstrumentInfoError || isInstrumentInfoFlagsError) {
    return <Navigate to={ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG} />;
  }

  if (isInstrumentInfoLoading || isInstrumentInfoFlagsLoading)
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderContainer}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );

  if (!instrumentInfo) return null;

  const { instrument: i = [] } = instrumentInfo;

  const { personCategoryTypeName, personCategoryTypeFullName, personCategoryTypeCode } = i[0] || {};

  const categories = [
    {
      code: personCategoryTypeCode,
      fullName: personCategoryTypeFullName,
      name: personCategoryTypeName,
      passed: personCategory === 'TESTPASSED',
    },
  ];

  if (hasTestingAccess && !hasBottomSheetShown)
    return (
      <CategorizationBottomSheet
        data={categories}
        setHasBottomSheetShown={setHasBottomSheetShown}
      />
    );

  return (
    <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
      disableSwipe
      tabs={tabs}
      icons={icons ? icons : undefined}
      classNameWrapper={styles.tabsWrapper}
      classNameContent={styles.tabsContent}
      replace={true}
    >
      {children}
    </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
  );
};

export default InstrumentPageWrapper;

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';

import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';

import { useSnackBar } from 'hooks/useSnackBar';

import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';
import { useInstrumentNotes } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentNotes';
import { getInstrumentIds } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import TradeOrderHistory from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory';

import { HeaderPageProps } from 'components/HeaderPage/types';
import FavoriteButton from 'components/Instrument/components/FavoriteButton';
import { CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet, InstrumentNotesBottomSheet } from 'components/Notes';

import { ReactComponent as NotesSvg } from 'images/icons/notes.svg';

import styles from './Applications.module.pcss';

const Applications = () => {
  const { instrument } = useParams();
  const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = getInstrumentIds(instrument);

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useSnackBar();

  const { data: instrumentInfo, isLoading: isInstrumentInfoLoading } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId: instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId: tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: false,
    source: useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam(),
  });

  const {
    handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss,
    handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss,
    handleNotesClick,
    openedCreateOrEditNoteData,
    openedInstrumentNotesData,
  } = useInstrumentNotes({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });

  if (isInstrumentInfoLoading) return <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />;

  if (!instrumentInfo) return null;

  const { instrumentName, instrumentCode, tradePlaceShortName, favorite } =
    instrumentInfo.instrument[0];
  const headerProps: HeaderPageProps = {
    title: instrumentName,
    subtitle: `${instrumentCode} · ${tradePlaceShortName}`,
    leftIconVariant: 'back',
    onLeftIconClick: () => navigate(-1),
    addonRight: (
      <div className={styles.iconsWrapper}>
        <div className={styles.notesIconWrapper} onClick={handleNotesClick}>
          <NotesSvg />
        </div>
        <FavoriteButton
          instrumentId={Number(instrumentId)}
          isFavorite={favorite}
          tradePlaceId={Number(tradePlaceId)}
        />
      </div>
    ),
  };
  return (
    <>
      <TradeOrderHistory
        instrumentId={Number(instrumentId)}
        tradePlaceId={Number(tradePlaceId)}
        headerProps={headerProps}
      />

      <InstrumentNotesBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedInstrumentNotesData}
        instrumentId={openedInstrumentNotesData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedInstrumentNotesData?.tradePlaceId}
        onDismiss={handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss}
      />

      <CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedCreateOrEditNoteData}
        instrumentId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.tradePlaceId}
        noteId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.noteId}
        text={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.text}
        changeTime={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.changeTime}
        onDismiss={handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default Applications;

import React from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import BlockItem from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/components/BlockItem/BlockItem';
import { BlockItemProps, BlockProps } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/types';

import styles from './Block.module.pcss';

const blockItemsConstructor = (items: BlockItemProps[]) => {
  const itemsWithDefinedValue = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.value) {
      itemsWithDefinedValue.push(item);
    }
  }
  return itemsWithDefinedValue;
};

const Block: React.FC<BlockProps> = ({ name, items }) => {
  const itemsWithDefinedValue = blockItemsConstructor(items);
  if (itemsWithDefinedValue.length === 0) return null;

  const blockName = name && (
    <div className={styles.blockName}>
      <Text type={'labelRegular'}>{name}</Text>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <div>
      {blockName}
      {itemsWithDefinedValue.map((el, index) => (
        <BlockItem key={index} {...el} separator={index !== itemsWithDefinedValue.length - 1} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Block;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import IconButton from '@vision/icon-button';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { colorForeground3 } from 'vars/palette';

import DynamicHintBottomSheet from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/components/DynamicHintBottomSheet/DynamicHintBottomSheet';
import DynamicHintButton from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/components/DynamicHintButton/DynamicHintButton';
import { BlockItemProps } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/types';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { ReactComponent as GlyphCopySvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/copy.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SmallArrowRightSvg } from 'images/icons/small-arrow-right.svg';

import styles from './BlockItem.module.pcss';

const BlockItem: React.FC<BlockItemProps> = ({
  addonBottom,
  name,
  value,
  to,
  separator,
  canBeCopied,
  slug,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  if (!value) return null;

  const handleCopyButton = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(value));
    createAlertNotification({ text: 'Скопировано', status: 'info' });
  };

  const copyButton = canBeCopied ? (
    <IconButton onClick={handleCopyButton}>
      <GlyphCopySvg color={colorForeground3} />
    </IconButton>
  ) : undefined;

  const addonRight = copyButton ? (
    copyButton
  ) : to ? (
    <SmallArrowRightSvg color={colorForeground3} />
  ) : null;

  const onClick = () => {
    to && navigate(to);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.containerHorizonPaddings} onClick={onClick}>
      <div className={cx(styles.containerVerticalPaddings, separator && styles.separator)}>
        <div className={styles.infoContainer}>
          <div className={styles.nameContainer}>
            <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
              {name}
            </Text>
            {slug && <DynamicHintButton onClick={() => setOpen(true)} />}
          </div>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} className={cx(styles.text, addonBottom && styles.value)}>
            {value}
          </Text>
          {addonBottom}
        </div>
        {addonRight}
      </div>
      {open && slug && (
        <DynamicHintBottomSheet open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} slug={slug} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default BlockItem;

import React from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';

import styles from './ErrorPlug.module.pcss';

import React from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';

import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';

import { useSnackBar } from 'hooks/useSnackBar';

import Header from 'modules/InstrumentPage/components/Header/Header';
import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';
import { useInstrumentNotes } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentNotes';
import { getInstrumentIds } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import Block from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/components/Block/Block';
import ErrorPlug from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/components/ErrorPlug/ErrorPlug';
import { useDetails } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/hooks/useDetails';

import { CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet, InstrumentNotesBottomSheet } from 'components/Notes';

import styles from './Details.module.pcss';

const Details = () => {
  const { instrument } = useParams();

  const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = getInstrumentIds(instrument);
  const {
    data: instrumentInfo,
    isLoading: isInstrumentInfoLoading,
    refetch,
  } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: false,
    source: useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam(),
  });

  useSnackBar();

  const {
    details,
    isLoading: isDetailsLoading,
    isError: isDetailsError,
  } = useDetails(instrumentId, tradePlaceId);

  const {
    handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss,
    handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss,
    handleNotesClick,
    openedCreateOrEditNoteData,
    openedInstrumentNotesData,
  } = useInstrumentNotes({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });

  if (isInstrumentInfoLoading || isDetailsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderContainer}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (isDetailsError) {
    return <ErrorPlug />;
  }

  const {
    instrumentCode = '',
    tradePlaceShortName = '',
    favorite = false,
    instrumentName = '',
  } = instrumentInfo?.instrument[0] || {};

  return (
    <>
      <Header
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
        tradePlaceShortName={tradePlaceShortName}
        favorite={favorite}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        onNotesClick={handleNotesClick}
        onRefetch={refetch}
      />
      <div>
        {details?.map((el, index) => (
          <Block key={index} {...el} />
        ))}
      </div>

      <InstrumentNotesBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedInstrumentNotesData}
        instrumentId={openedInstrumentNotesData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedInstrumentNotesData?.tradePlaceId}
        onDismiss={handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss}
      />

      <CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedCreateOrEditNoteData}
        instrumentId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.tradePlaceId}
        noteId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.noteId}
        text={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.text}
        changeTime={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.changeTime}
        onDismiss={handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default Details;
