import { generatePath } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENT, ROUTE_ISSUERS_INSTRUMENTS } from 'const/routes';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { getNoun } from 'utils/string';
import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { INSTRUMENT_CATEGORIES } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/consts';
import { BlockProps, InstrumentCategoryType } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/types';

import {
  CorporateEventsResponse,
  IssuerDescription,
  IssuerDescriptionResponse,
  IssuerIndustry,
  IssuerIndustryResponse,
  IssuerIndustryTree,
  PlanCorpEvent,
} from 'types/details';
import { Entries } from 'types/helpers';
import {
  BondDepreciation,
  BondOffer,
  Bond as BondType,
  DR,
  FXSpot,
  Futures,
  Instrument,
  InstrumentInfoResponse,
  Option,
  Other,
  PriceCurrencyType,
  Share,
  Trading,
} from 'types/instruments';

const formattedPrice = (price: number, currency: PriceCurrencyType) => {
  if (!price || !currency) return;
  return `${sumFormatter(price, null, 2)} ${currencySign(currency)}`;
};

export const formattedDate = (date: string) => {
  if (!date) return;
  return DateTime.fromISO(date).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
};

const formattedMetalLotSize = (lotSize: number) => {
  if (!lotSize) return;
  return `${sumFormatter(lotSize, null, 2)} гр.`;
};

const formattedDaysCount = (days?: number) => {
  if (!days) return;
  return `${days} ${getNoun(days, 'день', 'дня', 'дней')}`;
};

const getIssuerBlock = (issuerId?: number, issuerName?: string) => ({
  name: 'Эмитент',
  value: issuerName,
  to: generatePath(ROUTE_ISSUERS_INSTRUMENTS, { issuerId: String(issuerId) }),
  addonBottom: (
    <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorAccent">
      Все инструменты эмитента
    </Text>
  ),
});

export const getInstrumentType = (
  instrumentCategoryCode?: string,
): InstrumentCategoryType | null => {
  if (!instrumentCategoryCode) return null;
  const entries = Object.entries(INSTRUMENT_CATEGORIES) as Entries<typeof INSTRUMENT_CATEGORIES>;
  for (const [category, categoryCodes] of entries) {
    if (categoryCodes.includes(instrumentCategoryCode)) return category;
  }
  return 'other';
};

export const getBondDetails = (
  instrument: Instrument,
  bond: BondType,
  trading: Trading,
  bondOffer: BondOffer,
  bondDepreciation: BondDepreciation,
  planCorpEvent: PlanCorpEvent,
  issuerDescription: IssuerDescription,
  issuerIndustry: IssuerIndustry,
  issuerIndustryTree?: IssuerIndustryTree,
) => {
  const main: BlockProps = {
    items: [
      getIssuerBlock(bond?.issuerId, bond?.issuerName),
      {
        name: 'ISIN',
        value: bond?.isin,
        canBeCopied: true,
        slug: 'INSTRUMENT_ISIN',
      },
      {
        name: 'Лот',
        value: trading?.lotSize,
        slug: 'INSTRUMENT_LOTSIZE',
      },
      {
        name: 'НДФЛ',
        value: bond?.couponTaxApplicable ? 'Облагается' : 'Не облагается',
        canBeCopied: true,
        slug: 'FI_DETAILS_NDFL',
      },
      {
        name: 'Тип инструмента',
        value: instrument?.instrumentCategoryName,
      },
      {
        name: 'Рынок',
        value: instrument?.tradePlaceShortName,
      },
      {
        name: 'Номинал',
        value: formattedPrice(bond?.nominal, bond?.nominalCurrencyCode),
      },
      {
        name: 'Доходность к погашению',
        value: formattedPrice(bond?.yield, 'PRC'),
      },
      {
        name: 'Дата погашения',
        value: formattedDate(bond?.maturityDate),
      },
      {
        name: 'Периодичность выплаты купона',
        value: formattedDaysCount(Number(bond?.couponFrequency)),
      },
      {
        name: 'Дата выплаты ближайшего купона',
        value: formattedDate(bond?.couponDate),
      },
      {
        name: 'Размер ближайшего купона',
        value: formattedPrice(bond?.couponValue, bond?.couponValueCurrencyCode),
        slug: 'INSTRUMENT_COUP_SIZE',
      },
      {
        name: 'Купонная доходность к текущей цене',
        value: formattedPrice(planCorpEvent?.paymentPercent, 'PRC'),
      },
      {
        name: 'Накопленный купонный доход',
        value: formattedPrice(bond?.accruedInterest, bond?.accruedInterestCurrencyCode),
        slug: 'INSTRUMENT_NKD',
      },
      {
        name: 'Тип инструмента',
        value: instrument?.instrumentCategoryName,
      },
      {
        name: 'Рынок',
        value: instrument?.tradePlaceShortName,
      },
      {
        name: 'Информация',
        value: issuerDescription?.description,
      },
      {
        name: 'Отрасль',
        value: issuerIndustry?.name,
      },
      {
        name: 'Категория отрасли',
        value: issuerIndustryTree?.name,
      },
      {
        name: 'Ликвидационная оценка стоимости позиции',
        value: formattedPrice(instrument?.liquidationPrice, instrument?.priceCurrency),
        slug: 'INSTRUMENT_STRUCTURAL_NOTES_PRICE_LIQUIDATION',
      },
    ],
  };

  const offer: BlockProps = {
    name: 'Оферта',
    items: [
      {
        name: 'Дата начала периода приема заявлений эмитентом',
        value: formattedDate(bondOffer?.earlyRedemptionStartDate),
      },
      {
        name: 'Дата окончания периода  приема заявлений эмитентом',
        value: formattedDate(bondOffer?.earlyRedemptionEndDate),
      },
      {
        name: 'Цена выкупа',
        value: formattedPrice(
          bondOffer?.earlyRedemptionBuybackPrice,
          bondOffer?.buybackCurrencyCode,
        ),
      },
      {
        name: 'Плановая дата КД',
        value: formattedDate(bondOffer?.plannedDate),
      },
      {
        name: 'Фактическая дата КД',
        value: formattedDate(bondOffer?.actualDate),
      },
    ],
  };

  const depreciation: BlockProps = {
    name: 'Амортизация',
    items: [
      {
        name: 'Дата фиксации',
        value: formattedDate(bondDepreciation?.fixingDate),
      },
      {
        name: 'Ставка погашения части номинальной стоимости (%)',
        value: bondDepreciation?.nominalRepaymentPercent,
      },
    ],
  };
  return [main, offer, depreciation];
};

export const getDetails = (
  instrumentType: InstrumentCategoryType,
  instrumentInfoData: InstrumentInfoResponse,
  issuerDescriptionData?: IssuerDescriptionResponse,
  issuerIndustryData?: IssuerIndustryResponse,
  corporateEvents?: CorporateEventsResponse,
): BlockProps[] => {
  const {
    instrument = [],
    share = [],
    bond = [],
    futures = [],
    option = [],
    dr = [],
    other = [],
    trading = [],
    fxSpot = [],
    bondOffer = [],
    bondDepreciation = [],
  } = instrumentInfoData || {};
  const { planCorpEvent = [] } = corporateEvents || {};
  const { issuerDescription = [] } = issuerDescriptionData || {};
  const { issuerIndustry = [], issuerIndustryTree = [] } = issuerIndustryData || {};
  const parentIssuerIndustry = issuerIndustryTree.find((f) => !f?.parentId);
  switch (instrumentType) {
    case 'bond':
      return getBondDetails(
        instrument[0],
        bond[0],
        trading[0],
        bondOffer[0],
        bondDepreciation[0],
        planCorpEvent[0],
        issuerDescription[0],
        issuerIndustry[0],
        parentIssuerIndustry,
      );
    case 'share':
      return getShareDetails(
        instrument[0],
        share[0],
        trading[0],
        issuerDescription[0],
        issuerIndustry[0],
        parentIssuerIndustry,
      );
    case 'futures':
      return getFuturesDetails(
        instrument[0],
        futures[0],
        issuerDescription[0],
        issuerIndustry[0],
        issuerIndustryTree[0],
      );
    case 'option':
      return getOptionDetails(
        instrument[0],
        option[0],
        issuerDescription[0],
        issuerIndustry[0],
        parentIssuerIndustry,
      );
    case 'depositaryReceipt':
      return getDepositaryReceiptDetails(
        instrument[0],
        dr[0],
        issuerDescription[0],
        issuerIndustry[0],
        parentIssuerIndustry,
      );
    case 'currency':
      return getCurrencyDetails(instrument[0], fxSpot[0], trading[0]);
    case 'metal':
      return getMetalDetails(instrument[0], fxSpot[0], trading[0]);
    case 'other':
      return getOtherDetails(
        instrument[0],
        other[0],
        trading[0],
        issuerDescription[0],
        issuerIndustry[0],
        parentIssuerIndustry,
      );
  }
};

import {
  useGetCorporateEventsQuery,
  useGetIssuerDescriptionQuery,
  useGetIssuerIndustryQuery,
} from 'core/api/details';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { useGetUKDisclaimerQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';

import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';
import { getDetails, getInstrumentType } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/helpers';

export const useDetails = (instrumentId: string, tradePlaceId: string) => {
  const {
    data: instrumentInfo,
    isLoading: isInstrumentInfoLoading,
    isError: isInstrumentInfoError,
  } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: false,
    source: useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam(),
  });
  const { instrument = [] } = instrumentInfo || {};
  const instrumentType = getInstrumentType(instrument[0]?.instrumentCategoryCode);

  const { data: issuerDescriptionData, isLoading: isIssuerDescriptionDataLoading } =
    useGetIssuerDescriptionQuery(
      {
        instrumentCode: instrumentInfo?.instrument[0]?.instrumentCode || '',
      },
      {
        skip:
          !instrumentType ||
          instrumentType === 'metal' ||
          instrumentType === 'currency' ||
          !instrumentInfo?.instrument[0]?.instrumentCode,
      },
    );
  const { data: issuerIndustryData, isLoading: isIssuerIndustryDataLoading } =
    useGetIssuerIndustryQuery(
      { instrumentId: Number(instrumentId) },
      {
        skip: !instrumentType || instrumentType === 'metal' || instrumentType === 'currency',
      },
    );

  const { data: corporateEvents, isLoading: isCorporateEventsLoading } = useGetCorporateEventsQuery(
    { instrumentId: Number(instrumentId), tradePlaceId: Number(tradePlaceId) },
    {
      skip: !instrumentType || instrumentType !== 'bond',
    },
  );

  const { data: disclaimer, isLoading: isDisclaimerLoading } = useGetUKDisclaimerQuery();

  const { data: infoFlags, isLoading: isInfoFlagsLoading } = useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
  });

  const isLoading =
    isInstrumentInfoLoading ||
    isIssuerDescriptionDataLoading ||
    isIssuerIndustryDataLoading ||
    isCorporateEventsLoading ||
    isDisclaimerLoading ||
    isInfoFlagsLoading;

  const details =
    !isLoading && !isInstrumentInfoError && instrumentType && instrumentInfo
      ? getDetails(
          instrumentType,
          instrumentInfo,
          issuerDescriptionData,
          issuerIndustryData,
          corporateEvents,
        )
      : null;

  if (details && infoFlags?.instrumentInfoFlag[0].foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompany)
    details[0].items.push({
      name: 'Дополнительное информация',
      value: disclaimer?.disclaimer[0].foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompanyFull,
    });

  return {
    details,
    isLoading,
    isError: isInstrumentInfoError,
  };
};

import { FC, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENT_NEWS } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetNewsQuery } from 'core/api/analytics';

import AnalyticsBottomSheet from 'modules/Analytics/components/AnalyticsBottomSheet/AnalyticsBottomSheet';
import AnalyticsCard from 'modules/Analytics/components/AnalyticsCard/AnalyticsCard';
import FlashAnalyticsCard from 'modules/Analytics/components/FlashAnalyticsCard/FlashAnalyticsCard';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { NewsBlockProps } from './types';

const NewsBlock: FC<NewsBlockProps> = ({ issuerId }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { instrument } = useParams();

  const [analyticId, setAnalyticId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const { data, isError } = useGetNewsQuery({
    issuerId,
    rowsCount: 3,
    sourceList: 'Interfax, WebAdmin',
  });

  const handleAnalyticsCardClick = (analyticId: number) => {
    setAnalyticId(analyticId);
  };

  const handleAllNewsBtnClick = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENT_NEWS, { instrument }));
  };

  if (!data?.length || isError) return null;

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <Text type="bodySemiBold">Новости</Text>
        <Button shape="text" variant="secondary" onClick={handleAllNewsBtnClick}>
          Все
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div>
        {data?.map((el, index) => {
          if (el.hasDetails) {
            return (
              <AnalyticsCard
                key={`${el.analyticId}-${index}`}
                analyticId={el.analyticId}
                title={el.title}
                created={el.created}
                sourceName={el.sourceName}
                isUrgently={el.urgency > 3}
                instrumentImages={el.instrumentImages}
                onClick={handleAnalyticsCardClick}
              />
            );
          }

          return (
            <FlashAnalyticsCard
              key={`${el.analyticId}-${index}`}
              title={el.title}
              created={el.created}
              sourceName={el.sourceName}
              isUrgently={el.urgency > 3}
              instrumentImages={el.instrumentImages}
            />
          );
        })}

        {analyticId && (
          <AnalyticsBottomSheet analyticId={analyticId} onClose={() => setAnalyticId(null)} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default NewsBlock;

import { FC, memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';

import { NotesCarouselProps } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/types';

import { Note } from 'components/Notes';

import More from './More';
import styles from './NotesCarousel.module.pcss';

const NotesCarousel: FC<NotesCarouselProps> = ({ notes, onMoreClick }) => {
  const formattedNotes = useMemo(() => {
    if (notes.length < 3) {
      return notes;
    }

    return notes.slice(0, 3);
  }, [notes]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      {formattedNotes.map(({ noteId, text, changeTime, instrumentId, tradePlaceId, onClick }) => (
        <Note
          key={noteId}
          isInCarousel
          noteId={noteId}
          text={text}
          changeTime={changeTime}
          instrumentId={instrumentId}
          tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
          className={cx(styles.note, notes.length > 1 ? styles.multiple : styles.one)}
          onClick={onClick}
        />
      ))}

      {notes.length > 3 && <More onClick={onMoreClick} />}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(NotesCarousel);

--- FILE: src\modules\InstrumentPage\pages\Instrument\Instrument.tsx ---

import { FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Navigate, generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import cn from 'classnames';
import {
  ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG,
  ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER,
  ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_BLOCKED_PLUG,
  ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_NONE_PLUG,
} from 'const/routes';

import { useGetAccountsQuery } from 'core/api/accounts';
import { useLazyGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';
import { useLazyGetSessionTradeSignStateQuery } from 'core/api/tradePassword';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { updateLimitOrdersStatus } from 'core/limitOrdersStatus/limitOrdersStatusSlice';
import { setActiveTab } from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useSnackBar } from 'hooks/useSnackBar';

import { ECatalogGoal } from 'modules/Catalog/types';
import Header from 'modules/InstrumentPage/components/Header/Header';
import StopOrderButton from 'modules/InstrumentPage/components/StopOrderButton';
import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';
import { useInstrumentNotes } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentNotes';
import {
  getDirectionForStopOrder,
  getInstrumentIds,
  getIssuerIdByInstrumentCategory,
  getStopOrderStatus,
  getStopOrderStatusText,
  getTradingSessionBtn,
} from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import NotesCarousel from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Instrument/components/NotesCarousel';
import styles from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Instrument/styles.module.pcss';
import NonTradableInstrument, { isNonTradableInstrument } from 'modules/NonTradableInstrument';
import OrderBook from 'modules/OrderBook';
import PositionCards from 'modules/PositionCards';
import MiniChartPage from 'modules/TradingView/MobileTVChart/MiniChartPage';

import { SnackbarInfo, SnackbarInfoWrapper } from 'components';
import AddonBottom from 'components/AddonBottom';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import { CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet, InstrumentNotesBottomSheet } from 'components/Notes';

import NewsBlock from './components/NewsBlock/NewsBlock';

const Instrument: FC = () => {
  const { instrument } = useParams();
  const [getSessionTradeSignState] = useLazyGetSessionTradeSignStateQuery();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const [hasPositionValuationByProduct, setHasPositionValuationByProduct] = useState(false);
  useSnackBar();

  const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = getInstrumentIds(instrument);
  const { data: accounts } = useGetAccountsQuery({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });
  const [trigger, { data: hintsResponse }] = useLazyGetHintsQuery();

  const {
    formattedNotes,
    handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss,
    handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss,
    handleNotesClick,
    isPersonsCurrentNotesInstrumentError,
    openedCreateOrEditNoteData,
    openedInstrumentNotesData,
  } = useInstrumentNotes({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });

  const tradeSessionStatus = useAppSelector(
    (state) => state?.tradeSession?.sessionRegistry[tradePlaceId]?.sessionState || '',
  );

  const {
    tradePermissionState,
    deniedReason,
    stopOrderPermissionState = '',
    stopOrderDeniedReason = '',
  } = accounts?.tradingAvailability[0] || {};
  const { tradingProducts = [], tradingAccounts = [] } = accounts || {};

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tradePermissionState || !tradeSessionStatus) return;

    if (
      tradeSessionStatus === 'CLEARING' ||
      tradePermissionState !== 'GRANTED' ||
      stopOrderPermissionState !== 'GRANTED'
    ) {
      trigger();
    }
  }, [stopOrderPermissionState, tradePermissionState, tradeSessionStatus, trigger]);

  const { isBtnShow, notificationText } = getTradingSessionBtn(
    tradeSessionStatus,
    tradePermissionState,
    deniedReason,
    hintsResponse?.hints,
    tradingProducts,
    tradingAccounts,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(updateLimitOrdersStatus({ isAvailable: isBtnShow, reason: notificationText || '' }));
  }, [dispatch, isBtnShow, notificationText]);

  const {
    data: instrumentInfo,
    isSuccess: isInstrumentInfoSuccess,
    isError: isInstrumentInfoError,
    refetch,
  } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId: instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId: tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: true,
    source: useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam(),
  });

  const { data: instrumentInfoFlags } = useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    sourceList: 'Interfax',
  });

  const infoFlags = instrumentInfoFlags?.instrumentInfoFlag[0];
  const positions = Boolean(infoFlags?.positions);
  const hasStopOrder = Boolean(infoFlags?.stopOrder);
  const hasOrderBook = Boolean(infoFlags?.orderBook);
  const hasNews = Boolean(infoFlags?.issuerNews);

  const handleBtnClick = async (direction: 'buy' | 'sell') => {
    const response = await getSessionTradeSignState().unwrap();

    if (response?.tradePasswordState === 'NONE') {
      navigate(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_NONE_PLUG);
      return;
    }

    if (response?.tradePasswordState === 'BLOCKED') {
      navigate(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_BLOCKED_PLUG);
      return;
    }

    dispatch(setActiveTab('limit'));

    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, {
        instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`,
        direction,
      }),
    );
  };

  const handleStopOrderButtonClick = () => {
    if (stopOrderStatus === 'NONACTIVE') {
      const text = getStopOrderStatusText({
        stopOrderDeniedReason,
        hints: hintsResponse?.hints || [],
        tradingProducts,
        tradingAccounts,
      });

      createAlertNotification({ text });
    } else {
      dispatch(setActiveTab('stopOrder'));
      navigate(
        generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, {
          instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`,
          direction: getDirectionForStopOrder(positions, hasPositionValuationByProduct),
        }),
      );
    }
  };

  const { instrument: i = [], trading = [] } = instrumentInfo || {};

  const { instrumentCategoryCode, instrumentName, instrumentCode, tradePlaceShortName, favorite } =
    i?.[0] || {};

  useEffect(() => {
    reachGoal(ECatalogGoal.catalog, ECatalogGoal.overviewView, {
      instrument_code: instrumentCode,
      instrument_id: instrumentId,
      trade_place_id: tradePlaceId,
    });
  }, [instrumentCode, instrumentId, tradePlaceId]);

  if (isInstrumentInfoSuccess && isNonTradableInstrument(instrumentInfo.instrument[0])) {
    return <NonTradableInstrument instrumentId={instrumentId} tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId} />;
  }

  if (
    !instrumentId ||
    !tradePlaceId ||
    isInstrumentInfoError ||
    isPersonsCurrentNotesInstrumentError
  ) {
    return <Navigate to={ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG} />;
  }

  if (!instrumentInfo || !formattedNotes) {
    return null;
  }

  const { tradeAvailability, tradingStatus } = trading[0] || {};

  const stopOrderStatus = getStopOrderStatus({
    tradeAvailability,
    stopOrderPermissionState,
    stopOrderDeniedReason,
  });

  const frontSnackBarsHeight =
    (document.querySelector('#snackBars')?.getBoundingClientRect()?.height || 0) + 8;

  const frontSnackBars = notificationText ? (
    <SnackbarInfoWrapper>
      <SnackbarInfo text={notificationText} />
    </SnackbarInfoWrapper>
  ) : null;

  const issuerId = getIssuerIdByInstrumentCategory(instrumentInfo);

  return (
    <>
      <Header
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
        tradePlaceShortName={tradePlaceShortName}
        favorite={favorite}
        onNotesClick={handleNotesClick}
        onRefetch={refetch}
      />

      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={cn(styles.content, notificationText && styles.bigPadding)}>
          <MiniChartPage
            instrumentId={instrumentId}
            tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
            instrumentData={instrumentInfo}
          />
          <div className={styles.article}>
            <NotesCarousel notes={formattedNotes} onMoreClick={handleNotesClick} />
            {hasOrderBook && tradingStatus && <OrderBook variant="short" />}

            {stopOrderStatus !== 'OFF' && (
              <StopOrderButton
                status={stopOrderStatus}
                hasStopOrder={hasStopOrder}
                onClick={handleStopOrderButtonClick}
              />
            )}

            {hasNews && issuerId && <NewsBlock issuerId={issuerId} />}

            {positions && (
              <PositionCards
                instrumentId={instrumentId}
                tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
                instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
                setHasPositionValuationByProduct={setHasPositionValuationByProduct}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <AddonBottom>
          {isBtnShow ? (
            <div className={cn(styles.btns, styles.wrapper)}>
              <Button variant="buy" onClick={() => handleBtnClick('buy')}>
                Купить
              </Button>
              <Button variant="sell" onClick={() => handleBtnClick('sell')}>
                Продать
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            frontSnackBars && <div style={{ height: `${frontSnackBarsHeight}px` }} />
          )}
        </AddonBottom>
        {!isBtnShow && frontSnackBars}
      </div>

      <InstrumentNotesBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedInstrumentNotesData}
        instrumentId={openedInstrumentNotesData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedInstrumentNotesData?.tradePlaceId}
        onDismiss={handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss}
      />

      <CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedCreateOrEditNoteData}
        instrumentId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.tradePlaceId}
        noteId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.noteId}
        text={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.text}
        changeTime={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.changeTime}
        onDismiss={handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default Instrument;

import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';

import Analytics from 'modules/Analytics';
import Header from 'modules/InstrumentPage/components/Header/Header';
import { getInstrumentIds, getIssuerIdByInstrumentCategory } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';

const News = () => {
  const { instrument } = useParams();
  const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = getInstrumentIds(instrument);

  const { data: instrumentInfo } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: false,
  });

  if (!instrumentInfo) return null;

  const { instrumentName, instrumentCode, tradePlaceShortName, favorite } =
    instrumentInfo.instrument[0];

  const issuerId = getIssuerIdByInstrumentCategory(instrumentInfo);

  return (
    <>
      <Header
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
        tradePlaceShortName={tradePlaceShortName}
        favorite={favorite}
      />
      <Analytics type="news" issuerId={issuerId} />
    </>
  );
};

export default News;

import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';

import Header from 'modules/InstrumentPage/components/Header/Header';
import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';
import { getInstrumentIds } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import OrderBook from 'modules/OrderBook';
import OrderBookPlug from 'modules/OrderBook/components/OrderBookPlug/OrderBookPlug';

const OrderBookTab = () => {
  const { instrument: i } = useParams();

  const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = getInstrumentIds(i);

  const { data: instrumentInfo, isLoading } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: false,
    source: useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam(),
  });

  const { instrument = [], trading = [] } = instrumentInfo || {};

  const {
    instrumentCode = '',
    tradePlaceShortName = '',
    favorite = false,
    instrumentName = '',
  } = instrument[0] || {};

  const { tradingStatus } = trading[0] || {};

  return (
    <>
      <Header
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
        tradePlaceShortName={tradePlaceShortName}
        favorite={favorite}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
      />

      {isLoading ? (
        <CircleLoader type="page" brandColor />
      ) : tradingStatus ? (
        <OrderBook variant="full" />
      ) : (
        <OrderBookPlug variant="full" />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default OrderBookTab;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import { ROUTE_INVESTMENT_PROFILE_QUIZ, ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION } from 'const/routes';

import {
  useGetUserSettingTransformQuery,
  useUpdateUserSettingMutation,
} from 'core/api/userSettings';
import { useInvestmentProfile } from 'core/investmentProfile';

import AccessDenied from 'modules/AccessDenied';
import Onboarding from 'modules/OnboardingPage';

import { ReactComponent as OnboardingSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/onboarding/investment-profile.svg';

import styles from './InvestmentProfileInfo.module.pcss';
import { InfoNotFinishedQuiz } from './pages/InfoNotFinishedQuiz';
import { InfoStart } from './pages/InfoStart';
import { InfoWithProfile } from './pages/InfoWithProfile';

const USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_INVEST_PROFILE = 'onboarding_investprofile';

const InvestmentProfileInfo = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [showOnboarding, setShowOnboarding] = useState(false);

  const {
    isLoading,
    isError,
    hasInvestmentProfileAccess,
    hasNotFinishedQuiz,
    isInvestmentProfileNotDefined,
    statusDetailCode,
    statusDetailName,
    statusDetailValue,
    statusDetailValueDate,
  } = useInvestmentProfile();
  const {
    data: userSetting,
    isSuccess: isSuccessUserSetting,
    isLoading: isLoadingUserSetting,
  } = useGetUserSettingTransformQuery({
    name: USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_INVEST_PROFILE,
  });

  const [updateUserSetting] = useUpdateUserSettingMutation();

  useEffect(() => {
    setShowOnboarding(
      isSuccessUserSetting &&
        (!userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_INVEST_PROFILE]?.value ||
          userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_INVEST_PROFILE]?.value === '0') &&
        isInvestmentProfileNotDefined,
    );
  }, [isInvestmentProfileNotDefined, isSuccessUserSetting, userSetting]);

  const handleOnboardingClick = () => {
    setShowOnboarding(false);
    updateUserSetting({
      name: USER_SETTING_SHOW_ONBOARDING_INVEST_PROFILE,
      value: '1',
    });
  };

  if (isLoading || isLoadingUserSetting) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loader}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !hasInvestmentProfileAccess) {
    return <AccessDenied />;
  }

  if (showOnboarding) {
    return (
      <Onboarding
        title="Инвестиционный профиль"
        text="Определение профиля поможет подобрать оптимальную тактику инвестирования. Ответьте на
        несколько вопросов, это займёт не более 15 минут"
        svg={<OnboardingSvg />}
        hintTitle="Что такое инвестиционный профиль?"
        hintSubTitle="Что такое инвестиционный профиль и зачем он нужен?"
        hintText={[
          'Инвестиционный профиль определяет ваш стиль инвестирования, чтобы правильно распределить активы в портфеле.',
          'Исходя из ожидаемого уровня доходности, планируемого срока инвестиций, уровня риска, на который вы готовы пойти, и других факторов, вам будет присвоен один из трёх риск-профилей. На основе присвоенного профиля брокер сможет предлагать индивидуальные инвестиционные решения.',
          'Такое тестирование закреплено в Положении Банка России от 3 августа 2015 года № 482-П и обязательно для клиентов, которые не являются квалифицированными инвесторами.',
        ]}
        onClick={handleOnboardingClick}
      />
    );
  }

  const startNewQuiz = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INVESTMENT_PROFILE_QUIZ, { type: 'new' }));
  };

  if (!isInvestmentProfileNotDefined) {
    return (
      <InfoWithProfile
        headerLeftIconVariant="back"
        code={statusDetailCode}
        title={statusDetailName}
        info={statusDetailValue}
        date={statusDetailValueDate}
        buttons={
          hasNotFinishedQuiz ? (
            <React.Fragment>
              <Button
                onClick={() => {
                  navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INVESTMENT_PROFILE_QUIZ, { type: 'previous' }));
                }}
              >
                Продолжить прохождение теста
              </Button>
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={startNewQuiz}>
                Начать тестирование
              </Button>
            </React.Fragment>
          ) : (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={startNewQuiz}>
              Пройти повторно
            </Button>
          )
        }
        onClose={() => {
          navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  if (hasNotFinishedQuiz) {
    return <InfoNotFinishedQuiz />;
  }

  return <InfoStart />;
};

export default InvestmentProfileInfo;

import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';

import { useInvestmentProfile } from 'core/investmentProfile';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import Quiz from 'modules/Quiz';

import styles from './InvestmentProfileQuiz.module.pcss';
import { SomethingWentWrong } from './pages/SomethingWentWrong';

const PERSON_INVESTMENTPROFILE_CHANGE = 'PERSON_INVESTMENTPROFILE_CHANGE';

const InvestmentProfileQuiz = () => {
  const isPermissionPersonInvestmentProfileChangeGranted = Permissions.granted(
    PERSON_INVESTMENTPROFILE_CHANGE,
  );

  const { type } = useParams();

  const { isLoading, hasInvestmentProfileAccess, hasNotFinishedQuiz, requestGuid } =
    useInvestmentProfile();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loader}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const hasInvestmentProfileQuizAccess =
    hasNotFinishedQuiz || isPermissionPersonInvestmentProfileChangeGranted;

  if (!hasInvestmentProfileAccess || !hasInvestmentProfileQuizAccess) {
    return <SomethingWentWrong />;
  }

  return <Quiz isInvestmentProfile isPrevious={type === 'previous'} requestGuid={requestGuid} />;
};

export default InvestmentProfileQuiz;

import { FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Checkbox, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import AmountInput from '@vision/amount-input/dist';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { setInitialTradeOrderForm, setLotSize } from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import QuantityInput from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/TradeOrderForm/components/QuantityInput';
import { getMultipleQuantity } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import { BottomSheetStateType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import { Banner } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as LockIcon } from 'images/icons/glyphs/lock-close.svg';

import IPOTradeOrderConfirmation from '../IPOTradeOrderConfirmation';
import { IPOTradeOrderFormProps } from '../IPOTradeOrderForm/types';
import IPOTradeOrderFormCheckboxLabel from '../IPOTradeOrderFormCheckboxLabel';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const IPOBondsTradeOrderForm: FC<IPOTradeOrderFormProps> = ({
  ipoData,
  docs,
  subAccount,
  activePortfolioName,
  onMainBtnClick,
}) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);

  const { lotSizeInputValue } = useAppSelector((state) => ({
    lotSizeInputValue: state.tradeOrder.lotSize,
  }));

  const { data } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<BottomSheetStateType>(null);

  const {
    lotSize,
    priceCurrency,
    minimumAmount,
    placingRate,
    nominal,
    nominalCurrencyCode,
    instrumentImageName,
    instrumentName,
    tradePlaceId,
    instrumentId,
    isMarket,
    id,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    isin,
  } = ipoData;

  const { instrumentCurrencyBalance: balance, subAccountId } = subAccount;

  const minQuantity = Math.ceil(minimumAmount / ((placingRate / 100) * nominal));
  const minimumQuantity = minQuantity < lotSize ? lotSize : minQuantity;
  const minQuantityBannerText = `Минимальный объём ${sumFormatter(
    minimumAmount,
    -1,
    null,
  )} ${currencySign(nominalCurrencyCode)} (${minimumQuantity} шт.)`;
  const volume = lotSizeInputValue ? (placingRate * nominal * lotSizeInputValue) / 100 : 0;
  const priceInputValue = placingRate ? sumFormatter(placingRate, null, 2) : '–';
  const quantityUnit = 'шт.';
  const isDecrementBtnDisabled = (lotSizeInputValue || 0) <= 0;
  const isCheckboxShown =
    (instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB') &&
    isMarket &&
    Boolean(docs.length);
  const isMainBtnDisabled =
    Number(lotSizeInputValue) < minimumQuantity || (isCheckboxShown && !isChecked);

  const banner =
    balance < volume ? (
      <Banner
        hints={data?.hints || []}
        slugData={{ slug: 'TRADE_BYE_WARRANTY' }}
        text="Используются заёмные средства"
      />
    ) : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      dispatch(setInitialTradeOrderForm());
    };
  }, [dispatch]);

  const handleQuantityInputBlur = () => {
    if (!lotSizeInputValue) return;

    const multipleQuantity = getMultipleQuantity(lotSizeInputValue, lotSize);

    dispatch(setLotSize(multipleQuantity));
  };

  const handleQuantityInputChange = ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    dispatch(setLotSize(Number(value)));
  };

  const handleDecrementButtonClick = () => {
    const lotsize = lotSizeInputValue ? lotSizeInputValue : 0;

    dispatch(setLotSize(lotsize - lotSize));
  };

  const handleInrementButtonClick = () => {
    const lotsize = lotSizeInputValue ? lotSizeInputValue : 0;

    dispatch(setLotSize(lotsize + lotSize));
  };

  const handleBtnClick = () => {
    if (!lotSizeInputValue) return;

    onMainBtnClick({
      subAccountId,
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentId,
      direction: 'BUY',
      orderType: isMarket ? 'NEGOTIATED' : 'LIMIT',
      price: placingRate,
      lots: lotSizeInputValue / lotSize,
      quantity: lotSizeInputValue,
      takeProfitPrice: 0,
      stopPrice: 0,
      volume: { value: volume, label: 'Объём', currency: currencySign(nominalCurrencyCode) },
      ipoId: id,
      portfolioName: activePortfolioName,
      discretionOffsetType: 0,
      discretionOffsetValue: 0,
      goodTillCancel: false,
      pegOffsetType: 0,
      pegOffsetValue: 0,
    });

    setBottomSheetState('check');
  };

  const handleChange = () => {
    setIsChecked((prev) => !prev);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <Text type="lineRegular">Цена</Text>
          <div className={styles.inputs}>
            <AmountInput
              disabled
              suffix={currencySign(priceCurrency)}
              classNameInput={styles.input}
              value={priceInputValue}
            />
            <Button size="s" variant="secondary" className={styles.lockBtn}>
              <LockIcon />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <QuantityInput
          label={`Количество (от ${lotSize} ${quantityUnit})`}
          suffix="шт."
          placeholder="0 шт."
          value={lotSizeInputValue}
          onChange={handleQuantityInputChange}
          onBlur={handleQuantityInputBlur}
          onDecrementBtnClick={handleDecrementButtonClick}
          onIncrementBtnClick={handleInrementButtonClick}
          isDecrementBtnDisabled={isDecrementBtnDisabled}
        />
        <div className={styles.row}>
          {isCheckboxShown && (
            <Checkbox
              label={<IPOTradeOrderFormCheckboxLabel docs={docs} />}
              checked={isChecked}
              onChange={handleChange}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <div className={styles.banners}>
          {data?.hints && lotSizeInputValue && lotSizeInputValue < minimumQuantity ? (
            <Banner hints={data.hints} text={minQuantityBannerText} />
          ) : null}
          {banner}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.volume}>
          <div>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              Объём
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(volume, 2)} ${currencySign(
              nominalCurrencyCode,
            )}`}</Text>
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="buy"
            disabled={isMainBtnDisabled}
            onClick={() => setBottomSheetState('confirmation')}
          >
            Участвовать
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetState === 'confirmation'}
        onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetState(null)}
      >
        <IPOTradeOrderConfirmation
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
          instrumentName={instrumentName}
          activePortfolioName={activePortfolioName}
          price={`${priceInputValue} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`}
          quantity={lotSizeInputValue ? `${lotSizeInputValue} ${quantityUnit}` : '–'}
          banner={banner}
          onMainBtnClick={handleBtnClick}
          volume={`${sumFormatter(volume)} ${currencySign(nominalCurrencyCode)}`}
          mainBtnText="Участвовать"
          isin={isin}
        />
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
};

export default IPOBondsTradeOrderForm;

import { FC, useState } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Checkbox, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import AmountInput from '@vision/amount-input/dist';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getHintText } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import { BottomSheetStateType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import { Banner, DynamicHint } from 'components';

import IPOTradeOrderConfirmation from '../IPOTradeOrderConfirmation';
import { IPOTradeOrderFormProps } from '../IPOTradeOrderForm/types';
import IPOTradeOrderFormCheckboxLabel from '../IPOTradeOrderFormCheckboxLabel';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const IPOEquityTradeOrderForm: FC<IPOTradeOrderFormProps> = ({
  ipoData,
  docs,
  subAccount,
  activePortfolioName,
  onMainBtnClick,
}) => {
  const [isChecked, setIsChecked] = useState(false);

  const { data } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<BottomSheetStateType>(null);

  const {
    priceCurrency,
    minimumAmount,
    isMarket,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    priceRangeTo,
    dealCurrency,
    instrumentImageName,
    instrumentName,
    isin,
    isBond,
    tradePlaceId,
    instrumentId,
    id,
  } = ipoData;

  const { instrumentCurrencyBalance: balance, subAccountId } = subAccount;

  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(minimumAmount);

  const minQuantityBannerText = `Минимальный объём ${sumFormatter(
    minimumAmount,
    -1,
    null,
  )} ${currencySign(dealCurrency ?? 'RUB')}`;
  const isCheckboxShown =
    (instrumentCategoryCode === 'STB' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'INB') &&
    isMarket &&
    Boolean(docs.length);
  const isMainBtnDisabled = inputValue < minimumAmount || (isCheckboxShown && !isChecked);

  const banner =
    balance < inputValue ? (
      <Banner
        hints={data?.hints || []}
        slugData={{ slug: 'TRADE_BYE_WARRANTY' }}
        text="Используются заёмные средства"
      />
    ) : null;

  const hintSlug = data?.hints && getHintText(data?.hints, 'IPO_PRICE_RANGE');

  const handleBtnClick = () => {
    onMainBtnClick({
      subAccountId,
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentId,
      direction: 'BUY',
      orderType: isMarket ? 'NEGOTIATED' : 'LIMIT',
      takeProfitPrice: 0,
      stopPrice: 0,
      volume: { value: inputValue, label: 'Объём', currency: currencySign(dealCurrency ?? 'RUB') },
      ipoId: id,
      portfolioName: activePortfolioName,
      discretionOffsetType: 0,
      discretionOffsetValue: 0,
      goodTillCancel: false,
      pegOffsetType: 0,
      pegOffsetValue: 0,
      amount: inputValue,
      lots: 0,
      price: null,
    });

    setBottomSheetState('check');
  };

  const handleChange = () => {
    setIsChecked((prev) => !prev);
  };

  const handleInputChange = ({ floatValue }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    floatValue && setInputValue(floatValue);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.price}>
          <div className={styles.row}>
            <Text type="lineMedium">Ориентир цены</Text>
            <div className={styles.slug}>
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                Может меняться в ходе размещения
              </Text>
              {hintSlug && <DynamicHint slug="IPO_PRICE_RANGE" />}
            </div>
          </div>
          <Text type="lineMedium">{`${sumFormatter(priceRangeTo, null, null)} ${currencySign(
            priceCurrency,
          )}`}</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.inputs}>
          <Text type="lineRegular">Объём участия</Text>
          <AmountInput
            suffix={currencySign(dealCurrency)}
            value={inputValue}
            onChange={handleInputChange}
          />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          {isCheckboxShown && (
            <Checkbox
              label={<IPOTradeOrderFormCheckboxLabel docs={docs} />}
              checked={isChecked}
              onChange={handleChange}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <div className={styles.banners}>
          {data?.hints && inputValue < minimumAmount ? (
            <Banner hints={data.hints} text={minQuantityBannerText} />
          ) : null}
          {banner}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.volume}>
          <div>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              Объём
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(inputValue, 2)} ${currencySign(
              dealCurrency ?? 'RUB',
            )}`}</Text>
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="buy"
            disabled={isMainBtnDisabled}
            onClick={() => setBottomSheetState('confirmation')}
          >
            Участвовать
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetState === 'confirmation'}
        onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetState(null)}
      >
        <IPOTradeOrderConfirmation
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
          instrumentName={instrumentName}
          activePortfolioName={activePortfolioName}
          banner={banner}
          onMainBtnClick={handleBtnClick}
          volume={`${sumFormatter(inputValue)} ${currencySign(dealCurrency ?? 'RUB')}`}
          mainBtnText="Участвовать"
          isin={isin}
          isBond={isBond}
        />
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
};

export default IPOEquityTradeOrderForm;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetAccountsQuery } from 'core/api/accounts';
import { useGetIpoQuery } from 'core/api/ipo';
import { isError } from 'core/helpers/isError';
import { BaseQueryErrorType } from 'core/types';

import AccountCards from 'modules/AccountCards';
import Checks from 'modules/Checks';
import CreateTradeOrder from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/CreateTradeOrder/CreateTradeOrder';
import { OrderDataType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components/Instrument';

import { Order } from 'types/orders';
import { SubAccount } from 'types/subAccount';

import IPOTradeOrderForm from './components/IPOTradeOrderForm';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const IPOTradeOrder = () => {
  const { ipoId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [activeSubAccount, setActiveSubAccount] = useState<SubAccount>();
  const [activePortofolioName, setActivePortofolioName] = useState('');
  const [showCreateTradeOrder, setShowCreateTradeOrder] = useState(false);
  const [orderData, setOrderData] = useState<OrderDataType | null>(null);
  const [orderExecutionReport, setOrderExecutionReport] = useState<Order | null>(null);
  const [isCheckOpen, setIsCheckOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [orderCreateError, setOrderCreateError] = useState<BaseQueryErrorType | null>(null);
  const { data } = useGetIpoQuery(Number(ipoId), { skip: !ipoId });

  const { instrumentId, tradePlaceId } = data?.ipo[0] || {};

  const { data: accounts } = useGetAccountsQuery(
    {
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      tradePlaceId: String(tradePlaceId),
    },
    { skip: !(instrumentId && tradePlaceId) },
  );

  if (!data || !(instrumentId && tradePlaceId)) return null;

  const {
    instrumentImageName,
    instrumentName,
    isBond,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    priceCurrency,
    isin,
    instrumentCategoryName,
  } = data.ipo[0];

  const { tradingProducts = [], tradingAccounts = [] } = accounts || {};

  const handleActiveSubAccount = (subAccount: SubAccount) => {
    setActiveSubAccount(subAccount);
  };

  const handleTradingProductChange = (portfolioName: string) => {
    setActivePortofolioName(portfolioName);
  };

  const handleTradeOrderGoBackBtn = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const handleMainBtnClick = (data: OrderDataType) => {
    setOrderData(data);
    setShowCreateTradeOrder(true);
  };

  const handleSuccessOrderCreate = (order: Order) => {
    setOrderExecutionReport(order);
    handleCloseCreateTradeOrder();
    setIsCheckOpen(true);
  };

  const handleErrorOrderCreate = (error?: unknown) => {
    if (isError(error)) {
      setOrderCreateError(error);
    }
    handleCloseCreateTradeOrder();
    setIsCheckOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCloseCreateTradeOrder = () => {
    setShowCreateTradeOrder(false);
  };

  const handleCancelButtonClick = () => {
    console.log('click');
  };

  if (showCreateTradeOrder && orderData) {
    const { volume, portfolioName, quantity, ...body } = orderData;

    return (
      <CreateTradeOrder
        order={body}
        onSuccess={handleSuccessOrderCreate}
        onError={handleErrorOrderCreate}
        onClose={handleCloseCreateTradeOrder}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <HeaderPage
        title="Участие в размещении"
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleTradeOrderGoBackBtn}
      />
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />
        <div>
          <Text type="lineSemiBold">{instrumentName}</Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {instrumentCategoryName}
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <AccountCards
        instrumentId={String(instrumentId)}
        tradePlaceId={String(tradePlaceId)}
        tradingProducts={tradingProducts}
        tradingAccounts={tradingAccounts}
        onSubAccountChange={handleActiveSubAccount}
        instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel="Доступно"
        freeCollateralLabel="С учётом «плеча»"
        instrumentType={isBond ? 'isBond' : 'isStock'}
        onTraidingProductChange={handleTradingProductChange}
      />
      {activeSubAccount && (
        <IPOTradeOrderForm
          ipoData={data.ipo[0]}
          docs={data.document}
          subAccount={activeSubAccount}
          activePortfolioName={activePortofolioName}
          onMainBtnClick={handleMainBtnClick}
        />
      )}
      <Checks
        open={isCheckOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCheckOpen(false)}
        onTradeOrderGoBackBtn={handleTradeOrderGoBackBtn}
        onTradeOrderCancelButtonClick={handleCancelButtonClick}
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        instrumentCode={isin}
        instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
        currency={priceCurrency}
        subAccountId={activeSubAccount?.subAccountId}
        side={'BUY'}
        ordStatus={orderExecutionReport?.ordStatus}
        orderQty={orderExecutionReport?.orderQty || orderData?.quantity}
        cumQty={orderExecutionReport?.orderQty || 0}
        transactTime={orderExecutionReport?.transactTime}
        price={orderExecutionReport?.price || orderData?.price}
        priceSecondary={orderData?.priceSecondary}
        priceSecondaryCurrencyCode={orderData?.priceSecondaryCurrencyCode}
        orderNum={orderExecutionReport?.orderNum}
        totalPrice={orderData?.volume.value}
        totalPriceSecondary={orderData?.volume?.secondValue}
        totalPriceCurrency={orderData?.volume.currency}
        portfolioName={orderData?.portfolioName}
        errorMessage={
          isError(orderCreateError) ? orderCreateError?.data.error[0].errorMessageText : undefined
        }
        orderType="limit"
        isIpo
        showDividers={false}
        isBond={isBond}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default IPOTradeOrder;

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { getNoun } from 'utils/string';

import {
  InstrumentListWithDataLine,
  NormalizeInstrumentListByGroupCode,
} from 'modules/Issuers/types';

import { InstrumentList, QuoteHistory } from 'types/issuers';

export const mergeInstrumentListAndQuoteHistory = (
  instrumentList?: InstrumentList[],
  quoteHistory?: QuoteHistory[],
) => {
  if (!instrumentList) return;
  if (!quoteHistory) return instrumentList;
  return instrumentList.map((el) => {
    const instrument: InstrumentListWithDataLine = {
      ...el,
      dataLine: [],
    };

    quoteHistory.forEach((quote) => {
      if (
        quote.instrumentId === instrument.instrumentId &&
        quote.tradePlaceId === instrument.tradePlaceId
      ) {
        instrument?.dataLine?.push(quote.quote);
      }
    });
    return instrument;
  });
};

export const groupInstrumentsByGroupCode = (
  instrumentList?: (InstrumentList | InstrumentListWithDataLine)[],
) => {
  if (!instrumentList) return;

  return instrumentList.reduce((acc, instrument) => {
    if (acc[instrument.instrumentGroupCode]) {
      acc[instrument.instrumentGroupCode].push(instrument);
      return acc;
    }
    acc[instrument.instrumentGroupCode] = [instrument];
    return acc;
  }, {} as NormalizeInstrumentListByGroupCode);
};

export const filterInstrumentsByExpirationDate = (instruments?: InstrumentList[]) => {
  if (!instruments?.length) return [];
  const now = DateTime.now();
  return instruments.filter((instrument) => {
    if (!instrument?.expirationDate) return true;
    return now < DateTime.fromISO(instrument.expirationDate);
  });
};

export const getMaturityDescriptionFromExpirationDate = (expirationDate?: string) => {
  if (!expirationDate) return;
  const now = DateTime.now();

  const yearNouns = ['год', 'года', 'лет'] as const;

  const diff = DateTime.fromISO(expirationDate).diff(now, ['years', 'months']);

  const years = Math.floor(diff.years);
  const months = Math.floor(diff.months);

  if (years > 0 && months > 0) return `${years} ${getNoun(years, ...yearNouns)} ${months} мес`;
  if (years > 0) return `${years} ${getNoun(years, ...yearNouns)}`;
  if (months > 0) return `${months} мес`;
};

import { FC } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetIssuerQuery } from 'core/api/issuers';

import PageWrapper from 'modules/Issuers/components/PageWrapper/PageWrapper';
import { TABS } from 'modules/Issuers/consts';

import { HeaderPage, SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components';
import InstrumentIcon from 'components/Instrument/components/InstrumentIcon/InstrumentIcon';

import styles from './Issuers.module.pcss';

const Issuers: FC = ({ children }) => {
  const { issuerId = '' } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useGetIssuerQuery({ issuerId, rowsCountByType: 4 });

  const { issuer } = data || {};

  const { issuerImageName, shortName, fullName } = issuer?.[0] || {};

  const tabs = TABS.map((tab) => ({
    ...tab,
    link: generatePath(tab.link, { issuerId }),
  }));

  const handleBack = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage leftIconVariant="back" title={shortName} onLeftIconClick={handleBack} />
      <PageWrapper isError={isError} isLoading={isLoading}>
        <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
          tabs={tabs}
          classNameWrapper={styles.tabsWrapper}
          classNameTabs={styles.tabs}
          additionalTop={
            <Headline
              title={
                <Text type="title" className={styles.title}>
                  {shortName}
                </Text>
              }
              addonBottomText={fullName}
              iconLeft={<InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={issuerImageName} />}
            />
          }
          replace
        >
          {children}
        </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
      </PageWrapper>
    </>
  );
};

export default Issuers;

import React from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { InformationCell } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetIssuerQuery } from 'core/api/issuers';

import EmptyPlug from 'modules/Issuers/components/EmptyPlug/EmptyPlug';

const IssuersInfo = () => {
  const { issuerId = '' } = useParams();

  const { data } = useGetIssuerQuery({ issuerId, rowsCountByType: 4 });

  const { issuer, issuerIndustryTree } = data || {};

  const { industryName, description } = issuer?.[0] || {};
  const { name } = issuerIndustryTree?.[issuerIndustryTree?.length - 1] || {};

  const isEmpty = !industryName && !description && !name;

  if (isEmpty) return <EmptyPlug />;

  return (
    <>
      {description && <InformationCell title={description} />}
      {name && <InformationCell label="Отрасль" title={name} />}
      {industryName && (
        <InformationCell label="Категория отрасли" title={industryName} separator={false} />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default IssuersInfo;

import React, { Fragment } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_ISSUERS_INSTRUMENTS_GROUP } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetIssuerQuery } from 'core/api/issuers';

import EmptyPlug from 'modules/Issuers/components/EmptyPlug/EmptyPlug';
import IssuerInstrumentCard from 'modules/Issuers/components/IssuerInstrumentCard/IssuerInstrumentCard';
import { GROUPS } from 'modules/Issuers/consts';
import {
  filterInstrumentsByExpirationDate,
  groupInstrumentsByGroupCode,
  mergeInstrumentListAndQuoteHistory,
} from 'modules/Issuers/helpers';

const IssuersInstruments = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { issuerId = '' } = useParams();
  const { data } = useGetIssuerQuery({ issuerId, rowsCountByType: 4 });
  const { instrumentList, quoteHistory } = data || {};

  const filteredInstruments = filterInstrumentsByExpirationDate(instrumentList);
  const parsedInstrumentList = groupInstrumentsByGroupCode(
    mergeInstrumentListAndQuoteHistory(filteredInstruments, quoteHistory),
  );
  const availableGroups = GROUPS.filter((group) =>
    Object.keys(parsedInstrumentList || {}).includes(group.instrumentGroupCode),
  );

  const isEmpty = !filteredInstruments?.length;

  const handleShowAllClick = (group: string) => () => {
    const path = generatePath(ROUTE_ISSUERS_INSTRUMENTS_GROUP, {
      issuerId,
      groupId: group.toLowerCase(),
    });
    navigate(path);
  };

  if (isEmpty) return <EmptyPlug />;

  return (
    <>
      {parsedInstrumentList &&
        availableGroups.map(({ name, instrumentGroupCode }) => {
          const instruments = parsedInstrumentList?.[instrumentGroupCode];
          return (
            <Fragment key={instrumentGroupCode}>
              <Headline
                title={<Text type="subtitleSemiBold">{name}</Text>}
                addonRightNode={
                  instruments &&
                  instruments.length > 3 && (
                    <Button
                      shape="text"
                      variant="secondary"
                      onClick={handleShowAllClick(instrumentGroupCode)}
                    >
                      Показать все
                    </Button>
                  )
                }
              />
              {instruments?.slice(0, 3)?.map(({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, ...instrument }) => (
                <IssuerInstrumentCard
                  key={`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`}
                  instrumentId={instrumentId}
                  tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
                  {...instrument}
                />
              ))}
            </Fragment>
          );
        })}
    </>
  );
};

export default IssuersInstruments;

import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { Navigate, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_360 } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetIssuerQuery } from 'core/api/issuers';

import EmptyPlug from 'modules/Issuers/components/EmptyPlug/EmptyPlug';
import IssuerInstrumentCard from 'modules/Issuers/components/IssuerInstrumentCard/IssuerInstrumentCard';
import PageWrapper from 'modules/Issuers/components/PageWrapper/PageWrapper';
import { GROUPS } from 'modules/Issuers/consts';
import {
  filterInstrumentsByExpirationDate,
  mergeInstrumentListAndQuoteHistory,
} from 'modules/Issuers/helpers';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

const IssuersInstrumentsGroup: FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { issuerId = '', groupId = '' } = useParams();

  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useGetIssuerQuery(
    {
      issuerId,
      rowsCountByType: 2000,
      instrumentGroupCode: groupId.toUpperCase(),
    },
    { skip: !issuerId || !groupId },
  );
  const { instrumentList, quoteHistory } = data || {};

  const filteredInstruments = filterInstrumentsByExpirationDate(instrumentList);
  const parsedInstrumentList = mergeInstrumentListAndQuoteHistory(
    filteredInstruments,
    quoteHistory,
  );
  const group = GROUPS.find((group) => group.instrumentGroupCode === groupId.toUpperCase());

  const isEmpty = !instrumentList?.length;

  const handleBack = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  if (!group || !issuerId) return <Navigate to={ROUTE_360} />;

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title={group.name} leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={handleBack} />
      <PageWrapper isError={isError} isLoading={isLoading}>
        {isEmpty && <EmptyPlug />}
        {!isEmpty &&
          parsedInstrumentList?.map(({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, ...instrument }) => (
            <IssuerInstrumentCard
              key={`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`}
              instrumentId={instrumentId}
              tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
              {...instrument}
            />
          ))}
      </PageWrapper>
    </>
  );
};

export default IssuersInstrumentsGroup;

import { FC, useMemo } from 'react';

import { Headline } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_HELP, ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION, ROUTE_SETTINGS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { getSessionSelector } from 'core/session/session';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { useExpiredAnketNeedAcceptAttention } from 'modules/MyInformation/hooks/useExpiredAnketNeedAcceptAttention';

import { HeaderPage, SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as IndicatorSvg } from 'images/icons/circle-indicator.svg';

import styles from './More.module.pcss';

const tabs = [
  { name: 'Профиль', link: ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION },
  { name: 'Настройки', link: ROUTE_SETTINGS },
  { name: 'Помощь', link: ROUTE_HELP },
];

const More: FC = ({ children }) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const anketAttention = useExpiredAnketNeedAcceptAttention();

  const tabIcons = useMemo(() => {
    if (!anketAttention.isAttention) return;
    return {
      Профиль: <IndicatorSvg className={styles.profileTabAttentionDot} />,
    };
  }, [anketAttention.isAttention]);

  const { data } = useAppSelector(getSessionSelector);
  const personFirstName = data?.personFirstName;
  const personLastName = data?.personLastName;

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrapper : styles.wrapperDesktop}>
      {isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage
          size="big"
          title={personFirstName && personLastName ? `${personFirstName} ${personLastName}` : ''}
          className={styles.header}
        />
      ) : (
        <Headline
          className={styles.headlineDesktop}
          title={personFirstName && personLastName ? `${personFirstName} ${personLastName}` : ''}
        />
      )}

      <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
        tabs={tabs}
        icons={tabIcons}
        classNameContent={isMobile ? styles.tabsContent : styles.tabsContentDesktop}
        classNameWrapper={cn(styles.tabsWrapper, { [styles.tabsWrapperDesktop]: !isMobile })}
      >
        {children}
      </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default More;

import { FC } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import Button from '@vision/button';
import { ROUTE_CHAT } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { setOpenBlockedService } from 'core/services/servicesSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';

import styles from 'modules/MyInformation/components/Services/Services.module.pcss';

import ModalCommonSelect from 'components/ModalCommonSelect';

const DeniedBottomSheet: FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;
  const { openBlockedService } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const goToChat = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_CHAT);
  };

  const onDismiss = () => {
    dispatch(setOpenBlockedService(false));
  };

  return (
    <ModalCommonSelect
      isDesktopView={isDesktopView}
      open={openBlockedService}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
    >
      <div className={styles.wrap}>
        <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Услуга недоступна</Text>
        <div className={styles.description}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Для получения подробной информации обратитесь в чат</Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.buttongroup}>
        <Button variant="primary" className={styles.button} onClick={goToChat}>
          Написать в Чат
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" className={styles.button} onClick={onDismiss}>
          Не сейчас
        </Button>
      </div>
    </ModalCommonSelect>
  );
};

export default DeniedBottomSheet;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ActionCell, BottomSheet, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_REPORTS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { PERMISSION_PERSON_REPORTING } from 'modules/ReportsPage/constants';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ReportsSvg } from 'images/icons/copy.svg';
import { ReactComponent as OrderReportSvg } from 'images/icons/share.svg';

import styles from './ReportsActionCell.module.pcss';

const ReportsActionCell = () => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const isPermissionGranted = Permissions.granted(PERMISSION_PERSON_REPORTING);

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const Wrapper = isMobile ? BottomSheet : AdaptivePopup;

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleBottomSheetOpen = () => setOpen(true);

  const handleReportsClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_REPORTS, { state: { status: 'isProgress' } });

  return (
    <>
      <ActionCell
        description={
          <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            Заказ отчётов
          </Text>
        }
        title="Отчёты и справки"
        iconLeft={<ReportsSvg />}
        classNameIconLeft={cx(styles.primaryIconWrapper, styles.blueIcon)}
        onClick={handleBottomSheetOpen}
        separator={false}
      />
      <Wrapper open={open} onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss} initialFocusRef={false}>
        <div className={styles.bottomSheetContent}>
          <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.title}>
            Отчёты и справки
          </Text>

          <ActionCell
            addonRight
            disabled={!isPermissionGranted}
            description="Брокерский отчёт, справка о балансовой стоимости, ведомость о доходах и другие"
            title="Заказать онлайн"
            iconLeft={<OrderReportSvg />}
            classNameIconLeft={cx(styles.primaryIconWrapper, {
              [styles.blueIcon]: isPermissionGranted,
              [styles.disabledIcon]: !isPermissionGranted,
            })}
            separator={false}
            onClick={handleReportsClick}
          />
        </div>
      </Wrapper>
    </>
  );
};

export default ReportsActionCell;

import React, { FC, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_PROFILE, ROUTE_RISKGROUP_CHANGE } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetRiskGroupsQuery } from 'core/api/riskGroup';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { setPortFolioId, setRiskGroupName } from 'core/services/servicesSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import styles from 'modules/MyInformation/components/Services/Services.module.pcss';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import ActionCell from 'components/ActionCell';

const RiskGroup: FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;
  const { productIdServices } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);

  const {
    data: riskGroups,
    isError: isRiskGroupError,
    isFetching: isFetchingRiskGroup,
    refetch,
  } = useGetRiskGroupsQuery({ product_id: productIdServices }, { skip: !productIdServices });

  useEffect(() => {
    !productIdServices && navigate(ROUTE_PROFILE);
  }, [navigate, productIdServices]);

  useErrorNotification(isRiskGroupError);

  if (isRiskGroupError) {
    return (
      <Placeholder
        variant={'error'}
        title={'Что-то пошло не так'}
        text={'Попробуйте ещё раз или вернитесь позднее, чтобы повторить попытку'}
        actionButtonText={'Повторить попытку'}
        onActionButtonClick={refetch}
        actionSecondButtonText={'Вернуться'}
        onActionSecondButtonClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_PROFILE)}
        mode={'auto'}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_PROFILE)}
        documentTitle={'Группы риска'}
      />
      <div className={cx(styles.wrap, { [styles.wrapDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
        <Text type={'title'}>Группы риска</Text>
        <div className={styles.description}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>
            Влияет на возможный размер дополнительно предоставленных денежных средств и ценных
            бумаг, а также на допустимые значения параметров риска, которые могут быть применены к
            портфелю.
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      {isFetchingRiskGroup ? (
        <div>
          <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor className={styles.loader} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={cx({ [styles.wrapDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
          {riskGroups?.productRiskGroups.map((riskGroup) => (
            <ActionCell
              onClick={() => {
                dispatch(setRiskGroupName(riskGroup.riskGroupName));
                dispatch(setPortFolioId(riskGroup.portfolioId));
                navigate(ROUTE_RISKGROUP_CHANGE);
              }}
              key={riskGroup.portfolioCode}
              subtitle={riskGroup.riskGroupName}
              separator={true}
              className={styles.containerCell}
            >
              {riskGroup.portfolioCode}
            </ActionCell>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RiskGroup;

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_SERVICES_SUCCESS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { API_REQUEST_URL } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import { useSetRiskGroupConfirmMutation } from 'core/api/riskGroup';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';
import useDownloadFile from 'hooks/useDownloadFile';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import styles from 'modules/MyInformation/components/Services/RiskGroupChangeConfirmPage/RiskGroupChangeConfirmPage.module.pcss';
import { stateRiskGroupChange } from 'modules/MyInformation/constants';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell';
import ModalCommonSelect from 'components/ModalCommonSelect';

const RiskGroupChangeConfirmPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

  const { requestGuid, riskGroupCRC } = useAppSelector((state) => state.services);

  const filePath = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/portfolios/risk_groups/change/file?requestGuid=${requestGuid}`;

  const { file } = useDownloadFile({
    url: filePath,
  });

  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading, error: smsError }] =
    useSetRiskGroupConfirmMutation();

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const handleConfirmButton = () => {
    getSms({ requestGuid });
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_SERVICES_SUCCESS, { state: stateRiskGroupChange });
  };

  useErrorNotification(smsError);

  if (isSmsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
        <HeaderPage
          title={'СМС-подтверждение'}
          leftIconVariant="close"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        />
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
        <Text>Запрос СМС-кода...</Text>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {!smsData ? (
        <div className={cx(styles.root, { [styles.rootDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
          <>
            <HeaderPage leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick} />
            <div className={styles.main}>
              <Text type="title">Изменение группы риска</Text>
              <Text className={styles.text} type="bodyRegular">
                Проверьте и подпишите документы на изменение группы риска
              </Text>
              <div className={styles.document}>
                <DocumentCell
                  url={file?.url}
                  name={'Заявление на обслуживание'}
                  id={`ID: ${riskGroupCRC}`}
                />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.divider} />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.bottom}>
              <Text
                type="lineMedium"
                className={cx(styles.info, { [styles.infoDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
              >
                Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
              </Text>
              <Button
                onClick={handleConfirmButton}
                className={cx(styles.btn, { [styles.btnDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
                variant="primary"
              >
                Подтвердить
              </Button>
            </div>
          </>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ModalCommonSelect
          shape={'sms'}
          open={Boolean(smsData)}
          onDismiss={handleBackClick}
          isDesktopView={isDesktopView}
        >
          <SmsConfirmation
            initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
            smsInputCount={4}
            onSuccess={handleConfirm}
            onError={() => console.log('Error')}
            loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется смена группы риска...</Text>}
          />
        </ModalCommonSelect>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RiskGroupChangeConfirmPage;
