import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Input, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_RISKGROUP_CONFIRM, ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useGetRiskGroupsAvailableQuery,
  useLazyGetRiskGroupsChangeDocumentQuery,
  useLazyGetRiskGroupsChangeStatusQuery,
  useSetRiskGroupChangeMutation,
} from 'core/api/riskGroup';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { setRequestGuid, setRiskGroupCRC, setRiskGroupId } from 'core/services/servicesSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import styles from 'modules/MyInformation/components/Services/RiskGroupChangePage/RiskGroupChange.module.pcss';
import Skeleton from 'modules/MyInformation/components/Services/RiskGroupChangePage/Skeleton';
import { PRODUCT_OPTIONS_RISKGROUP_CHANGE } from 'modules/MyInformation/constants';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import ModalCommonSelect from 'components/ModalCommonSelect';

import { ReactComponent as ArrowDown } from 'images/icons/arrow-small-down.svg';
import { ReactComponent as Check } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

const RiskGroupChangePage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

  const { riskGroupName, productIdServices, portfolioId, riskGroupId } =
    useAppSelector(servicesSelector);

  const riskGroupChangePermission = Permissions.get(
    PRODUCT_OPTIONS_RISKGROUP_CHANGE,
    String(productIdServices),
  );

  const isRiskGroupChangePermissionDenied = riskGroupChangePermission === 'DENIED';
  const isRiskGroupChangePermissionBlocked = riskGroupChangePermission === 'BLOCKED';

  const [isRiskGroupChangeBottomSheetOpen, setIsRiskGroupChangeBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [checkedGroupRisk, setCheckedGroupRisk] = useState(riskGroupName);
  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);

  const [getRiskGroupStatus, { data: resultGetRiskGroupStatus, isLoading: isStatusLoading }] =
    useLazyGetRiskGroupsChangeStatusQuery();

  const [getRiskGroupDocument, { data: resultGetRiskGroupDocument, isLoading: isDocumentLoading }] =
    useLazyGetRiskGroupsChangeDocumentQuery();

  const {
    data: riskGroupsAvailable,
    isLoading: isRiskGroupsAvailableLoading,
    isError: isRiskGroupsAvailableError,
  } = useGetRiskGroupsAvailableQuery({ product_id: productIdServices });

  const [
    changeGroupRisk,
    {
      data: changeGroupRiskData,
      isLoading: isChangeGroupRiskLoading,
      isError: isChangeGroupRiskError,
      isSuccess: isChangeGroupRiskSuccess,
    },
  ] = useSetRiskGroupChangeMutation();

  const requestGuid = changeGroupRiskData?.requestGuid;
  const riskGroupStatus = resultGetRiskGroupStatus?.requestStatus[0].status;
  const crc = resultGetRiskGroupDocument?.crc;

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const onDismis = () => {
    setIsRiskGroupChangeBottomSheetOpen(false);
    setCheckedGroupRisk(riskGroupName);
  };

  const handleConfirmChange = async () => {
    const res = await changeGroupRisk({
      portfolio_Id: portfolioId,
      riskGroup_Id: riskGroupId,
    }).unwrap();
    getRiskGroupStatus(res).unwrap();
  };

  const filteredGroups = useMemo(
    () =>
      riskGroupsAvailable?.availableRiskGroups.filter(
        (riskGroup) => riskGroup.portfolioId === portfolioId,
      ),
    [portfolioId, riskGroupsAvailable?.availableRiskGroups],
  );

  const riskGroupsAvailableList = filteredGroups?.map((riskGroupAvailable) => (
    <div
      onClick={() => {
        setCheckedGroupRisk(riskGroupAvailable.riskGroupName);
        dispatch(setRiskGroupId(riskGroupAvailable.riskGroupId));
        setIsRiskGroupChangeBottomSheetOpen(false);
      }}
      key={Math.random()}
    >
      <div className={styles.changeRiskGroupItem}>
        <span>{riskGroupAvailable.riskGroupName}</span>
        {checkedGroupRisk === riskGroupAvailable.riskGroupName && <Check />}
      </div>
    </div>
  ));

  useEffect(() => {
    let setTimeOutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (riskGroupStatus === 'waiting_documents') {
      setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => {
        getRiskGroupStatus({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
        setRetryCount((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 3000);
    }
    if (riskGroupStatus === 'signing_documents') {
      getRiskGroupDocument({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
    }
    if (retryCount >= 10) {
      navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
    }

    return () => clearTimeout(setTimeOutId);
  }, [
    retryCount,
    getRiskGroupDocument,
    getRiskGroupStatus,
    riskGroupStatus,
    requestGuid,
    navigate,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(setRequestGuid(requestGuid));
    dispatch(setRiskGroupCRC(crc));
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [requestGuid, crc]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resultGetRiskGroupDocument) navigate(ROUTE_RISKGROUP_CONFIRM);
  });

  useErrorNotification(isRiskGroupsAvailableError);
  useErrorNotification(isChangeGroupRiskError);

  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.wrap, { [styles.wrapDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        documentTitle={'Изменение группы риска'}
      />
      <div className={styles.main}>
        <div className={styles.head}>
          <Text type={'title'}>Изменение группы риска</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.form}>
          <Input
            label={'Текущая группа риска'}
            disabled={true}
            placeholder={riskGroupName}
            addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
          />
          <div onClick={() => setIsRiskGroupChangeBottomSheetOpen(true)}>
            <Input
              label={'Новая группа риска'}
              value={
                checkedGroupRisk === riskGroupName ? 'Выберите группу риска' : checkedGroupRisk
              }
              addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
              readOnly
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={cx(styles.footer, { [styles.footerDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
        <Button
          onClick={handleConfirmChange}
          disabled={
            checkedGroupRisk === riskGroupName ||
            isRiskGroupChangePermissionBlocked ||
            isRiskGroupChangePermissionDenied
          }
          loading={
            isChangeGroupRiskLoading ||
            isStatusLoading ||
            isDocumentLoading ||
            isChangeGroupRiskSuccess
          }
        >
          Подтвердить
        </Button>
      </div>

      <ModalCommonSelect
        open={isRiskGroupChangeBottomSheetOpen}
        onDismiss={onDismis}
        className={styles.wrap}
        isDesktopView={isDesktopView}
      >
        <div className={styles.title}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Выберите новую группу риска</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.changeRiskGroup}>
          {!isRiskGroupsAvailableLoading ? <>{riskGroupsAvailableList} </> : <Skeleton />}
        </div>
      </ModalCommonSelect>
    </div>
  );
};

export default RiskGroupChangePage;

import { FC, useEffect } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import {
  setOpenSelectProducts,
  setProductIdServices,
  setSelectService,
} from 'core/services/servicesSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';

import { SelectProductBSHProps } from 'modules/MyInformation/types';

import ModalCommonSelect from 'components/ModalCommonSelect';

import styles from './SelectProductBSH.module.pcss';

const SelectProductBsh: FC<SelectProductBSHProps> = ({
  products,
  handleRiskGroup,
  handleGetUba,
  handleChangeTariff,
}) => {
  const { openSelectProducts, selectService, productIdServices } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

  const isHideBottomSheet = products.length === 1;
  const onDismiss = () => {
    dispatch(setSelectService(null));
    dispatch(setOpenSelectProducts(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (productIdServices && isHideBottomSheet) {
      handleSelectProduct(productIdServices);
    }
  }, [selectService]);

  const serviceActions = {
    riskGroup: handleRiskGroup,
    uba: handleGetUba,
    tariff: handleChangeTariff,
  };
  const handleSelectProduct = (productId: number) => {
    dispatch(setProductIdServices(productId));
    const serviceAction = selectService && serviceActions[selectService];
    if (serviceAction) {
      serviceAction(productId);
    }
    onDismiss();
  };

  return (
    <ModalCommonSelect
      open={openSelectProducts}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      isDesktopView={isDesktopView}
    >
      <div className={styles.title}>
        <Text type={'subtitle'}>Выберите счёт</Text>
      </div>
      <div className={cx(styles.products, { [styles.productsDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
        {products.map((product) => (
          <div key={product.productId} onClick={() => handleSelectProduct(product.productId)}>
            <Text type={'lineRegular'}>
              {product.productTypeName} №{product.accountNo}
            </Text>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ModalCommonSelect>
  );
};

export default SelectProductBsh;

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Placeholder, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_PROFILE, ROUTE_SERVICES_SUCCESS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useSetUbaOpenMutation } from 'core/api/uba';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import {
  PRODUCT_OPTIONS_UBA_ADD,
  buttonTitle,
  stateUba,
  ubaTitle,
} from 'modules/MyInformation/constants';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import ModalCommonSelect from 'components/ModalCommonSelect';

import { ReactComponent as UbaSuccessSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-success.svg';

import styles from './UbaPage.module.pcss';

const UbaPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { operationType } = useParams();
  const { productIdServices } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading, error: isSmsError }] =
    useSetUbaOpenMutation();

  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const hint = useMemo(() => {
    const text = hints?.hints.find((f) => f?.slug === 'UBA_DETAIL_INFO')?.text;

    return text;
  }, [hints]);

  const ubaAddPermission = Permissions.get(PRODUCT_OPTIONS_UBA_ADD, String(productIdServices));
  const isUbaAddPermissionDenied = ubaAddPermission === 'DENIED' || ubaAddPermission === 'BLOCKED';

  const ubaTitleText = operationType && ubaTitle[operationType];
  const buttonTitleText = operationType && buttonTitle[operationType];

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_PROFILE);
  };

  const handleConfirmClick = () => {
    getSms({ product_id: productIdServices }).unwrap();
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_SERVICES_SUCCESS, { state: stateUba });
  };

  const isDisabled =
    operationType === 'processing' || (operationType === 'disactive' && isUbaAddPermissionDenied);

  const handleClick = operationType === 'disactive' ? handleConfirmClick : handleBackClick;

  useErrorNotification(isSmsError);

  return (
    <>
      {!smsData ? (
        <div className={cx(styles.wrap, { [styles.wrapDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
          <HeaderPage
            leftIconVariant={'back'}
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
            documentTitle={'Единый брокерский счёт'}
          />
          <Placeholder
            shape={'emptyState'}
            title={ubaTitleText}
            text={hint}
            img={
              <div className={styles.placeholderIcon}>
                <UbaSuccessSvg />
              </div>
            }
            buttons={
              <div className={styles.wrapperBtn}>
                {operationType === 'disactive' && (
                  <span className={styles.overlineText}>
                    Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
                  </span>
                )}
                <div className={cx({ [styles.btnDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
                  <Button onClick={handleClick} loading={isSmsLoading} disabled={isDisabled}>
                    {buttonTitleText}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            }
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ModalCommonSelect
          shape={'sms'}
          isDesktopView={isDesktopView}
          open={Boolean(smsData)}
          onDismiss={handleBackClick}
        >
          <SmsConfirmation
            initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
            smsInputCount={4}
            onSuccess={handleConfirm}
            onError={() => console.log('Error')}
            loaderChildren={<Text>Подключение единого брокерского счёта...</Text>}
          />
        </ModalCommonSelect>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default UbaPage;

import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

const NEED_ACCEPT_CODES = new Set(['NeedAcceptLK', 'NeedAcceptOffice']);
const CONFIRMED_CODE = 'Confirmed';
const PROCESSING_CODE = 'Processing';

export type AnketStatusRow = {
  anketDataStatusCode?: string;
  AnketDataStatusCode?: string;
  endDate?: string;
  EndDate?: string;
};

export type AnketAttentionInfo = {
  isAttention: boolean;
  text: string;
};

/** Анкета просрочена по EndDate и ожидает подтверждения в ЛК / офисе (GET profile → anketDataStatus). */
export function getIsExpiredAnketNeedAccept(
  anketDataStatus: AnketStatusRow[] | undefined,
): boolean {
  const row = anketDataStatus?.[0];
  const statusCode = row?.anketDataStatusCode || row?.AnketDataStatusCode;
  const endDate = row?.endDate || row?.EndDate;
  if (!statusCode || !endDate) return false;
  if (statusCode === PROCESSING_CODE) return false;
  if (!NEED_ACCEPT_CODES.has(statusCode)) return false;
  const end = DateTime.fromISO(endDate);
  if (!end.isValid) return false;
  return DateTime.now().startOf('day') > end.startOf('day');
}

/** До EndDate осталось менее месяца при статусе Confirmed. */
export function getIsLessThanOneMonthNeedAccept(anketDataStatus: AnketStatusRow[] | undefined): {
  isNeedAccept: boolean;
  formattedEndDate: string;
} {
  const row = anketDataStatus?.[0];
  const statusCode = row?.anketDataStatusCode || row?.AnketDataStatusCode;
  const endDate = row?.endDate || row?.EndDate;
  if (!statusCode || !endDate || statusCode !== CONFIRMED_CODE) {
    return { isNeedAccept: false, formattedEndDate: '' };
  }

  const end = DateTime.fromISO(endDate);
  if (!end.isValid) return { isNeedAccept: false, formattedEndDate: '' };

  const today = DateTime.now().startOf('day');
  const endDay = end.startOf('day');
  const monthBeforeEnd = endDay.minus({ months: 1 }).startOf('day');

  return {
    isNeedAccept: today > monthBeforeEnd && today <= endDay,
    formattedEndDate: endDay.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT),
  };
}

export function getAnketAttentionInfo(
  anketDataStatus: AnketStatusRow[] | undefined,
): AnketAttentionInfo {
  if (getIsExpiredAnketNeedAccept(anketDataStatus)) {
    return { isAttention: true, text: 'Необходимо обновить' };
  }

  const { isNeedAccept, formattedEndDate } = getIsLessThanOneMonthNeedAccept(anketDataStatus);
  if (isNeedAccept) {
    return { isAttention: true, text: `Обновите до ${formattedEndDate}` };
  }

  return { isAttention: false, text: '' };
}

import { ACCESS_VALUES, PERSON_PROFILE } from '../constants';

export const useIsPersonProfile = () => {

  return {

};

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { PERSON_QUALIFICATION } from '../constants';

export const useIsQualInvestor = () => {
  const session = getSession();

  const isQualPermissionsGranted = Permissions.someGranted(PERSON_QUALIFICATION);
  const isQual = session?.isQual;
  const isActualQualOrder = session?.isActualQualOrder;
  const isPossibleQual = isQualPermissionsGranted && session?.isPossibleQual;

  return {
    isQual,
    isActualQualOrder,
    isPossibleQual,
    isQualPermissionsGranted,
  };
};

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_RISKGROUP, ROUTE_RISKGROUP_TEST } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetCheckingTestQuery } from 'core/api/riskGroup';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { setOpenBlockedService } from 'core/services/servicesSlice';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import { PRODUCT_OPTIONS_RISKGROUP } from 'modules/MyInformation/constants';
import { CategoriesListType } from 'modules/MyInformation/types';

export const useRiskGroup = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const session = getSession();
  const { productIdServices } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const riskGroupPermission = Permissions.get(PRODUCT_OPTIONS_RISKGROUP, String(productIdServices));
  const isRiskGroupPermissionDenied =
    riskGroupPermission === 'DENIED' || riskGroupPermission === 'BLOCKED';

  const {
    data: checkingTest,
    isError: isCheckingTestError,
    refetch: refetchCheckingTest,
  } = useGetCheckingTestQuery('');

  const isMarginPassed = checkingTest?.categories?.filter(
    (item: CategoriesListType) => item.name === 'Маржинальное кредитование',
  );
  const isMarginTest = isMarginPassed?.[0]?.passed;
  const isQual = session?.isQual;

  const handleRiskGroup = () => {
    if (!isRiskGroupPermissionDenied) {
      if (!(isQual || isMarginTest)) {
        navigate(ROUTE_RISKGROUP_TEST);
      }
      navigate(ROUTE_RISKGROUP);
    } else {
      dispatch(setOpenBlockedService(true));
    }
  };

  useErrorNotification(isCheckingTestError);

  return { handleRiskGroup, isCheckingTestError, refetchCheckingTest };
};

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { PATH_TARIFFS_TARIFF_SELECT, ROUTE_TARIFFS } from 'const/routes';

import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_UBA } from 'const/routes';

import { useLazyGetUbaStatusQuery } from 'core/api/uba';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { setOpenBlockedService } from 'core/services/servicesSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import { PRODUCT_OPTIONS_UBA } from 'modules/MyInformation/constants';

import { productOptionsType } from 'types/uba';

export const useUBA = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { productIdServices } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const ubaPermission = Permissions.get(PRODUCT_OPTIONS_UBA, String(productIdServices));
  const isUbaPermissionDenied = ubaPermission === 'DENIED' || ubaPermission === 'BLOCKED';

  const [getUbaStatus, { isFetching: isUbaLoading, isError: isUbaError }] =
    useLazyGetUbaStatusQuery();

  const handleUba = (ubaStatus: productOptionsType[]) => {
    const isUbaOptionCodeActive =
      ubaStatus?.[1].optionCode === 'Product.Option.UBA'
        ? ubaStatus?.[1].isActive
        : ubaStatus?.[0].isActive;

    const isUbaOptionCodeBlocked =
      ubaStatus?.[1].optionCode === 'Product.Option.UBA'
        ? ubaStatus?.[1].isBlocked
        : ubaStatus?.[0].isBlocked;

    !(isUbaOptionCodeBlocked && isUbaOptionCodeActive === 'off')
      ? handleOperationType(isUbaOptionCodeActive)
      : dispatch(setOpenBlockedService(true));
  };

  const handleGetUbaStatus = async (productId: number | null) => {
    if (!isUbaPermissionDenied && productId) {
      const ubaStatus = await getUbaStatus({ product_id: productId }).unwrap();
      handleUba(ubaStatus.productOptions);
    }
  };

  const handleOperationType = (isUbaOptionCodeActive: string) => {
    const operationType = isUbaOptionCodeActive === 'on' ? 'active' : 'disactive';
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_UBA, { operationType }));
  };

  useErrorNotification(isUbaError);

  return { handleGetUbaStatus, isUbaLoading, isUbaError };
};

import React, { ChangeEvent, FC, useEffect } from 'react';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Input from '@aurora/input';

import { useGetSwiftBanksQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { useGetTransliterationQuery } from 'core/api/transliteration';
import { setAccount, setBankName, setPayee, setSwift } from 'core/requisite/requisiteSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import useReducerAsState from 'hooks/useReducerAsState';

import Autocomplete from 'components/Autocomplete';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { CurrencyFormProps, State } from './types';

const initialState: State = {
  swiftDirty: false,
  accountDirty: false,
  bankNameDirty: false,
  error: null,
};

const CurrencyForm: FC<CurrencyFormProps> = ({
  classNameInput,
  classNameInputWrapper,
  templateName,
  currencyCode,
  onSubmit,
  tabWithEnter,
}) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const { bankName, account, swift, payee } = useAppSelector((state) => state.requisite);

  const { state, setState } = useReducerAsState(initialState);
  const { swiftDirty, bankNameDirty } = state;

  const banksInfoQuery = useGetSwiftBanksQuery({ Code: swift, Name: bankName });
  const transliterationQuery = useGetTransliterationQuery();
  const { data: transliterationData, isSuccess: isTransliterationSuccess } = transliterationQuery;
  const invisibleButton =
    !transliterationData || !bankName || !swift || !account || !templateName || !currencyCode;

  const onBlurHandler = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    switch (e.target.name) {
      case 'swift':
        if (swift.length === 11) setState({ swiftDirty: false });
        else {
          setState({ swiftDirty: true });
        }
        break;
      case 'bankName':
        setState({ bankNameDirty: true });
        break;
    }
  };

  const onSubmitHandler = (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    onSubmit({
      name: bankName,
      payee: payee,
      benBankSWIFT: swift,
      benBankAccount: account,
      currencyCode: currencyCode,
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (swift.length === 11) setState({ swiftDirty: false });
  }, [swift, setState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(setPayee(transliterationData?.transliteratedPayee[0].payee));
  }, [dispatch, transliterationData?.transliteratedPayee]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (swift.length >= 3) {
      if (banksInfoQuery.isSuccess && banksInfoQuery.data?.banksSwift.length < 1) {
        setState({ swiftDirty: true });
      } else {
        setState({ swiftDirty: false });
      }
    }
  }, [swift, banksInfoQuery, setState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (bankName.length >= 3) {
      if (banksInfoQuery.isSuccess && banksInfoQuery.data?.banksSwift.length < 1) {
        setState({ bankNameDirty: true });
      } else {
        setState({ bankNameDirty: false });
      }
    }
  }, [bankName, banksInfoQuery, setState]);

  return (
    <>
      {transliterationData && isTransliterationSuccess && (
        <>
          <Input
            classNameInput={classNameInput}
            className={classNameInputWrapper}
            label="Получатель"
            value={payee}
            onChange={(e) => {
              dispatch(setPayee(e.target.value));
            }}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          />
          <Autocomplete
            name="bankName"
            classNameInput={classNameInput}
            className={classNameInputWrapper}
            label="Банк получателя"
            placeholder="Например, ПАО «Сбербанк»"
            value={bankName}
            list={
              banksInfoQuery.isSuccess
                ? banksInfoQuery.data.banksSwift.map((bank) => ({
                    id: bank.id,
                    value: bank.name,
                    description: bank.code,
                  }))
                : []
            }
            status={bankNameDirty ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={bankNameDirty ? 'Банк не найден' : ''}
            onChange={(e) => {
              dispatch(setBankName(e.target.value));
            }}
            onSelect={(selectedBank) => {
              if (selectedBank.value === bankName && selectedBank.description === swift) return;
              dispatch(setSwift(selectedBank.description));
              dispatch(setBankName(selectedBank.value));
            }}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          />
          <Autocomplete
            name="swift"
            classNameInput={classNameInput}
            className={classNameInputWrapper}
            label="SWIFT банка получателя"
            placeholder="000000000"
            value={swift}
            status={swiftDirty ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={swiftDirty ? 'Банк не найден' : ''}
            onBlur={(e) => onBlurHandler(e)}
            onChange={(e) => dispatch(setSwift(e.target.value))}
            list={
              banksInfoQuery.isSuccess
                ? banksInfoQuery.data.banksSwift.map((bank) => ({
                    id: bank.id,
                    value: bank.name,
                    description: bank.code,
                  }))
                : []
            }
            onSelect={(selectedBank) => {
              if (selectedBank.value === bankName && selectedBank.description === swift) return;
              dispatch(setSwift(selectedBank.description));
              dispatch(setBankName(selectedBank.value));
            }}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          />

          <Input
            name="account"
            classNameInput={classNameInput}
            className={classNameInputWrapper}
            label="Расчётный счёт в банке получателя"
            placeholder="00000000000000000000"
            value={account}
            onChange={(e) => dispatch(setAccount(e.target.value))}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          />

          <div className={styles.divider}></div>
          <Button disabled={invisibleButton} className={styles.button} onClick={onSubmitHandler}>
            Сохранить
          </Button>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default CurrencyForm;

import React, { FC, useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import BottomSheet from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cx from 'classnames';

import CurrencyIcon from 'modules/Transfers/components/CurrencyIcon';

import { ReactComponent as CheckedIcon } from 'images/icons/checked.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ArrowDown } from 'images/raw-icons/arrow-down-simple.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { SelectProps } from './types';

const CurrencyPicker: FC<SelectProps> = ({
  label,
  classNameLabel,
  options,
  className,
  onSelect,
}) => {
  const [isOpened, setIsOpened] = useState(false);
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState(options[0].name);

  const handleClick = useCallback(
    (currencyName: string, currencyCode: string) => {
      setCurrency(currencyName);
      onSelect(currencyCode);
      setIsOpened(false);
    },
    [onSelect],
  );

  const optionsList = useMemo(
    () =>
      options?.map((option) => (
        <li key={option.id} className={styles.currencyListItem}>
          <button
            onClick={() => handleClick(option.name, option.code)}
            aria-label={option.name}
            type="button"
            className={styles.chooseButton}
          ></button>
          <span className={styles.currencyIcon}>
            <CurrencyIcon currencyCode={option.code} />
          </span>
          <p className={styles.currencyName}>{option.name}</p>
          <span className={styles.checked}>{currency === option.name && <CheckedIcon />}</span>
        </li>
      )),
    [options, currency, handleClick],
  );

  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <label>{label && <div className={cx(styles.label, classNameLabel)}>{label}</div>}</label>
      <div className={styles.input} onClick={() => setIsOpened(true)}>
        <div className={styles.inputFormElement}>
          <span className={styles.fieldValue}>{currency}</span>
        </div>
        <ArrowDown />
      </div>

      <BottomSheet open={isOpened} onDismiss={() => setIsOpened(false)}>
        <div className={cx(styles.wrapper, styles.selected)}>
          <Text type="subtitleBold">Выбор валюты</Text>
          <ul className={styles.currencyList}>{optionsList}</ul>
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CurrencyPicker;

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Checkbox from '@aurora/checkbox';
import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import { ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE_SUCCESS } from 'const/routes';

import { useConfirmMutation } from 'core/api/requisites';
import { resetState } from 'core/requisite/requisiteSlice';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';
import useDownloadFile from 'hooks/useDownloadFile';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell';

import { AddRequisitesResponse } from 'types/requisites';

import RequisiteErrorPage from '../RequisiteErrorPage';
import RequisiteModal from '../RequisiteModal/RequisiteModal';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type StatusType = 'def' | 'sms';

const ApprovePage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [checkAgreement, setCheckAgreement] = useState(false);
  const [isBottomOpened, setIsBottomOpened] = useState(false);
  const [headerTitle, setHeaderTitle] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<StatusType>('def');
  const [btnCount, setBtnCount] = useState<number>(0);

  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const location = useLocation();
  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading, error: smsError }] =
    useConfirmMutation();
  const { checkSum, ftpPath } = location?.state as AddRequisitesResponse;

  const { file } = useDownloadFile({
    url: ftpPath,
  });

  const confirmHandler = () => {
    setBtnCount((prev) => ++prev);
    setStatus('sms');
  };

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    if (status === 'sms') {
      setStatus('def');
    } else {
      setIsBottomOpened(true);
      dispatch(resetState());
    }
  };

  const handleSuccess = useCallback(() => {
    navigate(ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE_SUCCESS);
    dispatch(resetState());
  }, [navigate, dispatch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (btnCount === 1) getSms();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [btnCount]);

  useErrorNotification(smsError);

  if (isSmsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
        <HeaderPage
          title={'СМС-подтверждение'}
          leftIconVariant="close"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        />

        <CircleLoader brandColor />
        <Text>Запрос СМС-кода...</Text>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (ftpPath === '' || !ftpPath) {
    return <RequisiteErrorPage />;
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.root}>
      {status === 'def' ? (
        <>
          <HeaderPage
            title={headerTitle}
            leftIconVariant="back"
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          />
          <div className={styles.main}>
            <Text type="title">Подтверждение заявки</Text>
            <Text className={styles.text} type="bodyRegular">
              Подтвердите согласие и подпишите файлы с помощью SMS
            </Text>
            <div className={styles.document}>
              <DocumentCell
                url={file?.url}
                name={'Заявление о добавлении реквизитов'}
                id={`ID: ${checkSum}`}
              />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.divider} />
            <Checkbox
              checked={checkAgreement}
              onChange={() => setCheckAgreement(!checkAgreement)}
              label="Подтверждаю корректность данных в Заявлении"
            />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.bottom}>
            <Text type="lineMedium" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.info}>
              Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
            </Text>
            <Button
              onClick={confirmHandler}
              className={styles.btn}
              variant="primary"
              disabled={!checkAgreement}
            >
              Подтвердить
            </Button>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <SmsConfirmation
          initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
          smsInputCount={4}
          onSuccess={handleSuccess}
          onError={() => console.log('Error')}
          headerleftIconVariant="close"
          onBackClick={() => setStatus('def')}
          loaderChildren={<Text>Добавление реквизитов...</Text>}
        />
      )}

      {isBottomOpened && (
        <RequisiteModal open={isBottomOpened} onClose={() => setIsBottomOpened(false)} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default ApprovePage;

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE_APPROVE } from 'const/routes';

import { useAddRequisitesMutation } from 'core/api/requisites';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import quizResultsErrorSrc from 'images/icons/quiz-results-error.png';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const RequisiteErrorPage = () => {
  const { bic, cardAccount, account, currencyCode, templateName, payee, personalAccount, swift } =
    useAppSelector((state) => state.requisite);

  const [
    addRequisite,
    {
      data: addRequisiteData,
      isLoading: isAddRequisiteLoading,
      error: addRequisiteError,
      isSuccess: isAddRequisiteSucces,
    },
  ] = useAddRequisitesMutation();

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const onSubmitRub = async () => {
    try {
      addRequisite({
        bic,
        cardAccount,
        checkingAccount: account,
        currencyCode,
        name: templateName,
        payee,
        personalAccount,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const onSubmitCurr = async () => {
    try {
      addRequisite({
        currencyCode,
        name: templateName,
        payee,
        benBankAccount: account,
        benBankSWIFT: swift,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const onClose = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  useErrorNotification(addRequisiteError);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAddRequisiteSucces) navigate(ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE_APPROVE, { state: addRequisiteData });
  }, [addRequisiteData, isAddRequisiteSucces, navigate]);

  if (isAddRequisiteLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.root}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="" leftIconVariant="close" onLeftIconClick={onClose} />

      <div className={styles.root}>
        <div className={cx(styles.main, styles.errorIconWrapper)}>
          <img alt="" src={quizResultsErrorSrc} />
        </div>

        <div className={styles.bottom}>
          <div className={styles.status}>Ошибка</div>
          <Text type="title" className={styles.wrongTitle}>
            Что-то пошло не так
          </Text>
          <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.errorText}>
            Не удалось сохранить введённые реквизиты. Повторите попытку позже.
          </Text>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            className={styles.button}
            // @ts-ignore
            onClick={currencyCode === 'RUB' ? onSubmitRub : onSubmitCurr}
          >
            Обновить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default RequisiteErrorPage;

import React, { FC, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import { ROUTE_REQUISITES } from 'const/routes';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

export type BottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
};

const BottomSheet: FC<BottomSheetProps> = ({ onClose, open }) => {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(open);

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleClose = () => {
    setOpened(false);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheetComponent open={opened} onDismiss={handleClose}>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <Text type="subtitleBold">Уверены, что хотите прервать добавление реквизитов?</Text>
        <Text className={styles.bottomText} type="labelMedium" color="colorForeground2">
          Введенные данные не сохранятся
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.bottomBtns}>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleClose}>
            Отмена
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_REQUISITES)}>
            Выйти
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheetComponent>
  );
};

export default BottomSheet;

import React, { ChangeEvent, FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Input from '@aurora/input';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { useGetBanksQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import {
  setAccount,
  setBankName,
  setBic,
  setCardAccount,
  setCorrespondAccount,
  setPayee,
  setPersonalAccount,
} from 'core/requisite/requisiteSlice';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import useReducerAsState from 'hooks/useReducerAsState';

import Autocomplete from 'components/Autocomplete';
import { BankItem } from 'components/Autocomplete/types';

import { ReactComponent as Arrow } from 'images/icons/arrow-right.svg';

import styles from './RubForm.module.pcss';
import { RubFormProps, State } from './types';

const initState = {
  bicDirty: false,
  accountDirty: false,
  bankNameDirty: false,
};

const RubForm: FC<RubFormProps> = ({
  classNameInput,
  classNameInputWrapper,
  templateName,
  currencyCode,
  onSubmit,
  tabWithEnter,
}) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const {
    bic,
    bankName,
    account,
    cardAccount,
    personalAccount,
    correspondAccount,
    paymentPurpose,
  } = useAppSelector((state) => state.requisite);

  const { state, setState } = useReducerAsState<State>(initState);
  const { bicDirty, accountDirty, bankNameDirty } = state;

  const banksInfoQuery = useGetBanksQuery({ Code: bic, Name: bankName });
  const personName = getSession()?.personName;
  const [showAddingInfo, setShowAddingInfo] = useState(false);
  const invisibleButton = bic.length !== 9 || !bankName || account.length !== 20 || !templateName;

  const onBlurHandler = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    switch (e.target.name) {
      case 'account':
        if (account.length === 20) {
          setState({ accountDirty: false });
        } else setState({ accountDirty: true });
        break;
      case 'bic':
        if (bic.length === 9) {
          setState({ bicDirty: false });
        } else setState({ bicDirty: true });
        break;
      case 'bankName':
        if (bic.length === 9) {
          setState({ bankNameDirty: false });
        } else setState({ bankNameDirty: true });
        break;
    }
  };

  const accountHandler = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    dispatch(setAccount(e.target.value));
    if (account.length === 20) setState({ accountDirty: false });
  };

  const validateHandler = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    dispatch(setBankName(e.target.value));

    if (bic.length === 9 && bankName) setState({ bicDirty: false });
  };

  const onSubmitHandler = (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e?.preventDefault();
    onSubmit({
      bic,
      cardAccount: cardAccount.replace(/\s/gi, ''),
      checkingAccount: account,
      currencyCode,
      name: templateName,
      payee: personName,
      personalAccount,
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(setPayee(personName));
  }, [dispatch, personName]);

  const onSelectHandler = (selectedBank: BankItem) => {
    const bank = banksInfoQuery.data?.banksRus?.find((bank) => bank.id === selectedBank.id);
    if (
      selectedBank.value === bankName &&
      selectedBank.description === bic &&
      bank?.corrAccount === correspondAccount
    )
      return;
    dispatch(setBic(selectedBank.description));
    dispatch(setBankName(selectedBank.value));
    dispatch(setCorrespondAccount(bank?.corrAccount ?? ''));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (account.length === 20) setState({ accountDirty: false });
    if (bic.length === 9) setState({ bicDirty: false });
  }, [account, bic, setState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (bic.length >= 3) {
      if (banksInfoQuery.isSuccess && banksInfoQuery.data?.banksRus.length < 1) {
        setState({ bicDirty: true });
      } else {
        setState({ bicDirty: false });
      }
    }
  }, [bic, banksInfoQuery, setState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (bankName.length >= 3) {
      if (banksInfoQuery.isSuccess && banksInfoQuery.data?.banksRus.length < 1) {
        setState({ bankNameDirty: true });
      } else {
        setState({ bankNameDirty: false });
      }
    }
  }, [bankName, banksInfoQuery, setState]);

  return (
    <>
      {personName && (
        <>
          <Autocomplete
            classNameInput={classNameInput}
            className={classNameInputWrapper}
            label="Наименование банка"
            placeholder="Например, ПАО «Сбербанк»"
            value={bankName}
            list={
              banksInfoQuery.isSuccess
                ? banksInfoQuery.data.banksRus.map((bank) => ({
                    id: bank.id,
                    value: bank.name,
                    description: bank.code,
                  }))
                : []
            }
            status={bankNameDirty ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={bankNameDirty ? 'Банк не найден' : ''}
            name="bankName"
            onBlur={(e) => onBlurHandler(e)}
            onChange={(e) => validateHandler(e)}
            onSelect={(selectedBank) => onSelectHandler(selectedBank)}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          />
          <Autocomplete
            name="bic"
            classNameInput={classNameInput}
            className={classNameInputWrapper}
            label="БИК"
            placeholder="000000000"
            value={bic}
            mask="999999999"
            status={bicDirty ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={bicDirty ? 'Банк не найден' : ''}
            list={
              banksInfoQuery.isSuccess
                ? banksInfoQuery.data.banksRus.map((bank) => ({
                    id: bank.id,
                    value: bank.name,
                    description: bank.code,
                  }))
                : []
            }
            onChange={(e) => {
              dispatch(setBic(e.target.value.replace(/\D/gi, '')));
            }}
            onSelect={(selectedBank) => onSelectHandler(selectedBank)}
            onBlur={(e) => onBlurHandler(e)}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          />

          <Input
            classNameInput={classNameInput}
            className={classNameInputWrapper}
            label="Расчётный счёт"
            mask="99999999999999999999"
            placeholder="00000000000000000000"
            value={account}
            onChange={(e) => accountHandler(e)}
            status={accountDirty ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={accountDirty ? 'Длина расчётного счета должна составлять 20 символов' : ''}
            name="account"
            onBlur={(e) => onBlurHandler(e)}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          />
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAddingInfo(!showAddingInfo)}
            className={cx(styles.moreInfoButton, { [styles.active]: showAddingInfo })}
          >
            Дополнительные поля
            <span className={styles.moreInfoButtonIcon}>
              <Arrow />
            </span>
          </button>
          {showAddingInfo && (
            <>
              <Input
                classNameInput={classNameInput}
                className={classNameInputWrapper}
                label="Номер карты (указывается при наличии)"
                mask="9999 9999 9999 9999 9999 9999 9"
                placeholder="0000 0000 0000 0000"
                value={cardAccount}
                onChange={(event) => dispatch(setCardAccount(event.target.value))}
                onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
              />
              <Input
                classNameInput={classNameInput}
                className={classNameInputWrapper}
                label="Лицевой/карточный счёт (указывается при наличии)"
                mask="99999999999999999999"
                placeholder="00000000000000000000"
                value={personalAccount}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  dispatch(setPersonalAccount(e.target.value.slice(0, 20).replace(/\D/gi, '')))
                }
                onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
              />
              <Input
                label="Назначение платежа"
                placeholder="Для зачисления на счёт"
                classNameInput={classNameInput}
                className={classNameInputWrapper}
                disabled
                value={
                  paymentPurpose === null && (personalAccount || cardAccount)
                    ? `Для зачисления${personalAccount ? ` на счёт ${personalAccount}` : ''}${
                        cardAccount ? ` на карту ${cardAccount}` : ''
                      }${` на имя ${personName}`}`
                    : paymentPurpose ?? ''
                }
                onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
              />
              <Input
                classNameInput={classNameInput}
                className={classNameInputWrapper}
                label="Получатель"
                value={personName}
                disabled
              />
              <Input
                classNameInput={classNameInput}
                className={classNameInputWrapper}
                label="Корреспондентский счёт"
                placeholder="00000000000000000"
                mask="99999999999999999"
                value={correspondAccount}
                disabled
                onChange={(e) => dispatch(setCorrespondAccount(e.target.value.replace(/\D/gi, '')))}
              />
            </>
          )}
          <div className={styles.divider}></div>
          <Button disabled={invisibleButton} className={styles.button} onClick={onSubmitHandler}>
            Сохранить
          </Button>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default RubForm;

    checkingAccount,

import React, { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import Input from '@aurora/input';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import { ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE_APPROVE } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetAllCurrenciesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { useLazyGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useAddRequisitesMutation } from 'core/api/requisites';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';
import { resetState, setCurrencyCode, setTemplateName } from 'core/requisite/requisiteSlice';
import { allDataSelector } from 'core/view360/view360Selectors';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { AddRequisitesCurrencyRequest, AddRequisitesRequest } from 'types/requisites';

import CurrencyForm from './components/CurrencyForm';
import CurrencyPicker from './components/CurrencyPicker';
import RubForm from './components/RubForm';
import styles from './newRequisitePage.module.pcss';

const NewRequisitePage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const { currencyCode, templateName } = useAppSelector((state) => state.requisite);
  const [trigger, { data: hintsResponse }] = useLazyGetHintsQuery();

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
    dispatch(resetState());
  };

  const { data: currenciesResponse, error: getCurrenciesError } = useGetAllCurrenciesQuery();
  const currenciesList = currenciesResponse?.currency.slice(0, 7);

  const [
    addRequisite,
    {
      data: addRequisiteData,
      isLoading: isAddRequisiteLoading,
      error: addRequisiteError,
      isSuccess: isAddRequisiteSucces,
    },
  ] = useAddRequisitesMutation();

  const onSubmitRub = async ({
    bic,
    cardAccount,
    checkingAccount,
    currencyCode,
    name,
    payee,
    personalAccount,
  }: AddRequisitesRequest) => {
    try {
      addRequisite({
        bic,
        cardAccount,
        checkingAccount,
        currencyCode,
        name,
        payee,
        personalAccount,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(e);
    }
  };

  const { positionValuationByCurrency = [] } = useAppSelector(allDataSelector);

  const onSubmitCurr = async ({
    name,
    payee,
    benBankSWIFT,
    benBankAccount,
    currencyCode,
  }: AddRequisitesCurrencyRequest) => {
    try {
      addRequisite({
        currencyCode,
        name: templateName,
        payee,
        benBankAccount,
        benBankSWIFT,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAddRequisiteSucces) navigate(ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE_APPROVE, { state: addRequisiteData });
  }, [addRequisiteData, isAddRequisiteSucces, navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hintsResponse) {
      trigger();
    }
  }, [hintsResponse, trigger]);

  const currenciesForDetails = useMemo(
    () =>
      JSON.parse(
        hintsResponse?.hints.find((item) => item.slug === 'CURRENCY_FOR_DETAILS')?.text || '[]',
      ),
    [hintsResponse?.hints],
  );

  useErrorNotification(addRequisiteError);
  useErrorNotification(getCurrenciesError);
  useErrorNotification(currenciesList ? currenciesList.length < 1 : false);

  const Loader = () => {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );
  };

  const positionValuationCurrencies = positionValuationByCurrency.map(
    (currency) => currency.currencyCode,
  );
  const currencyOptions = (currenciesResponse?.currency || []).filter(
    ({ code }, index) =>
      index === 0 || currenciesForDetails.concat(positionValuationCurrencies).includes(code),
  );

  return (
    <div className={styles.root}>
      <HeaderPage
        title={isAddRequisiteLoading ? 'Добавление реквизитов' : ''}
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
      />
      {isAddRequisiteLoading ? (
        <Loader />
      ) : (
        <>
          {!isAddRequisiteSucces && (
            <>
              <Text type="title">Добавление реквизитов</Text>
              <Text className={styles.attentionText} type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                Вывод на счета третьих лиц невозможен за исключением случаев, предусмотренных
                регламентом
              </Text>
              <Input
                classNameInput={styles.input}
                label="Название шаблона реквизитов"
                placeholder="Новые реквизиты"
                value={templateName}
                onChange={(e) => dispatch(setTemplateName(e.target.value))}
                onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
              />
              <div className={styles.divider}></div>
              {currenciesResponse && currenciesResponse.currency.length > 1 && (
                <CurrencyPicker
                  label="Валюта"
                  className={styles.inputWrapper}
                  options={currencyOptions}
                  onSelect={(code) => dispatch(setCurrencyCode(code))}
                />
              )}

              {currencyCode === 'RUB' ? (
                <RubForm
                  currencyCode={currencyCode}
                  templateName={templateName}
                  classNameInput={styles.input}
                  classNameInputWrapper={styles.inputWrapper}
                  onSubmit={(data) => onSubmitRub(data)}
                  tabWithEnter={(e) => tabWithEnter(e)}
                />
              ) : (
                <CurrencyForm
                  currencyCode={currencyCode}
                  templateName={templateName}
                  classNameInput={styles.input}
                  classNameInputWrapper={styles.inputWrapper}
                  onSubmit={(data) => onSubmitCurr(data)}
                  tabWithEnter={(e) => tabWithEnter(e)}
                />
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default NewRequisitePage;

import React from 'react';

import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS } from 'const/routes';

import { useMoveToLKAuthToken } from 'hooks/useMoveToLKAuthToken';

import NonTradable from 'components/NonTradable';

import {
  DEFAULT_TEXT,
  DEFAULT_TITLE,
  DYNAMIC_PARTIAL_TEXT_SLUG,
  DYNAMIC_PARTIAL_TITLE_SLUG,
} from './consts';
import { NonTradableInstrumentProps } from './types';

const NonTradableInstrument: React.FC<NonTradableInstrumentProps> = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
}) => {
  const { handleNavigateToLK } = useMoveToLKAuthToken();

  const onToLKButtonClick = () => {
    handleNavigateToLK(`${ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS}/${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`)();
  };

  return (
    <NonTradable
      title={DEFAULT_TITLE}
      titleSlug={DYNAMIC_PARTIAL_TITLE_SLUG}
      text={DEFAULT_TEXT}
      textSlug={DYNAMIC_PARTIAL_TEXT_SLUG}
      onToLKButtonClick={onToLKButtonClick}
    />
  );
};

export default NonTradableInstrument;

--- FILE: src\modules\NonTradableInstrument\utils.ts ---

import { getLkUrl } from 'core/helpers/lk';

import { nonTradableInstrumentFilters } from 'modules/NonTradableInstrument/consts';

import { Entries } from 'types/common';
import { Instrument } from 'types/instruments';

export const isNonTradableInstrument = (instrument: Instrument) => {
  for (const nonTradableInstrumentFilter of nonTradableInstrumentFilters) {
    let result = true;
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(nonTradableInstrumentFilter) as Entries<Instrument>) {
      result = result && instrument[key] === value;
    }
    if (result) {
      return result;
    }
  }
  return false;
};

export const getUKInstrumentLkLink = (instrumentId?: string | number) => {
  if (!instrumentId) return;
  return getLkUrl(`/view360/instruments-uk/${instrumentId}`);
};

import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS } from 'const/routes';

import { getLkUrl } from 'core/helpers/lk';

import {
  IS_NON_TRADABLE_INSTRUMENT_CASES,
  NON_TRADABLE_INSTRUMENTS_MOCK,
} from 'modules/NonTradableInstrument/__tests__/fixtures';
import {
  getInstrumentalLkLink,
  getUKInstrumentLkLink,
  isNonTradableInstrument,
} from 'modules/NonTradableInstrument/utils';

jest.mock('core/helpers/lk', () => ({
  ...jest.requireActual('core/helpers/lk'),
  getLkUrl: jest.fn(),
}));

describe('isNonTradableInstrument', () => {
  describe.each(IS_NON_TRADABLE_INSTRUMENT_CASES)(
    'returns true when the instrument matches a non-tradable instrument filter: %p',
    (instruments, toBe) => {
      it.each(instruments)('', (instrument) => {
        const result = isNonTradableInstrument(instrument);
        expect(result).toBe(toBe);
      });
    },
  );
});

describe('getInstrumentalLkLink', () => {
  it.each(NON_TRADABLE_INSTRUMENTS_MOCK)(
    'calls getLkUrl with the correct path: %p',
    (instrument) => {
      getInstrumentalLkLink(instrument.instrumentId, instrument.tradePlaceId);
      expect(getLkUrl).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        `${ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS}/${instrument.instrumentId}_${instrument.tradePlaceId}`,
      );
    },
  );
});

describe('getUKInstrumentLkLink', () => {
  const instrumentId = 1;
  it('returns undefined when instrumentId is not provided', () => {
    const result = getUKInstrumentLkLink();
    expect(result).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('calls getLkUrl with the correct path', () => {
    getUKInstrumentLkLink(instrumentId);
    expect(getLkUrl).toHaveBeenCalledWith(`/view360/instruments-uk/${instrumentId}`);
  });
});

import { FC, memo } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENT } from 'const/routes';

import { getNoun } from 'utils/string';

import { palette } from 'vars';

import { InstrumentWithLastNoteProps } from 'modules/Notes/types';

import { InstrumentCardWithButton } from 'components/Instrument';
import { Note } from 'components/Notes';

import { ReactComponent as PlusSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/plus.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SmallArrowRightSvg } from 'images/icons/small-arrow-right.svg';

import styles from './InstrumentWithLastNote.module.pcss';

const InstrumentWithLastNote: FC<InstrumentWithLastNoteProps> = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  instrumentName,
  instrumentCode,
  tradePlaceCode,
  instrumentImageName,
  count,
  noteId,
  text,
  changeTime,
  onNotesClick,
  onPlusClick,
  onNoteClick,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const isMoreThanOneNote = count > 1;

  const handleNavigateToInstrumentPage = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENT, { instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}` }));
  };

  const handleNotesClick = () => {
    onNotesClick({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentName,
      instrumentCode,
      instrumentImageName,
      tradePlaceCode,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.headerWrapper}>
        <InstrumentCardWithButton
          instrumentName={instrumentName}
          instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
          tradePlaceCode={tradePlaceCode}
          className={styles.instrumentCard}
          onClick={handleNavigateToInstrumentPage}
        />

        {isMoreThanOneNote ? (
          <div className={styles.notesWrapper} onClick={handleNotesClick}>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.notes}>
              {count} {getNoun(count, 'заметка', 'заметки', 'заметок')}
            </Text>

            <SmallArrowRightSvg
              color={palette.colorForeground3}
              className={styles.smallArrowRightIconWrapper}
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <PlusSvg
            color={palette.colorForeground3}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onPlusClick({
                instrumentId,
                tradePlaceId,
                instrumentName,
                instrumentCode,
                instrumentImageName,
                tradePlaceCode,
              });
            }}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      <Note
        noteId={noteId}
        text={text}
        changeTime={changeTime}
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        className={styles.note}
        onClick={onNoteClick}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentWithLastNote);

import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_360 } from 'const/routes';

import { useLazyGetPersonsCurrentNotesQuery } from 'core/api/notes';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import InstrumentWithLastNote from 'modules/Notes/components/InstrumentWithLastNote';
import NoteSkeleton from 'modules/Notes/components/NoteSkeleton';
import ErrorOrEmpty from 'modules/Notes/pages/ErrorOrEmpty';
import Skeleton from 'modules/Notes/pages/Skeleton';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import { CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet, InstrumentNotesBottomSheet } from 'components/Notes';
import { NOTE_CHANGED } from 'components/Notes/constants';
import {
  NoteType,
  OpenedCreateOrEditNoteDataType,
  PartialInstrument,
} from 'components/Notes/types';

import { InstrumentWithLastNote as InstrumentWithLastNoteType } from 'types/notes';

import styles from './InstrumentsWithLastNote.module.pcss';
import { ROWS_COUNT, ROWS_OFFSET } from './constants';

const InstrumentsWithLastNote = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [getPersonsCurrentNotes, { isError, isFetching }] = useLazyGetPersonsCurrentNotesQuery();

  const [parentElement, setParentElement] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [isStoppedPagination, setStoppedPagination] = useState(false);
  const [rowsOffset, setRowsOffset] = useState(ROWS_OFFSET);
  const [instrumentsWithLastNote, setInstrumentsWithLastNote] = useState<
    InstrumentWithLastNoteType[] | null
  >(null);
  const [openedInstrumentNotesData, setOpenedInstrumentNotesData] =
    useState<PartialInstrument | null>(null);
  const [openedCreateOrEditNoteData, setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData] =
    useState<OpenedCreateOrEditNoteDataType | null>(null);

  const header = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      <HeaderPage
        size="small"
        leftIconVariant="back"
        title="Заметки"
        onLeftIconClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_360)}
      />
    );
  }, [navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = () => {
      getPersonsCurrentNotes({ rowsOffset: ROWS_OFFSET, rowsCount: rowsOffset + ROWS_COUNT })
        .unwrap()
        .then((data) => {
          setInstrumentsWithLastNote(data.notes);
        })
        .catch((error) => console.error(error));
    };

    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe(NOTE_CHANGED, listener);

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [rowsOffset, getPersonsCurrentNotes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    getPersonsCurrentNotes({ rowsOffset: rowsOffset, rowsCount: ROWS_COUNT })
      .unwrap()
      .then((data) => {
        const { notes } = data;

        if (notes.length < ROWS_COUNT) {
          setStoppedPagination(true);
        }

        setInstrumentsWithLastNote((prev) => {
          if (!notes.length) {
            return prev || notes;
          }

          if (prev) {
            return [...prev, ...notes];
          }

          return notes;
        });
      })
      .catch((error) => console.error(error));
  }, [rowsOffset, getPersonsCurrentNotes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      if (
        !isStoppedPagination &&
        parentElement &&
        parentElement.scrollHeight - Math.ceil(parentElement.scrollTop) ===
          parentElement.clientHeight
      ) {
        setRowsOffset((prev) => prev + ROWS_COUNT);
      }
    };

    if (parentElement) {
      parentElement.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
    }

    return () => {
      if (parentElement) {
        parentElement.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
      }
    };
  }, [isStoppedPagination, parentElement]);

  const setContainerRef = useCallback((node: HTMLDivElement) => {
    if (node) {
      setParentElement(node.parentElement);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleInstrumentWithLastNoteClick = useCallback(
    ({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentName,
      instrumentCode,
      tradePlaceCode,
      instrumentImageName,
    }: PartialInstrument) => {
      setOpenedInstrumentNotesData({
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
        instrumentName,
        instrumentCode,
        tradePlaceCode,
        instrumentImageName,
      });
    },
    [],
  );

  const handlePlusClick = useCallback(
    ({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentName,
      instrumentCode,
      tradePlaceCode,
      instrumentImageName,
    }: PartialInstrument) => {
      setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData({
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
        futureInstrumentInfo: {
          instrumentName,
          instrumentCode,
          instrumentImageName,
          tradePlaceCode,
        },
      });
    },
    [],
  );

  const handleNoteClick = useCallback(
    ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, noteId, text, changeTime }: NoteType) => {
      setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId, noteId, text, changeTime });
    },
    [],
  );

  const handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss = useCallback(
    () => setOpenedInstrumentNotesData(null),
    [],
  );

  const handleCreateNote = useCallback(
    ({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentName,
      instrumentCode,
      tradePlaceCode,
      instrumentImageName,
    }: PartialInstrument) => {
      setOpenedInstrumentNotesData({
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
        instrumentName,
        instrumentCode,
        tradePlaceCode,
        instrumentImageName,
      });
    },
    [],
  );

  const handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss = useCallback(
    () => setOpenedCreateOrEditNoteData(null),
    [],
  );

  if (isError) {
    return <ErrorOrEmpty isError header={header} />;
  }

  if (!instrumentsWithLastNote) {
    return <Skeleton header={header} />;
  }

  if (!instrumentsWithLastNote.length) {
    return <ErrorOrEmpty isError={false} header={header} />;
  }

  return (
    <div ref={setContainerRef} className={styles.container}>
      {header}

      {instrumentsWithLastNote.map(
        ({
          noteId,
          instrumentId,
          tradePlaceId,
          instrumentName,
          instrumentCode,
          tradePlaceCode,
          instrumentImageName,
          count,
          text,
          changeTime,
        }) => (
          <InstrumentWithLastNote
            key={noteId}
            instrumentId={instrumentId}
            tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
            instrumentName={instrumentName}
            instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
            tradePlaceCode={tradePlaceCode}
            instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
            count={count}
            noteId={noteId}
            text={text}
            changeTime={changeTime}
            onNotesClick={handleInstrumentWithLastNoteClick}
            onPlusClick={handlePlusClick}
            onNoteClick={handleNoteClick}
          />
        ),
      )}

      {isFetching && <NoteSkeleton />}

      <InstrumentNotesBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedInstrumentNotesData}
        instrumentId={openedInstrumentNotesData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedInstrumentNotesData?.tradePlaceId}
        instrumentName={openedInstrumentNotesData?.instrumentName}
        instrumentCode={openedInstrumentNotesData?.instrumentCode}
        tradePlaceCode={openedInstrumentNotesData?.tradePlaceCode}
        instrumentImageName={openedInstrumentNotesData?.instrumentImageName}
        onDismiss={handleInstrumentNotesBottomSheetDismiss}
      />

      <CreateOrEditNoteBottomSheet
        isOpen={!!openedCreateOrEditNoteData}
        instrumentId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.tradePlaceId}
        noteId={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.noteId}
        text={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.text}
        changeTime={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.changeTime}
        futureInstrumentInfo={openedCreateOrEditNoteData?.futureInstrumentInfo}
        onCreate={handleCreateNote}
        onDismiss={handleCreateOrEditNoteBottomSheetDismiss}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentsWithLastNote);

import { useState } from 'react';

import Placeholder from '@aurora/placeholder';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetNotificationsPriceQuery } from 'core/api/notification';

import Skeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Skeleton';
import { defaultAboutPriceFilter, stubScreenAboutPrice } from 'modules/Notification/constants';

import { InstrumentCard } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as BlockedSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/servise-17.svg';

import { INotificationFilters } from 'types/notification';

import CommonNotification from '../CommonNotification';
import styles from './AboutPrice.module.pcss';

const AboutPrice = () => {
  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useState<INotificationFilters>(defaultAboutPriceFilter);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { data, isFetching, isError, refetch } = useGetNotificationsPriceQuery(allFilters);

  if (!isFetching && isError) {
    return (
      <>
        <Placeholder
          onActionButtonClick={() => refetch()}
          actionButtonText={'Повторить попытку'}
          badgeText={'Ошибка'}
          title={'Что-то пошло не так'}
          text={'Попробуйте ещё раз или вернитесь позднее, чтобы повторить попытку'}
          variant={'error'}
          img={<BlockedSvg width={100} height={100} />}
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  if (!data) return <Skeleton />;

  return (
    <div
      className={
        data?.subscriptionPriceThreshold.length
          ? cn({ [styles.desktopWrapper]: !isMobile })
          : styles.nonotifications
      }
    >
      <CommonNotification
        allFilters={allFilters}
        data={data?.subscriptionPriceThreshold}
        setAllFilters={setAllFilters}
        stubScreen={stubScreenAboutPrice}
        timeFieldSort={'sendTime'}
        isFetching={isFetching}
      >
        <InstrumentCard
          classNameWrapper={cn(styles.notificationWrapper, { [styles.desktopWrapper]: !isMobile })}
          className={cn(styles.shadowLink, {
            [styles.desktopNotification]: !isMobile,
          })}
          {...data?.subscriptionPriceThreshold[0]}
        />
      </CommonNotification>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AboutPrice;

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { useLazyGetFullMessageQuery, useReadMessageMutation } from 'core/api/notification';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import useUuid from 'hooks/useUuid';
import useViewOnScreen from 'hooks/useViewOnScreen';

import {
  DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_ROWS_COUNT,
  sectionUnavailable,
} from 'modules/Notification/constants';
import { dayFormatter, transformMessage } from 'modules/Notification/helpers';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as NoNotificationSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/servise-17.svg';

import { CommonNotificationProps, NotificationData } from 'types/notification';

import NoNotification from '../NoNotification';
import NotificationFromDiscoveryCard from '../NotificationFromDiscoveryCard';
import styles from './CommonNotification.module.pcss';

const CommonNotification = ({
  allFilters,
  data,
  setAllFilters,
  stubScreen,
  timeFieldSort,
  isFetching,
  children,
}: React.PropsWithChildren<CommonNotificationProps>) => {
  const notificationPermission = Permissions.get('PERSON_MESSAGES');
  const isNotificationPermissionDenied = notificationPermission === 'DENIED';
  const isNotificationPermissionBlocked = notificationPermission === 'BLOCKED';
  const isDeniedOrBlocked = isNotificationPermissionDenied || isNotificationPermissionBlocked;
  const [accumFetchData, setAccumFetchData] = useState(data);
  const [isOpenBs, setIsOpenBs] = useState(false);

  const observerRef = useRef(null);
  const isOnViewScreen = useViewOnScreen(observerRef, {
    threshold: 1,
  });
  const uuid = useUuid();

  const aboutPriceData = !!data[0]?.instrumentId;
  const brokerData = !!data[0]?.messageId;

  const [getFullMessage, { data: fullMessage, isFetching: isFetchingFullMessage }] =
    useLazyGetFullMessageQuery();
  const [readMessage] = useReadMessageMutation();

  const dateFullMessage = fullMessage && dayFormatter(fullMessage.message[0].receiveTime);
  const titleFullMessage = fullMessage?.message[0].title;

  const createMarkUp = () => {
    return fullMessage && { __html: fullMessage.message[0].body };
  };
  const bodyFullMessage = <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={createMarkUp()} />;

  const onDismiss = () => {
    setIsOpenBs(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!allFilters.offset || allFilters.offset === 1) {
      setAccumFetchData(data);
    } else if (data) {
      setAccumFetchData([...accumFetchData, ...data.slice(1)]);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [data]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOnViewScreen && data?.length === DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_ROWS_COUNT) {
      setAllFilters({ ...allFilters, offset: allFilters.offset + 20 });
    }
    if (isOnViewScreen) {
      setAllFilters({ ...allFilters, count: allFilters.count + 20 });
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isOnViewScreen]);

  if (isDeniedOrBlocked) {
    return (
      <NoNotification
        title={sectionUnavailable.title}
        text={sectionUnavailable.text}
        ImageNotification={NoNotificationSvg}
      />
    );
  }
  if (!data || !data?.length) {
    return (
      <NoNotification
        title={stubScreen.title}
        text={stubScreen.text}
        ImageNotification={NoNotificationSvg}
      />
    );
  }
  const reduceByField = transformMessage(accumFetchData, timeFieldSort as keyof NotificationData);

  return (
    <>
      {brokerData &&
        Object.entries(reduceByField).map((item, index, self) => {
          return (
            <>
              <div key={uuid}>
                <Text type="labelRegular" color={'colorForeground'} className={styles.date}>
                  {item[0]}
                </Text>
              </div>
              {item[1].map((item) => {
                return (
                  <div
                    key={item.receiveTime}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setIsOpenBs(true);
                      getFullMessage(`${item.messageId}`);
                      item.unread && readMessage(`${item.messageId}`);
                    }}
                    className={cn(styles.messageCard)}
                  >
                    <NotificationFromDiscoveryCard
                      title={item.title}
                      receiveTime={item.receiveTime}
                      importance={item.importance}
                      classNameWrapper={cn(styles.messageCardWrapper, {
                        [styles.messageRead]: !item.unread,
                      })}
                    />
                  </div>
                );
              })}
              {index === self.length - 1 && <div ref={observerRef} />}
            </>
          );
        })}
      {isFetchingFullMessage ? (
        <AdaptivePopup open={isFetchingFullMessage}>
          <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
            <CircleLoader brandColor type={'page'} />
          </div>
        </AdaptivePopup>
      ) : (
        <AdaptivePopup
          open={isOpenBs}
          onDismiss={onDismiss}
          bottomSheetProps={{ snapPoints: ({ maxHeight }) => [maxHeight - 40, maxHeight] }}
        >
          <div className={styles.messageWrap}>
            <Text type={'labelSemiBold'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
              {dateFullMessage}
            </Text>
            <div className={styles.messageDescription}>
              <Text type={'title'}>{titleFullMessage}</Text>
              <Text tag="span" type={'bodyRegular'}>
                {bodyFullMessage}
              </Text>
            </div>
          </div>
        </AdaptivePopup>
      )}

      {aboutPriceData &&
        Object.entries(reduceByField).map((item, index, self) => {
          return (
            <>
              <div key={index}>
                <Text type="labelRegular" color={'colorForeground'} className={styles.date}>
                  {item[0]}
                </Text>
              </div>

              {item[1].map((item) => {
                return (
                  <div key={item.receiveTime}>
                    {React.cloneElement(children, {
                      ...item,
                      tradePlaceShortName: item.tradePlaceCode,
                    })}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
              {index === self.length - 1 && <div ref={observerRef} />}
            </>
          );
        })}

      {isFetching && (
        <div className={styles.spinner}>
          <CircleLoader brandColor />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default CommonNotification;

import { FC } from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { NoNotificationProps } from 'types/notification';

import styles from './NoNotification.module.pcss';

const NoNotification: FC<NoNotificationProps> = ({ title, text, ImageNotification }) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  return (
    <div className={cn(styles.container, { [styles.desktopContainer]: !isMobile })}>
      <ImageNotification />
      <Text type={'subtitleBold'} className={styles.title}>
        {title}
      </Text>
