import { FC, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Filter, FilterBar, Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetNotificationsFromDiscoveryQuery } from 'core/api/notification';

import Skeleton from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/Skeleton';
import {
  defaultFromDiscoveryFilter,
  stubScreenFromDiscovery,
} from 'modules/Notification/constants';

import { ReactComponent as BlockedSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/servise-17.svg';

import { INotificationFilters } from 'types/notification';

import CommonNotification from '../CommonNotification';
import NoNotification from '../NoNotification';
import NotificationFromDiscoveryCard from '../NotificationFromDiscoveryCard';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const Notification: FC = () => {
  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useState<INotificationFilters>(defaultFromDiscoveryFilter);
  const [currentFilter, setCurrentFilter] = useState('all');

  const { data, isFetching, isError, refetch } = useGetNotificationsFromDiscoveryQuery(allFilters, {
    refetchOnMountOrArgChange: true,
  });

  const handleFilter = useCallback((filterParam) => {
    setCurrentFilter(filterParam);
  }, []);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentFilter === 'important') {
      setAllFilters({ ...defaultFromDiscoveryFilter, importance: 'HIGH' });
    } else {
      setAllFilters(defaultFromDiscoveryFilter);
    }
  }, [currentFilter]);

  if (!isFetching && isError) {
    return (
      <>
        <Placeholder
          onActionButtonClick={() => refetch()}
          actionButtonText={'Повторить попытку'}
          badgeText={'Ошибка'}
          title={'Что-то пошло не так'}
          text={'Попробуйте ещё раз или вернитесь позднее, чтобы повторить попытку'}
          variant={'error'}
          img={<BlockedSvg width={100} height={100} />}
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  if (!data) return <Skeleton withFilter={false} />;

  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) {
    return (
      <NoNotification
        title={stubScreenFromDiscovery.title}
        text={stubScreenFromDiscovery.text}
        ImageNotification={BlockedSvg}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <FilterBar>
        {data.messageList.length && (
          <Filter
            shape={'toggle'}
            mode="whitebg"
            text={'Все'}
            onClick={() => handleFilter('all')}
            active={currentFilter === 'all'}
          />
        )}
        {data.messageList.length && (
          <Filter
            shape={'toggle'}
            text={'Важные'}
            onClick={() => handleFilter('important')}
            active={currentFilter === 'important'}
          />
        )}
      </FilterBar>
      {
        <div
          className={
            data.messageList.length
              ? cn(styles.root, { [styles.desktopWrapper]: !isMobile })
              : styles.nonotifications
          }
        >
          <CommonNotification
            allFilters={allFilters}
            data={data?.messageList}
            setAllFilters={setAllFilters}
            stubScreen={stubScreenFromDiscovery}
            timeFieldSort={'receiveTime'}
            isFetching={isFetching}
          >
            <NotificationFromDiscoveryCard />
          </CommonNotification>
        </div>
      }
    </>
  );
};

export default Notification;

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { NotificationData } from 'types/notification';

export const isToday = (date: string) => {
  return DateTime.fromISO(date).toISODate() === DateTime.local().toISODate();
};

export const dayFormatter = (date: string) => {
  const formattedDate = DateTime.fromISO(date).setLocale('ru').toFormat('dd MMMM yyyy');

  if (isToday(date)) {
    return `Сегодня, ${formattedDate}`;
  }
  return formattedDate;
};

export const transformMessage = (data: NotificationData[], field: keyof NotificationData) => {
  return data.reduce((acc: { [key: string]: NotificationData[] }, item) => {
    if (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null) {
      const key = item[field];
      if (typeof key === 'string') {
        const currentDate = dayFormatter(key);

        if (acc[currentDate]) {
          acc[currentDate].push(item);
        } else {
          acc[currentDate] = [];
          acc[currentDate].push(item);
        }
      }
    }
    return acc;
  }, {});
};

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Map, Placemark, YMaps } from 'react-yandex-maps';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { officesSelector } from 'core/offices/officesSelectors';
import {
  setIsNeededUpdateOffice,
  setIsNeededUpdatePosition,
  setOfficeId,
  setPosition,
} from 'core/offices/officesSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { OfficesProps } from 'types/offices';

import styles from './MapOffices.module.pcss';

const MapOffices = () => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const {
    officeId,
    position,
    yourPosition,
    offices,
    isNeededUpdatePosition,
    filteredOffices,
    homeOffice,
    isNeededUpdateOffice,
  } = useAppSelector(officesSelector);

  const handleClick = (officeId: number, office: OfficesProps) => {
    dispatch(setOfficeId(officeId));
    dispatch(setIsNeededUpdatePosition(true));
    dispatch(setPosition({ latitude: office.latitude, longitude: office.longitude }));
    dispatch(setIsNeededUpdateOffice(false));
  };

  const handleMoveMap = () => {
    dispatch(setIsNeededUpdateOffice(false));
    dispatch(setIsNeededUpdatePosition(false));
  };

  const getIconHref = (typeCode: string) => {
    const name = (() => {
      switch (typeCode) {
        case 'Banks':
          return 'green';
        case 'Partners':
          return 'black';
        // OpenBroker
        default:
          return 'blue';
      }
    })();
    return `/images/geotag-${name}-without.svg`;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const chosenOffice = offices.offices?.filter((item) => item.officeId === officeId)[0];

    if (homeOffice && isNeededUpdateOffice) {
      dispatch(setPosition({ latitude: homeOffice.latitude, longitude: homeOffice.longitude }));
      dispatch(setOfficeId(homeOffice.officeId));
    }
    if (chosenOffice && !isNeededUpdateOffice) {
      const { latitude, longitude } = chosenOffice;
      dispatch(setIsNeededUpdateOffice(false));
      dispatch(setOfficeId(chosenOffice.officeId));
      isNeededUpdatePosition && dispatch(setPosition({ latitude, longitude }));
    }
  }, [dispatch, isNeededUpdateOffice, homeOffice, isNeededUpdatePosition, officeId, offices]);

  const yourPositionPlaceMark = yourPosition && (
    <Placemark
      geometry={[yourPosition.latitude, yourPosition.longitude]}
      options={{
        iconImageSize: [20, 25],
        iconLayout: 'default#image',
      }}
    />
  );

  const officesPlaceMark = filteredOffices?.map((office) => (
    <Placemark
      key={office.officeId}
      geometry={[office.latitude, office.longitude]}
      options={{
        iconImageSize: [20, 25],
        iconLayout: 'default#image',
        iconImageHref: getIconHref(office.typeCode),
      }}
      onClick={() => handleClick(office.officeId, office)}
    />
  ));

  const neededMapState = !isNeededUpdatePosition ? (
    <Map
      defaultState={{
        zoom: 13,
        center: [position.latitude, position.longitude],
        controls: ['zoomControl', 'fullscreenControl'],
      }}
      height="100%"
      width="100%"
    >
      {yourPositionPlaceMark}
      {officesPlaceMark}
    </Map>
  ) : (
    <Map
      state={{
        zoom: 13,
        center: [position.latitude, position.longitude],
        controls: ['zoomControl', 'fullscreenControl'],
      }}
      onBoundsChange={handleMoveMap}
      height="100%"
      width="100%"
    >
      {yourPositionPlaceMark}
      {officesPlaceMark}
    </Map>
  );

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrap : styles.wrapAdaptive}>
      <YMaps query={{ load: 'package.full' }}>{neededMapState}</YMaps>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MapOffices;

import { FC } from 'react';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { officesList, operationList } from 'modules/Offices/consts';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as Check } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import { OperationsBottomSheetProps } from 'types/offices';

import styles from './OperationsBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const OperationsBottomSheet: FC<OperationsBottomSheetProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  activeOperations,
  setActiveOperations,
  onDismiss,
  setOfficesType,
  officesTypes,
  officesTypeState,
  operationsState,
}) => {
  const menuItemChange = (option: string, mode: string) => {
    const setState = mode === 'offices' ? setOfficesType : setActiveOperations;
    setState((state: string[]) => {
      if (state.includes(option)) {
        const operations = state.filter((el) => el !== option);
        return operations.length === 0 ? state : operations;
      }
      return [...state, option];
    });
  };

  const resetMenu = () => {
    setOfficesType(officesTypeState.map((offices) => offices.description));
    setActiveOperations(operationsState.map((operation) => operation.description));
  };

  return (
    <AdaptivePopup open={isOpen} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.wrap}>
        <div className={styles.headerWrap}>
          <Text type={'title'}>Фильтр</Text>
          <Button variant={'negative'} onClick={resetMenu} className={styles.btn}>
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} tag={'span'}>
              Сбросить
            </Text>
          </Button>
        </div>

        <Text type={'bodyMedium'} className={styles.subtitle}>
          Тип офиса
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.list}>
          {officesList.map(({ id, title, icon, description }) => (
            <div
              key={id}
              onClick={() => menuItemChange(description, 'offices')}
              className={styles.officesListItem}
            >
              {icon}
              {title}
              {officesTypes.includes(description) && <Check />}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.divider} />

        <Text type={'bodyMedium'} className={styles.subtitle}>
          Услуги
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.list}>
          {operationList.map(({ id, title, description }) => (
            <div
              key={id}
              onClick={() => menuItemChange(description, 'operations')}
              className={styles.operationListItem}
            >
              {title}
              {activeOperations.includes(description) && <Check />}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopup>
  );
};

export default OperationsBottomSheet;

import { FC, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ActionCell, BottomSheet, SmartLink, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_OFFICES_MAP } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetNearOfficeQuery } from 'core/api/offices';
import { officesSelector } from 'core/offices/officesSelectors';
import { setOfficeId } from 'core/offices/officesSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import GeoTagIcon from 'modules/Offices/components/GeoTagIcon';
import { HEAD_OFFICE } from 'modules/Offices/consts';
import { telFormatter, workTimeFormatter } from 'modules/Offices/helpers';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { OfficeBottomSheetProps, OfficesWorkdaysProps } from 'types/offices';

const YourOfficeBottomSheet: FC<OfficeBottomSheetProps> = ({ isOpen, onDismiss }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const isMapStyle = pathname.includes('map');
  const twoBarBlocks = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const firstBarBlock = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const { officeId, yourPosition, isNeededUpdatePosition, offices, homeOffice } =
    useAppSelector(officesSelector);

  const { data: nearOffice } = useGetNearOfficeQuery({
    latitude: yourPosition.latitude,
    longitude: yourPosition.longitude,
    distance: 100,
  });

  const [bottomHeight, setBottomHeight] = useState(1);
  const [totalHeight, setTotalHeight] = useState(1);
  const [displayedOffice, setDisplayedOffice] = useState(HEAD_OFFICE);
  const [displayedTel, setDisplayedTel] = useState('');
  const [displayedWorkDays, setDisplayedWorkDays] = useState<OfficesWorkdaysProps>();
  const [isNeededUpdateOffice, setIsNeededUpdateOffice] = useState(true);

  const chosenOffice = offices?.offices?.find((item) => item.officeId === officeId);
  const firstOfficesTel = offices?.officesPhones?.find(
    (item) => item?.officeId === displayedOffice?.officeId,
  );
  const firstOfficesWorkDays = offices?.officesWorkdays?.find(
    (item) => item?.officeId === displayedOffice?.officeId,
  );

  const replaceNumber = (number: string) => number.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    const totalHeight = twoBarBlocks.current?.clientHeight || 372;
    const bottom = firstBarBlock.current?.clientHeight || 1;
    setTotalHeight(totalHeight);
    setBottomHeight(bottom);
  });

  const handleClick = () => {
    if (!isMapStyle) {
      onDismiss();
      navigate(ROUTE_OFFICES_MAP);
    }
    dispatch(setOfficeId(officeId));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    !Object.values(yourPosition).includes(0) && nearOffice && setDisplayedOffice(nearOffice);
  }, [nearOffice, yourPosition]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (homeOffice && isNeededUpdateOffice) {
      setDisplayedOffice(homeOffice);
      setIsNeededUpdateOffice(false);
    }
    if (chosenOffice && isNeededUpdatePosition) {
      setDisplayedOffice(chosenOffice);
    }
  }, [chosenOffice, homeOffice, isNeededUpdateOffice, isNeededUpdatePosition]);

  useEffect(() => {
    firstOfficesTel && setDisplayedTel(firstOfficesTel.number);
    firstOfficesWorkDays && setDisplayedWorkDays(firstOfficesWorkDays);
  }, [firstOfficesTel, firstOfficesWorkDays]);

  const mainContent = (
    <div ref={twoBarBlocks} id="twoBarBlocks">
      <div ref={firstBarBlock} id="firstBarBlock" onClick={handleClick}>
        <ActionCell
          label={'Офис обслуживания'}
          title={
            <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} tag={'span'}>
              {displayedOffice?.name}
            </Text>
          }
          addonRight={!isMobile && chosenOffice && <GeoTagIcon typeCode={chosenOffice.typeCode} />}
          arrowRight={false}
          hover={false}
        />
      </div>
      <div id="secondBarBlock">
        <ActionCell
          label={'Адрес'}
          title={
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} tag={'span'}>
              {displayedOffice?.address}
            </Text>
          }
          hover={false}
        />
        {displayedTel && (
          <ActionCell
            label={'Телефон'}
            title={
              <SmartLink link={`tel:+7${replaceNumber(displayedTel)}`}>
                {telFormatter(displayedTel)}
              </SmartLink>
            }
            hover={false}
          />
        )}
        <ActionCell
          label={'Часы работы'}
          title={
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} tag={'span'}>
              пн — пт:{' '}
              {displayedWorkDays
                ? workTimeFormatter(displayedWorkDays?.startTime) +
                  ' - ' +
                  workTimeFormatter(displayedWorkDays?.endTime)
                : 'выходной'}
              <br />
              сб, вс: выходной
            </Text>
          }
          hover={false}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile && (
        <BottomSheet
          open={isMapStyle || isOpen}
          blocking={!isMapStyle}
          onDismiss={!isMapStyle ? onDismiss : undefined}
          maxHeight={totalHeight + 12}
          defaultSnap={({ maxHeight, snapPoints }) => (isMapStyle ? snapPoints[0] : maxHeight)}
          snapPoints={({ maxHeight }) =>
            isMapStyle ? [bottomHeight + 12, maxHeight] : [maxHeight]
          }
        >
          {mainContent}
        </BottomSheet>
      )}

      {!isMobile && !isMapStyle && (
        <AdaptivePopup open={isOpen} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
          {mainContent}
        </AdaptivePopup>
      )}

      {!isMobile && isMapStyle && <>{mainContent}</>}
    </>
  );
};

export default YourOfficeBottomSheet;

import { FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_CONTACTS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useGetCitiesQuery,
  useGetHomeOfficeQuery,
  useGetOfficeWithParamsQuery,
} from 'core/api/offices';
import { officesSelector } from 'core/offices/officesSelectors';
import {
  setBottomSheetState,
  setChosenCity,
  setHomeOffices,
  setIsFilteredOffices,
  setOffices,
  setPosition,
  setTitleCity,
  setYourPosition,
} from 'core/offices/officesSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import CitiesBottomSheet from 'modules/Offices/components/CitiesBototmSheet';
import OperationsBottomSheet from 'modules/Offices/components/OperationsBottomSheet';
import YourOfficeBottomSheet from 'modules/Offices/components/YourOfficeBottomSheet';
import { officesList, operationList, tabs } from 'modules/Offices/consts';

import { HeaderPage, SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SettingsSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/glyph-settings.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ArrowSmallDownSvg } from 'images/icons/small-arrow-down.svg';

import styles from './Offices.module.pcss';

const Offices: FC = ({ children }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const { bottomSheetState, titleCity } = useAppSelector(officesSelector);

  const { data: cities } = useGetCitiesQuery();
  const { data: homeOffice, isLoading: isHomeOfficeLoading } = useGetHomeOfficeQuery();

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isNeededFetch, setIsNeededFetch] = useState(true);
  const [activeOperations, setActiveOperations] = useState(
    operationList.map((operation) => operation.id),
  );
  const [officesTypes, setOfficesType] = useState(officesList.map((office) => office.id));

  const chosenOperations = activeOperations?.toString().replaceAll(',', '%2C');
  const { data: offices } = useGetOfficeWithParamsQuery({
    operations: chosenOperations,
  });

  const titleCitiesList = cities?.officesCities;

  const handleBackClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_CONTACTS);

  const onDismiss = () => dispatch(setBottomSheetState(null));

  const handleTitleClick = () => {
    dispatch(setBottomSheetState('cities'));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const filteredOffices = offices?.offices.filter((item) => officesTypes.includes(item.typeCode));
    offices && dispatch(setOffices(offices));
    filteredOffices && dispatch(setIsFilteredOffices(filteredOffices));
  }, [dispatch, offices, officesTypes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const chosenCity = offices?.offices.filter((item) => item.city === titleCity);
    const filteredChosenCity = chosenCity?.filter((item) => officesTypes.includes(item.typeCode));
    filteredChosenCity && dispatch(setChosenCity(filteredChosenCity));
  }, [dispatch, offices?.offices, officesTypes, titleCity]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (homeOffice) {
      dispatch(setHomeOffices(homeOffice));
      dispatch(setTitleCity(homeOffice.city));
      dispatch(setPosition({ latitude: homeOffice.latitude, longitude: homeOffice.longitude }));
    }
  }, [dispatch, homeOffice]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (navigator.geolocation && isNeededFetch) {
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition((position) => {
        const { latitude, longitude } = position.coords;
        if (latitude && longitude) {
          const findCity = offices?.offices?.filter(
            (office) =>
              (office?.latitude?.toFixed(2) && office?.longitude?.toFixed(2)) ===
              (latitude?.toFixed(2) && longitude?.toFixed(2)),
          )?.[0].city;
          findCity && setIsNeededFetch(false);
          findCity && dispatch(setTitleCity(findCity));
          dispatch(setPosition({ latitude, longitude }));
          dispatch(setYourPosition({ latitude, longitude }));
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      });
    }
    setIsLoading(false);
  }, [dispatch, isNeededFetch, offices?.offices]);

  if (isLoading || isHomeOfficeLoading) return <CircleLoader brandColor type={'page'} />;

  return (
    <div className={cx({ [styles.wrapAdaptive]: !isMobile })}>
      {isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage documentTitle={'Офисы'}>
          <div className={isMobile ? styles.headerWrapper : styles.headerWrapperAdaptive}>
            <BackSvg onClick={handleBackClick} />
            <div className={styles.headerCenter} onClick={handleTitleClick}>
              <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>{titleCity}</Text>
              <ArrowSmallDownSvg />
            </div>
            <SettingsSvg onClick={() => dispatch(setBottomSheetState('operations'))} />
          </div>
        </HeaderPage>
      ) : (
        <>
          <HeaderPage
            documentTitle={'Офисы'}
            leftIconVariant={'back'}
            withoutMargin
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          />
          <div className={styles.headerTitleWrap}>
            <div className={styles.headerLine} onClick={handleTitleClick}>
              <Headline title={titleCity} indent={false} />
              <ArrowSmallDownSvg />
            </div>
            <SettingsSvg
              onClick={() => dispatch(setBottomSheetState('operations'))}
              className={styles.button}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
        disableSwipe
        tabs={tabs}
        classNameWrapper={cx({ [styles.tabsWrapper]: !isMobile })}
      >
        {children}
      </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>

      <CitiesBottomSheet
        isOpen={bottomSheetState === 'cities'}
        titleCitiesList={titleCitiesList}
        onDismiss={onDismiss}
      />

      <OperationsBottomSheet
        isOpen={bottomSheetState === 'operations'}
        onDismiss={onDismiss}
        activeOperations={activeOperations}
        setActiveOperations={setActiveOperations}
        officesTypes={officesTypes}
        setOfficesType={setOfficesType}
        officesTypeState={officesList}
        operationsState={operationList}
      />

      <YourOfficeBottomSheet
        isOpen={bottomSheetState === 'office'}
        onDismiss={onDismiss}
        offices={offices}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Offices;

import { memo, useState } from 'react';

import { Button } from '@aurora/components';
import ButtonInline from '@vision/button-inline';
import Text from '@vision/text';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import AdaptivePopup from 'components/AdaptivePopup';

import styles from './Hint.module.pcss';

type Params = {
  title: string;
  subTitle: string;
  text: string[];
};

const Hint = ({ title, subTitle, text }: Params) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleOpenHint = () => {
    setOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ButtonInline onClick={handleOpenHint} className={styles.btnInline}>
        {title}
      </ButtonInline>
      <AdaptivePopup open={open} onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}>
        <div className={isMobile ? styles.bottomSheetContent : styles.bottomSheetContentDesktop}>
          <div className={cx({ [styles.textWrapper]: !isMobile })}>
            <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.name}>
              {subTitle}
            </Text>
            {text.map((paragraph, index) => (
              <Text
                type="lineRegular"
                className={index === 0 ? styles.first : styles.line}
                key={index}
              >
                {paragraph}
              </Text>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Button className={styles.btn} onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}>
            Хорошо
          </Button>
        </div>
      </AdaptivePopup>
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(Hint);

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import styles from './OnboardingPage.module.pcss';
import Hint from './components/Hint';

type Props = {
  title: string;
  text: string;
  svg: React.ReactNode;
  hintTitle: string;
  hintSubTitle: string;
  hintText: string[];
  onClick: (isShow: boolean) => void;
};

const OnboardingPage = ({
  title,
  text,
  svg,
  hintTitle,
  hintSubTitle,
  hintText,
  onClick,
}: Props) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const handleLeftIconClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
  };
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleButtonClick = () => {
    onClick(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.container : styles.containerDesktop}>
      <HeaderPage leftIconVariant={'back'} onLeftIconClick={handleLeftIconClick} />

      {svg}
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.textContainer : styles.textContainerDesktop}>
        <Text type={isMobile ? 'title' : 'subtitleBold'} className={styles.titleText}>
          {title}
        </Text>
        <Text
          type={'bodyRegular'}
          color={isMobile ? 'colorForeground' : 'colorForeground2'}
          className={styles.bodyText}
        >
          {text}
        </Text>
        <Hint title={hintTitle} subTitle={hintSubTitle} text={hintText} />
      </div>
      <Button className={cx({ [styles.btn]: !isMobile })} onClick={handleButtonClick}>
        Пройти тестирование
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OnboardingPage;

import { FC, MouseEvent, memo, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { ReactComponent as CheckSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/indicator-checked.svg';
import { ReactComponent as QuestionOutlineSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/small-question-outline.svg';

import { FilterRowProps, OrderBookFilterType } from '../../types';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const FilterRow: FC<FilterRowProps> = ({
  name,
  id,
  icon,
  hintText,
  label,
  isChecked,
  onFilterChange,
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleRowClick = () => {
    onFilterChange({ [name]: id } as OrderBookFilterType);
  };

  const handleQuestionIconClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
    event.stopPropagation();
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.row} onClick={handleRowClick}>
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <Button iconLeft={icon} className={styles.icon} size="s" />
        <div className={styles.text}>
          <Text type="lineRegular">{label}</Text>
          {hintText && <QuestionOutlineSvg onClick={handleQuestionIconClick} />}
        </div>
      </div>
      {isChecked && <CheckSvg />}
      <BottomSheet open={isOpen} onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}>
        <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.container}>
          {hintText}
        </Text>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(FilterRow);

import { ORDER_DIRECTION_ROWS } from './consts';

export const getOrderDirectionRows = (hints: { hint: string; id: number }[]) =>
  ORDER_DIRECTION_ROWS.map((item) => {
    const currentHint = hints.find(({ id }) => id === item.id)?.hint;

    return { ...item, hintText: currentHint };
  });

import { FC, memo, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import { getHintText } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';

import FilterBlock from './components/FilterBlock';
import {
  CELL_LAYOUT_ROWS,
  CELL_SIZE_ROWS,
  DIRECT_ORDER_DIRECTION_DEFAULT_TEXT,
  SPECULAR_ORDER_DIRECTION_DEFAULT_TEXT,
} from './consts';
import { getOrderDirectionRows } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { OrderBookFilterBottomSheetProps, OrderBookFilterType } from './types';

const OrderBookFilterBottomSheet: FC<OrderBookFilterBottomSheetProps> = ({
  orderBookFilters,
  open,
  onDismiss,
  setOrderBookFilters,
}) => {
  const [currentFilters, setcurrentFilters] = useState(orderBookFilters);

  const { cellLayout, cellSize, direction } = currentFilters;

  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const directOrderDirectionHintText =
    (hints?.hints && getHintText(hints?.hints, 'ORDER_BOOK_SETTINGS_DIRECT')) ??
    DIRECT_ORDER_DIRECTION_DEFAULT_TEXT;

  const specularOrderDirectionHintText =
    (hints?.hints && getHintText(hints?.hints, 'ORDER_BOOK_SETTINGS_SPECULAR')) ??
    SPECULAR_ORDER_DIRECTION_DEFAULT_TEXT;

  const handleFilterChange = (value: OrderBookFilterType) => {
    setcurrentFilters({ ...currentFilters, ...value });
  };

  const handleBtnClick = () => {
    setOrderBookFilters(currentFilters);
    onDismiss();
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <Text type="subtitleSemiBold" className={styles.title}>
          Настройка стакана
        </Text>
        <FilterBlock
          name="cellLayout"
          title="Расположение ячеек"
          activeId={cellLayout}
          rows={CELL_LAYOUT_ROWS}
          onFilterChange={handleFilterChange}
        />
        <FilterBlock
          name="direction"
          title="Направление выставления поручения"
          activeId={direction}
          rows={getOrderDirectionRows([
            { id: 1, hint: directOrderDirectionHintText },
            { id: 2, hint: specularOrderDirectionHintText },
          ])}
          onFilterChange={handleFilterChange}
        />
        <FilterBlock
          name="cellSize"
          title="Размер ячеек"
          activeId={cellSize}
          rows={CELL_SIZE_ROWS}
          onFilterChange={handleFilterChange}
        />
        <Button onClick={handleBtnClick}>Применить</Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(OrderBookFilterBottomSheet);

import { FC, memo } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER } from 'const/routes';

import { setPrice } from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import styles from '../../styles.module.pcss';
import { OrderBookTableRowProps } from './types';

const OrderBookTableRow: FC<OrderBookTableRowProps> = ({
  buySell,
  price,
  quantity,
  priceCurrency,
  maxVolume,
  orderBookFilters,
  canTrade = false,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const { instrument } = useParams();

  const cellWidth = (100 * quantity) / maxVolume;

  const { cellSize, cellLayout, direction } = orderBookFilters;

  const cellSizeStyle = cellSize === 1 ? 'small' : cellSize === 2 ? 'medium' : 'large';

  const handleRowClick = () => {
    if (!canTrade) return;

    dispatch(setPrice(price));

    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, {
        instrument,
        direction:
          direction === 1 ? (buySell === 'S' ? 'sell' : 'buy') : buySell === 'S' ? 'buy' : 'sell',
      }),
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.row, cellLayout === 3 && styles.twoColumns)} onClick={handleRowClick}>
      {cellLayout !== 3 && (
        <div className={styles.rowBar}>
          <div
            className={cx(styles.buyQuantity, cellLayout === 1 ? styles.left : styles.right)}
            style={{ width: buySell === 'B' ? `${cellWidth}%` : 0 }}
          />
          <Text
            color="colorConstructive"
            type="lineRegular"
            className={cx(
              styles.text,
              cellLayout === 1 ? styles.textLeft : styles.textRight,
              styles[cellSizeStyle],
            )}
          >
            {buySell === 'B' ? quantity : null}
          </Text>
        </div>
      )}
      <Text
        className={cx(styles.price, styles.text, styles[cellSizeStyle])}
        type="lineRegular"
      >{`${sumFormatter(price, null, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency ?? 'RUB')}`}</Text>
      <div className={styles.rowBar}>
        <div
          className={cx(
            buySell === 'B' ? styles.buyQuantity : styles.sellQuantity,
            cellLayout === 2 ? styles.left : styles.right,
          )}
          style={{ width: buySell === 'S' || cellLayout === 3 ? `${cellWidth}%` : 0 }}
        />
        <Text
          color={buySell === 'B' ? 'colorConstructive' : 'colorDestructive'}
          type="lineRegular"
          className={cx(
            styles.text,
            cellLayout === 2 ? styles.textLeft : styles.textRight,
            styles[cellSizeStyle],
          )}
        >
          {cellLayout === 3 || buySell === 'S' ? quantity : null}
        </Text>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(OrderBookTableRow);

import { FC, memo, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useSessionStorage } from 'react-use';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { OrderBookTableProps } from 'modules/OrderBook/types';

import { ReactComponent as FilterIcon } from 'images/icons/fix-icon-size.svg';

import { OrderDataType } from 'types/instruments';

import OrderBookFilterBottomSheet from './components/OrderBookFilterBottomSheet';
import { ORDER_BOOK_FILTER_DEFAULT_PARAMS } from './components/OrderBookFilterBottomSheet/consts';
import OrderBookTableRow from './components/OrderBookTableRow';
import OrderRowTablePlug from './components/OrderRowTablePlug';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const OrderBookFullTable: FC<OrderBookTableProps> = ({ data, priceCurrency, canTrade }) => {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const [orderBookFilters, setOrderBookFilters] = useSessionStorage(
    'orderBookFilters',
    ORDER_BOOK_FILTER_DEFAULT_PARAMS,
  );

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const cellLayoutRight = orderBookFilters.cellLayout === 3;

  useEffect(() => {
    ref.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
  }, []);

  const [buyOrderData, sellOrderData, maxBuyQuanity, maxSellQuantity] = useMemo(() => {
    const buyOrderData: OrderDataType[] = [];
    const sellOrderData: OrderDataType[] = [];
    let maxBuyQuanity = 0;
    let maxSellQuantity = 0;

    data.orderData?.forEach((item) => {
      if (item.buySell === 'B') {
        buyOrderData.push(item);
        maxBuyQuanity = Math.max(maxBuyQuanity, item.quantity);
      } else {
        sellOrderData.push(item);
        maxSellQuantity = Math.max(maxSellQuantity, item.quantity);
      }
    });

    return [buyOrderData, sellOrderData, maxBuyQuanity, maxSellQuantity];
  }, [data.orderData]);

  const handleFilterBtnClick = () => {
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <article className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <div className={styles.flexContainer}>
            {data?.buyPcnt && (
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorConstructive">{`${sumFormatter(
                data.buyPcnt,
                2,
              )}% покупают`}</Text>
            )}
            {data?.sellPcnt && (
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorDestructive">{`${sumFormatter(
                data?.sellPcnt,
                2,
              )}% продают`}</Text>
            )}
          </div>
          {Boolean(data?.buyPcnt || data?.sellPcnt) && (
            <div className={styles.bar}>
              <div
                className={cx(styles.bar, styles.greenBar)}
                style={{ width: `${data?.buyPcnt}%` }}
              />
              <div
                className={cx(styles.bar, styles.redBar)}
                style={{ width: `${data?.sellPcnt}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.table}>
          <Button
            iconLeft={<FilterIcon />}
            className={styles.filterBtn}
            size="s"
            variant="white"
            onClick={handleFilterBtnClick}
          />
          <div className={styles.data}>
            {sellOrderData.length ? (
              sellOrderData.map((item) => (
                <OrderBookTableRow
                  key={item.price}
                  {...item}
                  priceCurrency={priceCurrency}
                  maxVolume={maxSellQuantity}
                  orderBookFilters={orderBookFilters}
                  canTrade={canTrade}
                />
              ))
            ) : (
              <OrderRowTablePlug variant="S" />
            )}
            <div
              ref={ref}
              className={cx(styles.row, styles.columName, cellLayoutRight && styles.twoColumns)}
            >
              {!cellLayoutRight && (
                <Text color="colorForeground2" type="lineMedium">
                  Лоты
                </Text>
              )}
              <Text
                color="colorForeground2"
                type="lineMedium"
                className={cx(styles.price, cellLayoutRight && styles.textLeft)}
              >
                Цена
              </Text>
              <Text color="colorForeground2" type="lineMedium" className={styles.textRight}>
                Лоты
              </Text>
            </div>
            {buyOrderData.length ? (
              buyOrderData.map((item, arr) => (
                <OrderBookTableRow
                  key={item.price}
                  {...item}
                  priceCurrency={priceCurrency}
                  maxVolume={maxBuyQuanity}
                  orderBookFilters={orderBookFilters}
                  canTrade={canTrade}
                />
              ))
            ) : (
              <OrderRowTablePlug variant="B" />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
      <OrderBookFilterBottomSheet
        orderBookFilters={orderBookFilters}
        setOrderBookFilters={setOrderBookFilters}
        open={isOpen}
        onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(OrderBookFullTable);

import { FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENT_ORDER_BOOK } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetAccountsQuery } from 'core/api/accounts';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery, useSetOrderBookQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';

import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';
import { getInstrumentIds } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';

import OrderBookFullTable from './components/OrderBookFullTable';
import OrderBookPlug from './components/OrderBookPlug';
import OrderBookShortTable from './components/OrderBookShortTable';
import Skeleton from './components/Skeleton';
import { OrderBookProps } from './types';

const OrderBook: FC<OrderBookProps> = ({ variant }) => {
  const { instrument: i } = useParams();
  const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = getInstrumentIds(i);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { data: allData } = useSetOrderBookQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    active: true,
    type: variant === 'short' ? 'S' : 'F',
  });

  const data = allData && allData[`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`];

  const { data: instrumentInfo } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId: instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId: tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: true,
    source: useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam(),
  });

  const { data: accounts } = useGetAccountsQuery({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });

  const { instrument = [], trading = [] } = instrumentInfo || {};
  const { priceCurrency } = instrument[0] || {};
  const { ask: a, askSizeLot, bid: b, bidSizeLot } = trading[0] || {};
  const canTrade = accounts?.tradingAvailability[0].tradePermissionState === 'GRANTED';

  const bidAskData = {
    ask: data?.ask ?? a,
    askSize: data?.askSize ?? askSizeLot,
    bid: data?.bid ?? b,
    bidSize: data?.bidSize ?? bidSizeLot,
  };

  const [showPlug, setShowPlug] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => setShowPlug(true), 2000);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
    };
  }, []);

  if ((!data || !bidAskData) && !showPlug) return variant === 'short' ? <Skeleton /> : null;

  if (!(data || bidAskData) || (!data?.buyPcnt && !data?.sellPcnt))
    return showPlug ? <OrderBookPlug variant={variant} text="Нет данных для отображения" /> : null;

  const orderBookTableProps = {
    data,
    priceCurrency,
    ...bidAskData,
  };

  const handleShortTableClick = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENT_ORDER_BOOK, { instrument: i }));
  };

  return variant === 'full' ? (
    <OrderBookFullTable {...orderBookTableProps} canTrade={canTrade} />
  ) : (
    <OrderBookShortTable {...orderBookTableProps} onClick={handleShortTableClick} />
  );
};

export default OrderBook;

import { OrderBookResponseType, PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

export type OrderBookProps = {
  variant: OrderBookVariant;
};

export type OrderBookTableProps = {
  data: OrderBookResponseType;
  priceCurrency: PriceCurrencyType;

import { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { ReactComponent as IndicatorCheckedSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/indicator-checked.svg';

import CommonHeadSheet from '../CommonHeadSheet';
import styles from './AccountsBottomSheet.module.pcss';
import { AccountsBottomSheetProps } from './types';

const AccountsBottomSheet: FC<AccountsBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  setOpen,
  productId,
  setProductId,
  data,
}) => {
  const [currentProductId, setCurrentAccountId] = useState(productId);
  const onDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    setCurrentAccountId(productId);
  };
  const handleSubmit = (reset?: boolean) => {
    setProductId(!reset ? currentProductId : '');
    onDismiss();
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentAccountId(productId);
  }, [productId]);
  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss} onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <CommonHeadSheet
          name={'Счета'}
          handleSubmit={() => handleSubmit(true)}
          activeBtn={!!productId}
        />
        <div className={styles.item} onClick={() => setCurrentAccountId('')}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Все счета</Text>
          {!currentProductId && <IndicatorCheckedSvg />}
        </div>
        {data.map((item) => (
          <div
            key={item.productId}
            className={styles.item}
            onClick={() => setCurrentAccountId(String(item.productId))}
          >
            <Text type={'lineRegular'}>
              {item.closed
                ? item.productFullName
                : `Счет № ${item.accountNo} ${item.productTypeName}`}
            </Text>
            {currentProductId === String(item.productId) && <IndicatorCheckedSvg />}
          </div>
        ))}
        <Button onClick={() => handleSubmit(false)}>Применить</Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default memo(AccountsBottomSheet);

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useDebounce } from 'react-use';

import BottomSheet from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import { Checkbox, SelectableCell } from '@aurora/components';
import Input from '@aurora/input/dist/index';
import Text from '@aurora/text';

import SvgHistoryIcon from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/SvgHistoryIcon';
import { ADMINISTRATIVE } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import { getFilteredThemes } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import { useFilterBSH } from 'modules/OrderHistory/hooks/useFilterBSH';
import { OrderFiltersBottomSheetProps } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import { ReactComponent as SearchSvg } from 'images/icons/search/search.svg';

import CommonHeadSheet from '../CommonHeadSheet';
import styles from './ActionTypesBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const ActionTypesBottomSheet: React.FC<OrderFiltersBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  setOpen,
  allFilters,
  setAllFilters,
  orderFilters,
  type,
  className,
}) => {
  const {
    handleSetSavedFilters,
    handleFilterSubmit,
    handleResetFilter,
    filters,
    handleSelectFilter,
    handleAllSelectFilter,
  } = useFilterBSH({ filterName: 'actionTypeCode', orderFilters, allFilters, setAllFilters });

  const onDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    handleSetSavedFilters();
    setInputSearch('');
  };
  const [filterBySearch, setFilterBySearch] = useState(orderFilters);

  useEffect(() => {
    setFilterBySearch(orderFilters);
  }, [orderFilters]);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    handleFilterSubmit();
    onDismiss();
  };

  const [inputSearch, setInputSearch] = useState('');
  useDebounce(
    () => {
      setFilterBySearch(getFilteredThemes(orderFilters, inputSearch));
    },
    700,
    [inputSearch],
  );

  const handleSearch = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setInputSearch(e.target.value);
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      className={className}
      initialFocusRef={false}
      header={
        <div className={styles.head}>
          <CommonHeadSheet
            name={'Темы поручений'}
            handleSubmit={handleResetFilter}
            activeBtn={filters.length !== 0}
          />
          {type?.name === ADMINISTRATIVE && (
            <div>
              <Input
                placeholder={'Найти тему'}
                addonBefore={<SearchSvg />}
                value={inputSearch}
                onChange={handleSearch}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      }
      footer={
        <div className={styles.btnWrapper}>
          <Button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={filters.length === orderFilters.length}>
            <Text tag={'div'}>Применить</Text>
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
      snapPoints={({ maxHeight }) => [maxHeight]}
      defaultSnap={({ snapPoints }) => snapPoints[0]}
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.scrollContent}>
          {filterBySearch.length === orderFilters.length && (
            <SelectableCell
              addonRight={
                <Checkbox checked={filters.length === 0} onChange={handleAllSelectFilter} />
              }
              title={'Все категории'}
              separator={false}
              variant={'filter'}
              iconLeft={<SvgHistoryIcon iconName={'all'} />}
            />
          )}
          {filterBySearch.map((item) => (
            <SelectableCell
              key={item.code}
              addonRight={
                <Checkbox
                  checked={!filters.includes(item.code)}
                  onChange={() => handleSelectFilter(item.code)}
                />
              }
              separator={false}
              variant={'filter'}
              title={item.name}
              iconLeft={<SvgHistoryIcon iconName={item.code} />}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default ActionTypesBottomSheet;

import React, { useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import {
  useGetAdministrativeParametersQuery,
  useGetAdministrativeQuery,
} from 'core/api/orderHistory';

import {
  ADMINISTRATIVE_FILTERS,
  ADMINISTRATIVE__FILTER_PERIOD,
  DEFAULT_ADMINISTRATIVE_ROWS_COUNT,
  SET_MONTH,
  administrativeType,
  defaultFilters,
} from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import { INonTradeOrderHistory, PeriodTypes } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import { FilterContext } from '../../OrderHistoryWrapper';
import CommonNonTrade from '../CommonNonTrade';

const Administrative: React.FC = () => {
  const [selectPeriod, setSelectPeriod] = useState<PeriodTypes>(
    sessionStorage[ADMINISTRATIVE__FILTER_PERIOD] || SET_MONTH,
  );
  const getInitialAllFilters = useMemo(
    () => () => {
      let initialObject = { ...defaultFilters };
      sessionStorage[ADMINISTRATIVE_FILTERS] &&
        Object.assign(initialObject, { ...JSON.parse(sessionStorage[ADMINISTRATIVE_FILTERS]) });
      initialObject = {
        ...initialObject,
        rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
        rowsCount: DEFAULT_ADMINISTRATIVE_ROWS_COUNT,
      };
      return initialObject;
    },
    [],
  );
  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useState<INonTradeOrderHistory>(getInitialAllFilters());

  const pathedFilters = useMemo(() => {
    if (allFilters.actionTypeCode.includes('Person.PersonProfile')) {
      return {
        ...allFilters,
        actionTypeCode: [allFilters.actionTypeCode, 'Person.Profile'].join(','),
      };
    }
    return allFilters;
  }, [allFilters]);

  const {
    data: { ordersHistoryAdministrative = [] } = {},
    isFetching,
    error,
    refetch,
  } = useGetAdministrativeQuery(pathedFilters);

  const {
    data: { ordersHistoryActionType = [], ordersHistoryStatus = [], ordersHistoryDates = [] } = {},
    error: errorFetchParameters,
    isFetching: isFetchingAdmParameters,
  } = useGetAdministrativeParametersQuery();
  useEffect(() => {
    sessionStorage.setItem(ADMINISTRATIVE_FILTERS, JSON.stringify(allFilters));
    sessionStorage.setItem(ADMINISTRATIVE__FILTER_PERIOD, selectPeriod);
  }, [allFilters, selectPeriod]);

  const { permissionAdministrative } = useContext(FilterContext) ?? {};

  return (
    <CommonNonTrade
      type={administrativeType}
      allFilters={allFilters}
      setAllFilters={setAllFilters}
      dataOrders={ordersHistoryAdministrative}
      isFetching={isFetching || isFetchingAdmParameters}
      error={error}
      actionTypes={ordersHistoryActionType}
      ordersStatus={ordersHistoryStatus}
      defaultRowCount={DEFAULT_ADMINISTRATIVE_ROWS_COUNT}
      selectPeriod={selectPeriod}
      setSelectPeriod={setSelectPeriod}
      ordersHistoryDates={ordersHistoryDates[0]}
      errorHideFilters={errorFetchParameters || permissionAdministrative}
      negativePermission={!!permissionAdministrative}
      refetch={refetch}
    />
  );
};

export default Administrative;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Text from '@aurora/text';

import { defaultFilters } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import { IAssetTypeCode, INonTradeOrderHistory } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import { ReactComponent as IndicatorCheckedSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/indicator-checked.svg';

import { IOrdersHistoryType } from 'types/orderHistory';

import CommonHeadSheet from '../CommonHeadSheet';
import SvgHistoryIcon from '../SvgHistoryIcon';
import styles from './AssetTypeBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type AssetTypeBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  allFilters: INonTradeOrderHistory;
  setAllFilters: (filters: INonTradeOrderHistory) => void;
  assetTypes?: IOrdersHistoryType[];
  className?: string;
};

const AssetTypeBottomSheet: React.FC<AssetTypeBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  setOpen,
  allFilters,
  setAllFilters,
  assetTypes = [],
  className,
}) => {
  const [assetTypeFilter, setAssetTypeFilter] = useState(defaultFilters.assetTypeCode);
  const onDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    setAssetTypeFilter(allFilters.assetTypeCode);
  };
  const handleSubmit = (reset: boolean) => {
    setAllFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      assetTypeCode: !reset ? assetTypeFilter : '',
      rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
    });
    onDismiss();
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    setAssetTypeFilter(allFilters.assetTypeCode);
  }, [allFilters.assetTypeCode]);
  return (
    <BottomSheetComponent
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      className={className}
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <CommonHeadSheet
          name={'Активы'}
          handleSubmit={() => handleSubmit(true)}
          activeBtn={!!allFilters.assetTypeCode}
        />
        <div className={styles.checkboxWrapper} onClick={() => setAssetTypeFilter('')}>
          <SvgHistoryIcon iconName={'all'} />
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Все активы</Text>
          {!assetTypeFilter && <IndicatorCheckedSvg />}
        </div>
        {assetTypes?.map((assetType) => (
          <div
            key={assetType.code}
            className={styles.checkboxWrapper}
            onClick={() => setAssetTypeFilter(assetType.code as IAssetTypeCode)}
          >
            <SvgHistoryIcon iconName={assetType.code} />
            <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{assetType.name}</Text>
            {assetTypeFilter === assetType.code && <IndicatorCheckedSvg />}
          </div>
        ))}
        <Button onClick={() => handleSubmit(false)}>
          <Text>Применить</Text>
        </Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheetComponent>
  );
};

export default AssetTypeBottomSheet;

import React from 'react';

import BottomSheet from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import { skipToken } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query';

import { useGetDetailStructureQuery, useGetOrderDetailQuery } from 'core/api/orderHistory';

import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import FormattedBalance from 'components/Balance/FormattedBalance';

import { IOrderHistoryCommon } from 'types/orderHistory';

import { NON_TRADE } from '../../constants';
import { orderDateReformat } from '../../helpers';
import { ITypes } from '../../types';
import Item from '../Item';
import OrderSkeleton from '../OrderSkeleton';
import styles from './BottomSheetDetails.module.pcss';
import Details from './components/Details/Details';
import HeaderDetails from './components/HeaderDetails';
import StructureDetails from './components/StructureDetails';

type BottomSheetDetailsProps = {
  openDetails: boolean;
  setOpenDetails: (openDetails: boolean) => void;
  order: IOrderHistoryCommon;
  type: ITypes;
};

const BottomSheetDetails: React.FC<BottomSheetDetailsProps> = ({
  openDetails,
  setOpenDetails,
  order,
  type,
}) => {
  const isNeedLoad = order.orderGuid && openDetails && order.hasDetail;
  const isStructure = order.orderTypeCode.includes('Structure');
  const isNonTrade = type.name === NON_TRADE;

  const {
    data: dataNonTradeDetail,
    isLoading: isLoadingNonTradeDetail,
    error: errorNonTradeDetail,
  } = useGetOrderDetailQuery(isNeedLoad && !isStructure ? order.orderGuid : skipToken);

  const {
    data: dataStructureDetail,
    isLoading: isLoadingStructureDetail,
    error: errorStructureDetail,
  } = useGetDetailStructureQuery(isNeedLoad && isStructure ? order.orderGuid : skipToken);

  const error = errorNonTradeDetail || errorStructureDetail;
  const isLoading = isLoadingNonTradeDetail || isLoadingStructureDetail;

  useErrorNotification(error);

  const onDismiss = () => setOpenDetails(false);

  const getNameVolume = () => {
    if (order.orderTypeCode.includes('Security')) {
      return 'Количество ЦБ';
    } else {
      return order.orderTypeCode === 'Money.Refill' ? 'Сумма пополнения' : 'Сумма';
    }
  };

  const getValueVolume = () => {
    return order.orderTypeCode.includes('Security') ? (
      `${order.volume} шт.`
    ) : (
      <FormattedBalance
        value={order.volume}
        currency={order.currencyCode || 'PCS'}
        type={'lineSemiBold'}
      />
    );
  };

  const isSecurity = order.orderTypeCode.includes('Security');

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
      open={openDetails}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      header={<HeaderDetails order={order} />}
      footer={
        <div className={styles.btn}>
          <Button onClick={onDismiss}>Закрыть</Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.container}>
        {!isStructure && !isSecurity && (
          <div className={styles.block}>
            <Item title={'Выставлено'} content={orderDateReformat(order.orderDate)} />
            {order.statusComment && (
              <Item
                title={'Комментарий к статусу'}
                content={order.statusComment}
                contentColor={'colorForeground2'}
              />
            )}
            {order.volume && <Item title={getNameVolume()} content={getValueVolume()} />}
          </div>
        )}
        {isLoading ? (
          <OrderSkeleton count={3} type={'details'} />
        ) : (
          <>
            {error ? (
              <div className={styles.centered}>Не удалось загрузить данные</div>
            ) : (
              <>
                {dataNonTradeDetail && <Details data={dataNonTradeDetail} order={order} />}
                {dataStructureDetail && <StructureDetails data={dataStructureDetail} />}
                {!isSecurity && (
                  <div className={styles.border}>
                    <Item title={'ID заявки'} content={order.orderNumber} />
                    {(isNonTrade || isStructure) && (
                      <Item title={'Место подачи'} content={order.source} />
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};
export default BottomSheetDetails;

import React from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { Color } from '@aurora/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { orderDateReformat } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';

import FormattedBalance from 'components/Balance/FormattedBalance';

import { IOrderHistoryCommon, IOrderHistoryDetails } from 'types/orderHistory';

import Item from '../../../Item';
import styles from './Details.module.pcss';

type DetailsProps = {
  data: IOrderHistoryDetails;
  order?: IOrderHistoryCommon;
};

type DetailRow = {
  title: string;
  content?: React.ReactNode;
  contentColor?: Color;
};

const isPresent = (value: React.ReactNode) => {
  if (value === 0) {
    return true;
  }

  return Boolean(value) && value !== '-';
};

const DetailSection: React.FC<{ title?: string; rows: DetailRow[] }> = ({ title, rows }) => {
  const visibleRows = rows.filter((row) => isPresent(row.content));

  if (!visibleRows.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.section}>
      {title && (
        <div className={styles.miniHead}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>{title}</Text>
        </div>
      )}
      {visibleRows.map((row) => (
        <Item
          key={row.title}
          title={row.title}
          content={row.content}
          contentColor={row.contentColor}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

const formatQuantity = (quantity?: number) => {
  if (quantity == null || !Number.isFinite(Number(quantity))) {
    return;
  }

  return `${quantity} шт.`;
};

const Details: React.FC<DetailsProps> = ({ data, order }) => {
  const { nonTradeDetails, bankDetails, moneyDetails, securityDetails } = data;

  const MONEY = nonTradeDetails?.orderTypeCode.includes('Money');
  const MONEY_TRANSFER = nonTradeDetails?.orderTypeCode === 'Money.Transfer';
  const MONEY_WITHDRAWAL = nonTradeDetails?.orderTypeCode === 'Money.Withdrawal';
  const MONEY_REFILL = nonTradeDetails?.orderTypeCode === 'Money.Refill';
  const isSecurity =
    Boolean(securityDetails) || Boolean(nonTradeDetails?.orderTypeCode.includes('Security'));

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      {MONEY && (
        <>
          {moneyDetails?.comission !== undefined && (
            <Item
              title={'Комиссия'}
              content={
                <FormattedBalance
                  value={moneyDetails.comission}
                  currency={moneyDetails.currencyCodeLat3 || 'PCS'}
                  precision={moneyDetails.currencyCodeLat3 ? 2 : null}
                  type={'lineSemiBold'}
                />
              }
            />
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {MONEY_TRANSFER && (
        <div className={styles.border}>
          <div className={cn(styles.miniHead, styles.borderTop)}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Откуда списать</Text>
          </div>
          <Item title={'Со счёта'} content={moneyDetails?.productName} />
          <Item title={'Из портфеля'} content={moneyDetails?.portfolioName} />
          <div className={cn(styles.miniHead, styles.borderTop)}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Куда зачислить</Text>
          </div>
          <Item title={'На счёт'} content={moneyDetails?.toProductName} />
          <Item title={'В портфель'} content={moneyDetails?.toPortfolioName} />
        </div>
      )}
      {MONEY_WITHDRAWAL && (
        <div className={styles.border}>
          <div className={cn(styles.miniHead, styles.borderTop)}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Откуда списать</Text>
          </div>
          <Item title={'Со счёта'} content={moneyDetails?.productName} />
          <Item title={'Из портфеля'} content={moneyDetails?.portfolioName} />
          {moneyDetails?.bankDetailsId && (
            <Item title={'По реквизитам'} content={`Счёт ${bankDetails?.shortName}`} />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {MONEY_REFILL && (
        <div className={styles.border}>
          <div className={cn(styles.miniHead, styles.borderTop)}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Куда зачислить</Text>
          </div>
          <Item title={'На счёт'} content={moneyDetails?.toProductName} />
          <Item title={'В портфель'} content={moneyDetails?.toPortfolioName} />
        </div>
      )}
      {isSecurity && (
        <div className={styles.sectionsGroup}>
          <DetailSection
            rows={[
              {
                title: 'Инструмент',
                content: securityDetails?.instrumentName || securityDetails?.instrumentFullName,
              },
              { title: 'ISIN', content: securityDetails?.isin },
              { title: '№ гос.регистрации', content: securityDetails?.regNum },
              { title: 'Количество', content: formatQuantity(securityDetails?.quantity) },
            ]}
          />
          <DetailSection
            title="Откуда списать"
            rows={[
              {
                title: 'Со счета',
                content: securityDetails?.subAccount || securityDetails?.productName,
              },
              { title: 'Со счета депо', content: securityDetails?.depoSubAccount },
              { title: 'Депозитарий', content: securityDetails?.depo },
              { title: 'Контрагент', content: securityDetails?.contractorName },
            ]}
          />
          <DetailSection
            title="Куда зачислить"
            rows={[
              {
                title: 'На счет',
                content: securityDetails?.subAccountTo || securityDetails?.toProductName,
              },
              { title: 'На счет депо', content: securityDetails?.depoSubAccountTo },
              { title: 'Депозитарий', content: securityDetails?.depoTo },
              { title: 'Контрагент', content: securityDetails?.contractorNameTo },
              { title: 'Передать справку о составе затрат', content: securityDetails?.sendCosts },
            ]}
          />
          <DetailSection
            rows={[
              {
                title: 'Выставлено',
                content:
                  nonTradeDetails?.orderDate || order?.orderDate
                    ? orderDateReformat(nonTradeDetails?.orderDate || order?.orderDate || '')
                    : undefined,
              },
              {
                title: 'Завершено',
                content: nonTradeDetails?.statusUpdateTime
                  ? orderDateReformat(nonTradeDetails.statusUpdateTime)
                  : undefined,
              },
              {
                title: 'Комментарий к статусу',
                content: order?.statusComment || nonTradeDetails?.comment,
                contentColor: 'colorForeground2',
              },
              { title: 'ID заявки', content: order?.orderNumber || nonTradeDetails?.orderNumber },
              { title: 'Место подачи', content: order?.source || nonTradeDetails?.source },
            ]}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {bankDetails && moneyDetails?.bankDetailsId && (
        <div className={styles.border}>
          <div className={styles.miniHead}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Реквизиты перевода</Text>
          </div>
          <Item title={'Получатель'} content={bankDetails?.payee} />
          {bankDetails?.withdrawTypeCode === 'Swift' && (
            <>
              <Item title={'SWIFT банка получателя'} content={bankDetails.benefBankSwift} />
              <Item title={'Банк-корреспондент: SWIFT'} content={bankDetails.imediaBankSwift} />
              <Item
                title={'Банк-корреспондент: расчётный счёт'}
                content={bankDetails.imediaBankRs}
              />
              <Item title={'Расчётный счёт банка получателя'} content={bankDetails.benefBankRs} />
            </>
          )}
          {bankDetails?.withdrawTypeCode === 'Bank' && (
            <>
              <Item title={'БИК'} content={bankDetails.bicCode} />
              <Item title={'Наименование банка'} content={bankDetails.accountBank} />
              <Item title={'Расчётный счёт'} content={bankDetails.accountRs} />
              <Item title={'Корреспондентский счёт'} content={bankDetails.accountCorr} />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Details;
