import React, { Fragment, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { Filter, FilterBar, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import camelcaseKeys from 'camelcase-keys';

import { orderHistoryApi } from 'core/api/orderHistory';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';
import useViewOnScreen from 'hooks/useViewOnScreen';

import ActionTypesBottomSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/ActionTypesBottomSheet';
import EmptyContentCheck from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/EmptyContentCheck';
import OrderItem from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/OrderItem';
import StatusBottomSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/StatusBottomSheet';
import TypeBottomSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/TypeBottomSheet';
import { NON_TRADE, SET_MONTH, defaultFilters } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import {
  currentDate,
  getDetailsDate,
  getFilterText,
  getNTPDateName,
} from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import { useFirstRedirectWhenBlockedPermission } from 'modules/OrderHistory/hooks/useFirstRedirectWhenBlockedPermission';
import { ICommonNonTradeProps } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import { IOrderHistoryCommon } from 'types/orderHistory';

import AssetTypeBottomSheet from '../AssetTypeBottomSheet';
import OrderSkeleton from '../OrderSkeleton';
import PeriodBottomSheet from '../PeriodBottomSheet';
import styles from './CommonNonTrade.module.pcss';

type OrderHistoryChangedItem = Partial<IOrderHistoryCommon> & {
  orderGuid?: string;
  sessionToken?: string | null;
  statusUpdateTime?: string;
};

type OrderHistoryListWrapper = {
  orderHistoryList?: OrderHistoryChangedItem[];
};

type OrderHistoryChangedPayload = {
  lastModified: number;
  response?: unknown;
};

/** Поля строки истории, которые можно обновить из OrderHistoryRow (сокет). */
const ORDER_HISTORY_ROW_KEYS: Array<keyof IOrderHistoryCommon> = [
  'comission',
  'currencyCode',
  'currencyName',
  'hasDetail',
  'initiator',
  'initiatorRole',
  'instrumentCode',
  'instrumentImageName',
  'instrumentImageTime',
  'instrumentName',
  'instrument_Id',
  'moneyCategory',
  'operation',
  'orderDate',
  'orderNumber',
  'orderTypeCode',
  'orderTypeName',
  'orderGuid',
  'source',
  'sourceCode',
  'statusComment',
  'status',
  'statusCode',
  'tradePlaceName',
  'tradePlace_Id',
  'volume',
];

const isOrderHistoryListWrapper = (value: unknown): value is OrderHistoryListWrapper =>
  typeof value === 'object' &&
  value != null &&
  'orderHistoryList' in value &&
  Array.isArray((value as OrderHistoryListWrapper).orderHistoryList);

const normalizeOrderHistoryUpdates = (response: unknown): OrderHistoryChangedItem[] => {
  if (response == null) {
    return [];
  }

  const camelized = camelcaseKeys(response as Record<string, unknown> | unknown[], {
    deep: true,
  });

  if (Array.isArray(camelized)) {
    if (camelized.length > 0 && isOrderHistoryListWrapper(camelized[0])) {
      return camelized.flatMap((item) =>
        isOrderHistoryListWrapper(item) ? item.orderHistoryList ?? [] : [],
      );
    }

    return camelized as OrderHistoryChangedItem[];
  }

  if (isOrderHistoryListWrapper(camelized)) {
    return camelized.orderHistoryList ?? [];
  }

  if (
    typeof camelized === 'object' &&
    camelized != null &&
    ('orderGuid' in camelized || 'statusCode' in camelized || 'status' in camelized)
  ) {
    return [camelized as OrderHistoryChangedItem];
  }

  return [];
};

/** Подменяет в строке все пришедшие из сокета поля OrderHistoryRow. */
const mergeOrderHistoryRow = (
  order: IOrderHistoryCommon,
  update: OrderHistoryChangedItem,
): IOrderHistoryCommon => {
  const next: IOrderHistoryCommon = { ...order };

  ORDER_HISTORY_ROW_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(update, key) && update[key] !== undefined) {
      (next as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = update[key];
    }
  });

  return next;
};

const applyOrderHistoryUpdates = (
  orders: IOrderHistoryCommon[],
  updates: OrderHistoryChangedItem[],
) => {
  if (!updates.length || !orders.length) {
    return orders;
  }

  const updatesByGuid = new Map(
    updates.filter((item) => item.orderGuid).map((item) => [item.orderGuid!.toLowerCase(), item]),
  );

  if (updatesByGuid.size === 0) {
    return orders;
  }

  let hasChanges = false;
  const nextOrders = orders.map((order) => {
    const update = updatesByGuid.get(order.orderGuid?.toLowerCase());
    if (!update) {
      return order;
    }

    hasChanges = true;
    return mergeOrderHistoryRow(order, update);
  });

  return hasChanges ? nextOrders : orders;
};

const CommonNonTrade: React.FC<ICommonNonTradeProps> = ({
  type,
  allFilters,
  setAllFilters,
  dataOrders,
  isFetching,
  error,
  actionTypes,
  ordersStatus,
  defaultRowCount,
  selectPeriod,
  setSelectPeriod,
  ordersHistoryDates,
  errorHideFilters,
  assetTypes,
  negativePermission,
  refetch,
}) => {
  const [typeBottomSheet, setTypeBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [themeBottomSheet, setThemeBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [statusBottomSheet, setStatusBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [assetTypeBottomSheet, setAssetTypeBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [periodBottomSheet, setPeriodBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [accumFetchData, setAccumFetchData] = useState<IOrderHistoryCommon[]>([]);
  const wsUpdatesRef = useRef<OrderHistoryChangedItem[]>([]);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const ref = useRef(null);
  const isOnViewScreen = useViewOnScreen(ref, {
    threshold: 0.75,
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    const withWsUpdates = applyOrderHistoryUpdates(dataOrders, wsUpdatesRef.current);

    if (allFilters.rowsOffset === defaultFilters.rowsOffset) {
      setAccumFetchData(withWsUpdates);
    } else {
      setAccumFetchData((prev) =>
        applyOrderHistoryUpdates([...prev, ...dataOrders], wsUpdatesRef.current),
      );
    }
  }, [dataOrders]); //eslint-disable-line
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOnViewScreen && dataOrders.length === defaultRowCount) {
      setAllFilters({ ...allFilters, rowsOffset: allFilters.rowsOffset + defaultRowCount });
    }
  }, [isOnViewScreen]); //eslint-disable-line

  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (data: OrderHistoryChangedPayload) => {
      const updates = normalizeOrderHistoryUpdates(data?.response);
      if (!updates.length) {
        return;
      }

      const updatesByGuid = new Map(
        updates
          .filter((item) => item.orderGuid)
          .map((item) => [item.orderGuid!.toLowerCase(), item]),
      );

      wsUpdatesRef.current = [
        ...wsUpdatesRef.current.filter(
          (item) => !item.orderGuid || !updatesByGuid.has(item.orderGuid.toLowerCase()),
        ),
        ...updates.filter((item) => item.orderGuid),
      ];

      // Сбросить кэш детализации по затронутым заявкам
      dispatch(
        orderHistoryApi.util.invalidateTags(
          updates
            .filter((item) => item.orderGuid)
            .map((item) => ({
              type: 'OrderHistoryDetail' as const,
              id: item.orderGuid as string,
            })),
        ),
      );

      setAccumFetchData((prev) => {
        const next = applyOrderHistoryUpdates(prev, updates);
        const hasLocalMatch = updates.some((update) =>
          prev.some(
            (order) =>
              order.orderGuid &&
              update.orderGuid &&
              order.orderGuid.toLowerCase() === update.orderGuid.toLowerCase(),
          ),
        );

        // Если заявки ещё нет в текущем списке — перезапросим историю
        if (!hasLocalMatch) {
          refetch?.();
        }

        return next;
      });
    };

    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('OrderHistoryChanged', listener);
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [dispatch, refetch]);

  const getAssetTypeName = (prefix: string) =>
    (allFilters.assetTypeCode === 'Money' && `${prefix}: Денежные средства`) ||
    (allFilters.assetTypeCode === 'Security' && `${prefix}: Ценные бумаги`) ||
    'Все активы';

  const handlePeriodReset = () => {
    setAllFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      dateFrom: defaultFilters.dateFrom,
      dateTo: defaultFilters.dateTo,
      rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
    });
    setSelectPeriod(SET_MONTH);
  };

  const { lockFilters, errorPermission } = useFirstRedirectWhenBlockedPermission(
    negativePermission,
    type,
  );

  const viewResetAllFilters = () => {
    const { rowsCount, rowsOffset, product_Id, ...restAllFilters } = allFilters;
    const { rowsOffset: _, product_Id: p, ...restDefaultFilters } = defaultFilters;
    return (
      JSON.stringify(restDefaultFilters) !== JSON.stringify(restAllFilters) ||
      selectPeriod !== SET_MONTH
    );
  };

  const handleResetAllFilters = () => {
    setAllFilters({
      ...defaultFilters,
      product_Id: allFilters.product_Id,
      rowsCount: defaultRowCount,
    });
    setSelectPeriod(SET_MONTH);
  };

  const isActivePeriodReset =
    defaultFilters.dateFrom !== allFilters.dateFrom || defaultFilters.dateTo !== allFilters.dateTo;

  const multipleActionType = allFilters.actionTypeCode.split(',');
  const multipleStatus = allFilters.statusCode.split(',');

  return (
    <div className={styles.orderWrapper}>
      {lockFilters && (
        <FilterBar className={styles.filtersWrapper}>
          {viewResetAllFilters() && <Filter shape={'reset'} onClick={handleResetAllFilters} />}
          <Filter
            shape={'select'}
            text={type.name}
            onClick={() => setTypeBottomSheet(!typeBottomSheet)}
          />
          {!errorHideFilters && (
            <Filter
              shape={'select'}
              active={isActivePeriodReset}
              text={getNTPDateName(allFilters.dateFrom, allFilters.dateTo, selectPeriod)}
              onClick={() => setPeriodBottomSheet(!periodBottomSheet)}
              onClose={handlePeriodReset}
            />
          )}
          {!errorHideFilters && type.name === NON_TRADE && (
            <Filter
              shape={'select'}
              active={!!allFilters.assetTypeCode}
              text={getAssetTypeName('Актив')}
              onClick={() => setAssetTypeBottomSheet(!assetTypeBottomSheet)}
              onClose={() => setAllFilters({ ...allFilters, assetTypeCode: '' })}
            />
          )}
          {!errorHideFilters && (
            <Filter
              shape={'select'}
              active={!!allFilters.actionTypeCode}
              text={getFilterText(
                actionTypes,
                allFilters.actionTypeCode,
                'Все темы',
                'Тема',
                'Темы',
              )}
              onClick={() => setThemeBottomSheet(!themeBottomSheet)}
              onClose={() =>
                setAllFilters({
                  ...allFilters,
                  actionTypeCode: '',
                  rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
                })
              }
              showIndicator={multipleActionType.length > 1}
              indicatorValue={multipleActionType.length}
            />
          )}
          {!errorHideFilters && (
            <Filter
              shape={'select'}
              active={!!allFilters.statusCode}
              text={getFilterText(
                ordersStatus,
                allFilters.statusCode,
                'Все статусы',
                'Статус',
                'Статусы',
              )}
              onClose={() =>
                setAllFilters({
                  ...allFilters,
                  statusCode: '',
                  rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
                })
              }
              onClick={() => setStatusBottomSheet(!statusBottomSheet)}
              showIndicator={multipleStatus.length > 1}
              indicatorValue={multipleStatus.length}
            />
          )}
        </FilterBar>
      )}
      <div className={styles.content} onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {isFetching && allFilters.rowsOffset === defaultFilters.rowsOffset ? (
          <OrderSkeleton count={4} />
        ) : (
          <EmptyContentCheck
            content={dataOrders.length ? dataOrders : accumFetchData}
            error={!!error || errorPermission}
            isFetching={isFetching}
            negativePermission={negativePermission}
            refetch={refetch}
            viewResetAllFilters={viewResetAllFilters}
            handleResetAllFilters={handleResetAllFilters}
            titleEmpty={'По выбранным параметрам поручений нет'}
            titleError={'Что-то пошло не так'}
            textError={'Попробуйте обновить страницу'}
          >
            {accumFetchData.map((order, i, self) => (
              <Fragment key={order.orderGuid}>
                {getDetailsDate(self[i - 1]?.orderDate) !== getDetailsDate(order.orderDate) && (
                  <div className={styles.date}>
                    <Text type={'labelRegular'} className={styles.text}>
                      {currentDate() === getDetailsDate(order.orderDate) && 'Сегодня, '}
                      {getDetailsDate(order.orderDate)}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                )}
                <OrderItem order={order} type={type} ref={i === self.length - 1 ? ref : null} />
              </Fragment>
            ))}
          </EmptyContentCheck>
        )}
      </div>
      <TypeBottomSheet open={typeBottomSheet} setOpen={setTypeBottomSheet} type={type} />
      <ActionTypesBottomSheet
        orderFilters={actionTypes}
        open={themeBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setThemeBottomSheet}
        allFilters={allFilters}
        setAllFilters={setAllFilters}
        type={type}
        className={styles.bottomSheet}
      />
      <StatusBottomSheet
        orderFilters={ordersStatus}
        open={statusBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setStatusBottomSheet}
        allFilters={allFilters}
        setAllFilters={setAllFilters}
        className={styles.bottomSheet}
      />
      <AssetTypeBottomSheet
        open={assetTypeBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setAssetTypeBottomSheet}
        allFilters={allFilters}
        setAllFilters={setAllFilters}
        assetTypes={assetTypes}
        className={styles.bottomSheet}
      />
      {!isFetching && (
        <PeriodBottomSheet
          open={periodBottomSheet}
          setOpen={setPeriodBottomSheet}
          allFilters={allFilters}
          setAllFilters={setAllFilters}
          selectPeriod={selectPeriod}
          setSelectPeriod={setSelectPeriod}
          orderDates={ordersHistoryDates}
          className={styles.bottomSheet}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CommonNonTrade;

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Placeholder from '@aurora/placeholder';
import { ROUTE_CHAT } from 'const/routes';

import { ReactComponent as CrossSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/servise-17.svg';

import OrderSkeleton from '../OrderSkeleton';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  content: unknown[];
  error?: boolean;
  isFetching: boolean;
  negativePermission?: boolean;
  refetch: () => void;
  viewResetAllFilters: () => boolean;
  handleResetAllFilters: () => void;
  titleEmpty?: string;
  textEmpty?: string;
  titleError?: string;
  textError?: string;
  extraPlaceholder?: boolean;
  extraTitle?: string;
  extraText?: string;
  extraBtnText?: string;
  extraOnClick?: () => void;
};

const EmptyContentCheck: React.FC<Props> = ({
  children,
  content,
  error,
  isFetching,
  negativePermission,
  refetch,
  viewResetAllFilters,
  handleResetAllFilters,
  titleEmpty,
  textEmpty,
  titleError,
  textError,
  extraPlaceholder,
  extraTitle,
  extraText,
  extraBtnText,
  extraOnClick,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  if (error)
    return (
      <Placeholder
        variant={'error'}
        title={titleError}
        text={textError}
        shape={'emptyState'}
        actionButtonText="Обновить"
        onActionButtonClick={refetch}
      />
    );
  if (negativePermission) {
    return (
      <Placeholder
        variant={'error'}
        title={'Раздел недоступен'}
        text={'Для получения подробной информации обратитесь в чат'}
        shape={'emptyState'}
        img={<CrossSvg width={100} height={100} />}
        actionButtonText="Написать в чат"
        onActionButtonClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_CHAT)}
      />
    );
  }
  if (extraPlaceholder) {
    return (
      <Placeholder
        variant={'error'}
        title={extraTitle}
        text={extraText}
        buttons={<Button onClick={extraOnClick}>{extraBtnText}</Button>}
        img={<CrossSvg width={100} height={100} />}
        shape={'emptyState'}
      />
    );
  }
  if (content.length < 1) {
    return (
      <Placeholder
        variant={'error'}
        title={titleEmpty}
        text={textEmpty}
        shape={'emptyState'}
        img={<CrossSvg width={100} height={100} />}
        actionButtonText={viewResetAllFilters() ? 'Сбросить фильтры' : ''}
        onActionButtonClick={viewResetAllFilters() ? handleResetAllFilters : undefined}
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        {children}
        {isFetching && <OrderSkeleton count={1} />}
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default EmptyContentCheck;

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { BottomSheet, Button, CheckHeader, Currency, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS } from 'const/routes';

import { headerBackgroundColor } from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/EventHistory/components/EventDetailsBottomSheet/constants';
import Item from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/Item';
import Hline from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/Separator';
import { getEventDetailDate } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components';

import { NonTradeEventType } from 'types/eventHistory';

import styles from './EventDetailsBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type EventDetailsBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  event: NonTradeEventType;
};

const EventDetailsBottomSheet: React.FC<EventDetailsBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  setOpen,
  event,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const onDismiss = () => setOpen(false);
  const dateEventDetail = getEventDetailDate(event.eventDate);

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
      header={
        <CheckHeader
          instrumentIcon={
            <InstrumentIcon
              instrumentImageName={event.imageName}
              className={styles.instrumentImg}
            />
          }
          orderTypeName={event.eventName}
          description={event.eventDescription}
          showIndicator={false}
          variant={headerBackgroundColor[event.eventTypeCode] || 'accent'}
        />
      }
      footer={
        <div className={styles.btnWrapper}>
          <Button onClick={onDismiss}>Закрыть</Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <>
        <Hline />
        <div className={styles.main}>
          <Item
            title={'Инструмент'}
            content={
              event.instrumentName && (
                <div
                  onClick={() =>
                    navigate(`${ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS}/${event.instrumentId}_${event.tradePlaceId}`)
                  }
                >
                  <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} color={'colorAccent'}>
                    {event.instrumentName}
                  </Text>
                </div>
              )
            }
          />
          <Item
            title={'Дата и время'}
            content={
              <>
                <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>{dateEventDetail.date}</Text>
                <Text tag={'span'} type={'lineSemiBold'}>
                  {dateEventDetail.time}
                </Text>{' '}
                <Text tag={'span'} type={'lineSemiBold'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                  ({dateEventDetail.utc})
                </Text>
              </>
            }
          />
          <Item
            title={'Сумма'}
            content={
              <Currency
                value={event.amountCurr || event.amount}
                currency={event.amountCurrCurrency || event.amountCurrency}
                type={'lineSemiBold'}
              />
            }
          />
        </div>
      </>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default EventDetailsBottomSheet;

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Checkbox, Result, SelectableCell } from '@aurora/components';

import { initialEventsFilters } from 'core/orderHistory/constants';
import { eventHistorySelector } from 'core/orderHistory/orderHistorySelector';
import {
  setEventHistoryFilters,
  setEventTypesNotChecked,
} from 'core/orderHistory/orderHistorySlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import CommonHeadSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/CommonHeadSheet';
import { getFilterEventTypes, getNameDate } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';

import { CheckedEventType, EventType } from 'types/eventHistory';

import styles from './EventFilterBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type EventFilterBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  className: string;
  eventTypes: EventType[];
  activeReset: boolean;
  resetFilter: () => void;
};

const EventFilterBottomSheet: React.FC<EventFilterBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  setOpen,
  className,
  eventTypes,
  activeReset,
  resetFilter,
}) => {
  const { filters, eventTypesNotChecked, selectedPeriod } = useAppSelector(eventHistorySelector);
  const getInitialNotSelectedEventTypes = useMemo(
    () => eventTypesNotChecked || ({} as CheckedEventType),
    [eventTypesNotChecked],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    setNotSelectedEventTypes(getInitialNotSelectedEventTypes);
  }, [getInitialNotSelectedEventTypes]);
  const [notSelectedEventTypes, setNotSelectedEventTypes] = useState<CheckedEventType>(
    getInitialNotSelectedEventTypes,
  );
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const onDismiss = () => setOpen(false);

  const isAllEventTypes = Object.keys(notSelectedEventTypes).length === 0;

  const handleSelectAllEventTypes = () => {
    if (isAllEventTypes) {
      const notSelected = eventTypes.reduce((acc, item) => {
        acc = { ...acc, [item.eventTypeCode]: false };
        return acc;
      }, {});
      setNotSelectedEventTypes(notSelected);
    } else {
      setNotSelectedEventTypes({});
    }
  };
  const handleSelectEventTypes = (eventTypeCode: string) => {
    if (notSelectedEventTypes[eventTypeCode] === false) {
      const updSelectedTypes = { ...notSelectedEventTypes };
      delete updSelectedTypes[eventTypeCode];
      setNotSelectedEventTypes(updSelectedTypes);
    } else {
      setNotSelectedEventTypes({ ...notSelectedEventTypes, [eventTypeCode]: false });
    }
  };
  const delEventTypesFromFilter = () => {
    const updFilters = { ...filters };
    delete updFilters.eventTypes;
    dispatch(setEventHistoryFilters(updFilters));
    dispatch(setEventTypesNotChecked(null));
  };
  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!isAllEventTypes) {
      if (Object.keys(notSelectedEventTypes).length === eventTypes.length) {
        delEventTypesFromFilter();
      } else {
        dispatch(
          setEventHistoryFilters({
            ...filters,
            eventTypes: getFilterEventTypes(eventTypes, notSelectedEventTypes),
            rowsOffset: initialEventsFilters.rowsOffset,
          }),
        );
        dispatch(setEventTypesNotChecked(notSelectedEventTypes));
      }
    } else {
      delEventTypesFromFilter();
    }
    onDismiss();
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    resetFilter();
    onDismiss();
  };

  const title = useMemo(
    () => getNameDate(filters.startDate, selectedPeriod),
    [filters.startDate, selectedPeriod],
  );

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      className={className}
      header={
        <div className={styles.header}>
          <CommonHeadSheet
            name={'События'}
            handleSubmit={handleReset}
            activeBtn={activeReset}
            addonBottom={title}
          />
        </div>
      }
      footer={
        <div className={styles.footer}>
          <Button onClick={() => handleSubmit()}>Применить</Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.eventTypes}>
          <SelectableCell
            addonRight={<Checkbox checked={isAllEventTypes} onChange={handleSelectAllEventTypes} />}
            title={'Все категории'}
            separator={false}
            variant={'filter'}
            description={<span>&nbsp;</span>}
          />
          {eventTypes.map((eventType) => (
            <SelectableCell
              key={eventType.eventTypeCode}
              addonRight={
                <Checkbox
                  checked={notSelectedEventTypes[eventType.eventTypeCode] ?? true}
                  onChange={() => handleSelectEventTypes(eventType.eventTypeCode)}
                />
              }
              separator={false}
              variant={'filter'}
              title={eventType.eventTypeName}
              description={
                <Result
                  value={eventType.amount}
                  variant={!eventType.amount ? 'neutral' : eventType.amount > 0 ? 'plus' : 'minus'}
                />
              }
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default EventFilterBottomSheet;

import React, { forwardRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { ActionCell, BottomSheet, CircleLoader, Currency, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { skipToken } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query';

import { useGetNonTradeQuery } from 'core/api/orderHistory';
import { useGetOneOrderQuery } from 'core/api/orders';
import { NONTRADE_ORDER, TRADE_ORDER } from 'core/orderHistory/constants';

import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import BottomSheetDetails from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/BottomSheetDetails';
import EventDetailsBottomSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/EventHistory/components/EventDetailsBottomSheet';
import { nonTradeType } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import OrderDetails from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderDetails';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components';

import { NonTradeEventType } from 'types/eventHistory';

import styles from './EventItem.module.pcss';

type EventItemProps = {
  event: NonTradeEventType;
  separator: boolean;
};

const EventItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, EventItemProps>(({ event, separator }, ref) => {
  const currencyColor =
    event.amountCurr?.toString().includes('-') || event.amount?.toString().includes('-')
      ? 'colorDestructive'
      : 'colorConstructive';

  const [openCommonEventDetail, setOpenCommonEventDetail] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [openNonTradeDetail, setOpenNonTradeDetail] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [openTradeDetail, setOpenTradeDetail] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const {
    data: { ordersHistoryNonTrade = [] } = {},
    isFetching: isFetchingNonTradeOrder,
    error: errorNonTradeOrder,
  } = useGetNonTradeQuery(openNonTradeDetail ? { order_guid: event.detailsKey } : skipToken);
  const {
    data: { orderList = [] } = {},
    isFetching: isFetchingTradeOrder,
    error: errorTradeOrder,
  } = useGetOneOrderQuery(openTradeDetail ? { orderNum: event.detailsKey } : skipToken);

  const error = errorNonTradeOrder || errorTradeOrder;
  useErrorNotification(error);
  useEffect(() => {
    errorTradeOrder && setOpenTradeDetail(null);
  }, [errorTradeOrder]); //eslint-disable-line

  const isFetching = isFetchingNonTradeOrder || isFetchingTradeOrder;

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLoading(isFetching);
  }, [isFetching]);

  const handleOpenDetail = async (event: NonTradeEventType) => {
    if (event.detailsType === NONTRADE_ORDER) {
      setOpenNonTradeDetail(event.detailsKey);
    }
    if (event.detailsType === TRADE_ORDER) {
      setOpenTradeDetail(event.detailsKey);
    } else if (!event.detailsType) {
      setOpenCommonEventDetail(true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={ref}>
      <ActionCell
        addonBottom={
          <>
            {(event.amountCurr || event.amount) && currencyColor === 'colorConstructive' && (
              <Text tag={'span'} color={currencyColor} type={'labelRegular'}>
                +
              </Text>
            )}
            <Currency
              tag={'span'}
              currency={event.amountCurrCurrency || event.amountCurrency}
              color={currencyColor}
              value={event.amountCurr || event.amount}
              type={'labelRegular'}
            />
          </>
        }
        description={event.eventDescription}
        iconLeft={<InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={event.imageName} />}
        title={event.eventName}
        variant="history"
        separator={separator}
        onClick={() => handleOpenDetail(event)}
      />
      <EventDetailsBottomSheet
        open={openCommonEventDetail}
        setOpen={setOpenCommonEventDetail}
        event={event}
      />
      {ordersHistoryNonTrade.length > 0 && (
        <BottomSheetDetails
          openDetails={!!openNonTradeDetail}
          setOpenDetails={(open) => !open && setOpenNonTradeDetail(null)}
          order={ordersHistoryNonTrade[0]}
          type={nonTradeType}
        />
      )}
      {orderList.length > 0 && (
        <OrderDetails
          isOpen={!!openTradeDetail}
          onDismiss={() => setOpenTradeDetail(null)}
          data={orderList[0]}
        />
      )}
      <BottomSheet open={isLoading} onDismiss={() => setIsLoading(false)}>
        <div className={styles.loader}>
          <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
});

EventItem.displayName = 'EventItem';

export default EventItem;

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, DatePicker } from '@aurora/components';

import { initialEventsFilters } from 'core/orderHistory/constants';
import { eventHistorySelector } from 'core/orderHistory/orderHistorySelector';
import {
  setEventHistoryFilters,
  setEventTypesNotChecked,
  setSelectedPeriod,
} from 'core/orderHistory/orderHistorySlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import CommonHeadSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/CommonHeadSheet';
import {
  getDatePickerFormat,
  getFilterDateFormat,
  getYearFromJSDate,
} from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import { PeriodTypes } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import styles from './EventPeriodBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type EventPeriodBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  className: string;
  activeReset: boolean;
  resetFilter: () => void;
};

const EventPeriodBottomSheet: React.FC<EventPeriodBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  setOpen,
  className,
  activeReset,
  resetFilter,
}) => {
  const { selectedPeriod, filters } = useAppSelector(eventHistorySelector);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const onDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };
  const handleSubmit = (dates: Date[]) => {
    dispatch(setEventHistoryFilters({ ...initialEventsFilters, ...getFilterDateFormat(dates) }));
    dispatch(setEventTypesNotChecked(null));
    onDismiss();
  };

  const handleSelectPeriod = (p: PeriodTypes) => {
    if (p === selectedPeriod) return;
    dispatch(setSelectedPeriod(p));
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    resetFilter();
    onDismiss();
  };

  const datePickerFormat = useMemo(
    () => getDatePickerFormat(filters.startDate, filters.endDate),
    [filters.startDate, filters.endDate],
  );

  const currentYear = useMemo(() => getYearFromJSDate(filters.startDate), [filters.startDate]);

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      className={className}
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <CommonHeadSheet name={'Период'} handleSubmit={handleReset} activeBtn={activeReset} />
        <DatePicker
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          periodPreset={true}
          dates={datePickerFormat}
          currentYear={currentYear}
          customOptionsPeriodPreset={['month', 'quarter']}
          defaultOptionPeriodPreset={selectedPeriod}
          onSetOptionPeriodPreset={(p) => handleSelectPeriod(p)}
        />
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default EventPeriodBottomSheet;

import React, { Fragment, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { Filter, FilterBar, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetEventsHistoryQuery } from 'core/api/orderHistory';
import { EVENT_PERIOD_MONTH, initialEventsFilters } from 'core/orderHistory/constants';
import { eventHistorySelector } from 'core/orderHistory/orderHistorySelector';
import {
  setEventHistoryAccumEvents,
  setEventHistoryFilters,
  setEventTypesNotChecked,
  setSelectedPeriod,
} from 'core/orderHistory/orderHistorySlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import useViewOnScreen from 'hooks/useViewOnScreen';

import { FilterContext } from 'modules/OrderHistory/OrderHistoryWrapper';
import EmptyContentCheck from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/EmptyContentCheck';
import EventFilterBottomSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/EventHistory/components/EventFilterBottomSheet';
import EventItem from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/EventHistory/components/EventItem';
import EventPeriodBottomSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/EventHistory/components/EventPeriodBottomSheet';
import OrderSkeleton from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/OrderSkeleton';
import {
  currentDate,
  getDetailsDate,
  getNameDate,
  getNameEventFilter,
} from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';

import styles from './EventHistory.module.pcss';

const EventHistory = () => {
  const { productId } = useContext(FilterContext) ?? {};
  const { filters, accumEvents, eventTypesNotChecked, selectedPeriod } =
    useAppSelector(eventHistorySelector);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const ref = useRef(null);
  const isOnViewScreen = useViewOnScreen(ref, {
    threshold: 0.75,
  });

  const {
    data: { events = [], eventTypes = [] } = {},
    isFetching,
    error,
    refetch,
  } = useGetEventsHistoryQuery(!productId ? filters : { ...filters, productId });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (filters.rowsOffset === initialEventsFilters.rowsOffset) {
      dispatch(setEventHistoryAccumEvents(events));
    } else {
      dispatch(setEventHistoryAccumEvents([...accumEvents, ...events]));
    }
  }, [events]); //eslint-disable-line
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOnViewScreen && events.length === initialEventsFilters.rowsCount) {
      dispatch(
        setEventHistoryFilters({
          ...filters,
          rowsOffset: filters.rowsOffset + initialEventsFilters.rowsCount,
        }),
      );
    }
  }, [isOnViewScreen]); //eslint-disable-line
  const [eventPeriodBottomSheet, setEventPeriodBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [eventFilterBottomSheet, setEventFilterBottomSheet] = useState(false);

  const isActivePeriodReset =
    initialEventsFilters.startDate !== filters.startDate ||
    initialEventsFilters.endDate !== filters.endDate;

  const isActiveEventsReset = !!filters.eventTypes;

  const isActiveResetAll = isActivePeriodReset || isActiveEventsReset;

  const handleResetEventsFilter = () => {
    dispatch(setEventTypesNotChecked(null));
    const updFilters = { ...filters };
    delete updFilters.eventTypes;
    dispatch(setEventHistoryFilters(updFilters));
  };

  const handleResetAllFilters = () => {
    dispatch(setEventHistoryFilters(initialEventsFilters));
    dispatch(setSelectedPeriod(EVENT_PERIOD_MONTH));
    dispatch(setEventTypesNotChecked(null));
  };

  const nameEventsFilter = getNameEventFilter(eventTypes, eventTypesNotChecked);

  const handleOpenPeriod = () => setEventPeriodBottomSheet(true);

  const extraTitle = useMemo(
    () => getNameDate(filters.startDate, selectedPeriod),
    [filters.startDate, selectedPeriod],
  );

  const filterPeriodTitle = useMemo(
    () => getNameDate(filters.startDate, selectedPeriod),
    [filters.startDate, selectedPeriod],
  );

  return (
    <div className={styles.orderWrapper}>
      <FilterBar className={styles.filtersWrapper}>
        {isActiveResetAll && <Filter shape={'reset'} onClick={handleResetAllFilters} />}
        <Filter
          shape={'select'}
          text={filterPeriodTitle}
          onClick={handleOpenPeriod}
          active={isActivePeriodReset}
          onClose={handleResetAllFilters}
        />
        <Filter
          shape={'select'}
          text={nameEventsFilter.name}
          onClick={() => setEventFilterBottomSheet(true)}
          showIndicator={!!nameEventsFilter.count}
          indicatorValue={nameEventsFilter.count}
          active={nameEventsFilter.active}
          onClose={handleResetEventsFilter}
        />
      </FilterBar>
      <div className={styles.content} onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {isFetching && filters.rowsOffset === initialEventsFilters.rowsOffset ? (
          <OrderSkeleton count={3} />
        ) : (
          <EmptyContentCheck
            content={events.length ? events : accumEvents}
            error={!!error}
            isFetching={isFetching}
            refetch={refetch}
            viewResetAllFilters={() => isActiveResetAll}
            handleResetAllFilters={handleResetAllFilters}
            titleEmpty={
              isActiveResetAll ? 'Нет событий по выбранным параметрам' : 'Список событий пуст'
            }
            textEmpty={
              isActiveResetAll
                ? 'Попробуйте изменить настройки фильтров'
                : 'Отсутствуют события по выбранным параметрам'
            }
            titleError={'Не удалось загрузить список событий'}
            textError={'Попробуйте обновить страницу'}
            extraPlaceholder={!isActivePeriodReset && events.length < 1}
            extraTitle={`Нет событий за ${extraTitle}`}
            extraText={'Попробуйте изменить настройки временного периода'}
            extraBtnText={'Выбрать период'}
            extraOnClick={handleOpenPeriod}
          >
            {accumEvents.map((event, i, self) => (
              <Fragment key={`${event.detailsKey}_${event.eventDate}_${event.amount}`}>
                {getDetailsDate(self[i - 1]?.eventDate) !== getDetailsDate(event.eventDate) && (
                  <div className={styles.date}>
                    <Text type={'labelRegular'} className={styles.text}>
                      {currentDate() === getDetailsDate(event.eventDate) && 'Сегодня, '}
                      {getDetailsDate(event.eventDate)}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                )}
                <EventItem
                  event={event}
                  ref={i === self.length - 1 ? ref : null}
                  separator={
                    getDetailsDate(self[i + 1]?.eventDate) === getDetailsDate(event.eventDate)
                  }
                />
              </Fragment>
            ))}
          </EmptyContentCheck>
        )}
      </div>
      <EventPeriodBottomSheet
        open={eventPeriodBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setEventPeriodBottomSheet}
        className={styles.bottomSheet}
        activeReset={isActivePeriodReset}
        resetFilter={handleResetAllFilters}
      />
      <EventFilterBottomSheet
        open={eventFilterBottomSheet}
        setOpen={setEventFilterBottomSheet}
        className={styles.bottomSheet}
        eventTypes={eventTypes}
        activeReset={isActiveEventsReset}
        resetFilter={handleResetEventsFilter}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default EventHistory;

import React, { useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { useGetNonTradeParametersQuery, useGetNonTradeQuery } from 'core/api/orderHistory';

import { FilterContext } from 'modules/OrderHistory/OrderHistoryWrapper';
import {
  COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS,
  DEFAULT_NON_TRADE_ROWS_COUNT,
  NON_TRADE_FILTERS,
  NON_TRADE_FILTER_PERIOD,
  SET_MONTH,
  defaultFilters,
  nonTradeType,
} from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import { INonTradeOrderHistory, PeriodTypes } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import { getSortNonTradeActionTypes } from '../../helpers';
import CommonNonTrade from '../CommonNonTrade';

const NonTrade: React.FC = () => {
  const { productId, permissionNonTrade } = useContext(FilterContext) ?? {};
  const [selectPeriod, setSelectPeriod] = useState<PeriodTypes>(
    sessionStorage[NON_TRADE_FILTER_PERIOD] || SET_MONTH,
  );
  const getInitialAllFilters = useMemo(
    () => () => {
      let initialObject = { ...defaultFilters };
      sessionStorage[NON_TRADE_FILTERS] &&
        Object.assign(initialObject, { ...JSON.parse(sessionStorage[NON_TRADE_FILTERS]) });
      sessionStorage[COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS] &&
        Object.assign(initialObject, { ...JSON.parse(sessionStorage[COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS]) });
      initialObject = {
        ...initialObject,
        rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
        rowsCount: DEFAULT_NON_TRADE_ROWS_COUNT,
      };
      return initialObject;
    },
    [],
  );
  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useState<INonTradeOrderHistory>(getInitialAllFilters());
  const {
    data: { ordersHistoryNonTrade = [] } = {},
    isFetching,
    error,
    refetch,
  } = useGetNonTradeQuery(allFilters);
  const {
    data: {
      ordersHistoryActionType = [],
      ordersHistoryStatus = [],
      ordersHistoryDates = [],
      ordersHistoryAssetType = [],
    } = {},
    error: errorFetchParameters,
    isFetching: isFetchingNonTradeParameters,
  } = useGetNonTradeParametersQuery();
  useEffect(() => {
    setAllFilters({ ...allFilters, product_Id: productId, rowsOffset: 0 });
  }, [productId]); //eslint-disable-line
  const sortActionTypes = useMemo(
    () => getSortNonTradeActionTypes(ordersHistoryActionType),
    [ordersHistoryActionType],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    sessionStorage.setItem(NON_TRADE_FILTERS, JSON.stringify(allFilters));
    sessionStorage.setItem(NON_TRADE_FILTER_PERIOD, selectPeriod);
    sessionStorage.setItem(
      COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS,
      JSON.stringify({ product_Id: allFilters.product_Id }),
    );
  }, [allFilters, selectPeriod]);

  return (
    <CommonNonTrade
      type={nonTradeType}
      allFilters={allFilters}
      setAllFilters={setAllFilters}
      dataOrders={ordersHistoryNonTrade}
      isFetching={isFetching || isFetchingNonTradeParameters}
      error={error}
      actionTypes={sortActionTypes}
      ordersStatus={ordersHistoryStatus}
      defaultRowCount={DEFAULT_NON_TRADE_ROWS_COUNT}
      selectPeriod={selectPeriod}
      setSelectPeriod={setSelectPeriod}
      ordersHistoryDates={ordersHistoryDates[0]}
      errorHideFilters={errorFetchParameters || permissionNonTrade}
      assetTypes={ordersHistoryAssetType}
      negativePermission={!!permissionNonTrade}
      refetch={refetch}
    />
  );
};

export default NonTrade;

import React, { forwardRef, useState } from 'react';

import Text, { Color } from '@aurora/text';

import { textStatusColors } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import { orderDateReformat } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components';
import FormattedBalance from 'components/Balance/FormattedBalance';

import { IOrderHistoryCommon } from 'types/orderHistory';

import { ITypes } from '../../types';
import BottomSheetDetails from '../BottomSheetDetails';
import SvgHistoryIcon from '../SvgHistoryIcon';
import styles from './OrderItem.module.pcss';

type OrderProps = {
  order: IOrderHistoryCommon;
  type: ITypes;
};

const OrderItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, OrderProps>(({ order, type }, ref) => {
  const [openDetails, setOpenDetails] = useState(false);
  const handleDetails = () => {
    setOpenDetails(true);
  };
  return (
    <div className={styles.ItemContainer} onClick={handleDetails} ref={ref}>
      <div className={styles.head}>
        <div>
          <Text color={textStatusColors[order.statusCode] as Color} type={'labelRegular'}>
            {order.status}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div>
          <Text color={'colorForeground2'} type={'labelRegular'}>
            {orderDateReformat(order.orderDate)}
          </Text>
        </div>
        {order.statusComment && (
          <div className={styles.statusComment}>
            <Text color={'colorForeground2'} type={'labelRegular'}>
              {order.statusComment}
            </Text>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.section}>
        <div>
          {!order.instrumentImageName ? (
            <SvgHistoryIcon iconName={order.orderTypeCode} />
          ) : (
            <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={order.instrumentImageName} />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.info}>
          <div>
            <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>{order.orderTypeName}</Text>
          </div>
          <div>
            <Text color={'colorForeground2'} type={'labelRegular'}>
              {order.operation}
            </Text>
          </div>
          {order.volume && (
            <div>
              <FormattedBalance
                value={order.volume}
                currency={order.currencyCode || 'PCS'}
                precision={order.currencyCode ? 2 : null}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.hLine} />
      <BottomSheetDetails
        openDetails={openDetails}
        setOpenDetails={setOpenDetails}
        order={order}
        type={type}
      />
    </div>
  );
});

OrderItem.displayName = 'OrderItem';

export default OrderItem;

import React from 'react';

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import { DatePicker } from '@aurora/components';

import { IOrdersHistoryDates } from 'types/orderHistory';

import { SET_MONTH, defaultFilters } from '../../constants';
import {
  getDatePickerFormat,
  getFilterDateFormat,
  getYearFromJSDate,
  toJsDate,
} from '../../helpers';
import { INonTradeOrderHistory, PeriodTypes } from '../../types';
import CommonHeadSheet from '../CommonHeadSheet';
import styles from './PeriodBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type PeriodBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  allFilters: INonTradeOrderHistory;
  setAllFilters: (filters: INonTradeOrderHistory) => void;
  selectPeriod: PeriodTypes;
  setSelectPeriod: (period: PeriodTypes) => void;
  orderDates: IOrdersHistoryDates;
  className?: string;
};

const PeriodBottomSheet: React.FC<PeriodBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  setOpen,
  allFilters,
  setAllFilters,
  selectPeriod,
  setSelectPeriod,
  orderDates,
  className,
}) => {
  const onDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setAllFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      dateFrom: defaultFilters.dateFrom,
      dateTo: defaultFilters.dateTo,
      rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
    });
    setSelectPeriod(SET_MONTH);
    onDismiss();
  };

  const handleSubmit = (dates: Date[]) => {
    const { startDate, endDate } = getFilterDateFormat(dates);
    setAllFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      dateFrom: startDate,
      dateTo: endDate,
      rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
    });
    onDismiss();
  };

  const datePickerFormat = useMemo(
    () => getDatePickerFormat(allFilters.dateFrom, allFilters.dateTo),
    [allFilters.dateFrom, allFilters.dateTo],
  );

  const yearFromJSDate = useMemo(() => getYearFromJSDate(allFilters.dateTo), [allFilters.dateTo]);

  return (
    <BottomSheetComponent
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      className={className}
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <CommonHeadSheet
          name={'Период'}
          handleSubmit={handleReset}
          activeBtn={selectPeriod !== SET_MONTH}
        />
      </div>
      <DatePicker
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        periodPreset
        dates={datePickerFormat}
        currentYear={yearFromJSDate}
        customOptionsPeriodPreset={['month', 'quarter', 'year', 'day']}
        onSetOptionPeriodPreset={(p) => setSelectPeriod(p)}
        defaultOptionPeriodPreset={selectPeriod}
        minDate={toJsDate(orderDates.minFromDate)}
      />
    </BottomSheetComponent>
  );
};

export default PeriodBottomSheet;

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import { Checkbox, SelectableCell } from '@aurora/components';
import Text from '@aurora/text';

import SvgHistoryIcon from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/SvgHistoryIcon';
import { getSortStatus } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import { useFilterBSH } from 'modules/OrderHistory/hooks/useFilterBSH';
import { OrderFiltersBottomSheetProps } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import CommonHeadSheet from '../CommonHeadSheet';
import styles from './StatusBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const StatusBottomSheet: React.FC<OrderFiltersBottomSheetProps> = ({
  open,
  setOpen,
  allFilters,
  setAllFilters,
  orderFilters = [],
  className,
}) => {
  const {
    handleSetSavedFilters,
    handleFilterSubmit,
    handleResetFilter,
    filters,
    handleSelectFilter,
    handleAllSelectFilter,
  } = useFilterBSH({ filterName: 'statusCode', orderFilters, allFilters, setAllFilters });

  const onDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    handleSetSavedFilters();
  };

  const sortStatus = useMemo(() => getSortStatus(orderFilters), [orderFilters]);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    handleFilterSubmit();
    onDismiss();
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheetComponent
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      className={className}
      header={
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <CommonHeadSheet
            name={'Статусы'}
            handleSubmit={handleResetFilter}
            activeBtn={filters.length !== 0}
          />
        </div>
      }
      footer={
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <Button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={filters.length === orderFilters.length}>
            <Text>Применить</Text>
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapperMain}>
        <SelectableCell
          addonRight={<Checkbox checked={filters.length === 0} onChange={handleAllSelectFilter} />}
          title={'Все статусы'}
          separator={false}
          variant={'filter'}
          iconLeft={<SvgHistoryIcon iconName={'all'} />}
        />
        {sortStatus.map((status) => (
          <SelectableCell
            key={status.code}
            addonRight={
              <Checkbox
                checked={!filters.includes(status.code)}
                onChange={() => handleSelectFilter(status.code)}
              />
            }
            separator={false}
            variant={'filter'}
            title={status.name}
            iconLeft={<SvgHistoryIcon iconName={status.code} />}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </BottomSheetComponent>
  );
};

export default StatusBottomSheet;

import React from 'react';

import {
  AllSvg,
  CanceledSvg,
  CrashedSvg,
  CurrentMonthSvg,
  DeclinedBySmevSvg,
  DeclinedSvg,
  DefaultSvg,
  ExpiredSvg,
  FailedSvg,
  ForPeriodSvg,
  FulfilledSvg,
  IduSvg,
  InWorkSvg,
  LockSvg,
  LoyaltySvg,
  MoneyRefillSvg,
  MoneySVG,
  MoneyTransferSvg,
  MoneyWithdrawalSvg,
  NotificationSvg,
  PersonApprovalSvg,
  PersonBankDetailsSvg,
  PersonContestSvg,
  PersonDOSSvg,
  PersonInvestDeductionSvg,
  PersonOriginalsSvg,
  PersonPersonProfileSvg,
  PersonW8Svg,
  PrerogativeRightSvg,
  ProductSvg,
  SecuritySvg,
  SecurityWriteOffSbpSvg,
  StructureOrderSvg,
  TServiceSvg,
  TerminalSvg,
  UnlockSvg,
} from 'images/raw-icons/history';

type SvgIconProps = {
  iconName: string;
  className?: string;
};

const icons: { [key: string]: React.FC } = {
  default: DefaultSvg,
  Notification: NotificationSvg,
  'Person.BankDetails': PersonBankDetailsSvg,
  'Person.Contest': PersonContestSvg,
  'Person.DOS': PersonDOSSvg,
  'Person.InvestDeduction': PersonInvestDeductionSvg,
  'Person.Originals': PersonOriginalsSvg,
  'Person.PersonProfile': PersonPersonProfileSvg,
  'Person.Qual.Order': LoyaltySvg,
  'Person.W8': PersonW8Svg,
  'Person.Loyalty': LoyaltySvg,
  Product: ProductSvg,
  'Structure.Order': StructureOrderSvg,
  TService: TServiceSvg,
  Terminal: TerminalSvg,
  CANCELED: CanceledSvg,
  COMPLETED: FulfilledSvg,
  CRASHED: CrashedSvg,
  DECLINED: DeclinedSvg,
  DECLINED_BY_SMEV: DeclinedBySmevSvg,
  EXPIRED: ExpiredSvg,
  FAILED: FailedSvg,
  PROCESSING: InWorkSvg,
  'Person.Categorization': PersonPersonProfileSvg,
  IDU: IduSvg,
  Refill: MoneyRefillSvg,
  Transfer: MoneyTransferSvg,
  Withdrawal: MoneyWithdrawalSvg,
  Lock: LockSvg,
  PrerogativeRight: PrerogativeRightSvg,
  Unlock: UnlockSvg,
  Money: MoneySVG,
  Security: SecuritySvg,
  WriteOffSBP: SecurityWriteOffSbpSvg,
  CurrentMonth: CurrentMonthSvg,
  ForPeriod: ForPeriodSvg,
  all: AllSvg,
  'Person.Approval': PersonApprovalSvg,
};

const SvgHistoryIcon: React.FC<SvgIconProps> = ({ iconName, className }) => {
  if (iconName.includes('Product')) {
    iconName = 'Product';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Profile')) {
    iconName = 'Person.PersonProfile';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Contest')) {
    iconName = 'Person.Contest';
  } else if (iconName.includes('InvestDeduction')) {
    iconName = 'Person.InvestDeduction';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Structure')) {
    iconName = 'Structure.Order';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Terminal')) {
    iconName = 'Terminal';
  } else if (iconName.includes('TService')) {
    iconName = 'TService';
  } else if (iconName.includes('BankDetails')) {
    iconName = 'Person.BankDetails';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Originals')) {
    iconName = 'Person.Originals';
  } else if (iconName.includes('WriteOffSBP')) {
    iconName = 'WriteOffSBP';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Refill')) {
    iconName = 'Refill';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Transfer')) {
    iconName = 'Transfer';
  } else if (iconName.includes('IDU')) {
    iconName = 'IDU';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Withdrawal')) {
    iconName = 'Withdrawal';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Qual.Order')) {
    iconName = 'Person.Qual.Order';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Notification')) {
    iconName = 'Notification';
  } else if (iconName.includes('Loyalty')) {
    iconName = 'Person.Loyalty';
  }
  const Icon = icons[iconName] ? icons[iconName] : DefaultSvg;
  return <Icon className={className} />;
};

export default SvgHistoryIcon;

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import {
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_ADMINISTRATIVE,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_NON_TRADE,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE,
} from 'const/routes';

import { TAB_ORDER_HISTORY } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';

const TabRedirect: React.FC = ({ children }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const tradeTab = pathname.includes(`/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE}`);
  const nontradeTab = pathname.includes(`/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_NON_TRADE}`);

  const defaultTab =
    localStorage.getItem(TAB_ORDER_HISTORY) || PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_ADMINISTRATIVE;

  const url = tradeTab
    ? PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE
    : nontradeTab
    ? PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_NON_TRADE
    : defaultTab;
  useEffect(() => {
    navigate(url);
  }, [navigate, url]);
  return <>{children}</>;
};

export default TabRedirect;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Text from '@aurora/text';

import { ITypes } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import { ReactComponent as IndicatorCheckedSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/indicator-checked.svg';

import { TAB_ORDER_HISTORY, administrativeType, nonTradeType } from '../../constants';
import styles from './TypeBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type TypeBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  type: ITypes;
};

const TypeBottomSheet: React.FC<TypeBottomSheetProps> = ({ open, setOpen, type }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [selectType, setSelectType] = useState(type.path);
  const onDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    setSelectType(type.path);
  };
  const handleSubmit = () => {
    onDismiss();
    localStorage.setItem(TAB_ORDER_HISTORY, selectType);
    navigate(`/history/tab/${selectType}`);
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectType(type.path);
  }, [type]);
  return (
    <BottomSheetComponent open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div>
          <Text type={'subtitleBold'}>Типы поручений</Text>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div className={styles.section}>
            <div
              className={styles.btnWrapper}
              onClick={() => setSelectType(administrativeType.path)}
            >
              <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{administrativeType.name}</Text>
              {selectType === administrativeType.path && <IndicatorCheckedSvg />}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.btnWrapper} onClick={() => setSelectType(nonTradeType.path)}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{nonTradeType.name}</Text>
              {selectType === nonTradeType.path && <IndicatorCheckedSvg />}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={handleSubmit}>
          <Text>Применить</Text>
        </Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheetComponent>
  );
};

export default TypeBottomSheet;

import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import {
  EVENT_PERIOD_DAY,
  EVENT_PERIOD_MONTH,
  EVENT_PERIOD_QUARTER,
  EVENT_PERIOD_YEAR,
} from 'core/orderHistory/constants';

import { capitalizeFirstLetter } from 'utils/string';

import { PeriodTypes } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

import { CheckedEventType, EventType } from 'types/eventHistory';
import { IOrdersHistoryType } from 'types/orderHistory';

export const orderDateReformat = (orderDate: string) => {
  const normalizeDate = DateTime.fromISO(orderDate);
  return `${normalizeDate.toLocaleString()} в ${normalizeDate.toFormat('HH:mm:ss')}`;
};

export const currentDate = () => DateTime.now().toLocaleString(DateTime.DATE_FULL);

const replacerKeyboardLayout: { [key: string]: string } = {
  q: 'й',
  w: 'ц',
  e: 'у',
  r: 'к',
  t: 'е',
  y: 'н',
  u: 'г',
  i: 'ш',
  o: 'щ',
  p: 'з',
  '[': 'х',
  ']': 'ъ',
  a: 'ф',
  s: 'ы',
  d: 'в',
  f: 'а',
  g: 'п',
  h: 'р',
  j: 'о',
  k: 'л',
  l: 'д',
  ';': 'ж',
  "'": 'э',
  z: 'я',
  x: 'ч',
  c: 'с',
  v: 'м',
  b: 'и',
  n: 'т',
  m: 'ь',
  ',': 'б',
  '.': 'ю',
  '/': '.',
};

export const getFilteredThemes = (arr: IOrdersHistoryType[], str: string) => {
  const sample =
    !/[a-z]/gi.test(str) || /w8?\b/gi.test(str)
      ? str
      : str
          .split('')
          .map((item) => replacerKeyboardLayout[item])
          .join('');
  return arr.filter((item) => {
    return item.name.toLowerCase().includes(sample.toLowerCase());
  });
};

export const getSortByCode = (arrSortable: IOrdersHistoryType[], arrSort: string[]) => {
  return [...arrSortable].sort((a, b) => {
    return arrSort.indexOf(a.code) - arrSort.indexOf(b.code);
  });
};

export const sortStatus = [
  'COMPLETED',
  'PROCESSING',
  'FAILED',
  'CANCELED',
  'CRASHED',
  'DECLINED',
  'DECLINED_BY_SMEV',
  'EXPIRED',
];
export const sortNonTradeActionTypes = [
  'Refill',
  'Transfer',
  'Withdrawal',
  'IDU',
  'Lock',
  'Unlock',
  'PrerogativeRight',
];

export const getSortStatus = (arr: IOrdersHistoryType[]) => getSortByCode(arr, sortStatus);
export const getSortNonTradeActionTypes = (arr: IOrdersHistoryType[]) =>
  getSortByCode(arr, sortNonTradeActionTypes);

export const getFilterText = (
  arr: IOrdersHistoryType[],
  filter: string,
  defaultText: string,
  prefix: string,
  multi: string,
) => {
  if (filter.split(',').length > 1) {
    return multi;
  }
  const text = arr.find((item) => item.code === filter && item)?.name;
  if (text) {
    return text.length > 20 ? `${prefix}: ${text.slice(0, 18)}...` : `${prefix}: ${text}`;
  }
  return defaultText;
};

export const toString = (num?: number) => String(num) || '';

const DATE_PERIOD_DAY = 'dd LLL yyyy';

export const getViewDataFormat = (date: string) =>
  DateTime.fromISO(date).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);

export const getDetailsDate = (date: string) =>
  DateTime.fromISO(date).toLocaleString(DateTime.DATE_FULL);

export const asyncSessionStorage = {
  setItem: function (key: string, value: string) {
    return Promise.resolve().then(function () {
      sessionStorage.setItem(key, value);
    });
  },
  getItem: function (key: string) {
    return Promise.resolve().then(function () {
      return sessionStorage.getItem(key);
    });
  },
};

export const getNameDate = (date: string, period: PeriodTypes) => {
  const initialDate = DateTime.fromISO(date);
  return period === EVENT_PERIOD_MONTH
    ? `${capitalizeFirstLetter(initialDate.monthLong)} ${initialDate.year}`
    : `Q${initialDate.quarter} ${initialDate.year}`;
};

export const getDatePickerFormat = (startDate: string, endDate: string) => [
  DateTime.fromISO(startDate).toJSDate(),
  DateTime.fromISO(endDate).toJSDate(),
];

export const getFilterDateFormat = (dates: Date[]) => {
  const startDate = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[0], { zone: 'local' }).toFormat(
    DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT,
  );
  const endDate = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[1], { zone: 'local' }).toFormat(
    DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT,
  );
  return {
    startDate,
    endDate,
  };
};

export const getYearFromJSDate = (date: string) => DateTime.fromISO(date).year;

export const getFilterEventTypes = (
  eventTypes: EventType[],
  notSelectedEventTypes: CheckedEventType,
) =>
  eventTypes
    .reduce((acc: string[], item) => {
      if (notSelectedEventTypes[item.eventTypeCode] !== false) {
        acc = [...acc, item.eventTypeCode];
      }
      return acc;
    }, [])
    .join(',');

export const getNameEventFilter = (
  eventTypes: EventType[],
  eventTypesNotChecked: CheckedEventType | null,
) => {
  if (!eventTypesNotChecked) {
    return { name: 'Все события' };
  }
  const events = eventTypes.filter((item) => eventTypesNotChecked[item.eventTypeCode] !== false);
  return events.length === 1
    ? { name: events[0].eventTypeName, active: true }
    : {
        name: 'События',
        count: events.length,
        active: true,
      };
};

export const getEventDetailDate = (date: string) => {
  const normalDate = DateTime.fromISO(date);
  return {
    date: normalDate.toFormat('dd MMMM yyyy'),
    time: normalDate.toFormat('HH:mm'),
    utc: normalDate.toFormat('ZZ'),
  };
};

export const getNTPDateName = (dateStart: string, dateEnd: string, period: PeriodTypes) => {
  const initialStartDate = DateTime.fromISO(dateStart);
  const initialEndDate = DateTime.fromISO(dateEnd);
  const defaultName = `${capitalizeFirstLetter(initialStartDate.monthLong)} ${
    initialStartDate.year
  }`;
  switch (period) {
    case EVENT_PERIOD_MONTH:
      return defaultName;
    case EVENT_PERIOD_QUARTER:
      return `Q${initialStartDate.quarter} ${initialStartDate.year}`;
    case EVENT_PERIOD_YEAR:
      return `${initialStartDate.year} год`;
    case EVENT_PERIOD_DAY:
      return `${initialStartDate.toFormat(DATE_PERIOD_DAY)} - ${initialEndDate.toFormat(
        DATE_PERIOD_DAY,
      )}`;
    default:
      return defaultName;
  }
};

export const toJsDate = (date: string) => DateTime.fromISO(date).toJSDate();

export const getMismatchedKeys = (arrAllKey: string[], arr: string[]) =>
  arrAllKey.filter((key) => !arr.includes(key));

export const getKeyArr = (arr: IOrdersHistoryType[]) =>
  arr.reduce((acc: string[], item) => [...acc, item.code], []);

import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

export const getStartEndOfMonth = (year?: number, month?: number) => {
  let initialDate = DateTime.now();
  if (month) {
    initialDate = initialDate.set({ month });
  }
  if (year) {
    initialDate = initialDate.set({ year });
  }
  const startDate = initialDate.startOf('month').toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);
  const endDate = initialDate.endOf('month').toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);
  const numberYear = initialDate.year;
  const dates = [initialDate.startOf('month').toJSDate(), initialDate.endOf('month').toJSDate()];
  return {
    startDate,
    endDate,
    numberYear,
    dates,
  };
};

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { defaultFilters } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import { getKeyArr, getMismatchedKeys } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import { useFilterBSHType } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

export const useFilterBSH = ({
  filterName,
  orderFilters,
  allFilters,
  setAllFilters,
}: useFilterBSHType) => {
  const getAllStatusChecked = useMemo(() => getKeyArr(orderFilters), [orderFilters]);

  const savedFilters =
    allFilters[filterName].length > 0
      ? getMismatchedKeys(getAllStatusChecked, allFilters[filterName].split(','))
      : [];

  const [filters, setFilter] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const handleSelectFilter = (code: string) => {
    if (filters.includes(code)) {
      setFilter((prevState) => prevState.filter((item) => item !== code));
    } else {
      setFilter([...filters, code]);
    }
  };

  const handleAllSelectFilter = () => {
    if (filters.length > 1) {
      setFilter([]);
    } else {
      setFilter(getAllStatusChecked);
    }
  };

  const handleResetFilter = () => setFilter([]);

  const handleSetSavedFilters = () => setFilter(savedFilters);

  const handleFilterSubmit = () => {
    const getStatusFilter = getMismatchedKeys(getAllStatusChecked, filters);
    setAllFilters({
      ...allFilters,
      [filterName]: filters.length > 0 ? getStatusFilter.join(',') : '',
      rowsOffset: defaultFilters.rowsOffset,
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    handleSetSavedFilters();
  }, [allFilters[filterName]]); //eslint-disable-line

  const init = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!init.current && orderFilters.length) {
      init.current = true;
      const codes = allFilters[filterName].split(',').filter(Boolean);
      if (!codes.length) return;
      setFilter(orderFilters.filter((of) => !codes.includes(of.code)).map((of) => of.code));
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [orderFilters]);

  return {
    handleSetSavedFilters,
    handleFilterSubmit,
    handleResetFilter,
    filters,
    handleSelectFilter,
    handleAllSelectFilter,
  };
};

import { useContext, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB, ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY } from 'const/routes';

import { FilterContext } from 'modules/OrderHistory/OrderHistoryWrapper';
import { BLOCKED } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import { asyncSessionStorage } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import { ITypes } from 'modules/OrderHistory/types';

export const useFirstRedirectWhenBlockedPermission = (
  negativePermission: boolean,
  type: ITypes,
) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { permissionNonTrade, permissionAdministrative, errorPermission } =
    useContext(FilterContext) ?? {};

  const defineSessionBlockedKey = async (key: string) =>
    await asyncSessionStorage.setItem(`${BLOCKED}${key}`, key);

  const whenBlockedPermission = async (key: string, path: string, altFullPath: string) =>
    await asyncSessionStorage.getItem(key).then((item) => {
      permissionNonTrade && defineSessionBlockedKey(permissionNonTrade);
      permissionAdministrative && defineSessionBlockedKey(permissionAdministrative);
      return item === path ? null : navigate(altFullPath);
    });

  useEffect(() => {
    negativePermission &&
      whenBlockedPermission(
        BLOCKED + type.path,
        type.path,
        `${ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY}/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB}/${type.altPath}`,
      );
  }, []); //eslint-disable-line

  const lockFilters = !((permissionNonTrade && permissionAdministrative) || errorPermission);

  return { lockFilters, errorPermission };
};

import { FC, createContext, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import {
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_EVENT_FEED,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_ADMINISTRATIVE,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_NON_TRADE,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE,
  ROUTE_360,
  ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY,
} from 'const/routes';

import { useGetProductsQuery } from 'core/api/orderHistory';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import { SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components/Tabs';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ArrowSmallDownSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/history/miniArrowDown.svg';

import styles from './OrderHistoryWrapper.module.pcss';
import AccountsBottomSheet from './components/AccountsBottomSheet';
import {
  COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS,
  PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_ADMINISTRATIVE,
  PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_NONTRADE,
  defaultFilters,
} from './constants';
import { IFilterContext } from './types';

const tabs = [
  { name: 'События', link: `${ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY}/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_EVENT_FEED}` },
  { name: 'Неторговые', link: `${ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY}/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB}` },
];

export const FilterContext = createContext<IFilterContext>(null);

const OrderHistoryWrapper: FC = ({ children }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();

  const isTrade = pathname.includes(`/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE}`);

  const { data: { products: p = [] } = {} } = useGetProductsQuery({
    showVirtual: false,
    showUK: false,
  });

  const [productId, setProductId] = useState<string>(
    (sessionStorage[COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS] &&
      JSON.parse(sessionStorage[COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS])?.product_Id) ||
      defaultFilters.product_Id,
  );
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const activeTab = pathname.includes(PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB) ? 1 : 0;
  const products = isTrade ? p.filter((item) => !(item.isModel || item.isStructure)) : p;
  const errorPermission = Permissions.getStatus() === 'error';
  const headerTitle = isTrade ? 'Заявки' : 'История';

  const productItem = useMemo(() => {
    return products.find((item) => String(item.productId) === productId);
  }, [productId, products]);

  const currentAccount = () => {
    const num = productItem?.accountNo;
    return num ? `По счёту ${num}` : 'Все счета';
  };

  const productIdForContext = useMemo(() => {
    return !productItem ? '' : productId;
  }, [productItem, productId]);

  const permissionAdministrative = () => {
    if (
      Permissions.denied(PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_ADMINISTRATIVE) ||
      Permissions.blocked(PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_ADMINISTRATIVE)
    ) {
      return PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_ADMINISTRATIVE;
    }
  };

  const permissionNonTrade = () => {
    if (
      Permissions.denied(PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_NONTRADE) ||
      Permissions.blocked(PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_NONTRADE)
    ) {
      return PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_NON_TRADE;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.orderHistoryWrapper}>
      <HeaderPage title={headerTitle}>
        <header className={styles.wrapper}>
          <div className={styles.center}>
            <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>{headerTitle}</Text>
            <div className={styles.left} onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_360)}>
              <BackSvg />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.bottom}>
              <div className={styles.withArrow} onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
                <Text type={'labelMedium'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                  {currentAccount()}
                </Text>
                <ArrowSmallDownSvg />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </header>
      </HeaderPage>
      {!isTrade ? (
        <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
          activeTab={activeTab}
          tabs={tabs}
          classNameWrapper={styles.tabsWrapper}
          classNameContent={styles.tabsContent}
        >
          <FilterContext.Provider
            value={{
              productId,
              permissionNonTrade: permissionNonTrade() || '',
              permissionAdministrative: permissionAdministrative() || '',
              errorPermission,
            }}
          >
            {children}
          </FilterContext.Provider>
        </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
      ) : (
        <FilterContext.Provider value={{ productId: productIdForContext }}>
          {children}
        </FilterContext.Provider>
      )}
      <AccountsBottomSheet
        open={open}
        setOpen={setOpen}
        productId={productId}
        setProductId={setProductId}
        data={products}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default OrderHistoryWrapper;

import {
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_ADMINISTRATIVE,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_NON_TRADE,
} from 'const/routes';

import { IOrderHistoryCommon, IOrdersHistoryDates, IOrdersHistoryType } from 'types/orderHistory';

export type ISort = 'StatusCode-' | 'StatusCode+' | 'OrderDate-' | 'OrderDate+';

export type IAssetTypeCode = 'Money' | 'Security' | '';

export type INonTradeOrderHistory = {
  orderBy: ISort;
  actionTypeCode: string;
  statusCode: string;
  rowsOffset: number;
  dateFrom: string;
  dateTo: string;
  rowsCount?: number;
  date?: string;
  product_Id?: string;
  assetTypeCode: IAssetTypeCode;
};

export type IOnlyGuid = { order_guid: string };

type IPathOrderHistoryTab =
  | typeof PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_ADMINISTRATIVE
  | typeof PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_NON_TRADE;

export type ITypes = {
  name: 'Административные' | 'Зачисления и переводы';
  path: IPathOrderHistoryTab;
  altPath: IPathOrderHistoryTab;
};

export type PeriodTypes = 'month' | 'quarter' | 'year' | 'day';

export type ICommonNonTradeProps = {
  type: ITypes;
  allFilters: INonTradeOrderHistory;
  setAllFilters: (allFilters: INonTradeOrderHistory) => void;
  dataOrders: IOrderHistoryCommon[];
  isFetching: boolean;
  error: unknown;
  actionTypes: IOrdersHistoryType[];
  ordersStatus: IOrdersHistoryType[];
  defaultRowCount: number;
  selectPeriod: PeriodTypes;
  setSelectPeriod: (period: PeriodTypes) => void;
  ordersHistoryDates: IOrdersHistoryDates;
  errorHideFilters: unknown;
  assetTypes?: IOrdersHistoryType[];
  negativePermission: boolean;
  refetch: () => void;
};

export type IFilterContext = {
  productId: string;
  permissionAdministrative?: string;
  permissionNonTrade?: string;
  errorPermission?: boolean;
} | null;

export type OrderFiltersBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  allFilters: INonTradeOrderHistory;
  setAllFilters: (filters: INonTradeOrderHistory) => void;
  orderFilters: IOrdersHistoryType[];
  type?: ITypes;
  className?: string;
};

export type useFilterBSHType = {
  filterName: 'statusCode' | 'actionTypeCode';
  orderFilters: IOrdersHistoryType[];
  allFilters: INonTradeOrderHistory;
  setAllFilters: (filters: INonTradeOrderHistory) => void;
};
