import React, { ChangeEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import {
  BannerWarningLine,
  Button,
  CircleLoader,
  Input,
  Text,
  useSnackbars,
} from '@aurora/components';
import { MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES } from 'const/messages';

import {
  useCancelFormDraftMutation,
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useLazyGetFormDraftQuery,
  useSaveFormDraftMutation,
  useSaveFormINNMutation,
} from 'core/api/personalData';

import { INN_LENGTH, getIsPersonProfileEdit } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/constants';
import {
  changeCurrentSectorStatus,
  getSectorsWithErrors,
  notZeros,
  sanitizeString,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import defaultIcon from 'images/icons/defaultSnackBar.png';
import { ReactComponent as InfoBadgeIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/bannerInfoBadge.svg';

import styles from './additionalDocuments.module.pcss';
import { ADDOCS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES } from './constant';
import { AdditionalDocumentsProps } from './types';

const AdditionalDocuments: React.FC<AdditionalDocumentsProps> = ({
  goBack,
  startInn,
  startSnils,
  requestGuid,
  disabled,
  isNonResident,
  errorText,
  setPersonalSectors,
  personalSectors,
  sectorErrorsFromCheck,
}) => {
  const isPersonProfileEdit = getIsPersonProfileEdit();

  const { snackbarInfo, snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();

  const [innInputError, setInnInputError] = useState(
    sectorErrorsFromCheck.find((item) => item.errorCode === 'INN')?.shortMessage || '',
  );
  const [snilsInputError, setSnilsInputError] = useState(
    sectorErrorsFromCheck.find((item) => item.errorCode === 'SNILS')?.shortMessage || '',
  );

  const [cancelForm] = useCancelFormDraftMutation();

  const [saveINN, { isError: isSaveInnError, isLoading: isInnLoading }] = useSaveFormINNMutation();
  const [
    checkForm,
    { isError: isCheckFormError, isLoading: isCheckFormLoading, isFetching: isCheckFormFetching },
  ] = useLazyCheckFormQuery();

  const [
    getFormDraft,
    { data: formDraft, isLoading: isFormDraftLoading, isFetching: isFormDraftFetching },
  ] = useLazyGetFormDraftQuery();

  const [saveFormDraft, { isError: isSaveFormDraftDataError }] = useSaveFormDraftMutation();

  const [snilsValue, setSnilsValue] = useState(startSnils || '');
  const [innValue, setInnValue] = useState(startInn || '');

  const [isInnChanged, setIsInnChanged] = useState(false);
  const errorsInFields = !!(innInputError || snilsInputError);
  const innIsInvalid = useMemo(
    () => innValue.length < INN_LENGTH && innValue?.length !== 0,
    [innValue],
  );
  const isSaveDisabled = useMemo(
    () => innIsInvalid || disabled || !isPersonProfileEdit || errorsInFields || !isInnChanged,
    [disabled, errorsInFields, innIsInvalid, isInnChanged, isPersonProfileEdit],
  );

  const isSnackBarError = isSaveInnError || isCheckFormError || isSaveFormDraftDataError;

  const saveConfirmFormDraft = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await saveFormDraft({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
      setSnilsInputError('');
      setInnInputError('');
      setPersonalSectors((oldSectors) =>
        oldSectors ? changeCurrentSectorStatus(oldSectors, 'AdditionalDocuments') : oldSectors,
      );
      goBack();
    } catch {
      cancelForm({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [cancelForm, goBack, requestGuid, saveFormDraft, setPersonalSectors]);

  const onAdditionalDocumentsSave = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!startInn && innValue.length === INN_LENGTH && requestGuid) {
      try {
        await saveINN({ requestGuid, INN: innValue }).unwrap();
        const checkFormResult = await checkForm({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
        setPersonalSectors((oldSectors) =>
          oldSectors ? getSectorsWithErrors(checkFormResult, oldSectors) : oldSectors,
        );
        const isCurrentSectorError = checkFormResult?.find((item) =>
          ADDOCS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(item.fieldCode),
        );

        if (isCurrentSectorError) {
          const snilsError = checkFormResult?.find((item) => item.fieldCode === 'SNILS');
          const innError = checkFormResult?.find((item) => item.fieldCode === 'INN');

          setSnilsInputError(snilsError?.shortMessage || '');
          setInnInputError(innError?.shortMessage || '');
        } else {
          await saveConfirmFormDraft();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        cancelForm({ requestGuid });
      }
    }
  }, [
    cancelForm,
    checkForm,
    innValue,
    requestGuid,
    saveConfirmFormDraft,
    saveINN,
    setPersonalSectors,
    startInn,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (formDraft) {
      setSnilsValue(formDraft?.personIdentity[0].snils);
      setInnValue(formDraft?.personIdentity[0].inn);
    }
  }, [formDraft]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (requestGuid && personalSectors.AdditionalDocuments === 'changed') {
      getFormDraft({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [getFormDraft, personalSectors.AdditionalDocuments, requestGuid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSnackBarError) return;

    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 5000,
      label: MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES,
      variant: 'primary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [isSnackBarError, snackbarTopAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(disabled && errorText)) return;
    const id = snackbarInfo?.show({
      autoClose: 5000,
      caption: <span>{errorText}</span>,
      variant: 'primary',
      icon: <img style={{ width: '40px' }} src={defaultIcon} alt="snackBarImage" />,
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarInfo?.close(id);
    };
  }, [disabled, errorText, snackbarInfo]);

  const onInnInputBlur = useCallback(() => {
    const length = sanitizeString(innValue).length;
    if (length < INN_LENGTH && length !== 0) {
      setInnInputError('ИНН должен состоять из 12 цифр');
    } else if (length === INN_LENGTH && !notZeros(innValue)) {
      setInnInputError('ИНН не может состоять из одних нулей');
    } else setInnInputError('');
  }, [innValue]);

  const onInnInputChange = useCallback(
    (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const oldInnValue = sanitizeString(startInn || '');
      const newInnValue = sanitizeString(e.target.value);
      setInnInputError('');
      setInnValue(newInnValue);
      setIsInnChanged(newInnValue !== oldInnValue);
    },
    [startInn],
  );

  if (
    isFormDraftLoading ||
    isFormDraftFetching ||
    isInnLoading ||
    isCheckFormLoading ||
    isCheckFormFetching
  ) {
    return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="Редактирование данных" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text type={'title'} className={styles.title}>
            Дополнительные документы
          </Text>
          <Input
            label="ИНН в стране гражданства"
            onBlur={onInnInputBlur}
            placeholder="000000000000"
            className={styles.input}
            value={innValue}
            onChange={onInnInputChange}
            mask="999999999999"
            disabled={disabled || !!startInn || isNonResident}
            status={innInputError ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={innInputError}
          />
          <Input
            label="СНИЛС"
            placeholder="000 000 000 00"
            className={styles.input}
            value={snilsValue}
            mask="999 999 999 99"
            disabled
            status={snilsInputError ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={snilsInputError}
          />
        </div>

        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          {!!startInn && (
            <BannerWarningLine
              addonLeft={<InfoBadgeIcon />}
              title="Для изменения номеров ИНН и СНИЛС обратитесь в офис Инвестиционной палаты"
              className={styles.banner}
            />
          )}
          <Button onClick={onAdditionalDocumentsSave} disabled={isSaveDisabled}>
            Сохранить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default AdditionalDocuments;

import { RequestErrorList } from 'types/personalData';

export type AdditionalDocumentsProps = {

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useReducer, useState } from 'react';

import {
  BannerWarningLine,
  BottomSheet,
  Button,
  ButtonBar,
  Checkbox,
  CircleLoader,
  DatePicker,
  Input,
  Text,
  useSnackbars,
} from '@aurora/components';
import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import {
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useLazyGetFormDraftQuery,
  useLazyGetKladrValueQuery,
} from 'core/api/personalData';

import { addressReducer } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as Calendar } from 'images/icons/calendarI.svg';
import defaultIcon from 'images/icons/defaultSnackBar.png';
import { ReactComponent as AddressReload } from 'images/raw-icons/addressReload.svg';
import { ReactComponent as Check } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';
import { ReactComponent as InfoBadgeIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/orangeBadgeIcon.svg';
import { ReactComponent as RedBucket } from 'images/raw-icons/redBucket.svg';

import RegistrationForm from './RegistrationForm';
import styles from './address.module.pcss';
import { initAddressState } from './const';
import { expiryDateFormatter, getCurrentPostAddress } from './helper';
import useFormSave from './hooks/useFormSave';
import { useGetInitialAddress } from './hooks/useGetInitialAddress';
import { useIsAddressDataChanged } from './hooks/useIsAddressDataChanged';
import { AddressTypeProps, PersonAddressType } from './types';

const Address: React.FC<AddressTypeProps> = ({
  goBack,
  personAddress,
  requestGuid,
  disabled,
  isNonResident,
  errorText,
  setPersonalSectors,
  personalSectors,
}) => {
  const { snackbarInfo } = useSnackbars();
  const [getFormDraft, { data: formDraft, isError: isFormDraftError }] = useLazyGetFormDraftQuery();
  const [checkForm, { data: checkFormDraft, fulfilledTimeStamp }] = useLazyCheckFormQuery();
  const [getKladrAddress, { data: kladrAddressData }] = useLazyGetKladrValueQuery();
  const [getKladrRegion, { data: kladrRegionData }] = useLazyGetKladrValueQuery();
  const [registrationBS, setRegistrationBS] = useState(false);
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(addressReducer, initAddressState);

  const [registrationAddressFromKladr, setRegistrationAddressFromKladr] = useState(true);
  const [regionFromKladr, setRegionFromKladr] = useState(true);

  const [livingAddressFromKladr, setLivingAddressFromKladr] = useState(true);
  const [livingRegionFromKladr, setLivingRegionFromKladr] = useState(true);

  const isAddressReady = (
    addressFromKladr: boolean,
    regionFromKladrFlag: boolean,
    region: string,
  ) => addressFromKladr || (regionFromKladrFlag && region.trim().length >= 3);

  const dataFromKladr =
    isAddressReady(
      registrationAddressFromKladr,
      regionFromKladr,
      state.registrationNewData.region,
    ) &&
    (state.livingAddressIsSame ||
      isAddressReady(livingAddressFromKladr, livingRegionFromKladr, state.livingNewData.region));

  const [bottomSheetOpen, setBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const prevPostAddress = state.registrationIsPostalOld === state.livingIsPostalOld;
  const [postAddressBsOpen, setPostAddressBsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isLivingAddressSame, setIsLivingAddressSame] = useState(
    state.registrationIsPostalNew === state.livingIsPostalNew,
  );
  const [expiryDateErrorMessage, setExpiryDateErrorMessage] = useState('');

  const isRegError = useMemo(
    () =>
      state.registrationNewData.postIndex?.length < 6 ||
      (state.registrationNewData.region?.length < 3 &&
        state.registrationNewData.addressString?.length < 3) ||
      (state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'additional' &&
        !state.registrationNewData.expiryDate),
    [
      state.registrationNewData.addressString?.length,
      state.registrationNewData.expiryDate,
      state.registrationNewData.postIndex?.length,
      state.registrationNewData.region?.length,
      state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration,
    ],
  );
  const isLivingError = useMemo(
    () =>
      state.livingNewData.postIndex?.length < 6 ||
      (state.livingNewData.region?.length < 3 && state.livingNewData.addressString?.length < 3),
    [
      state.livingNewData.addressString?.length,
      state.livingNewData.postIndex?.length,
      state.livingNewData.region?.length,
    ],
  );

  //** Дата временной регистрации должна быть больше текущей даты */
  const minExpiryDate = useMemo(() => {
    return DateTime.now().plus({ days: 1 }).set({ hour: 0, minute: 0, second: 0, millisecond: 0 });
  }, []);
  //** Разница между датой временной регистрации и текущей датой должна быть не более 5 лет */
  const maxExpiryDate = useMemo(() => {
    return DateTime.now().plus({ years: 5 }).set({ hour: 0, minute: 0, second: 0, millisecond: 0 });
  }, []);

  const onDateSubmit = useCallback(
    (e: Date[]) => {
      const currentDate = e[0];
      if (!currentDate) return;

      const newExpiryDate = DateTime.local(
        currentDate.getFullYear(),
        currentDate.getMonth() + 1,
        currentDate.getDate(),
      ).set({ hour: 0, minute: 0, second: 0, millisecond: 0 });

      setState({
        registrationNewData: {
          ...state.registrationNewData,
          expiryDate: newExpiryDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT),
        },
      });

      if (newExpiryDate < minExpiryDate) {
        setExpiryDateErrorMessage('Дата окончания срока действия должна быть больше текущей даты');
      } else if (newExpiryDate > maxExpiryDate) {
        setExpiryDateErrorMessage(
          'Дата окончания срока действия должна быть не больше 5 лет от текущей даты',
        );
      } else {
        setExpiryDateErrorMessage('');
      }

      setRegistrationBS(false);
    },
    [maxExpiryDate, minExpiryDate, state.registrationNewData],
  );

  const [currentPostAddress, setCurrentPostAddress] = useState('');
  const addressesSource = formDraft?.personAddress?.length
    ? formDraft.personAddress
    : personAddress;
  const mainRegistrationAddress = useMemo(
    () =>
      addressesSource?.find((item: PersonAddressType) => item.addressTypeCode === 'REG_ADDRESS'),
    [addressesSource],
  );
  const tempRegistrationAddress = useMemo(
    () =>
      addressesSource?.find((item: PersonAddressType) => item.addressTypeCode === 'TEMP_ADDRESS'),
    [addressesSource],
  );

  const [hasBothRegistrationTypes, setHasBothRegistrationTypes] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mainRegistrationAddress && tempRegistrationAddress) {
      setHasBothRegistrationTypes(true);
    }
  }, [mainRegistrationAddress, tempRegistrationAddress]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const postAddress = getCurrentPostAddress(state);
    setCurrentPostAddress(postAddress);
  }, [state]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!requestGuid) return;
    getFormDraft({ requestGuid: requestGuid });
  }, [getFormDraft, requestGuid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!requestGuid || personalSectors?.Address !== 'error') return;
    checkForm({ requestGuid });
  }, [checkForm, personalSectors?.Address, requestGuid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!checkFormDraft) return;
    const expiryError = checkFormDraft.find(
      (item) =>
        item.errorCode === 'PersonProfile.TempExpire' ||
        /expire|expiry|enddate/i.test(item.fieldCode || '') ||
        /expire|expiry|enddate/i.test(item.errorCode || ''),
    );
    setExpiryDateErrorMessage(expiryError?.fullMessage || expiryError?.shortMessage || '');
  }, [checkFormDraft, fulfilledTimeStamp]);

  useGetInitialAddress(formDraft, isFormDraftError, personAddress, setState);
  const { isLivingDataChanged, isRegDataChanged, isPostalAddressChanged } =
    useIsAddressDataChanged(state);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.registrationNewData.addressString === state.registrationOldData.addressString) return;
    if (state.registrationNewData.addressString.length < 3) return;
    getKladrAddress({ query: state.registrationNewData.addressString });
  }, [
    getKladrAddress,
    state.registrationNewData.addressString,
    state.registrationOldData.addressString,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (registrationAddressFromKladr) return;
    if (state.registrationNewData.region.length < 3) return;
    getKladrRegion({ query: state.registrationNewData.region, typeFilter: 'region' });
  }, [getKladrRegion, registrationAddressFromKladr, state.registrationNewData.region]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.livingNewData.addressString === state.livingOldData.addressString) return;
    if (state.livingNewData.addressString.length < 3) return;
    getKladrAddress({ query: state.livingNewData.addressString });
  }, [getKladrAddress, state.livingNewData.addressString, state.livingOldData.addressString]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (state.livingAddressIsSame || livingAddressFromKladr) return;
    if (state.livingNewData.region.length < 3) return;
    getKladrRegion({ query: state.livingNewData.region, typeFilter: 'region' });
  }, [
    getKladrRegion,
    livingAddressFromKladr,
    state.livingAddressIsSame,
    state.livingNewData.region,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(disabled && errorText)) return;
    const id = snackbarInfo?.show({
      autoClose: 5000,
      caption: <span>{errorText}</span>,
      variant: 'primary',
      icon: <img style={{ width: '40px' }} src={defaultIcon} alt="snackBarImage" />,
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarInfo?.close(id);
    };
  }, [disabled, errorText, snackbarInfo]);

  const { saveData, isSaving } = useFormSave(
    requestGuid,
    personalSectors,
    setPersonalSectors,
    goBack,
    state,
    {
      registrationAddressFromKladr,
      livingAddressFromKladr,
    },
  );

  const postAddress = useMemo(() => {
    const addressGroup =
      isLivingAddressSame ||
      state.registrationNewData.addressString === state.livingNewData.addressString
        ? [state.registrationNewData.addressString]
        : [state.registrationNewData.addressString, state.livingNewData.addressString];

    return addressGroup?.map((item) => (
      <div
        onClick={() => {
          setState({
            livingIsPostalNew: item === state.livingNewData.addressString,
            registrationIsPostalNew: item === state.registrationNewData.addressString,
          });
          setPostAddressBsOpen(false);
        }}
        key={item}
      >
        <div className={styles.changeRiskGroupItem}>
          <span>{item}</span>
          {item === currentPostAddress && <Check />}
        </div>
      </div>
    ));
  }, [currentPostAddress, isLivingAddressSame, state.livingNewData, state.registrationNewData]);

  const isDisabled =
    isRegError ||
    (state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'additional' &&
      Boolean(expiryDateErrorMessage)) ||
    (isLivingError && !state.livingAddressIsSame) ||
    disabled ||
    !(
      isLivingDataChanged ||
      isRegDataChanged ||
      isPostalAddressChanged ||
      !(prevPostAddress === isLivingAddressSame)
    ) ||
    !dataFromKladr;

  const conflictPostalAddress =
    addressesSource?.find((item) => item.isPostal === 'Y')?.addressString || '';
  const postAddressValue = currentPostAddress || conflictPostalAddress;
  const isSaveBlockedByRegistrationConflict = hasBothRegistrationTypes;
  const isRegistrationEditBlocked = disabled || Boolean(isNonResident);
  const isOtherAddressEditBlocked = disabled;

  if (isSaving) {
    return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;
  }
  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="Редактирование данных" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />

      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text type={'title'} className={styles.title}>
            Адреса
          </Text>
          <div className={styles.contentTitle}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
              Адрес постоянной регистрации
            </Text>
            {state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'main' ? (
              <div
                onClick={() => {
                  if (isRegistrationEditBlocked) return;
                  setState({
                    registrationNewData: {
                      ...state.registrationNewData,
                      addressString: '',
                      postIndex: '',
                      region: '',
                    },
                  });
                  setExpiryDateErrorMessage('');
                  setRegistrationAddressFromKladr(false);
                }}
              >
                <RedBucket
                  style={{
                    opacity: isRegistrationEditBlocked ? 0.4 : 1,
                    pointerEvents: isRegistrationEditBlocked ? 'none' : 'auto',
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div onClick={() => !isRegistrationEditBlocked && setBottomSheetOpen(true)}>
                <AddressReload
                  style={{
                    opacity: isRegistrationEditBlocked ? 0.4 : 1,
                    pointerEvents: isRegistrationEditBlocked ? 'none' : 'auto',
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'main' && (
            <RegistrationForm
              state={state}
              setState={setState}
              addressFromKladr={registrationAddressFromKladr}
              setAddressFromKladr={setRegistrationAddressFromKladr}
              kladrData={kladrAddressData}
              kladrRegionData={kladrRegionData}
              regionFromKladr={regionFromKladr}
              setRegionFromKladr={setRegionFromKladr}
              disabled={isRegistrationEditBlocked}
              stateType="registrationNewData"
              oldStateType="registrationOldData"
            />
          )}

          <div className={styles.spacer} />
          <div className={styles.contentTitle}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
              Адрес временной регистрации
            </Text>
            {state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'additional' ? (
              <div
                onClick={() => {
                  if (isRegistrationEditBlocked) return;
                  setState({
                    registrationNewData: {
                      ...state.registrationNewData,
                      expiryDate: '',
                      addressString: '',
                      postIndex: '',
                      region: '',
                    },
                  });
                  setRegistrationAddressFromKladr(false);
                }}
              >
                <RedBucket
                  style={{
                    opacity: isRegistrationEditBlocked ? 0.4 : 1,
                    pointerEvents: isRegistrationEditBlocked ? 'none' : 'auto',
                  }}
                />{' '}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                onClick={() => {
                  if (isRegistrationEditBlocked) return;
                  setBottomSheetOpen(true);
                }}
              >
                <AddressReload
                  style={{
                    opacity: isRegistrationEditBlocked ? 0.4 : 1,
                    pointerEvents: isRegistrationEditBlocked ? 'none' : 'auto',
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'additional' && (
            <>
              <RegistrationForm
                state={state}
                setState={setState}
                addressFromKladr={registrationAddressFromKladr}
                setAddressFromKladr={setRegistrationAddressFromKladr}
                kladrData={kladrAddressData}
                kladrRegionData={kladrRegionData}
                regionFromKladr={regionFromKladr}
                setRegionFromKladr={setRegionFromKladr}
                disabled={isRegistrationEditBlocked}
                stateType="registrationNewData"
                oldStateType="registrationOldData"
              />
              <Input
                label="Окончание срока действия"
                value={expiryDateFormatter(state.registrationNewData.expiryDate || '')}
                className={styles.input}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (!isRegistrationEditBlocked) setRegistrationBS(true);
                }}
                description={
                  expiryDateErrorMessage ||
                  (state.registrationNewData.expiryDate ? '' : 'Поле должно быть заполнено')
                }
                status={
                  expiryDateErrorMessage || !state.registrationNewData.expiryDate
                    ? 'error'
                    : undefined
                }
                addonAfter={<Calendar />}
                disabled={isRegistrationEditBlocked}
              />
            </>
          )}
          {state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'main' && hasBothRegistrationTypes && (
            <>
              <Input
                value={tempRegistrationAddress?.addressString || ''}
                className={styles.input}
                disabled
                placeholder="Заполните адрес"
              />
              <Input
                label="Индекс"
                value={tempRegistrationAddress?.postIndex || ''}
                className={styles.input}
                disabled
              />
            </>
          )}

          <div className={styles.spacer} />
          <div className={styles.contentTitle}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
              Адрес пребывания
            </Text>
            <div
              onClick={() =>
                !isOtherAddressEditBlocked &&
                setState({ livingNewData: { ...state.livingNewData, addressString: '' } })
              }
            >
              <RedBucket
                style={{
                  opacity: isOtherAddressEditBlocked ? 0.4 : 1,
                  pointerEvents: isOtherAddressEditBlocked ? 'none' : 'auto',
                }}
              />{' '}
            </div>
          </div>
          <Checkbox
            checked={isLivingAddressSame}
            onChange={() => {
              if (isOtherAddressEditBlocked) return;
              setIsLivingAddressSame(!isLivingAddressSame);
              setState({ livingAddressIsSame: !state.livingAddressIsSame });
            }}
            label="Совпадает с адресом регистрации"
            className={styles.checkBox}
            disabled={isOtherAddressEditBlocked}
          />
          {isLivingAddressSame ? (
            <Input
              onChange={(e) =>
                setState({
                  registrationNewData: { ...state.registrationNewData, postIndex: e.target.value },
                })
              }
              value={state.registrationNewData.addressString}
              className={styles.customInput}
              disabled
            />
          ) : (
            <RegistrationForm
              state={state}
              setState={setState}
              addressFromKladr={livingAddressFromKladr}
              setAddressFromKladr={setLivingAddressFromKladr}
              kladrData={kladrAddressData}
              kladrRegionData={kladrRegionData}
              regionFromKladr={livingRegionFromKladr}
              setRegionFromKladr={setLivingRegionFromKladr}
              disabled={isOtherAddressEditBlocked}
              stateType="livingNewData"
              oldStateType="livingOldData"
            />
          )}
          <div className={styles.spacer} />
          <div className={styles.contentTitle}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
              Почтовый адрес
            </Text>
          </div>
          <Input
            onClick={() => !isOtherAddressEditBlocked && setPostAddressBsOpen(true)}
            value={postAddressValue}
            className={styles.customInput}
            disabled={isOtherAddressEditBlocked}
          />
          <div className={styles.spacer} />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          {isSaveBlockedByRegistrationConflict && (
            <BannerWarningLine
              addonLeft={<InfoBadgeIcon />}
              title="Нельзя одновременно указать адрес постоянной регистрации и адрес временной регистрации"
              className={styles.banner}
            />
          )}
          <Button
            disabled={
              isDisabled || isOtherAddressEditBlocked || isSaveBlockedByRegistrationConflict
            }
            onClick={async () => {
              await saveData();
            }}
          >
            Сохранить
          </Button>
        </div>
        <BottomSheet
          open={registrationBS && !isRegistrationEditBlocked}
          onDismiss={() => setRegistrationBS(false)}
          onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            <Text type="subtitleBold" color="colorForeground">
              Укажите срок действия регистрации
            </Text>
          </div>

          <DatePicker
            withPeriod={false}
            withOptions={false}
            minDate={minExpiryDate.toJSDate()}
            maxDate={maxExpiryDate.toJSDate()}
            onSubmit={onDateSubmit}
          />
        </BottomSheet>
        <BottomSheet
          open={bottomSheetOpen}
          onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetOpen(false)}
          className={styles.registrationReplaceBottomSheet}
        >
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            <Text className={styles.title} type="subtitleBold">
              Можно указать только один адрес регистрации. Заменить?
            </Text>
            <div>
              <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                {`При указании адреса ${
                  state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'main'
                    ? 'временной'
                    : 'постоянной'
                } регистрации адрес ${
                  state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'main'
                    ? 'постоянной'
                    : 'временной'
                } регистрации будет удалён`}
              </Text>
              <ButtonBar shape="vertical" className={styles.buttonBar}>
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setState({
                      registrationNewData: {
                        ...state.registrationNewData,
                        typeOfRegistration:
                          state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'main'
                            ? 'additional'
                            : 'main',
                        addressString: '',
                        region: '',
                        postIndex: '',
                      },
                    });
                    setHasBothRegistrationTypes(false);
                    setBottomSheetOpen(false);
                  }}
                >
                  Заменить регистрацию
                </Button>
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setBottomSheetOpen(false)}>
                  Отмена
                </Button>
              </ButtonBar>
            </div>
          </div>
        </BottomSheet>
        <BottomSheet
          open={postAddressBsOpen}
          onDismiss={() => setPostAddressBsOpen(false)}
          className={styles.wrapper}
        >
          <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Выберите почтовый адрес</Text>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.changeRiskGroup}>{postAddress}</div>
        </BottomSheet>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default Address;

import React from 'react';

interface ITestProps {
  onClickClose?: () => void;
  setInputText?: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string>>;
  addresess?: string[];
}

const DropDownContent: React.FC<ITestProps> = ({ onClickClose, setInputText, addresess }) => {
  const commonStyle = {
    alignItems: 'left',
    background: '#ffffff',
    display: 'flex',
    padding: '12px',
  };

  const handleAction = (arg: string) => {
    if (!onClickClose || !setInputText) {
      return;
    }
    onClickClose();
    setInputText(arg);
  };

  return (
    <>
      {addresess?.map((item, index) => {
        return (
          <div
            key={index}
            onClick={() => {
              handleAction(item);
            }}
            style={commonStyle}
          >
            <span>{item}</span>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
};
export default DropDownContent;

import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { AddressStateType } from './types';

export const getCurrentPostAddress = (state: AddressStateType) => {
  const { registrationIsPostalNew, registrationNewData, livingIsPostalNew, livingNewData } = state;

  // Регистрационный адрес имеет приоритет
  if (registrationIsPostalNew && registrationNewData.addressString) {
    return registrationNewData.addressString;
  }

  // Если регистрационный не почтовый или пустой - проверяем адрес проживания
  if (livingIsPostalNew && livingNewData.addressString) {
    return livingNewData.addressString;
  }

  return '';
};

export const expiryDateFormatter = (str: string) => {
  if (!str) return '';

  if (DateTime.fromFormat(str, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT).isValid) {
    return str;
  }

  const luxonDate = DateTime.fromISO(str);
  if (luxonDate.isValid) {
    return luxonDate.setLocale('en').toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
  }

  console.warn('Unable to format date:', str);
  return str;
};

export const expiryDateFormatterForSave = (dateStr: string): string => {
  if (!dateStr) return '';

  // Пробуем парсить как DD.MM.YYYY
  const viewDate = DateTime.fromFormat(dateStr, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
  if (viewDate.isValid) {
    return viewDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);
  }

  // Пробуем парсить как ISO
  const isoDate = DateTime.fromISO(dateStr);
  if (isoDate.isValid) {
    return isoDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);
  }

  // Если уже в формате YYYY-MM-DD - возвращаем как есть
  const inputDate = DateTime.fromFormat(dateStr, DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);
  if (inputDate.isValid) {
    return dateStr;
  }

  console.warn('Unable to format date:', dateStr);
  return dateStr;
};

import { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';
import { MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES } from 'const/messages';

import {
  useCancelFormDraftMutation,
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useSaveFormAddressMutation,
  useSaveFormAddressPostalMutation,
  useSaveFormDraftMutation,
} from 'core/api/personalData';

import {
  changeCurrentSectorStatus,
  getSectorsWithErrors,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';
import { PersonalSectorsType } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/types';

import { ADDRESS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES } from '../const';
import { expiryDateFormatterForSave } from '../helper';
import { AddressStateType } from '../types';
import { useIsAddressDataChanged } from './useIsAddressDataChanged';

const useFormSave = (
  requestGuid: string,
  personalSectors: PersonalSectorsType,
  setPersonalSectors: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PersonalSectorsType | undefined>>,
  goBack: () => void,
  state: AddressStateType,
  addressKladrFlags: {
    registrationAddressFromKladr: boolean;
    livingAddressFromKladr: boolean;
  },
) => {
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();
  const [cancelForm] = useCancelFormDraftMutation();
  const [saveFormAddress, { isLoading: isSaveFormAddressLoading }] = useSaveFormAddressMutation();

  const [saveFormAddressPostal, { isLoading: isSaveFormAddressPostalLoading }] =
    useSaveFormAddressPostalMutation();
  const [saveFormDraft, { isLoading: isSaveFormDraftLoading }] = useSaveFormDraftMutation();
  const [checkForm, { isLoading: isCheckFormLoading }] = useLazyCheckFormQuery();
  const { isLivingDataChanged, isRegDataChanged } = useIsAddressDataChanged(state);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState(false);

  const saveData = useCallback(async () => {
    const isMainRegistration = state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration === 'main';
    const expiryDateToSave =
      isMainRegistration || !state.registrationNewData.expiryDate
        ? ''
        : expiryDateFormatterForSave(state.registrationNewData.expiryDate);

    const regProps = {
      requestGuid,
      action: 'U',
      addressTypeCode: isMainRegistration ? 'REG_ADDRESS' : 'TEMP_ADDRESS',
      postIndex: state.registrationNewData.postIndex,
      countryCode: 'Russian Federation',
      regionType: state.registrationNewData.regionType,
      region: state.registrationNewData.region,
      addressString: state.registrationNewData.addressString,
      FIASFlag: addressKladrFlags.registrationAddressFromKladr,
      expiryDate: expiryDateToSave,
    };
    const regPropsDelete = {
      requestGuid,
      action: 'D',
      addressTypeCode: isMainRegistration ? 'TEMP_ADDRESS' : 'REG_ADDRESS',
      countryCode: 'Russian Federation',
      FIASFlag: false,
      addressString: '',
    };

    const livingProps = {
      requestGuid,
      action: 'U',
      addressTypeCode: 'ACTUAL_ADDRESS',
      postIndex: state.livingAddressIsSame
        ? state.registrationNewData.postIndex
        : state.livingNewData.postIndex,
      countryCode: 'Russian Federation',
      regionType: state.livingAddressIsSame
        ? state.registrationNewData.regionType
        : state.livingNewData.regionType,
      region: state.livingAddressIsSame
        ? state.registrationNewData.region
        : state.livingNewData.region,
      addressString: state.livingAddressIsSame
        ? state.registrationNewData.addressString
        : state.livingNewData.addressString,
      FIASFlag: state.livingAddressIsSame
        ? addressKladrFlags.registrationAddressFromKladr
        : addressKladrFlags.livingAddressFromKladr,
    };

    try {
      if (state.livingAddressIsSame) {
        await saveFormAddress(livingProps).unwrap();
      }
      if (isRegDataChanged) {
        if (
          state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration !==
          state.registrationOldData.typeOfRegistration
        ) {
          await saveFormAddress(regPropsDelete).unwrap();
        }
        await saveFormAddress(regProps).unwrap();
      }
      if (isLivingDataChanged) {
        await saveFormAddress(livingProps).unwrap();
      }

      const isPostalAddressChanged =
        state.registrationIsPostalNew !== state.registrationIsPostalOld;

      const isNewPostalInRegistration =
        state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration !==
        state.registrationOldData.typeOfRegistration;
      if (isPostalAddressChanged || isNewPostalInRegistration) {
        if (state.registrationIsPostalNew) {
          await saveFormAddressPostal({
            requestGuid,
            addressTypeCode: 'ACTUAL_ADDRESS',
            isPostal: false,
          });
          await saveFormAddressPostal({
            requestGuid,
            addressTypeCode: isMainRegistration ? 'REG_ADDRESS' : 'TEMP_ADDRESS',
            isPostal: true,
          });
        }
        if (state.livingIsPostalNew) {
          await saveFormAddressPostal({
            requestGuid,
            addressTypeCode: isMainRegistration ? 'REG_ADDRESS' : 'TEMP_ADDRESS',
            isPostal: false,
          });
          await saveFormAddressPostal({
            requestGuid,
            addressTypeCode: 'ACTUAL_ADDRESS',
            isPostal: true,
          });
        }
      }
      const errors = await checkForm({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
      const addressErrors =
        errors?.filter((item) => ADDRESS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(item.fieldCode)) || [];

      if (!addressErrors.length) {
        await saveFormDraft({ requestGuid: requestGuid });

        const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errors, personalSectors);
        const updatedSectors = changeCurrentSectorStatus(sectorsWithErrors, 'Address');
        setPersonalSectors(updatedSectors);

        goBack();
      } else {
        const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errors, personalSectors);
        setPersonalSectors(sectorsWithErrors);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      await cancelForm({ requestGuid });
      setSaveError(true);
    }
  }, [
    addressKladrFlags.livingAddressFromKladr,
    addressKladrFlags.registrationAddressFromKladr,
    cancelForm,
    checkForm,
    goBack,
    isLivingDataChanged,
    isRegDataChanged,
    personalSectors,
    requestGuid,
    saveFormAddress,
    saveFormAddressPostal,
    saveFormDraft,
    setPersonalSectors,
    state.livingAddressIsSame,
    state.livingIsPostalNew,
    state.livingNewData.addressString,
    state.livingNewData.postIndex,
    state.livingNewData.region,
    state.livingNewData.regionType,
    state.registrationIsPostalNew,
    state.registrationIsPostalOld,
    state.registrationNewData.addressString,
    state.registrationNewData.expiryDate,
    state.registrationNewData.postIndex,
    state.registrationNewData.region,
    state.registrationNewData.regionType,
    state.registrationNewData.typeOfRegistration,
    state.registrationOldData.typeOfRegistration,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!saveError) return;

    //waiting for group-arr of snacks component
    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 3000,
      label: MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES,
      variant: 'primary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [requestGuid, saveError, snackbarTopAlert]);

  return {
    saveData,
    isSaving:
      isCheckFormLoading ||
      isSaveFormAddressLoading ||
      isSaveFormAddressPostalLoading ||
      isSaveFormDraftLoading,
  };
};

export default useFormSave;

import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';

import { ProfileResponse } from 'types/investmentProfile';

import { AddressStateType, LivingAddressType, PersonAddressType, RegistrationType } from '../types';

export function useGetInitialAddress(
  formDraft: ProfileResponse | undefined,
  isFormDraftError: boolean,
  personAddress: PersonAddressType[],
  setState: React.Dispatch<Partial<AddressStateType>>,
) {
  const getAddressString = (item?: PersonAddressType) => {
    return item?.addressString || item?.value || '';
  };

  const isRegistrationAddress = (item: PersonAddressType) => {
    const code = item.addressTypeCode?.toUpperCase() || '';
    const name = item.addressTypeName?.toLowerCase() || '';
    return (
      code.includes('REG') ||
      name.includes('постоян') ||
      (name.includes('регистрац') && !name.includes('времен'))
    );
  };

  const isTempRegistrationAddress = (item: PersonAddressType) => {
    const code = item.addressTypeCode?.toUpperCase() || '';
    const name = item.addressTypeName?.toLowerCase() || '';
    return code.includes('TEMP') || name.includes('времен');
  };

  const isLivingAddress = (item: PersonAddressType) => {
    const code = item.addressTypeCode?.toUpperCase() || '';
    const name = item.addressTypeName?.toLowerCase() || '';
    return (
      code.includes('ACTUAL') ||
      code.includes('LIVE') ||
      name.includes('пребыван') ||
      name.includes('фактичес')
    );
  };

  const draftAddress = formDraft?.personAddress;
  const sourceAddress = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isFormDraftError && draftAddress?.length) {
      return draftAddress;
    }
    return personAddress;
  }, [draftAddress, isFormDraftError, personAddress]);

  const mainRegistration = useMemo(() => {
    return sourceAddress?.find((item) => isRegistrationAddress(item));
  }, [sourceAddress]);

  const tempRegistration = useMemo(() => {
    return sourceAddress?.find((item) => isTempRegistrationAddress(item));
  }, [sourceAddress]);

  const livingData = useMemo(() => {
    return sourceAddress?.find((item) => isLivingAddress(item));
  }, [sourceAddress]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const registrationDataSource =
      (mainRegistration ? mainRegistration : tempRegistration) || sourceAddress?.[0];
    const livingDataSource =
      livingData ||
      sourceAddress?.find((item) => item !== registrationDataSource) ||
      sourceAddress?.[0];
    const registrationType = mainRegistration ? 'main' : 'additional';

    const registrationData: RegistrationType = {
      typeOfRegistration: registrationType,
      addressTypeCode: registrationDataSource?.addressTypeCode || '',
      postIndex: registrationDataSource?.postIndex || '',
      regionType: registrationDataSource?.regionType || '',
      region: registrationDataSource?.region || '',
      addressString: getAddressString(registrationDataSource),
      addressStringError: false,
      postIndexError: false,
      regionError: false,
      expiryDate: registrationDataSource?.expiryDate,
    };
    const livingAddressData: LivingAddressType = {
      addressTypeCode: livingDataSource?.addressTypeCode || '',
      postIndex: livingDataSource?.postIndex || '',
      regionType: livingDataSource?.regionType || '',
      region: livingDataSource?.region || '',
      addressString: getAddressString(livingDataSource),
      addressStringError: false,
      postIndexError: false,
      regionError: false,
    };
    setState({
      registrationOldData: registrationData,
      registrationIsPostalOld: !!(registrationDataSource?.isPostal === 'Y'),
      registrationNewData: registrationData,
      registrationIsPostalNew: !!(registrationDataSource?.isPostal === 'Y'),
      livingOldData: livingAddressData,
      livingIsPostalOld: !!(livingDataSource?.isPostal === 'Y'),
      livingNewData: livingAddressData,
      livingIsPostalNew: !!(livingDataSource?.isPostal === 'Y'),
    });
  }, [sourceAddress, livingData, mainRegistration, setState, tempRegistration]);
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { AddressStateType } from '../types';

export function useIsAddressDataChanged(state: AddressStateType) {
  const [isRegDataChanged, setIsRegDataChanged] = useState(false);
  const [isLivingDataChanged, setIsLivingDataChanged] = useState(false);
  const [isPostalAddressChanged, setIsPostalAddressChanged] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const isRegDataEqual =
      JSON.stringify(state.registrationNewData) === JSON.stringify(state.registrationOldData);

    const isLivingDataEqual =
      JSON.stringify(state.livingNewData) === JSON.stringify(state.livingOldData);

    const isPostalAddressEqual = state.registrationIsPostalNew === state.registrationIsPostalOld;
    setIsPostalAddressChanged(!isPostalAddressEqual);
    setIsLivingDataChanged(!isLivingDataEqual);
    setIsRegDataChanged(!isRegDataEqual);
  }, [
    state.registrationNewData,
    state.registrationOldData,
    state.livingNewData,
    state.livingOldData,
    state.registrationIsPostalNew,
    state.registrationIsPostalOld,
  ]);

  return { isRegDataChanged, isLivingDataChanged, isPostalAddressChanged };
}

import React, { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Autocomplete, Input, TListItem } from '@aurora/components';

import styles from './address.module.pcss';
import { RegistrationFormProps } from './types';

const isManualAddressOption = (id: unknown) => typeof id === 'string' && id.startsWith('manual-');

const RegistrationForm: React.FC<RegistrationFormProps> = ({
  kladrData,
  kladrRegionData,
  disabled,
  setState,
  state,
  setAddressFromKladr,
  addressFromKladr,
  setRegionFromKladr,
  regionFromKladr,
  stateType,
  oldStateType,
  autocompleteClassNameContent = styles.autocompleteContent,
}) => {
  const [addressConfirmedFromList, setAddressConfirmedFromList] = useState(false);
  const typedAddress = state[stateType].addressString.trim();
  const isPostIndexValid = (postIndex: string) => postIndex.length === 6 && postIndex[0] !== '0';
  const addressOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const source = kladrData || [];
    if (!typedAddress || typedAddress.length < 3) {
      return source;
    }

    const normalizedTypedAddress = typedAddress.toLowerCase();
    const hasTypedAddressInList = source.some(
      (item: { value?: string }) => item?.value?.trim().toLowerCase() === normalizedTypedAddress,
    );

    if (hasTypedAddressInList) {
      return source;
    }

    return [
      {
        id: `manual-${normalizedTypedAddress}`,
        value: typedAddress,
      },
      ...source,
    ];
  }, [kladrData, state, stateType, typedAddress]);

  const isManualAddressFlow = !addressFromKladr && addressConfirmedFromList;
  const isPostIndexEmpty = !state[stateType].postIndex.trim();
  const isRegionEmpty = !state[stateType].region.trim();
  const showPostIndexFillError = isManualAddressFlow && isPostIndexEmpty;
  const showRegionFillError = !addressFromKladr && (isRegionEmpty || !regionFromKladr);

  const onIndexInputChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      setState({
        [stateType]: {
          ...state[stateType],
          postIndex: e.target.value,
          postIndexError: isPostIndexValid(e.target.value)
            ? false
            : state[stateType].postIndexError,
        },
      });
    },
    [setState, state, stateType],
  );

  const onIndexInputBlur = useCallback(() => {
    if (state[stateType].postIndex.slice(0, 1) === '0') {
      setState({
        [stateType]: {
          ...state[stateType],
          postIndexError: true,
        },
      });
    }
  }, [setState, state, stateType]);

  const onMainAddressChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      setState({
        [stateType]: {
          ...state[stateType],
          addressString: e.target.value,
        },
      });
      setAddressConfirmedFromList(false);
      setAddressFromKladr(false);
    },
    [setAddressFromKladr, setState, state, stateType],
  );

  const onMainAddressSelect = useCallback(
    (e: TListItem & { postalCode?: string; regionType?: string; region?: string }) => {
      const isManualAddress = isManualAddressOption(e.id);

      if (isManualAddress) {
        setState({
          [stateType]: {
            ...state[stateType],
            addressString: e.value,
            postIndex: '',
            postIndexError: false,
            region: '',
            regionType: '',
            regionError: false,
          },
        });
        setAddressConfirmedFromList(true);
        setAddressFromKladr(false);
        setRegionFromKladr(false);
        return;
      }

      const nextPostIndex = e.postalCode?.trim() || state[stateType].postIndex;
      setState({
        [stateType]: {
          ...state[stateType],
          addressString: e.value,
          postIndex: nextPostIndex,
          postIndexError: isPostIndexValid(nextPostIndex) ? false : state[stateType].postIndexError,
          regionType: e.regionType || state[stateType].regionType,
          region: e.region || state[stateType].region,
        },
      });
      setAddressConfirmedFromList(true);
      setAddressFromKladr(true);
    },
    [setAddressFromKladr, setRegionFromKladr, setState, state, stateType],
  );

  const onRegionChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      setState({
        [stateType]: { ...state[stateType], region: e.target.value },
      });
      setRegionFromKladr(false);
    },
    [setRegionFromKladr, setState, state, stateType],
  );

  const onRegionSelect = useCallback(
    (e: TListItem & { regionType?: string; region?: string }) => {
      setState({
        [stateType]: {
          ...state[stateType],
          region: e.value || e.region,
          regionType: e.regionType,
        },
      });
      setRegionFromKladr(true);
    },
    [setRegionFromKladr, setState, state, stateType],
  );

  return (
    <>
      {disabled ? (
        <Input
          placeholder="Заполните адрес"
          value={state[stateType].addressString}
          className={styles.input}
          disabled
        />
      ) : (
        <Autocomplete
          classNameContent={autocompleteClassNameContent}
          className={styles.autocomplete}
          classNameInput={styles.autocompleteInput}
          list={addressOptions}
          name="mainAddress"
          onChange={onMainAddressChange}
          onSelect={onMainAddressSelect}
          placeholder="Заполните адрес"
          value={state[stateType].addressString}
          separatorActionCells={false}
          classNamePopover={`${styles.autocompletePopover} ${styles.perenosHyphens}`}
          status={
            state[stateType].addressString.length < 4 ||
            (!addressFromKladr && !addressConfirmedFromList)
              ? 'error'
              : undefined
          }
          description={
            (state[stateType].addressString.length < 4 ||
              (!addressFromKladr && !addressConfirmedFromList)) &&
            'Выберете адрес из списка'
          }
        />
      )}
      <div>
        <Input
          placeholder="Укажите индекс"
          label="Индекс"
          mask="999999"
          value={state[stateType].postIndex}
          className={styles.input}
          status={state[stateType].postIndexError || showPostIndexFillError ? 'error' : undefined}
          description={
            state[stateType].postIndexError
              ? 'Индекс должен содержать 6 цифр'
              : showPostIndexFillError
              ? 'Заполните поле'
              : undefined
          }
          onChange={onIndexInputChange}
          onBlur={onIndexInputBlur}
          disabled={disabled}
        />

        {state[stateType].addressString &&
          !addressFromKladr &&
          (disabled ? (
            <Input
              label="Регион"
              value={state[stateType].region}
              className={styles.input}
              disabled
            />
          ) : (
            <Autocomplete
              classNameContent={autocompleteClassNameContent}
              className={styles.autocomplete}
              list={kladrRegionData || []}
              label="Регион"
              name="region"
              onChange={onRegionChange}
              onSelect={onRegionSelect}
              placeholder="Выберите регион"
              value={state[stateType].region}
              separatorActionCells={false}
              classNamePopover={`${styles.autocompletePopover} ${styles.perenosHyphens}`}
              status={showRegionFillError || state[stateType].regionError ? 'error' : undefined}
              description={
                showRegionFillError || state[stateType].regionError ? 'Заполните поле' : undefined
              }
            />
          ))}
        {state[stateType].addressString && !addressFromKladr && (
          <Input label="Страна" value={'Российская Федерация'} className={styles.input} disabled />
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default RegistrationForm;

import React, { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Button, Checkbox, CircleLoader, SmartLink, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { API_CREATE_FORM_DRAFT_CHECK_LIST_FILE } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import { useSetFormDraftVerifyMutation } from 'core/api/personalData';

//import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';
import useDownloadFile from 'hooks/useDownloadFile';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

//import { ProfileFileChangedType } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/types';
import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell/DocumentCell';

import AnketDocumentLoadingCell from '../AnketDocumentLoadingCell';
import styles from './confirmationAgreement.module.pcss';
import { ConfirmationAgreementProps } from './types';

const ConfirmationAgreement: React.FC<ConfirmationAgreementProps> = ({
  requestGuid,
  crcCode,
  goBackToProfile,
  setActiveSector,
}) => {
  const [checkBox, setCheckBox] = useState(false);
  //const [crcCode, setCrcCode] = useState('');

  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading, error: smsError }] =
    useSetFormDraftVerifyMutation();

  const filePath = useMemo(
    () =>
      crcCode && requestGuid
        ? `${API_CREATE_FORM_DRAFT_CHECK_LIST_FILE}?request_Guid=${requestGuid}&type=Анкета`
        : undefined,
    [crcCode, requestGuid],
  );
  const { file } = useDownloadFile({
    url: filePath,
  });

  // useEffect(() => {
  //   if (crcCode) return;
  //   const listener = (data: ProfileFileChangedType) => {
  //     const crc = data.response.PersonProfileFileList[0].CRC;
  //     setCrcCode(crc);
  //   };
  //   const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('ProfileFileChanged', listener);
  //   return () => {
  //     unsubscribe();
  //   };
  // }, [crcCode]);

  const handleConfirmButton = useCallback(() => {
    getSms({ requestGuid });
  }, [getSms, requestGuid]);

  const handleConfirm = useCallback(
    (smsConfirmData?: any) => {
      const requestStatus = smsConfirmData?.requestStatus?.[0];
      if (
        requestStatus?.status === 'waiting_confirmation' ||
        requestStatus?.warningCode === 'SmsCodeConfirmationFailed'
      ) {
        createAlertNotification({
          text: requestStatus?.warning || 'Вы ввели неправильный код',
          status: 'error',
        });
        return;
      }
      setActiveSector('Success');
    },
    [setActiveSector],
  );

  useErrorNotification(smsError);

  if (isSmsLoading) {
    return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;
  }

  return !smsData ? (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant="close"
        onLeftIconClick={goBackToProfile}
        documentTitle="Обновление персональных данных"
      />
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <div>
            <Text type={'title'} className={styles.title}>
              Обновление персональных данных
            </Text>
            {crcCode ? (
              <DocumentCell url={file?.url} name={'Анкета'} id={crcCode ? `ID: ${crcCode}` : ''} />
            ) : (
              <AnketDocumentLoadingCell />
            )}

            <div className={styles.checkboxWrapper}>
              <Checkbox
                checked={checkBox}
                className={styles.checkbox}
                onChange={() => setCheckBox(!checkBox)}
              />
              <div onClick={() => setCheckBox(!checkBox)}>
                <Text>
                  Подтверждаю, что информация, указанная в Анкете клиента, верна и даю{' '}
                  <SmartLink
                    className={styles.link}
                    external
                    link="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/personal-data-consent.pdf"
                  >
                    cогласие
                  </SmartLink>{' '}
                  на обработку своих персональных данных
                </Text>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'} className={styles.btnTitle}>
              {crcCode
                ? 'Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения'
                : 'Пожалуйста подождите, анкета формируется'}
            </Text>
            <Button onClick={handleConfirmButton} disabled={!(checkBox && crcCode)}>
              Подтвердить
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  ) : (
    <SmsConfirmation
      initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
      smsInputCount={4}
      subTitle={
        <Text type="labelRegular">
          Пожалуйста, не покидайте и не перезагружайте страницу. Дождитесь код подтверждения
        </Text>
      }
      onSuccess={handleConfirm}
      onError={console.error}
    />
  );
};
export default ConfirmationAgreement;

import { FC, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetDraftForSignQuery } from 'core/api/personalData';

import ErrorPage from '../ErrorPage/ErrorPage';
import { FinalGettingStatusProps } from './types';

const FinalGettingStatus: FC<FinalGettingStatusProps> = ({
  requestGuid,
  goBackToProfile,
  setActiveSector,
}) => {
  const {
    data: draftForSignStatus,
    isError,
    isFetching,
    refetch,
  } = useGetDraftForSignQuery({
    requestGuid: requestGuid,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (draftForSignStatus === 'checklist') {
      setActiveSector('ConfirmationAgreement');
    }
  }, [draftForSignStatus, setActiveSector]);

  const onTryAgainClick = useCallback(() => {
    if (isError || draftForSignStatus !== 'checklist') {
      refetch();
    }
  }, [draftForSignStatus, isError, refetch]);

  if (isFetching) {
    return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;
  }

  if (draftForSignStatus !== 'checklist') {
    return (
      <ErrorPage
        goBackToProfile={goBackToProfile}
        goBackLocal={goBackToProfile}
        onTryAgainClick={onTryAgainClick}
      />
    );
  }
  return null;
};
export default FinalGettingStatus;

import React from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, ButtonBar, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useDeleteFormDraftMutation } from 'core/api/personalData';

import styles from './goBackWithoutRecords.module.pcss';
import { GoBackWithoutRecordsProps } from './types';

const GoBackWithoutRecords: React.FC<GoBackWithoutRecordsProps> = ({
  open,
  onDismiss,
  handleExit,
  requestGuid,
}) => {
  const [deletePersonalFormDraft] = useDeleteFormDraftMutation();

  const onExitWithoutSave = async () => {
    handleExit();
    await deletePersonalFormDraft({ requestGuid });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
        <div className={styles.root}>
          <div className={styles.text}>
            <Text type="subtitleSemiBold">Уверены, что хотите выйти?</Text>
            <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              При выходе обновлённые данные <br />
              не сохранятся
            </Text>
          </div>
          <ButtonBar shape="vertical" classNameWrapper={styles.buttonsWrapper}>
            <Button variant="secondaryNegative" onClick={onExitWithoutSave}>
              Выйти без сохранения
            </Button>
            <Button variant="link" onClick={onDismiss}>
              Остаться
            </Button>
          </ButtonBar>
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default GoBackWithoutRecords;
