import { FC, useEffect, useMemo, useReducer, useState } from 'react';

import {
  BottomSheet,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  CircleLoader,
  Input,
  Radio,
  RadioFormGroup,
  Text,
  useSnackbars,
} from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { useLazyGetFormDraftDataQuery } from 'core/api/personalData';

import { hdoReducer } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ArrowDown } from 'images/icons/arrow-small-down.svg';
import defaultIcon from 'images/icons/defaultSnackBar.png';
import { ReactComponent as Check } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import ExclamationIcon from '../TaxesResidence/ExclamationIcon';
import styles from './HDO.module.pcss';
import Skeleton from './Skeleton';
import {
  CATEGORIES_DICTIONARY,
  HDO_ERROR_CODES_FOR_INPUTS,
  HDO_ERROR_CODES_FOR_SNACKBAR,
  initHdoState,
} from './const';
import { isAllFilled, stringFormatter } from './helper';
import { useGetHdoData } from './hooks/useGetHdoData';
import { useGetInitialHdoData2 } from './hooks/useGetInitialHdoData2';
import { useHdoDataChanged } from './hooks/useHdoDataChanged';
import { useSaveHdoData } from './hooks/useSaveHdoData';
import { HDOProps } from './types';

const HDO2: FC<HDOProps> = ({
  goBack,
  setPersonalSectors,
  personalSectors,
  isConfirmedFromProfile,
  requestGuid,
  disabled,
  errorText,
  businessRelations,
  sectorErrorsFromCheck,
}) => {
  const { mapa } = useGetHdoData();
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(hdoReducer, initHdoState);
  const [BSoperations, setBSoperations] = useState(false);
  const [currentInput, setCurrentInput] = useState<0 | 1>(0);
  const [currentCode, setCurrentCode] =
    useState<keyof typeof CATEGORIES_DICTIONARY>('КОНВЕРСИОННЫЕ');
  const [showNotification, setShowNotification] = useState(false);
  const { snackbarInfo, snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();
  const { isHdoLoading } = useGetHdoData();
  const [
    getFormDraft,
    { data: formDraft, isError: isFormDraftError, isLoading: isFormDraftLoading },
  ] = useLazyGetFormDraftDataQuery();

  useGetInitialHdoData2(businessRelations, formDraft, isFormDraftError, setState);
  const [isConfirmed, setIsConfirmed] = useState<string>(() => {
    if (formDraft) {
      return formDraft.personData[0].businessRelationsConfirm ? '0' : '1';
    } else {
      return isConfirmedFromProfile ? '0' : '1';
    }
  });
  const [isHdoTouched, setIsHdoTouched] = useState(false);

  const isDataChanged = useHdoDataChanged(state);

  const isDisabledToChange = isConfirmed === '1' || disabled;
  const isDisabledToSave =
    isDisabledToChange || (!isDataChanged && !isHdoTouched) || isAllFilled(state);

  const inputErrors = useMemo(
    () =>
      sectorErrorsFromCheck.filter((item) => HDO_ERROR_CODES_FOR_INPUTS.includes(item.errorCode)),
    [sectorErrorsFromCheck],
  );

  const snackbarErrors = useMemo(
    () =>
      sectorErrorsFromCheck
        .filter((item) => HDO_ERROR_CODES_FOR_SNACKBAR.includes(item.errorCode))
        .map((err) => err.fullMessage),
    [sectorErrorsFromCheck],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!snackbarErrors.length || isHdoLoading || isFormDraftLoading) return;

    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 3000,
      label: snackbarErrors[0],
      variant: 'primary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [isFormDraftLoading, isHdoLoading, snackbarErrors, snackbarTopAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (personalSectors.Relationships === 'changed') {
      getFormDraft({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [getFormDraft, personalSectors.Relationships, requestGuid]);

  const { saveData, isSaving } = useSaveHdoData(
    requestGuid,
    personalSectors,
    setPersonalSectors,
    goBack,
    state,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(disabled && errorText)) return;
    const id = snackbarInfo?.show({
      autoClose: 5000,
      caption: <span>{errorText}</span>,
      variant: 'primary',
      icon: <img style={{ width: '40px' }} src={defaultIcon} alt="snackBarImage" />,
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarInfo?.close(id);
    };
  }, [disabled, errorText, snackbarInfo]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showNotification) return;
    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 3000,
      variant: 'secondary',
      label: 'Сначала укажите вид операции',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
      setShowNotification(false);
    };
  }, [showNotification, snackbarTopAlert]);

  const currentItem = useMemo(() => {
    return mapa?.find((item) => item.code === currentCode);
  }, [currentCode, mapa]);

  const codes = useMemo(() => {
    const currentCategory = CATEGORIES_DICTIONARY?.[currentCode];
    const currentCodeValue = state.newHdoData[currentCategory].businessRelationTypeCode;
    const values = currentItem?.currentPurposes?.map((elem) => elem.businessRelationTypeCode);
    return values?.map((item) => (
      <div
        onClick={() => {
          const selectedTypeCode = stringFormatter(item);
          const currentTypeCode = state.newHdoData[currentCategory].businessRelationTypeCode;
          const shouldResetRelationCode =
            currentTypeCode.trim().toUpperCase() !== selectedTypeCode.trim().toUpperCase();

          setState({
            newHdoData: {
              ...state.newHdoData,
              [currentCategory]: {
                ...state.newHdoData[currentCategory],
                businessRelationTypeCode: selectedTypeCode,
                businessRelationCode: shouldResetRelationCode
                  ? ''
                  : state.newHdoData[currentCategory].businessRelationCode,
              },
            },
          });
          setIsHdoTouched(true);
          setBSoperations(false);
        }}
        key={item}
      >
        <div className={styles.changeRiskGroupItem}>
          <span>{stringFormatter(item)}</span>
          {stringFormatter(item) === currentCodeValue && <Check />}
        </div>
      </div>
    ));
  }, [currentCode, currentItem?.currentPurposes, state.newHdoData]);

  const purposes = useMemo(() => {
    const currentCategory = CATEGORIES_DICTIONARY?.[currentCode];
    const currentCategoryValue = state.newHdoData[currentCategory].businessRelationCode;
    const values = currentItem?.currentPurposes
      ?.find(
        (it) =>
          it.businessRelationTypeCode ===
          state.newHdoData[currentCategory].businessRelationTypeCode.toUpperCase(),
      )
      ?.categories?.map((elem) => elem.businessRelationCode);
    return (
      values?.map((item) => (
        <div
          onClick={() => {
            setState({
              newHdoData: {
                ...state.newHdoData,
                [currentCategory]: {
                  ...state.newHdoData[currentCategory],
                  businessRelationCode: stringFormatter(item),
                },
              },
            });
            setIsHdoTouched(true);
            setBSoperations(false);
          }}
          key={item}
        >
          <div className={styles.changeRiskGroupItem}>
            <span>{stringFormatter(item)}</span>
            {stringFormatter(item) === currentCategoryValue && <Check />}
          </div>
        </div>
      )) || []
    );
  }, [currentCode, currentItem?.currentPurposes, state.newHdoData]);

  const {
    isChecked: conversChecked,
    businessRelationCode: conversBusinessRelationCode,
    businessRelationTypeCode: conversBusinessRelationTypeCode,
  } = state.newHdoData.convers;

  const {
    isChecked: targetChecked,
    businessRelationCode: targetBusinessRelationCode,
    businessRelationTypeCode: targetBusinessRelationTypeCode,
  } = state.newHdoData.targets;

  const {
    isChecked: speculativeChecked,
    businessRelationTypeCode: speculativeBusinessRelationTypeCode,
  } = state.newHdoData.speculative;

  const { isChecked: otherChecked } = state.newHdoData.other;

  if (isSaving || isHdoLoading || isFormDraftLoading) {
    return <CircleLoader type="page" brandColor />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="Редактирование данных" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text type={'title'} className={styles.title}>
            Характер деловых отношений
          </Text>

          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.subTitle}>
            Бенефициары, выгодоприобретатели, ПДЛ
          </Text>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} className={styles.mainText}>
            Вы самостоятельно и исключительно в своих интересах (т.к. у вас нет бенефициарного
            владельца или выгодоприобретателя) намерены совершать/совершаете операции в рамках
            заключаемого/заключённого с брокером договора на брокерское обслуживание и/или
            депозитарного договора? Вы не являетесь иностранным/российским публичным должностным
            лицом (ПДЛ), должностным лицом публичной международной организации, супругом или близким
            родственником перечисленных лиц?
          </Text>
          <RadioFormGroup shape="vertical" className={styles.radioGroup}>
            <Radio
              label="Да, перечисленное выше верно"
              value="0"
              checked={isConfirmed === '0'}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setIsConfirmed(e.target.value);
                setIsHdoTouched(true);
              }}
              controlled
              className={styles.radio}
              disabled={disabled}
            />
            <Radio
              label="Нет, у меня есть бенефициар или выгодоприобретатель / Нет, я являюсь ПДЛ"
              onChange={(e) => {
                setIsConfirmed(e.target.value);
                setIsHdoTouched(true);
              }}
              value="1"
              controlled
              checked={isConfirmed === '1'}
              className={styles.radio}
              disabled={disabled}
            />
          </RadioFormGroup>
          {isConfirmed === '1' && (
            <div className={styles.notification}>
              <div className={styles.icon}>
                <ExclamationIcon />
              </div>
              <Text type="labelRegular">
                В случае отрицательного ответа изменение анкетных данных в личном кабинете
                невозможно. Пожалуйста, обратитесь лично в офис.
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className={styles.spacer} />
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.subTitle}>
            Характер деловых отношений
          </Text>
          <div>
            <div className={styles.hdoGroup}>
              <Checkbox
                label="Конверсионные (валютообменные сделки)"
                checked={conversChecked}
                onChange={() => {
                  const { convers } = state.newHdoData;
                  setState({
                    newHdoData: {
                      ...state.newHdoData,
                      convers: { ...convers, isChecked: !conversChecked },
                    },
                  });
                  setIsHdoTouched(true);
                  setCurrentCode('КОНВЕРСИОННЫЕ');
                }}
                className={styles.checkBox}
                disabled={isDisabledToChange}
              />
              {conversChecked && (
                <>
                  <div
                    onClick={() => {
                      setBSoperations(true);
                      setCurrentCode('КОНВЕРСИОННЫЕ');
                      setCurrentInput(0);
                    }}
                  >
                    <Input
                      label="Вид операции"
                      value={stringFormatter(conversBusinessRelationTypeCode)}
                      addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
                      className={styles.input}
                      placeholder={`Выберите операцию`}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (conversBusinessRelationTypeCode) {
                        setBSoperations(true);
                        setCurrentInput(1);
                        setCurrentCode('КОНВЕРСИОННЫЕ');
                      } else {
                        setShowNotification(true);
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    <Input
                      label="Источник или цели"
                      value={stringFormatter(conversBusinessRelationCode)}
                      addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
                      className={styles.input}
                      placeholder="Выберите источник или цели"
                    />
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.hdoGroup}>
              <Checkbox
                label="Разовые целевые операции с одним или несколькими инструментами"
                checked={targetChecked}
                onChange={() => {
                  const { targets } = state.newHdoData;
                  setState({
                    newHdoData: {
                      ...state.newHdoData,
                      targets: { ...targets, isChecked: !targetChecked },
                    },
                  });
                  setIsHdoTouched(true);
                  setCurrentCode('ЦЕЛЕВЫЕ');
                  setCurrentInput(0);
                }}
                className={styles.checkBox}
                disabled={isDisabledToChange}
              />
              {targetChecked && (
                <>
                  <div
                    onClick={() => {
                      setBSoperations(true);
                      setCurrentCode('ЦЕЛЕВЫЕ');
                      setCurrentInput(0);
                    }}
                  >
                    <Input
                      label="Вид операции"
                      value={stringFormatter(targetBusinessRelationTypeCode)}
                      addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
                      className={styles.input}
                      placeholder={`Выберите операцию`}
                    />
                  </div>
                  {targetBusinessRelationTypeCode.toUpperCase() !== 'ИНОЕ' && (
                    <div
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (targetBusinessRelationTypeCode) {
                          setCurrentCode('ЦЕЛЕВЫЕ');
                          setBSoperations(true);
                          setCurrentInput(1);
                        } else {
                          setShowNotification(true);
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                      <Input
                        label="Источник или цели"
                        value={stringFormatter(targetBusinessRelationCode)}
                        addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
                        className={styles.input}
                        placeholder="Выберите источник или цели"
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.hdoGroup}>
              <Checkbox
                label="Спекулятивный или инвестиционный характер сделок с разнообразными ЦБ и/или производными финансовыми 
                инструментами и/или валютой, хеджирование"
                checked={speculativeChecked}
                onChange={() => {
                  const { speculative } = state.newHdoData;
                  setState({
                    newHdoData: {
                      ...state.newHdoData,
                      speculative: { ...speculative, isChecked: !speculativeChecked },
                    },
                  });
                  setIsHdoTouched(true);
                  setCurrentCode('СПЕКУЛЯТИВНЫЕ');
                  setCurrentInput(0);
                }}
                className={styles.checkBox}
                disabled={isDisabledToChange}
              />
              {speculativeChecked && (
                <>
                  <div
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (isDisabledToChange) return;
                      setBSoperations(true);
                      setCurrentCode('СПЕКУЛЯТИВНЫЕ');
                    }}
                  >
                    <Input
                      label="Срок"
                      value={stringFormatter(speculativeBusinessRelationTypeCode)}
                      addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
                      className={styles.input}
                      placeholder={`Выберите срок`}
                      disabled={isDisabledToChange}
                    />
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.hdoGroup}>
              <Checkbox
                label={<span className={styles.otherLabel}>Иные</span>}
                checked={otherChecked}
                onChange={() => {
                  const { other } = state.newHdoData;
                  setState({
                    newHdoData: {
                      ...state.newHdoData,
                      other: { ...other, isChecked: !otherChecked },
                    },
                  });
                  setIsHdoTouched(true);
                }}
                className={styles.checkBox}
                disabled={isDisabledToChange}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          <Button disabled={isDisabledToSave} onClick={saveData}>
            Сохранить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <BottomSheet
        open={BSoperations}
        onDismiss={() => setBSoperations(false)}
        className={cx(styles.wrap, !BSoperations && styles.bsWrapFixed)}
      >
        <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>
            {currentInput === 0
              ? `Выберите ${currentCode === 'СПЕКУЛЯТИВНЫЕ' ? 'срок' : 'операцию'}`
              : 'Выберите источник или цели'}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.changeRiskGroup}>
          {!isHdoLoading ? <> {currentInput === 0 ? codes : purposes}</> : <Skeleton />}
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default HDO2;


--- FILE: src\modules\PersonalInformation\components\HDO\helper.ts ---

import { BusinessRelationCategoryType } from 'types/personalData';

import { CategoriesType, HDOStateType, HdoCategoriesType } from './types';

export const isBusinessCategoryExist = (
  category: string,
  dictionaries?: BusinessRelationCategoryType[],
) => !!dictionaries?.some((item) => item.businessRelationCategoryCode === category);

export const stringFormatter = (str: string) => {
  if (!str) return '';
  return str[0]?.toUpperCase() + str?.slice(1)?.toLowerCase();
};

export const isAllFilled = (state: HDOStateType) => {
  const isConversFilled = state.newHdoData.convers.isChecked
    ? !!(
        state.newHdoData.convers.isChecked &&
        state.newHdoData.convers.businessRelationCode &&
        state.newHdoData.convers.businessRelationTypeCode
      )
    : true;

  const isTargetsFilled = state.newHdoData.targets.isChecked
    ? !!(
        state.newHdoData.targets.isChecked &&
        state.newHdoData.targets.businessRelationCode &&
        state.newHdoData.targets.businessRelationTypeCode
      ) ||
      !!(
        state.newHdoData.targets.isChecked &&
        state.newHdoData.targets.businessRelationTypeCode.toUpperCase() === 'ИНОЕ'
      )
    : true;

  const isSpeculativeFilled = state.newHdoData.speculative.isChecked
    ? !!(
        state.newHdoData.speculative.isChecked &&
        state.newHdoData.speculative.businessRelationTypeCode
      )
    : true;

  const isOneOfChecked = [
    state.newHdoData.speculative.isChecked,
    state.newHdoData.convers.isChecked,
    state.newHdoData.targets.isChecked,
    state.newHdoData.other.isChecked,
  ].some((it) => it);

  return !(isConversFilled && isTargetsFilled && isSpeculativeFilled && isOneOfChecked);
};

export const isSameItems = (state: HDOStateType, category: CategoriesType) => {
  const oldItem = state.oldHdoData[category];
  const newItem = state.newHdoData[category];
  return JSON.stringify(oldItem) === JSON.stringify(newItem);
};

export const isHdoItemsDifferent = (obj1: HdoCategoriesType, obj2: HdoCategoriesType): boolean => {
  return !(
    obj1.businessRelationCategoryCode.toUpperCase() ===
      obj2.businessRelationCategoryCode.toUpperCase() &&
    obj1.businessRelationTypeCode.toUpperCase() === obj2.businessRelationTypeCode.toUpperCase() &&
    obj1.businessRelationCode.toUpperCase() === obj2.businessRelationCode.toUpperCase()
  );
};

import { useGetHdoDictionariesQuery } from 'core/api/personalData';

export function useGetHdoData() {
  const { data: hdoDictionaries, isLoading: isHdoLoading } = useGetHdoDictionariesQuery();

  const dictionaries = hdoDictionaries?.businessRelationCategory;
  const operations = hdoDictionaries?.businessRelation;
  const purposes = hdoDictionaries?.businessRelationType;

  const mapa = dictionaries?.map((item) => {
    const id = item.businessRelationCategoryId;
    const currentPurposes = purposes
      ?.filter((element) => element.businessRelationCategoryId === id)
      .map((item) => {
        const items = operations?.filter(
          (op) => op.businessRelationTypeId === item.businessRelationTypeId,
        );
        return { ...item, categories: items };
      });
    return { id, currentPurposes, code: item.businessRelationCategoryCode };
  });

  return { mapa, isHdoLoading, dictionaries };
}

import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { BusinessRelationsType, DraftProfileResponse } from 'types/investmentProfile';

import { CONVERS_CATEGORY, OTHER_CATEGORY, SPECULATIVE_CATEGORY, TARGETS_CATEGORY } from '../const';
import { HDOStateType, HdoBusinessCategories } from '../types';

export function useGetInitialHdoData2(
  businessRelations: BusinessRelationsType[],
  formDraft: DraftProfileResponse | undefined,
  isFormDraftError: boolean,
  setState: React.Dispatch<Partial<HDOStateType>>,
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!formDraft || isFormDraftError) {
      const dataHdo = businessRelations;
      const otherHdo = dataHdo.find((it) => it.businessRelationCategoryCode === OTHER_CATEGORY);
      const converseHdo = dataHdo.find(
        (it) => it.businessRelationCategoryCode === CONVERS_CATEGORY,
      );
      const targetsHdo = dataHdo.find((it) => it.businessRelationCategoryCode === TARGETS_CATEGORY);
      const speculativeHdo = dataHdo.find(
        (it) => it.businessRelationCategoryCode === SPECULATIVE_CATEGORY,
      );

      const hdoData: HdoBusinessCategories = {
        other: {
          businessRelationCategoryCode: OTHER_CATEGORY,
          businessRelationTypeCode: '',
          businessRelationCode: '',
          isChecked: !!otherHdo?.businessRelationCategoryCode,
        },
        convers: {
          businessRelationCategoryCode: CONVERS_CATEGORY,
          businessRelationTypeCode: converseHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode || '',
          businessRelationCode: converseHdo?.businessRelationCode || '',
          isChecked: !!converseHdo?.businessRelationCategoryCode,
        },
        speculative: {
          businessRelationCategoryCode: SPECULATIVE_CATEGORY,
          businessRelationTypeCode: speculativeHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode || '',
          businessRelationCode: speculativeHdo?.businessRelationCode || '',
          isChecked: !!speculativeHdo?.businessRelationCategoryCode,
        },
        targets: {
          businessRelationCategoryCode: TARGETS_CATEGORY,
          businessRelationTypeCode: targetsHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode || '',
          businessRelationCode: targetsHdo?.businessRelationCode || '',
          isChecked: !!targetsHdo?.businessRelationCategoryCode,
        },
      };
      setState({
        newHdoData: hdoData,
        oldHdoData: hdoData,
      });
    }

    if (formDraft) {
      const dataHdo = formDraft.personBusinessRelation;
      const converseHdo = dataHdo.find(
        (it) => it.businessRelationCategoryCode === CONVERS_CATEGORY,
      );
      const targetsHdo = dataHdo.find((it) => it.businessRelationCategoryCode === TARGETS_CATEGORY);
      const speculativeHdo = dataHdo.find(
        (it) => it.businessRelationCategoryCode === SPECULATIVE_CATEGORY,
      );
      const otherHdo = dataHdo.find((it) => it.businessRelationCategoryCode === OTHER_CATEGORY);

      const hdoData: HdoBusinessCategories = {
        other: {
          businessRelationCategoryCode: OTHER_CATEGORY,
          businessRelationTypeCode: '',
          businessRelationCode: '',
          isChecked: !!otherHdo,
        },
        convers: {
          businessRelationCategoryCode: CONVERS_CATEGORY,
          businessRelationTypeCode: converseHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode || '',
          businessRelationCode: converseHdo?.businessRelationCode || '',
          isChecked: !!converseHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode,
        },
        speculative: {
          businessRelationCategoryCode: SPECULATIVE_CATEGORY,
          businessRelationTypeCode: speculativeHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode || '',
          businessRelationCode: speculativeHdo?.businessRelationCode || '',
          isChecked: !!speculativeHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode,
        },
        targets: {
          businessRelationCategoryCode: TARGETS_CATEGORY,
          businessRelationTypeCode: targetsHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode || '',
          businessRelationCode: targetsHdo?.businessRelationCode || '',
          isChecked: !!targetsHdo?.businessRelationTypeCode,
        },
      };
      setState({
        newHdoData: hdoData,
        oldHdoData: hdoData,
      });
    }
  }, [businessRelations, formDraft, isFormDraftError, setState]);
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { HDOStateType } from '../types';

export function useHdoDataChanged(state: HDOStateType) {
  const [isHdoChanged, setIsHdoChanged] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isOtherBlockEqual = JSON.stringify(state.newHdoData) === JSON.stringify(state.oldHdoData);
    setIsHdoChanged(!isOtherBlockEqual);
  }, [state.newHdoData, state.oldHdoData]);
  return isHdoChanged;
}

import { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useCallback } from 'react';

import { useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';
import { MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES } from 'const/messages';

import {
  useCancelFormDraftMutation,
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useSaveFormBusinessRelationsMutation,
  useSaveFormDraftMutation,
  useSaveFormPersonDataMutation,
} from 'core/api/personalData';

import {
  changeCurrentSectorStatus,
  getPersonalDataErrorMessage,
  getSectorsWithErrors,
  throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';
import { PersonalSectorsType } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/types';

import { isHdoItemsDifferent, isSameItems } from '../helper';
import { CategoryCodes, HDOStateType, HdoCategoriesType, RequestBusinessDataType } from '../types';

export function useSaveHdoData(
  requestGuid: string,
  personalSectors: PersonalSectorsType,
  setPersonalSectors: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PersonalSectorsType | undefined>>,
  goBack: () => void,
  state: HDOStateType,
) {
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();
  const [cancelForm] = useCancelFormDraftMutation();
  const [saveBusinessRelations, { isLoading: isSaveBusinessRelationsLoading }] =
    useSaveFormBusinessRelationsMutation();
  const [saveFormDraft, { isLoading: isSaveFormDraftLoading }] = useSaveFormDraftMutation();
  const [checkForm, { isLoading: isCheckFormLoading }] = useLazyCheckFormQuery();
  const [savePersonData, { isLoading: isSavePersonDataLoading }] = useSaveFormPersonDataMutation();

  const showSaveError = useCallback(
    (error: unknown) => {
      const label = getPersonalDataErrorMessage(error) ?? MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES;
      snackbarTopAlert?.show({
        autoClose: 3000,
        label,
        variant: 'primary',
      });
    },
    [snackbarTopAlert],
  );

  const saveData = useCallback(async () => {
    const { oldHdoData, newHdoData } = state;

    const isConversDataChanged = isHdoItemsDifferent(oldHdoData.convers, newHdoData.convers);
    const conversProps: RequestBusinessDataType = {
      request_Guid: requestGuid,
      action: isConversDataChanged ? 'U' : 'I',
      businessRelationCategoryCode:
        newHdoData.convers.businessRelationCategoryCode.toUpperCase() as CategoryCodes,
      businessRelationTypeCode: newHdoData.convers.businessRelationTypeCode.toUpperCase(),
      businessRelationCode: newHdoData.convers.businessRelationCode.toUpperCase(),
    };

    const isSpeculativeDataChanged = isHdoItemsDifferent(
      oldHdoData.speculative,
      newHdoData.speculative,
    );
    const speculativeProps: RequestBusinessDataType = {
      request_Guid: requestGuid,
      action: isSpeculativeDataChanged ? 'U' : 'I',
      businessRelationCategoryCode:
        newHdoData.speculative.businessRelationCategoryCode.toUpperCase() as CategoryCodes,
      businessRelationTypeCode: newHdoData.speculative.businessRelationTypeCode.toUpperCase(),
    };

    const isTargetsDataChanged = isHdoItemsDifferent(oldHdoData.targets, newHdoData.targets);
    const targetsProps: RequestBusinessDataType = {
      request_Guid: requestGuid,
      action: isTargetsDataChanged ? 'U' : 'I',
      businessRelationCategoryCode:
        newHdoData.targets.businessRelationCategoryCode.toUpperCase() as CategoryCodes,
      businessRelationTypeCode: newHdoData.targets.businessRelationTypeCode.toUpperCase(),
      businessRelationCode: newHdoData.targets.businessRelationCode.toUpperCase(),
    };

    const otherProps: RequestBusinessDataType = {
      request_Guid: requestGuid,
      action: oldHdoData.other.isChecked ? 'U' : 'I',
      businessRelationCategoryCode:
        newHdoData.other.businessRelationCategoryCode.toUpperCase() as CategoryCodes,
    };

    try {
      throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(await savePersonData({ requestGuid }).unwrap());

      const saveIfChecked = async (
        isChecked: boolean,
        newProps: RequestBusinessDataType,
        oldProps: HdoCategoriesType,
        skip?: boolean,
      ) => {
        if (skip) return;
        if (isChecked) {
          throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(await saveBusinessRelations(newProps).unwrap());
        } else if (oldProps.isChecked) {
          throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(
            await saveBusinessRelations({ ...newProps, action: 'D' }).unwrap(),
          );
        }
      };

      await saveIfChecked(
        newHdoData.convers.isChecked,
        conversProps,
        oldHdoData.convers,
        isSameItems(state, 'convers'),
      );
      await saveIfChecked(
        newHdoData.speculative.isChecked,
        speculativeProps,
        oldHdoData.speculative,
        isSameItems(state, 'speculative'),
      );
      await saveIfChecked(
        newHdoData.targets.isChecked,
        targetsProps,
        oldHdoData.targets,
        isSameItems(state, 'targets'),
      );
      await saveIfChecked(
        newHdoData.other.isChecked,
        otherProps,
        oldHdoData.other,
        isSameItems(state, 'other'),
      );

      const errors = await checkForm({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
      throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(await saveFormDraft({ requestGuid }).unwrap());

      const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errors, personalSectors);
      const updatedSectors = changeCurrentSectorStatus(sectorsWithErrors, 'Relationships');
      setPersonalSectors(updatedSectors);
      goBack();
    } catch (error) {
      showSaveError(error);
      await cancelForm({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [
    requestGuid,
    state,
    personalSectors,
    savePersonData,
    checkForm,
    saveFormDraft,
    setPersonalSectors,
    goBack,
    saveBusinessRelations,
    cancelForm,
    showSaveError,
  ]);

  return {
    saveData,
    isSaving:
      isSaveBusinessRelationsLoading ||
      isSaveFormDraftLoading ||
      isSavePersonDataLoading ||
      isCheckFormLoading,
  };
}

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const BHContent = () => {
  const myComponentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (myComponentRef.current) {
      myComponentRef.current.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <div ref={myComponentRef} className={styles.wrapper}>
        <Text className={styles.subtitle} type={'subtitleBold'}>
          Зачем нужно обновлять данные в анкете?
        </Text>
        <Text type={'lineRegular'}>
          У брокера есть законодательное требование не только проводить идентификацию клиентов до
          приёма на обслуживание, но и обновлять данную информацию не реже одного раза в год либо
          при возникновении сомнений в достоверности и точности ранее полученной информации. Важно
          своевременно предоставлять брокеру информацию об изменении анкетных данных, иначе
          возникнут проблемы с вашей идентификацией.
        </Text>
        <Text className={styles.subtitle} type="subtitleBold">
          Подтверждение личности
        </Text>

        <Text type={'lineRegular'}>
          При обслуживании главным документом, удостоверяющим вашу личность, является паспорт.
          Данные паспорта указаны в вашей анкете, и сотрудник сверяет информацию в анкете с
          информацией из паспорта, который вы представили. Расхождение информации может осложнить
          простейшую операцию. Получить деньги на счёт будет гораздо сложнее: клиентскому менеджеру
          нужно будет предоставить информацию, что вы — это вы. Пока информация не будет обновлена,
          вам может быть отказано в обслуживании.
        </Text>
        <Text className={styles.subtitle} type="subtitleBold">
          Наличие актуальной контактной информации
        </Text>

        <Text type={'lineRegular'}>
          Смена адреса регистрации, почтового адреса или номера телефона также может создать
          проблемы при обслуживании: брокер может направлять ответные письма на запросы клиента или
          иную информацию по почте, а значит, если вы переехали и живете по другому адресу, данная
          информация не будет вам доставлена. Наличие актуальных контактов — не прихоть брокера, а
          возможность своевременно связаться с клиентом для предоставления важной информации.
        </Text>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};
export default BHContent;

import React, { memo, useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Placeholder, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_360 } from 'const/routes';

import BHContent from './BHContent';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const OnboardingPage: React.FC<OnboardingPageProps> = memo(({ handleBackClick }) => {
  const [bhOpen, setBhOpen] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const onLeftIconClick = useCallback(() => {
    navigate(ROUTE_360);

        variant={'success'}
        text={
          <div>
            <p>
              Подтвердите, что ваши данные не изменились, или обновите их. Это нужно, чтобы
              сохранить доступ к торговым и другим операциям.
            </p>
            <div onClick={() => setBhOpen(true)}>
              <Text className={styles.link} type={'bodyRegular'} color={'colorAccent'}>
                Зачем обновлять анкету?

            </div>
          </div>

        title={'Обновление данных'}

      />
      <BottomSheet open={bhOpen} onDismiss={() => setBhOpen(false)}>

    </>

});

import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { RequestErrorList } from 'types/personalData';

import { correctDateValue, correctValue, needToFill, onlyRussianChars } from './const';
import { IdStateType } from './types';

export const passportSeriesFormatter = (series: string) => {
  const clearSeries = series.replace(/\s/g, '');
  return clearSeries.slice(0, 2) + ' ' + clearSeries.slice(2);
};

export const isPassportFormErrors = (state: IdStateType) => {
  const {
    isFirstNameError,
    isLastNameError,
    isThirdNameError,
    isNoThirdName,
    thirdName,
    firstName,
    lastName,
  } = state.newFioData;
  const {
    isDateOfIssueError,
    isDepartmentCodeError,
    isIssuedByError,
    isNumberOfDocumentError,
    isSeriesOfDocumentError,
    dateOfIssue,
    numberOfDocument,
    seriesOfDocument,
    departmentCode,
    issuedBy,
  } = state.newPassportData;

  const isFioDataErrorsDetected =
    isFirstNameError || isLastNameError || isThirdNameError || (thirdName === '' && !isNoThirdName);

  const isFioEmptyField =
    firstName === '' || lastName === '' || (thirdName === '' && !isNoThirdName);

  const isPassportDataErrorsDetected =
    isDateOfIssueError ||
    isDepartmentCodeError ||
    isIssuedByError ||
    isNumberOfDocumentError ||
    isSeriesOfDocumentError;

  const isPassportEmptyField =
    dateOfIssue === '' ||
    departmentCode === '' ||
    issuedBy === '' ||
    numberOfDocument === '' ||
    seriesOfDocument === '';

  const isErrorDetected =
    isFioDataErrorsDetected ||
    isPassportDataErrorsDetected ||
    isFioEmptyField ||
    isPassportEmptyField;
  return isErrorDetected;
};

export const dateFormatterForSave = (dateString: string) => {
  const dateTime = DateTime.fromFormat(dateString, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
  if (!dateTime.isValid) {
    console.error('Invalid date format:', dateString);
    return dateString;
  }
  return dateTime.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);
};

export const visualDateFormatter = (dateString: string) => {
  let dateTime = DateTime.fromFormat(dateString, DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);

  if (!dateTime.isValid) {
    dateTime = DateTime.fromFormat(dateString, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
  }

  if (!dateTime.isValid) {
    console.error('Invalid date format:', dateString);
    return dateString;
  }

  return dateTime.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
};

export const capitalizeString = (str: string): string =>
  str ? str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1).toLowerCase() : '';

export const fieldNumberDescription = (
  isError: boolean,
  fieldValue: string,
  requestError?: RequestErrorList | null,
) => {
  if (requestError) return requestError.shortMessage;
  if (!fieldValue.length) return needToFill;
  return isError ? correctValue : '';
};

export const fieldDateDescription = (
  isError: boolean,
  fieldValue: string,
  requestError?: RequestErrorList | null,
) => {
  if (requestError) return requestError.shortMessage;
  if (!fieldValue.length) return needToFill;
  return isError ? correctDateValue : '';
};

export const fieldDescription = (
  isError: boolean,
  fieldValue: string,
  requestError?: RequestErrorList | null,
) => {
  if (requestError) return requestError.shortMessage;
  if (!fieldValue.length) return needToFill;
  return isError ? onlyRussianChars : '';
};

export const descriptionStatus = (
  isError: boolean,
  fieldValue: string,
  requestError?: RequestErrorList | null,
) => {
  return requestError || isError || fieldValue === '' ? 'error' : undefined;
};

export const dateSplitter = (date: string): number => {
  const dateTime = DateTime.fromFormat(date, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);

  if (!dateTime.isValid) {
    console.error('Invalid date format:', date);
    return Number.NaN;
  }

  return dateTime.toMillis();
};

export const futureDateTimeStamper = (timestamp: number, years: number): number => {
  if (!timestamp || Number.isNaN(timestamp)) {
    console.error('Invalid timestamp:', timestamp);
    return Number.NaN;
  }

  const dateTime = DateTime.fromMillis(timestamp);
  if (!dateTime.isValid) return Number.NaN;

  return dateTime.plus({ years }).toMillis();
};

export const isValidDateOfIssue = (dateOfIssue: string, dateOfBirth: string) => {
  const dateOfIssueTimeStamp = dateSplitter(dateOfIssue);
  const dateOfBirthTimeStamp = dateSplitter(dateOfBirth);
  const currentDayTimeStamp = Date.now();

  const diffYears = DateTime.fromMillis(currentDayTimeStamp).diff(
    DateTime.fromMillis(dateOfBirthTimeStamp),
    'years',
  ).years;

  if (dateOfIssueTimeStamp > currentDayTimeStamp) return false;
  if (dateOfIssueTimeStamp > futureDateTimeStamper(dateOfBirthTimeStamp, 45) && diffYears > 45) {
    return true;
  } else if (
    dateOfIssueTimeStamp > futureDateTimeStamper(dateOfBirthTimeStamp, 20) &&
    dateOfIssueTimeStamp < futureDateTimeStamper(dateOfBirthTimeStamp, 45) &&
    diffYears < 45 &&
    diffYears > 20
  ) {
    return true;
  } else if (
    dateOfIssueTimeStamp > futureDateTimeStamper(dateOfBirthTimeStamp, 14) &&
    dateOfIssueTimeStamp < futureDateTimeStamper(dateOfBirthTimeStamp, 20) &&
    diffYears < 20
  ) {
    return true;
  } else {
    return false;
  }
};

import { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';

import { useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';
import { MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES } from 'const/messages';

import {
  useCancelFormDraftMutation,
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useSaveFormDraftMutation,
  useSaveFormFIOMutation,
  useSaveFormPassportMutation,
} from 'core/api/personalData';

import {
  changeCurrentSectorStatus,
  getSectorsWithErrors,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';
import { PersonalSectorsType } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/types';

import { PersonalDataFIORequest, PersonalDataPassportRequest } from 'types/personalData';

import { PASPORT_ERROR_FIELD_CODES } from '../const';
import { dateFormatterForSave, passportSeriesFormatter } from '../helper';
import { IdStateType } from '../types';
import { useIsPassportDataChanged } from './useIsPassportChanged';

const useFormSave = (
  requestGuid: string,
  personalSectors: PersonalSectorsType,
  setPersonalSectors: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PersonalSectorsType | undefined>>,
  goBack: () => void,
  state: IdStateType,
) => {
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();
  const [cancelForm] = useCancelFormDraftMutation();
  const [saveFIO, { isError: saveFioError, isLoading: isSaveFioLoading }] =
    useSaveFormFIOMutation();
  const [savePassport, { isError: savePassportError, isLoading: isSavePassportLoading }] =
    useSaveFormPassportMutation();
  const [saveFormDraft, { isLoading: isSaveFormDraftLoading }] = useSaveFormDraftMutation();
  const [checkForm, { isLoading: isCheckFormLoading }] = useLazyCheckFormQuery();
  const { isFioChanged, isPassportDataChanged } = useIsPassportDataChanged(state);
  const saveError = saveFioError || savePassportError;

  const saveData = useCallback(async () => {
    const fioProps: PersonalDataFIORequest = {
      requestGuid,
      firstName: state.newFioData.firstName.trim(),
      lastName: state.newFioData.lastName.trim(),
      middleName: state.newFioData.isNoThirdName ? '' : state.newFioData.thirdName.trim(),
      noMiddleName: state.newFioData.isNoThirdName,
    };

    const passportProps: PersonalDataPassportRequest = {
      requestGuid,
      issueDate: dateFormatterForSave(state.newPassportData.dateOfIssue),
      issuingAuthority: state.newPassportData.issuedBy,
      issuingAuthorityCode: state.newPassportData.departmentCode,
      series: passportSeriesFormatter(state.newPassportData.seriesOfDocument),
      number: state.newPassportData.numberOfDocument,
    };

    try {
      if (isFioChanged) {
        await saveFIO(fioProps).unwrap();
      }
      if (isPassportDataChanged) {
        await savePassport(passportProps).unwrap();
      }
      const errors = await checkForm({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
      const passportErrors =
        errors?.filter((item) => PASPORT_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(item.fieldCode)) || [];

      if (!passportErrors.length) {
        await saveFormDraft({ requestGuid });

        const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errors, personalSectors);
        const updatedSectors = changeCurrentSectorStatus(sectorsWithErrors, 'Id');
        setPersonalSectors(updatedSectors);

        goBack();
      } else {
        const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errors, personalSectors);
        setPersonalSectors(sectorsWithErrors);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      await cancelForm({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [
    requestGuid,
    state.newFioData.firstName,
    state.newFioData.lastName,
    state.newFioData.isNoThirdName,
    state.newFioData.thirdName,
    state.newPassportData.dateOfIssue,
    state.newPassportData.issuedBy,
    state.newPassportData.departmentCode,
    state.newPassportData.seriesOfDocument,
    state.newPassportData.numberOfDocument,
    isFioChanged,
    isPassportDataChanged,
    checkForm,
    saveFIO,
    savePassport,
    saveFormDraft,
    personalSectors,
    setPersonalSectors,
    goBack,
    cancelForm,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!saveError) return;
    //waiting for group-arr of snacks component
    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 3000,
      label: MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES,
      variant: 'primary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [cancelForm, requestGuid, saveError, snackbarTopAlert]);

  return {
    saveData,
    isSaving:
      isCheckFormLoading || isSaveFioLoading || isSavePassportLoading || isSaveFormDraftLoading,
  };
};

export default useFormSave;

import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { PersonDataType, PersonDocumentType, ProfileResponse } from 'types/investmentProfile';

import { capitalizeString, isValidDateOfIssue } from '../helper';
import { FIOPassportType, IdStateType, PassportType } from '../types';

export function useGetInitialPassportData(
  formDraft: ProfileResponse | undefined,
  isFormDraftError: boolean,
  setState: React.Dispatch<Partial<IdStateType>>,
  personPassport: PersonDocumentType | undefined,
  personFio: PersonDataType | undefined,
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!formDraft || isFormDraftError) {
      const birthDate = personFio?.birthDate
        ? DateTime.fromISO(personFio.birthDate).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)
        : '';
      const issueDate = personPassport?.issueDate
        ? DateTime.fromISO(personPassport.issueDate).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)
        : '';
      const fioData: FIOPassportType = {
        firstName: capitalizeString(personFio?.nameFirst || ''),
        lastName: capitalizeString(personFio?.nameLast || ''),
        thirdName: capitalizeString(personFio?.nameMiddle || ''),
        isNoThirdName: personFio?.nameMiddle === undefined || personFio?.nameMiddle === '',
        isFirstNameError: false,
        isLastNameError: false,
        isThirdNameError: false,
      };

      const passportData: PassportType = {
        dateOfBirth: birthDate,
        placeOfBirth: personFio?.birthPlace || '',
        citizenship: personFio?.citizenshipCountryName || '',
        typeOfDocument: personPassport?.documentTypeName || '',
        seriesOfDocument: personPassport?.series || '',
        isSeriesOfDocumentError: false,
        numberOfDocument: personPassport?.number || '',
        isNumberOfDocumentError: false,
        issuedBy: personPassport?.issuedBy || '',
        isIssuedByError: false,
        dateOfIssue: issueDate,
        isDateOfIssueError:
          Boolean(issueDate) && Boolean(birthDate) && !isValidDateOfIssue(issueDate, birthDate),
        departmentCode: personPassport?.subdivisionCode || '',
        isDepartmentCodeError: false,
        expirationDate: personPassport?.expiryDate
          ? DateTime.fromISO(personPassport.expiryDate).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)
          : '',
      };
      setState({
        newFioData: fioData,
        oldFioData: fioData,
        newPassportData: passportData,
        oldPassportData: passportData,
      });
    }
  }, [formDraft, isFormDraftError, personFio, personPassport, setState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (formDraft) {
      const {
        firstName,
        lastName,
        middleName,
        birthDate,
        birthPlace,
        noMiddleName,
        citizenshipCountryName,
      } = formDraft.personIdentity[0];

      const {
        documentTypeName,
        series,
        number,
        issueDate,
        issuedBy,
        issuingAuthorityCode,
        expiryDate,
        issuingAuthority,
      } = formDraft.personDocument[0];

      const fioData: FIOPassportType = {
        firstName: capitalizeString(firstName),
        lastName: capitalizeString(lastName),
        thirdName: capitalizeString(middleName),
        isNoThirdName: noMiddleName,
        isFirstNameError: false,
        isLastNameError: false,
        isThirdNameError: false,
      };

      const passportData: PassportType = {
        dateOfBirth: DateTime.fromISO(birthDate.toString()).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT),
        placeOfBirth: birthPlace,
        citizenship: citizenshipCountryName,
        typeOfDocument: documentTypeName,
        seriesOfDocument: series,
        isSeriesOfDocumentError: false,
        numberOfDocument: number,
        isNumberOfDocumentError: false,
        issuedBy: capitalizeString(issuingAuthority),
        isIssuedByError: false,
        dateOfIssue: DateTime.fromISO(issueDate).toISODate(),
        isDateOfIssueError: !isValidDateOfIssue(
          DateTime.fromISO(issueDate).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT),
          DateTime.fromISO(birthDate.toString()).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT),
        ),
        departmentCode: issuingAuthorityCode || '',
        isDepartmentCodeError: false,
        expirationDate: expiryDate
          ? DateTime.fromISO(expiryDate).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)
          : '',
      };
      setState({
        newFioData: fioData,
        oldFioData: fioData,
        newPassportData: passportData,
        oldPassportData: passportData,
      });
    }
  }, [formDraft, setState]);
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { IdStateType } from '../types';

export function useIsPassportDataChanged(state: IdStateType) {
  const [isFioChanged, setIsFioChanged] = useState(false);
  const [isPassportDataChanged, setIsPassportDataChanged] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const isFIODataEqual = JSON.stringify(state.newFioData) === JSON.stringify(state.oldFioData);

    const isPassportDataEqual =
      JSON.stringify(state.newPassportData) === JSON.stringify(state.oldPassportData);

    setIsFioChanged(!isFIODataEqual);
    setIsPassportDataChanged(!isPassportDataEqual);
  }, [state.newFioData, state.newPassportData, state.oldFioData, state.oldPassportData]);

  return { isFioChanged, isPassportDataChanged };
}

import { FC, useEffect, useReducer } from 'react';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text, useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyGetFormDraftQuery } from 'core/api/personalData';

import { idReducer } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import defaultIcon from 'images/icons/defaultSnackBar.png';

import ExclamationIcon from '../TaxesResidence/ExclamationIcon';
import styles from './Passport.module.pcss';
import PassportForm from './PassportForm';
import { initIdData } from './const';
import { isPassportFormErrors } from './helper';
import useFormSave from './hooks/useFormSave';
import { useGetInitialPassportData } from './hooks/useGetInitialPassportData';
import { useIsPassportDataChanged } from './hooks/useIsPassportChanged';
import { PassportProps } from './types';

const Passport: FC<PassportProps> = ({
  goBack,
  setPersonalSectors,
  personalSectors,
  disabled,
  requestGuid,
  personPassport,
  personFio,
  errorText,
  sectorErrorsFromCheck,
}) => {
  const { snackbarInfo } = useSnackbars();
  const [getFormDraft, { data: formDraft, isError: isFormDraftError }] = useLazyGetFormDraftQuery();
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(idReducer, initIdData);
  const { isFioChanged, isPassportDataChanged } = useIsPassportDataChanged(state);
  const citizenshipCode = personFio?.[0]?.citizenshipCountryCode?.toUpperCase?.() || '';
  const citizenshipName = personFio?.[0]?.citizenshipCountryName?.trim?.().toLowerCase?.() || '';
  const isRussianCitizenship =
    citizenshipCode === '643' ||
    citizenshipCode === 'RU' ||
    citizenshipCode === 'RUS' ||
    citizenshipName === 'российская федерация';
  const isPassportEditBlockedForNonResident = !isRussianCitizenship;
  const nonResidentPassportEditMessage =
    'Ваше гражданство не позволяет обновить паспортные данные онлайн. Пожалуйста, обратитесь в офис';

  useGetInitialPassportData(formDraft, isFormDraftError, setState, personPassport[0], personFio[0]);

  // const isRussianFederationPasport = useMemo(() => {
  //   const mainDoc = personPassport.find(d => d.isMain);

  //   return mainDoc?.documentCategoryCode === 'Identity Card' && mainDoc.documentTypeCode === 'Passport';
  // }, [personPassport]);

  const { saveData, isSaving } = useFormSave(
    requestGuid,
    personalSectors,
    setPersonalSectors,
    goBack,
    state,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (personalSectors.Id === 'changed') {
      getFormDraft({ requestGuid: requestGuid });
    }
  }, [getFormDraft, personalSectors.Id, requestGuid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(disabled && errorText)) return;
    const id = snackbarInfo?.show({
      autoClose: 5000,
      caption: <span>{errorText}</span>,
      variant: 'primary',
      icon: <img style={{ width: '40px' }} src={defaultIcon} alt="snackBarImage" />,
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarInfo?.close(id);
    };
  }, [disabled, errorText, snackbarInfo]);

  if (isSaving) {
    return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;
  }

  const isSaveBtnDisabled =
    disabled ||
    isPassportEditBlockedForNonResident ||
    !(isFioChanged || isPassportDataChanged) ||
    isPassportFormErrors(state);

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="Редактирование данных" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text type="title" className={styles.title}>
            Паспортные данные
          </Text>
          <PassportForm
            state={state}
            setState={setState}
            disabled={disabled || isPassportEditBlockedForNonResident}
            sectorErrorsFromCheck={sectorErrorsFromCheck}
          />
        </div>

        {isPassportEditBlockedForNonResident && (
          <div className={styles.btnNotification}>
            <div className={styles.icon}>
              <ExclamationIcon />
            </div>
            <Text type="labelRegular">{nonResidentPassportEditMessage}</Text>
          </div>
        )}

        {!isPassportEditBlockedForNonResident && isPassportFormErrors(state) && (
          <div className={styles.btnNotification}>
            <div className={styles.icon}>
              <ExclamationIcon />
            </div>
            <Text type="labelRegular">Заполните все поля</Text>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          <Button disabled={isSaveBtnDisabled} onClick={saveData}>
            Сохранить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default Passport;

import { FC, useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import { Checkbox, DatePicker, Input, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { ReactComponent as Calendar } from 'images/icons/calendarI.svg';

import styles from './Passport.module.pcss';
import { PASPORT_ERROR_CODES_FOR_INPUTS, rusFields } from './const';
import {
  descriptionStatus,
  fieldDateDescription,
  fieldDescription,
  fieldNumberDescription,
  isValidDateOfIssue,
  visualDateFormatter,
} from './helper';
import { IdPassportField, PassportFormProps, PassportFormType } from './types';

const PassportForm: FC<PassportFormProps> = ({
  setState,
  state,
  disabled,
  sectorErrorsFromCheck,
}) => {
  const [openBSDateIssue, setOpenBSDateIssue] = useState(false);
  const setCustomState = (
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
    field: IdPassportField,
    type: PassportFormType,
  ) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    const rusRegex = /^[\sЁА-яё-]+$/;

    const departmentRegex = /^(?=.*[\d"#(),./\\_invx«»а-яё“„№-])[\d\s"#(),./\\_invx«»а-яё“„№-]+$/gi;
    if (!rusRegex.test(value) && value !== '' && rusFields.includes(field)) return;
    if (!departmentRegex.test(value) && field === 'issuedBy' && value !== '') return;
    if (value.split('').filter((it) => it === ' ').length > 1 && field !== 'issuedBy') return;

    setState({
      [type]: {
        ...state[type],
        [field]: value,
      },
    });
  };

  const inputErrors = useMemo(
    () =>
      sectorErrorsFromCheck.filter((item) =>
        PASPORT_ERROR_CODES_FOR_INPUTS.includes(item.errorCode),
      ),
    [sectorErrorsFromCheck],
  );

  const setCustomError = (field: IdPassportField, condition: boolean, type: PassportFormType) => {
    setState({
      [type]: {
        ...state[type],
        [field]: condition,
      },
    });
  };

  const noMiddleNameHandler = useCallback(() => {
    setState({
      newFioData: {
        ...state.newFioData,
        isNoThirdName: !state.newFioData.isNoThirdName,
        thirdName: '',
      },
    });
  }, [setState, state.newFioData]);

  const onDateSubmit = useCallback(
    (e: Date[]) => {
      const currentDate = e[0];
      if (!currentDate) return;
      setState({
        newPassportData: {
          ...state.newPassportData,
          dateOfIssue: DateTime.fromJSDate(new Date(currentDate)).toFormat(
            DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT,
          ),
        },
      });
      setOpenBSDateIssue(false);
    },
    [setState, state.newPassportData],
  );

  const {
    isFirstNameError,
    isLastNameError,
    isNoThirdName,
    isThirdNameError,
    lastName,
    firstName,
    thirdName,
  } = state.newFioData;

  const {
    isDateOfIssueError,
    isDepartmentCodeError,
    isIssuedByError,
    isNumberOfDocumentError,
    isSeriesOfDocumentError,
    issuedBy,
    dateOfBirth,
    dateOfIssue,
    departmentCode,
    placeOfBirth,
    citizenship,
    typeOfDocument,
    seriesOfDocument,
    numberOfDocument,
    expirationDate,
  } = state.newPassportData;

  const dateOFIssueController = () =>
    setCustomError(
      'isDateOfIssueError',
      dateOfIssue.length === 0 || !isValidDateOfIssue(dateOfIssue, dateOfBirth),
      'newPassportData',
    );

  //** ошибки полей, полученные из метода draft/check */
  const expiryDateRequestError = useMemo(
    () => inputErrors.find((e) => e.fieldCode === 'Document.ExpiryDate'),
    [inputErrors],
  );
  const issueDateRequestError = useMemo(
    () => inputErrors.find((e) => e.fieldCode === 'Document.IssueDate'),
    [inputErrors],
  );

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.formWrapper}>
        <Input
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'lastName', 'newFioData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Фамилия"
          value={lastName}
          className={styles.input}
          status={descriptionStatus(isLastNameError, lastName)}
          description={fieldDescription(isLastNameError, lastName)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setCustomError(
              'isLastNameError',
              lastName.length === 0 || lastName === ' ',
              'newFioData',
            );
          }}
          disabled={disabled}
        />
        <Input
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'firstName', 'newFioData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Имя"
          value={firstName}
          className={styles.input}
          status={descriptionStatus(isFirstNameError, firstName)}
          description={fieldDescription(isFirstNameError, firstName)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setCustomError(
              'isFirstNameError',
              firstName.length === 0 || firstName === ' ',
              'newFioData',
            );
          }}
        />
        {!isNoThirdName && (
          <Input
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'thirdName', 'newFioData')}
            placeholder=""
            label="Отчество"
            value={thirdName}
            className={styles.input}
            status={descriptionStatus(isThirdNameError, thirdName)}
            description={fieldDescription(isThirdNameError, thirdName)}
            onBlur={() => {
              setCustomError(
                'isThirdNameError',
                thirdName.length === 0 || thirdName === ' ',
                'newFioData',
              );
            }}
          />
        )}
        <Checkbox
          checked={isNoThirdName}
          onChange={noMiddleNameHandler}
          label="Нет отчества"
          className={styles.checkBox}
          disabled={disabled}
        />
        <Input
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'dateOfBirth', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Дата рождения"
          value={dateOfBirth}
          className={styles.input}
          disabled
          addonAfter={<Calendar />}
        />
        <Input
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'placeOfBirth', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Место рождения"
          value={placeOfBirth || 'г.Москва'}
          className={styles.input}
          disabled
        />
        <Input
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'citizenship', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Гражданство"
          value={citizenship || 'Российская Федерация'}
          className={styles.input}
          disabled
        />
        <Input
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'typeOfDocument', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Тип документа"
          value={typeOfDocument || 'Паспорт'}
          className={styles.input}
          disabled
        />
        <Input
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'seriesOfDocument', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Серия"
          mask="9999"
          value={seriesOfDocument}
          className={styles.input}
          status={descriptionStatus(isSeriesOfDocumentError, seriesOfDocument)}
          description={fieldNumberDescription(isSeriesOfDocumentError, seriesOfDocument)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setCustomError(
              'isSeriesOfDocumentError',
              seriesOfDocument.length < 4,
              'newPassportData',
            );
          }}
        />
        <Input
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'numberOfDocument', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Номер"
          mask="999999"
          value={numberOfDocument}
          className={styles.input}
          status={descriptionStatus(isNumberOfDocumentError, numberOfDocument)}
          description={fieldNumberDescription(isNumberOfDocumentError, numberOfDocument)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setCustomError(
              'isNumberOfDocumentError',
              numberOfDocument.length < 6,
              'newPassportData',
            );
          }}
        />
        <Input
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'issuedBy', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Кем выдан"
          value={issuedBy}
          className={styles.input}
          status={descriptionStatus(isIssuedByError, issuedBy)}
          description={fieldNumberDescription(isIssuedByError, issuedBy)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setCustomError('isIssuedByError', issuedBy.length === 0, 'newPassportData');
          }}
        />
        <div onClick={() => setOpenBSDateIssue(!disabled)}>
          <Input
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={(e) => null}
            placeholder=""
            label="Дата выдачи"
            value={visualDateFormatter(dateOfIssue)}
            className={styles.input}
            status={descriptionStatus(isDateOfIssueError, dateOfIssue, issueDateRequestError)}
            description={fieldDateDescription(
              isDateOfIssueError,
              dateOfIssue,
              issueDateRequestError,
            )}
            onBlur={dateOFIssueController}
            onFocus={dateOFIssueController}
            addonAfter={<Calendar />}
          />
        </div>
        <Input
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'departmentCode', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Код подразделения"
          mask="999-999"
          value={departmentCode}
          className={styles.input}
          status={descriptionStatus(isDepartmentCodeError, departmentCode)}
          description={fieldNumberDescription(isDepartmentCodeError, departmentCode)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setCustomError('isDepartmentCodeError', departmentCode?.length < 7, 'newPassportData');
          }}
        />
        <Input
          onChange={(e) => setCustomState(e, 'expirationDate', 'newPassportData')}
          placeholder=""
          label="Дата окончания"
          value={expirationDate}
          className={styles.input}
          status={descriptionStatus(false, expirationDate || '-', expiryDateRequestError)}
          description={fieldDateDescription(false, expirationDate || '-', expiryDateRequestError)}
          disabled
        />
      </div>
      <BottomSheetComponent
        open={openBSDateIssue}
        onDismiss={() => setOpenBSDateIssue(false)}
        onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <Text type="subtitleBold" color="colorForeground">
            Выберите дату выдачи
          </Text>
        </div>

        <DatePicker withPeriod={false} withOptions={false} onSubmit={onDateSubmit} />
      </BottomSheetComponent>
    </>
  );
};

export default PassportForm;

export type PassportProps = {

  personalSectors: PersonalSectorsType;
  disabled: boolean;
  requestGuid: string;
  personPassport: PersonDocumentType[];
  personFio: PersonDataType[];

  sectorErrorsFromCheck: RequestErrorList[];
};

export type IdPassportType = {
  firstName: string;
  isFirstNameError: boolean;
  lastName: string;
  isLastNameError: boolean;
  thirdName: string;
  isThirdNameError: boolean;
  isNoThirdName: boolean;
  dateOfBirth: string;
  placeOfBirth: string;
  citizenship: string;
  typeOfDocument: string;
  seriesOfDocument: string;
  isSeriesOfDocumentError: boolean;
  numberOfDocument: string;
  isNumberOfDocumentError: boolean;
  issuedBy: string;
  isIssuedByError: boolean;
  dateOfIssue: string;
  isDateOfIssueError: boolean;
  departmentCode: string;
  isDepartmentCodeError: boolean;
  expirationDate: string;
};

export type FIOPassportType = {
  firstName: string;
  isFirstNameError: boolean;
  lastName: string;
  isLastNameError: boolean;
  thirdName: string;
  isThirdNameError: boolean;
  isNoThirdName: boolean;
};

export type PassportType = {
  dateOfBirth: string;
  placeOfBirth: string;
  citizenship: string;
  typeOfDocument: string;
  seriesOfDocument: string;
  isSeriesOfDocumentError: boolean;
  numberOfDocument: string;
  isNumberOfDocumentError: boolean;
  issuedBy: string;
  isIssuedByError: boolean;
  dateOfIssue: string;
  isDateOfIssueError: boolean;
  departmentCode: string;
  isDepartmentCodeError: boolean;
  expirationDate: string;
};

export type IdStateType = {

  oldPassportData: PassportType;
  newFioData: FIOPassportType;

};

export type PassportFormProps = {
  setState: React.Dispatch<Partial<IdStateType>>;
  state: IdStateType;
  disabled: boolean;
  sectorErrorsFromCheck: RequestErrorList[];
};

export type PassportFormType = 'newFioData' | 'newPassportData';

export type IdPassportField = keyof IdPassportType;

export const CONTACTS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES = [
  'Email.PRIMARY',
  'Phone.PRIMARY',
  'Phone.General',
  'Email.General',
  'Email.ADDITIONAL',
  'Phone.ADDITIONAL',
];

export const CONTACTS_ERROR_CODES_FOR_INPUTS = [
  'PersonProfile.PhoneNumber',
  'PersonProfile.Email.Required',
  'PersonProfile.Phone.Required',
  'PersonProfile.Email.Format',
  'PersonProfile.Phone.Format',
];

export const CONTACTS_ERROR_CODES_FOR_SNACKBAR = [
  'PersonProfile.Email.Same',

];

const emailShapeRegexp = /[\w%+.-]+@[\d.a-z-]+\.[a-z]{2,64}/i;

export const isContactEmailFormatValid = (value: string) =>
  Boolean(value) && !value.includes('..') && emailShapeRegexp.test(value);

export const correctEmailRegexpChecker = { test: isContactEmailFormatValid };
