export { default } from './PersonalContacts';


--- FILE: src\modules\PersonalInformation\components\PersonalContacts\PersonalContacts.tsx ---

import React, { ChangeEvent, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useReducer, useState } from 'react';

import {
  BannerWarningLine,
  Button,
  CircleLoader,
  Input,
  Text,
  useSnackbars,
} from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES } from 'const/messages';

import {
  useCancelFormDraftMutation,
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useLazyGetFormDraftQuery,
  useSaveFormDraftMutation,
  useSaveFormEmailMutation,
  useSaveFormPhoneMutation,
} from 'core/api/personalData';

import {
  CONTACT_ERROR_MESSAGE,
  EMAIL_ADDITIONAL,
  EMAIL_ERROR_MESSAGE,
  EMAIL_PRIMARY,
  PHONE_ADDITIONAL,
  PHONE_ERROR_MESSAGE,
  PHONE_PRIMARY,
  getIsPersonProfileEdit,
  initPersonalContactsState,
  phoneRegex,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/constants';
import {
  changeCurrentSectorStatus,
  contactsReducer,
  getSectorsWithErrors,
  getValueChangeAction,
  isValid,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import defaultIcon from 'images/icons/defaultSnackBar.png';
import { ReactComponent as InfoBadgeIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/orangeBadgeIcon.svg';

import {
  PersonalDataEmailRequest,
  PersonalDataPhoneRequest,
  RequestErrorList,
} from 'types/personalData';

import {
  CONTACTS_ERROR_CODES_FOR_INPUTS,
  CONTACTS_ERROR_CODES_FOR_SNACKBAR,
  CONTACTS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES,
} from './constant';
import { correctEmailRegexpChecker } from './helper';
import styles from './personalContacts.module.pcss';
import { PersonalContactsProps } from './types';

const PersonalContacts: React.FC<PersonalContactsProps> = ({
  goBack,
  contactsData,
  requestGuid,
  personalSectors,
  setPersonalSectors,
  setSectorErrors,
  disabled,
  errorText,
  sectorErrorsFromCheck,
}) => {
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(contactsReducer, initPersonalContactsState);
  const [snackbarErrors, setSnackbarErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [inputErrors, setInputErrors] = useState<RequestErrorList[]>([]);
  const [cancelForm] = useCancelFormDraftMutation();
  const { snackbarInfo, snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();
  const isPersonProfileEdit = getIsPersonProfileEdit();
  const [
    getFormDraft,
    { data: formDraft, isLoading: isFormDraftLoading, isFetching: isFormDraftFetching },
  ] = useLazyGetFormDraftQuery();
  const [
    saveFormDraft,
    {
      isLoading: isSaveFormDraftDataLoading,
      isSuccess: isSaveFormDraftDataSuccess,
      isError: isSaveFormDraftDataError,
    },
  ] = useSaveFormDraftMutation();
  const [
    saveFormPhone,
    {
      data: formPhoneData,
      status: phoneChangeStatus,
      isError: isSavePhoneError,
      isLoading: isPhoneLoading,
    },
  ] = useSaveFormPhoneMutation();

  const [
    saveFormEmail,
    {
      data: formEmailData,
      status: emailChangeStatus,
      isError: isSaveEmailError,
      isLoading: isEmailLoading,
    },
  ] = useSaveFormEmailMutation();

  const [
    checkForm,
    {
      data: checkFormDraft,
      isError: isCheckFormError,
      isLoading: isCheckFormLoading,
      isFetching: isCheckFormFetching,
      fulfilledTimeStamp: checkFulfilledTimeStamp,
    },
  ] = useLazyCheckFormQuery();

  const isMainLoading =
    isPhoneLoading || isEmailLoading || isCheckFormLoading || isCheckFormFetching;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sectorErrorsFromCheck.length) {
      setSnackbarErrors(
        sectorErrorsFromCheck
          .filter((item) => CONTACTS_ERROR_CODES_FOR_SNACKBAR.includes(item.errorCode))
          .map((err) => err.fullMessage),
      );
    }
  }, [sectorErrorsFromCheck]);

  const checkAndSaveFormDraft = useCallback(async () => {
    if (requestGuid) {
      try {
        const errorList = await checkForm({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
        setSectorErrors(errorList);

        const contactsErrors =
          errorList?.filter((item) => CONTACTS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(item.fieldCode)) || [];

        setInputErrors(
          contactsErrors.filter((item) => CONTACTS_ERROR_CODES_FOR_INPUTS.includes(item.errorCode)),
        );
        setSnackbarErrors(
          contactsErrors
            .filter((item) => CONTACTS_ERROR_CODES_FOR_SNACKBAR.includes(item.errorCode))
            .map((item) => item.fullMessage),
        );

        if (!contactsErrors.length) {
          await saveFormDraft({ requestGuid }).unwrap();

          const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errorList, personalSectors);
          const updatedSectors = changeCurrentSectorStatus(sectorsWithErrors, 'ContactInfo');
          setPersonalSectors(updatedSectors);

          goBack();
        } else {
          const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errorList, personalSectors);
          setPersonalSectors(sectorsWithErrors);
        }
      } catch {
        await cancelForm({ requestGuid });
      }
    }
  }, [
    cancelForm,
    checkForm,
    goBack,
    personalSectors,
    requestGuid,
    saveFormDraft,
    setPersonalSectors,
    setSectorErrors,
  ]);

  const onPersonalContactsSave = useCallback(async () => {
    const savePromises = [];
    if (state.phone !== state.startPhone && !!state.phone) {
      const primaryPhoneData: PersonalDataPhoneRequest = {
        requestGuid,
        action: getValueChangeAction(state.startPhone, state.phone),
        areaCode: state.phone?.slice(0, 3) || '',
        contactTypeCode: 'PHONE_PRIMARY',
        countryCode: '7',
        phoneNumber: state.phone?.slice(3) || '',
        sequence: 1,
      };
      savePromises.push(saveFormPhone(primaryPhoneData));
    }
    if (state.email !== state.startEmail && !!state.email) {
      const primaryEmailData: PersonalDataEmailRequest = {
        requestGuid,
        action: getValueChangeAction(state.startEmail, state.email),
        contactTypeCode: 'EMAIL_PRIMARY',
        email: state.email,
        sequence: 1,
      };
      savePromises.push(saveFormEmail(primaryEmailData));
    }
    if (
      state.startAdditionalPhone !== state.additionalPhone ||
      state.startAdditionalPhoneCode !== state.additionalPhoneCode
    ) {
      const additionalPhoneData: PersonalDataPhoneRequest = {
        requestGuid,
        action: getValueChangeAction(
          `${state.startAdditionalPhoneCode}${state.startAdditionalPhone}`,
          `${state.additionalPhoneCode}${state.additionalPhone}`,
        ),
        areaCode: state.additionalPhone?.slice(0, 3),
        contactTypeCode: 'PHONE_ADDITIONAL',
        countryCode: state.additionalPhoneCode?.slice(1) || '',
        phoneNumber: state.additionalPhone?.slice(3) || '',
        sequence: 2,
      };
      savePromises.push(saveFormPhone(additionalPhoneData));
    }
    if (
      (state.additionalEmail || state.startAdditionalEmail) &&
      state.startAdditionalEmail !== state.additionalEmail
    ) {
      const additionalEmailData: PersonalDataEmailRequest = {
        requestGuid,
        action: getValueChangeAction(state.startAdditionalEmail, state.additionalEmail),
        contactTypeCode: 'EMAIL_ADDITIONAL',
        email: state.additionalEmail,
        sequence: 2,
      };
      savePromises.push(saveFormEmail(additionalEmailData));
    }

    if (savePromises.length) {
      const results = await Promise.all(savePromises);
      const allSuccess = results.every(
        (result) => result && typeof result === 'object' && !('error' in result && result.error),
      );

      if (allSuccess) {
        await checkAndSaveFormDraft();
      } else {
        setSnackbarErrors([MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES]);
      }
    }
  }, [
    checkAndSaveFormDraft,
    requestGuid,
    saveFormEmail,
    saveFormPhone,
    state.additionalEmail,
    state.additionalPhone,
    state.additionalPhoneCode,
    state.email,
    state.phone,
    state.startAdditionalEmail,
    state.startAdditionalPhone,
    state.startAdditionalPhoneCode,
    state.startEmail,
    state.startPhone,
  ]);

  const MIN_ADDITIONAL_PHONE_DIGITS = 7;
  const MAX_ADDITIONAL_PHONE_DIGITS = 15;

  const onAdditionalPhoneCodeChange = (str: string) => {
    const items = str
      .split('')
      .filter((el) => +el >= 0)
      .join('');
    const actualItems = items.length > 3 ? items.slice(0, 3) : items;
    return actualItems ? '+' + actualItems : '';
  };

  const getAdditionalPhoneDigitsLength = (code?: string, phone?: string) => {
    const codeDigits = (code || '').replace(/\D/g, '').length;
    const phoneDigits = (phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '').length;

    return codeDigits + phoneDigits;
  };

  const isAdditionalPhoneInvalid = useCallback((code?: string, phone?: string) => {
    const hasAdditionalPhoneInput = !!code || !!phone;

    return (
      hasAdditionalPhoneInput &&
      getAdditionalPhoneDigitsLength(code, phone) < MIN_ADDITIONAL_PHONE_DIGITS
    );
  }, []);

  const isStartPhoneActive =
    state.startPhone !== state.phone && !state.phoneError && !state.phoneFieldActive;

  const isStartEmailActive =
    state.startEmail !== state.email && !state.emailError && !state.emailFieldActive;

  const isAdditionalEmailActive =
    state.startAdditionalEmail !== state.additionalEmail && !state.additionalEmailError;

  const isAdditionalPhoneActive =
    state.startAdditionalPhone !== state.additionalPhone && !state.additionalPhoneError;

  const isAdditionalPhoneCodeActive =
    state.startAdditionalPhoneCode !== state.additionalPhoneCode && !state.additionalPhoneCodeError;

  const isAdditionalContactsActive =
    isAdditionalEmailActive || isAdditionalPhoneActive || isAdditionalPhoneCodeActive;

  const isNotActive =
    state.additionalEmailFieldActive ||
    state.additionalPhoneCodeFieldActive ||
    state.additionalPhoneFieldActive ||
    state.phoneFieldActive ||
    state.emailFieldActive;

  const isStartActive =
    (isStartPhoneActive || isStartEmailActive || isAdditionalContactsActive) && !isNotActive;

  useEffect(() => {
    const startPhone =
      contactsData
        .find((el) => el.contactTypeCode === PHONE_PRIMARY)
        ?.value.match(phoneRegex)?.[0]
        .slice(2) || '';

    const startEmail = contactsData.find((el) => el.contactTypeCode === EMAIL_PRIMARY)?.value;
    const startAdditionalEmail =
      contactsData.find((el) => el.contactTypeCode === EMAIL_ADDITIONAL)?.value || '';
    const startAdditionalPhone = contactsData
      .find((el) => el.contactTypeCode === PHONE_ADDITIONAL)
      ?.value.match(phoneRegex)?.[0];

    const additionalPhoneCode = startAdditionalPhone?.slice(0, 2);
    const additionalPhone = startAdditionalPhone?.slice(2);

    setState({
      startPhone: startPhone,
      startEmail: startEmail,
      phone: startPhone,
      phoneError: startPhone ? !(startPhone[0] === '9' && startPhone.length === 10) : false,
      email: startEmail,
      emailError: !isValid(startEmail || ''),
      additionalEmail: startAdditionalEmail,
      additionalEmailError: startAdditionalEmail ? !isValid(startAdditionalEmail) : false,
      startAdditionalEmail: startAdditionalEmail,
      additionalPhone: additionalPhone || '',
      startAdditionalPhone: additionalPhone || '',
      additionalPhoneCode: additionalPhoneCode || '',
      startAdditionalPhoneCode: additionalPhoneCode || '',
    });
  }, [contactsData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (formDraft) {
      const emailObj = formDraft?.personEmail.find((el) => el.sequence === 1);
      const phoneObj = formDraft?.personPhone.find((el) => el.sequence === 1);
      const additionalPhoneObj = formDraft?.personPhone.find((el) => el.sequence === 2);
      const additionalEmailObj = formDraft?.personEmail.find((el) => el.sequence === 2);
      setState({
        phone: `${phoneObj?.areaCode || ''}${phoneObj?.phoneNumber || ''}`,
        startPhone: `${phoneObj?.areaCode || ''}${phoneObj?.phoneNumber || ''}`,
        additionalPhoneCode: additionalPhoneObj?.countryCode
          ? `+${additionalPhoneObj?.countryCode}`
          : '',
        startAdditionalPhoneCode: additionalPhoneObj?.countryCode
          ? `+${additionalPhoneObj?.countryCode}`
          : '',
        additionalPhone: `${additionalPhoneObj?.areaCode || ''}${
          additionalPhoneObj?.phoneNumber || ''
        }`,
        startAdditionalPhone: `${additionalPhoneObj?.areaCode || ''}${
          additionalPhoneObj?.phoneNumber || ''
        }`,
        email: emailObj?.email,
        startEmail: emailObj?.email,
        additionalEmail: additionalEmailObj?.email,
        startAdditionalEmail: additionalEmailObj?.email,
        emailError: !isValid(emailObj?.email || ''),
        additionalEmailError: additionalEmailObj?.email
          ? !isValid(additionalEmailObj?.email)
          : false,
      });
    }
  }, [formDraft]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (requestGuid && personalSectors.ContactInfo === 'changed') {
      getFormDraft({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [checkForm, getFormDraft, personalSectors.ContactInfo, requestGuid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSaveFormDraftDataError) return;

    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 3000,
      label: 'Не удалось сохранить изменения',
      variant: 'primary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [isSaveFormDraftDataError, snackbarTopAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      !snackbarErrors.length ||
      isMainLoading ||
      isSaveFormDraftDataLoading ||
      isSaveFormDraftDataSuccess
    )
      return;

    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 3000,
      label: snackbarErrors[0],
      variant: 'primary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [
    isMainLoading,
    isSaveFormDraftDataLoading,
    isSaveFormDraftDataSuccess,
    checkFormDraft,
    snackbarErrors,
    checkFulfilledTimeStamp,
    snackbarTopAlert,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(disabled && errorText)) return;
    const id = snackbarInfo?.show({
      autoClose: 5000,
      caption: <span>{errorText}</span>,
      variant: 'primary',
      icon: <img style={{ width: '40px' }} src={defaultIcon} alt="snackBarImage" />,
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarInfo?.close(id);
    };
  }, [disabled, errorText, snackbarInfo]);

  const onPhoneMainChanged = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setState({ phone: e.target.value.replace(/\s/g, '') });
  }, []);

  const onPhoneMainBlur = useCallback(() => {
    setState({
      phoneFieldActive: false,
      phoneError: state.phone.length !== 10 || state.phone[0] !== '9',
    });
  }, [state]);

  const onPhoneMainFocus = useCallback(() => setState({ phoneFieldActive: true }), []);

  const onEmailMainChanged = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setState({ emailError: !correctEmailRegexpChecker.test(value), email: value });
  }, []);

  const onAdditionalPhoneCodeChanged = useCallback(
    (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const value = onAdditionalPhoneCodeChange(e.target.value);
      const maxPhoneDigits = MAX_ADDITIONAL_PHONE_DIGITS - value.replace(/\D/g, '').length;

      setState({
        additionalPhoneCode: value,
        additionalPhone: (state.additionalPhone || '').slice(0, maxPhoneDigits),
        additionalPhoneCodeFieldActive: true,
      });
    },
    [state.additionalPhone],
  );

  const onAdditionalPhoneCodeBlur = useCallback(() => {
    const code = state.additionalPhoneCode;
    const phone = state.additionalPhone;

    setState({
      additionalPhoneCodeError: !!code?.length && code.length < 2,
      additionalPhoneCodeFieldActive: false,
      additionalPhoneError: isAdditionalPhoneInvalid(code, phone),
    });
  }, [state.additionalPhoneCode, state.additionalPhone, isAdditionalPhoneInvalid]);

  const onAdditionalPhoneNumberChanged = useCallback(
    (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const maxPhoneDigits =
        MAX_ADDITIONAL_PHONE_DIGITS - (state.additionalPhoneCode || '').replace(/\D/g, '').length;

      setState({
        additionalPhone: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, maxPhoneDigits),
        additionalPhoneFieldActive: true,
      });
    },
    [state.additionalPhoneCode],
  );

  const onAdditionalPhoneNumberBlur = useCallback(() => {
    const phone = state.additionalPhone;
    const code = state.additionalPhoneCode;

    setState({
      additionalPhoneFieldActive: false,
      additionalPhoneError: isAdditionalPhoneInvalid(code, phone),
    });
  }, [isAdditionalPhoneInvalid, state.additionalPhone, state.additionalPhoneCode]);

  const onAdditionalEmailChanged = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    setState({
      additionalEmailError: !!value?.length && !correctEmailRegexpChecker.test(value),
      additionalEmail: value,
    });
  }, []);

  if (isFormDraftFetching || isMainLoading) {
    return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;
  }

  const isSaveBtnDisabled =
    !isStartActive ||
    disabled ||
    !isPersonProfileEdit ||
    !state.phone ||
    state.phoneError ||
    !state.email ||
    state.emailError ||
    state.additionalEmailError ||
    state.additionalPhoneError ||
    (!!state.additionalPhone && !state.additionalPhoneCode) ||
    (!state.additionalPhone && !!state.additionalPhoneCode);

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="Редактирование данных" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text type={'title'} className={styles.title}>
            Контактная информация
          </Text>
          <Input
            addonBefore="+7"
            label="Телефон"
            mask="999 999 99 99"
            placeholder="123 456 78 90"
            type="tel"
            className={styles.input}
            value={state.phone}
            onChange={onPhoneMainChanged}
            onBlur={onPhoneMainBlur}
            onFocus={onPhoneMainFocus}
            status={state.phoneError || state.phone === '' ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={state.phoneError || state.phone === '' ? PHONE_ERROR_MESSAGE : undefined}
            disabled={disabled}
          />

          <Input
            label="E-mail"
            type="email"
            placeholder="Введите адрес"
            className={styles.input}
            value={state.email}
            onChange={onEmailMainChanged}
            status={state.emailError || state.email === '' ? 'error' : undefined}
            description={
              state.emailError || state.email === '' || state.email === ''
                ? EMAIL_ERROR_MESSAGE
                : undefined
            }
            disabled={disabled}
          />
          <div className={styles.spacer} />
          <div>
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.subTitle}>
              Запасные контакты
            </Text>
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} color="colorForeground2">
              Не обязательно
            </Text>

            <div className={styles.additionalPhone}>
              <Input
                label="Код страны"
                onBlur={onAdditionalPhoneCodeBlur}
                onChange={onAdditionalPhoneCodeChanged}
                value={state.additionalPhoneCode}
                placeholder="+0"
                type="tel"
                className={cx(styles.input, styles.additionalPhoneCode)}
                status={state.additionalPhoneCodeError ? 'error' : undefined}
                description={state.additionalPhoneCodeError ? CONTACT_ERROR_MESSAGE : undefined}
                disabled={disabled}
              />
              <Input
                label="Номер телефона"
                onBlur={onAdditionalPhoneNumberBlur}
                onChange={onAdditionalPhoneNumberChanged}
                value={state.additionalPhone}
                placeholder="000 000 00 00"
                type="tel"
                maxLength={
                  MAX_ADDITIONAL_PHONE_DIGITS -
                  (state.additionalPhoneCode || '').replace(/\D/g, '').length
                }
                status={state.additionalPhoneError ? 'error' : undefined}
                className={styles.input}
                disabled={disabled}
              />
            </div>
            <Input
              label="E-mail"
              type="email"
              placeholder="Введите адрес"
              className={styles.input}
              value={state.additionalEmail}
              onChange={onAdditionalEmailChanged}
              status={state.additionalEmailError ? 'error' : undefined}
              description={state.additionalEmailError ? EMAIL_ERROR_MESSAGE : undefined}
              disabled={disabled}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          {(!state.phone || !state.email) && !disabled && (
            <BannerWarningLine
              addonLeft={<InfoBadgeIcon />}
              title="Заполните все поля"
              className={styles.banner}
            />
          )}
          <Button onClick={onPersonalContactsSave} disabled={isSaveBtnDisabled}>
            Сохранить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(PersonalContacts);

import { memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { SectorType } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/types';

type ProfileSectionDescriptionProps = {
  defaultLabel: string;
  sectorStatus: SectorType | undefined;
  sectorNotFilled: boolean;
};

const ProfileSectionDescription = ({
  defaultLabel,
  sectorStatus,
  sectorNotFilled,
}: ProfileSectionDescriptionProps) => {
  const sectorColors = useMemo(() => {
    if (sectorNotFilled) return 'colorAttention';
    if (sectorStatus === 'changed') return 'colorAccent';
    if (sectorStatus === 'error') return 'colorDestructive';
  }, [sectorNotFilled, sectorStatus]);

  const label = useMemo(() => {
    if (sectorNotFilled) return 'Раздел не заполнен';
    if (sectorStatus === 'changed') return 'Внесены изменения';
    if (sectorStatus === 'error') return 'Раздел содержит ошибки';

    return defaultLabel;
  }, [defaultLabel, sectorNotFilled, sectorStatus]);

  return (
    <Text type="labelRegular" color={sectorColors}>
      {label}
    </Text>
  );
};

export default memo(ProfileSectionDescription);

import { ChangeEvent, memo, useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Autocomplete, BottomSheet, Checkbox, Input, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { ReactComponent as ArrowDown } from 'images/icons/arrow-small-down.svg';
import { ReactComponent as RedBucket } from 'images/raw-icons/redBucket.svg';

import { CountryListItem, InncrsAbsenceReasonType } from 'types/investmentProfile';

import { countryNameRF } from '../../const';
import { isCorrectInn } from '../../helper';
import { AdditionalResidenceType } from '../../types';
import { ChangeResidenceProps } from '../AdditionalResidency/types';
import InncrsAbsenceReasonItem from '../InncrsAbsenceReasonItem';
import styles from './AdditionalResidenceItem.module.pcss';

interface AdditionalResidenceItemProps {
  residenceIndex: number;
  residence: AdditionalResidenceType;
  countries: CountryListItem[];
  crsIssues: InncrsAbsenceReasonType[];
  onChangeIsInn(n: number): void;
  onRemoveResidence(n: number): void;
  onChangeResidence(props: ChangeResidenceProps): void;
}

const AdditionalResidenceItem = ({
  residenceIndex,
  residence,
  countries,
  crsIssues,
  onChangeIsInn,
  onRemoveResidence,
  onChangeResidence,
}: AdditionalResidenceItemProps) => {
  const [isIssueBottomSheetOpen, setIsIssueBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [countryState, setCountryState] = useState('');

  const onDismisBS = useCallback(() => setIsIssueBottomSheetOpen(false), []);
  const onShowBS = useCallback(() => setIsIssueBottomSheetOpen(true), []);

  const onCountrySelect = useCallback(
    (item: CountryListItem) => {
      onChangeResidence({
        index: residenceIndex,
        country: item.value,
        countryCode: item.code as string,
      });
      setCountryState('');
    },
    [onChangeResidence, residenceIndex],
  );

  const onCountryInputChange = useCallback(
    (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setCountryState(e.target.value),
    [],
  );

  const onRemoveClick = useCallback(
    () => onRemoveResidence(residenceIndex),
    [onRemoveResidence, residenceIndex],
  );

  const onChangeIsInnValue = useCallback(
    () => onChangeIsInn(residenceIndex),
    [onChangeIsInn, residenceIndex],
  );

  const onChangeInnValue = useCallback(
    (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
      onChangeResidence({ index: residenceIndex, innValue: e.target.value }),
    [onChangeResidence, residenceIndex],
  );

  const countryList = useMemo(
    () =>
      countries?.filter((item) => item.value.toLowerCase().includes(countryState.toLowerCase())) ||
      [],
    [countries, countryState],
  );

  return (
    <div key={residenceIndex} className={styles.wrapper}>
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Резидентство №{residenceIndex + 1}</Text>
        <div onClick={onRemoveClick}>
          <RedBucket />
        </div>
      </div>
      <Autocomplete
        classNameContent={styles.autocompleteContent}
        className={styles.autocomplete}
        list={countryList}
        name="mainAddress"
        onChange={onCountryInputChange}
        onSelect={onCountrySelect}
        placeholder="Укажите страну"
        value={residence.country || countryState}
        separatorActionCells={false}
      />
      <Checkbox label="У меня есть ИНН" checked={residence.isIin} onChange={onChangeIsInnValue} />
      {!residence.isIin && (
        <div onClick={onShowBS}>
          <Input
            value={residence.iinIssue}
            addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
            className={styles.input}
            placeholder="Укажите причину отсутствия ИНН"
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {residence.isIin && (
        <Input
          onChange={onChangeInnValue}
          label="ИНН в стране гражданства"
          value={residence.iinNumber}
          mask={residence.country === countryNameRF ? '999999999999' : '********************'}
          maxLength={residence.country === countryNameRF ? 12 : 20}
          className={styles.input}
          placeholder="Укажите ИНН"
          status={isCorrectInn(residence.iinNumber, residence.country) ? undefined : 'error'}
          description={
            isCorrectInn(residence.iinNumber, residence.country)
              ? ''
              : 'Укажите корректное значение ИНН'
          }
        />
      )}

      <BottomSheet
        open={isIssueBottomSheetOpen}
        onDismiss={onDismisBS}
        className={cx(styles.wrap, { [styles.bsWrapFixed]: !isIssueBottomSheetOpen })}
      >
        <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Причина отсутствия ИНН</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.changeRiskGroup}>
          {crsIssues?.map((item: InncrsAbsenceReasonType, index) => (
            <InncrsAbsenceReasonItem
              key={`${item.reasonId}_${index}`}
              data={item}
              residenceIndex={residenceIndex}
              selected={item.reasonName === residence.iinIssue}
              onChangeResidence={onChangeResidence}
              onDismisBS={onDismisBS}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(AdditionalResidenceItem);

import { FC, useCallback } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useSaveSrcDataMutation } from 'core/api/personalData';

import { ReactComponent as CrossIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/crossIcon.svg';

import { newEmptyResidence } from '../../const';
import { useGetInitialData } from '../../hooks/useGetInitialData';
import { AdditionalResidenceType } from '../../types';
import AdditionalResidenceItem from '../AdditionalResidenceItem';
import styles from './AdditionalResidency.module.pcss';
import { AdditionalResidencyProps, ChangeResidenceProps } from './types';

const AdditionalResidency: FC<AdditionalResidencyProps> = ({ state, setState, requestGuid }) => {
  const [saveSrc] = useSaveSrcDataMutation();
  const { countries, crsIssues } = useGetInitialData();

  const { additionalResidences, isAdditionalResidence } = state.residenceNewData;

  const onAddNewResidence = () => {
    setState({
      residenceNewData: {
        ...state.residenceNewData,
        additionalResidences: [...additionalResidences, newEmptyResidence],
      },
    });
  };

  const onRemoveResidence = useCallback(
    async (index: number) => {
      const updatedAdditionalResidences = additionalResidences.filter((item, ix) => index !== ix);
      const removedResidence = additionalResidences[index];

      if (removedResidence.countryCode) {
        const srcProps = {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
          action: 'D',
          country: removedResidence.countryCode || '',
          INN: removedResidence.iinNumber,
          reason: removedResidence.iinIssue,
          primary: false,
        };
        await saveSrc(srcProps).unwrap();
      }

      setState({
        residenceNewData: {
          ...state.residenceNewData,
          additionalResidences: [...updatedAdditionalResidences],
          isAdditionalResidence: updatedAdditionalResidences.length ? isAdditionalResidence : false,
        },
      });
    },
    [
      additionalResidences,
      isAdditionalResidence,
      requestGuid,
      saveSrc,
      setState,
      state.residenceNewData,
    ],
  );

  const onChangeIsInn = useCallback(
    (index: number) => {
      const chosenResidence = additionalResidences[index];
      const updatedChosenResidence: AdditionalResidenceType = {
        ...chosenResidence,
        isIin: !chosenResidence.isIin,
      };

      const updatedAdditionalResidences = [
        ...additionalResidences.slice(0, index),
        updatedChosenResidence,
        ...additionalResidences.slice(index + 1),
      ];

      setState({
        residenceNewData: {
          ...state.residenceNewData,
          additionalResidences: [...updatedAdditionalResidences],
        },
      });
    },
    [additionalResidences, setState, state.residenceNewData],
  );

  const onChangeResidence = useCallback(
    ({ index, innValue, innIssue, country, countryCode }: ChangeResidenceProps) => {
      const chosenResidence = additionalResidences[index];
      const updatedChosenResidence: AdditionalResidenceType = {
        ...chosenResidence,
        iinNumber: typeof innValue === 'string' ? innValue || '' : chosenResidence.iinNumber,
        iinIssue: innIssue || chosenResidence.iinIssue,
        country: country || chosenResidence.country,
        countryCode: countryCode || chosenResidence.countryCode,
      };

      const updatedAdditionalResidences = [
        ...additionalResidences.slice(0, index),
        updatedChosenResidence,
        ...additionalResidences.slice(index + 1),
      ];

      setState({
        residenceNewData: {
          ...state.residenceNewData,
          additionalResidences: [...updatedAdditionalResidences],
        },
      });
    },
    [additionalResidences, setState, state.residenceNewData],
  );

  const mappedData = additionalResidences?.map((residence, index) => {
    return (
      <AdditionalResidenceItem
        key={index}
        residenceIndex={index}
        residence={residence}
        countries={countries || []}
        crsIssues={crsIssues || []}
        onChangeIsInn={onChangeIsInn}
        onChangeResidence={onChangeResidence}
        onRemoveResidence={onRemoveResidence}
      />
    );
  });

  return (
    <>
      {additionalResidences && mappedData}
      {additionalResidences.length < 5 && (
        <div className={styles.additionalHeader}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Резидентство №{additionalResidences.length + 1}</Text>
          <div onClick={onAddNewResidence}>
            <CrossIcon />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default AdditionalResidency;

import { memo, useCallback } from 'react';

import { ReactComponent as Check } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import { InncrsAbsenceReasonType } from 'types/investmentProfile';

import { ChangeResidenceProps } from '../AdditionalResidency/types';
import styles from './InncrsAbsenceReasonItem.module.pcss';

interface InncrsAbsenceReasonItemProps {
  data: InncrsAbsenceReasonType;
  residenceIndex: number;
  selected: boolean;
  onChangeResidence(props: ChangeResidenceProps): void;
  onDismisBS(): void;
}

const InncrsAbsenceReasonItem = ({
  data,
  residenceIndex,
  selected,
  onChangeResidence,
  onDismisBS,
}: InncrsAbsenceReasonItemProps) => {
  const onItemClick = useCallback(() => {
    onDismisBS();
    onChangeResidence({ index: residenceIndex, innIssue: data.reasonName });
  }, [data.reasonName, onChangeResidence, onDismisBS, residenceIndex]);

  return (
    <div onClick={onItemClick} key={data.reasonCode}>
      <div className={styles.item}>
        <span>{data.reasonName}</span>
        {selected && <Check />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(InncrsAbsenceReasonItem);

import { countryNameRF } from './const';
import { TaxesResidenceStateType } from './types';

export const checkForm = (state: TaxesResidenceStateType) => {
  const additionalResidences = state.residenceNewData.additionalResidences;

  const isAllFilled = additionalResidences.every(
    (item) =>
      item.country &&
      (item.isIin
        ? !item.iinNumber?.split('').every((it) => it === '0') &&
          (item.iinNumber?.length > 9 ||
            (item.country !== countryNameRF && item.iinNumber?.length >= 4))
        : item.iinIssue),
  );
  return isAllFilled;
};

export const isCorrectInn = (inn: string, countryName: string) => {
  if (inn.split('').every((it) => it === '0')) return false;

  if (countryName === countryNameRF) return inn.length > 9 && inn.length <= 12;

  return inn.length >= 4 && inn.length <= 20;
};

import { Dispatch, SetStateAction, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';

import { useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';
import { MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES } from 'const/messages';

import {
  useCancelFormDraftMutation,
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useSaveFormDraftMutation,
  useSaveResidencesStatusDataMutation,
  useSaveSrcDataMutation,
} from 'core/api/personalData';

import { isErrorResponseType } from 'utils/errorResponse';

import {
  changeCurrentSectorStatus,
  getSectorsWithErrors,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';
import { PersonalSectorsType } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/types';

import { TAXES_RESIDENCE_ERROR_FIELD_CODES } from '../const';
import { TaxesResidenceStateType } from '../types';

const useFormSave = (
  requestGuid: string,
  personalSectors: PersonalSectorsType,
  setPersonalSectors: Dispatch<SetStateAction<PersonalSectorsType | undefined>>,
  goBack: () => void,
  state: TaxesResidenceStateType,
) => {
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();
  const [cancelForm] = useCancelFormDraftMutation();
  const [
    saveResidencesStatus,
    {
      isError: isSaveResidenceStatusError,
      error: saveResidenceStatusError,
      isLoading: isSaveResidenceStatusLoading,
    },
  ] = useSaveResidencesStatusDataMutation();
  const [saveFormDraft, { isError: isSaveFormError, isLoading: isSaveFormDraftLoading }] =
    useSaveFormDraftMutation();
  const [checkForm, { isError: isCheckFormError, isLoading: isCheckFormLoading }] =
    useLazyCheckFormQuery();

  const [saveSrc, { isError: isSaveSrcError, error: saveSrcError, isLoading: isSaveSrcLoading }] =
    useSaveSrcDataMutation();

  const saveData = useCallback(async () => {
    const newResidences = state.residenceNewData.additionalResidences;

    try {
      await saveResidencesStatus({
        request_Guid: requestGuid,
        isAdditionalTaxResidency: state.residenceNewData.isAdditionalResidence,
        isCitizenshipTaxResidency: state.residenceNewData.isMainResidence,
      });
      for (const residence of newResidences) {
        const srcProps = {
          request_Guid: requestGuid,
          action: residence.status,
          country: residence.countryCode || '',
          INN: residence.isIin ? residence.iinNumber : '',
          reason: residence.iinIssue,
          primary: false,
        };
        await saveSrc(srcProps).unwrap();
      }

      const errors = await checkForm({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
      const taxesResErrors =
        errors?.filter((item) => TAXES_RESIDENCE_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(item.fieldCode)) || [];

      if (!taxesResErrors.length) {
        await saveFormDraft({ requestGuid });
        const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errors, personalSectors);
        const updatedSectors = changeCurrentSectorStatus(sectorsWithErrors, 'TaxesResidence');
        setPersonalSectors(updatedSectors);

        goBack();
      } else {
        const sectorsWithErrors = getSectorsWithErrors(errors, personalSectors);
        setPersonalSectors(sectorsWithErrors);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      await cancelForm({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [
    cancelForm,
    checkForm,
    goBack,
    personalSectors,
    requestGuid,
    saveFormDraft,
    saveResidencesStatus,
    saveSrc,
    setPersonalSectors,
    state.residenceNewData.additionalResidences,
    state.residenceNewData.isAdditionalResidence,
    state.residenceNewData.isMainResidence,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isError =
      isSaveSrcError || isCheckFormError || isSaveFormError || isSaveResidenceStatusError;

    if (!isError) return;

    const error = saveSrcError || saveResidenceStatusError;

    const message = isErrorResponseType(error)
      ? error?.data?.error?.[0]?.errorMessageText || MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES
      : MSG_CANT_SAVE_CHANGES;
    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 3000,
      label: message,
      variant: 'primary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [
    isCheckFormError,
    isSaveFormError,
    isSaveResidenceStatusError,
    isSaveSrcError,
    requestGuid,
    saveResidenceStatusError,
    saveSrcError,
    snackbarTopAlert,
  ]);

  return {
    saveData,
    isSaving:
      isSaveFormDraftLoading ||
      isSaveResidenceStatusLoading ||
      isCheckFormLoading ||
      isSaveSrcLoading,
  };
};

export default useFormSave;

import { useGetCrsIssuesQuery, useGetResidenceCountriesQuery } from 'core/api/personalData';

export function useGetInitialData() {
  const {

    isLoading: isCountriesLoading,

  const {
    data: crsIssues,
    isLoading: isCrsIssuesLoading,
    isError: isCrsIssuesError,
  } = useGetCrsIssuesQuery();

  return { countries, crsIssues, isLoading, isError };
}

import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { PersonCRSDataType, PersonInnType } from 'types/investmentProfile';

import { AdditionalResidenceType, ResidenceDataType, TaxesResidenceStateType } from '../types';

export function useGetInitialResidenceData(
  currencyResidency: string,
  personIin: PersonInnType[],
  formDraftCRSData: PersonCRSDataType[] | undefined,
  isFormDraftError: boolean,
  setState: React.Dispatch<Partial<TaxesResidenceStateType>>,
  personIdentityInn: string,
) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!formDraftCRSData || isFormDraftError) {
      const primaryIin = personIin.find((it) => it.primary);
      const additionalResidences = personIin.filter((it) => !it.primary);

      const mainResidenceData: PersonCRSDataType = {
        countryCode: '',
        countryName: primaryIin?.country || '',
        inn: primaryIin?.inn || '',
        reason: '',
        status: '',
        primary: primaryIin?.primary || false,
      };

      const additionalResidenceDataBlocks: AdditionalResidenceType[] = additionalResidences.map(
        (residence) => ({
          country: residence.country,
          isIin: residence.inn !== '',
          iinNumber: residence.inn,
          iinIssue: residence.absenceReason || '',
          status: 'U',
        }),
      );

      const residenceData: ResidenceDataType = {
        isMainResidence: mainResidenceData.primary,
        isAdditionalResidence: !!additionalResidenceDataBlocks.length,
        mainResidenceCountry: currencyResidency,
        mainResidenceIin: mainResidenceData.inn,
        additionalResidences: additionalResidenceDataBlocks,
      };

      setState({
        residenceNewData: residenceData,
        residenceOldData: residenceData,
      });
    }
    if (formDraftCRSData) {
      const mainResidence = formDraftCRSData.find((item) => item.primary);
      const additionalResidences = formDraftCRSData.filter((item) => !item.primary);

      const mainResidenceData: PersonCRSDataType = {
        countryCode: mainResidence?.countryCode || '',
        countryName: mainResidence?.countryName || '',
        inn: mainResidence?.inn || personIdentityInn,
        reason: mainResidence?.reason || '',
        status: mainResidence?.status || '',
        primary: mainResidence?.primary || false,
      };

      const additionalResidenceDataBlocks: AdditionalResidenceType[] = additionalResidences.map(
        (residence) => ({
          country: residence.countryName,
          countryCode: residence.countryCode,
          isIin: residence.inn !== '',
          iinNumber: residence.inn,
          iinIssue: residence.reason,
          isFilled: !!residence.countryName,
          status: 'U',
        }),
      );

      const residenceData: ResidenceDataType = {
        isMainResidence: mainResidenceData.primary,
        isAdditionalResidence: !!additionalResidenceDataBlocks.length,
        mainResidenceCountry: currencyResidency,
        mainResidenceIin: mainResidenceData.inn,
        additionalResidences: additionalResidenceDataBlocks,
      };

      setState({
        residenceNewData: residenceData,
        residenceOldData: residenceData,
      });
    }
  }, [
    currencyResidency,
    formDraftCRSData,
    isFormDraftError,
    personIdentityInn,
    personIin,
    setState,
  ]);
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { TaxesResidenceStateType } from '../types';

export function useResidenceDataChanged(state: TaxesResidenceStateType) {
  const [isChanged, setIsChanged] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isOtherBlockEqual =
      JSON.stringify(state.residenceNewData) === JSON.stringify(state.residenceOldData);
    setIsChanged(!isOtherBlockEqual);
  }, [state.residenceNewData, state.residenceOldData]);
  return { isChanged };
}

import React, { FC, useEffect, useReducer, useState } from 'react';

import {
  Button,
  CircleLoader,
  Input,
  Radio,
  RadioFormGroup,
  Tab,
  Tabs,
  Text,
  useSnackbars,
} from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyGetFormDraftQuery, useSaveSrcDataMutation } from 'core/api/personalData';

import { residenceReducer } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import defaultIcon from 'images/icons/defaultSnackBar.png';

import ExclamationIcon from './ExclamationIcon';
import styles from './TaxesResidence.module.pcss';
import AdditionalResidency from './components/AdditionalResidency/AdditionalResidency';
import { initResidenceState } from './const';
import { checkForm } from './helper';
import useFormSave from './hooks/useFormSave';
import { useGetInitialResidenceData } from './hooks/useGetInitialResidenceData';
import { useResidenceDataChanged } from './hooks/useResidenceDataChanged';
import { TaxesResidenceProps } from './types';

const TaxesResidence: FC<TaxesResidenceProps> = ({
  disabled,
  goBack,
  requestGuid,
  personInn,
  currencyResidency,
  setPersonalSectors,
  personalSectors,
  errorText,
  isNonResident,
}) => {
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(residenceReducer, initResidenceState);
  const { snackbarInfo } = useSnackbars();
  const [getFormDraft, { data: formDraft, isError: isFormDraftError }] = useLazyGetFormDraftQuery();
  const [saveSrc] = useSaveSrcDataMutation();

  const personIdentityInn = formDraft?.personIdentity[0].inn || '';
  const noInn = !!formDraft?.personCrsData[0]?.inn || !!personIdentityInn;

  useGetInitialResidenceData(
    currencyResidency || '',
    personInn,
    formDraft?.personCrsData,
    isFormDraftError,
    setState,
    personIdentityInn,
  );

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!requestGuid) return;
    getFormDraft({ requestGuid });
  }, [getFormDraft, requestGuid]);

  const {
    isMainResidence,
    isAdditionalResidence,
    mainResidenceCountry,
    mainResidenceIin,
    additionalResidences,
  } = state.residenceNewData;
  const { isChanged } = useResidenceDataChanged(state);
  const allAdditionalResidenceItemFilled = checkForm(state);

  const { saveData, isSaving } = useFormSave(
    requestGuid,
    personalSectors,
    setPersonalSectors,
    goBack,
    state,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(disabled && errorText)) return;
    const id = snackbarInfo?.show({
      autoClose: 5000,
      caption: <span>{errorText}</span>,
      variant: 'primary',
      icon: <img style={{ width: '40px' }} src={defaultIcon} alt="snackBarImage" />,
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarInfo?.close(id);
    };
  }, [disabled, errorText, snackbarInfo]);

  const isDisableToSave =
    disabled ||
    !allAdditionalResidenceItemFilled ||
    !isChanged ||
    (!isMainResidence && !isNonResident) ||
    (!noInn && !isNonResident);

  if (isSaving) {
    return <CircleLoader type="page" brandColor />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="Редактирование данных" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text type={'title'} className={styles.title}>
            Налоговое и валютное резидентства
          </Text>

          <Tabs
            onChange={() => setActiveTab(activeTab === 0 ? 1 : 0)}
            value={activeTab}
            variant="primary"
          >
            <Tab label="Основное" value={0} />
            <Tab label="Дополнительные" value={1} />
          </Tabs>

          {activeTab === 0 && (
            <>
              <Input
                onChange={(e) => null}
                placeholder=""
                label="Валютное резидентство"
                value={mainResidenceCountry}
                className={styles.input}
                disabled
              />
              <div className={styles.spacer} />
              <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.subTitle}>
                Имеется ли налоговое резидентство в стране гражданства?
              </Text>

              <RadioFormGroup shape="horizontal" className={styles.radioGroup}>
                <Radio
                  label="Да, имеется"
                  value="0"
                  checked={isMainResidence}
                  onChange={() => {
                    setState({
                      residenceNewData: { ...state.residenceNewData, isMainResidence: true },
                    });
                  }}
                  controlled
                  className={styles.radio}
                  disabled={disabled}
                />
                <Radio
                  label="Нет, не имеется"
                  onChange={() =>
                    setState({
                      residenceNewData: { ...state.residenceNewData, isMainResidence: false },
                    })
                  }
                  value="1"
                  controlled
                  checked={!isMainResidence}
                  className={styles.radio}
                  disabled={disabled}
                />
              </RadioFormGroup>
              {isMainResidence && (
                <Input
                  onChange={(e) => null}
                  label="ИНН в стране гражданства"
                  value={mainResidenceIin || 'Не указан'}
                  className={styles.input}
                  disabled
                />
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {activeTab === 1 && (
            <>
              <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.subTitle}>
                Имеются ли дополнительные налоговые резидентства?
              </Text>
              <RadioFormGroup shape="horizontal" className={styles.radioGroup}>
                <Radio
                  label="Да, имеется"
                  value="0"
                  checked={isAdditionalResidence}
                  onChange={() => {
                    setState({
                      residenceNewData: {
                        ...state.residenceNewData,
                        isAdditionalResidence: true,
                        additionalResidences: [
                          {
                            country: '',
                            isIin: true,
                            iinNumber: '',
                            iinIssue: '',
                            isFilled: false,
                            status: 'I',
                          },
                        ],
                      },
                    });
                  }}
                  controlled
                  className={styles.radio}
                  disabled={disabled}
                />
                <Radio
                  label="Нет, не имеется"
                  onChange={async () => {
                    for (const residence of additionalResidences) {
                      if (!residence.countryCode) break;
                      const srcProps = {
                        request_Guid: requestGuid,
                        action: 'D',
                        country: residence.countryCode || '',
                        INN: residence.iinNumber,
                        reason: residence.iinIssue,
                        primary: false,
                      };
                      await saveSrc(srcProps).unwrap();
                    }

                    setState({
                      residenceNewData: {
                        ...state.residenceNewData,
                        isAdditionalResidence: false,
                        additionalResidences: [],
                      },
                    });
                  }}
                  value="1"
                  controlled
                  checked={!isAdditionalResidence}
                  className={styles.radio}
                  disabled={disabled}
                />
              </RadioFormGroup>
              {isAdditionalResidence && (
                <>
                  <div className={styles.spacer} />
                  <AdditionalResidency
                    setState={setState}
                    state={state}
                    requestGuid={requestGuid}
                  />
                </>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          {!isMainResidence && !disabled && !isNonResident && (
            <div className={styles.notification}>
              <div className={styles.icon}>
                <ExclamationIcon />
              </div>
              <Text type="labelRegular">Укажите сведения о налоговом резидентстве</Text>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className={styles.spacer} />
          {!allAdditionalResidenceItemFilled && !disabled && (
            <div className={styles.btnNotification}>
              <div className={styles.icon}>
                <ExclamationIcon />
              </div>
              <Text type="labelRegular">Заполните все поля</Text>
            </div>
          )}
          {!noInn && isMainResidence && !disabled && (
            <div className={styles.btnNotification}>
              <div className={styles.icon}>
                <ExclamationIcon />
              </div>
              <Text type="labelRegular">
                Заполните ИНН страны гражданства в разделе Дополнительные документы
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
          <Button disabled={isDisableToSave} onClick={saveData}>
            Сохранить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default TaxesResidence;

import React, { useCallback } from 'react';

import { Button, ButtonBar, FileUploader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { FILE_EXT_ACCEPT, FILE_UPLOAD_INFO_TEXT } from 'const/files';

import { useUploadFilesCommitMutation, useUploadFilesMutation } from 'core/api/personalData';

import { useSequentialFileUpload } from 'hooks/useSequentialFileUpload';

import { throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { UploadingFileSteps, UploadingPasportProps } from './types';
import styles from './uploadingDocuments.module.pcss';

const UploadingPasport: React.FC<UploadingPasportProps> = ({
  goBack,
  requestGuid,
  setActiveSector,
  needRegistration,
}) => {
  const [uploadFileMutation] = useUploadFilesMutation();
  const [uploadFileCommit] = useUploadFilesCommitMutation();
  const uploadSingleFile = useCallback(
    async (file: File) => {
      return uploadFileMutation({
        requestGuid,
        type: UploadingFileSteps.PASPORT,
        file: [file],
      }).unwrap();
    },
    [requestGuid, uploadFileMutation],
  );

  const onComplete = useCallback(async () => {
    const data = await uploadFileCommit({ requestGuid, type: UploadingFileSteps.PASPORT }).unwrap();
    throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(data);

    if (needRegistration) {
      setActiveSector('UploadingRegistration');
    } else {
      setActiveSector('FinalGettingStatus');
    }

    return data;
  }, [needRegistration, requestGuid, setActiveSector, uploadFileCommit]);

  const {
    files: passportFiles,
    isLocked,
    isUploading,
    submitLabel,
    onValidateFiles,
    handleFilesChange,
    uploadPendingFiles,
  } = useSequentialFileUpload({
    uploadFile: uploadSingleFile,
    onComplete,
  });

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="Редактирование данных" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div>
          <Text type="title">
            Загрузите фото или pdf
            <br /> паспорта РФ
          </Text>

          <ol className={styles.list}>
            <Text type="lineRegular">1. Разворот с фотографией</Text>
            <Text type="lineRegular">2. Разворот с регистрацией</Text>
            <Text type="lineRegular">3. Сведения о ранее выданных паспортах</Text>
          </ol>
          <div className={styles.beforeSubmitBlock}>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold">Перед отправкой убедитесь, что:</Text>
            <ul className={styles.recommendationList}>
              <li>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Разворот паспорта виден целиком</Text>
              </li>
              <li>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Печать не заслонена пальцами</Text>
              </li>
              <li>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Нет бликов и нечитаемых зон</Text>
              </li>
              <li>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Текст не размыт и хорошо читается</Text>
              </li>
            </ul>
          </div>

          <div className={isLocked ? styles.uploaderLocked : undefined}>
            <FileUploader
              listShape="box"
              mode="attach"
              variant="button"
              accept={FILE_EXT_ACCEPT}
              onChange={handleFilesChange}
              className={styles.uploader}
              caption={FILE_UPLOAD_INFO_TEXT}
              validateFiles={onValidateFiles}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <ButtonBar shape="horizontal">
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={uploadPendingFiles}
            disabled={passportFiles.length === 0 || isUploading}
          >
            {isUploading ? 'Отправка...' : submitLabel}
          </Button>
        </ButtonBar>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default UploadingPasport;

import React, { useCallback } from 'react';

import { Button, ButtonBar, FileUploader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { FILE_EXT_ACCEPT, FILE_UPLOAD_INFO_TEXT } from 'const/files';

import { useUploadFilesCommitMutation, useUploadFilesMutation } from 'core/api/personalData';

import { useSequentialFileUpload } from 'hooks/useSequentialFileUpload';

import { throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/helper';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { UploadingDocumentsProps, UploadingFileSteps } from './types';
import styles from './uploadingDocuments.module.pcss';

const UploadingRegistration: React.FC<UploadingDocumentsProps> = ({
  goBack,
  requestGuid,
  setActiveSector,
}) => {
  const [uploadFileMutation] = useUploadFilesMutation();
  const [uploadFileCommit] = useUploadFilesCommitMutation();

  const uploadSingleFile = useCallback(
    async (file: File) => {
      return uploadFileMutation({
        requestGuid,
        type: UploadingFileSteps.REG,
        file: [file],
      }).unwrap();
    },
    [requestGuid, uploadFileMutation],
  );

  const onComplete = useCallback(async () => {
    const data = await uploadFileCommit({ requestGuid, type: UploadingFileSteps.REG }).unwrap();
    throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError(data);
    setActiveSector('FinalGettingStatus');
    return data;
  }, [requestGuid, setActiveSector, uploadFileCommit]);

  const {
    files: regFiles,
    isLocked,
    isUploading,
    submitLabel,
    onValidateFiles,
    handleFilesChange,
    uploadPendingFiles,
  } = useSequentialFileUpload({
    uploadFile: uploadSingleFile,
    onComplete,
  });

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="Редактирование данных" leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={goBack} />
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div>
          <Text type="title">Загрузите фото или pdf свидетельства о временной регистрации</Text>

          <div className={isLocked ? styles.uploaderLocked : undefined}>
            <FileUploader
              listShape="box"
              mode="attach"
              variant="button"
              accept={FILE_EXT_ACCEPT}
              onChange={handleFilesChange}
              className={styles.uploader}
              caption={FILE_UPLOAD_INFO_TEXT}
              validateFiles={onValidateFiles}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <ButtonBar shape="horizontal">
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={uploadPendingFiles}
            disabled={regFiles.length === 0 || isUploading}
          >
            {isUploading ? 'Отправка...' : submitLabel}
          </Button>
        </ButtonBar>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default UploadingRegistration;

export const getIsPersonProfileEdit = () => {
  const editStatus = Permissions.get('PERSON_PROFILE_EDIT');
  const confirmStatus = Permissions.get('PERSON_PROFILE_CONFIRM');

  const hasForbiddenStatus =
    editStatus === Permissions.DENIED ||
    editStatus === Permissions.BLOCKED ||
    confirmStatus === Permissions.DENIED ||
    confirmStatus === Permissions.BLOCKED;

  if (hasForbiddenStatus) {
    return false;
  }

  const editableStatuses = [Permissions.GRANTED, Permissions.NONACTIVE];

  return (
    editableStatuses.includes(editStatus as typeof editableStatuses[number]) &&
    editableStatuses.includes(confirmStatus as typeof editableStatuses[number])
  );
};

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { PersonalDataActionType, RequestErrorList } from 'types/personalData';

import { AddressStateType } from './components/Address/types';
import { HDOStateType } from './components/HDO/types';
import { IdStateType } from './components/Passport/types';
import { PersonalContactsStateType } from './components/PersonalContacts/types';
import { TaxesResidenceStateType } from './components/TaxesResidence/types';
import { errorCodesData } from './constants';
import { PersonalInfoIdType, PersonalSectorsType } from './types';

export const sanitizeString = (str: string) => str.replace(/\s/g, '');

export const notZeros = (str: string) => !/^0+$/.test(sanitizeString(str));

export const getSectorsWithErrors = (
  response: RequestErrorList[],
  personalSectors: PersonalSectorsType,
) => {
  const sectors = response
    .map((it) => {
      const errorCode = it.errorCode as keyof typeof errorCodesData;
      return errorCodesData[errorCode] as PersonalInfoIdType;
    })
    .filter((sector): sector is PersonalInfoIdType => sector !== undefined);

  const uniqueSectorsWithErrors = new Set(sectors);

  const allSectors = Object.keys(personalSectors).filter(
    (key) => key !== 'isChanged',
  ) as PersonalInfoIdType[];
  const updatedSectors = { ...personalSectors };

  allSectors.forEach((sector) => {
    if (uniqueSectorsWithErrors.has(sector)) {
      updatedSectors[sector] = 'error';
    } else if (personalSectors[sector] === 'error') {
      updatedSectors[sector] = null;
    }
  });

  // Устанавливаем isChanged: false если есть ошибки, иначе старое значение isChanged
  updatedSectors.isChanged = uniqueSectorsWithErrors.size > 0 ? false : personalSectors.isChanged;

  return updatedSectors;
};

export const changeCurrentSectorStatus = (
  personalSectors: PersonalSectorsType,
  sector: PersonalInfoIdType,
) => ({ ...personalSectors, [sector]: 'changed', isChanged: true });

export const contactsReducer = (
  state: PersonalContactsStateType,
  changes: Partial<PersonalContactsStateType>,
) => {
  const newState = { ...state, ...changes };
  return newState;
};

export const addressReducer = (state: AddressStateType, changes: Partial<AddressStateType>) => {
  const newState = { ...state, ...changes };
  return newState;
};

export const isValid = (str: string) => {
  if (!str || str.includes('..')) return false;
  const emailRegex = /[\w%+.-]+@[\d.A-Za-z-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,64}/;
  return emailRegex.test(str);
};

export const idReducer = (state: IdStateType, changes: Partial<IdStateType>) => {
  const newState = { ...state, ...changes };
  return newState;
};

export const hdoReducer = (state: HDOStateType, changes: Partial<HDOStateType>) => {
  const newState = { ...state, ...changes };
  return newState;
};

export const residenceReducer = (
  state: TaxesResidenceStateType,
  changes: Partial<TaxesResidenceStateType>,
) => {
  const newState = { ...state, ...changes };
  return newState;
};

export const getValueChangeAction = (
  oldValue: string | null | undefined,
  newValue: string | null | undefined,
): PersonalDataActionType => {
  const initValue = oldValue?.trim();
  const valueToSave = newValue?.trim();

  if (!initValue?.length && !!valueToSave?.length) return 'I';

  if (!!initValue?.length && !valueToSave?.length) return 'D';

  return 'U';
};

const normalizeErrorPayload = (payload: unknown): unknown => {
  if (typeof payload !== 'string') return payload;

  const trimmed = payload.trim();
  if (!trimmed.startsWith('{') && !trimmed.startsWith('[')) {
    return payload;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(trimmed);
  } catch {
    return payload;
  }
};

const extractErrorMessageFromPayload = (payload: unknown): string | undefined => {
  const normalized = normalizeErrorPayload(payload);
  if (!normalized || typeof normalized !== 'object') return undefined;

  const record = normalized as Record<string, unknown>;
  const errorList = record.Error ?? record.error;

  if (!Array.isArray(errorList) || !errorList[0] || typeof errorList[0] !== 'object') {
    return undefined;
  }

  const firstError = errorList[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
  const message = firstError.ErrorMessageText ?? firstError.errorMessageText;

  return typeof message === 'string' && message.trim() ? message : undefined;
};

export const getPersonalDataErrorMessage = (error: unknown): string | undefined => {
  if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') return undefined;

  const record = error as Record<string, unknown>;
  const directMessage = extractErrorMessageFromPayload(error);
  if (directMessage) return directMessage;

  if ('data' in record) {
    const dataMessage = extractErrorMessageFromPayload(record.data);
    if (dataMessage) return dataMessage;
  }

  if ('error' in record && record.error && typeof record.error === 'object') {
    return getPersonalDataErrorMessage(record.error);
  }

  return undefined;
};

export const throwIfPersonalDataResponseHasError = (response: unknown): void => {
  if (!response || typeof response !== 'object') return;

  const record = response as Record<string, unknown>;
  const errorList = record.Error ?? record.error;

  if (Array.isArray(errorList) && errorList.length > 0) {
    throw { data: response };
  }
};

export const isAnketExpired = (dateEnd: string) => {
  const inputDate = DateTime.fromISO(dateEnd);
  const currentDate = DateTime.now();

  return inputDate < currentDate;
};
