import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useLocalStorage } from 'react-use';

import { ActionCell, Button, ButtonBar, CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetProfileQuery } from 'core/api/investmentProfile';
import {
  useCancelFormDraftMutation,
  useCreateFormDraftMutation,
  useGetPersonalDraftStatusQuery,
  useLazyCheckFormQuery,
  useLazyCheckListFormQuery,
} from 'core/api/personalData';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { CheckListFormDataResponse, RequestErrorList } from 'types/personalData/responses';

import AdditionalDocuments from './components/AdditionalDocuments';
import { ADDOCS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES } from './components/AdditionalDocuments/constant';
import Address from './components/Address/Address';
import ConfirmationAgreement from './components/ConfirmationAgreement';
import ErrorPage from './components/ErrorPage';
import FinalGettingStatus from './components/FinalGettingStatus/FinalGettingStatus';
import GoBackWithoutRecords from './components/GoBackWithoutRecords';
import HDO from './components/HDO/HDO';
import { HDO_ERROR_FIELD_CODES } from './components/HDO/const';
import OnboardingPage from './components/OnboardingPage/OnboardingPage';
import Passport from './components/Passport/Passport';
import { PASPORT_ERROR_FIELD_CODES } from './components/Passport/const';
import PersonalContacts from './components/PersonalContacts/PersonalContacts';
import { CONTACTS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES } from './components/PersonalContacts/constant';
import ProcessingAttentionCard from './components/ProcessingAttentionCard';
import ProfileSectionDescription from './components/ProfileSectionDescription';
import ProfileSkeleton from './components/ProfileSkeleton';
import SuccessPage from './components/SuccessPage/SuccessPage';
import TaxesResidence from './components/TaxesResidence/TaxesResidence';
import UploadingPasport from './components/UploadingDocuments/UploadingPasport';
import UploadingRegistration from './components/UploadingDocuments/UploadingRegistration';
import { UploadingFileSteps } from './components/UploadingDocuments/types';
import {
  getIsPersonProfileEdit,
  initialSectors,
  notRequiredSetsForNonResident,
  personalInfoData,
} from './constants';
import { getSectorsWithErrors } from './helper';
import styles from './personalInformation.module.pcss';
import {
  ActivePersonalDataSectorType,
  PersonalInfoIdType,
  PersonalSectorsType,
  ProfileFileChangedType,
} from './types';

const PersonalInformation = () => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [activeSector, setActiveSector] = useLocalStorage<ActivePersonalDataSectorType>(
    'ActiveSector',
    null,
  );
  const [requiredDocumentsSector, setRequiredDocumentsSector] = useLocalStorage<string>(
    'RequiredDocumentsSector',
    '',
  );
  const [requestGuid, setRequestGuid] = useLocalStorage<string>('RequestGuid', '');
  const [draftStatus, setDraftStatus] = useLocalStorage<string>('DraftStatus', '');
  const [crcCode, setCrcCode] = useLocalStorage<string>('AnketCrcCode', '');

  const [personalSectors, setPersonalSectors] = useLocalStorage<PersonalSectorsType>(
    'PersonalSectors',
    initialSectors,
  );

  const [sectorErrors, setSectorErrors] = useState<RequestErrorList[]>([]);

  const [goBackWithoutRecords, setGoBackWithoutRecords] = useState(false);

  const {
    data: profileData,
    isError: isProfileError,
    isSuccess: isProfileSuccess,
    refetch: profileRefetch,
    isLoading: isProfileLoading,
  } = useGetProfileQuery('current');

  const [
    createFormDraft,
    { data: formDraft, isLoading: isFormDraftLoading, error: formDraftError },
  ] = useCreateFormDraftMutation();

  const [cancelForm] = useCancelFormDraftMutation();

  const [checkListFormDraft, { isLoading: checkListLoading, isError: isCheckListError }] =
    useLazyCheckListFormQuery();

  const [checkFormDraft] = useLazyCheckFormQuery();
  const [firstEnter, setFirstEnter] = useState(false);
  const [isSaveLoading, setIsSaveLoading] = useState(false);
  //const [crcCode, setCrcCode] = useState('');
  const [startCrcListener, setStartCrcListener] = useState(false);

  const {
    data,
    isError: isPersonalDraftStatusError,
    refetch: refetchPersonalDraftStatus,
  } = useGetPersonalDraftStatusQuery();

  const anketDataStatusCode = data?.anketDataStatus?.[0]?.anketDataStatusCode;
  const isAnketDataProcessing = anketDataStatusCode === 'Processing';

  const hasFormDraftCreateError = Boolean(formDraftError);
  const formDraftCreateErrorText = hasFormDraftCreateError
    ? 'Извините, анкету невозможно отредактировать в личном кабинете. Пожалуйста, обратитесь в офис'
    : '';

  const isReadyToEdit = draftStatus === 'editing';
  const isPersonProfileEdit = getIsPersonProfileEdit();
  const isSectionDisabled =
    hasFormDraftCreateError || !isReadyToEdit || !isPersonProfileEdit || isAnketDataProcessing;

  const contactsData = profileData?.personContact || [];
  const residenceTypeCode = profileData?.personData?.[0]?.residenceTypeCode || '';
  const isNonResident = residenceTypeCode.toUpperCase() === 'NONRESIDENT';

  const allSectorsFilled = useMemo(() => {
    if (isNonResident) {
      return personalInfoData.every((sector) =>
        sector.datasets.every(
          (set) =>
            notRequiredSetsForNonResident.includes(set) || (profileData?.[set]?.length ?? 0) > 0,
        ),
      );
    }

    return personalInfoData.every((sector) =>
      sector.datasets.every((set) => (profileData?.[set]?.length ?? 0) > 0),
    );
  }, [isNonResident, profileData]);

  const isSaveWithoutChangingDisabled = hasFormDraftCreateError || isAnketDataProcessing;
  const isSomethingChanged = useMemo(
    () => personalSectors && Object.values(personalSectors).includes('changed'),
    [personalSectors],
  );
  const isErrorsInSectors = useMemo(
    () => personalSectors && Object.values(personalSectors).includes('error'),
    [personalSectors],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!startCrcListener) return;
    const listener = (data: ProfileFileChangedType) => {
      const crc = data.response.PersonProfileFileList[0].CRC;
      setCrcCode(crc);
      if (crc) setStartCrcListener(false);
    };
    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('ProfileFileChanged', listener);
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [setCrcCode, startCrcListener]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (formDraft?.requestGuid) {
      setRequestGuid(formDraft?.requestGuid);
      setDraftStatus(formDraft?.status);
    } else if (!requestGuid && firstEnter) {
      createFormDraft();
    }
  }, [
    createFormDraft,
    firstEnter,
    formDraft?.requestGuid,
    formDraft?.status,
    requestGuid,
    setDraftStatus,
    setRequestGuid,
  ]);

  const clearPersonalDataLocalStorage = useCallback(() => {
    setPersonalSectors(initialSectors);
    setActiveSector(null);
    setRequiredDocumentsSector('');
    setRequestGuid('');
    setDraftStatus('');
    setSectorErrors([]);
    setStartCrcListener(false);
    setCrcCode('');
  }, [
    setActiveSector,
    setDraftStatus,
    setPersonalSectors,
    setRequestGuid,
    setRequiredDocumentsSector,
    setSectorErrors,
    setStartCrcListener,
    setCrcCode,
  ]);

  const onPersonSectionClick = useCallback(
    (index: number, id: PersonalInfoIdType) => {
      setFirstEnter(true);
      setActiveSector(id);
    },
    [setActiveSector],
  );

  const goBackToProfileFromSuccess = useCallback(() => {
    refetchPersonalDraftStatus();
    clearPersonalDataLocalStorage();
    window.location.href = ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION;
  }, [clearPersonalDataLocalStorage, refetchPersonalDraftStatus]);

  const goBackToProfile = useCallback(() => {
    setSectorErrors([]);
    if (personalSectors?.isChanged || isSomethingChanged) {
      setGoBackWithoutRecords(true);
    } else {
      clearPersonalDataLocalStorage();
      navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
    }
  }, [clearPersonalDataLocalStorage, isSomethingChanged, navigate, personalSectors?.isChanged]);

  const SNILS = useMemo(
    () =>
      profileData?.personParam.find(
        (element) => element.paramCode === 'InsuranceIndividualAccountNumber',
      )?.paramValue || '',
    [profileData?.personParam],
  );
  const INN = useMemo(
    () =>
      profileData?.personParam?.find(
        (element) => element.paramCode === 'TaxpayerIdentificationNumber',
      )?.paramValue || '',
    [profileData?.personParam],
  );

  const personalProfileTable = useMemo(
    () =>
      personalInfoData.map((item, index) => {
        const { datasets: checkerDatasets, id: ItemId, label, title, icon } = item;
        const personSectorsFilled = isNonResident
          ? checkerDatasets.every(
              (set) =>
                notRequiredSetsForNonResident.includes(set) ||
                (profileData?.[set]?.length ?? 0) > 0,
            )
          : checkerDatasets.every((set) => (profileData?.[set]?.length ?? 0) > 0);

        const personSectorStatus = personalSectors?.[ItemId];

        return (
          <ActionCell
            title={title}
            description={
              <ProfileSectionDescription
                defaultLabel={label}
                sectorNotFilled={!(personalSectors?.isChanged || personSectorsFilled)}
                sectorStatus={personSectorStatus}
              />
            }
            separator={true}
            iconLeft={icon}
            key={index}
            addonRight={' '}
            onClick={() => onPersonSectionClick(index, ItemId)}
          />
        );
      }),
    [isNonResident, onPersonSectionClick, personalSectors, profileData],
  );

  const goBack = () => setActiveSector(null);

  const onCheckListFinished = useCallback(
    (checkResult?: CheckListFormDataResponse) => {
      setRequiredDocumentsSector('');
      const requiredDocuments = checkResult?.requiredDocuments;
      if (requiredDocuments?.length) {
        setRequiredDocumentsSector(requiredDocuments.map((doc) => doc.type).join(';'));
        const needUploadPasport = requiredDocuments.find(
          (doc) => doc.type === UploadingFileSteps.PASPORT,
        );
        const needUploadRegistration = requiredDocuments.find(
          (doc) => doc.type === UploadingFileSteps.REG,
        );

        if (needUploadPasport) setActiveSector('UploadingPasport');
        else if (needUploadRegistration) setActiveSector('UploadingRegistration');
        //else setActiveSector('ConfirmationAgreement');
      } else {
        setActiveSector('FinalGettingStatus');
      }
    },
    [setActiveSector, setRequiredDocumentsSector],
  );

  const saveChanges = useCallback(
    async (reqGuid: string) => {
      setCrcCode('');
      const checklistResult = await checkListFormDraft({ requestGuid: reqGuid });
      if (checklistResult.isError) {
        cancelForm({ requestGuid: reqGuid });
        setActiveSector('isError');
        setIsSaveLoading(false);
      } else {
        setStartCrcListener(true);
        setIsSaveLoading(false);
        onCheckListFinished(checklistResult.data);
      }
    },
    [cancelForm, checkListFormDraft, onCheckListFinished, setActiveSector, setCrcCode],
  );

  const onSaveChangesClick = useCallback(() => {
    if (requestGuid) {
      setSectorErrors([]);
      setIsSaveLoading(true);
      saveChanges(requestGuid);
    }
  }, [requestGuid, saveChanges, setSectorErrors]);

  const saveWithoutChanging = useCallback(
    async (reqGuid: string) => {
      const checkDraftErrorsResult = await checkFormDraft({ requestGuid: reqGuid });
      if (checkDraftErrorsResult.isError) {
        setActiveSector('isError');
        setIsSaveLoading(false);
      } else {
        const checkDraftErrors = checkDraftErrorsResult.data || [];
        if (checkDraftErrors?.length && personalSectors) {
          setSectorErrors(checkDraftErrors);
          setIsSaveLoading(false);
          setPersonalSectors({ ...getSectorsWithErrors(checkDraftErrors, personalSectors) });
        } else {
          await saveChanges(reqGuid);
        }
      }
    },
    [checkFormDraft, personalSectors, saveChanges, setActiveSector, setPersonalSectors],
  );

  const onSaveWithoutChangingClick = useCallback(async () => {
    setSectorErrors([]);
    setIsSaveLoading(true);
    if (requestGuid) {
      saveWithoutChanging(requestGuid);
    } else {
      try {
        const createFormResult = await createFormDraft().unwrap();
        if (createFormResult.requestGuid) {
          saveWithoutChanging(createFormResult.requestGuid);
        } else {
          setActiveSector('isError');
          setIsSaveLoading(false);
        }
      } catch {
        setActiveSector('isError');
        setIsSaveLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [createFormDraft, requestGuid, saveWithoutChanging, setActiveSector, setSectorErrors]);

  const onTryAgainClick = useCallback(async () => {
    if (requestGuid) {
      if (isProfileError) profileRefetch();
      if (isCheckListError) await checkListFormDraft({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [checkListFormDraft, isCheckListError, isProfileError, profileRefetch, requestGuid]);

  const isInvalidAnketDataStatus =
    isProfileSuccess && !(profileData?.anketDataStatus && profileData.anketDataStatus.length > 0);

  const cannotLoadPersonalProfileHub =
    isProfileError || isPersonalDraftStatusError || isInvalidAnketDataStatus;

  if (cannotLoadPersonalProfileHub) {
    return (
      <ErrorPage
        onTryAgainClick={() => {
          profileRefetch();
          refetchPersonalDraftStatus();
        }}
        goBackToProfile={() => navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION)}
      />
    );
  }

  if (activeSector === 'isError') {
    return (
      <ErrorPage
        onTryAgainClick={onTryAgainClick}
        goBackLocal={() => {
          setActiveSector(null);
        }}
        goBackToProfile={() => navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION)}
      />
    );
  }

  if (isFormDraftLoading || checkListLoading || isSaveLoading) {
    return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;
  }
  if (isProfileLoading) {
    return <ProfileSkeleton />;
  }

  if (activeSector === 'Onboarding') {
    return <OnboardingPage handleBackClick={() => setActiveSector(null)} />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      {activeSector === null && (
        <>
          <HeaderPage
            title="Персональные данные"
            leftIconVariant="back"
            onLeftIconClick={goBackToProfile}
          />
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            <div>
              {isAnketDataProcessing && <ProcessingAttentionCard isMobile={isMobile} />}
              {personalProfileTable}
            </div>

            <ButtonBar classNameWrapper={styles.buttonsBarWrapper} shape="vertical">
              {personalSectors?.isChanged || isSomethingChanged || isErrorsInSectors ? (
                <>
                  <Button
                    variant="primary"
                    onClick={onSaveChangesClick}
                    disabled={isErrorsInSectors || isSectionDisabled}
                  >
                    Сохранить изменения
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="negative" onClick={goBackToProfile}>
                    Отменить изменения
                  </Button>
                </>
              ) : (
                allSectorsFilled && (
                  <Button
                    variant="primary"
                    onClick={onSaveWithoutChangingClick}
                    disabled={isSaveWithoutChangingDisabled}
                  >
                    Подтвердить без изменений
                  </Button>
                )
              )}
            </ButtonBar>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {activeSector === 'UploadingPasport' && (
        <UploadingPasport
          goBack={goBackToProfile}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          setActiveSector={setActiveSector}
          needRegistration={requiredDocumentsSector?.includes(UploadingFileSteps.REG)}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'UploadingRegistration' && (
        <UploadingRegistration
          goBack={goBackToProfile}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          setActiveSector={setActiveSector}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'FinalGettingStatus' && (
        <FinalGettingStatus
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          goBackToProfile={goBackToProfile}
          setActiveSector={setActiveSector}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'ConfirmationAgreement' && (
        <ConfirmationAgreement
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          crcCode={crcCode || ''}
          goBackToProfile={goBackToProfile}
          setActiveSector={setActiveSector}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'Success' && <SuccessPage handleBackClick={goBackToProfileFromSuccess} />}
      {activeSector === 'AdditionalDocuments' && personalSectors && (
        <AdditionalDocuments
          goBack={goBack}
          startSnils={SNILS}
          startInn={INN}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          disabled={isSectionDisabled}
          isNonResident={isNonResident}
          errorText={formDraftCreateErrorText}
          setPersonalSectors={setPersonalSectors}
          personalSectors={personalSectors}
          sectorErrorsFromCheck={sectorErrors.filter((sec) =>
            ADDOCS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(sec.fieldCode),
          )}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'ContactInfo' && personalSectors && (
        <PersonalContacts
          goBack={goBack}
          contactsData={contactsData}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          setPersonalSectors={setPersonalSectors}
          setSectorErrors={setSectorErrors}
          personalSectors={personalSectors}
          disabled={isSectionDisabled}
          errorText={formDraftCreateErrorText}
          sectorErrorsFromCheck={sectorErrors.filter((sec) =>
            CONTACTS_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(sec.fieldCode),
          )}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'Address' && personalSectors && (
        <Address
          goBack={goBack}
          personAddress={profileData?.personAddress || []}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          disabled={isSectionDisabled}
          isNonResident={isNonResident}
          errorText={formDraftCreateErrorText}
          setPersonalSectors={setPersonalSectors}
          personalSectors={personalSectors}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'Id' && personalSectors && (
        <Passport
          goBack={goBack}
          setPersonalSectors={setPersonalSectors}
          personalSectors={personalSectors}
          disabled={isSectionDisabled}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          personPassport={profileData?.personDocument || []}
          personFio={profileData?.personData || []}
          errorText={formDraftCreateErrorText}
          sectorErrorsFromCheck={sectorErrors.filter((sec) =>
            PASPORT_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(sec.fieldCode),
          )}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'Relationships' && personalSectors && (
        <HDO
          goBack={goBack}
          disabled={isSectionDisabled}
          setPersonalSectors={setPersonalSectors}
          personalSectors={personalSectors}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          isConfirmedFromProfile={profileData?.businessRelationsConfirm[0]?.isConfirmed || false}
          businessRelations={profileData?.businessRelations || []}
          errorText={formDraftCreateErrorText}
          sectorErrorsFromCheck={sectorErrors.filter((sec) =>
            HDO_ERROR_FIELD_CODES.includes(sec.fieldCode),
          )}
        />
      )}
      {activeSector === 'TaxesResidence' && personalSectors && (
        <TaxesResidence
          goBack={goBack}
          disabled={isSectionDisabled}
          setPersonalSectors={setPersonalSectors}
          personalSectors={personalSectors}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
          isConfirmedFromProfile={profileData?.businessRelationsConfirm[0]?.isConfirmed || false}
          personInn={profileData?.personInn || []}
          errorText={formDraftCreateErrorText}
          currencyResidency={
            profileData?.personStatus.find((it) => it.statusCode === 'CurrencyResidency')
              ?.statusValue
          }
          isNonResident={isNonResident}
        />
      )}
      {
        <GoBackWithoutRecords
          open={goBackWithoutRecords}
          onDismiss={() => setGoBackWithoutRecords(false)}
          handleExit={() => {
            clearPersonalDataLocalStorage();
            navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
          }}
          requestGuid={requestGuid || ''}
        />
      }
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(PersonalInformation);

--- FILE: src\modules\PinCreation\PinCreation.tsx ---

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text, useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';

import { useNativeApi } from 'hooks/useNativeApi';

import styles from './PinCreation.module.pcss';

interface PinCreationProps {
  minLength?: number;
  maxLength?: number;
  onComplete: (pin: string | null) => void;
}

function createArrayByLength(length: number) {
  return Array.from({ length: length }, () => '');
}

const PinCreation: React.FC<PinCreationProps> = ({ minLength = 4, maxLength = 6, onComplete }) => {
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();

  // Улучшенная функция для отображения сообщений через snackbar
  const showSnackbar = (message: string, type?: 'success' | 'fail') => {
    snackbarTopAlert?.closeAll();

    const options: any = {
      autoClose: 3500,
      label: message,
    };

    if (type === 'success') {
      options.variant = 'secondary';
    }

    snackbarTopAlert?.show(options);
  };

  const nativeApi = useNativeApi();

  // Состояния
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<'initial' | 'create' | 'confirm'>('initial');
  const [firstPin, setFirstPin] = useState<string>('');
  const [pinValues, setPinValues] = useState<string[]>(createArrayByLength(maxLength));
  const [isVerifying, setIsVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('Создание PIN-кода');

  // Состояние для отслеживания анимирующейся точки
  const [bouncingIndex, setBouncingIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Ссылки на поля ввода
  const inputRefs = useRef<(HTMLInputElement | null)[]>([]);

  // Текущее активное поле для фокуса
  const [activeInput, setActiveInput] = useState(0);

  // Заголовок на основании текущего этапа
  const currentTitle = (() => {
    switch (stage) {
      case 'create':
        return title;
      case 'confirm':
        return 'Подтверждение PIN-кода';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  })();

  // Текст подсказки
  const promptText = (() => {
    switch (stage) {
      case 'create':
        return `Придумайте PIN-код от ${minLength} до ${maxLength} символов`;
      case 'confirm':
        return 'Повторите PIN-код для подтверждения';
      default:
        return '';
    }
  })();

  // Инициализация ссылок на инпуты
  useEffect(() => {
    inputRefs.current = inputRefs.current.slice(0, maxLength);
    if (stage !== 'initial') {
      inputRefs.current[0]?.focus();
    }
  }, [maxLength, stage]);

  // Сброс полей при смене этапа
  useEffect(() => {
    if (stage !== 'initial') {
      setPinValues(createArrayByLength(maxLength));
      setActiveInput(0);
      setTimeout(() => {
        inputRefs.current[0]?.focus();
      }, 0);
    }
  }, [stage, maxLength]);

  // Обработка ввода цифры
  const handleInputChange = (index: number, value: string) => {
    if (!/^\d*$/.test(value)) {
      return; // Только цифры разрешены
    }

    const newPinValues = [...pinValues];
    newPinValues[index] = value;
    setPinValues(newPinValues);

    // Запускаем анимацию для текущей точки
    setBouncingIndex(index);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setBouncingIndex(null);
    }, 300); // Время анимации

    // Переход к следующему полю
    if (value && index < maxLength - 1) {
      setActiveInput(index + 1);
      inputRefs.current[index + 1]?.focus();
    }
  };

  // Обработка нажатия клавиш
  const handleKeyDown = (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !pinValues[index] && index > 0) {
      setActiveInput(index - 1);
      inputRefs.current[index - 1]?.focus();
    }
  };

  // Получение полного PIN-кода
  const getEnteredPin = (): string => {
    return pinValues.join('');
  };

  // Валидация PIN-кода
  const validatePin = (pin: string): string | null => {
    if (pin.length < minLength) {
      return `PIN-код должен содержать не менее ${minLength} цифр`;
    }

    if (!/^\d+$/.test(pin)) {
      return 'PIN-код должен содержать только цифры';
    }

    return null; // Нет ошибок
  };

  // Обработка нажатия кнопки "Продолжить"
  const handleContinue = async () => {
    const pin = getEnteredPin();

    if (stage === 'create') {
      const errorMsg = validatePin(pin);

      if (errorMsg) {
        showSnackbar(errorMsg, 'fail');
        return;
      }

      // Сохраняем первый PIN и переходим к подтверждению
      setFirstPin(pin);
      setStage('confirm');
      showSnackbar('Теперь подтвердите PIN-код', 'success');
    } else if (stage === 'confirm') {
      // Проверяем, совпадает ли подтверждение с первым PIN
      if (pin !== firstPin) {
        showSnackbar('PIN-коды не совпадают, попробуйте еще раз', 'fail');
        setStage('create');
        return;
      }

      // PIN-код успешно создан, сохраняем его
      setIsVerifying(true);
      try {
        if (nativeApi) {
          await nativeApi.savePin('login', pin);
        }
        setIsVerifying(false);
        showSnackbar('PIN-код успешно сохранен', 'success');
        onComplete(pin);
      } catch (e) {
        setIsVerifying(false);
        showSnackbar('Ошибка сохранения PIN-кода', 'fail');
      }
    }
  };

  // Обработка нажатия кнопки "Отмена"
  const handleCancel = () => {
    if (stage === 'confirm') {
      setStage('create');
    } else {
      onComplete(null);
    }
  };

  // Обработка нажатия на контейнер с точками
  const handlePinContainerClick = () => {
    // Фокус на активном или первом пустом поле
    const emptyIndex = pinValues.indexOf('');
    const focusIndex = emptyIndex >= 0 ? emptyIndex : activeInput;
    inputRefs.current[focusIndex]?.focus();
  };

  if (!nativeApi) {
    onComplete(null);
    return null;
  }

  // Рендер начального экрана с вопросом
  if (stage === 'initial') {
    return (
      <div className={styles.overlay}>
        <Text type="bodyMedium" direction="center">
          Желаете установить PIN для входа?
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.buttonsContainer}>
          <Button
            className={styles.buttonsContainerItem}
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={() => onComplete(null)}
          >
            Нет
          </Button>
          <Button
            className={styles.buttonsContainerItem}
            variant="primary"
            onClick={() => setStage('create')}
          >
            Да
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Рендер экранов создания/подтверждения PIN-кода
  return (
    <div className={styles.overlay}>
      <Text type="bodyMedium" direction="center">
        {currentTitle}
      </Text>
      <Text type="bodyMedium" direction="center" className={styles.prompt}>
        {promptText}
      </Text>

      {/* Визуальное отображение точек PIN-кода с анимацией */}
      <div className={styles.pinDotsContainer} onClick={handlePinContainerClick}>
        {createArrayByLength(maxLength).map((_, index) => (
          <div
            key={index}
            className={`
              ${styles.pinDot} 
              ${pinValues[index] ? styles.filled : ''} 
              ${bouncingIndex === index ? styles.bouncing : ''}
            `}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Скрытые поля ввода для обработки числового ввода */}
      <div className={styles.hiddenInputs}>
        {createArrayByLength(maxLength).map((_, index) => (
          <input
            key={index}
            type="password"
            maxLength={1}
            inputMode="numeric"
            pattern="[0-9]*"
            value={pinValues[index]}
            onChange={(e) => handleInputChange(index, e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(index, e)}
            ref={(el) => (inputRefs.current[index] = el)}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {isVerifying ? (
        <div className={styles.loaderContainer}>
          <CircleLoader />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.buttonsContainer}>
          <Button
            className={styles.buttonsContainerItem}
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={handleCancel}
          >
            {stage === 'confirm' ? 'Назад' : 'Отмена'}
          </Button>

          <Button
            className={styles.buttonsContainerItem}
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleContinue}
            disabled={pinValues.filter((val) => val !== '').length < minLength}
          >
            Продолжить
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PinCreation;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader, Text, useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';

import { useNativeApi } from 'hooks/useNativeApi';

import styles from './PinEntry.module.pcss';

const STORE_KEY = 'login';

interface PinEntryOnCompleteProps {
  isSuccess: boolean;
  enrtyData: string | null;
}

interface PinEntryProps {
  minLength?: number;
  maxLength?: number;
  onComplete: (data: PinEntryOnCompleteProps) => void;
}

function createArrayByLength(length: number) {
  return Array.from({ length: length }, () => '');
}

const PinEntry: React.FC<PinEntryProps> = ({ minLength = 4, maxLength = 6, onComplete }) => {
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();
  const nativeApi = useNativeApi();

  // Константы для обработки попыток ввода PIN-кода
  const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

  // Состояния
  const [pinValues, setPinValues] = useState<string[]>(createArrayByLength(maxLength));
  const [isVerifying, setIsVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [attemptCount, setAttemptCount] = useState(0);
  const [bouncingIndex, setBouncingIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Функция для отображения сообщений
  const showSnackbar = (message: string, type?: 'success' | 'fail') => {
    snackbarTopAlert?.closeAll();

    const options: any = {
      autoClose: 3500,
      label: message,
    };

    if (type === 'success') {
      options.variant = 'secondary';
    }

    snackbarTopAlert?.show(options);
  };

  // Функция для добавления цифры в PIN-код
  const handleNumberPress = (number: number) => {
    const emptyIndex = pinValues.indexOf('');
    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
      const newPinValues = [...pinValues];
      newPinValues[emptyIndex] = number.toString();
      setPinValues(newPinValues);

      // Запускаем анимацию для текущей точки
      setBouncingIndex(emptyIndex);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBouncingIndex(null);
      }, 300);

      // Автоматическая проверка при вводе последней цифры
      if (emptyIndex === maxLength - 1) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          verifyPin([...newPinValues]);
        }, 300);
      }
    }
  };

  // Функция для удаления последней цифры
  const handleBackspace = () => {
    const filledValues = pinValues.filter((v) => v !== '');
    if (filledValues.length > 0) {
      const newPinValues = [...pinValues];
      const lastFilledIndex = newPinValues.findIndex(
        (v, i, arr) => v !== '' && (i === arr.length - 1 || arr[i + 1] === ''),
      );

      if (lastFilledIndex !== -1) {
        newPinValues[lastFilledIndex] = '';
        setPinValues(newPinValues);
      }
    }
  };

  // Функция для проверки PIN-кода
  const verifyPin = async (pinArray: string[]) => {
    const pin = pinArray.join('');

    if (pin.length < minLength) {
      showSnackbar(`PIN-код должен содержать не менее ${minLength} цифр`, 'fail');
      return;
    }

    setIsVerifying(true);
    try {
      // Вызов API для проверки PIN-кода
      const enrtyData = await nativeApi.getSecureData(STORE_KEY, pin);

      setIsVerifying(false);

      if (enrtyData) {
        setAttemptCount(0);
        showSnackbar('Введите смс код', 'success');
        onComplete({
          isSuccess: true,
          enrtyData,
        });
      } else {
        const newAttemptCount = attemptCount + 1;
        setAttemptCount(newAttemptCount);

        if (newAttemptCount >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
          showSnackbar(`Превышено количество попыток (${MAX_ATTEMPTS})`, 'fail');
          handleMaxAttemptsReached();
        } else {
          showSnackbar(
            `Неверный PIN-код. Осталось попыток: ${MAX_ATTEMPTS - newAttemptCount}`,
            'fail',
          );
          setPinValues(createArrayByLength(maxLength));
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setIsVerifying(false);
      showSnackbar('Ошибка проверки PIN-кода', 'fail');
    }
  };

  // Обработка превышения лимита попыток
  const handleMaxAttemptsReached = async () => {
    await nativeApi.removeSecureData(STORE_KEY);
    showSnackbar(`Превышено количество попыток (${MAX_ATTEMPTS}). Доступ заблокирован.`, 'fail');
    onComplete({
      isSuccess: true,
      enrtyData: null,
    });
  };

  // Функция для отмены ввода PIN-кода
  const handleCancel = async () => {
    await nativeApi.removeSecureData(STORE_KEY);
    onComplete({
      isSuccess: true,
      enrtyData: null,
    });
  };

  // Функция ручного подтверждения ввода
  const handleEnter = () => {
    // Проверить, есть ли введенные цифры
    const pin = pinValues.filter((v) => v !== '');
    if (pin.length > 0) {
      verifyPin(pinValues);
    }
  };

  // Генерация цифровых кнопок для клавиатуры
  const renderNumericKeypad = () => {
    // Расположение кнопок как на стандартной клавиатуре телефона
    const rows = [
      [1, 2, 3],
      [4, 5, 6],
      [7, 8, 9],
      ['logout', 0, 'backspace'],
    ];

    return (
      <div className={styles.keypad}>
        {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
          <div key={rowIndex} className={styles.keypadRow}>
            {row.map((item, index) => {
              if (item === 'logout') {
                return (
                  <button
                    key={`${rowIndex}-${index}`}
                    className={styles.keypadButton}
                    onClick={handleCancel}
                    disabled={isVerifying}
                  >
                    Выйти
                  </button>
                );
              } else if (item === 'backspace') {
                return (
                  <button
                    key={`${rowIndex}-${index}`}
                    className={styles.keypadButton}
                    onClick={handleBackspace}
                    disabled={isVerifying}
                  >
                    ⌫
                  </button>
                );
              } else {
                return (
                  <button
                    key={`${rowIndex}-${index}`}
                    className={styles.keypadButton}
                    onClick={() => handleNumberPress(item as number)}
                    disabled={isVerifying}
                  >
                    {item}
                  </button>
                );
              }
            })}
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className={styles.enterButtonContainer}>
          <button
            className={styles.enterButton}
            onClick={handleEnter}
            disabled={isVerifying || pinValues.filter((v) => v !== '').length < minLength}
          >
            Войти
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (!nativeApi) {
    onComplete({
      isSuccess: true,
      enrtyData: null,
    });
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.fullScreenContainer}>
      <div className={styles.pinEntryContainer}>
        <div className={styles.contentWrapper}>
          <Text type="bodyMedium" direction="center" className={styles.prompt}>
            Введите PIN-код для входа
          </Text>

          {/* Визуальное отображение точек PIN-кода с анимацией */}
          <div className={styles.pinDotsContainer}>
            {createArrayByLength(maxLength).map((_, index) => (
              <div
                key={index}
                className={`
                  ${styles.pinDot} 
                  ${pinValues[index] ? styles.filled : ''} 
                  ${bouncingIndex === index ? styles.bouncing : ''}
                `}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          {isVerifying ? (
            <div className={styles.loaderContainer}>
              <CircleLoader size="medium" />
            </div>
          ) : (
            renderNumericKeypad()
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PinEntry;

import { FC, memo, useEffect } from 'react';

import Card from '@aurora/card';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { setProductId } from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import { FormattedBalance } from 'components';

import { Position } from 'types/positions';

import { checkIsModel } from '../../helpers';
import Skeleton from '../Skeleton';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = Position & {
  isActive: boolean;
  instrumentCategoryCode: string;
  isLoading: boolean;
  positionIsNotModel?: number | null;
};

const PositionCard: FC<Props> = ({
  accountNo,
  dailyFinRes,
  dailyFinResCurr,
  dailyFinResPcnt,
  finRes,
  finResCurr,
  finResCurrCurrency,
  finResCurrency,
  finResPcnt,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  isActive,
  isLoading,
  positionIsNotModel,
  positionOpenPrice,
  positionOpenPriceCurrency,
  productCategoryCode,
  productId,
  productName,
  quantity,
  totalAmount,
  totalAmountCurr,
  totalAmountCurrCurrency,
  totalAmountCurrency,
}) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const isCurrencyOrMetals = instrumentCategoryCode === 'CUP' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'MLP';
  const isFuturesOrOption = instrumentCategoryCode === 'FUT' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'OPT';
  const dailyRes = isCurrencyOrMetals ? dailyFinRes : dailyFinResCurr;
  const res = isCurrencyOrMetals ? finRes : finResCurr;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading) {
      const isModel = checkIsModel(productCategoryCode);

      if (isActive) {
        const currentProductId = isModel ? positionIsNotModel : productId;

        currentProductId && dispatch(setProductId(currentProductId));
      }
    }
  }, [dispatch, isActive, isLoading, positionIsNotModel, productCategoryCode, productId]);

  if (isLoading) return <Skeleton />;

  return (
    <Card withShadow={isActive} className={cn(styles.card, isActive && styles.activeCard)}>
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
          Счёт №{accountNo}
        </Text>
        <Text type="lineSemiBold">{productName}</Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.list}>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            Количество
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelSemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(quantity, null)} ${
            instrumentCategoryCode === 'CUP'
              ? currencySign(totalAmountCurrCurrency)
              : instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP'
              ? 'гр.'
              : 'шт'
          }`}</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            Стоимость позиции
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelSemiBold">
            {`${sumFormatter(isCurrencyOrMetals ? totalAmount : totalAmountCurr)}
            ${
              instrumentCategoryCode === 'CUP' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP'
                ? currencySign(totalAmountCurrency)
                : currencySign(totalAmountCurrCurrency)
            }`}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            Средняя цена открытия
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelSemiBold">
            {positionOpenPrice
              ? `${sumFormatter(positionOpenPrice, null, 2)}
            ${currencySign(positionOpenPriceCurrency)}`
              : '–'}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            За сегодня
          </Text>
          <FormattedBalance
            value={dailyRes}
            currency={isCurrencyOrMetals ? finResCurrency : finResCurrCurrency}
            diff={isFuturesOrOption ? undefined : dailyFinResPcnt}
            showDiff={!isFuturesOrOption}
          />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            За всё время
          </Text>
          <FormattedBalance
            value={res}
            currency={isCurrencyOrMetals ? finResCurrency : finResCurrCurrency}
            diff={isFuturesOrOption ? res : finResPcnt}
            showDiff={!isFuturesOrOption}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default memo(PositionCard);

import { FC, memo, useEffect } from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { Pagination } from 'swiper';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';

import { useGetPositionsQuery } from 'core/api/positions';

import PositionCard from './components/PositionCard';
import { checkIsModel } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/pagination';

type Props = {
  instrumentId: string;
  tradePlaceId: string;
  instrumentCategoryCode: string;
  setHasPositionValuationByProduct: (hasPositionValuationByProduct: boolean) => void;
};

const PositionCards: FC<Props> = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  setHasPositionValuationByProduct,
}) => {
  const { data: positions, isLoading } = useGetPositionsQuery({
    datasets: 'PositionValuationByProduct',
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
  });

  const pagination = {
    renderBullet: function (_: number, className: string) {
      return '<span class="' + className + '"></span>';
    },
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!positions?.positionValuationByProduct?.length) return;

    setHasPositionValuationByProduct(
      Boolean(positions?.positionValuationByProduct[0]?.quantity > 0),
    );
  }, [positions?.positionValuationByProduct, setHasPositionValuationByProduct]);

  const positionIsNotModel =
    positions?.positionValuationByProduct?.find(
      (item) => checkIsModel(item.productCategoryCode) === false,
    )?.productId || null;

  if (!positions) return null;

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Text className={styles.title} type="bodySemiBold">
        Мои счета
      </Text>
      <Swiper
        className={styles.mySwiper}
        modules={[Pagination]}
        pagination={pagination}
        preventClicksPropagation
        slidesPerView="auto"
        spaceBetween={8}
        touchMoveStopPropagation
        touchStartPreventDefault
      >
        {positions.positionValuationByProduct?.map((item, index) => (
          <SwiperSlide
            key={`${item.accountNo}-${index}`}
            className={cn(
              positions.positionValuationByProduct?.length === 1
                ? styles.aloneSlider
                : styles.slider,
            )}
          >
            {({ isActive }) => (
              <PositionCard
                {...item}
                instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
                isActive={isActive}
                isLoading={isLoading}
                positionIsNotModel={positionIsNotModel}
              />
            )}
          </SwiperSlide>
        ))}
      </Swiper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(PositionCards);

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Checkbox, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_QUAL_SUCCESS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { API_REQUEST_URL } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import { useSetQualConfirmMutation } from 'core/api/qual';

import useDownloadFile from 'hooks/useDownloadFile';
import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import { AdaptivePopup, HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell';

import { qualState } from '../../consts';
import styles from './QualConfirm.module.pcss';

type stateProps = {
  crc: string;
  requestGuid: string;
};

const QualConfirm = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const location = useLocation();
  const state = location.state as stateProps;

  const filePath = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/persons/current/qual/change/file/checkfile?requestGuid=${state.requestGuid}`;

  const { file } = useDownloadFile({
    url: filePath,
  });

  const [checkAgreement, setCheckAgreement] = useState(false);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const qualSuccessState = {
    ...qualState,
    requestGuid: state.requestGuid,
  };

  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading, error: smsError }] =
    useSetQualConfirmMutation();

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const handleConfirmButton = async () => {
    !smsData && getSms({ requestGuid: state.requestGuid });
    !isMobile && setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_QUAL_SUCCESS, { state: qualSuccessState, replace: true });
  };

  useErrorNotification(smsError);

  if (isSmsLoading && isMobile) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          documentTitle={'Квалифицированный инвестор'}
        />
        <CircleLoader brandColor type={'page'} />
        <Text>Запрос СМС-кода...</Text>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {(!smsData && isMobile) || !isMobile ? (
        <div className={isMobile ? styles.root : styles.rootAdaptive}>
          <HeaderPage
            leftIconVariant="back"
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
            documentTitle={'Квалифицированный инвестор'}
          />
          <div className={isMobile ? styles.main : styles.mainAdaptive}>
            <Text type="title">
              Подтверждение заявки на получение статуса квалифицированного инвестора
            </Text>
            <Text className={styles.text} type="bodyRegular">
              Подтвердите согласие и подпишите файлы с помощью SMS
            </Text>
            <div>
              <DocumentCell
                url={file?.url}
                name={'Заявление о признании квалифицированным инвестором'}
                id={`ID: ${state.crc}`}
              />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.divider} />

            <div className={styles.checkbox}>
              <Checkbox
                checked={checkAgreement}
                onChange={() => setCheckAgreement(!checkAgreement)}
                label={
                  !isMobile &&
                  'Подтверждаю, что заявление мной прочитано, со всеми указанными в нем условиями согласен'
                }
              />
              {isMobile && (
                <div>
                  <Text tag={'span'} type="lineRegular">
                    Подтверждаю, что{' '}
                    <a
                      href={file?.url}
                      target={'_blank'}
                      rel={'noreferrer'}
                      className={styles.link}
                    >
                      Заявление
                    </a>{' '}
                    мной прочитано, со всеми указанными в нем условиями согласен
                  </Text>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className={isMobile ? styles.bottom : styles.bottomAdaptive}>
            <Text type="lineMedium" className={styles.info}>
              Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
            </Text>
            <Button
              disabled={!checkAgreement}
              onClick={handleConfirmButton}
              className={isMobile ? styles.btn : styles.btnAdaptive}
              variant="primary"
            >
              Подтвердить
            </Button>
          </div>
          {!isMobile && (
            <AdaptivePopup
              open={isOpen}
              onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
              classNameContent={styles.contentDesktop}
            >
              {!smsData ? (
                <CircleLoader brandColor />
              ) : (
                <SmsConfirmation
                  initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
                  smsInputCount={4}
                  onSuccess={handleConfirm}
                  onError={() => console.log('Error')}
                  loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется запрос...</Text>}
                />
              )}
            </AdaptivePopup>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        isMobile && (
          <SmsConfirmation
            initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
            smsInputCount={4}
            onSuccess={handleConfirm}
            onError={() => console.log('Error')}
            loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется запрос...</Text>}
          />
        )
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default QualConfirm;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Card, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { LK_ROUTE_QUAL_MOBILE } from 'const/lkRoutes';
import { ROUTE_QUAL_CONFIRM, ROUTE_QUAL_SUCCESS, ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';
import { Pagination } from 'swiper';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useLazyQualChangeDocumentQuery,
  useLazyQualChangeStatusQuery,
  useQualChangeMutation,
} from 'core/api/qual';

import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';
import { useMoveToLKAuthToken } from 'hooks/useMoveToLKAuthToken';

import { useIsQualInvestor } from 'modules/MyInformation/hooks/useIsQualInvestor';

import HeaderPage from 'components/HeaderPage';

import { ReactComponent as PDFSvg } from 'images/icons/pdf.svg';

import { qualState } from '../../consts';
import NotAllowedPlug from '../NotAllowedPlug/NotAllowedPlug';
import styles from './QualOnboarding.module.pcss';
import { notIsPossibleQualData, qualSlideData, stepsData } from './QualSlideData';

const QualOnboarding = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const { handleNavigateToLK } = useMoveToLKAuthToken();

  const { isQual, isPossibleQual, isActualQualOrder } = useIsQualInvestor();

  const [
    changeQual,
    { data: changeQualData, isLoading: isQualChangeLoading, isError: isQualChangeError },
  ] = useQualChangeMutation();

  const [
    getQualStatus,
    { data: resultQualStatus, isLoading: isQualStatusLoading, isError: isQualStatusError },
  ] = useLazyQualChangeStatusQuery();

  const [
    getQualDocument,
    { data: resultQualDocuments, isLoading: isQualDocumentsLoading, isError: isQualDocumentsError },
  ] = useLazyQualChangeDocumentQuery();

  const requestGuid = changeQualData?.requestGuid;
  const qualStatus = resultQualStatus?.requestStatus[0].status;
  const crc = resultQualDocuments?.crc;
  const stateQualRequest = {
    crc: crc,
    requestGuid: requestGuid,
  };
  const isError = isQualChangeError || isQualStatusError || isQualDocumentsError;

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const qualTerms = () => {
    window.open(
      'https://investpalata.ru/documents/dokumenty/poryadok-priznaniya-lic-kvalificirovannymi-investorami',
      '_blank',
      'noopener, noreferrer',
    );
  };

  const qualMobileNavigate = () => {
    handleNavigateToLK(LK_ROUTE_QUAL_MOBILE)();
  };

  const handleActionButtonClick = () => {
    isPossibleQual ? handleChangeQual() : qualMobileNavigate();
  };

  const handleChangeQual = async () => {
    const res = await changeQual({}).unwrap();
    getQualStatus(res).unwrap();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let setTimeOutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (qualStatus === 'processing') {
      setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => {
        getQualStatus({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
        setRetryCount((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 3000);
    }
    if (qualStatus === 'signing_documents') {
      getQualDocument({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
    }
    if (retryCount >= 10) {
      navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
    }

    return () => clearTimeout(setTimeOutId);
  }, [getQualDocument, getQualStatus, navigate, qualStatus, requestGuid, retryCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resultQualDocuments) navigate(ROUTE_QUAL_CONFIRM, { state: stateQualRequest });
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isQualChangeLoading || isQualStatusLoading || isQualDocumentsLoading) {
      setIsLoading(true);
    }
    if (isQualChangeError || isQualStatusError || isQualDocumentsError) {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [
    isQualChangeError,
    isQualChangeLoading,
    isQualDocumentsError,
    isQualDocumentsLoading,
    isQualStatusError,
    isQualStatusLoading,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActualQualOrder) {
      navigate(ROUTE_QUAL_SUCCESS, { state: qualState });
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useErrorNotification(isError);

  if (isQual) return <NotAllowedPlug />;

  return (
    <>
      <div>
        <HeaderPage
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          documentTitle="Квалифицированный инвестор"
        />

        <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrapper : styles.wrapperAdaptive}>
          <div className={isMobile ? styles.title : styles.titleAdaptive}>
            {isMobile ? (
              <Text type={'title'}>Зачем нужен статус квалифицированного инвестора?</Text>
            ) : (
              <Headline indent={false} title={'Зачем нужен статус квалифицированного инвестора?'} />
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={isMobile ? styles.cardWrap : styles.cardWrapAdaptive}>
            {qualSlideData.map((item) => (
              <Card indent={false} key={item.id} className={styles.card}>
                <div className={styles.cardContentWrap}>
                  <div className={styles.imgWrap}>{item.img}</div>
                  <div>
                    <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>{item.title}</Text>
                    <Text type={'labelRegular'}>{item.description}</Text>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>

          {!isPossibleQual && (
            <div>
              <div className={styles.title}>
                <Text type={'title'}>Выберите подходящий критерий для получения статуса</Text>
              </div>
              <div className={isMobile ? styles.cardWrap : styles.cardWrapAdaptive}>
                {notIsPossibleQualData.map((item) => (
                  <Card indent={false} key={item.id} className={styles.criteriaCard}>
                    <div className={styles.criteriaContentWrap}>
                      <div className={styles.imgWrap}>{item.img}</div>
                      <div className={cx({ [styles.stepText]: !isMobile })}>
                        <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>{item.title}</Text>
                        <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                          {item.description}
                        </Text>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <div className={styles.title}>
              <Text type={'title'}>Как получить?</Text>
            </div>
            <div className={isMobile ? styles.cardWrap : styles.stepCardWrap}>
              {stepsData.map((item) => (
                <Card indent={false} key={item.id}>
                  <div className={isMobile ? styles.cardContentWrap : styles.stepCardContentWrap}>
                    <div className={styles.imgId}>{item.id}</div>
                    <div className={cx({ [styles.stepText]: !isMobile })}>
                      <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>{item.title}</Text>
                      <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                        {item.description}
                      </Text>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className={isMobile ? styles.buttonGroup : styles.buttonGroupAdaptive}>
            <Button variant={'secondary'} iconLeft={<PDFSvg />} onClick={qualTerms}>
              Подробные условия
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleActionButtonClick} loading={isLoading}>
              Получить статус
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default QualOnboarding;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useLazyQualChangeStatusQuery } from 'core/api/qual';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as SuccessSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-success.svg';
import { ReactComponent as WrongSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-wrong.svg';

import { SuccessProps } from 'types/qual';

import styles from './QualSuccess.module.pcss';
import { defaultBadgeText, defaultText, defaultTitle } from './const';

const QualSuccess = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const location = useLocation();
  const state = location.state as SuccessProps;

  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isError, setIsError] = useState(false);

  const [getQualStatus, { data: resultQualStatus, isError: isQualStatusError }] =
    useLazyQualChangeStatusQuery();
  const qualStatus = resultQualStatus?.requestStatus[0].status;
  const requestGuid = state.requestGuid;
  const isProgress = state?.status === 'isProgress';

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isProgress) {
      getQualStatus({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
      let setTimeOutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
      setIsLoading(true);
      if (qualStatus === 'completed') {
        setIsLoading(false);
      } else {
        setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => {
          getQualStatus({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
          setRetryCount((prev) => prev + 1);
        }, 3000);
      }
      if (retryCount >= 10) {
        setIsError(true);
      }
      return () => clearTimeout(setTimeOutId);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [getQualStatus, navigate, qualStatus, retryCount, state.requestGuid, state?.status]);

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    state.route ? navigate(state?.route) : navigate(-1);
  };

  const onAction = () => {
    state.route ? navigate(state?.route) : navigate(-1);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'close'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        title={state?.successHeader && state?.successHeader}
        documentTitle={'Квалифицированный Инвестор'}
        indent
      />
      {isLoading && !isProgress ? (
        <div className={styles.main}>
          <CircleLoader brandColor type={'page'} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Placeholder
          variant={isQualStatusError || isError ? 'error' : 'success'}
          badgeText={
            isQualStatusError || isError
              ? 'Заявка не принята в работу'
              : state?.successBadgeText
              ? state?.successBadgeText
              : defaultBadgeText
          }
          text={
            isQualStatusError || isError
              ? 'Что-то пошло не так. Попробуйте повторить попытку позднее'
              : state?.successText
              ? state?.successText
              : defaultText
          }
          title={
            isQualStatusError || isError
              ? 'Заявка не принята!'
              : state?.successTitle
              ? state?.successTitle
              : defaultTitle
          }
          actionButtonText={'Хорошо'}
          onActionButtonClick={onAction}
          img={isQualStatusError || isError ? <WrongSvg /> : <SuccessSvg />}
          className={cx({ [styles.placeholderAdaptive]: !isMobile })}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default QualSuccess;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { LK_ROUTE_QUAL_MOBILE } from 'const/lkRoutes';
import {
  ROUTE_QUAL_CONFIRM,
  ROUTE_QUAL_ONBOARDING,
  ROUTE_QUAL_SUCCESS,
  ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG,
} from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useLazyQualChangeDocumentQuery,
  useLazyQualChangeStatusQuery,
  useQualChangeMutation,
} from 'core/api/qual';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';
import { useMoveToLKAuthToken } from 'hooks/useMoveToLKAuthToken';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as QualRequestImg } from 'images/raw-icons/qual/qual-request.svg';

import { PERSON_QUALIFICATION } from '../MyInformation/constants';
import { useIsQualInvestor } from '../MyInformation/hooks/useIsQualInvestor';
import styles from './Qual.module.pcss';
import NotAllowedPlug from './components/NotAllowedPlug/NotAllowedPlug';
import { qualState } from './consts';

const QualRequest = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const qualPermission = Permissions.get(PERSON_QUALIFICATION);

  const isNotAllowed = qualPermission === 'DENIED' || qualPermission === 'BLOCKED';

  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const { handleNavigateToLK } = useMoveToLKAuthToken();

  const { isQual, isPossibleQual, isActualQualOrder } = useIsQualInvestor();

  const [
    changeQual,
    { data: changeQualData, isLoading: isQualChangeLoading, isError: isQualChangeError },
  ] = useQualChangeMutation();

  const [
    getQualStatus,
    { data: resultQualStatus, isLoading: isQualStatusLoading, isError: isQualStatusError },
  ] = useLazyQualChangeStatusQuery();

  const [
    getQualDocument,
    { data: resultQualDocuments, isLoading: isQualDocumentsLoading, isError: isQualDocumentsError },
  ] = useLazyQualChangeDocumentQuery();

  const requestGuid = changeQualData?.requestGuid;
  const qualStatus = resultQualStatus?.requestStatus[0].status;
  const crc = resultQualDocuments?.crc;
  const stateQualRequest = {
    crc: crc,
    requestGuid: requestGuid,
  };
  const isError = isQualChangeError || isQualDocumentsError || isQualStatusError;

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const qualMobileNavigate = () => {
    handleNavigateToLK(LK_ROUTE_QUAL_MOBILE)();
  };

  const handleActionButtonClick = () => {
    isPossibleQual ? handleChangeQual() : qualMobileNavigate();
  };

  const handleChangeQual = async () => {
    const res = await changeQual({}).unwrap();
    getQualStatus(res).unwrap();
  };

  const handleLink = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_QUAL_ONBOARDING);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let setTimeOutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (qualStatus === 'processing') {
      setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => {
        getQualStatus({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
        setRetryCount((prev) => prev + 1);
        setIsLoading(true);
      }, 3000);
    }
    if (qualStatus === 'signing_documents') {
      getQualDocument({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
    }
    if (retryCount >= 10) {
      navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
    }

    return () => clearTimeout(setTimeOutId);
  }, [getQualDocument, getQualStatus, navigate, qualStatus, requestGuid, retryCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resultQualDocuments) navigate(ROUTE_QUAL_CONFIRM, { state: stateQualRequest });
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isQualChangeLoading || isQualStatusLoading || isQualDocumentsLoading) {
      setIsLoading(true);
    }
    if (isError) {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [isError, isQualChangeLoading, isQualDocumentsLoading, isQualStatusLoading]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActualQualOrder) {
      navigate(ROUTE_QUAL_SUCCESS, { state: qualState });
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useErrorNotification(isError);

  if (isNotAllowed || isQual) return <NotAllowedPlug />;

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrap}>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        documentTitle={'Квалифицированный инвестор'}
      />
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.main : styles.mainAdaptive}>
        <div className={styles.imgWrap}>
          <QualRequestImg />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.description}>
          <Text type={'title'}>Квалифицированный инвестор</Text>
          <Text type={'bodyRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
            По результатам оценки состояния ваших счетов в «Открытие Инвестиции» вы соответствуете
            одному из критериев для получения статуса квалифицированного инвестора.
          </Text>
          <span className={styles.link} onClick={handleLink}>
            Подробнее о статусе
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.footer : styles.footerAdaptive}>
        <Button onClick={handleActionButtonClick} loading={isLoading}>
          Получить статус
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default QualRequest;

import React from 'react';

import { Accordion } from '@aurora/components';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as EditSvg } from 'images/icons/edit.svg';

import { Question } from 'types/quiz';

import styles from './Results.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  isInvestmentProfile: boolean;
  categoryTypeName: string;
  selfQuestionsLength: number;
  questions: Question[];
  selectedOptions: Record<number, Option<number> | Option<number>[]>;
  editAnswer: (questionIndex: number) => void;
};

const getAnswer = (selectedOption: Option<number> | Option<number>[]) => {
  if (Array.isArray(selectedOption)) {
    return (
      <React.Fragment>
        {selectedOption.map((option) => (
          <Text key={option.id} type="labelRegular" className={styles.answer}>
            - {option.title}
          </Text>
        ))}
      </React.Fragment>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.answer}>
      {selectedOption.title}
    </Text>
  );
};

const Results = ({
  isInvestmentProfile,
  categoryTypeName,
  selfQuestionsLength,
  questions: allQuestions,
  selectedOptions,
  editAnswer,
}: Props) => {
  const selfQuestions = allQuestions.slice(0, selfQuestionsLength);
  const questions = allQuestions.slice(selfQuestionsLength);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const getAnswers = (isSelf: boolean) => {
    return (isSelf ? selfQuestions : questions).map(({ questionId, value }, index) => (
      <React.Fragment key={questionId}>
        {index !== 0 && <div className={styles.separator} />}

        <div
          className={cx(
            styles.answerWrapper,
            index === 0 && !isInvestmentProfile && styles.firstAnswerWrapper,
          )}
        >
          <div className={styles.infoWrapper}>
            <Text type="lineMedium">{`${index + 1}. ${value}`}</Text>
            {getAnswer(selectedOptions[isSelf ? index : selfQuestionsLength + index])}
          </div>

          <div
            className={styles.iconWrapper}
            onClick={() => {
              editAnswer(isSelf ? index : selfQuestionsLength + index);
            }}
          >
            <EditSvg />
          </div>
        </div>
      </React.Fragment>
    ));
  };

  const getContent = () => {
    if (isInvestmentProfile) {
      return getAnswers(false);
    }

    return (
      <React.Fragment>
        {selfQuestions.length > 0 && (
          <Accordion title="Самооценка" isOpen>
            {getAnswers(true)}
          </Accordion>
        )}

        {questions.length > 0 && (
          <Accordion title={categoryTypeName} isOpen>
            {getAnswers(false)}
          </Accordion>
        )}
      </React.Fragment>
    );
  };

  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <Text type="bodyMedium" className={styles.check}>
        Проверьте ваши ответы перед завершением тестирования
      </Text>
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.answersWrapper : styles.answersWrapperDesktop}>
        {getContent()}
      </div>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
};

export { getAnswer, Results };

import React from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import Hint from '@vision/hint';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { Option, OptionsList } from 'components';

import styles from './Steps.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  disabled?: boolean;
  value: string | null;
  hint: string | null | undefined;
  type: string | null;
  hintAfter: string | null | undefined;
  imageUrl: string | null | undefined;
  selectedOption: Option<number> | Option<number>[];
  options: { id: number; title: string }[];
  onChangeOption: (option: Option<number>) => void;
};

const Steps = ({
  disabled = false,
  value,
  hint,
  type,
  hintAfter,
  imageUrl,
  selectedOption,
  options,
  onChangeOption,
}: Props) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const getOptionsList = () => {
    if (
      type === 'MultyCheckBox' &&
      (selectedOption === undefined || Array.isArray(selectedOption))
    ) {
      return (
        <OptionsList
          inputPosition="left"
          type="multi"
          options={options}
          selectedOptions={selectedOption}
          className={cx(isMobile ? styles.optionsWrapper : styles.optionsWrapperDesktop, {
            [styles.optionsWrapperDisabled]: disabled,
          })}
          onChange={onChangeOption}
        />
      );
    }

    if (type === 'CheckBox' && !Array.isArray(selectedOption)) {
      return (
        <OptionsList
          inputPosition="left"
          type="circle"
          options={options}
          selectedOption={selectedOption}
          className={cx(isMobile ? styles.optionsWrapper : styles.optionsWrapperDesktop, {
            [styles.optionsWrapperDisabled]: disabled,
          })}
          onChange={onChangeOption}
        />
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.questionWrapper : styles.questionWrapperDesktop}>
        <Text type="bodyMedium">{value}</Text>
        {hint && <Hint placement="bottomRight" content={hint} className={styles.hint} />}
      </div>

      {hintAfter && (
        <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.hintAfter}>
          {hintAfter}
        </Text>
      )}

      {imageUrl && <img alt="" src={imageUrl} className={styles.imageUrl} />}

      {getOptionsList()}
    </React.Fragment>
  );
};

export { Steps };


--- FILE: src\modules\Quiz\helpers.ts ---

import { Option } from 'components';

const getAnswerId = (selectedOption: Option<number> | Option<number>[] | null) => {
  if (!selectedOption) {
    return '';
  }

  if (Array.isArray(selectedOption)) {
    return selectedOption.reduce((acc, option, index) => {
      if (index === 0) {
        return option.id as unknown as string;
      }

      return `${acc};${option.id}`;
    }, '');
  }

  return selectedOption.id as unknown as string;
};

export { getAnswerId };

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useCalculateInvestmentProfileMutation } from 'core/api/investmentProfile';

import { useWaitStatus } from './useWaitStatus';

const WAITING_RESULT = 'waiting_result';
const WAITING_CONFIRM = 'waiting_confirm';

const useCalculateInvestmentProfile = (requestGuid: string | null | undefined) => {
  const [
    calculateInvestmentProfile,
    { isError: isCalculateInvestmentProfileError, isSuccess: isCalculateInvestmentProfileSuccess },
  ] = useCalculateInvestmentProfileMutation();
  const {
    resetAndStartWaiting: resetAndStartWaitingResultWaiting,
    isTimeoutError: isWaitingResultTimeoutError,
    isError: isWaitingResultError,
    isSuccess: isWaitingResultSuccess,
  } = useWaitStatus(WAITING_RESULT);
  const {
    resetAndStartWaiting: resetAndStartWaitingConfirmWaiting,
    isTimeoutError: isWaitingConfirmTimeoutError,
    isError: isWaitingConfirmError,
    isSuccess: isWaitingConfirmSuccess,
    quizData,
  } = useWaitStatus(WAITING_CONFIRM);

  const [isCalculateInvestmentProfileProccesing, setCalculateInvestmentProfileProccesing] =
    useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isCalculateInvestmentProfileProccesing && requestGuid) {
      calculateInvestmentProfile(requestGuid);
    }
  }, [isCalculateInvestmentProfileProccesing, requestGuid, calculateInvestmentProfile]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isCalculateInvestmentProfileSuccess && requestGuid) {
      resetAndStartWaitingResultWaiting({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [isCalculateInvestmentProfileSuccess, requestGuid, resetAndStartWaitingResultWaiting]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isWaitingResultSuccess && requestGuid) {
      resetAndStartWaitingConfirmWaiting({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [isWaitingResultSuccess, requestGuid, resetAndStartWaitingConfirmWaiting]);

  return {
    calculateInvestmentProfile: () => {
      setCalculateInvestmentProfileProccesing(true);
    },
    isProccesing: isCalculateInvestmentProfileProccesing,
    isTimeoutError: isWaitingResultTimeoutError || isWaitingConfirmTimeoutError,
    isError: isCalculateInvestmentProfileError || isWaitingResultError || isWaitingConfirmError,
    isSuccess: isWaitingConfirmSuccess,
    quizData,
  };
};

export { WAITING_CONFIRM, useCalculateInvestmentProfile };

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { useLazyGetQuestionsQuery, useStartQuizMutation } from 'core/api/quiz';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { useWaitStatus } from './useWaitStatus';

type Params = {
  hasNotFinishedQuiz: boolean;
  isInvestmentProfile: boolean;
  requestGuid: string | null | undefined;
};

const WAITING_ANSWERS = 'waiting_answers';
const PERSON_CATEGORIZATION_START = 'PERSON_CATEGORIZATION_START';
const INVESTMENT_PROFILE = 'investment_profile';
const CATEGORIZATION = 'categorization';

const useFetchQuiz = ({ hasNotFinishedQuiz, isInvestmentProfile, requestGuid }: Params) => {
  const { category: categoryCode } = useParams();
  const session = getSession();

  const [startQuiz, { isError: isStartQuizError, data: startQuizData }] = useStartQuizMutation();
  const {
    resetAndStartWaiting: resetAndStartWaitingAnswersWaiting,
    isTimeoutError: isWaitingAnswersTimeoutError,
    isError: isWaitingAnswersError,
    isSuccess: isWaitingAnswersSuccess,
  } = useWaitStatus(WAITING_ANSWERS);
  const [getQuestions, { status: questionStatus, isError: isQuestionsError, data: questionsData }] =
    useLazyGetQuestionsQuery();

  const [attemptsNumber, setAttemptsNumber] = useState(1);
  const [isOnlyOneRequestForWaiting, setOnlyOneRequestForWaiting] = useState(false);
  const [localRequestGuid, setLocalRequestGuid] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const localQuestionsData = questionStatus === 'fulfilled' ? questionsData : undefined;

  const hasTestingAccess = useMemo(() => {
    if (!session) {
      return null;
    }

    if (session.isQual) {
      return false;
    }

    return Permissions.granted(PERSON_CATEGORIZATION_START);
  }, [session]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasNotFinishedQuiz && (isInvestmentProfile || (categoryCode && hasTestingAccess))) {
      startQuiz(
        isInvestmentProfile
          ? { quizTypeCode: INVESTMENT_PROFILE }
          : { quizTypeCode: CATEGORIZATION, personCategoryTypeCode: categoryCode },
      );
    }
  }, [hasNotFinishedQuiz, isInvestmentProfile, categoryCode, hasTestingAccess, startQuiz]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasNotFinishedQuiz && !isStartQuizError && startQuizData) {
      const foundRequest = startQuizData.request.find((request) => request.requestGuid);

      if (foundRequest) {
        const { requestGuid: foundRequestGuid } = foundRequest;

        resetAndStartWaitingAnswersWaiting({
          requestGuid: foundRequestGuid,
          requestAttemptsLimit: isOnlyOneRequestForWaiting ? 1 : undefined,
        });
        setLocalRequestGuid(foundRequestGuid);
      }
    }
  }, [
    hasNotFinishedQuiz,
    attemptsNumber,
    isOnlyOneRequestForWaiting,
    isStartQuizError,
    startQuizData,
    resetAndStartWaitingAnswersWaiting,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasNotFinishedQuiz && requestGuid) {
      getQuestions(requestGuid);
    } else if (isWaitingAnswersSuccess && localRequestGuid) {
      getQuestions(localRequestGuid);
    }
  }, [hasNotFinishedQuiz, requestGuid, isWaitingAnswersSuccess, localRequestGuid, getQuestions]);

  const isSomeDataNotFetched =
    (!hasNotFinishedQuiz && (!startQuizData || !isWaitingAnswersSuccess)) || !localQuestionsData;
  const isRequestsHaveNoErrors =
    (isInvestmentProfile || hasTestingAccess !== false) &&
    (hasNotFinishedQuiz ||
      (!isStartQuizError && !isWaitingAnswersTimeoutError && !isWaitingAnswersError)) &&
    !isQuestionsError;

  return {
    isLoading: isSomeDataNotFetched && isRequestsHaveNoErrors,
    hasTestingAccess,
    isTimeoutError: isWaitingAnswersTimeoutError,
    isError: isStartQuizError || isWaitingAnswersError || isQuestionsError,
    questionsData: localQuestionsData,
    requestGuid: hasNotFinishedQuiz ? requestGuid : localRequestGuid,
    resetFetch: () => {
      setAttemptsNumber((prev) => prev + 1);
      setOnlyOneRequestForWaiting(true);
    },
  };
};

export { useFetchQuiz };
