import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useCommitQuizMutation, useLazyGetFilesQuery } from 'core/api/quiz';

import { useWaitStatus } from './useWaitStatus';

const SIGNING_DOCUMENTS = 'signing_documents';

const useFinishQuiz = (requestGuid: string | null | undefined) => {
  const [commitQuiz, { isError: isCommitQuizError, isSuccess: isCommitQuizSuccess }] =
    useCommitQuizMutation();
  const {
    resetAndStartWaiting: resetAndStartSigningDocumentsWaiting,
    isTimeoutError: isSigningDocumentsTimeoutError,
    isError: isSigningDocumentsError,
    isSuccess: isSigningDocumentsSuccess,
  } = useWaitStatus(SIGNING_DOCUMENTS);
  const [getFiles, { isError: isFilesError, data: filesData }] = useLazyGetFilesQuery();

  const [attemptsNumber, setAttemptsNumber] = useState(0);
  const [isOnlyOneRequestForWaiting, setOnlyOneRequestForWaiting] = useState(false);
  const [isQuizFinishProccesing, setQuizFinishProccesing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isQuizFinishProccesing && requestGuid) {
      commitQuiz(requestGuid);
    }
  }, [isQuizFinishProccesing, requestGuid, commitQuiz]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isCommitQuizSuccess && requestGuid) {
      resetAndStartSigningDocumentsWaiting({
        requestGuid,
        requestAttemptsLimit: isOnlyOneRequestForWaiting ? 1 : undefined,
      });
    }
  }, [
    attemptsNumber,
    isOnlyOneRequestForWaiting,
    isCommitQuizSuccess,
    requestGuid,
    resetAndStartSigningDocumentsWaiting,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSigningDocumentsSuccess && requestGuid) {
      getFiles(requestGuid);
    }
  }, [isSigningDocumentsSuccess, requestGuid, getFiles]);

  return {
    finishQuiz: () => {
      setAttemptsNumber((prev) => prev + 1);
      setQuizFinishProccesing(true);
    },
    isProccesing: isQuizFinishProccesing,
    isTimeoutError: isSigningDocumentsTimeoutError,
    isError: isCommitQuizError || isSigningDocumentsError || isFilesError,
    isSigningDocuments: !isFilesError && filesData,
    files: filesData,
    resetFinish: () => {
      setAttemptsNumber((prev) => prev + 1);
      setOnlyOneRequestForWaiting(true);
    },
  };
};

export { useFinishQuiz };

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Answer, QuestionsResponse } from 'types/quiz';

type Params = {
  isInvestmentProfile: boolean;
  questionsData: QuestionsResponse | undefined;
  questionIndex: number;
};

const QUESTIONS_INITIAL_DATA = {
  selfQuestionsLength: 0,
  questionsLength: 0,
  testBlock: { id: '', personCategoryTypeCode: '', personCategoryTypeName: '' },
};

const useMemoizedQuiz = ({ isInvestmentProfile, questionsData, questionIndex }: Params) => {
  const { category: categoryCode } = useParams();

  const { selfQuestionsLength, questionsLength, testBlock } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!questionsData) {
      return QUESTIONS_INITIAL_DATA;
    }

    const { test: testBlocks, question: allQuestions } = questionsData;

    if (isInvestmentProfile) {
      return { ...QUESTIONS_INITIAL_DATA, questionsLength: allQuestions.length };
    }

    if (!categoryCode) {
      return QUESTIONS_INITIAL_DATA;
    }

    const foundTestBlock = testBlocks.find(
      (testBlock) => testBlock.personCategoryTypeCode === categoryCode,
    );

    if (!foundTestBlock) {
      return QUESTIONS_INITIAL_DATA;
    }

    const { selfQuestionsLength, questionsLength } = allQuestions.reduce(
      (acc, question) => {
        return question.testId === foundTestBlock.id
          ? { ...acc, questionsLength: acc.questionsLength + 1 }
          : { ...acc, selfQuestionsLength: acc.selfQuestionsLength + 1 };
      },
      {
        selfQuestionsLength: 0,
        questionsLength: 0,
      },
    );

    return { selfQuestionsLength, questionsLength, testBlock: foundTestBlock };
  }, [questionsData, isInvestmentProfile, categoryCode]);

  const {
    allQuestions,
    currentQuestionId,
    currentQuestionValue,
    currentQuestionHint,
    currentQuestionType,
    currentQuestionHintAfter,
    currentQuestionImageUrl,
    currentQuestionOptions,
  } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!questionsData) {
      return {
        allQuestions: [],
        currentQuestionId: null,
        currentQuestionValue: null,
        currentQuestionHint: null,
        currentQuestionType: null,
        currentQuestionHintAfter: null,
        currentQuestionImageUrl: null,
        currentQuestionOptions: [],
      };
    }

    const { question: allQuestions, answer: allAnswers } = questionsData;

    const { questionId, value, hint, type, hintAfter, imageUrl } = allQuestions[questionIndex];

    const answers = allAnswers.reduce(
      (acc: Answer[], answer) => (answer.questionId === questionId ? [...acc, answer] : acc),
      [],
    );

    return {
      allQuestions,
      currentQuestionId: questionId,
      currentQuestionValue: value,
      currentQuestionHint: hint,
      currentQuestionType: type,
      currentQuestionHintAfter: hintAfter,
      currentQuestionImageUrl: imageUrl,
      currentQuestionOptions: answers.map((answer) => ({
        id: answer.answerId,
        title: answer.value,
      })),
    };
  }, [questionsData, questionIndex]);

  return {
    selfQuestionsLength,
    questionsLength,
    testBlock,
    allQuestions,
    currentQuestionId,
    currentQuestionValue,
    currentQuestionHint,
    currentQuestionType,
    currentQuestionHintAfter,
    currentQuestionImageUrl,
    currentQuestionOptions,
  };
};

export { useMemoizedQuiz };

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { QuestionsResponse } from 'types/quiz';

type Params = {
  hasNotFinishedQuiz: boolean;
  questionsData: QuestionsResponse | undefined;
  setActiveQuestionIndex: (previousActiveQuestionIndex: number) => void;
  setSelectedOptions: (
    previousSelectedOptions: Record<number, Option<number> | Option<number>[]>,
  ) => void;
};

const usePreviousInvestmentProfile = ({
  hasNotFinishedQuiz,
  questionsData,
  setActiveQuestionIndex,
  setSelectedOptions,
}: Params) => {
  const [isPreviousSetted, setPreviousSetted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasNotFinishedQuiz && questionsData) {
      const { question: questions, answer: answers } = questionsData;

      const { previousActiveQuestionIndex, previousSelectedOptions } = answers.reduce<{
        previousActiveQuestionIndex: number | null;
        previousSelectedOptions: Record<number, Option<number>> | null;
      }>(
        (acc, answer) => {
          const { questionId, answerId, value, selected } = answer;

          if (selected) {
            const foundQuestionIndex = questions.findIndex(
              (question) => question.questionId === questionId,
            );

            if (foundQuestionIndex === -1) {
              return acc;
            }

            const { previousSelectedOptions } = acc;
            const option = { id: answerId, title: value };

            return {
              ...acc,
              previousActiveQuestionIndex: foundQuestionIndex,
              previousSelectedOptions:
                previousSelectedOptions === null
                  ? { [foundQuestionIndex]: option }
                  : { ...previousSelectedOptions, [foundQuestionIndex]: option },
            };
          }

          return acc;
        },
        {
          previousActiveQuestionIndex: null,
          previousSelectedOptions: null,
        },
      );

      if (previousActiveQuestionIndex !== null) {
        setActiveQuestionIndex(previousActiveQuestionIndex);
      }

      if (previousSelectedOptions !== null) {
        setSelectedOptions(previousSelectedOptions);
      }

      setPreviousSetted(true);
    }
  }, [hasNotFinishedQuiz, questionsData, setActiveQuestionIndex, setSelectedOptions]);

  return { isPreviousSetted };
};

export { usePreviousInvestmentProfile };

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useVerifyQuizMutation } from 'core/api/quiz';

import { useWaitStatus } from './useWaitStatus';

const WAITING_CONFIRMATION = 'waiting_confirmation';

const useVerifyQuiz = (requestGuid: string | null | undefined) => {
  const [verifyQuiz, { isError: isVerifyQuizError, data: verifyData }] = useVerifyQuizMutation();
  const {
    resetAndStartWaiting: resetAndStartWaitingConfirmationWaiting,
    isError: isWaitingConfirmationError,
    isSuccess: isWaitingConfirmationSuccess,
  } = useWaitStatus(WAITING_CONFIRMATION);

  const [isQuizVerifyProccesing, setQuizVerifyProccesing] = useState(false);
  const [isResetedSmsConfirmation, setResetedSmsConfirmation] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isQuizVerifyProccesing && requestGuid) {
      verifyQuiz(requestGuid);
    }
  }, [isQuizVerifyProccesing, requestGuid, verifyQuiz]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (verifyData && requestGuid) {
      resetAndStartWaitingConfirmationWaiting({ requestGuid });
    }
  }, [verifyData, requestGuid, resetAndStartWaitingConfirmationWaiting]);

  return {
    verifyQuiz: () => {
      setQuizVerifyProccesing(true);
      setResetedSmsConfirmation(false);
    },
    isError: isVerifyQuizError || isWaitingConfirmationError,
    isSmsConfirmation: isWaitingConfirmationSuccess && !isResetedSmsConfirmation,
    verifyData,
    resetVerify: () => {
      setResetedSmsConfirmation(true);
    },
  };
};

export { useVerifyQuiz };

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { useLazyGetQuizQuery } from 'core/api/quiz';

const STATUS_REQUESTS_ATTEMPTS_LIMIT = 10;

const useWaitStatus = (expectedStatus: string) => {
  const [
    getQuiz,
    {
      fulfilledTimeStamp: quizFulfilledTimeStamp,
      status: quizStatus,
      isError: isQuizError,
      data: quizData,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetQuizQuery();

  const statusRequestsAttemptsRef = useRef(0);
  const [requestGuid, setRequestGuid] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isWaiting, setWaiting] = useState(false);
  const [attemptsNumber, setAttemptsNumber] = useState(0);
  const [statusRequestsAttemptsLimit, setStatusRequestsAttemptsLimit] = useState(
    STATUS_REQUESTS_ATTEMPTS_LIMIT,
  );
  const [localStatus, setLocalStatus] = useState('');
  const [isLocalError, setLocalError] = useState(false);
  const [isStatusError, setStatusError] = useState(false);
  const [isStatusSuccess, setStatusSuccess] = useState(false);

  const isStatusRequestDone = isStatusError || isStatusSuccess;

  const resetAndStartWaiting = useCallback(
    ({
      requestGuid,
      requestAttemptsLimit,
    }: {
      requestGuid?: string;
      requestAttemptsLimit?: number;
    }) => {
      statusRequestsAttemptsRef.current = 0;

      if (requestGuid) {
        setRequestGuid(requestGuid);
      }
      setWaiting(true);

      setAttemptsNumber((prev) => prev + 1);

      if (typeof requestAttemptsLimit === 'number') {
        setStatusRequestsAttemptsLimit(requestAttemptsLimit);
      }
      setLocalStatus('');
      setLocalError(false);
      setStatusError(false);
      setStatusSuccess(false);
    },
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalStatus(quizStatus);
  }, [quizStatus]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalError(isQuizError);
  }, [isQuizError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isWaiting && requestGuid) {
      getQuiz(requestGuid);
      statusRequestsAttemptsRef.current++;
    }
  }, [attemptsNumber, isWaiting, requestGuid, getQuiz]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;

    if (
      !isStatusRequestDone &&
      localStatus === 'fulfilled' &&
      !isLocalError &&
      quizData &&
      requestGuid
    ) {
      const foundRequestStatus = quizData.requestStatus.find(
        (requestStatus) => requestStatus.status === expectedStatus,
      );

      if (foundRequestStatus) {
        setStatusSuccess(true);
      } else if (statusRequestsAttemptsRef.current < statusRequestsAttemptsLimit) {
        timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
          getQuiz(requestGuid);
          statusRequestsAttemptsRef.current++;
        }, 3000);
      } else if (statusRequestsAttemptsRef.current === statusRequestsAttemptsLimit) {
        setStatusError(true);
      }
    }

    return () => {
      if (timeoutId) {
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      }
    };
  }, [
    quizFulfilledTimeStamp,
    statusRequestsAttemptsLimit,
    isStatusRequestDone,
    localStatus,
    isLocalError,
    quizData,
    requestGuid,
    expectedStatus,
    getQuiz,
  ]);

  return {
    resetAndStartWaiting,
    isWaiting,
    isTimeoutError: isStatusError,
    isError: isLocalError,
    isSuccess: isStatusSuccess,
    quizData,
  };
};

export { useWaitStatus };

import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import Badge from '@vision/badge';
import { ROUTE_CATEGORIES_LIST, ROUTE_CATEGORY_INFO } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ResultSuccess } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-success.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ResultWrong } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-wrong.svg';

import styles from './QuizResults.module.pcss';
import { GetData, GetDataReturn } from './types';

type Props = {
  isTechnicalError: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  isSuccess: boolean;
  resetResults: () => void;
};

const getData = ({ isTechnicalError, isError, isSuccess }: GetData): GetDataReturn => {
  if (isTechnicalError) {
    return {
      badgeVariant: 'error',
      badgeText: 'Возникла ошибка отображения результатов',
      info: 'Проверьте статус позже в разделе «Моя информация»',
      buttonText: 'Обновить результаты',
    };
  }

  if (isError) {
    return {
      badgeVariant: 'danger',
      badgeText: 'Тестирование не пройдено',
      info: 'Вы можете пройти его повторно',
      buttonText: 'Пройти еще раз',
    };
  }

  if (isSuccess) {
    return {
      badgeVariant: 'success',
      badgeText: 'Тестирование пройдено успешно',
      info: 'Вскоре вам будет открыт доступ к торговым инструментам выбранной категории.',
      buttonText: 'Хорошо',
    };
  }
};

const QuizResults = ({ isTechnicalError, isError, isSuccess, resetResults }: Props) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { category: categoryCode } = useParams();

  const data = getData({ isTechnicalError, isError, isSuccess });

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <HeaderPage
        size="small"
        leftIconVariant="close"
        onLeftIconClick={() => {
          navigate(ROUTE_CATEGORIES_LIST);
        }}
        indent
        documentTitle={'Ваши результаты'}
      />

      <div className={styles.iconWrapper}>{isSuccess ? <ResultSuccess /> : <ResultWrong />}</div>

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.infoWrapper : styles.infoWrapperDesktop}>
        {data && <Badge variant={data.badgeVariant}>{data.badgeText}</Badge>}

        <Text type="title" className={styles.results}>
          Ваши результаты
        </Text>
        <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.info}>
          {data?.info}
        </Text>

        <Button
          className={isMobile ? styles.button : styles.buttonDesktop}
          onClick={() => {
            if (isTechnicalError) {
              resetResults();
            } else if (isError) {
              navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_CATEGORY_INFO, { category: categoryCode }));
            } else if (isSuccess) {
              navigate(ROUTE_CATEGORIES_LIST);
            }
          }}
        >
          {data?.buttonText}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export { getData, QuizResults };

};

        size="small"
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={onClose}
        documentTitle={'Подтвердите результаты тестирования'}
      />

      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <Text type="title">Подтвердите результаты тестирования</Text>
        <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.sms}>
          Проверьте корректность ответов и подпишите файлы с помощью SMS
        </Text>

        <DocumentCell
          url={fileSelfRating?.url}
          name={`${files?.referenceDocuments[0]?.displayName}`}
          id={`ID: ${files?.referenceDocuments[0]?.crc}`}
        />
        <div className={styles.separator} />
        <DocumentCell
          url={fileCategory?.url}
          name={`${files?.referenceDocuments[1]?.displayName}`}
          id={`ID: ${files?.referenceDocuments[1]?.crc}`}
        />
        <div className={styles.separator} />
        <Checkbox
          checked={isChecked}
          label="Подтверждаю корректность данных в файлах с ответами"
          className={isMobile ? styles.check : styles.checkDesktop}
          onChange={() => {
            setChecked((prev) => !prev);
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.bottomWrapper : styles.bottomWrapperDesktop}>
        <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.operationComplete}>
          Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
        </Text>

        <Button
          disabled={!isChecked}
          className={isMobile ? styles.button : styles.buttonDesktop}
          onClick={() => {
            if (isChecked) {
              verifyQuiz();
            }
          }}
        >
          Подтвердить
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export { SigningDocuments };

--- FILE: src\modules\Quiz\Quiz.tsx ---

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Confirm, Progress, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import {
  ROUTE_CATEGORIES_LIST,
  ROUTE_INVESTMENT_PROFILE_INFO,
  ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION,
} from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useAnswerQuestionMutation } from 'core/api/quiz';

import AccessDenied from 'modules/AccessDenied';
import { InfoWithProfile } from 'modules/InvestmentProfileInfo/pages/InfoWithProfile';

import { Option, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import AdaptivePopup from 'components/AdaptivePopup';
import HeaderPage from 'components/HeaderPage';

import styles from './Quiz.module.pcss';
import { Results } from './components/Results';
import { Steps } from './components/Steps';
import { getAnswerId } from './helpers';
import {
  WAITING_CONFIRM,
  useCalculateInvestmentProfile,
} from './hooks/useCalculateInvestmentProfile';
import { useFetchQuiz } from './hooks/useFetchQuiz';
import { useFinishQuiz } from './hooks/useFinishQuiz';
import { useMemoizedQuiz } from './hooks/useMemoizedQuiz';
import { usePreviousInvestmentProfile } from './hooks/usePreviousInvestmentProfile';
import { useVerifyQuiz } from './hooks/useVerifyQuiz';
import { OK, useWaitResults } from './hooks/useWaitResults';
import { QuizResults } from './pages/QuizResults';
import { SendingFailure } from './pages/SendingFailure';
import { SigningDocuments } from './pages/SigningDocuments';
import { SomethingWentWrong } from './pages/SomethingWentWrong';
import { Waiting } from './pages/Waiting';

type Props = {
  isInvestmentProfile?: boolean;
  isPrevious?: boolean;
  requestGuid?: string | null;
};

const YOUR_INVESTMENT_PROFILE = 'Ваш инвестиционный профиль';

const Quiz = ({ isInvestmentProfile = false, isPrevious = false, requestGuid }: Props) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [
    answerQuestion,
    {
      fulfilledTimeStamp: answerQuestionFulfilledTimeStamp,
      isLoading: isAnswerQuestionLoading,
      isError: isAnswerQuestionError,
      isSuccess: isAnswerQuestionSuccess,
    },
  ] = useAnswerQuestionMutation();

  const [isConfirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeQuestionIndex, setActiveQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedOptions, setSelectedOptions] = useState<
    Record<number, Option<number> | Option<number>[]>
  >({});
  const [isLocalAnswerQuestionError, setLocalAnswerQuestionError] = useState(false);
  const [isQuizFinished, setQuizFinished] = useState(false);
  const [editedAnswerIndex, setEditedAnswerIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [selectedOptionEdit, setSelectedOptionEdit] = useState<
    Option<number> | Option<number>[] | null
  >(null);

  const hasNotFinishedQuiz = !!(isInvestmentProfile && isPrevious && requestGuid);

  const isEditingAnswer = editedAnswerIndex !== null;
  const actualQuestionIndex = isEditingAnswer ? editedAnswerIndex : activeQuestionIndex;

  const {
    isLoading,
    hasTestingAccess,
    isTimeoutError,
    isError,
    questionsData,
    requestGuid: localRequestGuid,
    resetFetch,
  } = useFetchQuiz({ hasNotFinishedQuiz, isInvestmentProfile, requestGuid });

  const { isPreviousSetted } = usePreviousInvestmentProfile({
    hasNotFinishedQuiz,
    questionsData,
    setActiveQuestionIndex,
    setSelectedOptions,
  });

  const {
    selfQuestionsLength,
    questionsLength,
    testBlock,
    allQuestions,
    currentQuestionId,
    currentQuestionValue,
    currentQuestionHint,
    currentQuestionType,
    currentQuestionHintAfter,
    currentQuestionImageUrl,
    currentQuestionOptions,
  } = useMemoizedQuiz({ isInvestmentProfile, questionsData, questionIndex: actualQuestionIndex });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAnswerQuestionSuccess) {
      if (isEditingAnswer) {
        setEditedAnswerIndex(null);
        setSelectedOptionEdit(null);

        if (selectedOptionEdit) {
          setSelectedOptions((prev) => ({ ...prev, [editedAnswerIndex]: selectedOptionEdit }));
        }
      } else if (activeQuestionIndex + 1 < allQuestions.length) {
        setActiveQuestionIndex((prev) => prev + 1);
      } else {
        setQuizFinished(true);
      }
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [answerQuestionFulfilledTimeStamp, isAnswerQuestionSuccess]);

  const {
    calculateInvestmentProfile,
    isProccesing: isCalculateInvestmentProfileProccesing,
    isTimeoutError: isCalculateInvestmentProfileTimeoutError,
    isError: isCalculateInvestmentProfileError,
    isSuccess: isCalculateInvestmentProfileSuccess,
    quizData: quizInvestmentProfileData,
  } = useCalculateInvestmentProfile(localRequestGuid);

  const {
    finishQuiz,
    isTimeoutError: isFinishQuizTimeoutError,
    isError: isFinishQuizError,
    isProccesing: isQuizFinishProccesing,
    isSigningDocuments,
    files,
    resetFinish,
  } = useFinishQuiz(localRequestGuid);

  const {
    verifyQuiz,
    isError: isVerifyQuizError,
    isSmsConfirmation,
    verifyData,
    resetVerify,
  } = useVerifyQuiz(localRequestGuid);

  const {
    waitResults,
    isWaiting: isWaitingResults,
    isTimeoutError: isResultsTimeoutError,
    isError: isResultsError,
    isSuccess: isResultsSuccess,
    quizData: quizResultsData,
    resetResults,
  } = useWaitResults(localRequestGuid);

  const isCalculateInvestmentProfileDone =
    isCalculateInvestmentProfileTimeoutError ||
    isCalculateInvestmentProfileError ||
    isCalculateInvestmentProfileSuccess;
  const isResultsDone = isResultsTimeoutError || isResultsError || isResultsSuccess;

  const isWaitingForCalculateInvestmentProfileSection =
    isCalculateInvestmentProfileProccesing && !isCalculateInvestmentProfileDone;
  const isCalculateInvestmentProfileSection =
    isCalculateInvestmentProfileDone && !isQuizFinishProccesing;

  const isWaitingForSigningDocumentsSection = isQuizFinishProccesing && !isSigningDocuments;
  const isSigningDocumentsSection = !!(isSigningDocuments && !isSmsConfirmation);
  const isSmsConfirmationSection = isSmsConfirmation && !isWaitingResults;
  const isWaitingForResultsSection = isWaitingResults && !isResultsDone;
  const isResultsSection = isResultsDone;

  const isMainQuizSection =
    !isWaitingForCalculateInvestmentProfileSection &&
    !isCalculateInvestmentProfileSection &&
    !isWaitingForSigningDocumentsSection &&
    !isSigningDocumentsSection &&
    !isSmsConfirmationSection &&
    !isWaitingForResultsSection &&
    !isResultsSection;

  const isSelfBlock = actualQuestionIndex < selfQuestionsLength;
  const currentBlockActiveQuestionIndex = isSelfBlock
    ? actualQuestionIndex
    : actualQuestionIndex - selfQuestionsLength;
  const currentBlockQuestionsLength = isSelfBlock ? selfQuestionsLength : questionsLength;
  const isCurrentMultiSelect = currentQuestionType === 'MultyCheckBox';
  const selectedOption = selectedOptions[actualQuestionIndex];
  const isNextDisabled =
    !selectedOption ||
    (isCurrentMultiSelect && Array.isArray(selectedOption) && selectedOption.length === 0) ||
    (isEditingAnswer && Array.isArray(selectedOptionEdit) && selectedOptionEdit.length === 0) ||
    isAnswerQuestionLoading;

  const redirectToInvestmentProfileInfo = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_INVESTMENT_PROFILE_INFO);
  };

  const redirectOnErrorOrExit = () => {
    if (isInvestmentProfile) {
      redirectToInvestmentProfileInfo();
    } else {
      navigate(ROUTE_CATEGORIES_LIST);
    }
  };

  const confirm = (
    <Confirm
      open={isConfirmOpen}
      title="Уверены, что хотите прервать тестирование?"
      description="Ваши ответы не сохранятся"
      confirmBtnText="Выйти"
      onCancel={() => {
        setConfirmOpen(false);
      }}
      onConfirm={redirectOnErrorOrExit}
    />
  );

  const handleAnswerQuestion = () => {
    const doAnswerQuestion = () => {
      if (isNextDisabled) {
        return;
      }

      if (!localRequestGuid || !currentQuestionId) {
        return;
      }

      if (!isQuizFinished || isEditingAnswer) {
        answerQuestion({
          requestGuid: localRequestGuid,
          questionId: isEditingAnswer
            ? allQuestions[editedAnswerIndex].questionId
            : currentQuestionId,
          answerId: getAnswerId(isEditingAnswer ? selectedOptionEdit : selectedOption),
        });
      }
    };

    doAnswerQuestion();
  };

  if (isMainQuizSection && (isLoading || (hasNotFinishedQuiz && !isPreviousSetted))) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loader}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isMainQuizSection && !isInvestmentProfile && !hasTestingAccess) {
    return <AccessDenied />;
  }

  if (isMainQuizSection && (isTimeoutError || isError)) {
    return <SomethingWentWrong onClose={redirectOnErrorOrExit} onAction={resetFetch} />;
  }
  if (isMainQuizSection && isAnswerQuestionLoading && isLocalAnswerQuestionError) {
    return <Waiting />;
  }

  if (isMainQuizSection && isAnswerQuestionError) {
    return (
      <SendingFailure
        onClose={redirectOnErrorOrExit}
        onAction={() => {
          setLocalAnswerQuestionError(true);
          handleAnswerQuestion();
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  if (isWaitingForSigningDocumentsSection && (isFinishQuizTimeoutError || isFinishQuizError)) {
    return <SendingFailure onClose={redirectOnErrorOrExit} onAction={resetFinish} />;
  }

  if (isSigningDocumentsSection && isVerifyQuizError) {
    return <SendingFailure onClose={redirectOnErrorOrExit} onAction={redirectOnErrorOrExit} />;
  }

  if (isWaitingForCalculateInvestmentProfileSection) {
    return (
      <Waiting
        title={YOUR_INVESTMENT_PROFILE}
        content={
          <React.Fragment>
            <Text type="title" className={styles.thanks}>
              Спасибо!
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.info}>
              Анализируем ваши ответы
            </Text>
          </React.Fragment>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  if (isCalculateInvestmentProfileSection && quizInvestmentProfileData) {
    const foundRequestStatus = quizInvestmentProfileData.requestStatus.find(
      (requestStatus) => requestStatus.status === WAITING_CONFIRM,
    );

    return (
      <React.Fragment>
        <InfoWithProfile
          headerLeftIconVariant="close"
          code={foundRequestStatus?.investmentProfileCode}
          title={foundRequestStatus?.investmentProfileName}
          info={foundRequestStatus?.investmentProfileDescription}
          buttons={
            <React.Fragment>
              <Button onClick={finishQuiz}>Подтвердить</Button>
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={redirectToInvestmentProfileInfo}>
                Пройти повторно
              </Button>
            </React.Fragment>
          }
          onClose={() => {
            setConfirmOpen(true);
          }}
        />

        {confirm}
      </React.Fragment>
    );
  }

  if (isWaitingForSigningDocumentsSection) {
    return (
      <Waiting
        title={isInvestmentProfile ? YOUR_INVESTMENT_PROFILE : testBlock.personCategoryTypeName}
        content={
          isInvestmentProfile ? (
            <React.Fragment>
              <Text type="title" className={styles.thanks}>
                Спасибо!
              </Text>
              <Text type="bodyRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.info}>
                Результаты будут отображены в PDF-файлах, которые необходимо подписать
              </Text>
            </React.Fragment>
          ) : null
        }
      />
    );
  }

  if (isSigningDocumentsSection && files && localRequestGuid) {
    return (
      <React.Fragment>
        <SigningDocuments
          files={files}
          requestGuid={localRequestGuid}
          verifyQuiz={verifyQuiz}
          onClose={() => {
            setConfirmOpen(true);
          }}
        />

        {confirm}
      </React.Fragment>
    );
  }

  if (isSmsConfirmationSection && verifyData) {
    return (
      <>
        {isMobile ? (
          <SmsConfirmation
            initialOTPChallenge={verifyData.otpChallenge}
            smsInputCount={4}
            onError={() => {
              console.error('SMS CONFIRMATION ERROR');
            }}
            onSuccess={waitResults}
            onBackClick={resetVerify}
          />
        ) : (
          <AdaptivePopup open onDismiss={resetVerify} className={styles.popup}>
            {!isMobile && (
              <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.popupTitle}>
                SMS-подтверждение
              </Text>
            )}

            <SmsConfirmation
              initialOTPChallenge={verifyData.otpChallenge}
              smsInputCount={4}
              onError={() => {
                console.error('SMS CONFIRMATION ERROR');
              }}
              onSuccess={waitResults}
              onBackClick={resetVerify}
            />
          </AdaptivePopup>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  if (isWaitingForResultsSection) {
    return (
      <Waiting
        title={isInvestmentProfile ? YOUR_INVESTMENT_PROFILE : testBlock.personCategoryTypeName}
        content={
          isInvestmentProfile ? null : (
            <React.Fragment>
              <Text type="title" className={styles.thanks}>
                Спасибо за ответы
              </Text>
              <Text type="bodyRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.info}>
                Нам нужно немного времени на анализ и подготовку результатов
              </Text>
            </React.Fragment>
          )
        }
      />
    );
  }

  if (isResultsSection && isInvestmentProfile && quizResultsData) {
    const foundRequestStatus = quizResultsData.requestStatus.find(
      (requestStatus) => requestStatus.status === OK,
    );

    if (!foundRequestStatus) {
      return (
        <SendingFailure
          onClose={redirectToInvestmentProfileInfo}
          onAction={redirectToInvestmentProfileInfo}
        />
      );
    }

    return (
      <InfoWithProfile
        headerLeftIconVariant="close"
        isVerifiedProfile
        code={foundRequestStatus.investmentProfileCode}
        title={foundRequestStatus.investmentProfileName}
        info={foundRequestStatus.investmentProfileDescription}
        buttons={
          <Button
            onClick={() => {
              navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
            }}
          >
            Хорошо
          </Button>
        }
        onClose={redirectToInvestmentProfileInfo}
      />
    );
  }

  if (isResultsSection && !isInvestmentProfile && quizResultsData) {
    const foundTestStatus = quizResultsData.testStatus.find(
      (testStatus) => testStatus.personCategoryTypeCode === testBlock.personCategoryTypeCode,
    );

    return (
      <QuizResults
        isTechnicalError={isResultsTimeoutError || isResultsError}
        isError={!foundTestStatus?.passedStatus}
        isSuccess={!!foundTestStatus?.passedStatus}
        resetResults={resetResults}
      />
    );
  }

  const getMainSectionTitle = () => {
    if (isInvestmentProfile) {
      return YOUR_INVESTMENT_PROFILE;
    }

    if (isSelfBlock) {
      return 'Самооценка';
    }

    return testBlock.personCategoryTypeName;
  };

  const handleChangeOption = (option: Option<number>) => {
    if (isEditingAnswer) {
      setSelectedOptionEdit((prev) => {
        if (isCurrentMultiSelect && Array.isArray(prev)) {
          const hasOption = prev.some((prevOption) => prevOption.id === option.id);

          return [
            ...prev.filter((prevOption) => prevOption.id !== option.id),
            ...(hasOption ? [] : [option]),
          ];
        }

        return option;
      });
    } else {
      setSelectedOptions((prev) => {
        const prevValue = prev[actualQuestionIndex];

        if (isCurrentMultiSelect) {
          if (!Array.isArray(prevValue)) {
            return { ...prev, [actualQuestionIndex]: [option] };
          }

          const hasOption = prevValue.some((prevOption) => prevOption.id === option.id);

          return {
            ...prev,
            [actualQuestionIndex]: [
              ...prevValue.filter((prevOption) => prevOption.id !== option.id),
              ...(hasOption ? [] : [option]),
            ],
          };
        }
        return { ...prev, [actualQuestionIndex]: option };
      });
    }
  };

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    if (isEditingAnswer) {
      setEditedAnswerIndex(null);
      setSelectedOptionEdit(null);
    } else if (isInvestmentProfile) {
      redirectToInvestmentProfileInfo();
    } else {
      setConfirmOpen(true);
    }
  };

  const progressStep =
    isQuizFinished || isEditingAnswer
      ? undefined
      : `${currentBlockActiveQuestionIndex + 1} из ${currentBlockQuestionsLength}`;

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.container : styles.containerDesktop}>
      <HeaderPage
        size="small"
        leftIconVariant={isEditingAnswer ? 'back' : 'close'}
        title={getMainSectionTitle()}
        subtitle={progressStep}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
      />
      {!isMobile && (
        <div className={styles.titleWrap}>
          <Text type={'title'}>{getMainSectionTitle()}</Text>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
            {progressStep}
          </Text>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className={cx({ [styles.wrapper]: isMobile })}>
        <Progress
          progress={
            (currentBlockActiveQuestionIndex * 100) / currentBlockQuestionsLength +
            100 / currentBlockQuestionsLength
          }
          shape="line"
          variant="navbar"
          className={styles.progressBar}
        />

        {isQuizFinished && !isEditingAnswer ? (
          <Results
            isInvestmentProfile={isInvestmentProfile}
            categoryTypeName={testBlock.personCategoryTypeName}
            selfQuestionsLength={selfQuestionsLength}
            questions={allQuestions}
            selectedOptions={selectedOptions}
            editAnswer={(questionIndex) => {
              setEditedAnswerIndex(questionIndex);
              setSelectedOptionEdit(selectedOptions[questionIndex]);
            }}
          />
        ) : (
          <Steps
            disabled={isAnswerQuestionLoading}
            value={currentQuestionValue}
            hint={currentQuestionHint}
            type={currentQuestionType}
            hintAfter={currentQuestionHintAfter}
            imageUrl={currentQuestionImageUrl}
            selectedOption={
              isEditingAnswer ? (selectedOptionEdit as Option<number>) : selectedOption
            }
            options={currentQuestionOptions}
            onChangeOption={handleChangeOption}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.buttonsWrapper : styles.buttonsWrapperDesktop}>
        <Button
          disabled={activeQuestionIndex === 0}
          variant="secondary"
          className={
            isMobile ? (isEditingAnswer ? styles.redTextButton : undefined) : styles.buttonDesktop
          }
          onClick={() => {
            if (isEditingAnswer) {
              setEditedAnswerIndex(null);
              setSelectedOptionEdit(null);
            } else if (isQuizFinished) {
              setQuizFinished(false);
            } else if (activeQuestionIndex !== 0) {
              setActiveQuestionIndex((prev) => prev - 1);
            }
          }}
        >
          Назад
        </Button>
        <Button
          disabled={isNextDisabled}
          variant="primary"
          className={cx({ [styles.buttonDesktop]: !isMobile })}
          onClick={() => {
            if (isEditingAnswer || !isQuizFinished) {
              setLocalAnswerQuestionError(false);
              handleAnswerQuestion();
            } else if (isInvestmentProfile) {
              calculateInvestmentProfile();
            } else if (!isInvestmentProfile) {
              finishQuiz();
            }
          }}
        >
          {isQuizFinished ? 'Готово' : 'Далее'}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {confirm}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Quiz;


--- FILE: src\modules\Quiz\__tests__\helpers.test.ts ---

import React from 'react';

import { render } from '@testing-library/react';

import { getAnswer } from 'modules/Quiz/components/Results';
import { getAnswerId } from 'modules/Quiz/helpers';
import { getData } from 'modules/Quiz/pages/QuizResults';
import { GetData, GetDataReturn } from 'modules/Quiz/pages/types';

import { Option } from 'components';

describe('test getAnswer helper', () => {
  test('object arg', () => {
    const MOCK_TITLE = 'test title 1';
    const MOCK_OBJECT_DATA: Option<number> = { id: 1, title: MOCK_TITLE };

    const renderedElement = getAnswer(MOCK_OBJECT_DATA);

    expect(React.isValidElement(renderedElement)).toBe(true);

    const { getByText } = render(renderedElement);

    const foundElement = getByText(MOCK_TITLE);

    expect(foundElement).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  test('array arg', () => {
    const MOCK_TITLES = ['test title 2', 'test title 3', 'test title 4'];
    const MOCK_ARRAY_DATA: Option<number>[] = [
      { id: 2, title: MOCK_TITLES[0] },
      { id: 3, title: MOCK_TITLES[1] },
      { id: 4, title: MOCK_TITLES[2] },
    ];

    const renderedElement = getAnswer(MOCK_ARRAY_DATA);

    expect(React.isValidElement(renderedElement)).toBe(true);

    const { getByText } = render(renderedElement);

    MOCK_TITLES.forEach((title) => {
      const foundElement = getByText(`- ${title}`);
      expect(foundElement).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });
});

describe('test getData helper', () => {
  test('wrong arg', () => {
    const MOCK_WRONG_ARG_DATA = { isTechnicalError: false, isError: false, isSuccess: false };
    expect(getData(MOCK_WRONG_ARG_DATA)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  const MOCK_CORRECT_ARG_DATA: [GetData, GetDataReturn][] = [
    [
      { isTechnicalError: true, isError: false, isSuccess: false },

        badgeVariant: 'error',

        badgeVariant: 'danger',
        badgeText: 'Тестирование не пройдено',
        info: 'Вы можете пройти его повторно',
        buttonText: 'Пройти еще раз',

        buttonText: 'Хорошо',
      },

  test.each(MOCK_CORRECT_ARG_DATA)('correct arg', (arg, result) => {

describe('test getAnswerId helper', () => {

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_LOGIN, ROUTE_RECOVERY } from 'const/routes';
import md5 from 'crypto-js/md5';

import { authApi2, useGetPasswordPoliciesQuery } from 'core/api/auth';

import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';
import useNewPasswordInput from 'hooks/useNewPasswordInput';

import { HeaderPage, InputNewPassword, InputPassword, Progress } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import styles from './FormNewPassword.module.pcss';

const FormNewPassword: React.FC = () => {
  const [setFetchPassword, { isLoading, error, isSuccess }] = authApi2.useSetNewPasswordMutation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { password, confirmPassword, minReq, confirmPasswordOnChange, newPasswordOnChange } =
    useNewPasswordInput();
  const { data: dataPasswordPolicy } = useGetPasswordPoliciesQuery();
  const passwordPolicy = dataPasswordPolicy?.passwordPolicy?.[0];

  useErrorNotification(error);

  useEffect(() => {
    isSuccess &&
      createAlertNotification({
        status: 'info',
        text: 'Пароль изменен',
      });
  }, [isSuccess]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isSuccess && navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN);
  }, [isSuccess, navigate]);

  const disable = !(minReq && password.value && password.value === confirmPassword.value);

  const handleSubmit = (ev?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    ev?.preventDefault();
    const passwordHash = md5(password.value).toString().toUpperCase();
    setFetchPassword({ passwordHash });
  };

  if (isLoading)
    return (
      <div className={styles.centered}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      </div>
    );
  if (error) navigate(ROUTE_RECOVERY);

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        title={'Новый пароль'}
        onLeftIconClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_RECOVERY)}
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
      />
      <form className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.inputs}>
          <InputNewPassword
            value={password.value}
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            label={'Пароль *'}
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            onChange={newPasswordOnChange}
            status={password?.status}
            passwordPolicy={passwordPolicy}
          />
          <InputPassword
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            value={confirmPassword.value}
            onChange={confirmPasswordOnChange}
            label={'Повторите пароль *'}
            description={confirmPassword?.description}
            status={confirmPassword?.status}
            addonUnder={
              <Progress
                status={confirmPassword?.progressStatus}
                percentage={confirmPassword.percent}
              />
            }
          />
          {passwordPolicy?.hint && (
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              {passwordPolicy.hint}
            </Text>
          )}
        </div>
        <div>
          <Button disabled={disable} onClick={handleSubmit}>
            <div>Продолжить</div>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </>
  );
};

export default FormNewPassword;

import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { PATTERN_CYRILLIC, PATTERN_EMAIL } from 'const/regex';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

export const validateNames = (name: string) => {
  const match = PATTERN_CYRILLIC.test(name);
  return { match, message: 'Содержит только русские буквы' };
};

export const validateEmail = (email: string) => {
  const match = PATTERN_EMAIL.test(email);
  return { match, message: 'Неверный формат' };
};

export const validateDate = (userDate: string) => {
  const match = userDate === DateTime.fromISO(userDate).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);
  if (match) {
    const sufficientAge = DateTime.now().year - DateTime.fromISO(userDate).year >= 18;
    return { match: sufficientAge, message: 'Возраст не может быть меньше 18 лет' };
  }
  return { match, message: 'Неверный формат даты' };
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import { InputStatus } from '@vision/input/types';

export interface IValidator {
  match: boolean;
  message: string;
}

export interface useInputReturn {
  value: string;
  onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  onBlur: (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
  description: string;
  status?: InputStatus | null;
}

export interface useInputProps {
  (initialValue: string, required?: true, validator?: (str: string) => IValidator): useInputReturn;
}

const useInputRecovery: useInputProps = (initialValue = '', required?: true, validator?) => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initialValue);
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<InputStatus | null>();

  const onChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const { value } = e.target;
    setValue(value);
    if (validator) {
      const { match, message } = validator(value);
      if (value && match) {
        setDescription('');
        setStatus(null);
      } else {
        setDescription(message);
        setStatus('error');
      }
    } else {
      setDescription('');
      setStatus(null);
    }
  };
  const onBlur = (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (!value && required) {
      setDescription('Обязательное поле');
      setStatus('error');
    }
  };
  return {
    value,
    onChange,
    onBlur,
    description,
    status,
  };
};

export default useInputRecovery;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import { Button, CircleLoader, DatePicker, Input, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_SEND_MAIL_SUCCESS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { authApi2, useGetCaptchaConfigQuery } from 'core/api/auth';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';

import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';

import { visualDateFormatter } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/components/Passport/helper';
import {
  validateEmail,
  validateNames,
} from 'modules/RecoveryAuth/components/LoginRecovery/helpers';

import { Captcha } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as Calendar } from 'images/icons/calendarI.svg';

import styles from './LoginRecovery.module.pcss';
import useInputRecovery from './hooks';

const LoginRecovery: React.FC = () => {
  const [openBS, setOpenBS] = useState(false);
  const { data: needCaptcha } = useGetCaptchaConfigQuery();
  const [birthDate, setBirthDate] = useState('');
  const [isBirthDateError, setIsBirthDateError] = useState(false);
  const [recoveryLogin, { isLoading, error, isSuccess }] = authApi2.useRecoverLoginMutation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  useErrorNotification(error);

  useEffect(() => {
    isSuccess && navigate(ROUTE_SEND_MAIL_SUCCESS, { state: 'логина' });
  }, [isSuccess, navigate]);

  const firstName = useInputRecovery('', true, validateNames);
  const lastName = useInputRecovery('', true, validateNames);
  const middleName = useInputRecovery('', true, validateNames);
  //const birthDate = useInputRecovery('', true, validateDate);
  const email = useInputRecovery('', true, validateEmail);
  const captcha = useInputRecovery('', true);

  const btnNextDisable =
    !(firstName.value && lastName.value && middleName.value && birthDate && email.value) ||
    (needCaptcha?.recoverLoginCaptchaImmediate && captcha.value.length < 4) ||
    isBirthDateError ||
    !!(firstName.status || lastName.status || middleName.status || email.status || captcha.status);

  const onDateSubmit = (e: Date[]) => {
    const currentDate = e[0];
    if (!currentDate) return;

    const day = String(currentDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const month = String(currentDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const year = currentDate.getFullYear();

    const formattedDate = `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
    setBirthDate(formattedDate);
    setOpenBS(false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = (event?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event && event.preventDefault();
    recoveryLogin({
      FirstName: firstName.value,
      LastName: lastName.value,
      MiddleName: middleName.value,
      BirthDate: birthDate,
      Email: email.value,
      Captcha: captcha.value || '',
    });
  };

  const birthDateController = () => setIsBirthDateError(birthDate.length === 0);

  if (isLoading)
    return (
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.load : styles.loadDesktop}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <>
      <form className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.inputs}>
          <Input
            label={'Фамилия'}
            {...lastName}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            className={isMobile ? styles.input : styles.inputDesktop}
          />
          <Input
            label={'Имя'}
            {...firstName}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            className={isMobile ? styles.input : styles.inputDesktop}
          />
          <Input
            label={'Отчество'}
            {...middleName}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            className={isMobile ? styles.input : styles.inputDesktop}
          />
          <div onClick={() => setOpenBS(true)}>
            <Input
              onChange={(e) => null}
              placeholder=""
              label="Дата рождения"
              value={visualDateFormatter(birthDate)}
              className={styles.input}
              status={isBirthDateError ? 'error' : undefined}
              description={isBirthDateError && 'Введите корректную дату'}
              onBlur={birthDateController}
              onFocus={birthDateController}
              addonAfter={<Calendar />}
            />
          </div>
          <Input
            label={'Адрес электронной почты'}
            {...email}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            className={isMobile ? styles.input : styles.inputDesktop}
          />
          {(needCaptcha?.recoverLoginCaptchaImmediate || error) && (
            <div className={cn({ [styles.captcha]: !isMobile })}>
              <Captcha {...captcha} />{' '}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={cn({ [styles.divider]: !isMobile })}>
          <Button
            disabled={btnNextDisable}
            onClick={handleSubmit}
            className={cn({ [styles.buttonWrapDesktop]: !isMobile })}
          >
            Продолжить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>

      <BottomSheetComponent
        open={openBS}
        onDismiss={() => setOpenBS(false)}
        onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <Text type="subtitleBold" color="colorForeground">
            Выберите дату рождения
          </Text>
        </div>

        <DatePicker withPeriod={false} withOptions={false} onSubmit={onDateSubmit} />
      </BottomSheetComponent>
    </>
  );
};

export default LoginRecovery;

import React, { useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Input, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_SEND_MAIL_SUCCESS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { authApi2, useGetCaptchaConfigQuery } from 'core/api/auth';

import { useErrorNotification } from 'hooks/useErrorNotification';
import useInput from 'hooks/useInput';

import { RecoveryContext } from 'modules/RecoveryAuth/RecoveryAuth';

import { Captcha, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import AdaptivePopup from 'components/AdaptivePopup';

import FormNewPassword from '../FormNewPassword/FormNewPassword';
import styles from './PasswordRecovery.module.pcss';

const SMS_LENGTH = 4;

const PasswordRecovery: React.FC = () => {
  const { data: needCaptcha, refetch } = useGetCaptchaConfigQuery();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [resetPassword, { isLoading, data, isSuccess, error }] =
    authApi2.useResetPasswordMutation();
  useEffect(() => {
    error && refetch();
  }, [error, refetch]);
  const login = useInput('');
  const captcha = useInput('');
  const disable = !(login.value && captcha.value.length === SMS_LENGTH);
  useErrorNotification(error);

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const initialOTPChallenge = data?.otpChallenge;

  const handleResetPassword = (event?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event && event.preventDefault();
    resetPassword({ Login: login.value, Captcha: captcha.value });
    !isOpen && setIsOpen(true);
  };
  const handleConfirm = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_SEND_MAIL_SUCCESS, { state: 'пароля' });
  };
  const setConfirmData = useContext(RecoveryContext);
  useEffect(() => {
    isSuccess &&
      setConfirmData &&
      setConfirmData({
        initialOTPChallenge: data?.otpChallenge,
        onSuccess: handleConfirm,
        smsInputCount: SMS_LENGTH,
      });
  }, [isSuccess]); //eslint-disable-line

  if (isLoading && isMobile)
    return (
      <div className={styles.load}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      </div>
    );

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <form className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.inputs}>
          <Input {...login} autoFocus={true} label={'Логин'} className={styles.inputDesktop} />
          {(needCaptcha?.resetPasswordCaptchaImmediate || error) && <Captcha {...captcha} />}
        </div>
        <div>
          <Text
            type={'lineRegular'}
            color={'colorForeground2'}
            className={isMobile ? styles.text : styles.textDesktop}
          >
            Для продолжения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
          </Text>
          <Button
            disabled={disable}
            onClick={handleResetPassword}
            className={cn({ [styles.buttonWrapDesktop]: !isMobile })}
          >
            Продолжить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
      {!isMobile && !error && (
        <AdaptivePopup
          open={isOpen}
          onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          classNameContent={styles.contentDesktop}
        >
          {isLoading ? (
            <CircleLoader brandColor />
          ) : (
            <SmsConfirmation
              initialOTPChallenge={initialOTPChallenge}
              onError={() => console.error('onError')}
              onSuccess={handleConfirm}
              smsInputCount={SMS_LENGTH}
            />
          )}
        </AdaptivePopup>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default PasswordRecovery;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

const SMS_LENGTH = 4;

const RestoreHashCheckLogin: React.FC = () => {
  const { search } = useLocation();
  const hash = search && search.replace('?reset_id=', '');
  const [checkId, { data, isSuccess, isLoading, error }] = authApi2.useCheckIdResetLoginMutation();
  const [smsCheck, setSmsCheck] = useState<boolean>(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    checkId(hash);
  }, [checkId, hash]);
  useErrorNotification(error);

  if (isLoading)
    return (
      <div className={styles.root}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );
  if (smsCheck) return <FormNewPassword />;

  return (
    <div className={styles.root}>
      {isSuccess ? (
        <SmsConfirmation
          initialOTPChallenge={data?.otpChallenge}
          onError={() => console.log('onError')}
          onSuccess={() => setSmsCheck(true)}
          smsInputCount={SMS_LENGTH}
        />
      ) : (
        <WrongUrl />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { createContext, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import {
  PATH_RECOVERY_LOGIN,
  PATH_RECOVERY_PASSWORD,
  ROUTE_LOGIN,
  ROUTE_SEND_MAIL_SUCCESS,
} from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation, SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';

import styles from './RecoveryAuth.module.pcss';
import { IConfirmData, IContextDefault } from './types';

export const RecoveryContext = createContext<IContextDefault | null>(null);

export const pageTabs = [
  { name: 'Пароль', link: PATH_RECOVERY_PASSWORD },
  { name: 'Логин', link: PATH_RECOVERY_LOGIN },
];

const RecoveryAuth: React.FC = ({ children }) => {
  const [confirmData, setConfirmData] = useState<IConfirmData | null>(null);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isSendMailSuccess = location.pathname === ROUTE_SEND_MAIL_SUCCESS;

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN);
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.rootContainer}>
      {!confirmData?.initialOTPChallenge || !isMobile ? (
        <>
          {isMobile && (
            <HeaderPage
              title={'Восстановить'}
              onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
              leftIconVariant={'back'}
            />
          )}

          <div className={isMobile ? styles.container : styles.containerDesktop}>
            <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrapper : styles.wrapperDesktop}>
              {!isMobile && (
                <div className={styles.headerButtonWrapper}>
                  <Button
                    iconLeft={<BackSvg />}
                    onClick={handleBackClick}
                    variant="white"
                    className={styles.header}
                  >
                    <Text type="labelMedium">Назад</Text>
                  </Button>
                  {!isSendMailSuccess && (
                    <Text direction="center" type="headline">
                      Восстановить
                    </Text>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
              <RecoveryContext.Provider value={setConfirmData}>
                <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
                  tabs={pageTabs}
                  classNameContent={cx(styles.contentWrapper, {
                    [styles.contentWrapperDesktop]: !isMobile,
                  })}
                  classNameWrapper={cx(styles.tabsWrapper, {
                    [styles.tabsWrapperDesktop]: !isMobile,
                  })}
                >
                  {children}
                </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
              </RecoveryContext.Provider>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.smsWrap}>
          {isMobile && (
            <SmsConfirmation
              initialOTPChallenge={confirmData.initialOTPChallenge}
              onError={() => console.error('onError')}
              onSuccess={confirmData.onSuccess}
              smsInputCount={confirmData.smsInputCount}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default RecoveryAuth;

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Input, Tab, Tabs, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { ReactComponent as Check } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import { Roles, UserRole, selectRoleRequest } from 'types/auth';

import styles from './ChooseRoleForm.module.pcss';

interface ChooseRoleFormProps {
  roles: Roles;
  onSubmit(data: selectRoleRequest): void;
}

const ChooseRoleForm = ({ roles, onSubmit }: ChooseRoleFormProps) => {
  /** 1 - client, 2 - delegate */
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<number>(1);
  const [client, setClient] = useState<UserRole | null>();
  const [openBsTrustees, setOpenBsTrustees] = useState(false);
  const [selectedTrustee, setSelectedTrustee] = useState<UserRole | null>(null);

  const roleClient = useMemo(() => roles?.find((role) => role.role === 'Client'), [roles]);
  const showTrustees = !roleClient;

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (roleClient) {
      setClient(roleClient);
      setCurrentTab(1);
    } else {
      setCurrentTab(2);
    }
  }, [roleClient]);

  const onTabClick = useCallback((e, tab) => {
    setCurrentTab(tab);
  }, []);

  const trustees = useMemo(
    () =>
      roles
        .sort((a, b) => {
          if (a.details === b.details) {
            return a.details < b.details ? -1 : a.details > b.details ? 1 : 0;
          } else {
            return a.details < b.details ? -1 : 1;
          }
        })
        .filter((role) => role.role !== 'Client'),
    [roles],
  );

  const trusteesOptions = useMemo(
    () =>
      trustees?.map((item) => (
        <div
          onClick={() => {
            setSelectedTrustee(item);
            onSubmit({
              DetailsId: item.detailsId,
              Role: item.role,
            });
            setOpenBsTrustees(false);
          }}
          key={item.role}
        >
          <div className={styles.changeTrusteeItem}>
            <span>{item.details}</span>
            {item.detailsId === selectedTrustee?.detailsId && <Check />}
          </div>
        </div>
      )) || [],
    [onSubmit, selectedTrustee?.detailsId, trustees],
  );

  return (
    <>
      <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
        {client && !!Object.keys(client).length && !!trustees.length && (
          <Tabs value={currentTab} onChange={onTabClick}>
            <Tab value={1} label="Клиент">
              <Text direction="center" color="colorForeground2">
                Вы можете войти в свой личный кабинет, либо в кабинет доверенного лица.
              </Text>
              {client?.detailsId && (
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, MouseEvent>) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    onSubmit({
                      DetailsId: client.detailsId,
                      Role: client.role,
                    });
                  }}
                >
                  Войти как клиент
                </Button>
              )}
            </Tab>
            <Tab value={2} label="Представитель">
              <Text direction="center" color="colorForeground2">
                Вы можете войти в свой личный кабинет, либо в кабинет доверенного лица.
              </Text>
              {showTrustees && (
                <Input
                  classNameInputElement={styles.input}
                  classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
                  label={'Войти как представитель'}
                  value={selectedTrustee?.detailsId}
                  onClick={() => setOpenBsTrustees(true)}
                  className={styles.inputDesktop}
                />
              )}
            </Tab>
          </Tabs>
        )}
        {/* 
            <div className="b-form__row">
              <div className="b-layout_col b-layoutcol--12 b-layout_col--center">
                {error.message && <div className="b-error">{error.message}</div>}

                {(error.code === 400 || error.code === 401) && (
                  <div>
                    Для авторизации перейдите по{' '}
                    <a className="b-link b-link--blue b-link--no-underline" href="/">
                      ссылке
                    </a>
                    .
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div> */}
      </form>
      <BottomSheet
        open={openBsTrustees}
        onDismiss={() => setOpenBsTrustees(false)}
        className={cn(styles.wrap, !openBsTrustees && styles.bsWrapFixed)}
      >
        <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Войти как представитель</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.changeTrustee}>{trusteesOptions}</div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default ChooseRoleForm;

import React, { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Input, InputStatus, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_LOGIN } from 'const/routes';
import md5 from 'crypto-js/md5';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetPasswordPoliciesQuery } from 'core/api/auth';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';

import useInput from 'hooks/useInput';
import useNewPasswordInput from 'hooks/useNewPasswordInput';

import { InputNewPassword, InputPassword, Progress } from 'components';

import { setCredentialsUserRequest } from 'types/auth';

import styles from './CredentialsForm.module.pcss';

interface CredentialsFormProps {
  withEmail?: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  onSubmit(data: setCredentialsUserRequest): void;
  onBackClick(): void;
}

interface CredentialInputStateProps {
  value: string;
  status?: InputStatus;
  description?: string;
}

/**
 * Компонент для ввода логина/пароля пользователя
 * @param {boolean} [withEmail=false] Добавить поле для ввода email
 */
const CredentialsForm = ({ withEmail, isLoading, onSubmit, onBackClick }: CredentialsFormProps) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const email = useInput('');
  const [login, setLogin] = useState<CredentialInputStateProps>({ value: '' });

  const { password, confirmPassword, minReq, confirmPasswordOnChange, newPasswordOnChange } =
    useNewPasswordInput();

  const { data: dataPasswordPolicy } = useGetPasswordPoliciesQuery();
  const passwordPolicy = dataPasswordPolicy?.passwordPolicy?.[0];

  const disable =
    isLoading ||
    !(login.value && minReq && password.value && password.value === confirmPassword.value);

  const handleSubmit = (ev?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    ev?.preventDefault();
    const passwordHash = md5(password.value).toString().toUpperCase();
    onSubmit({ Login: login.value, passwordHash });
  };

  const onLoginChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const { value } = e.target;

    if (value?.trim()) {
      setLogin({
        value: value,
        status: 'success',
      });
    } else {
      setLogin({
        value: value,
        status: 'error',
        description: 'Логин не может быть пустым',
      });
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.formInputs}>
          <Input
            required
            autoComplete="username"
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            label={'Логин *'}
            value={login.value}
            description={login?.description}
            status={login?.status}
            onChange={onLoginChange}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
          />

          <InputNewPassword
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            label={'Пароль *'}
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            value={password.value}
            passwordPolicy={passwordPolicy}
            onChange={newPasswordOnChange}
            status={password?.status}
          />
          <InputPassword
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            value={confirmPassword.value}
            onChange={confirmPasswordOnChange}
            label={'Повторите пароль *'}
            description={confirmPassword?.description}
            status={confirmPassword?.status}
            addonUnder={
              <Progress
                status={confirmPassword?.progressStatus}
                percentage={confirmPassword.percent}
              />
            }
          />

          {passwordPolicy?.hint && (
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              {passwordPolicy.hint}
            </Text>
          )}

          {withEmail && (
            <Input
              classNameInputElement={styles.input}
              classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
              label={'Email'}
              {...email}
              onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
              className={styles.inputDesktop}
            />
          )}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          <Button disabled={disable} onClick={handleSubmit}>
            Далее
          </Button>
          <Button variant="specialSecondary" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN)}>
            Отменить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </>
  );
};

export default CredentialsForm;

import { useState } from 'react';

import { Button, Input } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';

import useInput from 'hooks/useInput';

import {
  descriptionStatus,
  fieldDescription,
  fieldNumberDescription,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/components/Passport/helper';

import { setAdditionalDataRequest } from 'types/auth';

import styles from './PassportForm.module.pcss';

interface PassportFormProps {
  isLoading: boolean;
  onSubmit(data: setAdditionalDataRequest): void;
  onBackClick(): void;
}

/**
 * Компонент формы подтверждения паспорта
 */
const PassportForm = ({ onSubmit, isLoading }: PassportFormProps) => {
  const series = useInput('');
  const number = useInput('');
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [isSeriesOfDocumentError, setIsSeriesOfDocumentError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isNumberOfDocumentError, setIsNumberOfDocumentError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (series.value && number.value) {
      onSubmit({
        PassportNumber: number.value,
        PassportSeries: series.value,
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.formInputs}>
          <Input
            required
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            label={'Серия*'}
            mask="9999"
            {...series}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            status={descriptionStatus(isSeriesOfDocumentError, series.value)}
            description={fieldNumberDescription(isSeriesOfDocumentError, series.value)}
            onBlur={() => {
              setIsSeriesOfDocumentError(series.value?.length < 4);
            }}
          />

          <Input
            required
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            label={'Номер*'}
            mask="999999"
            {...number}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            status={descriptionStatus(isNumberOfDocumentError, number.value)}
            description={fieldNumberDescription(isNumberOfDocumentError, number.value)}
            onBlur={() => {
              setIsNumberOfDocumentError(number.value?.length < 6);
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {/* {(isNumberOfDocumentError || isSeriesOfDocumentError) && (
          <div className={styles.btnNotification}>
            <div className={styles.icon}>
              <ExclamationIcon />
            </div>
            <Text type="labelRegular">Заполните все поля</Text>
          </div>
        )} */}

        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          <Button
            disabled={
              isLoading ||
              !(series.value && number.value) ||
              isNumberOfDocumentError ||
              isSeriesOfDocumentError
            }
            onClick={handleSubmit}
          >
            Далее
          </Button>
          <Button variant="specialSecondary" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN)}>
            Отменить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </>
  );
};

export default PassportForm;
