import React, { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Checkbox, Input, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_LOGIN } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetCaptchaConfigQuery } from 'core/api/auth';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';

import useInput from 'hooks/useInput';

import {
  descriptionStatus,
  fieldDescription,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/components/Passport/helper';
import { CONTACT_ERROR_MESSAGE } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/constants';

import { Captcha } from 'components';

import { RegisterUserRequest } from 'types/auth';

import styles from './RegistrationForm.module.pcss';
import { rusFields, rusRegex } from './const';

interface RegistrationFormProps {
  isLoading: boolean;
  formData: RegisterUserRequest;
  setFormData: (value: React.SetStateAction<RegisterUserRequest>) => void;
  onSubmit(data: RegisterUserRequest): void;
}

const RegistrationForm: React.FC<RegistrationFormProps> = ({
  isLoading,
  formData,
  setFormData,
  onSubmit,
}) => {
  const { data: needCaptcha } = useGetCaptchaConfigQuery();
  const [agreeDataProcessing, setAgreeDataProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [agreeEDS, setAgreeEDS] = useState(false);

  const captcha = useInput('');

  const [phoneError, setPhoneError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastNameError, setLastNameError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [firstNameError, setFirstNameError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleSubmit = useCallback(() => {
    onSubmit({
      ...formData,
      Captcha: captcha.value,
    });
  }, [captcha.value, formData, onSubmit]);

  const onPhoneChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      setFormData((oldValue) => ({ ...oldValue, Phone: e.target.value.replace(/\s/g, '') }));
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  // Добавьте эту функцию перед компонентом
  const validateNameInput = (value: string): boolean => {
    // Запрещаем тире в начале
    if (value.startsWith('-')) return false;

    // Запрещаем 2 и более тире подряд
    if (/--+/.test(value)) return false;

    return true;
  };

  const onLastNameChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const value = e.target.value;
      if (!rusRegex.test(value) && value !== '' && rusFields.includes('lastName')) return;
      if (!validateNameInput(value)) return;

      setFormData((oldValue) => ({ ...oldValue, LastName: value }));
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  const onFirstNameChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const value = e.target.value;
      if (!rusRegex.test(value) && value !== '' && rusFields.includes('firstName')) return;
      if (!validateNameInput(value)) return;

      setFormData((oldValue) => ({ ...oldValue, FirstName: value }));
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  const onMiddleNameChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const value = e.target.value;
      if (!rusRegex.test(value) && value !== '' && rusFields.includes('middleName')) return;
      if (!validateNameInput(value)) return;

      setFormData((oldValue) => ({ ...oldValue, MiddleName: value }));
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  const isEmptyInputs = !(formData.LastName && formData.FirstName && formData.Phone);
  const isError = phoneError || lastNameError || firstNameError;

  return (
    <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
      <div className={styles.formInputs}>
        <Input
          required
          classNameInputElement={styles.input}
          classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
          label={'Фамилия*'}
          value={formData.LastName}
          onChange={onLastNameChange}
          onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          status={descriptionStatus(lastNameError, formData.LastName)}
          description={fieldDescription(lastNameError, formData.LastName)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setLastNameError(!formData.LastName?.trim()?.length);
          }}
          className={styles.inputDesktop}
        />

        <Input
          required
          classNameInputElement={styles.input}
          classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
          label={'Имя*'}
          value={formData.FirstName}
          onChange={onFirstNameChange}
          onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          status={descriptionStatus(firstNameError, formData.FirstName)}
          description={fieldDescription(firstNameError, formData.FirstName)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setFirstNameError(!formData.FirstName?.trim()?.length);
          }}
          className={styles.inputDesktop}
        />

        <Input
          classNameInputElement={styles.input}
          classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
          label="Отчество (не обязательно)"
          value={formData.MiddleName}
          onChange={onMiddleNameChange}
          onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          className={styles.inputDesktop}
        />

        <Input
          required
          addonBefore={<Text color="colorForeground2">+7</Text>}
          label="Номер телефона*"
          mask="999 999 99 99"
          placeholder="123 456 78 90"
          type="tel"
          className={styles.inputDesktop}
          classNameInputElement={styles.input}
          classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
          value={formData.Phone}
          onChange={onPhoneChange}
          onBlur={() => setPhoneError(formData.Phone?.length !== 10 || formData.Phone?.[0] !== '9')}
          status={phoneError || !formData.Phone ? 'error' : undefined}
          description={phoneError || !formData.Phone ? CONTACT_ERROR_MESSAGE : undefined}
        />

        <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
          * Поля, отмеченные звездочкой, являются обязательными для заполнения
        </Text>

        {needCaptcha?.registerCaptchaImmediate && <Captcha autoFocus={false} {...captcha} />}

        <Checkbox
          checked={agreeDataProcessing}
          label={
            <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.labelReg} color="colorForeground2">
              <a
                rel="noreferrer"
                href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/Согласие для регистрации на ресурсах ИП.pdf"
                target="_blank"
                className={styles.link}
              >
                Согласие на обработку персональных данных ООО &quot;Инвестиционная палата&quot;
              </a>
              . Подробнее об обработке данных в{' '}
              <a
                rel="noreferrer"
                href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/Политика конфиденциальности _ политика в отношении обработки ПДн (ред. 21.11.2025)(v4) (3).pdf"
                target="_blank"
                className={styles.link}
              >
                Политике
              </a>
            </Text>
          }
          className={isMobile ? styles.check : styles.checkDesktop}
          onChange={() => {
            setAgreeDataProcessing((prev) => !prev);
          }}
        />

        <Checkbox
          checked={agreeEDS}
          label={
            <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.labelReg} color="colorForeground2">
              Заключаю{' '}
              <a
                rel="noreferrer"
                href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/Соглашение об ЭДО и ПЭП (1).pdf"
                target="_blank"
                className={styles.link}
              >
                Соглашение об использовании системы ЭДО и электронной подписи ООО
                &quot;Инвестиционная палата&quot;
              </a>
            </Text>
          }
          className={isMobile ? styles.check : styles.checkDesktop}
          onChange={() => {
            setAgreeEDS((prev) => !prev);
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.textHelp}>
        В случае возникновения проблем с регистрацией просим обращаться на адрес электронной почты{' '}
        <a rel="noreferrer" href="mailto:clients_support@investpalata.ru" className={styles.link}>
          clients_support@investpalata.ru
        </a>{' '}
        для проверки специалистами Ваших анкетных данных.
      </Text>

      <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
        <Button
          disabled={
            isLoading ||
            isEmptyInputs ||
            isError ||
            (needCaptcha?.registerCaptchaImmediate && !captcha.value) ||
            !agreeDataProcessing ||
            !agreeEDS
          }
          onClick={handleSubmit}
        >
          Далее
        </Button>
        <Button variant="specialSecondary" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN)}>
          Отменить
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
};

export default RegistrationForm;

import React, { ReactNode, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import SmsConfirmation from 'components/SmsConfirmation';

  ErrorResponse,
  RegisterUserRequest,
  UserRole,
  selectRoleRequest,
  setAdditionalDataRequest,
  setCredentialsUserRequest,
} from 'types/auth';

import styles from './RegistrationPage.module.pcss';
import ChooseRoleForm from './components/ChooseRoleForm/ChooseRoleForm';
import CredentialsForm from './components/CredentialsForm/CredentialsForm';
import PassportForm from './components/PassportForm/PassportForm';

const RegistrationPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [withEmail, setWithEmail] = useState(false);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<EnumRegFormSteps>(EnumRegFormSteps.REG);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();

  const [regOtpData, setRegOtpData] = useState<OTPChallenge | null>(null);
  const [roles] = useState<UserRole[]>([]);
  const [showLoginLink, setShowLoginLink] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [logout] = authApi.useLogoutMutation();
  const [getSalt] = authApi.useLazyGetSaltQuery();

  const [registerUser, { isLoading: isRegLoading, error: regError }] =
    authApi2.useRegisterUserMutation();
  const [savePassport, { isLoading: isPassportLoading, error: passportError }] =
    authApi2.useSaveRegAdditionalDataMutation();
  const [saveCredentials, { isLoading: isCredentialsLoading, error: credentialsError }] =
    authApi2.useSaveRegCredentialsMutation();
  const [selectRole, { isLoading: isSelectRoleLoading }] = authApi2.useSelectRoleMutation();

  const [formDataReg, setFormDataReg] = useState<RegisterUserRequest>(defaultRegFormData);

  useEffect(() => {
    const serviceParam = searchParams.get('service');
    if (serviceParam === 'obmen') {
      localStorage.setItem('service', 'obmen');
    }
  }, [searchParams]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const stepError = regError || passportError || credentialsError;
    if (stepError) {
      const errorData = (stepError as ErrorResponse)?.data;

      createAlertNotification({
        status: 'error',
        text: errorData?.error[0]?.errorMessageText || 'Произошла ошибка',
      });

      if (errorData?.error[0]?.error === '701') {
        logout()
          .then(() => getSalt())
          .then(() => setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.REG))
          .catch((err) => console.error(err));
      }
    }
  }, [regError, passportError, credentialsError, logout, getSalt]);

  const handleSubmitRegStep = useCallback(
    async (data: RegisterUserRequest) => {
      try {
        setShowLoginLink(false);
        registerUser(data)
          .then((response) => {
            if ('data' in response) {
              setRegOtpData(response.data.otpChallenge);
              setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.CONFIRM);
            }
          })
          .catch(() => {
            createAlertNotification({
              text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
              status: 'error',
            });
          });
      } catch (e) {
        //
      }
    },
    [registerUser, setShowLoginLink],
  );

  const handleOTPError = useCallback(
    async (error: unknown) => {
      if (isErrorResponseType(error)) {
        const code = error.data?.error[0]?.errorCode;
        if (code === 'LoginAlreadyExists') {
          setShowLoginLink(true);
        } else if (code === 'PersonNotFoundRegistration') {
          try {
            await logout().unwrap();
            await getSalt().unwrap();
            setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.REG);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error(err);
          }
        }
      }
    },
    [getSalt, logout],
  );

  const handlePhoneConfirm = useCallback(
    (data?: OTPConfirmRegResponse | null) => {
      if (data?.userCheckStatus) {
        const status = data.userCheckStatus?.status;
        switch (status) {
          case 'data_clarification': {
            setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.PASSPORT);
            break;
          }
          case 'non_registered': {
            setWithEmail(true);
            setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.CREDENTIALS);
            break;
          }
          case 'identified': {
            setWithEmail(false);
            setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.CREDENTIALS);
            break;
          }
          case 'registered': {
            navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN);
            break;
          }
          default: {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    },
    [navigate],
  );

  const handleSubmitPassportStep = useCallback(
    (data: setAdditionalDataRequest) => {
      savePassport(data)
        .then((response) => {
          if ('data' in response) {
            setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.CREDENTIALS);
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          createAlertNotification({
            text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
            status: 'error',
          });
        });
    },
    [savePassport],
  );

  const handleLoginLinkClick = useCallback(
    (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
      const serviceParam = searchParams.get('service');

      if (serviceParam) {
        e.preventDefault();

        if (serviceParam === 'obmen') {
          const loginUrl =
            process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
              ? 'https://x.investpalata.ru'
              : 'https://x-tt.investpalata.ru';
          window.open(loginUrl, '_self');
        }
      }
    },
    [searchParams],
  );

  const handleSubmitCredentialsStep = useCallback(
    (data: setCredentialsUserRequest) => {
      saveCredentials(data)
        .then((response) => {
          if ('data' in response) {
            const data = response.data;
            if (data.session?.[0]?.userId) {
              navigate(ROUTE_360);
            }
            //else if (data.roles?.length) {
            //  setRoles(data.roles);
            //  setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.ROLE);
            //}
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          createAlertNotification({
            text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
            status: 'error',
          });
        });
    },
    [navigate, saveCredentials],
  );

  const handleSubmitRole = useCallback(
    (data: selectRoleRequest) => {
      selectRole(data)
        .then((response) => {
          if ('data' in response) {
            const data = response.data;
            if (data?.session?.[0]?.userId) {
              navigate(ROUTE_360);
            }
          }
        })
        .catch(() => {
          createAlertNotification({
            text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
            status: 'error',
          });
        });
    },
    [navigate, selectRole],
  );

  const stepsData: { [K in EnumRegFormSteps]: ReactNode } = {
    reg: (
      <div className={styles.titleReg}>
        для действующих клиентов ООО «Инвестиционная палата», если Вы таковым не являетесь,
        регистрация для Вас недоступна.
      </div>
    ),
    confirm: 'Введите код подтверждения',
    passport: 'Укажите паспортные данные',
    credentials: 'Придумайте логин и пароль',
    chooseRole: 'Выберите роль',
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.rootContainer}>
      {isRegLoading || isPassportLoading || isCredentialsLoading || isSelectRoleLoading ? (
        <div className={styles.load}>
          <CircleLoader brandColor />
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <HeaderPage title="Регистрация" />
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.container : styles.containerDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          {!isMobile && (
            <div className={styles.headerButtonWrapper}>
              <Text direction="center" type="headline">
                Регистрация
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}

          <Text direction="center" color="colorForeground2">
            {stepsData[step]}
          </Text>

          <Progress
            className={styles.stepper}
            activeIndex={regformSteps.indexOf(step)}
            shape="stepper"
            steps={['', '', '', '']}
          />

          {step === 'reg' && (
            <RegistrationForm
              isLoading={isRegLoading}
              formData={formDataReg}
              onSubmit={handleSubmitRegStep}
              setFormData={setFormDataReg}
            />
          )}

          {step === 'confirm' && regOtpData && (
            <div className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
              <SmsConfirmation
                withHeader
                withTitle={false}
                onBackClick={() => setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.REG)}
                onOTPError={handleOTPError}
                subTitle={
                  <>
                    <Text
                      className={styles.textCenter}
                      color="colorForeground2"
                      type="labelRegular"
                    >{`Для заключения Соглашения об использовании системы ЭДО и электронной подписи ООО «Инвестиционная палата» и продолжения регистрации введите код подтверждения из SMS`}</Text>
                    <Text
                      className={styles.textCenter}
                      color="colorForeground2"
                      type="labelRegular"
                    >{`Отправлен на номер: ${regOtpData?.maskedPhone}`}</Text>
                  </>
                }
                initialOTPChallenge={regOtpData}
                smsInputCount={SMS_LENGTHS}
                onSuccess={handlePhoneConfirm}
                onError={console.error}
              />

              {showLoginLink && (
                <Text className={styles.textCenter} color="colorForeground2">
                  Для авторизации перейдите по&nbsp;
                  <a href={ROUTE_LOGIN} rel="noreferrer" onClick={handleLoginLinkClick}>
                    ссылке
                  </a>
                </Text>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {step === 'passport' && (
            <PassportForm
              isLoading={isPassportLoading}
              onSubmit={handleSubmitPassportStep}
              onBackClick={() => setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.REG)}
            />
          )}

          {step === 'credentials' && (
            <CredentialsForm
              withEmail={withEmail}
              isLoading={isCredentialsLoading}
              onSubmit={handleSubmitCredentialsStep}
              onBackClick={() => setStep(EnumRegFormSteps.REG)}
            />
          )}

          {step === 'chooseRole' && <ChooseRoleForm roles={roles} onSubmit={handleSubmitRole} />}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default RegistrationPage;

export enum EnumRegFormSteps {
  REG = 'reg',
  CONFIRM = 'confirm',
  PASSPORT = 'passport',
  CREDENTIALS = 'credentials',
  ROLE = 'chooseRole',
}

export const regformSteps = Object.values(EnumRegFormSteps);

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Input, Tab, Tabs, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { ReactComponent as Check } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import { Roles, UserRole, selectRoleRequest } from 'types/auth';

import styles from './ChooseRoleForm.module.pcss';

interface ChooseRoleFormProps {
  roles: Roles;
  onSubmit(data: selectRoleRequest): void;
}

const ChooseRoleForm = ({ roles, onSubmit }: ChooseRoleFormProps) => {
  /** 1 - client, 2 - delegate */
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<number>(1);
  const [client, setClient] = useState<UserRole | null>();
  const [openBsTrustees, setOpenBsTrustees] = useState(false);
  const [selectedTrustee, setSelectedTrustee] = useState<UserRole | null>(null);

  const roleClient = useMemo(() => roles?.find((role) => role.role === 'Client'), [roles]);
  const showTrustees = !roleClient;

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (roleClient) {
      setClient(roleClient);
      setCurrentTab(1);
    } else {
      setCurrentTab(2);
    }
  }, [roleClient]);

  const onTabClick = useCallback((e, tab) => {
    setCurrentTab(tab);
  }, []);

  const trustees = useMemo(
    () =>
      roles
        .sort((a, b) => {
          if (a.details === b.details) {
            return a.details < b.details ? -1 : a.details > b.details ? 1 : 0;
          } else {
            return a.details < b.details ? -1 : 1;
          }
        })
        .filter((role) => role.role !== 'Client'),
    [roles],
  );

  const trusteesOptions = useMemo(
    () =>
      trustees?.map((item) => (
        <div
          onClick={() => {
            setSelectedTrustee(item);
            onSubmit({
              DetailsId: item.detailsId,
              Role: item.role,
            });
            setOpenBsTrustees(false);
          }}
          key={item.role}
        >
          <div className={styles.changeTrusteeItem}>
            <span>{item.details}</span>
            {item.detailsId === selectedTrustee?.detailsId && <Check />}
          </div>
        </div>
      )) || [],
    [onSubmit, selectedTrustee?.detailsId, trustees],
  );

  return (
    <>
      <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
        {client && !!Object.keys(client).length && !!trustees.length && (
          <Tabs value={currentTab} onChange={onTabClick}>
            <Tab value={1} label="Клиент">
              <Text direction="center" color="colorForeground2">
                Вы можете войти в свой личный кабинет, либо в кабинет доверенного лица.
              </Text>
              {client?.detailsId && (
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  onClick={(e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, MouseEvent>) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    onSubmit({
                      DetailsId: client.detailsId,
                      Role: client.role,
                    });
                  }}
                >
                  Войти как клиент
                </Button>
              )}
            </Tab>
            <Tab value={2} label="Представитель">
              <Text direction="center" color="colorForeground2">
                Вы можете войти в свой личный кабинет, либо в кабинет доверенного лица.
              </Text>
              {showTrustees && (
                <Input
                  classNameInputElement={styles.input}
                  classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
                  label={'Войти как представитель'}
                  value={selectedTrustee?.detailsId}
                  onClick={() => setOpenBsTrustees(true)}
                  className={styles.inputDesktop}
                />
              )}
            </Tab>
          </Tabs>
        )}
        {/* 
            <div className="b-form__row">
              <div className="b-layout_col b-layoutcol--12 b-layout_col--center">
                {error.message && <div className="b-error">{error.message}</div>}

                {(error.code === 400 || error.code === 401) && (
                  <div>
                    Для авторизации перейдите по{' '}
                    <a className="b-link b-link--blue b-link--no-underline" href="/">
                      ссылке
                    </a>
                    .
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div> */}
      </form>
      <BottomSheet
        open={openBsTrustees}
        onDismiss={() => setOpenBsTrustees(false)}
        className={cn(styles.wrap, !openBsTrustees && styles.bsWrapFixed)}
      >
        <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Войти как представитель</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.changeTrustee}>{trusteesOptions}</div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default ChooseRoleForm;

import React, { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Input, InputStatus, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_LOGIN } from 'const/routes';
import md5 from 'crypto-js/md5';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetPasswordPoliciesQuery } from 'core/api/auth';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';

import useInput from 'hooks/useInput';
import useNewPasswordInput from 'hooks/useNewPasswordInput';

import { InputNewPassword, InputPassword, Progress } from 'components';

import { setCredentialsUserRequest } from 'types/auth';

import styles from './CredentialsForm.module.pcss';

interface CredentialsFormProps {
  withEmail?: boolean;
  onSubmit(data: setCredentialsUserRequest): void;
  onBackClick(): void;
}

interface CredentialInputStateProps {
  value: string;
  status?: InputStatus;
  description?: string;
}

/**
 * Компонент для ввода логина/пароля пользователя
 * @param {boolean} [withEmail=false] Добавить поле для ввода email
 */
const CredentialsForm = ({ withEmail, onSubmit, onBackClick }: CredentialsFormProps) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const email = useInput('');
  const [login, setLogin] = useState<CredentialInputStateProps>({ value: '' });
  const { password, confirmPassword, minReq, confirmPasswordOnChange, newPasswordOnChange } =
    useNewPasswordInput();

  const { data: dataPasswordPolicy } = useGetPasswordPoliciesQuery();
  const passwordPolicy = dataPasswordPolicy?.passwordPolicy?.[0];

  const disable = !(
    login.value &&
    minReq &&
    password.value &&
    password.value === confirmPassword.value
  );

  const handleSubmit = (ev?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    ev?.preventDefault();
    const passwordHash = md5(password.value).toString().toUpperCase();
    onSubmit({ Login: login.value, passwordHash });
  };

  const onLoginChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const { value } = e.target;

    if (value?.trim()) {
      setLogin({
        value: value,
        status: 'success',
      });
    } else {
      setLogin({
        value: value,
        status: 'error',
        description: 'Логин не может быть пустым',
      });
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.formInputs}>
          <Input
            required
            autoComplete="username"
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            label={'Логин *'}
            value={login.value}
            description={login?.description}
            status={login?.status}
            onChange={onLoginChange}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
          />

          <InputNewPassword
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            label={'Пароль *'}
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            value={password.value}
            passwordPolicy={passwordPolicy}
            onChange={newPasswordOnChange}
            status={password?.status}
          />
          <InputPassword
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            value={confirmPassword.value}
            onChange={confirmPasswordOnChange}
            label={'Повторите пароль *'}
            description={confirmPassword?.description}
            status={confirmPassword?.status}
            addonUnder={
              <Progress
                status={confirmPassword?.progressStatus}
                percentage={confirmPassword.percent}
              />
            }
          />

          {passwordPolicy?.hint && (
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              {passwordPolicy.hint}
            </Text>
          )}

          {withEmail && (
            <Input
              classNameInputElement={styles.input}
              classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
              label={'Email'}
              {...email}
              onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
              className={styles.inputDesktop}
            />
          )}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          <Button disabled={disable} onClick={handleSubmit}>
            Далее
          </Button>
          <Button variant="specialSecondary" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN)}>
            Отменить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </>
  );
};

export default CredentialsForm;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Input } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_LOGIN } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';

import useInput from 'hooks/useInput';

import {
  descriptionStatus,
  fieldNumberDescription,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/components/Passport/helper';

import { setAdditionalDataRequest } from 'types/auth';

import styles from './PassportForm.module.pcss';

interface PassportFormProps {
  onSubmit(data: setAdditionalDataRequest): void;
  onBackClick(): void;
}

/**
 * Компонент формы подтверждения паспорта
 */
const PassportForm = ({ onSubmit, onBackClick }: PassportFormProps) => {
  const series = useInput('');
  const number = useInput('');
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [isSeriesOfDocumentError, setIsSeriesOfDocumentError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isNumberOfDocumentError, setIsNumberOfDocumentError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (series.value && number.value) {
      onSubmit({
        PassportNumber: number.value,
        PassportSeries: series.value,
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.formInputs}>
          <Input
            required
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            label={'Серия*'}
            mask="9999"
            {...series}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            status={descriptionStatus(isSeriesOfDocumentError, series.value)}
            description={fieldNumberDescription(isSeriesOfDocumentError, series.value)}
            onBlur={() => {
              setIsSeriesOfDocumentError(series.value?.length < 4);
            }}
          />

          <Input
            required
            classNameInputElement={styles.input}
            classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
            className={styles.inputDesktop}
            label={'Номер*'}
            mask="999999"
            {...number}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
            status={descriptionStatus(isNumberOfDocumentError, number.value)}
            description={fieldNumberDescription(isNumberOfDocumentError, number.value)}
            onBlur={() => {
              setIsNumberOfDocumentError(number.value?.length < 6);
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {/* {(isNumberOfDocumentError || isSeriesOfDocumentError) && (
          <div className={styles.btnNotification}>
            <div className={styles.icon}>
              <ExclamationIcon />
            </div>
            <Text type="labelRegular">Заполните все поля</Text>
          </div>
        )} */}

        <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
          <Button
            disabled={
              !(series.value && number.value) || isNumberOfDocumentError || isSeriesOfDocumentError
            }
            onClick={handleSubmit}
          >
            Далее
          </Button>
          <Button variant="specialSecondary" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN)}>
            Отменить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </>
  );
};

export default PassportForm;

import React, { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Checkbox, Input, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import Hint from '@vision/hint';
import { ROUTE_LOGIN } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetCaptchaConfigQuery } from 'core/api/auth';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';

import useInput from 'hooks/useInput';

import {
  descriptionStatus,
  fieldDescription,
} from 'modules/PersonalInformation/components/Passport/helper';
import { CONTACT_ERROR_MESSAGE } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/constants';

import { Captcha } from 'components';

import { RegisterUserRequest } from 'types/auth';

import styles from './RegistrationForm.module.pcss';
import { rusFields, rusRegex } from './const';

interface RegistrationFormProps {
  onSubmit(data: RegisterUserRequest): void;
}

const RegistrationForm: React.FC<RegistrationFormProps> = ({ onSubmit }) => {
  const { data: needCaptcha } = useGetCaptchaConfigQuery();
  const [agree, setAgree] = useState(false);

  const captcha = useInput('');

  const [phoneValue, setPhoneValue] = useState<string>('');
  const [phoneError, setPhoneError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [lastName, setLastName] = useState<string>('');
  const [lastNameError, setLastNameError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState<string>('');
  const [firstNameError, setFirstNameError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [middleName, setMiddleName] = useState<string>('');

  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleSubmit = useCallback(() => {
    onSubmit({
      LastName: lastName,
      FirstName: firstName,
      MiddleName: middleName,
      Phone: phoneValue,
      Captcha: captcha.value,
    });
  }, [captcha.value, firstName, lastName, middleName, onSubmit, phoneValue]);

  const onPhoneChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setPhoneValue(e.target.value.replace(/\s/g, ''));
  }, []);

  const onLastNameChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    if (!rusRegex.test(value) && value !== '' && rusFields.includes('lastName')) return;

    setLastName(value);
  }, []);

  const onFirstNameChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    if (!rusRegex.test(value) && value !== '' && rusFields.includes('firstName')) return;

    setFirstName(value);
  }, []);

  const onMiddleNameChange = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value;
    if (!rusRegex.test(value) && value !== '' && rusFields.includes('middleName')) return;

    setMiddleName(value);
  }, []);

  return (
    <form className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
      <div className={styles.formInputs}>
        <Input
          required
          classNameInputElement={styles.input}
          classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
          label={'Фамилия*'}
          value={lastName}
          onChange={onLastNameChange}
          onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          status={descriptionStatus(lastNameError, lastName)}
          description={fieldDescription(lastNameError, lastName)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setLastNameError(!lastName?.trim()?.length);
          }}
          className={styles.inputDesktop}
        />

        <Input
          required
          classNameInputElement={styles.input}
          classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
          label={'Имя*'}
          value={firstName}
          onChange={onFirstNameChange}
          onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          status={descriptionStatus(firstNameError, firstName)}
          description={fieldDescription(firstNameError, firstName)}
          onBlur={() => {
            setFirstNameError(!firstName?.trim()?.length);
          }}
          className={styles.inputDesktop}
        />

        <Input
          classNameInputElement={styles.input}
          classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
          label="Отчество (не обязательно)"
          value={middleName}
          onChange={onMiddleNameChange}
          onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          className={styles.inputDesktop}
        />

        <Input
          required
          addonBefore="+7"
          label="Номер телефона*"
          mask="999 999 99 99"
          placeholder="123 456 78 90"
          type="tel"
          className={styles.inputDesktop}
          classNameInputElement={styles.input}
          classNameLabel={styles.inputLabel}
          value={phoneValue}
          onChange={onPhoneChange}
          onBlur={() => setPhoneError(phoneValue?.length !== 10 || phoneValue?.[0] !== '9')}
          status={phoneError || !phoneValue ? 'error' : undefined}
          description={phoneError || !phoneValue ? CONTACT_ERROR_MESSAGE : undefined}
          addonAfter={
            <Hint
              portal={true}
              content="Введите номер телефона, который вы указали в анкете клиента при оформлении инвестиционного продукта."
              placement="topLeft"
            />
          }
        />

        <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
          * Поля, отмеченные звездочкой, являются обязательными для заполнения
        </Text>

        {needCaptcha?.registerCaptchaImmediate && <Captcha {...captcha} />}

        <Checkbox
          checked={agree}
          label={
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              Согласие на обработку персональных данных ООО{'"'}Инвестиционная палата{'"'}
            </Text>
          }
          className={isMobile ? styles.check : styles.checkDesktop}
          onChange={() => {
            setAgree((prev) => !prev);
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
        <Button
          disabled={
            !lastName ||
            !firstName ||
            !phoneValue ||
            phoneError ||
            lastNameError ||
            firstNameError ||
            (needCaptcha?.registerCaptchaImmediate && !captcha.value) ||
            !agree
          }
          onClick={handleSubmit}
        >
          Далее
        </Button>
        <Button variant="specialSecondary" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN)}>
          Отменить
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
};

export default RegistrationForm;

// RegistrationFlow.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';

import { Progress } from '@aurora/components';

import styles from './RegistrationPageEsia.module.pcss';

interface RegistrationFlowProps {}

const RegistrationFlow: React.FC<RegistrationFlowProps> = () => {
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);
  const [phoneNumber, setPhoneNumber] = useState('');
  const [phoneError, setPhoneError] = useState('');
  const [smsCode, setSmsCode] = useState(['', '', '', '']);
  const [agreementChecked, setAgreementChecked] = useState({
    personal: false,
    communication: false,
  });

  const totalSteps = 7;

  const validatePhone = (phone: string): boolean => {
    const phoneRegex = /^\+7 \(\d{3}\) \d{3} \d{2} \d{2}$/;
    return phoneRegex.test(phone);
  };

  const formatPhone = (value: string): string => {
    const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, '');

    // Если нет цифр или только "7"
    if (digits.length === 0) return '+7 (';
    if (digits.length === 1) {
      // Если введена 7, показываем пустую маску
      return digits === '7' ? '+7 (' : `+7 (${digits}`;
    }

    // Убираем первую 7, если она есть
    const phoneDigits = digits.startsWith('7') ? digits.slice(1) : digits;

    if (phoneDigits.length === 0) return '+7 (';
    if (phoneDigits.length <= 3) return `+7 (${phoneDigits}`;
    if (phoneDigits.length <= 6) return `+7 (${phoneDigits.slice(0, 3)}) ${phoneDigits.slice(3)}`;
    if (phoneDigits.length <= 8)
      return `+7 (${phoneDigits.slice(0, 3)}) ${phoneDigits.slice(3, 6)} ${phoneDigits.slice(6)}`;
    return `+7 (${phoneDigits.slice(0, 3)}) ${phoneDigits.slice(3, 6)} ${phoneDigits.slice(
      6,
      8,
    )} ${phoneDigits.slice(8, 10)}`;
  };

  const handlePhoneChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const formatted = formatPhone(e.target.value);
    setPhoneNumber(formatted);
    setPhoneError('');
  };

  const handlePhoneSubmit = () => {
    if (!validatePhone(phoneNumber)) {
      setPhoneError('Введите корректный номер телефона');
      return;
    }
    if (!agreementChecked.personal || !agreementChecked.communication) {
      setPhoneError('Необходимо принять все соглашения');
      return;
    }
    setCurrentStep(2);
  };

  const handleSmsChange = (index: number, value: string) => {
    if (!/^\d*$/.test(value)) return;

    const newCode = [...smsCode];
    newCode[index] = value.slice(-1);
    setSmsCode(newCode);

    // Автоматический переход к следующему полю
    if (value && index < 3) {
      const nextInput = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(`sms-input-${index + 1}`);
      nextInput?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleSmsKeyDown = (index: number, e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !smsCode[index] && index > 0) {
      const prevInput = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(`sms-input-${index - 1}`);
      prevInput?.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleSmsSubmit = () => {
    if (smsCode.every((digit) => digit !== '')) {
      setCurrentStep(3);
    }
  };

  const renderProgressBar = () => (
    <Progress
      className={styles.stepper}
      activeIndex={currentStep - 1}
      shape="stepper"
      steps={Array.from({ length: totalSteps }, () => '')}
    />
  );

  const renderStep1 = () => (
    <div className={styles.stepContent}>
      <h1 className={styles.title}>Открытие счетов</h1>
      <h2 className={styles.subtitle}>
        В ООО «Инвестиционная палата» с помощью портала Госуслуги (ЕСИА)¹
      </h2>
      <p className={styles.description}>
        Введите номер телефона в целях открытия брокерского и депозитарного счетов в ООО
        «Инвестиционная палата»
      </p>

      <div className={styles.inputGroup}>
        <input
          type="text"
          className={`${styles.phoneInput} ${phoneError ? styles.inputError : ''}`}
          value={phoneNumber}
          onChange={handlePhoneChange}
          placeholder="+7 (999) 999 99 99"
          maxLength={18}
        />
        {phoneError && <span className={styles.errorText}>{phoneError}</span>}
      </div>

      <div className={styles.checkboxGroup}>
        <label className={styles.checkboxLabel}>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={agreementChecked.personal}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setAgreementChecked({ ...agreementChecked, personal: e.target.checked })
            }
          />
          <span>
            Выражаю <a href="#">Согласие на обработку персональных данных</a>. Подробнее об
            обработке данных в <a href="#">Политике</a>
          </span>
        </label>

        <label className={styles.checkboxLabel}>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={agreementChecked.communication}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setAgreementChecked({ ...agreementChecked, communication: e.target.checked })
            }
          />
          <span>
            Выражаю <a href="#">Согласие на коммуникацию</a>
          </span>
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.documentLinks}>
        <p>
          Прежде чем нажимать кнопку «Продолжить», обязательно ознакомьтесь со следующими
          документами:
        </p>
        <ul>
          <li>
            <a href="#">
              Ключевая информация о договоре на брокерское обслуживание ООО «Инвестиционная палата»
            </a>
          </li>
          <li>
            <a href="#">Декларации и уведомления о рисках</a>

        </ul>
      </div>

      <button className={styles.primaryButton} onClick={handlePhoneSubmit}>

      </button>

      <p className={styles.agreementText}>

      </p>
    </div>
  );

  const renderStep2 = () => (
    <div className={styles.stepContent}>
      <h1 className={styles.title}>СМС-подтверждение</h1>
      <p className={styles.description}>
        Мы отправили на указанный Вами номер +7 (926) *** ** 22 код подтверждения. Введите его для

      </p>

      <div className={styles.smsInputs}>
        {smsCode.map((digit, index) => (

      </div>

  const renderStep3 = () => (

  const renderStep4 = () => (
    <div className={styles.stepContent}>
      <h1 className={styles.title}>Ваши данные</h1>

        <a href="#"> портале Госуслуги</a> и вернитесь к открытию счетов. Если Вы зашли под чужой

      </p>

      <div className={styles.form}>

        </div>

        <div className={styles.formRow}>

            </div>

      </div>

      <button className={styles.primaryButton} onClick={() => setCurrentStep(6)}>

  );

  const renderStep6 = () => (
    <div className={styles.stepContent}>
      <h1 className={styles.title}>Подписание документов</h1>

      <div className={styles.smsInputs}>
        {smsCode.map((digit, index) => (
          <input
            key={index}
            id={`sms-sign-${index}`}
            type="text"
            className={styles.smsInput}
            value={digit}
            onChange={(e) => handleSmsChange(index, e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => handleSmsKeyDown(index, e)}
            maxLength={1}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <button
        className={styles.primaryButton}
        onClick={() => setCurrentStep(7)}
        disabled={!smsCode.every((digit) => digit !== '')}
      >
        Подписать
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  const renderStep7 = () => (
    <div className={styles.stepContent}>
      <h1 className={styles.title}>Подписание документов завершено</h1>
      <h2 className={styles.subtitle}>Счета скоро будут открыты</h2>
      <p className={styles.description}>
        Ваши документы приняты в работу. Уведомление об открытии счетов поступит на указанный Вами
        email или в СМС сообщении
      </p>

      <button className={styles.primaryButton} onClick={() => window.close()}>
        Закрыть
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      {renderProgressBar()}
      {currentStep === 1 && renderStep1()}
      {currentStep === 2 && renderStep2()}
      {currentStep === 3 && renderStep3()}
      {currentStep === 4 && renderStep4()}
      {currentStep === 5 && renderStep5()}
      {currentStep === 6 && renderStep6()}
      {currentStep === 7 && renderStep7()}
    </div>
  );
};

export default RegistrationFlow;

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import BottomSheet from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import { Button, CheckHeader } from '@aurora/components';
import httpCommunicator from '@aurora/http-communicator';
import { ROUTE_REPORTS } from 'const/routes';
import { saveAs } from 'file-saver';

import { API_REQUEST_REPORT_FILE } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import { getDefaultHeaders } from 'core/api/common';
import {
  useLazyGetReportFileQuery,
  useLazyGetReportParametersQuery,
  useLazyGetReportStatusQuery,
} from 'core/api/reports';
import { setCurrentRequestGuid, setReorderData } from 'core/reports/reportsSlice';

import { isErrorResponseType } from 'utils/errorResponse';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import { orderDateReformat } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import { visualDateFormatter } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/components/Passport/helper';
import {
  reportBadge,
  reportColors,
  testStatusNames,
  textStatusColors,
} from 'modules/ReportsPage/components/ReportsHistory/constants';
import { visualIsoPeriodFormatter } from 'modules/ReportsPage/components/ReportsOrder/helper';

import { ReactComponent as PdfSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/history/filePdf.svg';

import { ErrorData } from 'types/auth/models';
import { ReportItem } from 'types/reports';

import DetailsItem from '../DetailsItem';
import styles from './BottomSheetDetails.module.pcss';

type BottomSheetDetailsProps = {
  openDetails: boolean;
  setOpenDetails: (openDetails: boolean) => void;
  report: ReportItem;
  askStatus: boolean;
  onParametersError: () => void;
  onParametersErrorClear: () => void;
  isMobile: boolean;
};

const BottomSheetDetails: React.FC<BottomSheetDetailsProps> = ({
  openDetails,
  setOpenDetails,
  report,
  askStatus,
  onParametersError,
  onParametersErrorClear,
  isMobile,
}) => {
  const [isReportStatusCheck, setIsReportStatusCheck] = useState(false);
  const [getReportStatus, { data: currentReportStatus }] = useLazyGetReportStatusQuery();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const fileUrl = useMemo(
    () => `${API_REQUEST_REPORT_FILE}?file_Id=${report.fileList?.[0]?.fileId}`,
    [report],
  );
  const [getReportParameters, { data: reportParameters, isError: isParametersError }] =
    useLazyGetReportParametersQuery();

  const [checkReportFile, { data: fileData }] = useLazyGetReportFileQuery();
  const [isFileError, setIsFileError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleDownloadFile = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await httpCommunicator(fileUrl, {
        method: 'get',
        responseType: 'blob',
        headers: getDefaultHeaders(fileUrl),
      });
      if (response.data?.Error) {
        setIsFileError(true);
      } else {
        const blob = new Blob([response.data], { type: 'application/pdf' });
        const fileName = `${report.reportTypeName}-${report.requestTime}.pdf`;

        saveAs(blob, fileName);
      }
    } catch {
      setIsFileError(true);
    }
  };

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isParametersError) onParametersError();
  }, [isParametersError, onParametersError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (openDetails && report.requestGuid) {
      getReportParameters(report.requestGuid);
      setIsReportStatusCheck(askStatus);
    }
  }, [askStatus, getReportParameters, openDetails, report.requestGuid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let intervalId: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;

    if (isReportStatusCheck) {
      // Функция для проверки статуса
      const checkStatus = () => {
        if (currentReportStatus === 'completed' || currentReportStatus === 'error') {
          setIsReportStatusCheck(false);
          getReportParameters(report.requestGuid);
          if (intervalId) {
            clearInterval(intervalId);
            intervalId = null;
          }
          return;
        }

        getReportStatus(report.requestGuid).unwrap();
      };

      // Запускаем интервал
      intervalId = setInterval(checkStatus, 3000);

      // Выполняем первую проверку сразу
      checkStatus();
    }

    return () => {
      if (intervalId) {
        clearInterval(intervalId);
      }
    };
  }, [
    isReportStatusCheck,
    currentReportStatus,
    getReportParameters,
    getReportStatus,
    report.requestGuid,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fileId = report.fileList?.[0]?.fileId;
    if (openDetails && fileId) {
      checkReportFile(fileId);
    }
  }, [checkReportFile, openDetails, report.fileList]);

  const onDismiss = useCallback(() => {
    dispatch(setReorderData(null));
    dispatch(setCurrentRequestGuid(null));
    setOpenDetails(false);
    onParametersErrorClear();
  }, [dispatch, setOpenDetails, onParametersErrorClear]);

  const handleReOrder = useCallback(() => {
    dispatch(setReorderData(reportParameters));
    navigate(ROUTE_REPORTS);
  }, [dispatch, navigate, reportParameters]);

  const statusColorName = textStatusColors[currentReportStatus || report.requestStatusCode];
  const isCompleted =
    currentReportStatus === 'completed' || report.requestStatusCode === 'completed';
  const isNew = currentReportStatus === 'new' || report.requestStatusCode === 'new';
  const showReorderButton = isCompleted || isNew;

  const canDownload =
    report.downloadable &&
    !isFileError &&
    !isErrorResponseType(fileData) &&
    !(fileData as ErrorData)?.error &&
    isCompleted;

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
      open={openDetails}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      header={
        <CheckHeader
          variant={reportColors[statusColorName]}
          orderTypeName={report.reportTypeName}
          instrumentIcon={<PdfSvg />}
          indicator={reportBadge[statusColorName]}
          title={
            currentReportStatus ? testStatusNames[currentReportStatus] : report.requestStatusName
          }
        />
      }
      footer={
        <div className={styles.footer}>
          {canDownload && (
            <Button variant="link" onClick={handleDownloadFile}>
              Открыть документ
            </Button>
          )}

          <div className={styles.buttons}>
            {showReorderButton && (
              <Button
                disabled={!reportParameters?.reportTypeId}
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={handleReOrder}
              >
                Перезаказать
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button onClick={onDismiss}>Закрыть</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.border}>
          <DetailsItem title={'Инвестиционный счёт'} content={report.productName} />
          <DetailsItem title={'Лицевой счёт'} content={report.portfolioName} />
          <DetailsItem title={'Договор'} content={report.agreementName} />
          <DetailsItem
            title={'За период'}
            content={
              report.toDate && report.fromDate
                ? visualIsoPeriodFormatter(report.fromDate, report.toDate)
                : report.fromDate
                ? visualDateFormatter(report.fromDate)
                : '-'
            }
          />
          <DetailsItem title={'Дата заказа'} content={orderDateReformat(report.requestTime)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default BottomSheetDetails;

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { ActionCell, StatusHistory, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { reportsSelector } from 'core/reports/reportsSelector';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { orderDateReformat } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import {
  visualIsoDateFormatter,
  visualIsoPeriodFormatter,
} from 'modules/ReportsPage/components/ReportsOrder/helper';

import { ReactComponent as PdfSvg } from 'images/icons/file-icon-pdf.svg';

import { ReportItem, ReportStatus } from 'types/reports';

import BottomSheetDetails from '../BottomSheetDetails';
import styles from './ReportListItem.module.pcss';

interface ReportListItemProps {
  item: ReportItem;
  isReady: boolean;
  onParametersError: () => void;
  onParametersErrorClear: () => void;
  isMobile: boolean;
}

const statuses: { [K in ReportStatus]: StatusHistory | undefined } = {
  completed: 'suscess',
  error: 'error',
  new: undefined,
  processing: 'attension',
};

const ReportListItem = ({
  item,
  isReady,
  isMobile,
  onParametersError,
  onParametersErrorClear,
}: ReportListItemProps) => {
  const [openDetails, setOpenDetails] = useState(false);

  const { currentRequestGuid } = useAppSelector(reportsSelector);

  const handleDetails = useCallback(() => {
    setOpenDetails(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentRequestGuid === item.requestGuid) {
      handleDetails();
    }
  }, [item.requestGuid, currentRequestGuid, handleDetails]);

  const title = item.toDate && item.fromDate && item.toDate === item.fromDate ? 'Дата' : 'Период';

  return (
    <>
      <ActionCell
        onClick={handleDetails}
        className={styles.cell}
        addonBottom={
          <div className={styles.addonBottom}>
            <Text type="labelMedium" color="colorForeground2">
              {title}
            </Text>
            <Text type="labelMedium">
              {item.toDate && item.fromDate && item.toDate !== item.fromDate
                ? visualIsoPeriodFormatter(item.fromDate, item.toDate)
                : item.fromDate
                ? visualIsoDateFormatter(item.fromDate)
                : '-'}
            </Text>
          </div>
        }
        description={
          <>
            <p>{item.productName}</p>
            <p>{item.portfolioName}</p>
          </>
        }
        iconLeft={<PdfSvg className={styles.pdfIcon} />}
        statusData={orderDateReformat(item.requestTime)}
        statusText={isReady ? 'Готово' : item.requestStatusName}
        status={isReady ? 'suscess' : statuses[item.requestStatusCode]}
        title={item.reportTypeName}
        variant="history"
      />

      <BottomSheetDetails
        openDetails={openDetails}
        setOpenDetails={setOpenDetails}
        report={item}
        askStatus={!!currentRequestGuid && currentRequestGuid === item.requestGuid}
        onParametersError={onParametersError}
        onParametersErrorClear={onParametersErrorClear}
        isMobile={isMobile}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default ReportListItem;

import { getFilterDateFormat } from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';

  reportTypeCode: 'all',

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import { Button, DatePicker, Filter, FilterBar, Placeholder, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetReportsParametersQuery } from 'core/api/reports';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';
import { reportsSelector } from 'core/reports/reportsSelector';
import { setCurrentRequestGuid } from 'core/reports/reportsSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import CommonHeadSheet from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/CommonHeadSheet';
import OrderSkeleton from 'modules/OrderHistory/components/OrderSkeleton';
import {
  getDatePickerFormat,
  getFilterDateFormat,
  getNTPDateName,
  getYearFromJSDate,
} from 'modules/OrderHistory/helpers';
import { useReportHistory } from 'modules/ReportsPage/hooks/useReportHistory';

import { ReactComponent as EmptySvg } from 'images/birds/birds-empty-content.svg';
import { ReactComponent as NotConnectedSvg } from 'images/birds/birds-no-connect.svg';

import { ReportHistoryFilters, ReportType, ReportsReadyNotificatorResponse } from 'types/reports';

import Skeleton from '../ReportsOrder/Skeleton';
import ReportSelectItem from '../ReportsOrder/components/ReportSelectItem';
import styles from './ReportsHistory.module.pcss';
import ReportListItem from './components/ReportListItem';
import {
  REPORT_HISTORY_FILTER_PERIOD_KEY,
  ReportsPeriodTypes,
  defaultFilterPeriod,
  defaultFilterType,
  defaultFilters,
} from './constants';

const ReportsHistory = () => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { currentRequestGuid } = useAppSelector(reportsSelector);
  const [typeBottomSheet, setTypeBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [periodBottomSheet, setPeriodBottomSheet] = useState(false);
  const [selectPeriod, setSelectPeriod] = useState<ReportsPeriodTypes>(
    sessionStorage[REPORT_HISTORY_FILTER_PERIOD_KEY] || defaultFilterPeriod,
  );
  const [selectReportType, setSelectReportType] = useState<ReportType>(defaultFilterType);

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<ReportHistoryFilters>(defaultFilters);
  const [startReportGuidsListener, setStartReportGuidsListener] = useState(false);
  const [readyReportGuids, setReadyReportGuids] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isErrorReportParameters, setIsErrorReportParameters] = useState(false);

  const { data: reportRequests, isLoading } = useReportHistory(filters);
  const { data: reportParams } = useGetReportsParametersQuery();

  const reportTypeList = useMemo(
    () => [defaultFilterType, ...(reportParams?.reportTypes || [])],
    [reportParams?.reportTypes],
  );

  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentRequestGuid) setStartReportGuidsListener(true);
  }, [currentRequestGuid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!startReportGuidsListener) return;
    const listener = (data: ReportsReadyNotificatorResponse) => {
      const list = data.response.AsyncProcessList || [];
      setReadyReportGuids((oldList) => {
        const newGuids = list.filter((guid) => !oldList.includes(guid));
        return [...oldList, ...newGuids];
      });
    };
    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('ReportReady', listener);
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [startReportGuidsListener]);

  const handleResetAllFilters = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectPeriod(defaultFilterPeriod);
    setSelectReportType(defaultFilterType);
    setFilters(defaultFilters);
  }, []);

  const handleResetPeriodFilter = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectPeriod(defaultFilterPeriod);
    setPeriodBottomSheet(false);
  }, []);

  const handleSubmitFilterDates = useCallback((dates: Date[]) => {
    const { startDate, endDate } = getFilterDateFormat(dates);
    setFilters((oldFilters) => ({
      ...oldFilters,
      fromDate: startDate,
      toDate: endDate,
    }));
    setPeriodBottomSheet(false);
  }, []);

  const handleSelectReportType = (item: ReportType) => {
    setSelectReportType(item);
    setFilters((oldFilters) => ({
      ...oldFilters,
      reportTypeId: item.reportTypeId,
      reportTypeCode: item.code,
    }));
    setTypeBottomSheet(false);
  };

  const handleBackToHistoryClick = useCallback(() => {
    setIsErrorReportParameters(false);
    dispatch(setCurrentRequestGuid(null));
  }, [dispatch]);

  const reportTypeItems = reportTypeList.map((item) => (
    <ReportSelectItem
      key={item.code}
      name={item.name}
      selected={selectReportType?.code === item.code}
      onClick={() => handleSelectReportType(item)}
    />
  ));

  const datePickerFormat = useMemo(
    () => getDatePickerFormat(filters.fromDate, filters.toDate),
    [filters.fromDate, filters.toDate],
  );

  const yearFromJSDate = useMemo(() => getYearFromJSDate(filters.toDate), [filters.toDate]);

  const isActivePeriodReset = defaultFilterPeriod !== selectPeriod;

  const showResetFilters =
    defaultFilters.fromDate !== filters.fromDate ||
    defaultFilters.toDate !== filters.toDate ||
    defaultFilters.reportTypeCode !== filters.reportTypeCode;

  if (isErrorReportParameters) {
    return (
      <Placeholder
        title={'При запросе произошла ошибка'}
        text={'Повторите попытку позднее'}
        variant={'error'}
        shape={'emptyState'}
        img={<NotConnectedSvg />}
        buttons={
          <Button
            style={{ maxWidth: 300 }}
            variant={'secondary'}
            onClick={handleBackToHistoryClick}
          >
            Вернуться к Истории обращений
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <FilterBar className={styles.filtersWrapper}>
          {showResetFilters && <Filter shape={'reset'} onClick={handleResetAllFilters} />}
          <Filter
            shape={'select'}
            active={isActivePeriodReset}
            text={getNTPDateName(
              filters.fromDate || defaultFilters.fromDate,
              filters.toDate || defaultFilters.toDate,
              selectPeriod,
            )}
            onClick={() => setPeriodBottomSheet(!periodBottomSheet)}
            onClose={handleResetPeriodFilter}
          />
          <Filter
            shape={'select'}
            text={selectReportType?.name}
            onClick={() => setTypeBottomSheet(!typeBottomSheet)}
          />
        </FilterBar>
        <div className={styles.content} onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
          {isLoading ? (
            <OrderSkeleton count={4} />
          ) : (
            <div>
              {reportRequests?.length ? (
                <>
                  {reportRequests?.map((item) => (
                    <ReportListItem
                      key={item.requestGuid}
                      item={item}
                      isReady={readyReportGuids.includes(item.requestGuid)}
                      onParametersError={() => setIsErrorReportParameters(true)}
                      onParametersErrorClear={() => setIsErrorReportParameters(false)}
                      isMobile={isMobile}
                    />
                  ))}
                </>
              ) : (
                <Placeholder
                  shape="emptyState"
                  title="Здесь пока пусто"
                  text="Нет ранее заказанных отчётов"
                  img={<EmptySvg />}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <BottomSheetComponent
        open={typeBottomSheet}
        onDismiss={() => setTypeBottomSheet(false)}
        className={cx(styles.bottomSheet, styles.bsWrap, {
          [styles.bsWrapFixed]: !typeBottomSheet,
        })}
      >
        <div className={styles.bottomSheetHeader}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Тип отчёта или справки</Text>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.selectList}>{isLoading ? <Skeleton /> : reportTypeItems}</div>
      </BottomSheetComponent>

      <BottomSheetComponent
        open={periodBottomSheet}
        onDismiss={() => setPeriodBottomSheet(false)}
        onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className={cx(styles.bottomSheet, styles.bsWrap, {
          [styles.bsWrapFixed]: !periodBottomSheet,
        })}
      >
        <div className={styles.bottomSheetHeader}>
          <CommonHeadSheet
            name="Период"
            handleSubmit={handleResetPeriodFilter}
            activeBtn={selectPeriod !== defaultFilterPeriod}
          />
        </div>
        <DatePicker
          onSubmit={handleSubmitFilterDates}
          periodPreset
          dates={datePickerFormat}
          currentYear={yearFromJSDate}
          customOptionsPeriodPreset={['month', 'quarter', 'year']}
          onSetOptionPeriodPreset={(p) => p !== 'day' && setSelectPeriod(p)}
          defaultOptionPeriodPreset={selectPeriod}
        />
      </BottomSheetComponent>
    </>
  );
};

export default ReportsHistory;

import React from 'react';

import IconButton from '@vision/icon-button';
import Input, { IInputProps } from '@vision/input';

import { ReactComponent as CloseSvg } from 'images/icons/search/close.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SearchSvg } from 'images/icons/search/search.svg';

import styles from './InstrumentSearch.module.pcss';

type InstrumentSearchProps = {
  onClearButtonClick?: (event?: React.MouseEvent) => void;
} & IInputProps;

const InstrumentSearch = ({ value, onClearButtonClick, ...props }: InstrumentSearchProps) => {
  const addonBefore = (
    <div className={styles.addonBefore}>
      <SearchSvg />
    </div>
  );

  const addonAfter = value && value?.length > 0 && (
    <div className={styles.addonAfterContainer}>
      <IconButton onClick={onClearButtonClick}>
        <CloseSvg />
      </IconButton>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Input
      value={value}
      addonBefore={addonBefore}
      addonAfter={addonAfter}
      className={styles.input}
      placeholder={'Поиск по названию или тикеру'}
      {...props}
    />
  );
};

export default InstrumentSearch;

import React, { useCallback } from 'react';
import { useDebounce } from 'react-use';

import { BottomSheet, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyGetDepoInstrumentsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentDepo';

import { DepoInstrumentItem } from 'types/reports';

import { InstrumentCard } from '../InstrumentCard';
import InstrumentSearch from '../InstrumentSearch';
import styles from './InstrumentSearchBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type InstrumentSearchBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onInstrumentClick?: (instrument: DepoInstrumentItem | null) => void;
  searchText: string;
  onSearchTextChange?: (text: string) => void;
};

const InstrumentSearchBottomSheet = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  onInstrumentClick,
  searchText,
  onSearchTextChange,
}: InstrumentSearchBottomSheetProps) => {
  const [getInstruments, { data, isFetching }] = useLazyGetDepoInstrumentsQuery();

  const handleSearchChange = useCallback(
    (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      onSearchTextChange?.(event.target.value);
    },
    [onSearchTextChange],
  );

  const searchInstruments = useCallback(() => {
    if (searchText.length < 3) return;
    getInstruments({ searchText: searchText, maxCount: 16 });
  }, [getInstruments, searchText]);

  useDebounce(searchInstruments, 300, [searchText]);

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onClose}
      defaultSnap={({ maxHeight }) => maxHeight / 2}
      snapPoints={({ maxHeight }) => [maxHeight / 2]}
    >
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <InstrumentSearch
          value={searchText}
          onChange={handleSearchChange}
          className={styles.inputBottomSheet}
          onClearButtonClick={() => {
            onSearchTextChange && onSearchTextChange('');
          }}
        />
        {searchText.length < 3 ? (
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            <Text color={'colorForeground2'}>Введите ISIN или название инструмента</Text>
          </div>
        ) : isFetching ? (
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            <CircleLoader brandColor />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className={styles.instrumentContainer}>
            {data?.map((instrument) => {
              return (
                <InstrumentCard
                  key={`${instrument.instrumentId}_${instrument.depoInstrumentId}`}
                  onClick={() => onInstrumentClick?.(instrument)}
                  instrumentName={instrument.name}
                  {...instrument}
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default InstrumentSearchBottomSheet;

import { memo } from 'react';

import { Input } from '@aurora/components';

import styles from './ReportFormInput.module.pcss';
import { ReportInputNames, inputLabelsByName } from './constants';

interface ReportFormInputProps {
  className?: string;
  onClick?(name: ReportInputNames): void;
  name: ReportInputNames;
  value?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

const ReportFormInput = ({ className, name, value, disabled, onClick }: ReportFormInputProps) => (
  <div className={className} onClick={() => onClick?.(name)}>
    <Input
      disabled={disabled}
      name={name}

      value={value}
      addonAfter={<ArrowDown />}
      className={styles.input}
      placeholder={`Выберите из списка`}
      variant={undefined}
    />
  </div>
);

export default memo(ReportFormInput);

import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { CreateReportRequest, ReportParameter } from 'types/reports';

export const timeFormat = 'HH:mm';

export const visualPeriodFormatter = (dateFrom: string, dateTo: string) => {
  const parsedDateFrom = DateTime.fromFormat(dateFrom, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
  const parsedDateTo = DateTime.fromFormat(dateTo, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);

  if (parsedDateFrom && parsedDateTo) {
    return `${dateFrom} - ${dateTo}`;
  }

  const partsDateFrom = dateFrom.split('-');
  const formattedDateFrom = `${partsDateFrom[2]}.${partsDateFrom[1]}.${partsDateFrom[0]}`;

  const partsDateTo = dateTo.split('-');
  const formattedDateTo = `${partsDateTo[2]}.${partsDateTo[1]}.${partsDateTo[0]}`;

  return `${formattedDateFrom} - ${formattedDateTo}`;
};

export const visualIsoPeriodFormatter = (dateFrom: string, dateTo: string) => {
  const dtFrom = DateTime.fromISO(dateFrom);
  const dtTo = DateTime.fromISO(dateTo);

  return `${dtFrom.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)} - ${dtTo.toFormat(
    DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT,
  )}`;
};

export const visualIsoDateFormatter = (date: string) => {
  const dt = DateTime.fromISO(date);

  return dt.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
};

export const validateReportForm = (
  parameters: ReportParameter[],
  data: CreateReportRequest | null,
) => {
  if (!data?.reportTypeId) return false;

  let isValid = true;
  parameters.forEach((param) => {
    if (param.required) {
      if (param.parameter === 'Date' && !data?.fromDate) {
        isValid = false;
        return;
      }

      if (param.parameter === 'Period' && !(data?.fromDate && data?.toDate)) {
        isValid = false;
        return;
      }

      if (param.parameter === 'Product' && !data?.productId) {
        isValid = false;
        return;
      }

      if (param.parameter === 'Portfolio' && !data?.portfolioId) {
        isValid = false;
        return;
      }

      if (param.parameter === 'DepoAccount' && !data?.depoAccountId) {
        isValid = false;
        return;
      }

      if (param.parameter === 'Agreement' && !data?.agreementId) {
        isValid = false;
        return;
      }

      if (param.parameter === 'Instrument' && !data?.instrumentId) {
        isValid = false;
        return;
      }
    }
  });

  return isValid;
};
