import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import {
  BannerWarningLine,
  BottomSheet,
  Button,
  DatePicker,
  Headline,
  Input,
  Placeholder,
  Switch,
  Text,
} from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { ROUTE_PROFILE } from 'const/routes';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import { visualDateFormatter } from 'modules/PersonalInformation/components/Passport/helper';
import { useReportOrder } from 'modules/ReportsPage/hooks/useReportOrder';

import { ReactComponent as SomethingWrongSvg } from 'images/birds/birds-broken-pen.svg';
import { ReactComponent as NotConnectedSvg } from 'images/birds/birds-no-connect.svg';
import { ReactComponent as Calendar } from 'images/icons/calendarI.svg';
import { ReactComponent as InfoBadgeIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/bannerWarningBadge.svg';

import { DepoInstrumentItem, ReportDepoAccountParameter, ReportType } from 'types/reports';

import { ReportsPeriodTypes } from '../ReportsHistory/constants';
import styles from './ReportsOrder.module.pcss';
import Skeleton from './Skeleton';
import InstrumentSearchBottomSheet from './components/InstrumentSearchBottomSheet';
import ReportFormInput from './components/ReportFormInput';
import { ReportInputNames, bsTitleByInputName } from './components/ReportFormInput/constants';
import ReportSelectItem from './components/ReportSelectItem';
import { defaultOrderPeriod } from './constants';
import { validateReportForm, visualPeriodFormatter } from './helper';

const ReportsOrder = () => {
  const [bottomSheetOpen, setBottomSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bottomSheetDateOpen, setBottomSheetDateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bottomSheetPeriodOpen, setBottomSheetPeriodOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bottomSheetEmailConfirm, setBottomSheetEmailConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [currentInput, setCurrentInput] = useState<ReportInputNames>('reportType');
  const [dateError, setDateError] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [periodError, setPeriodError] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [selectPeriod, setSelectPeriod] = useState<ReportsPeriodTypes>(defaultOrderPeriod);
  const [openSearchInstrument, setOpenSearchInstrument] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [searchInstrumentText, setSearchInstrumentText] = useState<string>('');

  const { data: hintsResult } = useGetHintsQuery();
  const reportToEmailText = hintsResult?.hints.find(
    (item) => item.slug === 'REPORT_TO_EMAIL',
  )?.text;

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const {
    handleFormSubmit,
    setReportTypeSelected,
    setSelectedInstrument,
    setSelectedDepoAccount,
    setFormData,
    formData,
    paramsData,
    reportPeriodEnable,
    reportTypeSelected,
    selectedInstrument,
    selectedDepoAccount,
    parameters,
    isLoading,
    isErrorParameters,
    email,
    isStatusLoading,
    isStatusError,
    isCreateReportError,
  } = useReportOrder();

  const handleInputClick = useCallback((name: ReportInputNames) => {
    setBottomSheetOpen(true);
    setCurrentInput(name);
  }, []);

  const handleChangeEmail = useCallback(() => {
    navigate(ROUTE_PROFILE);
  }, [navigate]);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    setBottomSheetEmailConfirm(false);
    handleFormSubmit();
  };

  const onReportTypeSelect = useCallback(
    (item: ReportType) => {
      setReportTypeSelected(item);
      setFormData((oldData) => ({ ...oldData, reportTypeId: item.reportTypeId }));
      setBottomSheetOpen(false);
    },
    [setFormData, setReportTypeSelected],
  );

  const onProductSelect = useCallback(
    (id?: number) => {
      setFormData((oldData) => ({ ...oldData, productId: id }));
      setBottomSheetOpen(false);
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  const onPortfolioSelect = useCallback(
    (id?: number) => {
      setFormData((oldData) => ({ ...oldData, portfolioId: id }));
      setBottomSheetOpen(false);
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  const onDepoAccountSelect = useCallback(
    (item: ReportDepoAccountParameter) => {
      setSelectedDepoAccount(item);
      setFormData((oldData) => ({ ...oldData, depoAccountId: item.depoAccountId }));
      setBottomSheetOpen(false);
    },
    [setFormData, setSelectedDepoAccount],
  );

  const onAgreementSelect = useCallback(
    (id?: number) => {
      setFormData((oldData) => ({ ...oldData, agreementId: id }));
      setBottomSheetOpen(false);
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  const handleSearchInstrumentClick = useCallback(() => {
    setOpenSearchInstrument(true);
  }, []);

  const handleInstrumentClick = useCallback(
    (instrument: DepoInstrumentItem | null) => {
      setSelectedInstrument(instrument);
      setFormData((oldData) => ({ ...oldData, instrumentId: instrument?.instrumentId }));
      setOpenSearchInstrument(false);
    },
    [setFormData, setSelectedInstrument],
  );

  const onDateSubmit = useCallback(
    (e: Date[]) => {
      const currentDate = e[0];
      if (!currentDate) return;
      setFormData((oldData) => ({
        ...oldData,
        fromDate: DateTime.fromJSDate(new Date(currentDate)).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT),
      }));
      setBottomSheetDateOpen(false);
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  const onPeriodSubmit = useCallback(
    (e: Date[]) => {
      if (!(e?.[0] && e?.[1])) return;

      const paramsMinDate = paramsData.dates?.[0]?.minFromDate
        ? DateTime.fromISO(paramsData.dates[0].minFromDate)
        : undefined;
      const paramsMaxDate = paramsData.dates?.[0]?.maxToDate
        ? DateTime.fromISO(paramsData.dates[0].maxToDate)
        : undefined;

      const fromDate = DateTime.fromFormat(e[0].toLocaleDateString(), DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
      const toDate = DateTime.fromFormat(e[1].toLocaleDateString(), DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);

      setFormData((oldData) => ({
        ...oldData,
        fromDate:
          paramsMinDate && fromDate < paramsMinDate
            ? paramsMinDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)
            : fromDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT),
        toDate:
          paramsMaxDate && toDate > paramsMaxDate
            ? paramsMaxDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)
            : toDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT),
      }));
      setBottomSheetPeriodOpen(false);
    },
    [paramsData.dates, setFormData],
  );

  const onSendEmailChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      setFormData((oldData) => ({ ...oldData, sendViaEmail: e.target.checked }));
    },
    [setFormData],
  );

  const dateController = useCallback(
    () => setDateError(formData?.fromDate?.length === 0),
    [formData?.fromDate],
  );

  const periodController = useCallback(
    () => setPeriodError(formData?.fromDate?.length === 0 || formData?.toDate?.length === 0),
    [formData?.fromDate?.length, formData?.toDate?.length],
  );

  const reportTypeItems = paramsData.types.map((item) => (
    <ReportSelectItem
      key={item.code}
      name={item.name}
      selected={reportTypeSelected?.code === item.code}
      onClick={() => onReportTypeSelect(item)}
    />
  ));

  const reportProductItems = paramsData.products.map((item) => (
    <ReportSelectItem
      key={`${item.productId}_${item.reportTypeId}_${item.name}`}
      name={item.name}
      selected={formData?.productId === item.productId}
      onClick={() => onProductSelect(item.productId)}
    />
  ));

  const reportPortfolioItems = paramsData.portfolios?.map((item) => (
    <ReportSelectItem
      key={`${item.portfolioId}_${item.reportTypeId}_${item.name}`}
      name={item.name}
      selected={formData?.portfolioId === item.portfolioId}
      onClick={() => onPortfolioSelect(item.portfolioId)}
    />
  ));

  const reportDepoAccItems = paramsData.depoAccounts?.map((item) => (
    <ReportSelectItem
      key={`${item.depoAccountId}_${item.reportTypeId}_${item.name}`}
      name={item.name}
      selected={formData?.depoAccountId === item.depoAccountId}
      onClick={() => onDepoAccountSelect(item)}
    />
  ));

  const reportAgreementItems = paramsData.agreements?.map((item) => (
    <ReportSelectItem
      key={`${item.agreementId}_${item.reportTypeId}_${item.name}`}
      name={item.name}
      selected={formData?.agreementId === item.agreementId}
      onClick={() => onAgreementSelect(item.agreementId)}
    />
  ));

  const isFormValid = useMemo(
    () => validateReportForm(parameters, formData),
    [formData, parameters],
  );

  if (isErrorParameters) {
    return (
      <Placeholder
        title={'При запросе произошла ошибка'}
        text={'Повторите попытку позднее'}
        variant={'error'}
        shape={'emptyState'}
        img={<NotConnectedSvg />}
      />
    );
  }

  if (isCreateReportError || isStatusError) {
    return (
      <Placeholder
        title={'Что-то пошло не так'}
        text={'Повторите попытку или попробуйте позднее'}
        variant={'error'}
        shape={'emptyState'}
        img={<SomethingWrongSvg />}
        actionButtonText="Обновить"
        onActionButtonClick={handleFormSubmit}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Headline size="s" title="Заказать онлайн" />

      <ReportFormInput
        name="reportType"
        value={reportTypeSelected?.name}
        className={styles.reportType}
        onClick={handleInputClick}
      />

      <div className={styles.formWrapper}>
        {parameters.map((param) => {
          return {
            Date: (
              <div onClick={() => setBottomSheetDateOpen(true)}>
                <Input
                  onChange={(e) => null}
                  placeholder=""
                  label="Дата"
                  value={visualDateFormatter(formData?.fromDate || '')}
                  className={styles.input}
                  status={dateError ? 'error' : undefined}
                  description={dateError && 'Введите корректную дату'}
                  onBlur={dateController}
                  onFocus={dateController}
                  addonAfter={<Calendar />}
                />
              </div>
            ),
            Period: (
              <div onClick={() => reportPeriodEnable && setBottomSheetPeriodOpen(true)}>
                <Input
                  disabled={!reportPeriodEnable}
                  onChange={(e) => null}
                  placeholder="Выберите период"
                  label="Период"
                  value={
                    formData?.fromDate && formData?.toDate
                      ? visualPeriodFormatter(formData?.fromDate || '', formData?.toDate || '')
                      : ''
                  }
                  className={styles.input}
                  status={periodError ? 'error' : undefined}
                  description={periodError && 'Введите корректый период'}
                  onBlur={periodController}
                  onFocus={periodController}
                  addonAfter={<Calendar />}
                />
              </div>
            ),
            Portfolio: (
              <ReportFormInput
                disabled={!formData?.productId}
                name="portfolio"
                value={
                  paramsData.portfolios.find((item) => item.portfolioId === formData?.portfolioId)
                    ?.name || ''
                }
                onClick={handleInputClick}
              />
            ),
            Product: (
              <ReportFormInput
                disabled={!formData?.reportTypeId}
                name="product"
                value={
                  paramsData.products.find((item) => item.productId === formData?.productId)
                    ?.name || ''
                }
                onClick={handleInputClick}
              />
            ),
            DepoAccount: (
              <ReportFormInput
                disabled={!formData?.reportTypeId}
                name="depoAccount"
                value={
                  paramsData.depoAccounts.find(
                    (item) => item.depoAccountId === formData?.depoAccountId,
                  )?.name || ''
                }
                onClick={handleInputClick}
              />
            ),
            Agreement: (
              <ReportFormInput
                disabled={!formData?.reportTypeId}
                name="agreement"
                value={
                  paramsData.agreements.find((item) => item.agreementId === formData?.agreementId)
                    ?.name || ''
                }
                onClick={handleInputClick}
              />
            ),
            Instrument: (
              <div onClick={handleSearchInstrumentClick}>
                <Input
                  onChange={(e) => null}
                  disabled={!selectedDepoAccount}
                  placeholder="Выберите ценную бумагу"
                  label="Наименование ЦБ"
                  value={selectedInstrument?.name || undefined}
                  className={styles.input}
                  onFocus={(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => event.target.blur()}
                  variant={undefined}
                />
              </div>
            ),
          }[param.parameter];
        })}

        {reportTypeSelected?.code === 'DepoSecurityPos' && (
          <>
            <Input
              disabled
              name="isin"
              label="ISIN-код"
              value={selectedInstrument?.isin || undefined}
              className={styles.input}
              variant={undefined}
            />
            <Input
              disabled
              name="issuerName"
              label="Эмитент"
              value={selectedInstrument?.issuerName || undefined}
              className={styles.input}
              variant={undefined}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className={styles.buttonWrapper}>
        {email && (
          <Switch
            onChange={onSendEmailChange}
            checked={formData?.sendViaEmail}
            label="Отправить документ с электронной подписью на почту"
          />
        )}

        {reportToEmailText && (
          <BannerWarningLine
            variant="attention"
            addonLeft={<InfoBadgeIcon />}
            title={<span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sanitizeHtml(reportToEmailText) }} />}
            className={styles.banner}
          />
        )}

        <Button
          loading={isStatusLoading}
          disabled={!isFormValid || isStatusLoading}
          onClick={
            formData?.sendViaEmail ? () => setBottomSheetEmailConfirm(true) : handleFormSubmit
          }
        >
          {isStatusLoading ? 'Отправка...' : 'Заказать отчёт'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetOpen}
        onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetOpen(false)}
        className={cx(styles.wrap, { [styles.bsWrapFixed]: !bottomSheetOpen })}
      >
        <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>{bsTitleByInputName[currentInput]}</Text>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.selectList}>
          {isLoading ? (
            <Skeleton />
          ) : (
            <>
              {' '}
              {
                {
                  reportType: reportTypeItems,
                  product: reportProductItems,
                  portfolio: reportPortfolioItems,
                  depoAccount: reportDepoAccItems,
                  agreement: reportAgreementItems,
                  instrument: [],
                }[currentInput]
              }
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>

      <InstrumentSearchBottomSheet
        open={openSearchInstrument}
        onClose={() => setOpenSearchInstrument(false)}
        searchText={searchInstrumentText}
        onSearchTextChange={setSearchInstrumentText}
        onInstrumentClick={handleInstrumentClick}
      />

      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetDateOpen}
        onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetDateOpen(false)}
        onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className={cx(styles.wrap, { [styles.bsWrapFixed]: !bottomSheetDateOpen })}
      >
        <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Выберите дату</Text>
        </div>

        <DatePicker withPeriod={false} withOptions={false} onSubmit={onDateSubmit} />
      </BottomSheet>

      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetPeriodOpen}
        onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetPeriodOpen(false)}
        onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className={cx(styles.wrap, { [styles.bsWrapFixed]: !bottomSheetPeriodOpen })}
      >
        <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Выберите период</Text>
        </div>

        <DatePicker
          periodPreset
          customOptionsPeriodPreset={['day', 'month', 'year']}
          onSetOptionPeriodPreset={(p) => setSelectPeriod(p)}
          defaultOptionPeriodPreset={selectPeriod}
          onSubmit={onPeriodSubmit}
          minDate={
            paramsData.dates?.[0]?.minFromDate
              ? DateTime.fromISO(paramsData.dates[0].minFromDate).toJSDate()
              : undefined
          }
          maxDate={
            paramsData.dates?.[0]?.maxToDate
              ? DateTime.fromISO(paramsData.dates[0].maxToDate).toJSDate()
              : undefined
          }
        />
      </BottomSheet>

      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetEmailConfirm}
        onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetEmailConfirm(false)}
        onTouchMove={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        className={cx(styles.wrap, { [styles.bsWrapFixed]: !bottomSheetEmailConfirm })}
      >
        <div className={styles.BHtitle}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>Подтверждение отправки</Text>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.selectList}>
          <Text type="bodyRegular">
            {`${reportTypeSelected?.name} будет отправлен на почту `}
            <Text inline type="bodySemiBold">
              {email}
            </Text>
          </Text>

          <Button onClick={handleSubmit}>Отправить</Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleChangeEmail}>
            Изменить почту
          </Button>
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default ReportsOrder;

  'При запросе произошла ошибка. Повторите попытку позднее.';

import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { useLazyGetReportsHistoryQuery } from 'core/api/reports';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

import { ReportHistoryFilters } from 'types/reports';

import { DEFAULT_QUERY_ERROR_MESSAGE } from '../constants';

export const useReportHistory = (filters: ReportHistoryFilters) => {
  const [getReportsHistory, { data, isLoading, isError }] = useLazyGetReportsHistoryQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    getReportsHistory(filters);
  }, [filters, getReportsHistory]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isError &&
      createAlertNotification({
        text: DEFAULT_QUERY_ERROR_MESSAGE,
        status: 'error',
      });
  }, [isError]);

  return {
    data,
    isLoading,
  };
};

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { ROUTE_REPORTS_HISTORY } from 'const/routes';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import {
  useCreateReportMutation,
  useGetReportsParametersQuery,
  useLazyGetReportStatusQuery,
} from 'core/api/reports';
import { getReportsParametersWithData } from 'core/reports/helpers';
import { reportsSelector } from 'core/reports/reportsSelector';
import { setCurrentRequestGuid, setReorderData } from 'core/reports/reportsSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import {
  CreateReportRequest,
  DepoInstrumentItem,
  ReportDepoAccountParameter,
  ReportType,
} from 'types/reports';

export const useReportOrder = () => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { reOrderData } = useAppSelector(reportsSelector);
  const [reportTypeSelected, setReportTypeSelected] = useState<ReportType | null>(null);
  const [selectedInstrument, setSelectedInstrument] = useState<DepoInstrumentItem | null>(null);
  const [selectedDepoAccount, setSelectedDepoAccount] = useState<ReportDepoAccountParameter | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateReportRequest | null>(null);
  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useGetReportsParametersQuery();
  const [getReportStatus, { isLoading: isStatusLoading, isError: isStatusError }] =
    useLazyGetReportStatusQuery();
  const [createReport, { isError: isCreateReportError }] = useCreateReportMutation();

  const reportTypes = useMemo(() => data?.reportTypes || [], [data?.reportTypes]);

  const reportProductList = useMemo(
    () =>
      data?.reportProductParameters?.filter(
        (item) => item.reportTypeId === formData?.reportTypeId,
      ) || [],
    [formData, data],
  );

  const reportPortfolioList = useMemo(
    () =>
      data?.reportPortfolioParameters?.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.reportTypeId === formData?.reportTypeId && item.productId === formData?.productId,
      ) || [],
    [formData, data],
  );

  const reportDepoAccountList = useMemo(
    () =>
      data?.reportDepoAccountParameters?.filter(
        (item) => item.reportTypeId === formData?.reportTypeId,
      ) || [],
    [formData, data],
  );

  const reportDateList = useMemo(
    () =>
      data?.reportDates?.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.reportTypeId === formData?.reportTypeId &&
          ((item.reportTypeId === 1 &&
            item.productId === formData?.productId &&
            item.portfolioId === formData?.portfolioId) ||
            ([3, 5].includes(item.reportTypeId) && item.depoAccountId === formData?.depoAccountId)),
      ) || [],
    [formData, data],
  );

  const reportPeriodEnable = useMemo(
    () =>
      (formData?.reportTypeId === 1 && formData?.productId && formData?.portfolioId) ||
      (formData?.reportTypeId &&
        [3, 5].includes(formData?.reportTypeId) &&
        formData?.depoAccountId),
    [formData],
  );

  const reportAgreementList = useMemo(
    () =>
      data?.reportAgreementParameters?.filter(
        (item) => item.reportTypeId === formData?.reportTypeId,
      ) || [],
    [formData, data],
  );

  const reportTypesObject = useMemo(() => (data ? getReportsParametersWithData(data) : {}), [data]);
  const parameters = useMemo(
    () => (reportTypeSelected ? reportTypesObject[reportTypeSelected?.code] || [] : []),
    [reportTypeSelected, reportTypesObject],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const repTypesData = data?.reportTypes || [];
    if (repTypesData.length) {
      //** если вернули с перезаказа отчета - заполняем данными Перезаказа */
      if (reOrderData?.reportTypeId) {
        const reportType = repTypesData.find((rt) => rt.reportTypeId === reOrderData?.reportTypeId);
        if (reportType) {
          setReportTypeSelected(reportType);
          const fromDate = reOrderData.fromDate
            ? DateTime.fromISO(reOrderData.fromDate).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)
            : undefined;
          const toDate = reOrderData.toDate
            ? DateTime.fromISO(reOrderData.toDate).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT)
            : undefined;
          setFormData({
            reportTypeId: reOrderData.reportTypeId,
            productId: reOrderData.productId,
            portfolioId: reOrderData.portfolioId,
            depoAccountId: reOrderData.depoAccountId,
            agreementId: reOrderData.agreementId,
            fromDate: fromDate,
            toDate: toDate,
          });
        }
      } else {
        //** иначе - заполняем дефолтные данные по брокерскому отчету */
        const reportType = repTypesData.find((rt) => rt.code === 'BrokRep');
        if (reportType) {
          setReportTypeSelected(reportType);

          const firstProductId = data?.reportProductParameters?.find(
            (item) => item.reportTypeId === reportType.reportTypeId,
          )?.productId;
          const firstPortfolioId = firstProductId
            ? data?.reportPortfolioParameters?.find(
                (item) =>
                  item.reportTypeId === reportType.reportTypeId &&
                  item.productId === firstProductId,
              )?.portfolioId
            : undefined;

          const today = DateTime.now().toFormat('dd.MM.yyyy');
          const yesterday = DateTime.now().minus({ days: 1 }).toFormat('dd.MM.yyyy');

          setFormData({
            reportTypeId: reportType.reportTypeId,
            productId: firstProductId,
            portfolioId: firstPortfolioId,
            fromDate: yesterday,
            toDate: today,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }, [reOrderData, data]);

  const handleFormSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (formData) {
      dispatch(setReorderData(null));

      try {
        const createResult = await createReport(formData).unwrap();
        const guid = createResult?.reportRequest?.[0]?.requestGuid;
        if (guid) {
          dispatch(setCurrentRequestGuid(guid));
          const statusResult = await getReportStatus(guid).unwrap();
          if (statusResult) {
            navigate(ROUTE_REPORTS_HISTORY);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      }
    }
  }, [createReport, dispatch, formData, getReportStatus, navigate]);

  return {
    formData,
    setFormData,
    reportTypeSelected,
    setReportTypeSelected,
    selectedInstrument,
    setSelectedInstrument,
    selectedDepoAccount,
    setSelectedDepoAccount,
    parameters,
    isLoading,
    isErrorParameters: isError,
    paramsData: {
      types: reportTypes,
      products: reportProductList,
      portfolios: reportPortfolioList,
      depoAccounts: reportDepoAccountList,
      agreements: reportAgreementList,
      dates: reportDateList,
    },
    reportPeriodEnable,
    email: data?.eMail?.[0]?.eMail,
    handleFormSubmit,
    isStatusLoading,
    isStatusError,
    isCreateReportError,
  };
};

import { FC } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Headline, Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { PERMISSION_PERSON_REPORTING } from 'modules/ReportsPage/constants';

import { HeaderPage, SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as BlockedSvg } from 'images/plug/unavailable-birds.svg';

import styles from './ReportsPage.module.pcss';
import { pageTabs } from './constants';

const ReportsPage: FC = ({ children }) => {
  const isPermissionGranted = Permissions.granted(PERMISSION_PERSON_REPORTING);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const goBackToProfile = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
  };

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage
          title="Отчёты и справки"
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={goBackToProfile}
        />
      ) : (
        <Headline className={styles.headlineDesktop} title="Отчёты и справки" />
      )}

      {isPermissionGranted ? (
        <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
          tabs={pageTabs}
          classNameContent={cx(styles.contentWrapper, {
            [styles.contentWrapperDesktop]: !isMobile,
          })}
          classNameWrapper={cx(styles.tabsWrapper, { [styles.tabsWrapperDesktop]: !isMobile })}
        >
          {children}
        </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
      ) : (
        <Placeholder
          className={styles.placeholder}
          title={'Раздел недоступен'}
          text={'У вас нет прав на просмотр этого раздела'}
          variant={'error'}
          shape={'emptyState'}
          img={<BlockedSvg />}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default ReportsPage;

import React, { FC, useState } from 'react';

import BottomSheetComponent from '@aurora/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Text from '@aurora/text';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

export type BottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
};

const DeleteModal: FC<BottomSheetProps> = ({ onClose, open, onDelete }) => {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(open);

  const handleClose = () => {
    setOpened(false);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheetComponent
      open={opened}
      onDismiss={handleClose}
      style={{ position: 'relative', zIndex: 1000 }}
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <Text type="subtitleBold">Уверены, что хотите удалить реквизиты?</Text>
        <Text className={styles.bottomText} type="labelMedium" color="colorForeground2">
          Отменить действие не получится
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.bottomBtns}>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleClose}>
            Отмена
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={onDelete}>
            Удалить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </BottomSheetComponent>
  );
};

export default DeleteModal;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Checkbox from '@aurora/checkbox';
import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import { ROUTE_DELETE_REQUISITE_SUCCESS } from 'const/routes';

import { useConfirmMutation } from 'core/api/requisites';

import useDownloadFile from 'hooks/useDownloadFile';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell';

import { DeleteRequisitesResponse } from 'types/requisites';

import RequisiteErrorPage from '../RequisiteErrorPage';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type StatusType = 'def' | 'sms';

const ApprovePage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [checkAgreement, setCheckAgreement] = useState(false);
  const location = useLocation();
  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading }] = useConfirmMutation();
  const { checkSum, ftpPath } = location.state as DeleteRequisitesResponse;
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<StatusType>('def');
  const [btnCount, setBtnCount] = useState<number>(0);

  const { file } = useDownloadFile({
    url: ftpPath,
  });

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    if (status === 'sms') {
      setStatus('def');
    } else {
      navigate(-1);
    }
  };

  const handleSuccess = () => navigate(ROUTE_DELETE_REQUISITE_SUCCESS);

  const confirmHandler = () => {
    setBtnCount((prev) => ++prev);
    setStatus('sms');
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (btnCount === 1) getSms();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [btnCount]);

  if (ftpPath === '' || !ftpPath) {
    return <RequisiteErrorPage />;
  }

  if (isSmsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
        <HeaderPage
          title={'СМС-подтверждение'}
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        />

        <CircleLoader brandColor />
        <Text>Запрос СМС-кода...</Text>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {status === 'def' ? (
        <div className={styles.root}>
          <HeaderPage
            title={isSmsLoading ? 'SMS-подтверждение' : ''}
            leftIconVariant="back"
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          />
          <div className={styles.main}>
            <Text type="title">Подтверждение заявки</Text>
            <Text className={styles.text} type="bodyRegular">
              Подтвердите согласие и подпишите файлы с помощью SMS
            </Text>
            <div className={styles.document}>
              <DocumentCell
                url={file?.url}
                name={'Заявление об удалении реквизитов'}
                id={`ID: ${checkSum}`}
              />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.divider} />
            <Checkbox
              checked={checkAgreement}
              onChange={() => setCheckAgreement(!checkAgreement)}
              label="Подтверждаю корректность данных в Заявлении"
            />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.bottom}>
            <Text type="lineMedium" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.info}>
              Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
            </Text>
            <Button
              onClick={confirmHandler}
              className={styles.btn}
              variant="primary"
              disabled={!checkAgreement}
            >
              Подтвердить
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <SmsConfirmation
          initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
          smsInputCount={4}
          onSuccess={handleSuccess}
          onError={() => console.log('Error')}
          onBackClick={() => setStatus('def')}
          loaderChildren={<Text>Удаление реквизитов...</Text>}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default ApprovePage;

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_DELETE_REQUISITE } from 'const/routes';

import { useDeleteMutation } from 'core/api/requisites';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import quizResultsErrorSrc from 'images/icons/quiz-results-error.png';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const RequisiteErrorPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { deleteId } = useAppSelector((state) => state.requisite);

  const [
    deleteRequisite,
    { data: deleteData, isSuccess: isDeleteSuccess, isLoading: isDeleteLoading },
  ] = useDeleteMutation();

  const onClose = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const handleApproveDelete = () => {
    deleteId && deleteRequisite(deleteId);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDeleteSuccess) navigate(ROUTE_DELETE_REQUISITE, { state: deleteData });
  }, [deleteData, isDeleteSuccess, navigate]);

  if (isDeleteLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage title="" leftIconVariant="close" onLeftIconClick={onClose} />

      <div className={styles.root}>
        <div className={cx(styles.main, styles.errorIconWrapper)}>
          <img alt="" src={quizResultsErrorSrc} />
        </div>

        <div className={styles.bottom}>
          <div className={styles.status}>Ошибка</div>
          <Text type="title" className={styles.wrongTitle}>
            Что-то пошло не так
          </Text>
          <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.errorText}>
            Не удалось сохранить введённые реквизиты. Повторите попытку позже.
          </Text>
          <Button variant="primary" className={styles.button} onClick={handleApproveDelete}>
            Обновить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default RequisiteErrorPage;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Button from '@aurora/button';
import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import { ROUTE_DELETE_REQUISITE } from 'const/routes';

import { useDeleteMutation } from 'core/api/requisites';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { setDeleteId } from 'core/requisite/requisiteSlice';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { BankDetails } from 'types/requisites';

import DeleteModal from './components/DeleteModal';
import InfoItem from './components/InfoItem';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const RequisitePage = () => {
  const [modalOpened, setModalOpened] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const handleBackClick = () => navigate(-1);
  const location = useLocation();
  const localState = location.state as BankDetails;
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const {
    bankDetailsId,
    payee,
    bankName,
    bic,
    currencyName,
    checkingAccount,
    currencyCode,
    cardAccount,
    paymentPurpose,
    corrAccount,

    benBankAccount,
    benBankName,
    benBankSwift,
  } = localState;

  const [
    deleteRequisite,
    { data: deleteData, isSuccess: isDeleteSuccess, isLoading: isDeleteLoading },
  ] = useDeleteMutation();

  const handleApproveDelete = () => {
    setModalOpened(false);
    deleteRequisite(bankDetailsId);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(setDeleteId(bankDetailsId));
  }, [dispatch, bankDetailsId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDeleteSuccess) navigate(ROUTE_DELETE_REQUISITE, { state: deleteData });
  }, [deleteData, isDeleteSuccess, navigate]);

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        title={!isDeleteLoading ? 'Информация о реквизитах' : 'Удаление реквизитов'}
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
      />
      <div className={styles.root}>
        {isDeleteLoading ? (
          <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
            <CircleLoader brandColor />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className={styles.main}>
              {currencyCode === 'RUB' ? (
                <>
                  <InfoItem label="Получатель" value={payee} />
                  <InfoItem label="Наименование банка" value={bankName} />
                  <InfoItem label="БИК" value={bic} />
                  <InfoItem label="Расчётный счёт	" value={checkingAccount} />
                  <InfoItem label="Валюта" value={currencyName} />
                  {cardAccount && <InfoItem label="Номер карты" value={cardAccount} />}
                  {paymentPurpose && <InfoItem label="Назначение платежа" value={paymentPurpose} />}
                  {corrAccount && <InfoItem label="Корреспондентский счёт" value={corrAccount} />}
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <InfoItem label="Получатель" value={payee} />
                  <InfoItem label="Банк получателя" value={benBankName} />
                  <InfoItem label="SWIFT банка получателя" value={benBankSwift} />
                  <InfoItem label="Расчётный счёт в банке получателя" value={benBankAccount} />
                  <InfoItem label="Валюта" value={currencyName} />
                </>
              )}
            </div>
            {!Permissions.denied('PERSON_BANKDETAILS_DELETE') && (
              <div className={styles.bottom}>
                <Button
                  disabled={Permissions.blocked('PERSON_BANKDETAILS_DELETE')}
                  variant="negative"
                  onClick={() => setModalOpened(true)}
                >
                  Удалить реквизиты
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}

            {modalOpened && (
              <DeleteModal
                open={modalOpened}
                onClose={() => setModalOpened(false)}
                onDelete={handleApproveDelete}
              />
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default RequisitePage;

import React, { FC, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';

import cx from 'classnames';

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { Context } from 'modules/RequisitesPage/RequisitesPage';
import { getTouchEventData } from 'modules/RequisitesPage/helpers';

import { ReactComponent as ArrowSvg } from 'images/icons/arrow-left.svg';
import { ReactComponent as TrashIcon } from 'images/icons/trashcan.svg';

import { BankDetails } from 'types/requisites';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type RequisiteProps = {
  className?: string;
  bankDetails: BankDetails;
  swiped: boolean;
};

const RequisiteCard: FC<RequisiteProps> = ({ bankDetails, className, swiped }) => {
  const context = useContext(Context);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [currentElRightPos, setCurrentElRightPos] = useState(0);
  const [currentStartPos, setCurrentStartPos] = useState(0);
  const [currentOffset, setCurrentOffset] = useState(0);
  const [isSwiped, setIsSwiped] = useState(swiped);

  const maxOffset = 80;

  const onTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent<HTMLDivElement> | React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    setCurrentStartPos(getTouchEventData(e).clientX);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onTouchMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onTouchEnd);
    window.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
    window.addEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
  };

  const onTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent | MouseEvent) => {
    const currentX = getTouchEventData(e).clientX;

    setCurrentOffset(Math.ceil(currentElRightPos - currentX));

    if (Math.ceil(currentElRightPos - currentX) > 5) {
      setCurrentOffset(maxOffset);
      setIsSwiped(true);
      context?.setIsSwiped(true);
      context?.setSwipedId(bankDetails.bankDetailsId);
    }

    if (Math.ceil(currentElRightPos - currentX) <= 0 || currentStartPos < currentX) {
      setCurrentOffset(0);
      setIsSwiped(false);
      context?.setSwipedId(null);
      context?.setIsSwiped(false);
    }
  };

  const onTouchEnd = () => {
    window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onTouchMove);
    window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onTouchEnd);
    window.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove);
    window.removeEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (containerRef.current) {
      setCurrentElRightPos(containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect().right);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = () => {
    setCurrentOffset(0);
    setIsSwiped(false);
    context?.onSwipe();
    context?.setSwipedId(bankDetails.bankDetailsId);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (context?.isSwiped && context.swipedId === bankDetails.bankDetailsId) {
      setCurrentOffset(maxOffset);
      setIsSwiped(true);
      context?.setIsSwiped(true);
      context?.setSwipedId(bankDetails.bankDetailsId);
    } else {
      setCurrentOffset(0);
      setIsSwiped(false);
      context?.setIsSwiped(false);
    }
  }, [context?.swipedId]);

  const transform = isSwiped ? maxOffset : Math.ceil(currentOffset);

  const swipeAllowed =
    !Permissions.blocked('PERSON_BANKDETAILS_DELETE') &&
    !Permissions.denied('PERSON_BANKDETAILS_DELETE');

  return (
    <div
      className={cx(styles.root, className)}
      {...(swipeAllowed && { onTouchStart, onMouseDown: onTouchStart })}
    >
      <div
        className={cx(styles.rootWrapper, { [styles.swiped]: isSwiped })}
        style={{
          userSelect: 'none',
          touchAction: 'pan-y',
          transform: `translate3d(${-transform}px, 0, 0)`,
        }}
        ref={containerRef}
      >
        <Link
          to={`/requisites/${bankDetails.bankDetailsId}`}
          state={bankDetails}
          aria-label={bankDetails.name}
          className={styles.link}
        />

        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          {bankDetails.name}
          <div className={styles.arrowWrapper}>
            <ArrowSvg />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" className={styles.btn} onClick={handleDelete}>
        <TrashIcon />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default RequisiteCard;

import React, { FC, useContext, useMemo } from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';

import { Context } from 'modules/RequisitesPage/RequisitesPage';

import { ReactComponent as EmptyIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/empty.svg';

import { BankDetails } from 'types/requisites';

import RequisiteCard from '../RequisiteCard';

type RequisitesListProps = {
  className?: string;

};

        </Text>
      </div>
    );
  }, [list]);

  return <div className={className}>{content}</div>;
};

import React, { createContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_DELETE_REQUISITE, ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE, ROUTE_WITHDRAWAL } from 'const/routes';

import { useDeleteMutation, useGetAllRequisitesQuery } from 'core/api/requisites';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { setDeleteId } from 'core/requisite/requisiteSlice';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import DeleteModal from 'modules/RequisitePage/components/DeleteModal';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as BlockedIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/blocked.svg';
import { ReactComponent as PhoneIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/phone.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ErrorIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-wrong.svg';

import RequisitesList from './components/RequisitesList';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type TContext = {
  swipedId: number | null;
  setSwipedId: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<any>>;
  isSwiped: boolean;
  setIsSwiped: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>;
  setCloseModal: () => void;
  onSwipe: () => void;
} | null;

export const Context = createContext<TContext>(null);

const RequisitesPage = () => {
  const [isSwiped, setIsSwiped] = useState(false);
  const [swipedId, setSwipedId] = useState<number>(0);
  const [modalOpened, setModalOpened] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const {
    data: requisitesListData,
    isError: isGetRequisitesError,
    isLoading: isGetLoading,
  } = useGetAllRequisitesQuery();
  const [
    deleteRequisite,
    {
      data: deleteData,
      isSuccess: isDeleteSuccess,
      isLoading: isDeleteLoading,
      isError: isDeleteError,
    },
  ] = useDeleteMutation();

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    if (isGetRequisitesError && isDeleteError && isDeleteLoading && isGetLoading) {
      navigate(-1);
    } else {
      navigate(ROUTE_WITHDRAWAL);
    }
  };

  const isBlocked =
    Permissions.blocked('PERSON_BANKDETAILS') || Permissions.denied('PERSON_BANKDETAILS');

  const handleButtonClick = () => {
    if (isBlocked) handleBackClick();
    else navigate(ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE);
  };

  const handleApproveDelete = () => {
    setModalOpened(false);
    deleteRequisite(swipedId);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(setDeleteId(swipedId));
  }, [dispatch, swipedId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDeleteSuccess) navigate(ROUTE_DELETE_REQUISITE, { state: deleteData });
  }, [deleteData, isDeleteSuccess, navigate]);

  if (isGetRequisitesError || isDeleteError) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage title="" leftIconVariant="close" onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick} />

        <div className={styles.root}>
          <div className={cx(styles.main, styles.errorIconWrapper)}>
            <ErrorIcon />
          </div>

          <div className={styles.bottom}>
            <div className={styles.status}>Ошибка</div>
            <Text type="title" className={styles.wrongTitle}>
              Что-то пошло не так
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.errorText}>
              {`Не удалось ${
                isGetRequisitesError ? 'загрузить список реквизитов' : 'удалить реквизиты'
              }. Повторите попытку позже.`}
            </Text>
            <Button variant="primary" className={styles.button} onClick={() => navigate(0)}>
              Обновить
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  if (isDeleteLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
        <HeaderPage
          title={'Удаление реквизитов'}
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        />
        <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        title={!isGetRequisitesError ? 'Банковские реквизиты' : ''}
        leftIconVariant={!isGetRequisitesError ? 'back' : 'close'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        showDivider
      />
      <div className={styles.root}>
        {Permissions.granted('PERSON_BANKDETAILS') &&
          requisitesListData &&
          (isGetLoading ? (
            <CircleLoader brandColor />
          ) : (
            <>
              <Context.Provider
                value={{
                  onSwipe: () => setModalOpened(true),
                  setSwipedId,
                  isSwiped,
                  setIsSwiped,
                  swipedId,
                  setCloseModal: () => setModalOpened(false),
                }}
              >
                <RequisitesList list={requisitesListData?.bankDetails} className={styles.main} />
              </Context.Provider>

              {modalOpened && (
                <DeleteModal
                  open={modalOpened}
                  onClose={() => setModalOpened(false)}
                  onDelete={handleApproveDelete}
                />
              )}
            </>
          ))}

        {isBlocked && (
          <div className={cx(styles.main, styles.blocked)}>
            <BlockedIcon />
            <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.title}>
              Раздел недоступен
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              У вас нет прав на просмотр этого раздела
            </Text>
            <a href="tel:88007751945" className={styles.call}>
              <PhoneIcon />
              Позвонить брокеру
            </a>
          </div>
        )}

        {!Permissions.denied('PERSON_BANKDETAILS_CREATE') && (
          <div className={styles.bottom}>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              className={styles.button}
              onClick={handleButtonClick}
              disabled={Permissions.blocked('PERSON_BANKDETAILS_CREATE')}
            >
              {!isBlocked ? 'Добавить реквизиты' : 'Вернуться назад'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default RequisitesPage;

import { PaymentArray } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

export const generateQRValue = (
  item: Pick<
    PaymentArray,
    'payee' | 'bankAccount' | 'bankName' | 'bic' | 'corrAccount' | 'inn' | 'kpp' | 'paymentPurpose'
  >,
) => {
  const value =
    'ST00012|' +
    `Name=${item.payee}|` +
    `PersonalAcc=${item.bankAccount}|` +
    `BankName=${item.bankName}|` +
    `BIC=${item.bic}|` +
    `CorrespAcc=${item.corrAccount}|` +
    `PayeeINN=${item.inn}|` +
    `KPP=${item.kpp}|` +
    `Purpose=${item.paymentPurpose}`;

  return value;
};

import React, { memo, useCallback } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { BankDetails } from 'types/requisites';

import BankDetailsQRCode from '../BankDetailsQRCode';
import InfoItem from '../InfoItem';
import styles from './RequisiteBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type RequisiteBottomSheetProps = {
  openDetails: boolean;
  setOpenDetails: (openDetails: boolean) => void;
  bankDetails: BankDetails;
};

const RequisiteBottomSheet: React.FC<RequisiteBottomSheetProps> = ({
  bankDetails,
  openDetails,
  setOpenDetails,
}) => {
  const {
    payee,
    bankName,
    bic,
    currencyName,
    bankAccount,
    currencyCode,
    cardAccount,
    paymentPurpose,
    corrAccount,

    benBankAccount,
    benBankName,
    benBankSwift,
  } = bankDetails;

  const onDismiss = useCallback(() => {
    setOpenDetails(false);
  }, [setOpenDetails]);

  return (
    <AdaptivePopup onDismiss={onDismiss} open={openDetails} className={styles.bottomSheet}>
      <div className={styles.root}>
        <Text type={'subtitleSemiBold'} className={styles.title}>
          Информация о реквизитах
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.main}>
          {currencyCode === 'RUB' ? (
            <>
              <InfoItem label="Получатель" value={payee} />
              <InfoItem label="Наименование банка" value={bankName} />
              <InfoItem label="БИК" value={bic} />
              <InfoItem label="Расчётный счёт	" value={bankAccount} />
              <InfoItem label="Валюта" value={currencyName} />
              {cardAccount && <InfoItem label="Номер карты" value={cardAccount} />}
              {paymentPurpose && <InfoItem label="Назначение платежа" value={paymentPurpose} />}
              {corrAccount && <InfoItem label="Корреспондентский счёт" value={corrAccount} />}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <InfoItem label="Получатель" value={payee} />
              <InfoItem label="Банк получателя" value={benBankName} />
              <InfoItem label="SWIFT банка получателя" value={benBankSwift} />
              <InfoItem label="Расчётный счёт в банке получателя" value={benBankAccount} />
              <InfoItem label="Валюта" value={currencyName} />
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {bankDetails && <BankDetailsQRCode bankDetails={bankDetails} />}
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopup>
  );
};

export default memo(RequisiteBottomSheet);

import { FC, useMemo } from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';

import { ReactComponent as EmptyIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/empty.svg';

import { BankDetails } from 'types/requisites';

import RequisiteCard from '../RequisiteCard';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type RequisitesListProps = {
  className?: string;
  list: BankDetails[];
};

const getRequisiteSortOrder = (name: string) => {
  if (name.includes('ФР МБ')) {
    return 0;
  }
  if (name.includes('ФР СБП')) {
    return 1;
  }
  return 2;
};

const RequisitesList: FC<RequisitesListProps> = ({ className, list }) => {
  const sortedList = useMemo(
    () => [...list].sort((a, b) => getRequisiteSortOrder(a.name) - getRequisiteSortOrder(b.name)),
    [list],
  );

  const content = useMemo(() => {
    return sortedList.length ? (
      <>
        {sortedList.map((bankDetails) => (
          <RequisiteCard
            key={`${bankDetails.bankDetailsId}-${bankDetails.bankAccount}`}
            bankDetails={bankDetails}
          />
        ))}
      </>
    ) : (
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <EmptyIcon />
        <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.title}>
          Список реквизитов пуст
        </Text>
        <Text type="bodyRegular">
          Добавьте реквизиты, чтобы воспользоваться ими для вывода средств на банковский счёт
        </Text>
      </div>
    );
  }, [sortedList]);

  return <div className={className}>{content}</div>;
};

export default RequisitesList;

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_TRANSFERS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetAllBankDetailsQuery } from 'core/api/requisites';

import { MONEY_REQUISITES_PAGE_TITLE } from 'modules/Transfers/constants';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ErrorIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-wrong.svg';

import RequisitesList from './components/RequisitesList';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const RequisitesViewPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const {
    data: requisitesListData,
    isError: isGetRequisitesError,
    isLoading: isGetLoading,
  } = useGetAllBankDetailsQuery();

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_TRANSFERS);
  };

  const headerPageMobile = (
    <HeaderPage
      title={MONEY_REQUISITES_PAGE_TITLE}
      documentTitle={MONEY_REQUISITES_PAGE_TITLE}
      leftIconVariant="back"
      onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
      showDivider
    />
  );

  const headlineDesktop = <Text className={styles.pageTitle}>{MONEY_REQUISITES_PAGE_TITLE}</Text>;

  if (isGetRequisitesError) {
    return (
      <>
        {isMobile ? (
          <HeaderPage title="" leftIconVariant="close" onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick} />
        ) : (
          headlineDesktop
        )}

        <div className={styles.root}>
          <div className={cx(styles.main, styles.errorIconWrapper)}>
            <ErrorIcon />
          </div>

          <div className={styles.bottom}>
            <div className={styles.status}>Ошибка</div>
            <Text type="title" className={styles.wrongTitle}>
              Что-то пошло не так
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.errorText}>
              {`Не удалось загрузить список реквизитов. Повторите попытку позже.`}
            </Text>
            <Button variant="primary" className={styles.button} onClick={() => navigate(0)}>
              Обновить
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? headerPageMobile : headlineDesktop}
      <div className={styles.root}>
        {requisitesListData &&
          (isGetLoading ? (
            <CircleLoader brandColor />
          ) : (
            <RequisitesList list={requisitesListData?.bankDetails} className={styles.main} />
          ))}
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default RequisitesViewPage;

  //   isLoading: isCodewordLoading,
  //   isError: isCodewordStateError,
  // } = useGetCodewordStateQuery();

  const isTradePasswordDenied = Permissions.denied(TRADE_PASSWORD_PERMISSION_FIELD);
  const isTradePasswordBlocked = Permissions.blocked(TRADE_PASSWORD_PERMISSION_FIELD);
  //const isCodewordDenied = Permissions.denied(CODEWORD_PERMISSION_FIELD);
  //const isCodewordBlocked = Permissions.blocked(CODEWORD_PERMISSION_FIELD);
  //const isCodewordChangedDenied = Permissions.denied(PERSON_CODEWORD_CHANGE);
  //const isBlocked = isCodewordBlocked || isCodewordChangedDenied;

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [bottomSheetsState, setBottomSheetsState] = useState<BottomSheetsState>(null);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isOpenTradePasswordConfirmation, setIsOpenTradePasswordConfirmation] = useState(false);

  const Tooltip = (
    <Hint
      content={tooltipContent}
      placement={'bottomRight'}
      portal={true}
      titleClassName={styles.hint}
    />
  );

  const handleBottomSheetClose = () => {
    isOpen && setIsOpen(false);
    bottomSheetsState && setBottomSheetsState(null);
  };

  const handleTradePasswordCellClick = () => {
    if (!isSessionTradeSignStateError) {
      !isTradePasswordBlocked && setBottomSheetsState('tradePassword');
    } else {
      navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
    }
  };

  // const handleCodewordCellClick = () => {
  //   if (!isCodewordStateError) {
  //     !isBlocked && setBottomSheetsState('codeword');
  //   } else {
  //     navigate(ROUTE_CODE_WORD_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
  //   }
  // };

  const handleDeleteTradingPasswordConfirm = () => {
    isMobile ? navigate(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_DELETE) : setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDeleteTradingPasswordClick = () => {
    setBottomSheetsState('confirm');
  };

  //const { handleNavigateToLK } = useMoveToLKAuthToken();

  if (isSessionTradeSignStateLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.loaderContainer : styles.loaderContainerDesktop}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.cardContainer : styles.cardContainerDesktop}>
      <HeaderPage documentTitle={'Настройки'} className={styles.header} hide />
      <StartScreen />
      {!isTradePasswordDenied && (
        <Card withShadow className={styles.card}>
          <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.cardTitle}>
            Безопасность
          </Text>
          {/*        <ActionCell
          title="PIN-код для входа в систему"
          onClick={handleNavigateToLK(LK_ROUTE_PROFILE_PASSWORD_CHANGE)}
          separator={true}
          iconLeft={<LKPasswordSvg />}
          addonRight
        />*/}
          <ActionCell
            title="Торговый пароль"
            description={'Для операций покупки и продажи'}
            onClick={handleTradePasswordCellClick}
            separator={true}
            iconLeft={<TradePasswordSvg />}
            addonRight={isTradePasswordBlocked ? Tooltip : true}
            arrowRight={!isTradePasswordBlocked}
            hover={!isTradePasswordBlocked}
            classNameTitle={cx({ [styles.disableCell]: isTradePasswordBlocked })}
          />

          {/*
        {!isCodewordDenied && (
          <ActionCell
            title="Кодовое слово"
            description={'Для вашей идентификации'}
            onClick={handleCodewordCellClick}
            separator={false}
            iconLeft={<CodeWordSvg />}
            addonRight={isBlocked ? Tooltip : true}
            arrowRight={!isBlocked}
            hover={!isBlocked}
            classNameTitle={cx({ [styles.disableCell]: isBlocked })}
          />
        )} */}
        </Card>
      )}

      <AdaptivePopup
        open={bottomSheetsState === 'tradePassword'}
        onDismiss={handleBottomSheetClose}
      >
        <TradePasswordBottomSheet
          tradePasswordState={sessionTradeSignState?.tradePasswordState}
          onDeleteCellClick={handleDeleteTradingPasswordClick}
        />
      </AdaptivePopup>

      <AdaptivePopup
        open={bottomSheetsState === 'confirm'}
        onDismiss={handleBottomSheetClose}
        classNameContent={styles.popupContent}
      >
        {!isOpen ? (
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            <Text type="subtitleBold">Уверены, что хотите удалить торговый пароль?</Text>
            <Text className={styles.bottomText} type="lineRegular">
              Без пароля вы не сможете подавать торговые поручения в личном кабинете и мобильном
              приложении.
            </Text>
            <Text className={styles.bottomText} type="lineRegular">
              Подтвердите удаление, и мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения.
            </Text>
            <div className={styles.bottomButtons}>
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleBottomSheetClose}>
                Нет
              </Button>
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleDeleteTradingPasswordConfirm}>
                Да
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className={styles.smsWrapper}>
            {!isOpenTradePasswordConfirmation ? (
              <TradePasswordDelete
                setIsOpenTradePasswordConfirmation={setIsOpenTradePasswordConfirmation}
              />
            ) : (
              <TradePasswordConfirmation />
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </AdaptivePopup>

      {/* <CodewordBottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetsState === 'codeword'}
        onDismiss={handleBottomSheetClose}
        isExist={isExist}
      /> */}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Settings;

import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { useGetBondsQuery, useGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { CATALOG_BONDS, CATALOG_TYPE_REQUEST } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';
import { useCatalogFilters } from 'modules/Catalog/hooks';
import Showcase from 'modules/Showcases/components/Showcase/Showcase';
import { parseInstrumentShowcaseBonds } from 'modules/Showcases/utils';

import { TCategoryType } from 'types/catalog';

import { CATEGORIES, DEFAULT_BONDS_EBNZ_FILTERS, DEFAULT_BONDS_FILTERS, TITLE } from './store';

const Bonds = () => {
  const groupCode = 'actual_bond';
  const { actualBond } = getSession() || {};

  const [allFilters, setAllFilters] = useCatalogFilters();
  const categoryType = allFilters.bonds.category;
  const currentCategory = useMemo(() => categoryType || CATALOG_TYPE_REQUEST.OFZ, [categoryType]);

  const [category, setCategory] = useState<TCategoryType>(currentCategory);

  const {
    data: bonds,
    isLoading: isBondsLoading,
    isError: isBondsError,
  } = useGetBondsQuery(
    {
      category,
      ...DEFAULT_BONDS_FILTERS,
      ...(category !== CATALOG_TYPE_REQUEST.EBNZ && DEFAULT_BONDS_EBNZ_FILTERS),
    },
    { skip: actualBond },
  );

  const {
    data: showcaseGroup,
    isLoading: isShowcaseGroupLoading,
    isError: isShowcaseGroupError,
  } = useGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery({ groupCode, rowsCount: 20 }, { skip: !actualBond });

  const instuments = actualBond
    ? showcaseGroup?.showcaseInstrument
    : bonds?.instrumentShowcaseBonds;

  const isLoading = isBondsLoading || isShowcaseGroupLoading;
  const isError = isBondsError || isShowcaseGroupError;

  const parsedInstruments = useMemo(
    () => (instuments && parseInstrumentShowcaseBonds(instuments)) || [],
    [instuments],
  );

  const handleChangeCategory = useCallback((category: string) => {
    setCategory(category as TCategoryType);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const setFilter = {
      ...allFilters,
      bonds: {
        ...allFilters.bonds,
        category,
      },
    };

    setAllFilters(setFilter);
  }, [category, allFilters]);

  return (
    <Showcase
      activeCategory={currentCategory}
      categories={!actualBond ? CATEGORIES : undefined}
      formattedBalanceSymbolType="arrow"
      formattedBalanceVariant="labelMedium"
      instruments={parsedInstruments}
      isLoading={isLoading}
      maxInstrumentNameLines={2}
      name={TITLE}
      onCategoryChange={handleChangeCategory}
      toDetails={CATALOG_BONDS}
      stateTo={{ stateParams: category }}
      isError={isError}
    />
  );
};

export default memo(Bonds);

import { FC, memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import { useGetEquitiesQuery, useGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import Showcase from 'modules/Showcases/components/Showcase/Showcase';
import { parseInstrumentShowcaseEquities } from 'modules/Showcases/utils';

import { CATEGORIES } from './store';

const Equities: FC = () => {
  const category = 'RCE.1';
  const groupCode = 'actual_equities';

  const { actualEquities } = getSession() || {};

  const {
    data: showcaseEquities,
    isLoading: isEquitiesLoading,
    isError: isEquitiesError,
  } = useGetEquitiesQuery(
    {
      category: category,
      rowsCount: 20,
      sorting: 'PRICE_6_MONTHS-',
    },
    { skip: actualEquities },
  );

  const {
    data: showcaseGroup,
    isLoading: isShowcaseGroupLoading,
    isError: isShowcaseGroupError,
  } = useGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery({ groupCode, rowsCount: 20 }, { skip: !actualEquities });

  const instruments = actualEquities
    ? showcaseGroup?.showcaseInstrument
    : showcaseEquities?.instrumentShowcaseEquities;

  const isLoading = isEquitiesLoading || isShowcaseGroupLoading;
  const isError = isEquitiesError || isShowcaseGroupError;

  const parsedInstruments = useMemo(
    () => (instruments && !isError && parseInstrumentShowcaseEquities(instruments)) || [],
    [instruments, isError],
  );

  const toDetails = useMemo(
    () => CATEGORIES.find((item) => item.category === category)?.link,
    [category],
  );

  return (
    <Showcase
      categories={CATEGORIES}
      formattedBalanceSymbolType="arrow"
      formattedBalanceVariant="labelMedium"
      instruments={parsedInstruments}
      isLoading={isLoading}
      name="Акции"
      toDetails={toDetails}
      isError={isError}
    />
  );
};

export default memo(Equities);

import { useGetETFQuery, useGetShowcaseFavoritesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';

import React from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Card from '@aurora/card';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENT } from 'const/routes';

import FormattedBalance from 'components/Balance/FormattedBalance';
import { InstrumentIcon, SubIcon } from 'components/Instrument';

import { InstrumentCardProps } from '../../types';
import styles from './InstrumentCard.module.pcss';

const InstrumentCard: React.FC<InstrumentCardProps> = ({
  currencyCode,
  diff,
  formattedBalanceSymbolType,
  formattedBalanceVariant,
  hasInvestIdea,
  hasPriceThreshold,
  hasStopOrder,
  id,
  img,
  instrumentCategory,
  isFavorite,
  maxLines = 1,
  name,
  subtitle,
  value,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const handleClick = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENT, { instrument: id }));
  };

  //**TODO: временное ограничение для прода */
  const isTestMode = !process.env.TIER || process.env.TIER === 'tt';

  return (
    <Card size={'medium'} className={styles.card} onClick={isTestMode ? handleClick : undefined}>
      <div className={cn(styles.icon, styles.cardItem)}>
        <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={img} />
        <SubIcon
          hasInvestIdea={hasInvestIdea}
          hasPriceThreshold={hasPriceThreshold}
          hasStopOrder={hasStopOrder}
          isFavorite={isFavorite}
          className={styles.subIcon}
        />
      </div>
      <p
        className={cn(styles.name, styles.cardItem)}
        style={{ '--max-lines': maxLines } as React.CSSProperties}
      >
        {name}
      </p>

      {instrumentCategory && !/ETF/.test(instrumentCategory) && (
        <div className={styles.cardItem}>
          <FormattedBalance
            diff={diff}
            value={value}
            type={formattedBalanceVariant}
            currency={currencyCode}
            symbolType={formattedBalanceSymbolType}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {subtitle && (
        <div className={styles.cardItem}>
          <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
            {subtitle}
          </Text>
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
};

export default InstrumentCard;

import { FC, memo, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';
// eslint-disable-next-line import/no-unresolved
import { Swiper as SwiperType } from 'swiper/types';

import { InstrumentCardsProps } from '../../types';
import InstrumentCard from '../InstrumentCard/InstrumentCard';
import styles from '../InstrumentCards/Instruments.module.pcss';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/pagination';

const InstrumentCards: FC<InstrumentCardsProps> = ({
  formattedBalanceSymbolType,
  formattedBalanceVariant,
  instrumentCategory,
  instruments,
  maxInstrumentNameLines,
}) => {
  const [swiper, setSwiper] = useState<SwiperType>();

  useEffect(() => {
    swiper?.slideTo(0, 0);
  }, [instruments]);

  if (!instruments || instruments.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Swiper
        onSwiper={setSwiper}
        slidesPerView="auto"
        spaceBetween={8}
        className={styles.swiper}
        touchMoveStopPropagation={true}
        touchStartPreventDefault={true}
        preventClicksPropagation={true}
      >
        {instruments
          .map((item) => {
            if (!item.name) return null;

            return (
              <SwiperSlide key={`instrument-card-${item.id}`} className={styles.slider}>
                <InstrumentCard
                  {...item}
                  formattedBalanceSymbolType={formattedBalanceSymbolType}
                  formattedBalanceVariant={formattedBalanceVariant}
                  instrumentCategory={instrumentCategory}
                  maxLines={maxInstrumentNameLines}
                />
              </SwiperSlide>
            );
          })
          .filter(Boolean)}
      </Swiper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(InstrumentCards);

import React, { FC, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import CategoryButton, { CategoryButtonVariant } from '@vision/category-button';
import { CategoryType } from '@vision/category-buttons';

import { getToAllLink } from 'modules/Showcases/utils';

import styles from './style.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  name: string;
  categories?: CategoryType[];
  onCategoryChange?: (category: string) => void;
  variant?: CategoryButtonVariant;
  to?: string;
};

const TopBlock: FC<Props> = ({
  name,
  categories,
  variant = 'primary',
  onCategoryChange: onChange,
  to,
}) => {
  const [activeButton, setActiveButton] = useState<string | null>(
    categories ? categories[0].category : null,
  );
  const handleClick = (category: string) => () => {
    setActiveButton(category);
    onChange && onChange(category);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.header}>
          <Text type={'bodySemiBold'}>{name}</Text>
          <Link
            to={to ?? getToAllLink({ categories, activeButton, name })}
            className={styles.toDerails}
          >
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
              Все
            </Text>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      {categories && onChange && (
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <div className={styles.container}>
            {categories.map((el) => (
              <CategoryButton
                key={el.category}
                variant={variant}
                active={activeButton === el.category}
                onClick={handleClick(el.category)}
              >
                {el.title}
              </CategoryButton>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default TopBlock;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';
import CategoryButtons from '@vision/category-buttons';

import InstrumentCards from 'modules/Showcases/components/InstrumentCards/InstrumentCards';
import Skeleton from 'modules/Showcases/components/Skeleton/Skeleton';

import BlockWrapper from 'components/BlockWrapper';

import styles from './Showcase.module.pcss';
import { IShowcaseProps } from './types';

const Showcase: FC<IShowcaseProps> = ({
  activeCategory,
  categories,
  formattedBalanceSymbolType,
  formattedBalanceVariant,
  instruments,
  isLoading,
  maxInstrumentNameLines,
  name,
  onCategoryChange,
  stateTo,
  toDetails,
  isError,
}) => {
  if (isLoading && !isError) {
    return <Skeleton />;
  }

  return (
    <BlockWrapper name={name} to={toDetails} stateTo={stateTo}>
      {categories && onCategoryChange && (
        <CategoryButtons
          className={styles.tabs}
          categories={categories}
          onChange={onCategoryChange}
          activeCategory={activeCategory}
        />
      )}
      {instruments?.length ? (
        <InstrumentCards
          formattedBalanceSymbolType={formattedBalanceSymbolType}
          formattedBalanceVariant={formattedBalanceVariant}
          instrumentCategory={name}
          instruments={instruments}
          maxInstrumentNameLines={maxInstrumentNameLines}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <Placeholder
            shape="emptyStateSmall"
            title={isError ? 'Не удалось загрузить данные' : 'Здесь пока пусто'}
            text={
              isError
                ? 'Попробуйте обновить экран позже'
                : 'Инструменты данной категории не найдены'
            }
            mode="mobile"
            className={styles.placeholder}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </BlockWrapper>
  );
};

import { CategoryType } from '@vision/category-buttons';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { CATALOG_BONDS_OFZ, CATALOG_STOCK_TYPE_VALUE_RUS } from 'modules/Catalog/constants';

import {
  ShowcaseBonds,
  ShowcaseCurrencies,
  ShowcaseETF,
  ShowcaseEquities,
  ShowcaseFutures,
  ShowcaseInstrument,
} from 'types/catalog';

export const parseInstrumentShowcaseBonds = (
  instrumentShowcaseBonds: ShowcaseBonds[] | ShowcaseInstrument[],
) =>
  instrumentShowcaseBonds?.map(
    ({
      hasInvestIdea,
      hasPriceThreshold,
      hasStopOrder,
      instrumentId,
      instrumentImageName,
      instrumentName,
      isFavorite,
      maturityDescription,
      tradePlaceId,
      yield: diff,
    }) => ({
      id: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`,
      img: instrumentImageName,
      name: instrumentName,
      diff,
      subtitle: maturityDescription ? `На ${maturityDescription}` : '—',
      hasInvestIdea,
      hasPriceThreshold,
      hasStopOrder,
      isFavorite,
    }),
  );

export const parseInstrumentShowcaseCurrencies = (
  instrumentShowcaseCurrencies: ShowcaseCurrencies[],
) =>
  instrumentShowcaseCurrencies.map(
    ({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentImageName,
      instrumentName,
      lastPrice,
      priceCurrency,
      hasInvestIdea,
      hasPriceThreshold,
      hasStopOrder,
      isFavorite,
    }) => ({
      id: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`,
      img: instrumentImageName,
      name: instrumentName,
      value: lastPrice,
      currencyCode: priceCurrency,
      hasInvestIdea,
      hasPriceThreshold,
      hasStopOrder,
      isFavorite,
    }),
  );

export const createPeriodStartSubtitle = (dateTime?: string) => {
  if (!dateTime) return '—';
  const parsedDateTime = DateTime.fromISO(dateTime).setLocale('ru').toFormat('MMMM yyyy');
  return `С ${parsedDateTime}`;
};

export const parseInstrumentShowcaseEquities = (
  instrumentShowcaseEquities: ShowcaseEquities[] | ShowcaseInstrument[],
) => {
  return instrumentShowcaseEquities.map((el) => ({
    id: el.instrumentId + '_' + el.tradePlaceId,
    img: el.instrumentImageName,
    name: el.instrumentName,
    diff: el.periodPriceDiffPcnt,
    subtitle: createPeriodStartSubtitle(el.periodStartDate),
    hasInvestIdea: el.hasInvestIdea,
    hasPriceThreshold: el.hasPriceThreshold,
    hasStopOrder: el.hasStopOrder,
    isFavorite: el.isFavorite,
  }));
};

export const parseInstrumentShowcaseETF = (
  instrumentShowcaseETF: ShowcaseETF[] | ShowcaseInstrument[],
) => {
  return instrumentShowcaseETF.map((el) => ({
    id: el.instrumentId + '_' + el.tradePlaceId,
    img: el.instrumentImageName,
    name: el.instrumentName,
    currencyCode: el.currencyCode,
    hasInvestIdea: el.hasInvestIdea,
    hasPriceThreshold: el.hasPriceThreshold,
    hasStopOrder: el.hasStopOrder,
    isFavorite: el.isFavorite,
  }));
};

export const createExpirationDateSubtitle = (dateTime: string) => {
  return DateTime.fromISO(dateTime).setLocale('ru').toFormat('d MMMM yyyy');
};

export const parseInstrumentShowcaseFutures = (instrumentShowcaseFutures: ShowcaseFutures[]) => {
  return instrumentShowcaseFutures.map((el) => ({
    id: el.instrumentId + '_' + el.tradePlaceId,
    img: el.instrumentImageName,
    name: el.instrumentName,
    value: el.lastPrice,
    currencyCode: el.priceCurrency,
    subtitle: createExpirationDateSubtitle(el.expirationDate),
    hasInvestIdea: el.hasInvestIdea,
    hasPriceThreshold: el.hasPriceThreshold,
    hasStopOrder: el.hasStopOrder,
    isFavorite: el.isFavorite,
  }));
};

export const getToAllLink = ({
  categories,
  activeButton,
  name,
}: {
  categories?: CategoryType[];
  activeButton: string | null;
  name: string;
}) => {
  const fallbackLink = name === 'Акции' ? CATALOG_STOCK_TYPE_VALUE_RUS : CATALOG_BONDS_OFZ;
  return categories && activeButton
    ? categories.find((el) => el.category === activeButton)?.link || fallbackLink
    : fallbackLink;
};
