import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Placeholder } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import HeaderPage from 'components/HeaderPage';

import { ReactComponent as BlockedSvg } from 'images/plug/plug-4.svg';

import styles from './SomethingWentWrong.module.pcss';

type SomethingWentWrongProps = {
  onAction?: () => void;
  onSecondAction?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  title?: string;
  error?: string;
  text?: string;
  buttonText?: string;
  secondButtonText?: string;
  loading?: boolean;
};

const SomethingWentWrong = ({
  onAction,
  onSecondAction,
  onClose,
  title,
  error,
  text,
  buttonText,
  secondButtonText,
  loading,
}: SomethingWentWrongProps) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

  const errorTitle = 'Что-то пошло не так';
  const errorText = 'Не удалось загрузить данные. Повторите попытку позже.';
  const actionButtonText = 'Обновить';

  const handleClose = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const handleActionButton = () => {
    onAction ? onAction() : handleClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.common, { [styles.desktop]: isDesktopView })}>
      <HeaderPage
        title={title || errorTitle}
        documentTitle={title || errorTitle}
        leftIconVariant={'close'}
        onLeftIconClick={onClose || handleClose}
      />
      <Placeholder
        variant={'error'}
        badgeText={'Ошибка'}
        title={error || errorTitle}
        text={text || errorText}
        //@ts-ignore
        actionButtonText={
          loading ? (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px' }}>
              <CircleLoader brandColor={true} />
              {buttonText || actionButtonText}
            </div>
          ) : (
            buttonText || actionButtonText
          )
        }
        onActionButtonClick={handleActionButton}
        actionSecondButtonText={secondButtonText}
        onActionSecondButtonClick={onSecondAction}
        img={<BlockedSvg width={250} height={150} />}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default SomethingWentWrong;

    id: 'view360',
    title: 'Портфель',
    icon: <View360Svg />,
  },
  {
    id: 'favorites',
    title: 'Избранное',
    icon: <FavoritesSvg />,
  },
  {
    id: 'catalog',
    title: 'Каталог',
    icon: <CatalogSvg />,
  },
];

const START_SCREEN_TITLE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  view360: 'Портфель',
  favorites: 'Избранное',
  catalog: 'Каталог',
};

const StartScreen = () => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [chosenScreen, setChosenScreen] = useState<string>();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const startScreen = localStorage.getItem('startScreen');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!startScreen || !START_SCREEN_TITLE_MAP[startScreen]) {
      localStorage.setItem('startScreen', 'view360');
      setChosenScreen('view360');
    } else {
      setChosenScreen(startScreen);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    startScreen && startScreen !== chosenScreen && setChosenScreen(startScreen);
  };

  const handleCellClick = () => {
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const onStartScreenChange = ({ id }: Option<string>) => {
    setChosenScreen(id);
  };

  const handleApplyClick = () => {
    chosenScreen && localStorage.setItem('startScreen', chosenScreen);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const selectedScreenOption = OPTIONS.find(({ id }) => chosenScreen === id);

  const Wrapper = isMobile ? BottomSheet : AdaptivePopup;

  return (
    <>
      <Card withShadow className={isMobile ? styles.card : styles.cardDesktop}>
        <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.cardTitle}>
          Приложение
        </Text>
        <ActionCell
          description={START_SCREEN_TITLE_MAP[startScreen || 'view360']}
          title={'Стартовый экран'}
          iconLeft={<StartScreenSvg />}
          separator={false}
          addonRight
          onClick={handleCellClick}
        />
      </Card>
      <Wrapper open={open} onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss} initialFocusRef={false}>
        <div className={styles.bottomSheetContent}>
          <div className={styles.space}>
            <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.title}>
              Стартовый экран
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.subTitle}>
              При запуске открывать
            </Text>
          </div>
          <div>
            <OptionsList
              type="check"
              options={OPTIONS}
              selectedOption={selectedScreenOption}
              onChange={onStartScreenChange}
            />
          </div>
          <Button variant="link" className={styles.btn} onClick={handleApplyClick}>
            Применить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Wrapper>
    </>
  );
};

export default StartScreen;

import React from 'react';

import Text from '@vision/text';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { ReactComponent as IndicatorCheckedSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/indicator-checked.svg';

import styles from './AccountBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  title: string;
  data: { id: string | number; icon?: React.ReactNode; value: string; isChecked: boolean }[];
  selectOption: (newId: string | number) => void;
};

const AccountBottomSheet = ({ title, data, selectOption }: Props) => {
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Text type="subtitleBold">{title}</Text>

      {data.map(({ id, icon, value, isChecked }, index) => (
        <div
          key={id}
          className={cx(styles.itemWrapper, index === 0 && styles.itemWrapperFirst)}
          onClick={() => {
            selectOption(id);
          }}
        >
          <div className={styles.itemInnerWrapper}>
            {icon}
            <Text type="lineRegular" className={cx(icon && styles.value)}>
              {value}
            </Text>
          </div>

          {isChecked && <IndicatorCheckedSvg />}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default AccountBottomSheet;

import React from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { numberValueChecker } from 'modules/Stats/helpers';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import DividendsCircle from '../DividendsCircle';
import DividendsHeaderItemSkeleton from '../DividendsHeaderItemSkeleton';
import styles from './dividendsHeader.module.pcss';

type DividendsHeaderProps = {
  cpnValue: number;
  cpnIsNotFactValue?: number;
  cpnCurrency: PriceCurrencyType;
  dvdValue: number;
  dvdIsNotFactValue?: number;
  dvdCurrency: PriceCurrencyType;
  isCurrentDivYear: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
};

const DividendsHeader: React.FC<DividendsHeaderProps> = ({
  cpnValue,
  cpnIsNotFactValue,
  dvdValue,
  dvdIsNotFactValue,
  cpnCurrency,
  dvdCurrency,
  isCurrentDivYear,
  isLoading,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.first}>
        <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="lineRegular" className={styles.title}>
          Дивиденды
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.second}>
        <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="lineRegular" className={styles.title}>
          Купоны
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.third}></div>
      <div className={styles.four}>
        {isLoading ? (
          <DividendsHeaderItemSkeleton />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className={styles.iconTitleContainer}>
              <DividendsCircle type="CPN" isFact />
              <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="labelSemiBold">
                {dvdValue
                  ? `${numberValueChecker(dvdValue, currencySign(dvdCurrency), true)}`
                  : '—'}
              </Text>
            </div>
            {isCurrentDivYear ? (
              <div className={styles.iconTitleContainer}>
                <DividendsCircle type="CPN" isFact={false} />
                <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="labelSemiBold">
                  {dvdIsNotFactValue
                    ? `${numberValueChecker(dvdIsNotFactValue, currencySign(dvdCurrency), true)}`
                    : '—'}
                </Text>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.five}>
        {isLoading ? (
          <DividendsHeaderItemSkeleton />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className={styles.iconTitleContainer}>
              <DividendsCircle type="DVD" isFact />
              <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="labelSemiBold">
                {cpnValue
                  ? `${numberValueChecker(cpnValue, currencySign(dvdCurrency), true)}`
                  : '—'}
              </Text>
            </div>
            {isCurrentDivYear ? (
              <div className={styles.iconTitleContainer}>
                <DividendsCircle type="DVD" isFact={false} />
                <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="labelSemiBold">
                  {cpnIsNotFactValue
                    ? `${numberValueChecker(cpnIsNotFactValue, currencySign(dvdCurrency), true)}`
                    : '—'}
                </Text>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.six}>
        {isLoading ? (
          <DividendsHeaderItemSkeleton />
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className={styles.iconTitleContainer}>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <DividendsCircle type="CPN" isFact />
                <DividendsCircle type="DVD" isFact />
              </div>
              <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="labelRegular">
                факт
              </Text>
            </div>

            {isCurrentDivYear && (
              <div className={styles.iconTitleContainer}>
                <div className={styles.row}>
                  {<DividendsCircle type="CPN" isFact={false} />}
                  {<DividendsCircle type="DVD" isFact={false} />}
                </div>
                <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="labelRegular">
                  прогноз
                </Text>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DividendsHeader;

import React, { Fragment } from 'react';

import { DataCell, LegendItem, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import InfoListSkeletonGroup from 'modules/Stats/components/StatisticInformationTable/components/InfoListSkeletonGroup';
import { colorsTable } from 'modules/Stats/const';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { CorporateEventType } from 'types/stats';

import DetailHeader from '../DetailHeader/DetailHeader';
import styles from './dividendsTable.module.pcss';

type DividendsTableProps = {
  tableData: {
    date: number[];
    dateRange: string;
    papers: CorporateEventType[];
    normalizedDate: string;
    cpnAmount: number;
    dvdAmount: number;
    currency: PriceCurrencyType;
    hasNotFactPayments: boolean;
  }[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  setIsLegendBSOpen: (item: boolean) => void;
};
const DividendsTable: React.FC<DividendsTableProps> = ({
  tableData,
  isLoading,
  setIsLegendBSOpen,
}) => {
  const hasPapersWithStatus = !!tableData.some((table) =>
    table.papers.some((paper) => paper.status),
  );

  // if (tableData.length === 0 && !isLoading)
  //   return (
  //     <div className={styles.imageWrapper}>
  //       <img src={emptyBoxBird} alt="emptyData" className={styles.image} />
  //     </div>
  //   );

  const dividendsTable = tableData.map((table) => {
    return (
      <div key={table.dateRange + table.normalizedDate}>
        <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.periodTitle}>
          {table.normalizedDate}
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.periodHeader}>
          {!!table.dvdAmount && (
            <div className={styles.subTitle}>
              <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
                Дивиденды
              </Text>
              <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
                {`+ ${sumFormatter(table.dvdAmount)} ${currencySign(table.currency)}`}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
          {!!table.cpnAmount && (
            <div className={styles.subTitle}>
              <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
                Купоны
              </Text>
              <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
                {`+ ${sumFormatter(table.cpnAmount)} ${currencySign(table.currency)}`}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div>
          {table.papers
            .sort((paperA, paperB) => paperA.dateTmstp - paperB.dateTmstp)
            .map((paper, index) => {
              return (
                <div key={paper.instrument_Id}>
                  <DataCell
                    addonRight={
                      <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
                        {`${sumFormatter(paper.amountCurr)} ${
                          paper.amountCurrCurrency ? currencySign(paper.amountCurrCurrency) : '-'
                        }`}
                      </Text>
                    }
                    addonRightBottom={
                      table.dateRange === 'day' ? null : (
                        <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
                          {paper.date}
                        </Text>
                      )
                    }
                    description={
                      <>
                        {paper.status ? (
                          <LegendItem
                            color={colorsTable[paper.status]}
                            indent={false}
                            text={
                              <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
                                {paper.typeCode === 'DVD'
                                  ? 'Выплата дивидендов'
                                  : 'Выплата купонов'}
                              </Text>
                            }
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
                            {paper.typeCode === 'DVD' ? 'Выплата дивидендов' : 'Выплата купонов'}
                          </Text>
                        )}
                      </>
                    }
                    iconLeft={<InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={paper.instrumentImageName} />}
                    title={paper.instrumentName}
                    className={styles.dataCell}
                    separator={index < table.papers.length - 1}
                  />
                </div>
              );
            })}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  });

  return (
    <Fragment>
      {isLoading ? (
        <>
          <InfoListSkeletonGroup />
          <InfoListSkeletonGroup />
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          {hasPapersWithStatus && <DetailHeader setIsLegendBSOpen={setIsLegendBSOpen} />}
          {dividendsTable}
        </>
      )}
    </Fragment>
  );
};

export default DividendsTable;

import React, { useContext, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { BarChart, BottomSheet, DatePicker, StackedBarChartConfig, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';
import { NO_DIVIDENDS, divChartConfiguration } from 'modules/Stats/const';
import {
  DividendsCouponsData,
  DividendsPropsType,
  DividendsRange,
  MonthQuartYearType,
  PeriodsRangeType,
} from 'modules/Stats/types';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { CorporateEventsDataNormalized } from 'types/stats';

import * as helpers from '../../helpers';
import DividendsHeader from './components/DividendsHeader';
import DividendsTable from './components/DividendsTable';
import LegendBottomSheet from './components/LegendBottomSheet';
import styles from './dividends.module.pcss';

type DividendsProps = {
  isCurrentDivYear: boolean;
  tappedDICValue: DividendsCouponsData;
  selectedCurrencyCode: PriceCurrencyType;
  isDividendsDataLoading: boolean;
  dividendsData: CorporateEventsDataNormalized | undefined;
  dividendsProps: DividendsPropsType;
  isDivDatePickerOpen: boolean;
  setSelectedDateRangeType: (item: PeriodsRangeType) => void;
  setTappedDICValue: (item: DividendsCouponsData) => void;
  setIsDivDatePickerOpen: (it: boolean) => void;
};
const Dividends: React.FC<DividendsProps> = ({
  isCurrentDivYear,
  tappedDICValue,
  selectedCurrencyCode,
  isDividendsDataLoading,
  dividendsData,
  dividendsProps,
  isDivDatePickerOpen,
  setSelectedDateRangeType,
  setTappedDICValue,
  setIsDivDatePickerOpen,
}) => {
  const {
    beginDateAll,
    endPositionDate,
    beginPositionDate,
    selectedDateRangeType,
    setBeginPositionDate,
    setEndPositionDate,
  } = useContext(StatsContext);
  const [isLegendBSOpen, setIsLegendBSOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeDivIndex, setActiveDivIndex] = useState(-1);

  const { dividendsBarChart, isBarChartGraph } = useMemo(() => {
    const barChart = helpers.barChartDataCreator(dividendsData?.corporateEventGroupedNormalized);
    const isBarChartGraph = helpers.barChartDataReducer(barChart);
    return { dividendsBarChart: barChart, isBarChartGraph: !!isBarChartGraph };
  }, [dividendsData?.corporateEventGroupedNormalized]);

  const filteredGroupedData = useMemo(() => {
    return dividendsData && helpers.getFilteredGroupedData(dividendsData);
  }, [dividendsData]);

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.contentWrapperWithPadding}>
        <DividendsHeader
          isLoading={isDividendsDataLoading}
          isCurrentDivYear={isCurrentDivYear}
          cpnValue={
            tappedDICValue ? tappedDICValue.pv : dividendsData?.corporateEventTotal.cpnValue || 0
          }
          cpnIsNotFactValue={
            tappedDICValue
              ? tappedDICValue.uv
              : dividendsData?.corporateEventTotal.cpnIsNotFact || 0
          }
          dvdValue={
            tappedDICValue ? tappedDICValue.amt : dividendsData?.corporateEventTotal.dvdValue || 0
          }
          dvdIsNotFactValue={
            tappedDICValue
              ? tappedDICValue.rv
              : dividendsData?.corporateEventTotal.dvdIsNotFact || 0
          }
          cpnCurrency={dividendsData?.corporateEventTotal?.amountCurrency || selectedCurrencyCode}
          dvdCurrency={dividendsData?.corporateEventTotal?.amountCurrency || selectedCurrencyCode}
        />
        <BarChart
          showSkeleton={isDividendsDataLoading}
          message={isBarChartGraph ? '' : !isDividendsDataLoading ? NO_DIVIDENDS : ''}
          colors={['#82C64D', '#006D8A']}
          config={divChartConfiguration as StackedBarChartConfig}
          data={dividendsBarChart}
          shape="stack"
          showPeriods
          periods={['month', 'quarter', 'year']}
          activeBarIndex={activeDivIndex}
          activePeriod={selectedDateRangeType}
          onPeriodChange={(e) => {
            setSelectedDateRangeType(e as DividendsRange);
            setBeginPositionDate('');
            setEndPositionDate('');
          }}
          xAxisFormat="period"
          onHover={(e, index) => {
            setTappedDICValue(e as DividendsCouponsData);
            setActiveDivIndex(index);
          }}
        />
        <div className={styles.tableWrapper}>
          <DividendsTable
            isLoading={isDividendsDataLoading}
            tableData={filteredGroupedData?.tableData || []}
            setIsLegendBSOpen={setIsLegendBSOpen}
          />
        </div>
        <LegendBottomSheet isLegendBSOpen={isLegendBSOpen} setIsLegendBSOpen={setIsLegendBSOpen} />
      </div>
      <BottomSheet
        open={isDivDatePickerOpen}
        onDismiss={() => {
          setIsDivDatePickerOpen(false);
        }}
        className={styles.bottomSheet}
      >
        <div>
          <div className={styles.calendarHeader}>
            <Text type="subtitleBold" color="colorForeground">
              Период
            </Text>
            {/* <div
              onClick={() => {
                console.log('click');
              }}
            >
              <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorDestructive">
                Сбросить
              </Text>
            </div> */}
          </div>
          <DatePicker
            defaultOptionReset="month"
            periodPreset
            defaultOptionPeriodPreset={
              selectedDateRangeType === 'all' || selectedDateRangeType === 'day'
                ? (helpers.getPeriodFromDatePart(dividendsProps.datePart) as MonthQuartYearType)
                : (selectedDateRangeType as MonthQuartYearType)
            }
            customOptionsPeriodPreset={['month', 'quarter', 'year']}
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              // if (e[0] === null) {
              //   console.log('CHECK IT IS RESET');
              // }
              const actualData = helpers.getNormalizedDateFormat(e as Date[]);
              setBeginPositionDate(actualData.startDate);
              setEndPositionDate(actualData.endDate);
              setIsDivDatePickerOpen(false);
            }}
            onSetOptionPeriodPreset={(e) => setSelectedDateRangeType(e as DividendsRange)}
            minDate={new Date(beginDateAll)}
            dates={
              selectedDateRangeType === 'all' || selectedDateRangeType === 'day'
                ? [new Date(dividendsProps.beginDate), new Date(dividendsProps.endDate)]
                : [new Date(beginPositionDate), new Date(endPositionDate)]
            }
            currentYear={
              selectedDateRangeType === 'all' || selectedDateRangeType === 'day'
                ? +dividendsProps.endDate.split('-')?.[0]
                : +endPositionDate.split('-')?.[0]
            }
          />
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default Dividends;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_360 } from 'const/routes';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ErrorSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/servise-17.svg';

import styles from './errorPage.module.pcss';
import { ErrorPageProps } from './types';

const ErrorPage: React.FC<ErrorPageProps> = ({
  refetchFunctions,
  insidePage = false,
  noCallToAction,
}) => {
  const [isBtnLoading, setIsBtnLoading] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const onToView360ButtonClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_360);

  const handleClick = () => {
    if (!refetchFunctions) return;
    setIsBtnLoading(true);
    refetchFunctions.forEach((func) => (func ? func() : null));
  };
  return (
    <>
      {!insidePage && (
        <HeaderPage
          title="Статистика"
          leftIconVariant={'back'}
          onLeftIconClick={onToView360ButtonClick}
        />
      )}
      <div className={styles.contentWrapper}>
        <div className={styles.errorImage}>
          <ErrorSvg width={100} height={100} />
        </div>
        <div className={cn(styles.bottomWrapper, noCallToAction && styles.pageWithoutButton)}>
          <div className={styles.textWrapper}>
            <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="title" className={styles.title}>
              Не удалось загрузить данные
            </Text>
            <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="lineRegular">
              Попробуйте ещё раз или вернитесь позже, чтобы повторить попытку
            </Text>
          </div>

          {!noCallToAction && (
            <div className={styles.btnWrapper}>
              <Button
                className={styles.firstBtn}
                onClick={handleClick}
                loading={isBtnLoading}
                disabled={isBtnLoading}
              >
                Повторить попытку
              </Button>
              {!insidePage && (
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onToView360ButtonClick}>
                  Вернуться в Портфель
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default ErrorPage;

import React, { useContext } from 'react';

import FilterCard from '@vision/filter-card';
import { ROUTE_STATS_DYNAMIC, ROUTE_STATS_STRUCTURE } from 'const/routes';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';
import {
  BLOCK_ASSETS,
  BLOCK_CURRENCIES,
  BLOCK_DIVIDENDS,
  BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT,
  BLOCK_INDUSTRIES,
  BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS,
} from 'modules/Stats/const';
import { BlockType } from 'modules/Stats/types';

type FilterCardGroupProps = {
  currentLocation: string;

  setSelectedBlockType: (it: BlockType) => void;
};
const FilterCardGroup: React.FC<FilterCardGroupProps> = ({
  currentLocation,

  setSelectedBlockType,
}) => {
  const { selectedBlockType } = useContext(StatsContext);
  if (currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_DYNAMIC) {
    return (
      <>
        <FilterCard
          {...(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT ? {} : { transparent: true })}
          type="toggle"
          text="Финансовый результат"
          handleClick={() => {
            setSelectedBlockType(BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT);
          }}
        />
        <FilterCard
          {...(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_ASSETS ? {} : { transparent: true })}
          type="toggle"
          text="Активы"
          handleClick={() => {
            setSelectedBlockType(BLOCK_ASSETS);
          }}
        />
        <FilterCard
          {...(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_DIVIDENDS ? {} : { transparent: true })}
          type="toggle"
          text="Дивиденды"
          handleClick={() => {
            setSelectedBlockType(BLOCK_DIVIDENDS);
          }}
        />
      </>
    );
  } else if (currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_STRUCTURE) {
    return (
      <>
        <FilterCard
          {...(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS ? {} : { transparent: true })}
          type="toggle"
          text="Инструменты"
          handleClick={() => {
            setSelectedBlockType(BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS);
          }}
        />
        <FilterCard
          {...(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_CURRENCIES ? {} : { transparent: true })}
          type="toggle"
          text="Валюта"
          handleClick={() => {
            setSelectedBlockType(BLOCK_CURRENCIES);
          }}
        />
        <FilterCard
          {...(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_INDUSTRIES ? {} : { transparent: true })}
          type="toggle"
          text="Отрасли"
          handleClick={() => {
            setSelectedBlockType(BLOCK_INDUSTRIES);
          }}
        />
      </>
    );
  } else return null;
};

export default FilterCardGroup;

import React, { useContext, useMemo } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';
import { BLOCK_ASSETS, BLOCK_DIVIDENDS, BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT } from 'modules/Stats/const';
import { useGetAmountRangeData } from 'modules/Stats/hooks';
import { DividendsCouponsData, TappedValueType } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import * as helpers from '../../helpers';
import DividendsDateRangeSkeleton from './DividendsDateRangeSkeleton';
import styles from './finresAndDivHeader.module.pcss';

type FinresAndDivHeaderProps = {
  isDividendsError: boolean;
  isPositionsError: boolean;
  tappedValue: TappedValueType;
  tappedDICValue: DividendsCouponsData;

  setIsDivDatePickerOpen: (it: boolean) => void;
  setIsDatePickerOpen: (it: boolean) => void;
  statRange: string | null;
  isDividendsDataLoading: boolean;
  divRange: string | null;
};
const FinresAndDivHeader: React.FC<FinresAndDivHeaderProps> = ({
  isDividendsError,
  isPositionsError,
  tappedValue,
  tappedDICValue,

  setIsDivDatePickerOpen,
  setIsDatePickerOpen,
  statRange,
  isDividendsDataLoading,
  divRange,
}) => {
  const { sign, positionsData, selectedBlockType } = useContext(StatsContext);
  const currentDivRange = useMemo(() => {
    return tappedDICValue
      ? helpers.getCustomDateRange({
          beginDate: tappedDICValue.startDate as number,
          endDate: tappedDICValue.endDate as number,
        })
      : divRange;
  }, [divRange, tappedDICValue]);

  const { endTotalAmount, isPositiveAmountRange, amountRange } = useGetAmountRangeData(
    sign,
    positionsData,
  );

  return (
    <div className={styles.contentWrapperWithPadding}>
      {(isDividendsError && selectedBlockType === BLOCK_DIVIDENDS) ||
      (isPositionsError &&
        (selectedBlockType === BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT ||
          selectedBlockType === BLOCK_ASSETS)) ? null : (
        <div
          onClick={() =>
            selectedBlockType === 'BLOCK_DIVIDENDS'
              ? setIsDivDatePickerOpen(true)
              : setIsDatePickerOpen(true)
          }
        >
          <Text
            type="lineRegular"
            className={styles.dateRange}
            color={tappedValue || tappedDICValue ? 'colorForeground2' : 'colorAccent'}
          >
            {selectedBlockType !== 'BLOCK_DIVIDENDS' ? (
              tappedValue ? (
                helpers.getTappedDateRange(tappedValue?.startDate, tappedValue.endDate)
              ) : (
                statRange
              )
            ) : isDividendsDataLoading ? (
              <DividendsDateRangeSkeleton />
            ) : (
              currentDivRange
            )}
          </Text>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className={styles.infoWrapper}>
        {selectedBlockType === 'BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT' && (
          <Text
            type="subtitleBold"
            color={helpers.getAmountRangeColor(
              tappedValue
                ? helpers.getPositiveAmountRangeStatus(tappedValue.valueDay)
                : isPositiveAmountRange,
            )}
          >
            {tappedValue
              ? helpers.getAmountRange(tappedValue.valueDay, sign, tappedValue?.percents, false)
              : amountRange}
          </Text>
        )}
        {selectedBlockType === 'BLOCK_ASSETS' && (
          <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.endTotalAmount}>
            {tappedValue
              ? helpers.getAmountRange(tappedValue.valueDay, sign, 0, true)
              : endTotalAmount}
          </Text>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default FinresAndDivHeader;

import React, { useContext } from 'react';

import {
  BottomSheet,
  CalendarVariant,
  DatePicker,

} from '@aurora/components';

import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';
import { lineChartConfig, lineChartSeries } from 'modules/Stats/const';
import {
  getLineChartMessage,
  getNormalizedDateFormat,
  getNumberDateFromString,
  valueFromAxisY,
} from 'modules/Stats/helpers';
import { useGetAreaChartData } from 'modules/Stats/hooks';
import { PeriodsRangeType, TappedValueType } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import styles from './finResults.module.pcss';

type FinResultsProps = {
  isDatePickerOpen: boolean;
  setIsDatePickerOpen: (it: boolean) => void;
  setNotFormattedDates: (it: Date[]) => void;
  setSelectedDateRangeType: (it: PeriodsRangeType) => void;
  setStatRange: (item: string) => void;
  isMainLoading: boolean;

  setTappedValue: (value: React.SetStateAction<TappedValueType>) => void;
};
const FinResults: React.FC<FinResultsProps> = ({
  isDatePickerOpen,
  setIsDatePickerOpen,
  setNotFormattedDates,
  setSelectedDateRangeType,
  setStatRange,
  isMainLoading,

  setTappedValue,
}) => {
  const {
    positionsData,
    endPositionDate,
    beginPositionDate,
    beginDateAll,
    selectedBlockType,
    selectedDateRangeType,
    setBeginPositionDate,
    setEndPositionDate,
  } = useContext(StatsContext);
  const areaChartData = useGetAreaChartData(selectedBlockType, positionsData);

  const areaChartsSmallDots =
    !!areaChartData && areaChartData?.length > 0 && areaChartData?.length < 3;
  const emptyChartsData = !areaChartData || areaChartData.length === 0;

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.graphWrapper}>
        <LineChart
          yAxisTickFormatter={(e) => valueFromAxisY(e)}
          referenceLineLabelFormatter={(e) => sumFormatter(e, 0)}
          config={lineChartConfig}
          periods={['month', 'quarter', 'year', 'all']}
          activePeriod={selectedDateRangeType}
          periodsFormat="long"
          onPeriodChange={(e) => {
            setSelectedDateRangeType(e as PeriodsRangeType);
            setBeginPositionDate('');
            setEndPositionDate('');
          }}
          showDatePicker
          showPeriods={!isMainLoading}
          showLoader={!areaChartData}
          showReferenceLine
          showSkeleton={isMainLoading}
          onHover={(payload) => setTappedValue(payload)}
          series={lineChartSeries}
          seriesData={areaChartData ? (areaChartsSmallDots ? [] : areaChartData) : []}
          onDatepickerBtnClick={() => setIsDatePickerOpen(true)}
          message={getLineChartMessage(emptyChartsData, areaChartsSmallDots, isMainLoading)}
          {...(areaChartData && {
            minDate: areaChartData[0].startDate,
            maxDate: areaChartData[areaChartData.length - 1]?.endDate,
          })}
        />
      </div>
      <BottomSheet
        open={isDatePickerOpen}
        onDismiss={() => {
          setIsDatePickerOpen(false);
        }}
      >
        <div>
          <div className={styles.calendarHeader}>
            <Text type="subtitleBold" color="colorForeground">
              Период
            </Text>
          </div>
          <DatePicker
            periodPreset
            defaultOptionPeriodPreset={
              selectedDateRangeType === 'all' ? 'month' : (selectedDateRangeType as CalendarVariant)
            }
            customOptionsPeriodPreset={['month', 'quarter', 'year', 'day']}
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              setNotFormattedDates(e as Date[]);
              const actualData = getNormalizedDateFormat(e as Date[]);
              setBeginPositionDate(actualData.startDate);
              setEndPositionDate(actualData.endDate);
              setStatRange(actualData.rangeDate);
              setIsDatePickerOpen(false);
            }}
            onSetOptionPeriodPreset={(e) => setSelectedDateRangeType(e)}
            minDate={new Date(beginDateAll)}
            dates={
              selectedDateRangeType === 'all'
                ? []
                : [
                    getNumberDateFromString(beginPositionDate),
                    getNumberDateFromString(endPositionDate),
                  ]
            }
            currentYear={+endPositionDate.split('-')?.[0]}
            currentMonth={(+endPositionDate.split('-')?.[1] - 1) as Month}
          />
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default FinResults;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Card, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_REFILL } from 'const/routes';

import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getActualSubtitlesForMarginalGraph } from 'modules/Stats/helpers';
import { BannerLkTypes } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import { CollateralDataType } from 'types/stats';

import { noMinMarginalArr, marginalSign as sign } from '../../const';
import MarginalBanner from '../MarginalBanner';
import MarginalTradingBottomSheet from '../MarginalTradingBottomSheet';
import MarginalTradingRangeGraph from '../MarginalTradingRangeGraph';
import styles from './graph.module.pcss';

type GraphProps = {
  productId: number | string;
  portfolioId: number;
  portfolioType: string;
  setCurrentType: (it: BannerLkTypes) => void;
  setNotRelevantError: (it: boolean) => void;
  currentCollateralData: CollateralDataType;
};

const Graph: React.FC<GraphProps> = ({
  productId,
  portfolioId,
  portfolioType,
  setCurrentType,
  setNotRelevantError,
  currentCollateralData,
}) => {
  const {
    totalAmount,
    minimumCollateralAmount,
    collateralAmount,
    riskCoverage1,
    riskCoverage2,
    freeCollateralAmount,
    collateralLevelPcnt,
  } = currentCollateralData;
  const { beforeMinCallName, beforeStartCallName } =
    getActualSubtitlesForMarginalGraph(portfolioType);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [hintOpen, setHintOpen] = useState(false);

  const isGreenArea =
    totalAmount > collateralAmount && minimumCollateralAmount !== collateralAmount;

  const isEmptyCount =
    (totalAmount === 0 && collateralAmount === 0) ||
    (freeCollateralAmount === 0 &&
      ((collateralAmount === 0 && totalAmount === 0) ||
        collateralAmount === undefined ||
        totalAmount === undefined));

  const positiveFromZero = collateralAmount === 0 && totalAmount > 0;

  const isDebt = collateralAmount === 0 && totalAmount < 0;

  const marginCall =
    totalAmount > 0 &&
    minimumCollateralAmount > totalAmount &&
    collateralAmount > minimumCollateralAmount;

  const isLessStartMarginal =
    minimumCollateralAmount > 0 &&
    +(minimumCollateralAmount * 1.1).toFixed(0) <= totalAmount &&
    collateralAmount > totalAmount;

  const highRiskMarginCall =
    minimumCollateralAmount > 0 &&
    totalAmount > minimumCollateralAmount &&
    +(1.1 * minimumCollateralAmount).toFixed(0) > totalAmount &&
    collateralAmount > totalAmount;

  const isPositiveMoreZero =
    minimumCollateralAmount > 0 &&
    collateralAmount > minimumCollateralAmount &&
    totalAmount > collateralAmount;

  const isEqualStartMarginal = collateralAmount > 0 && collateralAmount === totalAmount;

  const typeHelper = [
    ['isDebt', isDebt],
    ['positiveMoreZero', isPositiveMoreZero],
    ['positiveFromZero', positiveFromZero],
    ['isEqualStartMarginal', isEqualStartMarginal],
    ['isLessStartMarginal', isLessStartMarginal],
    ['marginCall', marginCall],
    ['highRiskMarginCall', highRiskMarginCall],
  ];

  const currentType = typeHelper.find((item) => item[1])?.[0] as BannerLkTypes;

  const isTable =
    (riskCoverage1 || riskCoverage2) &&
    currentType !== 'positiveFromZero' &&
    currentType !== 'isDebt';

  const currentDebtValue = highRiskMarginCall
    ? collateralAmount - totalAmount
    : minimumCollateralAmount - totalAmount;

  const noMinMarginal =
    minimumCollateralAmount == null &&
    totalAmount &&
    collateralAmount &&
    noMinMarginalArr.includes(currentType?.[0] as string);

  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentType(currentType);
    if (currentType === undefined && !isEmptyCount) {
      setNotRelevantError(true);
    }
  }, [currentType, isEmptyCount, setCurrentType, setNotRelevantError, portfolioId]);

  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.container, isEmptyCount && styles.emptyCountWrapper)}>
      <Card withShadow>
        <div className={styles.header}>
          <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            Свободное обеспечение
          </Text>
          <div onClick={() => setHintOpen(true)}>
            <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorAccent">
              Как работает?
            </Text>
          </div>
        </div>
        <>
          <div className={styles.totalValue}>
            {isGreenArea && <div className={styles.dashedCircle} />}
            <Text type="title" color="colorForeground">
              {`${sumFormatter(freeCollateralAmount)} ${sign}`}
            </Text>
          </div>
          {isDebt && (
            <div>
              <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorDestructive">
                Есть задолженность
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
        </>

        <MarginalTradingRangeGraph
          sign={sign}
          min={minimumCollateralAmount}
          st={collateralAmount}
          portfolioValue={totalAmount}
          isEmptyCount={isEmptyCount}
          isDebt={isDebt}
          portfolioType={portfolioType}
          noMinMarginal={!!noMinMarginal}
          currentType={currentType}
        />
        {!!isTable && (
          <div className={styles.table}>
            {isGreenArea && (
              <div className={styles.tableItem}>
                <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                  Уровень обеспечения
                </Text>
                <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorConstructive">
                  {`${collateralLevelPcnt} %`}
                </Text>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className={styles.tableItem}>
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                <span> {beforeStartCallName}</span>
              </Text>
              <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground">
                {typeof riskCoverage1 === 'number'
                  ? `${sumFormatter(Math.abs(riskCoverage1))} ${sign}`
                  : '-'}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.tableItem}>
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                <span> {beforeMinCallName}</span>
              </Text>
              <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground">
                {typeof riskCoverage2 === 'number'
                  ? `${sumFormatter(Math.abs(riskCoverage2))} ${sign}`
                  : '-'}
              </Text>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
      {currentType && (
        <MarginalBanner
          type={currentType}
          sign={sign}
          debtValue={currentDebtValue > 0 ? currentDebtValue : undefined}
          portfolioType={portfolioType}
          productId={productId}
          portfolioId={portfolioId}
        />
      )}
      {isEmptyCount && (
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          onClick={() => {
            navigate(ROUTE_REFILL, {
              state: { totalAmount: 5000, portfolioId: portfolioId, productId: productId },
            });
          }}
        >
          Пополнить портфель
        </Button>
      )}
      <MarginalTradingBottomSheet hintOpen={hintOpen} setHintOpen={setHintOpen} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Graph;

import React, { useContext, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import BottomSheet from '@vision/bottom-sheet';
import FilterCard from '@vision/filter-card';
import Text from '@vision/text';
import { ROUTE_360 } from 'const/routes';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';
import { ALL_PRODUCTS, CURRENCIES, INITIAL_BOTTOM_SHEET, statisticName } from 'modules/Stats/const';
import { BottomSheetStateType } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ArrowSmallDownSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/history/miniArrowDown.svg';

import { Currency } from 'types/catalog';
import { ProductsResponse } from 'types/orderHistory';

import AccountBottomSheet from '../AccountBottomSheet';
import styles from './Header.module.pcss';

type HeaderProps = {
  currencies: Currency[] | null;
  setSelectedProductId: (newSelectedProductId: string | number) => void;
  setSelectedCurrencyId: (newSelectedCurrencyId: number) => void;
  isError: boolean;
  isHiddenCurrencies: boolean;
  bottomSheetState: BottomSheetStateType;
  setBottomSheetState: (item: BottomSheetStateType) => void;
  productsData?: ProductsResponse;
  isProductsLoading: boolean;
};

const Header = ({
  currencies,
  setSelectedProductId,
  setSelectedCurrencyId,
  isError,
  isHiddenCurrencies,
  bottomSheetState,
  setBottomSheetState,
  productsData,
  isProductsLoading,
}: HeaderProps) => {
  const { sign, selectedCurrencyId, selectedProductId } = useContext(StatsContext);

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const products = useMemo(() => {
    if (!productsData) {
      return null;
    }
    return productsData.products.filter(({ isStructure, isUK }) => !isStructure && !isUK);
  }, [productsData]);

  const productName = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedProductId === ALL_PRODUCTS) {
      return 'Все счета';
    }
    if (!products) {
      return '';
    }
    const foundProduct = products.find(({ productId }) => productId === selectedProductId);
    return foundProduct ? foundProduct.productFullName : '';
  }, [selectedProductId, products]);

  const formattedProducts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!products) {
      return [];
    }
    return [
      { id: ALL_PRODUCTS, value: 'Все счета', isChecked: selectedProductId === ALL_PRODUCTS },
      ...products.map(({ productId, productFullName }) => {
        return {
          id: productId,
          value: productFullName,
          isChecked: productId === selectedProductId,
        };
      }),
    ];
  }, [products, selectedProductId]);

  const formattedCurrencies = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currencies) {
      return [];
    }
    return currencies.map(({ id, code, name }) => {
      return {
        id,
        icon: CURRENCIES[code as keyof typeof CURRENCIES],
        value: name,
        isChecked: id === selectedCurrencyId,
      };
    });
  }, [currencies, selectedCurrencyId]);

  const isProducts = bottomSheetState.type === 'PRODUCTS';

  const productsHandler = () => {
    if (isProductsLoading) return;
    setBottomSheetState({ ...INITIAL_BOTTOM_SHEET, isOpen: true, type: 'PRODUCTS' });
  };

  const currenciesHandler = () => {
    if (isError || isProductsLoading) return;
    setBottomSheetState({ ...INITIAL_BOTTOM_SHEET, isOpen: true, type: 'CURRENCY' });
  };

  const backToView360Handler = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_360);
  };

  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div onClick={backToView360Handler} className={styles.backSvg}>
          <BackSvg />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <Text type="lineSemiBold">{statisticName}</Text>
          {productsData && !isProductsLoading && (
            <div className={styles.innerWrapper} onClick={productsHandler}>
              <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.productName}>
                {productName}
              </Text>
              <div className={styles.arrowSmallDownIconWrapper}>
                <ArrowSmallDownSvg />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div
          className={styles.filterCardWrapper}
          style={{ opacity: `${isHiddenCurrencies ? 0 : 1}` }}
        >
          <FilterCard type="select" text={sign || '₽'} handleClick={currenciesHandler} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetState.isOpen}
        onDismiss={() => {
          setBottomSheetState(INITIAL_BOTTOM_SHEET);
        }}
      >
        <AccountBottomSheet
          title={isProducts ? 'Выберите счёт' : 'Валюта отображения активов'}
          data={isProducts ? formattedProducts : formattedCurrencies}
          selectOption={(newId) => {
            if (isProducts) {
              setSelectedProductId(newId);
            } else {
              setSelectedCurrencyId(newId as number);
            }
            setBottomSheetState(INITIAL_BOTTOM_SHEET);
          }}
        />
      </BottomSheet>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
};

export default Header;

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { BannerLk, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_360, ROUTE_REFILL } from 'const/routes';

import { setActiveIndex } from 'core/services/servicesSlice';

import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { bannerHelper } from 'modules/Stats/const';
import { getActualSubtitlesForMarginalGraph } from 'modules/Stats/helpers';
import { BannerLkTypes } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import styles from './marginalBanner.module.pcss';

type MarginalBannerProps = {
  type: BannerLkTypes;
  sign?: string;
  debtValue?: number;
  portfolioType: string;
  portfolioId: number;
  productId: number | string;
};

const MarginalBanner: React.FC<MarginalBannerProps> = ({
  type,
  debtValue,
  sign,
  portfolioType,
  portfolioId,
  productId,
}) => {
  const { text: marginalText } = getActualSubtitlesForMarginalGraph(portfolioType);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const products = useAppSelector((state) => state.view360.allData.positionValuationByProduct);

  const productIndex = products?.findIndex((element) => element.productId === productId) + 1;

  const { title, buttonColor, buttonText, background, linkText, to } = bannerHelper[type];

  const handler = () => {
    if (type === 'isEqualStartMarginal' || type === 'isLessStartMarginal') {
      navigate(ROUTE_REFILL, {
        state: { portfolioId, productId },
      });
    } else if (debtValue) {
      navigate(ROUTE_REFILL, {
        state: { refillAmountValue: debtValue, portfolioId, productId },
      });
    } else if (to) {
      navigate(to);
    }
  };
  const backToView360Handler = () => {
    dispatch(setActiveIndex(productIndex));
    navigate(ROUTE_360);
  };
  return (
    <BannerLk
      addonBottom={
        <div>
          <span
            className={styles.bannerMainButton}
            style={{ backgroundColor: buttonColor }}
            onClick={handler}
          >
            <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorFixedWhite">
              {!debtValue && buttonText}
              {!!debtValue && `${buttonText} ${Math.trunc(debtValue)} ${sign}`}
            </Text>
            {linkText !== '' && debtValue && (
              <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorFixedWhite">
                {linkText}
              </Text>
            )}
          </span>
          {linkText && (
            <span className={styles.bannerSecondButton} onClick={backToView360Handler}>
              <Text color="colorAttention" type="labelSemiBold">
                Продать бумаги
              </Text>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      }
      colorBackground={background}
      colorText="#28282D"
      description={marginalText[type]}
      title={
        <Text type="bodySemiBold" color="colorForeground">
          {title}
        </Text>
      }
      className={styles.bannerLk}
      limitLineDescription={false}
    />
  );
};

export default MarginalBanner;

import React, { memo, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import {
  ALL_PRODUCTS,
  noMinMarginalArr,
  noPossibleToShowMarginalGraphArr,
} from 'modules/Stats/const';
import { refetchFunctionsHelper } from 'modules/Stats/helpers';
import { BannerLkTypes } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import AnotherCountPage from '../AnotherCountPage';
import ErrorPage from '../ErrorPage';
import FilterCardGroupTest from '../FilterCardGroupTest';
import Graph from '../Graph';
import MarginalTradingSkeleton from './Skeletons/MarginalTradingSkeleton';
import styles from './marginalTrading.module.pcss';
import { MarginalTradingProps } from './types';

const MarginalTrading: React.FC<MarginalTradingProps> = ({
  loading,
  selectedProductId,
  setBottomSheetState,
  setActiveMarginalTab,
  activeMarginalTab,
  portfoliosData,
  collateralData,
  marginalTradingErrors,
}) => {
  const [currentType, setCurrentType] = useState('' as BannerLkTypes);
  const [notRelevantType, setNotRelevantError] = useState(false);
  const productsHandler = () => {
    setBottomSheetState({ isOpen: true, type: 'PRODUCTS' });
  };

  const currentCollateralData = collateralData?.portfolioRisk[0];

  const refetchFunctions = refetchFunctionsHelper(marginalTradingErrors);

  const noErrors = useMemo(() => {
    return marginalTradingErrors.filter((it) => it.isError).length === 0;
  }, [marginalTradingErrors]);

  const noData = currentCollateralData?.freeCollateralAmount == null;

  const activePortfolio = useMemo(() => {
    return portfoliosData.find((el) => el.id === activeMarginalTab.portfolioId)?.type || '';
  }, [activeMarginalTab.portfolioId, portfoliosData]);

  const noDataPlug =
    (currentCollateralData?.totalAmount == null ||
      currentCollateralData.collateralAmount == null) &&
    noMinMarginalArr.includes(currentType);

  const noPossibleToShowMarginalGraph =
    (currentCollateralData?.minimumCollateralAmount == null ||
      currentCollateralData?.totalAmount == null ||
      currentCollateralData?.collateralAmount == null) &&
    noPossibleToShowMarginalGraphArr.includes(currentType);

  const showEmptyBirds = noDataPlug || noPossibleToShowMarginalGraph || noData;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (showEmptyBirds) {
      setCurrentType('' as BannerLkTypes);
    }
  }, [showEmptyBirds, activeMarginalTab]);

  if (loading) {
    return <MarginalTradingSkeleton />;
  }

  if (marginalTradingErrors.filter((item) => item.isError).length) {
    return <ErrorPage refetchFunctions={refetchFunctions} insidePage />;
  }

  if (selectedProductId === ALL_PRODUCTS && noErrors) {
    return <AnotherCountPage productsHandler={productsHandler} />;
  }
  if (portfoliosData.length === 0 && noErrors) {
    return <AnotherCountPage productsHandler={productsHandler} noCounts />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.filtersWrapper}>
        <FilterCardGroupTest
          setActiveTab={setActiveMarginalTab}
          selectedBlockType={activeMarginalTab}
          portfoliosData={portfoliosData}
        />
      </div>
      {showEmptyBirds || notRelevantType ? (
        <ErrorPage insidePage noCallToAction />
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.content}>
          {currentCollateralData && !loading && (
            <Graph
              currentCollateralData={currentCollateralData}
              productId={selectedProductId}
              portfolioId={activeMarginalTab.portfolioId}
              portfolioType={activePortfolio}
              setCurrentType={setCurrentType}
              setNotRelevantError={setNotRelevantError}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(MarginalTrading);

import React from 'react';
import ContentLoader from 'react-content-loader';

const TabsSkeleton = () => (
  <ContentLoader
    speed={2}
    width={375}
    height={64}
    viewBox="0 0 375 64"
    backgroundColor="#f3f3f3"
    foregroundColor="#ecebeb"
  >

import React from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, ButtonBar, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import Link from '../../../../components/Link/Link';
import styles from './marginalTradingBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type MarginalTradingBottomSheetProps = {
  hintOpen: boolean;
  setHintOpen: (item: boolean) => void;
};
const MarginalTradingBottomSheet: React.FC<MarginalTradingBottomSheetProps> = ({
  hintOpen,
  setHintOpen,
}) => {
  const { data: hint } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const actualHint = hint?.hints.find((item) => item.slug === 'MARGIN_TRADING');

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={hintOpen}
      onDismiss={() => {
        setHintOpen(false);
      }}
    >
      <div className={styles.bottomSheet}>
        <Text type="subtitleSemiBold" color="colorForeground" className={styles.BSHeader}>
          Как это работает?
        </Text>
        {actualHint && (
          <div
            className={styles.hintText}
            dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: sanitizeHtml(actualHint.text) }}
          />
        )}
        <ButtonBar shape="vertical">
          <Link
            to="https://investpalata.ru/invest/faq/margin-1/"
            external
            classNameWrapper={styles.link}
          >
            Узнать больше
          </Link>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={() => {
              setHintOpen(false);
            }}
          >
            Всё понятно
          </Button>
        </ButtonBar>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default MarginalTradingBottomSheet;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getActualSubtitlesForMarginalGraph, getThumbPositions } from 'modules/Stats/helpers';

import EmptyMarginalCount from '../EmptyMarginalCount';
import VerticalLine from '../Graph/VerticalLine';
import styles from './marginalTradingRangeGraph.module.pcss';
import { MarginalTradingRangeGraphProps } from './types';

const MarginalTradingRangeGraph: React.FC<MarginalTradingRangeGraphProps> = ({
  min,
  portfolioValue,
  st,
  sign,
  isEmptyCount,
  isDebt,
  portfolioType,
  noMinMarginal,
  currentType,
}) => {
  const [activeData, setActiveData] = useState({ startX: 0, valueX: 0, color: 'FFF' });
  const [graphWidth, setGraphWidth] = useState(0);

  const { minCallValue, startCallName } = getActualSubtitlesForMarginalGraph(portfolioType);

  useEffect(() => {
    const { startX, valueX, color } = getThumbPositions(portfolioValue, st, min, currentType);
    setActiveData({ startX, valueX, color });
  }, [currentType, min, portfolioValue, st]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const graphWidthValue = window.innerWidth - 64;
    setGraphWidth(graphWidthValue);
  }, []);

  const itemWidth = (graphWidth * 0.9 * activeData.valueX) / 100;
  const cssVars = {
    '--startX-position': activeData.startX,
    '--valueX-position': activeData.valueX,
    '--colored-item-width': itemWidth,
  } as React.CSSProperties;

  const isGreenArea = portfolioValue > st;
  const isPositiveFromZero = st === min && portfolioValue > 0;

  if (isEmptyCount) {
    return <EmptyMarginalCount />;
  }

  if (isPositiveFromZero) {
    return (
      <div className={cx(styles.wrapper, styles.wrapperZeroCase)}>
        <div className={styles.graphWrapper} id="graphWrapper">
          <div
            className={cx(styles.coloredItemLabel, styles.coloredItemLabelEqualMarginValues)}
            style={{ ...cssVars, left: `50%` }}
          >
            <div className={styles.lineWrapper}>
              <div></div>
              <VerticalLine />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.valueTextBLock}>
              <div>
                <Text
                  type="labelSemiBold"
                  color="colorForeground"
                  className={cx(styles.textWrapperRight, styles.textWrapperRightEqualMarginValues)}
                >
                  {`${sumFormatter(portfolioValue)} ${sign}`}
                </Text>
                <Text
                  type="labelRegular"
                  color="colorForeground2"
                  className={cx(styles.textWrapperRight, styles.textWrapperRightEqualMarginValues)}
                >
                  Стоимость портфеля
                </Text>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div
            className={cx(
              styles.startItemLabel,
              startCallName.length < 15 ? styles.equalMarginValuesShort : styles.equalMarginValues,
            )}
          >
            <div>
              <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
                {`${sumFormatter(st)} ${sign}`}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
              <span>{startCallName}</span>
            </Text>
            <div className={styles.lineWrapper}>
              <VerticalLine />
              <div></div>
            </div>
          </div>
          {!noMinMarginal && (
            <div className={styles.minItemLabel} style={{ ...cssVars }}>
              <div className={styles.lineWrapper}>
                <VerticalLine />
                <div></div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <Text
                  type="labelSemiBold"
                  color="colorForeground"
                  className={styles.textWrapperLeft}
                >
                  {`${sumFormatter(min)} ${sign}`}
                </Text>
              </div>
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
                <span>{minCallValue}</span>
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
          <div
            className={styles.coloredItem}
            id="coloredItem"
            style={{
              width: '50%',
              backgroundColor: activeData.color,
            }}
          ></div>
          {!noMinMarginal && <div className={styles.thumbMin} />}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isDebt) {
    return (
      <div className={cx(styles.wrapper, styles.wrapperRedCase)}>
        <div className={styles.graphWrapper} id="graphWrapper">
          <div className={styles.startItemLabelRedCase}>
            <div className={styles.lineWrapper}>
              <VerticalLine />
              <div></div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
                {`${sumFormatter(portfolioValue)} ${sign}`}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
              Стоимость <br />
              портфеля
            </Text>
          </div>

          <div className={cx(styles.coloredItem, styles.coloredItemRedCase)} id="coloredItem"></div>
          <div className={cx(styles.thumbStart, styles.thumbStartRedCase)}></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>
      <div className={styles.graphWrapper} id="graphWrapper">
        <div
          className={styles.coloredItemLabel}
          style={{ ...cssVars, left: `${(itemWidth ?? 0) - (st === portfolioValue ? 6 : 2)}px` }}
        >
          <div className={styles.valueTextBLock} style={{ left: isGreenArea ? '-100%' : '0' }}>
            <div>
              <Text
                type="labelSemiBold"
                color="colorForeground"
                className={isGreenArea ? styles.textWrapperRight : styles.textWrapperLeft}
              >
                {`${sumFormatter(portfolioValue)} ${sign}`}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <Text
              type="labelRegular"
              color="colorForeground2"
              className={isGreenArea ? styles.textWrapperRight : styles.textWrapperLeft}
            >
              Стоимость портфеля
            </Text>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.lineWrapper}>
            <div></div>
            <VerticalLine />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.startItemLabel} style={{ ...cssVars }}>
          <div className={styles.lineWrapper}>
            <VerticalLine />
            <div></div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
              {`${sumFormatter(st)} ${sign}`}
            </Text>
          </div>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
            <span>{startCallName}</span>
          </Text>
        </div>

        {!noMinMarginal && (
          <div className={styles.minItemLabel} style={{ ...cssVars }}>
            <div className={styles.lineWrapper}>
              <VerticalLine />
              <div></div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <Text type="labelSemiBold" color="colorForeground" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
                {`${sumFormatter(min)} ${sign}`}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.textWrapperLeft}>
              <span>{minCallValue}</span>
            </Text>
          </div>
        )}
        <div
          className={styles.coloredItem}
          id="coloredItem"
          style={{
            width: min === portfolioValue ? `${activeData.valueX}%` : `${activeData.valueX * 0.9}%`,
            backgroundColor: activeData.color,
          }}
        />
        {activeData.valueX > activeData.startX && (
          <div
            className={styles.dashedItem}
            style={{
              ...cssVars,
            }}
          />
        )}
        {!noMinMarginal && <div className={styles.thumbMin} />}
        <div className={styles.thumbStart} style={{ ...cssVars }} id="thumbStart"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MarginalTradingRangeGraph;

import React, { useContext, useState } from 'react';

import { CompactTable, DataCell, PieChart, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import { colorData } from '../../../../const';
import { BlockType, PieChartInstrumentDTO } from '../../../../types';
import styles from './customPieChart.module.pcss';

type CustomPieChartProps = {
  data: PieChartInstrumentDTO[];
  selectedBlockType: BlockType;
  title: string | number;
  currencyCode: PriceCurrencyType;
  isDataLoading: boolean;
};
const CustomPieChart: React.FC<CustomPieChartProps> = ({
  data,
  selectedBlockType,
  title,
  currencyCode,
  isDataLoading,
}) => {
  const { sign } = useContext(StatsContext);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);

  const colorsData = colorData[selectedBlockType].map((color) => Object.values(color)[0]);

  const hasSelection =
    typeof activeIndex === 'number' && activeIndex <= data.length - 1 && activeIndex >= 0;

  const pieChartData = data.map((item) => {
    return {
      name: item.name,
      percents: item.percents,
      value: item.value,
      realValue: item.realValue,
    };
  });

  return (
    <div className={styles.pieChartWrapper}>
      <PieChart
        activeIndex={activeIndex}
        className={styles.chart}
        colors={colorsData}
        currency={currencyCode}
        data={pieChartData}
        dataKey="value"
        // onMouseLeave={() => setActiveIndex(-1)}
        // onMouseMove={(_, idx) => setActiveIndex(idx)}
        subtitle={data[activeIndex]?.name}
        title={
          hasSelection
            ? sumFormatter(data[activeIndex]?.realValue) +
              ' ' +
              currencySign(data[activeIndex].currencyCode)
            : sumFormatter(+title) + ' ' + sign
        }
        // onHover={(e, idx) => setActiveIndex(idx)}
      />
      {data.map((item, idx) => {
        const isActive = activeIndex === idx;
        return (
          <DataCell
            key={idx}
            addonRight={
              <>
                <Text
                  tag="div"
                  color="colorForeground"
                  type="lineSemiBold"
                  className={styles.extraText}
                >
                  {sumFormatter(+item.percents) + '%'}
                </Text>
                {selectedBlockType !== 'BLOCK_CURRENCIES' && (
                  <Text
                    tag="div"
                    color="colorForeground2"
                    type="labelRegular"
                    className={styles.titleWrapper}
                  >
                    {sumFormatter(item.value)} {currencySign(item.currencyCode)}
                  </Text>
                )}
              </>
            }
            addonBottom={
              selectedBlockType === 'BLOCK_CURRENCIES' ? (
                <CompactTable
                  className={styles.compactTable}
                  data={[
                    {
                      addonRight: (
                        <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="labelRegular">
                          {sumFormatter(item.realValue)} {currencySign(item.currencyCode)}
                        </Text>
                      ),
                      title: 'Всего',
                    },
                    {
                      addonRight: (
                        <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="labelRegular">
                          {sumFormatter(+item?.inPosition ?? 0)} {currencySign(item.currencyCode)}
                        </Text>
                      ),
                      title: 'В позиции',
                    },
                    {
                      addonRight: (
                        <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="labelRegular">
                          {sumFormatter(+item?.inCurrency ?? 0)} {currencySign(item.currencyCode)}
                        </Text>
                      ),
                      title: 'В денежных средствах',
                    },
                  ]}
                  size="small"
                />
              ) : null
            }
            as="div"
            className={cx(styles.cell, hasSelection && !isActive && styles['cell--inactive'])}
            classNameIndicator={styles.cell__indicator}
            indicator={true}
            onMouseLeave={() => setActiveIndex(-1)}
            onMouseMove={() => setActiveIndex(idx)}
            style={
              {
                '--indicator-color': colorsData[idx],
              } as React.CSSProperties
            }
            title={item.name}
            separator={data.length - 1 > idx}
          />
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CustomPieChart;

import React, { Fragment, useContext } from 'react';

import { Accordion, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import { BLOCK_CURRENCIES, BLOCK_INDUSTRIES, BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS } from '../../const';
import { pieChartDataFormatter } from '../../helpers';
import { ResultsDataType } from '../../types';
import PieChartPlug from './components/PieChartPlug';
import PieChartSkeleton from './components/PieChartSkeleton';
import { CustomPieChart } from './components/PieCharts';
import styles from './pieChartGroup.module.pcss';

type PieChartGroupProps = {
  pieChartData: ResultsDataType;
  selectedCurrencyCode: PriceCurrencyType;
  isDataLoading: boolean;
};
const PieChartGroup: React.FC<PieChartGroupProps> = ({
  pieChartData,
  selectedCurrencyCode,
  isDataLoading,
}) => {
  const { selectedBlockType } = useContext(StatsContext);
  const pieChartsTabs = [BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS, BLOCK_CURRENCIES, BLOCK_INDUSTRIES];

  if (!pieChartsTabs.includes(selectedBlockType)) return null;

  const isNotEmptyInstruments =
    pieChartData.instruments?.investmentsAmount || pieChartData.instruments?.liabilitiesAmount;

  const isNotEmptyCurrencies =
    pieChartData.currencies?.investmentsAmount || pieChartData.currencies?.liabilitiesAmount;

  const isInvestmentsAndLiabilitiesInstruments =
    pieChartData.instruments?.liabilitiesAmount && pieChartData.instruments?.investmentsAmount;

  const isInvestmentsAndLiabilitiesCurrencies =
    pieChartData.currencies?.liabilitiesAmount && pieChartData.currencies?.investmentsAmount;

  return !isDataLoading ? (
    <Fragment>
      {selectedBlockType === BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS && (
        <div className={styles.instrumentsWrapper}>
          {isInvestmentsAndLiabilitiesInstruments ? (
            <Accordion
              title={'Инвестиции'}
              isOpen={true}
              className={styles.wrapper}
              shape="headline"
            >
              <CustomPieChart
                data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.instruments.investmentsInstrumentsData)}
                selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
                title={pieChartData.instruments.investmentsAmount}
                currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
              />
            </Accordion>
          ) : pieChartData.instruments?.investmentsAmount ? (
            <CustomPieChart
              data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.instruments.investmentsInstrumentsData)}
              selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
              title={pieChartData.instruments.investmentsAmount}
              currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
              isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
            />
          ) : null}

          {isInvestmentsAndLiabilitiesInstruments ? (
            <Accordion
              title={'Обязательства'}
              isOpen={true}
              className={styles.wrapper}
              shape="headline"
            >
              <CustomPieChart
                data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.instruments.liabilitiesInstrumentsData)}
                selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
                title={pieChartData.instruments.liabilitiesAmount}
                currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
              />
            </Accordion>
          ) : pieChartData.instruments?.liabilitiesAmount ? (
            <div className={styles.liabilitiesWrapper}>
              <Text type="lineSemiBold" color="colorForeground" className={styles.liabilitiesTitle}>
                Обязательства
              </Text>
              <CustomPieChart
                data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.instruments.liabilitiesInstrumentsData)}
                selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
                title={pieChartData.instruments.liabilitiesAmount}
                currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
              />
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      )}
      {(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS || selectedBlockType === 'BLOCK_INDUSTRIES') &&
        !isNotEmptyInstruments && (
          <PieChartPlug currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode} type="instruments" />
        )}

      {selectedBlockType === BLOCK_CURRENCIES && (
        <div className={styles.instrumentsWrapper}>
          {isInvestmentsAndLiabilitiesCurrencies ? (
            <Accordion
              title={'Инвестиции'}
              isOpen={true}
              className={styles.wrapper}
              shape="headline"
            >
              <CustomPieChart
                data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.currencies.investmentsInstrumentsData)}
                selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
                title={pieChartData.currencies.investmentsAmount}
                currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
              />
            </Accordion>
          ) : pieChartData.currencies?.investmentsAmount ? (
            <CustomPieChart
              data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.currencies.investmentsInstrumentsData)}
              selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
              title={pieChartData.currencies.investmentsAmount}
              currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
              isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
            />
          ) : null}

          {isInvestmentsAndLiabilitiesCurrencies ? (
            <Accordion
              title={'Обязательства'}
              isOpen={true}
              className={styles.wrapper}
              shape="headline"
            >
              <CustomPieChart
                data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.currencies.liabilitiesInstrumentsData)}
                selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
                title={pieChartData.currencies.liabilitiesAmount}
                currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
              />
            </Accordion>
          ) : pieChartData.currencies?.liabilitiesAmount ? (
            <div className={styles.liabilitiesWrapper}>
              <Text type="lineSemiBold" color="colorForeground" className={styles.liabilitiesTitle}>
                Обязательства
              </Text>
              <CustomPieChart
                data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.currencies.liabilitiesInstrumentsData)}
                selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
                title={pieChartData.currencies.liabilitiesAmount}
                currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
              />
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      )}
      {selectedBlockType === BLOCK_CURRENCIES && !isNotEmptyCurrencies && (
        <PieChartPlug currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode} type="currency" />
      )}

      {selectedBlockType === BLOCK_INDUSTRIES && (
        <div className={styles.instrumentsWrapper}>
          {pieChartData.instruments.investmentsAmount ? (
            <CustomPieChart
              data={pieChartDataFormatter(pieChartData.industries.investmentsInstrumentsData)}
              selectedBlockType={selectedBlockType}
              title={pieChartData.industries.investmentsAmount}
              currencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
              isDataLoading={isDataLoading}
            />
          ) : null}
        </div>
      )}
    </Fragment>
  ) : (
    <PieChartSkeleton />
  );
};

export default PieChartGroup;
