import React, { useContext, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, ButtonBar, DatePicker, Text, useSnackbars } from '@aurora/components';

import { usePostReportMutation } from 'core/api/stats';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';
import { ALL_PRODUCTS } from 'modules/Stats/const';
import {
  getNormalizedDateFormat,
  getNumberDateFromString,
  getReportCurrentPreset,
  getReportCurrentYear,
} from 'modules/Stats/helpers';
import { useStatSnackBars } from 'modules/Stats/hooks';
import { DividendsPropsType, ReportParamsType } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import styles from './reportBottomSheet.module.pcss';

type ReportBottomSheetProps = {
  reportBSOpen: boolean;
  setReportBSOpen: (it: boolean) => void;

  selectedCurrencyId: number | null;
  selectedProductId: string | number;
  divProps: DividendsPropsType;
};
const ReportBottomSheet: React.FC<ReportBottomSheetProps> = ({
  reportBSOpen,
  setReportBSOpen,

  selectedCurrencyId,
  selectedProductId,

  divProps,
}) => {
  const {
    endPositionDate,
    beginPositionDate,
    beginDateAll,
    selectedBlockType,
    selectedDateRangeType,
  } = useContext(StatsContext);
  const [reportParams, setReportParams] = useState({} as ReportParamsType);
  const [createReport, setCreateReport] = useState(false);

  const userEMail = getSession()?.userEMail;
  const { snackbarTopAlert } = useSnackbars();
  const [postReport, { data: postReportData, error: postReportError, isError: isPostReportError }] =
    usePostReportMutation();

  useStatSnackBars(snackbarTopAlert, isPostReportError, postReportError, postReportData);

  const handleCreateReport = async () => {
    setReportBSOpen(false);
    setCreateReport(false);
    try {
      await postReport(reportParams);
    } catch (error) {
      console.log('error');
    }
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={reportBSOpen}
      onDismiss={() => {
        setReportBSOpen(false);
        setCreateReport(false);
      }}
    >
      <div className={styles.reportWrapper}>
        <Text color="colorForeground" tag="span" type="subtitleBold" className={styles.BSHeader}>
          {createReport ? 'Отправить отчёт?' : 'Отчёт за период'}
        </Text>
        {!createReport && (
          <DatePicker
            submitBtnText="Отправить отчёт на  e-mail"
            periodPreset
            defaultOptionPeriodPreset={getReportCurrentPreset(
              selectedBlockType,
              selectedDateRangeType,
              divProps.datePart,
            )}
            customOptionsPeriodPreset={['month', 'quarter', 'year']}
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              setCreateReport(true);
              const actualData = getNormalizedDateFormat(e as Date[]);
              const params: ReportParamsType = {
                currencyId: selectedCurrencyId,
                productId:
                  selectedProductId !== ALL_PRODUCTS ? (selectedProductId as string) : undefined,
                reportType: actualData.type,
                year: actualData.selectedYear,
                quarter: actualData.type === 'Quarter' ? actualData.selectedPeriod : undefined,
                month: actualData.type === 'Month' ? actualData.selectedPeriod : undefined,
                sendViaEmail: true,
              };
              setReportParams(params);
            }}
            minDate={new Date(beginDateAll)}
            defaultOptionReset={'month'}
            dates={
              selectedDateRangeType === 'day' || selectedDateRangeType === 'all'
                ? []
                : [
                    getNumberDateFromString(beginPositionDate),
                    getNumberDateFromString(endPositionDate),
                  ]
            }
            currentYear={getReportCurrentYear(
              selectedBlockType,
              selectedDateRangeType,
              divProps.endDate,
              endPositionDate,
            )}
          />
        )}
        {createReport && (
          <>
            <div>
              <p className={styles.BSHeader}>
                В течении часа отчёт за выбранный период будет отправлен на{' '}
                <span className={styles.boldText}>{userEMail}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
            <ButtonBar shape="horizontal">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={() => {
                  setReportBSOpen(false);
                  setCreateReport(false);
                }}
              >
                Отменить
              </Button>
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleCreateReport}>
                Подтвердить
              </Button>
            </ButtonBar>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default ReportBottomSheet;

import React from 'react';

import Text from '@vision/text';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { IconType, InfoItem } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import styles from './InfoList.module.pcss';

type Props = { data: InfoItem[] };

const getIconClassName = (type: IconType) => {
  switch (type) {
    case 'ATTENTION':
      return styles.iconAttention;
    case 'CONSTRUCTIVE':
      return styles.iconConstructive;
    case 'DESTRUCTIVE':
      return styles.iconDestructive;
    case 'DEFAULT':
      return styles.iconDefault;
    default:
      return styles.iconDefault;
  }
};

const InfoList = ({ data }: Props) => {
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      {data.map(({ type, icon, title, value }, index) => (
        <React.Fragment key={title}>
          {index !== 0 && <div className={styles.separator} />}

          <div className={styles.itemWrapper}>
            <div className={styles.itemInnerWrapper}>
              <div className={cx(styles.iconWrapper, getIconClassName(type))}>{icon}</div>

              <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.title}>
                {title}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <Text type="lineRegular">{value}</Text>
          </div>
        </React.Fragment>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default InfoList;

import React from 'react';

import Text from '@vision/text';

import { InfoItem } from 'modules/Stats/types';

import InfoList from '../InfoList';
import InfoListSkeletonGroup from '../InfoListSkeletonGroup';
import styles from './InfoSection.module.pcss';

type Props = { title: string; data: InfoItem[] | InfoItem[][]; isLoading: boolean };

const getKey = (items: InfoItem[]) => {
  return items.reduce((acc, { title }, index) => {
    if (index === 0) {
      return acc;
    }

    return `${acc}-${title}`;
  }, '');
};

const InfoSection = ({ title, data, isLoading }: Props) => {
  const isArrays = data.some((item) => Array.isArray(item));

  const rowsData = isArrays ? (
    (data as InfoItem[][]).map((items, index) => (
      <React.Fragment key={getKey(items)}>
        {index !== 0 && <div className={styles.separator} />}
        <InfoList data={items} />
      </React.Fragment>
    ))
  ) : (
    <InfoList data={data as InfoItem[]} />
  );

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <>
        <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.title}>
          {title}
        </Text>
        {isLoading && <InfoListSkeletonGroup />}
        {!isLoading && rowsData}
      </>
    </div>
  );
};

export default InfoSection;

import React, { useContext } from 'react';

import { StatsContext } from 'modules/Stats/Stats';
import { BLOCK_ASSETS, BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT } from 'modules/Stats/const';
import { useGetAssetsIncomeOtherData } from 'modules/Stats/hooks';

import InfoListSkeletonGroup from './components/InfoListSkeletonGroup';
import InfoSection from './components/InfoSection';
import styles from './statisticInformationTable.module.pcss';

type StatisticInformationTableProps = {
  isMainLoading: boolean;
  isPositionDataFetching: boolean;
};
const StatisticInformationTable: React.FC<StatisticInformationTableProps> = ({
  isMainLoading,
  isPositionDataFetching,
}) => {
  const { sign, positionsData, selectedBlockType } = useContext(StatsContext);
  const { assetsData, incomeAndCostsData, otherData } = useGetAssetsIncomeOtherData(
    sign,
    positionsData,
  );

  return (
    <>
      {(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT || selectedBlockType === BLOCK_ASSETS) && (
        <div className={styles.contentWrapperWithPadding}>
          {isMainLoading && <InfoListSkeletonGroup />}
          {assetsData && (
            <InfoSection title="Активы" data={assetsData} isLoading={isPositionDataFetching} />
          )}
          {incomeAndCostsData && (
            <InfoSection
              title="Доходы и расходы"
              data={incomeAndCostsData}
              isLoading={isPositionDataFetching}
            />
          )}
          {otherData && (
            <InfoSection title="Прочее" data={otherData} isLoading={isPositionDataFetching} />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default React.memo(StatisticInformationTable);

export const formatMonth = (month: string) => {
  switch (month) {
    case '1':
      return 'янв';
    case '2':
      return 'фев';
    case '3':
      return 'мар';
    case '4':
      return 'апр';
    case '5':
      return 'май';
    case '6':
      return 'июн';
    case '7':
      return 'июл';
    case '8':
      return 'авг';
    case '9':
      return 'сен';
    case '10':
      return 'окт';
    case '11':
      return 'ноя';
    case '12':
      return 'дек';
    default:
      return 'дек';
  }
};

export const getDateRange = ({ beginDate, endDate }: { beginDate: string; endDate: string }) => {
  const beginDateDay = DateTime.fromISO(beginDate).toFormat('dd');
  const beginDateMonth = DateTime.fromISO(beginDate).setLocale('ru').toFormat('M');
  const beginDateYear = DateTime.fromISO(beginDate).toFormat('yy');

  const endDateDay = DateTime.fromISO(endDate).toFormat('dd');
  const endDateMonth = DateTime.fromISO(endDate).setLocale('ru').toFormat('M');
  const endDateYear = DateTime.fromISO(endDate).toFormat('yy');

  return `${beginDateDay} ${formatMonth(
    beginDateMonth,
  )} ${beginDateYear} - ${endDateDay} ${formatMonth(endDateMonth)} ${endDateYear}`;
};

export const geDateRangeFromTimeStamp = ({ date }: { date: number }) => {
  const dateDay = DateTime.fromMillis(date).toFormat('dd');
  const dateMonth = DateTime.fromMillis(date).setLocale('ru').toFormat('M');
  const dateYear = DateTime.fromMillis(date).toFormat('yy');
  return `${dateDay} ${formatMonth(dateMonth)} ${dateYear}`;
};

export const getCustomDateRange = ({
  beginDate,
  endDate,
}: {
  beginDate: number;
  endDate: number;
}) => {
  if (beginDate === endDate) {
    return `${geDateRangeFromTimeStamp({ date: beginDate })}`;
  }
  return `${geDateRangeFromTimeStamp({ date: beginDate })} - ${geDateRangeFromTimeStamp({
    date: endDate,
  })}`;
};

export const formatNumber = (value: number) => Math.abs(value).toLocaleString();

export const getAssetsData = ({
  sign,
  financialResultStartAmount,
  endTotalAmount,
}: {
  sign: string;
  financialResultStartAmount: number;
  endTotalAmount: number;
}): InfoItem[] => {
  return [
    {
      type: ATTENTION,
      icon: <PeriodBeginningSvg />,
      title: 'Начало периода',
      value: numberValueChecker(financialResultStartAmount, sign, true),
    },
    {
      type: ATTENTION,
      icon: <PeriodEndSvg />,
      title: 'Конец периода',
      value: numberValueChecker(endTotalAmount, sign, true),
    },
  ];
};

export const numberValueChecker = (
  value: number | null | undefined,
  sign: string,
  isAbsValue = false,
) => {
  return value != undefined
    ? isAbsValue
      ? `${sumFormatter(value)} ${sign}`
      : `${value > 0 ? '+' : ''}${sumFormatter(value)} ${sign}`
    : '—';
};

export const getIncomeAndCostsData = ({
  sign,
  dividends,
  coupons,
  taxes,
  tradeProfit,
  commissions,
}: {
  sign: string;
  dividends: number;
  coupons: number;
  taxes: number;
  tradeProfit: number;
  commissions: number;
}): InfoItem[][] => {
  return [
    [
      {
        type: CONSTRUCTIVE,
        icon: <DividendsSvg />,
        title: 'Дивиденды',
        value: numberValueChecker(dividends, sign),
      } as InfoItem,
      {
        type: CONSTRUCTIVE,
        icon: <CouponsSvg />,
        title: 'Купоны',
        value: numberValueChecker(coupons, sign),
      } as InfoItem,
      tradeProfit >= 0
        ? ({
            type: CONSTRUCTIVE,
            icon: <PlusSvg />,
            title: 'Прибыль от сделок',
            value: numberValueChecker(tradeProfit, sign),
          } as InfoItem)
        : ({} as InfoItem),
    ].filter((item) => item?.title),
    [
      tradeProfit < 0
        ? ({
            type: DESTRUCTIVE,
            icon: <MinusSvg />,
            title: 'Убыток от сделок',
            value: numberValueChecker(tradeProfit, sign),
          } as InfoItem)
        : ({} as InfoItem),
      {
        type: DESTRUCTIVE,
        icon: <TaxesSvg />,
        title: 'Налоги',
        value: numberValueChecker(-taxes, sign),
      } as InfoItem,

      {
        type: DESTRUCTIVE,
        icon: <BrokersCommissionSvg />,
        title: 'Комиссия',
        value: numberValueChecker(commissions, sign),
      } as InfoItem,
    ].filter((item) => item?.title),
  ];
};

export const pieChartDataFormatter = (
  instrumentsData: PieChartInstrumentData[],
): PieChartInstrumentDTO[] => {
  const isCurrencyDTO = instrumentsData[0]?.inPosition || instrumentsData[0]?.inCurrency;
  return instrumentsData
    ?.map((element) => {
      return {
        name: element.groupName,
        percents: element.amountPcnt,
        value: Math.round((isCurrencyDTO ? element.amountPcnt : element.amount) * 100) / 100,
        inPosition: element?.inPosition || 0,
        inCurrency: element?.inCurrency || 0,
        currencyCode: element.currencyCode,
        realValue: Math.round(element.amount * 100) / 100,
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.percents - a.percents)
    .map((item) => {
      return item.percents < 0.1 ? { ...item, percents: '<0.1' } : item;
    });
};

function daysInMonth(month: number, year: number) {
  return new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
}

export const monthFormatter = (period: 'month' | 'quart' | 'year') => {
  const nowDate = DateTime.now();

  const month = nowDate.month;
  const year = nowDate.year;

  const quartsDates = {
    '1': { startDate: `${year}-1-01`, endDate: `${year}-3-31`, dateRange: 'Q1' },
    '2': { startDate: `${year}-4-01`, endDate: `${year}-6-30`, dateRange: 'Q2' },
    '3': { startDate: `${year}-7-01`, endDate: `${year}-9-30`, dateRange: 'Q3' },
    '4': { startDate: `${year}-10-01`, endDate: `${year}-12-31`, dateRange: 'Q4' },
  };

  switch (period) {
    case 'month': {
      const startDate = `${year}-${month}-01`;
      const endDate = `${year}-${month}-${daysInMonth(month, year)}`;

      const dateRange = `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`;

      return { startDate: startDate, endDate: endDate, dateRange: dateRange };
    }
    case 'quart': {
      const currentQuart = quartsMonths[month] as '1' | '2' | '3' | '4';
      const currentQuartDates = quartsDates[currentQuart];

      return {
        startDate: currentQuartDates.startDate,
        endDate: currentQuartDates.endDate,
        dateRange: `${currentQuartDates.dateRange} ${year}`,
      };
    }
    case 'year': {
      return { startDate: `${year}-1-01`, endDate: `${year}-12-31`, dateRange: `${year}` };
    }
    // No default
  }
};

export const getNormalizedDateFormat = (dates: Date[], isDayPeriod?: boolean) => {
  const startDate = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[0], { zone: 'local' }).toFormat(
    DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT,
  );
  const endDate = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[1], { zone: 'local' }).toFormat(
    DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT,
  );

  const diff = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[1]).diff(DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[0]), [
    'years',
    'months',
    'days',
    'hours',
  ]);

  const monthsDiff = diff.months;

  let rangeDate = '';
  let type = '';

  const startDay = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[0]);
  const endDay = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[1]);

  const currentMonth = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[0]).month;
  const currentYear = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[0]).year;
  const currentQuart = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[0]).quarter;

  const startDayValue = startDay.day;
  const startMonthValue = startDay.month;
  const startYearValue = startDay.year;

  const endDayValue = endDay.day;
  const endMonthValue = endDay.month;
  const endYearValue = endDay.year;

  if (isDayPeriod) {
    rangeDate = `${startDayValue} ${
      months[startMonthValue - 1]
    } ${startYearValue} - ${endDayValue} ${months[endMonthValue - 1]} ${endYearValue}`;

    type = 'Month';
  } else if (monthsDiff < 2) {
    rangeDate = `${months[currentMonth - 1]} ${currentYear}`;

    type = 'Month';
  } else if (monthsDiff === 2) {
    const endMonth = DateTime.fromJSDate(dates[1]).month;
    const currentQuart = quartsMonths[endMonth] as '1' | '2' | '3' | '4';
    rangeDate = `${quartsDates[currentQuart]} ${currentYear}`;
    type = 'Quarter';
  } else if (monthsDiff > 2) {
    rangeDate = endDate.split('-')[0];
    type = 'Year';
  }

  type periodsHelperEnum = 'Month' | 'Quarter' | 'Year';
  const periodsHelper = { Month: currentMonth, Quarter: currentQuart, Year: currentYear };

  return {
    startDate,
    endDate,
    rangeDate,
    type: type as 'Month' | 'Quarter' | 'Year',
    selectedPeriod: periodsHelper[type as periodsHelperEnum],
    selectedYear: currentYear,
  };
};

export const getDividendsRange = (period: DividendsRange) => {
  const nowDate = DateTime.now();

  const month = nowDate.month;
  const year = nowDate.year;
  switch (period) {
    case 'month': {
      return `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`;
    }
    case 'quarter': {
      const currentQuart = quartsMonths[month] as '1' | '2' | '3' | '4';
      const currentQuartDates = quartsDates[currentQuart];
      return `${currentQuartDates} ${year}`;
    }
    case 'year': {
      return year;
    }
    // No default
  }
};

export const isReportErrorType = (error: unknown): error is PostReportError => {
  const data = (error as { data?: unknown })?.data;
  return (
    typeof error === 'object' &&
    error != null &&
    'data' in error &&
    typeof data === 'object' &&
    data != null &&
    'error' in data &&
    Array.isArray((data as { error: unknown }).error) &&
    typeof (data as { error: unknown[] }).error[0] === 'object' &&
    (data as { error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).error[0] != null &&
    'error' in (data as { error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).error[0] &&
    typeof (data as { error: { error: unknown }[] }).error[0].error === 'string' &&
    'errorMessageText' in (data as { error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).error[0] &&
    typeof (data as { error: { errorMessageText: unknown }[] }).error[0].errorMessageText ===
      'string'
  );
};

export const barChartDataCreator = (
  data?: CorporateEventGroupedNormalizedType,
): BarChartDataType[] => {
  if (!data) return [];

  return data.cpnIsFact.map((element, index) => {
    return {
      date: element?.normalizedData ? element?.normalizedData : 0,
      name: (index + 1).toString(),
      pv: element.amount,
      amt: data.dvdIsFact[index].amount,
      uv: data.cpnIsNotFact[index].amount,
      rv: data.dvdIsNotFact[index].amount,
      startDate: element.normalizedStartDate,
      endDate: element.normalizedEndDate,
    };
  });
};

const getDatesFromCorporateEventGrouped = (arr: CorporateEventGroupedType[]) => {
  return arr.map((el) => {
    const date1 = DateTime.fromISO(el.startDate).toMillis();
    const date2 = DateTime.fromISO(el.endDate).toMillis();
    return {
      dates: [date1, date2],
      amount: el.amount,
      amountCurr: el.amountCurrency,
      type: el.typeCode,
      range: getCustomDateRange({ beginDate: date1, endDate: date2 }),
    };
  });
};

const getSortedPapersByPeriods = (data: ModdedType[], papers: CorporateEventType[]) => {
  return data.map((date) => {
    const currentPapers = papers
      .filter((paper) => paper.date >= date.dates[0] && paper.date <= date.dates[1])
      .map((paper) => {
        return {
          ...paper,
          date: geDateRangeFromTimeStamp({ date: +paper.date }),
          dateTmstp: +paper.date,
        };
      });

    const date1 = DateTime.fromMillis(date.dates[0]);
    const date2 = DateTime.fromMillis(date.dates[1]);
    const diff = date2.diff(date1, ['days']);
    const period = diff.days;

    const getPeriodRange = (days: number) => {
      if (days === 0)
        return {
          currentPeriod: 'day',
          range: geDateRangeFromTimeStamp({ date: date.dates[0] }),
        };
      else if (days > 26)
        return {
          currentPeriod: 'month',
          range: `${months[+date1.setLocale('ru').toFormat('M') - 1]} ${date1.year}`,
        };
      else
        return {
          currentPeriod: 'week',
          range: getCustomDateRange({ beginDate: date.dates[0], endDate: date.dates[1] }),
        };
    };

    const { currentPeriod, range } = getPeriodRange(period);

    const hasNotFactPayments = !!currentPapers.some((paper) => !paper.isFact);

    return {
      date: date.dates,
      dateRange: currentPeriod,
      papers: currentPapers,
      normalizedDate: range,
      cpnAmount: date.CPNAmount || 0,
      dvdAmount: date.DVDAmount || 0,
      currency: date.currency,
      hasNotFactPayments,
    };
  });
};

export const getFilteredGroupedData = (data: CorporateEventsDataNormalized) => {
  const corporateEventsData = data.corporateEventGroupedNormalized;

  const isFilteredCpnIsFact = corporateEventsData.cpnIsFact.filter((el) => el.amount > 0);
  const isFilteredCpnIsNotFact = corporateEventsData.cpnIsNotFact.filter((el) => el.amount > 0);
  const isFilteredDvdIsFact = corporateEventsData.dvdIsFact.filter((el) => el.amount > 0);
  const isFilteredDvdIsNotFact = corporateEventsData.dvdIsNotFact.filter((el) => el.amount > 0);

  const datesArr = [
    ...getDatesFromCorporateEventGrouped(isFilteredCpnIsFact),
    ...getDatesFromCorporateEventGrouped(isFilteredCpnIsNotFact),
    ...getDatesFromCorporateEventGrouped(isFilteredDvdIsFact),
    ...getDatesFromCorporateEventGrouped(isFilteredDvdIsNotFact),
  ].sort((a, b) => a.dates[0] - b.dates[0]);

  const outputArray: ModdedType[] = [...datesArr].reduce((acc: any, curr: any) => {
    const existing = acc.find((item: any) => item.range === curr.range);
    if (!existing) {
      acc.push({
        range: curr.range,
        [curr.type + 'Amount']: curr.amount,
        dates: curr.dates,
        type: curr.type,
        currency: curr.amountCurr,
      });
    } else {
      existing[curr.type + 'Amount'] = (existing[curr.type + 'Amount'] || 0) + curr.amount;
    }
    return acc;
  }, []);

  return {
    isFilteredCpnIsFact,
    isFilteredCpnIsNotFact,
    isFilteredDvdIsFact,
    isFilteredDvdIsNotFact,
    tableData: getSortedPapersByPeriods(outputArray, data.corporateEvent),
  };
};

export const getDatesIfSSisALLorDay = () => {
  const nowDate = DateTime.now();

  const month = nowDate.month;
  const year = nowDate.year;
  return {
    startDate: `${year}-${month}-01`,
    endDate: `${year}-${month}-${daysInMonth(month, year)}`,
  };
};

const shortYearFormatter = (year: string) => {
  return year.slice(2, 4);
};

export const getDatesFromCalendarHelper = (
  period: DividendsRange | 'all' | undefined,
  beginPeriodDate: string,
  endPeriodDate: string,
  beginDateAll?: string,
  endDateAll?: string,
  isFirstRequest?: boolean,
): DivResultsType => {
  const nowDate = DateTime.now();

  let month = nowDate.month;
  let year = nowDate.year;
  const currentDay = nowDate.day;

  const isPrevMonth = isFirstRequest && currentDay < 3;

  if (isPrevMonth) {
    const prevMonth = month - 1 >= 1 ? month - 1 : 12;
    const prevYear = month - 1 >= 1 ? nowDate.year : nowDate.year - 1;
    month = prevMonth as MonthNumbers;
    year = prevYear;
  }

  const datesFromCalendar = !!(beginPeriodDate || endPeriodDate);

  const yearFromCalendar = beginPeriodDate.split('-')[0];
  const monthFromCalendar = +beginPeriodDate.split('-')[1] as MonthNumbers;
  const quartFromCalendar = quartsMonths[monthFromCalendar] as '1' | '2' | '3' | '4';

  const dayFromCalendar = dayFromCalendarFormatter(+beginPeriodDate.split('-')[2]);

  const endYearFromCalendar = endPeriodDate.split('-')[0];
  const endMonthFromCalendar = +endPeriodDate.split('-')[1] as MonthNumbers;
  const endDayFromCalendar = dayFromCalendarFormatter(+endPeriodDate.split('-')[2]);

  const quartsDates = geQuartsDates(year);

  const initialState = {
    startDate: `${year}-${month}-01`,
    endDate: `${year}-${month}-${daysInMonth(month, year)}`,
    dateRange: `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`,
    divDateRange: `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`,
    datePart: 'day' as DividendsPeriodsType,
  };

  switch (period) {
    case 'day': {
      const dateRange = `${dayFromCalendar} ${formatMonth(
        monthFromCalendar.toString(),
      )} ${shortYearFormatter(yearFromCalendar)} - ${endDayFromCalendar} ${formatMonth(
        monthFromCalendar.toString(),
      )} ${shortYearFormatter(endYearFromCalendar)}`;

      return {
        startDate: beginPeriodDate,
        endDate: endPeriodDate,
        dateRange: dateRange,
        divDateRange: `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`,
        datePart: 'day',
      };
    }

    case 'month': {
      const startDate = `${year}-${month}-01`;
      const endDate = `${year}-${month}-${daysInMonth(month, year)}`;
      const dateRange = datesFromCalendar
        ? `${months[monthFromCalendar - 1]} ${yearFromCalendar}`
        : `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`;

      return {
        startDate: beginPeriodDate || startDate,
        endDate: endPeriodDate || endDate,
        dateRange: dateRange,
        divDateRange: dateRange,
        datePart: 'day',
      };
    }

    case 'quarter': {
      const currentQuart = quartsMonths[month] as '1' | '2' | '3' | '4';
      const currentQuartDates = quartsDates[currentQuart];

      return {
        startDate: beginPeriodDate || currentQuartDates.startDate,
        endDate: endPeriodDate || currentQuartDates.endDate,
        dateRange: datesFromCalendar
          ? `${quartsDates[quartFromCalendar].dateRange} ${yearFromCalendar}`
          : `${currentQuartDates.dateRange} ${year}`,
        divDateRange: datesFromCalendar
          ? `${quartsDates[quartFromCalendar].dateRange} ${yearFromCalendar}`
          : `${currentQuartDates.dateRange} ${year}`,
        datePart: 'week',
      };
    }
    case 'year': {
      return {
        startDate: beginPeriodDate || `${year}-1-01`,
        endDate: endPeriodDate || `${year}-12-31`,
        dateRange: datesFromCalendar ? `${yearFromCalendar} год` : `${year} год`,
        divDateRange: datesFromCalendar ? `${yearFromCalendar} год` : `${year} год`,
        datePart: 'month',
      };
    }
    case 'all': {
      return beginDateAll && endDateAll
        ? {
            startDate: beginDateAll,
            endDate: endDateAll,
            dateRange: getDateRange({ beginDate: beginDateAll, endDate: endDateAll }),
            divDateRange: `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`,
            datePart: 'month',
          }
        : initialState;
    }
    default:
      return initialState;
  }
};

const geQuartsDates = (year: number) => {
  return {
    '1': { startDate: `${year}-1-01`, endDate: `${year}-3-31`, dateRange: 'Q1' },
    '2': { startDate: `${year}-4-01`, endDate: `${year}-6-30`, dateRange: 'Q2' },
    '3': { startDate: `${year}-7-01`, endDate: `${year}-9-30`, dateRange: 'Q3' },
    '4': { startDate: `${year}-10-01`, endDate: `${year}-12-31`, dateRange: 'Q4' },
  };
};

export const getActualData = (
  beginDateAll: string,
  endDateAll: string,
  selectedDateRangeType: DateRangeType,
  beginStatDate: string,
  endStatDate: string,
) => {
  const nowDate = DateTime.now();
  const month = nowDate.month;
  const year = nowDate.year;
  const yearFromCalendar = beginStatDate.split('-')[0];
  const monthFromCalendar = +beginStatDate.split('-')[1] as MonthNumbers;
  const dayFromCalendar = +beginStatDate.split('-')[2] as DayNumbers;

  const endYearFromCalendar = endStatDate.split('-')[0];
  const endMonthFromCalendar = +endStatDate.split('-')[1] as MonthNumbers;
  const endDayFromCalendar = +endStatDate.split('-')[2] as DayNumbers;
  const quartFromCalendar = quartsMonths[monthFromCalendar] as '1' | '2' | '3' | '4';

  const quartsDates = geQuartsDates(year);

  const datesFromCalendar = !!(beginStatDate || endStatDate);
  const initialState = { beginDate: '', endDate: '', dateRange: null };

  if (!beginDateAll || !endDateAll) {
    return initialState;
  }
  if (selectedDateRangeType === DATE_RANGE_DAY) {
    const dateRange = `${dayFromCalendar} ${
      months[monthFromCalendar - 1]
    } ${yearFromCalendar} - ${endDayFromCalendar} ${
      months[endMonthFromCalendar - 1]
    } ${endYearFromCalendar}`;

    return {
      beginDate: beginStatDate,
      endDate: endStatDate,
      dateRange: dateRange,
    };
  }

  if (selectedDateRangeType === DATE_RANGE_MONTH) {
    const dateRange = datesFromCalendar
      ? `${months[monthFromCalendar - 1]} ${yearFromCalendar}`
      : `${months[month - 1]} ${year}`;

    const startDate = `${year}-${month}-01`;
    const endDate = `${year}-${month}-${daysInMonth(month, year)}`;

    return {
      beginDate: beginStatDate || startDate,
      endDate: endStatDate || endDate,
      dateRange: dateRange,
    };
  }

  if (selectedDateRangeType === DATE_RANGE_QUARTER) {
    const currentQuart = quartsMonths[month] as '1' | '2' | '3' | '4';
    const currentQuartDates = quartsDates[currentQuart];

    return {
      beginDate: beginStatDate || currentQuartDates.startDate,
      endDate: endStatDate || currentQuartDates.endDate,
      dateRange: datesFromCalendar
        ? `${quartsDates[quartFromCalendar].dateRange} ${yearFromCalendar}`
        : `${currentQuartDates.dateRange} ${year}`,
    };
  }

  if (selectedDateRangeType === DATE_RANGE_YEAR) {
    return {
      beginDate: beginStatDate || `${year}-1-01`,
      endDate: endStatDate || `${year}-12-31`,
      dateRange: datesFromCalendar ? `${yearFromCalendar}` : `${year}`,
    };
  }

  if (selectedDateRangeType === DATE_RANGE_ALL) {
    return {
      beginDate: beginDateAll,
      endDate: endDateAll,
      dateRange: getDateRange({ beginDate: beginDateAll, endDate: endDateAll }),
    };
  }

  return initialState;
};

export const barChartDataReducer = (data: BarChartDataType[]) => {
  return data.reduce((acc, it) => {
    acc += it.amt + it.pv + it.rv + it.uv;
    return acc;
  }, 0);
};

export const dateRangeNormalizer = (range: string) => {
  if (range === 'day') return DATE_RANGE_DAY;
  if (range === 'month') return DATE_RANGE_MONTH;
  if (range === 'quarter') return DATE_RANGE_QUARTER;
  if (range === 'year') return DATE_RANGE_YEAR;
  if (range === 'all') return DATE_RANGE_ALL;
  return DATE_RANGE_MONTH;
};

export const dateRangeAntiNormalizer = (range: string | undefined) => {
  if (!range) return;
  if (range === DATE_RANGE_DAY) return 'day';
  if (range === DATE_RANGE_MONTH) return 'month';
  if (range === DATE_RANGE_QUARTER) return 'quarter';
  if (range === DATE_RANGE_YEAR) return 'year';
  if (range === DATE_RANGE_ALL) return 'all';
  return 'month';
};

export const getAmountRangeColor = (
  value: number,
): 'colorForeground2' | 'colorConstructive' | 'colorDestructive' => {
  if (value === 0) return 'colorForeground2';
  return value === 1 ? 'colorConstructive' : 'colorDestructive';
};

export const getPeriodFromDatePart = (datePart: 'day' | 'week' | 'month') => {
  return {
    day: 'month',
    week: 'quarter',
    month: 'year',
  }[datePart];
};

export const getReportCurrentPreset = (
  selectedBlockType: BlockType,
  selectedDateRangeType: PeriodsRangeType,
  datePart: DividendsPeriodsType,
) => {
  if (selectedBlockType === 'BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT') {
    return selectedDateRangeType === 'all' || selectedDateRangeType === 'day'
      ? 'month'
      : (selectedDateRangeType as CalendarVariant);
  } else {
    return getPeriodFromDatePart(datePart) as CalendarVariant;
  }
};

export const getReportCurrentYear = (
  selectedBlockType: BlockType,
  selectedDateRangeType: PeriodsRangeType,
  endDivDate: string,
  endPositionDate: string,
) => {
  if (selectedDateRangeType === 'all' || selectedDateRangeType === 'day') {
    return selectedBlockType === 'BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT'
      ? +endPositionDate.split('-')?.[0]
      : endDivDate
      ? +endDivDate.split('-')?.[0]
      : DateTime.now().year;
  } else {
    return +endPositionDate.split('-')?.[0];
  }
};

export const getDivCurrentPreset = (
  selectedBlockType: BlockType,
  selectedDateRangeType: PeriodsRangeType,
  datePart: DividendsPeriodsType,
) => {
  if (selectedBlockType === 'BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT') {
    return selectedDateRangeType === 'all' || selectedDateRangeType === 'day'
      ? 'month'
      : (selectedDateRangeType as CalendarVariant);
  } else {
    return getPeriodFromDatePart(datePart) as CalendarVariant;
  }
};

export const valueFromAxisY = (value: number) => {
  if (value === 0) return '0';
  if (Math.abs(value) < 1000) {
    return (+(value / 100 + 0.1).toFixed(1) * 100).toFixed(0).toString();
  }
  if (Math.abs(value) < 10_000) {
    return (+(value / 1000 + 0.1).toFixed(1) * 1000).toFixed(0).toString();
  }
  const milValue = value / 1_000_000;
  return Math.abs(value) >= 1_000_000
    ? `${sumFormatter(milValue, milValue > 10 ? 0 : 1)} млн`
    : sumFormatter(value, 0);
};

export const getAmountRange = (
  financialResult: number,
  sign: string,
  pcntValue: number,
  withoutPercents: boolean,
) => {
  const initialCase = `0,00 ${sign}`;

  if (withoutPercents) {
    return financialResult === 0 ? initialCase : `${numberValueChecker(financialResult, sign)} `;
  }
  return financialResult === 0
    ? initialCase
    : `${numberValueChecker(financialResult, sign)} (${numberValueChecker(
        +Math.abs(pcntValue).toFixed(2),
        '',
        true,
      )}%)`;
};

export const getPositiveAmountRangeStatus = (financialResult: number) => {
  if (financialResult === 0) return 0;
  return financialResult > 0 ? 1 : 2;
};

export const getTappedDateRange = (startDate: number, endDate: number) => {
  if (startDate === endDate) {
    return geDateRangeFromTimeStamp({
      date: startDate,
    });
  }
  return `${geDateRangeFromTimeStamp({
    date: startDate,
  })} - ${geDateRangeFromTimeStamp({
    date: endDate,
  })}`;
};

export const getLineChartMessage = (
  emptyChartsData: boolean,
  areaChartsSmallDots: boolean,
  isMainLoading: boolean,
) => {
  if (isMainLoading) {
    return;
  } else if (areaChartsSmallDots) {
    return 'Недостаточно данных для построения графика за выбранный период';
  } else if (emptyChartsData) {
    return 'Не удалось загрузить данные';
  }
  return;
};

export const productIdFormatter = (productId: string | number) => {
  return productId === ALL_PRODUCTS ? undefined : productId;
};

export const getThumbPositions = (
  value: number,
  start: number,
  minValue: number,
  type: BannerLkTypes,
) => {
  const minX = 10;
  const startX = 65;
  const valueQ = (startX * value) / start;
  let valueX = valueQ > 100 ? 100 : valueQ;

  if (value === minValue) {
    valueX = minX;
  }

  if (start === value) {
    valueX = startX;
  }

  if (valueX > 65 && valueX < 70) {
    valueX = 70;
  }
  if (valueX > 60 && valueX < 65) {
    valueX = 60;
  }
  if (valueX > 10 && valueX < 15) {
    valueX = 15;
  }
  if (valueX < 10) {
    valueX = value > minValue ? 15 : value === minValue ? 10 : 6;
  }

  if (minValue > value) {
    valueX = 6;
  }

  return { minX, startX, valueX, color: typeColorsHelper[type] };
};

export const getDataFromPositionsParams = (positionsParams: PositionParamsResponse | undefined) => {
  if (positionsParams && positionsParams?.other?.[0] && positionsParams?.validDateRange?.[0]) {
    const { beginDate, endDate } = positionsParams.validDateRange[0];

    const { everRefilled } = positionsParams.other[0];

    return { beginDateAll: beginDate, endDateAll: endDate, isOpenCount: everRefilled };
  } else {
    return { beginDateAll: '', endDateAll: '', isOpenCount: false };
  }
};

export const dayFromCalendarFormatter = (day: number) => {
  return day >= 10 ? day : `0${day}`;
};

export const getNumberDateFromString = (date: string) => {
  const [year, month, day] = date.split('-');
  return new Date(+year, +month - 1, +day);
};

export const getActualSubtitlesForMarginalGraph = (portfolio: string) => {
  if (EBC_PORTFOLIOS.includes(portfolio)) {
    return portfoliosData['ЕБС'];
  } else if (CP_FORTS_PORTFOLIOS.includes(portfolio)) {
    return portfoliosData['CP_FORTS'];
  } else return portfoliosData['OTHERS'];
};

export const refetchFunctionsHelper = (statsErrors: StatsErrorsType[]) => {
  return statsErrors
    .map((errorArr) => {
      return errorArr.isError ? errorArr.callBack : undefined;
    })
    .filter((item) => item !== undefined);
};

import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { AllCurrenciesResponse, Currency } from 'types/catalog';
import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { PositionsResponse, StructurePositionsResponse } from 'types/positions';
import { PositionParamsResponse } from 'types/stats';

import { BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT, CURRENCIES_CODES } from './const';
import {
  getAssetsData,
  getIncomeAndCostsData,
  getOtherData,
  getPositiveAmountRangeStatus,
  isReportErrorType,
  numberValueChecker,
} from './helpers';
import {
  BlockType,
  InfoItem,
  PieChartInstrumentData,
  PieChartInstrumentsType,
  ReportParamsResponseType,
  ResultsDataType,
  SnackbarTopAlertType,
} from './types';

export const useGetPieChartData = (
  positionsData: StructurePositionsResponse | undefined,
  allCurrenciesData: AllCurrenciesResponse | undefined,
): ResultsDataType => {
  const pieChartData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!positionsData || !allCurrenciesData) return {} as ResultsDataType;
    const positionValuationData = positionsData.positionValuation?.[0];
    const positionValuationByCurrency = positionsData.positionValuationByCurrency;
    const instrumentsData = positionsData.positionValuationByInstrumentGroup;
    const industriesData = positionsData.positionValuationByIndustry;
    if (
      !positionValuationData ||
      !instrumentsData ||
      !positionValuationByCurrency ||
      !industriesData
    )
      return {} as ResultsDataType;
    const investmentsAmount = positionValuationData?.investmentsAmount || 0;
    const liabilitiesAmount = positionValuationData?.liabilitiesAmount || 0;

    const investmentsInstrumentsData: PieChartInstrumentData[] = instrumentsData
      .filter((item) => !(item.investmentAmount === 0 && item.investmentsAmountPcnt === 0))
      .map((group) => {
        return {
          currencyCode: group.currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType,
          groupName: group.groupName,
          amount: group.investmentAmount,
          amountPcnt: group.investmentsAmountPcnt,
          isLiabilities: false,
        };
      });

    const liabilitiesInstrumentsData: PieChartInstrumentData[] = instrumentsData
      .filter((item) => !(item.liabilitiesAmountPcnt === 0 && item.liabilitiesAmount === 0))
      .map((group) => {
        return {
          currencyCode: group.currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType,
          groupName: group.groupName,
          amount: group.liabilitiesAmount,
          amountPcnt: group.liabilitiesAmountPcnt,
          isLiabilities: true,
        };
      });

    const investmentsCurrenciesData: PieChartInstrumentData[] = positionValuationByCurrency
      .filter((item) => !(item.investmentsAmount === 0 && item.investmentsAmountPcnt === 0))
      .map((group) => {
        return {
          currencyCode: group.currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType,
          groupName:
            allCurrenciesData.currency.find((item) => item.code === group.currencyCode)?.name ||
            '-',
          amountPcnt: group.investmentsAmountPcnt,
          amount: group.investmentsAmount,
          inPosition: group.securityInvestmentAmount,
          inCurrency: group.currencyInvestmentAmount,
          isLiabilities: false,
        };
      });
    const liabilitiesCurrenciesData: PieChartInstrumentData[] = positionValuationByCurrency
      .filter((item) => !(item.liabilitiesAmount === 0 && item.liabilitiesAmountPcnt === 0))
      .map((group) => {
        return {
          currencyCode: group.currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType,
          groupName:
            allCurrenciesData.currency.find((item) => item.code === group.currencyCode)?.name ||
            '-',
          amountPcnt: group.liabilitiesAmountPcnt,
          amount: group.liabilitiesAmount,
          inPosition: group.securityLiabilitiesAmount,
          inCurrency: group.currencyLiabilitiesAmount,
          isLiabilities: true,
        };
      });

    const investmentsIndustriesData: PieChartInstrumentData[] = industriesData
      .filter((item) => !(item.investmentAmount === 0 && item.investmentsAmountPcnt === 0))
      .map((group) => {
        return {
          currencyCode: group.currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType,
          groupName: group.industryName,
          amount: group.investmentAmount,
          amountPcnt: group.investmentsAmountPcnt,
          isLiabilities: false,
        };
      });

    const instruments: PieChartInstrumentsType = {
      investmentsAmount: investmentsAmount,
      liabilitiesAmount: liabilitiesAmount,
      investmentsInstrumentsData: investmentsInstrumentsData,
      liabilitiesInstrumentsData: liabilitiesInstrumentsData,
    };
    const currencies: PieChartInstrumentsType = {
      investmentsAmount: investmentsAmount,
      liabilitiesAmount: liabilitiesAmount,
      investmentsInstrumentsData: investmentsCurrenciesData,
      liabilitiesInstrumentsData: liabilitiesCurrenciesData,
    };
    const industries: PieChartInstrumentsType = {
      investmentsAmount: investmentsAmount,
      liabilitiesAmount: 0,
      investmentsInstrumentsData: investmentsIndustriesData,
      liabilitiesInstrumentsData: [],
    };
    return { instruments, currencies, industries };
  }, [allCurrenciesData, positionsData]);
  return pieChartData;
};

export const useGetAmountRangeData = (sign: string, positionsData?: PositionsResponse) => {
  const { endTotalAmount, isPositiveAmountRange, amountRange } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!positionsData || !positionsData.financialResults) {
      return { endTotalAmount: null, isPositiveAmountRange: 0, amountRange: null };
    }

    const { endTotalAmount, financialResult, financialResultRelativePcnt } =
      positionsData.financialResults[0];

    return {
      endTotalAmount: `${numberValueChecker(endTotalAmount, sign)}`,
      isPositiveAmountRange: getPositiveAmountRangeStatus(financialResult),
      amountRange:
        financialResult === 0
          ? `0,00 ${sign}`
          : `${numberValueChecker(financialResult, sign)} (${numberValueChecker(
              +Math.abs(financialResultRelativePcnt).toFixed(2),
              '',
              true,
            )}%)`,
    };
  }, [positionsData, sign]);
  return { endTotalAmount, isPositiveAmountRange, amountRange };
};

export const useGetAreaChartData = (
  selectedBlockType: BlockType,
  positionsData?: PositionsResponse,
) => {
  const areaChartData = useMemo(() => {
    if (
      !positionsData ||
      !positionsData.financialResultsHistory ||
      !positionsData.positionValuationHistory
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    return selectedBlockType === BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT
      ? positionsData.financialResultsHistory.map(
          ({
            financialResultDay,
            financialResult,
            currencyCode,
            endDate,
            startDate,
            financialResultPcntDay,
          }) => {
            return {
              currencyCode: currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType,
              value: financialResult,
              valueDay: financialResultDay,
              endDate: Date.parse(endDate),
              startDate: Date.parse(startDate),
              percents: financialResultPcntDay,
            };
          },
        )
      : positionsData.positionValuationHistory.map(
          ({ amount, currencyCode, endDate, startDate }, index) => {
            return {
              currencyCode: currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType,
              value: amount,
              endDate: Date.parse(endDate),
              startDate: Date.parse(startDate),
              percents: 0,
              valueDay: amount,
            };
          },
        );
  }, [positionsData, selectedBlockType]);

  return areaChartData;
};

export const useGetAssetsIncomeOtherData = (sign: string, positionsData?: PositionsResponse) => {
  const { assetsData, incomeAndCostsData, otherData } = useMemo<{
    assetsData: InfoItem[] | null;
    incomeAndCostsData: InfoItem[][] | null;
    otherData: InfoItem[] | null;
  }>(() => {
    if (!positionsData || !positionsData.financialResults) {
      return { assetsData: null, incomeAndCostsData: null, otherData: null };
    }

    const {
      financialResultStartAmount,
      endTotalAmount,
      dividends,
      coupons,
      taxes,
      tradeProfit,
      commissions,
      inAmount,
      outAmount,
    } = positionsData.financialResults[0];

    return {
      assetsData: getAssetsData({ sign, financialResultStartAmount, endTotalAmount }),
      incomeAndCostsData: getIncomeAndCostsData({
        sign,
        dividends,
        coupons,
        taxes,
        tradeProfit,
        commissions,
      }),
      otherData: getOtherData({ sign, inAmount, outAmount }),
    };
  }, [positionsData, sign]);
  return { assetsData, incomeAndCostsData, otherData };
};

export const useCurrentSign = (
  filteredCurrencies: Currency[] | null,
  selectedCurrencyId: number | null,
  setSelectedCurrencyCode: (it: PriceCurrencyType) => void,
) => {
  const sign = useMemo(() => {
    if (!filteredCurrencies) {
      return '';
    }
    const foundCurrency = filteredCurrencies.find(({ id }) => id === selectedCurrencyId);
    setSelectedCurrencyCode((foundCurrency?.code as PriceCurrencyType) || 'RUB');
    return foundCurrency ? currencySign(foundCurrency.code as PriceCurrencyType) : '';
  }, [filteredCurrencies, selectedCurrencyId, setSelectedCurrencyCode]);
  return sign;
};

export const useStatSnackBars = (
  snackbarTopAlert: SnackbarTopAlertType,
  isPostReportError: boolean,
  postReportError: unknown,
  postReportData?: ReportParamsResponseType,
) => {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!postReportData) return;
    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 2500,
      label: 'PDF отправлен на почту',
      variant: 'secondary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [postReportData, snackbarTopAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(isPostReportError && isReportErrorType(postReportError))) return;
    const id = snackbarTopAlert?.show({
      autoClose: 2500,
      label: 'Отправка не удалась, повторите попытку или попробуйте позже',
      variant: 'primary',
    });

    return () => {
      id && snackbarTopAlert?.close(id);
    };
  }, [isPostReportError, postReportError, snackbarTopAlert]);
};

export const useGetFilteredCurrencies = (allCurrenciesData: AllCurrenciesResponse | undefined) => {
  return useMemo(() => {
    return allCurrenciesData
      ? allCurrenciesData.currency.filter(({ code }) => CURRENCIES_CODES.includes(code))
      : null;
  }, [allCurrenciesData]);
};

export const useGetDataFromParams = (positionsParams: PositionParamsResponse | undefined) => {
  const { beginDateAll, endDateAll, isOpenCount } = useMemo(() => {
    if (positionsParams && positionsParams?.other?.[0] && positionsParams?.validDateRange?.[0]) {
      const { beginDate, endDate } = positionsParams.validDateRange[0];
      const { everRefilled } = positionsParams.other[0];
      return { beginDateAll: beginDate, endDateAll: endDate, isOpenCount: everRefilled };
    } else {
      return { beginDateAll: '', endDateAll: '', isOpenCount: false };
    }
  }, [positionsParams]);

  return { beginDateAll, endDateAll, isOpenCount };
};

import React from 'react';

--- FILE: src\modules\Stats\Stats.tsx ---

import { createContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import {
  ROUTE_STATS_DYNAMIC,
  ROUTE_STATS_MARGIN_TRADING,
  ROUTE_STATS_STRUCTURE,
} from 'const/routes';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { useGetAllCurrenciesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { useGetProductsQuery } from 'core/api/orderHistory';
import { useLazyGetPositionsQuery } from 'core/api/positions';
import {
  useLazyGetCorporateEventsDataQuery,
  useLazyGetPortfoliosCollateralQuery,
  useLazyGetPositionParamsQuery,
  useLazyGetProductPortfoliosQuery,
} from 'core/api/stats';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { view360Selector } from 'core/view360/view360Selectors';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import {
  BlockType,
  DividendsCouponsData,
  DividendsPropsType,
  MarginTabType,
  PeriodsRangeType,
  PortfolioDataType,
  PositionPropsType,
  StructurePositionPropsType,
  TappedValueType,
} from 'modules/Stats/types';

import { HeaderPage, SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ShareSvg } from 'images/icons/share.svg';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import MainCountSkeleton from './MainCountSkeleton';
import styles from './Stats.module.pcss';
import Dividends from './components/Dividends';
import EmptyStatPage from './components/EmptyStatPage';
import ErrorPage from './components/ErrorPage';
import FilterCardGroup from './components/FilterCardGroup';
import FinResults from './components/FinResults';
import FinresultHeader from './components/FinresultHeader';
import Header from './components/Header';
import MarginalTrading from './components/MarginalTrading';
import PieChartGroup from './components/PieChartGroup';
import ReportBottomSheet from './components/ReportBottomSheet';
import StatisticInformationTable from './components/StatisticInformationTable';
import {
  ALL_PRODUCTS,
  BLOCK_ASSETS,
  BLOCK_DIVIDENDS,
  BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT,
  INITIAL_BOTTOM_SHEET,
  defaultValue,
  rubCurrencyId,
  statisticName,
} from './const';
import * as helpers from './helpers';
import * as StatsHooks from './hooks';

export const StatsContext = createContext(defaultValue);

const Stats = () => {
  const { productIdFromView360 } = useAppSelector(view360Selector);
  const { stateIsUk, stateIsStructure } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);

  const {
    isLoading: isAllCurrenciesLoading,
    isError: isAllCurrenciesError,
    data: allCurrenciesData,
    refetch: allCurrenciesDataRefetch,
  } = useGetAllCurrenciesQuery();

  const [
    getPositionsParams,
    {
      data: positionsParams,
      isLoading: positionsParamsLoading,
      isFetching: positionsParamsFetching,
      isError: isPositionsParamsError,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetPositionParamsQuery();

  const isPositionsParamsLoading = positionsParamsLoading || positionsParamsFetching;

  const [
    getDividendsData,
    {
      data: dividendsData,
      isLoading: dividendsLoading,
      isFetching: dividendsFetching,
      isError: isDividendsError,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetCorporateEventsDataQuery();

  const isDividendsDataLoading = dividendsLoading || dividendsFetching;

  const [
    getPositions,
    {
      isError: isPositionsError,
      data: positionsData,
      isLoading: isPositionDataLoading,
      isFetching: isPositionDataFetching,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetPositionsQuery();

  const isPositionsLoading = isPositionDataLoading || isPositionDataFetching;

  const [
    getStructurePositions,
    {
      isError: isStructurePositionsError,
      data: structurePositionsData,
      isLoading: isStructurePositionDataLoading,
      isFetching: isStructurePositionDataFetching,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetPositionsQuery();

  const [
    getProductsPortfolios,
    {
      isError: isProductsPortfolioError,
      data: productsPortfolios,
      isLoading: isProductsPortfoliosLoading,
      isFetching: isProductsPortfoliosFetching,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetProductPortfoliosQuery();

  const [
    getCollateralData,
    {
      data: collateralData,
      isLoading: collateralDataLoading,
      isFetching: collateralDataFetching,
      isError: isCollateralDataError,
    },
  ] = useLazyGetPortfoliosCollateralQuery();

  const {
    isLoading: isProductsLoading,
    isError: isProductsError,
    data: productsData,
    isFetching: isProductRefetch,
    refetch: productsDataRefetch,
  } = useGetProductsQuery({});

  const isProductsPortfoliosMainLoading =
    isProductsPortfoliosLoading || isProductsPortfoliosFetching;

  const structureDataLoading = isStructurePositionDataLoading || isStructurePositionDataFetching;

  const isDataLoading = isPositionDataLoading || isPositionDataFetching;

  const pieChartData = StatsHooks.useGetPieChartData(structurePositionsData, allCurrenciesData);

  const preSelectedProductId = useMemo(
    () => (stateIsUk || stateIsStructure ? ALL_PRODUCTS : productIdFromView360 ?? ALL_PRODUCTS),
    [stateIsUk, stateIsStructure, productIdFromView360],
  );
  const [selectedProductId, setSelectedProductId] = useState<string | number>(preSelectedProductId);

  const [selectedCurrencyId, setSelectedCurrencyId] = useState<number | null>(rubCurrencyId);
  const [selectedCurrencyCode, setSelectedCurrencyCode] = useState<PriceCurrencyType>('RUB');

  const [selectedBlockType, setSelectedBlockType] = useState<BlockType>(BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT);
  const [selectedDateRangeType, setSelectedDateRangeType] = useState<PeriodsRangeType>('month');

  const [isDatePickerOpen, setIsDatePickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isDivDatePickerOpen, setIsDivDatePickerOpen] = useState(false);

  const [beginPositionDate, setBeginPositionDate] = useState<string>('');
  const [endPositionDate, setEndPositionDate] = useState<string>('');

  const [statRange, setStatRange] = useState<string | null>('');
  const [divRange, setDivRange] = useState<string | null>('');

  const [tappedValue, setTappedValue] = useState<TappedValueType>(null);
  const [tappedDICValue, setTappedDICValue] = useState<DividendsCouponsData>(null);

  const [reportBSOpen, setReportBSOpen] = useState(false);

  const [isCurrentDivYear, setIsCurrentDivYear] = useState(true);

  const [positionProps, setPositionProps] = useState<PositionPropsType>({} as PositionPropsType);
  const [dividendsProps, setDividendsProps] = useState<DividendsPropsType>(
    {} as DividendsPropsType,
  );
  const [structurePositionProps, setStructurePositionProps] = useState<StructurePositionPropsType>(
    {} as StructurePositionPropsType,
  );

  const [notFormattedDates, setNotFormattedDates] = useState<Date[]>([]);

  const [isFirstRequest, setIsFirstRequest] = useState(true);

  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState(INITIAL_BOTTOM_SHEET);
  const [activeMarginalTab, setActiveMarginalTab] = useState<MarginTabType>({
    name: '',
    portfolioId: 0,
  });

  const [activeMarginalTab2, setActiveMarginalTab2] = useState<MarginTabType>({
    name: '',
    portfolioId: 0,
  });
  const [startLoading, setStartLoading] = useState(true);
  const [currentTabError, setCurrentTabError] = useState(false);

  const isMainLoading =
    startLoading ||
    isAllCurrenciesLoading ||
    isPositionsParamsLoading ||
    isPositionsLoading ||
    structureDataLoading;

  const marginalLoading =
    isProductsPortfoliosMainLoading ||
    collateralDataLoading ||
    collateralDataFetching ||
    isProductRefetch ||
    isProductsLoading;

  const statsErrors = useMemo(() => {
    return [
      { isError: isAllCurrenciesError, callBack: allCurrenciesDataRefetch },
      {
        isError: isPositionsParamsError,
        callBack: () => getPositionsParams({ productId: selectedProductId }),
      },
      { isError: isPositionsError, callBack: () => getPositions(positionProps) },
      { isError: isDividendsError, callBack: () => getDividendsData(dividendsProps) },
      {
        isError: isStructurePositionsError,
        callBack: () => getStructurePositions(structurePositionProps),
      },
    ];
  }, [
    isAllCurrenciesError,
    allCurrenciesDataRefetch,
    isPositionsParamsError,
    isPositionsError,
    isDividendsError,
    isStructurePositionsError,
    getPositionsParams,
    selectedProductId,
    getPositions,
    positionProps,
    getDividendsData,
    dividendsProps,
    getStructurePositions,
    structurePositionProps,
  ]);

  const marginalTradingErrors = useMemo(() => {
    return [
      {
        isError: isProductsPortfolioError,
        callBack: () =>
          getProductsPortfolios({ productId: selectedProductId as string, onlyPortfolio: true }),
      },
      {
        isError: isCollateralDataError,
        callBack: () => getCollateralData({ portfolioId: activeMarginalTab.portfolioId }),
      },
      { isError: isProductsError, callBack: productsDataRefetch },
    ];
  }, [
    activeMarginalTab.portfolioId,
    getCollateralData,
    getProductsPortfolios,
    isCollateralDataError,
    isProductsError,
    isProductsPortfolioError,
    productsDataRefetch,
    selectedProductId,
  ]);

  const refetchFunctions = useMemo(() => {
    return helpers.refetchFunctionsHelper(statsErrors);
  }, [statsErrors]);

  const currentLocation = document.location.pathname;

  const filteredCurrencies = StatsHooks.useGetFilteredCurrencies(allCurrenciesData);

  const sign = StatsHooks.useCurrentSign(
    filteredCurrencies,
    selectedCurrencyId,
    setSelectedCurrencyCode,
  );

  const { beginDateAll, endDateAll, isOpenCount } =
    StatsHooks.useGetDataFromParams(positionsParams);

  const portfoliosData: PortfolioDataType[] = useMemo(() => {
    const data = productsPortfolios?.portfolios ?? [];
    return data.map((item) => {
      return {
        id: item.portfolioId,
        name:
          item.portfolioTypeCode +
          (item.subAccountCode ? ' (л/c ' + item.subAccountCode + ')' : ''),
        type: item.portfolioTypeCode,
      };
    });
  }, [productsPortfolios]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeMarginalTab.portfolioId === 0) return;
    getCollateralData({ portfolioId: activeMarginalTab.portfolioId });
  }, [activeMarginalTab.portfolioId, getCollateralData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveMarginalTab({
      name: portfoliosData[0]?.name || '',
      portfolioId: +portfoliosData[0]?.id || 0,
    });
  }, [portfoliosData, selectedProductId, setActiveMarginalTab]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedProductId === ALL_PRODUCTS) return;
    getProductsPortfolios({ productId: selectedProductId as string, onlyPortfolio: true });
  }, [getProductsPortfolios, selectedProductId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAllCurrenciesError || isDividendsError || isPositionsError) {
      setCurrentTabError(true);
    }
  }, [isAllCurrenciesError, isDividendsError, isPositionsError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setStartLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    getPositionsParams({
      productId: helpers.productIdFormatter(selectedProductId),
    });
  }, [getPositionsParams, selectedProductId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDateRangeType === 'day') {
      const { rangeDate } = helpers.getNormalizedDateFormat(notFormattedDates, true);
      setStatRange(rangeDate);
    }
  }, [notFormattedDates, selectedDateRangeType]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_STRUCTURE) {
      setSelectedBlockType('BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS');
    } else if (currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_DYNAMIC) {
      setSelectedBlockType('BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT');
    }
  }, [currentLocation]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isNotCorrectForDVD = selectedDateRangeType === 'all' || selectedDateRangeType === 'day';

    const { endDate, startDate, dateRange, datePart, divDateRange } =
      helpers.getDatesFromCalendarHelper(
        selectedDateRangeType,
        beginPositionDate,
        endPositionDate,
        beginDateAll,
        endDateAll,
        isFirstRequest,
      );

    if (endDate && startDate && selectedCurrencyId && selectedProductId) {
      const currentPositionProps = {
        datasets:
          'FinancialResults,FinancialResultsHistory,PositionValuationHistory,PositionValuation',
        beginDate: startDate,
        endDate: endDate,
        currencyId: selectedCurrencyId,
        productId: selectedProductId !== ALL_PRODUCTS ? (selectedProductId as string) : undefined,
      };

      const currentDividendsProps = {
        beginDate: startDate,
        endDate: endDate,
        datePart: datePart,
        dateStep: 1,
        currencyId: selectedCurrencyId,
        productId: selectedProductId !== ALL_PRODUCTS ? (selectedProductId as string) : undefined,
      };

      setPositionProps(currentPositionProps);
      getPositions(currentPositionProps);
      setStatRange(dateRange);
      setBeginPositionDate(startDate);
      setEndPositionDate(endDate);
      setIsFirstRequest(false);

      if (!isNotCorrectForDVD) {
        getDividendsData(currentDividendsProps);
        setDividendsProps(currentDividendsProps);
        setDivRange(divDateRange);
        setIsCurrentDivYear(!(+endDate.split('-')[0] < DateTime.now().year));
      }
    }
  }, [
    beginPositionDate,
    endPositionDate,
    getDividendsData,
    selectedCurrencyId,
    selectedDateRangeType,
    selectedProductId,
    beginDateAll,
    endDateAll,
    getPositions,
    isFirstRequest,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCurrencyId && selectedProductId) {
      const currentStructurePositionProps = {
        datasets:
          'PositionValuation,PositionValuationByCurrency,PositionValuationByIndustry,PositionValuationByInstrumentGroup',
        currencyId: selectedCurrencyId,
        productId: selectedProductId !== ALL_PRODUCTS ? (selectedProductId as string) : undefined,
      };
      setStructurePositionProps(currentStructurePositionProps);
      getStructurePositions(currentStructurePositionProps);
    }
  }, [getStructurePositions, selectedCurrencyId, selectedProductId]);

  const isReportAllowed =
    !isMainLoading &&
    currentLocation !== ROUTE_STATS_MARGIN_TRADING &&
    isOpenCount &&
    !isDividendsError &&
    !isPositionsError &&
    !isAllCurrenciesError;

  const value = {
    sign,
    selectedProductId,
    selectedCurrencyId,
    selectedBlockType,
    positionsData,
    beginDateAll,
    endPositionDate,
    beginPositionDate,
    selectedDateRangeType,
    setBeginPositionDate,
    setEndPositionDate,
  };

  let page;

  if (isPositionsParamsError && !isMainLoading) {
    page = <ErrorPage refetchFunctions={refetchFunctions} />;
  } else if (!isMainLoading && !isOpenCount && selectedProductId === ALL_PRODUCTS) {
    page = <EmptyStatPage selectedProductId={selectedProductId} />;
  } else {
    page = (
      <StatsContext.Provider value={value}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <HeaderPage title={statisticName}>
            <Header
              currencies={filteredCurrencies}
              setSelectedProductId={setSelectedProductId}
              setSelectedCurrencyId={setSelectedCurrencyId}
              isError={isAllCurrenciesError}
              isHiddenCurrencies={currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_MARGIN_TRADING}
              bottomSheetState={bottomSheetState}
              setBottomSheetState={setBottomSheetState}
              productsData={productsData}
              isProductsLoading={isProductsLoading || isProductRefetch}
            />
          </HeaderPage>
          <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
            disableSwipe
            tabs={[
              { name: 'Динамика', link: ROUTE_STATS_DYNAMIC },
              { name: 'Структура', link: ROUTE_STATS_STRUCTURE },
              { name: 'Маржинальная торговля', link: ROUTE_STATS_MARGIN_TRADING },
            ]}
            classNameWrapper={styles.tabsWrapper}
            classNameContent={styles.tabsContent}
            classNameTabs={styles.tabs}
          >
            {isOpenCount && currentLocation !== ROUTE_STATS_MARGIN_TRADING && (
              <div
                className={styles.filtersWrapper}
                onTouchMove={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                }}
              >
                <FilterCardGroup
                  currentLocation={currentLocation}
                  setSelectedBlockType={setSelectedBlockType}
                />
              </div>
            )}
            {isAllCurrenciesError &&
              (currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_DYNAMIC ||
                currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_STRUCTURE) && (
                <ErrorPage refetchFunctions={refetchFunctions} insidePage />
              )}
            {isDividendsError && selectedBlockType === BLOCK_DIVIDENDS && (
              <ErrorPage refetchFunctions={refetchFunctions} insidePage />
            )}
            {isPositionsError &&
              (currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_DYNAMIC ||
                currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_STRUCTURE) &&
              selectedBlockType !== BLOCK_DIVIDENDS && (
                <ErrorPage refetchFunctions={refetchFunctions} insidePage />
              )}
            {!isMainLoading &&
              !isOpenCount &&
              currentLocation !== ROUTE_STATS_MARGIN_TRADING &&
              !currentTabError && <EmptyStatPage selectedProductId={selectedProductId} />}

            {!isPositionsError &&
              !isAllCurrenciesError &&
              currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_STRUCTURE &&
              isOpenCount && (
                <PieChartGroup
                  pieChartData={pieChartData}
                  isDataLoading={isDataLoading || isMainLoading}
                  selectedCurrencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                />
              )}

            {currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_MARGIN_TRADING && (
              <MarginalTrading
                loading={marginalLoading}
                collateralData={collateralData}
                selectedProductId={selectedProductId}
                setBottomSheetState={setBottomSheetState}
                setActiveMarginalTab={setActiveMarginalTab}
                activeMarginalTab={activeMarginalTab}
                setActiveMarginalTab2={setActiveMarginalTab2}
                activeMarginalTab2={activeMarginalTab2}
                portfoliosData={portfoliosData}
                marginalTradingErrors={marginalTradingErrors}
                // refetchMarginalFunctions={refetchMarginalFunctions}
              />
            )}
            {currentLocation === ROUTE_STATS_DYNAMIC && isOpenCount && !isAllCurrenciesError && (
              <div
                className={styles.contentWrapper}
                style={{
                  display:
                    (isPositionsError && selectedBlockType !== BLOCK_DIVIDENDS) ||
                    (isDividendsError && selectedBlockType === BLOCK_DIVIDENDS)
                      ? 'none'
                      : 'flex',
                }}
              >
                {isMainLoading && (
                  <div className={styles.contentWrapperWithPadding}>
                    <MainCountSkeleton />
                  </div>
                )}

                {!isMainLoading && (
                  <FinresultHeader
                    isDividendsError={isDividendsError}
                    isPositionsError={isPositionsError}
                    tappedValue={tappedValue}
                    tappedDICValue={tappedDICValue}
                    setIsDivDatePickerOpen={setIsDivDatePickerOpen}
                    setIsDatePickerOpen={setIsDatePickerOpen}
                    statRange={statRange}
                    isDividendsDataLoading={isDividendsDataLoading}
                    divRange={divRange}
                  />
                )}
                {selectedBlockType === BLOCK_DIVIDENDS && !isAllCurrenciesError && (
                  <Dividends
                    dividendsData={dividendsData}
                    isDividendsDataLoading={isDividendsDataLoading}
                    isCurrentDivYear={isCurrentDivYear}
                    tappedDICValue={tappedDICValue}
                    selectedCurrencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                    setSelectedDateRangeType={setSelectedDateRangeType}
                    setTappedDICValue={setTappedDICValue}
                    dividendsProps={dividendsProps}
                    isDivDatePickerOpen={isDivDatePickerOpen}
                    setIsDivDatePickerOpen={setIsDivDatePickerOpen}
                  />
                )}
                {(selectedBlockType === BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT ||
                  selectedBlockType === BLOCK_ASSETS) &&
                  !isAllCurrenciesError &&
                  !isPositionsError && (
                    <FinResults
                      isDatePickerOpen={isDatePickerOpen}
                      setIsDatePickerOpen={setIsDatePickerOpen}
                      setNotFormattedDates={setNotFormattedDates}
                      setSelectedDateRangeType={setSelectedDateRangeType}
                      setStatRange={setStatRange}
                      isMainLoading={isMainLoading || isDataLoading}
                      setTappedValue={setTappedValue}
                    />
                  )}
                <StatisticInformationTable
                  isMainLoading={isMainLoading}
                  isPositionDataFetching={isPositionDataFetching}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
          {isReportAllowed && (
            <div className={styles.bottomWrapper} onClick={() => setReportBSOpen(true)}>
              <Text type="lineMedium" color="colorAccent">
                Заказать отчёт
              </Text>
              <div className={styles.iconWrapper}>
                <ShareSvg />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <ReportBottomSheet
            reportBSOpen={reportBSOpen}
            setReportBSOpen={setReportBSOpen}
            selectedCurrencyId={selectedCurrencyId}
            selectedProductId={selectedProductId}
            divProps={dividendsProps}
          />
        </div>
      </StatsContext.Provider>
    );
  }

  return page;
};

export default Stats;

import { SnackbarCommonProps } from '@aurora/components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { PositionsResponse } from 'types/positions';

import {
  ATTENTION,
  BLOCK_ASSETS,
  BLOCK_CURRENCIES,
  BLOCK_DIVIDENDS,
  BLOCK_FINANCIAL_RESULT,
  BLOCK_INDUSTRIES,
  BLOCK_INSTRUMENTS,
  CONSTRUCTIVE,
  DATE_RANGE_ALL,
  DATE_RANGE_DAY,
  DATE_RANGE_MONTH,
  DATE_RANGE_QUARTER,
  DATE_RANGE_YEAR,
  DEFAULT,
  DESTRUCTIVE,
} from './const';

export type IconType = typeof ATTENTION | typeof CONSTRUCTIVE | typeof DESTRUCTIVE | typeof DEFAULT;

export type InfoItem = {
  type: IconType;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  value: string;
};

export type TappedValueType = {
  currencyCode: string;
  endDate: number;
  percents: number;
  startDate: number;
  value: number;
  valueDay: number;
} | null;

export type PieChartInstrumentData = {
  currencyCode: PriceCurrencyType;
  groupName: string;
  amount: number;
  amountPcnt: number;
  inPosition?: number;
  inCurrency?: number;
  isLiabilities: boolean;
};

export type PieChartInstrumentsType = {
  investmentsAmount: number;
  liabilitiesAmount: number;
  investmentsInstrumentsData: PieChartInstrumentData[];
  liabilitiesInstrumentsData: PieChartInstrumentData[];
};

export type ResultsDataType = {
  instruments: PieChartInstrumentsType;
  currencies: PieChartInstrumentsType;
  industries: PieChartInstrumentsType;
};
//todo PICK

export type PieChartInstrumentDTO = {
  name: string;
  percents: number | string;
  value: number;
  inPosition: number | string;
  inCurrency: number | string;
  currencyCode: PriceCurrencyType;
  realValue: number;
};

export type PeriodsRangeType = 'month' | 'quarter' | 'year' | 'day' | 'all' | undefined;

export type DividendsRange = 'month' | 'quarter' | 'year' | 'day';

export type DividendsPeriodsType = 'day' | 'week' | 'month';

export type ReportParamsType = {
  sendViaEmail: boolean;
  currencyId: number | null;
  productId?: string | number;
  reportType: 'Year' | 'Quarter' | 'Month';
  year?: number;
  month?: number;
  quarter?: number;
};

export type ReportParamsResponseType = {
  Request_Id: string;
};

export type SnackbarTopAlertType = {
  show: (props: SnackbarCommonProps) => string;
  close: (id: string) => void;
  closeAll: () => void;
} | null;

export type ReportErrorType = {
  status: number;
  data: { error: ErrorType[] };
};

type ErrorType = {
  error: string;
  errorMessageText: string;
};

export type PostReportError = {
  status: number;
  data: {
    error: Array<{ error: string; errorMessageText: string }>;
  };
};

export type PositionPropsType = {
  datasets: string;
  beginDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  currencyId?: number;
  productId?: string;
};

export type ModdedType = {
  range: string;
  CPNAmount?: number;
  dates: number[];
  DVDAmount?: number;
  type: 'CPN' | 'DVD';
  currency: PriceCurrencyType;
};

export type DateRangeType =
  | typeof DATE_RANGE_MONTH
  | typeof DATE_RANGE_QUARTER
  | typeof DATE_RANGE_YEAR
  | typeof DATE_RANGE_ALL
  | typeof DATE_RANGE_DAY;

export type DividendsPropsType = {
  beginDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  datePart: DividendsPeriodsType;
  dateStep: number;
  currencyId: number;
  productId?: string;
};

export type StructurePositionPropsType = {
  datasets: string;
  currencyId?: number;
  productId?: string;
};

export type BarChartDataType = {
  date: number;
  name: string;
  pv: number;
  amt: number;
