import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Checkbox, CircleLoader, Placeholder, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { skipToken } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { PATH_TARIFFS_TARIFF_SELECT, ROUTE_360, ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useGetAvailableTariffQuery,
  useGetCurrentTariffQuery,
  useSetTariffChangeMutation,
} from 'core/api/tariffs';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { tariffSelector } from 'core/tariff/tariffSelectors';
import { setActiveSlideIndex, setNeedUpdateTariffs } from 'core/tariff/tariffSlice';

import { isErrorResponseType } from 'utils/errorResponse';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import AdaptivePopup from 'components/AdaptivePopup';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { ReactComponent as ArrowRightSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/arrow-right.svg';
import { ReactComponent as AcceptedSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-success.svg';

import { SMS_COUNT } from '../../constants';
import { datePlusOneDay } from '../../helpers';
import styles from './ChangeTariff.module.pcss';

const ChangeTariff: React.FC = () => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const { tariffId } = useAppSelector(tariffSelector);
  const { productIdServices: productId } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tariffId === null) {
      navigate(`../${PATH_TARIFFS_TARIFF_SELECT}`);
    }
  }, [tariffId, navigate]);

  const { data: currentTariff, isLoading: currentTariffLoading } = useGetCurrentTariffQuery(
    productId ?? skipToken,
  );
  const { data: availableTariff, isLoading: availableTariffLoading } = useGetAvailableTariffQuery(
    productId ?? skipToken,
  );
  const [
    changeTariff,
    {
      data: initialOTPChallenge,
      isLoading: tariffChangeLoading,
      isSuccess,
      error: errorChangeTariff,
    },
  ] = useSetTariffChangeMutation();

  const isLoading = currentTariffLoading || availableTariffLoading || tariffChangeLoading;
  const [isTradingIdeas, setIsTradingIdeas] = useState(false);
  const [changeTariffSuccess, setChangeTariffSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true);

  const nextTariff = useMemo(
    () => availableTariff?.availableTariffs.find((tariff) => tariff.tariffId === tariffId),
    [availableTariff?.availableTariffs, tariffId],
  );

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    productId &&
      tariffId &&
      nextTariff &&
      changeTariff({
        productType_Id: nextTariff.productTypeId,
        tariff_Id: tariffId,
        YFA: isTradingIdeas,
        productId: productId,
      });
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    dispatch(setNeedUpdateTariffs(productId));
    productId && dispatch(setActiveSlideIndex({ [productId]: 0 }));
    setChangeTariffSuccess(true);
  };

  const handleActionButtonClick = () => {
    productId ? navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION) : navigate(ROUTE_360);
  };

  const currentRevertTariff =
    currentTariff && tariffId === currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffId;

  const handleBackClick = () => navigate(`../${PATH_TARIFFS_TARIFF_SELECT}`);

  if (changeTariffSuccess) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage
          leftIconVariant={'back'}
          title={!currentRevertTariff ? 'Смена тарифа' : 'Отмена изменения  тарифа'}
          onLeftIconClick={handleActionButtonClick}
          indent
        />
        {!isMobile && (
          <Text type={'title'} className={styles.successTextWrap}>
            {!currentRevertTariff ? 'Смена тарифа' : 'Отмена изменения  тарифа'}
          </Text>
        )}

        <Placeholder
          onActionButtonClick={handleActionButtonClick}
          actionButtonText={'Хорошо'}
          badgeText={!currentRevertTariff ? 'Заявка принята в работу' : 'Заявка выполнена'}
          title={!currentRevertTariff ? 'Заявка принята' : 'Заявка выполнена'}
          text={
            !currentRevertTariff
              ? `Мы получили ваш запрос, изменения вступят в силу с ${datePlusOneDay()} года`
              : 'Мы получили ваш запрос, изменения вступили в силу'
          }
          variant={'success'}
          img={<AcceptedSvg />}
          className={cx({ [styles.placeholderDesktop]: !isMobile })}
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  if (errorChangeTariff) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage
          leftIconVariant={'close'}
          onLeftIconClick={() => navigate(`../${PATH_TARIFFS_TARIFF_SELECT}`)}
          documentTitle={'Ошибка'}
        />
        <Placeholder
          onActionButtonClick={handleSubmit}
          actionButtonText={'Отправить ещё раз'}
          badgeText={'Ошибка'}
          title={'Отправка не удалась'}
          text={'Попробуйте ещё раз или вернитесь позднее, чтобы повторить отправку'}
          variant={'error'}
          className={cx({ [styles.placeholderDesktop]: !isMobile })}
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {(isMobile && !isSuccess) || !isMobile ? (
        <>
          <HeaderPage
            title={!currentRevertTariff ? 'Смена тарифа' : 'Отмена изменения  тарифа'}
            leftIconVariant={'back'}
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          />

          {isLoading && isMobile ? (
            <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />
          ) : (
            <div className={isMobile ? styles.changeWrapper : styles.changeWrapperDesktop}>
              <div className={styles.main}>
                <Text type={'subtitleBold'}>
                  {!currentRevertTariff ? 'Подтвердите смену тарифа' : 'Отмена изменения тарифа'}
                </Text>
                <div className={styles.description}>
                  <Text>
                    {!currentRevertTariff
                      ? 'Проверьте данные и подтвердите согласие на смену тарифа'
                      : 'Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения'}
                  </Text>
                  <div className={styles.tariffs}>
                    <Text className={styles.text} type={'bodySemiBold'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                      {!currentRevertTariff
                        ? currentTariff?.productTariff[0].currentTariffName
                        : currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffName}
                    </Text>
                    <div className={styles.svg}>
                      <ArrowRightSvg />
                    </div>
                    <Text className={styles.text} type={'bodySemiBold'}>
                      {nextTariff?.tariffName}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                  <div className={styles.tariffDate}>
                    <Text tag={'span'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                      Вступит в силу{' '}
                    </Text>
                    <Text tag={'span'} color={'colorForeground2'} type={'bodySemiBold'}>
                      {!currentRevertTariff ? `с ${datePlusOneDay()} года` : 'после подтверждения'}
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className={styles.tradingIdeas}>
                  {!currentRevertTariff && (
                    <Checkbox
                      checked={isTradingIdeas}
                      onChange={() => setIsTradingIdeas(!isTradingIdeas)}
                      label={
                        <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground'}>
                          Хочу получать торговые идеи бесплатно. Отменить подписку можно в
                          настройках
                        </Text>
                      }
                    />
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={isMobile ? styles.footer : styles.footerDesktop}>
                {!currentRevertTariff && (
                  <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                    Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
                  </Text>
                )}
                <Button
                  onClick={handleSubmit}
                  className={cx({ [styles.btn]: !isMobile })}
                  loading={isLoading && !isMobile}
                >
                  {!currentRevertTariff ? 'Подтвердить' : 'Получить код'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {isSuccess && !isMobile && (
            <AdaptivePopup
              open={isOpen}
              onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
              className={styles.popup}
            >
              {!isMobile && (
                <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.popupTitle}>
                  SMS-подтверждение
                </Text>
              )}

              <SmsConfirmation
                initialOTPChallenge={initialOTPChallenge?.otpChallenge}
                onError={() =>
                  createAlertNotification({
                    status: 'error',
                    text: isErrorResponseType(errorChangeTariff)
                      ? errorChangeTariff.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText
                      : 'Произошла ошибка',
                  })
                }
                onSuccess={handleConfirm}
                smsInputCount={SMS_COUNT}
                loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется смена тарифа...</Text>}
              />
            </AdaptivePopup>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.smsWrap}>
          <SmsConfirmation
            initialOTPChallenge={initialOTPChallenge?.otpChallenge}
            onError={() =>
              createAlertNotification({
                status: 'error',
                text: isErrorResponseType(errorChangeTariff)
                  ? errorChangeTariff.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText
                  : 'Произошла ошибка',
              })
            }
            onSuccess={handleConfirm}
            smsInputCount={SMS_COUNT}
            loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется смена тарифа...</Text>}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default ChangeTariff;

import React, { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { skipToken } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query';
import { ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION, ROUTE_PROFILE } from 'const/routes';
import { Pagination } from 'swiper';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';
// eslint-disable-next-line import/no-unresolved
import { PaginationOptions } from 'swiper/types';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetAvailableTariffQuery, useGetCurrentTariffQuery } from 'core/api/tariffs';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { tariffSelector } from 'core/tariff/tariffSelectors';
import {
  setActiveSlideIndex,
  setNeedUpdateTariffs,
  setTariffIsArchive,
} from 'core/tariff/tariffSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as DownloadSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/download.svg';
import { ReactComponent as PDFIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/pdf-icon.svg';

import { PRODUCT_OPTIONS_TARIFF_CHANGE } from '../../constants';
import TariffSlide from '../TariffSlide';
import styles from './Tariffs.module.pcss';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/pagination';

const Tariffs: React.FC = () => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const { needUpdateTariffs, activeSlideIndex } = useAppSelector(tariffSelector);
  const { productIdServices } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (productIdServices === null) {
      navigate(ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION);
    }
  }, [productIdServices, navigate]);

  const {
    data: currentTariff,
    isFetching: currentTariffFetching,
    refetch: refetchCurrentTariff,
  } = useGetCurrentTariffQuery(productIdServices ?? skipToken);
  const {
    data: availableTariff,
    isFetching: availableTariffFetching,
    refetch: refetchAvailableTariff,
  } = useGetAvailableTariffQuery(productIdServices ?? skipToken);
  const isFetching = currentTariffFetching || availableTariffFetching;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (productIdServices && needUpdateTariffs === productIdServices) {
      refetchCurrentTariff();
      refetchAvailableTariff();
      dispatch(setActiveSlideIndex({ [productIdServices]: 0 }));
      dispatch(setNeedUpdateTariffs(null));
    }
  }, [
    needUpdateTariffs,
    productIdServices,
    navigate,
    refetchCurrentTariff,
    refetchAvailableTariff,
    dispatch,
  ]);

  const pagination: PaginationOptions = {
    dynamicBullets: true,
    dynamicMainBullets: 2,
    renderBullet: (index: number, className: string) => '<span class="' + className + '"></span>',
  };

  const openTariffPdf = () =>
    window.open('https://investpalata.ru/current_broker_tarif', '_blank', 'noopener, noreferrer');

  const isFutureTariff = currentTariff?.productTariff[0].futureTariffName;
  const availableTariffNameList = availableTariff?.availableTariffs.map(
    (tariff) => tariff.tariffName,
  );
  const currentTariffName = currentTariff?.productTariff[0].currentTariffName;

  //фильтр доступных тарифов, чтобы исключить двойной вывод одного и того же тарифа
  const availableTariffFilter = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isFutureTariff) {
      return availableTariff?.availableTariffs;
    }
    return (
      availableTariff &&
      availableTariff.availableTariffs.filter(
        (tariff) => tariff.tariffId !== currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffId,
      )
    );
  }, [availableTariff, currentTariff?.productTariff, isFutureTariff]);

  const tariffGranted =
    productIdServices && Permissions.granted(PRODUCT_OPTIONS_TARIFF_CHANGE, productIdServices);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (availableTariffNameList?.includes(currentTariffName ? currentTariffName : '')) {
      dispatch(setTariffIsArchive(true));
    } else {
      dispatch(setTariffIsArchive(false));
    }
  }, [availableTariffNameList, currentTariffName, dispatch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // чтобы нижний бар ios в pwa был в цвет фона
    isMobile && document.body.classList.add(styles.body);
    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove(styles.body);
    };
  }, [isMobile]);

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        title={'Выберите тариф'}
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_PROFILE)}
      />
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.background : styles.backgroundDesktop}>
        {isFetching ? (
          <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />
        ) : (
          <>
            {isMobile ? (
              <>
                <div className={styles.swiperWrapper}>
                  <Swiper
                    slidesPerView={1.2}
                    spaceBetween={10}
                    pagination={pagination}
                    modules={[Pagination]}
                    className={styles.swiper}
                    centeredSlides={true}
                    onActiveIndexChange={({ activeIndex }) =>
                      productIdServices &&
                      dispatch(setActiveSlideIndex({ [productIdServices]: activeIndex }))
                    }
                    initialSlide={(productIdServices && activeSlideIndex[productIdServices]) || 0}
                    slideActiveClass={styles.swiperSlideActive}
                  >
                    {isFutureTariff && (
                      <SwiperSlide className={styles.slider}>
                        <TariffSlide
                          tariffType={'future'}
                          tariffName={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffName}
                          tariffDescription={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffHint}
                          tariffId={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffId}
                          tariffFutureDate={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffDate}
                          tariffParamsUnicode={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffParams}
                        />
                      </SwiperSlide>
                    )}
                    {currentTariff && (
                      <SwiperSlide className={styles.slider}>
                        <TariffSlide
                          tariffType={isFutureTariff ? 'current-revert' : 'current'}
                          tariffName={currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffName}
                          tariffDescription={currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffHint}
                          tariffId={currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffId}
                          tariffParamsUnicode={currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffParams}
                        />
                      </SwiperSlide>
                    )}
                    {tariffGranted &&
                      availableTariffFilter &&
                      availableTariffFilter.map((tariff) => (
                        <SwiperSlide className={styles.slider} key={tariff.tariffId}>
                          <TariffSlide
                            tariffType={'available'}
                            tariffName={tariff.tariffName}
                            tariffDescription={tariff.tariffDescription}
                            tariffId={tariff.tariffId}
                            tariffParamsUnicode={tariff.tariffParams}
                          />
                        </SwiperSlide>
                      ))}
                  </Swiper>
                </div>
                <div className={styles.pdfWrapper}>
                  <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Полные условия тарифа</Text>
                  <div className={styles.pdf} onClick={openTariffPdf}>
                    <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Открыть PDF </Text>
                    <DownloadSvg />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className={styles.titleWrap}>
                  <Text type={'title'}>Выберите тариф</Text>
                  <div onClick={openTariffPdf} className={styles.linkWrap}>
                    <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorAccent'}>
                      <PDFIcon className={styles.pdfIcon} /> Полные условия
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className={styles.container}>
                  <div className={styles.wrapperDesktop}>
                    {isFutureTariff && (
                      <TariffSlide
                        tariffType={'future'}
                        tariffName={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffName}
                        tariffDescription={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffHint}
                        tariffId={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffId}
                        tariffFutureDate={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffDate}
                        tariffParamsUnicode={currentTariff.productTariff[0].futureTariffParams}
                      />
                    )}
                    {currentTariff && (
                      <TariffSlide
                        tariffType={isFutureTariff ? 'current-revert' : 'current'}
                        tariffName={currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffName}
                        tariffDescription={currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffHint}
                        tariffId={currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffId}
                        tariffParamsUnicode={currentTariff.productTariff[0].currentTariffParams}
                      />
                    )}
                    {tariffGranted &&
                      availableTariffFilter &&
                      availableTariffFilter.map((tariff) => (
                        <TariffSlide
                          tariffType={'available'}
                          tariffName={tariff.tariffName}
                          tariffDescription={tariff.tariffDescription}
                          tariffId={tariff.tariffId}
                          tariffParamsUnicode={tariff.tariffParams}
                          key={tariff.tariffId}
                        />
                      ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default Tariffs;

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import Hint from '@vision/hint';
import { PATH_TARIFFS_TARIFF_CHANGE } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { tariffSelector } from 'core/tariff/tariffSelectors';
import { setTariffId } from 'core/tariff/tariffSlice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { dateNormalize } from '../../helpers';
import TariffSvg from '../TariffSvg';
import styles from './TariffSlide.module.pcss';
import { TariffSlideProps, tariffParamsProps } from './types';

const TariffSlide: React.FC<TariffSlideProps> = ({
  tariffType = 'available',
  tariffName,
  tariffId,
  tariffDescription,
  tariffFutureDate,
  tariffParamsUnicode,
}) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleChangeTariff = (tariffId: number) => {
    dispatch(setTariffId(tariffId));
    navigate(`../${PATH_TARIFFS_TARIFF_CHANGE}`);
  };
  const handleAbout = () =>
    window.open('https://investpalata.ru/invest/tariffs/', '_blank', 'noopener, noreferrer');

  const tariffParams: tariffParamsProps[] = tariffParamsUnicode && JSON.parse(tariffParamsUnicode);

  const { tariffIsArchive } = useAppSelector(tariffSelector);

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.wrapperSvg}>
        <div className={isMobile ? styles.backgroundSvg : styles.backgroundSvgDesktop} />
        <div className={isMobile ? styles.svg : styles.svgDesktop}>
          <TariffSvg tariffId={tariffId} />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.aboutWrapper : styles.aboutWrapperDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.head}>
          <Text type={'title'} color={'colorForeground'}>
            {tariffName}
          </Text>
          <Hint content={tariffDescription} placement={'bottom'} titleClassName={styles.hint}>
            <Text type={'bodyRegular'} color={'colorForeground'}>
              <span className={styles.lineClamp}>{tariffDescription}</span>
            </Text>
          </Hint>
        </div>
        {tariffParams &&
          tariffParams.map((params) => (
            <div className={styles.description} key={params.name}>
              <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                {params.name}
              </Text>
              <Text type={'title'} color={'colorForeground'}>
                {params.subname}
              </Text>
              {tariffType === 'available' && (
                <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                  {params.comment}
                </Text>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        <div className={styles.footer}>
          {tariffType === 'future' && (
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
              Вступит в силу {tariffFutureDate && dateNormalize(tariffFutureDate)}
            </Text>
          )}
          {tariffType === 'current' && (
            <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
              Текущий тариф
            </Text>
          )}
          {tariffType === 'available' && (
            <Button onClick={() => handleChangeTariff(tariffId)}>Выбрать тариф</Button>
          )}
          {tariffType === 'current-revert' && tariffIsArchive && (
            <Button onClick={() => handleChangeTariff(tariffId)} variant={'secondary'}>
              Вернуть тариф
            </Button>
          )}
          <div onClick={handleAbout} className={styles.link}>
            <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} color={'colorAccent'}>
              Узнать больше
            </Text>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TariffSlide;

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { PRODUCT_OPTIONS_TARIFF } from './constants';

export const dateNormalize = (date: string) => DateTime.fromISO(date).toLocaleString();

export const datePlusOneDay = () => DateTime.now().plus({ days: 1 }).toFormat('d MMMM yyyy');

export const getOrderPermissions = (productId: number) => {
  return Permissions.granted(PRODUCT_OPTIONS_TARIFF, productId);
};

type TestCaseType<Args, Exp> = { args: Args; expected: Exp }[];

export const DATE_TIME_NOW_FAKE = new Date('2020-01-01');

export const DATE_NORMALIZE_CASES: TestCaseType<string, string> = [
  { args: '2022-09-22T10:16:49.409Z', expected: '22.09.2022' },
];

export const DATE_PLUS_ONE_DAY_CASES: TestCaseType<void, string> = [
  { args: undefined, expected: '2 января 2020' },
];

];


--- FILE: src\modules\Tariffs\__tests__\helpers.test.ts ---

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import {
  DATE_NORMALIZE_CASES,
  DATE_PLUS_ONE_DAY_CASES,
  DATE_TIME_NOW_FAKE,
  GET_ORDER_PERMISSIONS_CASES,
} from 'modules/Tariffs/__tests__/fixtures';
import { dateNormalize, datePlusOneDay, getOrderPermissions } from 'modules/Tariffs/helpers';

jest.useFakeTimers().setSystemTime(DATE_TIME_NOW_FAKE);

describe.each(DATE_NORMALIZE_CASES)('dateNormalize testing', ({ args, expected }) => {
  test(`arg "${args}", expected "${expected}"`, () => {
    expect(dateNormalize(args)).toBe(expected);
  });
});

describe.each(DATE_PLUS_ONE_DAY_CASES)('datePlusOneDay testing', ({ args, expected }) => {
  test(`arg "${args}", expected "${expected}"`, () => {
    expect(datePlusOneDay()).toBe(expected);
  });
});

describe.each(GET_ORDER_PERMISSIONS_CASES)('getOrderPermissions testing', ({ args, expected }) => {
  test(`arg "${args}", expected "${expected}"`, () => {
    const spy = jest.spyOn(Permissions, 'granted');
    spy.mockReturnValue(true);
    expect(getOrderPermissions(args)).toBe(expected);
  });
});

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { DateRange } from 'react-day-picker';

import Button from '@vision/button';
import Text from '@vision/text';

import { DateRangePickerBottomSheet, DefaultFiltersNameType } from 'components/DateRangePicker';

import styles from './TestDateRangePicker.module.pcss';

const TestDateRangePicker = () => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [range, setRange] = useState<DateRange | undefined>();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<DefaultFiltersNameType | null>(null);

  const handleButtonClick = () => {
    setOpen(true);
  };
  return (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <Text type={'subtitleBold'}>Выбор периода</Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <Button onClick={handleButtonClick}>Открыть боттомшит</Button>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <Text type={'subtitleBold'}>Выбранный интервал</Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <Text type={'bodyRegular'}>{`От: ${
          range?.from ? range?.from?.toISOString() : 'не выбран'
        }`}</Text>
        <Text type={'bodyRegular'}>{`До:  ${
          range?.to ? range?.to?.toISOString() : 'не выбран'
        }`}</Text>
      </div>
      <DateRangePickerBottomSheet
        range={range}
        onDateRangeChange={setRange}
        enabledFilters={['lastYear']}
        activeFilter={filter}
        onActiveFilterChange={setFilter}
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default TestDateRangePicker;

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_BLOCKED_PLUG } from 'const/routes';

import { useDeleteOrderMutation } from 'core/api/orders';
import { useInitilizeTradePasswordSignatureQuery } from 'core/api/tradePassword';
import { isError } from 'core/helpers/isError';

import { createSignature } from 'utils/signature';
import { toPascalCase } from 'utils/string';

import { useCancelTradeOrder } from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/CancelTradeOrder/CancelTradeOrderContext';
import { getDate } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';
import TradePasswordEntry from 'modules/TradePasswordPage/components/TradePasswordEntry';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

const CancelIpoOrder = () => {
  const {
    state: { orderNum, subAccountId, tradePlaceId, time: date, secBoard, onSuccess, onError },
    setCancelTradeOrderState,
  } = useCancelTradeOrder();

  const { data: tradePasswordSignature } = useInitilizeTradePasswordSignatureQuery();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [trigger] = useDeleteOrderMutation();

  const { tradePasswordPublicKey = '', sessionPublicKey = '' } =
    tradePasswordSignature?.sessionTradeSign[0] || {};

  const onClose = () => setCancelTradeOrderState && setCancelTradeOrderState({ open: false });

  const deleteTradeOrder = async (password: string) => {
    if (!(orderNum && subAccountId && tradePlaceId && secBoard && date)) return;

    try {
      const signature = await createSignature(
        'DELETE',
        password,
        tradePasswordPublicKey,
        sessionPublicKey,
        [String(orderNum), String(subAccountId), String(tradePlaceId)],
      );

      const response = await trigger({
        orderNum,
        subAccountId,
        tradePlaceId: Number(tradePlaceId),
        board: secBoard,
        date: getDate(date),
        signature,
      }).unwrap();
      const {
        ordStatus: statusCode,
        cumQty: executedQuantity,
        orderQty: quantity,
      } = response.executionReport[0];
      onSuccess &&
        onSuccess({
          statusCode: toPascalCase(statusCode),
          executedQuantity,
          quantity,
          date,
          orderNum,
        });
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      if (isError(error) && error.data.error[0].errorCode === 'SignatureCheckFailed') {
        createAlertNotification({ text: 'Неверный торговый пароль', status: 'error' });
      } else if (isError(error) && error.data.error[0].errorCode === 'TradePasswordBlocked') {
        navigate(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_BLOCKED_PLUG);
      } else {
        onError && onError(error);
        onClose();
      }
    }
  };

  return <TradePasswordEntry onTradePasswordFulfilled={deleteTradeOrder} onClose={onClose} />;
};

export default CancelIpoOrder;

import React, { createContext, useState } from 'react';

import { OrderType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import { IDType } from 'types/ipoOrder';
import { UpdatedOrderHistoryItem } from 'types/orderHistory';

import CancelIpoOrder from './CancelIpoOrder';
import CancelTradeOrder from './CancelTradeOrder';
import CancelTradeStopOrder from './CancelTradeStopOrder';

type CancelTradeOrderStateType = {
  open: boolean;
  orderNum?: number;
  orderType?: OrderType;
  subAccountId?: number;
  tradePlaceId?: IDType;
  time?: string;
  secBoard?: string;
  isIpo?: boolean;
  onSuccess?: (updatedOrder: UpdatedOrderHistoryItem) => void;
  onError?: (error?: unknown) => void;
};

type CancelTradeOrderContextType = {
  state: CancelTradeOrderStateType;
  setCancelTradeOrderState?: (values: Partial<CancelTradeOrderStateType>) => void;
};

const initialState = {
  open: false,
};

const initialContext = {
  state: initialState,
};

const CancelTradeOrderContext = createContext<CancelTradeOrderContextType>(initialContext);

export const useCancelTradeOrder = () => {
  const context = React.useContext(CancelTradeOrderContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useCancelTradeOrder must be used within a CancelTradeOrderProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export const CancelTradeOrderProvider: React.FC = ({ children }) => {
  const [state, setState] = useState<CancelTradeOrderStateType>(initialState);

  const setCancelTradeOrderState = (values: Partial<CancelTradeOrderStateType>) => {
    setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...values }));
  };

  return (
    <CancelTradeOrderContext.Provider value={{ state, setCancelTradeOrderState }}>
      {state.open ? (
        state.isIpo ? (
          <CancelIpoOrder />
        ) : state.orderType === 'limit' ? (
          <CancelTradeOrder />
        ) : (
          <CancelTradeStopOrder />
        )
      ) : (
        children
      )}
    </CancelTradeOrderContext.Provider>
  );
};

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_BLOCKED_PLUG } from 'const/routes';

import { useCreateOrderMutation } from 'core/api/orders';
import { useInitilizeTradePasswordSignatureQuery } from 'core/api/tradePassword';
import { isError } from 'core/helpers/isError';

import { createSignature } from 'utils/signature';

import TradePasswordEntry from 'modules/TradePasswordPage/components/TradePasswordEntry';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { Order, OrderRequest } from 'types/orders';

type CreateTradeOrderProps = {
  order: OrderRequest;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (order: Order) => void;
  onError?: (error?: unknown) => void;
};

const CreateTradeOrder = ({ order, onSuccess, onError, onClose }: CreateTradeOrderProps) => {
  const { data: tradePasswordSignature } = useInitilizeTradePasswordSignatureQuery();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [trigger] = useCreateOrderMutation();

  const {
    subAccountId,
    tradePlaceId,
    instrumentId,
    direction,
    orderType,
    price,
    lots,
    amount,
    stopPrice,
    takeProfitPrice,
  } = order || {};

  const { tradePasswordPublicKey = '', sessionPublicKey = '' } =
    tradePasswordSignature?.sessionTradeSign[0] || {};

  const createTradeOrder = async (password: string) => {
    try {
      const signature = await createSignature(
        'POST',
        password,
        tradePasswordPublicKey,
        sessionPublicKey,
        [
          String(subAccountId),
          String(tradePlaceId),
          String(instrumentId),
          direction,
          orderType,
          price,
          lots,
          stopPrice,
          takeProfitPrice,
          amount,
        ],
      );

      const response = await trigger({ ...order, signature }).unwrap();
      onSuccess && onSuccess(response.executionReport[0]);
    } catch (error) {
      if (isError(error) && error.data.error[0].errorCode === 'SignatureCheckFailed') {
        createAlertNotification({ text: 'Неверный торговый пароль', status: 'error' });
      } else if (isError(error) && error.data.error[0].errorCode === 'TradePasswordBlocked') {
        navigate(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_BLOCKED_PLUG);
      } else {
        onError && onError(error);
      }
    }
  };

  return <TradePasswordEntry onTradePasswordFulfilled={createTradeOrder} onClose={onClose} />;
};

export default CreateTradeOrder;

import { FC, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { useGetUKDisclaimerQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { DisclaimerProps } from './types';

const Disclaimer: FC<DisclaimerProps> = ({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId }) => {
  const [isDisclaimerOpened, setIsDisclaimerOpened] = useState(false);

  const { data: infoFlags } = useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
  });

  const { data: disclaimer } = useGetUKDisclaimerQuery();

  const handleDisclaimerBtnClick = () => {
    setIsDisclaimerOpened(true);
  };

  const handleDismiss = () => {
    setIsDisclaimerOpened(false);
  };

  if (
    !infoFlags?.instrumentInfoFlag[0].foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompany ||
    !disclaimer?.disclaimer[0] ||
    !disclaimer?.disclaimer[0].foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompanyShort
  )
    return null;

  const { foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompanyFull, foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompanyShort } =
    disclaimer.disclaimer[0];

  return (
    <div className={styles.disclaimer}>
      {foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompanyShort}
      {foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompanyFull && (
        <div>
          <Button shape="text" size="s" onClick={handleDisclaimerBtnClick}>
            Подробнее
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      <BottomSheet open={isDisclaimerOpened} onDismiss={handleDismiss}>
        <div className={styles.full}>
          <Text className={styles.text}>{foreignInstrumentOfRussianCompanyFull}</Text>
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Disclaimer;

  instrumentCode,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  onMainBtnClick,
}) => {
  const { data } = useGetHintsQuery();
  // const { subAccountId } = useAppSelector((state) => state?.tradeOrder);
  const [getCommision, { isLoading: isCommissionLoading }] = useLazyCalcComissionQuery();
  const [commissionValue, setCommissionValue] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { data: accounts } = useGetAccountsQuery({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });

  useEffect(() => {
    const subAccountId = accounts?.tradingAccounts[0].subAccountId || 0;

    if (isLimit && priceInputValue) {
      getCommision({
        direction: isBought ? 'BUY' : 'SELL',
        price: priceInputValue,
        lots: quantity ? Number.parseFloat(quantity) : 0,
        instrumentId,
        tradePlaceId,
        subAccountId: subAccountId,
      })
        .then((response: any) => {
          if (response.data) {
            setCommissionValue(
              `${sumFormatter(response.data.preTradeInfo[0].comission, null, 2)} ${currencySign(
                response.data.preTradeInfo[0].comissionCurrency || 'RUB',
              )}`,
            );
          }
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          console.error('Error fetching commission:', error);
        });
    }
  }, []);
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <InstrumentIcon className={styles.logo} instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />
      <div className={cn(styles.title)}>
        <Text type="subtitleBold">
          {`${isLimit ? 'Лимитная' : 'Условная'} заявка на ${
            isBought ? 'покупку' : 'продажу'
          } ${instrumentName}`}
        </Text>
        {instrumentCode && (
          <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {instrumentCode}
          </Text>
        )}
      </div>
      <Disclaimer tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId} instrumentId={instrumentId} />
      <div className={styles.block}>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <Text type="lineRegular">На счёт</Text>
          <div className={styles.desc}>
            <Text type="lineSemiBold">
              {productName} {activeSubAccountLabel}
            </Text>
          </div>
        </div>
        {isLimit && (
          <>
            <div className={styles.row}>
              <Text type="lineRegular">Цена {isLimit && priceUnit}</Text>
              <Text type="lineSemiBold">{price}</Text>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.row}>
              <Text type="lineRegular">Количество</Text>
              <Text type="lineSemiBold">{quantity}</Text>
            </div>

            <div className={styles.row}>
              <Text type="lineRegular">Объём</Text>
              <Text type="lineSemiBold">
                {secondVolume ? `${secondVolume} (${volume})` : volume}
              </Text>
            </div>
            {(commissionValue || isCommissionLoading) && (
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Комиссия</Text>
                <Text type="lineSemiBold">
                  {' '}
                  {isCommissionLoading ? 'Расчёт...' : commissionValue}
                </Text>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
        {!isLimit && (
          <>
            {takeProfit ? (
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Тэйк-профит {priceUnit}</Text>
                <Text type="lineSemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(takeProfit, null, 2)} ${currencySign(
                  priceCurrency,
                )}`}</Text>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            {deviation ? (
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Отступ от {isBought ? 'min' : 'max'}</Text>
                <Text type="lineSemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(deviation, null, 2)} ${currencySign(
                  priceCurrency,
                )}`}</Text>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            {protectiveSpread ? (
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Защитный спред</Text>
                <Text type="lineSemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(
                  protectiveSpread,
                  null,
                  2,
                )} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`}</Text>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            {stopLimit ? (
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Стоп-лимит {priceUnit}</Text>
                <Text type="lineSemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(stopLimit, null, 2)} ${currencySign(
                  priceCurrency,
                )}`}</Text>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            {stopLimitPrice ? (
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <Text type="lineRegular">Цена выставления лимитной заявки {priceUnit}</Text>
                <Text type="lineSemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(stopLimitPrice, null, 2)} ${currencySign(
                  priceCurrency,
                )}`}</Text>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className={styles.row}>
              <Text type="lineRegular">Количество</Text>
              <Text type="lineSemiBold">{quantity}</Text>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.row}>
              <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Срок действия</Text>
              <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>До отмены</Text>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        {data?.hints ? (
          <>
            {isWarningBannerShow && (
              <Banner hints={data.hints} slugData={{ slug, vars }} text={text} />
            )}
            {isAcceptBannerShow && (
              <Banner
                hints={data.hints}
                slugData={{ slug: acceptBannerSlug.slug, vars: acceptBannerSlug.vars }}
                text={acceptBannerSlug.text}
                className={styles.banner}
                variant="accent"
              />
            )}
            {hasStopOrder && isLimit && (
              <Banner
                hints={data.hints}
                text="У вас есть условные заявки по данному инструменту"
                variant="accent"
              />
            )}
            {!isLimit && !stopLimit && (
              <Banner
                hints={data.hints}
                text="Вы также можете указать стоп-лимит"
                variant="accent"
              />
            )}
            {!isLimit && !takeProfit && (
              <Banner
                hints={data.hints}
                text="Вы также можете указать тэйк-профит"
                variant="accent"
              />
            )}
          </>
        ) : null}

        <Button
          variant={isLimit ? (isBought ? 'buy' : 'sell') : 'primary'}
          className={cn(styles.mainBtn)}
          onClick={onMainBtnClick}
        >
          {btnText}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TradeOrderConfirmation;

--- FILE: src\modules\TradeOrder\components\TradeOrderForm\components\LimitTradeOrderForm\LimitTradeOrderForm.tsx ---

import { FC, memo, useState } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';

import AmountInput from '@vision/amount-input';
import BottomSheet from '@vision/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@vision/button';
import Text from '@vision/text';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';
import { setPrice, setQuantity } from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import TradeOrderConfirmation from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/TradeOrderConfirmation';
import {
  getInstrumentDataByOrderType,
  getMultiplePrice,
  getMultipleQuantity,
} from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import { OrderDataType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import Banner from 'components/Banner';

import { InstrumentInfoResponse } from 'types/instruments';
import { SubAccount } from 'types/subAccount';

import IsQualBottomsheet from '../IsQualBottomsheet';
import QuantityInput from '../QuantityInput';
import TradeFormBtns from '../TradeFormBtns';
import LimitTradeOrderPlug from './components/LimitTradeOrderPlug';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  subAccount?: SubAccount;
  isBought: boolean;
  instrumentInfo: InstrumentInfoResponse;
  activePortofolioName: string;
  priceUnit: string;
  onMainBtnClick: (data: OrderDataType) => void;
};

type BottomSheetStateType = 'confirmation' | 'check' | null;
type BottomSheetQualStateType = boolean;

const TradeOrderForm: FC<Props> = ({
  subAccount,
  isBought,
  instrumentInfo,
  activePortofolioName,
  priceUnit,
  onMainBtnClick,
}) => {
  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<BottomSheetStateType>(null);
  const [bottomSheetQualState, setBottomSheetQualState] = useState<BottomSheetQualStateType>(false);
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const session = getSession();

  const {
    price: priceInputValue,
    quantity: lotSizeInputValue,
    limitOrdersStatus,
  } = useAppSelector((state) => ({
    price: state?.tradeOrder.price,
    quantity: state?.tradeOrder.quantity,
    limitOrdersStatus: state.limitOrdersStatus,
  }));

  const { instrument, trading = [], futures = [] } = instrumentInfo;

  const {
    priceCurrency,
    lastPrice,
    instrumentName,
    priceDiffCurr,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    instrumentImageName,
    instrumentCode,
  } = instrument[0];
  const { priceStep } = trading[0] || {};
  const { priceMinStep, pointPrice, priceTickValueCurrencyCode } = futures[0] || {};

  const { data } = useGetHintsQuery();
  const { data: infoFlag } = useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery({
    instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
    tradePlaceId: String(tradePlaceId),
  });

  const hasStopOrder = infoFlag?.instrumentInfoFlag[0]?.stopOrder;

  const {
    priceLabel,
    lotSize,
    quantityText,
    btnText,
    instrumentType,
    volume: { value, secondValue, label, currency },
    isWarningBannerShow,
    warningBannerSlug,
    acceptBannerSlug,
    isAcceptBannerShow,
    precision,
  } = getInstrumentDataByOrderType({
    isBought,
    instrumentInfo,
    quantity: lotSizeInputValue || 0,
    price: priceInputValue,
    subAccount,
    orderType: 'limit',
  });

  const isFutures = instrumentType === 'isFutures';
  const isMainBtnDisabled = Boolean(
    !priceInputValue || !lotSizeInputValue || lotSizeInputValue % lotSize !== 0,
  );

  const handleDecrement = () => {
    dispatch(setPrice(priceInputValue - priceStep));
  };

  const handleIncrement = () => {
    dispatch(setPrice(priceInputValue + priceStep));
  };

  const handleLotSizeDecrement = () => {
    dispatch(setQuantity(lotSizeInputValue - lotSize));
  };

  const handleLoteSizeIncrement = () => {
    dispatch(setQuantity(lotSizeInputValue + lotSize));
  };

  const handlePriceInputChange = ({ floatValue, value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    dispatch(setPrice(floatValue || Number.parseFloat(value)));
  };

  const handleLotSizeInputChange = ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    dispatch(setQuantity(Number.parseFloat(value)));
  };

  const handlePriceInputBlur = () => {
    if (!priceInputValue) return;

    const multiplePrice = getMultiplePrice(Number(priceInputValue), priceStep, precision);

    dispatch(setPrice(multiplePrice));
  };

  const handleLotSizeInputBlur = () => {
    if (!lotSizeInputValue) return;

    const multipleQuantity = getMultipleQuantity(Number(lotSizeInputValue), lotSize);

    dispatch(setQuantity(multipleQuantity));
  };

  const handleBtnClick = () => {
    onMainBtnClick({
      subAccountId: subAccount?.subAccountId || '',
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentId,
      direction: isBought ? 'BUY' : 'SELL',
      orderType: 'LIMIT',
      price: priceInputValue,
      priceSecondary: isFutures ? priceInputValue * pointPrice : undefined,
      priceSecondaryCurrencyCode: isFutures ? priceTickValueCurrencyCode : undefined,
      lots: lotSizeInputValue / lotSize,
      quantity: lotSizeInputValue,
      takeProfitPrice: 0,
      stopPrice: 0,
      amount: 0,
      volume: { value, label, currency, secondValue },
      portfolioName: activePortofolioName,
    });
    setBottomSheetState('check');
  };

  const price = !isFutures
    ? `${sumFormatter(priceInputValue, null, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`
    : `${sumFormatter(priceInputValue, null, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)} (${sumFormatter(
        priceInputValue * pointPrice,
      )} ${currencySign(priceTickValueCurrencyCode)})`;

  if (!limitOrdersStatus.isAvailable)
    return <LimitTradeOrderPlug text={limitOrdersStatus.reason} />;

  return (
    <div className={styles.tradeOrderForm}>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <Text type="lineRegular">{`${priceLabel} (шаг = ${sumFormatter(
          instrumentCategoryCode === 'FUT' ? priceMinStep : priceStep,
          null,
          2,
        )} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)})`}</Text>
        <div className={styles.inputs}>
          <AmountInput
            suffix={currencySign(priceCurrency)}
            classNameInput={styles.input}
            className={styles.inputWrapper}
            value={priceInputValue}
            onChange={handlePriceInputChange}
            onBlur={handlePriceInputBlur}
            precision={precision}
          />
          <TradeFormBtns
            isDecrementBtnDisabled={Number(priceInputValue) <= 0}
            onDecrementBtnClick={handleDecrement}
            onIncrementBtnClick={handleIncrement}
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            Цена последней сделки
          </Text>
          <Text
            tag="span"
            type="labelRegular"
            color={priceDiffCurr > 0 ? 'colorConstructive' : 'colorDestructive'}
          >
            {priceDiffCurr && priceDiffCurr > 0 ? ' ↑' : ' ↓'}
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground">{` ${sumFormatter(
            lastPrice,
            null,
            2,
          )} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`}</Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" tag="span">
            {` ${priceUnit}`}
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <QuantityInput
          label={`Количество ${
            !isFutures ? `(лот = ${isFutures ? 1 : lotSize} ${quantityText})` : ''
          } `}
          suffix={quantityText}
          placeholder={`0 ${quantityText}`}
          value={lotSizeInputValue}
          isDecrementBtnDisabled={(lotSizeInputValue || 0) <= 0}
          positionText={`${subAccount?.balance ?? '–'} ${quantityText}`}
          onChange={handleLotSizeInputChange}
          onBlur={handleLotSizeInputBlur}
          onDecrementBtnClick={handleLotSizeDecrement}
          onIncrementBtnClick={handleLoteSizeIncrement}
        />
      </div>
      {data?.hints ? (
        <>
          {Boolean(isWarningBannerShow && lotSizeInputValue) && (
            <div className={styles.bannerWrapper}>
              <Banner
                hints={data.hints}
                slugData={{ slug: warningBannerSlug.slug, vars: warningBannerSlug.vars }}
                text={warningBannerSlug.text}
                className={styles.banner}
              />
            </div>
          )}
          {isAcceptBannerShow && acceptBannerSlug.slug && (
            <div className={styles.bannerWrapper}>
              <Banner
                hints={data.hints}
                slugData={{ slug: acceptBannerSlug.slug, vars: acceptBannerSlug.vars }}
                text={acceptBannerSlug.text}
                className={styles.banner}
                variant="accent"
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      ) : null}
      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <div>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {label}
          </Text>
          <Text type="bodySemiBold">{`${sumFormatter(value)} ${currency}`}</Text>
        </div>
        <Button
          variant={isBought ? 'buy' : 'sell'}
          disabled={isMainBtnDisabled}
          className={styles.mainBtn}
          onClick={() => {
            const isUserQual = !!session?.isQual;
            const instrumentQual = !!instrument[0]?.isQual;
            const instrumentUserBalance = subAccount?.balance || 0;

            if (!isUserQual && instrumentQual) {
              if (isBought) {
                setBottomSheetQualState(true);
                return;
              }

              if (!isBought && lotSizeInputValue > instrumentUserBalance) {
                setBottomSheetQualState(true);
                return;
              }
            }

            setBottomSheetState('confirmation');
          }}
        >
          {btnText}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetState === 'confirmation'}
        onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetState(null)}
      >
        <TradeOrderConfirmation
          isLimit
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
          instrumentName={instrumentName}
          isBought={isBought}
          activeSubAccountLabel={activePortofolioName}
          price={price}
          priceInputValue={priceInputValue}
          quantity={`${lotSizeInputValue} ${quantityText}`}
          volume={`${sumFormatter(value)} ${currency}`}
          secondVolume={
            secondValue ? `${sumFormatter(secondValue)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}` : undefined
          }
          btnText={btnText}
          warningBannerSlug={warningBannerSlug}
          acceptBannerSlug={acceptBannerSlug}
          isAcceptBannerShow={isAcceptBannerShow}
          isWarningBannerShow={isWarningBannerShow}
          onMainBtnClick={handleBtnClick}
          priceCurrency={priceCurrency}
          hasStopOrder={hasStopOrder}
          precision={precision}
          priceUnit={priceUnit}
          instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
          tradePlaceId={String(tradePlaceId)}
          instrumentId={String(instrumentId)}
        />
      </BottomSheet>

      <BottomSheet open={bottomSheetQualState} onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetQualState(false)}>
        <IsQualBottomsheet
          onDetailsClick={() => {
            window.location.href = 'https://investpalata.ru/%d1%87%d0%b0%d0%b2%d0%be/';
          }}
          onCancelClick={() => {
            setBottomSheetQualState(false);
          }}
        />
      </BottomSheet>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(TradeOrderForm);

      <div>

);

export default QuantityInput;

import { FC, useEffect } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';

import AmountInput from '@vision/amount-input';
import Text from '@vision/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import {
  setDeviationPrct,
  setProtectiveSpreadPrct,
  setStopLimitPricePrct,
} from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { StopOrderAccordion } from '../../types';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const AccordionContent: FC<StopOrderAccordion> = ({
  priceCurrency,
  precision,
  takeProfit,
  stopLimit,
  deviationInputLabel,
  deviation,
  protectiveSpread,
  stopLimitPrice,
  onDeviationInputChange,
  onProtectiveSpreadInputChange,
  onStopLimitPriceInputChange,
  onDeviationInputBlur,
  onProtectiveSpreadInputBlur,
  onStopLimitPriceInputBlur,
}) => {
  const { deviationPrct, protectiveSpreadPrct, stopLimitPricePrct } = useAppSelector((state) => ({
    deviationPrct: state.tradeOrder.deviationPrct,
    protectiveSpreadPrct: state.tradeOrder.protectiveSpreadPrct,
    stopLimitPricePrct: state.tradeOrder.stopLimitPricePrct,
  }));

  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const suffix = currencySign(priceCurrency);
  const placeholder = `${sumFormatter(0, 2)} ${suffix}`;
  const takeProfitDisabled = Boolean(!takeProfit);
  const stopLimitDisabled = Boolean(!stopLimit);

  const handleDeviationInputChange = ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    if (!takeProfit) return;

    onDeviationInputChange(Number(value));
  };

  const handleProtectiveSpreadInputChange = ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    if (!takeProfit) return;

    onProtectiveSpreadInputChange(Number(value));
  };

  const handleStopLimitPriceInputChange = ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    if (!stopLimit) return;

    onStopLimitPriceInputChange(Number(value));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const protectiveSpreadPrct =
      protectiveSpread && takeProfit ? (protectiveSpread / takeProfit) * 100 : 0;

    dispatch(setProtectiveSpreadPrct(protectiveSpreadPrct));
  }, [dispatch, protectiveSpread, takeProfit]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const deviationPrct = deviation && takeProfit ? (deviation / takeProfit) * 100 : 0;

    dispatch(setDeviationPrct(deviationPrct));
  }, [deviation, dispatch, protectiveSpread, takeProfit]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const StopLimitPricePrct =
      stopLimit && stopLimitPrice ? Math.abs(((stopLimit - stopLimitPrice) / stopLimit) * 100) : 0;

    dispatch(setStopLimitPricePrct(StopLimitPricePrct));
  }, [dispatch, stopLimit, stopLimitPrice]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.content}>
      <div>
        <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.title}>
          Тэйк-профит
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <div className={styles.inputWrapper}>
            <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              {deviationInputLabel}
            </Text>
            <AmountInput
              suffix={suffix}
              classNameInput={cn(styles.input, takeProfitDisabled && styles.disabledInput)}
              value={deviation !== undefined ? String(deviation) : ''}
              onChange={handleDeviationInputChange}
              onBlur={onDeviationInputBlur}
              placeholder={placeholder}
              precision={precision}
              disabled={takeProfitDisabled}
            />
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground3">
              Изменение {sumFormatter(deviationPrct, 2)} %
            </Text>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.inputWrapper}>
            <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              Защитный спред
            </Text>
            <AmountInput
              suffix={suffix}
              classNameInput={cn(styles.input, takeProfitDisabled && styles.disabledInput)}
              value={protectiveSpread !== undefined ? String(protectiveSpread) : ''}
              onChange={handleProtectiveSpreadInputChange}
              onBlur={onProtectiveSpreadInputBlur}
              placeholder={placeholder}
              precision={precision}
              disabled={takeProfitDisabled}
            />
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground3">
              Изменение {sumFormatter(protectiveSpreadPrct, 2)} %
            </Text>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <Text className={styles.title} type="bodySemiBold">
          Стоп-лимит
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.inputWrapper}>
          <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            Цена выст. лимит. заявки
          </Text>
          <AmountInput
            suffix={suffix}
            classNameInput={cn(styles.input, stopLimitDisabled && styles.disabledInput)}
            value={stopLimitPrice !== undefined ? String(stopLimitPrice) : ''}
            onChange={handleStopLimitPriceInputChange}
            onBlur={onStopLimitPriceInputBlur}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            precision={precision}
            disabled={stopLimitDisabled}
          />
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground3">
            Изменение {sumFormatter(stopLimitPricePrct, 2)} %
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <Text type="bodySemiBold">Время действия поручения</Text>
        <Text className={styles.text} type="labelSemiBold">
          До отмены
        </Text>
        <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
          Условная заявка будет действовать, пока её условия не выполнятся или вы её не отмените
        </Text>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AccordionContent;

import { FC, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import BottomSheet from '@vision/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@vision/button';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { ReactComponent as IconSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/small-question-outline.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { IStopOrderFormHint } from './types';

const StopOrderFormHint: FC<IStopOrderFormHint> = ({ data, slug, className }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleToggleBottomSheet = () => {
    setIsOpen(!isOpen);
  };

  const hint = useMemo(() => {
    return data?.hints.find((hint) => hint?.slug === slug)?.text.split('\n');
  }, [data, slug]);

  if (!hint) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        className={cn(styles.btn, className)}
        variant="outline"
        size="s"
        onClick={handleToggleBottomSheet}
        inline
      >
        <IconSvg />
      </Button>
      <BottomSheet open={isOpen} onDismiss={handleToggleBottomSheet}>
        <div className={styles.container}>
          {hint.map((item, index) => (
            <Text className={styles.text} key={index} type="bodyRegular">
              {item}
            </Text>
          ))}
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default StopOrderFormHint;

--- FILE: src\modules\TradeOrder\components\TradeOrderForm\components\StopTradeOrderForm\StopTradeOrderForm.tsx ---

import { FC, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';

import AmountInput from '@vision/amount-input';
import BottomSheet from '@vision/bottom-sheet';
import Button from '@vision/button';
import Text from '@vision/text';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import {
  setDeviation,
  setLotSize,
  setProtectiveSpread,
  setStopLimit,
  setStopLimitPrice,
  setTakeProfit,
} from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import TradeOrderConfirmation from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/TradeOrderConfirmation';
import {
  getInstrumentDataByOrderType,
  getMultiplePrice,
  getMultipleQuantity,
  getStopOrderBannerText,
} from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import { BottomSheetStateType, OrderDataType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import { Banner } from 'components';

import { InstrumentInfoResponse } from 'types/instruments';
import { SubAccount } from 'types/subAccount';

import QuantityInput from '../QuantityInput';
import StopOrderFormAccordion from '../StopOrderFormAccordion';
import StopOrderFormHint from './components/StopOrderFormHint';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  instrumentInfo: InstrumentInfoResponse;
  activePortofolioName: string;
  isBought: boolean;
  subAccount?: SubAccount;
  priceUnit: string;
  onMainBtnClick: (data: OrderDataType) => void;
};

const StopTradeOrderForm: FC<Props> = ({
  instrumentInfo,
  isBought,
  activePortofolioName,
  subAccount,
  priceUnit,
  onMainBtnClick,
}) => {
  const { takeProfit, deviation, lotSizeInputValue, protectiveSpread, stopLimit, stopLimitPrice } =
    useAppSelector((state) => ({
      takeProfit: state.tradeOrder.takeProfit,
      deviation: state.tradeOrder.deviation,
      lotSizeInputValue: state.tradeOrder.lotSize,
      protectiveSpread: state.tradeOrder.protectiveSpread,
      stopLimit: state.tradeOrder.stopLimit,
      stopLimitPrice: state.tradeOrder.stopLimitPrice,
    }));

  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<BottomSheetStateType>(null);

  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const { instrument = [], trading = [] } = instrumentInfo;
  const {
    priceCurrency,
    instrumentImageName,
    instrumentName,
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    instrumentCode,
  } = instrument[0] || {};
  const { priceStep } = trading[0] || {};

  const {
    precision,
    instrumentType,
    lotSize,
    quantityText,
    volume: { value, secondValue, currency, label },
    warningBannerSlug,
    warningBannerSlug: { slug, vars, text },
    acceptBannerSlug,
    isAcceptBannerShow,
    isWarningBannerShow,
    deviationInputLabel,
  } = getInstrumentDataByOrderType({
    isBought,
    subAccount,
    quantity: lotSizeInputValue ?? undefined,
    instrumentInfo,
    price: Math.max(Number(takeProfit), Number(stopLimitPrice)),
    orderType: 'stopOrder',
  });

  const isFutures = instrumentType === 'isFutures';
  const isTakeProfitValidated = (takeProfit && protectiveSpread) ?? deviation;
  const isStopLimitValidated = stopLimit && stopLimitPrice;
  const stopOrderBannerText = getStopOrderBannerText({ takeProfit, stopLimit, isBought });
  const isMainBtnDisabled = Boolean(
    !(isTakeProfitValidated || isStopLimitValidated) ||
      !lotSizeInputValue ||
      lotSizeInputValue % lotSize !== 0 ||
      stopOrderBannerText,
  );

  const handleBtnClick = () => {
    if (!lotSizeInputValue) return;

    onMainBtnClick({
      subAccountId: subAccount?.subAccountId || '',
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentId,
      direction: isBought ? 'BUY' : 'SELL',
      orderType:
        takeProfit && stopLimit ? 'TAKEPROFIT_STOPLIMIT' : takeProfit ? 'TAKEPROFIT' : 'STOPLIMIT',
      price: stopLimitPrice,
      lots: lotSizeInputValue / lotSize,
      quantity: lotSizeInputValue,
      takeProfitPrice: takeProfit,
      stopPrice: stopLimit,
      amount: null,
      volume: { value, label, currency, secondValue },
      portfolioName: activePortofolioName,
      goodTillCancel: true,
      pegOffsetType: 0,
      pegOffsetValue: protectiveSpread,
      discretionOffsetType: 0,
      discretionOffsetValue: deviation,
    });

    setBottomSheetState('check');
  };

  const handleTakeProfitChange = ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    const takeProfit = Number(value);

    dispatch(setTakeProfit(Number(value)));

    if (!takeProfit) {
      dispatch(setDeviation(null));
      dispatch(setProtectiveSpread(null));
      return;
    }

    const multipleValue = getMultiplePrice(takeProfit * 0.02, priceStep, precision);

    dispatch(setProtectiveSpread(multipleValue));

    if (!deviation) dispatch(setDeviation(0));
  };

  const handleStopLimitChange = ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    const stopLimit = Number(value);

    dispatch(setStopLimit(stopLimit));

    if (!stopLimit) {
      dispatch(setStopLimitPrice(null));
      return;
    }

    const stopLimitPrice = isBought ? stopLimit * 1.02 : stopLimit * 0.98;

    const multipleValue = getMultiplePrice(stopLimitPrice, priceStep, precision);

    dispatch(setStopLimitPrice(multipleValue));
  };

  const handleLotSizeInputChange = ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    dispatch(setLotSize(Number(value)));
  };

  const handleDeviationInputChange = (value: number) => {
    dispatch(setDeviation(value));
  };

  const handleProtectiveSpreadInputChange = (value: number) => {
    dispatch(setProtectiveSpread(value));
  };

  const handleStopLimitPriceInputChange = (value: number) => {
    dispatch(setStopLimitPrice(value));
  };

  const handleTakeProfitBlur = () => {
    if (!takeProfit) return;

    const multiplePrice = getMultiplePrice(takeProfit, priceStep, precision);

    dispatch(setTakeProfit(multiplePrice));
  };

  const handleStopLimitBlur = () => {
    if (!stopLimit) return;

    const multiplePrice = getMultiplePrice(stopLimit, priceStep, precision);

    dispatch(setStopLimit(multiplePrice));
  };

  const handleLotSizeInputBlur = () => {
    if (!lotSizeInputValue) return;

    const multipleQuantity = getMultipleQuantity(lotSizeInputValue, lotSize);

    dispatch(setLotSize(multipleQuantity));
  };

  const handleDeviationInputBlur = useCallback(() => {
    if (!deviation) return;

    const multipleValue = getMultiplePrice(deviation, priceStep, precision);

    dispatch(setDeviation(multipleValue));
  }, [deviation, dispatch, precision, priceStep]);

  const handleProtectiveSpreadInputBlur = useCallback(() => {
    if (!protectiveSpread) return;

    const multipleValue = getMultiplePrice(protectiveSpread, priceStep, precision);

    dispatch(setProtectiveSpread(multipleValue));
  }, [dispatch, precision, priceStep, protectiveSpread]);

  const handleStopLimitPriceInputBlur = () => {
    if (!stopLimitPrice) return;

    const multipleValue = getMultiplePrice(stopLimitPrice, priceStep, precision);

    dispatch(setStopLimitPrice(multipleValue));
  };

  const handleLotSizeDecrement = () => {
    const lotsize = lotSizeInputValue ? lotSizeInputValue : 0;

    dispatch(setLotSize(lotsize - lotSize));
  };

  const handleLoteSizeIncrement = () => {
    const lotsize = lotSizeInputValue ? lotSizeInputValue : 0;

    dispatch(setLotSize(lotsize + lotSize));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    handleProtectiveSpreadInputBlur();
    handleDeviationInputBlur();
  }, [handleDeviationInputBlur, handleProtectiveSpreadInputBlur]);

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.hint}>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {isBought ? 'Купить' : 'Продать'}, когда цена {priceUnit} достигнет заданной (шаг цены{' '}
            <Text tag="span" type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground">
              {`${sumFormatter(priceStep, -1)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`}
            </Text>
            )
          </Text>
          <StopOrderFormHint className={styles.hintIcon} data={hints} slug="STOP_ORDER_INFO" />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <div className={styles.inputWrapper}>
            <Text type="lineRegular">Тэйк-профит</Text>
            <AmountInput
              suffix={currencySign(priceCurrency)}
              classNameInput={styles.input}
              value={takeProfit ? String(takeProfit) : ''}
              onChange={handleTakeProfitChange}
              onBlur={handleTakeProfitBlur}
              placeholder={`${isBought ? '≤' : '≥'} ${sumFormatter(0, 2)} ${currencySign(
                priceCurrency,
              )}`}
              precision={precision}
              prefix={isBought ? '≤ ' : '≥ '}
            />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.inputWrapper}>
            <Text type="lineRegular">Стоп-лимит</Text>
            <AmountInput
              suffix={currencySign(priceCurrency)}
              classNameInput={styles.input}
              value={stopLimit ? String(stopLimit) : ''}
              onChange={handleStopLimitChange}
              onBlur={handleStopLimitBlur}
              placeholder={`${isBought ? '≥' : '≤'} ${sumFormatter(0, 2)} ${currencySign(
                priceCurrency,
              )}`}
              precision={precision}
              prefix={isBought ? '≥ ' : '≤ '}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <QuantityInput
          label={`Количество ${
            !isFutures ? `(лот = ${isFutures ? 1 : lotSize} ${quantityText})` : ''
          } `}
          suffix={quantityText}
          placeholder={`0 ${quantityText}`}
          value={lotSizeInputValue}
          isDecrementBtnDisabled={(lotSizeInputValue || 0) <= 0}
          positionText={`${subAccount?.balance} ${quantityText}`}
          onChange={handleLotSizeInputChange}
          onBlur={handleLotSizeInputBlur}
          onDecrementBtnClick={handleLotSizeDecrement}
          onIncrementBtnClick={handleLoteSizeIncrement}
        />
      </div>
      <StopOrderFormAccordion
        takeProfit={takeProfit}
        stopLimit={stopLimit}
        priceCurrency={priceCurrency}
        precision={precision}
        deviationInputLabel={deviationInputLabel}
        deviation={deviation}
        protectiveSpread={protectiveSpread}
        stopLimitPrice={stopLimitPrice}
        onProtectiveSpreadInputChange={handleProtectiveSpreadInputChange}
        onDeviationInputChange={handleDeviationInputChange}
        onStopLimitPriceInputChange={handleStopLimitPriceInputChange}
        onDeviationInputBlur={handleDeviationInputBlur}
        onProtectiveSpreadInputBlur={handleProtectiveSpreadInputBlur}
        onStopLimitPriceInputBlur={handleStopLimitPriceInputBlur}
      />
      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <div className={styles.banners}>
          {hints?.hints ? (
            <>
              {stopOrderBannerText && (
                <Banner
                  hints={hints.hints}
                  slugData={{
                    slug: isBought ? 'TRADE_STOP_LOWER_TAKEPROFIT' : 'TRADE_STOP_HIGHER_TAKEPROFIT',
                  }}
                  text={stopOrderBannerText}
                />
              )}
              {isWarningBannerShow && (
                <Banner
                  hints={hints.hints}
                  slugData={{ slug, vars }}
                  text={text}
                  className={styles.banner}
                />
              )}
              {isAcceptBannerShow && (
                <Banner
                  hints={hints.hints}
                  slugData={{ slug: acceptBannerSlug.slug, vars: acceptBannerSlug.vars }}
                  text={acceptBannerSlug.text}
                  className={styles.banner}
                  variant="accent"
                />
              )}
            </>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.mainBtn}>
          <Button disabled={isMainBtnDisabled} onClick={() => setBottomSheetState('confirmation')}>
            Подать
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <BottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetState === 'confirmation'}
        onDismiss={() => setBottomSheetState(null)}
      >
        <TradeOrderConfirmation
          isLimit={false}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
          instrumentName={instrumentName}
          isBought={isBought}
          activeSubAccountLabel={activePortofolioName}
          price={'100'}
          quantity={`${lotSizeInputValue} ${quantityText}`}
          volume={`${sumFormatter(value)} ${currency}`}
          secondVolume={
            secondValue ? `${sumFormatter(secondValue)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}` : undefined
          }
          btnText="Подать"
          warningBannerSlug={warningBannerSlug}
          acceptBannerSlug={acceptBannerSlug}
          isAcceptBannerShow={isAcceptBannerShow}
          isWarningBannerShow={isWarningBannerShow}
          takeProfit={takeProfit}
          stopLimit={stopLimit}
          stopLimitPrice={stopLimitPrice}
          deviation={deviation}
          protectiveSpread={protectiveSpread}
          onMainBtnClick={handleBtnClick}
          priceCurrency={priceCurrency}
          precision={precision}
          priceUnit={priceUnit}
          instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
          tradePlaceId={String(tradePlaceId)}
          instrumentId={String(instrumentId)}
        />
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default StopTradeOrderForm;

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { OrderDataType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import { InstrumentInfoResponse } from 'types/instruments';
import { SubAccount } from 'types/subAccount';

import { OrderType } from '../../types';
import LimitTradeOrderForm from './components/LimitTradeOrderForm';
import StopTradeOrderForm from './components/StopTradeOrderForm';

type Props = {
  subAccount?: SubAccount;
  isBought: boolean;
  instrumentInfo: InstrumentInfoResponse;
  activePortofolioName: string;
  orderType: OrderType;
  priceUnit: string;
  onMainBtnClick: (data: OrderDataType) => void;
};

const TradeOrderForm: FC<Props> = ({
  subAccount,
  isBought,
  instrumentInfo,
  activePortofolioName,
  orderType,
  priceUnit,
  onMainBtnClick,
}) => {
  return orderType === 'limit' ? (
    <LimitTradeOrderForm
      subAccount={subAccount}
      isBought={isBought}
      instrumentInfo={instrumentInfo}
      activePortofolioName={activePortofolioName}
      priceUnit={priceUnit}
      onMainBtnClick={onMainBtnClick}
    />
  ) : (
    <StopTradeOrderForm
      instrumentInfo={instrumentInfo}
      isBought={isBought}
      subAccount={subAccount}
      activePortofolioName={activePortofolioName}
      priceUnit={priceUnit}
      onMainBtnClick={onMainBtnClick}
    />
  );
};

export default memo(TradeOrderForm);
