import { generatePath } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CategoryType } from '@vision/category-buttons/dist';
import { ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER } from 'const/routes';

import { getTradeSessionByTradePlaceId } from 'core/tradeSession';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getStopOrderStatus } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import { StopOrderStatusParams } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/types';
import { SlugData } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/StopOrders/StopOrdersHistory/types';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import { BannerSlug } from 'components/Banner/types';

import { Hint, HintsResponse } from 'types/hints';
import {
  Futures,
  InstrumentCategoryCode,
  InstrumentCategoryType,
  PriceCurrencyType,
  Trading,
} from 'types/instruments';
import { CancelDeniedReasonType, CancelPermissionStateType } from 'types/orders';
import { SubAccount } from 'types/subAccount';

import { LIMIT_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP } from './components/consts';
import { InstrumentDataByOrderType } from './types';

export type VolumeType = {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  secondValue?: number;
  currency: string;
};

export const getInstrumentType = (code: InstrumentCategoryCode): InstrumentCategoryType => {
  switch (code) {
    case 'RBN':
    case 'EBN':
    case 'FBN':
    case 'RGB':
    case 'FGB':
    case 'FCB':
    case 'RCB':
    case 'INB':
      return 'isBond';

    case 'FUT':
      return 'isFutures';

    case 'CUP':
      return 'isCurrencyPair';

    case 'MTP':
      return 'isMetal';

    default:
      return 'isStock';
  }
};

export const getInstrumentDataByOrderType = ({
  isBought,
  instrumentInfo,
  quantity,
  price,
  subAccount,
  orderType,
}: InstrumentDataByOrderType) => {
  const { instrument, trading: t = [], fxSpot, futures: f } = instrumentInfo;
  const { priceCurrency, instrumentCategoryCode, tradePlaceCode, lastPrice, faceValue } =
    instrument[0];

  const { type, baseCurrencyCode } = fxSpot[0] || {};
  const futures = f[0] || {};
  const trading = t[0] || {};
  const instrumentType = getInstrumentType(instrumentCategoryCode);

  const {
    ask,
    bid,
    askSize,
    bidSize,
    askSizeLot,
    bidSizeLot,
    lotSize,
    priceStep,
    accruedInterest,
    tradeCurrency: accruedInterestCurrencyCode,
  } = trading;

  const buySize = instrumentType === 'isFutures' ? askSizeLot : askSize;
  const sellSize = instrumentType === 'isFutures' ? bidSizeLot : bidSize;
  const fxSpotType =
    instrumentType === 'isCurrencyPair' || instrumentType === 'isMetal' ? `(${type})` : '';
  const quantityText =
    instrumentType === 'isCurrencyPair'
      ? currencySign(baseCurrencyCode)
      : instrumentType === 'isMetal'
      ? 'гр.'
      : 'шт.';
  const volume = getVolume(
    instrumentType,
    quantity,
    price,
    priceCurrency,
    trading,
    futures,
    faceValue,
  );
  const isWarningBannerShow =
    subAccount && isBought
      ? volume.value > subAccount?.instrumentCurrencyBalance
      : subAccount && !isBought
      ? Number(quantity) > subAccount?.balance
      : false;
  const precision = priceStep.toString().match(/\.(\d+)/)?.[1].length || 2;
  const warningBannerSlug: BannerSlug & { text: string } =
    tradePlaceCode === 'ФБ СПБ'
      ? isBought
        ? { slug: 'TRADE_BYE_WARRANTY_SPB', text: 'Используются заёмные средства	' }
        : {
            slug: 'TRADE_SELL_WARRANTY_SPB',
            text: 'Используются заёмные средства. Короткая позиция может быть принудительно закрыта перед фиксацией реестра акционеров.	',
          }
      : isBought
      ? { slug: 'TRADE_BYE_WARRANTY', text: 'Используются заёмные средства	' }
      : { slug: 'TRADE_SELL_WARRANTY', text: 'Используются заёмные средства	' };
  const instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel =
    instrumentType === 'isFutures' ? 'Доступно под ГО' : 'Доступно';
  const freeCollateralLabel =
    instrumentType === 'isFutures' ? 'ГО за один контракт' : 'С учётом «плеча»';
  const isAcceptBannerShow = Boolean(
    quantity && (instrumentType === 'isBond' || instrumentType === 'isFutures'),
  );
  const acceptBannerSlug: BannerSlug & { text: string } =
    subAccount && quantity && instrumentType === 'isFutures'
      ? {
          ...getFuturesAcceptBannerSlugData(
            isBought,
            subAccount,
            quantity,
            futures.initialMargin,
            precision,
          ),
        }
      : {
          slug:
            orderType === 'limit'
              ? isBought
                ? 'TRADE_BYE_BOND_ACI'
                : 'TRADE_SELL_BOND_ACI'
              : isBought
              ? 'TRADE_BYE_BOND_STOP'
              : 'TRADE_SELL_BOND_STOP',
          vars: {
            value: sumFormatter(Number(quantity) * accruedInterest),
            accruedInterestCurrencyCode: currencySign(accruedInterestCurrencyCode),
          },
          text:
            orderType === 'limit'
              ? isBought
                ? `При покупке вы заплатите НКД в размере ${sumFormatter(
                    Number(quantity) * accruedInterest,
                  )} ${currencySign(accruedInterestCurrencyCode)}`
                : `При продаже вы заплатите НКД в размере ${sumFormatter(
                    Number(quantity) * accruedInterest,
                  )} ${currencySign(accruedInterestCurrencyCode)}`
              : isBought
              ? 'При покупке потребуется заплатить НКД. Размер НКД зависит от даты совершения сделки'
              : 'Размер НКД зависит от даты совершения сделки',
        };

  const label =
    orderType === 'limit' ? `${!isBought ? 'Покупают' : 'Продают'} по ` : 'Цена последней сделки ';

  const value =
    orderType === 'limit'
      ? {
          bidAsk: isBought
            ? ask
              ? `${sumFormatter(ask, precision, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`
              : '–'
            : bid
            ? `${sumFormatter(bid, precision, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`
            : '–',
          size: !ask || !bid ? '' : ` • ${isBought ? buySize : sellSize} ${quantityText}`,
        }
      : { bidAsk: ` ${sumFormatter(lastPrice, precision, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}` };
  const deviationInputLabel = `Отступ от ${isBought ? 'min' : 'max'}`;

  return {
    headerTitle: isBought ? 'Покупка' : 'Продажа',
    text: {
      label,
      value,
    },
    fxSpotType,
    priceLabel: isBought ? 'Цена не выше' : 'Цена не ниже',
    priceInputData: isBought ? ask : bid,
    lotSize: instrumentType === 'isFutures' ? 1 : lotSize,
    quantityText,
    btnText: isBought ? 'Купить' : 'Продать',
    instrumentType,
    volume,
    isWarningBannerShow: instrumentType !== 'isFutures' && isWarningBannerShow,
    warningBannerSlug,
    instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel,
    freeCollateralLabel,
    isAcceptBannerShow,
    acceptBannerSlug,
    precision,
    deviationInputLabel,
  };
};

export const getVolume = (
  instrumentType: InstrumentCategoryType,
  quantity = 0,
  price = 0,
  priceCurrency: PriceCurrencyType,
  { bondNominal, accruedInterest, tradeCurrency }: Trading,
  { pointPrice, priceTickValueCurrencyCode }: Futures,
  faceValue = 1,
): VolumeType => {
  if (instrumentType === 'isFutures')
    return {
      label: `${sumFormatter(quantity * price)} пт.`,
      value: quantity * price * pointPrice,
      secondValue: quantity * price,
      currency: currencySign(priceTickValueCurrencyCode),
    };

  if (instrumentType === 'isBond')
    return {
      label: 'Объем',
      value: quantity * ((bondNominal * price) / (100 * faceValue) + accruedInterest),
      currency: currencySign(tradeCurrency),
    };

  return {
    label: 'Объем',
    value: quantity * (price / faceValue),
    currency: currencySign(priceCurrency),
  };
};

const getFuturesAcceptBannerSlugData = (
  isBought: boolean,
  { balance, collateralCurrency: currency }: SubAccount,
  quantity = 0,
  initialMargin: number,
  precision: number,
): BannerSlug & { text: string } => {
  const collateralCurrency = currencySign(currency);

  if ((isBought && balance < 0) || (!isBought && balance > 0)) {
    const balanceAbs = Math.abs(balance);

    if (quantity <= balanceAbs) {
      const value = `${sumFormatter(initialMargin * quantity, precision, 2)}`;

      return {
        slug: 'TRADE_FUT_WARRANTY_UNRESERVE',
        vars: { value, collateralCurrency },
        text: `Разрезервирование ГО: ${value} ${collateralCurrency}`,
      };
    }

    if (quantity > balanceAbs && quantity < balanceAbs * 2) {
      const value = `${sumFormatter((2 * balanceAbs - quantity) * initialMargin, precision, 2)}`;

      return {
        slug: 'TRADE_FUT_WARRANTY_UNRESERVE',
        vars: { value, collateralCurrency },
        text: `Разрезервирование ГО: ${value} ${collateralCurrency}`,
      };
    }

    if (quantity === balanceAbs * 2 || balanceAbs * 2 - quantity === 0)
      return { slug: '', vars: {}, text: '' };

    if (quantity > balanceAbs * 2) {
      const value = `${sumFormatter((2 * balanceAbs - quantity) * initialMargin, precision, 2)}`;

      return {
        slug: 'TRADE_FUT_WARRANTY_RESERVE',
        vars: { value, collateralCurrency },
        text: `Резервирование ГО: ${value} ${collateralCurrency}`,
      };
    }

    return { slug: '', vars: {}, text: '' };
  }

  const value = `${sumFormatter(initialMargin * quantity)}`;
  return {
    slug: 'TRADE_FUT_WARRANTY_RESERVE',
    vars: {
      value,
      collateralCurrency,
    },
    text: `Резервирование ГО: ${value} ${collateralCurrency}`,
  };
};

export const getTradeOrderPath = (instrument = '') => [
  {
    name: 'Купить',
    link: generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, { instrument, direction: 'buy' }),
  },
  {
    name: 'Продать',
    link: generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, { instrument, direction: 'sell' }),
  },
];

export const getHint = (hints: Hint[] | undefined, slugData: SlugData): string => {
  if (!hints || !slugData.slug) return slugData.default;

  return hints?.find((f) => f.slug === slugData.slug)?.text ?? slugData.default;
};

export const isCancelButtonActive = (
  tradePlaceId: number,
  cancelPermissionState?: CancelPermissionStateType,
  cancelDeniedReason?: CancelDeniedReasonType,
  hints?: HintsResponse,
) => {
  if (!tradePlaceId || !hints || !cancelPermissionState) return;

  const status = getStatusText(tradePlaceId, cancelPermissionState, cancelDeniedReason, hints);

  if (status) {
    createAlertNotification({
      text: status,
      status: 'info',
    });

    return false;
  }

  return true;
};

export const getMultiplePrice = (price: number, priceStep: number, precision: number): number => {
  const mulpitlePrice =
    price > 0 && price < priceStep
      ? priceStep
      : (price * Math.pow(10, precision)) % (priceStep * Math.pow(10, precision)) === 0
      ? price
      : Math.floor(price / priceStep) * priceStep;

  return Number(mulpitlePrice.toFixed(precision));
};

export const getMultipleQuantity = (lotSizeValue: number, lotSize: number): number =>
  Number(lotSizeValue) > 0 && Number(lotSizeValue) < lotSize
    ? lotSize
    : Math.floor(Number(lotSizeValue) / lotSize) * lotSize;

export const getCategories = ({
  tradeAvailability,
  stopOrderPermissionState,
  stopOrderDeniedReason,
}: StopOrderStatusParams): CategoryType[] => {
  const categories = [{ title: 'Лимитная заявка', category: 'limit' }];

  const stopOrderStatus = getStopOrderStatus({
    tradeAvailability,
    stopOrderPermissionState,
    stopOrderDeniedReason,
  });

  stopOrderStatus === 'ACTIVE' &&
    categories.push({ title: 'Условная заявка', category: 'stopOrder' });

  return categories;
};

export const getStatusText = (
  tradePlaceId: number,
  permissionState?: string,
  deniedReason?: string,
  hints?: HintsResponse,
) => {
  if (getTradeSessionByTradePlaceId(tradePlaceId)?.sessionState === 'CLEARING') {
    return getHint(hints?.hints, {
      slug: 'ORDER_LIST_CLEARING',
      default: 'Проводится клиринг. Совершение операций невозможно.',
    });
  }

  if (permissionState === 'DENIED') {
    if (!deniedReason) return '';

    const sluData = LIMIT_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[deniedReason];

    if (!sluData) return '';
    return getHint(hints?.hints, sluData);
  }

  return '';
};

//TODO: Убрать null у второго аргумента как только бек начнет возвращать baseCurrencyCode
export const getFaceValueUnit = (
  instrumentCode: InstrumentCategoryCode,
  currency: PriceCurrencyType | null,
) => {
  return instrumentCode === 'MTP'
    ? 'гр.'
    : instrumentCode === 'CUP'
    ? currencySign(currency || 'PCS')
    : 'шт.';
};

export const getStopOrderBannerText = ({
  takeProfit,
  stopLimit,
  isBought,
}: {
  takeProfit: number | null;
  stopLimit: number | null;
  isBought: boolean;
}) => {
  if (!(takeProfit && stopLimit)) return '';

  if (isBought) {
    return Number(takeProfit) > Number(stopLimit) ? 'Стоп-лимит ниже тэйк-профит' : '';
  }

  return Number(takeProfit) > Number(stopLimit) ? '' : 'Стоп-лимит выше тэйк-профит';
};

import { FC, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import CategoryButtons from '@vision/category-buttons';

import { useGetAccountsQuery } from 'core/api/accounts';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';
import { isError } from 'core/helpers/isError';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';
import { setActiveTab, setInitialTradeOrderForm, setPrice } from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { isErrorResponseType } from 'utils/errorResponse';
import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import AccountCards from 'modules/AccountCards';
import CategorizationBottomSheet from 'modules/Catalog/components/Pages/CategorizationBottomSheet';
import Checks from 'modules/Checks';
import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';
import { getInstrumentIds } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import { useCancelTradeOrder } from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/CancelTradeOrder';
import CreateTradeOrder from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/CreateTradeOrder/CreateTradeOrder';
import { OrderDataType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components/Instrument';
import { SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper } from 'components/Tabs';

import { Order } from 'types/orders';
import { SubAccount } from 'types/subAccount';

import Disclaimer from './components/Disclaimer';
import TradeOrderForm from './components/TradeOrderForm';
import { getCategories, getInstrumentDataByOrderType, getTradeOrderPath } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { OrderType } from './types';

const TradeOrder: FC = () => {
  const { instrument: instrumentIds, direction } = useParams();
  const [instrumentId, tradePlaceId] = getInstrumentIds(instrumentIds);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const session = getSession();

  const [activeSubAccount, setActiveSubAccount] = useState<SubAccount>();
  const [showCreateTradeOrder, setShowCreateTradeOrder] = useState(false);
  const { setCancelTradeOrderState } = useCancelTradeOrder();
  const [orderData, setOrderData] = useState<OrderDataType | null>(null);
  const [activePortofolioName, setActivePortofolioName] = useState('');

  const { price, orderType } = useAppSelector((state) => ({
    orderType: state.tradeOrder.activeTab,
    price: state.tradeOrder.price,
  }));

  const [isCheckOpen, setIsCheckOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isInitialPriceSet, setIsInitialPriceSet] = useState(false);
  const [orderExecutionReport, setOrderExecutionReport] = useState<Order | null>(null);
  const [orderCreateErrorText, setOrderCreateErrorText] = useState<string | undefined>();
  const [hasBottomSheetShown, setHasBottomSheetShown] = useState(false);

  const isBought = direction === 'buy';
  const activeTab = isBought ? 0 : 1;

  const { data: instrumentInfo } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId: instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId: tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: true,
    source: useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam(),
  });

  const { data: accounts } = useGetAccountsQuery({ instrumentId, tradePlaceId });
  const { data: instrumentInfoFlags, isSuccess: isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees } =
    useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
    });
  const tabs = useMemo(() => getTradeOrderPath(instrumentIds), [instrumentIds]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      dispatch(setInitialTradeOrderForm());
    };
  }, [dispatch]);

  if (!instrumentInfo) return null;

  const { instrument, futures = [], fxSpot, trading = [] } = instrumentInfo;
  const {
    instrumentName,
    instrumentImageName,
    priceDiffCurr,
    faceValue,
    personCategoryTypeName,
    personCategoryTypeFullName,
    personCategoryTypeCode,
  } = instrument[0];
  const { tradeAvailability } = trading[0];
  const { baseCurrencyCode } = fxSpot[0] || {};
  const { initialMargin, initialMarginCurrencyCode } = futures[0] || {};
  const { tradingProducts = [], tradingAccounts = [], tradingAvailability = [] } = accounts || {};
  const personCategory =
    isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees && instrumentInfoFlags.instrumentInfoFlag[0].personCategory;

  const hasTestingAccess =
    !session?.isQual && (personCategory === 'TESTNOTPASSED' || personCategory === 'TESTPASSED');

  const categories = getCategories({
    tradeAvailability,
    stopOrderPermissionState: tradingAvailability[0]?.stopOrderPermissionState,
    stopOrderDeniedReason: tradingAvailability[0]?.stopOrderDeniedReason,
  });

  const {
    headerTitle,
    text: { label, value },
    fxSpotType,
    priceInputData,
    instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel,
    freeCollateralLabel,
    instrumentType,
  } = getInstrumentDataByOrderType({ isBought, instrumentInfo, orderType });

  if (!isInitialPriceSet) {
    !price && priceInputData && dispatch(setPrice(priceInputData));
    setIsInitialPriceSet(true);
  }

  const priceUnit =
    faceValue > 1
      ? `за ${faceValue} ${
          instrumentType === 'isCurrencyPair'
            ? currencySign(baseCurrencyCode)
            : instrumentType === 'isMetal'
            ? 'гр.'
            : 'шт.'
        }`
      : '';

  const handleTradeOrderGoBackBtn = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const handleActiveSubAccount = (subAccount: SubAccount) => {
    setActiveSubAccount(subAccount);
  };

  const handleMainBtnClick = (data: OrderDataType) => {
    setOrderData(data);
    setShowCreateTradeOrder(true);
  };

  const handleCloseCreateTradeOrder = () => {
    setShowCreateTradeOrder(false);
  };

  const handleSuccessOrderCreate = (order: Order) => {
    setOrderExecutionReport(order);
    handleCloseCreateTradeOrder();
    setIsCheckOpen(true);
  };

  const handleErrorOrderCreate = (error?: unknown) => {
    if (isErrorResponseType(error)) {
      setOrderCreateErrorText(error.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText);
    }
    handleCloseCreateTradeOrder();
    setIsCheckOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCancelButtonClick = () => {
    const onSuccess = () => {
      handleTradeOrderGoBackBtn();
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Заявка отменена', status: 'info', isCheckMark: true });
    };

    const onError = (error?: unknown) => {
      const errorMessage = isError(error) && error?.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText;
      handleTradeOrderGoBackBtn();
      createAlertNotification({
        text: errorMessage || 'Не удалось отменить заявку',
        status: 'error',
      });
    };

    if (orderExecutionReport) {
      setCancelTradeOrderState?.({
        open: true,
        orderNum: Number(orderExecutionReport.orderNum),
        orderType: orderType === 'stopOrder' ? 'stopOrder' : 'limit',
        onSuccess: onSuccess,
        onError: onError,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleCategoryChange = (category: string) => {
    dispatch(setActiveTab(category as OrderType));
  };

  const handleTradingProductChange = (portfolioName: string) => {
    setActivePortofolioName(portfolioName);
  };

  if (showCreateTradeOrder && orderData) {
    const { volume, portfolioName, ...body } = orderData;

    return (
      <CreateTradeOrder
        order={body}
        onSuccess={handleSuccessOrderCreate}
        onError={handleErrorOrderCreate}
        onClose={handleCloseCreateTradeOrder}
      />
    );
  }

  const personCategories = [
    {
      code: personCategoryTypeCode,
      fullName: personCategoryTypeFullName,
      name: personCategoryTypeName,
      passed: personCategory === 'TESTPASSED',
    },
  ];

  if (hasTestingAccess && !hasBottomSheetShown)
    return (
      <CategorizationBottomSheet
        data={personCategories}
        setHasBottomSheetShown={setHasBottomSheetShown}
      />
    );

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <HeaderPage
        title={headerTitle}
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleTradeOrderGoBackBtn}
      />
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />
        <div>
          <Text type="lineSemiBold">{`${instrumentName} ${fxSpotType}`}</Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" initial>
            {label}
          </Text>
          {orderType === 'stopOrder' && (
            <Text
              tag="span"
              type="labelRegular"
              color={priceDiffCurr > 0 ? 'colorConstructive' : 'colorDestructive'}
              initial
            >
              {priceDiffCurr && priceDiffCurr > 0 ? ' ↑' : ' ↓'}
            </Text>
          )}
          <Text type="labelRegular" initial>
            {value.bidAsk}
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" initial>
            {` ${priceUnit} ${value.size ?? ''}`}
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
      <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper tabs={tabs} replace activeTab={activeTab}>
        <Disclaimer tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId} instrumentId={instrumentId} />
        <AccountCards
          instrumentId={instrumentId}
          tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
          tradingProducts={tradingProducts}
          tradingAccounts={tradingAccounts}
          onSubAccountChange={handleActiveSubAccount}
          instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel={instrumentCurrencyBalanceLabel}
          freeCollateralLabel={freeCollateralLabel}
          instrumentType={instrumentType}
          initialMargin={initialMargin}
          initialMarginCurrencyCode={initialMarginCurrencyCode}
          onTraidingProductChange={handleTradingProductChange}
        />
      </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
      <div className={styles.categories}>
        <CategoryButtons
          activeCategory={orderType}
          categories={categories}
          onChange={handleCategoryChange}
          variant="secondary"
        />
      </div>
      <TradeOrderForm
        subAccount={activeSubAccount}
        isBought={isBought}
        instrumentInfo={instrumentInfo}
        onMainBtnClick={handleMainBtnClick}
        activePortofolioName={activePortofolioName}
        orderType={orderType}
        priceUnit={priceUnit}
      />
      <Checks
        open={isCheckOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsCheckOpen(false)}
        onTradeOrderGoBackBtn={handleTradeOrderGoBackBtn}
        onTradeOrderCancelButtonClick={handleCancelButtonClick}
        instrumentId={instrument[0]?.instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={instrument[0]?.tradePlaceId}
        instrumentCategoryCode={instrument[0]?.instrumentCategoryCode}
        baseCurrencyCode={fxSpot[0]?.baseCurrencyCode}
        instrumentName={instrument[0]?.instrumentName}
        instrumentCode={instrument[0]?.instrumentCode}
        instrumentImageName={instrument[0]?.instrumentImageName}
        currency={instrument[0]?.priceCurrency}
        subAccountId={activeSubAccount?.subAccountId}
        side={isBought ? 'BUY' : 'SELL'}
        ordStatus={orderExecutionReport?.ordStatus}
        orderQty={orderExecutionReport?.orderQty || orderData?.quantity}
        cumQty={orderExecutionReport?.cumQty || 0}
        transactTime={orderExecutionReport?.transactTime}
        price={orderExecutionReport?.price || orderData?.price}
        priceSecondary={orderData?.priceSecondary}
        priceSecondaryCurrencyCode={orderData?.priceSecondaryCurrencyCode}
        orderNum={orderExecutionReport?.orderNum}
        totalPrice={orderData?.volume.value}
        totalPriceSecondary={orderData?.volume?.secondValue}
        totalPriceCurrency={orderData?.volume.currency}
        portfolioName={orderData?.portfolioName}
        errorMessage={orderCreateErrorText}
        orderType={orderType}
        priceUnit={priceUnit}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default TradeOrder;

import { Futures, Trading } from 'types/instruments';

import {
  getHint,

import React from 'react';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import styles from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/CancelBottomSheetContent/CancelBottomSheetContent.module.pcss';
import {
  formattedCancelTitle,
  formattedCount,
  formattedDateTime,
  parseDate,
  parseTime,
} from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';
import { CancelBottomSheetContentProps } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

const CancelBottomSheetContent = ({
  onCancel,
  onConfirm,
  side,
  instrumentName,
  transactTime,
  cumQty,
  orderQty,
  baseCurrencyCode,
  instrumentCode,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  orderType = 'limit',
  isIpo = false,
}: CancelBottomSheetContentProps) => {
  const ipoText = `Участие в размещении ${instrumentName} ${
    instrumentCode ? `(${instrumentCode})` : ''
  }`;

  return (
    <div className={styles.content}>
      <Text className={styles.title} type="subtitleBold">
        Отменить заявку?
      </Text>
      <Text type="lineRegular" color={'colorForeground2'} className={styles.cutText}>
        {isIpo ? ipoText : side && formattedCancelTitle(side, instrumentName, instrumentCode)}
      </Text>
      <Text type="lineRegular" color={'colorForeground2'}>
        {transactTime
          ? isIpo
            ? `${parseDate(transactTime)} в ${parseTime(transactTime)}`
            : formattedDateTime(transactTime)
          : null}
      </Text>
      <Text type="lineRegular" color={'colorForeground2'}>
        {orderType === 'limit'
          ? formattedCount(cumQty, orderQty, instrumentCategoryCode, baseCurrencyCode) +
            ' исполнено'
          : cumQty &&
            baseCurrencyCode &&
            `${sumFormatter(cumQty, -1)} ${currencySign(baseCurrencyCode)}`}
      </Text>
      <div className={styles.buttonBar}>
        <Button onClick={onCancel} variant="secondary">
          Нет
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={onConfirm}>Да</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CancelBottomSheetContent;

import { render } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import CancelBottomSheetContent from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/CancelBottomSheetContent/CancelBottomSheetContent';
import { CancelBottomSheetContentProps } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

const BASE_TEST_DATA: CancelBottomSheetContentProps = {
  onCancel: () => null,
  onConfirm: () => null,
  side: 'S',
  instrumentName: 'EUR/RUB от 0,01€',
  transactTime: '2022-08-31T18:14:47.337+03:00',
  cumQty: 21,
  orderQty: 500,
  baseCurrencyCode: 'RUB',
  instrumentCode: 'EUR/RUB',
  instrumentCategoryCode: 'CUP',
};

test('CancelBottomSheet render props', async () => {
  const testData: CancelBottomSheetContentProps = {
    ...BASE_TEST_DATA,
    onCancel: jest.fn(),
    onConfirm: jest.fn(),
  };

  const { getByText } = render(<CancelBottomSheetContent {...testData} />);

  expect(getByText(/EUR\/RUB от 0,01€/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(getByText(/EUR\/RUB/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(getByText(/21/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(getByText(/500/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(getByText(/31.08.22 в 18:14:47/)).toBeInTheDocument();

  const yesButton = getByText(/Да/);
  const noButton = getByText(/Нет/);

  await userEvent.click(yesButton);
  await userEvent.click(noButton);

  expect(testData.onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect(testData.onCancel).toHaveBeenCalled();
});

test('CancelBottomSheet instrumentCategoryCode === CUP', () => {
  const { getByText } = render(<CancelBottomSheetContent {...BASE_TEST_DATA} />);

  if (!BASE_TEST_DATA?.baseCurrencyCode)
    throw new Error('BASE_TEST_DATA doesnt contain baseCurrencyCode');

  expect(getByText(new RegExp(currencySign(BASE_TEST_DATA?.baseCurrencyCode)))).toBeInTheDocument();
});

test('CancelBottomSheet instrumentCategoryCode === MTP', () => {
  const testData: CancelBottomSheetContentProps = {
    ...BASE_TEST_DATA,
    instrumentCategoryCode: 'MTP',
  };
  const { getByText } = render(<CancelBottomSheetContent {...testData} />);

  expect(getByText(/гр./)).toBeInTheDocument();
});

test('CancelBottomSheet some instrumentCategoryCode', () => {

    ...BASE_TEST_DATA,
    instrumentCategoryCode: 'FCB',
  };
  const { getByText } = render(<CancelBottomSheetContent {...testData} />);

  expect(getByText(/шт./)).toBeInTheDocument();
});

test('CancelBottomSheet sale', () => {
  const testData: CancelBottomSheetContentProps = {

  };

  expect(getByText(/Продажа/)).toBeInTheDocument();
});

test('CancelBottomSheet buy', () => {

import { LIMIT_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP } from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/consts';
import { getHint } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';

import { Hint } from 'types/hints';
import { CancelPermissionStateType } from 'types/ipoOrder';

import { IPO_ORDERS_CANCEL_BTN_ACTIVE_STATUSES } from '../NoIpoOrdersPlug/consts';
import { ColorVariant, GetPriceLabelParamsType } from './types';

export const getIpoOrderStatusColor = (statusCode: string, statusName: string): ColorVariant => {
  if (
    (statusName === 'В работе' &&
      (statusCode === 'New' || statusCode === 'PartiallyFilled' || statusCode === 'Suspended')) ||
    (statusName === 'В ожидании отмены' && statusCode === 'PendingCancel')
  )
    return 'colorAttention';

  if (statusCode === 'Filled' && statusName === 'Исполнено') return 'colorConstructive';

  return 'colorDestructive';
};

export const getPriceLabel = ({ price, priceRangeTo }: GetPriceLabelParamsType) => {
  if (price) return { pricelabel: 'Цена', priceValue: price };

  if (priceRangeTo) return { pricelabel: 'Ориентир цены', priceValue: priceRangeTo };

  return { pricelabel: 'Цена', priceValue: null };
};

export const getIsCancelBtnActive = (
  status: string,
  permissionState?: CancelPermissionStateType,
): boolean | null => {
  if (!IPO_ORDERS_CANCEL_BTN_ACTIVE_STATUSES.includes(status)) return null;

  return permissionState === 'GRANTED';
};

export const getIpoCancelBtnStatusText = (hints: Hint[] | undefined, deniedReason: string) => {
  if (deniedReason === 'InappropriateOrderStatus') return null;

  const sluData = LIMIT_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[deniedReason];

  if (!sluData)
    return getHint(hints, {
      slug: 'ОRDER_LIST_DEFAULT',
      default: 'Совершение торговых операций невозможно',
    });

  return getHint(hints, sluData);
};

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { Card, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import OrderCardButton from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderCardButton/OrderCardButton';
import {
  formatOrderProductPortfolio,
  parseTime,
} from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components';

import { getIpoOrderStatusColor, getIsCancelBtnActive, getPriceLabel } from './helper';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { IpoOrderCardProps } from './types';

const IpoOrderCard: FC<IpoOrderCardProps> = ({
  ipoOrder,
  showDivider,
  orderCardBtnVariant,
  onCancelBtnClick,
  onClick,
}) => {
  const {
    instrumentName,
    portfolioFullName,
    time,
    productFullName,
    deniedReason,
    quantity,
    instrumentImageName,
    statusName,
    statusCode,
    secCode,
    price,
    priceRangeTo,
    priceCurrency,
    amount,
    currency,
    cancelPermissionState,
  } = ipoOrder;
  const statusColor = getIpoOrderStatusColor(statusCode, statusName);
  const { pricelabel, priceValue } = getPriceLabel({ price, priceRangeTo });
  const isCancelBtnActive = getIsCancelBtnActive(statusCode, cancelPermissionState);

  const handleCancelBtnClick = () => {
    onCancelBtnClick(ipoOrder, isCancelBtnActive);
  };

  const handleCardClick = () => {
    onClick(ipoOrder);
  };

  return (
    <Card
      className={cx(styles.card, showDivider && styles.cardWithDivider)}
      onClick={handleCardClick}
    >
      <div className={cx(styles.row, showDivider && styles.divider)}>
        <Text type="labelRegular" color={statusColor}>
          {statusName}
        </Text>
        <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
          Выставлена в {parseTime(time)}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.content}>
        <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />
        <div>
          <div className={styles.heading}>
            <Text type="lineSemiBold" className={cx(styles.cutText, styles.instrumentName)}>
              {instrumentName
                ? `Участие в размещении ${instrumentName} ${secCode ? `(${secCode})` : ''}`
                : '-'}
            </Text>
          </div>
          <Text
            type="labelRegular"
            color="colorForeground2"
            className={cx(styles.cutText, styles.productShortName)}
          >
            {formatOrderProductPortfolio(
              productFullName,
              portfolioFullName,
              deniedReason === 'NoActiveTradingAccount',
            ) || '-'}
          </Text>
          <div className={styles.numbers}>
            <div className={styles.row}>
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                {pricelabel}
              </Text>
              <Text type="labelRegular">
                {priceValue
                  ? `${sumFormatter(priceValue, null, 2)} ${
                      priceCurrency ? currencySign(priceCurrency) : ''
                    }`
                  : '-'}
              </Text>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.row}>
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                Объём
              </Text>
              <Text type="labelRegular">
                {amount
                  ? `${sumFormatter(amount, null, 2)} ${currency ? currencySign(currency) : ''}`
                  : '-'}
              </Text>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.row}>
            {quantity && (
              <Text type="labelMedium">
                {quantity ? `${sumFormatter(quantity, null)} ${currencySign('PCS')}` : '-'}
              </Text>
            )}
            {isCancelBtnActive !== null && (
              <OrderCardButton
                variant={orderCardBtnVariant}
                disabled={!isCancelBtnActive}
                onClick={handleCancelBtnClick}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
};

export default memo(IpoOrderCard);

import { FC } from 'react';

import { Accordion, BottomSheet, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useGetOrderTradesQuery } from 'core/api/orderTrades';

import { getNoun } from 'utils/string';
import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import Header from 'modules/Checks/components/Header/Header';
import { formattedDateTime, getInstrumentIconIndicator } from 'modules/Checks/helpers';
import { getFaceValueUnit } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import Footer from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderDetails/components/Footer/Footer';
import OrderDetailsBlock from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderDetails/components/OrderDetailsBlock';
import { getOrderTradesRows } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderDetails/components/OrderDetailsBlock/helpers';
import { formatOrderProductPortfolio } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';

import {
  getIpoCancelBtnStatusText,
  getIpoOrderStatusColor,
  getIsCancelBtnActive,
  getPriceLabel,
} from '../IpoOrderCard/helper';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { IpoOrderDetailsProps } from './types';

const IpoOrderDetails: FC<IpoOrderDetailsProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  data,
  onOrderCardBtnClick,
  onDismiss,
}) => {
  const {
    deniedReason,
    orderNum,
    tradePlaceId,
    statusCode,
    statusName,
    instrumentImageName,
    buySell,
    instrumentName,
    instrumentId,
    cancelPermissionState,
    cancelDeniedReason,
    time,
    price,
    priceRangeTo,
    priceCurrency,
    quantity,
    amount,
    currency,
    sourceName,
    instrumentCategory,
    issuerName,
    productFullName,
    portfolioFullName,
    secCode,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    faceValue,
  } = data;

  const { data: orderTrades } = useGetOrderTradesQuery({ orderNum, tradePlaceId });
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const statusColor = getIpoOrderStatusColor(statusCode, statusName);
  const type =
    statusColor === 'colorConstructive'
      ? 'performed'
      : statusColor === 'colorAttention'
      ? 'registered'
      : 'error';
  const indicator = getInstrumentIconIndicator(type);
  const isActive = getIsCancelBtnActive(statusCode, cancelPermissionState);
  const status = isActive ? '' : getIpoCancelBtnStatusText(hints?.hints, cancelDeniedReason);
  const { pricelabel, priceValue } = getPriceLabel({ price, priceRangeTo });
  const faceValueUnit = getFaceValueUnit(instrumentCategoryCode, null);
  const orderTradesCount = orderTrades?.tradeList.length;

  const handleOrderCardBtnClick = () => {
    onOrderCardBtnClick(data, true);
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={isOpen}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
      header={
        <Header
          type={type}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
          side={buySell === 'B' ? 'BUY' : 'SELL'}
          instrumentName={instrumentName ?? '–'}
          headerText={statusName}
          indicator={indicator}
          isIpo
          instrumentId={`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`}
          titleClassName={styles.titleClassName}
          subTitle={secCode}
        />
      }
      footer={
        <Footer
          type={type}
          onReadyButtonClick={onDismiss}
          onOrderCardBtnClick={handleOrderCardBtnClick}
          isBtnDisabled={Boolean(!isActive)}
          deniedReason={status ?? ''}
          isActive={isActive}
        />
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <OrderDetailsBlock rows={[{ label: 'Выставлена', value: formattedDateTime(time) }]} />
        <OrderDetailsBlock
          rows={[
            {
              label: pricelabel,
              value: priceValue
                ? `${sumFormatter(priceValue, null, 2)} ${
                    priceCurrency ? currencySign(priceCurrency) : ''
                  }`
                : '-',
            },
            {
              label: 'Количество',
              value: quantity ? `${sumFormatter(quantity, null)} ${currencySign('PCS')}` : '-',
            },
            {
              label: 'Объём участия',
              value: amount
                ? `${sumFormatter(amount, null, 2)} ${currency ? currencySign(currency) : ''}`
                : '-',
            },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
      <Accordion title="Дополнительная информация">
        <OrderDetailsBlock
          rows={[
            {
              label: 'Номер торгового поручения',
              value: `${orderNum}`,
            },
            {
              label: 'Место выставления',
              value: sourceName ?? '–',
            },
            {
              label: 'На счёт',
              value:
                formatOrderProductPortfolio(
                  productFullName,
                  portfolioFullName,
                  deniedReason === 'NoActiveTradingAccount',
                ) || '-',
            },
            {
              label: 'Категория',
              value: `${instrumentCategory}`,
            },
            {
              label: 'Эмитент',
              value: `${issuerName}`,
            },
          ]}
          withBorder={false}
        />
      </Accordion>
      {orderTradesCount ? (
        <div className={styles.container}>
          <Text type="bodySemiBold">
            {`${orderTradesCount} ${getNoun(orderTradesCount, 'сделка', 'сделки', 'сделок')}`}
          </Text>
          <OrderDetailsBlock
            rows={getOrderTradesRows(
              orderTrades?.tradeList,
              instrumentCategoryCode,
              faceValue && faceValue > 1 ? `(за ${faceValue} ${faceValueUnit})` : '',
            )}
            withBorder={false}
            className={styles.orderTrades}
          />
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default IpoOrderDetails;

import { FC, memo, useState } from 'react';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useInfiniteIpoOrderScrollQuery } from 'core/api/ipoOrder';
import { isError } from 'core/helpers/isError';

import { useCancelTradeOrder } from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/CancelTradeOrder';
import { ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/consts';

import { FilterScrollProvider, createAlertNotification } from 'components';

import { IpoOrderType } from 'types/ipoOrder';

import CancelBottomSheet from '../CancelBottomSheet/CancelBottomSheet';
import OrderCardSkeleton from '../OrderCardSkeleton/OrderCardSkeleton';
import OrdersSkeleton from '../OrdersSkeleton/OrdersSkeleton';
import { getIpoCancelBtnStatusText } from './components/IpoOrderCard/helper';
import IpoOrderDetails from './components/IpoOrderDetails';
import IpoOrderGroup from './components/IpoOrderGroup';
import NoIpoOrdersPlug from './components/NoIpoOrdersPlug';
import { ERROR_TEXT } from './components/NoIpoOrdersPlug/consts';
import { ACTIVE_IPO_ORDERS_FILTER_STATUSES, NON_ACTIVE_IPO_ORDERS_FILTER_STATUSES } from './consts';
import { IpoOrderHistoryProps } from './types';

const IpoOrderHistory: FC<IpoOrderHistoryProps> = ({ requestData, filters }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isIpoDetailsOpen, setIsIpoDetailsOpen] = useState(false);

  const [activeIpoOrder, setActiveIpoOrder] = useState<IpoOrderType | null>(null);

  const { dateFrom, dateTo, ...propsForActive } = requestData;
  const requestParams = filters.isHistoryFilterActive ? requestData : propsForActive;

  const commonQueryParams = {
    ...requestParams,
    orderStatuses: filters.isHistoryFilterActive
      ? NON_ACTIVE_IPO_ORDERS_FILTER_STATUSES
      : ACTIVE_IPO_ORDERS_FILTER_STATUSES,
    subscribe: false,
    rowsCount: ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT,
    ipo: 'all',
  };
  const {
    instrumentName,
    time,
    quantity,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    secCode,
    orderNum,
    secBoard,
    subAccountId,
    tradePlaceId,
  } = activeIpoOrder || {};

  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();
  const { setCancelTradeOrderState } = useCancelTradeOrder();

  const [
    getNextPage,
    {
      data,
      status,
      isFetching,
      isError: isIpoOrdersError,
      page,
      hasNextPage,
      isNextPageFetching,
      isNextPageError,
    },
  ] = useInfiniteIpoOrderScrollQuery({ ...commonQueryParams, rowsOffset: 0 });

  const onScroll = (ref: HTMLDivElement) => {
    if (
      !isFetching &&
      !isNextPageFetching &&
      !isIpoOrdersError &&
      hasNextPage &&
      (ref.scrollHeight - ref.scrollTop) * 0.9 <= ref.clientHeight
    ) {
      getNextPage({
        ...commonQueryParams,
        rowsOffset: ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT * page,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSuccessCancelOrder = () => {
    createAlertNotification({ text: 'Поручение на отмену заявки принято', status: 'info' });
  };

  const handleErrorCancelOrder = (error?: unknown) => {
    const errorMessage = isError(error) && error?.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText;
    createAlertNotification({
      text: errorMessage || 'Не удалось отменить заявку',
      status: 'error',
    });
    handleCloseCancelTradeOrder();
  };

  const handleCloseCancelTradeOrder = () => {
    setCancelTradeOrderState &&
      setCancelTradeOrderState({
        open: false,
      });
  };

  const handleConfirmBtn = () => {
    if (activeIpoOrder) {
      setIsOpen(false);
      setCancelTradeOrderState &&
        setCancelTradeOrderState({
          open: true,
          isIpo: true,
          orderNum,
          secBoard,
          subAccountId,
          tradePlaceId,
          time,
          onSuccess: handleSuccessCancelOrder,
          onError: handleErrorCancelOrder,
        });
    }
  };

  const handleCancelBtnClick = (ipoOrder: IpoOrderType, isActive: boolean | null) => {
    const { cancelDeniedReason } = ipoOrder;

    if (!isActive) {
      if (!hints) return;

      const text = getIpoCancelBtnStatusText(hints?.hints, cancelDeniedReason);

      text && createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text });

      return;
    }

    setActiveIpoOrder(ipoOrder);
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCardClick = (ipoOrder: IpoOrderType) => {
    setActiveIpoOrder(ipoOrder);
    setIsIpoDetailsOpen(true);
  };

  if (isFetching || status === 'idle') return <OrdersSkeleton />;

  if (isIpoOrdersError) return <NoIpoOrdersPlug isError />;

  if (isNextPageError) createAlertNotification({ text: ERROR_TEXT, status: 'error' });

  if (!data || !Object.keys(data).length)
    return (
      <NoIpoOrdersPlug
        isActive={!filters.isHistoryFilterActive}
        productId={requestParams.productId}
      />
    );

  return (
    <FilterScrollProvider onScroll={onScroll}>
      {Object.keys(data).map((item, index) => (
        <IpoOrderGroup
          key={index}
          date={item}
          orderList={data[item]}
          orderCardBtnVariant="cancel"
          onCancelBtnClick={handleCancelBtnClick}
          onCardClick={handleCardClick}
        />
      ))}
      {hasNextPage && <OrderCardSkeleton />}
      <CancelBottomSheet
        open={isOpen}
        onCancel={() => setIsOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmBtn}
        isIpo
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
        instrumentCode={secCode}
        cumQty={quantity}
        transactTime={time}
        orderType="stop"
        baseCurrencyCode={'PCS'}
      />
      {activeIpoOrder && (
        <IpoOrderDetails
          isOpen={isIpoDetailsOpen}
          data={activeIpoOrder}
          onDismiss={() => setIsIpoDetailsOpen(false)}
          onOrderCardBtnClick={handleCancelBtnClick}
        />
      )}
    </FilterScrollProvider>
  );
};

export default memo(IpoOrderHistory);

import { FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import camelcaseKeys from 'camelcase-keys';
import { ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import {
  useMutateTradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollState,
  useTradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollQuery,
  useUnsubscribeFromOrdersMutation,
} from 'core/api/orderHistory';
import { isError } from 'core/helpers/isError';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';
import {
  setPrice,
  setProductId,
  setQuantity,
  setSubAccountId,
} from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import { useCancelTradeOrder } from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/CancelTradeOrder';
import { LIMIT_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP } from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/consts';
import { getHint, isCancelButtonActive } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import styles from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/TradeOrderHistory.module.pcss';
import { ACTIVE_ORDERS_STATUSES, ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/consts';
import {
  getDate,
  getIsLimitOrderBtnActive,
  getIsNewLimitOrder,
  parseOrdersHistory,
} from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';
import { FilterStateType } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/localCache';

import { FilterScrollProvider } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { UpdatedOrderHistoryItem } from 'types/orderHistory';
import { OrderHistoryItem, TradeOrdersHistoryRequest } from 'types/orders';

import CancelBottomSheet from '../CancelBottomSheet/CancelBottomSheet';
import Orders from '../Orders/Orders';

type Props = {
  requestData: Pick<
    TradeOrdersHistoryRequest,
    'dateFrom' | 'dateTo' | 'instrumentId' | 'productId' | 'tradePlaceId'
  >;
  filters: FilterStateType;
  historyStatuses: string[];
};

const LimitOrders: FC<Props> = ({ requestData, filters, historyStatuses }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  const { dateFrom, dateTo, ...propsForActive } = requestData;
  const requestParams = filters.isHistoryFilterActive ? requestData : propsForActive;

  const [showCancelConfirmation, setShowCancelConfirmation] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [orderData, setOrderData] = useState<OrderHistoryItem>();

  const mutateTradeOrderHistory = useMutateTradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollState();
  const [unsubscribeFromOrders] = useUnsubscribeFromOrdersMutation();
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const commonQueryParams = {
    ...requestParams,
    orderStatuses: filters.isHistoryFilterActive ? historyStatuses : ACTIVE_ORDERS_STATUSES,
    subscribe: !filters.isHistoryFilterActive,
    rowsCount: ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT,
  };

  const { setCancelTradeOrderState } = useCancelTradeOrder();

  const handleCancelConfirmButtonClick = () => {
    if (orderData) {
      setShowCancelConfirmation(false);
      setCancelTradeOrderState &&
        setCancelTradeOrderState({
          open: true,
          orderNum: orderData.orderNum,
          orderType: 'limit',
          onSuccess: handleSuccessCancelOrder,
          onError: handleErrorCancelOrder,
        });
    }
  };

  const handleOrderBtnClick = (order: OrderHistoryItem) => {
    const isNewOrder = getIsNewLimitOrder(order.statusCode);

    isNewOrder ? handleCancelButtonClick(order) : handleRetryBtnClick(order);
  };

  const handleCancelButtonClick = (order: OrderHistoryItem) => {
    if (
      isCancelButtonActive(
        order.tradePlaceId,
        order.cancelPermissionState,
        order.cancelDeniedReason,
        hints,
      )
    ) {
      setOrderData(order);
      setShowCancelConfirmation(true);
    }
  };

  const handleRetryBtnClick = ({
    price,
    quantity,
    productId,
    subAccountId,
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    buySell,
    orderType,
    permissionState,
    deniedReason,
  }: OrderHistoryItem) => {
    const isActive = getIsLimitOrderBtnActive(permissionState, tradePlaceId);

    if (!isActive) {
      const slugData = LIMIT_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[deniedReason];

      const text = getHint(hints?.hints, slugData);

      createAlertNotification({ text });

      return;
    }

    orderType !== 'M' && dispatch(setPrice(price));
    dispatch(setQuantity(quantity));
    dispatch(setProductId(productId));
    dispatch(setSubAccountId(subAccountId));

    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, {
        instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`,
        direction: buySell === 'B' ? 'buy' : 'sell',
      }),
    );
  };

  const handleSuccessCancelOrder = (updatedOrder: UpdatedOrderHistoryItem) => {
    mutateTradeOrderHistory({
      callback: (state) => {
        if (state && state?.orderList && updatedOrder.time) {
          const date = getDate(updatedOrder.time);

          state.orderList.entities[date] = state.orderList.entities[date].filter(
            (f) => f.orderNum !== updatedOrder.orderNum,
          );
          const deprecatedIds: string[] = [];
          for (const id of state.orderList.ids) {
            if (state.orderList.entities[id].length === 0) {
              delete state.orderList.entities[id];
              deprecatedIds.push(id);
            }
          }
          state.orderList.ids = state.orderList.ids.filter((f) => !deprecatedIds.includes(f));
        }
      },
    });
    createAlertNotification({ text: 'Заявка отменена', status: 'info' });
  };

  const handleErrorCancelOrder = (error?: unknown) => {
    const errorMessage = isError(error) && error?.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText;
    createAlertNotification({
      text: errorMessage || 'Не удалось отменить заявку',
      status: 'error',
    });
    handleCloseCancelTradeOrder();
  };

  const handleCloseCancelTradeOrder = () => {
    setCancelTradeOrderState &&
      setCancelTradeOrderState({
        open: false,
      });
  };

  const [
    getNextPage,
    {
      data: tradeOrderHistory,
      isFetching: isTradeOrderHistoryFetching,
      isError: isTradeOrderHistoryError,
      page,
      hasNextPage,
      isNextPageFetching,
      isNextPageError,
    },
  ] = useTradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollQuery(
    { ...commonQueryParams, rowsOffset: 0 },
    { skip: filters.isHistoryFilterActive && historyStatuses.length === 0 },
  );

  const onScroll = (ref: HTMLDivElement) => {
    if (
      !isTradeOrderHistoryFetching &&
      !isNextPageFetching &&
      !isTradeOrderHistoryError &&
      hasNextPage &&
      (ref.scrollHeight - ref.scrollTop) * 0.9 <= ref.clientHeight
    ) {
      getNextPage({ ...commonQueryParams, rowsOffset: ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT * page });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (filters.isHistoryFilterActive) return;

    // TODO: Типизировать Notifications
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    const listener = (data: { lastModified: number; response: any }) => {
      mutateTradeOrderHistory({
        callback: (state) => {
          if (state && state?.orderList) {
            const response = camelcaseKeys(data.response, {
              deep: true,
            }).tradeOrderList[0].ordersData.filter((item: any) => item.recordStatus !== 'D');

            state.orderList = parseOrdersHistory(response);
          }
        },
      });
    };

    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('TradeOrderChanged', listener);

    return () => {
      if (!tradeOrderHistory?.subscription?.length) return;

      unsubscribe();
      unsubscribeFromOrders(tradeOrderHistory?.subscription[0]?.subscriptionGuid);
    };
  }, [
    filters.isHistoryFilterActive,
    mutateTradeOrderHistory,
    tradeOrderHistory?.subscription,
    unsubscribeFromOrders,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isNextPageError) {
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Не удалось загрузить данные', status: 'error' });
    }
  }, [isNextPageError]);

  return (
    <FilterScrollProvider onScroll={onScroll} className={styles.filterProvider}>
      <Orders
        orderList={tradeOrderHistory?.orderList}
        hasNextPage={hasNextPage}
        isLoading={isTradeOrderHistoryFetching}
        isError={isTradeOrderHistoryError}
        isHistoryFilterActive={filters.isHistoryFilterActive}
        onOrderButtonClick={handleOrderBtnClick}
      />
      <CancelBottomSheet
        open={showCancelConfirmation}
        onCancel={() => setShowCancelConfirmation(false)}
        side={orderData && orderData.buySell === 'B' ? 'BUY' : 'SELL'}
        onConfirm={handleCancelConfirmButtonClick}
        instrumentName={orderData && orderData.instrumentName}
        transactTime={orderData && orderData.time}
        cumQty={orderData && orderData.executedQuantity}
        orderQty={orderData && orderData.quantity}
        baseCurrencyCode={orderData && orderData.instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP' ? 'GRM' : 'PCS'}
        instrumentCategoryCode={orderData && orderData.instrumentCategoryCode}
        instrumentCode={orderData && orderData.secCode}
      />
    </FilterScrollProvider>
  );
};

export default LimitOrders;

import Card from '@vision/card';
import Text from '@vision/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getFaceValueUnit } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import CancelButton from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderCardButton/OrderCardButton';
import {
  formatOrderProductPortfolio,
  formattedTitle,
  getIsLimitOrderBtnActive,
  getIsNewLimitOrder,
  getOrderCardVariant,
  parseTime,
} from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';
import { OrderCardProps } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

import { FormattedBalance, InstrumentIcon } from 'components';
import Progress from 'components/Progress';

import styles from './OrderCard.module.pcss';

const OrderCard = ({ order, onOrderButtonClick, onClick, showDivider }: OrderCardProps) => {
  const quantityLabel = getFaceValueUnit(order.instrumentCategoryCode, null);
  const variant = getOrderCardVariant(order.statusCode);
  const isNewOrder = getIsNewLimitOrder(order.statusCode);
  const isActive = getIsLimitOrderBtnActive(
    isNewOrder ? order.cancelPermissionState : order.permissionState,
    order.tradePlaceId,
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <Card size={'medium'} onClick={() => onClick(order)}>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <Text
            type={'labelRegular'}
            color={
              variant === 'success'
                ? 'colorConstructive'
                : variant === 'warning'
                ? 'colorAttention'
                : 'colorDestructive'
            }
          >
            {order.statusName}
          </Text>
          <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
            Выставлена в {parseTime(order.time)}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.content}>
          <div className={styles.imgContainer}>
            <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={order.instrumentImageName} />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.info}>
            <div className={styles.infoSection}>
              <div className={styles.infoRow}>
                <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>
                  {formattedTitle(order.buySell, order.instrumentName, order.secCode)}
                </Text>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.infoRow}>
                <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                  {formatOrderProductPortfolio(
                    order.productFullName,
                    order.portfolioFullName,
                    order.deniedReason === 'NoActiveTradingAccount',
                  )}
                </Text>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.infoSection}>
              <div className={styles.infoRow}>
                <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                  Цена {order.faceValue > 1 ? `за ${order.faceValue} ${quantityLabel}` : ''}
                </Text>
                {order.orderType === 'L' ? (
                  <Text type={'labelRegular'}>{` ${sumFormatter(
                    order.price,
                    null,
                    2,
                  )} ${currencySign(order.priceCurrency)}`}</Text>
                ) : (
                  <Text type={'labelRegular'}>Рыночная</Text>
                )}
              </div>
              {order.orderType === 'L' && (
                <div className={styles.infoRow}>
                  <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                    Объём
                  </Text>
                  <FormattedBalance value={order.amount} currency={order.currency} />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.infoSection}>
              <div className={styles.progressBarContainer}>
                <Progress
                  status={variant}
                  percentage={+(order.executedQuantity / order.quantity).toFixed(2)}
                  className={styles.progressBar}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.infoSection}>
              <div className={styles.infoRow}>
                <div className={styles.quantityContainer}>
                  <Text
                    type={'labelMedium'}
                    className={styles.quantity}
                  >{`${order.executedQuantity} ${quantityLabel}`}</Text>
                  <Text
                    type={'labelMedium'}
                    color={'colorForeground2'}
                  >{`из ${order.quantity} ${quantityLabel}`}</Text>
                </div>
                <CancelButton
                  onClick={() => onOrderButtonClick(order)}
                  variant={isNewOrder ? 'cancel' : 'retry'}
                  disabled={!isActive}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>
      <div className={cn(showDivider && styles.divider)} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default OrderCard;

import { FC, MouseEvent } from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';

import { OrderCardButtonProps } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const OrderCardButton: FC<OrderCardButtonProps> = ({ variant = 'cancel', onClick, disabled }) => {
  const btnVariant = disabled ? 'secondary' : variant === 'cancel' ? 'negative' : 'primary';

  const handleClick = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    event.stopPropagation();

    onClick();
  };

  return (
    <button className={cx(styles.button, styles[btnVariant])} onClick={handleClick}>
      {variant === 'cancel' ? 'Отменить' : 'Повторить'}
    </button>
  );
};

export default OrderCardButton;

import { FC } from 'react';

import { Banner, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { FooterProps } from './types';

const Footer: FC<FooterProps> = ({
  type,
  deniedReason,
  isBtnDisabled,
  isActive = true,
  onOrderCardBtnClick,
  onReadyButtonClick,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      {deniedReason && <Banner shape="warningLine" variant="attention" label={deniedReason} />}
      <div className={styles.buttonContainer}>
        {isActive !== null && (
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={onOrderCardBtnClick}
            className={styles.button}
            disabled={!isActive}
          >
            {type === 'registered' ? (
              <Text
                type={'bodySemiBold'}
                color={isBtnDisabled ? 'colorDisabledButtonText' : 'colorDestructive'}
              >
                Отменить
              </Text>
            ) : (
              'Повторить'
            )}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button className={styles.button} onClick={onReadyButtonClick}>
          Закрыть
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Footer;

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { formattedDateTime } from 'modules/Checks/helpers';

import { InstrumentCategoryCode } from 'types/instruments';
import { OrderTrades } from 'types/orderTrades';

import { OrderDetailsBlockRow } from './types';

export const getOrderTradesRows = (
  orderTrades: OrderTrades[],
  instrumentCategoryCode: InstrumentCategoryCode,
  faceValueText?: string,
): OrderDetailsBlockRow[] => {
  return orderTrades.map(
    ({ tradeNum, amount, currency, time, quantity, price, priceCurrency }) => ({
      label: `№ ${tradeNum}`,
      value: `${sumFormatter(amount, null, 2)} ${currencySign(currency)}`,
      subInfo: formattedDateTime(time),
      subInfoValue: `${quantity} ${
        instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP' ? 'гр.' : 'шт.'
      } по ${sumFormatter(price, null, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)} ${faceValueText}`,
      copiedText: `${tradeNum}`,
    }),
  );
};

import { FC } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import CopyButton from 'components/CopyButton';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { OrderDetailsBlockRow } from './types';

type Props = {
  rows: OrderDetailsBlockRow[];
  withBorder?: boolean;
  className?: string;
};

const OrderDetailsBlock: FC<Props> = ({ rows, withBorder = true, className }) => {
  return (
    <div className={cn(styles.container, withBorder && styles.containerBordered, className)}>
      {rows.map(({ label, value, subInfo, subInfoValue, copiedText }, index) => (
        <div key={label}>
          <div className={styles.row}>
            <div>
              <Text type={subInfo ? 'lineMedium' : 'lineRegular'} tag="span">
                {label}
              </Text>
              {copiedText && <CopyButton text={copiedText} />}
            </div>
            <Text type="lineSemiBold" className={styles.value}>
              {value}
            </Text>
          </div>
          {subInfo && (
            <div
              className={cn(styles.row, ++index !== rows.length ? styles.rowBordered : undefined)}
            >
              <div>
                <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                  {subInfo}
                </Text>
              </div>
              <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" className={styles.value}>
                {subInfoValue}
              </Text>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

export default OrderDetailsBlock;

import OrderDetailsBlock from './components/OrderDetailsBlock';
import { getOrderTradesRows } from './components/OrderDetailsBlock/helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  data: OrderHistoryItem;
  onDismiss: () => void;
  onOrderButtonClick?: (order: OrderHistoryItem) => void;
};

const OrderDetails: FC<Props> = ({ isOpen, data, onDismiss, onOrderButtonClick }) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const {
    instrumentImageName,
    instrumentName,
    statusCode,
    orderNum,
    tradePlaceId,
    buySell,
    statusName,
    time,
    price,
    priceCurrency,
    executedAveragePrice,
    quantity,
    executedQuantity,
    executedAmount,
    currency,
    sourceName,
    productFullName,
    portfolioFullName,
    instrumentCategory,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    orderType,
    cancelPermissionState,
    cancelDeniedReason,
    permissionState,
    deniedReason,
    instrumentId,
    faceValue,
    secCode,
    productId,
    subAccountId,
  } = data;

  const { data: orderTrades } = useGetOrderTradesQuery({ orderNum, tradePlaceId });
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const { tradeSessionStatus, status } = useAppSelector((state) => ({
    tradeSessionStatus: state?.tradeSession?.sessionRegistry[tradePlaceId]?.sessionState || '',
    status: state.limitOrdersStatus.reason,
  }));

  const variant = getOrderCardVariant(statusCode);
  const faceValueUnit = getFaceValueUnit(instrumentCategoryCode, null);
  const type = variant === 'success' ? 'performed' : variant === 'warning' ? 'registered' : 'error';
  const indicator = getInstrumentIconIndicator(type);
  const quantityValue = instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP' ? 'гр.' : 'шт.';
  const isNewOrder = getIsNewLimitOrder(statusCode);
  const isActive = getIsLimitOrderBtnActive(
    isNewOrder ? cancelPermissionState : permissionState,
    tradePlaceId,
  );

  const handleRepeatOrder = () => {
    if (!isActive) {
      const slugData = LIMIT_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[deniedReason];
      createAlertNotification({ text: getHint(hints?.hints, slugData) });
      return;
    }

    orderType !== 'M' && dispatch(setPrice(price));
    dispatch(setQuantity(quantity));
    dispatch(setProductId(productId));
    dispatch(setSubAccountId(subAccountId));

    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, {
        instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`,
        direction: buySell === 'B' ? 'buy' : 'sell',
      }),
    );
  };

  const handleOrderCardBtnClick = () => {
    if (onOrderButtonClick) {
      onOrderButtonClick(data);
      return;
    }

    if (!isNewOrder) {
      handleRepeatOrder();
    }
  };

  if (type === 'performed' || type === 'error') {
    if (!(tradeSessionStatus === 'ACTIVE' && permissionState === 'GRANTED')) {
      dispatch(
        updateLimitOrdersStatus({
          isAvailable: false,
          reason: getStatusText(tradePlaceId, permissionState, deniedReason, hints),
        }),
      );
    }
  } else {
    if (cancelPermissionState !== 'GRANTED') {
      dispatch(
        updateLimitOrdersStatus({
          isAvailable: false,
          reason: getStatusText(tradePlaceId, cancelPermissionState, cancelDeniedReason, hints),
        }),
      );
    }
  }

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={isOpen}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      className={styles.notShowDividers}
      header={
        <Header
          type={type}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
          side={buySell === 'B' ? 'BUY' : 'SELL'}
          instrumentName={instrumentName}
          headerText={statusName}
          indicator={indicator}
          orderType={orderType === 'L' ? 'limit' : 'stopOrder'}
          instrumentId={`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`}
          subTitle={secCode}
        />
      }
      footer={
        <Footer
          type={type}
          onOrderCardBtnClick={handleOrderCardBtnClick}
          onReadyButtonClick={onDismiss}
          isBtnDisabled={!isActive}
          deniedReason={status}
          isActive={isActive}
        />
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <OrderDetailsBlock rows={[{ label: 'Выставлено', value: formattedDateTime(time) }]} />
        <OrderDetailsBlock
          rows={[
            {
              label: `Цена в поручении ${faceValue > 1 ? `за ${faceValue} ${faceValueUnit}` : ''}`,
              value:
                orderType === 'M'
                  ? 'Рыночная'
                  : `${sumFormatter(price, null, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`,
            },
            {
              label: 'Средняя цена исполнения',
              value: executedAveragePrice
                ? `${sumFormatter(executedAveragePrice, null, 2)} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`
                : '–',
            },
            {
              label: 'Исполнено',
              value: `${executedQuantity} из ${quantity} ${quantityValue}`,
            },
            {
              label: 'Исполненный объём',
              value: executedAmount
                ? `${sumFormatter(executedAmount, null, 2)} ${currencySign(currency)}`
                : '–',
            },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
      <Accordion title="Дополнительная информация">
        <OrderDetailsBlock
          rows={[
            {
              label: 'Номер торгового поручения',
              value: `${orderNum}`,
              copiedText: `${orderNum}`,
            },
            {
              label: 'Место выставления',
              value: sourceName,
            },
            {
              label: 'На счёт',
              value: formatOrderProductPortfolio(
                productFullName,
                portfolioFullName,
                deniedReason === 'NoActiveTradingAccount',
              ),
            },
            {
              label: 'Категория',
              value: instrumentCategory,
            },
          ]}
          withBorder={false}
        />
      </Accordion>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        {orderTrades?.tradeList.length ? (
          <>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold">
              {`${orderTrades?.tradeList.length} ${getNoun(
                orderTrades?.tradeList.length,
                'сделка',
                'сделки',
                'сделок',
              )}`}
            </Text>
            <OrderDetailsBlock
              rows={getOrderTradesRows(
                orderTrades?.tradeList,
                instrumentCategoryCode,
                `${faceValue > 1 ? `(за ${faceValue} ${faceValueUnit})` : ''}`,
              )}
              withBorder={false}
              className={styles.orderTrades}
            />
          </>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default OrderDetails;

import { FC, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import {
  BottomSheet,
  Button,
  DatePicker,
  HeadlineBottomSheet,
  PeriodOption,
  RefHandler,
} from '@aurora/components';

import { DatePickerData } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  datePickerData: DatePickerData;
  minDate?: Date;
  periodOption: PeriodOption;
  setPeriodOption: (option: PeriodOption) => void;
  setDatePickerData: (data: DatePickerData) => void;
  onDismiss: () => void;
  onResetDatePickerButtonClick: () => void;
};

const OrderHistoryDatePicker: FC<Props> = ({
  isOpen,
  datePickerData,
  minDate,
  periodOption,
  setPeriodOption,
  setDatePickerData,
  onDismiss,

  onResetDatePickerButtonClick,
}) => {
  const ref = useRef<RefHandler | null>(null);
  const dates: [Date, Date] = [new Date(datePickerData.dateFrom), new Date(datePickerData.dateTo)];
  const [selectedDates, setSelectedDates] = useState<[Date | null, Date | null]>(() => dates);
  const [selectedPeriod, setSelectedPeriod] = useState<PeriodOption>(periodOption);

  const reset = () => {
    ref.current?.reset();
    onResetDatePickerButtonClick();
  };

  const handleDatePickerSubmit = (dates: Date[]) => {
    setDatePickerData({
      dateFrom: dates[0].getTime(),
      dateTo: dates[1].getTime(),
    });

    onDismiss();
  };

  const handleSetPeriodOption = (periodOption: PeriodOption) => {
    setPeriodOption(periodOption);
  };

  const handleChangePeriodOption = (option: PeriodOption) => {
    setSelectedPeriod(option);
    if (option === 'self' && option !== periodOption) {
      setSelectedDates([null, null]);
    } else {
      setSelectedDates(dates);
    }
  };

  const isResetButtonDisabled = selectedPeriod === 'year';

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={isOpen} onDismiss={onDismiss} className={styles.btm}>
      <HeadlineBottomSheet
        title="Период"
        className={styles['btm-header']}
        addonRight={
          <Button shape="text" variant="primary" onClick={reset} disabled={isResetButtonDisabled}>
            Сбросить
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <DatePicker
        ref={ref}
        defaultOption={periodOption}
        defaultOptionReset="year"
        minDate={minDate}
        dates={selectedDates}
        onSetOption={handleSetPeriodOption}
        onSubmit={handleDatePickerSubmit}
        onChangeOption={handleChangePeriodOption}
        showSameDateInRange={true}
      />
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default OrderHistoryDatePicker;

import ErrorPlug from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/ErrorPlug/ErrorPlug';
import NoActiveOrders from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/NoActiveOrders/NoActiveOrders';
import OrderCardSkeleton from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderCardSkeleton/OrderCardSkeleton';
import OrderSection from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderSection/OrderSection';
import OrdersSkeleton from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrdersSkeleton/OrdersSkeleton';
import { OrdersProps } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

const Orders = ({
  orderList,
  onOrderButtonClick,
  hasNextPage,
  isHistoryFilterActive,
  isLoading,
  isError,
}: OrdersProps) => {
  if (isError) {
    return <ErrorPlug />;
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return <OrdersSkeleton />;
  }

  if (orderList && orderList.ids.length === 0) {
    return !isHistoryFilterActive ? (
      <NoActiveOrders
        title={'Нет активных заявок'}
        text={'Исполненные и отменённые заявки находятся в истории'}
      />
    ) : (
      <NoActiveOrders title={'Список заявок пуст'} text={'У вас нет торговых заявок'} />
    );
  }
  return (
    <div>
      {orderList?.ids.map((item) => (
        <OrderSection
          key={item}
          orders={orderList.entities[item]}
          date={item}
          onOrderButtonClick={onOrderButtonClick}
        />
      ))}
      {hasNextPage && <OrderCardSkeleton />}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Orders;


--- FILE: src\modules\TradeOrderHistory\components\OrderSection\OrderSection.tsx ---

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import Text from '@vision/text';

import OrderCard from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderCard/OrderCard';
import { parseDate } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';
import { OrderSectionProps } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

import { OrderHistoryItem } from 'types/orders';

import OrderDetails from '../OrderDetails';
import styles from './OrderSection.module.pcss';

const OrderSection: React.FC<OrderSectionProps> = ({ date, orders, onOrderButtonClick }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeCard, setActiveCard] = useState<OrderHistoryItem | null>(null);

  const handleCardClick = (order: OrderHistoryItem) => {
    setActiveCard(order);
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.stickyHeader}>
        <Text type={'labelRegular'}>{parseDate(date)}</Text>
      </div>
      {orders.map((item, index) => (
        <OrderCard
          key={item.orderNum}
          order={item}
          showDivider={index !== orders.length - 1}
          onOrderButtonClick={onOrderButtonClick}
          onClick={handleCardClick}
        />
      ))}
      {activeCard && (
        <OrderDetails
          isOpen={isOpen}
          onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          data={activeCard}
          onOrderButtonClick={onOrderButtonClick}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default OrderSection;
