import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { formattedDate } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/pages/Details/helpers';

import { OrderDetailsBlockRow } from '../OrderDetails/components/OrderDetailsBlock/types';
import { TakeProfitStopLimitRowsData } from './types';

export const getTakeProfitStopLimitRows = ({
  orderTypeCode,
  takeProfitConditionPrice,
  offset,
  spread,
  stopLossConditionPrice,
  price,
  currencyCode,
  buySell,
  offsetUnits,
  spreadUnits,
  quantity,
  quantityValue,
  expiryDate,
  faceValueText,
}: TakeProfitStopLimitRowsData): OrderDetailsBlockRow[] => {
  const data = [];
  const currency = currencyCode ? currencySign(currencyCode) : '';
  const offsetCurrency = offsetUnits === 'CUR' ? currency : currencySign('PRC');
  const spreadCurrency = spreadUnits === 'CUR' ? currency : currencySign('PRC');

  if (orderTypeCode === 'TAKEPROFIT' || orderTypeCode === 'TAKEPROFIT_STOPLIMIT') {
    if (takeProfitConditionPrice)
      data.push({
        label: `Тэйк-профит ${faceValueText}`,
        value: `${sumFormatter(takeProfitConditionPrice, null, 2)} ${currency}`,
      });
    if (offset)
      data.push({
        label: `Отступ от ${buySell === 'B' ? 'min' : 'max'}`,
        value: `${sumFormatter(offset, null, 2)} ${offsetCurrency}`,
      });
    if (spread)
      data.push({
        label: 'Защитный спред',
        value: `${sumFormatter(spread, null, 2)} ${spreadCurrency}`,
      });
  }

  if (orderTypeCode === 'STOPLIMIT' || orderTypeCode === 'TAKEPROFIT_STOPLIMIT') {
    if (stopLossConditionPrice)
      data.push({
        label: `Стоп-лимит ${faceValueText}`,
        value: `${sumFormatter(stopLossConditionPrice, null, 2)} ${currency}`,
      });

    if (price)
      data.push({
        label: `Цена выставления лимитной заявки ${faceValueText}`,
        value: `${sumFormatter(price, null, 2)} ${currency}`,
      });
  }

  data.push(
    {
      label: 'Количество',
      value: `${quantity} ${quantityValue}`,
    },
    {
      label: 'Срок действия',
      value: expiryDate ? `До ${formattedDate(expiryDate)}` : 'До отмены',
    },
  );

  return data;
};

import { FC, useState } from 'react';

import { Accordion, BottomSheet, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useLazyGetOrdersQuery } from 'core/api/orders';

import Header from 'modules/Checks/components/Header/Header';
import { formattedDateTime, getInstrumentIconIndicator } from 'modules/Checks/helpers';
import { getFaceValueUnit, getHint } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import {
  formatOrderProductPortfolio,
  getIsCancelBtnActive,
  getIsRetryBtnActive,
} from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';

import { ReactComponent as ArrowRightSvg } from 'images/icons/small-arrow-right.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ProductSVG } from 'images/raw-icons/history/product.svg';

import OrderDetails from '../OrderDetails';
import Footer from '../OrderDetails/components/Footer';
import OrderDetailsBlock from '../OrderDetails/components/OrderDetailsBlock';
import {
  STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP,
  STOP_ORDER_STATUS_DESCRIPTION_HINTS_MAP,
} from '../StopOrders/StopOrdersHistory/consts';
import { getStopOrderStatusColor } from '../StopOrders/components/StopOrderCard/helper';
import { getTakeProfitStopLimitRows } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { StopOrderDetailsProps } from './types';

const StopOrderDetails: FC<StopOrderDetailsProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  data,
  orderCardBtnVariant,
  onDismiss,
  onOrderCardBtnClick,
}) => {
  const {
    instrumentImageName,
    instrumentName,
    orderStatusCode,
    stopOrderNum,
    tradePlaceId,
    buySell,
    orderStatusName,
    time,
    price,
    currencyCode,
    quantity,
    sourceName,
    productFullName,
    portfolioFullName,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    instrumentId,
    faceValue = 1,
    orderTypeCode,
    offsetUnits,
    spreadUnits,
    offset,
    spread,
    stopLossConditionPrice,
    takeProfitConditionPrice,
    expiryDate,
    linkedOrderNum,
    activationDateTime,
    statusDescription,
    stopOrderPermissionState,
    stopOrderDeniedReason,
    stopOrderCancelPermissionState,
    stopOrderCancelDeniedReason,
    instrumentCode,
    statusDescriptionName,
  } = data;

  const [isBottomSheetOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const [getLinkedOrder, { data: linkedOrderData }] = useLazyGetOrdersQuery();
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const variant = getStopOrderStatusColor(orderStatusCode, statusDescription);
  const faceValueUnit = getFaceValueUnit(instrumentCategoryCode, null);
  const faceValueText = faceValue > 1 ? `за ${faceValue} ${faceValueUnit}` : '';
  const type =
    variant === 'colorConstructive'
      ? 'performed'
      : variant === 'colorAttention'
      ? 'registered'
      : 'error';
  const indicator = getInstrumentIconIndicator(type);
  const quantityValue = instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP' ? 'гр.' : 'шт.';
  const takeProfitStopLimitRows = getTakeProfitStopLimitRows({
    orderTypeCode,
    takeProfitConditionPrice,
    offset,
    spread,
    stopLossConditionPrice,
    price,
    currencyCode,
    buySell,
    offsetUnits,
    spreadUnits,
    quantity,
    quantityValue,
    expiryDate,
    faceValueText,
  });

  const isActive =
    orderCardBtnVariant === 'cancel'
      ? getIsCancelBtnActive(orderStatusCode, stopOrderCancelPermissionState)
      : getIsRetryBtnActive(orderStatusCode, stopOrderPermissionState);

  const slugData =
    orderCardBtnVariant === 'cancel'
      ? stopOrderCancelDeniedReason &&
        STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[stopOrderCancelDeniedReason]
      : stopOrderDeniedReason && STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[stopOrderDeniedReason];
  const status = slugData ? getHint(hints?.hints, slugData) : '';
  const statusDescriptionText =
    orderStatusCode && statusDescription
      ? hints?.hints.find(
          (f) =>
            f.slug === STOP_ORDER_STATUS_DESCRIPTION_HINTS_MAP[orderStatusCode][statusDescription],
        )?.text
      : '';

  const handleLinkedOrderClick = () => {
    getLinkedOrder({ orderNum: linkedOrderNum });
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOrderCardBtnClick = () => {
    onOrderCardBtnClick(data, true);
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheet
      open={isOpen}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
      header={
        <Header
          type={type}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
          side={buySell === 'B' ? 'BUY' : 'SELL'}
          instrumentName={instrumentName ?? '–'}
          headerText={statusDescriptionName ?? orderStatusName}
          indicator={indicator}
          orderType={'stopOrder'}
          instrumentId={`${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`}
          titleClassName={styles.titleClassName}
          subTitle={instrumentCode}
          slugText={statusDescriptionText}
        />
      }
      footer={
        <Footer
          type={type}
          onReadyButtonClick={onDismiss}
          onOrderCardBtnClick={handleOrderCardBtnClick}
          isBtnDisabled={Boolean(!isActive)}
          deniedReason={status}
          isActive={isActive}
        />
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <OrderDetailsBlock rows={[{ label: 'Выставлена', value: formattedDateTime(time) }]} />
        <OrderDetailsBlock rows={takeProfitStopLimitRows} />
      </div>
      <Accordion title="Дополнительная информация">
        <OrderDetailsBlock
          rows={[
            {
              label: 'Номер условной заявки',
              value: `${stopOrderNum}`,
              copiedText: `${stopOrderNum}`,
            },
            {
              label: 'Место выставления',
              value: sourceName ?? '–',
            },
            {
              label: 'На счёт',
              value: formatOrderProductPortfolio(
                productFullName,
                portfolioFullName,
                (productFullName ?? '')?.indexOf('(закрыт)') >= 0,
              ),
            },
          ]}
        />
      </Accordion>
      {Boolean(linkedOrderNum) && (
        <div className={cn(styles.container, styles.linkedBlock)} onClick={handleLinkedOrderClick}>
          <div className={styles.linkedDataWrapper}>
            <ProductSVG />
            <div>
              <Text type="lineRegular">Заявка №{linkedOrderNum}</Text>
              {activationDateTime && (
                <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                  {formattedDateTime(activationDateTime)}
                </Text>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <ArrowRightSvg className={styles.arrowRightIcon} />
        </div>
      )}
      {linkedOrderData?.orderList.length ? (
        <OrderDetails
          isOpen={isBottomSheetOpen}
          data={linkedOrderData?.orderList[0]}
          onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
        />
      ) : null}
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default StopOrderDetails;

import React, { FC } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetAccountsQuery } from 'core/api/accounts';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { useGetInstrumentInfoQuery } from 'core/api/instruments';
import { useGetPositionsQuery } from 'core/api/positions';
import { setActiveTab } from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import { useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helper/useInstrumentInfoQueryParams';
import { getDirectionForStopOrder, getStopOrderStatus } from 'modules/InstrumentPage/helpers';
import NoActiveOrders from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/NoActiveOrders/NoActiveOrders';

type Props = {
  title: string;
  instrumentId: string;
  tradePlaceId: string;
};

const NoStopOrders: FC<Props> = ({ title, instrumentId, tradePlaceId }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const { data: instrumentInfo } = useGetInstrumentInfoQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    subscribe: false,
    source: useInstrumentInfoQuerySourceParam(),
  });
  const { data: accounts } = useGetAccountsQuery({
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
  });

  const { data: instrumentInfoFlags, isSuccess: isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees } =
    useGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery({
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
    });

  const { data: positionsByProduct } = useGetPositionsQuery({
    datasets: 'PositionValuationByProduct',
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
  });

  const positions =
    isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees && instrumentInfoFlags.instrumentInfoFlag[0].positions;

  const { stopOrderPermissionState, stopOrderDeniedReason } =
    accounts?.tradingAvailability[0] || {};

  const { trading = [] } = instrumentInfo || {};

  const { tradeAvailability } = trading[0] || {};

  const stopOrderStatus = getStopOrderStatus({
    tradeAvailability,
    stopOrderPermissionState,
    stopOrderDeniedReason,
  });

  const handleNoActiveOrderBtnClick = () => {
    const positionValuationByProductQuantity = positionsByProduct?.positionValuationByProduct
      ?.length
      ? positionsByProduct?.positionValuationByProduct[0]?.quantity > 0
      : false;

    dispatch(setActiveTab('stopOrder'));
    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, {
        instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`,
        direction: getDirectionForStopOrder(positions, positionValuationByProductQuantity),
      }),
    );
  };

  return (
    <NoActiveOrders
      title={title}
      text={'Поданные ранее заявки отображаются в истории'}
      btnText={stopOrderStatus === 'ACTIVE' ? 'Создать заявку' : undefined}
      onBtnClick={handleNoActiveOrderBtnClick}
    />
  );
};

export default NoStopOrders;

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getInstrumentType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';

import { InstrumentCategoryCode, PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { OrderStatusCode, OrderTypeCode, StatusDescription } from 'types/stopOrders';

type ColorVariant = 'colorConstructive' | 'colorAttention' | 'colorDestructive';

export const getStopOrderStatusColor = (
  statusCode: OrderStatusCode,
  statusDescription: StatusDescription | null = null,
): ColorVariant => {
  if (!statusDescription)
    return statusCode === 'EXECUTED'
      ? 'colorConstructive'
      : statusCode === 'CANCELED'
      ? 'colorDestructive'
      : 'colorAttention';

  if (statusCode === 'EXECUTED') {
    if (statusDescription === 'ExposedOrderTS' || statusDescription === 'LinkedOrderCompleted')
      return 'colorConstructive';

    return 'colorDestructive';
  }

  if (statusCode === 'ACTIVE') return 'colorAttention';

  if (statusCode === 'ACTIVATED') {
    if (statusDescription === 'ExposedOrderTS') return 'colorConstructive';

    return 'colorDestructive';
  }

  return 'colorDestructive';
};

type OrderTypeData = {
  label: string;
  value: string;
};

type OrderTypeDataParams = {
  code: OrderTypeCode;
  orderTypeName?: string;
  takeProfitConditionPrice?: number;
  stopLossConditionPrice?: number;
  currencyCode?: PriceCurrencyType;
  instrumentCategoryCode: InstrumentCategoryCode;
  faceValue?: number;
  baseCurrencyCode?: PriceCurrencyType;
};

export const getOrderTypeData = ({
  code,
  orderTypeName,
  takeProfitConditionPrice = 0,
  stopLossConditionPrice = 0,
  currencyCode,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  faceValue = 1,
  baseCurrencyCode,
}: OrderTypeDataParams): OrderTypeData[] | null => {
  if (!orderTypeName) return null;

  const instrumentType = getInstrumentType(instrumentCategoryCode);
  const priceUnit =
    faceValue > 1
      ? `за ${faceValue} ${
          instrumentType === 'isCurrencyPair' && baseCurrencyCode
            ? currencySign(baseCurrencyCode)
            : instrumentType === 'isMetal'
            ? 'гр.'
            : 'шт.'
        }`
      : '';

  const currency = currencyCode ? currencySign(currencyCode) : '';

  if (code === 'TAKEPROFIT')
    return [
      {
        label: `${orderTypeName} ${priceUnit}`,
        value: `${sumFormatter(takeProfitConditionPrice, -1, 2)} ${currency}`,
      },
    ];

  if (code === 'STOPLIMIT')
    return [
      {
        label: `${orderTypeName} ${priceUnit}`,
        value: `${sumFormatter(stopLossConditionPrice, -1, 2)} ${currency}`,
      },
    ];

  return [
    {
      label: `Тэйк-профит ${priceUnit}`,
      value: `${sumFormatter(takeProfitConditionPrice, -1, 2)} ${currency}`,
    },
    {
      label: `Стоп-лимит ${priceUnit}`,
      value: `${sumFormatter(stopLossConditionPrice, -1, 2)} ${currency}`,
    },
  ];
};

import { FC } from 'react';

import Card from '@vision/card';
import Text from '@vision/text';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import OrderCardButton from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/OrderCardButton/OrderCardButton';
import {
  formatOrderProductPortfolio,
  getIsCancelBtnActive,
  getIsRetryBtnActive,
  parseTime,
} from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';
import { OrderCardBtnVariant } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components';

import { StopOrder } from 'types/stopOrders';

import { getOrderTypeData, getStopOrderStatusColor } from './helper';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  stopOrder: StopOrder;
  showDivider: boolean;
  orderCardBtnVariant: OrderCardBtnVariant;
  onClick: (stopOrderNum: number) => void;
  onOrderCardBtnClick: (stopOrder: StopOrder, isActive: boolean | null) => void;
};

const StopOrderCard: FC<Props> = ({
  stopOrder,
  showDivider,
  orderCardBtnVariant,
  onClick,
  onOrderCardBtnClick,
}) => {
  const {
    accountClosed,
    instrumentName,
    instrumentCode,
    buySell,
    orderTypeName,
    portfolioFullName,
    orderStatusName,
    orderStatusCode,
    time,
    stopLossConditionPrice,
    takeProfitConditionPrice,
    productFullName,
    currencyCode,
    orderTypeCode,
    quantity,
    instrumentImageName,
    statusDescription,
    stopOrderCancelPermissionState,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    faceValue,
    baseCurrencyCode,
    stopOrderNum,
    stopOrderPermissionState,
    statusDescriptionName,
  } = stopOrder;
  const statusColor = getStopOrderStatusColor(orderStatusCode, statusDescription);
  const isActive =
    orderCardBtnVariant === 'cancel'
      ? getIsCancelBtnActive(orderStatusCode, stopOrderCancelPermissionState)
      : getIsRetryBtnActive(orderStatusCode, stopOrderPermissionState);
  const orderTypeData = getOrderTypeData({
    code: orderTypeCode,
    orderTypeName,
    takeProfitConditionPrice,
    stopLossConditionPrice,
    currencyCode,
    instrumentCategoryCode,
    faceValue,
    baseCurrencyCode,
  });

  const handleOrderCardBtnClick = () => {
    onOrderCardBtnClick(stopOrder, isActive);
  };

  return (
    <Card
      className={cn(styles.card, showDivider && styles.cardWithDivider)}
      onClick={() => onClick(stopOrderNum)}
    >
      <div className={cn(styles.row, showDivider && styles.divider)}>
        {orderStatusName && (
          <Text type="labelRegular" color={statusColor}>
            {statusDescriptionName ?? orderStatusName}
          </Text>
        )}
        {time && (
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            Выставлена в {parseTime(time)}
          </Text>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.content}>
        <InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} />
        <div>
          <div className={styles.heading}>
            <Text type="lineSemiBold">
              {`${
                buySell === 'BUY' || buySell === 'B' ? 'Покупка' : 'Продажа'
              } ${instrumentName} (${instrumentCode})`}
            </Text>
          </div>
          <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
            {formatOrderProductPortfolio(productFullName, portfolioFullName, accountClosed)}
          </Text>
          <div className={styles.numbers}>
            {orderTypeData?.map(({ label, value }) => (
              <div key={label} className={styles.row}>
                <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                  {label}
                </Text>
                <Text type="labelRegular">{value}</Text>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className={styles.row}>
            {quantity && (
              <Text type="labelMedium">
                {`${sumFormatter(quantity, -1)} ${currencySign(
                  instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP' ? 'GRM' : 'PCS',
                )}`}
              </Text>
            )}
            {isActive !== null && (
              <OrderCardButton
                variant={orderCardBtnVariant}
                disabled={!isActive}
                onClick={handleOrderCardBtnClick}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
};

import { FC, useState } from 'react';

import Text from '@vision/text';

import { useLazyGetStopOrderQuery } from 'core/api/orders';

import StopOrderDetails from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/StopOrderDetails';
import { parseDate } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/formatting';

import StopOrderCard from '../StopOrderCard';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { StopOrderGroupProps } from './types';

const StopOrderGroup: FC<StopOrderGroupProps> = ({
  date,
  orderCardBtnVariant,
  stopOrderList,
  onOrderCardBtnClick,
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const [getStopOrder, { data: stopOrder }] = useLazyGetStopOrderQuery();

  const handleCardClick = (stopOrderNum: number) => {
    getStopOrder(stopOrderNum);
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.stickyHeader}>
        <Text type={'labelRegular'}>{parseDate(date)}</Text>
      </div>
      {stopOrderList.map((item, index) => (
        <StopOrderCard
          onClick={handleCardClick}
          key={index}
          stopOrder={item}
          showDivider={Boolean(index)}
          orderCardBtnVariant={orderCardBtnVariant}
          onOrderCardBtnClick={onOrderCardBtnClick}
        />
      ))}
      {stopOrder && (
        <StopOrderDetails
          isOpen={isOpen}
          onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          data={stopOrder}
          orderCardBtnVariant={orderCardBtnVariant}
          onOrderCardBtnClick={onOrderCardBtnClick}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default StopOrderGroup;

import { FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useActiveStopOrdersInfiniteScrollQuery } from 'core/api/stopOrders';
import { isError } from 'core/helpers/isError';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';

import { useCancelTradeOrder } from 'modules/TradeOrder/components/CancelTradeOrder';
import { getHint } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import styles from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/TradeOrderHistory.module.pcss';
import { ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/consts';

import { FilterScrollProvider } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { StopOrder } from 'types/stopOrders';

import CancelBottomSheet from '../../CancelBottomSheet/CancelBottomSheet';
import OrderCardSkeleton from '../../OrderCardSkeleton/OrderCardSkeleton';
import OrdersSkeleton from '../../OrdersSkeleton/OrdersSkeleton';
import { STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP } from '../StopOrdersHistory/consts';
import NoStopOrders from '../components/NoStopOrders';
import StopOrderGroup from '../components/StopOrderGroup';
import { RequestType } from '../types';

type Props = {
  requestData: RequestType;
};

const StopOrdersActive: FC<Props> = ({ requestData }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeStopOrder, setActiveStopOrder] = useState<StopOrder | null>(null);

  const { instrumentId, tradePlaceId, productId } = requestData;
  const { buySell, instrumentName, time, quantity, instrumentCategoryCode, instrumentCode } =
    activeStopOrder || {};

  const { setCancelTradeOrderState } = useCancelTradeOrder();
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const [
    getNextPage,
    { data: stopOrders, isFetching, page, hasNextPage, isNextPageFetching, isNextPageError },
    refresh,
  ] = useActiveStopOrdersInfiniteScrollQuery({ ...requestData, rowsOffset: 0 });

  const onScroll = (ref: HTMLDivElement) => {
    if (
      !isFetching &&
      !isNextPageFetching &&
      !isNextPageError &&
      hasNextPage &&
      (ref.scrollHeight - ref.scrollTop) * 0.9 <= ref.clientHeight
    ) {
      getNextPage({ ...requestData, rowsOffset: ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT * page });
    }
  };

  const handleErrorCancelOrder = (error?: unknown) => {
    const errorMessage = isError(error) && error?.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText;
    createAlertNotification({
      text: errorMessage || 'Не удалось отменить заявку',
      status: 'error',
    });
    handleCloseCancelTradeOrder();
  };

  const handleCloseCancelTradeOrder = () => {
    setCancelTradeOrderState &&
      setCancelTradeOrderState({
        open: false,
      });
  };

  const handleSuccessCancelOrder = () => {
    createAlertNotification({ text: 'Заявка отменена', status: 'info' });
  };

  const handleConfirmBtn = () => {
    if (activeStopOrder) {
      setIsOpen(false);
      setCancelTradeOrderState &&
        setCancelTradeOrderState({
          open: true,
          orderType: 'stopOrder',
          orderNum: activeStopOrder?.stopOrderNum,
          onSuccess: handleSuccessCancelOrder,
          onError: handleErrorCancelOrder,
        });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('StopOrderChanged', () => {
      refresh({ ...requestData, rowsOffset: 0 });
    });

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleOrderCardBtnClick = (stopOrder: StopOrder, isActive: boolean | null) => {
    const { stopOrderCancelDeniedReason } = stopOrder;

    if (!isActive) {
      if (!stopOrderCancelDeniedReason) return;

      const slugData = STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[stopOrderCancelDeniedReason];

      const text = getHint(hints?.hints, slugData);

      createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text });

      return;
    }

    setActiveStopOrder(stopOrder);
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isNextPageError) {
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Не удалось загрузить данные', status: 'error' });
    }
  }, [isNextPageError]);

  if (!stopOrders) return null;

  if (isFetching) {
    return <OrdersSkeleton />;
  }

  if (Object.keys(stopOrders).length === 0)
    return (
      <NoStopOrders
        title={productId ? 'Нет активных заявок на выбранном счёте' : 'Нет активных заявок'}
        instrumentId={String(instrumentId)}
        tradePlaceId={String(tradePlaceId)}
      />
    );

  return (
    <FilterScrollProvider onScroll={onScroll} className={styles.filterProvider}>
      <div>
        {Object.keys(stopOrders).map((item, index) => (
          <StopOrderGroup
            key={index}
            date={item}
            stopOrderList={stopOrders[item]}
            orderCardBtnVariant="cancel"
            onOrderCardBtnClick={handleOrderCardBtnClick}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      {hasNextPage && <OrderCardSkeleton />}
      <CancelBottomSheet
        open={isOpen}
        onCancel={() => setIsOpen(false)}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmBtn}
        side={buySell === 'B' ? 'BUY' : 'SELL'}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        instrumentCategoryCode={instrumentCategoryCode}
        instrumentCode={instrumentCode}
        cumQty={quantity}
        transactTime={time}
        orderType="stop"
        baseCurrencyCode={instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP' ? 'GRM' : 'PCS'}
      />
    </FilterScrollProvider>
  );
};

export default StopOrdersActive;

import { FC, useEffect } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import { useInfiniteScrollQuery } from 'core/api/stopOrders';
import Notifications from 'core/notification/notifications';
import {
  setActiveTab,
  setDeviation,
  setLotSize,
  setProductId,
  setProtectiveSpread,
  setStopLimit,
  setStopLimitPrice,
  setSubAccountId,
  setTakeProfit,
} from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import { getHint } from 'modules/TradeOrder/helpers';
import styles from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/TradeOrderHistory.module.pcss';
import { ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/consts';
import { getСonvertedOffsetOrSpead } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/helpers';

import { FilterScrollProvider } from 'components';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { StopOrder } from 'types/stopOrders';

import NoActiveOrders from '../../NoActiveOrders/NoActiveOrders';
import OrderCardSkeleton from '../../OrderCardSkeleton/OrderCardSkeleton';
import OrdersSkeleton from '../../OrdersSkeleton/OrdersSkeleton';
import StopOrderGroup from '../components/StopOrderGroup';
import { STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP } from './consts';
import { StopOrdersHistoryProps } from './types';

const StopOrdersHistory: FC<StopOrdersHistoryProps> = ({ requestData }) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [
    getNextPage,
    {
      data: stopOrders,
      isFetching,
      isError,
      page,
      hasNextPage,
      isNextPageFetching,
      isNextPageError,
    },
  ] = useInfiniteScrollQuery({ ...requestData, rowsOffset: 0 });
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery();

  const onScroll = (ref: HTMLDivElement) => {
    if (
      !isFetching &&
      !isNextPageFetching &&
      !isError &&
      hasNextPage &&
      (ref.scrollHeight - ref.scrollTop) * 0.9 <= ref.clientHeight
    ) {
      getNextPage({ ...requestData, rowsOffset: ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT * page });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isNextPageError) {
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Не удалось загрузить данные', status: 'error' });
    }
  }, [isNextPageError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = Notifications.subscribe('StopOrderChanged', () =>
      getNextPage({ ...requestData, rowsOffset: ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT * page }),
    );

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleOrderCardBtnClick = (stopOrder: StopOrder, isActive: boolean | null) => {
    const {
      stopOrderDeniedReason,
      quantity,
      productId,
      subAccountId,
      takeProfitConditionPrice,
      offset,
      spread,
      stopLossConditionPrice,
      price,
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      buySell,
      offsetUnits,
      spreadUnits,
    } = stopOrder;

    if (!isActive) {
      if (!stopOrderDeniedReason) return;

      const slugData = STOP_ORDER_DENIED_REASON_HINTS_MAP[stopOrderDeniedReason];

      const text = getHint(hints?.hints, slugData);

      createAlertNotification({ status: 'info', text });

      return;
    }

    dispatch(setActiveTab('stopOrder'));
    quantity && dispatch(setLotSize(quantity));
    productId && dispatch(setProductId(productId));
    subAccountId && dispatch(setSubAccountId(subAccountId));
    takeProfitConditionPrice && dispatch(setTakeProfit(takeProfitConditionPrice));
    offset != undefined &&
      takeProfitConditionPrice &&
      offsetUnits &&
      dispatch(
        setDeviation(getСonvertedOffsetOrSpead(offset, takeProfitConditionPrice, offsetUnits)),
      );
    spread &&
      takeProfitConditionPrice &&
      spreadUnits &&
      dispatch(
        setProtectiveSpread(
          getСonvertedOffsetOrSpead(spread, takeProfitConditionPrice, spreadUnits),
        ),
      );
    stopLossConditionPrice && dispatch(setStopLimit(stopLossConditionPrice));
    price && dispatch(setStopLimitPrice(price));

    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_ORDER, {
        instrument: `${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`,
        direction: buySell === 'B' ? 'buy' : 'sell',
      }),
    );
  };

  if (!stopOrders) return null;

  if (isFetching) {
    return <OrdersSkeleton />;
  }

  if (Object.keys(stopOrders).length === 0) {
    return (
      <NoActiveOrders
        title={
          requestData.productId ? 'Список заявок пуст на выбранном счёте' : 'Список заявок пуст'
        }
        text={'У вас нет условных заявок'}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <FilterScrollProvider onScroll={onScroll} className={styles.filterProvider}>
      <div>
        {Object.keys(stopOrders).map((item, index) => (
          <StopOrderGroup
            key={index}
            date={item}
            stopOrderList={stopOrders[item]}
            orderCardBtnVariant="retry"
            onOrderCardBtnClick={handleOrderCardBtnClick}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      {hasNextPage && <OrderCardSkeleton />}
    </FilterScrollProvider>
  );
};

export default StopOrdersHistory;

import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { getTradeSessionByTradePlaceId } from 'core/tradeSession';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { OrderType } from 'modules/TradeOrder/types';
import { ACTIVE_ORDERS_STATUSES } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/consts';
import { OrderCardVariant } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

import { InstrumentCategoryCode, PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { ParsedOrdersHistory } from 'types/orderHistory';
import { CancelPermissionStateType, OrderHistoryItem, OrderStatus } from 'types/orders';
import {
  OrderStatusCode,
  StopOrderCancelPermissionState,
  StopOrderPermissionState,
} from 'types/stopOrders';

export const getOrderCardVariant = (
  statusCode: string,
  orderType: OrderType = 'limit',
): OrderCardVariant => {
  if (orderType === 'stopOrder') {
    if (statusCode === 'EXECUTED') {
      return 'success';
    }

    if (statusCode === 'ACTIVE' || statusCode === 'ACTIVATED') {
      return 'warning';
    }

    return 'danger';
  }

  if (statusCode === 'Filled') {
    return 'success';
  }
  if (
    statusCode === 'New' ||
    statusCode === 'PartiallyFilled' ||
    statusCode === 'Suspended' ||
    statusCode === 'PendingCancel'
  ) {
    return 'warning';
  }
  return 'danger';
};

export const parseTime = (time: string) => DateTime.fromISO(time).toFormat('HH:mm:ss');

export const parseDate = (date: string) => DateTime.fromISO(date).toFormat('dd MMMM yyyy');

export const getDate = (date: string) => DateTime.fromISO(date).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT);

export const detectLocalTimeZone = () => Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;

export const checkTimeZoneValid = (tz: string): boolean => DateTime.local().setZone(tz).isValid;

export const getDateFromTimestamp = (timestamp: number, format = DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT) => {
  const datetime = DateTime.fromMillis(timestamp);
  const localTz = detectLocalTimeZone();
  const adjustedDt = checkTimeZoneValid(localTz) ? datetime.setZone(localTz) : datetime;
  return adjustedDt.toFormat(format);
};

export const formattedTitle = (side: string, instrumentName?: string, secCode?: string) => {
  return `${side === 'BUY' || side === 'B' ? 'Покупка' : 'Продажа'} ${instrumentName} (${secCode})`;
};

/** Счёт и портфель в атрибутах заявки (productFullName + portfolioFullName). */
export const formatOrderProductPortfolio = (
  productFullName?: string | null,
  portfolioFullName?: string | null,
  isAccountClosed = false,
) => {
  if (isAccountClosed) return productFullName || '';
  return [productFullName, portfolioFullName].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
};

export const formattedCancelTitle = (
  side: string,
  instrumentName?: string,
  instrumentCode?: string,
) => {
  return `${
    side === 'BUY' || side === 'B' ? 'Покупка' : 'Продажа'
  } ${instrumentName} (${instrumentCode})`;
};

export const formattedDateTime = (dateTime: string) =>
  DateTime.fromISO(dateTime).toFormat('dd.MM.yy в HH:mm:ss');

export const formattedCount = (
  cumQty?: number,
  orderQty?: number,
  instrumentCategoryCode?: InstrumentCategoryCode,
  baseCurrencyCode?: PriceCurrencyType,
) => {
  const isCurrency = instrumentCategoryCode === 'CUP' && baseCurrencyCode;
  const isMetal = instrumentCategoryCode === 'MTP';

  const postfix = isCurrency ? currencySign(baseCurrencyCode) : isMetal ? 'гр.' : 'шт.';

  return `${cumQty} из ${orderQty} ${postfix}`;
};

export const formattedVolume = (value: number, currency: string, quantityText?: string) => {
  return `${sumFormatter(value, 2)} ${currency}${quantityText ? ' (' + quantityText + ')' : ''}`;
};

export const getHistoryOrderStatuses = (orderStatuses: OrderStatus[]) => {
  return orderStatuses
    .filter((f) => !ACTIVE_ORDERS_STATUSES.includes(f.statusCode))
    .map((el) => el.statusCode);
};

export const getIsCancelBtnActive = (
  status: OrderStatusCode,
  permissionState?: StopOrderCancelPermissionState,
): boolean | null => {
  if (status !== 'ACTIVE') return null;

  return permissionState === 'GRANTED';
};

export const getIsRetryBtnActive = (
  status: OrderStatusCode,
  permissionState?: StopOrderPermissionState,
) => {
  if (!(status === 'EXECUTED' || status === 'CANCELED')) return null;

  return permissionState !== 'DENIED';
};

export const getIsNewLimitOrder = (status: string) =>
  status === 'New' ||
  status === 'PartiallyFilled' ||
  status === 'Suspended' ||
  status === 'PendingCancel';

export const getIsLimitOrderBtnActive = (
  permissionState: CancelPermissionStateType,
  tradePlaceId: number,
) =>
  getTradeSessionByTradePlaceId(tradePlaceId)?.sessionState === 'ACTIVE' &&
  permissionState === 'GRANTED';

export const parseOrdersHistory = (orderList: OrderHistoryItem[]) => {
  const result: ParsedOrdersHistory = {
    ids: [],
    entities: {},
  };

  const uniqueDates = new Set<string>();

  for (const item of orderList) {
    const date = getDate(item.time);

    uniqueDates.add(date);

    if (date in result.entities) {
      result.entities[date].push(item);
    } else {
      result.entities[date] = [item];
    }
  }

  result.ids = Array.from(uniqueDates);

  return result;
};

import { getDateFromTimestamp } from './formatting';

export const getOrderTypeBottonSheepOptions = (isInstrumentPage = false) => {
  const options = ['Лимитные', 'Условные'];

  //if (!isInstrumentPage) options.push('Размещения');

  return options;
};

export const getInitialDatePickerData = (): DatePickerData => {
  const currentDate = DateTime.now();
  const dateFrom = currentDate.minus({ year: 1 }).toMillis();

  return {
    dateFrom,
    dateTo: currentDate.toMillis(),
  };
};

export const getCardText = ({ dateFrom, dateTo }: DatePickerData, periodOption: PeriodOption) => {
  return periodOption === 'year'
    ? LAST_YEAR_TEXT
    : `${getDateFromTimestamp(dateFrom, 'dd.MM.yy')}-${getDateFromTimestamp(dateTo, 'dd.MM.yy')}`;
};

export const getСonvertedOffsetOrSpead = (
  offsetOrSpead: number,
  takeProfit: number,
  unit: Units,
) => {
  if (unit === 'CUR') return offsetOrSpead;

  return (offsetOrSpead * takeProfit) / 100;
};

export const FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY = 'orderHistoryFilterState';

export type FilterStateType = {
  isHistoryFilterActive: boolean;
};

export const defaultFilterState = {
  isHistoryFilterActive: false,
};

export const getFilterState = () => {
  const state = sessionStorage.getItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY);
  return state ? JSON.parse(state) : defaultFilterState;
};

export const setFilterState = (state: FilterStateType) => {
  sessionStorage.setItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
};

export const clearFilterState = () => sessionStorage.removeItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY);

import {
  FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY,
  clearFilterState,
  defaultFilterState,
  getFilterState,
  setFilterState,
} from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/localCache';

describe('localCache testing', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    sessionStorage.clear();
  });

  test('getFilterState testing with empty localStorage', () => {
    expect(getFilterState()).toBe(defaultFilterState);
  });

  test('getFilterState testing with fulfilled localStorage', () => {
    const testData = {
      isHistoryFilterActive: true,
    };
    sessionStorage.setItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(testData));
    expect(getFilterState()).toEqual(testData);
  });
  test('setFilterState testing', () => {
    const testData = {
      isHistoryFilterActive: true,
    };
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY)).toBeNull();
    setFilterState(testData);
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY)).toEqual(JSON.stringify(testData));
  });
  test('clearFilterState testing', () => {
    const testData = {
      isHistoryFilterActive: true,
    };

    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY)).toBeNull();
    sessionStorage.setItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(testData));
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY)).toEqual(JSON.stringify(testData));
    clearFilterState();
    expect(sessionStorage.getItem(FILTER_STATE_CACHE_KEY)).toBeNull();
  });
});

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useSessionStorage } from 'react-use';

import { Filter, FilterBar, PeriodOption, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { useGetOrderStatusesQuery } from 'core/api/orderHistory';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import styles from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/TradeOrderHistory.module.pcss';
import FilterSkeleton from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/components/FIlterSkeleton/FilterSkeleton';
import {
  FilterStateType,
  getFilterState,
  setFilterState,
} from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/helpers/localCache';
import { TradeOrderHistoryProps } from 'modules/TradeOrderHistory/types';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as StopOrderIcon } from 'images/raw-icons/badge-icon-stop-order.svg';

//import IpoOrderHistory from './components/IpoOrderHistory';
import IpoOrderHistoryPlug from './components/IpoOrderHistory/components/IpoOrderHistoryPlug';
import LimitOrders from './components/LimitOrders';
import OrderHistoryDatePicker from './components/OrderHistoryDatePicker';
import OrderTypesBottomSheet from './components/OrderTypesBottomSheet';
import StopOrders from './components/StopOrders';
import { DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES, LAST_YEAR_TEXT, ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT } from './consts';
import { getDateFromTimestamp, getHistoryOrderStatuses } from './helpers/formatting';
import {
  getCardText,
  getInitialDatePickerData,
  getOrderTypeBottonSheepOptions,
} from './helpers/helpers';

const TradeOrderHistory = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  productId,
  headerProps,
}: TradeOrderHistoryProps) => {
  const Jan01_2010 = new Date('2010-01-01');

  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<FilterStateType>(() => getFilterState());
  const [showOrderTypesBottomSheet, setShowOrderTypesBottomSheet] = useState(false);

  const [showOrderHistoryDatePicker, setShowOrderHistoryDatePicker] = useState(false);

  const [periodOption, setPeriodOption] = useSessionStorage<PeriodOption>('periodOption', 'year');
  const [datePickerData, setDatePickerData] = useSessionStorage(
    'datePickerData',
    getInitialDatePickerData(),
  );
  const [activeOrderType, setActiveOrderType] = useSessionStorage('activeOrderType', 'Лимитные');

  const activeLabel =
    instrumentId && activeOrderType === 'Размещения' ? 'Лимитные' : activeOrderType;

  const cardText = getCardText(datePickerData, periodOption);

  const {
    data: orderStatuses,
    isLoading: isOrderStatusesLoading,
    isError: isOrderStatusesError,
  } = useGetOrderStatusesQuery();

  const [
    getInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery,
    { data: instrumentInfoFlags, isSuccess: isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees },
  ] = useLazyGetInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!(instrumentId && tradePlaceId)) return;

    getInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery({
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      tradePlaceId: String(tradePlaceId),
    });
  }, [getInstrumentInfoFlagsQuery, instrumentId, tradePlaceId]);

  const historyStatuses = useMemo(() => {
    if (isOrderStatusesError) return getHistoryOrderStatuses(DEFAULT_ORDER_STATUSES);
    return orderStatuses ? getHistoryOrderStatuses(orderStatuses.orderStatus) : [];
  }, [orderStatuses, isOrderStatusesError]);

  const requestData = {
    dateFrom: getDateFromTimestamp(datePickerData.dateFrom),
    dateTo: getDateFromTimestamp(datePickerData.dateTo),
    instrumentId,
    tradePlaceId,
    productId,
  };

  const hasStopOrder =
    isInstrumentInfoFlagsSuccees && instrumentInfoFlags?.instrumentInfoFlag[0].stopOrder;

  //const showIpoOrderHistoryPlug = Permissions.blockedOrDenied('PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_IPOTRADE');
  //const isPersonOrderHistoryTradeGranted = Permissions.onlyGranted(
  //  activeLabel === 'Размещения' ? 'PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_IPOTRADE' : 'PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_TRADE',
  //);

  //const isHistoryFilterHidden = activeOrderType === 'Размещения' && showIpoOrderHistoryPlug;

  const isPersonOrderHistoryTradeGranted = Permissions.onlyGranted('PERSON_ORDERSHISTORY_TRADE');
  const options = getOrderTypeBottonSheepOptions(Boolean(instrumentId));

  const grantedProductId =
    productId &&
    Permissions.getObject(
      activeLabel === 'Размещения'
        ? 'PRODUCT_ORDERSHISTORY_IPOTRADE'
        : 'PRODUCT_ORDERSHISTORY_TRADE',
      productId,
    );

  const isPlugShown =
    !isPersonOrderHistoryTradeGranted || (grantedProductId && grantedProductId !== 'GRANTED');

  const handleHistoryFilterClick = () => {
    setFilters({ ...filters, isHistoryFilterActive: !filters.isHistoryFilterActive });
    setFilterState({ ...filters, isHistoryFilterActive: !filters.isHistoryFilterActive });
  };

  const handleOrderTypeClick = (label: string) => {
    setActiveOrderType(label);
  };

  const handleResetDatePickerButtonClick = () => {
    setPeriodOption('year');
    setDatePickerData(getInitialDatePickerData());
  };

  return (
    <>
      {headerProps && <HeaderPage {...headerProps} />}

      {!isOrderStatusesLoading ? (
        <FilterBar className={styles.filterWrapper}>
          <div className={styles.filterWrapper}>
            <Filter
              shape={'select'}
              text={
                <div className={styles.filterLabel}>
                  <Text type="labelSemiBold">{activeLabel}</Text>
                  {hasStopOrder && activeLabel === 'Условные' && <StopOrderIcon />}
                </div>
              }
              onClick={() => setShowOrderTypesBottomSheet(true)}
            />
            <Filter
              shape={'toggle'}
              text={'История'}
              onClick={() => handleHistoryFilterClick()}
              active={filters.isHistoryFilterActive}
            />
            {filters.isHistoryFilterActive && (
              <Filter
                shape="select"
                active={cardText !== LAST_YEAR_TEXT}
                text={cardText}
                onClick={() => setShowOrderHistoryDatePicker(true)}
                onClose={handleResetDatePickerButtonClick}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </FilterBar>
      ) : (
        <FilterSkeleton />
      )}
      {isPlugShown ? (
        <IpoOrderHistoryPlug />
      ) : (
        <>
          {activeLabel === 'Лимитные' && (
            <LimitOrders
              filters={filters}
              requestData={requestData}
              historyStatuses={historyStatuses}
            />
          )}
          {activeLabel === 'Условные' && (
            <StopOrders
              requestData={{
                ...requestData,
                typeList: 'TAKEPROFIT,STOPLIMIT,TAKEPROFIT_STOPLIMIT',
                rowsCount: ORDER_HISTORY_ROWS_COUNT,
              }}
              isHistoryFilterActive={filters.isHistoryFilterActive}
            />
          )}
          {/* {activeLabel === 'Размещения' ? (
            showIpoOrderHistoryPlug ? (
              <IpoOrderHistoryPlug />
            ) : (
              <IpoOrderHistory requestData={requestData} filters={filters} />
            )
          ) : null} */}
        </>
      )}
      <OrderTypesBottomSheet
        open={showOrderTypesBottomSheet}
        onDismiss={() => setShowOrderTypesBottomSheet(false)}
        options={options}
        activeLabel={activeLabel}
        onClick={handleOrderTypeClick}
      />
      <OrderHistoryDatePicker
        isOpen={showOrderHistoryDatePicker}
        datePickerData={datePickerData}
        periodOption={periodOption}
        setPeriodOption={setPeriodOption}
        minDate={Jan01_2010}
        setDatePickerData={setDatePickerData}
        onDismiss={() => setShowOrderHistoryDatePicker(false)}
        onResetDatePickerButtonClick={handleResetDatePickerButtonClick}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default TradeOrderHistory;

  change: {

    text: 'Теперь вы не можете подавать торговые поручения в личном кабинете и мобильном приложении',
  },
};

const Success = () => {

    ? operationSuccessStatuses[operationType]

        indent

        actionButtonText={actionButtonText}

};

import React from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import { ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG, ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_SUCCESS } from 'const/routes';
import { RTK_TAG_TRADE_PASSWORD } from 'const/rtkTags';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { tradePasswordApi } from 'core/api/tradePassword';

import { isOTPConfirmErrorType, isRetriableOTPConfirmError } from 'utils/oneTimePassword';

import { useAppDispatch } from 'hooks';

import { SmsConfirmation } from 'components';

import { useSetTradingPassword } from '../../hooks/useSetTradingPassword';

const TradePasswordConfirmation = () => {
  const { data, isUninitialized, isSuccess } = useSetTradingPassword()[2];
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { operationType } = useParams();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();

  if (!data?.otpChallenge || isUninitialized || !isSuccess) {
    navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
  }

  const handleSuccess = () => {
    dispatch(tradePasswordApi.util.invalidateTags([RTK_TAG_TRADE_PASSWORD])); //update tradePassword after mutation
    if (operationType) {
      navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_SUCCESS, { operationType }));
    } else {
      navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_SUCCESS, { operationType: 'delete' }));
    }
  };

  const handleError = (error: unknown) => {
    if (isOTPConfirmErrorType(error) && !isRetriableOTPConfirmError(error)) {
      navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {!isMobile && (
        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <Text type={'bodyMedium'}>SMS-подтверждение</Text>
        </div>
      )}
      <SmsConfirmation
        initialOTPChallenge={data?.otpChallenge}
        smsInputCount={4}
        onSuccess={handleSuccess}
        onError={handleError}
        loaderChildren={
          <Text>
            {operationType === 'create' || operationType === 'change'
              ? 'Выполняется сохранение торгового пароля...'
              : 'Выполняется удаление торгового пароля...'}
          </Text>
        }
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default TradePasswordConfirmation;

import React, { FC, useEffect } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG, ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { TradePasswordDeleteProps } from 'modules/TradePasswordPage/types';

import HeaderPage from 'components/HeaderPage';

import { useSetTradingPassword } from '../../hooks/useSetTradingPassword';
import styles from './TradePasswordDelete.module.pcss';

const TradePasswordDelete: FC<TradePasswordDeleteProps> = ({
  setIsOpenTradePasswordConfirmation,
}) => {
  const tradingPasswordSetup = useSetTradingPassword()[0];

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleDeleteTradePassword = async () => {
      try {
        await tradingPasswordSetup();
        isMobile &&
          navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION, { operationType: 'delete' }), {
            replace: true,
          });
        setIsOpenTradePasswordConfirmation && setIsOpenTradePasswordConfirmation(true);
      } catch (e) {
        navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
      }
    };
    handleDeleteTradePassword();
  }, [isMobile, navigate, setIsOpenTradePasswordConfirmation, tradingPasswordSetup]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.loaderContainer}>
      <>
        {isMobile && (
          <HeaderPage
            title={'СМС-подтверждение'}
            leftIconVariant="back"
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
            documentTitle={'Торговый пароль'}
          />
        )}

        <div className={styles.loaderContainer}>
          <CircleLoader brandColor />
        </div>
      </>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TradePasswordDelete;

import React, { ChangeEvent, useState } from 'react';

import { IInputProps, Input } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { ReactComponent as CrossedEyeSvg } from 'images/icons/crossed-eye.svg';
import { ReactComponent as EyeSvg } from 'images/icons/eye.svg';

import styles from './TradePasswordForm.module.pcss';

type InputTradingPasswordProps = IInputProps & {
  value: string;
  onChange: (ev: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
};

const InputTradePassword: React.FC<InputTradingPasswordProps> = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  description,
  ...props
}) => {
  const [showPass, setShowPass] = useState(false);

    ev.stopPropagation();
    setShowPass((prev) => !prev);
  };

  return (
    <Input
      {...props}
      type={'text'}
      pattern={'[0-9]*'}
      inputMode={'numeric'}
      name={'search_foo_89238759'}
      autoComplete={'off'}

      value={value}
      classNameInput={cx(styles.bgContent, !showPass && styles.textSecurityStars)}
      addonAfter={
        <div style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={toggleShowPass}>
          {showPass ? <CrossedEyeSvg /> : <EyeSvg />}
        </div>
      }
      description={description}
      onChange={onChange}
      disabled={props.disabled}
      className={styles.input}
    />
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Navigate, generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG, ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetSessionTradeSignStateQuery } from 'core/api/tradePassword';
import { tabWithEnter } from 'core/helpers/tabWithEnter';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { TradePasswordConfirmation } from 'modules/TradePasswordPage/index';

import { AdaptivePopup, HeaderPage } from 'components';

import {
  TRADE_PASSWORD_PERMISSION_FIELD,
  TRADING_PASSWORD_DESCRIPTION,
  TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH,
  TRADING_PASSWORD_REGEX,
} from '../../consts';
import { useSetTradingPassword } from '../../hooks/useSetTradingPassword';
import { OperationTypes, TradingPasswordStatus } from '../../types';
import NotAllowedPlug from '../NotAllowedPlug/NotAllowedPlug';
import InputTradePassword from './InputTradePassword';
import styles from './TradePasswordForm.module.pcss';

const tradingPasswordStatuses: Record<string, TradingPasswordStatus> = {
  empty: {
    description: TRADING_PASSWORD_DESCRIPTION,
    valid: false,
  },
  correct: {
    description: TRADING_PASSWORD_DESCRIPTION,
    valid: true,
  },
  incorrectLength: {
    description: TRADING_PASSWORD_DESCRIPTION,
    status: 'warning',
    valid: false,
  },
};

const tradingConfirmPasswordStatuses: Record<string, TradingPasswordStatus> = {
  empty: {
    description: '',
    valid: false,
  },
  correct: {
    description: '',
    valid: true,
  },
  passwordsDoNotMatch: {
    status: 'error',
    description: 'Пароли не совпадают',
    valid: false,
  },
};

const tradingPasswordPageTitles: Partial<Record<OperationTypes | string, string>> = {
  create: 'Создание торгового пароля',
  change: 'Изменение торгового пароля',
};

const TradingPasswordForm = () => {
  const { operationType } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { isError: iSessionTradeSignStateError } = useGetSessionTradeSignStateQuery();

  const tradePasswordPermission = Permissions.get(TRADE_PASSWORD_PERMISSION_FIELD);

  const [tradingPasswordSetup, setTradingPasswordResult, setTradingPasswordConfirmationResult] =
    useSetTradingPassword();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [tradingPasswordStatus, setTradingPasswordStatus] = useState<TradingPasswordStatus>(
    tradingPasswordStatuses['empty'],
  );
  const [tradingConfirmPasswordStatus, setTradingConfirmPasswordStatus] =
    useState<TradingPasswordStatus>(tradingConfirmPasswordStatuses['empty']);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const title = operationType && tradingPasswordPageTitles[operationType];

  const isNotAllowed =
    tradePasswordPermission === 'DENIED' || tradePasswordPermission === 'BLOCKED';

  const handlePasswordChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (
      !TRADING_PASSWORD_REGEX.test(event.target.value) &&
      event.target.value.length <= TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH
    ) {
      setPassword(event.target.value);
      if (event.target.value.length === TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
        setTradingPasswordStatus(tradingPasswordStatuses['correct']);
      }
      if (event.target.value.length < TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
        setTradingPasswordStatus(tradingPasswordStatuses['empty']);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmPasswordChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (
      !TRADING_PASSWORD_REGEX.test(event.target.value) &&
      event.target.value.length <= TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH
    ) {
      setConfirmPassword(event.target.value);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmButton = async () => {
    try {
      await tradingPasswordSetup(password);
      isMobile && navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_TRADE_PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION, { operationType }));
      setIsOpen(true);
    } catch (e) {
      navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
    }
  };

  const handleBackClick = () => navigate(-1);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (confirmPassword.length >= TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH && password === confirmPassword) {
      setTradingConfirmPasswordStatus(tradingConfirmPasswordStatuses['correct']);
    }
    if (confirmPassword.length < TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH || password.length === 0) {
      setTradingConfirmPasswordStatus(tradingConfirmPasswordStatuses['empty']);
    }
    if (
      password.length !== 0 &&
      confirmPassword.length >= TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH &&
      password !== confirmPassword
    ) {
      setTradingConfirmPasswordStatus(tradingConfirmPasswordStatuses['passwordsDoNotMatch']);
    }
  }, [password, confirmPassword]);

  if (
    iSessionTradeSignStateError ||
    !(operationType === 'create' || operationType === 'change' || operationType === 'delete')
  ) {
    return <Navigate to={ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG} />;
  }

  if (isNotAllowed) return <NotAllowedPlug />;

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrap : styles.wrapDesktop}>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        documentTitle={'Торговый пароль'}
      />
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.main : styles.mainDesktop}>
        {isMobile ? <Text type={'title'}>{title}</Text> : <Headline title={title} indent={false} />}
        <div className={isMobile ? styles.form : styles.formDesktop}>
          <InputTradePassword
            value={password}
            onChange={handlePasswordChange}
            description={tradingPasswordStatus?.description}
            status={tradingPasswordStatus?.status}
            placeholder={'Введите пароль'}
            onKeyDown={tabWithEnter}
          />
          <InputTradePassword
            value={confirmPassword}
            onChange={handleConfirmPasswordChange}
            label={'Подтверждение пароля'}
            description={tradingConfirmPasswordStatus?.description}
            status={tradingConfirmPasswordStatus?.status}
            placeholder={'Повторите пароль'}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.footer : styles.footerDesktop}>
        <span className={styles.overlineText}>
          Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
        </span>
        <Button
          onClick={handleConfirmButton}
          disabled={!(tradingPasswordStatus.valid && tradingConfirmPasswordStatus.valid)}
          loading={
            setTradingPasswordResult.isLoading || setTradingPasswordConfirmationResult.isLoading
          }
          className={cx({ [styles.btn]: !isMobile })}
        >
          Подтвердить
        </Button>
      </div>

      <AdaptivePopup open={isOpen} onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}>
        <TradePasswordConfirmation />
      </AdaptivePopup>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TradingPasswordForm;

export const TRADING_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 4;

--- FILE: src\modules\TradePasswordPage\hooks\useSetTradingPassword.tsx ---

import { useCallback } from 'react';

import { sha256 } from 'utils/crypto';

import {
  useSetTradingPasswordConfirmationMutation,
  useSetTradingPasswordMutation,
} from 'core/api/tradePassword';

export const useSetTradingPassword = () => {
  const [setTradingPassword, setTradingPasswordResult] = useSetTradingPasswordMutation();
  const [setTradingPasswordConfirmation, setTradingPasswordConfirmationResult] =
    useSetTradingPasswordConfirmationMutation({
      fixedCacheKey: 'shared-trading-password-confirmation',
    });

  const tradingPasswordSetup = async (password?: string) => {
    const { publicKey } = await setTradingPassword().unwrap();

    if (password) {
      const passwordHash = await sha256(password + publicKey.toUpperCase());

      return setTradingPasswordConfirmation({ hash: passwordHash }).unwrap();
    }
    return setTradingPasswordConfirmation({}).unwrap();
  };

  return [
    useCallback(tradingPasswordSetup, [setTradingPassword, setTradingPasswordConfirmation]),
    setTradingPasswordResult,
    setTradingPasswordConfirmationResult,
  ] as const;

import { Dispatch } from 'react';

import { BaseQueryFn, QueryDefinition } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query';
// eslint-disable-next-line import/no-unresolved
import { LazyQueryTrigger } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query/react/buildHooks';
import {
  ErrorCallback,
  HistoryCallback,
  HistoryMetadata,
  IDatafeedChartApi,
  LibrarySymbolInfo,
  OnReadyCallback,
  PeriodParams,
  ResolutionString,
  ResolveCallback,
} from 'charting_library/charting_library';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { QuotesHistoryRequest, QuotesHistoryResponse } from 'types/tradingView';

import { tradingViewHasQuotesAction } from './actions';
import {
  DEFAULT_TIMEZONE,
  LUXON_FULL_DATE_FORMAT,
  LUXON_FULL_DATE_FORMAT_WITH_TIME,
  supportedResolutions,
} from './constants';
import { getIntervalName, getIsDWM, getTimeForChart } from './helpers';
import { Action } from './types';

const config = {
  supported_resolutions: supportedResolutions,
};

export type DatefeedParams = {
  minDate: string;
  instrumentId: string;
  tradePlaceId: string;
  tradePlaceCode: string;
  instrumentName: string;
  priceStep: number;
  getQuotesHistory: LazyQueryTrigger<
    QueryDefinition<
      QuotesHistoryRequest,
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      BaseQueryFn<any, unknown, unknown, Record<string, unknown>, Record<string, unknown>>,
      never,
      QuotesHistoryResponse,
      'quotesHistoryApi'
    >
  >;
  dispatch: Dispatch<Action>;
};

class Datafeed implements IDatafeedChartApi {
  _params: DatefeedParams;

  constructor(params: DatefeedParams) {
    this._params = params;
  }

  onReady(cb: OnReadyCallback) {
    // https://github.com/tradingview/charting_library/wiki/JS-Api#onreadycallback
    setTimeout(() => cb(config), 0);
  }

  searchSymbols() {
    console.warn('Not implemented');
  }

  resolveSymbol(symbolName: string, onResolve: ResolveCallback) {
    let minmov = 1;
    let pricescale = 1;
    const { priceStep, instrumentName, tradePlaceCode } = this._params;
    if (priceStep >= 1) {
      minmov = priceStep;
    } else {
      const right = priceStep.toString().split('.')[1];
      pricescale = Math.pow(10, right.length);
      minmov = priceStep * pricescale;
    }

    const symbol_stub: LibrarySymbolInfo = {
      name: symbolName,
      full_name: instrumentName,
      description: instrumentName,
      type: 'stock',
      session: '24x7',
      exchange: tradePlaceCode,
      listed_exchange: tradePlaceCode,
      timezone: DEFAULT_TIMEZONE,
      format: 'price',
      pricescale,
      minmov,
      has_intraday: true,
      has_daily: true,
      has_weekly_and_monthly: true,
      intraday_multipliers: ['1', '5', '15', '30', '60'],
      supported_resolutions: supportedResolutions,
      volume_precision: 8,
      data_status: 'streaming',
      currency_code: 'RUB',
    };

    setTimeout(() => {
      onResolve(symbol_stub);
    }, 0);
  }

  async getBars(
    symbolInfo: LibrarySymbolInfo,
    resolution: ResolutionString,
    periodParams: PeriodParams,
    onResult: HistoryCallback,
    onError: ErrorCallback,
  ) {
    const { to, firstDataRequest, countBack } = periodParams;
    const stepType = getIntervalName(resolution);
    const isDWM = getIsDWM(stepType);
    const stepValue = resolution === '60' ? '1' : String(Number.parseInt(resolution));
    const subscribe = firstDataRequest && !isDWM;
    const dateFormat = isDWM ? LUXON_FULL_DATE_FORMAT : LUXON_FULL_DATE_FORMAT_WITH_TIME;
    const endDate = firstDataRequest ? undefined : DateTime.fromSeconds(to).toFormat(dateFormat);

    try {
      const { data } = await this._params.getQuotesHistory({
        instrument_id: this._params.instrumentId,
        trade_place_id: this._params.tradePlaceId,
        count: countBack,
        subscribe,
        step_type: stepType,
        step_value: stepValue,
        finish_date: endDate,
      });

      if (!data) throw Error;

      firstDataRequest &&
        this._params.dispatch(tradingViewHasQuotesAction(Boolean(data.quotes.length)));

      const bars = data.quotes.map(
        ({
          minPrice: low,
          maxPrice: high,
          openPrice: open,
          closePrice: close,
          volume,
          intervalStartTime: startTime,
          intervalFinishTime: finishTime,
        }) => {
          const time = getTimeForChart(startTime, finishTime, isDWM);

          return {
            low,
            high,
            open,
            close,
            volume,
            time,
          };
        },
      );

      let meta: HistoryMetadata | undefined;

      if (!data.quotes?.length) {
        meta = { noData: true };
      }

      onResult(bars, meta);
    } catch (error) {
      onError(error as unknown as string);
    }
  }

  subscribeBars() {
    // onTick: SubscribeBarsCallback, // resolution: ResolutionString, // symbolInfo: LibrarySymbolInfo,
    // this._unsubscribeCandlestickChanged = Notifications.subscribe(
    //   'CandlestickChanged',
    //   (data: unknown) => {
    //     this._onCandlestickChanged(onTick, data);
    //   },
    // );
  }

  unsubscribeBars() {
    // if (this._unsubscribeCandlestickChanged) {
    //   this._unsubscribeCandlestickChanged();
    // }
    // ApiInstruments.unsubscribeCandleStick(this._subscriptionGuid).catch((error) =>
    //   Debug.log('[TradingView] unsubscribeBars', error.message),
    // );
  }

  // _onCandlestickChanged(cb: (bar: Bar) => void, data: any) {
  // const { CandlestickData: candlestickData, SubscriptionGUID: subscriptionGUID } =
  //   data?.response.InstrumentCandlestickQuoteList[0];
  // if (this._subscriptionGuid !== subscriptionGUID) return;
  // const {
  //   Volume: volume,
  //   OpenPrice: open,
  //   ClosePrice: close,
  //   MinPrice: low,
  //   MaxPrice: high,
  //   IntervalStartTime: startTime,
  //   IntervalFinishTime: finishTime,
  // } = candlestickData[0];
  // const time = getTimeForChart(startTime, finishTime, this._isDWM);
  // const result = { low, high, open, close, volume, time };
  // //TradingView requires bar time in ms
  // cb(result);
  // }
}
export default Datafeed;

import { ChartingLibraryWidgetOptions, ResolutionString } from 'charting_library/charting_library';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import Datafeed from 'modules/TradingView/Datafeed';

import { UserSettingResponse } from 'types/userSetting';

import { DEFAULT_TIMEZONE, LIBRARY_PATH } from './constants';
import { FeatureKeys, Features, WidgetOptionsParamsType } from './types';

export const getIntervalName = (resolution: ResolutionString) => {
  switch (resolution) {
    case '1':
    case '3':
    case '5':
    case '15':
    case '30':
    case '45':
      return 'minute';
    case '60':
      return 'hour';
    case 'D':
    case '1D':
      return 'day';
    case 'W':
    case '1W':
      return 'week';
    case 'M':
    case '1M':
      return 'month';
    default:
      return 'month';
  }
};

export const getIsDWM = (stepType: string): boolean => {
  return stepType === 'day' || stepType === 'week' || stepType === 'month';
};

export const prepareChartFeatures = (features: Features) => {
  return Object.entries(features).reduce(
    (acc, [key, value]) => {
      if (value) {
        acc.enabled_features.push(key);
      } else {
        acc.disabled_features.push(key);
      }

      return acc;
    },
    {
      enabled_features: [] as string[],
      disabled_features: [] as string[],
    },
  ) as { enabled_features: FeatureKeys[]; disabled_features: FeatureKeys[] };
};

export const getWidgetOptions = ({
  minDate,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  tradePlaceCode,
  priceStep,
  instrumentName,
  containerId,
  features,
  width = '100%',
  height,
  autosize = false,
  fullscreen = false,
  interval = '5' as ResolutionString,
  timeframe,
  getQuotesHistory,
  dispatch,
}: WidgetOptionsParamsType): ChartingLibraryWidgetOptions => {
  return {
    datafeed: new Datafeed({
      minDate,
      instrumentId,
      tradePlaceId,
      instrumentName,
      tradePlaceCode,
      priceStep,
      getQuotesHistory,
      dispatch,
    }),
    interval,
    fullscreen,
    autosize,
    width: width as unknown as number,
    height,
    symbol: instrumentName,
    timezone: DEFAULT_TIMEZONE,
    library_path: LIBRARY_PATH,
    locale: 'ru',
    timeframe,
    debug: false,
    time_frames: [
      {
        text: '1d',
        resolution: '5' as ResolutionString,
        description: '1 день',
      },
      {
        text: '7d',
        resolution: '60' as ResolutionString,
        description: '7 дней',
      },
      {
        text: '1m',
        resolution: '1D' as ResolutionString,
        description: '1 Месяц',
      },
      {
        text: '3m',
        resolution: '1D' as ResolutionString,
        description: '3 Месяца',
      },
      {
        text: '6m',
        resolution: '1W' as ResolutionString,
        description: '6 Месяцев',
      },
      {
        text: '1y',
        resolution: '1W' as ResolutionString,
        description: '1 Год',
        title: '1г',
      },
      {
        text: '10y',
        resolution: '1M' as ResolutionString,
        description: 'Все время',
        title: 'Все время',
      },
    ],
    container: containerId,
    ...features,
  };
};

export const getFormattedDataForMiniChartHeader = (
  time: number,
  resolution: ResolutionString,
): { date: string; time?: string } => {
  const date = DateTime.fromSeconds(time).toFormat('dd.LL.yy');

  const introDay = Boolean(
    !(resolution.includes('W') || resolution.includes('M') || resolution.includes('D')),
  );

  if (introDay) {
    const startTime = DateTime.fromSeconds(time).toFormat('HH:mm');
    const finishTime = DateTime.fromSeconds(time + Number.parseInt(resolution) * 60).toFormat(
      'HH:mm',
    );

    return { date, time: resolution === '1' ? `${startTime}` : `${startTime} - ${finishTime}` };
  }

  if (resolution.includes('W') || resolution.includes('M')) {
    const period = resolution.includes('W') ? 'week' : 'month';
    const finishDate = DateTime.fromSeconds(time).endOf(period).toFormat('dd.LL.yy');

    return { date: `${date} - ${finishDate}` };
  }

  return { date };
};

export const getTimeForChart = (startTime: string, finishTime: string, isDWM = false): number => {
  const time = isDWM
    ? DateTime.fromISO(finishTime).toUTC().startOf('day')
    : DateTime.fromISO(startTime).plus({ seconds: 1 });

  return time.valueOf();
};

export const getUserResolution = (data: UserSettingResponse) => {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(data.userSetting[0].value)[0] as ResolutionString;
  } catch (error) {
    return '5' as ResolutionString;
  }
};

import { FC } from 'react';

import { ResolutionString } from 'charting_library/charting_library';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

interface Props {
  resolution: ResolutionString;
  activeResolution: ResolutionString;
  onClick: (text: ResolutionString) => void;
}

const ResolutionBtn: FC<Props> = ({ activeResolution, resolution, onClick }) => {
  const className = resolution === activeResolution ? styles.active : styles.btn;
  let resolutionText = `${resolution}M`;

  if (resolution === '60') resolutionText = '1Ч';
  if (resolution.indexOf('D') + 1) resolutionText = 'Д';
  if (resolution.indexOf('W') + 1) resolutionText = 'Н';
  if (resolution.indexOf('M') + 1) resolutionText = 'Мес';

  const handleClick = () => {
    onClick(resolution);
  };

  return (
    <button className={className} onClick={handleClick}>
      {resolutionText}
    </button>
  );
};

export default ResolutionBtn;

import { FC } from 'react';

import { ResolutionString } from 'charting_library/charting_library';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { supportedResolutions } from 'modules/TradingView/constants';
import { ChartIconsForMiniChartType } from 'modules/TradingView/types';

import { ReactComponent as BarSvg } from 'images/icons/chart/bar.svg';
import { ReactComponent as LineSvg } from 'images/icons/chart/line.svg';

import ResolutionBtn from './components/ResolutionBtn';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

interface Props {
  activeResolution: ResolutionString;
  activeChartType: number;
  className?: string;
  onIntervalBtnClick: (text: ResolutionString) => void;
  onChartBtnClick: (id: number) => void;
}

const MobileChartPageFooter: FC<Props> = ({
  activeResolution,
  activeChartType,
  className,
  onIntervalBtnClick,
  onChartBtnClick,
}) => {
  const CHART_ICONS_FOR_MINI_CHART: ChartIconsForMiniChartType[] = [
    { id: 1, icon: BarSvg },
    { id: 3, icon: LineSvg },
  ];

  return (
    <div className={cn(styles.footer, className)}>
      <div className={styles.btns}>
        {supportedResolutions.map((resolution) => (
          <ResolutionBtn
            key={resolution}
            resolution={resolution}
            activeResolution={activeResolution}
            onClick={onIntervalBtnClick}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.icons}>
        {CHART_ICONS_FOR_MINI_CHART.map((item) => (
          <button key={item.id} className={styles.btn} onClick={() => onChartBtnClick(item.id)}>
            <item.icon fill={activeChartType === item.id ? '#3AB6EC' : undefined} />
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>

import { FC, memo } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ResolutionString } from 'charting_library/charting_library';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { getFormattedDataForMiniChartHeader } from 'modules/TradingView/helpers';
import { BarDataType, QuotesPriceChange } from 'modules/TradingView/types';

import { FormattedBalance } from 'components';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  currentQuotePriceChange?: QuotesPriceChange;
  barData: BarDataType;
  resolution: ResolutionString;
  precision: number;
};

const BarInfo: FC<Props> = ({
  barData: { time, open, high, low, close },
  currentQuotePriceChange,
  resolution,
  precision,
}) => {
  const { date, time: t1 } = getFormattedDataForMiniChartHeader(time, resolution);

  return (
    <div className={styles.barInfo}>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <div className={styles.date}>
          <Text type="labelRegular">{date}</Text>
          {t1 && (
            <Text className={styles.time} type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
              {t1}
            </Text>
          )}
        </div>
        {currentQuotePriceChange?.priceChange ? (
          <div className={styles.balance}>
            <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2" tag="span">
              Измен.
            </Text>
            <FormattedBalance
              value={currentQuotePriceChange.priceChange}
              currency={currentQuotePriceChange.volumeCurrency}
              diff={currentQuotePriceChange.priceChangePcnt}
              precision={precision}
            />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <></>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="labelRegular">
            Открыт.
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" tag="span">
            {` ${sumFormatter(open, null)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text color="colorForeground2" tag="span" type="labelRegular">
            Макс.
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" tag="span">
            {` ${sumFormatter(high, null)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text color="colorForeground2" type="labelRegular" tag="span">
            Закрыт.
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" tag="span">
            {` ${sumFormatter(close, null)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.item}>
          <Text color="colorForeground2" type="labelRegular" tag="span">
            Мин.
          </Text>
          <Text type="labelRegular" tag="span">
            {` ${sumFormatter(low, null)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`}{' '}
          </Text>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(BarInfo);
