import React, { FC, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { useGetUserSettingQuery, useUpdateUserSettingMutation } from 'core/api/userSettings';

import { InstrumentInfoResponse } from 'types/instruments';

import { ResolutionString } from '../../../charting_library/charting_library';
import { useLazyGetQuotesHistoryQuery } from '../../../core/api/tradingView';
import { getUserResolution } from '../helpers';
import { BarDataType, QuotesPriceChange } from '../types';
import MobileTVChart from './MobileTVChart';
import MobileChartPageFooter from './components/MobileChartPageFooter';
import MobileChartPageHeader from './components/MobileChartPageHeader';

type Props = {
  instrumentId: string;
  tradePlaceId: string;

  instrumentData: InstrumentInfoResponse;
};

const MiniChartPage: FC<Props> = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,

  instrumentData: { instrument, trading = [] },
}) => {
  const { data } = useGetUserSettingQuery({ name: 'USER_SETTING_RESOLUTION' });
  const [setSettings] = useUpdateUserSettingMutation();
  const [getQuotesHistory, { data: quotesData, isSuccess, isError }] =
    useLazyGetQuotesHistoryQuery();
  const [chartType, setChartType] = useState(1);
  const [barData, setBarData] = useState<BarDataType | null>(null);
  const [currentQuouteTime, setCurrentQuouteTime] = useState(0);
  const [currentQuotePriceChange, setCurrentQuotePriceChange] = useState<QuotesPriceChange>();
  const [resolution, setResolution] = useState('5' as ResolutionString);
  const { lastPrice, priceDiffCurr, priceDiffPcnt, tradePlaceCode, instrumentName, priceCurrency } =
    instrument[0];

  const { priceStep, quotesDateFrom, tradeAvailability } = trading[0] || {};

  useEffect(() => {
    const currentQuote = quotesData?.quotes?.find((item) => {
      const currentTime = DateTime.fromISO(item.intervalStartTime).valueOf();

      return currentTime / 1000 === currentQuouteTime;
    });

    if (currentQuote)
      setCurrentQuotePriceChange({
        priceChange: currentQuote.priceChange,
        priceChangePcnt: currentQuote.priceChangePcnt,
        volumeCurrency: currentQuote.volumeCurrency,
      });
  }, [currentQuouteTime, quotesData?.quotes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data) setResolution(getUserResolution(data));
  }, [data]);

  const handleMiniChartResolutionChanged = (resolution: ResolutionString) => {
    setResolution(resolution);
    setSettings({ name: 'USER_SETTING_RESOLUTION', value: JSON.stringify([resolution]) });
  };

  const handleChartBtnClick = (id: number) => {
    setChartType(id);
  };

  const handleBarDataChange = (data: BarDataType) => {
    setBarData(data);
    setCurrentQuouteTime(data.time);
  };

  const handleChartClick = (status: boolean) => {
    if (status) setBarData(null);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <MobileChartPageHeader
        priceCurrency={priceCurrency}
        lastPrice={lastPrice}
        priceDiffCurr={priceDiffCurr}
        priceDiffPcnt={priceDiffPcnt}
        barData={barData}
        resolution={resolution}
        currentQuotePriceChange={currentQuotePriceChange}
        precision={priceStep?.toString().match(/\.(\d+)/)?.[1].length || 2}
      />
      <MobileTVChart
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        chartType={chartType}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        resolution={resolution}
        onBarDataChange={handleBarDataChange}
        onChartClick={handleChartClick}
        getQuotesHistory={getQuotesHistory}
        dateFrom={quotesDateFrom}
        instrumentName={instrumentName}
        priceStep={priceStep}
        tradePlaceCode={tradePlaceCode}
        tradeAvailability={tradeAvailability}
        hasError={isError}
      />
      {tradeAvailability && isSuccess && (
        <MobileChartPageFooter
          activeResolution={resolution}
          activeChartType={chartType}
          onChartBtnClick={handleChartBtnClick}
          onIntervalBtnClick={handleMiniChartResolutionChanged}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default MiniChartPage;

/* eslint-disable import/no-unresolved */
import React, { memo, useMemo, useReducer } from 'react';

import { QueryDefinition } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query';
import { BaseQueryApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query/baseQueryTypes';
import { LazyQueryTrigger } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query/react/buildHooks';

import { QuotesHistoryRequest, QuotesHistoryResponse } from 'types/tradingView';

import { ResolutionString } from '../../../charting_library/charting_library';
import TradingView from '../TradingView';
import { miniMobileFeatures } from '../constants';
import { getWidgetOptions, prepareChartFeatures } from '../helpers';
import reducer, { initialState } from '../reducer';
import { BarDataType } from '../types';
import PlugForMobile from './components/PlugForMobile';

type Props = {
  instrumentId: string;
  tradePlaceId: string;
  chartType?: number;
  resolution: ResolutionString;
  className?: string;
  dateFrom: string | null;
  instrumentName: string;
  priceStep: number | null;
  tradePlaceCode: string;
  tradeAvailability: boolean;
  onBarDataChange?: (data: BarDataType) => void;
  onChartClick?: (status: boolean) => void;
  getQuotesHistory: LazyQueryTrigger<
    QueryDefinition<
      QuotesHistoryRequest,
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      (args: any, api: BaseQueryApi, extraOptions: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<any>,
      never,
      QuotesHistoryResponse,
      'quotesHistoryApi'
    >
  >;
  hasError: boolean;
};

const MobileTVChart: React.FC<Props> = ({
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  chartType,
  resolution,
  className,
  dateFrom,
  instrumentName,
  priceStep,
  tradePlaceCode,
  tradeAvailability,
  onBarDataChange,
  onChartClick,
  getQuotesHistory,
  hasError,
}) => {
  const [{ hasQuotes }, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initialState);

  const options = useMemo(() => {
    return instrumentId && tradePlaceId && dateFrom && priceStep
      ? getWidgetOptions({
          instrumentId,
          tradePlaceId,
          minDate: dateFrom,
          instrumentName,
          priceStep,
          tradePlaceCode,
          features: prepareChartFeatures(miniMobileFeatures),
          height: 400,
          containerId: 'tv-chart',
          interval: resolution,
          getQuotesHistory,
          dispatch,
        })
      : null;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [instrumentId, tradePlaceId, dateFrom, priceStep, instrumentName, tradePlaceCode]);

  if (!tradeAvailability)
    return <PlugForMobile className={className} text="Не торгуется на бирже" />;

  if (hasError) return <PlugForMobile className={className} text="Не удалось загрузить данные" />;

  if (!hasQuotes)
    return (
      <PlugForMobile className={className} text="Недостаточно данных для построения графика" />
    );

  if (options) {
    return (
      <TradingView
        chartType={chartType}
        options={options}
        resolution={resolution}
        onBarDataChange={onBarDataChange}
        onChartClick={onChartClick}
      />
    );
  }

  return null;
};

export default memo(MobileTVChart);

import { TRADING_VIEW_HAS_QUOTES_ACTION } from './actions';
import { Action, State } from './types';

export const initialState: State = {
  hasQuotes: true,
};

const reducer = (state: State = initialState, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case TRADING_VIEW_HAS_QUOTES_ACTION:
      return { ...state, hasQuotes: action.payload };

    default:
      return state;
  }
};

export default reducer;

import React, { memo, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

import {
  ChartingLibraryWidgetOptions,
  IChartWidgetApi,
  ResolutionString,
  widget as TVWidget,
} from 'charting_library/charting_library';

import { BarDataType } from './types';

type TradingViewProps = {
  options: ChartingLibraryWidgetOptions;
  children?: undefined;
  resolution: ResolutionString;
  chartType?: number;
  onBarDataChange?: (data: BarDataType) => void;
  onChartClick?: (status: boolean) => void;
};

const TradingView: React.FC<TradingViewProps> = ({
  options,
  resolution,
  chartType,
  onBarDataChange,
  onChartClick,
}) => {
  const errorRef = useRef<unknown>();
  const chartRef = useRef<IChartWidgetApi | null>(null);
  const timer = useRef(1);
  const mountedRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const resolutionRef = useRef(resolution);
  const chartTypeRef = useRef(chartType);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mountedRef.current) {
      mountedRef.current = true;
      return;
    }

    const prevResolution = resolutionRef.current;

    if (typeof prevResolution !== typeof resolution) {
      console.error();
    }

    const chart = chartRef.current;

    if (!chart || !resolution) {
      return;
    }

    chart.setResolution(resolution);
  }, [resolution]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mountedRef.current) {
      mountedRef.current = true;
      return;
    }

    const prevChartType = chartTypeRef.current;

    if (typeof prevChartType !== typeof chartType) {
      console.warn('ошибка'); // TODO:
    }

    const chart = chartRef.current;

    if (!chart || !chartType) {
      return;
    }

    chart.setChartType(chartType);
  }, [chartType]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const widget = new TVWidget(options);
    let timeout: NodeJS.Timeout;

    widget.onChartReady(async () => {
      const chart = widget.chart();
      chartRef.current = chart;

      errorRef.current = null;
      try {
        await chart.exportData({ includeTime: false, includeSeries: false, includedStudies: [] });
      } catch (error) {
        errorRef.current = error;
      }

      chart.onIntervalChanged();
      // .subscribe(null, (interval) =>
      // UserSettingActions.setSettings('USER_SETTING_RESOLUTION', JSON.stringify([interval])),
      // );

      if (onBarDataChange && onChartClick) {
        chart.setChartType(1);
        chart.setZoomEnabled(false);

        chart.crossHairMoved().subscribe(null, async ({ time }) => {
          const { data } = await chart.exportData({
            from: time,
            to: time,
            includeSeries: true,
          });

          const [_, open, high, low, close] = Array.from(data[0]);

          onBarDataChange({ time, open, high, low, close });
        });

        // eslint-disable-next-line promise/catch-or-return
        chart.exportData().then(({ data }) => {
          const shortQuotes = data.slice(-40).map((item) => item[0]);

          const from = shortQuotes[0];
          const to = shortQuotes[shortQuotes.length - 1];

          chart.setVisibleRange({ from, to }, { applyDefaultRightMargin: false });
        });

        widget.subscribe('mouse_down', () => {
          timeout = setInterval(() => {
            timer.current -= 1;

            if (!timer.current) clearInterval(timeout);
          }, 100);
        });

        widget.subscribe('mouse_up', () => {
          if (timer.current > 0) {
            onChartClick(true);
          }

          clearInterval(timeout);
          timer.current = 1;
        });
      }
    });

    return () => {
      if (widget !== null) {
        widget.remove();
      }
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [options]);

  return <div id={options.container as string} />;
};

export default memo(TradingView);

import { Dispatch, FC, SVGProps } from 'react';

import { QueryDefinition } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query';
// eslint-disable-next-line import/no-unresolved
import { LazyQueryTrigger } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query/react/buildHooks';
import { BaseQueryApi } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/src/query/baseQueryTypes';
import {
  AccessList,
  ChartingLibraryFeatureset,
  ResolutionString,
} from 'charting_library/charting_library';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { QuotesHistoryRequest, QuotesHistoryResponse } from 'types/tradingView';

export type Features = Partial<Record<ChartingLibraryFeatureset, boolean>>;

export type ChartIconsForMiniChartType = {
  id: number;
  icon: FC<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>>;
};

export type BarDataType = {
  time: number;
  open: number;
  high: number;
  low: number;
  close: number;
};

export type WidgetOptionsParamsType = {
  minDate: string;
  instrumentId: string;
  tradePlaceId: string;
  tradePlaceCode: string;
  priceStep: number;
  containerId: string;
  instrumentName: string;
  width?: string | number;
  height?: number;
  fullscreen?: boolean;
  autosize?: boolean;
  features?: { enabled_features: FeatureKeys[]; disabled_features: FeatureKeys[] };
  interval?: ResolutionString;
  timeframe?: ResolutionString;
  drawings_access?: AccessList;
  getQuotesHistory: LazyQueryTrigger<
    QueryDefinition<
      QuotesHistoryRequest,
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      (args: any, api: BaseQueryApi, extraOptions: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<any>,
      never,
      QuotesHistoryResponse,
      'quotesHistoryApi'
    >
  >;
  dispatch: Dispatch<Action>;
};

export type QuotesPriceChange = {
  priceChange: number;
  priceChangePcnt: number;
  volumeCurrency: PriceCurrencyType;
};

export type FeatureKeys = keyof Features;

export interface State {
  hasQuotes: boolean;
}

export type HasQuotesAction = {
  type: 'TRADING_VIEW_HAS_QUOTES_ACTION';
  payload: boolean;
};

export type Action = HasQuotesAction;

import { ReactComponent as SGD } from './assets/sgd.svg';
import { ReactComponent as TRY } from './assets/try.svg';
import { ReactComponent as UAH } from './assets/uah.svg';
import { ReactComponent as USD } from './assets/usd.svg';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const currencyIcons = {
  BYN,
  CHF,
  CNY,
  EUR,
  FRF,
  GBP,
  HKD,
  JPY,
  KZT,
  RUB,
  SGD,
  TRY,
  UAH,
  USD,
} as const;

type CurrencyCode = keyof typeof currencyIcons;

export const isCurrencyCode = (value: unknown): value is CurrencyCode => {
  return typeof value === 'string' && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(currencyIcons, value);
};

type Props = {
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  currencyCode: CurrencyCode | Omit<string, CurrencyCode>;
};

const CurrencyIcon = ({ className, currencyCode, disabled }: Props) => {
  return (
    <div className={cn(className, styles.icon, disabled && styles.iconDisabled)}>
      {isCurrencyCode(currencyCode)
        ? createElement(currencyIcons[currencyCode], { className: styles.svg })
        : null}
    </div>
  );
};

export default CurrencyIcon;

import { useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { AdaptivePopover, CardButton, OptionsList } from 'components';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { CurrenciesProps } from './types';

const Currencies = ({
  currencyOptions: options,
  selectedCurrencyCode,
  onCurrencyChange,
  hintHidden,
  disabled,
}: CurrenciesProps) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const selectedCurrency =
    options.find((el) => el.id === selectedCurrencyCode) || options.find((el) => el.id === 'RUB');

  return (
    <AdaptivePopover
      isOpen={open}
      onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
      button={
        <CardButton
          title={
            selectedCurrency && currencySign(selectedCurrency.id)
              ? currencySign(selectedCurrency.id)
              : currencySign('RUB')
          }
          className={styles.cardWrapper}
          classNameTitle={styles.cardTitle}
          onClick={() => {
            if (disabled) return;
            setOpen(true);
          }}
        />
      }
      classNameContent={styles.popover}
    >
      <div
        className={cn({
          [styles.bottomSheetContent]: isMobile,
          [styles.bottomSheetContentDesktop]: !isMobile,
        })}
      >
        {isMobile && (
          <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.name}>
            Выберите валюту
          </Text>
        )}
        <div className={styles.optionsListsContainer}>
          <OptionsList
            options={[options[0]]}
            selectedOption={selectedCurrency}
            className={styles.optionListWrapper}
            onChange={onCurrencyChange}
            onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
          />
        </div>
        {!hintHidden && (
          <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.text}>
            Пополнение в других валютах доступно только через{' '}
            <span className={styles.highlight}>банк «Открытие»</span> или{' '}
            <span className={styles.highlight}>по реквизитам</span>
          </Text>
        )}
        <div className={styles.optionsListsContainer}>
          <OptionsList
            options={options.slice(1)}
            selectedOption={selectedCurrency}
            className={cn(styles.optionListWrapper, styles.space)}
            onChange={onCurrencyChange}
            onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopover>
  );
};

export default Currencies;

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import {
  CardIcon,
  OpenBankIcon,
  RequisitesIcon,
  SBPIcon,
} from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/paymentTypes';
import { PaymentTypes } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { AdaptivePopover, CardButton, OptionsList } from 'components';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { PaymentTypeSelectProps } from './types';

const getOptionDescription = (paymentMethod?: PaymentTypes) => {
  if (!paymentMethod) return '';
  const { commissionRate, timeEnrollment } = paymentMethod;
  return `Комиссия ${commissionRate ? commissionRate * 100 : 0}%, ${timeEnrollment}`;
};

const icons: Record<string, React.ReactElement> = {
  BFKO: <OpenBankIcon />,
  MONETA: <CardIcon />,
  BANK_DETAILS: <RequisitesIcon />,
  SBP: <SBPIcon />,
};

const PaymentTypeSelect = ({
  paymentTypes,
  selectedPaymentTypeCode,
  onPaymentTypeSelect,
}: PaymentTypeSelectProps) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const paymentMethodsObj = useMemo(() => {
    return paymentTypes.reduce(
      (ac: Partial<Record<PaymentTypes['paymentTypeCode'], PaymentTypes>>, el) => {
        ac[el.paymentTypeCode] = { ...el };

        return ac;
      },
      {},
    );
  }, [paymentTypes]);

  const options = useMemo(() => {
    return paymentTypes
      .filter((el) => el.paymentTypeCode !== 'BFKO')
      .map((el) => {
        return {
          id: el.paymentTypeCode,
          title: el.paymentTypeName,
          description: getOptionDescription(paymentMethodsObj[el.paymentTypeCode]),
          icon: icons[el.paymentTypeCode] ? icons[el.paymentTypeCode] : undefined,
        };
      });
  }, [paymentTypes, paymentMethodsObj]);

  const selectedType = options.find((el) => el.id === selectedPaymentTypeCode);

  return (
    <AdaptivePopover
      isOpen={open}
      onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
      button={
        <CardButton
          name="Способ"
          title={selectedType ? selectedType.title : options[0]?.title}
          subTitle={selectedType ? selectedType.description : options[0]?.description}
          classNameHeader={styles.cardName}
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
          icon={selectedType ? selectedType.icon : options[0]?.icon}
        />
      }
      isStretched
    >
      <div className={cn({ [styles.bottomSheetContent]: isMobile })}>
        {isMobile && (
          <div className={styles.space}>
            <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.name}>
              Способы пополнения
            </Text>
            <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.title}>
              Выберите удобный способ пополнения
            </Text>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className={styles.optionsListsContainer}>
          <OptionsList
            options={options}
            selectedOption={selectedType}
            className={cn(styles.optionListWrapper, styles.space)}
            onChange={onPaymentTypeSelect}
            onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopover>
  );
};

export default PaymentTypeSelect;

import React, { SetStateAction, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import Popover from '@aurora/popover';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { CardButton, Option, OptionsList } from 'components';

import { AddHeadlineFunctionParams, SelectProductsAndPortfoliosProps } from '../../types';
import PortfolioHint from '../PortfolioHint';
import ProductCardSubTitle from '../ProductCardSubTitle';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const addHeadlineToEachPortfolioDescription = ({ text, portfolios }: AddHeadlineFunctionParams) =>
  portfolios.map(({ description, ...rest }) => ({
    description: `${text}: ${description}`,
    ...rest,
  }));

const DesktopSelectProductsAndPortfiolios = ({
  button,
  open,
  setOpen,
  products,
  portfolios,
  selectedProduct,
  selectedPortfolio,
  productDescrTitle,
  portfolioDescrTitle = 'Доступно',
  showHints = false,
  hints,
  onProductSelect,
  onPortfolioSelect,
  onChanging,
}: SelectProductsAndPortfoliosProps & {
  button: React.ReactElement;
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
  onChanging?: React.Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>;
}) => {
  const [openPortfolios, setOpenPortfolios] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open && openPortfolios) {
      setOpenPortfolios(false);
    }
  }, [open, openPortfolios]);

  const handleDismissProductsPopover = () => {
    if (openPortfolios) return;
    setOpen(false);
    setOpenPortfolios(false);
    onChanging && onChanging(false);
  };

  const handleClickCardButton = (product: Option<number>) => () => {
    if (openPortfolios && product.id === selectedProduct?.id) {
      onChanging && onChanging(false);
      setOpenPortfolios(false);
    } else {
      onChanging && onChanging(true);
      onProductSelect(product);
      setOpenPortfolios(true);
    }
  };

  const handleClickPortfoliosPopover = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    setOpenPortfolios(false);
    onChanging && onChanging(false);
  };

  return (
    <Popover
      onClose={handleDismissProductsPopover}
      content={products.map((product) => {
        const { id, title, description, disabled = false } = product;
        const isSelected = openPortfolios && selectedProduct?.id === id;
        return (
          <Popover
            key={id}
            showContent={isSelected}
            controlled={true}
            className={styles.productsCard}
            classNameContent={styles.portfoliosPopover}
            {...(isSelected && { actionContainerRef: ref, portalContainerRef: ref })}
            content={
              <>
                <PortfolioHint />
                <OptionsList
                  options={addHeadlineToEachPortfolioDescription({
                    portfolios,
                    text: `${portfolioDescrTitle}`,
                  } as AddHeadlineFunctionParams)}
                  selectedOption={selectedPortfolio}
                  onChange={onPortfolioSelect}
                  onClick={handleClickPortfoliosPopover}
                />
              </>
            }
          >
            {
              <CardButton
                title={title}
                subTitle={
                  <ProductCardSubTitle
                    hints={hints || []}
                    description={description}
                    descriptionTitle={productDescrTitle}
                    showHint={showHints && disabled}
                  />
                }
                chevronRight
                disabled={disabled}
                onClick={handleClickCardButton(product)}
                className={cn(styles.productCard, {
                  [styles.chosen]: openPortfolios && id === selectedProduct?.id,
                })}
              />
            }
          </Popover>
        );
      })}
      showContent={open}
      controlled={true}
      className={styles.popover}
      classNameContent={styles.popoverContent}
    >
      <div ref={ref}>{button}</div>
    </Popover>
  );
};

export default DesktopSelectProductsAndPortfiolios;

import { memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { Hint } from 'types/hints';

interface ProductCardSubTitleProps {
  description?: string;
  descriptionTitle?: string;
  showHint?: boolean;
  hints: Hint[];
}

const ProductCardSubTitle = ({
  description,
  descriptionTitle,
  showHint,
  hints,
}: ProductCardSubTitleProps) => {
  const hintText = useMemo(() => {
    if (showHint && description) {
      const txt = hints.find((item) => item.slug === description)?.text;
      return txt ? sanitizeHtml(txt) : '';
    }

    return '';
  }, [description, hints, showHint]);

  if (showHint) {
    return (
      <div>
        <Text type="labelRegular">
          <span>{hintText}</span>
        </Text>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      {descriptionTitle && <div>{`${descriptionTitle}:`}</div>}
      <div>{description}</div>
    </>
  );
};

export default memo(ProductCardSubTitle);

import { useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import { CardButton, Option, OptionsList } from 'components';

import DesktopSelectProductsAndPortfiolios from './components/DesktopSelectProductsAndPortfiolios';
import PortfolioHint from './components/PortfolioHint';
import ProductCardSubTitle from './components/ProductCardSubTitle';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { AddHeadlineFunctionParams, SelectProductsAndPortfoliosProps } from './types';

const addHeadlineToEachPortfolioDescription = ({ text, portfolios }: AddHeadlineFunctionParams) =>
  portfolios.map(({ description, ...rest }) => ({
    description: `${text}: ${description}`,
    ...rest,
  }));

const SelectProductsAndPortfolios = ({
  title = 'Счёт и портфель',
  products,
  portfolios,
  selectedProduct,
  selectedPortfolio,
  productDescrTitle,
  portfolioDescrTitle = 'Доступно',
  showHints = false,
  onProductSelect,
  onPortfolioSelect,
  onBottomSheetStateChange,
  comment,
  descriptionHidden,
}: SelectProductsAndPortfoliosProps) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isProductList, setIsProductList] = useState(true);
  const [isHintDismissed, setIsHintDismissed] = useState(true);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { data: hintsData } = useGetHintsQuery(undefined, { skip: !showHints });

  const handleOpenBottomSheet = () => {
    setOpen(!open);
    onBottomSheetStateChange?.(!open);
  };

  const handleDismissBottomSheet = () => {
    setIsProductList(true);
    setOpen(false);
    onBottomSheetStateChange?.(false);
  };

  const handleClickCardButton = (product: Option<number>) => () => {
    onProductSelect(product);
    setIsProductList(false);
  };

  const SelectionCardButton = (
    <CardButton
      name={title}
      title={selectedProduct ? selectedProduct.title : ''}
      subTitle={selectedPortfolio ? selectedPortfolio.title : ''}
      onClick={handleOpenBottomSheet}
    />
  );

  const SelectionCardDescription = !descriptionHidden && (
    <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.cardComment} tag="div">
      {!selectedPortfolio?.description?.includes('Средств в портфеле: ') && (
        <span className={styles.cardCommentLight}>Средств в портфеле: </span>
      )}
      {selectedPortfolio?.description}
    </Text>
  );

  if (!isMobile) {
    return (
      <DesktopSelectProductsAndPortfiolios
        button={
          <>
            {SelectionCardButton}
            {SelectionCardDescription}
          </>
        }
        open={open}
        setOpen={setOpen}
        products={products}
        portfolios={portfolios}
        selectedProduct={selectedProduct}
        selectedPortfolio={selectedPortfolio}
        productDescrTitle={productDescrTitle}
        portfolioDescrTitle={portfolioDescrTitle}
        showHints={showHints}
        hints={hintsData?.hints || []}
        onProductSelect={onProductSelect}
        onPortfolioSelect={onPortfolioSelect}
        onChanging={onBottomSheetStateChange}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {SelectionCardButton}
      <BottomSheet
        open={open}
        initialFocusRef={false}
        {...(isHintDismissed ? { onDismiss: handleDismissBottomSheet } : {})}
        className={styles.bottomSheetWrapper}
      >
        <div className={styles.bottomSheetContent}>
          <div className={styles.header}>
            <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.name}>
              {isProductList ? 'Выберите счет' : 'Выберите портфель'}
            </Text>
            {!!comment && (
              <Text className={styles.comment} type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                {comment}
              </Text>
            )}
          </div>

          {isProductList ? (
            products.map((product) => {
              const { id, title, description, disabled = false } = product;
              return (
                <div key={id} className={styles.productsCard}>
                  <CardButton
                    title={title}
                    subTitle={
                      <ProductCardSubTitle
                        hints={hintsData?.hints || []}
                        description={description}
                        descriptionTitle={productDescrTitle}
                        showHint={showHints && disabled}
                      />
                    }
                    chevronRight
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onClick={handleClickCardButton(product)}
                  />
                </div>
              );
            })
          ) : (
            <>
              <PortfolioHint setIsDismissed={setIsHintDismissed} />
              <OptionsList
                type="circle"
                options={addHeadlineToEachPortfolioDescription({
                  portfolios,
                  text: `${portfolioDescrTitle}`,
                } as AddHeadlineFunctionParams)}
                selectedOption={selectedPortfolio}
                onChange={onPortfolioSelect}
                onClick={handleDismissBottomSheet}
              />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
      {SelectionCardDescription}
    </>
  );
};

export default SelectProductsAndPortfolios;

import { useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { AdaptivePopover, CardButton, OptionsList } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { CurrenciesProps } from './types';

const Currencies = ({ options, selectedCurrencyCode, onCurrencyChange }: CurrenciesProps) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const currencyMap = Object.fromEntries(options.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
  const sortedCurrencies = [
    ...[
      currencyMap['RUB'] && currencyMap['RUB'],
      currencyMap['USD'] && currencyMap['USD'],
      currencyMap['EUR'] && currencyMap['EUR'],
    ].filter(Boolean),
    ...options.filter(({ id }) => !['RUB', 'USD', 'EUR'].includes(id)),
  ];

  const selectedCurrency =
    options.find((el) => el.id === selectedCurrencyCode) || options.find((el) => el.id === 'RUB');

  return (
    <AdaptivePopover
      isOpen={open}
      onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
      button={
        <CardButton
          title={
            selectedCurrency && currencySign(selectedCurrency.id as PriceCurrencyType)
              ? currencySign(selectedCurrency.id as PriceCurrencyType)
              : currencySign('RUB')
          }
          className={styles.cardWrapper}
          classNameTitle={styles.cardTitle}
          onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        />
      }
      classNameContent={styles.popover}
    >
      <div className={cn({ [styles.bottomSheetContent]: isMobile })}>
        {isMobile && (
          <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.name}>
            Выберите валюту
          </Text>
        )}
        <div className={styles.optionsListsContainer}>
          <OptionsList
            options={sortedCurrencies}
            selectedOption={selectedCurrency}
            className={cn(styles.optionListWrapper, styles.space)}
            onChange={onCurrencyChange}
            onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopover>
  );
};

export default Currencies;

import { memo, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_CATEGORY_INFO } from 'const/routes';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as LeverageSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/transfers/leverage.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SecuritiesSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/transfers/securities.svg';
import { ReactComponent as WalletSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/transfers/wallet.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  onCancel: () => void;
};

const UnavailableLeverage = ({ onCancel }: Props) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    onCancel();
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const goToTest = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    onCancel();
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_CATEGORY_INFO, { category: 'REPO-CONTRACTS' }));
  };

  return (
    <AdaptivePopup open={open} onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.bottomSheetContent}>
        <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.name}>
          С обеспечением вы можете вывести больше средств, чем у вас есть
        </Text>
        <Text type="bodyRegular">
          Для этого пройдите тестирование по теме «Договоры РЕПО». После тестирования вы сможете:
        </Text>
        <div className={styles.listWrapper}>
          <div className={styles.listItem}>
            <div className={styles.listItemIcon}>
              <WalletSvg />
            </div>
            <Text type="lineRegular">
              Выводить больше, не продавая бумаги и не дожидаясь расчетов по сделкам
            </Text>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.listItem}>
            <div className={styles.listItemIcon}>
              <LeverageSvg />
            </div>
            <Text type="lineRegular">Получать больше прибыли за счёт сделок с плечом</Text>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.listItem}>
            <div className={styles.listItemIcon}>
              <SecuritiesSvg />
            </div>
            <Text type="lineRegular">Покупать бумаги, не имея полной суммы на счете</Text>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.btnWrapper}>
          <Button onClick={goToTest}>Пройти тестирование</Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}>
            Не сейчас
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopup>
  );
};

export default memo(UnavailableLeverage);

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { AmountInput, Button, Checkbox, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { skipToken } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { debounce } from 'lodash';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useCurrenciesQuery, useFreeBalanceQuery, useLeverageQuery } from 'core/api/transfers';
import { useGetUserSettingQuery, useUpdateUserSettingMutation } from 'core/api/userSettings';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useSnackBar } from 'hooks/useSnackBar';

import BlockedContent from 'modules/Transfers/components/BlockedContent';
import ArrowNextIcon from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/ArrowNextIcon';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import AddonBottom from 'components/AddonBottom';
import ArrowUpIcon from 'components/icons/ArrowUpIcon';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import CurrencySelect from '../../components/CurrencySelect';
import { AvailableLeverage, UnavailableLeverage } from '../../components/Leverage';
import Skeleton from '../../components/Skeleton';
import {
  prepareCurrencyOptions,
  preparePortfolioOptions,
  prepareProductOption,
} from '../../helpers';
import { useMoneyOperationParams, useTransfersState } from '../../hooks';
import SelectProductsAndPortfoliosForTransfer from '../SelectProductsAndPortfoliosForTransfer';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const rules = [
  ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    return value[0] !== '0';
  },
  ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    return value.length < 15;
  },
];

const SelectInternalTransfers = () => {
  const [
    {
      fromProduct,
      fromPortfolio,
      toProduct,
      toPortfolio,
      currencyId,
      currencyCode,
      transferAmount,
      fromSubAccountId,
      freeBalance,
      freeBalanceWithLeverage,
    },
    setState,
  ] = useTransfersState();
  const [amountValue, setAmountValue] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [amountInputFocused, setAmountInputFocused] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isLeverage, setIsLeverage] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showLeverageBottomSheet, setShowLeverageBottomSheet] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [firstLeverage, setFirstLeverage] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const handleBackButton = useCallback(() => {
    navigate(-1);
  }, [navigate]);

  const {
    moneyParameters,
    isSuccess: isSuccessMoneyParameters,
    isLoading: isLoadingMoneyParameters,
    isError: isErrorMoneyParameters,
  } = useMoneyOperationParams();

  const { data: userSettingData } = useGetUserSettingQuery({ name: 'margin_use' });
  const [setSettings] = useUpdateUserSettingMutation();

  useSnackBar((isSuccessMoneyParameters && moneyParameters?.hasUnavailableCurrencies) || false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userSettingData && Number(userSettingData?.userSetting[0].value) !== 1) {
      setFirstLeverage(true);
    }
  }, [userSettingData]);

  const fromProductOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const fromProductIds = new Map<number, boolean>();
    Array.from(moneyParameters.balanceMap.keys()).forEach((productId) => {
      fromProductIds.set(productId, true);
    });

    const productWithOperations = new Map();

    moneyParameters.operationMatrix.forEach((item) => {
      const prev = fromProductIds.get(item.fromProductId) ?? true;
      productWithOperations.set(item.fromProductId, true);
      fromProductIds.set(item.fromProductId, prev && item.withdrawalDenied === true);
    });

    return Array.from(fromProductIds.entries(), ([productId, denied]) => {
      return prepareProductOption({
        balanceByProductId: moneyParameters.balanceMap,
        productId,
        disabled: denied,
        hint: true,
        hasOperations: productWithOperations.has(productId),
      });
    })
      .sort((left, right) => Number(left.disabled) - Number(right.disabled))
      .filter(({ id }) => {
        const { balance, productCategoryCode } = moneyParameters.balanceMap.get(id) ?? {};
        return (
          (productCategoryCode !== 'STRUCT.PRODUCT' &&
            productCategoryCode !== 'IIA.STRUCT.PRODUCT') ||
          balance !== 0
        );
      });
  }, [moneyParameters.operationMatrix, moneyParameters.balanceMap]);

  const fromPortfoliosOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const fromPortfolioIds = moneyParameters.operationMatrix.reduce((acc, item) => {
      if (item.fromProductId === fromProduct?.id) {
        acc.add(item.fromPortfolioId);
      }
      return acc;
    }, new Set<number>());

    const portfolios = moneyParameters.portfolios.filter((item) =>
      fromPortfolioIds.has(item.portfolioId),
    );

    return preparePortfolioOptions(portfolios);
  }, [moneyParameters.operationMatrix, moneyParameters.portfolios, fromProduct?.id]);

  const toProductOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const fromPortfolioId = fromPortfolio?.id.split('_')[0];

    const toProductIds = new Map<number, boolean>();

    if (
      fromProduct != null &&
      fromPortfolioId != null &&
      Permissions.granted('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_INTERNAL', fromProduct.id)
    ) {
      toProductIds.set(fromProduct.id, false);
    }

    moneyParameters.operationMatrix.forEach((item) => {
      if (
        item.fromProductId === fromProduct?.id &&
        String(item.fromPortfolioId) === fromPortfolioId
      ) {
        toProductIds.set(item.toProductId, item.withdrawalDenied === true);
      }
    });

    return Array.from(toProductIds.entries(), ([productId, denied]) => {
      return prepareProductOption({
        balanceByProductId: moneyParameters.balanceMap,
        productId,
        disabled: denied,
      });
    }).filter((item) => !item.disabled);
  }, [fromProduct, fromPortfolio, moneyParameters.operationMatrix, moneyParameters.balanceMap]);

  const hasSubAccounts = useMemo(() => {
    const fromPortfolioId = fromPortfolio?.id.split('_')[0];
    let hasSubAccounts = false;
    if (
      fromPortfolioId != null &&
      fromProduct != null &&
      Permissions.granted('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_INTERNAL', fromProduct.id)
    ) {
      hasSubAccounts =
        moneyParameters.portfolios.reduce((acc, item) => {
          if (item.productId === fromProduct.id && String(item.portfolioId) === fromPortfolioId) {
            acc.add(item.subAccountId);
          }
          return acc;
        }, new Set<number>()).size > 1;
    }

    return hasSubAccounts;
  }, [fromPortfolio?.id, fromProduct, moneyParameters.portfolios]);

  const toPortfoliosOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const fromPortfolioId = fromPortfolio?.id.split('_')[0];

    const portfolioSubAccountsMap: Record<number, number[]> = {};

    const toPortfolioIds = moneyParameters.operationMatrix.reduce((acc, item) => {
      if (
        item.fromProductId === fromProduct?.id &&
        item.toProductId === toProduct?.id &&
        String(item.fromPortfolioId) === fromPortfolioId
      ) {
        if (item.fromSubAccountId === fromSubAccountId) {
          if (
            portfolioSubAccountsMap[item.toPortfolioId] &&
            !portfolioSubAccountsMap[item.toPortfolioId].includes(item.toSubAccountId)
          ) {
            portfolioSubAccountsMap[item.toPortfolioId].push(item.toSubAccountId);
          } else if (!portfolioSubAccountsMap[item.toPortfolioId]) {
            portfolioSubAccountsMap[item.toPortfolioId] = [item.toSubAccountId];
          }
        }
        acc.add(item.toPortfolioId);
      }
      return acc;
    }, new Set<number>());

    const portfolios = moneyParameters.portfolios.filter(
      (item) =>
        (toPortfolioIds.has(item.portfolioId) &&
          (Number(fromPortfolioId) === item.portfolioId
            ? portfolioSubAccountsMap[item.portfolioId]?.includes(item.subAccountId)
            : true)) ||
        (hasSubAccounts &&
          item.productId === fromProduct?.id &&
          item.productId === toProduct?.id &&
          String(item.portfolioId) === fromPortfolioId &&
          item.subAccountId !== fromSubAccountId &&
          portfolioSubAccountsMap[item.portfolioId]?.includes(item.subAccountId)),
    );

    return preparePortfolioOptions(portfolios);
  }, [
    fromPortfolio?.id,
    fromProduct?.id,
    fromSubAccountId,
    hasSubAccounts,
    moneyParameters.operationMatrix,
    moneyParameters.portfolios,
    toProduct?.id,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSuccessMoneyParameters) return;

    setState({
      fromProduct: fromProductOptions.find((item) => !item.disabled),
    });
  }, [setState, isSuccessMoneyParameters, fromProductOptions]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSuccessMoneyParameters) return;

    setState((prev) => {
      const fromPortfolio = fromPortfoliosOptions.find((item) => !item.disabled);
      const fromSubAccountId = fromPortfolio ? Number(fromPortfolio.id.split('_')[1]) : null;

      return prev.fromProduct == null && fromPortfoliosOptions.length === 0
        ? null
        : {
            fromPortfolio,
            fromSubAccountId,
          };
    });
  }, [setState, isSuccessMoneyParameters, fromPortfoliosOptions]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSuccessMoneyParameters) return;

    setState((prev) => {
      return prev.toProduct == null && toProductOptions.length === 0
        ? null
        : {
            toProduct: toProductOptions.find((item) => !item.disabled),
          };
    });
  }, [setState, isSuccessMoneyParameters, toProductOptions]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isSuccessMoneyParameters) return;

    setState((prev) => {
      const toPortfolio = toPortfoliosOptions.find(
        (item) => !item.disabled && prev.fromPortfolio?.id !== item.id,
      );
      const toSubAccountId = toPortfolio ? Number(toPortfolio.id.split('_')[1]) : null;

      return prev.toPortfolio == null && toPortfoliosOptions.length === 0
        ? null
        : {
            toPortfolio,
            toSubAccountId,
          };
    });
  }, [setState, isSuccessMoneyParameters, toPortfoliosOptions]);

  const { data: currenciesData } = useCurrenciesQuery();
  const { currencyNames, currencyIds } = useMemo(() => {
    const currencyNames = new Map<PriceCurrencyType, string>();
    const currencyIds = new Map<PriceCurrencyType, number>();

    currenciesData?.forEach((item) => {
      currencyNames.set(item.code as PriceCurrencyType, item.name);
      currencyIds.set(item.code as PriceCurrencyType, item.id);
    });

    return { currencyNames, currencyIds };
  }, [currenciesData]);
  const currencyOptions = useMemo(() => {
    return prepareCurrencyOptions({
      operations: moneyParameters.operationMatrix,
      fromProductId: fromProduct?.id,
      fromPortfolioId: fromPortfolio?.id.split('_')[0],
      toProductId: toProduct?.id,
      toPortfolioId: toPortfolio?.id.split('_')[0],
      currencyNames,
      withdrawalCurrencies: hasSubAccounts ? moneyParameters.withdrawalCurrencies : [],
    });
  }, [
    currencyNames,
    fromPortfolio?.id,
    fromProduct?.id,
    hasSubAccounts,
    moneyParameters.operationMatrix,
    moneyParameters.withdrawalCurrencies,
    toPortfolio?.id,
    toProduct?.id,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setState((prev) => {
      const currencyCode =
        currencyOptions.length === 0
          ? undefined
          : currencyOptions.some((option) => option.id === prev.currencyCode)
          ? prev.currencyCode
          : (currencyOptions[0].id as PriceCurrencyType);

      return {
        currencyCode,
        currencyId: (typeof currencyCode === 'string' && currencyIds.get(currencyCode)) || null,
      };
    });
  }, [currencyIds, currencyOptions, setState]);

  const portfolioParams =
    fromPortfolio == null || fromSubAccountId == null || currencyId == null
      ? skipToken
      : {
          currencyId,
          portfolioId: Number(fromPortfolio.id.split('_')[0]),
          subAccountId: fromSubAccountId,
        };

  const {
    data: leverage,
    isSuccess: isSuccessLeverage,
    isError: isErrorLeverage,
  } = useLeverageQuery(portfolioParams);

  const {
    data: freeBalanceResponse,
    isSuccess: isSuccessFreeBalance,
    isFetching: isFetchingFreeBalance,
  } = useFreeBalanceQuery(portfolioParams, { refetchOnMountOrArgChange: true });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSuccessFreeBalance && !isFetchingFreeBalance) {
      setState({
        freeBalance: freeBalanceResponse.balance,
        freeBalanceWithLeverage: freeBalanceResponse.balanceWithLeverage,
      });
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isSuccessFreeBalance, isFetchingFreeBalance, setState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!leverage || leverage.enabled) return;

    if (leverage?.needOpenCategory) {
      setShowLeverageBottomSheet(true);
    } else if (isLeverage) {
      setIsLeverage(false);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isSuccessLeverage, leverage]);

  const onAmountChange = ({ floatValue }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    setAmountValue(floatValue || null);
  };

  const onAmountBlur = () => {
    debounceAmountChange.flush();
    setAmountInputFocused(false);
  };

  const debounceAmountChange = useMemo(
    () =>
      debounce((value: number) => {
        setState({ transferAmount: value });
      }, 500),
    [setState],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (amountValue) {
      debounceAmountChange(amountValue);
    }
  }, [debounceAmountChange, amountValue]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setAmountValue(transferAmount);
  }, [transferAmount]);

  const setAmountInputFocus = () => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    ref.current.focus();
  };

  const onCheckBoxChange = useCallback(() => {
    if (firstLeverage && !isLeverage && leverage?.enabled) {
      setSettings({ name: 'margin_use', value: '1' });
    }
    setIsLeverage(!isLeverage);
  }, [firstLeverage, isLeverage, leverage?.enabled, setSettings]);

  const onLimitClick = useCallback(() => {
    if (!freeBalanceResponse) return;
    setAmountValue(isLeverage ? freeBalanceWithLeverage : freeBalance);
  }, [freeBalance, freeBalanceResponse, freeBalanceWithLeverage, isLeverage]);

  const onNotNowLeverageButton = () => {
    setIsLeverage(false);
  };

  const onCloseFirstLeverageMsg = () => {
    setFirstLeverage(false);
  };

  const onTransferRequest = useCallback(() => {
    setState({
      step: 'CONFIRM',
    });
  }, [setState]);

  const getErrorAmountMessage = useCallback(() => {
    if (freeBalance || (freeBalanceWithLeverage && isLeverage)) {
      return (
        <>
          <span>Недостаточно средств. Доступно </span>
          <span onClick={onLimitClick}>
            {`${sumFormatter(
              (isLeverage ? freeBalanceWithLeverage : freeBalance) as number,
            )} ${currencySign(currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType)}`}
          </span>
        </>
      );
    } else if (!freeBalance && freeBalanceWithLeverage && !isLeverage) {
      return (
        <span>
          Нет средств, доступных для перевода. Вы можете перевести средства под обеспечение
        </span>
      );
    } else {
      return <span>Нет средств, доступных для перевода</span>;
    }
  }, [currencyCode, freeBalance, freeBalanceWithLeverage, isLeverage, onLimitClick]);

  const isErrorAmountValue =
    (isLeverage &&
      freeBalanceWithLeverage !== null &&
      Number(amountValue) > freeBalanceWithLeverage) ||
    (!isLeverage && freeBalance !== null && Number(amountValue) > freeBalance) ||
    false;

  const isErrorAvailableAccounts = !fromProductOptions.some((option) => !option.disabled);

  const isButtonDisabled = isErrorAmountValue || !amountValue || isFetchingFreeBalance;
  const Header = useMemo(
    () =>
      isMobile ? (
        <HeaderPage
          size={'small'}
          title={'Перевод'}
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackButton}
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <HeaderPage>
            <Button
              iconLeft={<BackSvg />}
              onClick={handleBackButton}
              shape="inline"
              variant="white"
              className={styles.header}
            >
              <Text type="labelMedium">Назад</Text>
            </Button>
          </HeaderPage>
          <Text type="headline" className={styles.headline}>
            Перевод
          </Text>
        </>
      ),
    [handleBackButton, isMobile],
  );

  const Leverage = useMemo(
    () => (
      <div className={cn({ [styles.leverageWrapper]: !isMobile })}>
        <Checkbox
          label={
            <Text
              tag="span"
              type="lineMedium"
              color={
                !leverage?.enabled && !leverage?.needOpenCategory
                  ? 'colorForeground3'
                  : 'colorForeground2'
              }
            >
              Обеспечение
            </Text>
          }
          onChange={onCheckBoxChange}
          checked={isLeverage}
          disabled={!leverage?.enabled && !leverage?.needOpenCategory}
        />
      </div>
    ),
    [isLeverage, isMobile, leverage?.enabled, leverage?.needOpenCategory, onCheckBoxChange],
  );

  const FooterButton = useMemo(() => {
    return amountInputFocused || (amountValue && amountValue > 0) ? (
      <Button
        className={isMobile ? styles.btnMobile : styles.btnDesktop}
        variant={isMobile ? 'secondary' : 'primary'}
        size="s"
        iconRight={isMobile && <ArrowNextIcon disabled={isButtonDisabled} />}
        disabled={isButtonDisabled}
        onClick={onTransferRequest}
      >
        <Text type="lineMedium">Перевести</Text>
      </Button>
    ) : (
      <Button
        className={isMobile ? styles.btnMobile : styles.btnDesktop}
        variant={isMobile ? 'secondary' : 'primary'}
        size="s"
        iconRight={
          isMobile && <ArrowUpIcon disabled={!isSuccessFreeBalance || isFetchingFreeBalance} />
        }
        onClick={setAmountInputFocus}
        disabled={!isSuccessFreeBalance || isFetchingFreeBalance}
      >
        <Text type="lineMedium">Введите сумму</Text>
      </Button>
    );
  }, [
    amountInputFocused,
    amountValue,
    isButtonDisabled,
    isFetchingFreeBalance,
    isMobile,
    isSuccessFreeBalance,
    onTransferRequest,
  ]);

  if (isLoadingMoneyParameters)
    return (
      <>
        {Header}
        <Skeleton />
      </>
    );

  if (isErrorMoneyParameters || isErrorLeverage) {
    return (
      <>
        {isMobile ? (
          <HeaderPage
            size={'small'}
            title={'Перевод средств'}
            leftIconVariant="close"
            onLeftIconClick={handleBackButton}
          />
        ) : (
          <HeaderPage>
            <Button
              iconLeft={<BackSvg />}
              onClick={handleBackButton}
              shape="inline"
              variant="white"
              className={styles.header}
            >
              <Text type="labelMedium">Назад</Text>
            </Button>
          </HeaderPage>
        )}
        <BlockedContent type="errorInternalTransfer" />
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {Header}
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div>
          <SelectProductsAndPortfoliosForTransfer
            fromPortfolioOptions={fromPortfoliosOptions}
            fromProductOptions={fromProductOptions}
            toPortfolioOptions={toPortfoliosOptions}
            toProductOptions={toProductOptions}
          />
          <div>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.amountTitle}>
              Сумма перевода
            </Text>
            <div className={styles.amountWrapper}>
              <AmountInput
                placeholder="0"
                value={amountValue || ''}
                rules={rules}
                suffix={currencySign(currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType)}
                onChange={onAmountChange}
                onBlur={onAmountBlur}
                className={styles.amountInput}
                error={
                  !!(
                    isErrorAmountValue &&
                    freeBalanceResponse &&
                    !isFetchingFreeBalance &&
                    isErrorAvailableAccounts
                  )
                }
                disabled={!isSuccessFreeBalance || isFetchingFreeBalance}
                onFocus={() => setAmountInputFocused(true)}
                ref={ref}
              />
              <CurrencySelect
                options={currencyOptions}
                selectedCurrencyCode={currencyCode}
                onCurrencyChange={(option) => {
                  const currencyCode = option.id as PriceCurrencyType;
                  setState({
                    currencyCode,
                    currencyId: currencyIds.get(currencyCode),
                  });
                }}
              />
            </div>
            {(isErrorAmountValue && !isFetchingFreeBalance) || isErrorAvailableAccounts ? (
              <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.limitErrorHighlight} tag="div">
                {getErrorAmountMessage()}
              </Text>
            ) : (
              <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.cardComment} tag="div">
                <span className={styles.cardCommentLight}>Доступно для перевода </span>
                {isFetchingFreeBalance || !isSuccessFreeBalance ? (
                  <CircleLoader brandColor size={'small'} />
                ) : (
                  <span className={styles.mainColor} onClick={onLimitClick}>
                    {`${sumFormatter(
                      (isLeverage ? freeBalanceWithLeverage : freeBalance) as number,
                    )} ${currencySign(currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType)}`}
                  </span>
                )}
              </Text>
            )}
          </div>
          {showLeverageBottomSheet && isLeverage && (
            <UnavailableLeverage onCancel={onNotNowLeverageButton} />
          )}
          {!showLeverageBottomSheet && firstLeverage && leverage?.enabled && isLeverage && (
            <AvailableLeverage onClose={onCloseFirstLeverageMsg} />
          )}
          {!isMobile && Leverage}
        </div>
        {isMobile && (
          <div>
            <AddonBottom>
              <div className={cn(styles.footer, styles.footerMobile)}>
                {isMobile && Leverage}
                {FooterButton}
              </div>
            </AddonBottom>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {!isMobile && <div className={cn(styles.footer, styles.fixed)}>{FooterButton}</div>}
    </>
  );
};

export default SelectInternalTransfers;

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import SelectProductsAndPortfolios from 'modules/Transfers/components/SelectProductsAndPortfolios';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { useTransfersState } from '../../hooks/useTransfersState';

type Props = {
  fromProductOptions: Option<number>[];
  toProductOptions: Option<number>[];
  fromPortfolioOptions: Option<string>[];
  toPortfolioOptions: Option<string>[];
};

const SelectProductsAndPortfoliosForTransfer = ({
  fromPortfolioOptions,
  fromProductOptions,
  toPortfolioOptions,
  toProductOptions,
}: Props) => {
  const [{ fromProduct, fromPortfolio, toProduct, toPortfolio }, setState] = useTransfersState();

  const { onFromProductSelect, onFromPortfolioSelect, onToProductSelect, onToPortfolioSelect } =
    useMemo(
      () => ({
        onFromProductSelect(option: Option<number>) {
          setState((prev) =>
            prev.fromProduct?.id === option.id
              ? null
              : {
                  fromProduct: option,
                  fromPortfolio: null,
                  toPortfolio: null,
                  toProduct: null,
                },
          );
        },
        onFromPortfolioSelect(option: Option<string>) {
          const fromSubAccountId = Number(option.id.split('_')[1]);

          setState((prev) =>
            prev.fromPortfolio?.id === option.id
              ? null
              : {
                  fromPortfolio: option,
                  fromSubAccountId,
                  toProduct: null,
                  toPortfolio: null,
                },
          );
        },
        onToProductSelect(option: Option<number>) {
          setState((prev) =>
            prev.toProduct?.id === option.id
              ? null
              : {
                  toProduct: option,
                  toPortfolio: null,
                },
          );
        },
        onToPortfolioSelect(option: Option<string>) {
          const toSubAccountId = Number(option.id.split('_')[1]);
          setState({ toPortfolio: option, toSubAccountId });
        },
      }),
      [setState],
    );

  return (
    <>
      <SelectProductsAndPortfolios
        title="Со счёта"
        products={fromProductOptions}
        portfolios={fromPortfolioOptions}
        selectedProduct={fromProduct || undefined}
        selectedPortfolio={fromPortfolio || undefined}
        productDescrTitle="Всего средств"
        portfolioDescrTitle="Средств в портфеле"
        onProductSelect={onFromProductSelect}
        onPortfolioSelect={onFromPortfolioSelect}
        showHints
      />
      <SelectProductsAndPortfolios
        title="На счёт"
        products={toProductOptions}
        portfolios={toPortfolioOptions}
        selectedProduct={toProduct || undefined}
        selectedPortfolio={toPortfolio || undefined}
        productDescrTitle="Всего средств"
        portfolioDescrTitle="Средств в портфеле"
        onProductSelect={onToProductSelect}
        onPortfolioSelect={onToPortfolioSelect}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default SelectProductsAndPortfoliosForTransfer;

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_360, ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY } from 'const/routes';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { useTransfersState } from '../../hooks/useTransfersState';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const SuccessTransfer = () => {
  const [
    {
      fromProduct,
      fromPortfolio,
      toProduct,
      toPortfolio,
      currencyCode,
      transferAmount,
      freeBalance,
    },
  ] = useTransfersState();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const onReadyButtonClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_360);
  const onHistoryButtonClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY);

  const getBalanceChange = () => {
    if (!currencyCode) return;
    const formattedBalance = Number(new BigNumber(freeBalance as number).toFixed(2));
    const prevBalance = `${sumFormatter(formattedBalance)} ${currencySign(currencyCode)}`;
    const currentBalance = `${sumFormatter(
      formattedBalance - Number(transferAmount),
    )} ${currencySign(currencyCode)}`;
    return (
      <p>
        <span className={styles.lineThrough}>{prevBalance}</span> → {currentBalance}
      </p>
    );
  };

  return (
    <AdaptivePopup
      open
      onDismiss={onReadyButtonClick}
      bottomSheetProps={{
        snapPoints: ({ minHeight }) => [minHeight],
        header: false,
      }}
      classNameContent={styles.popup}
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.header}>
          <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.line}>
            Сумма перевода
          </Text>
          {transferAmount && currencyCode && (
            <Text type="headline">{`${sumFormatter(transferAmount)} ${currencySign(
              currencyCode,
            )}`}</Text>
          )}
          <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.line}>
            Осталось в портфеле
          </Text>
          <Text type="bodyMedium">{getBalanceChange()}</Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.contentWrapper}>
          <div className={styles.content}>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.divide}>
              Перевод осуществялется в течение 30 минут с 6:45 до 19:00 в рабочие дни
            </Text>
            <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.label} tag="div">
              Со счёта
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.account}>
              {fromProduct?.title}
            </Text>
            <Text type="labelRegular" className={cn(styles.label, styles.portfolio, styles.divide)}>
              {fromPortfolio?.title}
            </Text>
            <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.label} tag="div">
              На счёт
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.account}>
              {toProduct?.title}
            </Text>
            <Text type="labelRegular" className={cn(styles.label, styles.portfolio, styles.divide)}>
              {toPortfolio?.title}
            </Text>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.btnWrapper}>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              className={styles.historyBtn}
              onClick={onHistoryButtonClick}
            >
              К Истории
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={onReadyButtonClick}>Готово</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopup>

import { Fragment, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useMoneyTransferMutation } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { isRetriableOTPConfirmError } from 'utils/oneTimePassword';

import BlockedContent from 'modules/Transfers/components/BlockedContent';

import { AdaptivePopup, HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';

import { useTransfersState } from '../../hooks/useTransfersState';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  onBackClick?: () => void;
};

const TransferSmsConfirmation = ({ onBackClick }: Props) => {
  const [
    {
      fromPortfolio,
      toPortfolio,
      currencyId,
      transferAmount,
      fromSubAccountId,
      toSubAccountId,
      freeBalance,
      freeBalanceWithLeverage,
    },
    setState,
  ] = useTransfersState();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [
    moneyTransferRequestMutate,
    {
      data: moneyTransferRequestResponse,
      isError: isErrorMoneyTransferRequest,
      isSuccess: isSuccessMoneyTransferRequest,
      isLoading: isLoadingMoneyTransferRequest,
    },
  ] = useMoneyTransferMutation();

  useEffect(() => {
    const fromPortfolioId = fromPortfolio?.id.split('_')[0];
    const toPortfolioId = toPortfolio?.id.split('_')[0];
    moneyTransferRequestMutate({
      portfolioId: fromPortfolioId as string,
      subAccountId: fromSubAccountId as number,
      toPortfolioId: toPortfolioId as string,
      toSubAccountId: toSubAccountId as number,
      currencyId: currencyId as number,
      volume: transferAmount as number,
      freeBalance: freeBalance as number,
      freeBalanceWithLeverage: freeBalanceWithLeverage as number,
    });
  }, [
    moneyTransferRequestMutate,
    fromPortfolio?.id,
    fromSubAccountId,
    toPortfolio?.id,
    toSubAccountId,
    currencyId,
    transferAmount,
    freeBalance,
    freeBalanceWithLeverage,
  ]);

  const Wrapper = isMobile ? Fragment : AdaptivePopup;

  const handleCLoseBtn = useCallback(() => {
    onBackClick?.();
  }, [onBackClick]);

  return (
    <Wrapper
      open={true}
      onDismiss={handleCLoseBtn}
      classNameContent={styles.contentDesktop}
      className={styles.wrapperDesktopF}
    >
      {isLoadingMoneyTransferRequest && (
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          {isMobile ? (
            <HeaderPage
              size="small"
              title="SMS-подтверждение"
              leftIconVariant="back"
              onLeftIconClick={onBackClick}
            />
          ) : (
            <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.popupTitle}>
              SMS-подтверждение
            </Text>
          )}
          <CircleLoader brandColor type="page" />
        </div>
      )}
      {isSuccessMoneyTransferRequest && (
        <>
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            {!isMobile && (
              <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.popupTitle}>
                SMS-подтверждение
              </Text>
            )}
            <SmsConfirmation
              initialOTPChallenge={moneyTransferRequestResponse?.otpChallenge}
              smsInputCount={4}
              onBackClick={onBackClick}
              onSuccess={() => {
                setState({ step: 'SUCCESS' });
              }}
              onError={(error) => {
                if (!isRetriableOTPConfirmError(error)) {
                  setState({ step: 'FAILED' });
                }
              }}
              loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется перевод денежных средств...</Text>}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {isErrorMoneyTransferRequest && <BlockedContent type="error" />}
    </Wrapper>
  );
};

export default TransferSmsConfirmation;

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import {
  PortfolioCurrencyWithdrawal,
  PortfolioNontradeOperationMatrix,
  ProductBalance,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

const getDisabledSlug = (categoryCode: string, hasOperations: boolean): string => {
  return !hasOperations
    ? 'TRANSFER_INTERNAL_NO_ASSETS'
    : categoryCode.startsWith('IIA.')
    ? 'TRANSFER_INTERNAL_IIA'
    : 'TRADEMATIC.AUTO' === categoryCode
    ? 'TRANSFER_INTERNAL_MODEL'
    : 'TRANSFER_INTERNAL_OTHER_ACCOUNTS';
};

export const prepareProductOption = ({
  balanceByProductId,
  productId,
  disabled = false,
  hint = false,
  hasOperations = true,
}: {
  balanceByProductId: Map<number, ProductBalance>;
  productId: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  hint?: boolean;
  hasOperations?: boolean;
}): Option<number> => {
  const {
    currencyBalance,
    currencyCode = '',
    productFullName: title = '',
    productCategoryCode = '',
  } = balanceByProductId.get(productId) ?? {};

  const description =
    disabled && hint
      ? getDisabledSlug(productCategoryCode, hasOperations)
      : typeof currencyBalance === 'number'
      ? `${sumFormatter(currencyBalance)} ${currencySign(currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType)}`
      : '–';

  return {
    id: productId,
    title,
    description,
    disabled,
  };
};

const PROFILIES = {
  UNIFIED_BROKERAGE_ACCOUNT: 'Единый брокерский счет',
  MOSCOW_STOCK_MARKET: 'Фондовый рынок Московской биржи',
  PETERSBURG_STOCK_MARKET: 'Фондовый Рынок Санкт-Петербургской биржи',
};

export type PreparedPortfolio = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  productId: number;
  balance: number;
  currencyCode: string;
  portfolioId: number;
  subAccountId: number;
};

export const preparePortfolioOptions = (portfolios: PreparedPortfolio[]) => {
  const options = Object.entries(
    portfolios.reduce((acc, portfolio) => {
      const data = acc[portfolio.id];
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        data.push(portfolio);
      } else {
        acc[String(portfolio.id)] = [portfolio];
      }

      return acc;
    }, {} as Record<string, PreparedPortfolio[]>),
  ).map(([id, items]) => {
    const itemsWithBalance = items.filter((item) => item.balance !== 0);
    const description =
      itemsWithBalance
        .map(
          ({ balance, currencyCode = '' }) =>
            `${sumFormatter(balance)} ${currencySign(currencyCode as PriceCurrencyType)}`,
        )
        .join(' • ') || '0';

    return {
      id,
      title: items[0].name,
      description,
      disabled: false,
    };
  });
  const portfolioMap = Object.fromEntries(options.map((item) => [item.title, item]));
  const sortedPortfolios = [
    ...[
      portfolioMap[PROFILIES.UNIFIED_BROKERAGE_ACCOUNT] &&
        portfolioMap[PROFILIES.UNIFIED_BROKERAGE_ACCOUNT],
      portfolioMap[PROFILIES.MOSCOW_STOCK_MARKET] && portfolioMap[PROFILIES.MOSCOW_STOCK_MARKET],
      portfolioMap[PROFILIES.PETERSBURG_STOCK_MARKET] &&
        portfolioMap[PROFILIES.PETERSBURG_STOCK_MARKET],
    ].filter(Boolean),
    ...options.filter(({ title }) => !Object.values(PROFILIES).includes(title)),
  ];
  return sortedPortfolios;
};

const priorityCurrencies: PriceCurrencyType[] = ['RUB', 'USD', 'EUR'];

export type PreparedCurrency = {
  operations: PortfolioNontradeOperationMatrix[];
  fromProductId: number | null | undefined;
  toProductId: number | null | undefined;
  fromPortfolioId: string | null | undefined;
  toPortfolioId: string | null | undefined;
  currencyNames: Map<string, string>;
  withdrawalCurrencies: PortfolioCurrencyWithdrawal[];
};

export const prepareCurrencyOptions = ({
  operations,
  fromPortfolioId,
  fromProductId,
  toPortfolioId,
  toProductId,
  currencyNames,
  withdrawalCurrencies,
}: PreparedCurrency) => {
  const currencySet = new Set<PriceCurrencyType>();

  withdrawalCurrencies.forEach((item) => {
    if (item.productId === fromProductId && String(item.portfolioId) === fromPortfolioId) {
      currencySet.add(item.currencyCode);
    }
  });

  operations.forEach((item) => {
    if (
      item.fromProductId === fromProductId &&
      String(item.fromPortfolioId) === fromPortfolioId &&
      item.toProductId === toProductId &&
      String(item.toPortfolioId) === toPortfolioId
    ) {
      currencySet.add(item.currencyCode);
    }
  });

  const currencyCodes = priorityCurrencies
    .reduce<PriceCurrencyType[]>((acc, code) => {
      if (currencySet.has(code)) {
        currencySet.delete(code);
        acc.push(code);
      }
      return acc;
    }, [])
    .concat(Array.from(currencySet));

  return currencyCodes.map<Option<string>>((code) => ({
    id: code,
    title: currencyNames.get(code) ?? code,
    value: code,
    currency: currencySign(code as PriceCurrencyType) || '',
    icon: currencySign(code as PriceCurrencyType) || '',
  }));
};

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import { useMoneyCrossCurrenciesQuery } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { MoneyCrossCurrenciesParams } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

export const useCurrencyOptions = (params: MoneyCrossCurrenciesParams) => {
  const {
    data,
    isSuccess,
  } = useMoneyCrossCurrenciesQuery(params, {
    skip: !Object.values(params).every((value) => value != null && Number.isFinite(Number(value))),
  });

  return useMemo(() => {
    const currencies = new Map<string, number>();
    if (!isSuccess) {
      return {
        currencyOptions: [],
        currencies,
      };
    }

    return {
      currencyOptions: data
        .map<Option<string>>(({ code, name }) => ({
          id: code,
          title: name,
          value: code,
          currency: currencySign(code as PriceCurrencyType) || '',
          icon: currencySign(code as PriceCurrencyType) || '',
        })),
      currencies: data.reduce(
        (acc, { code, currencyId }) => acc.set(code, currencyId),
        currencies,
      ),
    };
  }, [isSuccess, data]);
};

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import { useGetMoneyOperationParamsQuery } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { ProductBalance } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

const DEFAULT_CURRENCY_CODE = 'RUB';

export const useMoneyOperationParams = () => {
  const { data, isError, isLoading, isSuccess } = useGetMoneyOperationParamsQuery();

  const moneyParameters = useMemo(() => {
    const balanceMap = new Map<number, ProductBalance>();
    if (!data) {
      return {
        balanceMap,
        portfolios: [],
        operationMatrix: [],
        withdrawalCurrencies: [],
        hasUnavailableCurrencies: false,
      };
    }

    data.productBalance.forEach((item) => balanceMap.set(item.productId, item));

    const portfolios = data.productBalanceVacantMoney.map(
      ({ balance, currencyCode, portfolioFullName, portfolioId, productId, subAccountId }) => ({
        id: `${portfolioId}_${subAccountId}`,
        name: portfolioFullName,
        productId: productId,
        portfolioId,
        subAccountId,
        balance: balance,
        currencyCode:
          currencyCode ?? balanceMap.get(productId)?.currencyCode ?? DEFAULT_CURRENCY_CODE,
      }),
    );

    const hasUnavailableCurrencies = data.productBalanceVacantMoney.some(({ currencyCode }) =>
      ['KZT', 'AMD', 'UZS', 'BYN'].includes(currencyCode),
    );

    return {
      balanceMap,
      portfolios,
      operationMatrix: data.portfolioNontradeOperationMatrix,
      withdrawalCurrencies: data.portfolioCurrencyWithdrawal,
      hasUnavailableCurrencies,
    };
  }, [data]);

  return {
    isError,
    isLoading,
    isSuccess,
    moneyParameters,
  };
};

import { createContext, Dispatch, useContext } from 'react';
import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { Option } from 'components'

export type State = {
  fromProduct: Option<number> | null;
  fromPortfolio: Option<string> | null;
  toProduct: Option<number> | null;
  toPortfolio: Option<string> | null;
  currencyId: number | null;
  currencyCode: PriceCurrencyType | null;
  transferAmount: number | null;
  fromSubAccountId: number | null;
  toSubAccountId: number | null;
  freeBalance: number | null;
  freeBalanceWithLeverage: number | null;
  step: 'FILL_IN' | 'CONFIRM' | 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED';
};

export const initialState: State = {
  fromProduct: null,
  fromPortfolio: null,
  toProduct: null,
  toPortfolio: null,
  currencyId: null,
  currencyCode: null,
  transferAmount: null,
  fromSubAccountId: null,
  toSubAccountId: null,
  freeBalance: null,
  freeBalanceWithLeverage: null,
  step: 'FILL_IN',
};

export type ActionState = Partial<State> | ((state: State) => Partial<State> | null) | null;

export const reducer = (state: State, update: ActionState): State => {
  const changes = typeof update === 'function' ? update(state) : update;

  if (changes === null) return state;

  return {
    ...state,
    ...changes,
  };
};

export const TransfersContextState = createContext(initialState);
export const TransfersContextDispatch = createContext<Dispatch<ActionState>>(() => null);

export const useTransfersState = (): [State, Dispatch<ActionState>] => {
  const state = useContext(TransfersContextState);
  const setState = useContext(TransfersContextDispatch);

  return [state, setState];
};

import { useReducer } from 'react';

import UnavailableContent from 'components/UnavailableContent';
import { getInternalTransferPermission } from 'modules/Transfers/permissions';

import InternalTransfers from './InternalTransfers';
import {
  TransfersContextDispatch,
  TransfersContextState,
  initialState,
  reducer,
} from './hooks/useTransfersState';

const InternalTransfersPage = () => {
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(reducer, initialState);
  const transferPermission = getInternalTransferPermission();

  return (
    <TransfersContextState.Provider value={state}>
      <TransfersContextDispatch.Provider value={setState}>
        {!transferPermission.isGranted ? (
          <UnavailableContent headerTitle="Перевод" />
        ) : (
          <InternalTransfers />
        )}
      </TransfersContextDispatch.Provider>
    </TransfersContextState.Provider>
  );
};

export default InternalTransfersPage;
