import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import SelectInternalTransfer from './components/SelectInternalTransfer';
import { FailedTransfer, SuccessTransfer } from './components/StatusTransfer';
import TransferSmsConfirmation from './components/TransferSmsConfirmation';
import { initialState, useTransfersState } from './hooks/useTransfersState';

const InternalTransfers = () => {
  const [{ step }, setState] = useTransfersState();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const reset = () => {
    setState(initialState);
  };

  return (
    <>
      {(step === 'FILL_IN' || (step === 'CONFIRM' && !isMobile)) && <SelectInternalTransfer />}
      {step === 'CONFIRM' && <TransferSmsConfirmation onBackClick={reset} />}
      {step === 'SUCCESS' && <SuccessTransfer />}
      {step === 'FAILED' && <FailedTransfer />}
    </>
  );
};

export default InternalTransfers;

import { CopyToClipboard } from 'react-copy-to-clipboard';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { PaymentArray } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import { ReactComponent as CopySvg } from 'images/raw-icons/copy.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  title: string;
  value?: string;
};

const BankDetailField = ({ title, value }: Props) => {
  const onCopy = () => {
    if (value) {
      createAlertNotification({
        text: 'Скопировано',
        status: 'info',
        className: styles.copyAlert,
      });
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className={styles.detail}>
      <div>
        <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.detailTitle}>
          {title}
        </Text>
        <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.detailDes}>
          {value}
        </Text>
      </div>
      <CopyToClipboard text={value || ''} onCopy={onCopy}>
        <div className={styles.copyIcon}>
          <CopySvg />
        </div>
      </CopyToClipboard>
    </div>
  );
};

type BankDetailProps = {
  bankDetail: PaymentArray;
  selectedCurrencyCode: string;
  className?: string;
};

const BankDetails = ({ bankDetail, selectedCurrencyCode, className }: BankDetailProps) => {
  return (
    <section className={className}>
      <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.bankTitle}>
        Перечислите средства на реквизиты
      </Text>
      <div>
        <BankDetailField title="Наименование банка" value={bankDetail.bankName} />
        <BankDetailField title="Получатель" value={bankDetail.payee} />
        <BankDetailField title="БИК" value={bankDetail.bic} />
        {selectedCurrencyCode === 'RUB' && (
          <BankDetailField title="Корреспондентский счет" value={bankDetail.corrAccount} />
        )}
        <BankDetailField
          title={
            selectedCurrencyCode === 'RUB'
              ? 'Расчётный счет'
              : `Транзитный счет для спец. брокер. в ${selectedCurrencyCode}`
          }
          value={bankDetail.bankAccount}
        />
        {bankDetail.swift && (
          <BankDetailField title="SWIFT банка получателя" value={bankDetail.swift} />
        )}
        <BankDetailField title="ИНН" value={bankDetail.inn} />
        <BankDetailField title="КПП" value={bankDetail.kpp} />
        <BankDetailField title="Назначение платежа" value={bankDetail.paymentPurpose} />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

export default BankDetails;

import { memo, useEffect } from 'react';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import QRCode from 'qrcode.react';

import { useShareFile } from 'hooks/useShareFile';

import { useRefillState } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useRefillState';
import { PaymentArray } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ShareIcon } from 'images/icons/share.svg';

import styles from '../SbpQRCode/styles.module.pcss';
import { generateQRValue } from './helpers';

type Props = {
  open: boolean;
  onDismiss: () => void;
};

const BankDetailsQRCode = ({ open, onDismiss }: Props) => {
  const [{ selectedBankDetail }] = useRefillState();
  const { generatingImage, file, ref, shareHandler } = useShareFile();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (file.current) {
      file.current = undefined;
    }
    //eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [selectedBankDetail]);

  return (
    <AdaptivePopup open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        {
          <>
            <Text type="subtitleBold">Ваш QR-код</Text>
            <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.text}>
              Отправьте код на другое устройство и отсканируйте его в своём банке
            </Text>
            <div className={styles.qrCodeWrapper} ref={ref}>
              <QRCode
                id="qrCode"
                value={generateQRValue(selectedBankDetail as PaymentArray)}
                size={234}
                includeMargin={true}
              />
            </div>
            <ol className={styles.list}>
              <li className={styles.listItem}>1. Зайдите в приложение вашего банка</li>
              <li className={styles.listItem}>2. Выберите «Оплата по QR-коду»</li>
              <li className={styles.listItem}>3. Наведите камеру на QR-код</li>
              <li className={styles.listItem}>4. Реквизиты заполнятся автоматически</li>
            </ol>
            <Button iconLeft={<ShareIcon />} onClick={shareHandler} loading={generatingImage}>
              Поделиться
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopup>
  );
};

export default memo(BankDetailsQRCode);

import { PaymentArray } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

export const generateQRValue = (
  item: Pick<
    PaymentArray,
    'payee' | 'bankAccount' | 'bankName' | 'bic' | 'corrAccount' | 'inn' | 'kpp' | 'paymentPurpose'
  >,
) => {
  const value =
    'ST00012|' +
    `Name=${item.payee}|` +
    `PersonalAcc=${item.bankAccount}|` +
    `BankName=${item.bankName}|` +
    `BIC=${item.bic}|` +
    `CorrespAcc=${item.corrAccount}|` +
    `PayeeINN=${item.inn}|` +
    `KPP=${item.kpp}|` +
    `Purpose=${item.paymentPurpose}`;

  return value;
};

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { useRefillState } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useRefillState';
import { BrokerBankAccountsResponse, PaymentArray } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { AdaptivePopover, CardButton, Option, OptionsList } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import { parsePortfolioKey } from '../../helpers';
import BankDetails from '../BankDetails';
import Currencies from '../CurrencySelect';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type BankSelectProps = {
  brokerBankParams: BrokerBankAccountsResponse;
  filteredCurrencies: Option<PriceCurrencyType>[];
};

const BankSelect = ({ brokerBankParams, filteredCurrencies }: BankSelectProps) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const [
    { selectedCurrencyCode, selectedProductId, selectedBankDetail, selectedPortfolioKey },
    setState,
  ] = useRefillState();

  const [selectedPortfolioId] = parsePortfolioKey(selectedPortfolioKey);

  const filteredBankDetails = useMemo(() => {
    const bankDetailsMap = brokerBankParams.paymentArray.reduce((acc, el) => {
      if (
        el.bankDetailsId &&
        !acc.get(el.bankDetailsId) &&
        el.currencyCode === selectedCurrencyCode &&
        el.portfolioId === selectedPortfolioId &&
        el.productId === selectedProductId
      ) {
        acc.set(el.bankDetailsId, el);
      }
      return acc;
    }, new Map<number, PaymentArray>());
    return Array.from(bankDetailsMap.values());
  }, [brokerBankParams.paymentArray, selectedPortfolioId, selectedCurrencyCode, selectedProductId]);

  const onBankDetailsSelect = (option: Option<number>) => {
    const selectedBankDetail = filteredBankDetails.find((el) => el.bankDetailsId === option.id);
    setState({ selectedBankDetail: selectedBankDetail });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (filteredBankDetails[0]) {
      setState({ selectedBankDetail: filteredBankDetails[0] });
    }
  }, [filteredBankDetails, setState]);

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const options = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredBankDetails.map((el) => {
      return {
        id: el.bankDetailsId,
        title: el.bankName || '',
      };
    }) as Option<number>[];
  }, [filteredBankDetails]);

  const selectedBank = options.find((el) => el.id === selectedBankDetail?.bankDetailsId);

  return (
    <div>
      <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.bankTitle}>
        Банк
      </Text>
      <div className={styles.bankSelectWrapper}>
        <AdaptivePopover
          isOpen={open}
          onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
          button={
            <CardButton
              title={selectedBankDetail?.bankName || ''}
              className={styles.bankSelect}
              classNameHeader={styles.cardName}
              classNameTitle={cn(styles.cardTitle, styles.cardText)}
              classNameTextWrapper={styles.cardText}
              onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
            />
          }
          className={styles.popoverWrapper}
        >
          <div className={styles.bottomSheetContent}>
            {isMobile && (
              <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.name}>
                Выберите банк
              </Text>
            )}
            <OptionsList
              options={options}
              selectedOption={selectedBank}
              onChange={onBankDetailsSelect}
              onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
            />
          </div>
        </AdaptivePopover>
        <Currencies
          currencies={filteredCurrencies}
          selectedCurrencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
          onCurrencyChange={(value) =>
            setState({ selectedCurrencyCode: value.id as PriceCurrencyType })
          }
        />
      </div>
      <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.cardComment} tag="div">
        Банк, с которого отправляются средства
      </Text>

      {brokerBankParams && selectedBankDetail && (
        <BankDetails
          bankDetail={selectedBankDetail}
          selectedCurrencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode || ''}
          className={cn({ [styles.bankDetailsWrapper]: !isMobile })}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default BankSelect;

import { useState } from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { AdaptivePopover, CardButton, OptionsList } from 'components';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';
import { CurrenciesProps } from './types';

const Currencies = ({ currencies, selectedCurrencyCode, onCurrencyChange }: CurrenciesProps) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleBottomSheetDismiss = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const selectedCurrency =
    currencies.find((el) => el.id === selectedCurrencyCode) ||
    currencies.find((el) => el.id === 'RUB');

  return (
    <AdaptivePopover
      isOpen={open}
      onDismiss={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
      button={
        <CardButton
          title={
            selectedCurrency && currencySign(selectedCurrency.id)
              ? currencySign(selectedCurrency.id)
              : currencySign('RUB')
          }
          className={styles.cardWrapper}
          classNameTitle={styles.cardTitle}
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        />
      }
      classNameContent={styles.popover}
    >
      <div className={cn({ [styles.bottomSheetContent]: isMobile })}>
        {isMobile && (
          <Text type="subtitleBold" className={styles.name}>
            Выберите валюту
          </Text>
        )}
        <div className={styles.optionsListsContainer}>
          <OptionsList
            options={currencies}
            selectedOption={selectedCurrency}
            className={cn(styles.optionListWrapper, styles.space)}
            onChange={onCurrencyChange}
            onClick={handleBottomSheetDismiss}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopover>
  );
};

export default Currencies;

import React from 'react';

import {
  PaymentMonetaExternalParameters,
  PaymentMonetaExternalParametersUpperSnakeCase,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

type Props = {
  moneyRefillMonetaParams: PaymentMonetaExternalParameters;
};

const camelToSnakeCase = (str: string) =>
  str.replace(/[A-z]/g, (letter: string) =>
    letter === letter.toUpperCase() ? `_${letter}` : letter.toUpperCase(),
  );

const MonetaPayment = ({ moneyRefillMonetaParams }: Props) => {
  const moneyRefillMonetaParamsFormated = Object.entries(
    moneyRefillMonetaParams,
  ).reduce((acc, [key, value]) => {
    Object.assign(acc, {
      [camelToSnakeCase(key)]: value,
    });
    return acc;
  }, {} as Record<`${keyof PaymentMonetaExternalParametersUpperSnakeCase}`, string>);

  return (
    <form
      style={{ display: 'none' }}
      action={moneyRefillMonetaParams.url}
      method="POST"
      ref={(form) => {
        form && form.submit();
      }}
    >
      {Object.keys(moneyRefillMonetaParamsFormated).map((k) => {
        const key = k as keyof PaymentMonetaExternalParametersUpperSnakeCase;
        if (key === 'URL') return null;
        return (
          <input
            type="hidden"
            name={key}
            value={moneyRefillMonetaParamsFormated[key]}
            key={`input_${key}`}
          />
        );
      })}
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="MNT_SUCCESS_URL"
        value={window.location.href + '?statusPayment=success'}
      />
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="MNT_FAIL_URL"
        value={window.location.href + '?statusPayment=fail'}
      />
      <input type="hidden" name="MNT_RETURN_URL" value={window.location.href} />
      <input type="Submit" value="Отправить" />
    </form>
  );
};

export default MonetaPayment;

export type State = {
  fetchingCountWaiting: number;
  fetchingCountProcessing: number;
  isError: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isSuccessPayment: boolean;
};

export const initialState: State = {
  fetchingCountWaiting: 0,
  fetchingCountProcessing: 0,
  isError: false,
  isLoading: true,
  isSuccessPayment: false,
};

export type ActionState = Partial<State> | ((state: State) => Partial<State> | null) | null;

export const reducer = (state: State, update: ActionState): State => {
  const changes = typeof update === 'function' ? update(state) : update;

  if (changes === null) return state;

  return {
    ...state,
    ...changes,
  };
};

import { memo, useEffect } from 'react';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import QRCode from 'qrcode.react';

import { useShareFile } from 'hooks/useShareFile';

import useSBPQRCode from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useSBPQRCode';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ShareIcon } from 'images/icons/share.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  guid: string;
  open: boolean;
  onDismiss: () => void;
};

const SBPQRCode = ({ guid, open, onDismiss }: Props) => {
  const { SBPState, sbpLink } = useSBPQRCode({ guid, active: open });
  const { generatingImage, file, ref, shareHandler } = useShareFile();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (file.current) {
      file.current = undefined;
    }
    //eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [guid]);

  return (
    <AdaptivePopup open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <>
          <Text type="subtitleBold">Ваш QR-код</Text>
          <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.text}>
            Отправьте код на другое устройство и отсканируйте его в своём банке
          </Text>
          <div className={styles.qrCodeWrapper} ref={ref}>
            {SBPState.isLoading ? (
              <CircleLoader brandColor />
            ) : !SBPState.isError && sbpLink ? (
              <QRCode id="qrCode" value={sbpLink} size={234} includeMargin={true} />
            ) : (
              <section className={styles.fetchError}>
                <div className={styles.fetchErrorText}>Ошибка при запросе формирования QR-кода</div>
              </section>
            )}
          </div>
          <ol className={styles.list}>
            <li className={styles.listItem}>1. Зайдите в приложение вашего банка</li>
            <li className={styles.listItem}>2. Выберите «Оплата по QR-коду»</li>
            <li className={styles.listItem}>3. Наведите камеру на QR-код</li>
            <li className={styles.listItem}>4. Подтвердите оплату</li>
          </ol>
          <Button
            iconLeft={<ShareIcon />}
            onClick={shareHandler}
            disabled={SBPState.isError || (!sbpLink && !SBPState.isError)}
            loading={generatingImage}
          >
            Поделиться
          </Button>
        </>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopup>
  );
};

export default memo(SBPQRCode);

import React from 'react';

import { getApiRequestPersonsAllBrokerBankAccountsPDFFile } from 'core/api/apiConstants';

import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { PaymentSettings } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

export const getAmountError = (paymentSettings: PaymentSettings) => {
  if (!paymentSettings) return null;
  if (paymentSettings.reason === 'PaymentMethod' && paymentSettings.paymentAmount !== undefined)
    return (
      <div>
        Лимит единоразового платежа для данного способа пополнения составляет{' '}
        <span className={styles.limitErrorHighlight}>
          {sumFormatter(paymentSettings.paymentAmount, 0)} {' ₽'}
        </span>
      </div>
    );

  if (paymentSettings.reason === 'DOS' && paymentSettings.dosAmount !== undefined)
    return (
      <>
        <div>
          Остаточный лимит пополнения{' '}
          <span className={styles.limitErrorHighlight}>{paymentSettings.dosAmount}</span>
        </div>
        <br />
        <div>Для снятия ограничения зачислите деньги по реквизитам</div>
      </>
    );

  if (paymentSettings.reason === 'Product' && paymentSettings.productAmount !== undefined)
    return (
      <div>
        В этом году ИИС можно пополнить еще на{' '}
        <span className={styles.limitErrorHighlight}>{paymentSettings.productAmount}</span>
      </div>
    );
};

export const openPDF = (guid: string | undefined) => {
  if (typeof guid === 'string' && guid) {
    const url = getApiRequestPersonsAllBrokerBankAccountsPDFFile(guid);

    const pdfWindow = window.open(url, '_blank');
    if (pdfWindow) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        pdfWindow.document.title = 'Реквизиты';
      }, 1200);
    }
  }
};

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

import { AmountInput, Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { debounce } from 'lodash';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetPaymentSettingsQuery } from 'core/api/transfers';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import ErrorBlock from 'modules/Transfers/components/ErrorBlock';
import PaymentTypeSelect from 'modules/Transfers/components/PaymentTypeSelect';
import SelectProductsAndPortfolios from 'modules/Transfers/components/SelectProductsAndPortfolios';
import BankSelect from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/components/BankSelect';
import Currencies from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/components/CurrencySelect';
import { useBankDetailsPDF } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useBankDetailsPDF';
import { useRefillState } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useRefillState';
import useSBPQRCode from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useSBPQRCode';
import ArrowNextIcon from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/ArrowNextIcon';
import DownloadIcon from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/DownloadIcon';
import QRCodeIcon from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/QRCodeIcon';
import ShareIcon from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/ShareIcon';
import {
  BrokerBankAccountsResponse,
  OrderNonTradeMoneyRefillExtCommission,
  PaymentTypes,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { Option } from 'components';
import AddonBottom from 'components/AddonBottom';
import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';
import ArrowUpIcon from 'components/icons/ArrowUpIcon';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import {
  handlePaymentTypeChange,
  handlePortfolioChange,
  handleProductChange,
  parseBrokerBankAccounts,
  parsePortfolioKey,
  prepareCurrencies,
  preparePortfolioOptions,
  prepareProductOptions,
  validateState,
} from '../../helpers';
import { getAmountError } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const showErrorMessage = () => {
  createAlertNotification({
    text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
    status: 'error',
  });
};

type Props = {
  brokerBankParams: BrokerBankAccountsResponse;
  calcCommission?: OrderNonTradeMoneyRefillExtCommission;
  selectedPaymentType?: PaymentTypes;
  paymentMethod?: PaymentTypes;
  loadingButton: boolean;
  refillSBPGuid: string | null;
  onNextClick: (paymentMethod: PaymentTypes['paymentTypeCode']) => void;
  openQRCode: () => void;
};

const rules = [
  ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    return value[0] !== '0';
  },
  ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    return value.length < 15;
  },
];

const SelectPayment = ({
  brokerBankParams,
  calcCommission,
  selectedPaymentType,
  paymentMethod,
  loadingButton,
  refillSBPGuid,
  onNextClick,
  openQRCode,
}: Props) => {
  const [state, setState] = useRefillState();
  const [isSelectingBottomSheet, setIsSelectingBottomSheet] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const location = useLocation();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const initialRefillAmountValue = ((location.state &&
    (location.state as { refillAmountValue: number }).refillAmountValue) ||
    null) as number | null;
  const [refillAmountValue, setRefillAmountValue] = useState<number | null>(
    initialRefillAmountValue,
  );
  const [amountInputFocused, setAmountInputFocused] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [refillSBPPayment, setRefillSBPPayment] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const { SBPState, sbpLink, resetQRCodePaymentParams } = useSBPQRCode({
    guid: refillSBPGuid,
    active: refillSBPPayment,
  });
  const {
    selectedPortfolioKey,
    selectedProductId,
    selectedCurrencyCode,
    selectedPaymentTypeCode,
    refillAmount,
  } = state;

  const {
    data: paymentSetting,
    isSuccess: isSuccessPaymentSettingStatus,
    isError: isErrorPaymentSettingStatus,
    isLoading: isLoadingPaymentSettingStatus,
  } = useGetPaymentSettingsQuery(
    {
      selectedProductId,
      paymentMethod: selectedPaymentTypeCode,
    },
    {
      skip:
        !selectedProductId ||
        selectedPaymentTypeCode === 'BFKO' ||
        selectedPaymentTypeCode === 'BANK_DETAILS',
    },
  );

  const { products, portfolios } = useMemo(() => {
    return parseBrokerBankAccounts(brokerBankParams);
  }, [brokerBankParams]);

  const productOptions = useMemo(() => {
    return prepareProductOptions(products);
  }, [products]);

  const portfoliosOptions = useMemo(() => {
    return preparePortfolioOptions(portfolios, selectedProductId);
  }, [portfolios, selectedProductId]);

  const [selectedPortfolioId] = parsePortfolioKey(selectedPortfolioKey);

  const filteredPaymentArray = useMemo(() => {
    return brokerBankParams.paymentArray.filter((item) => {
      return item.productId === selectedProductId && item.portfolioId === selectedPortfolioId;
    });
  }, [brokerBankParams.paymentArray, selectedProductId, selectedPortfolioId]);

  const paymentTypesByCurrenciesMap = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredPaymentArray.reduce((acc, item) => {
      const existedKey = acc.get(item.currencyCode);
      if (existedKey) {
        acc.set(item.currencyCode, [...existedKey, item.paymentTypeCode]);
      } else {
        acc.set(item.currencyCode, [item.paymentTypeCode]);
      }
      return acc;
    }, new Map<string, string[]>());
  }, [filteredPaymentArray]);

  const filteredPaymentTypes = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedCurrencyCode) return [];
    return brokerBankParams.paymentTypes.filter((item) => {
      return (
        paymentTypesByCurrenciesMap.get(selectedCurrencyCode)?.includes(item.paymentTypeCode) &&
        item.paymentTypeCode !== 'BFKO'
      );
    });
  }, [brokerBankParams.paymentTypes, paymentTypesByCurrenciesMap, selectedCurrencyCode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      !selectedPaymentTypeCode ||
      !filteredPaymentTypes.some(
        ({ paymentTypeCode }) => paymentTypeCode === selectedPaymentTypeCode,
      )
    ) {
      setState({
        selectedPaymentTypeCode: filteredPaymentTypes[0]?.paymentTypeCode,
      });
    }
  }, [filteredPaymentTypes, selectedCurrencyCode, selectedPaymentTypeCode, setState]);

  const filteredCurrencies = useMemo(() => {
    return prepareCurrencies(filteredPaymentArray);
  }, [filteredPaymentArray]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      filteredCurrencies[0]?.id &&
      (!selectedCurrencyCode || !filteredCurrencies.some(({ id }) => id === selectedCurrencyCode))
    ) {
      setState({ selectedCurrencyCode: filteredCurrencies[0]?.id });
    }
  }, [filteredCurrencies, selectedCurrencyCode, setState]);

  const debounceRefillAmountChange = useMemo(() => {
    return debounce((value: number) => {
      setState({ refillAmount: value });
    }, 500);
  }, [setState]);

  const onProductSelect = (option: Option<number>) => {
    const { products, portfolios, paymentArray } = brokerBankParams;
    setState(handleProductChange({ products, portfolios, paymentArray, productId: option.id }));

    reachGoal('pizza', 'click_acc');
  };

  const onPortfolioSelect = (option: Option<string>) => {
    setState(
      handlePortfolioChange({
        paymentArray: brokerBankParams.paymentArray,
        portfolioKey: option.id,
      }),
    );
    reachGoal('pizza', 'click_acc');
  };

  const onPaymentTypeSelect = (option: Option<string>) => {
    setState(
      handlePaymentTypeChange({
        paymentArray: brokerBankParams.paymentArray,
        paymentTypeCode: option.id,
      }),
    );
  };

  const onRefillAmountChange = ({ floatValue }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    setRefillAmountValue(floatValue || null);
  };

  const onRefillAmountBlur = () => {
    debounceRefillAmountChange.flush();
    setAmountInputFocused(false);
  };

  const setAmountInputFocus = () => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    ref.current.focus();
  };

  const openSBPLink = () => {
    if (!sbpLink) return;
    setRefillSBPPayment(false);
    window.location.href = sbpLink;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (refillAmountValue) {
      debounceRefillAmountChange(refillAmountValue);
      if (resetQRCodePaymentParams) {
        setRefillSBPPayment(false);
        resetQRCodePaymentParams();
      }
    }
    //eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [debounceRefillAmountChange, refillAmountValue]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (SBPState.isError || !SBPState.isLoading) {
      SBPState.isError && showErrorMessage();
      setRefillSBPPayment(false);
    }
  }, [SBPState.isError, SBPState.isLoading]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sbpLink) setState({ sbpLink: null });
    if (refillSBPPayment) setRefillSBPPayment(false);
    setRefillAmountValue(refillAmount);
    //eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [refillAmount]);

  const selectedPortfolio = portfolios.find((el) => el.portfolioId === selectedPortfolioId);
  const selectedOptionProduct = productOptions.find((el) => el.id === selectedProductId);
  const selectedOptionPortfolio = portfoliosOptions.find((el) => el.id === selectedPortfolioKey);

  const isErrorAmountValue = paymentSetting
    ? Number(refillAmount) > paymentSetting.availableAmount
    : false;

  const portfoliosError = !portfoliosOptions.length && !isSelectingBottomSheet;
  const paymentTypesError =
    !filteredPaymentTypes.length && !portfoliosError && !isSelectingBottomSheet;
  const currenciesError =
    !filteredCurrencies.length && !paymentTypesError && !portfoliosError && !isSelectingBottomSheet;
  const isErrorParams = portfoliosError || paymentTypesError || currenciesError;

  const amountAccountAfterEnrollment = (() => {
    const productCurrencyEvaluation = selectedPortfolio?.portfolioCurrencyEvaluation?.find((el) => {
      return selectedCurrencyCode === el.currencyCode;
    });
    if (!productCurrencyEvaluation || !refillAmount || !refillAmountValue)
      return `0 ${currencySign('RUB')}`;

    return `${sumFormatter(
      new BigNumber(productCurrencyEvaluation.balance + Number(refillAmount)).toNumber(),
    )} ${currencySign(productCurrencyEvaluation.currencyCode)}`;
  })();

  const isButtonDisabled =
    portfoliosError ||
    paymentTypesError ||
    currenciesError ||
    !paymentMethod ||
    !validateState({
      ...state,
      paymentMethodCode: paymentMethod.paymentTypeCode,
    }) ||
    (paymentMethod.paymentTypeCode !== 'BANK_DETAILS' && isErrorAmountValue);

  const useSBPPay = () => {
    ref?.current?.blur();
    if (SBPState.isError) {
      showErrorMessage();
    } else {
      if (sbpLink) {
        openSBPLink();
      } else {
        setRefillSBPPayment(true);
      }
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!refillSBPPayment) return;
    openSBPLink();
    //eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [sbpLink]);

  const handleClickBtn = () => {
    if (paymentMethod) {
      onNextClick(paymentMethod.paymentTypeCode);
    }
  };

  const { handleLoadPDF, isPDFLoading } = useBankDetailsPDF(selectedPortfolioId, isMobile);

  const Buttons = () => {
    const defaultBtn = (
      <Button
        className={cn({ [styles.btnMobile]: isMobile })}
        variant="secondary"
        size="s"
        iconRight={isMobile && <ArrowUpIcon />}
        onClick={setAmountInputFocus}
      >
        <Text type="lineMedium">Введите сумму</Text>
      </Button>
    );
    if (
      !paymentMethod ||
      (!(refillAmountValue || amountInputFocused) &&
        paymentMethod.paymentTypeCode !== 'BANK_DETAILS')
    ) {
      return defaultBtn;
    }

    switch (paymentMethod.paymentTypeCode) {
      case 'BANK_DETAILS':
        return (
          <div className={styles.btnWrapper}>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="s"
              onClick={openQRCode}
              iconLeft={<QRCodeIcon isBlack={!isMobile} />}
              className={cn(styles.qrBtn, { [styles.btnMobile]: isMobile })}
            >
              <Text type="lineMedium">Показать QR</Text>
            </Button>
            <Button
              className={cn({ [styles.btnMobile]: isMobile })}
              variant="secondary"
              size="s"
              iconRight={isMobile && <ShareIcon disabled={isButtonDisabled || loadingButton} />}
              iconLeft={!isMobile && <DownloadIcon />}
              disabled={isButtonDisabled}
              loading={isMobile ? loadingButton : isPDFLoading}
              onClick={isMobile ? handleClickBtn : handleLoadPDF}
            >
              <Text type="lineMedium">{isMobile ? 'Поделиться' : 'Скачать PDF'}</Text>
            </Button>
          </div>
        );
      case 'MONETA':
        return (
          <Button
            className={cn({ [styles.btnMobile]: isMobile })}
            variant="secondary"
            size="s"
            iconRight={
              isMobile && (
                <ArrowNextIcon
                  disabled={
                    isButtonDisabled || loadingButton || (amountInputFocused && !refillAmountValue)
                  }
                />
              )
            }
            disabled={
              isButtonDisabled || loadingButton || (amountInputFocused && !refillAmountValue)
            }
            loading={loadingButton}
            onClick={() => onNextClick(paymentMethod.paymentTypeCode)}
          >
            <Text type="lineMedium">Пополнить</Text>
          </Button>
        );
      case 'SBP':
        return (
          <div className={cn(styles.btnWrapper, { [styles.oneBtn]: !refillAmountValue })}>
            {refillAmountValue && !isButtonDisabled && paymentMethod.paymentTypeCode === 'SBP' && (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                size="s"
                onClick={openQRCode}
                iconLeft={<QRCodeIcon isBlack={!isMobile} />}
                className={cn(styles.qrBtn, { [styles.btnMobile]: isMobile })}
              >
                <Text type="lineMedium">Показать QR</Text>
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button
              className={cn({ [styles.btnMobile]: isMobile })}
              variant="secondary"
              size="s"
              iconRight={
                isMobile && (
                  <ArrowNextIcon
                    disabled={
                      (refillSBPPayment && SBPState.isLoading) ||
                      (amountInputFocused && !refillAmountValue) ||
                      isButtonDisabled ||
                      loadingButton
                    }
                  />
                )
              }
              loading={refillSBPPayment && SBPState.isLoading}
              disabled={
                (refillSBPPayment && SBPState.isLoading) ||
                isButtonDisabled ||
                (amountInputFocused && !refillAmountValue) ||
                loadingButton
              }
              onClick={useSBPPay}
            >
              <Text type="lineMedium">Пополнить</Text>
            </Button>
          </div>
        );
      default:
        return defaultBtn;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={cn(styles.wrapper, { [styles.desktopWrapper]: !isMobile })}>
      <div>

          products={productOptions}

          selectedPortfolio={selectedOptionPortfolio}

          onPortfolioSelect={onPortfolioSelect}
          productDescrTitle="Доступно на счёте"

        />
        {portfoliosError && (
          <ErrorBlock
            title="Нет доступных портфелей для выбранных параметров"
            description="Выберите другой счёт или обновите страницу"
          />
        )}
        {paymentTypesError && (
          <ErrorBlock
            title="Нет доступных способов пополнений для выбранных параметров"
            description="Выберите другой счёт или обновите страницу"
          />
        )}
        {currenciesError && (
          <ErrorBlock
            title="Нет доступных валют для выбранных параметров"
            description="Выберите другой счёт или обновите страницу"
          />
        )}
        {!!filteredPaymentTypes.length && !isErrorParams && (
          <>
            <PaymentTypeSelect
              selectedPaymentTypeCode={selectedPaymentTypeCode}
              paymentTypes={filteredPaymentTypes}
              onPaymentTypeSelect={onPaymentTypeSelect}
            />
            {isLoadingPaymentSettingStatus && (
              <div className={styles.loader}>
                <CircleLoader brandColor />
              </div>
            )}
            {isErrorPaymentSettingStatus && (
              <ErrorBlock
                title="Ошибка загрузки максимальной суммы"
                description="Попробуйте обновить страницу или выбрать другой способ оплаты"
              />
            )}
          </>
        )}

        {selectedPaymentType &&
          isSuccessPaymentSettingStatus &&
          selectedPaymentType.paymentTypeCode !== 'BFKO' &&
          selectedPaymentType.paymentTypeCode !== 'BANK_DETAILS' && (
            <div>
              <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.amountTitle}>
                Сумма пополнения
              </Text>
              <div className={styles.amountWrapper}>
                <AmountInput
                  suffix=""
                  placeholder="0"
                  value={refillAmountValue || ''}
                  rules={rules}
                  onChange={onRefillAmountChange}
                  onBlur={onRefillAmountBlur}
                  className={styles.amountInput}
                  error={!!(isErrorAmountValue && paymentSetting)}
                  disabled={!brokerBankParams}
                  onFocus={() => setAmountInputFocused(true)}
                  ref={ref}
                />
                <Currencies
                  currencies={filteredCurrencies}
                  selectedCurrencyCode={selectedCurrencyCode}
                  onCurrencyChange={(value) =>
                    setState({ selectedCurrencyCode: value.id as PriceCurrencyType })
                  }
                />
              </div>
              {isErrorAmountValue && paymentSetting && (
                <div className={styles.limitErrorWrapper}>
                  <div className={styles.limitErrorHighlight}>Превышение лимита.</div>
                  {getAmountError(paymentSetting)}
                </div>
              )}
              {refillAmount && refillAmountValue && (
                <>
                  <div className={styles.wrapperColumn}>
                    <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.titleColumn}>
                      Комиссия
                    </Text>
                    <div className={styles.valueColumn}>
                      {isErrorAmountValue
                        ? '—'
                        : (refillAmount &&
                            refillAmountValue &&
                            calcCommission &&
                            `${sumFormatter(calcCommission.commission)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`) ||
                          `0 ${currencySign('RUB')}`}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className={styles.wrapperColumn}>
                    <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.titleColumn}>
                      Сумма с комиссией
                    </Text>
                    <div className={styles.valueColumn}>
                      {isErrorAmountValue
                        ? '—'
                        : refillAmount && refillAmountValue && calcCommission
                        ? `${sumFormatter(calcCommission.payAmount)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`
                        : `0 ${currencySign('RUB')}`}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className={styles.wrapperColumn}>
                    <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.titleColumn}>
                      В портфеле после зачисления
                    </Text>
                    <div className={styles.valueColumn}>
                      {isErrorAmountValue ? '—' : amountAccountAfterEnrollment}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        {selectedPaymentType?.paymentTypeCode === 'BANK_DETAILS' && (
          <BankSelect filteredCurrencies={filteredCurrencies} brokerBankParams={brokerBankParams} />
        )}
      </div>
      {isMobile ? (
        <div>
          <AddonBottom>
            <div className={styles.addonWrapper}>
              <Buttons />
            </div>
          </AddonBottom>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.footer}>
          <Buttons />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_360, ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY } from 'const/routes';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { parseBrokerBankAccounts } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/helpers';
import { useRefillState } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useRefillState';
import {
  BrokerBankAccountsResponse,
  OrderNonTradeMoneyRefillExtCommission,
  PortfolioCurrencyEvaluation,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { parsePortfolioKey } from '../../helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  calcCommission?: OrderNonTradeMoneyRefillExtCommission;
  brokerBankParams: BrokerBankAccountsResponse;
};

const SuccessPayment = ({ calcCommission, brokerBankParams }: Props) => {
  const [{ selectedProductId, selectedPortfolioKey }] = useRefillState();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const onReadyButtonClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_360);
  const onHistoryButtonClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY);

  const selectedProduct = brokerBankParams.products.find(
    (el) => el.productId === selectedProductId,
  );
  const [selectedPortfolioId, selectedSubAccountId] = parsePortfolioKey(selectedPortfolioKey);
  const { portfolios } = useMemo(() => {
    return parseBrokerBankAccounts(brokerBankParams);
  }, [brokerBankParams]);

  const selectedPortfolio = portfolios.find(
    (el) => el.portfolioId === selectedPortfolioId && el.subAccountId === selectedSubAccountId,
  );

  const getBalanceChange = (portfolioCurrencyEvaluation: PortfolioCurrencyEvaluation[]) => {
    const rubEvaluation = portfolioCurrencyEvaluation.find(
      ({ currencyCode }) => currencyCode === 'RUB',
    );
    const formattedBalance = Number(new BigNumber(rubEvaluation?.balance as number).toFixed(2));
    const prevBalance = `${sumFormatter(formattedBalance)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`;
    const currentBalance = `${sumFormatter(
      formattedBalance + Number(calcCommission?.payAmount) - Number(calcCommission?.commission),
    )} ${currencySign('RUB')}`;
    return (
      <p>
        <span className={styles.lineThrough}>{prevBalance}</span> → {currentBalance}
      </p>
    );
  };

  return (
    <AdaptivePopup
      open
      onDismiss={onReadyButtonClick}
      bottomSheetProps={{
        className: styles.headerSuccess,
      }}
      classNameContent={styles.popup}
    >
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.header}>
          <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.line}>
            Сумма пополнения
          </Text>
          {calcCommission?.payAmount && (
            <Text type="headline">{`${sumFormatter(
              calcCommission.payAmount - calcCommission.commission,
            )} ${currencySign('RUB')}`}</Text>
          )}
          <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.line}>
            На счёте после зачисления
          </Text>
          {selectedPortfolio?.portfolioCurrencyEvaluation && (
            <Text type="bodyRegular">
              {getBalanceChange(selectedPortfolio.portfolioCurrencyEvaluation)}
            </Text>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.contentWrapper}>
          <div className={styles.content}>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.divide}>
              Зачисление происходит в течение 30 минут с 10 до 17 в рабочие дни
            </Text>
            <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.label} tag="div">
              Счёт и портфель
            </Text>
            <Text type="bodyRegular" className={styles.account}>
              {selectedProduct?.productTypeName}
            </Text>
            <Text type="labelRegular" className={cn(styles.label, styles.portfolio, styles.divide)}>
              {selectedPortfolio?.portfolioName}
            </Text>
            {calcCommission?.commission && (
              <>
                <Text type="labelRegular" className={styles.label} tag="div">
                  Комиссия
                </Text>
                <Text type="bodyRegular">
                  {`${sumFormatter(calcCommission.commission)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`}
                </Text>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={styles.btnWrapper}>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              className={styles.historyBtn}
              onClick={onHistoryButtonClick}
            >
              К Истории
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={onReadyButtonClick}>Готово</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopup>
  );
};

export default SuccessPayment;

import { BrokerBankPortfolio, BrokerBankProduct, PaymentArray } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { parsePortfolioKey } from './parsePortfolioKey';

export const handleProductChange = ({
  paymentArray,
  portfolios,
  products,
  productId,
  initialProductId,
  initialPortfolioId,
}: {
  paymentArray: PaymentArray[];
  portfolios: BrokerBankPortfolio[];
  products: BrokerBankProduct[];
  productId?: number;
  initialProductId?: number;
  initialPortfolioId?: number;
}) => {
  if (products.length === 0) return null;
  const selectedProductId = initialProductId || productId || products[0]?.productId;
  const portfolio = portfolios.find((el) => el.productId === selectedProductId);
  const portfolioId = initialPortfolioId || portfolio?.portfolioId;
  const subAccountId = portfolio?.subAccountId;

  return {
    selectedProductId,
    ...handlePortfolioChange({
      paymentArray,
      portfolioKey: portfolioId && subAccountId ? [portfolioId, subAccountId].join('_') : null,
    }),
  };
};

export const handlePortfolioChange = ({
  paymentArray,
  portfolioKey: selectedPortfolioKey,
}: {
  paymentArray: PaymentArray[];
  portfolioKey: string | null;
}) => {
  if (paymentArray.length === 0) return null;
  const [portfolioId] = parsePortfolioKey(selectedPortfolioKey);
  const filteredPaymentArray = paymentArray.filter((item) => item.portfolioId === portfolioId);

  const paymentTypeSBP = filteredPaymentArray.find((type) => type.paymentTypeCode === 'SBP');
  const selectedPaymentTypeCode =
    paymentTypeSBP?.paymentTypeCode ?? filteredPaymentArray[0]?.paymentTypeCode;

  return {
    selectedPortfolioKey,
    ...handlePaymentTypeChange({
      paymentArray: filteredPaymentArray,
      paymentTypeCode: selectedPaymentTypeCode,
    }),
  };
};

export const handlePaymentTypeChange = ({
  paymentArray,
  paymentTypeCode,
}: {
  paymentArray: PaymentArray[];
  paymentTypeCode?: string | null;
}) => {
  if (paymentArray.length === 0) return null;

  return {
    selectedPaymentTypeCode: paymentTypeCode ?? null,
  };
};

import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import {
  BrokerBankAccountsResponse,
  PaymentArray,
  PaymentTypes,
  PortfolioCurrencyEvaluation,
  ProductCurrencyEvaluation,
  ResultPortfolio,
  ResultProduct,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

export const parseBrokerBankAccounts = (data: BrokerBankAccountsResponse) => {
  const groupedProductCurrencyEvaluations = data.productCurrencyEvaluation.reduce(
    (ac: Record<string, ProductCurrencyEvaluation[]>, el) => {
      if (ac[el.productId]) {
        ac[el.productId].push(el);
      } else {
        ac[el.productId] = [el];
      }

      return ac;
    },
    {},
  );
  const groupedPortfolioCurrencyEvaluations = data.portfolioCurrencyEvaluation.reduce(
    (ac: Record<string, PortfolioCurrencyEvaluation[]>, el) => {
      if (ac[el.portfolioId]) {
        ac[el.portfolioId].push(el);
      } else {
        ac[el.portfolioId] = [el];
      }

      return ac;
    },
    {},
  );

  const products = data.products.map(
    (el): ResultProduct => ({
      ...el,
      productCurrencyEvaluation: groupedProductCurrencyEvaluations[el.productId],
    }),
  );
  const portfolios = data.portfolios.map(
    (el): ResultPortfolio => ({
      ...el,
      portfolioCurrencyEvaluation: groupedPortfolioCurrencyEvaluations[el.portfolioId],
    }),
  );

  return {
    products,
    portfolios,
  };
};

export type GetBalanceWithCurrency = {
  balance: number;
  currencyCode: PriceCurrencyType;
};

export const getBalanceWithCurrency = (currencyEvaluation: GetBalanceWithCurrency[]) => {
  const result: string[] = [];
  currencyEvaluation.forEach(({ balance, currencyCode }) => {
    const formatedBalance = Number(new BigNumber(balance).toFixed(2));

    result.push(`${sumFormatter(formatedBalance)} ${currencySign(currencyCode)}`);
  });
  return result.join(' • ');
};

export const prepareProductOptions = (products: ResultProduct[] | null) => {
  if (!products) return [];
  return products.map(({ productId, productTypeName, productCurrencyEvaluation }) => ({
    id: productId,
    title: productTypeName,
    description: getBalanceWithCurrency(productCurrencyEvaluation),
  }));
};

export const preparePortfolioOptions = (
  portfolios: ResultPortfolio[],
  selectedProductId: number | null,
) => {
  if (!portfolios) return [];
  return portfolios.reduce((ac: Option<string>[], portfolio) => {
    if (portfolio.productId === selectedProductId) {
      ac.push({
        id: [portfolio.portfolioId, portfolio.subAccountId].join('_'),
        title: portfolio.portfolioFullName,
        description: getBalanceWithCurrency(portfolio?.portfolioCurrencyEvaluation || []),
      });
    }
    return ac;
  }, []);
};

export const getGrantedPaymentTypes = (paymentTypes: PaymentTypes[]) => {
  const personBrokerBakDetailsGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_BROKER_BANK_DETAILS');
  const personNonTradeRefillExtGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL_EXT');
  const personNonTradeRefillSBPGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL_SBP');

  return paymentTypes.filter((el) => {
    return (
      (el.paymentTypeCode === 'BANK_DETAILS' && personBrokerBakDetailsGranted) ||
      (el.paymentTypeCode === 'MONETA' && personNonTradeRefillExtGranted) ||
      (el.paymentTypeCode === 'SBP' && personNonTradeRefillSBPGranted)
    );
  });
};

export const prepareCurrencies = (paymentArray: PaymentArray[]): Option<PriceCurrencyType>[] => {
  const currencies = new Map<PaymentArray['currencyCode'], Option<PriceCurrencyType>>();
  for (const { currencyCode, currencyName } of paymentArray) {
    if (!currencies.has(currencyCode)) {
      currencies.set(currencyCode, {
        id: currencyCode,
        title: currencyName,
        icon: currencySign(currencyCode),
      });
    }
  }

  const sortedCurrencies = [
    ...[
      currencies.has('RUB') && currencies.get('RUB'),
      currencies.has('USD') && currencies.get('USD'),
      currencies.has('EUR') && currencies.get('EUR'),
    ].filter(Boolean),
    ...Array.from(currencies.values()).filter(({ id }) => !['RUB', 'USD', 'EUR'].includes(id)),
  ];

  return sortedCurrencies as Option<PriceCurrencyType>[];
};


--- FILE: src\modules\Transfers\pages\Refill\helpers\parsePortfolioKey.ts ---

export const parsePortfolioKey = (
  key: string | null | undefined,
): [portfolioId: number | null, subAccountId: number | null] => {
  if (typeof key === 'string') {
    const [portfolioId, subAccountId] = key.split('_');
    const portfolioIdNum = Number(portfolioId);
    const subAccountIdNum = Number(subAccountId);

    return Number.isInteger(portfolioIdNum) && Number.isInteger(subAccountIdNum)
      ? [portfolioIdNum, subAccountIdNum]
      : [null, null];
  }

  return [null, null];
};

import { PaymentArray } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

export const shareBankDetails = (bankDetails: PaymentArray, currencyCode: PriceCurrencyType) => {
  const text =
    `Наименование банка\n${bankDetails.bankName}\n` +
    `Получатель\n${bankDetails.payee}\n` +
    `БИК\n${bankDetails.bic}\n` +
    (bankDetails.swift ? `SWIFT банка получателя\n${bankDetails.swift}\n` : '') +
    (currencyCode === 'RUB'
      ? `Корреспондентский счёт\n${bankDetails.corrAccount}\n` +
        `Расчётный счёт\n${bankDetails.bankAccount}\n`
      : `Транзитный счет для спец. брокер. в ${currencyCode}\n${bankDetails.bankAccount}\n`) +
    `ИНН\n${bankDetails.inn}\n` +
    `КПП\n${bankDetails.kpp}\n` +
    `Назначение платежа\n${bankDetails.paymentPurpose}`;
  if (navigator.share) {
    const shareData = {
      text: text,
    } as ShareData;
    navigator.share(shareData);
  }
  return;
};

import { PaymentTypeCode } from 'modules/Transfers/types';
import { State } from '../hooks/useRefillState';

type Params = Partial<State> & {
  paymentMethodCode: PaymentTypeCode;
};

export const validateState = ({
  selectedCurrencyCode,
  selectedPaymentTypeCode,
  selectedPortfolioKey,
  selectedProductId,
  paymentMethodCode,
}: Params) => {
  // Заблокировать банк открытие
  if (paymentMethodCode === 'BFKO') return false;

  const isValidBaseField =
    !!selectedCurrencyCode &&
    !!selectedPaymentTypeCode &&
    !!selectedPortfolioKey &&
    !!selectedProductId;

  return isValidBaseField;
};

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import {
  useBrokerBankPDFMutation,
  useBrokerBankPDFStatusMutation,
} from 'core/api/brokerBankAccounts';

import { useRefillState } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useRefillState';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

const MAX_RETRIES = 20;

export const useBankDetailsPDF = (selectedPortfolioId: number | null, isMobile: boolean) => {
  const [state] = useRefillState();

  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);
  const [isPDFLoading, setIsPDFLoading] = useState(false);
  const { selectedBankDetail, brokerBankAccountGuid } = state;
  const [loadPdf, { data: guidPDF }] = useBrokerBankPDFMutation();

  const [getStatusPDF, { data: requestStatusPDF }] = useBrokerBankPDFStatusMutation();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMobile || !guidPDF || retryCount > MAX_RETRIES) return;
    let setTimeOutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
    setIsPDFLoading(true);
    if (requestStatusPDF === 'completed') {
      setIsPDFLoading(false);
    }
    if (requestStatusPDF !== 'completed') {
      setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => {
        getStatusPDF(guidPDF);
        setRetryCount((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 3000);
    }
    if (retryCount >= MAX_RETRIES) {
      setIsPDFLoading(false);
      createAlertNotification({
        status: 'error',
        text: 'Произошла ошибка при формировании PDF',
      });
    }
    return () => clearTimeout(setTimeOutId);
  }, [getStatusPDF, requestStatusPDF, retryCount, guidPDF, isMobile]);

  const handleLoadPDF = () => {
    if (!selectedBankDetail?.bankDetailsId || !brokerBankAccountGuid || !selectedPortfolioId)
      return;
    setRetryCount(0);
    loadPdf({
      brokerBankAccountGuid,
      portfolioId: selectedPortfolioId,
      bankDetailsId: selectedBankDetail.bankDetailsId,
    });
  };

  return {
    handleLoadPDF,
    isPDFLoading,
  };
};

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import {
  useGetBrokerBankAccountsParamsQuery,
  useGetBrokerBankAccountsQuery,
  useGetBrokerBankAccountsStatusQuery,
} from 'core/api/brokerBankAccounts';

import { CurrencyItem } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

const initialState = {
  enabledStatusQuery: false,
  enabledParamsQuery: false,
};

const currencyValues: Record<string, number | undefined> = {
  RUB: 3,
  USD: 2,
  EUR: 1,
};

export const sortCurrency = (left: CurrencyItem, right: CurrencyItem) => {
  const leftVal = currencyValues[left.currencyCode] || 0;
  const rightVal = currencyValues[right.currencyCode] || 0;
  if (leftVal > 0 || rightVal > 0) {
    return Math.sign(rightVal - leftVal);
  }

  return left.currencyName.localeCompare(right.currencyName, 'ru', { sensitivity: 'base' });
};

export const useBrokerBankParams = () => {
  const [{ enabledStatusQuery, enabledParamsQuery }, setState] = useState(initialState);
  const [isErrorStatus, setErrorStatus] = useState(false);

  const {
    data: responseDataGuid,
    isSuccess: isSuccessStatusFetchGuid,
    isError: isErrorStatusFetchGuid,
  } = useGetBrokerBankAccountsQuery();

  const brokerBankAccountGuid = responseDataGuid ? responseDataGuid : null;

  const {
    data: bankAccountsStatus,
    isSuccess: isSuccessFetchBankAccountsStatus,
    isError: isErrorFetchBankAccountsStatus,
  } = useGetBrokerBankAccountsStatusQuery(brokerBankAccountGuid, {
    skip: !brokerBankAccountGuid || !enabledStatusQuery,
    pollingInterval: 2000,
  });

  const {
    data: brokerBankParams,
    isLoading: isLoadingStatusFetchBrokerBank,
    isUninitialized: isUninitializedStatusFetchBrokerBank,
    isError: isErrorStatusFetchBrokerBank,
    isSuccess: isSuccessStatusFetchBrokerBank,
  } = useGetBrokerBankAccountsParamsQuery(brokerBankAccountGuid, {
    skip: !brokerBankAccountGuid || !enabledParamsQuery,
  });

  // При получении guid, запрашиваем статус раз в 2 секунды
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSuccessStatusFetchGuid && brokerBankAccountGuid) {
      setState({ enabledStatusQuery: true, enabledParamsQuery: false });
    }
  }, [isSuccessStatusFetchGuid, brokerBankAccountGuid]);

  // Когда получили статус "Выполнено", разрешаем запрос на получение параметров
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSuccessFetchBankAccountsStatus || isErrorFetchBankAccountsStatus) {
      if (bankAccountsStatus === 'completed') {
        setState({ enabledStatusQuery: false, enabledParamsQuery: true });
      }
      if (bankAccountsStatus === 'error') {
        setState({ enabledStatusQuery: false, enabledParamsQuery: false });
        setErrorStatus(true);
      }
    }
  }, [bankAccountsStatus, isSuccessFetchBankAccountsStatus, isErrorFetchBankAccountsStatus]);

  // Если пришли параметры, меняем флаг, чтобы не было перезапросов
  useEffect(() => {
    if (brokerBankParams && isSuccessStatusFetchBrokerBank) {
      setState({ enabledStatusQuery: false, enabledParamsQuery: false });
    }
  }, [brokerBankParams, isSuccessStatusFetchBrokerBank]);

  const isErrorPage =
    isErrorStatus ||
    isErrorStatusFetchBrokerBank ||
    isErrorFetchBankAccountsStatus ||
    isErrorStatusFetchGuid;

  const isLoadingPage =
    isLoadingStatusFetchBrokerBank || (isUninitializedStatusFetchBrokerBank && !brokerBankParams);

  const status = isErrorPage ? 'error' : isLoadingPage ? 'loading' : 'success';

  const preparedBankParams = useMemo(() => {
    if (!brokerBankParams) return;

    return {
      ...brokerBankParams,
      PaymentArray: brokerBankParams.paymentArray
        .filter((item) => item.paymentTypeCode !== 'BFKO')
        .sort(sortCurrency),
    };
  }, [brokerBankParams]);

  return {
    brokerBankParams: preparedBankParams,
    statusRequest: status as 'error' | 'loading' | 'success',
    brokerBankAccountGuid,
  };
};

import { createContext, Dispatch, useContext } from 'react';
import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';
import { PaymentArray } from 'modules/Transfers/types'

export type State = {
  selectedProductId: number | null;
  selectedPortfolioKey: string | null;
  selectedCurrencyCode: PriceCurrencyType | null;
  selectedPaymentTypeCode: string | null;
  selectedBankDetail: PaymentArray | null;
  refillAmount: number | null;
  brokerBankAccountGuid: string | null;
  sbpLink: string | null;
  stepBlockPayment:
    | 'SELECT_PAYMENT'
    | 'SBP_PAYMENT'
    | 'SUCCESS_PAYMENT'
    | 'FAIL_PAYMENT'
    | 'BANK_DETAILS_PAYMENT';
};

export const initialState: State = {
  selectedProductId: null,
  selectedPortfolioKey: null,
  selectedCurrencyCode: null,
  selectedPaymentTypeCode: null,
  selectedBankDetail: null,
  refillAmount: null,
  brokerBankAccountGuid: null,
  sbpLink: null,
  stepBlockPayment: 'SELECT_PAYMENT',
};

export type ActionState = Partial<State> | ((state: State) => Partial<State> | null) | null;

export const reducer = (state: State, update: ActionState): State => {
  const changes = typeof update === 'function' ? update(state) : update;

  if (changes === null) return state;

  return {
    ...state,
    ...changes,
  };
};

export const RefillContextState = createContext(initialState);
export const RefillContextDispatch = createContext<Dispatch<ActionState>>(() => null);

export const useRefillState = (): [State, Dispatch<ActionState>] => {
  const state = useContext(RefillContextState);
  const setState = useContext(RefillContextDispatch);

  return [state, setState];
};

import React, { useEffect, useReducer } from 'react';

import { useGetQRCodePaymentParamsMutation } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { initialState, reducer } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/components/SbpQRCode/reducer';
import { useRefillState } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/hooks/useRefillState';

type Props = {
  guid: string | null;
  active: boolean;
};

const useSBPQRCode = ({ guid, active }: Props) => {
  const [SBPState, setSBPState] = useReducer(reducer, initialState);
  const [{ sbpLink }, setState] = useRefillState();

  const [
    getQRCodeParams,
    {
      data: qrCodePaymentParamsResponse,
      isSuccess: isSuccessQRCodePaymentParamsStatus,
      isUninitialized: isUninitializedQRCodePaymentParamsStatus,
      reset: resetQRCodePaymentParams,
    },
  ] = useGetQRCodePaymentParamsMutation();
  const qrCodePaymentParams = qrCodePaymentParamsResponse
    ? qrCodePaymentParamsResponse.requestParameters[0]
    : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active || !guid) return;
    if (isUninitializedQRCodePaymentParamsStatus && !qrCodePaymentParamsResponse) {
      getQRCodeParams(guid);
      return;
    }
    let setTimeOutId: null | NodeJS.Timeout = null;
    if (isSuccessQRCodePaymentParamsStatus && qrCodePaymentParams) {
      if (qrCodePaymentParams.status === 'processing') {
        setSBPState(({ fetchingCountProcessing }) => {
          if (fetchingCountProcessing < 9) {
            setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => getQRCodeParams(guid), 2000);
          }
          return {
            fetchingCountProcessing: fetchingCountProcessing + 1,
            isLoading: fetchingCountProcessing < 9,
            isError: fetchingCountProcessing >= 9,
          };
        });
      }
      if (qrCodePaymentParams.status === 'waiting_payment') {
        setState({ sbpLink: qrCodePaymentParams.qrCodeLink });
        setSBPState(({ fetchingCountWaiting }) => {
          if (fetchingCountWaiting > 30) return null;
          if (fetchingCountWaiting === 0) {
            setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => getQRCodeParams(guid), 30_000);
            return {
              fetchingCountWaiting: 1,
              isLoading: false,
            };
          }
          setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => getQRCodeParams(guid), 2000);
          return {
            fetchingCountWaiting: fetchingCountWaiting + 1,
          };
        });
      }
      if (qrCodePaymentParams.status === 'canceled' || qrCodePaymentParams.status === 'error') {
        setSBPState({
          isLoading: false,
          isError: true,
        });
      }
      if (qrCodePaymentParams.status === 'ok') {
        setSBPState({
          isLoading: false,
          isSuccessPayment: true,
        });
      }
    }

    return () => {
      if (setTimeOutId) {
        clearTimeout(setTimeOutId);
      }
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [getQRCodeParams, qrCodePaymentParams, isUninitializedQRCodePaymentParamsStatus, active]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (SBPState.isSuccessPayment) {
      setState({ stepBlockPayment: 'SUCCESS_PAYMENT' });
    }
  }, [SBPState.isSuccessPayment, setState]);

  return { SBPState, sbpLink, resetQRCodePaymentParams };
};

export default useSBPQRCode;

import * as React from 'react';

const SvgComponent = () => (

import { useEffect, useMemo, useReducer } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_360, ROUTE_REFILL } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useMoneyRefillDetailMutation } from 'core/api/transfers';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { useSnackBar } from 'hooks/useSnackBar';

import Skeleton from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/components/Skeleton';

import { HeaderPage, UnavailableContent } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';

import Refill from './Refill';
import {
  RefillContextDispatch,
  RefillContextState,
  initialState,
  reducer,
} from './hooks/useRefillState';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const RefillPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  useSnackBar();
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(reducer, initialState);
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const query = useMemo(() => Object.fromEntries(searchParams), [searchParams]);
  const [getOldParams, { isLoading: isLoadingOldParamsResponse, data: oldParamsResponse }] =
    useMoneyRefillDetailMutation();
  const oldParams = oldParamsResponse ? oldParamsResponse.requestParameters[0] : null;

  const onToView360ButtonClick = () => navigate(ROUTE_360);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!query || (!query.statusPayment && !query.MNT_TRANSACTION_ID)) return;
    navigate(ROUTE_REFILL, { replace: true });

    if (query.statusPayment) {
      setState({
        stepBlockPayment: query.statusPayment === 'fail' ? 'FAIL_PAYMENT' : 'SUCCESS_PAYMENT',
      });
    }

    if (query.MNT_TRANSACTION_ID) {
      getOldParams({ guid: query.MNT_TRANSACTION_ID });
    }
  }, [navigate, query, getOldParams]);

  const personNonTradeRefillGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL');

  return (
    <RefillContextState.Provider value={state}>
      <RefillContextDispatch.Provider value={setState}>
        {!personNonTradeRefillGranted ? (
          <UnavailableContent headerTitle="Пополнить" />
        ) : (
          <>
            {state.stepBlockPayment === 'SELECT_PAYMENT' && (
              <>
                {isMobile ? (
                  <HeaderPage
                    size="small"
                    title="Пополнить"
                    leftIconVariant="back"
                    onLeftIconClick={onToView360ButtonClick}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <HeaderPage title="Пополнить">
                      <Button
                        iconLeft={<BackSvg />}
                        onClick={onToView360ButtonClick}
                        shape="inline"
                        variant="white"
                        className={styles.header}
                      >
                        <Text type="labelMedium">Назад</Text>
                      </Button>
                    </HeaderPage>
                    <Text type="headline" className={styles.headline}>
                      Пополнить
                    </Text>
                  </>
                )}
              </>
            )}
            {isLoadingOldParamsResponse ? <Skeleton /> : <Refill oldParams={oldParams} />}
          </>
        )}
      </RefillContextDispatch.Provider>
    </RefillContextState.Provider>
  );
};

export default RefillPage;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

import {
  useCalcCommissionQuery,
  useMoneyRefillMonetaParamsMutation,
  useMoneyRefillSBPMutation,
} from 'core/api/transfers';

import { isErrorResponseType } from 'utils/errorResponse';

import BlockedContent from 'modules/Transfers/components/BlockedContent';
import { MoneyRefillDetail, PaymentTypes } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components/Alert/createAlertNotification';

import BankDetailsQRCode from './components/BankDetailsQRCode';
import MonetaPayment from './components/MonetaPayment';
import SBPQRCode from './components/SbpQRCode/SBPQRCode';
import SelectPayment from './components/SelectPayment';
import Skeleton from './components/Skeleton';
import { FailedPayment, SuccessPayment } from './components/StatusPayment';
import { handleProductChange, parsePortfolioKey, shareBankDetails } from './helpers';
import { useBrokerBankParams } from './hooks/useBrokerBankParams';
import { State, useRefillState } from './hooks/useRefillState';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const showErrorMessage = () => {
  createAlertNotification({
    text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
    status: 'error',
  });
};

type Props = {
  oldParams: MoneyRefillDetail | null;
};

const Refill = ({ oldParams }: Props) => {
  const [
    {
      selectedPaymentTypeCode,
      refillAmount,
      selectedPortfolioKey,
      selectedBankDetail,
      selectedCurrencyCode,
      stepBlockPayment,
      selectedProductId,
    },
    setState,
  ] = useRefillState();

  const location = useLocation();

  const initialProductId = ((location?.state &&
    (location?.state as { productId: number }).productId) ||
    null) as number | undefined;

  const initialPortfolioId = ((location?.state &&
    (location?.state as { portfolioId: number }).portfolioId) ||
    null) as number | undefined;

  const [openQRCode, setOpenQRCode] = useState(false);
  const { brokerBankParams, statusRequest, brokerBankAccountGuid } = useBrokerBankParams();
  const [selectedPortfolioId, selectedSubAccountId] = parsePortfolioKey(selectedPortfolioKey);
  const [
    moneyRefillSBPMutate,
    {
      data: moneyRefillSBPResponse,
      error: moneyRefillSBPError,
      isLoading: isLoadingMoneyRefillSBPMutate,
    },
  ] = useMoneyRefillSBPMutation();
  const moneyRefillSBPGuid = moneyRefillSBPResponse
    ? moneyRefillSBPResponse.request[0].requestGuid
    : null;

  const [
    moneyRefillMonetaMutate,
    {
      data: moneyRefillMonetaResponse,
      isSuccess: isSuccessMoneyRefillMonetaMutate,
      isError: isErrorMoneyRefillMonetaMutate,
      isLoading: isLoadingMoneyRefillMonetaMutate,
    },
  ] = useMoneyRefillMonetaParamsMutation();
  const moneyRefillMonetaParams = moneyRefillMonetaResponse
    ? moneyRefillMonetaResponse.externalParameters[0]
    : null;

  const selectedPaymentType = brokerBankParams?.paymentTypes.find(
    (el) => el.paymentTypeCode === selectedPaymentTypeCode,
  );
  const paymentMethod = brokerBankParams?.paymentTypes.find(
    (el) => el.paymentTypeCode === selectedPaymentType?.paymentTypeCode,
  );

  const { data: calcCommission, isFetching: isFetchingCalcCommissionStatus } =
    useCalcCommissionQuery(
      {
        refillAmount: refillAmount,
        paymentMethod: paymentMethod?.paymentTypeCode,
      },
      {
        skip: !refillAmount || paymentMethod?.paymentTypeCode === 'BANK_DETAILS',
      },
    );

  const selectedPortfolio = brokerBankParams?.portfolios.find((item) => {
    return (
      item.portfolioId === selectedPortfolioId &&
      item.subAccountId === selectedSubAccountId &&
      item.productId === selectedProductId
    );
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!!refillAmount && moneyRefillSBPMutate) {
      const refillAmountNum = Number(refillAmount);

      if (selectedPortfolio && refillAmountNum) {
        moneyRefillSBPMutate({
          refillAmount,
          portfolioId: selectedPortfolio.portfolioId,
          subAccountId: selectedPortfolio.subAccountId,
        });
      }
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [refillAmount, moneyRefillSBPMutate]);

  const onNextClick = (paymentMethod: PaymentTypes['paymentTypeCode']) => {
    if (!brokerBankParams) return;

    if (paymentMethod === 'MONETA') {
      const refillAmountNum = Number(refillAmount);
      if (selectedPortfolio && refillAmount) {
        moneyRefillMonetaMutate({
          refillAmount: refillAmountNum,
          portfolioId: selectedPortfolio.portfolioId,
          subAccountId: selectedPortfolio.subAccountId,
        });
      }
    }
    if (paymentMethod === 'BANK_DETAILS' && selectedBankDetail && selectedCurrencyCode) {
      shareBankDetails(selectedBankDetail, selectedCurrencyCode);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (brokerBankParams && statusRequest === 'success') {
      if (oldParams) {
        const paymentType = brokerBankParams.PaymentArray.find((item) => {
          return item.portfolioId === oldParams.portfolioId && item.paymentTypeCode === 'MONETA';
        });

        const nState: Partial<State> = {
          selectedProductId: oldParams.productId,
          selectedPortfolioKey: [oldParams.portfolioId, oldParams.subAccountId].join('_'),
          selectedCurrencyCode: oldParams.currencyCode,
          refillAmount: oldParams.volume,
        };

        if (paymentType) {
          nState.selectedPaymentTypeCode = paymentType.paymentTypeCode;
        }

        setState(nState);
      } else {
        const { products, portfolios, paymentArray } = brokerBankParams;
        setState(
          handleProductChange({
            products,
            portfolios,
            paymentArray,
            initialProductId,
            initialPortfolioId,
          }),
        );
      }
    }
  }, [brokerBankParams, setState, statusRequest, oldParams, initialProductId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isErrorResponseType(moneyRefillSBPError)) {
      const isAmountExcessiveError =
        moneyRefillSBPError.data?.error[0]?.errorCode === 'AmountValueExcessive';
      !isAmountExcessiveError && showErrorMessage();
    }
  }, [moneyRefillSBPError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setState({ brokerBankAccountGuid });
  }, [brokerBankAccountGuid, setState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isErrorMoneyRefillMonetaMutate) {
      showErrorMessage();
    }
  }, [isErrorMoneyRefillMonetaMutate]);

  if (statusRequest === 'loading') return <Skeleton />;
  if (
    statusRequest === 'error' ||
    !brokerBankParams ||
    !brokerBankParams.paymentArray.length ||
    !brokerBankParams.productCurrencyEvaluation.length ||
    !brokerBankParams.portfolioCurrencyEvaluation.length
  )
    return <BlockedContent type="error" />;
  if (!brokerBankParams.products.length) return <BlockedContent type="noProducts" />;

  return (
    <>
      {stepBlockPayment === 'SELECT_PAYMENT' && (
        <>
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            <SelectPayment
              brokerBankParams={brokerBankParams}
              calcCommission={calcCommission}
              selectedPaymentType={selectedPaymentType}
              paymentMethod={paymentMethod}
              loadingButton={
                isLoadingMoneyRefillSBPMutate ||
                isLoadingMoneyRefillMonetaMutate ||
                isSuccessMoneyRefillMonetaMutate ||
                isFetchingCalcCommissionStatus
              }
              onNextClick={onNextClick}
              openQRCode={() => setOpenQRCode(true)}
              refillSBPGuid={moneyRefillSBPGuid}
            />
          </div>
          {paymentMethod?.paymentTypeCode === 'SBP' && brokerBankParams && moneyRefillSBPGuid && (
            <SBPQRCode
              open={openQRCode}
              guid={moneyRefillSBPGuid}
              onDismiss={() => setOpenQRCode(false)}
            />
          )}
          {paymentMethod?.paymentTypeCode === 'BANK_DETAILS' && selectedBankDetail && (
            <BankDetailsQRCode open={openQRCode} onDismiss={() => setOpenQRCode(false)} />
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {stepBlockPayment === 'SUCCESS_PAYMENT' && (
        <SuccessPayment calcCommission={calcCommission} brokerBankParams={brokerBankParams} />
      )}
      {moneyRefillMonetaParams && isSuccessMoneyRefillMonetaMutate && (
        <MonetaPayment moneyRefillMonetaParams={moneyRefillMonetaParams} />
      )}
      {stepBlockPayment === 'FAIL_PAYMENT' && (
        <FailedPayment
          brokerBankParams={brokerBankParams}
          loading={isLoadingMoneyRefillMonetaMutate || isSuccessMoneyRefillMonetaMutate}
          repeatPayment={() => onNextClick('MONETA')}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Refill;

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';

import { Button, Checkbox, CircleLoader, Input, SearchSelect, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { APP_TITLE, CDN_BASE_URL } from 'const/app';
