import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import {
  useGetSecuritiesContractorsQuery,
  useGetSecuritiesWriteOffParamsQuery,
  useLazyGetSecuritiesWriteOffFilesQuery,
  useLazyGetSecuritiesWriteOffQuery,
  useSecuritiesWriteOffMutation,
} from 'core/api/transfers';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_PAGE_TITLE } from 'modules/Transfers/constants';
import ArrowNextIcon from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/ArrowNextIcon';
import {
  SecuritiesContractor,
  SecuritiesWriteOffAccount,
  SecuritiesWriteOffMode,
  SecuritiesWriteOffParameter,
  SecuritiesWriteOffRequestParams,
  SecuritiesWriteOffResponse,
  SecuritiesWriteOffStatus,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
import { getSrc } from 'components/Instrument/components/InstrumentIcon/helpers';

import { ReactComponent as BackSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/back.svg';

import BlockedContent from '../../components/BlockedContent';
import WriteOffFailed from '../SecuritiesWriteOffOrder/WriteOffFailed';
import styles from './SecuritiesWriteOff.module.pcss';
import SecurityIcon from './SecurityIcon';
import {
  WriteOffFieldErrors,
  WriteOffFormField,
  hasWriteOffFieldErrors,
  parseWriteOffCheckResult,
  renderWriteOffHtml,
} from './writeOffCheckResult';
import { DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE, getWriteOffErrorMessage } from './writeOffErrors';
import {
  WRITEOFF_STATUS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS,
  WRITEOFF_STATUS_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS,
  getWriteOffStatus,
  isWriteOffSigningStatus,
  isWriteOffStatusReady,
  sleep,
} from './writeOffStatus';

const ACCOUNT_HINT = 'Счёт депо (депозитарий, номер договора)';

const getInstrumentIconSrc = (instrumentImageName?: string) =>
  instrumentImageName ? getSrc(CDN_BASE_URL, instrumentImageName) : undefined;

const getModeIconSrc = (imageName?: string) =>
  imageName ? getSrc(CDN_BASE_URL, imageName) : undefined;

const getQuantityFractionPart = (fractionPart?: number) => {
  if (fractionPart == null || !Number.isFinite(fractionPart) || fractionPart < 0) {
    return 0;
  }

  return Math.floor(fractionPart);
};

/** Одинаковый формат для value и подсказки — ровно QuantityFractionPart знаков после точки. */
const formatQuantity = (value: number, fractionPart?: number) => {
  const digits = getQuantityFractionPart(fractionPart);
  return value.toFixed(digits);
};

const formatQuantityHint = (
  quantity: number | undefined,
  fractionPart: number | undefined,
  label: string,
) =>
  quantity == null || !Number.isFinite(quantity)
    ? undefined
    : `${label} ${formatQuantity(quantity, fractionPart)} шт.`;

const toQuantityNumber = (value: string) => {
  const normalized = value.trim().replace(',', '.');
  if (!normalized || normalized === '.') {
    return null;
  }

  const parsed = Number(normalized);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
};

/** Комиссия способа + SendCostsComission, если включён чекбокс расходов. */
const getDisplayCommission = (
  mode: SecuritiesWriteOffMode | null | undefined,
  sendCosts: boolean,
) => {
  if (mode == null) {
    return '';
  }

  const base = Number(mode.comission) || 0;
  const sendCostsPart =
    sendCosts && mode.sendCostsComission != null && Number.isFinite(Number(mode.sendCostsComission))
      ? Number(mode.sendCostsComission)
      : 0;

  return String(base + sendCostsPart);
};

const formatCommissionDisplay = (value: string): string => {
  const amount = value === '' ? 0 : Number(value);

  if (!Number.isFinite(amount)) {
    return `0 ${currencySign('RUB')}`;
  }

  return `${sumFormatter(amount, 2)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`;
};

/**
 * Нормализация из react-number-format:
 * - точка как разделитель;
 * - без ведущих нулей;
 * - не больше QuantityFractionPart знаков после точки.
 */
const normalizeQuantityFromNumberFormat = (values: NumberFormatValues, fractionPart?: number) => {
  const digits = getQuantityFractionPart(fractionPart);
  const rawValue = (values.value ?? '').replace(',', '.');

  if (!rawValue) {
    return '';
  }

  // Пока печатают "5." — сохраняем незавершённый ввод
  if (digits > 0 && rawValue.endsWith('.')) {
    const intValue =
      values.floatValue != null && Number.isFinite(values.floatValue)
        ? String(Math.trunc(Math.abs(values.floatValue)))
        : '0';
    return `${intValue}.`;
  }

  if (values.floatValue != null && Number.isFinite(values.floatValue) && digits === 0) {
    return String(values.floatValue);
  }

  const cleaned = rawValue.replace(/[^\d.]/g, '');
  const separatorIndex = cleaned.indexOf('.');
  const rawInteger =
    separatorIndex === -1 ? cleaned : cleaned.slice(0, separatorIndex).replace(/\D/g, '');
  const strippedInteger = rawInteger.replace(/^0+/, '');
  const integerPart = strippedInteger === '' ? (rawInteger.length > 0 ? '0' : '') : strippedInteger;

  if (digits === 0 || separatorIndex === -1) {
    return integerPart;
  }

  const fractionValue = cleaned
    .slice(separatorIndex + 1)
    .replace(/\D/g, '')
    .slice(0, digits);

  return `${integerPart || '0'}.${fractionValue}`;
};

const mapInstrumentToOption = (instrument: SecuritiesWriteOffParameter) => ({
  id: instrument.depoInstrumentId,
  value: instrument.name,
  description: [
    instrument.instrumentShortType,
    instrument.issuerName,
    instrument.isin,
    formatQuantityHint(instrument.quantity, instrument.quantityFractionPart, 'Количество:'),
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' · '),
  iconLeft: (
    <SecurityIcon
      src={getInstrumentIconSrc(instrument.instrumentImageName)}
      alt={instrument.name}
    />
  ),
});

const mapAccountToOption = (account: SecuritiesWriteOffAccount, fractionPart?: number) => ({
  id: account.depoSubAccountId,
  value: account.name,
  description: formatQuantityHint(account.quantity, fractionPart, 'Количество:'),
  disabled: !account.allowed,
  disabledDescription: !account.allowed ? account.reason : undefined,
});

const mapModeToOption = (mode: SecuritiesWriteOffMode) => ({
  id: mode.code,
  value: mode.name,
  disabled: !mode.allowed,
  disabledDescription: !mode.allowed ? mode.reason : undefined,
  iconLeft: <SecurityIcon src={getModeIconSrc(mode.imageName)} alt={mode.name} square />,
});

const mapContractorToOption = (contractor: SecuritiesContractor, index: number) => ({
  id: contractor.id ?? `${contractor.name}-${index}`,
  value: contractor.name,
});

const filterByQuery = (
  instruments: SecuritiesWriteOffParameter[],
  query: string,
  fields: Array<keyof SecuritiesWriteOffParameter>,
): SecuritiesWriteOffParameter[] => {
  const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (!normalizedQuery) {
    return instruments;
  }

  return instruments.filter((instrument) =>
    fields.some((field) => {
      const value = instrument[field];
      return typeof value === 'string' && value.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery);
    }),
  );
};

const getRequestGuidFromResponse = (response: SecuritiesWriteOffResponse): string | undefined => {
  const fromRequest = response.request?.[0]?.requestGuid;
  if (fromRequest) {
    return fromRequest;
  }

  const record = response as Record<string, unknown>;
  const nestedRequest = record.request ?? record.Request;

  if (Array.isArray(nestedRequest) && nestedRequest[0]) {
    const first = nestedRequest[0] as Record<string, unknown>;
    const guid = first.requestGuid ?? first.RequestGuid;
    return typeof guid === 'string' ? guid : undefined;
  }

  const topLevelGuid = record.requestGuid ?? record.RequestGuid;
  return typeof topLevelGuid === 'string' ? topLevelGuid : undefined;
};

const SecuritiesWriteOff = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [instrumentValue, setInstrumentValue] = useState('');
  const [isinValue, setIsinValue] = useState('');
  const [accountValue, setAccountValue] = useState('');
  const [modeValue, setModeValue] = useState('');
  const [quantityValue, setQuantityValue] = useState('');
  const [commissionValue, setCommissionValue] = useState('');
  const [selectedInstrument, setSelectedInstrument] = useState<SecuritiesWriteOffParameter | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [selectedAccount, setSelectedAccount] = useState<SecuritiesWriteOffAccount | null>(null);
  const [selectedMode, setSelectedMode] = useState<SecuritiesWriteOffMode | null>(null);
  const [contractorValue, setContractorValue] = useState('');
  const [selectedContractor, setSelectedContractor] = useState<SecuritiesContractor | null>(null);
  const [transferExpensesInfo, setTransferExpensesInfo] = useState(false);
  const {
    data: writeOffParams,
    isLoading,
    isError: isParamsError,
  } = useGetSecuritiesWriteOffParamsQuery();
  const isSbpMode = selectedMode?.code === 'SBP';
  const {
    data: contractorsData,
    isLoading: isContractorsLoading,
    isFetching: isContractorsFetching,
  } = useGetSecuritiesContractorsQuery(isSbpMode ? { sbp: true } : undefined);
  const [writeOff, { isLoading: isWriteOffLoading }] = useSecuritiesWriteOffMutation();
  const [getWriteOffDetails] = useLazyGetSecuritiesWriteOffQuery();
  const [getWriteOffFiles] = useLazyGetSecuritiesWriteOffFilesQuery();
  const [isStatusPolling, setIsStatusPolling] = useState(false);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'FORM' | 'FAILED'>('FORM');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState(DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<WriteOffFieldErrors>({});
  const isNextBusy = isWriteOffLoading || isStatusPolling;

  const clearFieldError = (field: WriteOffFormField) => {
    setFieldErrors((prev) => {
      if (!prev[field]) {
        return prev;
      }

      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[field];
      return next;
    });
  };

  const instruments = writeOffParams?.writeOffParameters ?? [];
  const contractors = contractorsData ?? [];
  const accounts = selectedInstrument?.accounts ?? [];
  const modes = selectedAccount?.modes ?? [];
  const emptyMessage = isLoading ? 'Загрузка...' : 'Ничего не найдено';
  const disclaimerTexts = (writeOffParams?.disclaimer ?? [])
    .map((item) => item?.text?.trim())
    .filter((text): text is string => Boolean(text));

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_PAGE_TITLE} — ${APP_TITLE}`;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!writeOffParams) {
      return;
    }

    console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] raw response', writeOffParams);
    console.log(
      '[SecuritiesWriteOff] parsed fields',
      instruments.map((item) => ({
        instrument: item.name,
        isin: item.isin,
        iconSrc: getInstrumentIconSrc(item.instrumentImageName),
        accounts: item.accounts.map((account) => ({
          name: account.name,
          quantity: account.quantity,
          modes: account.modes.map((mode) => ({
            name: mode.name,
            comission: mode.comission,
            allowed: mode.allowed,
          })),
        })),
      })),
    );
  }, [writeOffParams, instruments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!contractorsData) {
      return;
    }

    console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] contractors raw/parsed', contractorsData);
    console.log(
      '[SecuritiesWriteOff] contractors for SearchSelect',
      contractors.map((item, index) => ({
        id: item.id ?? `${item.name}-${index}`,
        value: item.name,
        fromField: 'name',
      })),
    );
  }, [contractorsData, contractors]);

  const instrumentList = useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = filterByQuery(instruments, instrumentValue, [
      'name',
      'isin',
      'issuerName',
    ]).map((instrument) => mapInstrumentToOption(instrument));

    if (
      selectedInstrument &&
      !filtered.some((item) => item.id === selectedInstrument.depoInstrumentId)
    ) {
      return [mapInstrumentToOption(selectedInstrument), ...filtered];
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [instruments, instrumentValue, selectedInstrument]);

  const accountList = useMemo(() => {
    const fractionPart = selectedInstrument?.quantityFractionPart;
    const normalizedQuery = accountValue.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = (
      normalizedQuery
        ? accounts.filter((account) => account.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery))
        : accounts
    ).map((account) => mapAccountToOption(account, fractionPart));

    if (selectedAccount && !filtered.some((item) => item.id === selectedAccount.depoSubAccountId)) {
      return [mapAccountToOption(selectedAccount, fractionPart), ...filtered];
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [accounts, accountValue, selectedAccount, selectedInstrument?.quantityFractionPart]);

  const modeList = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedQuery = modeValue.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = (
      normalizedQuery
        ? modes.filter((mode) => mode.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery))
        : modes
    ).map((mode) => mapModeToOption(mode));

    if (selectedMode && !filtered.some((item) => item.id === selectedMode.code)) {
      return [mapModeToOption(selectedMode), ...filtered];
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [modes, modeValue, selectedMode]);

  const contractorList = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedQuery = contractorValue.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = (
      normalizedQuery
        ? contractors.filter((contractor) =>
            contractor.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery),
          )
        : contractors
    ).map((contractor, index) => mapContractorToOption(contractor, index));

    if (selectedContractor && !filtered.some((item) => item.value === selectedContractor.name)) {
      return [mapContractorToOption(selectedContractor, -1), ...filtered];
    }

    return filtered;
  }, [contractors, contractorValue, selectedContractor]);

  const resetAccountAndBelow = () => {
    setSelectedAccount(null);
    setAccountValue('');
    setSelectedMode(null);
    setModeValue('');
    setQuantityValue('');
    setCommissionValue('');
  };

  const resetModeAndBelow = () => {
    setSelectedMode(null);
    setModeValue('');
    setCommissionValue('');
  };

  const selectInstrument = (instrument: SecuritiesWriteOffParameter | null) => {
    clearFieldError('instrument');
    setSelectedInstrument(instrument);
    setInstrumentValue(instrument?.name ?? '');
    setIsinValue(instrument?.isin ?? '');
    resetAccountAndBelow();
  };

  const selectAccount = (account: SecuritiesWriteOffAccount | null) => {
    clearFieldError('account');
    clearFieldError('quantity');
    setSelectedAccount(account);
    setAccountValue(account?.name ?? '');
    setQuantityValue(
      account != null
        ? formatQuantity(account.quantity, selectedInstrument?.quantityFractionPart)
        : '',
    );
    resetModeAndBelow();
  };

  const selectMode = (mode: SecuritiesWriteOffMode | null) => {
    clearFieldError('mode');
    setSelectedMode(mode);
    setModeValue(mode?.name ?? '');
    setCommissionValue(getDisplayCommission(mode, transferExpensesInfo));
  };

  const selectContractor = (contractor: SecuritiesContractor | null) => {
    clearFieldError('contractor');
    setSelectedContractor(contractor);
    setContractorValue(contractor?.name ?? '');
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (instruments.length === 1 && !selectedInstrument) {
      selectInstrument(instruments[0]);
    }
  }, [instruments, selectedInstrument]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (accounts.length !== 1 || selectedAccount) {
      return;
    }

    const [account] = accounts;
    if (account.allowed) {
      selectAccount(account);
    }
  }, [accounts, selectedAccount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (modes.length !== 1 || selectedMode) {
      return;
    }

    const [mode] = modes;
    if (mode.allowed) {
      selectMode(mode);
    }
  }, [modes, selectedMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (contractors.length === 1 && !selectedContractor) {
      selectContractor(contractors[0]);
    }
  }, [contractors, selectedContractor]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedContractor || contractors.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const isSelectedContractorAvailable = contractors.some(
      (contractor) =>
        (selectedContractor.id != null && contractor.id === selectedContractor.id) ||
        contractor.name === selectedContractor.name,
    );

    if (!isSelectedContractorAvailable) {
      selectContractor(null);
    }
  }, [contractors, selectedContractor]);

  const preventClearButtonFocus = (event: any) => {
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (target?.closest('[class*="Input-module_icon-clear"]')) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  };

  const clearSearchSelect = (clear: () => void) => () => {
    clear();
    if (document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
      document.activeElement.blur();
    }
  };

  const maxQuantity = selectedAccount?.quantity ?? null;
  const quantityFractionPart = getQuantityFractionPart(selectedInstrument?.quantityFractionPart);
  const quantityNumber = toQuantityNumber(quantityValue);
  const isQuantityOverMax =
    quantityNumber != null && maxQuantity != null && quantityNumber > maxQuantity;
  const isQuantityNonPositive = quantityNumber != null && quantityNumber <= 0;
  const isQuantityError = isQuantityOverMax || isQuantityNonPositive;

  const handleQuantityValueChange = (values: NumberFormatValues) => {
    clearFieldError('quantity');
    setQuantityValue(normalizeQuantityFromNumberFormat(values, quantityFractionPart));
  };

  const handleQuantityBlur = () => {
    const parsed = toQuantityNumber(quantityValue);
    if (parsed == null) {
      return;
    }

    setQuantityValue(formatQuantity(parsed, quantityFractionPart));
  };

  const formPayload = useMemo(
    () => ({
      instrument: selectedInstrument
        ? {
            depoInstrumentId: selectedInstrument.depoInstrumentId,
            name: selectedInstrument.name,
            isin: selectedInstrument.isin,
            issuerName: selectedInstrument.issuerName,
            instrumentImageName: selectedInstrument.instrumentImageName,
          }
        : null,
      isin: isinValue,
      account: selectedAccount
        ? {
            depoSubAccountId: selectedAccount.depoSubAccountId,
            depoAccount: selectedAccount.depoAccount,
            name: selectedAccount.name,
            quantityAvailable: selectedAccount.quantity,
          }
        : null,
      mode: selectedMode
        ? {
            code: selectedMode.code,
            name: selectedMode.name,
            comission: selectedMode.comission,
            sendCostsComission: selectedMode.sendCostsComission,
            allowed: selectedMode.allowed,
          }
        : null,
      quantity: quantityValue,
      commission: commissionValue,
      contractor: selectedContractor
        ? {
            id: selectedContractor.id,
            name: selectedContractor.name,
          }
        : null,
      transferExpensesInfo,
    }),
    [
      selectedInstrument,
      isinValue,
      selectedAccount,
      selectedMode,
      quantityValue,
      commissionValue,
      selectedContractor,
      transferExpensesInfo,
    ],
  );

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_TRANSFERS);
  };

  const buildWriteOffRequest = (): SecuritiesWriteOffRequestParams => {
    const quantity = toQuantityNumber(formPayload.quantity);
    const contractorId = Number(formPayload.contractor?.id);

    return {
      depoInstrument_Id: formPayload.instrument?.depoInstrumentId ?? null,
      depoSubAccount_Id: formPayload.account?.depoSubAccountId ?? null,
      quantity: quantity != null && quantity > 0 ? quantity : null,
      contractor_Id: Number.isFinite(contractorId) ? contractorId : null,
      sbp: formPayload.mode == null ? null : formPayload.mode.code === 'SBP',
      sendCosts: formPayload.transferExpensesInfo,
      personalDataAgreement: true,
    };
  };

  const applyCheckResultErrors = (payload: unknown) => {
    const errors = parseWriteOffCheckResult(
      (payload ?? {}) as SecuritiesWriteOffResponse | Record<string, unknown>,
    );

    if (!hasWriteOffFieldErrors(errors)) {
      return false;
    }

    console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] CheckResult field errors', errors);
    setFieldErrors(errors);
    return true;
  };

  const showFailed = (message = DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE) => {
    setErrorMessage(message);
    setStep('FAILED');
  };

  const handleNextClick = async () => {
    if (isNextBusy) {
      return;
    }

    const requestParams = buildWriteOffRequest();

    console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] POST /v1/nontrade/securities/writeoff', requestParams);
    setFieldErrors({});

    try {
      const response = await writeOff(requestParams).unwrap();
      console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] writeoff success', response);

      if (applyCheckResultErrors(response)) {
        return;
      }

      const requestGuid = getRequestGuidFromResponse(response);

      if (!requestGuid) {
        console.error('[SecuritiesWriteOff] requestGuid missing in POST response', response);
        showFailed();
        return;
      }

      setIsStatusPolling(true);

      let details;
      let status: SecuritiesWriteOffStatus | undefined;
      const pollDeadline = Date.now() + WRITEOFF_STATUS_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS;
      let attempt = 0;

      while (Date.now() <= pollDeadline) {
        attempt += 1;
        details = await getWriteOffDetails({ requestGuid }, false).unwrap();
        status = getWriteOffStatus(details);

        console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] GET /v1/nontrade/securities/writeoff status poll', {
          attempt,
          requestGuid,
          status,
          remainingMs: Math.max(0, pollDeadline - Date.now()),
          details,
        });

        if (isWriteOffStatusReady(status)) {
          break;
        }

        const remainingMs = pollDeadline - Date.now();
        if (remainingMs <= 0) {
          break;
        }

        await sleep(Math.min(WRITEOFF_STATUS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS, remainingMs));
      }

      if (!isWriteOffStatusReady(status) || !details) {
        showFailed();
        return;
      }

      if (status === 'waiting_iia_close') {
        console.log(
          '[SecuritiesWriteOff] status waiting_iia_close — нужна форма закрытия ИИС',
          details,
        );
        showFailed('Ожидается закрытие ИИС. Продолжение пока недоступно.');
        return;
      }

      if (!isWriteOffSigningStatus(status)) {
        showFailed();
        return;
      }

      console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] signing documents ready', {
        requestGuid,
        status,
        details,
      });

      console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] GET /v1/nontrade/securities/writeoff/files', {
        requestGuid,
      });

      const files = await getWriteOffFiles({ requestGuid }, false).unwrap();

      console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOff] writeoff/files response', files);

      if (!files.length) {
        showFailed('Не удалось получить список документов для подписания.');
        return;
      }

      navigate(ROUTE_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_ORDER, {
        state: {
          formPayload: {
            ...formPayload,
            documentId: requestGuid,
          },
          requestGuid,
          writeOffDetails: details,
          writeOffStatus: status,
          referenceDocuments: files,
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[SecuritiesWriteOff] writeoff error', error);

      const errorData =
        (error as { data?: unknown } | undefined)?.data ??
        (error as { error?: unknown } | undefined)?.error;

      if (applyCheckResultErrors(errorData)) {
        return;
      }

      showFailed(getWriteOffErrorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setIsStatusPolling(false);
    }
  };

  if (step === 'FAILED') {
    return (
      <WriteOffFailed
        formPayload={formPayload}
        errorMessage={errorMessage}
        onRepeat={() => setStep('FORM')}
      />
    );
  }

  if (isParamsError) {
    return <BlockedContent type="errorInternalTransfer" />;
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderPage}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor size="large" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isStatusPolling) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderPage}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor size="large" />
        <Text>Обработка поручения...</Text>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      {isMobile && (
        <HeaderPage
          title={SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_PAGE_TITLE}
          documentTitle={SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_PAGE_TITLE}
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
          showDivider
        />
      )}

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrapper : styles.wrapperDesktop}>
        {!isMobile && (
          <>
            <Text className={styles.pageTitle}>{SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_PAGE_TITLE}</Text>
            <Button
              className={styles.backButton}
              iconLeft={<BackSvg />}
              onClick={handleBackClick}
              shape="inline"
              variant="white"
            >
              <Text type="labelMedium">Назад</Text>
            </Button>
          </>
        )}

        <div className={styles.form} onMouseDownCapture={preventClearButtonFocus}>
          <SearchSelect
            label="Инструмент:"
            className={styles.sideField}
            classNameLabel={styles.sideFieldLabel}
            classNamePopover={styles.searchSelectPopover}
            classNameContent={styles.searchSelectDropdown}
            classNameDescription={styles.fieldHint}
            placeholder="Введите название"
            scale="small"
            searchIcon
            clearable
            list={instrumentList}
            value={instrumentValue}
            minChar={3}
            emptyMessage={emptyMessage}
            separatorActionCells={false}
            status={fieldErrors.instrument ? 'error' : null}
            description={fieldErrors.instrument}
            onChange={(event) => {
              clearFieldError('instrument');
              setInstrumentValue(event.target.value);
              setSelectedInstrument(null);
              setIsinValue('');
              resetAccountAndBelow();
            }}
            onClear={clearSearchSelect(() => selectInstrument(null))}
            onSelect={(item) => {
              const selected =
                instruments.find((instrument) => instrument.depoInstrumentId === item.id) ?? null;
              selectInstrument(selected);
            }}
          />
          <Input
            label="ISIN:"
            className={`${styles.sideField} ${styles.fieldMax400}`}
            classNameLabel={styles.sideFieldLabel}
            placeholder="ISIN"
            scale="small"
            value={isinValue}
            disabled
          />

          <Text className={styles.sectionTitle}>Списать</Text>
          <SearchSelect
            label="Счёт:"
            className={styles.sideField}
            classNameLabel={styles.sideFieldLabel}
            classNamePopover={styles.searchSelectPopover}
            classNameContent={styles.searchSelectDropdown}
            classNameDescription={styles.fieldHint}
            description={fieldErrors.account ?? ACCOUNT_HINT}
            status={fieldErrors.account ? 'error' : null}
            placeholder="Выберите счёт"
            scale="small"
            searchIcon
            clearable
            list={accountList}
            value={accountValue}
            minChar={3}
            emptyMessage={!selectedInstrument ? 'Сначала выберите инструмент' : 'Ничего не найдено'}
            separatorActionCells={false}
            onChange={(event) => {
              clearFieldError('account');
              setAccountValue(event.target.value);
              setSelectedAccount(null);
              setQuantityValue('');
              resetModeAndBelow();
            }}
            onClear={clearSearchSelect(() => selectAccount(null))}
            onSelect={(item) => {
              const selected =
                accounts.find((account) => account.depoSubAccountId === item.id) ?? null;
              selectAccount(selected);
            }}
          />
          <SearchSelect
            label="Способ:"
            className={styles.sideField}
            classNameLabel={styles.sideFieldLabel}
            classNamePopover={styles.searchSelectPopover}
            classNameContent={styles.searchSelectDropdown}
            classNameDescription={styles.fieldHint}
            placeholder="Выберите способ"
            scale="small"
            searchIcon
            clearable
            list={modeList}
            value={modeValue}
            minChar={3}
            emptyMessage={!selectedAccount ? 'Сначала выберите счёт' : 'Ничего не найдено'}
            separatorActionCells={false}
            status={fieldErrors.mode ? 'error' : null}
            description={fieldErrors.mode}
            onChange={(event) => {
              clearFieldError('mode');
              setModeValue(event.target.value);
              setSelectedMode(null);
              setCommissionValue('');
            }}
            onClear={clearSearchSelect(() => selectMode(null))}
            onSelect={(item) => {
              const selected = modes.find((mode) => mode.code === item.id) ?? null;
              selectMode(selected);
            }}
          />
          <Input
            label="Количество:"
            className={styles.sideField}
            classNameLabel={styles.sideFieldLabel}
            classNameDescription={styles.fieldHint}
            description={
              fieldErrors.quantity
                ? fieldErrors.quantity
                : isQuantityOverMax && maxQuantity != null
                ? `Максимум ${formatQuantity(maxQuantity, quantityFractionPart)} шт.`
                : isQuantityNonPositive
                ? 'Количество должно быть больше 0'
                : selectedAccount
                ? formatQuantityHint(selectedAccount.quantity, quantityFractionPart, 'Доступно') ??
                  'Доступно — шт.'
                : 'Доступно — шт.'
            }
            placeholder="0"
            scale="small"
            variant="number"
            precision={quantityFractionPart}
            decimalSeparator="."
            allowedDecimalSeparators={['.', ',']}
            thousandSeparator=""
            allowLeadingZeros={false}
            status={fieldErrors.quantity || isQuantityError ? 'error' : null}
            value={quantityValue}
            onValueChange={handleQuantityValueChange}
            onBlur={handleQuantityBlur}
          />
          <Input
            label="Комиссия:"
            className={`${styles.sideField} ${styles.fieldMax400}`}
            classNameLabel={styles.sideFieldLabel}
            scale="small"
            value={formatCommissionDisplay(commissionValue)}
            disabled
          />

          <Text className={styles.sectionTitle}>Зачислить</Text>
          <SearchSelect
            label="Контрагент:"
            className={styles.sideField}
            classNameLabel={styles.sideFieldLabel}
            classNamePopover={styles.searchSelectPopover}
            classNameContent={styles.searchSelectDropdown}
            classNameDescription={styles.fieldHint}
            placeholder="Выберите контрагента"
            scale="small"
            searchIcon
            clearable
            list={contractorList}
            value={contractorValue}
            minChar={3}
            emptyMessage={
              isContractorsLoading || isContractorsFetching ? 'Загрузка...' : 'Ничего не найдено'
            }
            separatorActionCells={false}
            status={fieldErrors.contractor ? 'error' : null}
            description={fieldErrors.contractor}
            onChange={(event) => {
              clearFieldError('contractor');
              setContractorValue(event.target.value);
              setSelectedContractor(null);
            }}
            onClear={clearSearchSelect(() => selectContractor(null))}
            onSelect={(item) => {
              const selected =
                contractors.find((contractor, index) => {
                  const optionId = contractor.id ?? `${contractor.name}-${index}`;
                  return optionId === item.id || contractor.name === item.value;
                }) ?? null;
              selectContractor(selected);
            }}
          />
          <Checkbox
            className={styles.expensesCheckbox}
            classNameLabel={styles.expensesCheckboxLabel}
            label="Передать контрагенту информацию о расходах, связанных с приобретением и хранением переводимых активов"
            checked={transferExpensesInfo}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const checked = event.target.checked;
              setTransferExpensesInfo(checked);
              setCommissionValue(getDisplayCommission(selectedMode, checked));
            }}
          />
          {disclaimerTexts.length > 0 && (
            <div className={styles.disclaimer}>
              {disclaimerTexts.map((text, index) => (
                <div key={`${index}-${text.slice(0, 24)}`} className={styles.disclaimerItem}>
                  {renderWriteOffHtml(text)}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className={styles.footer}>
          <Button
            className={styles.navButton}
            iconRight={<ArrowNextIcon disabled={isNextBusy} />}
            onClick={handleNextClick}
            shape="inline"
            variant="white"
            disabled={isNextBusy}
          >
            <Text type="labelMedium">Далее</Text>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SecuritiesWriteOff;


--- FILE: src\modules\Transfers\pages\SecuritiesWriteOff\SecuritiesWriteOffUnavailable.tsx ---

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import Placeholder from '@aurora/placeholder';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_TRANSFERS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_PAGE_TITLE } from 'modules/Transfers/constants';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as BlockedSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/blocked.svg';

import styles from '../Withdrawal/components/Unavailable/Unavailable.module.pcss';

const SecuritiesWriteOffUnavailable = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_TRANSFERS);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant="close"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        title={SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_PAGE_TITLE}
      />
      <Placeholder
        variant="error"
        title="Раздел недоступен"
        text="У вас нет прав на просмотр этого раздела"

        actionSecondButtonText="Вернуться к переводам"

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import cx from 'classnames';

import placeHolder from 'images/icons/fi_placeholder.png';

import styles from './SecurityIcon.module.pcss';

type SecurityIconProps = {
  src?: string;
  alt?: string;
  square?: boolean;
};

/** Своя иконка вместо iconSrc SearchSelect: у кита abort при remount → onError → Avatar man1 */
const SecurityIcon = ({ src, alt = '', square = false }: SecurityIconProps) => {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setFailed(false);
  }, [src]);

  return (
    <img
      className={cx(styles.icon, square && styles.square)}
      src={!src || failed ? placeHolder : src}
      alt={alt}
      onError={() => setFailed(true)}
    />
  );
};

export default SecurityIcon;

import { createElement } from 'react';

import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { SecuritiesWriteOffResponse } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

export type WriteOffFormField =
  | 'instrument'
  | 'account'
  | 'mode'
  | 'quantity'
  | 'contractor'
  | 'personalDataAgreement';

export type WriteOffFieldErrors = Partial<Record<WriteOffFormField, string>>;

const CHECK_RESULT_STATUS_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  EMPTY: 'Поле должно быть заполнено',
  INVALID: 'Поле содержит неправильное значение',
};

const FIELD_NAME_MAP: Record<string, WriteOffFormField> = {
  // CheckResult.Field → form field (normalize: lower + keep underscore)
  // Backend: DepoInstrument_Id / DepoSubAccount_Id / Contractor_Id / …
  depoinstrument_id: 'instrument',
  instrument: 'instrument',
  instrument_id: 'instrument',
  deposubaccount_id: 'account',
  account: 'account',
  quantity: 'quantity',
  contractor_id: 'contractor', // Contractor_Id / contractor_Id
  contractor: 'contractor',
  sbp: 'mode',
  mode: 'mode',
  personaldataagreement: 'personalDataAgreement',
};

type RawCheckResultItem = {
  field?: string;
  Field?: string;
  status?: string;
  Status?: string;
  message?: string;
  Message?: string;
  errorMessageText?: string;
  ErrorMessageText?: string;
};

const normalizeKey = (value: string) =>
  value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^\d_a-z]/g, '');

const mapFieldName = (field?: string): WriteOffFormField | null => {
  if (!field) {
    return null;
  }

  return FIELD_NAME_MAP[normalizeKey(field)] ?? null;
};

const getCheckResultMessage = (item: RawCheckResultItem) => {
  const message = item.message ?? item.Message ?? item.errorMessageText ?? item.ErrorMessageText;
  if (typeof message === 'string' && message.trim()) {
    return message;
  }

  const status = item.status ?? item.Status;
  if (!status) {
    return CHECK_RESULT_STATUS_MESSAGES.INVALID;
  }

  return CHECK_RESULT_STATUS_MESSAGES[status.toUpperCase()] ?? CHECK_RESULT_STATUS_MESSAGES.INVALID;
};

export const parseWriteOffCheckResult = (
  response: SecuritiesWriteOffResponse | Record<string, unknown>,
): WriteOffFieldErrors => {
  const record = response as Record<string, unknown>;
  const rawList = (record.checkResult ?? record.CheckResult) as RawCheckResultItem[] | undefined;

  if (!Array.isArray(rawList) || rawList.length === 0) {
    return {};
  }

  return rawList.reduce<WriteOffFieldErrors>((errors, item) => {
    const status = (item.status ?? item.Status ?? '').toUpperCase();
    if (status === 'OK' || status === 'SUCCESS' || status === 'VALID') {
      return errors;
    }

    const formField = mapFieldName(item.field ?? item.Field);
    if (!formField) {
      return errors;
    }

    errors[formField] = getCheckResultMessage(item);
    return errors;
  }, {});
};

export const hasWriteOffFieldErrors = (errors: WriteOffFieldErrors) =>
  Object.keys(errors).length > 0;

/** Рендер HTML с бэка без экранирования тегов. */
export const renderWriteOffHtml = (html?: string) => {
  if (!html) {
    return;
  }

  return createElement('div', {
    dangerouslySetInnerHTML: { __html: sanitizeHtml(html) },
  });
};

import get from 'lodash/get';

export const DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE =
  'При запросе произошла ошибка. Повторите попытку позднее.';

const WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  SessionTokenNotSpecified: 'Не указан токен сессии',
  SessionClosed: 'Сессия была закрыта',
  NoSession: 'Отсутствует сессия',
  AccessDenied: 'Недостаточно полномочий',
  DepoNotFound: 'Не найден депозитарий',
  DepoNotSpecified: 'Не указан депозитарий',
  DepoSubAccountNotFound: 'Не найден раздел счета депо',
  DepoSubAccountNotSpecified: 'Не указан раздел счета депо',
  DuplicateRequestGUID: 'Данный запрос уже зарегистрирован в системе',
  InstrumentNotFound: 'Не найден инструмент',
  InstrumentNotSpecified: 'Не указан инструмент',
  PersonalDataAgreementNeeded: 'Требуется согласие на обработку персональных данных',
  NoFundsForCommission: 'Недостаточно денежных средств для списания комиссии',
  RequestNotFound: 'Не найден запрос',
  RequestGuidNotSpecified: 'Не указан GUID запроса',
  InvalidRequestState: 'Неверный статус запроса',
  QuantityExceeded: 'Превышено допустимое количество',
};

export const getWriteOffErrorCode = (error: unknown): string | undefined => {
  const code = get(error, 'data.Error.0.ErrorCode') ?? get(error, 'data.error.0.errorCode');
  return typeof code === 'string' ? code : undefined;
};

export const getWriteOffErrorMessage = (
  error: unknown,
  fallback = DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE,
): string => {
  const code = getWriteOffErrorCode(error);
  if (code && WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGES[code]) {
    return WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGES[code];
  }

  const serverMessage =
    get(error, 'data.Error.0.ErrorMessageText') ?? get(error, 'data.error.0.errorMessageText');

  if (typeof serverMessage === 'string' && serverMessage.trim()) {
    return serverMessage;
  }

  return fallback;
};

import {
  SecuritiesWriteOffDetailsResponse,
  SecuritiesWriteOffReferenceDocument,
  SecuritiesWriteOffStatus,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

/** Интервал между GET /nontrade/securities/writeoff при опросе статуса. */
export const WRITEOFF_STATUS_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 1000;

/** Максимальное время ожидания успешного статуса (3 минуты). */
export const WRITEOFF_STATUS_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS = 3 * 60 * 1000;

const WRITEOFF_SIGNING_STATUSES: SecuritiesWriteOffStatus[] = [
  'signing_document',
  'signing_documents',
];

const WRITEOFF_READY_STATUSES: SecuritiesWriteOffStatus[] = [
  'signing_document',
  'signing_documents',
  'waiting_iia_close',
];

export const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

export const getWriteOffStatus = (
  details?: SecuritiesWriteOffDetailsResponse | null,
): SecuritiesWriteOffStatus | undefined => details?.requestStatus?.[0]?.status;

export const getWriteOffDocuments = (
  details?: SecuritiesWriteOffDetailsResponse | null,
): SecuritiesWriteOffReferenceDocument[] => details?.referenceDocuments ?? [];

export const isWriteOffStatusReady = (status?: SecuritiesWriteOffStatus) =>
  Boolean(status && WRITEOFF_READY_STATUSES.includes(status));

export const isWriteOffSigningStatus = (status?: SecuritiesWriteOffStatus) =>
  Boolean(status && WRITEOFF_SIGNING_STATUSES.includes(status));

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Checkbox, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { APP_TITLE } from 'const/app';
import { ROUTE_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useSecuritiesWriteOffVerifyMutation } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { isRetriableOTPConfirmError } from 'utils/oneTimePassword';

import { SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_ORDER_PAGE_TITLE } from 'modules/Transfers/constants';
import {
  SecuritiesWriteOffFormPayload,
  SecuritiesWriteOffReferenceDocument,
  SecuritiesWriteOffStatus,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';

import {
  DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE,
  getWriteOffErrorMessage,
} from '../SecuritiesWriteOff/writeOffErrors';
import styles from './SecuritiesWriteOffOrder.module.pcss';
import WriteOffDocumentItem from './WriteOffDocumentItem';
import WriteOffFailed from './WriteOffFailed';
import WriteOffSuccess from './WriteOffSuccess';
import moexMoctLogo from './moex-moct.png';

const AGREEMENT_LABEL =
  'Подписывая кодом СМС я подтверждаю, что ознакомился и согласен со всеми документами и указанными в них условиями, принимаю все описанные риски.';
const SMS_PAGE_TITLE = 'SMS-подтверждение';

type OrderLocationState = {
  formPayload?: SecuritiesWriteOffFormPayload;
  requestGuid?: string;
  writeOffStatus?: SecuritiesWriteOffStatus;
  referenceDocuments?: SecuritiesWriteOffReferenceDocument[];
};

type OrderStep = 'ORDER' | 'CONFIRM' | 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED';

const SecuritiesWriteOffOrder = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [agreed, setAgreed] = useState(false);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<OrderStep>('ORDER');
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState(DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE);

  const [verifyWriteOff, { data: verifyData, isLoading: isVerifyLoading, reset: resetVerify }] =
    useSecuritiesWriteOffVerifyMutation();

  const state = (location.state as OrderLocationState | null) ?? {};
  const formPayload = state.formPayload;
  const requestGuid = state.requestGuid ?? formPayload?.documentId;
  const referenceDocuments = state.referenceDocuments ?? [];
  const otpChallenge = verifyData?.otpChallenge;

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = `${SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_ORDER_PAGE_TITLE} — ${APP_TITLE}`;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!formPayload || !requestGuid || !referenceDocuments.length) {
      navigate(ROUTE_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF, { replace: true });
    }
  }, [formPayload, navigate, referenceDocuments.length, requestGuid]);

  const handleSignClick = async () => {
    if (!agreed || !requestGuid || isVerifyLoading) {
      return;
    }

    console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOffOrder] POST /v1/nontrade/securities/writeoff/verify', {
      requestGuid,
    });

    try {
      const response = await verifyWriteOff({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
      console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOffOrder] writeoff/verify response', response);

      if (!response.otpChallenge) {
        setErrorMessage(response.requestStatus?.[0]?.warning || DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE);
        setStep('FAILED');
        return;
      }

      setStep('CONFIRM');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[SecuritiesWriteOffOrder] writeoff/verify error', error);
      setErrorMessage(getWriteOffErrorMessage(error));
      setStep('FAILED');
    }
  };

  const handleSmsSuccess = () => {
    resetVerify();
    setStep('SUCCESS');
  };

  const handleSmsError = (error: unknown) => {
    console.error('[SecuritiesWriteOffOrder] SMS confirmation error', error);

    // Неверный/просроченный код — остаёмся на экране SMS (как вывод/перевод).
    if (!isRetriableOTPConfirmError(error)) {
      resetVerify();
      setErrorMessage(getWriteOffErrorMessage(error));
      setStep('FAILED');
    }
  };

  const handleSmsBack = () => {
    resetVerify();
    setStep('ORDER');
  };

  const handleRepeat = () => {
    resetVerify();
    setAgreed(false);
    setErrorMessage(DEFAULT_WRITEOFF_ERROR_MESSAGE);
    setStep('ORDER');
  };

  if (!formPayload || !requestGuid || !referenceDocuments.length) {
    return null;
  }

  if (step === 'SUCCESS') {
    return <WriteOffSuccess formPayload={formPayload} />;
  }

  if (step === 'FAILED') {
    return (
      <WriteOffFailed
        formPayload={formPayload}
        errorMessage={errorMessage}
        onRepeat={handleRepeat}
      />
    );
  }

  if (step === 'CONFIRM') {
    if (!otpChallenge || isVerifyLoading) {
      return (
        <div className={styles.smsPage}>
          <HeaderPage
            size="small"
            title={SMS_PAGE_TITLE}
            documentTitle={SMS_PAGE_TITLE}
            leftIconVariant="back"
            onLeftIconClick={handleSmsBack}
          />
          <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
            <CircleLoader brandColor />
            <Text>Запрос СМС-кода...</Text>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className={styles.smsPage}>
        {!isMobile && <Text className={styles.smsPageTitle}>{SMS_PAGE_TITLE}</Text>}
        <SmsConfirmation
          initialOTPChallenge={otpChallenge}
          smsInputCount={4}
          onSuccess={handleSmsSuccess}
          onError={handleSmsError}
          onBackClick={handleSmsBack}
          loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется подписание поручения...</Text>}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      {isMobile && (
        <HeaderPage
          title={SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_ORDER_PAGE_TITLE}
          documentTitle={SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_ORDER_PAGE_TITLE}
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF)}
          showDivider
        />
      )}

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrapper : styles.wrapperDesktop}>
        {!isMobile && (
          <Text className={styles.pageTitle}>{SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_ORDER_PAGE_TITLE}</Text>
        )}

        <div className={styles.form}>
          <div className={styles.documents}>
            {referenceDocuments.map((document) => (
              <WriteOffDocumentItem
                key={`${document.type}-${document.crc}`}
                requestGuid={requestGuid}
                document={document}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <Checkbox
            className={styles.agreementCheckbox}
            label={AGREEMENT_LABEL}
            checked={agreed}
            onChange={(event) => setAgreed(event.target.checked)}
          />
        </div>

        <Button
          className={styles.signButton}
          variant="primary"
          disabled={!agreed || isVerifyLoading}
          onClick={handleSignClick}
        >
          Подписать кодом СМС
        </Button>

        <img className={styles.moexLogo} src={moexMoctLogo} alt="MOEX MOCT" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SecuritiesWriteOffOrder;

import { API_REQUEST_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_FILE } from 'core/api/apiConstants';

import useDownloadFile from 'hooks/useDownloadFile';

import { SecuritiesWriteOffReferenceDocument } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell';

type Props = {
  requestGuid: string;
  document: SecuritiesWriteOffReferenceDocument;
};

const buildWriteOffFileUrl = (requestGuid: string, fileType: string) => {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    requestGuid,
    fileType,
    download: 'false',
  });

  return `${API_REQUEST_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF_FILE}?${params.toString()}`;
};

const WriteOffDocumentItem = ({ requestGuid, document }: Props) => {
  const filePath = buildWriteOffFileUrl(requestGuid, document.type);

  console.log('[SecuritiesWriteOffOrder] GET /v1/nontrade/securities/writeoff/file', {
    requestGuid,
    fileType: document.type,
    filePath,
  });

  const { file, isError } = useDownloadFile({
    url: filePath,
    enabled: Boolean(document.type),
  });

  if (isError) {
    console.error('[SecuritiesWriteOffOrder] writeoff/file error', {
      requestGuid,
      fileType: document.type,
    });
  }

  return (
    <DocumentCell
      url={file?.url}
      name={document.displayName}
      id={document.crc || undefined}
      fullClickable
    />
  );
};

export default WriteOffDocumentItem;

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ActionCell, Card, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import {
  ROUTE_REQUISITES_VIEW,
  ROUTE_SECURITIES_REQUISITES,
  ROUTE_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF,
  ROUTE_WITHDRAWAL,
} from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { TRANSFERS_PAGE_TITLE } from 'modules/Transfers/constants';
import { getSecuritiesWriteOffPermission } from 'modules/Transfers/permissions';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as TransferIcon1 } from '../../img/icon (1).svg';
import { ReactComponent as TransferIcon2 } from '../../img/icon (2).svg';
import { ReactComponent as TransferIcon3 } from '../../img/icon (3).svg';
import styles from './Transfers.module.pcss';

type TransferMenuItem = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  link: string;
  icon: JSX.Element;
  visible?: boolean;
};

const Transfers = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const withdrawalGranted =
    (Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_OUT') ||
      Permissions.blocked('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_OUT')) &&
    Permissions.granted('PERSON_BANKDETAILS');

  const { isVisible: isSecuritiesWriteOffVisible } = getSecuritiesWriteOffPermission();

  const moneyItems: TransferMenuItem[] = [
    {
      id: 'money-requisites',
      title: 'Реквизиты для зачисления',
      description: 'Отобразить реквизиты для зачисления денежных средств',
      link: ROUTE_REQUISITES_VIEW,
      icon: <TransferIcon1 />,
      visible: true,
    },
    {
      id: 'money-withdrawal',
      title: 'Вывести на банковский счёт',
      description: 'Подача поручения на списание денежных средств',
      link: ROUTE_WITHDRAWAL,
      icon: <TransferIcon1 />,
      visible: withdrawalGranted,
    },
  ].filter((item) => item.visible);

  const securitiesItems: TransferMenuItem[] = [
    {
      id: 'securities-requisites',
      title: 'Реквизиты для зачисления',
      description: 'Отобразить реквизиты для зачисления ценных бумаг',
      link: ROUTE_SECURITIES_REQUISITES,
      icon: <TransferIcon3 />,
      visible: true,
    },
    {
      id: 'securities-writeoff',
      title: 'Списание ценных бумаг',
      description: 'Подача поручения на списание ценных бумаг к другому брокеру',
      link: ROUTE_SECURITIES_WRITEOFF,
      icon: <TransferIcon2 />,
      visible: isSecuritiesWriteOffVisible,
    },
  ].filter((item) => item.visible);

  const renderSection = (sectionTitle: string, items: TransferMenuItem[]) => (
    <section className={styles.section}>
      <Text className={styles.sectionTitle}>{sectionTitle}</Text>
      <div className={styles.items}>
        {items.map(({ id, title, description, link, icon }) => (
          <Card key={id} withShadow className={styles.itemCard}>
            <ActionCell
              title={title}
              description={description}
              iconLeft={icon}
              className={styles.itemActionCell}
              classNameTitle={styles.itemTitle}
              onClick={() => navigate(link)}
              separator={false}
              addonRight
            />
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );

  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      {isMobile && (
        <HeaderPage title={TRANSFERS_PAGE_TITLE} documentTitle={TRANSFERS_PAGE_TITLE} showDivider />
      )}

      <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrapper : styles.wrapperDesktop}>
        {!isMobile && <Text className={styles.pageTitle}>{TRANSFERS_PAGE_TITLE}</Text>}

        <div className={styles.form}>
          {renderSection('Денежные средства', moneyItems)}
          {renderSection('Ценные бумаги', securitiesItems)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Transfers;

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { ROUTE_REQUISITES } from 'const/routes';

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { ActionCell, Option, OptionsList } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as GlyphPlusSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/plus.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  open: boolean;
  selectedOption?: Option<number>;
  options: Option<number>[];
  onSelect: (option: Option<number>) => void;
  onAddBankDetails: () => void;
  submitEnable?: boolean;
  onSubmit: () => void;
  onDismiss: () => void;
  isBlocked: boolean;
};

const BankSelect = ({
  open,
  selectedOption,
  options,
  onSelect,
  onAddBankDetails,
  onSubmit,
  onDismiss,
  isBlocked,
}: Props) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isDenied = Permissions.denied('PERSON_BANKDETAILS_CREATE');

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.content}>
        <div className={cn(styles.wrapper, styles.header)}>
          <Text type="subtitleBold">Выберите реквизиты</Text>
          <Button variant="link" onClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_REQUISITES)}>
            Список
          </Button>
        </div>
        <OptionsList options={options} selectedOption={selectedOption} onChange={onSelect} />
        <div className={styles.separator} />
        {!isDenied && (
          <div className={styles.wrapper}>
            <ActionCell
              className={styles.addBankDetails}
              addonBefore={
                <GlyphPlusSvg
                  className={
                    !isBlocked ? styles.addBankDetailsBefore : styles.addBankDetailsBeforeBlocked
                  }
                />
              }
              onClick={onAddBankDetails}
              separator={false}
              disabled={isBlocked}
            >
              <Text type="lineRegular">Добавить реквизиты</Text>
            </ActionCell>
          </div>
        )}
        <Button
          className={styles.submit}
          variant="primary"
          onClick={onSubmit}
          disabled={!selectedOption}
        >
          Вывести
        </Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default BankSelect;

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Accordion, BottomSheet, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION } from 'const/routes';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import { ReactComponent as QuestionOutlineSvg } from 'images/icons/question-outline.svg';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const TRANSFER_OUTPUT_FAQ = 'TRANSFER_OUTPUT_FAQ';

type HintContent = {
  title: string;
  value: string;
  showHint: boolean;
}[];

const SingleAccountHint = () => {
  const { data } = useGetHintsQuery();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const loadedContent = useMemo(() => {
    const slug = data?.hints.find((item) => item.slug === TRANSFER_OUTPUT_FAQ);
    if (slug == null) return null;
    try {
      const parsed: HintContent = JSON.parse(slug.text);
      let hasHint = false;
      const content: HintContent = [];
      for (const { title, value } of parsed) {
        const showHint = !hasHint && title.toLowerCase().includes('портфель');
        if (showHint) hasHint = true;
        content.push({
          title,
          value: sanitizeHtml(value),
          showHint,
        });
      }

      return content;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, [data]);

  if (loadedContent == null || loadedContent.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <QuestionOutlineSvg onClick={() => setOpen(true)} />
      <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={() => setOpen(false)}>
        <div className={styles.wrapper}>
          <Text className={styles.title} type="subtitleBold">
            Вопросы и ответы
          </Text>
          <div>
            {loadedContent.map(({ title, value, showHint }, index) => (
              <Accordion key={index} title={title} isOpen={false}>
                <div className={styles.itemContent}>
                  {showHint && (
                    <Text tag="div" type="labelRegular" className={styles.hint}>
                      Подключите услугу{' '}
                      <Link to={ROUTE_MY_INFORMATION}>Единый брокерский счёт</Link> чтобы упростить
                      работу с портфелями
                    </Text>
                  )}
                  <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: value }} />
                </div>
              </Accordion>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </BottomSheet>
    </>
  );
};

export default SingleAccountHint;

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import CurrencyIcon from 'modules/Transfers/components/CurrencyIcon';
import { CurrencyOptionType } from 'modules/Transfers/components/CurrencySelect';
import { ProductBalance } from 'modules/Transfers/types';
import {
  Currency,
  PortfolioCurrencyWithdrawal,
  ProductBalanceVacantMoney,
} from 'modules/Transfers/types/moneyOperation';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

export const preparePortfolioOptions = (
  vacantMoney: ProductBalanceVacantMoney[],
  productId: number | null,
  availablePortfoliosForProduct: Set<number>,
  productCurrency?: PriceCurrencyType | null,
) => {
  const mapGroupByPortfolioId = vacantMoney
    .filter((item) => productId != null && item.productId === productId)
    .reduce((acc, item) => {
      const key = `${item.portfolioId}_${item.subAccountId}`;
      const arr = acc.get(key);
      if (arr) {
        arr.push(item);
      } else {
        acc.set(key, [item]);
      }

      return acc;
    }, new Map<string, ProductBalanceVacantMoney[]>());

  return Array.from(mapGroupByPortfolioId).map(([id, items]) => {
    const itemsWithBalance = items.filter((item) => item.balance > 0);
    const disabled = !availablePortfoliosForProduct.has(+id.split('_')[0]);
    const description =
      itemsWithBalance
        .map(
          ({ balance, currencyCode }) =>
            `${sumFormatter(balance).replace(/\s/g, '\u00A0')}\u00A0${currencySign(currencyCode)}`,
        )
        .join(' • ') || `0 ${productCurrency ? currencySign(productCurrency) : ''}`;

    const firstItem = items[0];

    return {
      id,
      title: firstItem.portfolioFullName,
      description,
      disabled,
    };
  });
};

const priorityCurrencies: PriceCurrencyType[] = ['RUB', 'USD', 'EUR'];

export const prepareCurrencyOptions = (
  portfolioCurrencies: PortfolioCurrencyWithdrawal[],
  currencies: Currency[] | undefined,
  productId: number | null,
  portfolioId: number | null,
): CurrencyOptionType[] => {
  if (!portfolioCurrencies.length || !currencies) {
    return [];
  }

  const currencySet = portfolioCurrencies.reduce((acc, item) => {
    if (item.productId === productId && item.portfolioId === portfolioId) {
      acc.add(item.currencyCode);
    }
    return acc;
  }, new Set<PriceCurrencyType>());

  const currencyNames = currencies.reduce(
    (acc, item) => acc.set(item.code, item.name),
    new Map<string, string>(),
  );

  const currencyCodes = priorityCurrencies
    .reduce<PriceCurrencyType[]>((acc, code) => {
      if (currencySet.has(code)) {
        currencySet.delete(code);
        acc.push(code);
      }
      return acc;
    }, [])
    .concat(Array.from(currencySet));

  return currencyCodes.map((currencyCode) => {
    const currencyName = currencyNames.get(currencyCode);

    return {
      id: currencyCode,
      icon: <CurrencyIcon currencyCode={currencyCode} />,
      title: currencyName ?? currencyCode,
    };
  });
};

export const prepareProductOptions = (
  products: ProductBalance[],
  currencies: PortfolioCurrencyWithdrawal[],
) => {
  const availableProductWithPortfoliosMap = currencies.reduce((acc, { productId, portfolioId }) => {
    if (!acc.has(productId)) {
      acc.set(productId, new Set([portfolioId]));
    } else {
      acc.get(productId)?.add(portfolioId);
    }
    return acc;
  }, new Map<number, Set<number>>());

  const spProductGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_STRUCTURE_PRODUCT');

  return {
    productOptions: products
      .filter(
        ({ productCategoryCode, balance }) =>
          (productCategoryCode !== 'STRUCT.PRODUCT' &&
            productCategoryCode !== 'IIA.STRUCT.PRODUCT') ||
          balance !== 0,
      )
      .map<Option<number>>(
        ({ productId, currencyBalance, currencyCode, productFullName, productCategoryCode }) => {
          let disabled = !availableProductWithPortfoliosMap.has(productId) ?? true;
          if (!disabled && productCategoryCode === 'STRUCT.PRODUCT') {
            disabled = !spProductGranted;
          }

          let description: string;
          if (disabled) {
            description = availableProductWithPortfoliosMap.has(productId)
              ? 'TRANSFER_OUTPUT_NO_ASSETS'
              : productCategoryCode.startsWith('IIA.')
              ? 'TRANSFER_OUTPUT_IIA'
              : productCategoryCode === 'TRADEMATIC.AUTO'
              ? 'TRANSFER_OUTPUT_MODEL'
              : 'TRANSFER_OUTPUT_OTHER_ACCOUNTS';
          } else {
            description = `Всего средств: ${sumFormatter(currencyBalance)} ${
              currencySign(currencyCode) || ''
            }`;
          }

          return {
            id: productId,
            title: productFullName,
            description,
            disabled,
          };
        },
      )
      .sort((a, b) => Number(a.disabled) - Number(b.disabled)),
    availableProductWithPortfoliosMap,
  };
};
