import debounce from 'lodash/debounce';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';
import {
  useBankDetailsQuery,
  useCurrenciesQuery,
  useFreeBalanceQuery,
  useLeverageQuery,
} from 'core/api/transfers';
//import { useGetUserSettingQuery, useUpdateUserSettingMutation } from 'core/api/userSettings';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useSnackBar } from 'hooks/useSnackBar';

import Currencies from 'modules/Transfers/components/CurrencySelect';
import ErrorBlock from 'modules/Transfers/components/ErrorBlock';
import SelectProductsAndPortfolios from 'modules/Transfers/components/SelectProductsAndPortfolios';
import { MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_PAGE_TITLE } from 'modules/Transfers/constants';
import ArrowNextIcon from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Refill/icons/ArrowNextIcon';

import { DynamicText, HeaderPage, Option } from 'components';
import AddonBottom from 'components/AddonBottom';
import ArrowUpIcon from 'components/icons/ArrowUpIcon';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import { showErrorMessage } from '../../helpers/showErrorMessage';
import { useMoneyOperationParams } from '../../hooks/useMoneyOperationParams';
import useOutAmount from '../../hooks/useOutAmount';
//import { usePortfolioDetails } from '../../hooks/usePortfolioDetails';
import { useWithdrawalDispatch, useWithdrawalState } from '../../hooks/useWithdrawalState';
import BankSelect from '../BankSelect';
//import LeverageBottomSheet from '../LeverageBottomSheet';
//import LeverageInfo from '../LeverageInfo';
import SingleAccountHint from '../SingleAccountHint';
//import WithdrawalInfo from '../WithdrawalInfo';
import Skeleton, { AmountInputSkeleton } from './Skeleton';
import { prepareCurrencyOptions, preparePortfolioOptions, prepareProductOptions } from './helpers';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const rules = [
  ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    return value[0] !== '0';
  },
  ({ value }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    return value.length < 15;
  },
];

const WithdrawalForm = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const setState = useWithdrawalDispatch();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const { product, portfolio, currencyCode, enteredAmount, bankDetailsData } = useWithdrawalState();

  const isBlocked = Permissions.blocked('PERSON_BANKDETAILS_CREATE');

  const productId = product?.id ?? null;
  const [portfolioId, subAccountId] = portfolio
    ? portfolio.id.split('_').map((str) => Number(str))
    : [null, null];

  const [amountValue, setAmountValue] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [amountInputFocused, setAmountInputFocused] = useState(false);
  const [bankSelectOpen, setSelectBankOpen] = useState(false);
  const [amountInputHintOpen, setAmountInputHintOpen] = useState(false);
  //const [leverageModalOpened, setLeverageModalOpened] = useState(false);
  //const [firstLeverage, setFirstLeverage] = useState(false);

  const {
    products,
    vacantMoneyData,
    productCurrencyMap,
    withdrawalCurrencies,
    isSuccess: isParamsSuccess,
    isError: isParamsError,
  } = useMoneyOperationParams();

  const hasUnavailableCurrencies = useMemo(
    () =>
      vacantMoneyData.some(({ currencyCode }) =>
        ['KZT', 'AMD', 'UZS', 'BYN'].includes(currencyCode),
      ),
    [vacantMoneyData],
  );

  useSnackBar((isParamsSuccess && hasUnavailableCurrencies) || false);

  //const { data: userSettingData } = useGetUserSettingQuery({ name: 'margin_use' });
  //const [setSettings] = useUpdateUserSettingMutation();

  // useEffect(() => {
  //   if (userSettingData && Number(userSettingData?.userSetting[0].value) !== 1) {
  //     setFirstLeverage(true);
  //   }
  // }, [userSettingData]);

  const { productOptions, availableProductWithPortfoliosMap } = useMemo(
    () => prepareProductOptions(products, withdrawalCurrencies),
    [products, withdrawalCurrencies],
  );
  const shouldSetDefaultProduct = product == null && productOptions.length > 0;

  const { data: hintsData } = useGetHintsQuery();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldSetDefaultProduct) return;
    const product = productOptions.find((item) => !item.disabled);
    if (!product) return;
    setState({ product });
  }, [productOptions, setState, shouldSetDefaultProduct]);

  const onProductSelect = (option: Option<number>) => {
    setAmountValue(null);
    setState((prev) =>
      prev.product && prev.product.id === option.id
        ? null
        : {
            product: option,
            portfolio: null,
            currencyCode: null,
            enteredAmount: null,
            bankDetailsData: null,
          },
    );
  };

  const handleOnAddBankDetails = () => {
    !isBlocked && navigate(ROUTE_NEW_REQUISITE);
  };

  const portfolioOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const productCurrency = productId ? productCurrencyMap.get(productId) : null;
    return preparePortfolioOptions(
      vacantMoneyData,
      productId,
      (productId && availableProductWithPortfoliosMap.get(productId)) || new Set([]),
      productCurrency,
    );
  }, [productId, productCurrencyMap, vacantMoneyData, availableProductWithPortfoliosMap]);

  const shouldSetDefaultPortfolio =
    portfolio == null && portfolioOptions.some(({ disabled }) => !disabled);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (shouldSetDefaultPortfolio) {
      setState({ portfolio: portfolioOptions.find(({ disabled }) => !disabled) });
    }
  }, [portfolioOptions, setState, shouldSetDefaultPortfolio]);

  const { data: currencies } = useCurrenciesQuery();
  const currencyId = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currencies) return null;
    return currencies.find((item) => item.code === currencyCode)?.id ?? null;
  }, [currencies, currencyCode]);

  const currencyOptions = useMemo(() => {
    return prepareCurrencyOptions(withdrawalCurrencies, currencies, productId, portfolioId);
  }, [currencies, withdrawalCurrencies, productId, portfolioId]);

  const shouldSetDefaultCurrencyCode = currencyCode == null && currencyOptions.length > 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!shouldSetDefaultCurrencyCode) return;
    const { id: currencyCode } = currencyOptions[0];
    setState({ currencyCode });
  }, [currencyOptions, setState, shouldSetDefaultCurrencyCode]);

  const onPortfolioSelect = (option: Option<string>) => {
    setAmountValue(null);
    const currencyCode = currencyOptions.find((item) => !item.disabled)?.id;
    setState((prev) =>
      prev.portfolio && prev.portfolio.id === option.id
        ? null
        : {
            portfolio: option,
            currencyCode: currencyCode,
            enteredAmount: null,
            bankDetailsData: null,
          },
    );
  };

  const debounceRefillAmountChange = useMemo(() => {
    return debounce((value: number | null | undefined) => {
      setState({ enteredAmount: value });
    }, 500);
  }, [setState]);

  const onAmountBlur = () => {
    debounceRefillAmountChange.flush();
    setAmountInputFocused(false);
  };

  const onAmountChange = ({ floatValue }: NumberFormatValues) => {
    const value = floatValue || null;
    setAmountValue(value);
    debounceRefillAmountChange(value);
  };

  const ref = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const setAmountInputFocus = () => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    ref.current.focus();
  };

  // const { singleBrokerageAccount = null } = usePortfolioDetails({
  //   productId,
  //   portfolioId,
  //   subAccountId,
  // });

  const { data: { bankDetails } = {} } = useBankDetailsQuery();
  const bankDetailOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (bankDetails == null) return [];
    return bankDetails.reduce<Option<number>[]>((acc, item) => {
      if (item.currencyCode === currencyCode) {
        acc.push({
          id: item.bankDetailsId,
          title: item.name,
          description:
            (item.checkingAccount || item.benBankAccount) &&
            `Расчётный счёт ${item.checkingAccount ?? item.benBankAccount}`,
        });
      }
      return acc;
    }, []);
  }, [bankDetails, currencyCode]);

  const selectedBank = bankDetailOptions.find((item) => item.id === bankDetailsData?.bankDetailsId);
  const shouldSetDefaultBankDetails = bankDetailsData == null && !!bankDetails?.length;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (shouldSetDefaultBankDetails) {
      setState({ bankDetailsData: bankDetails[0] });
    }
  }, [bankDetails, setState, shouldSetDefaultBankDetails]);

  const portfolioParams =
    portfolioId == null || subAccountId == null || currencyId == null
      ? skipToken
      : {
          currencyId,
          subAccountId,
          portfolioId,
        };
  const { isError: isLeverageError, currentData: { enabled, needOpenCategory } = {} } =
    useLeverageQuery(portfolioParams);
  const leverageCheckboxDisabled = !enabled && !needOpenCategory;
  const {
    isError: isFreeBalanceError,
    isFetching: isFreeBalanceFetching,
    currentData: {
      balance: freeBalance,
      balanceWithLeverage: freeBalanceWithLeverage,
      commission,
    } = {},
  } = useFreeBalanceQuery(portfolioParams);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFreeBalanceError || isLeverageError) {
      showErrorMessage();
    }
  }, [isFreeBalanceError, isLeverageError]);

  const {
    //isTaxWriteOffLoading,
    maxOutAmount = null,
    derivableAmount = null,
    pit,
    //retryCount,
  } = useOutAmount({
    portfolioId,
    subAccountId,
    commission,
    currencyId,
    freeBalance,
    freeBalanceWithLeverage,
    //useLeverage,
    enteredAmount,
  });

  const max = maxOutAmount != null ? maxOutAmount : freeBalance;

  // const max =
  // maxOutAmount != null ? maxOutAmount : useLeverage ? freeBalanceWithLeverage : freeBalance;

  const portfoliosError = product && portfolioOptions.length === 0;
  const isAmountInputDisabled = isFreeBalanceError || !isParamsSuccess || max == null || max <= 0;

  const isErrorAmountValue = !isAmountInputDisabled && enteredAmount != null && enteredAmount > max;

  const canChooseBank =
    !isAmountInputDisabled &&
    productId != null &&
    portfolioId != null &&
    currencyCode != null &&
    !!enteredAmount &&
    maxOutAmount != null &&
    enteredAmount <= maxOutAmount;

  const canSubmit =
    canChooseBank &&
    bankDetailsData != null &&
    subAccountId != null &&
    currencyId != null &&
    pit != null &&
    derivableAmount != null &&
    freeBalance != null &&
    freeBalanceWithLeverage != null;

  const headerPageMobile = (
    <HeaderPage
      size="small"
      title={MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_PAGE_TITLE}
      documentTitle={MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_PAGE_TITLE}
      leftIconVariant="back"
      onLeftIconClick={() => {
        navigate(ROUTE_TRANSFERS);
      }}
      addonRight={<SingleAccountHint />}
    />
  );

  const headlineDesktop = (
    <div className={styles.headlineDesktop}>
      <Text className={styles.pageTitle}>{MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_PAGE_TITLE}</Text>
      <SingleAccountHint />
    </div>
  );

  const amountTextComponent = max ? (
    <div>
      Доступно{' '}
      <span
        className={styles.amountHintValue}
        onClick={() => {
          setAmountValue(max);
          setState({ enteredAmount: max });
        }}
      >
        {sumFormatter(max)} {currencyCode ? currencySign(currencyCode) : ''}
      </span>{' '}
      •{' '}
      <span className={styles.amountHintTooltip} onClick={() => setAmountInputHintOpen(true)}>
        Почему меньше?
      </span>
    </div>
  ) : (
    <></>
  );

  const commissionTextComponent = commission ? (
    <div className={styles.commission}>
      Комиссия{' '}
      <span className={styles.amountHintValue}>
        {sumFormatter(commission)} {currencyCode ? currencySign(currencyCode) : ''}
      </span>
    </div>
  ) : (
    <></>
  );

  const [debouncedError, setDebouncedError] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isParamsError) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => setDebouncedError(true), 500);

    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [isParamsError]);

  if (debouncedError) {
    throw new Error('Params error');
  }

  if (!isParamsSuccess) {
    return (
      <>
        {isMobile ? headerPageMobile : headlineDesktop}
        <Skeleton />
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      {isMobile ? headerPageMobile : headlineDesktop}

      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <div className={styles.main}>
          <div>
            <SelectProductsAndPortfolios
              products={productOptions}
              portfolios={portfolioOptions}
              selectedProduct={product || undefined}
              selectedPortfolio={portfolio || undefined}
              onProductSelect={onProductSelect}
              onPortfolioSelect={onPortfolioSelect}
              comment="Сумма, доступная для вывода, указана после предварительного вычета комиссий и НДФЛ"
              descriptionHidden
              portfolioDescrTitle="Средств в портфеле"
              hints={hintsData?.hints || []}
              showHints
            />
          </div>
          {portfoliosError && (
            <ErrorBlock
              title="Нет доступных портфелей для выбранных параметров"
              description="Выберите другой счёт или обновите страницу"
            />
          )}

          <div>
            <Text type="bodySemiBold" className={styles.amountTitle}>
              Сумма вывода
            </Text>
            <div className={styles.amountWrapper}>
              {isFreeBalanceFetching ? (
                <AmountInputSkeleton />
              ) : (
                <AmountInput
                  ref={ref}
                  placeholder="0"
                  value={(!isAmountInputDisabled && amountValue) || ''}
                  rules={rules}
                  onChange={onAmountChange}
                  onBlur={onAmountBlur}
                  error={isErrorAmountValue}
                  disabled={isAmountInputDisabled}
                  onFocus={() => setAmountInputFocused(true)}
                  suffix=""
                  max={max}
                />
              )}
              <Currencies
                currencyOptions={currencyOptions}
                selectedCurrencyCode={currencyCode}
                onCurrencyChange={(value) => {
                  setAmountValue(null);
                  setState({
                    currencyCode: value.id as PriceCurrencyType,
                    enteredAmount: null,
                    bankDetailsData: null,
                  });
                }}
                hintHidden
                disabled={currencyOptions.length < 1}
              />
              <Text className={styles.amountHint} type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
                {isFreeBalanceFetching ? (
                  <>&nbsp;</>
                ) : isAmountInputDisabled &&
                  !leverageCheckboxDisabled &&
                  Number(freeBalanceWithLeverage) > 0 ? (
                  <span className={styles.textColorError}>
                    Нет средств, доступных для вывода
                    <br />
                    Вы можете попробовать вывести средства под обеспечение
                  </span>
                ) : isAmountInputDisabled ? (
                  <span className={styles.textColorError}>Нет средств, доступных для вывода</span>
                ) : isErrorAmountValue ? (
                  <span className={styles.textColorError}>
                    Недостаточно средств. Доступно {sumFormatter(max)}{' '}
                    {currencyCode ? currencySign(currencyCode) : ''}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {amountTextComponent}
                    {commissionTextComponent}
                    <BottomSheet
                      open={amountInputHintOpen}
                      onDismiss={() => setAmountInputHintOpen(false)}
                    >
                      <DynamicText
                        className={styles.inputHintBottomSheet}
                        type="bodyRegular"
                        slug="TRANSFER_OUTPUT_BANK_ACCOUNT_AMOUNT"
                      />
                    </BottomSheet>
                  </>
                )}
              </Text>
            </div>
            {/*  <div className={styles.info}>
                             {isTaxWriteOffLoading ? (
                <div className={styles.infoLoader}>
                  {retryCount >= 5 && (
                    <Text
                      className={styles.infoLoaderText}
                      type="labelRegular"
                      color="colorForeground2"
                    >
                      Пожалуйста, подождите. Расчёт НДФЛ занял больше времени, чем обычно
                    </Text>
                  )}
                  <span className={styles.infoLoaderCircle}>
                    <CircleLoader brandColor size={'small'} />
                  </span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <WithdrawalInfo
                  commission={commission}
                  pit={pit}
                  derivableAmount={derivableAmount}
                  currencyCode={currencyCode}
                />
              )} 
            </div>
            {useLeverage && firstLeverage ? (
              <div className={styles.leverageInfo}>
                <LeverageInfo
                  onClose={() => {
                    setFirstLeverage(false);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            ) : null}*/}
          </div>
        </div>
        <AddonBottom>
          <div className={styles.footer}>
            {/*             <Checkbox
              checked={useLeverage}
              disabled={leverageCheckboxDisabled}
              onChange={(event) => {
                if (enabled && !useLeverage && firstLeverage) {
                  setSettings({ name: 'margin_use', value: '1' });
                }

                if (enabled) {
                  setState({ useLeverage: event.target.checked, enteredAmount: null });
                } else if (needOpenCategory) {
                  setLeverageModalOpened(true);
                }
              }}
              label={
                <Text
                  tag="span"
                  type="lineMedium"
                  color={leverageCheckboxDisabled ? 'colorForeground3' : 'colorForeground2'}
                >
                  Обеспечение
                </Text>
              }
            /> */}

            {amountValue || amountInputFocused ? (
              <Button
                className={styles.btn}
                variant="secondary"
                size="s"
                iconRight={<ArrowNextIcon disabled={!canChooseBank} />}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectBankOpen(true);
                }}
                disabled={!canChooseBank}
              >
                <Text type="lineMedium">Вывести</Text>
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button
                className={styles.btn}
                variant="secondary"
                size="s"
                iconRight={<ArrowUpIcon disabled={isAmountInputDisabled} />}
                onClick={setAmountInputFocus}
                disabled={isAmountInputDisabled}
              >
                <Text type="lineMedium">Введите сумму</Text>
              </Button>
            )}

            <BankSelect
              open={bankSelectOpen}
              selectedOption={selectedBank}
              options={bankDetailOptions}
              onSelect={(option: Option<number>) => {
                const bankDetailsData = bankDetails?.find(
                  (item) => item.bankDetailsId === option.id,
                );
                if (bankDetailsData == null) return;
                setState({ bankDetailsData });
              }}
              onAddBankDetails={handleOnAddBankDetails}
              submitEnable={canSubmit}
              onSubmit={() => {
                setState({
                  step: 'REVIEW',
                  subAccountId,
                  currencyId,
                  pit,
                  derivableAmount,
                  freeBalance,
                  freeBalanceWithLeverage,
                  commission,
                });
              }}
              onDismiss={() => {
                setSelectBankOpen(false);
              }}
              isBlocked={isBlocked}
            />

            {/*             <LeverageBottomSheet
              open={leverageModalOpened}
              onDismiss={() => setLeverageModalOpened(false)}
            /> */}
          </div>
        </AddonBottom>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default WithdrawalForm;

import { CurrencyOptionType } from 'modules/Transfers/components/CurrencySelect';
import { PortfolioCurrencyWithdrawal, ProductBalance } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { prepareCurrencyOptions, preparePortfolioOptions, prepareProductOptions } from '../helpers';
import {
  CURRENCIES,
  CURRENCIES_OPTIONS,
  CurrencyForPreparation,
  PARSED_PRODUCT_OPTIONS,
  PORTFOLIO_CURRENCY_WITHDRAWAL,
  PORTFOLIO_OPTIONS,
  PRODUCT_BALANCE,
  PortfolioForPreparation,
  VACANT_MONEY_MOCK_DATA,
} from '../mockConsts';

describe('test preparePortfolioOptions helper', () => {
  type TestTuple = [PortfolioForPreparation, Option<string>[]];
  const MOCK_DATA: TestTuple[] = [
    [
      {
        vacantMoney: VACANT_MONEY_MOCK_DATA,
        productId: 4,
        availablePortfoliosForProduct: new Set([10, 5]),
        productCurrency: 'EUR',
      },
      PORTFOLIO_OPTIONS,
    ],
    [
      {
        vacantMoney: VACANT_MONEY_MOCK_DATA,
        productId: 1,
        availablePortfoliosForProduct: new Set([10, 5]),
        productCurrency: 'USD',
      },
      [],
    ],
  ];

  test.each(MOCK_DATA)('portfolios: %o, expected: %o ', (data, expected) => {
    expect(
      preparePortfolioOptions(
        data.vacantMoney,
        data.productId,
        data.availablePortfoliosForProduct,
        data.productCurrency,
      ),
    ).toStrictEqual(expected);
  });
});

describe('test prepareCurrencyOptions helper', () => {
  type TestTuple = [CurrencyForPreparation, CurrencyOptionType[]];
  const MOCK_DATA: TestTuple[] = [
    [
      {
        portfolioCurrencies: PORTFOLIO_CURRENCY_WITHDRAWAL,
        currencies: CURRENCIES,
        productId: 5,
        portfolioId: 6,
      },
      CURRENCIES_OPTIONS,
    ],
    [
      {
        portfolioCurrencies: PORTFOLIO_CURRENCY_WITHDRAWAL,
        currencies: CURRENCIES,
        productId: 5,
        portfolioId: 1,
      },
      [],
    ],
  ];

  test.each(MOCK_DATA)('currency: %o, expected: %o ', (data, expected) => {
    expect(
      prepareCurrencyOptions(
        data.portfolioCurrencies,
        data.currencies,
        data.productId,
        data.portfolioId,
      ),
    ).toStrictEqual(expected);
  });
});

describe('test prepareProductOption helper', () => {
  type TestTuple = [
    { products: ProductBalance[]; currencies: PortfolioCurrencyWithdrawal[] },
    {
      availableProductWithPortfoliosMap: Map<number, Set<number>>;
      productOptions: Option<number>[];
    },
  ];
  const MOCK_DATA: TestTuple[] = [
    [
      {
        products: PRODUCT_BALANCE,
        currencies: PORTFOLIO_CURRENCY_WITHDRAWAL,
      },
      PARSED_PRODUCT_OPTIONS,
    ],
    [
      {
        products: [],
        currencies: PORTFOLIO_CURRENCY_WITHDRAWAL,
      },
      {
        availableProductWithPortfoliosMap: new Map([[5, new Set([6, 7])]]),
        productOptions: [],
      },
    ],
  ];

  test.each(MOCK_DATA)('balances: %o, expected: %o ', (data, expected) => {
    expect(prepareProductOptions(data.products, data.currencies)).toStrictEqual(expected);
  });
});

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import Hint from '@vision/hint';
import cn from 'classnames';

import { sumFormatter } from 'core/helpers/json';
import { Nullable } from 'core/types';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { DynamicPartial } from 'components/Hint';

import { ReactComponent as IconSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/small-question-outline.svg';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  className?: string;
  commission: Nullable<number>;
  pit: Nullable<number>;
  derivableAmount: Nullable<number>;
  currencyCode: Nullable<PriceCurrencyType>;
};

type InfoItemProps = {
  value: Nullable<number>;
  label: string;
  sign: string;
  hintSlug?: string;
};

const InfoItem = ({ value, label, sign, hintSlug }: InfoItemProps) => {
  return (
    <div className={styles.item}>
      <Text className={styles.label} type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
        {hintSlug ? (
          <Hint placement="topLeft" content={<DynamicPartial slug={hintSlug} />}>
            {label} <IconSvg />
          </Hint>
        ) : (
          label
        )}
      </Text>
      <Text className={styles.value} type="labelMedium" color="colorForeground">
        {value != null ? `${sumFormatter(value)} ${sign}` : '–'}
      </Text>
    </div>
  );
};

const WithdrawalInfo = ({
  className,
  commission,
  pit,
  derivableAmount: enteredAmount,
  currencyCode,
}: Props) => {
  const sign = (currencyCode != null && currencySign(currencyCode)) || '';

  return (
    <div className={cn(className, styles.list)}>
      <InfoItem
        label="Комиссия"
        value={commission}
        sign={sign}
        hintSlug="TRANSFER_OUTPUT_COMMISSION"
      />
      {/* <InfoItem label="НДФЛ" value={pit} sign={sign} hintSlug="TRANSFER_OUTPUT_TAX" /> */}
      <InfoItem label="Итого спишется" value={enteredAmount} sign={sign} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default WithdrawalInfo;

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useWithdrawalDispatch } from '../../hooks/useWithdrawalState';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

const WithdrawalPreview = () => {
  const setState = useWithdrawalDispatch();

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>

import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useMoneyWithdrawalMutation } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { isRetriableOTPConfirmError } from 'utils/oneTimePassword';

import { MoneyWithdrawalParams } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';

import { validateFormData } from '../../helpers/validateFormData';
import { useWithdrawalDispatch, useWithdrawalState } from '../../hooks/useWithdrawalState';
import styles from './styles.module.pcss';

type Props = {
  onBackClick?: () => void;
};

const WithdrawalSmsConfirmation = ({ onBackClick }: Props) => {
  const setState = useWithdrawalDispatch();
  const {
    bankDetailsData,
    currencyCode,
    enteredAmount,
    derivableAmount,
    freeBalance,
    freeBalanceWithLeverage,
    portfolio,
    product,
    currencyId,
    subAccountId,
    commission,
    pit,
  } = useWithdrawalState();

  const [mutate, result] = useMoneyWithdrawalMutation();
  if (result.error) {
    throw new Error('MoneyWithdrawal error');
  }

  const moneyWithdrawalParams = useMemo((): MoneyWithdrawalParams | null => {
    const result = validateFormData({
      bankDetailsData,
      currencyCode,
      enteredAmount,
      derivableAmount,
      freeBalance,
      freeBalanceWithLeverage,
      portfolio,
      product,
      currencyId,
      subAccountId,
      commission,
      pit,
    });

    if (result.success) {
      const {
        portfolio,
        subAccountId,
        currencyId,
        freeBalance,
        freeBalanceWithLeverage,
        commission,
        pit,
        enteredAmount: volume,
        bankDetailsData: {
          bankDetailsId,
          name,
          payee,
          bic,
          checkingAccount,
          benBankSwift: benBankSWIFT,
          benBankAccount,
          corrBankSwift: corrBankSWIFT,
          corrBankAccount,
        },
      } = result.data;

      const portfolioId = Number(portfolio.id.split('_')[0]);

      return {
        portfolioId,
        subAccountId,
        currencyId,
        freeBalance,
        freeBalanceWithLeverage,
        bankDetailsId,
        volume,
        name,
        payee,
        bic,
        checkingAccount,
        benBankSWIFT,
        benBankAccount,
        corrBankSWIFT,
        corrBankAccount,
        commission,
        pit,
      };
    }

    return null;
  }, [
    bankDetailsData,
    currencyCode,
    enteredAmount,
    derivableAmount,
    freeBalance,
    freeBalanceWithLeverage,
    portfolio,
    product,
    currencyId,
    subAccountId,
    commission,
    pit,
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (moneyWithdrawalParams == null) return;

    mutate(moneyWithdrawalParams);
  }, [mutate, moneyWithdrawalParams]);

  if (moneyWithdrawalParams == null) {
    throw new Error('Params validation error');
  }

  const { data: { otpChallenge } = {} } = result;
  if (otpChallenge == null) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage
          size="small"
          title="SMS-подтверждение"
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={onBackClick}
        />
        <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
          <CircleLoader brandColor size={'large'} />
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>
      <SmsConfirmation
        initialOTPChallenge={otpChallenge}
        smsInputCount={4}
        onBackClick={onBackClick}
        onSuccess={() => {
          setState({ step: 'SUCCESS' });
        }}
        onError={(error) => {
          if (!isRetriableOTPConfirmError(error)) {
            setState({ step: 'FAILED' });
          }
        }}
        loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется вывод денежных средств...</Text>}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default WithdrawalSmsConfirmation;

import { State } from '../hooks/useWithdrawalState';

type NonNullableRecord<R extends Record<string, unknown>> = {
  [K in keyof R]: Exclude<R[K], null | undefined>;
};

type FormStateInput = Pick<
  State,
  | 'product'
  | 'portfolio'
  | 'currencyCode'
  | 'bankDetailsData'
  | 'derivableAmount'
  | 'enteredAmount'
  | 'freeBalance'
  | 'freeBalanceWithLeverage'
  | 'currencyId'
  | 'subAccountId'
  | 'commission'
  | 'pit'
>;

type FormStateOutput = NonNullableRecord<FormStateInput>;

type Result =
  | {
      success: true;
      data: FormStateOutput;
    }
  | {
      success: false;
    };

const isFormStateOutput = (input: FormStateInput): input is FormStateOutput => {
  const isValidPortfolioId =
    input.portfolio != null
      ? Number.isFinite(Number.parseInt(input.portfolio.id.split('_')[0]))
      : false;

  return (
    isValidPortfolioId &&
    input.portfolio != null &&
    input.currencyCode != null &&
    input.bankDetailsData != null &&
    input.derivableAmount != null &&
    input.enteredAmount != null &&
    input.freeBalance != null &&
    input.freeBalanceWithLeverage != null &&
    input.subAccountId != null &&
    input.currencyId != null
  );
};

export const validateFormData = (data: FormStateInput): Result => {
  if (isFormStateOutput(data) && data.enteredAmount > 0) {
    return {
      success: true,
      data,
    };
  }

  return {
    success: false,
  };
};

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import { useGetMoneyOperationParamsQuery } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

export const useMoneyOperationParams = () => {
  const { data, isError, isLoading, isSuccess } = useGetMoneyOperationParamsQuery();

  const computedData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data) {
      return {
        products: [],
        vacantMoneyData: [],
        productCurrencyMap: new Map<number, PriceCurrencyType>(),
        operations: [],
        withdrawalCurrencies: [],
      };
    }

    const products = data.productBalance;
    const vacantMoneyData = data.productBalanceVacantMoney;

    const productCurrencyMap = new Map<number, PriceCurrencyType>();
    for (const { productId, currencyCode } of data.productBalance) {
      productCurrencyMap.set(productId, currencyCode);
    }

    return {
      products,
      vacantMoneyData,
      productCurrencyMap,
      operations: data.portfolioNontradeOperationMatrix,
      withdrawalCurrencies: data.portfolioCurrencyWithdrawal,
    };
  }, [data]);

  return {
    ...computedData,
    isError,
    isLoading,
    isSuccess,
  };
};

import { useMemo } from 'react';

import { skipToken } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query';

import { usePortfoliosQuery } from 'core/api/transfers';

import { Portfolio } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

type Params = {
  productId: string | number | null;
  portfolioId: string | number | null;
  subAccountId: string | number | null;
};

export const usePortfolioDetails = ({ productId, portfolioId, subAccountId }: Params) => {
  const { currentData } = usePortfoliosQuery(productId ? productId : skipToken);
  return useMemo<Partial<Portfolio>>(() => {
    if (!Array.isArray(currentData) || !portfolioId || !subAccountId) return {};
    return (
      currentData.find(
        (portfolio) =>
          String(portfolio.portfolioId) === portfolioId &&
          String(portfolio.subAccountId) === subAccountId,
      ) ?? {}
    );
  }, [currentData, portfolioId]);
};

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { skipToken } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/dist/query';
import { ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import {
  useTaxWriteOffQuery,
  useTaxWriteOffResponseQuery,
  useTaxWriteOffStatusQuery,
} from 'core/api/transfers';

import { showErrorMessage } from '../helpers/showErrorMessage';

export const useTaxWriteOff = ({
  throwAfterRetry = false,
  retry: maxRetryCount = 300,
}: { throwAfterRetry?: boolean; retry?: number } = {}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);

  const guidQuery = useTaxWriteOffQuery();
  const {
    data: taxWriteOffStatus,
    isError: isTaxWriteOffStatusError,
    refetch,
  } = useTaxWriteOffStatusQuery(guidQuery.data, {
    skip: !guidQuery.isSuccess || retryCount >= maxRetryCount,
  });

  const isError = isTaxWriteOffStatusError || taxWriteOffStatus === 'error';
  const isRetriesFailed = retryCount >= maxRetryCount;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isRetriesFailed && throwAfterRetry) {
      throw new Error(`useTaxWriteOff error`);
    } else if (isRetriesFailed) {
      navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
    }
  }, [navigate, isRetriesFailed, throwAfterRetry]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isError) {
      showErrorMessage();
    }
  }, [isError]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      taxWriteOffStatus == null ||
      taxWriteOffStatus === 'completed' ||
      taxWriteOffStatus === 'error' ||
      retryCount >= maxRetryCount
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const id = setTimeout(() => {
      refetch();
      setRetryCount((prev) => prev + 1);
    }, 3000);

    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [taxWriteOffStatus, refetch, retryCount, maxRetryCount]);

  const query = useTaxWriteOffResponseQuery(
    !guidQuery.isSuccess || taxWriteOffStatus !== 'completed' ? skipToken : guidQuery.data,
  );

  return {
    ...query,
    retryCount,
  };
};

import { Dispatch, createContext, useContext } from 'react';

import { BankDetail } from 'modules/Transfers/types';

import { Option } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

export type State = {
  product: Option<number> | null;
  portfolio: Option<string> | null;
  subAccountId: number | null;
  currencyId: number | null;
  currencyCode: PriceCurrencyType | null;
  enteredAmount: number | null;
  derivableAmount: number | null;
  pit: number | null;
  useLeverage: boolean;
  bankDetailsData: BankDetail | null;
  freeBalance: number | null;
  freeBalanceWithLeverage: number | null;
  step: 'FILL_IN' | 'REVIEW' | 'CONFIRM' | 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED';
  commission: number | null;
};

export const getInitialState = (): State => ({
  product: null,
  portfolio: null,
  subAccountId: null,
  currencyId: null,
  currencyCode: null,
  enteredAmount: null,
  pit: null,
  derivableAmount: null,
  bankDetailsData: null,
  useLeverage: false,
  freeBalance: null,
  freeBalanceWithLeverage: null,
  step: 'FILL_IN',
  commission: null,
});

export type ActionState = Partial<State> | ((state: State) => Partial<State> | null) | null;

export const reducer = (state: State, update: ActionState): State => {
  const changes = typeof update === 'function' ? update(state) : update;

  if (changes === null) return state;

  return {
    ...state,
    ...changes,
  };
};

export const WithdrawalContextState = createContext(getInitialState());
export const WithdrawalContextDispatch = createContext<Dispatch<ActionState>>(() => null);

export const useWithdrawalState = (): State => {
  return useContext(WithdrawalContextState);
};

export const useWithdrawalDispatch = (): Dispatch<ActionState> => {
  return useContext(WithdrawalContextDispatch);
};

import { useCallback, useReducer } from 'react';
import { ErrorBoundary } from 'react-error-boundary';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_TRANSFERS } from 'const/routes';

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import SomethingWentWrong from 'modules/SomethingWentWrong/SomethingWentWrong';
import { MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_PAGE_TITLE } from 'modules/Transfers/constants';
import { WithdrawalUnavailable } from 'modules/Transfers/pages/Withdrawal/components/Unavailable';

import Withdrawal from './Withdrawal';
import {
  WithdrawalContextDispatch,
  WithdrawalContextState,
  getInitialState,
  reducer,
} from './hooks/useWithdrawalState';

const WithdrawalPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [state, setState] = useReducer(reducer, null, getInitialState);

  const permissionGranted =
    Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_OUT') &&
    Permissions.granted('PERSON_BANKDETAILS') &&
    Permissions.someGranted('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_OUT');

  const goToTransfers = useCallback(() => navigate(ROUTE_TRANSFERS), [navigate]);

  return (
    <WithdrawalContextDispatch.Provider value={setState}>
      <WithdrawalContextState.Provider value={state}>
        <ErrorBoundary
          fallbackRender={({ resetErrorBoundary }) => (
            <SomethingWentWrong
              title={MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_PAGE_TITLE}
              error={MONEY_WITHDRAWAL_PAGE_TITLE}
              text="Попробуйте ещё раз или вернитесь позднее, чтобы повторить попытку"
              buttonText="Повторить попытку"
              secondButtonText="Вернуться к переводам"
              onAction={() => {
                setState(getInitialState());
                resetErrorBoundary();
              }}
              onClose={goToTransfers}
              onSecondAction={goToTransfers}
            />
          )}
        >
          {!permissionGranted ? <WithdrawalUnavailable /> : <Withdrawal />}
        </ErrorBoundary>
      </WithdrawalContextState.Provider>
    </WithdrawalContextDispatch.Provider>
  );
};

export default WithdrawalPage;


--- FILE: src\modules\Transfers\pages\Withdrawal\Withdrawal.tsx ---

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import WithdrawalForm from './components/WithdrawalForm';
import WithdrawalReview from './components/WithdrawalReview';
import WithdrawalSmsConfirmation from './components/WithdrawalSmsConfirmation';
import { WithdrawalFailed, WithdrawalSuccess } from './components/WithdrawalStatus';
import {
  getInitialState,
  useWithdrawalDispatch,
  useWithdrawalState,
} from './hooks/useWithdrawalState';

const Withdrawal = () => {
  const setState = useWithdrawalDispatch();
  const { step } = useWithdrawalState();

  const reset = () => {
    setState(getInitialState());
  };

  return (
    <>
      {step === 'FILL_IN' && <WithdrawalForm />}
      {step === 'REVIEW' && (
        <>
          <HeaderPage size={'small'} leftIconVariant="back" onLeftIconClick={reset} />
          <WithdrawalReview />
        </>
      )}
      {step === 'CONFIRM' && <WithdrawalSmsConfirmation onBackClick={reset} />}
      {step === 'SUCCESS' && <WithdrawalSuccess />}
      {step === 'FAILED' && <WithdrawalFailed repeatPayment={reset} />}
    </>
  );
};

export default Withdrawal;

import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

type PermissionValue = 'granted' | 'blocked' | 'denied';

export const getInternalTransferPermission = () => ({
  get value(): PermissionValue {
    return (Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_WITHDRAWAL') &&
      Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL')) ||
      (Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL') &&
        Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_STRUCTURE_PRODUCT')) ||
      Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_INTERNAL')
      ? 'granted'
      : Permissions.denied('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_WITHDRAWAL') ||
        Permissions.denied('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL') ||
        Permissions.denied('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_STRUCTURE_PRODUCT') ||
        Permissions.denied('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_INTERNAL')
      ? 'denied'
      : 'blocked';
  },
  get isBlocked() {
    return this.value === 'blocked';
  },
  get isDenied() {
    return this.value === 'denied';
  },
  get isGranted() {
    return this.value === 'granted';
  },
});

export const getInternalTransferPermissionForProduct = () => ({
  get value(): PermissionValue {
    return ((Permissions.granted('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_WITHDRAWAL') ||
      Permissions.granted('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_STRUCTURE_PRODUCT')) &&
      Permissions.granted('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL')) ||
      Permissions.granted('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_INTERNAL')
      ? 'granted'
      : Permissions.blocked('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_WITHDRAWAL') ||
        Permissions.blocked('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_STRUCTURE_PRODUCT') ||
        Permissions.blocked('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL') ||
        Permissions.blocked('PRODUCT_NONTRADE_MONEY_INTERNAL')
      ? 'blocked'
      : 'denied';
  },
  get isBlocked() {
    return this.value === 'blocked';
  },
  get isDenied() {
    return this.value === 'denied';
  },
  get isGranted() {
    return this.value === 'granted';
  },
});

/**
 * PERSON_NONTRADE_SECURITY_WITHDRAWAL_OUT:
 * GRANTED / NONACTIVE — показать вкладку и форму
 * BLOCKED — скрыть вкладку
 * DENIED — показать вкладку, на странице заглушку
 */
export const getSecuritiesWriteOffPermission = () => {
  const code = 'PERSON_NONTRADE_SECURITY_WITHDRAWAL_OUT' as const;

  return {
    /** Вкладка видна при GRANTED, NONACTIVE и DENIED; скрыта при BLOCKED */
    get isVisible() {
      return Permissions.granted(code) || Permissions.denied(code);
    },
    /** Доступ к форме (GRANTED / NONACTIVE) */
    get isGranted() {
      return Permissions.granted(code);
    },
    get isDenied() {
      return Permissions.denied(code);
    },
    get isBlocked() {
      return Permissions.blocked(code);
    },
  };
};

import React from 'react';

import AssetsSkeleton from 'modules/UK/components/skeletons/AssetsSkeleton/AssetsSkeleton';
import { AssetsProps } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { FormattedBalance } from 'components';

import styles from './Assets.module.pcss';

const Assets = ({ title, totalAmount, finRes, finResPcnt, isLoading }: AssetsProps) => {
  if (isLoading) return <AssetsSkeleton />;
  return (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.balanceContainer}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
            {title}
          </Text>
          {totalAmount != null && <FormattedBalance value={totalAmount} type={'title'} />}
          {finRes != null && finResPcnt != null && (

import React from 'react';

import DateRangeBar from 'modules/UK/components/DateRangeBar/DateRangeBar';
import NotEnoughDataPlug from 'modules/UK/components/NotEnoughDataPlug/NotEnoughDataPlug';
import ChartSkeleton from 'modules/UK/components/skeletons/ChartSkeleton/ChartSkeleton';
import DateBarSkeleton from 'modules/UK/components/skeletons/DateBarSkeleton/DateBarSkeleton';
import { AssetsDynamicChartProps } from 'modules/UK/types';

import Chart from 'components/Chart';

const defaultSeries = [{ id: 'dot' }];

const AssetsDynamicChart = ({
  series,
  seriesData,
  lastPrice,
  dateRange,
  dateBuyBegin,
  isPercent,
  actualTime,
  onDateRangeChange,
  onTooltipStateChange,
  enableDatePicker,
  isNotEnoughData,
  isLoading,
  isFetching,
}: AssetsDynamicChartProps) => {
  return (
    <>
      {(isLoading || isFetching) && <ChartSkeleton />}
      {!isLoading && !isFetching && isNotEnoughData && <NotEnoughDataPlug />}
      {!isLoading && !isFetching && !isNotEnoughData && (
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'hidden' }}>
          <Chart
            series={series ?? defaultSeries}
            seriesData={seriesData || []}
            lastPrice={lastPrice}
            isPercent={isPercent}
            onTooltipStateChange={onTooltipStateChange}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {isLoading && <DateBarSkeleton />}
      {!isLoading && (
        <DateRangeBar
          dateRange={dateRange}
          dateBuyBegin={dateBuyBegin}
          actualTime={actualTime}
          onDateRangeChange={onDateRangeChange}
          enableDatePicker={enableDatePicker}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default AssetsDynamicChart;

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { useGetUKClosePriceHistoryQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import AssetsDynamicChart from 'modules/UK/components/AssetsDynamicChart/AssetsDynamicChart';
import Headline from 'modules/UK/components/Headline/Headline';
import Row from 'modules/UK/components/Row/Row';
import TooltipContent from 'modules/UK/components/TooltipContent/TooltipContent';
import { getDateRangeByType, getStepUnit, parseDateRange } from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import {
  ClosePriceHistoryChartProps,
  DateRangeButtonType,
  DateRangeType,
  RowProps,
} from 'modules/UK/types';

import { TooltipChangeEvent } from 'components/Chart/types';

const ClosePriceHistoryChart = ({
  type = 'price',
  title,
  paramName,
  lastPrice,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  dateBuyBegin,
  actualTime,
  tableConfig,
  hint,
  isLoading,
  onDateRangeChange,
}: ClosePriceHistoryChartProps) => {
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState<DateRangeType | undefined>();
  const [tooltipState, setTooltipState] = useState<TooltipChangeEvent | undefined>();
  const stepUnit = useMemo(() => getStepUnit(dateRange), [dateRange]);
  const parsedDateRange = useMemo(() => parseDateRange(dateRange), [dateRange]);

  const {
    data: history,
    isLoading: isHistoryLoading,
    isFetching: isHistoryFetching,
  } = useGetUKClosePriceHistoryQuery(
    {
      instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
      tradePlaceId: tradePlaceId,
      stepUnit: stepUnit,
      ...parsedDateRange,
    },
    { skip: !instrumentId || !tradePlaceId || !stepUnit || !dateRange || isLoading },
  );

  const table: RowProps[] | undefined = useMemo(() => {
    const lastClosePrice = history?.closePrice[history?.closePrice.length - 1];
    return tableConfig?.map((el) => ({
      type: el.type,
      name: el.name,
      [el.isDiff ? 'diff' : 'value']: el.format
        ? el.format(lastClosePrice?.[el.field])
        : lastClosePrice?.[el.field],
    }));
  }, [history, tableConfig]);

  const seriesData = useMemo(() => {
    const closePrice = history?.closePrice;
    return closePrice
      ? closePrice.map((item) => {
          const dateFrom = DateTime.fromISO(item.date);
          return {
            date: dateFrom.toMillis(),
            dot: item[type],
          };
        })
      : null;
  }, [type, history]);

  const isNotEnoughData =
    !seriesData || seriesData.length < 3 || !actualTime || !dateRange || !dateBuyBegin;

  const handleDateRangeChange = (type: DateRangeButtonType, dateRange?: DateRangeType) => {
    setDateRange(dateRange);
    onDateRangeChange && onDateRangeChange(type, dateRange);
  };

  const handleTooltipStateChange = (props: TooltipChangeEvent) => setTooltipState(props);

  useEffect(() => {
    actualTime && dateBuyBegin && setDateRange(getDateRangeByType('all', actualTime, dateBuyBegin));
  }, [actualTime, dateBuyBegin]);

  return (
    <div>
      <Headline isLoading={isLoading} hint={hint}>
        {title ? title : 'Динамика активов'}
      </Headline>

      {!tooltipState?.active && table && table.map((row, index) => <Row key={index} {...row} />)}
      {tooltipState && tooltipState.active && (
        <TooltipContent
          date={tooltipState.payload?.[1].payload.date}
          value={type === 'price' && tooltipState.payload?.[1].payload.dot}
          diff={type === 'priceDiffPcnt' && tooltipState.payload?.[1].payload.dot}
          name={paramName}
          currency={'RUB'}
        />
      )}
      <AssetsDynamicChart
        seriesData={seriesData}
        lastPrice={lastPrice}
        dateRange={dateRange}
        dateBuyBegin={dateBuyBegin}
        actualTime={actualTime}
        onDateRangeChange={handleDateRangeChange}
        onTooltipStateChange={handleTooltipStateChange}
        isPercent={type === 'priceDiffPcnt'}
        isNotEnoughData={isNotEnoughData}
        isLoading={isHistoryLoading || isLoading}
        isFetching={isHistoryFetching}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default ClosePriceHistoryChart;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { DateRange } from 'react-day-picker';

import IconButton from '@vision/icon-button';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { colorForeground } from 'vars/palette';

import styles from 'modules/UK/components/DateRangeBar/DateRangeBar.module.pcss';
import DateRangeButton from 'modules/UK/components/DateRangeButton/DateRangeButton';
import { DATE_RANGE_BUTTONS } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import { getDateRangeByType } from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import { DateRangeBarProps, DateRangeButtonType } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { DateRangePickerBottomSheet } from 'components/DateRangePicker';

import { ReactComponent as SmallCalendarSvg } from 'images/icons/small-calendar.svg';

const DateRangeBar = ({
  dateRange,
  actualTime,
  dateBuyBegin,
  enableDatePicker = true,
  onDateRangeChange,
}: DateRangeBarProps) => {
  const [currentDateRangeType, setCurrentDateRangeType] = useState<DateRangeButtonType>('all');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleDateRangeButtonClick = (dateRangeType: DateRangeButtonType) => {
    setCurrentDateRangeType(dateRangeType);
    onDateRangeChange &&
      onDateRangeChange(dateRangeType, getDateRangeByType(dateRangeType, actualTime, dateBuyBegin));
  };
  const handleDateRangeChange = (dateRange: DateRange) => {
    if (!dateRange.from || !dateRange.to) return;

    setCurrentDateRangeType('custom');
    onDateRangeChange &&
      onDateRangeChange('custom', {
        startDate: DateTime.fromJSDate(dateRange.from),
        finishDate: DateTime.fromJSDate(dateRange.to),
      });
  };

  const handleClose = () => setOpen(false);
  const handleOpen = () => setOpen(true);
  return (
    <div className={styles.dateRangeBar}>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.buttons}>
          {DATE_RANGE_BUTTONS.map(({ children, type }) => (
            <DateRangeButton
              key={type}
              active={type === currentDateRangeType}
              onClick={() => handleDateRangeButtonClick(type)}
            >
              {children}
            </DateRangeButton>
          ))}
        </div>
        {enableDatePicker && (
          <IconButton onClick={handleOpen}>
            <SmallCalendarSvg color={colorForeground} />
          </IconButton>
        )}
      </div>
      {enableDatePicker && (
        <DateRangePickerBottomSheet
          open={open}
          onClose={handleClose}
          range={{ from: dateRange?.startDate.toJSDate(), to: dateRange?.finishDate.toJSDate() }}
          onDateRangeChange={handleDateRangeChange}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default DateRangeBar;

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import Headline from 'modules/UK/components/Headline/Headline';
import Issuers from 'modules/UK/components/Issuers/Issuers';
import PortfolioStructureSkeleton from 'modules/UK/components/skeletons/PortfolioStructureSkeleton/PortfolioStructureSkeleton';
import { PORTFOLIO_STRUCTURE_TABS } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import { PortfolioStructureProps } from 'modules/UK/types';

import PieChartWithLegend from 'components/PieChartWithLegend';
import SwipeableTabsWrapper from 'components/Tabs/components/SwipeableTabsWrapper';

const PortfolioStructure = ({
  instrumentId,
  title,
  industry,
  issuers,
  hint,
  isLoading,
  onTabChange,
}: PortfolioStructureProps) => {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<number>(0);

  const data = useMemo(
    () =>
      industry?.map((el) => ({ name: el.industryClassifierTypeName, percents: el.percent })) || [],
    [industry],
  );

  if (isLoading) return <PortfolioStructureSkeleton />;

  if (industry?.length === 0 && issuers?.length === 0) return null;

  const handleTabChange = (_: unknown, newValue: number) => {
    setTab(newValue);
    onTabChange && onTabChange(newValue);
  };
  return (
    <div>
      <Headline hint={hint}>{title}</Headline>
      <SwipeableTabsWrapper
        tabs={PORTFOLIO_STRUCTURE_TABS}
        activeTab={tab}
        handleChange={handleTabChange}
      >
        {tab === 0 && <PieChartWithLegend data={data} chartLabel={'Структура по отраслям'} />}
        {tab === 1 && <Issuers issuers={issuers} />}
      </SwipeableTabsWrapper>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PortfolioStructure;

import React from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { redirectTo } from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import { RedirectToBottomSheetProps } from 'modules/UK/types';

import styles from './RedirectToLkBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const RedirectToBottomSheet = ({
  state,
  from,
  to,
  title,
  text,
  open,
  onClose,
}: RedirectToBottomSheetProps) => {
  const handleButtonClick = () => {
    if (!to) return;
    redirectTo(to);
    if (state !== 'redirectToUkLk') return;
    const eventId = from === 'pif' ? 'tap_pif_instrument' : 'tap_iic_instrument';
    reachGoal('uk', eventId);
  };

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onClose}>
      {title && (
        <Text type={'subtitleBold'} className={styles.title}>
          {title}
        </Text>
      )}
      <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'} className={styles.text}>
        {text}
      </Text>
      <div className={styles.button}>
        <Button onClick={handleButtonClick}>В личный кабинет</Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default RedirectToBottomSheet;

import React from 'react';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import Hint from 'modules/UK/components/Hint/Hint';
import styles from 'modules/UK/components/Row/Row.module.pcss';
import RowSkeleton from 'modules/UK/components/skeletons/RowSkeleton/RowSkeleton';
import { RowProps } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { FormattedBalance } from 'components';

const Row = ({
  type = 'text',
  name,
  value,
  diff,
  currency,
  precision,
  minPrecision,
  slug,
  descriptionFormatter,
  isLoading,
}: RowProps) => {
  if (isLoading) return <RowSkeleton />;
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <div className={styles.nameContainer}>
        <Text type={'lineRegular'} tag={'div'}>
          {name}
          <Hint slug={slug} descriptionFormatter={descriptionFormatter} className={styles.hint} />
        </Text>
      </div>
      {type === 'text' && typeof value === 'string' && (
        <Text type={'lineRegular'} className={styles.value}>
          {value}
        </Text>
      )}
      {type === 'text' && value == null && <Text type={'lineRegular'}>–</Text>}
      {type === 'balance' && value != null && typeof value === 'number' && (
        <FormattedBalance
          type={'lineRegular'}
          value={value}
          diff={diff}
          currency={currency}
          className={styles.value}
          precision={precision}
          minPrecision={minPrecision}
        />
      )}
      {type === 'balance' && value == null && (
        <FormattedBalance
          type={'lineRegular'}
          diff={diff}
          currency={currency}
          precision={precision}
          minPrecision={minPrecision}
          className={styles.value}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Row;

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { useGetUKStrategyPriceQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import AssetsDynamicChart from 'modules/UK/components/AssetsDynamicChart/AssetsDynamicChart';
import Headline from 'modules/UK/components/Headline/Headline';
import Row from 'modules/UK/components/Row/Row';
import StrategyBaseActives from 'modules/UK/components/StrategyBaseActives/StrategyBaseActives';
import { generateSeries, getDateRangeByType, parseDateRange } from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import { BaseActive, DateRangeButtonType, DateRangeType, RowProps } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { SeriesData } from 'components/Chart';

type StrategyPriceChartProps = {
  title?: string;
  lastPrice?: number;
  tradePlaceId?: number;
  instrumentId?: number;
  dateBuyBegin?: string;
  actualTime?: string;
  table?: RowProps[];
  isLoading?: boolean;
  onDateRangeChange?: (dateRangeType: DateRangeButtonType, dateRange?: DateRangeType) => void;
};

const StrategyPriceChart = ({
  title,
  lastPrice,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  dateBuyBegin,
  actualTime,
  table,
  isLoading,
  onDateRangeChange,
}: StrategyPriceChartProps) => {
  const [dateRange, setDateRange] = useState<DateRangeType | undefined>(
    getDateRangeByType('all', actualTime, dateBuyBegin),
  );

  const {
    data: strategyPrice,
    isLoading: isStrategyPriceLoading,
    isFetching: isStrategyPriceFetching,
  } = useGetUKStrategyPriceQuery(
    {
      instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
      ...parseDateRange(dateRange),
    },
    { skip: !tradePlaceId || !dateRange },
  );

  const series = useMemo(() => {
    const baseActiveInfo = strategyPrice?.baseAactiveInfo;
    if (!baseActiveInfo) return;
    return generateSeries(baseActiveInfo);
  }, [strategyPrice]);

  const seriesData = useMemo(() => {
    const baseActivePrice = strategyPrice?.baseAactivePrice;
    return baseActivePrice
      ? Object.values(
          baseActivePrice.reduce((ac: Record<string, SeriesData>, el) => {
            const dateFrom = new Date(el.date).getTime();
            if (!ac[dateFrom]) {
              ac[dateFrom] = {
                date: dateFrom,
                [el.baseActiveId]: el.priceDiffPcnt,
              };
            } else {
              ac[dateFrom][el.baseActiveId] = el.priceDiffPcnt;
            }

            return ac;
          }, {}),
        )
      : null;
  }, [strategyPrice]);

  const baseActives: BaseActive[] | undefined = useMemo(() => {
    const baseActiveInfo = strategyPrice?.baseAactiveInfo;
    const baseActivePrice = strategyPrice?.baseAactivePrice;
    if (!baseActiveInfo || !baseActivePrice) return;

    return baseActiveInfo.map((el) => {
      const lastPoint = baseActivePrice.filter((f) => f.baseActiveId === el.baseActiveId);
      return {
        baseActiveId: el.baseActiveId,
        name: el.name,
        instrumentImageName: el.instrumentImageName,
        price: lastPoint?.[lastPoint.length - 1]?.price,
        priceDiffPcnt: lastPoint?.[lastPoint.length - 1]?.priceDiffPcnt,
      };
    });
  }, [strategyPrice]);

  const isNotEnoughData =
    !seriesData || seriesData.length < 3 || !actualTime || !dateRange || !dateBuyBegin;

  const handleDateRangeChange = (dateRangeType: DateRangeButtonType, dateRange?: DateRangeType) => {
    setDateRange(dateRange);
    onDateRangeChange && onDateRangeChange(dateRangeType, dateRange);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <Headline isLoading={isLoading}>{title ? title : 'Динамика базовых активов'}</Headline>

      {table && table.map((row, index) => <Row key={index} {...row} />)}

      <AssetsDynamicChart
        series={series}
        seriesData={seriesData}
        lastPrice={lastPrice}
        dateRange={dateRange}
        dateBuyBegin={dateBuyBegin}
        actualTime={actualTime}
        onDateRangeChange={handleDateRangeChange}
        isNotEnoughData={isNotEnoughData}
        isLoading={isStrategyPriceLoading || isLoading}
        isFetching={isStrategyPriceFetching}
        isPercent={true}
      />
      {baseActives && <StrategyBaseActives baseActives={baseActives} />}
    </div>
  );
};

export default StrategyPriceChart;


--- FILE: src\modules\UK\components\StrategyYieldChart\StrategyYieldChart.tsx ---

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { useGetStrategyYieldQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import AssetsDynamicChart from 'modules/UK/components/AssetsDynamicChart/AssetsDynamicChart';
import Headline from 'modules/UK/components/Headline/Headline';
import Row from 'modules/UK/components/Row/Row';
import TooltipContent from 'modules/UK/components/TooltipContent/TooltipContent';
import { parseDateMillis } from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import { DateRangeButtonType, DateRangeType } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { TooltipChangeEvent } from 'components/Chart/types';

import { StrategyYieldPeriodType } from 'types/instrumentUK';

type StrategyYieldChartProps = {
  instrumentId: number;
  isLoading: boolean;
  actualTime?: string;
  onDateRangeChange?: (dateRangeType: DateRangeButtonType, dateRange?: DateRangeType) => void;
};

const DATE_RANGE_TO_PERIOD_MAP: Record<DateRangeButtonType, StrategyYieldPeriodType> = {
  all: 'ALL',
  month: 'LAST_MONTH',
  year: 'LAST_YEAR',
  threeYears: 'LAST_3_YEAR',
  custom: 'ALL',
};

const StrategyYieldChart = ({
  instrumentId,
  actualTime,
  isLoading,
  onDateRangeChange,
}: StrategyYieldChartProps) => {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<StrategyYieldPeriodType>('ALL');
  const [tooltipState, setTooltipState] = useState<TooltipChangeEvent | undefined>();

  const {
    data,
    isLoading: isYieldLoading,
    isFetching: isYieldFetching,
  } = useGetStrategyYieldQuery(
    {
      instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
      periodType: period,
    },
    { skip: !instrumentId || isLoading },
  );

  const seriesData = useMemo(() => {
    const closePrice = data?.strategyYield;
    return closePrice
      ? closePrice.map((item) => ({
          date: DateTime.fromISO(item.date).toMillis(),
          dot: item.value,
        }))
      : null;
  }, [data]);

  const isNotEnoughData = !seriesData || seriesData.length < 3;

  const handleDateRangeTypeChange = (type: DateRangeButtonType, dateRange?: DateRangeType) => {
    setPeriod(DATE_RANGE_TO_PERIOD_MAP[type]);
    onDateRangeChange && onDateRangeChange(type, dateRange);
  };

  const handleTooltipStateChange = (props: TooltipChangeEvent) => setTooltipState(props);

  return (
    <div>
      <Headline isLoading={isLoading} hint={{ slug: 'UK_GRAPH_IIC', size: 16 }}>
        Доходность стратегии
      </Headline>

      {!tooltipState?.active && (
        <>
          <Row
            name={'Показатели стратегии на'}
            value={parseDateMillis(seriesData?.[seriesData?.length - 1]?.date, 'dd.MM.yyyy')}
          />
          <Row
            type={'balance'}
            name={'Доходность'}
            diff={seriesData && seriesData[seriesData?.length - 1]?.dot}
          />
        </>
      )}
      {tooltipState && tooltipState.active && (
        <TooltipContent
          date={tooltipState.payload?.[1].payload.date}
          diff={tooltipState.payload?.[1].payload.dot}
          name={'Доходность'}
          currency={'PRC'}
        />
      )}
      <AssetsDynamicChart
        seriesData={seriesData}
        actualTime={actualTime}
        onDateRangeChange={handleDateRangeTypeChange}
        onTooltipStateChange={handleTooltipStateChange}
        isNotEnoughData={isNotEnoughData}
        isLoading={isYieldLoading || isLoading}
        isFetching={isYieldFetching}
        enableDatePicker={false}
        isPercent
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default StrategyYieldChart;

import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT, DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { GRAPH_COLORS } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import { DateRangeButtonType, DateRangeType, ParsedDateRange } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { BaseActiveInfo, StepUnitType } from 'types/instrumentUK';

export const redirectTo = (url?: string) => {
  if (!url) return;
  const newWindow = window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  if (newWindow) {
    newWindow.opener = null;
  }
};

export const parseValuationDate = (date?: string) => {
  if (!date) return 'Дата оценки на —';
  return DateTime.fromISO(date).toFormat('Дата оценки на dd.MM.yyyy');
};

export const parseQuantity = (quantity?: number) => {
  if (!quantity) return;
  const parsedQuantity = String(quantity).replace('.', ',');
  return `${parsedQuantity} шт.`;
};

export const getDateRangeByType = (
  dateRangeType: DateRangeButtonType,
  actualTime?: string,
  dateBuyBegin?: string,
  startDate?: DateTime,
  finishDate?: DateTime,
): DateRangeType | undefined => {
  if (!actualTime || !dateBuyBegin) return;
  switch (dateRangeType) {
    case 'all':
      return {
        startDate: DateTime.fromISO(dateBuyBegin),
        finishDate: DateTime.fromISO(actualTime),
      };
    case 'month':
      return {
        finishDate: DateTime.fromISO(actualTime),
        startDate: DateTime.fromISO(actualTime).minus({ months: 1 }),
      };
    case 'year':
      return {
        finishDate: DateTime.fromISO(actualTime),
        startDate: DateTime.fromISO(actualTime).minus({ years: 1 }),
      };
    case 'threeYears':
      return {
        finishDate: DateTime.fromISO(actualTime),
        startDate: DateTime.fromISO(actualTime).minus({ years: 3 }),
      };
    case 'custom':
      if (!finishDate || !startDate) throw new Error('finishDate or startDate doesnt exist');
      return {
        finishDate,
        startDate,
      };
    default:
      return {
        startDate: DateTime.fromISO(dateBuyBegin),
        finishDate: DateTime.fromISO(actualTime),
      };
  }
};

export const parseDateRange = (dateRange?: DateRangeType): ParsedDateRange | undefined => {
  if (!dateRange) return;
  return {
    startDate: dateRange.startDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT),
    finishDate: dateRange.finishDate.toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT),
  };
};

export const getStepUnit = (dateRange?: DateRangeType): StepUnitType | undefined => {
  if (!dateRange) return;
  if (dateRange.finishDate.diff(dateRange.startDate, ['years']).years < 1) {
    return 'week';
  }
  return 'month';
};

export const parseDateIISEnd = (date?: string) => {
  if (!date) return;
  return DateTime.fromISO(date).toFormat('с dd.MM.yyyy');
};

export const parseDate = (date?: string) => {
  if (!date) return;
  return DateTime.fromISO(date).toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_VIEW_FORMAT);
};

export const parseStrike = (strike?: string) => {
  if (!strike) return;
  return sumFormatter(Number(strike), null, 0);
};

export const getColorSet = (index: number) => {
  return GRAPH_COLORS[index % GRAPH_COLORS.length];
};

export const generateSeries = (ids: BaseActiveInfo[]) => {
  return ids.map((el, index) => ({
    id: String(el.baseActiveId),
    name: el.name,
    colorSet: getColorSet(index),
  }));
};

export const parseDateMillis = (date?: number, fmt = 'dd MMMM yyyy') => {
  if (!date) return;
  return DateTime.fromMillis(date).toFormat(fmt);
};

export const getUKLkLink = () => {
  const url = new URL('', 'https://clients.open-am.ru');
  url.searchParams.set('from', 'uk_card');
  return url.toString();
};

export const uncapitalizeFirstLetter = (string?: string) => {
  if (!string) return '';
  return string.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + string.slice(1);
};

export const getCouponProgress = (
  currentPrice?: number,
  couponBarrier?: number,
  recallBarrier?: number,
) => {
  if (!couponBarrier || !recallBarrier || !currentPrice || couponBarrier >= recallBarrier) return 0;
  if (currentPrice < couponBarrier) {
    return ((33 * currentPrice) / couponBarrier).toFixed(2) + '%';
  }
  if (currentPrice >= couponBarrier && currentPrice < recallBarrier) {
    return (
      (33 + (33 * (currentPrice - couponBarrier)) / (recallBarrier - couponBarrier)).toFixed(2) +
      '%'
    );
  }
  const progress = 66 + (33 * (currentPrice - recallBarrier)) / (recallBarrier - couponBarrier);
  if (progress > 100) return '100%';
  return progress.toFixed(2) + '%';
};

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useIntersection } from 'react-use';

const threshold = [1, 0.9, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1, 0];

const useJoinButtonIntersection = (buttonRef: HTMLButtonElement | null) => {
  const intersection = useIntersection(
    { current: buttonRef },
    {
      root: null,
      rootMargin: '0px',
      threshold,
    },
  );
  const [opacity, setOpacity] = useState<number>(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (intersection?.intersectionRatio == null) return setOpacity(0);
    setOpacity(1 - Math.floor(intersection?.intersectionRatio * 100) / 100);
  }, [intersection?.intersectionRatio]);

  return { opacity };
};

export default useJoinButtonIntersection;

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Navigate, generatePath, useLocation, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useScroll } from 'react-use';

import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import cx from 'classnames';
import {
  ROUTE_360,
  ROUTE_FUND_DETAILS,
  ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_FUND_REFILL_AMOUNT,
} from 'const/routes';

import { useGetUKFundQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import HeadWithImg from 'modules/UK/components/HeadWithImg/HeadWithImg';
import StickyBottomButton from 'modules/UK/components/StickyBottomButton/StickyBottomButton';
import { FUND_DETAILS_TABS } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import useBuyButtonIntersection from 'modules/UK/hooks/useBuyButtonIntersection';

import { HeaderPage, SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper, createAlertNotification } from 'components';
import { THandleChange } from 'components/Tabs';

import styles from './FundDetails.module.pcss';

const FundDetails: React.FC = ({ children }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { instrumentId } = useParams();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();

  const [buttonRef, setButtonRef] = useState<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const [scrollRef, setScrollRef] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const { y: scrollY } = useScroll({ current: scrollRef });

  const tabs = useMemo(
    () =>
      FUND_DETAILS_TABS.map((el) => ({
        name: el.name,
        link: generatePath(el.link, { instrumentId }),
      })),
    [instrumentId],
  );

  const disableSwipe = useMemo(
    () => pathname === generatePath(ROUTE_FUND_DETAILS, { instrumentId }),
    [pathname, instrumentId],
  );

  const { opacity } = useBuyButtonIntersection(buttonRef);

  const { data, isLoading } = useGetUKFundQuery(
    {
      instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
    },
    { skip: !instrumentId },
  );

  const { fund } = data || {};

  const { shortTitleOi, instrumentImageHeaderMLkName, shortInvestGoal } = fund?.[0] || {};

  const handleBack = () => navigate(-1);

  const handleBuyClick = (tap: 'top' | 'bot') => (event?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    const personAmcOpenAccountGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_OPENACCOUNT');
    const personAmcFundBuyGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_FUND_BUY');

    const hasBuyAccess = !personAmcOpenAccountGranted && personAmcFundBuyGranted;

    if (!hasBuyAccess) {
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Недостаточно полномочий', status: 'error' });
      return;
    }
    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_FUND_REFILL_AMOUNT + '?from=detail', { instrumentId }),
    );
    reachGoal('uk', 'catalog_uk_buy_view', {
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      type: 'pif',
      from: 'detail',
      tap,
    });
  };

  const handleTabChange: THandleChange<Event> = (_, newValue, name) => {
    const patterns = FUND_DETAILS_TABS.find((f) => f.name === name)?.id;
    reachGoal('uk', 'catalog_uk_card_product_tabs_tap', {
      type: 'pif',
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      patterns: String(patterns),
    });
  };

  if (!instrumentId) return <Navigate to={ROUTE_360} />;
  if (isLoading) return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;

  return (
    <div className={styles.container} ref={setScrollRef}>
      <HeaderPage
        className={cx(styles.headerWrapper, { [styles.headerWrapperBg]: scrollY > 0 })}
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBack}
        title={shortTitleOi}
      />
      <HeadWithImg
        type={'pif'}
        setButtonRef={setButtonRef}
        instrumentImageHeaderMLkName={instrumentImageHeaderMLkName}
        shortInvestGoal={shortInvestGoal}
        onClick={handleBuyClick('top')}
      />
      <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
        tabs={tabs}
        disableSwipe={disableSwipe}
        replace
        tabWidthEvenly={false}
        onChange={handleTabChange}
      >
        {children}
      </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
      <StickyBottomButton opacity={opacity} onClick={handleBuyClick('bot')}>
        Купить онлайн
      </StickyBottomButton>
    </div>
  );
};

export default FundDetails;

      <PortfolioStructure

      <Headline

        addonRightNode={

        }
      />
      <Carousel navigation={false} pagination={false}>
        {instrumentShowcaseFund
          ?.filter((f) => f.instrumentId !== Number(instrumentId))
          ?.map((el) => (
            <TrustManagementCard
              key={`${el.instrumentId}_${el.tradePlaceId}`}
              type={'pif'}

              instrumentImageName={el.instrumentImageName}
              shortTitleOI={el.shortTitleOi}
              diff={el.oneYear}
              riskType={el.riskType}
              withShadow
              onClick={handleOtherInstrumentClick}
            />
          ))}
      </Carousel>
    </>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

import Headline from '@aurora/headline';
import Text from '@aurora/text';

import styles from './TaxBenefits.module.pcss';

const TaxBenefits = () => {
  return (
    <>
      <Headline
        titleText={'Доходы по ценным бумагам реинвестируются в активы фонда без удержания налога'}
      />
      <Text className={styles.text}>
        Доходы по ценным бумагам (дивиденды по акциям и купонные выплаты по облигациям), возникающие
        при управлении фондом, реинвестируются в активы фонда без удержания налога. Это существенно
        улучшает общий результат инвестирования на длительных временных интервалах.
      </Text>
      <Headline titleText={'Необходимость уплаты налога на доход возникает при продаже паёв'} />
      <Text className={styles.text}>
        То есть с разницы между ценой продажи и ценой покупки паёв. УК «Открытие» выступает в
        качестве налогового агента и самостоятельно осуществляет исчисление, удержание и
        перечисление НДФЛ в бюджет.
      </Text>
      <Headline titleText={'Освобождение от налога на доход при владении паями более трёх лет'} />
      <Text className={styles.text}>
        Для получения налоговой льготы по паевым фондам, необходимо владеть паями более трёх лет.
        При этом налоговой льготе подлежит доход от инвестиций не превышающий три миллиона рублей в
        год. Таким образом, платить налог придётся, если вы заработали на инвестициях больше девяти
        миллионов рублей за три года.
      </Text>
      <Headline
        titleText={
          'Если обменивать паи одного фонда на паи другого, срок владения паями не прерывается'
        }
      />
      <Text className={styles.text}>
        Вы можете менять инвестиционные стратегии в течение трёх лет и освободиться от уплаты
        налогов.
      </Text>
      <Text className={styles.text}>
        В случае соблюдения всех условий получения налоговой льготы при подаче заявки на погашение
        паёв, УК «Открытие» выступает в качестве налогового агента и самостоятельно учитывает
        налоговый вычет при расчете НДФЛ.
      </Text>
    </>
  );
};

export default TaxBenefits;
