import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Navigate, generatePath, useLocation, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useScroll } from 'react-use';

import CircleLoader from '@aurora/circle-loader';
import cx from 'classnames';
import {
  ROUTE_360,
  ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_STRATEGY_REFILL_AMOUNT,
  ROUTE_STRATEGY_DETAILS,
} from 'const/routes';

import { useGetUKStrategyQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { getSession } from 'core/session/session';

import HeadWithImg from 'modules/UK/components/HeadWithImg/HeadWithImg';
import IIAAlreadyOpenedBottomSheet from 'modules/UK/components/IIAAlreadyOpenedBottomSheet/IIAAlreadyOpenedBottomSheet';
import StickyBottomButton from 'modules/UK/components/StickyBottomButton/StickyBottomButton';
import { STRATEGY_DETAILS_TABS } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import useBuyButtonIntersection from 'modules/UK/hooks/useBuyButtonIntersection';

import { HeaderPage, SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper, createAlertNotification } from 'components';
import { THandleChange } from 'components/Tabs';

import styles from './StrategyDetails.module.pcss';

const StrategyDetails: React.FC = ({ children }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { instrumentId } = useParams();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const [buttonRef, setButtonRef] = useState<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [scrollRef, setScrollRef] = useState<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const { y: scrollY } = useScroll({ current: scrollRef });

  const personAmcOpenAccount = Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_OPENACCOUNT');

  const tabs = useMemo(
    () =>
      STRATEGY_DETAILS_TABS.map((el) => ({
        name: el.name,
        link: generatePath(el.link, { instrumentId }),
      })),
    [instrumentId],
  );

  const disableSwipe = useMemo(
    () => pathname === generatePath(ROUTE_STRATEGY_DETAILS, { instrumentId }),
    [pathname, instrumentId],
  );

  const { opacity } = useBuyButtonIntersection(buttonRef);

  const { data, isLoading } = useGetUKStrategyQuery(
    {
      instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
    },
    { skip: !instrumentId },
  );

  const { strategy } = data || {};
  const { shortTitleOi, instrumentImageHeaderMLkName, shortInvestGoal } = strategy?.[0] || {};

  const handleBack = () => navigate(-1);

  const handleOpenIiaLockBottomSheet = () => setOpen(true);

  const handleCloseIiaLockBottomSheet = () => setOpen(false);

  const handleBuyClick = (tap: 'top' | 'bot') => () => {
    const personAmcOpenAccountGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_OPENACCOUNT');
    const personAmcFundBuyGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_FUND_BUY');
    const personAmcIiaBuyGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_STRATEGY_BUY');

    const haveIia = getSession()?.iia === 'ACTIVATING' || getSession()?.iia === 'ACTIVE';

    const hasBuyAccess =
      !personAmcOpenAccountGranted && personAmcFundBuyGranted && personAmcIiaBuyGranted;

    if (!hasBuyAccess) {
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Недостаточно полномочий', status: 'error' });
      return;
    }
    if (haveIia) {
      handleOpenIiaLockBottomSheet();
      return;
    }
    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_STRATEGY_REFILL_AMOUNT + '?from=detail', { instrumentId }),
    );
    reachGoal('uk', 'catalog_uk_buy_view', {
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      type: 'iic',
      from: 'detail',
      client: personAmcOpenAccount ? 'non_uk' : 'uk',
      tap,
    });
  };

  const handleTabChange: THandleChange<Event> = (_, newValue, name) => {
    const patterns = STRATEGY_DETAILS_TABS.find((f) => f.name === name)?.id;
    reachGoal('uk', 'catalog_uk_card_product_tabs_tap', {
      type: 'iic',
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      patterns: String(patterns),
    });
  };

  if (!instrumentId) return <Navigate to={ROUTE_360} />;

  if (isLoading) return <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />;

  return (
    <div className={styles.container} ref={setScrollRef}>
      <HeaderPage
        className={cx(styles.headerWrapper, { [styles.headerWrapperBg]: scrollY > 0 })}
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBack}
        title={shortTitleOi}
      />
      <HeadWithImg
        type={'pif'}
        setButtonRef={setButtonRef}
        instrumentImageHeaderMLkName={instrumentImageHeaderMLkName}
        shortInvestGoal={shortInvestGoal}
        onClick={handleBuyClick('top')}
      />
      <SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper
        tabs={tabs}
        replace
        tabWidthEvenly={false}
        disableSwipe={disableSwipe}
        onChange={handleTabChange}
      >
        {children}
      </SwipeableRouterTabsWrapper>
      <StickyBottomButton opacity={opacity} onClick={handleBuyClick('bot')}>
        Купить онлайн
      </StickyBottomButton>
      <IIAAlreadyOpenedBottomSheet open={open} onClose={handleCloseIiaLockBottomSheet} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default StrategyDetails;

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import Accordion from '@aurora/accordion';
import Button from '@aurora/button';
import Carousel from '@aurora/carousel';
import Headline from '@aurora/headline';
import InformationCell from '@aurora/information-cell';
import Text from '@aurora/text';
import { DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT } from 'const/date';
import { ROUTE_TURNKEY_SOLUTIONS } from 'const/routes';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';
import sanitizeHtml from 'sanitize-html';

import { useGetStrategiesQuery } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { useGetUKStrategyQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import Hint from 'modules/UK/components/Hint/Hint';
import PortfolioStructure from 'modules/UK/components/PortfolioStructure/PortfolioStructure';
import StrategyYieldChart from 'modules/UK/components/StrategyYieldChart/StrategyYieldChart';
import { DATE_RANGE_BAR_BUTTON_CLICK_EVENTS_MAP } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import { uncapitalizeFirstLetter } from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import { DateRangeButtonType } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { TrustManagementCard } from 'components';

const Review = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { instrumentId } = useParams();

  const now = useMemo(() => DateTime.now().toFormat(DEFAULT_DATE_INPUT_FORMAT), []);

  const { data: strategiesResponse } = useGetStrategiesQuery({
    structureSiteShow: 1,
    dateLKOIEnd: now,
  });
  const { data, isLoading } = useGetUKStrategyQuery(
    {
      instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
    },
    { skip: !instrumentId },
  );
  const { strategy, industry, issuer } = data || {};
  const { instrumentShowcaseStrategy } = strategiesResponse || {};
  const {
    investStrategy,
    actualTime,
    firstPaymentMinLk,
    currencyPortfolio,
    riskType,
    marketReview,
    yield: strategyYield,
    baseActiveClass,
  } = strategy?.[0] || {};

  const handleDateRangeChange = (dateRangeType: DateRangeButtonType) => {
    const period = DATE_RANGE_BAR_BUTTON_CLICK_EVENTS_MAP[dateRangeType];

  return (

        description={

            Можно заработать за 3 года
          </Text>
        }

      />
      <InformationCell

      <InformationCell

        label={
          <Text type={'title'} color={'colorForeground'}>
            {currencyPortfolio}
          </Text>
        }
        description={
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>

          </Text>
        }
        variant={'big'}
      />
      <InformationCell
        addonRightDescription={<Hint slug={'UK_TAX_IIC'} leftSpacing={false} size={16} />}
        label={
          <Text type={'title'} color={'colorForeground'}>
            до 52 тысяч в год
          </Text>
        }
        description={
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
            Налоговый вычет
          </Text>
        }

      />
      <InformationCell

          )}

      <Headline

          <Button variant={'secondary'} shape={'text'} onClick={handleToTurnkeySolutions}>

        }
      />

        {instrumentShowcaseStrategy

};

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import Accordion from '@aurora/accordion';
import Banner from '@aurora/banner';
import Headline from '@aurora/headline';
import Text from '@aurora/text';

import { ReactComponent as AlertSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/instrumentUk/alert.svg';
import { ReactComponent as IdeaSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/instrumentUk/idea.svg';

import styles from './TaxBenefits.module.pcss';

const TaxBenefits = () => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({ typeA: false, typeB: false });

  const handleToggle = (name: string) => () => {
    setOpen((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: !prev[name] }));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Banner
        shape={'message'}
        caption={
          'ИИС, помимо дохода от инвестиций, позволяет получить налоговую льготу на выбор — 13% ' +
          'от суммы взноса в виде вычета или освобождение дохода от НДФЛ.'
        }
        variant={'green'}
        showCloseBtn={false}
        size={'medium'}
        compact
        icon={<IdeaSvg />}
      />

      <Headline
        titleText={'Типы инвестиционных налоговых вычетов по ИИС'}
        typeTitle={'subtitleBold'}
      />
      <Accordion
        title={'Тип А'}
        shape={'headline'}
        isOpen={open.typeA}
        onToggle={handleToggle('typeA')}
      >
        <Text className={styles.text}>
          Инвестиционный налоговый вычет, который предоставляется в сумме денежных средств,
          внесённых в налоговом периоде на индивидуальный инвестиционный счёт, но не более 400 000
          рублей. Сумма возвращённого налога не может превышать сумму уплаченного в год применения
          вычета НДФЛ (сумма возвращаемого налога максимум 52 000 рублей в год, что составляет 13%
          от 400 000 рублей). В случае прекращения договора на ведение индивидуального
          инвестиционного счёта до истечения 3-х лет необходимо уплатить в бюджет сумму ранее
          полученного вычета, а также пени за каждый день просрочки, определяется в процентах от
          неуплаченной суммы налога. Воспользоваться указанным вычетом возможно уже по итогам
          первого года владения ИИС. При закрытии индивидуального инвестиционного счёта вам
          потребуется уплатить подоходный налог на доход.
        </Text>
      </Accordion>
      <Accordion
        title={'Тип Б'}
        shape={'headline'}
        isOpen={open.typeB}
        onToggle={handleToggle('typeB')}
      >
        <Text className={styles.text}>
          Инвестиционный налоговый вычет, который позволяет освободить от уплаты налога в размере
          13% весь доход, полученный по индивидуальному инвестиционному счёту. Данный вычет можно
          получить только при закрытии счёта и не раньше, чем через три года с даты его открытия.
        </Text>
      </Accordion>
      <Banner
        shape={'message'}
        caption={
          'Вы сможете воспользоваться только одним из вариантов инвестиционного налогового вычета.' +
          ' Если вы воспользуетесь инвестиционным вычетом «Тип А», то не сможете воспользоваться вычетом «Тип Б».'
        }
        variant={'orange'}
        showCloseBtn={false}
        size={'medium'}
        compact
        icon={<AlertSvg />}
      />
      <Banner
        shape={'message'}
        caption={
          'Можно иметь только один индивидуальный инвестиционный счёт. ' +
          'Открытие нескольких ИИС не позволяет воспользоваться инвестиционным налоговым вычетом ни по одному из них.'
        }
        variant={'orange'}
        showCloseBtn={false}
        size={'medium'}
        compact
        icon={<AlertSvg />}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default TaxBenefits;

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import { useLazyGetPositionsQuery } from 'core/api/positions';

import {
  INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY_UK_UKF,
  INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY_UK_UKS,
} from 'modules/Instrument/constants';
import { getUKInstrumentLkLink } from 'modules/NonTradableInstrument';
import { redirectTo } from 'modules/UK/helpers';

import NonTradable from 'components/NonTradable';

const UKPlug: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { instrumentId } = useParams();

  const [trigger, { data, isFetching }] = useLazyGetPositionsQuery();

  const instrumentGroupCode = data?.positionValuationByInstrument?.length
    ? data.positionValuationByInstrument[0].instrumentGroupCode
    : undefined;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (instrumentId) {
      trigger({
        instrumentId,
        datasets: 'PositionValuationByInstrument',
      });
    }
  }, [instrumentId]);

  if (
    !isFetching &&
    (!instrumentGroupCode ||
      ![INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY_UK_UKF, INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY_UK_UKS].includes(instrumentGroupCode))
  ) {
    navigate(ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG);
  }

  const isFund = instrumentGroupCode === INSTRUMENT_CATEGORY_UK_UKF;

  const onToLKButtonClick = () => {
    redirectTo(getUKInstrumentLkLink(instrumentId));
  };

  if (isFetching || !data) {
    return <CircleLoader brandColor type="page" />;
  }

  return (
    <NonTradable
      headerTitle={isFund ? 'Паевый фонд' : 'Стратегия ДУ'}
      title={isFund ? 'Паевый фонд' : 'Стратегия доверительного управления'}
      text={`Просматривайте подробную информацию по купленным ${
        isFund ? 'паевым фондам' : 'стратегиям доверительного управления'
      } в личном кабинете`}
      onToLKButtonClick={onToLKButtonClick}
    />
  );
};

export default UKPlug;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_FUND_REFILL_AMOUNT } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetUKFundQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { getUKInstrumentLkLink } from 'modules/NonTradableInstrument';
import ActionButtons from 'modules/UK/components/ActionButtons/ActionButtons';
import Assets from 'modules/UK/components/Assets/Assets';
import ClosePriceHistoryChart from 'modules/UK/components/ClosePriceHistoryChart/ClosePriceHistoryChart';
import ErrorPlug from 'modules/UK/components/ErrorPlug/ErrorPlug';
import OtherOperationsBottomSheet from 'modules/UK/components/OtherOperationsBottomSheet/OtherOperationsBottomSheet';
import PageLayout from 'modules/UK/components/PageLayout/PageLayout';
import PortfolioStructure from 'modules/UK/components/PortfolioStructure/PortfolioStructure';
import RedirectToBottomSheet from 'modules/UK/components/RedirectToBottomSheet/RedirectToBottomSheet';
import Row from 'modules/UK/components/Row/Row';
import ValuationDate from 'modules/UK/components/ValuationDate/ValuationDate';
import {
  DATE_RANGE_BAR_BUTTON_CLICK_EVENTS_MAP,
  PORTFOLIO_STRUCTURE_TAB_CHANGE_EVENTS_MAP,
} from 'modules/UK/consts';
import { getUKLkLink, parseQuantity } from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import { BottomSheetState, DateRangeButtonType, TableConfig } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { DisclaimerUK } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as TransferSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/instrumentUk/squircle-transfer-between-portfolios.svg';

import { PositionsResponse } from 'types/positions';

type PifProps = {
  instrumentId?: string;
  positions?: PositionsResponse;
  isPositionsLoading?: boolean;
};

const Pif = ({ instrumentId, positions, isPositionsLoading }: PifProps) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const {
    data: funds,
    isLoading: isFundsLoading,
    isError,
    refetch,
  } = useGetUKFundQuery({
    instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
  });
  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<BottomSheetState | null>(null);

  const handleRefillClick = () =>
    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_FUND_REFILL_AMOUNT + '?from=already_buy', { instrumentId }),
    );

  const handleOtherOperationsClick = () => setBottomSheetState('operations');

  const handleBottomSheetsClose = () => setBottomSheetState(null);

  const { positionValuationByInstrument, positionValuationByProduct } = positions || {};
  const { fund, industry, issuer } = funds || {};

  const { lastPrice, finRes, finResPcnt } = positionValuationByInstrument?.[0] || {};
  const { totalAmount, quantity } = positionValuationByProduct?.[0] || {};

  const { actualTime, tradePlaceId, dateBuyBegin } = fund?.[0] || {};

  const tableConfig: TableConfig[] = [
    { type: 'balance', name: 'Цена пая', field: 'price' },
    { type: 'balance', name: 'Изменение цены', field: 'priceDiffPcnt', isDiff: true },
  ];

  const actionCells = [
    {
      children: 'Обменять паи',
      addonBefore: <TransferSvg />,
      onClick: () => setBottomSheetState('redirectToLk'),
      separator: true,
    },
    {
      children: 'Продать паи',
      addonBefore: <TransferSvg />,
      onClick: () => setBottomSheetState('redirectToUkLk'),
      separator: true,
    },
  ];

  const handleDateRangeChange = (dateRangeType: DateRangeButtonType) => {
    const period = DATE_RANGE_BAR_BUTTON_CLICK_EVENTS_MAP[dateRangeType];
    reachGoal('uk', 'uk_period_tap', { instrumentId: String(instrumentId), period });
  };

  const handleTabChange = (newValue: number) => {
    const eventId = PORTFOLIO_STRUCTURE_TAB_CHANGE_EVENTS_MAP[newValue];
    eventId && reachGoal('uk', eventId, { instrumentId: String(instrumentId) });
  };

  if (isError) {
    return <ErrorPlug onRetry={refetch} />;
  }
  return (
    <PageLayout
      bottom={
        <>
          <DisclaimerUK isLoading={isFundsLoading} field={'disclaimerUk'} />
          {!isPositionsLoading && !isFundsLoading && (
            <ActionButtons
              onPrimaryButtonClick={handleRefillClick}
              onSecondaryButtonClick={handleOtherOperationsClick}
            />
          )}
        </>
      }
    >
      <ValuationDate date={actualTime} isLoading={isFundsLoading} />
      <Assets
        title={'Активы'}
        totalAmount={totalAmount}
        finRes={finRes}
        finResPcnt={finResPcnt}
        isLoading={isPositionsLoading}
      />
      <Row
        name={'Количество паёв'}
        value={parseQuantity(quantity)}
        isLoading={isPositionsLoading}
      />
      <ClosePriceHistoryChart
        paramName={'Цена пая'}
        lastPrice={lastPrice}
        instrumentId={Number(instrumentId)}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        dateBuyBegin={
          !isPositionsLoading && !isFundsLoading
            ? dateBuyBegin || new Date(0).toISOString()
            : undefined
        }
        actualTime={
          !isPositionsLoading && !isFundsLoading
            ? actualTime || new Date().toISOString()
            : undefined
        }
        isLoading={isPositionsLoading || isFundsLoading}
        tableConfig={tableConfig}
        onDateRangeChange={handleDateRangeChange}
      />
      <PortfolioStructure
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        title={'Структура портфеля фонда'}
        industry={industry}
        issuers={issuer}
        isLoading={isFundsLoading}
        onTabChange={handleTabChange}
      />
      <OtherOperationsBottomSheet
        open={bottomSheetState === 'operations'}
        onClose={handleBottomSheetsClose}
        actionCells={actionCells}
      />
      <RedirectToBottomSheet
        from={'pif'}
        state={bottomSheetState}
        to={
          bottomSheetState === 'redirectToLk'
            ? instrumentId && getUKInstrumentLkLink(instrumentId)
            : getUKLkLink()
        }
        text={`Для погашения паёв перейдите в Личный кабинет ${
          bottomSheetState === 'redirectToLk' ? 'Инвестиционной палаты' : 'Управляющей компании'
        }`}
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        open={bottomSheetState === 'redirectToLk' || bottomSheetState === 'redirectToUkLk'}
        onClose={handleBottomSheetsClose}
      />
    </PageLayout>
  );
};

export default Pif;

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import Assets from 'modules/UK/components/Assets/Assets';
import PageLayout from 'modules/UK/components/PageLayout/PageLayout';
import RedirectToBottomSheet from 'modules/UK/components/RedirectToBottomSheet/RedirectToBottomSheet';
import Row from 'modules/UK/components/Row/Row';
import StrategyOperationButton from 'modules/UK/components/StrategyOperationButton/StrategyOperationButton';
import StrategyPriceChart from 'modules/UK/components/StrategyPriceChart/StrategyPriceChart';
import ValuationDate from 'modules/UK/components/ValuationDate/ValuationDate';
import { DATE_RANGE_BAR_BUTTON_CLICK_EVENTS_MAP } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import { getUKLkLink, parseDate, parseDateIISEnd } from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import { DateRangeButtonType, TrustManagementStrategyProps } from 'modules/UK/types';

import { DisclaimerUK } from 'components';

const BondStructured = ({
  productCategoryCode,
  positions,
  strategyResponse,
  isStrategyLoading,
  isPositionsLoading,
}: TrustManagementStrategyProps) => {

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_STRATEGY_REFILL_AMOUNT } from 'const/routes';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { getUKInstrumentLkLink } from 'modules/NonTradableInstrument';
import ActionButtons from 'modules/UK/components/ActionButtons/ActionButtons';
import Assets from 'modules/UK/components/Assets/Assets';
import ClosePriceHistoryChart from 'modules/UK/components/ClosePriceHistoryChart/ClosePriceHistoryChart';
import PageLayout from 'modules/UK/components/PageLayout/PageLayout';
import PortfolioStructure from 'modules/UK/components/PortfolioStructure/PortfolioStructure';
import RedirectToBottomSheet from 'modules/UK/components/RedirectToBottomSheet/RedirectToBottomSheet';
import Row from 'modules/UK/components/Row/Row';
import ValuationDate from 'modules/UK/components/ValuationDate/ValuationDate';
import {
  DATE_RANGE_BAR_BUTTON_CLICK_EVENTS_MAP,
  PORTFOLIO_STRUCTURE_TAB_CHANGE_EVENTS_MAP,
} from 'modules/UK/consts';
import {
  getUKLkLink,
  parseDate,
  parseDateIISEnd,
  uncapitalizeFirstLetter,
} from 'modules/UK/helpers';
import {
  BottomSheetState,
  DateRangeButtonType,
  TableConfig,
  TrustManagementStrategyProps,
} from 'modules/UK/types';

import { DisclaimerUK } from 'components';

const Classical = ({
  productCategoryCode,
  positions,
  isPositionsLoading,
  strategyResponse,
  isStrategyLoading,
}: TrustManagementStrategyProps) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<BottomSheetState | null>(null);

  const { positionValuationByProduct } = positions || {};
  const { strategy, industry, issuer } = strategyResponse || {};

  const { totalAmount, finRes, finResPcnt } = positionValuationByProduct?.[0] || {};
  const { actualTime, dateIisEnd, dateIisOpen, tradePlaceId, instrumentId, baseActiveClass } =
    strategy?.[0] || {};

  const handlePrimaryButtonClick = () =>
    navigate(
      generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_STRATEGY_REFILL_AMOUNT + '?from=already_buy', {
        instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      }),
    );

  const handleSecondaryButtonClick = () => setBottomSheetState('redirectToUkLk');

  const handleBottomSheetsClose = () => setBottomSheetState(null);

  const tableConfig: TableConfig[] = [
    {
      type: 'text',
      name: 'Показатели стратегии на',
      field: 'date',
      format: (value) => {
        if (typeof value !== 'string') return;
        return parseDate(value);
      },
    },
    { type: 'balance', name: 'Доходность', field: 'priceDiffPcnt', isDiff: true },
  ];
  const handleDateRangeChange = (dateRangeType: DateRangeButtonType) => {
    const period = DATE_RANGE_BAR_BUTTON_CLICK_EVENTS_MAP[dateRangeType];
    reachGoal('uk', 'uk_period_tap', { instrumentId: String(instrumentId), period });
  };

  const handleTabChange = (newValue: number) => {
    const eventId = PORTFOLIO_STRUCTURE_TAB_CHANGE_EVENTS_MAP[newValue];
    eventId && reachGoal('uk', eventId, { instrumentId: String(instrumentId) });
  };

  return (
    <PageLayout
      bottom={
        <>
          <DisclaimerUK isLoading={isStrategyLoading} field={'disclaimerUk'} />
          {!isPositionsLoading && !isStrategyLoading && (
            <ActionButtons
              onPrimaryButtonClick={handlePrimaryButtonClick}
              onSecondaryButtonClick={handleSecondaryButtonClick}
            />
          )}
        </>
      }
    >
      <ValuationDate date={actualTime} isLoading={isStrategyLoading} />
      <Assets
        title={'Средства в стратегии'}
        totalAmount={totalAmount}
        finRes={finRes}
        finResPcnt={finResPcnt}
        isLoading={isPositionsLoading}
      />
      {productCategoryCode === 'UK.IIA' && (
        <Row
          name={'Вывод средств без потери вычетов возможен'}
          value={parseDateIISEnd(dateIisEnd)}
        />
      )}

      <ClosePriceHistoryChart
        type={'priceDiffPcnt'}
        paramName={'Доходность'}
        tableConfig={tableConfig}
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
        dateBuyBegin={
          !isPositionsLoading && !isStrategyLoading
            ? dateIisOpen || new Date(0).toISOString()
            : undefined
        }
        actualTime={
          !isPositionsLoading && !isStrategyLoading
            ? actualTime || new Date().toISOString()
            : undefined
        }
        isLoading={isPositionsLoading || isStrategyLoading}
        hint={{
          slug: 'UK_BUY_IIC_STRUCTURE',
          descriptionFormatter: (text) => {
            return text.replace('<BaseActiveClass>', `${uncapitalizeFirstLetter(baseActiveClass)}`);
          },
        }}
        onDateRangeChange={handleDateRangeChange}
      />
      <PortfolioStructure
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        title={'Структура портфеля'}
        industry={industry}
        issuers={issuer}
        isLoading={isStrategyLoading}
        onTabChange={handleTabChange}
      />
      <RedirectToBottomSheet
        from={'tm'}
        state={bottomSheetState}
        to={
          bottomSheetState === 'redirectToLk' ? getUKInstrumentLkLink(instrumentId) : getUKLkLink()
        }
        title={bottomSheetState === 'redirectToUkLk' ? 'Выберите операцию' : undefined}
        text={
          bottomSheetState === 'redirectToLk'
            ? 'Для пополнения перейдите в Личный кабинет Открытие Инвестиции'
            : 'Для совершения других операций перейдите в Личный кабинет Управляющей компании'
        }
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        open={bottomSheetState === 'redirectToLk' || bottomSheetState === 'redirectToUkLk'}
        onClose={handleBottomSheetsClose}
      />
    </PageLayout>
  );
};

export default Classical;

import React from 'react';
import { Navigate, generatePath } from 'react-router-dom';

import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_PLUG } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetUKStrategyQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import ErrorPlug from 'modules/UK/components/ErrorPlug/ErrorPlug';
import { AVAILABLE_STRATEGIES } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import BondStructured from 'modules/UK/pages/UKPurchasedDetails/categories/TrustManagement/strategies/BondStructured';
import Classical from 'modules/UK/pages/UKPurchasedDetails/categories/TrustManagement/strategies/Classical';
import Coupon from 'modules/UK/pages/UKPurchasedDetails/categories/TrustManagement/strategies/Coupon';
import Structured from 'modules/UK/pages/UKPurchasedDetails/categories/TrustManagement/strategies/Structured';
import { TrustManagementProps } from 'modules/UK/types';

const TrustManagement = ({
  instrumentId,
  productCategoryCode,
  positions,
  isPositionsLoading,
}: TrustManagementProps) => {
  const {
    data,
    isLoading: isStrategyLoading,
    isError,
    refetch,
  } = useGetUKStrategyQuery({
    instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
  });

  const { strategy } = data || {};

  const { strategyType } = strategy?.[0] || {};

  if (isError) {
    return <ErrorPlug onRetry={refetch} />;
  }

  if (strategyType && !AVAILABLE_STRATEGIES.includes(strategyType)) {
    return <Navigate to={generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_PLUG, { instrumentId })} replace />;
  }

  if (strategyType === 'clsc')
    return (
      <Classical
        productCategoryCode={productCategoryCode}
        positions={positions}
        strategyResponse={data}
        isPositionsLoading={isPositionsLoading}
        isStrategyLoading={isStrategyLoading}
      />
    );
  if (strategyType === 'strct')
    return (
      <Structured
        productCategoryCode={productCategoryCode}
        positions={positions}
        strategyResponse={data}
        isPositionsLoading={isPositionsLoading}
        isStrategyLoading={isStrategyLoading}
      />
    );
  if (strategyType === 'obl_strct')
    return (
      <BondStructured
        productCategoryCode={productCategoryCode}
        positions={positions}
        strategyResponse={data}
        isPositionsLoading={isPositionsLoading}
        isStrategyLoading={isStrategyLoading}
      />
    );
  if (strategyType === 'cpn')
    return (
      <Coupon
        productCategoryCode={productCategoryCode}
        positions={positions}
        strategyResponse={data}
        isPositionsLoading={isPositionsLoading}
        isStrategyLoading={isStrategyLoading}
      />
    );
  return null;
};

export default TrustManagement;

import React from 'react';
import { Navigate, generatePath, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import CircleLoader from '@vision/circle-loader';
import { ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_PLUG } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetPositionsQuery } from 'core/api/positions';

import ErrorPlug from 'modules/UK/components/ErrorPlug/ErrorPlug';
import { AVAILABLE_UK_PRODUCTS } from 'modules/UK/consts';
import styles from 'modules/UK/pages/UKPurchasedDetails/UKPurchasedDetails.module.pcss';
import Pif from 'modules/UK/pages/UKPurchasedDetails/categories/Pif/Pif';
import TrustManagement from 'modules/UK/pages/UKPurchasedDetails/categories/TrustManagement/TrustManagement';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

const UKPurchasedDetails = () => {
  const { instrumentId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const {
    data: positions,
    isLoading: isPositionsLoading,
    isError,
    refetch,
  } = useGetPositionsQuery({
    instrumentId,
    datasets: 'PositionValuationByInstrument,PositionValuationByProduct,PositionValuationHistory',
  });

  const handleBackButtonClick = () => navigate(-1);

  const { positionValuationByInstrument, positionValuationByProduct } = positions || {};

  const { instrumentName } = positionValuationByInstrument?.[0] || {};
  const { productCategoryCode } = positionValuationByProduct?.[0] || {};

  if (isPositionsLoading)
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderContainer}>
        <CircleLoader type={'page'} />
      </div>
    );

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage
          title={''}
          documentTitle={'Продукт'}
          leftIconVariant={'back'}
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackButtonClick}
        />
        <ErrorPlug onRetry={refetch} />
      </>
    );
  }
  if (productCategoryCode && !AVAILABLE_UK_PRODUCTS.includes(productCategoryCode)) {
    return <Navigate to={generatePath(ROUTE_INSTRUMENTS_UK_PLUG, { instrumentId })} replace />;
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        title={instrumentName}
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackButtonClick}
      />
      {productCategoryCode === 'UK.PIF' && (
        <Pif
          instrumentId={instrumentId}
          positions={positions}
          isPositionsLoading={isPositionsLoading}
        />
      )}
      {(productCategoryCode === 'UK.IIA' || productCategoryCode === 'UK.TM') && (
        <TrustManagement
          instrumentId={instrumentId}
          productCategoryCode={productCategoryCode}
          positions={positions}
          isPositionsLoading={isPositionsLoading}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default UKPurchasedDetails;

import React from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Banner } from '@aurora/components';

import { useInstrumentUkAddRequisitesMutation } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import { colorDestructive } from 'vars/palette';

import Header from 'modules/UKOperations/components/Header/Header';
import InstrumentBuyCard from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InstrumentBuyCard/InstrumentBuyCard';
import InteractDisclaimer from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InteractDisclaimer/InteractDisclaimer';
import StepContent from 'modules/UKOperations/components/StepContent/StepContent';
import { reachUkBuyGoal } from 'modules/UKOperations/helpers';
import { BuyConsumer } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { DisclaimerUK, createAlertNotification } from 'components';
import { Step } from 'components/VerticalStepper';
import VerticalStepper from 'components/VerticalStepper/VerticalStepper';

import { ReactComponent as AlertSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/alert.svg';

import styles from './BuySteps.module.pcss';

const BuySteps: BuyConsumer = ({
  instrumentType,
  disclaimerSlugs,
  headerTitle,
  headerSubtitles,
  routes,
  steps,
  info,
  requestStatus,
  currentStep,
  guid,
  statusError,
  refetchBuyStatus,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [addRequisites] = useInstrumentUkAddRequisitesMutation();

  const { value, status, warning, warningCode, operationType } = requestStatus || {};

  const { shortTitleOi, instrumentImageName, instrumentId } = info || {};

  const handleCreateFundApplication = () => {
    if (status === 'editing') {
      navigate(generatePath(routes?.createApplication, { guid: guid }));
    }
    if (status === 'waiting_confirmation') {
      navigate(generatePath(routes?.documentSign, { guid: guid }));
    }
    reachUkBuyGoal('uk_buy_sum_view', {
      instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
      operationType,
      instrumentType,
    });
  };

  const handleCreateStrategyApplication = async () => {
    if (status === 'editing') {
      if (instrumentType === 'strategy') {
        await addRequisites({ requestGuid: guid, value }).unwrap();
        const statusResponse = await refetchBuyStatus();
        const { status, warning, warningCode } = statusResponse?.requestStatus[0] || {};
        if (warning && warningCode === 'FullNameRecipientFailed') {
          createAlertNotification({
            status: 'error',
            text: warning,
          });
          return;
        }
        status === 'waiting_confirmation' &&
          navigate(generatePath(routes?.documentSign, { guid: guid }));
      } else {
        navigate(generatePath(routes?.createApplication, { guid: guid }));
      }
    }
    if (status === 'waiting_confirmation') {
      navigate(generatePath(routes?.documentSign, { guid: guid }));
    }
  };

  const handleCreateApplication = async () => {
    if (instrumentType === 'fund') {
      handleCreateFundApplication();
    } else {
      await handleCreateStrategyApplication();
    }
  };

  const handlePay = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(routes?.paymentMethod, { guid: guid }));
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Header
        currentStep={currentStep}
        headerTitle={headerTitle}
        headerSubtitles={headerSubtitles}
      />
      <div>
        <InstrumentBuyCard
          value={value}
          shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
        />
        <VerticalStepper activeIndex={currentStep ?? 0}>
          {steps({ createApplication: handleCreateApplication, pay: handlePay }).map(
            (step, index) => {
              return (
                <Step key={index} title={step.title}>
                  {warningCode !== 'UK.Email.Error' && !statusError && (
                    <StepContent
                      text={step.text}
                      buttonName={step.buttonName}
                      onClick={step.onClick}
                    />
                  )}
                  {(warningCode === 'UK.Email.Error' || statusError) && (
                    <Banner
                      icon={<AlertSvg color={colorDestructive} />}
                      variant="red"
                      caption={warning || statusError}
                      size="small"
                      showCloseBtn={false}
                      compact
                    />
                  )}
                </Step>
              );
            },
          )}
        </VerticalStepper>
      </div>
      <div>
        <InteractDisclaimer slug={disclaimerSlugs} shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi} />
        <DisclaimerUK field="disclaimerUk" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default BuySteps;

import React, { SyntheticEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Banner, Headline, Tab, Tabs } from '@aurora/components';

import { useInstrumentUkAddRequisitesMutation } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import { colorDestructive } from 'vars/palette';

import StickyBottomButton from 'modules/UK/components/StickyBottomButton/StickyBottomButton';
import AccountDetailsInput from 'modules/UKOperations/components/AccountDetailsInput/AccountDetailsInput';
import BankCardInput from 'modules/UKOperations/components/BankCardInput/BankCardInput';
import Header from 'modules/UKOperations/components/Header/Header';
import InstrumentBuyCard from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InstrumentBuyCard/InstrumentBuyCard';
import InteractDisclaimer from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InteractDisclaimer/InteractDisclaimer';
import { reachUkBuyGoal, validators } from 'modules/UKOperations/helpers';
import { BankDetailsType, BuyConsumer, InputsNames } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { DisclaimerUK, createAlertNotification } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as AlertSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/alert.svg';

import styles from './CreateApplication.module.pcss';

const CreateApplication: BuyConsumer = ({
  instrumentType,
  statusError,
  disclaimerSlugs,
  headerTitle,
  headerSubtitles,
  routes,
  guid,
  currentStep,
  info,
  refetchBuyStatus,
  requestStatus,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(0);
  const [bankDetails, setBankDetails] = useState<BankDetailsType>({
    cardNumber: { value: '' },
    bik: { value: '' },
    accountNumber: { value: '' },
  });

  const { value, warningCode, warning, status, operationType } = requestStatus || {};

  const { shortTitleOi, instrumentImageName, instrumentId } = info || {};

  const [
    addRequisites,
    { isUninitialized: isAddRequisitesUninitialized, isLoading: isAddRequisitesLoading },
  ] = useInstrumentUkAddRequisitesMutation();

  const isBankDetailsError =
    activeTab === 0
      ? Boolean(bankDetails.cardNumber?.error && bankDetails.cardNumber?.touched) ||
        !bankDetails.cardNumber?.value
      : (Boolean(bankDetails.bik?.error) && bankDetails.bik?.touched) ||
        (Boolean(bankDetails.accountNumber?.error) && bankDetails.accountNumber?.touched) ||
        !bankDetails.bik?.value ||
        !bankDetails.accountNumber?.value;
  const isCriticalError =
    (!isAddRequisitesUninitialized &&
      !isAddRequisitesLoading &&
      warningCode !== 'UK.CardNumber.Wrong' &&
      warningCode !== 'UK.SWIFT.BIK.NotFound' &&
      warningCode !== 'InvalidCheckingAccountMask') ||
    Boolean(statusError);

  const handleTabChange = (_: SyntheticEvent, value: number) => {
    setActiveTab(value);
    reachUkBuyGoal(
      'uk_buy_bank_data_view',
      {
        instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
        instrumentType,
        operationType,
      },
      {
        bank_data: value === 0 ? 'card' : 'requisites',
      },
    );
  };

  const handleInputChange = (name: InputsNames, value: string) => {
    setBankDetails((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [name]: {
        ...prev[name],
        error: validators[name](value),
        value,
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleInputBlur = (name: InputsNames) => {
    setBankDetails((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [name]: {
        ...prev[name],
        touched: true,
      },
    }));
  };

  const createCardApplication = async () => {
    const error = validators.cardNumber(bankDetails.cardNumber.value);
    if (error) {
      setBankDetails((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        cardNumber: {
          ...prev.cardNumber,
          error,
        },
      }));
      return;
    }
    await addRequisites({
      requestGuid: guid,
      value,
      cardNumber: bankDetails.cardNumber.value.replaceAll(' ', ''),
      paymentType: 2,
    }).unwrap();
    refetchBuyStatus();
  };

  const createAccountDetailsApplication = async () => {
    const bikError = validators.bik(bankDetails.bik.value);
    const checkingAccountError = validators.accountNumber(bankDetails.accountNumber.value);
    if (bikError || checkingAccountError) {
      setBankDetails((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        bik: {
          ...prev.bik,
          error: bikError,
        },
        accountNumber: {
          ...prev.accountNumber,
          error: checkingAccountError,
        },
      }));
      return;
    }
    await addRequisites({
      requestGuid: guid,
      value,
      bik: bankDetails.bik.value,
      accountNumber: bankDetails.accountNumber.value,
      paymentType: 1,
    }).unwrap();
    refetchBuyStatus();
  };

  const createApplication = async () => {
    if (activeTab === 0) {
      await createCardApplication();
    }
    if (activeTab === 1) {
      await createAccountDetailsApplication();
    }
    reachUkBuyGoal('uk_buy_doc_view', {
      instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
      instrumentType,
      operationType,
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (warningCode === 'UK.CardNumber.Wrong' && bankDetails.cardNumber.value) {
      setBankDetails((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        cardNumber: {
          ...prev.cardNumber,
          error: warning,
          touched: true,
        },
      }));
    }
    if (warningCode === 'UK.SWIFT.BIK.NotFound' && bankDetails.bik.value) {
      setBankDetails((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        bik: {
          ...prev.bik,
          error: warning,
          touched: true,
        },
      }));
    }
    if (warningCode === 'InvalidCheckingAccountMask' && bankDetails.accountNumber.value) {
      setBankDetails((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        accountNumber: {
          ...prev.accountNumber,
          error: warning,
          touched: true,
        },
      }));
    }
    if (warningCode === 'FullNameRecipientFailed') {
      createAlertNotification({
        text: warning ?? 'ФИО клиента должно совпадать с ФИО получателя',
        status: 'error',
      });
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [warningCode, warning]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'waiting_confirmation' || statusError) return;
    navigate(generatePath(routes?.documentSign, { guid }), {
      replace: true,
    });
  }, [status, statusError]);

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Header
        currentStep={currentStep}
        headerTitle={headerTitle}
        headerSubtitles={headerSubtitles}
      />
      <div>
        <InstrumentBuyCard
          value={value}
          shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
        />
        <Headline
          titleText="Укажите банковские реквизиты"
          typeTitle="subtitleBold"
          addonBottomText="Банковские реквизиты нужны для формирования заявки на приобретение паёв, а также для перечисления средств от операций"
        />
        <Tabs value={activeTab} onChange={handleTabChange}>
          <Tab label="Банковская карта" value={0} />
          <Tab label="Реквизиты счёта" value={1} />
        </Tabs>
        {isCriticalError && (
          <Banner
            icon={<AlertSvg color={colorDestructive} />}
            size="medium"
            variant="red"
            caption={
              warning || statusError || 'Произошла ошибка. Пожалуйста, повторите попытку позже'
            }
            showCloseBtn={false}
          />
        )}
        {activeTab === 0 && (
          <BankCardInput
            values={bankDetails}
            onChange={handleInputChange}
            onBlur={handleInputBlur}
          />
        )}
        {activeTab === 1 && (
          <AccountDetailsInput
            values={bankDetails}
            onChange={handleInputChange}
            onBlur={handleInputBlur}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      <div>
        <InteractDisclaimer slug={disclaimerSlugs} shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi} />
        <DisclaimerUK field="disclaimerUk" />
        <StickyBottomButton
          onClick={createApplication}
          opacity={1}
          disabled={isCriticalError || isBankDetailsError}
        >
          Сформировать документы
        </StickyBottomButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CreateApplication;

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import React from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Headline } from '@aurora/components';

import { useLazyInstrumentUkBuySbpQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';
import { isError } from 'core/helpers/isError';

import Header from 'modules/UKOperations/components/Header/Header';
import InstrumentBuyCard from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InstrumentBuyCard/InstrumentBuyCard';
import InteractDisclaimer from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InteractDisclaimer/InteractDisclaimer';
import { reachUkBuyGoal } from 'modules/UKOperations/helpers';
import { BuyConsumer } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { DisclaimerUK, createAlertNotification } from 'components';
import ActionCell from 'components/ActionCell';

import { ReactComponent as BankAccountSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/instrumentUk/squircle-bank-account.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SbpSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/instrumentUk/squircle-icon-sbp.svg';

import styles from './PaymentMethod.module.pcss';

const PaymentMethod: BuyConsumer = ({
  instrumentType,
  disclaimerSlugs,
  headerSubtitles,
  headerTitle,
  routes,
  info,
  currentStep,
  requestStatus,
  guid,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [buySbp] = useLazyInstrumentUkBuySbpQuery();

  const { value, requestGuid, operationType } = requestStatus || {};
  const { shortTitleOi, instrumentImageName, instrumentId } = info || {};

  const handleToRequisites = () =>
    navigate(generatePath(routes?.paymentMethodRequisites, { guid }));

  const handleToSbp = async () => {
    if (!value || !requestGuid) return;
    try {
      const response = await buySbp({ value, requestGuid }).unwrap();
      const url = response.sbp[0].qrcCode;
      if (!url) {
        createAlertNotification({ status: 'error', text: 'Не удалось получить ссылку для оплаты' });
        return;
      }
      const newWindow = window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
      if (newWindow) {
        newWindow.opener = null;
      }
      reachUkBuyGoal(
        'uk_buy_pay_view',
        {
          instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
          instrumentType,
          operationType,
        },
        {
          payment: 'SBP',
        },
      );
    } catch (error) {
      const errorMessage =
        isError(error) && error.data.error[0]?.errorMessageText
          ? error.data.error[0]?.errorMessageText
          : 'Что-то пошло не так';
      createAlertNotification({ status: 'error', text: errorMessage });
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Header
        currentStep={currentStep}
        headerTitle={headerTitle}
        headerSubtitles={headerSubtitles}
      />
      <div>
        <InstrumentBuyCard
          value={value}
          shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
        />
        <Headline titleText="Оплатите паи" typeTitle="subtitleBold" />
        <ActionCell
          contentClassName={styles.actionCell}
          addonBefore={<BankAccountSvg />}
          onClick={handleToRequisites}
        >
          По реквизитам
        </ActionCell>
        <ActionCell
          contentClassName={styles.actionCell}
          addonBefore={<SbpSvg />}
          onClick={handleToSbp}
        >
          Система Быстрых Платежей
        </ActionCell>
      </div>
      <div>
        <InteractDisclaimer slug={disclaimerSlugs} shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi} />
        <DisclaimerUK field="disclaimerUk" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
export default PaymentMethod;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { NumberFormatValues } from 'react-number-format';
import { generatePath, useLocation, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Banner, Button, Input } from '@aurora/components';

import { useInstrumentUkBuyMutation } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { colorAttention } from 'vars/palette';

import Header from 'modules/UKOperations/components/Header/Header';
import InstrumentBuyCard from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InstrumentBuyCard/InstrumentBuyCard';
import InteractDisclaimer from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InteractDisclaimer/InteractDisclaimer';
import { handleError, reachUkBuyGoal, setFrom } from 'modules/UKOperations/helpers';
import { BuyConsumer } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { DisclaimerUK } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as AlertSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/alert.svg';

import styles from './RefillAmount.module.pcss';

const RefillAmount: BuyConsumer = ({
  instrumentType,
  disclaimerSlugs,
  headerTitle,
  headerSubtitles,
  routes,
  currentStep,
  info,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { instrumentId } = useParams();

  const location = useLocation();

  const [inputState, setInputState] = useState<NumberFormatValues | null>(null);
  const [isError, setIsError] = useState<boolean>(true);

  const [buy, { isLoading: isBuyLoading, isError: isBuyError }] = useInstrumentUkBuyMutation();

  const { shortTitleOi, instrumentImageName, firstPaymentMinLk } = info || {};
  const validateValue = (value?: number) => {
    const isCurrentError = Boolean(
      !inputState || firstPaymentMinLk == null || value == null || value < firstPaymentMinLk,
    );
    if (isCurrentError === isError) return;
    setIsError(isCurrentError);
  };

  const handleInputChange = (value: NumberFormatValues) => {
    setInputState(value);
    validateValue(value?.floatValue);
  };

  const handleContinue = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await buy({
        instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
        value: inputState?.floatValue,
      }).unwrap();
      navigate(generatePath(routes?.buy, { guid: response?.request?.[0]?.requestGuid }));
      const from = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('from');
      from && setFrom(from);
      reachUkBuyGoal(
        'uk_buy_sum_view',
        {
          instrumentId: Number(instrumentId),
          instrumentType,
        },
        {
          uk_refill_amount: String(inputState?.floatValue),
        },
      );
    } catch (error) {
      handleError(error);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Header
        currentStep={currentStep}
        headerTitle={headerTitle}
        headerSubtitles={headerSubtitles}
      />
      <div>
        <InstrumentBuyCard instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName} shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi} />
        <Input
          variant="number"
          value={inputState?.value}
          label="Сумма инвестирования"
          description={
            firstPaymentMinLk &&
            `Минимальная сумма — ${sumFormatter(firstPaymentMinLk, null, 0)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`
          }
          placeholder="Введите сумму"
          suffix={' ' + currencySign('RUB')}
          className={styles.amountInput}
          onValueChange={handleInputChange}
          status={isError ? 'error' : undefined}
        />
        {instrumentType === 'strategy' && (
          <Banner
            icon={<AlertSvg color={colorAttention} />}
            variant="orange"
            caption={
              'Уведомляем Вас о том, что имея ИИС у другого брокера или управляющего, вы потеряете возможность' +
              ' на налоговый вычет, если не закроете его в течение 30 дней с момента покупки продукта' +
              ` «${shortTitleOi}».`
            }
            size="medium"
            showCloseBtn={false}
            compact
          />
        )}
      </div>
      <div>
        <InteractDisclaimer slug={disclaimerSlugs} shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi} />
        <DisclaimerUK field="disclaimerUk" />
        <div className={styles.buttonContainer}>
          <Button onClick={handleContinue} disabled={isError || isBuyError} loading={isBuyLoading}>
            Продолжить
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default RefillAmount;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Button, ButtonBar, CircleLoader, Headline } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetInstrumentUkRequisitesQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import Header from 'modules/UKOperations/components/Header/Header';
import InstrumentBuyCard from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InstrumentBuyCard/InstrumentBuyCard';
import InteractDisclaimer from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InteractDisclaimer/InteractDisclaimer';
import RequisitesBottomSheet from 'modules/UKOperations/components/RequisitesBottomSheet/RequisitesBottomSheet';
import { handleError } from 'modules/UKOperations/helpers';
import { BuyConsumer } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { DisclaimerUK } from 'components';

import RequisitesComponent from '../../components/Requisites/Requisites';
import styles from './Requisites.module.pcss';

const Requisites: BuyConsumer = ({
  instrumentType,
  disclaimerSlugs,
  headerSubtitles,
  headerTitle,
  info,
  currentStep,
  requestStatus,
  guid,
}) => {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const {
    data: requisitesResponse,
    error: requisitesError,
    isLoading: isRequisitesLoading,
    isError: isRequisitesError,
  } = useGetInstrumentUkRequisitesQuery({ requestGuid: guid }, { skip: !guid });
  const { payGround } = requisitesResponse?.request?.[0] || {};

  const { value, operationType } = requestStatus || {};
  const { shortTitleOi, instrumentImageName, instrumentId } = info || {};

  const requisites = {
    benificiar: info?.benificiar,
    bankAccount: info?.bankAccount,
    bank: info?.bank,
    bankAddress: info?.bankAddress,
    bankBik: info?.bankBik,
    bankCoraccount: info?.bankCoraccount,
    bankInn: info?.bankInn,
    bankKpp: info?.bankKpp,
    payGround,
  };

  const handleOpen = () => setOpen(true);

  const handleClose = () => setOpen(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!requisitesError) return;
    handleError(requisitesError);
  }, [requisitesError]);
  if (isRequisitesLoading) return <CircleLoader type="page" brandColor />;
  return (
    <div className={styles.container}>
      <Header
        currentStep={currentStep}
        headerTitle={headerTitle}
        headerSubtitles={headerSubtitles}
      />
      <div className={styles.topContainer}>
        <InstrumentBuyCard
          value={value}
          shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi}
          instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
        />
      </div>
      <div className={styles.scrollableMiddleContainer}>
        <Headline titleText="Оплата по реквизитам" typeTitle="subtitleBold" />
        <RequisitesComponent {...requisites} />
        <DisclaimerUK field="disclaimerUk" />
        <InteractDisclaimer slug={disclaimerSlugs} shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi} />
      </div>
      <ButtonBar className={styles.bottomContainer}>
        <Button onClick={handleOpen} disabled={isRequisitesError}>
          Завершить
        </Button>
      </ButtonBar>
      <RequisitesBottomSheet
        open={open}
        onClose={handleClose}
        shortTitleOi={shortTitleOi}
        instrumentId={instrumentId}
        instrumentType={instrumentType}
        operationType={operationType}
        instrumentImageName={instrumentImageName}
        value={value}
        {...requisites}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Requisites;

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import {
  useInstrumentUkSmsCheckMutation,
  useInstrumentUkSmsRepeatMutation,
} from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import { useTimer } from 'hooks/useTimer';

import styles from 'modules/UKOperations/blocks/SmsConfirmation/SmsConfirmation.module.pcss';
import { SMS_INPUT_COUNT, SMS_RETRY_TIMEOUT } from 'modules/UKOperations/consts';
import { handleError, reachUkBuyGoal } from 'modules/UKOperations/helpers';
import { BuyConsumer } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { HeaderPage, createAlertNotification } from 'components';
import SmsInput from 'components/SmsInput';

const SmsConfirmation: BuyConsumer = ({
  instrumentType,
  info,
  routes,
  guid,
  refetchBuyStatus,
  requestStatus,
  statusError,
}) => {
  const [
    smsCheck,
    {
      data: smsCheckResponse,
      isLoading: isSmsCheckLoading,
      reset: resetSmsCheck,
      isError: isSmsCheckError,
    },
  ] = useInstrumentUkSmsCheckMutation();
  const [
    smsRepeat,
    {
      isLoading: isSmsRepeatLoading,
      isSuccess: isSmsRepeatSuccess,
      isUninitialized: isSmsRepeatUninitialized,
      requestId: smsRepeatRequestId,
      isError: isSmsRepeatError,
    },
  ] = useInstrumentUkSmsRepeatMutation();

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { status, operationType } = requestStatus || {};
  const { instrumentId } = info || {};

  const { currentCount, formattedTimeout, startTimer, resetTimer } = useTimer(SMS_RETRY_TIMEOUT);

  const smsInputBlocked =
    smsCheckResponse?.requestStatus[0]?.warningCode === 'UK.Email.Error' ||
    Boolean(statusError) ||
    isSmsCheckError ||
    isSmsRepeatError;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSmsRepeatSuccess || isSmsRepeatUninitialized) startTimer();
  }, [startTimer, isSmsRepeatSuccess, isSmsRepeatUninitialized, smsRepeatRequestId]);

  const handleSmsInputChange = async (value: string) => {
    if (value.length !== SMS_INPUT_COUNT || !guid) return;
    try {
      const response = await smsCheck({ requestGuid: guid, smsCode: value }).unwrap();
      const { warningCode, warning } = response?.requestStatus[0] || {};
      if (warningCode === 'EmailConfirmationNotSend' && warning) {
        createAlertNotification({ text: warning, status: 'info' });
      }
      if (warningCode !== 'EmailConfirmationNotSend' && warning) {
        createAlertNotification({ text: warning, status: 'error' });
      }
      if (!warningCode) {
        refetchBuyStatus();
      }
      reachUkBuyGoal('uk_buy_sms_view', {
        instrumentId: String(instrumentId),
        instrumentType,
        operationType,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      handleError(error);
    }
  };
  const handleSmsRetryButtonClick = async () => {
    if (!guid) return;
    try {
      await smsRepeat({ requestGuid: guid }).unwrap();
      resetSmsCheck();
      resetTimer();
    } catch (error) {
      handleError(error);
    }
  };
  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'ok') return;
    navigate(generatePath(routes?.buy, { guid }), { replace: true });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [status]);

  useEffect(() => {
    statusError && handleError(statusError);
  }, [statusError]);

  if (isSmsCheckLoading || isSmsRepeatLoading) {
    return (
      <>
        <HeaderPage
          title="СМС-подтверждение"
          leftIconVariant="back"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        />

        <CircleLoader type="page" brandColor />
        {isSmsRepeatLoading && <Text>Запрос нового СМС-кода...</Text>}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrap}>
      <HeaderPage
        title={'СМС-подтверждение'}
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
      />
      <div className={styles.text}>
        <Text>
          Для подписания документов простой электронной подписью на Ваш номер был отправлен код.
          Введите код подтверждения ниже:
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.container}>
        <div className={styles.smsInputContainer}>
          <SmsInput
            count={SMS_INPUT_COUNT}
            onChange={handleSmsInputChange}
            disabled={smsInputBlocked}
          />
        </div>
        {!smsInputBlocked && (
          <div className={styles.inputBottomAddon}>
            {currentCount && currentCount !== 0 ? (
              <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                Запросить новый код через {formattedTimeout}
              </Text>
            ) : (
              <Button shape="text" onClick={handleSmsRetryButtonClick}>
                <Text type={'lineSemiBold'}>Отправить новый код</Text>
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SmsConfirmation;

import React from 'react';

import { Input } from '@aurora/components';

import { TabContentProps } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import styles from './AccountDetailsInput.module.pcss';

const AccountDetailsInput = ({ values, onChange, onBlur }: TabContentProps) => {
  return (
    <>
      <Input
        value={values.bik.value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange('bik', event.target.value)}
        onBlur={() => onBlur('bik')}
        className={styles.input}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Checkbox, CheckboxFormGroup } from '@aurora/components';

import { CheckboxesComponent } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

const FundCheckboxes: CheckboxesComponent = ({ shortTitleOi, onCheckboxesChecked }) => {
  const [checkboxes, setCheckboxes] = useState<boolean[]>([false, false]);

  const handleCheckboxChange = (index: number) => () => {
    setCheckboxes((prev) => prev.map((el, i) => (i === index ? !el : el)));
  };

  const allChecked = checkboxes.reduce((acc, curr) => acc && curr, true);

  useEffect(() => {
    onCheckboxesChecked(allChecked);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [allChecked]);
  return (
    <CheckboxFormGroup>
      <Checkbox
        checked={checkboxes[0]}
        label={
          'Подтверждаю, что я ознакомлен с правилами доверительного управления ОПИФ' +
          ` рыночных финансовых инструментов «${shortTitleOi}» и принимаю условия`
        }
        onChange={handleCheckboxChange(0)}
      />
      <Checkbox
        checked={checkboxes[1]}
        label={
          'Подтверждаю достоверность предоставленных данных и подтверждаю, что ознакомлен с документами, ' +
          'приведенными выше, а также даю согласие на их подписание'
        }
        onChange={handleCheckboxChange(1)}
      />
    </CheckboxFormGroup>
  );
};

export default FundCheckboxes;

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';

import { Disclaimer, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { useGetHintsQuery } from 'core/api/hints';

import styles from 'modules/UKOperations/components/InteractDisclaimer/InteractDisclaimer.module.pcss';
import { InteractDisclaimerProps } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

const InteractDisclaimer = ({ slug, shortTitleOi }: InteractDisclaimerProps) => {
  const { data: hints } = useGetHintsQuery(undefined, { skip: !slug });

  const hint = useMemo(() => {
    const text = hints?.hints.find((f) => f?.slug === slug)?.text;
    if (!text || !shortTitleOi) return;
    return text.replace('<ShortTitle>', shortTitleOi);
  }, [hints, slug, shortTitleOi]);
  return (
    <Disclaimer text="Вы взаимодействуете с УК «ОТКРЫТИЕ»">
      <Text type="lineRegular" className={styles.text}>
        {hint}
      </Text>
    </Disclaimer>
  );
};

export default InteractDisclaimer;

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';

import {
  BottomSheet,
  Button,
  HeadlineBottomSheet,
  InformationCell,
  Text,
} from '@aurora/components';
import QRCode from 'qrcode.react';

import { useShareFile } from 'hooks/useShareFile';

import styles from 'modules/UKOperations/components/QrCodeBottomSheet/QrCodeBottomSheet.module.pcss';
import { QrCodeBottomSheetProps } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { FormattedBalance } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as ShareSvg } from 'images/icons/share.svg';

const QrCodeBottomSheet = ({
  open,
  onClose,
  qrCodeValue = '',
  amount,
  shortTitleOi,
}: QrCodeBottomSheetProps) => {
  const { generatingImage, file, ref, shareHandler } = useShareFile();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (file.current) {
      file.current = undefined;
    }
    //eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [qrCodeValue]);
  return (
    <BottomSheet open={open} onDismiss={onClose} initialFocusRef={false}>
      <HeadlineBottomSheet title="Оплата по QR-коду" />
      <div className={styles.qrCodeContainer} ref={ref}>
        <QRCode id="qrCode" value={qrCodeValue} size={234} includeMargin={true} />
      </div>
      <InformationCell
        variant="small"
        separator={false}
        dataMainColumn={[
          {
            title: `Покупка паёв «${shortTitleOi}»`,
            addonRight: (
              <FormattedBalance
                type="lineRegular"
                value={amount}
                precision={null}
                minPrecision={0}
                currency="RUB"
              />
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />
      <div className={styles.footer}>
        <Text type="lineRegular" color="colorForeground2" direction="center">

          устройство
        </Text>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          iconLeft={<ShareSvg />}
          onClick={shareHandler}
          loading={generatingImage}
        >
          Отправить код
        </Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default QrCodeBottomSheet;

import React from 'react';

import { Button, ButtonBar, InformationCell, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import IconButton from '@vision/icon-button';

import { shareOrCopyText } from 'utils/shareOrCopyText';

import { colorForeground3 } from 'vars/palette';

import { prepareRequisitesToShare } from 'modules/UKOperations/helpers';
import { InformationCellStyledProps, RequisitesProps } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as CopySvg } from 'images/icons/copy.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ShareSvg } from 'images/icons/share.svg';

const InformationCellStyled = ({ label, title }: InformationCellStyledProps) => {
  const handleCopy = async () => {
    if (!title) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(title);
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Скопировано в буфер', ms: 1000 });
    } catch {
      return;
    }
  };
  return (
    <InformationCell
      label={
        <Text type="labelRegular" color="colorForeground2">
          {label}
        </Text>
      }
      title={<Text type="lineRegular">{title}</Text>}
      addonRight={
        <IconButton onClick={handleCopy}>
          <CopySvg color={colorForeground3} />
        </IconButton>
      }
    />
  );
};

const Requisites = ({
  bank,
  bankKpp,
  bankBik,
  bankCoraccount,
  bankInn,
  bankAddress,
  bankAccount,
  benificiar,
  payGround,
}: RequisitesProps) => {
  const handleShareRequisites = () => {
    shareOrCopyText(
      prepareRequisitesToShare({
        bank,
        bankKpp,
        bankBik,
        bankCoraccount,
        bankInn,
        bankAddress,
        bankAccount,
        benificiar,
        payGround,
      }),
    );
  };
  return (
    <>
      <InformationCellStyled label="Получатель платежа" title={benificiar} />
      <InformationCellStyled label="Банк" title={bank} />
      <InformationCellStyled label="Адрес банка" title={bankAddress} />
      <InformationCellStyled label="Назначение платежа" title={payGround} />
      <InformationCellStyled label="ИНН" title={bankInn} />
      <InformationCellStyled label="КПП" title={bankKpp} />
      <InformationCellStyled label="Расчётный счёт" title={bankAccount} />
      <InformationCellStyled label="Корпоративный счёт" title={bankCoraccount} />
      <InformationCellStyled label="БИК" title={bankBik} />
      <ButtonBar>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          size="s"
          iconLeft={<ShareSvg />}
          onClick={handleShareRequisites}
        >
          Поделиться реквизитами
        </Button>
      </ButtonBar>
    </>
  );
};

export default Requisites;

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { isErrorResponseType } from 'utils/errorResponse';

import { UK_BUY_FROM_KEY } from 'modules/UKOperations/consts';
import { InputsNames, ReachUkBuyGoalParams, RequisitesType } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

export const handleError = (error: unknown) => {
  const text = isErrorResponseType(error)
    ? error.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText
    : typeof error === 'string'
    ? error
    : 'Произошла ошибка';
  createAlertNotification({ text: text, status: 'error' });
};

export const createQrCodeData = ({
  benificiar,
  bankAccount,
  bank,
  bankBik,
  bankCoraccount,
  bankInn,
  bankKpp,
  payGround,
}: {
  benificiar?: string;
  bankAccount?: string;
  bank?: string;
  bankBik?: string;
  bankCoraccount?: string;
  bankInn?: string;
  bankKpp?: string;
  payGround?: string;
}) => {
  return (
    'ST00012|' +
    `Name=${benificiar}|` +
    `PersonalAcc=${bankAccount}|` +
    `BankName=${bank}|` +
    `BIC=${bankBik}|` +
    `CorrespAcc=${bankCoraccount}|` +
    `PayeeINN=${bankInn}|` +
    `KPP=${bankKpp}|` +
    `Purpose=${payGround}`
  );
};
export const validators: Record<InputsNames, (value: string) => string | undefined> = {
  cardNumber: (value) => {
    const skipSpaces = value.replaceAll(' ', '');
    const parsedValue = Number(skipSpaces);
    const valueLength = skipSpaces.length;
    if (
      Number.isNaN(parsedValue) ||
      !Number.isFinite(parsedValue) ||
      !Number.isInteger(parsedValue) ||
      valueLength < 16
    ) {
      return 'Не корректное значение';
    }
  },
  bik: (value) => {
    const parsedValue = Number(value);
    const valueLength = value.length;
    if (
      Number.isNaN(parsedValue) ||
      !Number.isFinite(parsedValue) ||
      !Number.isInteger(parsedValue) ||
      valueLength !== 9
    ) {
      return 'Не корректное значение';
    }
  },
  accountNumber: (value) => {
    const parsedValue = Number(value);
    const valueLength = value.length;
    if (
      Number.isNaN(parsedValue) ||
      !Number.isFinite(parsedValue) ||
      !Number.isInteger(parsedValue) ||
      valueLength !== 20
    ) {
      return 'Не корректное значение';
    }
  },
};
export const prepareRequisitesToShare = (requisites: Partial<RequisitesType>) => {
  const order = [
    'benificiar',
    'bank',
    'payGround',
    'bankAddress',
    'bankInn',
    'bankKpp',
    'bankAccount',
    'bankCoraccount',
    'bankBik',
  ] as const;
  const names = {
    bank: 'Банк',
    bankKpp: 'КПП',
    bankBik: 'БИК',
    bankCoraccount: 'Корпоративный счёт',
    bankInn: 'ИНН',
    bankAddress: 'Адрес банка',
    bankAccount: 'Расчётный счёт',
    benificiar: 'Получатель платежа',
    payGround: 'Назначение платежа',
  };
  return order.reduce((acc, curr) => {
    if (requisites[curr]) {
      return acc + `${names[curr]}: ${requisites[curr]}\n`;
    }
    return acc;
  }, '');
};

export const setFrom = (from: string) => {
  sessionStorage.setItem(UK_BUY_FROM_KEY, from);
};

export const getFrom = () => {
  return sessionStorage.getItem(UK_BUY_FROM_KEY);
};

export const reachUkBuyGoal = (
  id: string,
  params: ReachUkBuyGoalParams,
  others?: Record<string, string>,
) => {
  const { instrumentId, instrumentType, operationType } = params;
  reachGoal('uk', id, {
    instrumentId: instrumentId ? String(instrumentId) : '',
    client: Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_OPENACCOUNT') ? 'non_uk' : 'uk',
    dos: 'no',
    buy: operationType === 'create' ? 'yes' : 'no',
    morebuy: operationType === 'pay' ? 'yes' : 'no',
    type: instrumentType === 'fund' ? 'pif' : 'iic',
    from: getFrom() ?? '',
    ...others,
  });
};

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { useLazyGetInstrumentUkBuyStatusQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';

import { MAX_RETRIES } from 'modules/UKOperations/consts';

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

const useBuyStatus = (guid?: string) => {
  const [retries, setRetries] = useState(0);

  const [fetch, { data, error, isLoading, isFetching, isError }] =
    useLazyGetInstrumentUkBuyStatusQuery();

  const { status } = data?.requestStatus?.[0] || {};

  const isReady =
    status === 'ok' ||
    status === 'editing' ||
    status === 'error' ||
    status === 'waiting_confirmation' ||
    !guid ||
    isError ||
    retries >= MAX_RETRIES;

  const refetch = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!guid) return;

    let retriesCount = 0;
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
    while (true) {
      const response = await fetch({ requestGuid: guid }).unwrap();
      const { status } = response?.requestStatus?.[0] || {};
      const isReady =
        status === 'ok' ||
        status === 'editing' ||
        status === 'error' ||
        status === 'waiting_confirmation' ||
        retriesCount >= MAX_RETRIES;
      if (isReady) {
        retriesCount >= MAX_RETRIES &&
          createAlertNotification({ text: 'Что-то пошло не так. Попробуйте еще раз.' });
        setRetries(0);
        return response;
      } else {
        retriesCount += 1;
        setRetries(retriesCount);
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 5000));
      }
    }
  }, [fetch, guid]);

  useEffect(() => {
    refetch();
  }, [refetch]);

  return {
    data,
    error,
    isLoading: isLoading || !isReady,
    isFetching: isFetching || !isReady,
    isError,
    refetch,
  };
};

export default useBuyStatus;

import { UseBuyStepProps } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

const useBuyStep = ({ status }: UseBuyStepProps) => {
  if (!status) return;
  if (status === 'editing' || status === 'waiting_confirmation') {
    return 0;
  }
  return 1;
};

export default useBuyStep;

import React from 'react';
import { Navigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_360, ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetUKFundQuery } from 'core/api/instrumentUK';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { isErrorResponseType } from 'utils/errorResponse';

import {
  CHECKBOXES,
  DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE,
  DISCLAIMER_SLUGS,
  HEADER_SUBTITLES,
  HEADER_TITLES,
  ROUTES,
  STEPS,
} from 'modules/UKOperations/consts';
import useBuyStatus from 'modules/UKOperations/hooks/useBuyStatus';
import useBuyStep from 'modules/UKOperations/hooks/useBuyStep';
import { BuyProviderProps } from 'modules/UKOperations/types';

const FundBuyProvider = ({ Children }: BuyProviderProps) => {
  const { guid = '', instrumentId: instrumentIdFromParams } = useParams();

  const personAmcOpenAccountGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_OPENACCOUNT');
  const personAmcFundBuyGranted = Permissions.granted('PERSON_AMC_FUND_BUY');

  const hasAccess = !personAmcOpenAccountGranted && personAmcFundBuyGranted;

  const {
    data,
    error,
    isLoading: isStatusLoading,
    isFetching: isStatusFetching,
    isError: isStatusError,
    refetch,
  } = useBuyStatus(guid);
  const { status, instrumentId } = data?.requestStatus?.[0] || {};

  const statusError = isStatusError
    ? isErrorResponseType(error)
      ? error.data?.error[0]?.errorMessageText
      : DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE
    : undefined;

  const currentStep = useBuyStep({ status });

  const {
    data: fundResponse,
    isLoading: isFundLoading,
    isError: isFundError,
  } = useGetUKFundQuery(
    {
      instrumentId: instrumentIdFromParams ? Number(instrumentIdFromParams) : Number(instrumentId),
    },
    { skip: !hasAccess || (!instrumentIdFromParams && instrumentId == null) },
  );

  if (isFundError) return <Navigate to={ROUTE_SOMETHING_WENT_WRONG} replace />;
  if (!hasAccess) return <Navigate to={ROUTE_360} replace />;
  if (isStatusFetching || isFundLoading) return <CircleLoader type="page" brandColor />;

  return (
    <Children
      instrumentType="fund"
      disclaimerSlugs={DISCLAIMER_SLUGS.fund}
      routes={ROUTES.fund}
      headerTitle={HEADER_TITLES.fund}
      headerSubtitles={HEADER_SUBTITLES.fund}
      steps={STEPS.fund}
      Checkboxes={CHECKBOXES.fund}
      guid={guid}
      isStatusLoading={isStatusLoading}
      isStatusFetching={isStatusFetching}
      statusError={statusError}
      isFundLoading={isFundLoading}
      refetchBuyStatus={refetch}
      info={fundResponse?.fund?.[0]}
      requestStatus={data?.requestStatus?.[0]}
      currentStep={currentStep}
    />
  );
};

export default FundBuyProvider;
