import React from 'react';

import {
  Fund,
  GetInstrumentUkBuyStatusResponse,
  RequestStatus,
  RequestStatuses,
  Strategy,
} from 'types/instrumentUK';

export type ProviderType = 'fund' | 'strategy';

export type StepType = 0 | 1;

export type Step = {
  title: string;
  text: string;
  buttonName: string;
  onClick: () => void;
};

export type CreateStepsFn = ({
  createApplication,
  pay,
}: {
  createApplication: () => void;
  pay: () => void;
}) => Step[];

export type CheckboxesProps = {
  shortTitleOi?: string;
  onCheckboxesChecked: (checked: boolean) => void;
};

export type CheckboxesComponent = React.FC<CheckboxesProps>;

export type BuyConsumerProps = {
  instrumentType: ProviderType;
  disclaimerSlugs: string;
  steps: CreateStepsFn;
  routes: Record<string, string>;
  headerTitle: string;
  headerSubtitles: Record<StepType, string>;
  Checkboxes: CheckboxesComponent;
  info?: Fund | Strategy;
  statusError?: string;
  requestStatus?: RequestStatus;
  currentStep?: StepType;
  guid: string;
  refetchBuyStatus: () => Promise<GetInstrumentUkBuyStatusResponse | void>;
  isStatusLoading: boolean;
  isStatusFetching: boolean;
  isFundLoading: boolean;
};

export type BuyConsumer = (props: BuyConsumerProps) => JSX.Element;

export type BuyProviderProps = {
  Children: BuyConsumer;
};

export type RequisitesType = {
  benificiar: string;
  bank: string;
  bankAddress: string;
  payGround: string;
  bankInn: string;
  bankKpp: string;
  bankAccount: string;
  bankCoraccount: string;
  bankBik: string;
};

export type StepContentProps = {
  text: string;
  buttonName: string;
  onClick?: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  loading?: boolean;
};

export type InputState = {
  value: string;
  error?: string;
  touched?: boolean;
};

export type InputsNames = 'cardNumber' | 'bik' | 'accountNumber';

export type BankDetailsType = Record<InputsNames, InputState>;

export type TabContentProps = {
  values: BankDetailsType;
  onChange: (name: InputsNames, value: string) => void;
  onBlur: (name: InputsNames) => void;
};

export type HeaderProps = {
  headerTitle: string;
  headerSubtitles: Record<StepType, string>;
  currentStep?: StepType;
};

export type InstrumentCardProps = {
  instrumentImageName?: string;
  shortTitleOi?: string;
  value?: number;
};

export type InteractDisclaimerProps = {
  slug?: string;
  shortTitleOi?: string;
};

export type QrCodeBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  shortTitleOi?: string;
  amount?: number;
  onClose?: () => void;
  qrCodeValue?: string;
};

export type InformationCellStyledProps = {
  label?: string;
  title?: string;
};

export type RequisitesProps = Partial<RequisitesType>;

export type RequisitesBottomSheetProps = {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  instrumentImageName?: string;
  shortTitleOi?: string;
  instrumentId?: number;
  operationType?: string;
  instrumentType: ProviderType;
  value?: number;
} & Partial<RequisitesType>;

export type UseBuyStepProps = {
  status?: RequestStatuses;
};

export type ReachUkBuyGoalParams = {
  instrumentId?: number | string;
  operationType?: string;
  instrumentType: ProviderType;
};

import { forwardRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import cn from 'classnames';
import {
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB,
  PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE,
  ROUTE_FAVORITES_360,
  ROUTE_INTERNAL_TRANSFERS,
  ROUTE_NOTES,
  ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY,
  ROUTE_REFILL,
} from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';

import { getInternalTransferPermission } from 'modules/Transfers/permissions';
import CardButton from 'modules/View360/components/CardButton/CardButton';
import { HistoryIcon, OrdersIcon, PlusIcon, StarIcon, TransferIcon } from 'modules/View360/icons';
import { ReactComponent as NoteSvg } from 'modules/View360/icons/note.svg';
import { ButtonBarTypes, CardButtonTypes } from 'modules/View360/types';

import styles from './buttonsBar.module.pcss';

type CardButtonTypesVisible = CardButtonTypes & {
  visible: boolean;
};

const ButtonsBar = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ButtonBarTypes>(
  ({ bottomSheetPosition, visibleButtonsBar }, ref) => {
    const navigate = useNavigate();
    const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
    const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

    const refillPermission = Permissions.get('PERSON_NONTRADE_MONEY_REFILL');
    const isRefillHidden = refillPermission === 'DENIED' || refillPermission === 'BLOCKED';

    const handleToRefillButtonClick = () => {
      navigate(ROUTE_REFILL);
      reachGoal('refill', 'refill_tap', { from: 'view360', dashboardLkTest: '' });
    };

    const internalTransfersDenied = getInternalTransferPermission().isDenied;

    const buttons: CardButtonTypesVisible[] = [
      {
        icon: <PlusIcon />,
        label: 'Пополнить',
        action: handleToRefillButtonClick,
        visible: !isRefillHidden,
      },
      {
        icon: <OrdersIcon />,
        label: 'Заявки',
        to: `${ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY}/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB}/${PATH_ORDER_HISTORY_TAB_TRADE}`,
        visible: true,
      },
      {
        icon: <StarIcon />,
        label: 'Избранное',
        to: ROUTE_FAVORITES_360,
        visible: true,
      },
      {
        icon: <HistoryIcon />,
        label: 'История',
        to: ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY,
        visible: true,
      },
      {
        icon: <TransferIcon />,
        label: 'Перевести',
        to: ROUTE_INTERNAL_TRANSFERS,
        visible: !internalTransfersDenied,
      },
      {
        icon: <NoteSvg />,
        label: 'Заметки',
        to: ROUTE_NOTES,
        visible: true,
      },
    ];

    const vivisbleButtons = buttons.filter((b) => !!b.visible);

    return (
      <>
        <div
          className={cn(
            bottomSheetPosition === 'middle'
              ? styles.buttonsBarContainer
              : styles.buttonsBarContainerModified,
            {
              [styles.buttonsBarContainerDesktop]: isDesktopView,
              [styles.hide]: isDesktopView && !visibleButtonsBar,
            },
          )}
        >
          <div
            className={cn(styles.wrapper, { [styles.wrapperDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
            id="firstBarBlock"
          >
            {visibleButtonsBar &&
              vivisbleButtons.map((btn, ind) => (
                <CardButton key={`${btn.label}_${ind}`} {...btn} />
              ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  },
);

ButtonsBar.displayName = 'ButtonsBar';
export default ButtonsBar;

        {icon}
      </div>
      <Text type={'labelMedium'} color={isDesktopView ? 'colorForeground' : 'colorFixedWhite'}>
        {label}
      </Text>
    </div>
  ) : to ? (
    <NavLink to={to} className={styles.linkStyle}>
      <div className={cn(styles.cardWrapper, { [styles.cardWrapperDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
        <div className={styles.iconWrapper}>{icon}</div>
        <Text type={'labelMedium'}>{label}</Text>
      </div>
    </NavLink>
  ) : null;
};

export default CardButton;

import React, { FC, memo, useMemo } from 'react';

import { useGetTopCurrenciesQuery } from 'core/api/view360';

import { CollectionCurrencyProps } from 'modules/View360/types';

import AdaptiveCollectionCurrency from './components/AdaptiveCollectionCurrency/AdaptiveCollectionCurrency';

const CollectionCurrency: FC<CollectionCurrencyProps> = ({ products, countInProcess }) => {
  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    if (countInProcess) {
      return;
    }
    return products.filter((product) => !product.isStructure && !product.isModel && !product.isUK);
  }, [countInProcess, products]);

  const disable = !filteredProducts || filteredProducts?.length < 1;

  const { data: { showcaseInstrument = [] } = {}, isError } = useGetTopCurrenciesQuery(
    { showTrading: true },
    { skip: disable },
  );

  const filteredShowcaseInstrument = useMemo(
    () =>
      showcaseInstrument.filter(
        (item) =>
          item &&
          item.bid &&
          item.ask &&
          item.instrumentId &&
          item.tradePlaceId &&
          item.instrumentImageName,
      ),
    [showcaseInstrument],
  );

  const isLongDigits = useMemo(
    () =>
      filteredShowcaseInstrument?.some(
        ({ ask, bid }) =>
          (ask && ask.toFixed(2).toString().length > 3) ||
          (bid && bid.toFixed(2).toString().length > 3),
      ),
    [filteredShowcaseInstrument],
  );

  if (disable || isError || filteredShowcaseInstrument.length < 2) return null;

  return (
    <AdaptiveCollectionCurrency
      isLongDigits={isLongDigits}
      instruments={filteredShowcaseInstrument}
    />
  );
};

export default memo(CollectionCurrency);

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import Text from '@aurora/text';
import cx from 'classnames';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetUserSettingTransformQuery } from 'core/api/userSettings';
import {
  useGetProductsDataQuery,
  useLazyGetProductsDataQuery,
  useSetCurrencyMutation,
} from 'core/api/view360';
import { sumFormatter } from 'core/helpers/json';
import { Permissions } from 'core/permissions';
import { servicesSelector } from 'core/services/servicesSelectors';
import { allDataSelector, hideAccountAssetsSelector } from 'core/view360/view360Selectors';
import { setAllData } from 'core/view360/view360Slice';

import { currencySign } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import FormattedBalanceOnView from 'modules/View360/components/FormattedBalanceOnView';
import ProductRename from 'modules/View360/components/ProductRename';
import { ReactComponent as SmallEditSvg } from 'modules/View360/icons/SmallEdit.svg';
import { CountTypes } from 'modules/View360/types';

import HideBalance from 'components/HideBalance';

import { ReactComponent as SmallArrowDownSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/small-arrow-down.svg';

import { IRateType } from 'types/view360';

import {
  ACCOUNT_TITLE_LENGTH,
  HIDE_6_STARS,
  PRODUCT_RENAME,
  TOTAL_AMOUNT_LENGTH,
  USER_SETTING_VIEW_360_TOM_TOD,
  financialResultsParams,
  initialFilters,
  positionChangeCurrencyParams,
} from '../../constants';
import InlineSkeleton from '../InlineSkeleton';
import SelectCurrencies from '../SelectCurrencies';
import BadgeSkeleton from './BadgeSkeleton';
import styles from './count.module.pcss';

const Count: React.FC<CountTypes> = ({
  amount,
  currency,
  type = 'day',
  productName,
  accountNo,
  productId = 'cumulative',
  personId,
  isActive,
  setIsLoadingCount,
  isLoadingCount,
  productTitle,
  productSubtitle,
  bottomSheetPosition,
  handleChangeType,
  activeIndex,
}) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const allData = useAppSelector(allDataSelector);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;

  const { data: userSetting } = useGetUserSettingTransformQuery();
  const rateType =
    (userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_VIEW_360_TOM_TOD]?.value as IRateType) || initialFilters.rateType;

  const params = { ...financialResultsParams, rateType, product_Id: productId };
  const {
    data: productsData,
    isFetching,
    isSuccess,
  } = useGetProductsDataQuery(
    { params },
    { skip: !productId || productId === 'cumulative' || !isActive || !rateType },
  );
  const [getSelectedCurrency, { data: positionCurrencyUpd, isFetching: isFetchingUpdateCurrency }] =
    useLazyGetProductsDataQuery();
  const [setCurrency, { isLoading: isLoadingSetCurrency }] = useSetCurrencyMutation();

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLoadingCount(isFetching);
  }, [isFetching, setIsLoadingCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (productsData && isSuccess) {
      const currentProductId: number | string =
        productsData.positionValuationByProduct[0].productId;

      const withChangeCurrency = allData.positionValuationByProduct.find((item) => {
        return item.productId === productId;
      });

      const moddedProduct = allData.positionValuationByProduct.map((item) => {
        return item.productId === currentProductId
          ? {
              ...item,
              positionValuationByInstrumentGroup:
                withChangeCurrency?.positionValuationByInstrumentGroup ||
                productsData.positionValuationByInstrumentGroup,
            }
          : item;
      });

      const iis = productsData?.positionValuationByProduct?.find(
        (product) => product.isIia && !product.isUk,
      );

      dispatch(
        setAllData({
          ...allData,
          positionValuationByInstrument2: productsData.positionValuationByInstrument,
          positionValuationByProduct: moddedProduct,
          currencyValuationByPortfolio: productsData.currencyValuationByPortfolio,
          iis,
        }),
      );
    }
  }, [productId, isActive, isSuccess]); //eslint-disable-line

  useEffect(() => {
    if (positionCurrencyUpd) {
      const updateFinres = positionCurrencyUpd.positionValuation;
      const newData = allData.positionValuationByProduct.map((item) => {
        return item.productId === productId
          ? {
              ...item,
              positionValuationByInstrumentGroup:
                positionCurrencyUpd.positionValuationByInstrumentGroup,
              totalAmountCurrency: positionCurrencyUpd.positionValuation[0]?.currencyCode,
              totalAmount: positionCurrencyUpd.positionValuation[0].totalAmount,
              financialResultAccumulatedAllPeriod:
                updateFinres[0].financialResultAccumulatedAllPeriod,
              financialResultPcntAllPeriod: updateFinres[0].financialResultPcntAllPeriod,
              totalAmountDiff: updateFinres[0].totalAmountDiff,
              totalAmountDiffPcnt: updateFinres[0].totalAmountDiffPcnt,
            }
          : item;
      });

      if (activeIndex === 0) {
        dispatch(
          setAllData({
            ...allData,
            positionValuationByInstrumentGroup:
              positionCurrencyUpd.positionValuationByInstrumentGroup,
            positionValuation: positionCurrencyUpd.positionValuation,
          }),
        );
      } else {
        dispatch(
          setAllData({
            ...allData,
            positionValuationByProduct: newData,
          }),
        );
      }
    }
  }, [activeIndex, allData, dispatch, positionCurrencyUpd, productId]);

  const accountTitle = accountNo
    ? `${accountNo === 'Управляющая компания' ? '' : '№ '}` + accountNo + ' • ' + productName
    : productName;

  const updatedTitleWord =
    accountTitle?.split('•').length === 2
      ? accountTitle?.split('•')[1]
      : accountTitle?.split('•')[0];

  const actualDataLength = Math.abs(ACCOUNT_TITLE_LENGTH - accountTitle?.length);
  const modernUpdatedWordLength = updatedTitleWord?.length - actualDataLength;
  const newWord = [
    updatedTitleWord?.slice(0, modernUpdatedWordLength / 2 - 1),
    '...',
    updatedTitleWord?.slice(-modernUpdatedWordLength / 2),
  ].join('');
  const updatedAccountTitle = accountNo
    ? `${accountNo === 'Управляющая компания' ? '' : '№ '}` + accountNo + ' • ' + newWord
    : newWord;

  const { isHideAccountAssets, isFetching: isFetchingAccountAssets } =
    useAppSelector(hideAccountAssetsSelector);

  const isLoading = isFetchingAccountAssets || isFetchingUpdateCurrency || isLoadingSetCurrency;

  const title = accountTitle?.length >= ACCOUNT_TITLE_LENGTH ? updatedAccountTitle : accountTitle;

  const currencyBadge = currency;

  const finres =
    activeIndex === 0
      ? allData?.positionValuation?.[0]
      : allData.positionValuationByProduct.find((item) => item.productId === productId);

  const mainBlock = productSubtitle ? null : (
    <div
      className={cx(styles.badge, { [styles.badgeDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
      onClick={handleChangeType}
    >
      {isHideAccountAssets ? (
        <HideBalance
          starsCount={3}
          initialValue={
            type === 'day' ? finres?.totalAmountDiff : finres?.financialResultAccumulatedAllPeriod
          }
          textType={'labelSemiBold'}
        />
      ) : (
        <FormattedBalanceOnView
          type={type}
          currency={currencyBadge}
          productId={productId}
          activeIndex={activeIndex}
        />
      )}
      &nbsp;
      <Text tag={'span'} type={'lineRegular'} className={styles.accountPeriod}>
        {type === 'day' ? 'за сегодня' : 'за всё время'}{' '}
      </Text>
    </div>
  );

  const [isOpenSelectCurrencies, setIsOpenSelectCurrencies] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const alternativeCount = (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.title}>{productTitle}</div>
      <div className={styles.subTitle}>{productSubtitle}</div>
    </div>
  );

  const paramsWithoutProductId = {
    ...positionChangeCurrencyParams,
  };

  const handleUpdateCurrency = (currency_Id: number) => {
    getSelectedCurrency({
      params: productId
        ? { ...paramsWithoutProductId, product_Id: productId, currency_Id }
        : { ...paramsWithoutProductId, currency_Id },
    });
  };

  const totalAmountValue = [sumFormatter(amount), currencySign(currencyBadge)];
  const isLongValue = totalAmountValue.join(' ').length > TOTAL_AMOUNT_LENGTH;

  const { stateIsUk, stateIsStructure } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);

  const [openProductRename, setOpenProductRename] = useState(false);
  const handleRenameProduct = () => !stateIsUk && !stateIsStructure && setOpenProductRename(true);

  const isProductRenamePermissionBlocked = Permissions.blockedOrDenied(PRODUCT_RENAME);
  const disableRenameProduct =
    activeIndex === 0 || stateIsUk || stateIsStructure || isProductRenamePermissionBlocked;

  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.wrapper, { [styles.wrapperDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
      <div
        className={cx(styles.productName, { [styles.productNameDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
        id="topElement"
      >
        <span onClick={handleRenameProduct} className={styles.titleCountWithRename}>
          <span>{title}</span>
          {!disableRenameProduct && (
            <span className={cx(styles.renameIcon, { [styles.blackIcon]: isDesktopView })}>
              <SmallEditSvg />
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
        {!isDesktopView && (
          <div style={{ opacity: bottomSheetPosition === 'top' ? 1 : 0 }}>
            {isHideAccountAssets ? (
              <Text type={'headline'} tag={'span'}>
                {HIDE_6_STARS}
              </Text>
            ) : (
              sumFormatter(amount)
            )}{' '}
            {currencySign(currencyBadge)}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {productTitle ? (
        alternativeCount
      ) : (
        <span
          onClick={() => setIsOpenSelectCurrencies(true)}
          className={cx(
            styles.totalAmount,
            isLongValue && styles.totalAmountLong,
            isDesktopView && styles.totalAmountDesktop,
          )}
        >
          {isLoading ? (
            <InlineSkeleton />
          ) : (
            <div className={cx(isDesktopView && styles.pointerDesktop)}>
              {isHideAccountAssets ? (
                <Text type={'headline'} tag={'span'}>
                  {HIDE_6_STARS}
                </Text>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {totalAmountValue[0]}{' '}
                  <span className={styles.currencyIcon}>
                    {totalAmountValue[1]}
                    <SmallArrowDownSvg />
                  </span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </span>
      )}
      {(isLoadingCount && type !== 'day') || isLoading ? <BadgeSkeleton /> : mainBlock}
      <SelectCurrencies
        open={isOpenSelectCurrencies}
        setOpen={setIsOpenSelectCurrencies}
        productId={productId || 'cumulative'}
        onSubmit={handleUpdateCurrency}
        currencyCodeInitial={currency}
        setCurrency={setCurrency}
      />

      {!disableRenameProduct && (
        <ProductRename
          openProductRename={openProductRename}
          setOpenProductRename={setOpenProductRename}
          productId={productId}
          productName={productName}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Count;

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useLocalStorage } from 'react-use';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { ALL_CURRENCY_PORTFOLIO } from 'core/view360/constants';
import { currentPortfolioSelector } from 'core/view360/view360Selectors';
import {
  ISelectedPortfolio,
  loadCurrencyPortfolio,
  setCurrentPortfolio,
  switchCurrentPortfolioSelect,
} from 'core/view360/view360Slice';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';

import { CurrencyByPortfolioTypes } from 'modules/View360/types';

import ModalCommonSelect from 'components/ModalCommonSelect';

import { ReactComponent as CheckSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/check.svg';

import styles from './CurrencyByPortfolio.module.pcss';

const CurrencyByPortfolio: React.FC<CurrencyByPortfolioTypes> = ({
  currencyValuationByPortfolio,
  productId,
}) => {
  const { open, selectedPortfolio } = useAppSelector(currentPortfolioSelector);
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const [savedPortfolio, setSavedPortfolio] = useLocalStorage<{
    [key: string]: ISelectedPortfolio;
  }>('saveCurrencyPortfolio');

  useEffect(() => {
    savedPortfolio && dispatch(loadCurrencyPortfolio(savedPortfolio));
  }, []); //eslint-disable-line
  useEffect(() => {
    setSavedPortfolio(selectedPortfolio);
  }, [selectedPortfolio, setSavedPortfolio]);

  const onDismiss = () => dispatch(switchCurrentPortfolioSelect(false));

  const handleChangePortfolio = (name: string, portfolioId?: number) => {
    dispatch(
      setCurrentPortfolio({
        productId,
        portfolioId,
        name,
      }),
    );
    onDismiss();
  };

  return (
    <ModalCommonSelect
      isDesktopView={isDesktopView}
      open={open}
      onDismiss={onDismiss}
      className={styles.bottomSheet}
      header={
        <div className={styles.head}>
          <Text type={'subtitleBold'}>Выберите портфель</Text>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div className={styles.root}>
        <div className={styles.list} onClick={() => handleChangePortfolio(ALL_CURRENCY_PORTFOLIO)}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'}>{ALL_CURRENCY_PORTFOLIO}</Text>
          {!selectedPortfolio?.[productId]?.portfolioId && <CheckSvg />}
        </div>
        {currencyValuationByPortfolio &&
          Object.keys(currencyValuationByPortfolio)?.map((portfolioId) => (
            <div
              className={styles.list}
              key={portfolioId}
              onClick={() =>
                handleChangePortfolio(
                  currencyValuationByPortfolio[portfolioId][0].portfolioShortName,
                  currencyValuationByPortfolio[portfolioId][0].portfolioId,
                )
              }
            >
              <div className={styles.portfolio}>
                <Text type={'lineRegular'}>
                  {currencyValuationByPortfolio[portfolioId][0].portfolioShortName}
                </Text>
                <div className={styles.currencies}>
                  <Text type={'labelMedium'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                    {currencyValuationByPortfolio[portfolioId].map((currency, index) => (
                      <span key={currency.currencyCode}>
                        {index !== 0 && ' • '}
                        {sumFormatter(currency.quantity)} {currencySign(currency.currencyCode)}{' '}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                    <span> в портфеле</span>
                  </Text>
                </div>
                <Text type={'labelMedium'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
                  {currencyValuationByPortfolio[portfolioId][0].portfolioComment}
                </Text>
              </div>
              {selectedPortfolio?.[productId]?.portfolioId === +portfolioId && <CheckSvg />}
            </div>
          ))}
      </div>
    </ModalCommonSelect>
  );
};

export default CurrencyByPortfolio;

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CompactTable, Currency, FiCell } from '@aurora/components';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { FinInstrumentTypes } from 'modules/View360/types';

import { InstrumentIcon } from 'components/Instrument';

import styles from './FinInstrument.module.pcss';

const FinInstrument: React.FC<FinInstrumentTypes> = ({
  product,
  icon,
  productName,
  investmentsAmount,
  totalAmountCurrency,
  investmentQuantity,
  totalAmountCurrCurrency,
  lastPrice,
  dailyInvestmentFinRes,
  dailyInvestmentFinResPcnt,
  investmentFinRes,
  investmentFinResPcnt,
  totalAmount,
  type,
  instrumentGroupName,
  liabilitiesAmount,
  liabilitiesQuantity,
  investmentsAmountCurr,
  liabilitiesAmountCurr,
  isLiabilities,
  instrumentId,
  tradePlaceId,
  totalAmountCurr,
  instrumentCategoryCode,
  priceCurrency,
  amountPortfolio,
  quantityPortfolio,
  positionOpenPrice,
  investmentsAmountPcnt,
  liabilitiesAmountPcnt,
  isAggregateProductSelected,
  productCategoryCode,
}) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const isStructureProducts = instrumentGroupName === 'Структурные продукты';
  const isCurrency = product === 'CURRENCIES';
  const isUKproduct = instrumentCategoryCode === 'UKS' || instrumentCategoryCode === 'UKF';
  const isTrunked = (it: number) => {
    return Math.trunc(it) === it ? 0 : Math.abs(it).toString().split('.')[1]?.length;
  };

  const ukLink = `instruments-uk/${instrumentId}`;
  const productLink = `instruments/${instrumentId}_${tradePlaceId}`;

  if (isCurrency) {
    const quantity =
      quantityPortfolio || (isLiabilities ? liabilitiesQuantity : investmentQuantity || 0);

    const amount = amountPortfolio || (isLiabilities ? liabilitiesAmount : investmentsAmount || 0);

    const isRub = productName === 'Российский рубль';

    const navigateToInstrument = () => {
      if (isRub) return;
      navigate(productLink, { state: { from: 'portfolio' } });
    };

    //**TODO: временное ограничение для прода */
    const isTestMode = !process.env.TIER || process.env.TIER === 'tt';

    return (
      <FiCell
        onClick={isTestMode ? navigateToInstrument : undefined}
        iconLeft={<InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={icon} />}
        instrumentName={productName}
        hasFinResult={!isRub}
        currencyCode={totalAmountCurrency}
        instrumentCode={
          !isRub
            ? `${sumFormatter(quantity, isTrunked(quantity))} ${currencySign(
                totalAmountCurrCurrency,
              )} • ${sumFormatter(lastPrice, isTrunked(lastPrice))} ${currencySign(
                totalAmountCurrency,
              )}`
            : undefined
        }
        periodPriceDiff={!isRub ? (type ? dailyInvestmentFinRes : investmentFinRes) : undefined}
        periodPriceDiffPcnt={
          !isRub ? (type ? dailyInvestmentFinResPcnt : investmentFinResPcnt) : undefined
        }
        price={isLiabilities ? -amount : amount}
        variant="view"
        additionalInfoBtnText={'Свернуть'}
      />
    );
  }

  const itemPrice = investmentsAmount ? investmentsAmountCurr || 0 : -liabilitiesAmountCurr;
  const itemQuantity = investmentQuantity ? investmentQuantity : liabilitiesQuantity;

  const isFuturesOptions = product === 'FUTURES' || product === 'OPTIONS';

  const updatedName = productName
    .split('')
    .map((it) => {
      return it === '-' ? '‑' : it;
    })
    .join('');

  const handleNavigateToUkProduct = () => {
    navigate(`${isUKproduct ? ukLink : productLink}`, { state: { from: 'portfolio' } });
    if (!isUKproduct) return;
    const type = isAggregateProductSelected
      ? 'aggregate'
      : productCategoryCode === 'UK.PIF'
      ? 'pif_account'
      : productCategoryCode === 'UK.TM'
      ? 'iic_account'
      : 'str_account';
    reachGoal('uk', 'uk_account_card_view', { instrumentId: String(instrumentId), type });
  };

  //**TODO: временное ограничение для прода */
  const isTestMode = !process.env.TIER || process.env.TIER === 'tt';

  return (
    <FiCell
      className={!isMobile ? styles.instrumentItemDesktop : undefined}
      onClick={isTestMode ? handleNavigateToUkProduct : undefined}
      iconLeft={<InstrumentIcon instrumentImageName={icon} />}
      instrumentName={updatedName}
      instrumentCode={
        !isStructureProducts && !isUKproduct
          ? `${sumFormatter(itemQuantity, isTrunked(itemQuantity))} ${'шт.'} • ${sumFormatter(
              lastPrice,
              isTrunked(lastPrice),
            )} ${currencySign(priceCurrency)}`
          : undefined
      }
      hasFinResult={!isStructureProducts && !(isFuturesOptions && !dailyInvestmentFinRes)}
      hasPrice={!isFuturesOptions}
      currencyCode={priceCurrency}
      price={isStructureProducts ? totalAmountCurr || totalAmount : itemPrice}
      periodPriceDiff={
        !isStructureProducts ? (type ? dailyInvestmentFinRes : investmentFinRes) : undefined
      }
      periodPriceDiffPcnt={
        !isStructureProducts ? (type ? dailyInvestmentFinResPcnt : investmentFinResPcnt) : undefined
      }
      showAdditionalInfo
      additionalInfo={
        <CompactTable
          className={styles.compactTable}
          size={'small'}
          lineIndent={'small'}
          indent={false}
          data={[
            {
              addonRight: (
                <Currency
                  tag="span"
                  currency={'PCS'}
                  color={'colorForeground'}
                  value={investmentQuantity}
                  type={'labelMedium'}
                  empty={investmentQuantity === undefined}
                />
              ),
              title: 'Количество',
            },
            {
              addonRight: (
                <Currency
                  tag="span"
                  currency={priceCurrency}
                  color={'colorForeground'}
                  value={positionOpenPrice}
                  type={'labelMedium'}
                  empty={positionOpenPrice === undefined}
                />
              ),
              title: 'Средняя цена открытия',
            },
            {
              addonRight: (
                <Currency
                  tag="span"
                  currency={priceCurrency}
                  color={'colorForeground'}
                  value={lastPrice}
                  type={'labelMedium'}
                  empty={lastPrice === undefined}
                />
              ),
              title: 'Текущая цена',
            },
            {
              addonRight: (
                <Currency
                  tag="span"
                  currency={'PRC'}
                  color={'colorForeground'}
                  value={investmentsAmountPcnt || liabilitiesAmountPcnt}
                  type={'labelMedium'}
                  empty={investmentsAmountPcnt === undefined || liabilitiesAmountPcnt === undefined}
                />
              ),
              title: 'Доля в портфеле',
            },
          ]}
        />
      }
      variant="view"
      additionalInfoBtnText={'Свернуть'}
    />
  );
};

export default memo(FinInstrument);

import React, { Fragment, useState } from 'react';

import { Accordion } from '@aurora/components';
import cn from 'classnames';
import { DateTime } from 'luxon';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetUserSettingTransformQuery } from 'core/api/userSettings';
import { allDataSelector, currentPortfolioSelector } from 'core/view360/view360Selectors';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';
import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';

import TitlePositionBy from 'modules/View360/components/TitlePositionBy';
import YourIIS from 'modules/View360/components/YourIIS';
import { FinResultTypes } from 'modules/View360/types';

import { PositionValuationByInstrumentType } from 'types/view360';

import { USER_SETTING_SHOW_ASSETS_IN_CURRENCY_MLK, initialFilters } from '../../constants';
import { getGroupTotalName, groupNamesTable, instrumentSort } from '../../helpers';
import CurrencyByPortfolio from '../CurrencyByPortfolio';
import FinInstrument from '../FinInstrument';
import styles from './finResult.module.pcss';

const LUXON_DATE_FORMAT = 'dd.LL.yyyy';

type IIsOpenAccordion = Record<string, boolean>;

const FinResult: React.FC<FinResultTypes> = ({
  activeIndex,
  products,
  products2,
  isTypeDay,
  actualData,
  fxSpotCurrencies,
  productsDictionary,
  instrumentGroups,
  groupSumPosition,
  currencyValuationByPortfolio,
  iis,
  isAggregateProductSelected,
}) => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;
  const { data: userSetting } = useGetUserSettingTransformQuery();
  const actualDataDto = actualData?.map((item) => item?.actualDate)?.find((it) => it !== undefined);
  const actualDate =
    (actualDataDto && DateTime.fromISO(actualDataDto).toFormat(LUXON_DATE_FORMAT)) || '';
  const allData = useAppSelector(allDataSelector);

  const activeProducts = activeIndex === 0 ? products : products2;
  const instrumentCodes = Array.from(new Set(activeProducts?.map((it) => it.instrumentGroupCode)));
  const actualGroup =
    activeIndex === 0
      ? instrumentGroups
      : allData?.positionValuationByProduct[activeIndex - 1]?.positionValuationByInstrumentGroup;
  const updatedProductsList = productsDictionary
    ?.filter((item) => instrumentCodes.includes(item.code))
    ?.map((item) => item.code);

  const { selectedPortfolio } = useAppSelector(currentPortfolioSelector);

  const productId = actualData?.[activeIndex - 1]?.productId;
  const productCategoryCode =
    allData?.positionValuationByProduct?.[activeIndex - 1]?.productCategoryCode;

  const [isOpenAccordion, setIsOpenAccordion] = useState<IIsOpenAccordion>({});
  const onToggleAccordion = (name: string) => {
    setIsOpenAccordion({
      ...isOpenAccordion,
      [name]: isOpenAccordion[name] !== undefined ? !isOpenAccordion[name] : false,
    });
  };

  const getFinresValue = (
    variant: 'daily' | 'allTime',
    instrument: PositionValuationByInstrumentType,
  ) => {
    if (!instrument) return;
    const isCurrency = instrument.instrumentGroupCode === 'CURRENCIES';
    const isLiabilities = instrument.isLiabilities;
    if (variant === 'daily') {
      if (isCurrency) {
        return instrument.dailyInvestmentFinRes;
      } else {
        return isLiabilities
          ? instrument.dailyLiabilitiesFinResCurr
          : instrument.dailyInvestmentFinResCurr;
      }
    } else {
      if (isCurrency) {
        return instrument.investmentFinRes;
      } else {
        return isLiabilities ? instrument.liabilitiesFinResCurr : instrument.investmentFinResCurr;
      }
    }
  };

  const finResultList = updatedProductsList?.map((product) => {
    const block = activeProducts?.filter((item) => item.instrumentGroupCode === product);
    let blockList = block;

    if (product === 'CURRENCIES') {
      const RubCurrencyId = block?.findIndex(
        (currency) => currency.instrumentName === 'Российский рубль',
      );

      blockList =
        RubCurrencyId === -1
          ? blockList
          : block && [
              block[RubCurrencyId],
              ...block.slice(0, RubCurrencyId),
              ...block.slice(RubCurrencyId + 1),
            ];
    }

    const modernList = blockList.map((it) => {
      return { ...it, isLiabilities: false };
    });

    blockList.forEach((it) => {
      // if (it.investmentQuantity === 0) return;
      if (it.liabilitiesQuantity !== 0) {
        const prevIt = {
          ...it,
          investmentQuantity: 0,
          investmentsAmount: 0,
          totalAmount: 0,
          isLiabilities: true,
        };
        modernList.push(prevIt);
      }
    });

    const updatedML = modernList.filter(
      (it) =>
        (it.investmentQuantity !== 0 && !it.isLiabilities) ||
        (it.liabilitiesQuantity !== 0 && it.isLiabilities),
    );

    let subTitle = '';
    if (
      updatedML.filter(
        (instrument) =>
          instrument.instrumentGroupCode === 'UKS' || instrument.instrumentGroupCode === 'UKF',
      ).length
    ) {
      subTitle = actualDate;
    }

    const typeSort =
      (userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_SHOW_ASSETS_IN_CURRENCY_MLK] &&
        JSON.parse(userSetting[USER_SETTING_SHOW_ASSETS_IN_CURRENCY_MLK]?.value)) ||
      initialFilters.typeSort;

    const portfolioId = selectedPortfolio?.[productId]?.portfolioId;

    let updateMLWithCurrencyPortfolio = updatedML;

    if (portfolioId && updatedML[0].instrumentGroupCode === 'CURRENCIES') {
      currencyValuationByPortfolio?.[portfolioId]?.forEach((currencyFromPortfolio) => {
        updatedML.forEach((cur, index, self) => {
          if (currencyFromPortfolio.currencyCode === cur.currencyCode) {
            cur.amountPortfolio = currencyFromPortfolio.amount;
            cur.quantityPortfolio = currencyFromPortfolio.quantity;
          }
        });
        updateMLWithCurrencyPortfolio = updatedML.filter((item) => item.amountPortfolio);
      });
    }

    const blockListResults =
      updateMLWithCurrencyPortfolio &&
      typeSort &&
      instrumentSort(typeSort, updateMLWithCurrencyPortfolio, isTypeDay).map(
        (instrument, index) => {
          const instrumentId =
            instrument.instrumentId ||
            fxSpotCurrencies.find((it) => it.baseCurrencyCode === instrument.currencyCode)
              ?.instrumentId;
          const tradePlaceId =
            instrument.tradePlaceId ||
            fxSpotCurrencies?.find((it) => it.baseCurrencyCode === instrument.currencyCode)
              ?.tradePlaceId;
          return (
            <div key={`${instrument.instrumentId}_${index}`}>
              <FinInstrument
                product={product}
                icon={instrument.instrumentImageName}
                productName={instrument.instrumentName}
                totalAmountCurrency={instrument.totalAmountCurrency}
                investmentsAmount={instrument.investmentsAmount}
                totalAmountCurrCurrency={instrument.totalAmountCurrCurrency}
                investmentQuantity={instrument.investmentQuantity}
                lastPrice={instrument.lastPrice}
                investmentFinRes={getFinresValue('allTime', instrument) || 0}
                investmentFinResPcnt={
                  instrument.isLiabilities
                    ? instrument.liabilitiesFinResPcnt
                    : instrument.investmentFinResPcnt || 0
                }
                dailyInvestmentFinRes={getFinresValue('daily', instrument)}
                dailyInvestmentFinResPcnt={
                  instrument.isLiabilities
                    ? instrument.dailyLiabilitiesFinResPcnt
                    : instrument.dailyInvestmentFinResPcnt
                }
                type={isTypeDay}
                totalAmount={instrument.totalAmount}
                instrumentGroupName={instrument.instrumentGroupName}
                liabilitiesAmount={instrument.liabilitiesAmount}
                liabilitiesQuantity={instrument.liabilitiesQuantity}
                liabilitiesAmountCurr={instrument.liabilitiesAmountCurr}
                investmentsAmountCurr={instrument.investmentsAmountCurr}
                isLiabilities={instrument.isLiabilities}
                instrumentId={instrumentId}
                tradePlaceId={tradePlaceId}
                totalAmountCurr={instrument.totalAmountCurr}
                instrumentCategoryCode={instrument.instrumentCategoryCode}
                finResCurrCurrency={instrument.finResCurrCurrency}
                priceCurrency={instrument.totalAmountCurrCurrency || instrument.totalAmountCurrency}
                amountPortfolio={instrument.amountPortfolio}
                quantityPortfolio={instrument.quantityPortfolio}
                positionOpenPrice={instrument.positionOpenPrice}
                investmentsAmountPcnt={instrument.investmentsAmountPcnt}
                liabilitiesAmountPcnt={instrument.liabilitiesAmountPcnt}
                isAggregateProductSelected={isAggregateProductSelected}
                productCategoryCode={productCategoryCode}
              />
              <div
                className={styles.line}
                style={{ display: index === modernList.length - 1 ? 'none' : 'block' }}
                key={index}
              ></div>
            </div>
          );
        },
      );

    const group = actualGroup?.find(
      (item: any) => item.groupName === blockList[0].instrumentGroupName,
    );

    const groupTotal = (group && group.totalAmount) || 0;

    const AccordionBlock = blockList && (
      <Fragment key={blockList[0].instrumentGroupName}>
        <Accordion
          subtitleBottom={subTitle && `Результат за всё время на ${subTitle}`}
          title={
            <TitlePositionBy
              title={blockList[0].instrumentGroupName}
              activeIndex={activeIndex}
              product={product}
              currencyValuationByPortfolio={currencyValuationByPortfolio}
              productId={productId}
            />
          }
          shape="headline"
          isOpen={isOpenAccordion[blockList[0].instrumentGroupName] ?? true}
          onToggle={() => onToggleAccordion(blockList[0].instrumentGroupName)}
          limitWidthContent={!isDesktopView}
          classNameContentContainer={cn(isDesktopView && styles.accordionContentDesktop)}
        >
          {' '}
          {blockListResults}
        </Accordion>
        {groupSumPosition && group && group?.totalAmount !== 0 && (
          <div
            className={cn(styles.groupSumWrapper, {
              [styles.groupSumWrapperDesktop]: isDesktopView,
            })}
          >
            <div>{getGroupTotalName((group?.groupCode as keyof typeof groupNamesTable) || '')}</div>
            <div>
              {sumFormatter(groupTotal)}
              &nbsp;
              {currencySign(group?.currencyCode)}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </Fragment>
    );
    return AccordionBlock;
  });

  return (
    <>
      {iis && !!activeIndex && <YourIIS iis={iis} />}
      {finResultList}
      <CurrencyByPortfolio
        currencyValuationByPortfolio={currencyValuationByPortfolio}
        productId={productId}
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default FinResult;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { BottomSheet, Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { FIRST_TIME_SHAKE_KEY } from 'modules/View360/constants';
import { useShakeHide } from 'modules/View360/hooks/useShakeHide';

import styles from './FirstTimeShake.module.pcss';

const FirstTimeShake: React.FC = () => {
  const firsTimeShakeOpen = useShakeHide();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>();

  useEffect(() => {
    firsTimeShakeOpen && setOpen(firsTimeShakeOpen);
  }, [firsTimeShakeOpen]);

  const handleApprove = () => {
    localStorage.setItem(FIRST_TIME_SHAKE_KEY, 'check');
    setOpen(false);
  };

  if (!firsTimeShakeOpen) return <></>;

  return (
    <BottomSheet open={Boolean(open)} onDismiss={handleApprove}>
      <div className={styles.wrapper}>
        <Text type={'subtitleBold'}>
          Управляйте форматом отображения активов — потрясите телефон
        </Text>
        <Text>
          Вы впервые воспользовались жестом для скрытия и отображения активов — потрясли телефон.
        </Text>
        <Text>
          Для изменения вида нажмите на значение активов на Обзоре или воспользуйтесь жестом.
        </Text>
        <Button onClick={handleApprove}>Хорошо</Button>
      </div>
    </BottomSheet>
  );
};

export default FirstTimeShake;

import { allDataSelector } from 'core/view360/view360Selectors';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { FormattedBalance } from 'components';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

type FormattedBalanceOnViewProps = {
  activeIndex: number;
  productId: number | null | 'cumulative';
  type: 'day' | 'allPeriod';
  currency: PriceCurrencyType;
};

const FormattedBalanceOnView = ({
  activeIndex,
  productId,
  currency,
  type,
}: FormattedBalanceOnViewProps) => {
  const allData = useAppSelector(allDataSelector);

  const finres =
    activeIndex === 0
      ? allData.positionValuation[0]
      : allData.positionValuationByProduct.find((item) => item.productId === productId);

  return (
    <FormattedBalance
      currency={currency}
      value={Number(
        type === 'day'
          ? finres?.totalAmountDiff || 0
          : finres?.financialResultAccumulatedAllPeriod
          ? finres?.financialResultAccumulatedAllPeriod + (finres?.totalAmountDiff || 0)
          : 0,
      )}
      diff={Number(
        type === 'day'
          ? finres?.totalAmountDiffPcnt || 0
          : finres?.financialResultPcntAllPeriod
          ? finres?.financialResultPcntAllPeriod + (finres?.totalAmountDiffPcnt || 0)
          : 0,
      )}
    />
  );
};

export default FormattedBalanceOnView;

import { FC } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_IIS, ROUTE_IIS_TARIFF_SELECTIONS } from 'const/routes';

import { useGetProductsQuery } from 'core/api/orderHistory';
import { getSessionIiaSelector } from 'core/session/session';

import { useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

import { AdaptivePopup } from 'components';

import { IisBottomSheetProps } from 'types/iis';

import styles from './IisBottomSheet.module.pcss';

const IisBottomSheet: FC<IisBottomSheetProps> = ({ isOpen, setIsOpen }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { data: products } = useGetProductsQuery({ showUK: true });
  const iiaStatus = useAppSelector(getSessionIiaSelector);

  const isIia = products?.products.find((item) => item.isIia === true);
  const onDismiss = () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const handleOpenButtonClick = () => {
    if (isIia) {
      navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_IIS, { operationType: 'error' }));
    } else if (iiaStatus === 'ACTIVATING') {
      navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_IIS, { operationType: 'success' }));
    } else {
      window.open(ROUTE_IIS_TARIFF_SELECTIONS, '_self');
    }
  };

  return (
    <AdaptivePopup open={isOpen} onDismiss={onDismiss}>
      <div className={styles.wrap}>
        <Text type={'title'}>У вас может быть только один ИИС</Text>
        <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          Если вы уже открыли ИИС у другого брокера, его нужно закрыть в течение 30 календарных дней
        </Text>
        <Button onClick={handleOpenButtonClick}>У меня нет других ИИС</Button>
        <Button onClick={onDismiss} variant={'link'}>
          Отменить
        </Button>
      </div>
    </AdaptivePopup>
  );
};

export default IisBottomSheet;

};

type BondsDataProps = {
  nominal?: number;
  couponValue?: number;
  couponFrequency?: number;
};

type InstrumentDataProps = {
  lastPrice?: number;
};

const IisCalculator = () => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(0);
  const [value, setValue] = useState(400_000);
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);

  const { data: pai } = useGetShowcaseInstrumentQuery();
  const [getClosePriceRGB, { data: closePriceRGB }] = useLazyGetClosePriceHistoryQuery();
  const [getClosePricePAI, { data: closePricePAI }] = useLazyGetClosePriceHistoryQuery();
  const [getInstrument, { data: instrumentData }] = useLazyGetInstrumentQuery();

  const getIiaCalculateRgbInstrument = () => {
    return pai?.showcaseInstrument.map((instrument: ShowcaseInstrumentType) => {
      const { instrumentId, instrumentCode, tradePlaceId, tradePlaceCode, instrumentCategoryCode } =
        instrument;
      return {
        instrumentId,
        instrumentCode,
        tradePlaceId,
        tradePlaceCode,
        instrumentCategoryCode,
      };
    });
  };

  const res = getIiaCalculateRgbInstrument();
  const rgbShowcaseData = res?.find((item) => item.instrumentCategoryCode === 'RGB') || {};
  const paiShowcaseData = res?.find((item) => item.instrumentCategoryCode === 'PAI') || {};
  const instrument = instrumentData?.instrument[0] || {};
  const bonds = instrumentData?.bond[0] || {};

  const {
    instrumentCode: instrumentCodeRGB,
    tradePlaceCode: tradePlaceCodeRGB,
    instrumentId: instrumentIdRGB,
    tradePlaceId: tradePlaceIdRGB,
  }: RGBDataProps = rgbShowcaseData;
  const { instrumentCode: instrumentCodePAI, tradePlaceCode: tradePlaceCodePAI }: PAIDataProps =
    paiShowcaseData;
  const { nominal, couponValue, couponFrequency }: BondsDataProps = bonds;
  const { lastPrice }: InstrumentDataProps = instrument;

  const startDate = dateFormatter(3);
  const paiData = closePricePAI?.closePrice;
  const rgbData = closePriceRGB?.closePrice;

  const { incomeRatio, valueForThreeYears, taxDeduction, investmentIncome, financialResult } =
    useCalc(
      mode,
      value,
      data,
      closePricePAI,
      closePriceRGB,
      nominal,
      lastPrice,
      couponFrequency,
      couponValue,
    );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode === 0) setData(null);
    if (mode === 1) setData(rgbData);
    if (mode === 2) setData(paiData);
  }, [mode, paiData, rgbData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (instrumentCodeRGB) {
      getClosePriceRGB({
        instrumentCode: instrumentCodeRGB,
        tradePlaceCode: tradePlaceCodeRGB,
        startDate,
        stepUnit: 'day',
        step: 365,
      });
    }
  }, [getClosePriceRGB, instrumentCodeRGB, startDate, tradePlaceCodeRGB]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (instrumentCodePAI) {
      getClosePricePAI({
        instrumentCode: instrumentCodePAI,
        tradePlaceCode: tradePlaceCodePAI,
        startDate,
        stepUnit: 'day',
        step: 365,
      });
    }
  }, [getClosePricePAI, instrumentCodePAI, startDate, tradePlaceCodePAI]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (instrumentIdRGB) {
      getInstrument({
        instrument_id: instrumentIdRGB,
        trade_place_id: tradePlaceIdRGB,
      });
    }
  }, [getInstrument, instrumentIdRGB, tradePlaceIdRGB]);

  return (
    <div className={isMobile ? styles.wrap : styles.wrapAdaptive}>
      <Text type={'title'}>Рассчитайте выгоду</Text>
      <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'} className={styles.description}>
        Мы посчитали, сколько вы могли бы заработать, если бы открыли ИИС в {dateFormatter(3, 1)}{' '}
        году
      </Text>
      <OptionsList
        inputPosition="left"
        type="circle"
        options={options}
        onChange={(option) => setMode(option.id - 1)}
        selectedOption={options[mode] || options[0]}
        className={styles.optionList}
      />
      <Hint
        content={'ОФЗ — облигации федерального займа'}
        placement={'bottom'}
        className={isMobile ? styles.modifiedHint : styles.modifiedHintAdaptive}
      />
      <CalculationCard
        value={value}
        setValue={setValue}
        mode={mode}
        incomeRatio={incomeRatio}
        taxDeduction={taxDeduction}
      />
      <Total
        valueForThreeYears={valueForThreeYears}
        taxDeduction={taxDeduction}
        mode={mode}
        incomeRatio={incomeRatio}
        investmentIncome={investmentIncome}
        financialResult={financialResult}
        data={data}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default IisCalculator;

import { RangeField, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { range } from 'modules/View360/components/IisPage/IisMain/helpers';

import styles from './Range.module.pcss';

type RangeProps = {
  value: number;
  setValue: (value: number) => void;
};

const MIN = 0;
const MAX = 1_000_000;
const STEP = 1000;

const Range = ({ value, setValue }: RangeProps) => {
  return (
    <RangeField
      showLabels
      labelType="text"
      fieldLeftTitle={
        <Text color="colorForeground2" type="lineRegular" tag={'span'}>
          Ежегодное пополнение
        </Text>
      }
      fieldRightTitle={
        <Text type="bodySemiBold" tag={'span'}>
          {sumFormatter(value, 0)} {currencySign('RUB')}
        </Text>
      }
      farLeftLabel={
        <Text color="colorForeground2" type="lineRegular" tag={'span'}>
          от 0 {currencySign('RUB')}
        </Text>
      }
      farRightLabel={
        <Text color="colorForeground2" type="lineRegular" tag={'span'}>
          до 1 000 000 {currencySign('RUB')}
        </Text>
      }
      rangeOptions={{
        max: MAX,
        min: MIN,
        steps: [...range(MIN, MAX, STEP)],
        onChange: (_: number[], [value]: number[]) => setValue(value),
        values: [value],
      }}
      wrapperClassName={styles.rangeField}
    />
  );
};

export default Range;

import React from 'react';

import { BarChart, Card, Text } from '@aurora/components';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

import { TotalProps } from 'types/iis';

import styles from './Total.module.pcss';

const Total = ({
  valueForThreeYears,
  taxDeduction,
  mode,
  investmentIncome,
  financialResult,
  data,
}: TotalProps) => {
  const defaultItems =
    mode === 0
      ? [
          {
            legendTitle: '',
            value: valueForThreeYears,
          },
          {
            legendTitle: '',
            value: taxDeduction,
          },
        ]
      : [
          {
            legendTitle: '',
            value: valueForThreeYears,
          },
          {
            legendTitle: '',
            value: taxDeduction,
          },
          {
            legendTitle: '',
            value: investmentIncome,
          },
        ];

  const colors = ['#5D3FAF', '#3AB6EC', '#D8F0FB'];

  return (
    <>
      <Text type={'bodySemiBold'} className={styles.subtitle} tag={'span'}>
        Рассчитали ваш результат на 3 года
      </Text>
      <Card withShadow>
        <div className={styles.payment}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} className={styles.paymentLegend} tag={'span'}>
            <div className={styles.circle} style={{ background: `${colors[0]}` }} />
            Ваши взносы
          </Text>
          <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} tag={'span'}>
            {sumFormatter(valueForThreeYears, 0)} {currencySign('RUB')}
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.payment}>
          <Text type={'lineRegular'} className={styles.paymentLegend} tag={'span'}>
            <div className={styles.circle} style={{ background: `${colors[1]}` }} />
            Налоговый вычет
          </Text>
          <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} tag={'span'}>
            {taxDeduction
              ? `+ ${sumFormatter(taxDeduction, 0)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`
              : `0 ${currencySign('RUB')}`}
          </Text>
        </div>
        {mode !== 0 && (
          <div className={styles.payment}>
            <Text type={'lineRegular'} className={styles.paymentLegend} tag={'span'}>
              <div className={styles.circle} style={{ background: `${colors[2]}` }} />
              Инвестиционный доход
            </Text>
            <Text type={'lineSemiBold'} tag={'span'}>
              {data
                ? investmentIncome
                  ? `+ ${sumFormatter(investmentIncome, 0)} ${currencySign('RUB')}`
                  : `0 ${currencySign('RUB')}`
                : '-'}
            </Text>
          </div>
        )}
        <BarChart
          currency="RUB"
          items={valueForThreeYears > 0 ? defaultItems : []}
          shape="values"
          defaultColors={colors}
          showLegend={false}
        />
        <div className={styles.total}>
          <Text type={'lineMedium'}>Итоговая сумма</Text>
          <Text type={'subtitleSemiBold'}>
            {sumFormatter(financialResult, 0)} {currencySign('RUB')}
          </Text>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <div className={styles.info}>
        <Text type={'labelRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          Информация в этом разделе носит ознакомительный характер и не является гарантией или
          обещанием доходности вложений в будущем
        </Text>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default Total;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, CircleLoader, Headline, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_IIS, ROUTE_IIS_TARIFF_SELECTIONS } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { API_REQUEST_URL } from 'core/api/apiConstants';
import { useIisConfirmMutation } from 'core/api/iis';

import useDownloadFile from 'hooks/useDownloadFile';

import { AdaptivePopup, HeaderPage, SmsConfirmation } from 'components';
import DocumentCell from 'components/DocumentCell';

import { StateConfirmProps } from 'types/iis';

import styles from './IisConfirm.module.pcss';

const IisConfirm = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const state = location.state as StateConfirmProps;

  const fileJoin = state.documents.referenceDocuments[0].type;
  const crcJoin = state.documents.referenceDocuments[0].crc;
  const generatedJoin = state.documents.referenceDocuments[0].generated;
  const filesService = state.documents.referenceDocuments[1]?.type;
  const crcService = state.documents.referenceDocuments[1]?.crc;
  const generatedService = state.documents.referenceDocuments[1]?.generated;

  const filePathJoin = `${API_REQUEST_URL}/iia_resale/documents/file?requestGuid=${state.requestGuid}&fileType=${fileJoin}`;
  const filePathService =
    filesService &&
    `${API_REQUEST_URL}/iia_resale/documents/file?requestGuid=${state.requestGuid}&fileType=${filesService}`;

  const { file: joinFile } = useDownloadFile({
    url: filePathJoin,
  });
  const { file: serviceFile } = useDownloadFile({
    url: filePathService,
  });

  const [getSms, { data: smsData, isLoading: isSmsLoading, error: smsError }] =
    useIisConfirmMutation();

  const crcServiceID = crcService ?? '';
  const crcJoinID = crcJoin ?? '';

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_IIS_TARIFF_SELECTIONS);
  };

  const handleConfirmButton = () => {
    !smsData && getSms({ requestGuid: state.requestGuid });
    !isMobile && setIsOpen(true);
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_IIS, { operationType: 'success' }));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (smsError) {
      navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_IIS, { operationType: 'unavailable' }));
    }
  });

  if (isSmsLoading && isMobile) {
    return (
      <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
        <HeaderPage
          title={'СМС-подтверждение'}
          leftIconVariant="close"
          onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        />
        <CircleLoader brandColor />
        <Text>Запрос СМС-кода...</Text>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (!smsData && isMobile) || !isMobile ? (
    <div className={styles.root}>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        documentTitle={'ИИС'}
        withoutMargin
      />
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.main : styles.mainAdaptive}>
        {isMobile ? (
          <Text type="title">Открытие счёта</Text>
        ) : (
          <Headline title={'Открытие счёта'} indent={false} />
        )}
        <Text className={styles.text} type="bodyRegular">
          Ознакомтесь с документами и подпишите их для открытия счёта ИИС
        </Text>
        {filesService && (
          <>
            <div className={generatedService ? styles.document : styles.documentWithoutIconService}>
              <DocumentCell url={serviceFile?.url} name={filesService} id={`ID: ${crcServiceID}`} />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.divider} />
          </>
        )}
        <div className={generatedJoin ? styles.document : styles.documentWithoutIconJoin}>
          <DocumentCell url={joinFile?.url} name={fileJoin} id={`ID: ${crcJoinID}`} />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.divider} />
      </div>
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.bottom : styles.bottomAdaptive}>
        <Text type="lineMedium" className={styles.info}>
          Для завершения операции мы отправим вам SMS с кодом подтверждения
        </Text>
        <Button
          onClick={handleConfirmButton}
          className={isMobile ? styles.btn : styles.btnAdaptive}
          variant="primary"
        >
          Подтвердить
        </Button>
      </div>
      {!isMobile && (
        <AdaptivePopup
          open={isOpen}
          onDismiss={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          classNameContent={styles.contentDesktop}
        >
          {!smsData ? (
            <CircleLoader brandColor />
          ) : (
            <SmsConfirmation
              initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
              smsInputCount={4}
              onSuccess={handleConfirm}
              onError={() => console.error('Error')}
              loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется запрос...</Text>}
              onBackClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_IIS_TARIFF_SELECTIONS)}
            />
          )}
        </AdaptivePopup>
      )}
    </div>
  ) : (
    isMobile && (
      <SmsConfirmation
        initialOTPChallenge={smsData?.otpChallenge}
        smsInputCount={4}
        onSuccess={handleConfirm}
        onError={() => console.error('Error')}
        loaderChildren={<Text>Выполняется запрос...</Text>}
        onBackClick={() => navigate(ROUTE_IIS_TARIFF_SELECTIONS)}
      />
    )
  );
};

export default IisConfirm;

          в виде налоговых льгот от государства ежегодно

};

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import { Button } from '@aurora/components';
import cx from 'classnames';
import { Pagination } from 'swiper';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import IisBottomSheet from 'modules/View360/components/IisPage/IisMain/components/IisBottomSheet/IisBottomSheet';
import IisCalculator from 'modules/View360/components/IisPage/IisMain/components/IisCalculator';
import IisFAQ from 'modules/View360/components/IisPage/IisMain/components/IisFAQ';
import SlideContent from 'modules/View360/components/IisPage/IisMain/components/IisOnboarding/SlideContent';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import styles from './IisOnboarding.module.pcss';
import { onboardingSlideData } from './OnboardingSlideData';

const IisOnboarding = () => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    window.history.back();
  };

  const handleOpenIisButtonClick = () => {
    setIsOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className={cx({ [styles.container]: !isMobile })}>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        documentTitle={'ИИС'}
        withoutMargin
      />
      {isMobile ? (
        <div className={styles.wrap}>
          <Swiper
            slidesPerView={1.2}
            spaceBetween={12}
            centeredSlides
            pagination
            modules={[Pagination]}
            initialSlide={0}
            className={styles.swiper}
            slideActiveClass={styles.swiperSlideActive}
          >
            {onboardingSlideData?.map(({ id, title, description, img }) => (
              <SwiperSlide key={id} className={styles.slider}>
                <SlideContent title={title} description={description} img={img} />
              </SwiperSlide>
            ))}
          </Swiper>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className={styles.wrapAdaptive}>
          {onboardingSlideData?.map(({ id, title, description, img }) => (
            <SlideContent key={id} title={title} description={description} img={img} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <IisCalculator />
      <IisFAQ />
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.btnOpen : styles.btnOpenAdaptive}>
        <Button onClick={handleOpenIisButtonClick}>Открыть ИИС</Button>
      </div>
      <IisBottomSheet isOpen={isOpen} setIsOpen={setIsOpen} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default IisOnboarding;

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Button, Placeholder, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_360, ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY } from 'const/routes';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as SuccessSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-success.svg';
import { ReactComponent as BlackBeardSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/placeholder-wrong.svg';

import { OperationTypes, operationsStatuses } from 'types/iis';

import styles from './IisPlaceholder.module.pcss';

const IisPlaceholder = () => {
  const { operationType } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();

  const handleBadgeText =
    operationType === 'success' ? (
      <Text type={'overline'} className={styles.successText}>
        Заявка принята в работу
      </Text>
    ) : (
      <Text type={'overline'} className={styles.errorText}>
        Ошибка
      </Text>
    );

  const handleCloseClick = () => {
    window.open(ROUTE_360, '_self');
  };

  const handleActionClick = () => {
    window.open(ROUTE_360, '_self');
  };

  const handleSecondActionClick = () => {
    window.open(ROUTE_ORDER_HISTORY, '_self');
  };

  const handleTryAgain = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const operationsStatuses: Record<OperationTypes | string, operationsStatuses> = {
    success: {
      text: 'В ближайшее время ваш ИИС будет доступен на странице «Обзор»',
      title: 'Документы подписаны',
    },
    error: {
      text: 'Возможно, у вас уже есть индивидуальный инвестиционный счёт, или заявка на его открытие находится в обработке',
      title: 'Вы не можете открыть ИИС',
    },
    unavailable: {
      text: 'Попробуйте открыть ИИС позднее',
      title: 'Сервис недоступен',
    },
  };

  const status = operationType ? operationsStatuses[operationType] : operationsStatuses.unavailable;
  const operationTypeStatus = operationType === 'success' || operationType === 'error';

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'close'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleCloseClick}
        title={'Открытие ИИС'}
        documentTitle={'Открытие ИИС'}
        withoutMargin
      />
      <Placeholder
        variant={operationType === 'success' ? 'success' : 'error'}
        badge={handleBadgeText}
        text={status.text}
        title={status.title}
        className={isMobile ? styles.placeholder : styles.placeholderAdaptive}
        buttons={
          <>
            <Button
              variant={'secondary'}
              onClick={operationTypeStatus ? handleSecondActionClick : handleActionClick}
            >
              {operationTypeStatus ? 'Перейти к Истории поручений' : 'Вернуться на Обзор'}
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={operationTypeStatus ? handleActionClick : handleTryAgain}>
              {operationTypeStatus ? 'Вернуться на Обзор' : 'Повторить попытку'}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
        img={
          operationType === 'success' ? (
            <SuccessSvg />
          ) : operationType === 'error' ? (
            <BlackBeardSvg />
          ) : undefined
        }
      />
    </>
  );
};

export default IisPlaceholder;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_360 } from 'const/routes';
import { Pagination } from 'swiper';
import { Swiper, SwiperSlide } from 'swiper/react';
// eslint-disable-next-line import/no-unresolved
import { PaginationOptions } from 'swiper/types';

import { isMobileDevice } from 'core/DeviceDetector';
import { useGetCurrentTariffQuery } from 'core/api/iis';

import { colorAccent } from 'vars/palette';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { ReactComponent as PDFIcon } from 'images/icons/pdf.svg';
import { ReactComponent as DownloadSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/download.svg';
import { ReactComponent as TariffSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/tariffs/tarif.svg';

import { TariffSlide } from '../TariffSlide';
import styles from './IisTariffSelections.module.pcss';

import 'swiper/css';
import 'swiper/css/pagination';

const IisTariffSelections = () => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const [activeSlideIndex, setActiveSlideIndex] = useState(0);

  const { data: tariffs, isLoading: isTariffsLoading, isFetching } = useGetCurrentTariffQuery();
  const iiaTariffs = tariffs?.productType.find((item) => item.code === 'SelfTrade.RF.IIA')?.id;
  const availableTariffs = tariffs?.productTypeTariff.filter(
    (item) => item.productTypeId === iiaTariffs,
  );

  const openTariffPdf = () =>
    window.open('https://investpalata.ru/current_broker_tarif', '_blank', 'noopener, noreferrer');

  const pagination: PaginationOptions = {
    dynamicBullets: true,
    dynamicMainBullets: 2,
    renderBullet: (index: number, className: string) => '<span class="' + className + '"></span>',
  };

  const tariffSlide = availableTariffs?.map((item, index) => ({
    ...item,
    img: <TariffSvg />,
  }));

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    window.open(ROUTE_360, '_self');
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // чтобы нижний бар ios в pwa был в цвет фона
    isMobile && document.body.classList.add(styles.body);
    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove(styles.body);
    };
  }, [isMobile]);

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        title={'Выберите тариф'}
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        withoutMargin
      />
      <div className={isMobile ? styles.background : styles.backgroundAdaptive}>
        {isFetching || isTariffsLoading ? (
          <CircleLoader type={'page'} brandColor />
        ) : (
          <>
            {isMobile ? (
              <>
                <div className={styles.swiperWrapper}>
                  <Swiper
                    slidesPerView={1.2}
                    spaceBetween={10}
                    pagination={pagination}
                    modules={[Pagination]}
                    className={styles.swiper}
                    centeredSlides
                    initialSlide={activeSlideIndex || 0}
                    slideActiveClass={styles.swiperSlideActive}
                    onActiveIndexChange={({ activeIndex }) => setActiveSlideIndex(activeIndex)}
                  >
                    {tariffSlide?.map(
                      ({
                        img,
                        tariffDisplayName,
                        tariffDescription,
                        tariffId,
                        productTypeId,
                        tariffParams,
                      }) => (
                        <SwiperSlide key={tariffId} className={styles.slider}>
                          <TariffSlide
                            img={img}
                            title={tariffDisplayName}
                            description={tariffDescription}
                            tariffParams={tariffParams}
                            tariffId={tariffId}
                            productTypeId={productTypeId}
                          />
                        </SwiperSlide>
                      ),
                    )}
                  </Swiper>
                </div>
                <div className={styles.pdfWrapper}>
                  <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Полные условия тарифа</Text>
                  <div className={styles.pdf} onClick={openTariffPdf}>
                    <Text type={'lineRegular'}>Открыть PDF </Text>
                    <DownloadSvg />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className={styles.titleWrap}>
                  <Text type={'title'}>Выберите тариф</Text>
                  <div onClick={openTariffPdf} className={styles.linkWrap}>
                    <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorAccent'}>
                      <PDFIcon color={colorAccent} /> Полные условия
                    </Text>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className={styles.cardWrap}>
                  {tariffSlide?.map(
                    ({
                      img,
                      tariffDisplayName,
                      tariffDescription,
                      tariffId,
                      productTypeId,
                      tariffParams,
                    }) => (
                      <TariffSlide
                        key={tariffId}
                        img={img}
                        title={tariffDisplayName}
                        description={tariffDescription}
                        tariffParams={tariffParams}
                        tariffId={tariffId}
                        productTypeId={productTypeId}
                      />
                    ),
                  )}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { generatePath, useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { CircleLoader, Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_IIS, ROUTE_IIS_CONFIRM } from 'const/routes';

import { useLazyGetDocumentsQuery, useLazyGetStatusQuery } from 'core/api/iis';

import { HeaderPage } from 'components';

import { StateProps } from 'types/iis';

import styles from './TariffSlide.module.pcss';

const Loader = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const state = location.state as StateProps;

  const [retryCount, setRetryCount] = useState(0);

  const handleBackClick = () => {
    navigate(-1);
  };

  const [getIisStatus, { data: iisStatusData, isError: isIisStatusError }] =
    useLazyGetStatusQuery();
  const [getIisDocument, { data: iisDocumentData, isError: isIisDocumentError }] =
    useLazyGetDocumentsQuery();

  const stateIisRequest = {
    documents: iisDocumentData,
    requestGuid: state?.requestGuid,
  };

  const requestGuid = state?.requestGuid;

  useEffect(() => {
    getIisStatus({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let setTimeOutId: NodeJS.Timeout;
    if (iisStatusData?.status === 'processing' || iisStatusData?.status === 'waiting_documents') {
      setTimeOutId = setTimeout(() => {
        getIisStatus({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
        setRetryCount((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 5000);
    }
    if (iisStatusData?.status === 'signing_documents') {
      getIisDocument({ requestGuid }).unwrap();
    }
    if (retryCount >= 15) {
      navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_IIS, { operationType: 'unavailable' }));
    }
    return () => clearTimeout(setTimeOutId);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [getIisDocument, getIisStatus, iisStatusData?.status, requestGuid, retryCount, navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (iisDocumentData) {
      navigate(ROUTE_IIS_CONFIRM, { state: stateIisRequest });
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [iisDocumentData, navigate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isIisStatusError || isIisDocumentError) {
      navigate(generatePath(ROUTE_IIS, { operationType: 'unavailable' }));
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isIisDocumentError, isIisStatusError]);

  return (
    <>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant="back"
        onLeftIconClick={handleBackClick}
        title={'Открытие счёта'}
        documentTitle={'Открытие счёта'}
        withoutMargin
      />
      <div className={styles.loaderWrapper}>
        <CircleLoader brandColor size={'large'} />
        <Text type={'title'}>Пожалуйста, подождите...</Text>
        <Text type={'bodyRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          Нам нужно немного времени на подготовку документов
        </Text>
      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default Loader;
