import { getSessionIiaSelector, getSessionPersonIdSelector } from 'core/session/session';
import {
  allDataSelector,
  setAllDataSetedSelector,
  view360Selector,
} from 'core/view360/view360Selectors';
import {
  setAllData,
  setAllDataSeted,
  setCountInProcess,
  setProductIdFromView360,
} from 'core/view360/view360Slice';

import { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from 'hooks';

//import { useCommonSelector } from 'hooks/useCommonSelector';
//import { useSnackBar } from 'hooks/useSnackBar';
import { COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS } from 'modules/OrderHistory/constants';
import SomethingWentWrong from 'modules/SomethingWentWrong/SomethingWentWrong';
import AccessDenied from 'modules/View360/components/AccessDenied';
import CollectionCurrency from 'modules/View360/components/CollectionCurrency';
import FinresultInBottomSheet from 'modules/View360/components/FinresultInBottomSheet';
import FirstTimeShake from 'modules/View360/components/FirstTimeShake';
//import IisMain from 'modules/View360/components/IisPage/IisMain';
import Portfolio from 'modules/View360/components/Portfolio';
// import Steps from 'modules/View360/components/Steps';
import { useSteps } from 'modules/View360/hooks/useSteps';

//import { HeaderPage } from 'components';
//import Banners from 'components/Banners';
import Collapse from 'components/Collapse';

import { ReactComponent as ChevronLeftSvg } from 'images/icons/chevron-left.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ChevronRightSvg } from 'images/icons/chevron-right.svg';
import { ReactComponent as SettingsSvg } from 'images/icons/glyphs/glyph-settings.svg';

import { FXSpotType, IRateType, PositionValuationByProductType, StoryType } from 'types/view360';

//import RabbitOnboarding from '../../images/icons/rabbitOnboarding.png';
import FinresSkeleton from './components/ FinresSkeleton';
import ButtonsBar from './components/ButtonsBar';
import Count from './components/Count';
import FinResult from './components/FinResult';
//import IisHeader from './components/IisPage/IisHeader';
import NotificationMark from './components/NotificationMark';
//import StatisticOnboardingButtons from './components/Onboarding/StatisticOnboardingButtons';
import SettingsPortfolio from './components/SettingsPortfolio';
import Skeleton from './components/Skeleton';
import StoryBlock from './components/StoryBlock';
import StoryItem from './components/StoryItem';
import StoryListSkeleton from './components/StoryListSkeleton';
import {
  USER_SETTING_GROUP_SUM_POSITION,
  USER_SETTING_ONBOARD_PWA_VIEW,
  USER_SETTING_VIEW_360_TOM_TOD,
  defaultParamsProductsQuery,
  initialFilters, //productMap,
} from './constants';
import { useShowPersonalDataSnack } from './hooks/useShowPersonalDataSnack';
import styles from './view360.module.pcss';

const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;

const TRADING_MODULE_INFO_URL =
  'https://investpalata.ru/%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B5%D0%BC%D0%B0-quik/';

const TradingModuleBanner = ({
  className,
  textClassName,
}: {
  className?: string;
  textClassName?: string;
}) => (
  <div className={className}>
    <Text type="lineRegular" className={textClassName}>
      Торговый модуль находится в разработке. При необходимости Вы можете использовать приложение
      Vision Invest, QUIK/web-QUIK. Подробнее на{' '}
      <a
        href={TRADING_MODULE_INFO_URL}
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
        className={styles.tradingModuleBannerLink}
      >
        сайте
      </a>
      .
    </Text>
  </div>
);

const ViewPage = () => {
  const isMobile = isMobileDevice();
  const isDesktopView = !isMobile;
  //const navigate = useNavigate();
  const handleRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const { productIdFromView360 } = useAppSelector(view360Selector);
  const { activeIndex } = useAppSelector(servicesSelector);
  const allData = useAppSelector(allDataSelector);

  const [accountsNew, setAccountsNew] = useState<PositionValuationByProductType[] | any[]>([]);
  const [visibleButtonsBar, setVisibleButtonsBar] = useState(true);

  const personId = useAppSelector(getSessionPersonIdSelector) || 0;

  const statsOnboardingRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const {
    data: { products = [] } = {},
    isSuccess: isSuccessProducts,
    isFetching: isLoadingProducts,
    isError: isErrorProducts,
  } = useGetProductsQuery({
    showUK: true,
  });

  const { data: userSetting } = useGetUserSettingTransformQuery();
  const rateType =
    (userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_VIEW_360_TOM_TOD]?.value as IRateType) || initialFilters.rateType;

  const params = { ...defaultParamsProductsQuery, rateType };
  const { data: productsData, isError: isErrorPosition } = useGetProductsDataQuery(
    { params },
    { skip: !rateType || products.length === 0 },
  );

  useShowPersonalDataSnack();

  const [setSettings] = useUpdateUserSettingMutation();
  const [isOnboardingStory, setIsOnboardingStory] = useState(false);

  const isOnBoarded = userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_ONBOARD_PWA_VIEW]?.value;

  const isPWA = (window.navigator as any)?.standalone === true;
  const {
    data: storiesList,
    refetch,
    isLoading: isStoryListLoading,
    isError: isStoriesListError,
    isFetching: isStoryFetching,
  } = useStoriesListQuery();
  const [, setStoriesRead] = useState(false);

  const { countInProcess } = useAppSelector(view360Selector);
  //const navigate = useNavigate();

  const {
    show: showSteps,
    //hideSteps,
    isLoading: isStepsLoading,
  } = useSteps(productsData);

  const { data: productsDictionary, isFetching: isFetchingProductsListDictionary } =
    useProductsListDictionaryQuery('view360');

  const [getFxSpotList] = useLazyFxSpotListQuery();
  const [updateStoryReadStatus] = useUpdateStoryReadStatusMutation();

  const iiaStatus = useAppSelector(getSessionIiaSelector);

  const [isLoadingCount, setIsLoadingCount] = useState(true);

  const [fxSpot, setFxSpot] = useState<FXSpotType[] | any[]>([] as FXSpotType[]);
  const [fxLoading, setFxLoading] = useState(false);
  // const [isOnboarding, setIsOnboarding] = useState(true);
  // const [showStatsOnboarding, setShowStatsOnboarding] = useLocalStorage<boolean>(
  //   'statsOnboarding',
  //   true,
  // );
  const [bottomSheetPosition, setBottomSheetPosition] = useState<'top' | 'middle' | 'down'>(
    'middle',
  );
  const { name: isOSName } = new UAParser().getOS();
  const settingsData = allData.positionValuationByProduct;
  const currentProduct = settingsData?.[activeIndex - 1];

  const requiredStatus = iiaStatus === 'NONE' || iiaStatus === 'ACTIVATING';
  //const { title, description } = (requiredStatus && productMap[iiaStatus]) || {};

  const getFxSpotCurrencies = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const dataList = allData.positionValuationByCurrency.map((it) => it.currencyCode);

      const requests = dataList.map(async (it) => {
        return await getFxSpotList(it);
      });

      const currencyResponses = await Promise.all(requests);
      const currencyList: FXSpotType[] = [];

      currencyResponses.forEach((res) => {
        const spot = res.data?.fxSpot?.find((s) => s.type === 'TOD');
        if (spot?.tradePlaceId) currencyList.push(spot);
      });

      setFxSpot(currencyList);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setFxLoading(true);
    }
  }, [allData.positionValuationByCurrency, getFxSpotList]);

  const isPersonPositionGranted = Permissions.get('PERSON_POSITION') === Permissions.GRANTED;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoadingProducts && !isLoadingCount) {
      products.length === 0 &&
        (Permissions.granted('PERSON_POSITION') || Permissions.denied('PERSON_POSITION')) &&
        dispatch(setCountInProcess(true));
    }
  }, [products.length, isLoadingCount, isLoadingProducts, dispatch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!allData.positionValuationByCurrency?.length) {
      setFxLoading(true);
      return;
    }
    getFxSpotCurrencies();
  }, [getFxSpotCurrencies, allData.positionValuationByCurrency]);
  const allDataSeted = useAppSelector(setAllDataSetedSelector);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isErrorPosition || products.length === 0) {
      setIsLoadingCount(false);
    }
  }, [isErrorPosition, products.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!allDataSeted && productsData) {
      dispatch(setAllData(productsData));
      dispatch(setAllDataSeted(true));
      setIsLoadingCount(false);
    }
  }, [allDataSeted, dispatch, productsData]);

  const accountsMap = useCallback(() => {
    const isReceivedData = allData?.positionValuation || allData?.positionValuationByProduct;
    let mainAccEndPoint;
    let mainAccount;
    let anotherAccounts;
    let newAccounts;
    const defaultAccount = [
      {
        productName: 'Новый счёт',
        accountNo: '',
        productId: null,
        productTitle: 'Счёт открывается',
        productSubtitle: 'Ожидайте уведомления об открытии счёта',
      },
    ];

    if (isReceivedData) {
      mainAccEndPoint = allData?.positionValuation[0];
      mainAccount = [
        {
          totalAmount: mainAccEndPoint.totalAmount,
          financialResultAccumulatedAllPeriod: mainAccEndPoint.financialResultAccumulatedAllPeriod,
          financialResultPcntAllPeriod: mainAccEndPoint.financialResultPcntAllPeriod,
          totalAmountDiff: mainAccEndPoint.totalAmountDiff,
          totalAmountDiffPcnt: mainAccEndPoint.totalAmountDiffPcnt,
          productName: 'Все счета',
          accountNo: '',
          productId: null,
          currencyCode: mainAccEndPoint.currencyCode,
        },
      ];

      anotherAccounts = allData.positionValuationByProduct.map((acc) => ({
        productName: acc.productName,
        totalAmount: acc.totalAmount,
        financialResultAccumulatedAllPeriod: null,
        financialResultPcntAllPeriod: null,
        totalAmountDiff: acc.totalAmountDiff,
        totalAmountDiffPcnt: acc.totalAmountDiffPcnt,
        accountNo: acc.accountNo,
        productId: acc.productId,
        actualDate: acc.actualDate,
        totalAmountCurrency: acc.totalAmountCurrency,
      }));

      newAccounts = [...mainAccount, ...anotherAccounts];
    }

    if (countInProcess) {
      setAccountsNew([...defaultAccount]);
    } else if (!countInProcess && newAccounts) {
      setAccountsNew(newAccounts);
    }
  }, [allData?.positionValuation, allData?.positionValuationByProduct, countInProcess]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSuccessProducts || isErrorPosition) {
      accountsMap();
    }
  }, [accountsMap, isSuccessProducts, isErrorPosition]);

  const [type, setType] = useState(true);

  const [storyIndex, setStoryIndex] = useState(0);
  const [showStories, setShowStories] = useState<boolean | null>(null);

  const sheetRef = useRef<BottomSheetRef>(null);

  const [currentSheetHeight, setCurrentSheetHeight] = useState(0);
  const pagination = {
    clickable: true,
    bulletActiveClass: cx(
      isDesktopView
        ? styles.swiperPaginationBulletActiveDesktop
        : styles.swiperPaginationBulletActive,
    ),
    horizontalClass:
      !isDesktopView && !countInProcess
        ? styles.horizontalClassCompact
        : !isMobile
        ? styles.horizontalClassDesktop
        : styles.horizontalClass,
    progressbarFillClass: styles.test,
    renderBullet: function (_: number, className: string) {
      return (
        '<span class="' +
        cx(className, styles.swiperPaginationBullet, styles.swiperPaginationMode) +
        '"></span>'
      );
    },
  };

  const { isAggregateProductSelected } = useMemo(() => {
    const acc = accountsNew?.[activeIndex];

    return {
      isAggregateProductSelected: acc?.productId === null && acc?.productName === 'Все счета',
      isAccountOpened: acc?.productId === null && acc?.productName === 'Новый счёт',
    };
  }, [accountsNew, activeIndex]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeIndex >= 1) {
      if (currentProduct?.isUk) dispatch(setStateIsUk(true));
      else dispatch(setStateIsUk(false));
    } else {
      if (settingsData?.[activeIndex]?.isUk) dispatch(setStateIsUk(true));
      else dispatch(setStateIsUk(false));
    }
  }, [activeIndex, currentProduct?.isUk, dispatch, settingsData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeIndex >= 1) {
      if (currentProduct?.isStructure) dispatch(setStateIsStructure(true));
      else dispatch(setStateIsStructure(false));
    } else {
      if (settingsData?.[activeIndex]?.isStructure) dispatch(setStateIsStructure(true));
      else dispatch(setStateIsStructure(false));
    }
  }, [activeIndex, currentProduct?.isStructure, dispatch, settingsData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const productId = activeIndex > 0 ? currentProduct?.productId : null;
    dispatch(setProductIdFromView360(productId));
    sessionStorage.setItem(
      COMMON_HISTORY_FILTERS,
      JSON.stringify({ product_Id: productId ? String(productId) : productId }),
    );
  }, [
    activeIndex,
    currentProduct?.isModel,
    currentProduct?.isStructure,
    currentProduct?.productId,
    dispatch,
    settingsData,
  ]);

  const storiesListArr: StoryType[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!storiesList?.storyList) return [];

    return storiesList.storyList.reduce((acc: StoryType[], story: StoryType) => {
      const content = JSON.parse(story.content);
      const targetOS = story.name;

      const isTargetOS =
        (isOSName === 'iOS' && targetOS === 'IOS') ||
        (isOSName !== 'iOS' && targetOS === 'ANDROID');

      if (!isTargetOS) return acc;

      if (content.isOnboarding && !isOnBoarded) {
        acc.unshift(story);
      } else {
        acc.push(story);
      }

      return acc;
    }, []);
  }, [storiesList, isOSName, isOnBoarded]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!storiesListArr[0]) return;
    if (JSON.parse(storiesListArr[0].content).isOnboarding) {
      setIsOnboardingStory(storiesListArr[0].unread);
    }
  }, [storiesListArr]);

  const actualStories = useMemo(() => {
    if (!storiesListArr?.length) return [];

    const uniqueStories = Array.from(new Set(storiesListArr));

    return uniqueStories.map((story, index) => {
      const storyContent = JSON.parse(story.content);
      const storyName = storyContent.miniatureName;

      const backgroundStyle = storyContent.miniatureImageMlkSrc
        ? {
            backgroundImage: `url(${storyContent.miniatureImageMlkSrc})`,
            backgroundPosition: 'center',
            backgroundSize: '96px 96px',
          }
        : {
            background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30, 30, 30, 0) 0%, #3ab6ec 100%)',
          };

      const handleSlideClick = () => {
        setStoryIndex(index);
        setShowStories(true);
        if (story.unread) {
          updateStoryReadStatus(story.id);
        }
      };

      return (
        <SwiperSlide key={story.id || index} className={styles.storySlider}>
          <div
            className={story.unread ? styles.storyUnread : styles.story}
            style={backgroundStyle}
            ref={index === 0 ? handleRef : null}
            onClick={handleSlideClick}
          >
            <p className={styles.storyBlockLabel}>{storyName}</p>
            <div className={styles.storyOverlay} />
          </div>
        </SwiperSlide>
      );
    });
  }, [storiesListArr, setStoryIndex, setShowStories, updateStoryReadStatus]);

  const moddedStories = storiesListArr
    ? [...storiesListArr, storiesListArr[0]]
    : ([] as StoryType[]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const getPosition = () => {
      if (isDesktopView) return 'down';
      if (currentSheetHeight > windowHeight * 0.85) return 'top';
      if (currentSheetHeight > windowHeight * 0.55) return 'middle';
      return 'down';
    };

    setBottomSheetPosition(getPosition());
  }, [currentSheetHeight, isDesktopView]);

  const increaseMenuFunc = () => {
    if (sheetRef.current) {
      sheetRef.current.snapTo(({ snapPoints }) => Math.min(...snapPoints), {
        source: 'custom',
        velocity: 1,
      });
    }
  };

  const decreaseMenuFunc = () => {
    if (sheetRef.current) {
      sheetRef.current.snapTo(({ snapPoints }) => [...snapPoints].sort()[1], {
        source: 'custom',
        velocity: 1,
      });
    }
  };
  const handleStoryClick = useCallback(() => {
    if (!handleRef || !isOnboardingStory) return;
    handleRef?.current?.click();
    setSettings({ name: 'onboard_pwa_view', value: '1' });
    refetch();
  }, [isOnboardingStory, refetch, setSettings]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOnBoarded || isPWA || !isOnboardingStory) return;
    if (actualStories.length) {
      handleStoryClick();
    }
  }, [actualStories.length, isPWA, isOnBoarded, isOnboardingStory, handleStoryClick]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setVisibleButtonsBar(!(activeIndex === accountsNew.length && requiredStatus));
  }, [accountsNew.length, activeIndex, iiaStatus, requiredStatus]);

  const [isOpenSettingsPortfolio, setIsOpenSettingsPortfolio] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const handleOpenSettings = useCallback(() => {
    setIsOpenSettingsPortfolio(true);
  }, []);

  const [swiperInstance, setSwiperInstance] = useState<SwiperType>();
  //const [paginationWidth, setPaginationWidth] = useState(0);
  const handleSwiperInit = (swiper: SwiperType) => {
    //const paginationEl = swiper.pagination.el;
    //setPaginationWidth(paginationEl?.offsetWidth);
    !swiperInstance && setSwiperInstance(swiper);
  };

  const handleChangeType = () => {
    if (!countInProcess) setType(!type);
    return;
  };

  if (
    !isPersonPositionGranted &&
    !countInProcess &&
    !isLoadingCount &&
    !isLoadingProducts &&
    !isFetchingProductsListDictionary &&
    isSuccessProducts
  ) {
    return <AccessDenied />;
  }

  if (isErrorProducts || isErrorPosition) {
    return <SomethingWentWrong />;
  }

  // const closeBlock = () => {
  //   setIsOnboarding(false);
  //   setShowStatsOnboarding(false);
  // };
  // const goNext = () => {
  //   setIsOnboarding(false);
  //   navigate('/stats/dynamic');
  //   setShowStatsOnboarding(false);
  // };

  return (
    <div className={styles.wrapper}>
      {isDesktopView && (
        <div className={styles.wrapperBackgroundDesktop}>
          <div className={styles.backgroundDesktop} />
        </div>
      )}
      {/*{isOnboarding && productsData && showStatsOnboarding && (
        <Onboarding
          popupFixed
          addonBottomLeft={<img src={RabbitOnboarding} alt="onboardingFriend" />}
          addonBottomRight={<StatisticOnboardingButtons closeBlock={closeBlock} goNext={goNext} />}
          currentElement={0}
          data={[
            {
              description:
                'Теперь вместо «Статистики» – обновлённый раздел «Аналитика». В нём по-прежнему содержится вся информация о портфеле, а также новые данные – о доступности маржинальной торговли',
              target: {
                current: statsOnboardingRef.current,
              },
              title: 'Встречайте раздел «Аналитика»',
              borderWidth: 8,
            },
          ]}
          onClickOutsidePopup={closeBlock}
        />
      )} 
      <HeaderPage documentTitle={'Портфель брокера'} className={styles.headerPage} />*/}
      <div className={cx(isDesktopView && styles.containerDesktop)}>
        {isDesktopView && (
          <div className={styles.titleDesktop}>
            <Text type={'headline'}>Портфель</Text>
            {!countInProcess && (
              <SettingsSvg onClick={handleOpenSettings} className={styles.settingsDesktop} />
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        {showStories && (
          <StoryItem
            content={
              <div className={styles.storyTest}>
                {
                  <StoryBlock
                    stories={moddedStories}
                    setShowStories={setShowStories}
                    storyIndex={storyIndex}
                    setStoriesRead={setStoriesRead}
                    refetch={refetch}
                  />
                }
              </div>
            }
          />
        )}
        <div className={cx(styles.header, { [styles.headerDesktop]: isDesktopView })}>
          {!isDesktopView && <NotificationMark />}
          <div className={isDesktopView ? styles.headerMainPartDesktop : styles.headerMainPart}>
            {accountsNew.length ? (
              <div
                className={cx(styles.swiperWrapper, {
                  [styles.swiperWrapperCompact]: !countInProcess && !isDesktopView,
                })}
              >
                {isDesktopView && !countInProcess && (
                  <div className={styles.swiperArrows}>
                    <div className={styles.swiperArrow} onClick={() => swiperInstance?.slidePrev()}>
                      <ChevronLeftSvg onClick={() => swiperInstance?.slidePrev()} />
                    </div>
                    <div className={styles.swiperArrow} onClick={() => swiperInstance?.slideNext()}>
                      <ChevronRightSvg onClick={() => swiperInstance?.slideNext()} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                <Swiper
                  onInit={handleSwiperInit}
                  observer
                  observeParents
                  onObserverUpdate={handleSwiperInit}
                  slidesPerView={1}
                  spaceBetween={35}
                  pagination={bottomSheetPosition !== 'top' ? pagination : false}
                  modules={[Pagination]}
                  className={cx(styles.mySwiper, { [styles.mySwiperDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
                  id="count-swiper"
                  onSlideChange={(e) => {
                    dispatch(setActiveIndex(e.realIndex));
                  }}
                  initialSlide={activeIndex || 0}
                >
                  {accountsNew.map((item, index) => (
                    <SwiperSlide
                      key={item.productName + index}
                      className={cx({ [styles.mySlideDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
                    >
                      {allData && swiperInstance && (
                        <Count
                          activeIndex={index}
                          type={type ? 'day' : 'allPeriod'}
                          amount={item.totalAmount}
                          currency={item.currencyCode || item.totalAmountCurrency}
                          productName={isAggregateProductSelected ? 'Все счета' : item.productName}
                          accountNo={item.accountNo}
                          productId={item.productId}
                          personId={personId}
                          isActive={index === activeIndex}
                          setIsLoadingCount={setIsLoadingCount}
                          isLoadingCount={isLoadingCount}
                          productSubtitle={item?.productSubtitle}
                          productTitle={item?.productTitle}
                          bottomSheetPosition={bottomSheetPosition}
                          handleChangeType={handleChangeType}
                        />
                      )}
                    </SwiperSlide>
                  ))}
                  {/*                   {!countInProcess && requiredStatus && (
                    <SwiperSlide
                      className={cx(styles.aloneSlider, { [styles.mySlideDesktop]: isDesktopView })}
                    >
                      <IisHeader
                        title={'Новый счёт'}
                        productName={'ИИС'}
                        productTitle={title}
                        productDescription={description}
                        isDesktopView={isDesktopView}
                      />
                    </SwiperSlide>
                  )} */}
                </Swiper>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Skeleton />
            )}

            {!countInProcess && !isDesktopView && (
              <TradingModuleBanner
                className={cx(
                  styles.tradingModuleBannerWrapper,
                  styles.tradingModuleBannerWrapperMobile,
                )}
                textClassName={styles.tradingModuleBannerTextMobile}
              />
            )}

            {!countInProcess && (
              <ButtonsBar
                increaseMenuFunc={increaseMenuFunc}
                bottomSheetPosition={bottomSheetPosition}
                decreaseMenuFunc={decreaseMenuFunc}
                isMainAccountActive={activeIndex === 0}
                visibleButtonsBar={visibleButtonsBar}
                isLoading={Boolean(!accountsNew.length)}
                ref={statsOnboardingRef}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        {visibleButtonsBar ? (
          <Portfolio
            countInProcess={countInProcess}
            ref={sheetRef}
            setCurrentSheetHeight={setCurrentSheetHeight}
          >
            <div style={{ padding: '0 0 50px' }}>
              <div className={styles.body}>
                {!countInProcess && isDesktopView && (
                  <TradingModuleBanner
                    className={cx(
                      styles.tradingModuleBannerWrapper,
                      styles.tradingModuleBannerWrapperDesktop,
                    )}
                  />
                )}
                {accountsNew.length && bottomSheetPosition === 'top' && !countInProcess ? (
                  <div className={styles.headerBottomSheet}>
                    {
                      <FinresultInBottomSheet
                        totalAmount={accountsNew[activeIndex]?.totalAmount}
                        productId={productIdFromView360}
                        currency={
                          accountsNew[activeIndex]?.currencyCode ||
                          accountsNew[activeIndex]?.totalAmountCurrency
                        }
                        activeIndex={activeIndex}
                        type={type ? 'day' : 'allPeriod'}
                        handleChangeType={handleChangeType}
                      />
                    }
                    <SettingsSvg
                      onClick={handleOpenSettings}
                      className={styles.settingsInBottomSheet}
                    />
                  </div>
                ) : null}
                {/*{showSteps && (isAggregateProductSelected || countInProcess) && (*/}
                {/*  <Steps activeStep={activeStep} isLoading={isStepsLoading} hideSteps={hideSteps} />*/}
                {/*)}*/}
                {isStoryListLoading || isStoryFetching || isStepsLoading ? (
                  <div className={cx(isDesktopView && styles.skeletonWrapper)}>
                    <StoryListSkeleton isDesktopView={isDesktopView} />
                  </div>
                ) : !(showSteps && (isAggregateProductSelected || countInProcess)) &&
                  !isStoriesListError &&
                  actualStories?.length ? (
                  <Swiper
                    slidesPerView="auto"
                    spaceBetween={8}
                    className={styles.storySwiper}
                    id="stories-swiper"
                  >
                    {actualStories}
                  </Swiper>
                ) : null}
                {/* {!showSteps && (isAggregateProductSelected || countInProcess) && (
                  <Banners point="OVERVIEW" locationPoint="up" />
                )} */}
                {!isDesktopView && (
                  <CollectionCurrency products={products} countInProcess={countInProcess} />
                )}
                {isLoadingCount || !fxLoading ? (
                  <div className={cx(isDesktopView && styles.skeletonWrapper)}>
                    <FinresSkeleton isDesktopView={isDesktopView} />
                  </div>
                ) : countInProcess ? null : (
                  <Collapse isOpened={true} speed={500}>
                    <FinResult
                      activeIndex={activeIndex}
                      products2={allData.positionValuationByInstrument2}
                      products={allData.positionValuationByInstrument}
                      isTypeDay={type}
                      actualData={allData.positionValuationByProduct}
                      fxSpotCurrencies={fxSpot}
                      productsDictionary={productsDictionary?.instrumentGroup}
                      instrumentGroups={allData.positionValuationByInstrumentGroup}
                      groupSumPosition={
                        userSetting?.[USER_SETTING_GROUP_SUM_POSITION]?.value === '1'
                      }
                      currencyValuationByPortfolio={allData.currencyValuationByPortfolio}
                      iis={allData.iis}
                      isAggregateProductSelected={isAggregateProductSelected}
                    />
                  </Collapse>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </Portfolio>
        ) : (
          <div className={cx({ [styles.skeletonWrapper]: isDesktopView })}>
            <StoryListSkeleton isDesktopView={isDesktopView} />
            <FinresSkeleton isDesktopView={isDesktopView} />
          </div>
          //         <>
          //          {iiaStatus && productsData ? (
          //            <IisMain
          //              isDesktopView={isDesktopView}
          //              iiaStatus={iiaStatus}
          //              actualStories={actualStories}
          //            />
          //          ) : (
          //            <>
          //              <div className={cx({ [styles.skeletonWrapper]: isDesktopView })}>
          //                <StoryListSkeleton isDesktopView={isDesktopView} />
          //                <FinresSkeleton isDesktopView={isDesktopView} />
          //              </div>
          //            </>
          //          )}
          //        </>
        )}
        <SettingsPortfolio
          isOpen={isOpenSettingsPortfolio}
          setIsOpen={setIsOpenSettingsPortfolio}
        />
      </div>
      <FirstTimeShake />
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(ViewPage);

import React from 'react';

export type QuestionCardType = 'start' | 'refill' | 'instr' | 'ed';

export type WelcomeFAQQuestionType = QuestionCardType | 'port' | 'other';

export type QuestionCardProps = {

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

import { Text } from '@aurora/components';
import { ROUTE_CHAT } from 'const/routes';

import { reachGoal } from 'core/helpers/analytics';

import QuestionCard from 'modules/WelcomeFAQ/components/QuestionCard/QuestionCard';
import { QuestionCardProps, WelcomeFAQQuestionType } from 'modules/WelcomeFAQ/types';

import { ActionCell, HeaderPage } from 'components';
import DynamicHintBottomSheet from 'components/Hint/DynamicHintBottomSheet/DynamicHintBottomSheet';

import { ReactComponent as IncomeSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/welcome-faq/income.svg';
import { ReactComponent as InnovationSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/welcome-faq/innovation.svg';
import { ReactComponent as LearningSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/welcome-faq/learning.svg';
import { ReactComponent as ProductSvg } from 'images/raw-icons/welcome-faq/product.svg';

import styles from './WelcomeFAQ.module.pcss';

const QUESTION_CARDS: Omit<QuestionCardProps, 'onClick'>[] = [
  { icon: <InnovationSvg />, question: 'С чего начать?', slug: 'BRD_FAQ_BEGIN', type: 'start' },
  { icon: <IncomeSvg />, question: 'Как пополнить счёт?', slug: 'BRD_FAQ_TOPUP', type: 'refill' },
  {
    icon: <ProductSvg />,
    question: 'Как купить ценные бумаги?',
    slug: 'BRD_FAQ_HOWBUY',
    type: 'instr',
  },
  {
    icon: <LearningSvg />,
    question: 'Как научиться инвестировать?',
    slug: 'BRD_FAQ_INVEST',
    type: 'ed',
  },
];

const WelcomeFAQ = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [bottomSheetState, setBottomSheetState] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleBack = () => navigate(-1);

  const handleOpenBottomSheetHint = (slug: string, type: WelcomeFAQQuestionType) => {
    setBottomSheetState(slug);
    reachGoal('steps', 'steps_mini_faq_tap', { question: type });
  };
  const handleCloseBottomSheetHint = () => setBottomSheetState(null);

  const handleWhatIsPortfolioClick = () => handleOpenBottomSheetHint('BRD_FAQ_PORTF', 'port');
  const handleOtherQuestion = () => {
    navigate(ROUTE_CHAT);
    reachGoal('steps', 'steps_mini_faq_tap', { question: 'other' });
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <HeaderPage
        leftIconVariant={'back'}
        onLeftIconClick={handleBack}
        documentTitle={'Вопросы и ответы'}
      />
      <div className={styles.headline}>
        <Text type={'subtitleBold'} className={styles.title}>
          Вопросы и ответы
        </Text>
        <Text type={'lineRegular'} color={'colorForeground2'}>
          Узнайте больше о ваших возможностях в этом приложении
        </Text>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.cards}>
        {QUESTION_CARDS.map((el) => (
          <QuestionCard key={el.slug} {...el} onClick={handleOpenBottomSheetHint} />
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.headline}>
        <Text type={'subtitleBold'} className={styles.title}>
          Другие вопросы
        </Text>
      </div>
      <ActionCell onClick={handleWhatIsPortfolioClick}>Что такое портфель?</ActionCell>
      <ActionCell onClick={handleOtherQuestion}>У меня другой вопрос</ActionCell>
      <DynamicHintBottomSheet slug={bottomSheetState} onClose={handleCloseBottomSheetHint} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default WelcomeFAQ;

/// <reference lib="webworker" />

/* eslint-disable no-restricted-globals */
// This service worker can be customized!
// See https://developers.google.com/web/tools/workbox/modules
// for the list of available Workbox modules, or add any other
// code you'd like.
// You can also remove this file if you'd prefer not to use a
// service worker, and the Workbox build step will be skipped.
import { clientsClaim } from 'workbox-core';
import { ExpirationPlugin } from 'workbox-expiration';
import { createHandlerBoundToURL, precacheAndRoute } from 'workbox-precaching';
import { registerRoute } from 'workbox-routing';
import { StaleWhileRevalidate } from 'workbox-strategies';

declare const self: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope;

clientsClaim();

// Precache all of the assets generated by your build process.
// Their URLs are injected into the manifest variable below.
// This variable must be present somewhere in your service worker file,
// even if you decide not to use precaching. See https://cra.link/PWA
precacheAndRoute(self.__WB_MANIFEST);

// Set up App Shell-style routing, so that all navigation requests
// are fulfilled with your index.html shell. Learn more at
// https://developers.google.com/web/fundamentals/architecture/app-shell
const fileExtensionRegexp = new RegExp('/[^/?]+\\.[^/]+$');
registerRoute(
  // Return false to exempt requests from being fulfilled by index.html.
  ({ request, url }: { request: Request; url: URL }) => {
    // If this isn't a navigation, skip.
    if (request.mode !== 'navigate') {
      return false;
    }

    // If this is a URL that starts with /_, skip.
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/_')) {
      return false;
    }

    // If this looks like a URL for a resource, because it contains
    // a file extension, skip.
    if (url.pathname.match(fileExtensionRegexp)) {
      return false;
    }

    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/rs/')) {
      return false;
    }

    // Return true to signal that we want to use the handler.
    return true;
  },
  createHandlerBoundToURL(process.env.PUBLIC_URL + '/index.html'),
);

// An example runtime caching route for requests that aren't handled by the
// precache, in this case same-origin .png requests like those from in public/
registerRoute(
  // Add in any other file extensions or routing criteria as needed.
  ({ url }) => url.origin === self.location.origin && url.pathname.endsWith('.png'),
  // Customize this strategy as needed, e.g., by changing to CacheFirst.
  new StaleWhileRevalidate({
    cacheName: 'images',
    plugins: [
      // Ensure that once this runtime cache reaches a maximum size the
      // least-recently used images are removed.
      new ExpirationPlugin({ maxEntries: 50 }),
    ],
  }),
);

// This allows the web app to trigger skipWaiting via
// registration.waiting.postMessage({type: 'SKIP_WAITING'})
self.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
  if (event.data && event.data.type === 'SKIP_WAITING') {
    self.skipWaiting();
  }
});

// Any other custom service worker logic can go here.

// This optional code is used to register a service worker.
// register() is not called by default.
// This lets the app load faster on subsequent visits in production, and gives
// it offline capabilities. However, it also means that developers (and users)
// will only see deployed updates on subsequent visits to a page, after all the
// existing tabs open on the page have been closed, since previously cached
// resources are updated in the background.
// To learn more about the benefits of this model and instructions on how to
// opt-in, read https://cra.link/PWA
import httpCommunicator from '@aurora/http-communicator';
import { store } from 'store';

import { onUpdateServiceWorker } from './core/serviceWorker/serviceWorkerSlice';

const isLocalhost = Boolean(
  window.location.hostname === 'localhost' ||
    // [::1] is the IPv6 localhost address.
    window.location.hostname === '[::1]' ||
    // 127.0.0.0/8 are considered localhost for IPv4.
    window.location.hostname.match(/^127(?:\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)){3}$/),
);

type Config = {
  onSuccess?: (registration: ServiceWorkerRegistration) => void;
  onUpdate?: (registration: ServiceWorkerRegistration) => void;
};

export function register(config?: Config) {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && 'serviceWorker' in navigator) {
    // The URL constructor is available in all browsers that support SW.
    const publicUrl = new URL(process.env.PUBLIC_URL, window.location.href);
    if (publicUrl.origin !== window.location.origin) {

    }

        // service worker/PWA documentation.
        navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then(() => {

        });
      } else {

      }

}

function registerValidSW(swUrl: string, config?: Config) {
  navigator.serviceWorker
    .register(swUrl)
    .then((registration) => {
      registration.onupdatefound = () => {
        const installingWorker = registration.installing;
        if (installingWorker == null) {
          return;
        }
        installingWorker.onstatechange = () => {

              // It's the perfect time to display a
              // "Content is cached for offline use." message.

              if (config && config.onSuccess) {
                config.onSuccess(registration);
              }

function checkValidServiceWorker(swUrl: string, config?: Config) {
  // Check if the service worker can be found. If it can't reload the page.
  httpCommunicator(swUrl, {
    method: 'get',
    headers: { 'Service-Worker': 'script' },
  })
    .then((response) => {
      // Ensure service worker exists, and that we really are getting a JS file.
      const contentType = response.headers['content-type'];
      if (
        response.status === 404 ||
        (contentType != null && contentType.indexOf('javascript') === -1)

        navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then((registration) => {
          registration.unregister().then(() => {
            window.location.reload();
          });
        });
      } else {
        // Service worker found. Proceed as normal.
        registerValidSW(swUrl, config);
      }
    })
    .catch(() => {
      console.log('No internet connection found. App is running in offline mode.');
    });
}

export function unregister() {
  if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
    navigator.serviceWorker.ready
      .then((registration) => {
        registration.unregister();
      })
      .catch((error) => {
        console.error(error.message);
      });
  }
}

import {
  Action,
  Middleware,
  MiddlewareAPI,
  ThunkAction,
  configureStore,
  isRejected,
  isRejectedWithValue,
} from '@reduxjs/toolkit';

import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from 'core/api/apiUnionEntryPoint';
import { brokerBankAccountsApi } from 'core/api/brokerBankAccounts';
import { catalogApi } from 'core/api/catalog';
import { detailsApi } from 'core/api/details';
import { dictionariesApi } from 'core/api/dictionaries';
import { feedbackApi } from 'core/api/feedback';
import { depoInstrumentsApi } from 'core/api/instrumentDepo';
import { instrumentInfoFlagsApi } from 'core/api/instrumentInfoFlags';
import { instrumentsApi } from 'core/api/instruments';
import { investmentProfileApi } from 'core/api/investmentProfile';
import { notesApi } from 'core/api/notes';
import { ordersApi } from 'core/api/orders';
import { positionsApi } from 'core/api/positions';
import { quizApi } from 'core/api/quiz';
import { reportsApi } from 'core/api/reports';
import { statsApi } from 'core/api/stats';
import { subAccountApi } from 'core/api/subAccount';
import { quotesHistoryApi } from 'core/api/tradingView';
import { transfersApi } from 'core/api/transfers';
import { userSettingApi } from 'core/api/userSettings';
import { resetStore } from 'core/helpers/resetStore';

import { rootReducers } from './reducers';

export const rtkQueryErrorLogger: Middleware = (api: MiddlewareAPI) => (next) => (action) => {
  // RTK Query uses `createAsyncThunk` from redux-toolkit under the hood, so we're able to utilize these matchers!

  if (isRejected(action) || isRejectedWithValue(action)) {
    const status =
      action.payload?.status ||
      action.payload?.response?.status ||
      action.error?.status ||
      action.error?.code;

    if (status === 401) {
      console.warn('401 Unauthorized detected, redirecting to login');
      resetStore();
      window.location.href = '/login';
    }

    if (action.error) {
      console.warn('Async error:', {
        type: action.type,
        error: action.error,
        payload: action.payload,
      });
    }
  }

  return next(action);
};

export const store = configureStore({
  reducer: rootReducers,
  middleware: (getDefaultMiddleware) =>
    getDefaultMiddleware().concat(
      apiUnionEntryPoint.middleware,
      catalogApi.middleware,
      statsApi.middleware,
      instrumentsApi.middleware,
      quotesHistoryApi.middleware,
      positionsApi.middleware,
      userSettingApi.middleware,
      transfersApi.middleware,
      brokerBankAccountsApi.middleware,
      dictionariesApi.middleware,
      instrumentInfoFlagsApi.middleware,
      depoInstrumentsApi.middleware,
      subAccountApi.middleware,
      ordersApi.middleware,
      quizApi.middleware,
      reportsApi.middleware,
      investmentProfileApi.middleware,
      notesApi.middleware,
      detailsApi.middleware,
      feedbackApi.middleware,
      rtkQueryErrorLogger,
    ),
});

export type AppDispatch = typeof store.dispatch;
export type RootState = ReturnType<typeof store.getState>;
export type AppThunk<ReturnType = void> = ThunkAction<
  ReturnType,
  RootState,
  unknown,
  Action<string>
>;

import { analyticsInfiniteScrollApi } from 'core/api/analytics';
import { apiUnionEntryPoint } from 'core/api/apiUnionEntryPoint';
import { brokerBankAccountsApi } from 'core/api/brokerBankAccounts';

import { transfersApi } from 'core/api/transfers';
import { userSettingApi } from 'core/api/userSettings';
import commonReducer from 'core/common/commonSlice';
import limitOrdersStatusReducer from 'core/limitOrdersStatus';
import officesReducer from 'core/offices/officesSlice';
import orderHistoryReducer from 'core/orderHistory/orderHistorySlice';
import permissionsReducer from 'core/permissions/permissionsSlice';
import reportsReducer from 'core/reports/reportsSlice';
import requisiteReducer from 'core/requisite/requisiteSlice';
import serviceWorkerReducer from 'core/serviceWorker/serviceWorkerSlice';
import servicesReducer from 'core/services/servicesSlice';
import sessionReducer from 'core/session/sessionSlice';
import systemParametersReducer from 'core/systemParameters/systemParametersSlice';
import tariffReducer from 'core/tariff/tariffSlice';
import tradeOrderReducer from 'core/tradeOrder/tradeOrderSlice';
import tradeSessionReducer from 'core/tradeSession/tradeSessionSlice';
import view360Reducer from 'core/view360/view360Slice';

import alertReducer from 'components/Alert/alertSlice';

const combinedReducer = combineReducers({
  session: sessionReducer,
  permissions: permissionsReducer,
  tradeSession: tradeSessionReducer,
  alertNotifications: alertReducer,
  systemParameters: systemParametersReducer,
  limitOrdersStatus: limitOrdersStatusReducer,
  tariff: tariffReducer,
  offices: officesReducer,
  serviceWorker: serviceWorkerReducer,
  services: servicesReducer,
  tradeOrder: tradeOrderReducer,
  requisite: requisiteReducer,
  view360: view360Reducer,
  common: commonReducer,
  orderHistory: orderHistoryReducer,
  reports: reportsReducer,
  [apiUnionEntryPoint.reducerPath]: apiUnionEntryPoint.reducer,
  [catalogApi.reducerPath]: catalogApi.reducer,
  [quizApi.reducerPath]: quizApi.reducer,
  [investmentProfileApi.reducerPath]: investmentProfileApi.reducer,
  [notesApi.reducerPath]: notesApi.reducer,
  [instrumentsApi.reducerPath]: instrumentsApi.reducer,
  [userSettingApi.reducerPath]: userSettingApi.reducer,
  [quotesHistoryApi.reducerPath]: quotesHistoryApi.reducer,
  [positionsApi.reducerPath]: positionsApi.reducer,
  [reportsApi.reducerPath]: reportsApi.reducer,
  [transfersApi.reducerPath]: transfersApi.reducer,
  [instrumentInfoFlagsApi.reducerPath]: instrumentInfoFlagsApi.reducer,
  [depoInstrumentsApi.reducerPath]: depoInstrumentsApi.reducer,
  [brokerBankAccountsApi.reducerPath]: brokerBankAccountsApi.reducer,
  [dictionariesApi.reducerPath]: dictionariesApi.reducer,
  [subAccountApi.reducerPath]: subAccountApi.reducer,
  [ordersApi.reducerPath]: ordersApi.reducer,
  [statsApi.reducerPath]: statsApi.reducer,
  [tradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollApi.reducerPath]: tradeOrderHistoryInfiniteScrollApi.reducer,
  [stopOrdersInfiniteScrollApi.reducerPath]: stopOrdersInfiniteScrollApi.reducer,
  [activeStopOrdersInfiniteScrollApi.reducerPath]: activeStopOrdersInfiniteScrollApi.reducer,
  [feedbackApi.reducerPath]: feedbackApi.reducer,
  [detailsApi.reducerPath]: detailsApi.reducer,
  [ipoOrdersInfiniteScrollApi.reducerPath]: ipoOrdersInfiniteScrollApi.reducer,
  [analyticsInfiniteScrollApi.reducerPath]: analyticsInfiniteScrollApi.reducer,
});

export const rootReducers = (
  state: ReturnType<typeof combinedReducer> | undefined,
  action: AnyAction,
) => {
  if (action.type === 'RESET_STORE') {
    state = undefined;
  }
  return combinedReducer(state, action);
};

import { buildQueries, queryHelpers } from '@testing-library/dom';
import { Matcher, MatcherOptions } from '@testing-library/react';

const queryAllByHref = (
  container: HTMLElement,
  id: Matcher,
  options?: MatcherOptions | undefined,
) => queryHelpers.queryAllByAttribute('href', container, id, options);

const getMultipleError = (c: Element | null, dataCyValue: Matcher) =>
  `Found multiple elements with the href attribute of: ${dataCyValue}`;
const getMissingError = (c: Element | null, dataCyValue: Matcher) =>
  `Unable to find an element with the href attribute of: ${dataCyValue}`;

const [queryByByHref, getAllByByHref, getByByHref, findAllByByHref, findByByHref] = buildQueries(
  queryAllByHref,
  getMultipleError,
  getMissingError,
);

export { queryByByHref, getAllByByHref, getByByHref, findAllByByHref, findByByHref };

  data: {

  };
}

/** @deprecated Используйте ErrorResponse — он уже camelCase. */

export type LocationPointType = 'up' | 'down' | 'center';

export type PointType =
  | 'OVERVIEW' // Обзор 360 - главный экран
  | 'FI_CARD' // карточка финансового инструмента
  | 'TOPUP' // пополнение
  | 'WITHDRAWAL' //переводы/ выводы
  | 'IIA' // карточка счета ИИС
  | 'MORE' // Еще
  | 'MYINFORMATION' // моя информация
  | 'CURRENCY' // валюта (уточнить у торговли)
  | 'SHOWCASE' // витрина каталога(уточнить у торговли)
  | 'DASHBOARD'; // дашборд

export type ButtonType = {
  title: string; // Название кнопки
  link: string; // Ссылка
  type: // Тип
  | 'PRIMARY' // синяя кнопка
    | 'SECONDARY'; // серая кнопка
};

export type CustomFieldType = {
  title: string; //	Наименование
  text: string; // текст для вывода
  type: // тип
  'Admin' | 'Back';
};
export type ShareButtonType = {
  network:
    | 'VK' // соцсеть
    | 'Telegram';
  text: string; // текст для шеринга
};

export type BannerType = {
  id: number; // Идентификатор баннера
  priority: number; // Приоритет показа внутри карусели
  title: string; // Заголовок
  name: string; // наименование
  titleTooltip: string; // Тултип заголовка
  description: string; //	Описание
  descriptionTooltip: string; //	Тултип описания
  pictureBackground: string;
  imageBackground: string; // Картинка
  imageBackgroundMobile: string; // Картинка для МП
  useInAdaptive: boolean; //	Использовать в адаптиве
  presenceIcon: boolean; // Наличие иконки
  allBannerClickable: boolean; //	Весь баннер кликабельный
  signClosed: boolean; // Признак закрытия
  link: string;
  href: string;
  hrefText: string;
  cities: string[]; // Список городов
  point: PointType; // Точка показа
  type: string; //	Тип баннера
  platform: string[]; //	Платформа
  active: boolean; //	Признак активности
  version: number; // Версия
  versionCondition: string;
  colorBackground: string; // Цвет фона	hex
  colorText: string; // Цвет текста hex
  start: string; //	Дата начала показа баннера	2022-11-15 13:28:00,
  finish: string; //	Дата окончания показа баннера
  timerBanner: string; //	Таймер
  buttons: ButtonType[]; // Кнопки на баннере
  customFields: CustomFieldType[];
  shareButtons: ShareButtonType[];
  regulation: string;
};

export type CarouselType = {
  id: number; // Идентификатор
  active: boolean; //	Признак активности
  switchType: //	Тип переключения баннеров в карусели
  | 'manually' // вручную по клику
    | 'timer'; // по времени
  priority: number; //Приоритет карусели
  delay: number; //	Задержка при переключении сек	Учитывается если switchType = timer
  name: string; // Наименование карусели
  type: //	Тип карусели
  'standart' | 'timer';
  locationPoint: LocationPointType;
  locationImage: // Расположение картинки на баннере
  | 'left' // слева
    | 'right'; // справа
  point: PointType;
  size: // Размер
  | 'L' // большой
    | 'M' // средний
    | 'S'; // маленький
  banners: BannerType[];
};

  spreadUnits?: Units;

  stopOrderDeniedReason?: StopOrderDeniedReason;
  stopOrderCancelPermissionState?: StopOrderCancelPermissionState;
  stopOrderCancelDeniedReason?: StopOrderCancelDeniedReason;

  hasPriceThreshold: boolean;
  hasInvestIdea?: boolean;
  faceValue?: number;
  baseCurrencyCode?: PriceCurrencyType;

type IDType = string | number;

export type OrderTypeCode =
  | 'STOPLIMIT'
  | 'STOP_LIMITEXECUTION'
  | 'STOPLIMIT_ORDER'
  | 'STOP_OTHERINSTRUMENTPRICE'
  | 'TAKEPROFIT'
  | 'TAKEPROFIT_LIMITEXECUTION'
  | 'TAKEPROFIT_STOPLIMIT'
  | 'TAKEPROFIT_STOPLIMIT_EXECUTION';

export type OrderStatusCode = 'ACTIVATED' | 'ACTIVE' | 'CANCELED' | 'EXECUTED';

export type StatusDescription =
  | 'WaitingActivation'
  | 'ExposedOrderTS'
  | 'LimitControlFailed'
  | 'LinkedOrderCompleted'
  | 'RejectedTS'
  | 'Withdrawn'
  | 'LinkedOrderWithdrawn'
  | 'MinMaxCalculated'
  | 'MinMaxCalculatedWaitingActivation';

export type Units = 'CUR' | 'PRC';

export type StopOrderPermissionState = 'GRANTED' | 'NONACTIVE' | 'DENIED';

export type StopOrderCancelPermissionState = StopOrderPermissionState | 'BLOCKED';

type StopOrderDeniedReason =
  | 'InstrumentTypeOrTradePlaceRestriction'
  | 'AccountBlocked'
  | 'AbsenceOfTradingAccountCode'
  | 'MT5TerminalConnected'
  | 'TechnicalProblem'
  | 'StopOrderNotAvailable';

export type StopOrderCancelDeniedReason = 'TechnicalProblem' | 'StopOrderNotAvailable';

--- FILE: src\utils\autoFinFormatter.ts ---

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from 'utils/sumFormatter';

/**
 * Автоматические форматирование числа с подписью млн. и тыс.
 * autoFinFormatter 1234234.12 -> 1,2 млн
 * @param  {Number} value Число
 * @param {Number} precision Точность округления, если -1 – то сохранить
 *                                изначальную точность
 * @param  {Number} [minPrecision=null] Минимальная точность округления,
 *                                      работает только, когда precision = -1
 *                                      и текущая точность меньше minPrecision
 * @param {String} [currencyCode=null] Код валюты
 */
export const autoFinFormatter = (
  value: number,
  precision = -1,
  minPrecision = null,
  currencyCode = null,
) => {
  let currency = '';

  if (currencyCode) {
    currency = currencySign(currencyCode);
  }

  if (Number.isNaN(value) || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return value + ' ' + currency;
  }

  let amount = String(value).length;

  const belowZero = String(value).match(/\.(.+)/gm);

  if (belowZero !== null) {
    amount -= belowZero[0].length;
  }

  if (Number(value) < 0) {
    amount--;
  }

  if (amount >= 13) {
    return sumFormatter(value / 1_000_000_000_000, precision, minPrecision) + ' трлн. ' + currency;
  } else if (amount >= 10) {
    return sumFormatter(value / 1_000_000_000, precision, minPrecision) + ' млрд. ' + currency;
  } else if (amount >= 7) {
    return sumFormatter(value / 1_000_000, precision, minPrecision) + ' млн. ' + currency;
  } else if (amount >= 4) {
    return sumFormatter(value / 1000, precision, minPrecision) + ' тыс. ' + currency;
  } else {
    return sumFormatter(value, precision) + ' ' + currency;
  }
};


--- FILE: src\utils\bytesFormatter.ts ---

const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB', 'PB', 'EB', 'ZB', 'YB'];

export const bytesFormatter = (bytes?: number, decimals = 2) => {
  if (!bytes) return;
  if (!+bytes) return '0 Bytes';

  const k = 1024;
  const dm = decimals < 0 ? 0 : decimals;

  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));

  return `${Number.parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(dm))} ${sizes[i]}`;
};

import {
  FavoriteInstrument,
  ParsedFavoriteInstrument,
  QuoteChanges,
  QuoteHistory,
} from 'types/catalog';

const parseQuoteHistory = (
  instrumentId: number,
  tradePlaceId: number,
  quoteHistory: QuoteHistory[],
): number[] => {
  const parsedQuoteHistory = [];

  for (const point of quoteHistory) {
    if (
      point.instrumentId === instrumentId &&
      point.tradePlaceId === tradePlaceId &&
      point.quote !== undefined
    ) {
      parsedQuoteHistory.push(point.quote);
    }
  }
  return parsedQuoteHistory;
};

export const parseInstruments = (
  instruments: FavoriteInstrument[],
  quoteHistory: QuoteHistory[],
) => {
  return instruments.map((item) => {
    return {
      ...item,
      quoteHistory: parseQuoteHistory(item.instrumentId, item.tradePlaceId, quoteHistory),
    };
  });
};

export const applyRealTimeChanges = (
  instruments: ParsedFavoriteInstrument[],
  quoteChanges: QuoteChanges[],
) => {
  instruments.forEach((instrument) => {
    const quoteChange = quoteChanges.filter(
      (f) =>
        f.TradePlace_Id === instrument.tradePlaceId && f.Instrument_Id === instrument.instrumentId,
    );

    if (quoteChange.length !== 0) {
      instrument.lastPrice = quoteChange[0].LastPrice;
      instrument.priceCurrency = quoteChange[0].CurrencyCode;
      instrument.priceDiffCurr = quoteChange[0].PriceDiffCurr;
      instrument.priceDiffPcnt = quoteChange[0].PriceDiffPcnt;
    }
  });
};


--- FILE: src\utils\colors.ts ---

export type ColorStylesType = Pick<React.CSSProperties, 'backgroundColor' | 'color'>;

export const relativeLuminance = (rgb: number[]): number => {
  const [rf, gf, bf] = rgb
    .map((color) => color / 255)
    .map((color) => (color <= 0.039_28 ? color / 12.92 : Math.pow((color + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4)));

  return 0.2126 * rf + 0.7152 * gf + 0.0722 * bf;
};

export const getColorStyles = (image: HTMLImageElement): ColorStylesType | null => {
  const ctx = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
  if (!ctx) return null;
  ctx.drawImage(image, 0, 0, image.naturalWidth, image.naturalHeight, 0, 0, 40, 40);
  const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 20, 1, 1).data;

  const [r, g, b] = [data[0], data[1], data[2]];
  const lum = relativeLuminance([r, g, b]);

  // RRGB = SRGB × SA + DRGB × (1 − SA)
  const color = [r, g, b].map((num) => Math.round(lum <= 0.12 ? 30.6 + num * 0.88 : num * 0.88));
  const l2 = relativeLuminance(color);
  return {
    backgroundColor: `rgba(${color.join(',')},1)`,
    color: l2 < 0.4 ? '#ffffff' : '#28282d',
  };
};


--- FILE: src\utils\crypto.ts ---

// Stackoverflow https://stackoverflow.com/questions/18338890/are-there-any-sha-256-javascript-implementations-that-are-generally-considered-t/48161723#48161723

export async function sha256(message: string) {
  // encode as UTF-8
  const msgBuffer = new TextEncoder().encode(message);

  // hash the message
  const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgBuffer);

  // convert ArrayBuffer to Array
  const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));

  // convert bytes to hex string
  return hashArray.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}


--- FILE: src\utils\downloadFile.ts ---

const downloadFile = (
  data: Blob | ArrayBuffer | string | any,
  filename: string,
  mimeType = 'application/pdf',
): void => {
  // Создаем Blob из данных, если данные еще не в формате Blob
  const blob: Blob = data instanceof Blob ? data : new Blob([data], { type: mimeType });

  // Создаем URL для blob
  const fileURL: string = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  // Создаем элемент <a> для скачивания
  const downloadLink: HTMLAnchorElement = document.createElement('a');
  downloadLink.href = fileURL;
  downloadLink.download = filename;
  downloadLink.style.display = 'none';

  // Добавляем элемент в DOM, инициируем скачивание и удаляем элемент
  document.body.append(downloadLink);
  downloadLink.click();

  // Очистка после скачивания
  setTimeout(() => {
    downloadLink.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(fileURL); // Освобождаем память
  }, 100);
};

export default downloadFile;

import { ErrorResponse, ErrorResponsePascalCase } from 'types/auth';

/** Проверка формы ошибки после normalizeErrorData (camelCase). */
export const isErrorResponseType = (error: unknown): error is ErrorResponse => {
  const data = (error as { data?: unknown })?.data;

  return (
    typeof error === 'object' &&
    error != null &&
    'data' in error &&
    typeof data === 'object' &&
    data != null &&
    'error' in data &&
    Array.isArray((data as { error: unknown }).error) &&
    typeof (data as { error: unknown[] }).error[0] === 'object' &&
    (data as { error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).error[0] != null &&
    'error' in (data as { error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).error[0] &&
    typeof (data as { error: { error: unknown }[] }).error[0].error === 'string' &&
    'errorMessageText' in (data as { error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).error[0] &&
    typeof (data as { error: { errorMessageText: unknown }[] }).error[0].errorMessageText ===
      'string'
  );
};

/** @deprecated Используйте isErrorResponseType. */
export const isErrorResponseTypeLowerCase = isErrorResponseType;

export const isErrorResponseTypePascalCase = (error: unknown): error is ErrorResponsePascalCase => {
  const data = (error as { data?: unknown })?.data;

  return (
    typeof error === 'object' &&
    error != null &&
    'data' in error &&
    typeof data === 'object' &&
    data != null &&
    'Error' in data &&
    Array.isArray((data as { Error: unknown }).Error) &&
    typeof (data as { Error: unknown[] }).Error[0] === 'object' &&
    (data as { Error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).Error[0] != null &&
    'Error' in (data as { Error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).Error[0] &&
    typeof (data as { Error: { Error: unknown }[] }).Error[0].Error === 'string' &&
    'ErrorMessageText' in (data as { Error: Record<string, unknown>[] }).Error[0] &&
    typeof (data as { Error: { ErrorMessageText: unknown }[] }).Error[0].ErrorMessageText ===
      'string'
  );
};

export const getErrorMessageText = (error: unknown, fallback = 'Произошла ошибка'): string => {
  if (isErrorResponseType(error)) {
    return error.data.error[0]?.errorMessageText || fallback;
  }
  if (isErrorResponseTypePascalCase(error)) {
    return error.data.Error[0]?.ErrorMessageText || fallback;
  }
  return fallback;
};

export const getErrorCode = (error: unknown): string | undefined => {
  if (isErrorResponseType(error)) {
    return error.data.error[0]?.errorCode;
  }
  if (isErrorResponseTypePascalCase(error)) {
    return error.data.Error[0]?.ErrorCode;
  }
  return undefined;
};

export const INSTRUMENT_GROUPS = [
  'stock',
  'bond',
  'futures',
  'option',
  'currency',
  'metal',
  'depositaryReceipts',
  'fund',
  'other',
] as const;

export type InstrumentGroupType = typeof INSTRUMENT_GROUPS[number];

export const INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP: Record<Exclude<InstrumentGroupType, 'other'>, string[]> = {
  bond: [
    'RBN', //	Облигации РФ
    'EBN', // Еврооблигации
    'FBN', //	Иностранные облигации
    'RGB', // Государственные и муниципальные облигации РФ
    'FGB', // Государственные облигации других стран
    'FCB', // Облигации иностранных компаний
    'RCB', // Облигации российских компаний
    'INB', // Инвестиционные облигации
  ],
  stock: [
    'RSH', //	Российские акции
    'FSH', //	Иностранные акции
    'FCE', //	Акции иностранных компаний
    'RCE', //	Акции российских компаний
  ],
  option: ['OPT'],
  currency: ['CUP'],
  metal: ['MTP'],
  depositaryReceipts: ['DR'],
  futures: ['FUT'],
  fund: ['PAI', 'IFE'],
};

export const getInstrumentGroup = (instrumentCategoryCode: string): InstrumentGroupType => {
  for (const [groupName, groupCategoryCodes] of Object.entries(INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP)) {
    if (groupCategoryCodes.includes(instrumentCategoryCode)) {
      return groupName as InstrumentGroupType;
    }
  }
  return 'other';
};

export const isBond = (instrumentCategoryCode: string) => {
  return INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP.bond.includes(instrumentCategoryCode);
};

export const isStock = (instrumentCategoryCode: string) => {
  return INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP.stock.includes(instrumentCategoryCode);
};

export const isOption = (instrumentCategoryCode: string) => {
  return INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP.option.includes(instrumentCategoryCode);
};

export const isCurrency = (instrumentCategoryCode: string) => {
  return INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP.currency.includes(instrumentCategoryCode);
};

export const isMetal = (instrumentCategoryCode: string) => {
  return INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP.metal.includes(instrumentCategoryCode);
};

export const isDepositaryReceipts = (instrumentCategoryCode: string) => {
  return INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP.depositaryReceipts.includes(instrumentCategoryCode);
};

export const isFutures = (instrumentCategoryCode: string) => {
  return INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP.futures.includes(instrumentCategoryCode);
};

export const isFund = (instrumentCategoryCode: string) => {
  return INSTRUMENT_GROUP_MAP.fund.includes(instrumentCategoryCode);
};

import { OTPConfirmError } from '../types/oneTimePassword';

const RETRIABLE_SMS_ERROR_CODES = new Set([
  'SmsCodeConfirmationFailed',
  'SMSTryCountExpired',
  'SMSLifeTimeExpired',
  'SMSTryCountExceeded',
]);

export const isOTPConfirmErrorType = (error: unknown): error is OTPConfirmError => {
  const data = (error as { data?: unknown } | null)?.data;

  return (
    typeof error === 'object' &&
    error != null &&
    'data' in error &&
    typeof data === 'object' &&
    data != null &&
    'error' in data &&
    Array.isArray((data as OTPConfirmError['data']).error) &&
    typeof (data as OTPConfirmError['data']).error?.[0] === 'object' &&
    typeof (data as OTPConfirmError['data']).error?.[0]?.error === 'string' &&
    typeof (data as OTPConfirmError['data']).error?.[0]?.errorCode === 'string' &&
    typeof (data as OTPConfirmError['data']).error?.[0]?.errorMessageText === 'string'
  );
};

/** Неверный/просроченный SMS-код — остаёмся на экране ввода (алерт), без экрана ошибки. */
export const isRetriableOTPConfirmError = (error: unknown): boolean => {
  if (!isOTPConfirmErrorType(error)) {
    return false;
  }

  const errorCode = error.data.error[0]?.errorCode;
  const errorNumber = error.data.error[0]?.error;
  const status = error.status;

  return (
    (errorCode != null && RETRIABLE_SMS_ERROR_CODES.has(errorCode)) ||
    status === 702 ||
    status === 703 ||
    errorNumber === '702' ||
    errorNumber === '703'
  );
};

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

export const shareOrCopyText = async (text: string) => {
  if (!text) return;
  try {
    const shareData = {
      text,
    };
    if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare(shareData)) {
      await navigator.share(shareData);
    } else {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      createAlertNotification({ text: 'Скопировано в буфер', ms: 1000 });
    }
  } catch {
    createAlertNotification({
      text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
      status: 'error',
    });
  }
};

import { createAlertNotification } from 'components';

export const shareOrDownloadFile = (file: File) => {
  try {
    if (file) {
      const shareData = {
        files: [file],
      } as ShareData;
      if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare(shareData)) {
        navigator.share(shareData);
      } else {
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.download = file.name;
        link.href = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        link.click();
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    createAlertNotification({
      text: 'Что-то пошло не так',
      status: 'error',
    });
  }
  return;
};


--- FILE: src\utils\signature.ts ---

import { sha256 } from 'utils/crypto';

export const createSignature = async (
  method: 'POST' | 'DELETE',
  tradePassword: string,
  tradePasswordPublicKey: string,
  sessionPublicKey: string,
  params: Array<string | number | null | undefined>,
) => {
  const tradeHash = await sha256(tradePassword + tradePasswordPublicKey.toUpperCase()).then(
    (hash) => hash.toString().toUpperCase(),
  );

  const sessionSignature = await sha256(tradeHash + sessionPublicKey.toUpperCase()).then((hash) =>
    hash.toString().toUpperCase(),
  );

  const paramsConcat =
    method +
    params
      .filter((el) => el !== undefined)
      .map((item) => {
        if (item === null) return 'null'.toUpperCase();

        if (typeof item === 'string') {
          return item;
        }

        return item?.toFixed(10);
      })
      .join('');

  return await sha256(paramsConcat + sessionSignature).then((res) => res.toString().toUpperCase());
};

export function capitalizeFirstLetter(str: string | null) {
  if (!str?.length) return '';
  return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
}

export const toPascalCase = (str: string) => {
  return `${str}`
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(new RegExp(/[_-]+/, 'g'), ' ')
    .replace(new RegExp(/[^\s\w]/, 'g'), '')
    .replace(new RegExp(/\s+(.)(\w*)/, 'g'), ($1, $2, $3) => `${$2.toUpperCase() + $3}`)
    .replace(new RegExp(/\w/), (s) => s.toUpperCase());
};

/**
 * Возвращает слово в правильном склонении для числа
 * @param number - Число, для которого нужно просклонять слово
 * @param one - Слово в склонении с числом "1"
 * @param two - Слово в склонении с числом "2"
 * @param five - Слово в склонении с числом "5"
 */
export const getNoun = (number: number, one: string, two: string, five: string) => {
  let n = Math.abs(number);
  n %= 100;
  if (n >= 5 && n <= 20) {
    return five;
  }
  n %= 10;
  if (n === 1) {
    return one;
  }
  if (n >= 2 && n <= 4) {
    return two;
  }
  return five;
};

import BigNumber from 'bignumber.js';

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

const formatConfig = { groupSeparator: ' ', decimalSeparator: ',', groupSize: 3 };

export const sumFormatter = (
  number: number,
  precision: number | null = 2,
  minPrecision: number | null = null,
): string => {
  if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
    number = 0;
  }

  const x = new BigNumber(number);

  if (precision === null || precision < 0) {
    if (minPrecision !== null && x.decimalPlaces() < minPrecision) {
      return x.toFormat(minPrecision, formatConfig);
    }

    return x.toFormat(formatConfig);
  }

  return x.toFormat(precision, formatConfig);
};

export const currencySign = (code: PriceCurrencyType): string => {
  const knownSignes = {
    RUB: '₽', // российский рубль
    SUR: '₽', // советский рубль ☭
    GBP: '£', // фунт
    EUR: '€', // евро
    USD: '$', // доллар США
    JPY: '¥', // японская иена
    CNY: '¥', // китайский ююань
    HKD: 'HK$', // гонконгский доллар
    FRF: '₣', // франк
    CHF: '₣', // швейцарский франк
    UAH: 'грн.', // украинская гривна
    KZT: '₸', // казахский тенге
    TRY: '₺', // турецкая лира
    SGD: 'S$', // сингапурский доллар
    UZS: 'сўм', // узбекский сум
    PNT: 'пт.',
    PRC: '%',
    PCS: 'шт.',
    GRM: 'гр.',
    BYN: 'Br',
  };

  return knownSignes[code] || code || '';
};


--- FILE: src\utils\__tests__\sumFormatter.test.ts ---

import { PriceCurrencyType } from 'types/instruments';

import { currencySign, sumFormatter } from '../sumFormatter';

describe('test sumFormatter util', () => {
  type TestTuple = [number, number | null | undefined, number | null | undefined, string];

  const MOCK_DATA: TestTuple[] = [
    [0, undefined, undefined, '0,00'],
    [14, undefined, undefined, '14,00'],
    [100.1, undefined, undefined, '100,10'],
    [1000.111, null, undefined, '1 000,111'],
    [1000.111, 4, undefined, '1 000,1110'],
    [0.0089, null, undefined, '0,0089'],
    [0.8002, undefined, undefined, '0,80'],
    [0.1, 18, undefined, '0,100000000000000000'],
    [13, null, 2, '13,00'],
    [13.4124, null, 2, '13,4124'],
  ];

  test.each(MOCK_DATA)(
    'number: %d, precision: %o, minPrecision: %o, return: %s',
    (number, precision, minPrecision, expected) => {
      expect(sumFormatter(number, precision, minPrecision)).toStrictEqual(expected);
    },
  );
});

describe('test currencySign util', () => {
  type TestTuple = [PriceCurrencyType, string];

  const MOCK_DATA: TestTuple[] = [
    ['RUB', '₽'],
    ['PRC', '%'],
  ];

  test.each(MOCK_DATA)('code: %s, expected: %s ', (code, expected) => {
    expect(currencySign(code)).toBe(expected);
  });
});

replicaCount:
  _default: 1
  prod: 5

# 101 - id учетной записи nginx
podSecurityContext:
  fsGroup: 101
  runAsUser: 101
  runAsGroup: 101

env:
 ELK_PROTOCOL: tcp
 ELK_PORT: 30001

tiers:
  SITE_API_URL:
    _default: https://api-dv.investpalata.ru
    tt: https://newlk-tt.investpalata.ru
    prod: https://lk.investpalata.ru
  ELK_HOST:
    _default: legacy-tcp-30001.service.investpalata.tech
  ELK_LOG_INDEX_NAME:
    tt: web.lk.clients.tt
    pp: web.lk.clients.pp
    prod: web.lk.clients.prod
  ELASTIC_APM_SERVER_URL:
    _default: ""

serviceAccount:
  create: false

# можно задавать список сервисов и их портов
ports:
  http: 8080
#  metrics: 8080

service:
  type: ClusterIP

ingress:
  enabled: true
  annotations: {}
  #  nginx.org/server-snippets: client_header_buffer_size 2046k;
  hosts:
  - host:
      tt: newlk-tt.investpalata.ru
      pp: newlk-pp.investpalata.ru
      prod: lk.investpalata.ru
    paths:
    - path: /
      port: 8080

resources:
  _default:
    limits:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi

livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /server-status

readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /server-status

autoscaling:
  enabled: false
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 100
  targetCPU: 80
  # targetMemory: 80

configMaps:
  nginx:
    data:
      default.conf: |
        server {
          listen       8080;
          location / {
            index  index.html;
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
           }
         }

# вольюмы типов: secret, pvc, configMap
# items писать только если не все данные из configMap (в data) рассматривать в качестве файлов
volumes:
- type: configMap
  name: nginx

# монтируем не каталог, а конкретный файл, иначе затрутся все остальные файлы в каталоге
volumeMounts:
- name: nginx
  mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
  subPath: default.conf
